Irene is such a good professor honestly is probably the best professor here at IU. She cares about her students and makes learning so enjoyable. Definitely take her class! You do not have exams, only take home quizzes and they are so easy.

Irene is the BEST professor at IU. Not only does she do a good job, she is HILARIOUS. Class was so easy, notes are published on Canvas and quizzes are online. No final, and lowest quiz grade is dropped at the end of the semester, 3 assignments per quiz (module). Amazing experience, take the class no matter what.

Such a sweet and funny professor! Literally the easiest class I've ever taken. Her lectures were enjoyable, she provided the full notes for every take home quiz, and there was no actual final besides the last take home quiz (and one quiz is dropped). Assignments were so easy and quick. You can tell she cares deeply about her students.
Easily the best professor at IU. She is so funny and so sweet. Easiest class I have ever taken. All the tests and homework are online. Take psych 101 with Irene trust me!!!!

TAKE THIS CLASS!!! Irene is absolutely amazing and makes Psychology actually fun. There are 6 online quizzes, your worst gets dropped, and 16 assignments, your worst 3 get dropped. Extremely easy and fun. Don't make the mistake of taking P101 with any other professor. Can't stress enough how great Irene and her class is

Irene knows a lot about the subject and really cares about her students. Occasionally gets off topic in lectures, but is very funny. Attendance is not necessary and the class is an easy A if you stay up on the assignments and quizzes. No final either
She is an amazing understand and cares for her students! It is important that you go to her office hours if you're struggling in her class or scored low on an exam.
Very understanding and easy to work with. She uses lots of modern references and current events to help tie into lecture and it is very effective.

Irene is a great human, she struggles with ADD so that is harder for her to focus. While in class you will be talking about one thing and then she will start randomly talking about sex, former president trump, or cussing. She is very understanding when it comes to assignments majority of them were done in class, and quizzes were open notes.

I am a business major and was taking these classes to get my Natural Sciences credits and this class was one of my favorites at IU. Irene is hilarious, and a very good lecturer, and her topics are very interesting. She cares a lot about her students and does quite literally everything in her power to help you pass.

She is an amazing professor that truly cares about the success of her students. She is just a very loving person and one of the most amazing people on the planet. I will never speak a word against her and will constantly say that she is the best professor on this campus.

This class was really really easy but also encouraged learning. Irene is so funny and cares about her students. There isn't many grades that go in but she gives you a lot of time to complete assignments and the work load is very manageable. I will only take psych classes that she is teaching from now on.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you have the option to take a class with this professor, TAKE IT! She is amazing and hilarious, and she will make sure you are thoroughly prepared for any assignment she gives. Lectures are so fun and she is willing to meet with you outside of class if you need some extra help. She is brilliant and so sweet. AMAZING professor!
She truly loves what she teaches and makes learning psychology easy
Irene was amazing. She made psychology very fun and her lectures are intriguing. She made things easy to learn.

Super fun, super easy, makes learning about disorders hilarious! Breezy lectures are like a comedy show, and you don't even have to go to class to get good grades, so you will be glad you got into her class. THere's a reason her sections fill up first. She's such a nice lady, you will love Irene.
Easily the best professor at IU. She made learning fun somehow and I recommend her to anyone who needs to take a psychology course!

She is the absolute best professor here at IU. Very understanding that things happen and would cancel classes before holidays and give students plenty of time to get assignments done. Every quiz is posted with notes that will literally give you an A on the quiz. Definitely have her as a professor if you are considering taking psychology courses.

Irene is hands down the best professor at IU. She makes her lectures so fun and easy to understand. She really cares about her students and will go out of her way to help you. I highly recommend going to her office hours if you ever need extra help, especially with exams. Irene truly deserves the world, she is amazing.
LOVE HER
Irene is amazing
Best teacher ever she really wants you to pass the class and will help by any means necessary.
Great teacher love her class

Irene was probably one of the best professor's I've ever had. She truly cares about her students, and that is reflected in the way she teaches. Though this is a lecture based class, she always brings an incredible energy. I found that I could succeed without attending lectures (because she posts notes), but I still wanted to attend class anyways!
Best professor at IU!
One of the best professors at IU!

I've take three classes with Irene and she is absolutely amazing. Very passionate and funny, doesn't just make herself available to students, but LOVES to help students outside of class. Probably the best teacher I've had here.

Irene is the best professor here that I've met so far. She's caring and she makes it easy for you to get an A. You just have to talk to her. She can be a little hyper during class but she's such a great person to be around! I RECOMMEND taking her TOTALLY.
The absolute best! So caring, truly loves what she does

Literally the best Professor ever! Not only were her lectures amazing but she also helped me with my personal issues in her office hours. She supported me and motivated me to do better, If you want to learn psychology, have fun and get a good grade, enrol in her class. Irene is the most amazing and fun person I have met. BEST PSYCH PROF EVER!!!!!!!

Irene is such a caring professor and her class is very student-centered. As long as you show up to most classes and pay attention (which isn't hard because she keeps you interested) you'll do well. There are no big exams and the assignments are fairly easy.
Irene is a very caring professor. She understands that students have things to worry about outside of class, so she is lenient with assignments. She is always available and her class is super easy.

BEST PROF EVER. She is so funny and made lecture's super interesting. We had no final and only 6 quizzes. Assignments were easy too. I had friends in other P101 classes who had lots of work and quizzes but Irene is so amazing. She actually will make you laugh out loud in class. Please please please do yourself a favor and take any class with her.
Amazing prof. Super genuine and cares about her students.
Such an amazing professor. I loved having her this semester and will definitely be taking another class of hers.

Irene is a phenomenal professor to have. The only professor here that tries to get students interested in what she has to say, and it works. She is absolutely hilarious, and tries to help with extra credit and whatnot.

Irene definitely makes her lectures interesting. She goes off topic A LOT but Ive still learned a lot. She pushes her liberal views pretty hard on students and takes forever to put homework grades in, but other than that I would recommend her classes!

Favorite Prof here at IU so far. She's so supportive and understanding, plus she is unbelievably funny. Her lectures can be lengthy but she makes them super enjoyable. Plus quizzes are incredibly easy so long as you listen. She obviously loves her job and what she teaches. 100/10 recommend psych with Vlachos-Webber.
Her lectures are hilarious and intriguing. She is incredibly caring and wants to help in whatever way during office hours. Easy class if you pay attention. Would highly recommend!

I cannot say enough good things about this professor and her course. She is easily the most understanding, genuine, and funny professor I have had. Homework isnt difficult, exams are fair, and she really wants to see you succeed not just in this course. I went to her office hours just to vent and work through issues in my life, shes amazing!!

Irene is an amazing professor! She has an elaborate sense of humor and knows how to keep her students attention. Class is based mainly on tests, with a few assignments and discussions here and there. Going to office hours will really help you learn the material! :)

You dont actually have to know any psychology to get an A, but you do have to listen to her attempts at humor. Doesnt help that some kids egg her on to say more and more outrageous things. its cringy. Just study what she tells you to put on exams and you will do fine.

Thinks she is hilarious but she is annoying and offensive and inconsiderate of peoples feelings. Makes fun of people with psychological disorders. Cant believe professors are allowed to talk this way in class. On the plus side, easy A, no need to do much at all because she tells you exactly what is on the exam. Does not answer email.

Irene was my favorite professor at IU. She is kind, caring, and makes her lectures genuinely interesting. She is knowledgable but talks to students as if they are learning (which we are), and not as if we should already have an intensive background in pscyh. She is extremely willing to meet with students and truly wants to help everyone. Love her!
Professor Weber is hilarious! Her lectures are super fun and she makes sure to make psychology relatable to the students. Exams are easy, make sure to take good notes.

Super awesome, nice, and passionate. Had her for an online class due to COVID-19 but she provided great attention and care to each student nonetheless. Despite her large class size, she took the time and effort to grade everyone's responses individually and provided kind words of constructive feedback. I wish I had her for in-person lectures!
A great professor to be around. It feels like you know her even if you sit in the back row and have only spoken to her once.

i love this lady so much. her class is pretty easy and theres multiple opportunities to make up points, but with any class the best way to pass is to study. she cares about her students so much and her lectures are the BEST. my favorite professor so far

IRENE IS HANDS DOWN THE BEST PROFESSOR YOU WOULD EVER MEET. She is great at what she is doing - teaching and she teaches with great passion and genuine care for students but also with clarity and very systematic. Even if you dont need to take PSY for credit and looking for a good time - GO TO HER LECTURE. Literally a stand up comedy. LOVE IRENE!

LOVE HER SO MUCH! Irene is super chill, super funny, and really nice. Her lectures go kinda fast sometimes, so beware of that, but overall it's an easy class. No homework, you only get grades on tests (which is awesome to me, bc the tests were easy). Textbook was online, and we had questions to study from the book for the exams. A great class.

THE best professor at IU. Exams are your only grade. Difficult, but not if you STUDY! Exams come from notes so go to the lectures- they're fun. There are also a few things from the book. She will give you a study guide with the questions- easy. Lowest test score is dropped and final is optional. She is very helpful, I heard office hours are useful

Irene is literally the best professor that Ive ever had being at IU. She cares about her students deeply and want to see you succeed. She is very inspirational and advocates for her students. She makes psychology fun and does a great with applying the concepts to real life events. I would recommend taking all of your psychology courses with Irene.

Irene is awesome and if you study you should not have a problem with 101. The class size is usually huge (mine was almost five hundred) so it can be hard to reach her through email, but she is very good about office hours.

She is a fantastic lecturer and all the other reviews here are accurate. However, she has terrible control over her class. She ignores people talking and makes it hard to hear in what is already a terrible classroom. Please tell students to be quiet!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Makes sure her lectures are fun. Is always in a great mood and makes learning interesting. One of the funniest and most entertaining professors I have ever had.

Irene was by far the best professor I have ever had. She is so funny and makes her classes enjoyable. I needed accommodations and she made my testing so easy. She really spent the time to meet with me one on one and review materials before and after exams. If you can take Irene's classes.

I took every class Irene offers, shes amazing and truly cares about the success of students. Theres a reason she is reviewed so much, and its because she cares about us all. This is more of a senior class and supposed to be enjoyable and that breath of fresh air during final semester. Take it. Youll love every moment.

She is the best professor I've had at IU, so impressive. She is always there to help, even if I am an international student, I still get the most ideas in the class. Too good to be ture. Still miss this professor at OSU.

Irene is AMAZING. I had her for 101 and 102 and I plan on taking abnormal with her if I can get in (her classes fill up quick!) She is hilarious and makes you want to study and learn the material. She is one of the most genuine and caring profs I've had at IU and I wish I could take every class with her.

Irene is known as the Queen of Psychology at IU due to her overflowing well of knowledge as well as being comedic and relatable to her students and is very well liked. Lectures are easy to follow and understand. Tests are the only grades she has and these can be difficult but you just have to set aside plenty of time to study.

She's such a funny and down-to-earth person! She's very understanding if you tell her things that are happening that may conflict with classes and exams. She tries to find a way to make her lectures relate to the students and things we deal with daily or monthly as a student in college. LOVE HER!!!

She's incredibly kind and respectful and presents the material in an interest way -- however your grade is based entirely on exams (1 of which you can drop), so while attendance isn't mandatory, she likes to say "everything that comes out of my mouth is gold," so it's important that you attend anyway or get notes from someone who is thorough.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Literally my favorite professor at IU, convinced me to change to a psych major
GREAT PROFESSOR!! helps so much if needed or struggling. Would recommend her to anyone!

Irene is super laid back and really funny. The class definitely isnt a blowoff, but its not difficult if you study for the tests. She is VERY understanding. She also drops your lowest test score (there are 6 tests) and there is no final exam.

Irene is the best professor that I have had since being at IU. She is so genuine and she truly cares about every single one of her students. She is very understanding, going to her office hours and making sure she knows who you are will get you very far in her class.
One of the most kind, thoughtful professors I've ever had! Definitely recommend taking one of her courses!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: For one of my most dreaded gen-eds, Irene made this class so fun. If you need to get an N&M out of the way and don't want too terrible of a class, this is the way to go. Irene had me laughing constantly throughout the professor. Also, if you are ever struggling, do not hesitate to talk to her about it, she will be more than willing to help you out!

There is a reason she is the instructor everyone wants to UTA for. She is perfection! Even after taking so many of her classes, I still learn from her. Why? She relates the topics to today, and not to yesteryear. Irene is a goddess, without her IU would be a rut.

Irene, words do not describe the impact she can make. Hands down, she is the best instructor I have ever had. She cares about the students, and not just in success with school, but more so livelihood. When the semester starts to fall apart, she picks it back up and helps you recover from the daunting last minutes to finals.
This woman is literally a god. She is super funny and the material is easy to study. There's only 6 exams. No homework for grades to fall back on. (go to office hours)

I really enjoyed this class. Her lectures are incredibly entertaining yet informative. She literally tells you exactly what is going to be on the tests. Fairly easy class as long as you put in the time to learn the information. Ill be taking p102 next semester with her.

Irene is a great professor and absolutely hilarious. Along with her amazing sense of humor, she really knows what she is talking about. She is extremely knowledgeable and makes it easy for students to understand. She separates the semester into 6 exams instead of a midterm and final, which is very useful. I would definitely take this class again!

The best teacher Ive ever had. Her lectures were so enjoyable and she was so easy to approach if I did not understand something. She really cares about her students and is absolutely HILARIOUS. Her tests are easy. I really enjoyed this class and would take it again with her.

Very nice, funny woman and gives entertaining lectures. My friend who is a psych major said to take psych with her because she is "easier" than other professors. Grade is completely based on exams (6) in 101 but she drops your lowest score. Attendance is not mandatory, but you have to go to get notes and she basically tells you everything on exams.

Prof. Weber is amazing and is the reason I decided to minor in Psych. She can be disorganized but if she doesn't fit something into her lecture she won't put it on the exam. She's hilarious and tells lots of anecdotes as examples for concepts. If you show up and take decent notes you'll be fine, and she drops your lowest exam score from your grade.
So funny and interesting to listen to! Never a boring lecture.

One of my favorite professors by far! Very funny, makes psych very enjoyable even with a huge class size! Literally tells you what will be on each exam in the notes, posts study guides online. Although you must earn 4 study credits online and in person, its a breeze if you plan ahead of time!
Irene was the best teacher I ever had at IU. I had her for both P101 and 102 and she was awesome in both. I would recommend her to any student at this university.

Irene is by far the most amazing professor I have had my entire life. She is HILARIOUS and has no filter. Her tests are very easy/straightforward IF you attend class. She lets you drop your lowest grade and there is no homework,. She tells you the test essay questions ahead of time/what to scan for in the textbook (dont actually read the chapter)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I LOVE IRENE! She is amazing and easy to understand, she's very helpful when it comes to test taking and understanding the material.
Shes great. She really cares about all her students and the class is pretty easy.

Dont understand all of the hype behind Irene as a teacher. Extremely annoying during class, refuses to put notes online, and tests are annoying. She is also extremely disorganized and makes you wait over an hour during office hours. She is very nice though and will add points to your tests if you go to office hours.

Irene was my favorite teacher my freshman year of college. She always made lecture fun and enjoyable. I had this class on a Friday and always wanted to go because she made it not suck so bad! The quizzes are all online and an easy A. The notes taken in class are exactly whats on the tests. Gave extra credit a few times for being there on a Friday!

Irene is literally amazing! She's so sweet! Very amusing to listen to during class. She's goofy, knowledgeable and engaging. Just go to class and take good notes. All her tests are made from the notes coming out of her mouth, not through the textbook. Also go to all classes, sometimes she offers random extra credit! Highly recommend!!!

Irene is perfect. There's no other description for her. Attend class, take well written notes, and then review them often and her class is simple. Don't go to class, don't review the notes, then you blew the class off. Highly enjoyable, extremely comical and witty, and just a great class to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Awesome teacher. Super funny, makes lectures interesting. Minimal homework. Going to class is the best way to prepare for tests, everything she lectures on is relevant & will probably be on the test. One of my favorite teachers.

This classes requires four credits of psychology experiments (easy). Irene teaches her classes so that the class is enjoyable for the students. She lectures in a way which is easy to understand. You use an online textbook, which doubles as a workbook (and free points in class).

I took her psych 100 class and she was amazing. At the end of the semester I had a 92% and went into her office hours and she raised it to a 93%. Would for sure take again and made me love psych. If you are going to do a psychology class at IU, take it with Irene.

Irene is by far one of the kindest and most helpful professors I've ever had at IU. She goes above and beyond to make sure you understand the material and genuinely cares whether or not you do well in class. She even had me set up meetings outside of her office hours so she could help me with grad school application stuff. 10/10 amazing woman
Best professor I've had so far. Will definitely be taking another class with her.
By far, one of the best professors imaginable. Second class with her and I can't get enough.
She is so positive and she cares about her students. I have never been taught by a better educator. Keep going!

Irene is genuinely as great as all of the reviews say. She took the time to really work with me when I was having a rough semester (death, appendix bursting)-GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS! She made the material instantly engaging, and her funny lectures made remembering everything even easier. You can tell she has experience with the subject.

I will remember her class for forever. She takes time to care not only about student education but also student well being. She is also insanely hilarious. If you have the chance to take one of her classes, DO IT!
Irene is hands down the best professor I had at IU. I signed up for 18 credit hours just so I could take another one of her classes.
PLEASE GET IRENE. She is an actual angel!! Absolutely my favorite professor I have ever had at IU.

Irene was fabulous, but her TAs to everything for her. I had a lot of trouble communicating with her because she seemed a little inaccessible sometimes. Her lectures were fun and easily understood, but show up because some of the material not in the notes will be on the test.
Literally my favorite professor so far. She'll have you laughing during the entire lecture. Shows lots of funny videos, has lecture guides online, is just overall amazing. TAKE HER CLASS!
She's an amazing teacher who keeps the class engaged. She makes material easy to understand and fun to learn.
Take this class even if you aren't a psych major!
Irene is by far the best professor that has ever passed through IU. Please don't ever leave Irene!
Irene was very helpful and explained the material very well. It is obvious she really cares about her students. She is also hilarious and is very helpful even during the tests.
Best teacher literally ever.
Great teacher, easy class
my fav

Prof Irene is so funny and she can be so relatable believe it or not! She is so understanding so don't be afraid to go to office hours if you are having any troubles with anything! Her class isn't very hard, just listen carefully to the lecture and take good organized notes and you'll be fine.

Irene is a fantastic professor. She likes the material and provides great and funny examples to make everything easier to understand. If you go to class and take good notes, you will do well in this class.
Irene is a great professor. She cares for all of her students and will go the extra mile to make sure you enjoy her class.

BEST TEACHER AT IU! Try your best to take a class with her before you graduate. She makes every lecture interesting and I was always engaged. She is hilarious and she cares about every student. Also, if you go to class and pay attention, you will be prepared for all of the tests.
So funny she made the class exciting and always told stories

Irene is a fantastic professor because she breaks the mold of the typical professor. Her class is like an educational stand up routine. I learned a lot and am now considering a minor in Psychology because of this course and professor. Everyone should take this course, especially if you need a science credit.

The most amazing professor I have ever had hands down. Extreamly accommodating to every individual student in office hours. It is very obvious she cares about each student. Lectures are hilarious, easy to understand, and easy to pay attention to. Information is also very well explained. I love her.
Best. Class. Ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is super funny and nice. She is really easy and theres barely any homework. **** Her tests are only what is discussed in lecture, so pay attention and take good notes and you will be fine.**

Prepare to be shocked by the exams in this class. While the lectures are interesting, they are also confusing and unorganized. That being said, the professor makes you buy the online text book just so you can do the homework on it for a few points; the book material, however, is not on the exams. All exams are lecture-based. Prof. is kind, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you have the opportunity to have Irene as a professor, don't hesitate. She's amazing.

Irene is seriously one of the funniest people I've encountered. I love going to class because I know I will learn so much and laugh my way through class. Her tests are not difficult if you go to lecture and take good notes. Nothing from the book is on the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Irene is the best teacher out there, hands down. Her lectures are the funniest thing you will ever encounter and yet she covers the material. Being a Freshman, you get that "I want to skip that class because why should I go" feeling, but with Irene, I literally can't wait until her lectures! Plus she gives you free answers if you have test anxiety.

This is the 2nd class of Irene's that I've taken and I wish I could take more! For any underclassmen that are curious-- TAKE AS MANY OF IRENE'S CLASSES' AS YOU CAN! A phenomenal professor and person overall.
Irene is amazing and super funny and helpful. Lowkey the best P101 professor

IRENE IS AMAZING. I was struggling with getting good grades on the tests, so she took it upon herself to help me individually to make sure I got the grades I wanted. She's so caring and so funny, she laughs at all her own jokes in class and is adorable. If I needed another psych credit, I would take one of her classses HANDS DOWN.

Irene is a phenomenal educator, focused on teaching in a way that ensures students remember things well after test day. I decided to minor in psych just so I could take more classes with her! For those with test anxiety, Irene will meet to discuss all exam questions and to offer help. Strategies I learned in this class are still with me today!

I have never come across a professor more amazing than her. She truly cares about the students and her classes are a pleasure to attend. If I could do college over again, I would make sure I took more classes taught by her. She is a blessing for her students.

Irene is the greatest teacher ever. This class is super easy and fun. Just go to class and listen. Extra credit points are given almost every class. No homework/No textbook so for that always go to class and take notes. Easy A.

Irene has been my favorite professor in college so far. Her lectures are hilarious and interesting and she is an overall great person. Go in and see her in office hours and she will help you with any  questions or problems.

I laughed every day in this class. By far the best psyc 101 professor, but you have to go to class as she doesn't post the notes online. Drops your lowest exam grade and gives extra credit on random days just for coming to class. Also, no textbook so you never have to read long, boring chapters which is a bonus. TAKE PSYC 101 WITH IRENE!
Amazing Irene helps with anything you need
One of the best professors at IU! Her exams are tougher than most psych exams are but if you show up to EVERY class and go over your notes a lot before the exam you'll be okay.

She's is a remarkable teacher with remarkable talents. She is funny, engaging, and friendly. Talking to her is the best part of the class, and her interest of each student shows through.
