Dr. T was one of my favorite professors this semester; her lectures were always so intriguing and she never failed to make me laugh at least once per class. If you take this class and want a good grade, make sure to do everything she tells you. That being doing the textbook readings, taking the online quizzes, and studying everyday.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor knows what she is talking about but sometimes gets off track. Pay attention in class and restudy the material out of class and you will be fine. She actually cares about your grade if you talk to her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: not a fun class, she rambles on goes off track test on things she never went over expects you to read so much, terrible class 10/10 would never take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Really fun! She's big on relating psychology to real life, which makes it easier to remember things.

Dr. T was such an engaging professor. Highly recommend. Print slides out before class. Go to her office hours. Uses lots of anecdotes that help explain the material. She is very down to earth and is very respectable. Not one class I didn't laugh in. Study, Study, Studyyyy. And beware of pop quizzes! Would take this class over again!

Make sure to do the readings before class and bring the lecture notes to annotate in class. Lots of quizzes but only keeps your best five. Always has one or two bonus questions on the exams. Never really curves. As long as you keep up with the readings and go to class you'll be fine. Very interesting class and knowledgeable professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. T is a gem when it comes to college professors. Her lectures are always so fun because she cracks jokes and tells stories all while making sure that students understand the material. Extremely knowledgeable about psychology and offers extra credit questions on almost every test/quiz. Definitely take a class with Dr. T during your time at IU
Best teacher Ive had At IU. Her lectures are Amazing and you get so into them you will learn so much. Her tests contain a lot but if you study you will do just fine. I LOVED THIS CLASS

I loved her as a professor! I would recommend showing up to her lectures because some of the stuff she goes over isn't in the book. Her lectures are filled with a lot of information and they're very interesting. Unless you learn/study from the book, you really don't need it. She has plenty of resources under the Canvas page. Lots of quizzes!
I loved her so much! Had so many great stories and useful information . I learned so much and it wasn't even always about psychology . Wish I could take this class again

Amazing professor! one of the best professors I have ever had. Really smart, but explains things  in memorable ways,  so they make sense. Lots of stories from real life, but not in a disturbing or oversharing way -- just matter of fact examples. Dr. T cares a lot about students,wants them to succeed, and use psychology to help make the world better

Awesome professor! Lots of stories to make the material memorable. Not the easy A blow-off class, but easy to do well if you go to class, and use the resources.  Very sympathetic. I learned a lot, beyond just what the book says.

I really enjoy class with Professor Thomassen! I'm used to psychology classes being pretty easy but with her class you definitely have to study a lot in advance. So if you are looking for an easy A or a credit filler don't take a class with her. If you are genuinely interested in psychology she is the way to go. I always looked forward to lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I was excited to take this class with her, but as the semester progresses, I'm more and more disappointed. The notes are disorganized, quizzes are announced short notice and could be over any of exam the material, and exams are tough. There is just too much information crammed in a semester that it's too overwhelming. Don't take in heavy semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Stares a lot, speaks really fast, not a really great professor

Definitely my favorite professor here at IU so far. She is intelligent, enthusiastic, and makes lectures interesting and enjoyable. She gives a lot of quizzes but they are not that bad and can help boost your grade if you don't do well on a test (she also drops your lowest test grade, too!). Overall, it was a great experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. T is, so far, my favorite professor at IU. She is so funny in class and does the most unexpectant things. Ex. Walking into class juggling, throw the balls in the air, dabs at the class, and then sits down. She tells stories and jokes to help you understand the topics. Watch for quizzes and make sure you study! Great professor!
Funny very understanding professor. She is very kind and interesting

She was my favorite professor from freshman year. Extremely accommodating and an engaging lecturer. Taking notes is vital and she does a lot of quizzes. You have to study for the quizzes and tests; looking over your notes every day really helps retain information. You may need help during the neuroscience section.

Didn't need the lectures or the book, did just fine. Show up for the quizzes but she puts note outlines on oncourse and you just have to fill in the blanks, so actual lectures aren't really necessary. Test questions were kind of weird sometimes, so make sure to remember some detail.

I liked Lisa Thomassen's humor and sarcastic comments during class. I feel like she made lectures really interesting and gives lecture outlines to follow along. Taking the book online tests will help a lot because sometimes she uses those one quizzes and tests. Overall I would reccommend!

I passed P101 with an A taking Irene which is by far my favorite psych professor so far. 10/10 would not recommend taking Thomassen as a professor. She is really tough and tests are not easy. I am not a C student at all, but this will be the first class ever receiving a C. I studied a lot for her exams and still did poorly. She also gives quizzes

She's hilarious and explains things very well-- she's a psychology genius but isn't confusing when she lectures. The tests are easy if you just study the study guides, she gives lecture outlines for EVERY lecture so you don't have to take your own notes, and there are only 4 tests, which are short and you are always well-prepared.
She really took time to explain things well to the class.

Tests are kind of hard but you can easily get B's from going to class and studying. Quiz style isn't very easy and not sure what to expect on them. Use the resources she gives you as well. Overall, she is a great professor, her lectures are engaging, and she's hilarious!
Prof. T is great at making the material relatable to real life situations. One tip: USE THE RESOURCES SHE GIVES YOU. They will help out more than you know with the quizzes and exams.

Dr. Thomassen is the best professor I have had at IU. She is so funny and tries to connect with her students even in a large intro course. She does ramble, but the stories she tells are always relevant to the material. Her stories actually helped me connect with the concepts, and I would often remember them while taking tests. TAKE HER CLASS!

I had Dr. T for P101 and took her for P102. Same great experience and enthusiasm in the classroom, lots of opportunities to do well, lots of resources to help you (lecture outlines, study guides, assistants to help).
Took this class because I needed to fulfill a requirement, now I'm a major because of Dr. T. Amazing enthusiasm, great energy, class is enjoyable, you really learn a lot. Great teacher!

Dr. T kept lectures interesting and not boring. But she was very rude and talked very fast. She expected you to just pick up information right after she said it and if you didn't then she made you feel stupid.

I think that she may be one of the worst professors I have had. She is very rude. Lectures are interesting but her quiz style is horrible. Do not choose her for your professor I wish that I would have known before taking this class.

I really enjoyed Professor T. She is always telling us tips about how to study using empirically proven techniques for best memory performance. I took her class in a 6 -week summer session after a 20 year hiatus from I.U. She made the transition back much easier with her cheerfulness and encouragement.  THANKS PROFESSOR T!
Great professor. She's very fair and her lectures are really interesting!

I am shocked that people are saying this was a hard class. I did a minimum amount of studying and had almost a 100% average... it's so interesting it's hard not to absorb content by osmosis. She is super crazy in an awesome way. Definitely learned a ton in this class.

She is super helpful and super funny. Shes very smart and these "tangents" that the other complain about help you learn the material by relating it to life. She is fair and wants you to learn. I struggled with most of my classes this term, not this one. Don't be lazy, dont be dumb and you'll pass easily.

Easy class if you take the time to study. No writing assignments and all multiple choice tests. Dr. T reminds me of Sandra Bullock a little bit too, with her humor and general personality. Definitely recommend.

Really enjoying Dr. T's course! Reading some of the negative comments and I'm really shocked because I love Dr. T and I think her lectures and the exams are straightforward. Yes she can go off on weird jokes but not to the point where that's all she does. She always goes back to the material. It's really about those reading questions and outlines!

Dr. T is both incredibly knowledgable and incredibly tangential. With most professors, personal tangents and anecdotes are annoying, but she's hilarious and they make the sometimes-dry material fun and engaging. She also genuinely wants students to do well and makes sure we're well-equipped to score all points possible. I wholeheartedly recommend.

Even though attendance isn't mandatory, it's easy to fall behind if you don't go. Studied harder for this class than I felt was fair for a 100-level course. Tests and quizzes are pretty hard, and Prof. Thomassen goes off on tangents during lectures. She got annoying and condescending after a while. If you're taking for an easy gen-ed, go elsewhere.

Even though attendance isn't mandatory go to class, trust me.  She is very smart and gives thorough but boring lectures.  Study in advance for her tests definitely.  Bottom line is there are way easier professors to take for this class and I recommend that you do that.

She's a really  smart teacher and definitely knows what she's talking about! However, she goes through the slides way too quickly and the tests quizzes are difficult! Not an easy A by any stretch and a lot of the other psych classes are much easier! She should only teach upper level classes in my opinion.

She is a decent prof, but is very rude to students in lecture. She provides notes to fill in but goes through the power points very quickly. Definitely knows her stuff and would be better suited teaching higher level courses. Not a great fit for a 155 teacher.

Dr. T's class is unnecessarily  difficult.  If you are only taking psych 101 because you need to fulfill a ged ed requirement, I do not recommend her class.  If you want to do well, you will have to do a lot of reading and a lot of outside work.  Psych isn't necessarily an easy subject, but there are other teachers besides Dr. T who make it easier!

Thomassen is cool, she really enjoys her job. But sometimes she takes a lot of lecture time to talk about personal stuff. Read the book and you'll be fine. A lot of her test questions come from the book. Biggest mistake was not readingstudying. Treat it like a high school class and you'll be fine.

She really knows how to teach because she uses her psychology knowledge to ensure that you leave class knowing as much information as possible. She also reviews the material quite a bit, so it may seem repetitive  but at least everything is drilled into your memory by the time there is an exam. Make sure to use the lecture outlines she gives you.

She's not a bad teacher but is not very helpful and can be quite disrespectful to students.  She is not very willing to meet with students and has little to no regard for students' personal or family issues that happen to arise during the semester.  I would not suggest her, considering how other many great psychology professors we have here at IU.
Absolutely loved her.

3 day a week class, 50 mins per, most classes taking a lot of notes on chapter material, occasional quizzes and assignments, hard exams, a lot of reading, a lot of studying and preparing well in advance, nice and respectful, a lot of UTAs for help.
Get ready to work
Dr. T! Best professor I've had in college.
Super enthusiastic, wants students to do well, funny.  If you sleep, text or cheat, don't take this professor, tho

She was clearly very passionate about the subject and about teaching it. However, she would often go off on tangents and spend too much time discussing irrelevant information. She did not go over some of the material that was on the final exam.

Professor Thomassen is really engaging and interested in her subject.  She's really funny and makes class worthwhile to attend. She especially likes P155 because it's "advanced" and has two semesters of psych in one (I'm still easily getting an A+ however...) If you need Psych or just general science credit, take any of Dr. T's classes.

I put more out-of-class work into this class than any other this semester. Her lectures are long and tedious, and she doesn't put them online. It is clear she enjoys teaching and loves psychology, but the course itself and the tests are incredibly difficult and require lots of hours of outside work.
If you get the lecture notes and review those before quizzes and tests, you'll do great in the class! Prof T keeps it interesting and is passionate about the topic.

She is definitely my favorite professor that I've had so far.  Her lectures are easy to understand and she gives so many examples that help and are easy to remember on tests.  Her class is very enjoyable, and she drops the lowest exam grade and only takes the top 5 highest quizassignment grades.  Great teacher.
Dr. T is the best! Loved her lectures, and the tests were easy.
Dr. T is a great professor and made psychology very easy to understand. She did fun demos in class and always kept the class entertained. I throughly enjoyed being a student of hers.

Dr. T is amazing. Class is easy and she's helpful if you're not understanding. There are optional review session that basically cover what is on the exams. You get to drop one exam which helps a lot, but they tend to be really easy. She's hilarious and calls students out if they're on their phone.
Very good in her work.

Overall, she is good. The amount of work is maybe a little more than a regular intro class. But again I took this during the summer. You have to pay attention because she will call on you to answer questions but overall she's not bad. Tests were decent for the most part some questions are tricky but most are straight forward
She explained the material clearly and provided relevant and memorable examples. Attendance was fairly important in order to get the lecture notes. I recommend her class

Loved Dr. T. Not quite sure why people think she jumped around, she followed the flow of the chapters and it went right along with her notes. If you go to class and fill in the notes, the class is very easy. As long as your going to go to class, this is a great class to take.

Her class wasn't an easy one, like you might expect for an intro class. She was kind of rude at times, and I didn't like how her outlines were organized, but you pretty much had to use them. She loves Psychology and it shows, through her loud excited stories and enthusiasm.

She keeps you interested in class, but sometimes her lecture notes skip around and don't follow the ones she gives online. Tests aren't too hard, but she likes to put tricky answers for many. Pop quizzes given, but you can drop some. Overall a good teacher

Dr. T is hilarious! Very easy to pay attention to and test questions come directly from notes. Sort of hard if you don't study carefully though. Will call you out for texting in class despite there being 250 people.

Dr.T is an awesome professor. Attend class and follow her guidelines on how to pass her class and you are bound to get a good grade. I loved how she taught lecture. Also go to the help sessions before every test, it helps a lot too! Studying is needed, but it's manageable with her guidelines! She made the class enjoyable and FUN, I thought.

I had mixed feeling about Dr. T. I loved her attitude in class (VERY enthusiastic), however one time I asked her for help and she kind of  made me scared to ask her for help again. Basically, she made me feel dumb. & although attendance wasn't mandatory, she had pop quizzes every few classes but dropped many of the lowest exam/quiz scores.

Dr. T is awesome! She makes boring topics pretty interesting and she's funny. I really enjoyed her class. Because of her, I'm really interested in psychology now. She does get really off topic at times, and bounces around. But she's really great!

I somewhat was interested in psychology before taking this class but after having her as my professor I am very disinterested in the subject. She was super confusing, loud, and boring. Her lectures were really unorganized and didn't follow the lecture notes she provided to us. Her tests weren't too bad but I wouldn't recommend taking her class.

I dreaded going to her class. She is all over the place & confusing. She focuses on unimportant things & barely touched the important things. I would not recommend her for any beginner psych students. She is loud & rude. I had to reteach myself every single topic she covered.

Class lectures are ok, she tries to make class more fun with sexual innuendoes but toward the end of the class it becomes more and more annoying. She mostly follows the notes but sometimes skips around and doesn't tell you where she skipped to, expecting you to know. The tests are hard and some of the questions seem like she is trying to trick you

Thomassen came in to teach my class after my first professor, Dr. Summers, passed away. I wasn't to keen on having a new professor (especially after having the great Dr. Summers) but she is a great teacher. She has printable notes that follow her powerpoints exactly. She's pretty funny, too.

LOVE HER! She is literally one of the most clownin professors you will ever encounter at IU. Her mind is in the gutter 98% of the time which makes her hilarious. She also incorporates the mind-in-the-gutter thing in her lectures which honestly helps you remember and understand most of the material. Skeletons for all chapters. Go to class, get an A.

Dr. Thomassen is a really engaging lecturer, she keeps you interested the entire class unlike some psych professors at IU. Her tests can be a little tricky, but if you study the lecture notes and read the text book you should be fine. I HIGHLY recommend her.

Dr. T loves the materials she teaches!  I recommend doing the reading with the reading questions and going to class because it makes studying for the test much easier!  You can still do very well in the class if you do not do well on the quizzes.

Dr. T is a funny and interesting professor. Attendance isn't absolutely necessary but her lectures make you want to show up. Very helpful, explains material in a way that is fun and easy to comprehend.
I loved Dr. Thomassen. She's enthusiastic and I thought her class notes were incredibly helpful

AWESOME PROFESSOR. Really got me interested in psychology. She's hilarious and makes the class super interesting. We never had any homework, a few quizzes and tests were very easy. Strongly recommended.
So inspiring! I got really into psychology through this class! Best teacher ever!!!

Absolutely loved her! Attendance isn't critical to succeed in the class but you'll want to because her lectures help you retain the information. Take the online quizzes from the book site before class cause she often gives pop quizzes. Drops worst exam grade and a few quizzes at the end of the semester.
Great professor! Go to class and pay close attention and you will do fine.

She was a good professor, but her personality drove me crazy. She tried to entertain freshmen, but it came off as demeaning and annoying, especially when you were not a freshman. But it's an easy class.

Really fun prof! Interesting lectures filled with jokes, stories, and in-class demos that are relavent to material. Tests are easy and class overall demands very little effort. Also lets you out early all the time!

GREAT professor!! Makes her lectures both interesting and humorous, and she can tell when her students don't totally understand what she's saying (and clarifies right away). Also tells interesting stories to help remember facts. A must-have teacher for prospective Psych students!!

Great Professor and loved the class! I would definitely recommend her to anyone thinking about majoring in psychology or even to someone who wants to take an interesting class. She is very nice and helpful if you have any questions. Go to class and pay attention to the lecture and read the chapters and you should do fine!
Great professor.  Not a huge fan of psychology but loved attending her lectures.  Easy A if it's something you care about.  Easy to slide through with a B.
Great class, great professor.

She is a great professor, one of my favorites so far that I have had. She really makes the class fun and adds her own experiences into her examples. She is always in a great mood and has a great, quirky sense of humor that keeps the class fun. I definitely recommend her.

She is an awesome professor. She makes the boring topics (e.g. physiology, methods of experimentation) really fun and interesting. She has quite a dark sense of humor which I appreciate, and is very passionate in her field so I have a lot of respect for her. Great teacher- take this class!

Fantastic prof. She made Psychology look and sound interesting, and she didn't bother with the unimportant, and rarely bothered with the boring. Do the optional reading questions for good grades on the tests, but definitely not a difficult course. 4 experimental credits required; some pop quizzes; no homework; drops lowest grades at the end of sem.

She is really creative with her lectures and keeps it interesting, even if the subject can be dry.  She gives a 3-5 min break every class so students dont zone out.  She is funny and strange and a great teacher!

Great teacher, very funny, makes the class interesting and understandable. Just go to class and use her lecture outlines and its a pretty easy A. Know the syllabus too, she likes to quiz you on it in the middle of the semester
Dr. T was a pretty great teacher, being my first teacher at IU, she helped me prepare and expect the coming year! Perky and fun. She goes through notes quickly, but you learn to take them.

Dr. T. was a great professor to have. She is very challenging, so if you're looking for an easy A, you should look elsewhere. But those easier professors will not prepare you for future classes like Dr. Thomassen will.

Thomassen is funny and very knowledgeable. She gives you countless notes, and lots of short moderate quizzes, which really help you prepare for tests. She gives you lots and lots of resources to study from, and really enjoys teaching the class. She gives lots of examples to illustrate her points. Highly recommend her, made me want to pursue psych

-she's rude, talks incessantly, changes the syllabus without notice, is not helpful during office hours, unclear on info in class, too fast w/slides, doesn't post them,picks on students during class, desperately wants to be funny,isn't funny. I get A's usually. this class was hard to master w/her. you're in for a ton of work. quizzes are difficult.

Avoid this teacher at all costs. Hardest of all psychology teachers. Is well educated and knows what she's talking about, but gives countless pop quizzes essentially making attendance mandatory. Exams are very hard as well.

She is so funny and her class was always interesting.  She skips around a lot in her notes, but its basically all you have to study for the exams.  The quizzes aren't hard, but you have to go to class. I would take all my psych classes with her if I could.
awesome

Her syllabus is literally 15 pages long...only 2 pages are relevant to this class.  She treats everyone like a freshman, which is really annoying when you're not one.  You have to go to class for the quizzes, but as long as you study you'll do well.

This was my favorite class this past semester. Professor Thomassen makes things interesting and easy to understand. She does give Pop Quizzes, but they are always over the material that has already been covered. If you are prepared to go to class everyday, I would definitely recommend her.

It's what you would expect if you are a freshman. Don't take unless you are a major. Pop Quizzes and you must read before class. Does drop a lot of quizzes though. Not bad if you keep up. Can't cram for this class though. Freshman course for sure.

Probably the most annoying professor I've ever had. Makes comments that are irrelevant to the topic and serve only to flaunt her intelligence. The pop quizzes get annoying, expect to have 10 or  more. Don't take unless you are a psych major or a freshman that doesn't mind attending every class.
Overall this class was pretty easy and pretty interesting as well. She likes to give a lot of pop quizzes though and has even quizzed the class over the course syllabus.
She is a really good teacher, but she gives  pop quizzes all the time. You should always read the reading material before each class.

Excellent teacher. She lays everything out that is expected of you; while you do need to read the text to be prepared for pop quizzes, she provides reading questions that make it so much easier. The tests take studying, but nothing comes out of the blue. Quirky and interesting, genuine care for the students and passionate about psychology!
Awful, doesn't care about students at all or your family for that matter since she has a quiz on the last day before Thanksgiving, so good luck trying to get home earlier.

when I think of my most memorable professors at IU I think of her as my worst top 3... she doesn't prepare you for future endeavors and will always think less of you because you don't measure up to her

When I think of my most memorable professors at IU, she is in my top 3.  Loves her job and the students.  The class takes work, but the material is straightforward.  Expect a good laugh at every lecture.

GREAT teacher! She clearly loves what she is teaching and does her best to see that every student is able to understand the course material. Class would not have been the same with any other prof. She uses many examples and demos to get her point across. Very easy class as long as you read and pay attention.

Amazing! She comes into class at 9am extremely perky and entertaining, and she keeps class interested with demos and examples. She does all she can to help students succeed. Her tests are not difficult, and she is readily available to chat. Her lectures are detailed, and the book reading is not necessary. Defintiely recommend her! Easy class too...
I loved her! Her lectures are easy to follow and you can print out the notes. You have to study for her test but they are really easy! I suggest her!

She is amazing!  I decided to major in Psychology after taking her class.  She makes everything so interesting and she is funny too.  You do need to show up to class because she gives quizzes, but these are only there to boost your grade. She really wants her students to succeed, doesn't try to trick them, her tests are easy if you go to class!

She is really annoying, always talks about herself, and tries way too hard to get the students to like her. Her quizzes are really hard and require you to do all of the readings & pay really close attention in class in order to do even remotely well. Her tests are easy, though, and she drops a lot of grades which is nice. I don't recommend her.

She is not hot and who ever said that is obviously not looking at the right person. She is very annoying and tries WAY to hard to be cool. Her pop quizzes are NOT easy so make sure you study for them and READ the book and you should be okay.

She is a very enthusiastic teacher that keeps class interesting with lots of examples and demos. The quizzes and tests aren't that difficult if you just read and study the notes that she gives you. She makes psychology very interesting.
I loved her! She was awkwardly funny and made sure we understood the material by constantly reminding us of her office hours (where she gave us candy!).
Really nice, keeps the class interesting because she is funny, the class is pretty easy, don't always have to attend, just make sure you are there for the quiz days

I really like Prof. Thomassen. She was funny and very upbeat. The tests came almost exactly from the book, but you still need to go to class. Also I would highly recoment that you take the online quizzes, most of the time the questions on the test are exactly the same as the ones on the quizes! Overall a very intelligent and fun professor. I would
Real nice teacher and very funny. I highly recomend the front of the class if she knows you and likes you she will help you a lot. she thinks she is harder than she actually is which is fine with me.

Thomassen is awesome. She's really funny, a solid teacher, and an even better entertainer. Her jokes never end and they're all great, she loved me and my buddy so much she put my pictures up multiple times on her slideshows...awesome teacher, and I learned a lot.

In response to the other comment: she's hot. But seriously, a really cool teacher. I helped fix her microphone and she loved me forever because of it. Drops your lowest exam score, so do well early on and you won't have to take a final!

If you show up to class every day and pay attention and then study for the exams you will probably get a good grade. The class is really entertaining most of the time; she is a funny and interesting person. Also, I thought that the grading was really straightforward & fair. You know what's expected of you.
This is not the hardest class its just much harder then other psych classes.  I would not recommend her to anyone.  Find an easier, less annoying teacher.  There are plenty out there.
hilarious & sarcastic, always entertaining

This class was very, very basic and pretty easy if you read the book. She is pretty full of herself, but the lectures were not too bad. I know that a lot of people really liked her. She gives pop quizes, and the tests were very straight forward. I liked that I always knew what was expected of me, and I felt that everything was done fairly.
You learn one thing and she tests you over another!!Didn't enjoy at all harder than my Chem class... =(

Great professor! Makes subject extremely interesting and fun! She does rush through her PowerPoint slides quite quickly, and she refuses to post them online. Sometimes she gets a little absorbed in her own knowledge, but she does have a good understanding of the material. I'd definitely take it- you won't be disappointed.
prof thomassen was so much fun! i loved this class.
she is a very annoying teacher who is very absorbed in her own talents and knowhow...for p-100 I would take it, but if not I cant say you would actually learn anything from it
This class is ridiculously easy!  Read the assigned material and pay attention in class.  Thomassen does a great job keeping class interesting. Highly recommended.

I really liked her...The class was basically memorization. If you went to class, it was a lot easier to understand and the study guide was basically the test. Although Psychology is not my thing, she made the class tolerable. Overall, I highly recommend her...She'll keep you interested!
good techer who knows how to get you intereseted in the class.

If you struggle at learning, this class is hard.  I went to most of her office hours and she doesn't listen to her students.  You could say something one minute and she would completely dismiss it.  Worst 1 on 1 teacher I have ever had.  I never missed a class and fell short of my B- by 1% and she wouldn't help me out.  I hope she losses her job.
She's very clear and precise about what will be on the tests.  Tries to involve all her students as much as she can given the large class size.  Overall, a very good prof.
This is a very interesting class, and she is a very clear on what you need to know. She does like to brag alot about how smart she is! And she's a really good juggler!

Her focuses her class around making sure her students pass. She does everything she can to make lecture interesting and enjoyable. Even though the classroom sucked, I still enjoyed lecture, her, and I learned a lot. You'll like her and the class!!
I don't care for her at all.  I hate when she gives those damn quizzes.  She thinks she is the greatest professor in the world and likes to brag about herself.  I wish Merv taught the class instead.
The only professor I know that can make an 8AM class enjoyable.
great teacher.  definitely recommend!!  class averages on tests were high Bs!
She does a great job of making lecture interesting. The demos are pretty sweet. She does give pop quizzes a lot, but as long as you've done the reading they're  pretty easy.
Instantly responds to emails on Oncourse, very entertaining demos, class was not boring, tests are very hard though, but if you ask for help she will give it, fair grader.
She is a good teacher and such a good person.  She is very nice, and I am so glad to have had her as a professor.

She like to challenge her students so that they learn, but she grades harshly for a 300-level class. For the first time in my life I was fearful for my Spanish grade. Still, she's a really smart and understanding lady with really high expectations for her students.
She is a great teacher and does all she can to help you learn.  She is very understanding and is very clear and is always encouraging question.  She makes a very comfortable environment in class.

This course isn't suppose to be this hard. I'm almost fluent in Spanish and I'm very tired of all the busy work. There is at least 2 hours of homework before each class, grading is confusing, assignments are vague and complex, and projects are a lot of research. If you want a easy and enjoyable class, do not take it with Luciana.
She's a lot of fun and very understanding of the fact that we all have lives outside of Spanish. She's a great teacher and really wants you to be your best.
Super chill very helpful. Just hope you don't get one of the TA's to grade your assignments.
Super caring teacher and it really does improve your skills. Would absolutely take her again.
One of the best compass profs. Take her if you are able.

Nussbaum isn't teaching T275 anymore, but she was awesome online. Genuinely cared about the improvement of her students, and was easy to find outside of class. She cut down on busy work, and let us loose when there wasn't anything extra we could learn that day. I'd say if you're willing to learn, this class is a breeze.

I believe she is no longer teaching Compass II, but she was amazing at doing it. Very nice and actually gave great feedback. I'd suggest staying connected outside of class because she really does care about us and wants us to succeed. She also is very lenient if you need a deadline changed.
One of the best professors I've had at IU, so sweet and caring of her students and gives great tips!

Best prof for Compass. Prof Nussbaum was extremely caring and nice. Went faster than the other sections and was more flexible (eg. accepting Workshop format for resume). Has lots of fun activities and encouraged us to mingle and make friends. Her classes fill up first and she's great if you already have a good sensing of clubs/recruiting/networking

One of the nicest professors I've ever had. She truly cares about students and helping them with their professional careers. She is always willing to connect with students and share stories from her personal life which makes her more approachable.
Great professor boring material

Kathy is such a sweet person, and you can truly see her passion when she's teaching. Very easy class, but provides important career skills. At times classes can feel like a waste of time though, with information that's either not helpful or just dragged out.

She was so beyond nice and really does want to see her students succeed. She gives amazing feedback and is always available if you need anything at all. She loves what she does and will be teaching C104 next semester so I highly recommend taking her class! Love her!

A must have! She is so sweet and cares a lot about her students. She prepares everyone so well for the mock interviews and resume assignment and always sticks around after class to give feedback or answer questions. She also made us introduce ourselves to our peers which helped me make so many new friends-an overall amazing experience!!
She's a very sweet woman and gives feedback in a constructive way whenever you need it and leaves you feeling like you're a little ahead on life. If you can take her!
Cares a lot about her students and is a very nice person, but the class is not very helpful and mostly seen as busy work. Never felt very productive in her class and mostly just waited for it to end.

I recommend Professor Nussbaum to anyone. In addition to the fact she is an easy grader with mostly easy assignments, she truly cares about her students. She wants to see everyone succeed not only inside her classroom but also in life. If you take her for this course, you will do great and actually learn professionalism.
She super chill about things if you have to makeup an assignment or something. Class is not bad at all and no busy work either just straightforward assignments.
She truly cared about her students well being and the class was well structured.

I only wouldn't take her again because I found her to be quite a boring teacher and there are other BUS-T175 teachers that are most likely more fun. She was an easy grader though and did care that all her students did good. You absolutely have to go to class though as the course is set up for you be there, and class is only once a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was a good grader, but I do not think that she was the best at engaging all of the students. Also, she was always sick, so it was just frustrating when you're trying to not be sick. She made the class fine and easy though.
Really great Professor. Compass isn't the most interesting class, but she makes it fine. Assignments are easy and she's an easy grader.
Best professor I've had so far in college. Very reasonable expectations and made the 8am actually exciting to attend.
Compass 1 was very easy with this professor. She was very engaging and caring about her students.
Highly Recommended for Kelley Compass
She cared for all her students and taught Kelley Compass greatly and made sure everyone understood the assignments and can easily get A's
I LOVE THIS WOMAN, she is very passionate about what she does and is sooooo kind towards students. Pretty funny too. Take her class if you have the chance.

Professor O'Reilly is an amazing educator and is an expert in her field. She is SO knowledgeable and always explains concepts in detail and is always willing to help outside of lecture. She is very clear with expectations and is a fair grader. Don't skip the lectures, do the reading, and follow her directions, you should get at least a low A.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jessica was the worst professor I have ever had. She is the LEAST caring about her students and truly does not care to help them succeed. Her teaching was horrendous and she set me up to fail. Jessica is not only a terrible professor but also a terrible person. Jessica is the last person I would ever recommend to anyone and the worst professor ever

I really enjoyed learning from this professor and found her lectures very interesting. There are 4 tests that make up 90% of the grade but as long as you attend the lectures and read the book assigned during each section then they are fairly easy. The discussion section has optional attendance but I found it very helpful and the TA very nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor O'Reilly was really sweet, and she genuinely cared about what she taught. There were four tests over four units and books. I did not pick up a single book and was able to leave the class with an A-. Tests were online and not proctored. Attend in-person discussions and you're guaranteed a B at the least.

Our TA graded most of the asgmts so I cant say Jes was a hard grader. We had 4 books over the course. good luck on that. The discussions are mandatory but class isnt. Our last 3 exams were online but the first was in person. (we asked to get it changed) We don't have homework, just one paper and 4 exams. If you already have prior knowledge ur good
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: lots of reading (4 total books) that you must do since test questions come from the books. Fast paced very interesting course. Her lectures that she posted were recorded last year though so... and the in-person section was taught by an AI. Overall I would take this class again and I learned a lot and not too much time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had this class online due to COVID but Prof. O'Reilly was still an amazing professor who is very passionate about the subject. She is the very definition of a Midwesterner, always smiling and making the best out of a bad situation. Class covered expected topics and if I ever had a question and sent an email, she would always be able to respond.

I absolutely loved taking this class with Professor O'Reilly. She is so knowledgeable and passionate about her field of study, yet never condescending and explains things so clearly. Class is a pretty easy A and highly enjoyable. I definitely recommend taking a class with her!!

Great professor. Very knowledgeable and encourages questions, which she almost always has an answer for. Allows you to bring in study sheet for exams, very understanding of the fact you take other classes. Very passionate about her work which makes the class very interesting. A couple short papers that are super easy. Overall great teacher & easy B

Prof. O'Reilly is - without a doubt - one of the most caring professors I have come across. She's incredibly passionate about her work and it really shows in her teaching. INTL-420 was reading intensive, but if you go to class and are good at writing papers, you will do just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is now S304, not 269. Sandra is really knowledgeable about public health and has many years of experience. She does explain things well when the class needed more clarification. However, the attendance policy was the strictest I've ever experienced during my three years here. She is also an incredibly difficult grader.

Ortiz's online S200 course is the worst course I've taken at IU. Beware of getting flagged for work. If you have any prior Spanish experience, make it known. Heavy Spanish lecture, most can't understand what is going on, this is still a lower level Spanish course. I was trying to learn Spanish and she has pushed me very far away from it.

Professor Ortiz's grading scale is really weighed by participation and you won't know really until it's too late. She is susceptible to making a few accommodations when you have a family emergency or are out sick. If you have studied Spanish on your own make it known or else she will be prone to flag you. She speaks in Spanish the whole period also

Lots of practice in class to understand content, both with talking and writing. Clear what we need to know. Great feedback and corrections. Clear syllabus. Goes over content multiple times to make sure we understand. Posted slides on canvas to go back and review if needed. Spanish can be hard but prof helped.

Professor Ortiz is one of my favorite professors even though I am really awful at Spanish. I answer questions with so much unearned confidence and she always has to explain why Im wrong, but shes very patient which is much appreciated. She does her best to make sure everyone in class understands the material and is keeping up with the work.

Professor Ortiz is a very kind woman who is easily accessible and wants you to succeed. This class was not extremely difficult and though she does assign homework after each class, it is often participation so really a good booster if you just try.

I took the Spanish for health professionals class with professor Ortiz and I was nervous because I hadn't taken a Spanish class since sophomore year of high school. She was a great teacher with clear expectations regarding homework and group work. She is very helpful in office hours if you are struggling with a topic and seems to genuinely care.

Very solid professor. In S269, the same few concepts can often be applied to many of the test questions -- this is the key to doing well. If you do all the homework, participate in class, and learn the grammar before each test, this class should be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: I took this class and tested into a higher Spanish class, but this class goes at a good pace. She does speak quickly and sometimes I don't understand completely but it honestly helped me learn the language better. She seems to really care about her students. She even used a whole class period to review before our exam.
She is a great teacher and really helps out her students even if they can barely speak Spanish. Understanding and fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you're not somewhat decent at spanish, don't take her.  Speaks way too fast.

I LOVE SANDRA! She's awesome and I am so thankful to have had her for HISP-S 280. I've been taking Spanish for a long time so grammar is really dry and boring to me at this point, but she is very engaging which helps. She makes her students feel comfortable and wants to see all of them succeed. Would definitely recommend her!

This class was very easy and clear.  Prof. Ortiz explains everything clearly and prepares you really well for exams.  The homework is really short and pretty easy.  I was really nervous about speaking in all Spanish because I never had to in high school but she made the transition easy.
Sandra is awesome.  She's incredibly nice, and from Argentina.  Her teaching is clear and she cares about her students.  Like almost all IU classes, though, the tests and homework are difficult.
Prof. Ortiz is the S200 course supervisor, so she's probably the best one teaching it.  Very energetic in the classes, and she's a native speaker, which is definitely a plus.
Great instructor, and really nice. Very helpful in office hours.
Teaches right out of the book. Easy class.

The class itself is pretty hard, but there are a lot of resources to help you. The TAs and professor are always available if you have questions or need help understanding something. As long as you keep up with the work and ask for help when needed, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I enjoyed taking Olgun's class because his lectures were fun and engaging. The course requires some effort to earn an A, but ZyBooks helps a lot. He is a generous grader and not very strict as long as you put in effort. Great class for learning 2D and 3D design with hands on experience.
Extremely understanding professor, and actually cares!
Very Involved interactive way of teaching. Wants everyone to do well.
Great professor and great lectures. Extremely helpful and teaches in a way that helps everyone understand the concept. Exams were a little harsh, but if you study, you can do well on the exams

This is a hard course, but the lectures start slow and Olgun will make sure you know the material so you don't fall behind. He explains things really well. The exam questions were too hard, and maybe unclear. but there was a retake exam I think to make up for it. Simon and Bo were really good lab instructors and I learned a lot of tips from them.

Really nice professor that cares a lot about his students. You have a mini canvas quiz every class and one is dropped at the end (sadly not 2 since we're supposed to have 2 unexcused absences). The exams are kind of difficult. You have 4-5 coding questions & need to have perfect syntax or else you lose 20%-30% of points if you have any errors.

Prof. Sadik is a clearly worded, and fantastically patient professor that does an excellent job at introducing difficult concepts, and making them simple. You *have* to attend lecture and watch the lecture videos (theyre short), but its worth it! Hes a very kind person and will help you if you are behind as well. Best prof for E111/C291!
one of the best in the whole luddy school, the most understanding and caring professor I've had at iu.
Genuinely values learning experience for his students.

Professor Sadik is such a great teacher and person. He makes sure the class is always engaged and that everyone understands fully.  Before this class I had zero knowledge on coding and I can confidently say now that I have learned all the basics. Professor Sadik was very patient and approachable when there was confusion learning new codes.

Olgun is a real teacher! He always says that he doesn't care about the grades he just wants everybody to learn and he somehow does it. I like how he encourages and engages with students. I've also taken C200 at the same time and Olgun's course helped me learn more than C200. I'd recommend to take at least one of his courses before you graduate

Olgun is an amazing professor. If you are looking for a gen ed class or you are starting off in engineering I would 100% recommend him. He always came in with a smile and always encouraged his students. I never really coded before this class but through his encouragement and all the learning activities we had I felt like I learned very well.

Took E101 and had a solid experience. You learn the basics of Python for the first half of the semester and then you begin to use Raspberry Pi devices, building up to a group project. As a CS major, this class was very helpful for C200. Dr. Sadik is a fair grader and wants you to be engaged in his class. Would recommend this class for anybody.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Olgun is such a fantastic professor and person. You can tell that he cares immensely about his students. His class is difficult, but he is always willing to help and him and his TA's have office hours almost every day of the week.
Olgun is an amazing teacher, especially for a class that by nature is very difficult and dry. He really cares about students and is always looking for ways to help you learn and be successful!

Olgun is a wonderful teacher, faced with the difficult task of teaching complex and extremely difficult subjects to learn. He truly cares about students and has been incredibly flexible and adapts the class vases on student needs.

Panaite was great! She fostered a comfortable environment and was very nice in class. Sometimes her grading can be tough on exams since they were all free response, but it's understandable due to the level of the course. VERY reading-intensive. It is manageable, but it will require effort on your part.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Panaite is one of the best professors I've had here during my time at IU. She really does make an effort to connect with and understand her students. Although she can be a slightly tough grader, if you show development and effort you will get a good grade. 10/10 would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is super nice and understanding -- F300 is a reading-intensive course, but she explains the content clearly. I would take another French class with her in a heartbeat!

Prof. Panaite is great. She cares about her students and wants them to succeed. When it is clear her students are not understanding, she takes time to make sure everyone understands. The class is reading-heavy, but not excessively so. Show up to class and participate occasionally and you will do fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor knows her stuff, and this class is dead easy if you put even an ounce of effort into the material. Reading is assigned outside of class but we always get time to read it in class, and if you're one of the few students that participates, then she doesn't take points off for missing more than two classes.

She is a great and respectful professor. She puts time and effort into preparation for each class. She does care about attendance so you have to come to class regularly. You have to put in a decent amount of effort but the class is not overly difficult. She is always available to help you. She grades a little harshly, but nothing too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She was a true gem. Super kind, very willing to work with students, and wonderfully accepting of students' situations. Take any class you can with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is a great professor, but it is very important to know a few things. You must go to class, if you don't, you will lose lots of points and respect from her. you also must participate in class. She grades all of her tests subjectively, and if she likes you then you will do well on all exams and projects, which is key.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof. Panaïté is my favorite French professor so far. She is very strict about attendance, but I have no complaints aside from that. She grades fairly, the textbook she assigned was easy to read, and the amount of homework is reasonable. I felt that her French was easy to understand. On top of that, she is very nice and cares about her students.

Loved this class! Oana is such a sweet prof. She is extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the subject matter. She never makes you feel stupid for what you say in class or if you need help with a word. Very discussion heavy lectures. Her grading criteria can be unclear. Final project is a group video project which was kind of annoying.

I thoroughly enjoyed this class! Professor Panaïté is extremely passionate about the subject matter and leads very interesting discussions. In order to do well you just have to SPEAK. Add something to the discussion that isn't obvious. Ask questions. Link different chapters together. Also, put effort into the weekly written assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Madame Panaite is not horrible but her grading system is horrible and her classes tend to be on the disorganized side. Classes are mostly open discussion and there are a few big assignments that determine your grade. The class is not bad but she grades tough on french writing skills even if your anlayses are good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The lectures in class could sometimes be long and boring, but very engaging. You're graded on participation, so just talk and you will be fine. She makes literature more interesting than any other professor I have ever had. No homework (a little bit of reading) in this class as well. Wouldwill take again!

She is a nice person and knows her stuff, but the class is hard to follow. No textbook, but extremely long articles to read online. She doesn't write down many notes, so if you aren't good at listening to French, then it will be difficult for you to take notes. Tests are 50% essay and then a ton of dates and definitions to remember. Not that easy

The class is tough, with lots of homework reading, but you do learn a lot. Your reading, writing, and overall comprehension will greatly improve because of this class. Prof Panaite is strict but if you do the reading and participate in class, you will be fine. She goes over interesting material, historical and current.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR. There's no organized teaching style, no good way to take notes, and every hw assignment will take about 4-7 hours (if you want to do it well enough to get a good grade). You won't have seen more than a third of the terms on the midterm and final reviews, and you will use Wiki for just about everything.

Very sweet lady, but DON'T take this class. Incredibly interesting subject matter, but only with a proper reading list, or proper lectures. This class has no notes, no text, maybe an occasional article, but you'll wind up looking up all the exam terms on wiki the night before the exam.

Horrible. Run away. Really. Teaching style is awful: no textbook, no real lecture. She emails you huge articles to read then has students discuss it. Exams (essay) cover material you see for the first time when you get the review sheet three days before the exam. Awful.

Her teaching style was messy. She writes a little bit of stuff on the board, but it seems just random. There wasn't any organisation to teaching the subjects. She gives terms for the exams, but the class is such as mess that you have to use wikipedia to look up eveyone of them.
awful. i tried meeting with her 3 times at office hours and she was never there. i emailed her twice and she never returned my emails. stay away if you can.

I took this class the first semester of my freshman year and thought it was a nice way to ease into the French department here.  Go to class, pay attention, and take notes, and it will be fine, but it's probably not a good class to take if you want an "easy" grade.  I was 1 of only 3 people in my class to get an A- or better.

I am most certainly not a fan.  It is no wonder, then, that about half of the class dropped after a few weeks.  Oana really doesn't make the class very fun, and she makes it harder than it needs to be.  She is a very nice lady, but I will opt not to take a class with her again in the future.
No Comments
Ortega taught well and is knowledgeable. The class itself was pretty quiz-heavy, and there were lots of attendance points! Overall, an easy gen ed with her that I would recommend. Be ready to READ.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ortega is a very genuine and caring professor. She encourages students to do their best work about the things that they are passionate about, and makes the subjects of the class interesting and tailored to her students. A lot of reading, but it is interesting and manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: The class has a lot of different readings each week but were helpful for papers and class discussion. Professor Ortega was super helpful, knowledgeable, and passionate about the subject. She was kind of an easy grader but if topics were confusing she was more than happy to answer questions. She was one of the best professors I've had.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Ortega provided new material and summarised American migrant & immigrant labour across contexts exceptionally well. Her grading on intensive writing sections & helpful feedback grew my skills as a writer and interpreter of history. She is knowledgable, caring, and engaging, and a wonderful introduction to an unfamiliar subject matter.

She is AMAZING!! A GEM!! If you are pre-nursing, she has got you covered. Just do the work and study, you'll be fine. Super nice and apparently extermely renowned in Anatomy education. I miss her as my teacher. Enjoy her class! I'd loved it so much I want to TA.

As a PhD student in an A800 research credits course, difficulty stemmed from vague feedback and unstructured guidance rather than from intellectual challenge. Expectations were unclear, which made progress frustrating and reduced motivation. At the doctoral level, rigor should come from clear, challenging work, not confusion.

Fantastic professor, but you CANNOT fall behind. The lectures are fast-paced, and you have exams every 3 weeks, so you have to use your time wisely. She is a very engaging lecturer and does a lot of worksheets to help you remember important concepts. Highly recommend Dr. O!

Dr. O was phenomenal! Lectures were engaging but fast-paced and there were many assignments due before class but if you're on top of it, you are able to succeed. There are many opportunities for extra credit every week. Responds very fast through email! I never read the textbook but was able to succeed. Tests are based on notes. Lectures are posted

Dr. O is a really good professor to take anatomy with! Attendance is not mandatory, but I would still go to every class. She is very straightforward and knowledgable on the material. The tests don't have any trick questions and are really similar to BPEs. There is so much extra credit, so I would do as much as you can.

Dr, O is an excellent professor! She explains the material very well and doesn't make you feel dumb when asking silly questions. She also has a great sense of humor and keeps lectures entertaining. I really enjoyed the class set up in terms of having ample study tools and easy to follow lecture outlines. Definitely study if you want a good grade.

I never took anatomy in highschool so I was very nervous going into this class. Anatomy itself is a difficult class but she makes it enjoyable. You will have to put in a lot of work for the tests but its possible to get an A. Use the resources she gives, pay attention in class and put in the time!!! She gives a lot of extra credit which helps.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Anatomy is already decently difficult, but Dr. O made it enjoyable and much easier to understand. You can tell she really wants students to succeed. Lots of extra credit opportunities within each block, and 5 lecture and 5 lab exams total. There are pre lectures which are annoying, but there is a lot of content to get through. Take it with her!

Dr. O is great. She's a very funny professor and makes going to class worth it. Not too difficult, and there are TONS of extra credit opportunities available. Exams were online with lockdown browser during an in-person session. 10/10 would take her class again.
Difficult class led by an amazing teacher, engaging lectures.

The graduate anatomy seminar with Valerie was disheartening and disorganized, frequently focusing on irrelevant readings. Many sessions involved criticism of undergraduates and professional peers. Required every fall and spring, attending these often wasteful sessions was challenging as a Ph.D. student eager for a meaningful education

Dr. O is very nice and funny, and always tries to make the lectures engaging. Attendance is not mandatory, but it is the only way you will get the notes. The class itself is not nearly as bad as it seems. You can still get an A in the class even with a C/D exam average as long as you do the homework assignments until you get a 100.

Attendance is not mandatory because she does not take it. But let's be real, this is an anatomy class, and you need to attend. Half of the notes you get are in lecture. She is a really good teacher, and I loved her notes. The textbook is online, and I never read it and still passed.
I ended with an A and had her half a semester. I wish I had her all semester because she was so engaging and amazing at her job.

Valerie is one of my favorite professors. She is super nice and considerate and will have a conversation about anything within the class. The assignments are useful bc they are never just memorization. She really wants you to work through cases and do well. Exams are not too difficult but you have to study to do well and go over notes/slides

Dr. O is a great professor who has the ability to simplify difficult anatomical concepts. She has a sense of humor, and is more than willing to help clarify anything that may seem challenging to students. ANAT-A480 is only offered every other year, so take it if you get the chance. It's really interesting and fun.
anatomy is definitely a harder class but valerie makes it manageable and she is very funny!

Valerie is AWESOME. I wish I had known how to actually study beforehand, because this class is a pretty easy A if you do this: memorize the slides on the lectures, and make a quizlet over every word in the lab guide. Everything that is on the lecture is fair game, and no curveballs. Super helpful and funny lectures.

I LOVE Valerie. She made online anatomy the smoothest it could've been, given the circumstances. She is extremely caring and really wants you to do well! Everything on the exam is in her lecture notes. This class takes a lot of effort, but if you put in the work, you will do well! She is very straight forward and doesn't try to trick u with exams.

INCREDIBLE professor, truly cares for her students and is remarkably accessible despite having a lecture hall full of 300+ students. Anatomy is incredibly difficult but she doesn't throw curveballs on exams and she wants you to succeed

Mrs. O'Loughlin was a great prof for A215!! I have so much respect for her. She is highly educated, and makes her lectures funny! Pre-nursing students, you can do it! It just requires studying--nothing will pop up on a test that isnt in notes.
AMAZING professor! She really wants all of her students to pass
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's incredibly smart- but super tough class.

Dr. O'Loughlin was awesome! Her lectures were extremely clear and entertaining. Printed notes are available, she has study guides, and learning exercises. If you study, this class is not hard. I put in the work and got a good grade.

Valerie is an outstanding teacher! She is one of the smartest people i've ever met. Anatomy is a hard class, but if you attend class and put in the effort to do well, which involves ALOT of studying, you will do just fine. She gives you the lecture outlines and she is very easy to understand. She also has tons of AI's to help! Definitely recommend!

Dr. O'loughlin is by far the best anatomy teacher. She's very clear in her lectures and is very funny. She makes the class interesting and fun. Anatomy is hard and you'll have to be willing to put in the work, but having Valerie makes it a much easier process. If you have to take anatomy, take it with her!

I LOVED Professor O'Loughlin!  She makes a normally boring subject (anatomy) absolutely fascinating, by bringing in interesting little tidbits that help you remember what you're talking about.  I love the extra credit she builds into the class as homework, it was always very helpful in keeping me up on the material.  Hard subject, great teacher.
She is awesome!  Very entertaining during lectures and makes the class very interesting. If you can get her, do so! Not an easy class but if you work hard you can definitely get an A.

Absolutely wonderful professor! She makes the class so interesting and sometimes funny. If you come to class, pay attention and take notes and stay organized it is not impossible to get an A. She is so helpful and clear when questions are asked. Loved the class!

She is a very good professor, she cares a lot about what she is teaching and you can tell she loves it.  This class is not that hard if you study the material and go to lecture.  She adds jokes and funny sayings to help you remember stuff which helps in a memorization course.

Fantastic teacher for this class. Very clear in her lectures and very funny. She made the class easier for us to understand. Anatomy still requires many hours of studying, but if you can, get her as your anatomy teacher!

She's a great professor. Basically just go to class and take notes and review them and you'll be fine. She doesn't try to trick you. And she knows what she's talking about. Plus there's a lot of extra credit.
She wrote the book for Pete sakes!!  She makes class interesting and jokes a lot.  Definately one of the best professors I've had at IU.

Her tests are challenging.  I recommend preparing with note cards.  But if you attend lecture and study there is no reason not to get an A.  Valerie knows her stuff, is VERY helpful, makes a point to get to know names, and makes the lectures fun and enjoyable.  She also gives you plenty of optional resources for additional study and self testing.
She is an awesome professor! She knows her material and is able to explain it in a fun way that you WILL remember! Best teacher I've have for a biology class. Best Anatomy option, hands down!
Definitely knows her material and she is very helpful. Tests are difficult and require a fair amount of studying but overall she is a great professor.
I thought she was a great teacher. She cracks jokes and cares for every one of her students. Sometimes, she went over the material too quickly, but she is willing to answer any questions you have.
Very helpful and kind.
Oh! She rocks!She knows her stuff really well and ready to explain anything pertaining her domain in a fun and memorable way.Plus, she has an excellent sense of humor.
I love her! She is really passionate about what she is teaching. She makes learning anatomy pretty fun with her corny jokes. You really need to go to class and study the notes for the tests.

Good lecturer but not so strong in the clinical stuff. She's very knowlegeable in anatomy but has weak areas. Gives good generalizations that do work on the USMLE! Messy notes, tricky exams. Read "Essential Clincial Anatomy." She's not as good as Dr. Neff in the lab. That guy can find anything or tell you what something is in 5 seconds.
She is a great professor! She works in corny jokes that give you little breaks from lecture. She is very energetic too. If you study and go to lab, this class is easy.

She is very knowledable of everything she teaches and very clear. She moves at just the right pace so you don't fall asleep from getting bored or get overwhelmed with the material in the class. Highly recommended for any anatomy class!!
No Comments
I had Anatomy 3 years ago, and I can't really remember her lecture style.  As a bio major, I was able to skip class a lot since the lecture material was so repetitive.  Lab was different though...
she is kind of a dork, but i can understand her very well and she is a good teacher.
She's a great prof that makes painful concepts fun and interesting to learn.
No Comments

Very interesting lectures, she reads the slides, yes, but explains things in ways that make you curious to learn. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it will make a significant difference in your grade (the lowest 5 dropped). Exams aren't gotcha questions, and if you're attending and taking notes, you'll pass. You can tell she loves her field of study!
Loved her! She is so good and explaining everything and teaching in a way that helps you actually learn. If you pay attention and take notes, you will do well.
Just some short weekly assignments and exams. No readings. You'll do fine if you attend lectures. Recommend.

In all honesty, the class itself was quite easy, and the material taught is very valuable. The teaching style did not mix well with my learning style; it was very lecture heavy and not a lot of in class engagement. She is very available outside of class. A lot of minor issues with her though.

Dr. Uner is super kind, understanding, and genuinely passionate about the material Exams are fair MCQs with extra credit and no gotcha questions. The workload (TopHat, ZAPS, reviews) helps the info stick. She posts slides, recordings and study guides. The only downside is lectures are boring and feel slow, but she tries her best! Highly recommend.

Amazing professor. Lectures were always concise, but had all information. She is understanding and doesn't just teach to the test. Despite being early in her career, she is one of the best professors I've had at Indiana University.
It is hard to understand Professor Uner, but she is very lovely and a great teacher. The exams cover a lot of concepts.

Love this professor. Attendance is taken thru tophat with questions related to the lecture. Lectures are super easy to understand because she explains them very clearly. 4 exams taken in class all multiple choice, lowest exam gets dropped PLUSS she gives extra questions for extra points. She makes the materials interesting, overall W professor

Professor Uner is probably my favorite I've had so far at IU. She explains everything so well, is so kind, and you get to see so many pictures of her adorable dog. You get 6 absences, easy and engaging homework, lowest exam dropped, and the exams aren't hard if you pay attention. I have recommended this course to all my psych friends! Take it!

Dr. Uner is so caring & organized. Same assignments due at the same time each week. 3 exams & lowest is dropped. Final used previous exam questions. Top Hat for attendance & you get 6 free absences. Lecture is upbeat and engaging, not to mention she posts the slides after if you missed something. Not hard if you do the work. 10/10 would reccommend.

LOVED Prof Uner. she is so well organized and an amazing lecturer. i loved this class and she teaches the topics in such an amazing way. the class is set up for u to succeed. as long as you do the things you're supposed to you will do great. tests aren't bad at all and perfectly reflect class material. also lots of leg room for messups/absences.

Great class but lectures were sometimes boring because she goes through the material pretty slowly. The good news is that if you don't understand a concept, she will explain it a few times before moving on. The homework was not hard but did help a lot with understanding the concepts.

This class was amazing. I would not call it hard, I just personally struggled due to health reasons. Professor Uner always helped accommodated and was very caring. I feel I learned a lot and was always supported. I definitely recommend this class to anyone interested.
Super impatient, NOT clear grading, WILL roll his eyes in your face. Mood switches up every class. Very project heavy, they get really repetitive end of semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: he's nice and understanding but he's really impatient. he's helpful but mood changes so quick if the class doesn't understand an assignment. gets irritable quickly but I wouldn't say he's a bad professor.

This is genuinely one of the best professors you will ever have in your 4 years. He's funny, caring, nice, and actually cares about you and you performance. He takes time to get to know you during class as well, and he makes it a really comfortable environment for everyone. He will genuinely try to help any way he can if you run into a problem.
As long as you participate during class, which is practically mandatory, this should be a fairly easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's very helpful if you ask questions but can be confusing if you don't.

Professor Oakley is caring, genuine, wants everyone to succeed. Some of her lectures can be confusing when she makes mistakes often, but overall she gets content across and shows respect for her students. She makes resources very accessible

Professor Oakley was nice, however would mess up often, and go too quickly, confusing the class. Difficult teaching style, especially in comparison to other professor (they rotated teaching units). Coughed directly into the microphone often and had messy handwriting (further confusion for the class). Otherwise was good and likes making jokes.

she either explains too much or not enough. she just read off the slide and didn't really explain why she was doing something so i ended up teaching myself everything. additionally, her handwriting was hard to read and she messed up her notes every couple sentences which made it difficult to follow

Professor Oakley is nice, however she legit messes up every couple of sentences to the point where she has to go back and fix something every 2 minutes and confuses the entire class. She asks everyone if they understand to which we all respond no. Often your notes will be incorrect because you didn't realize she went to go back and fix something.

Professor Oakley gets a little confused during lecture sometimes, but she's not bad at teaching. Her style of teaching is a little different and it might take some adjusting. She very very kind though and makes a big effort to get to know her students. I would highly recommend orgo with Prof Oakley!!
Very good professor for Organic Chemistry. Is not the best with technology but that's okay. Very willing to help out students and has a lot of office hours. Not very good at emailing back though.

Martha can occasionally be unorganized but that doesn't take away the fact that her lectures are fun and entertaining as well as helpful. She cares a lot about her jobs and her students and if possible I highly recommend b

She might get a little confused during lectures but overall she is a sweet heart who loves her students. At the end of the year she gave us 5 bonus points on our final just for showing up to class on a random Friday.

Martha is extremely unorganized and does not respond to emails so good luck getting ahold of her. She would often make mistakes while teaching the content and her mini-lectures took away from our time to work on the worksheets. Given that this is a pass/fail class, it is a fair amount of work; however, the UTINs are helpful and so are office hours.
