I definitely recommend everyone taking this class with her. The way she sets up the course gives plenty of opportunity for success. She does get a little disorganized at times but having a lot of TAs makes up for it as they help just as much as she does when it comes to learning so definitely go to office hours if you get stuck on the homework.

Martha was amazing. She does everything she can to allow her students to succeed. She had so many TAs available almost every day and they way she set it up, this class really was not too time consuming. There are weekly Tuesday evening quizzes but those are not bad at all. I would highly recommend taking Prof. Oakley, she was amazing!

very cool professor. Eager to teach, learn, or be corrected. Learned everyone's names. I am not a fan of professor's repeating multiple times that they know more than you so sometimes I got irritated in her class. This wasn't a big deal though. if you have the opportunity, take your chemistry class with her. She's one of the few bests.

Dr. Oakley was a fantastic professor. I found myself going to her office hours, just so I could keep hearing her lecture. She was very available outside of class. Her tests were challenging, but I enjoyed the class so much, it wasn't a problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Martha wants her students to succeed, and she did a lot of things throughout the semester to help out. She can be a little disorganized sometimes and tends to underestimate the amount of times things can take to completes. Be prepared to learn. This class is hard, it's a lot of info, but you'll be amazed just how much you've learned.

Professor Oakley is all you could ask for in a professor: she's extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the subject matter, willing to help students and gives plenty of resources, and has humorous anecdotes. Take her class if you can.

Really great professor, she is very passionate about the subject. I recommend going to office hours at least once a week, and spending significant time on the problem sets and practice exams. Read the book and do the book problems to clarify material. Very detailed class, be fully prepared to put in a ton of effort.

Professor Oakley was one of the best chemistry professors I've had at IU. The material is not easy, but she explains it in way that you can understand. She is an entertaining teacher and she helps you a lot in office hours. Don't take this class if you are looking for a blow off class, but if you do have to take it, you will learn a lot with Oakley

I really loved Oakley. She moves very quickly, but she is a very good teacher. Her biggest problem is getting off topic. She is very personable; she knows almost everyone's names. Word of advice: DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS. All of them. They will keep you getting at least an 85 on the tests, which isn't a bad score for biochem.

Best professor I've had. She has a great sense of humor and is engaging during lectures. Also, very helpful in office hours. But be warned, her exams are difficult. I found it took hours of studying and doing book problems to get high B's to low A's.

Oakley is a great professor if you want to learn the information, if you want a class you can skim through, she is not for you.  She's hard, but you learn the information You'll have to do work in her class, but it's more about learning and applying rather than memorizing. Tests are more applying skills than exact mechanisms. Test info is obvious.

CHEM-C342 is difficult to begin with. Oakley tries her best to alleviate the difficulty level, however it comes down to how hard you are willing to work for a grade. She curves it a bit, but it's not going to keep you from failing. ATTEND HER OFFICE HOURS, this is the only way to do well. Memorizing will only help you fail.

Professor Oakley is the best professor I've had at IU.  I had her a year ago for C342.  When I saw she was teaching 484 this semester, I chose to take it instead of 483.  She enjoys teaching, and cares about her students.  I can honestly say that I'm going to miss this class.

Oakley has a great pedagogical theory & amount of time that she devotes to students puts other professors to sham. She pays attention to what concepts the class does not understand--you can tell by her annotations on post-exam keys and hints of what previous classes have struggled with. In our class of ~50, knows nearly everyone's names.

Dr. Oakley is the best chemistry professor I've had so far at IU. She does a great job organizing the class. Orgo 2 is a tough class regardless of the teacher, but Oakley makes it manageable. If you go to her office hours, she really wants to help you succeed in the class, and goes above and beyond with supplementary material.  Highly recommended!
Oakley is great. She does a nice job teaching the course and makes it quite manageable. She is one of the best professors in the department, and certainly the most likable.

Oakley is one of the best Professors in the Chemistry department. Amazingly impartial and intelligent. She treats every student with respect and understands that Orgo is difficult so she breaks it down better than anyone. It's not easy but she is awesome at teaching it

Oakley really cares about her students and is eager to explain everything. She wants everyone to succeed and is willing to help in any way possible. She posts boat loads of practice material online, and if you try realllly hard, it is not only possible to pass the class, but to get an A.

Prof. Oakley genuinely cares about the well-being and success of her students. GO TO OFFICE HOURS! She wants to help you and even if you don't ask questions, she'll teach you stuff you're about to learn so you have a leg up. However, getting an A is impossible. There is no curve at the end, even if 10 people get an A. If you pass, you did well.

She is very helpful in her office hours and tries to help students in any way possible. I would totally recommend her to any one. She has a great knowledge background of course materials and makes the students feel welcome ask questions during class and office hours.

Agree completely with review below for C342. She sometimes makes mistakes when writing notes on the screen, but is eager to be corrected. Very personable and funny, and offers considerable extra credit (~8%) the a generous curve. I found it easier to do well in this class than in C341.

Professor Oakley is a really great professor. The class material isn't easy, but she does a good job of making things as clear as they can be the first time through. Posts a TON of material online which is incredibly helpful. Exam averages were 70-75%. Suggestions: go to class and definitely utilize every online practice test.

I enjoyed having Oakley for my first biochemistry course. She makes it clear what she wants you to take away from her course, and will help you along the way. She is both a very kind and very approachable teacher who is certainly approachable. Exams usually have ~75% averages. I agree with the thoughts expressed in the review below.

Teaches at a quick pace. Posts very helpful practice exams. These give you a really good idea of what she thinks is important material, i.e. you can deduce what you're expected to know on the exams. Problem sets are very challenging but she's really helpful and patient with students during office hours. Good professor!

After a second year in Okelo's class, I can say that she is an amazing professor who cares for each of her students like family. She makes sure we try our hardest, but is also very kind. A decent workload, but it is easily accomplishable when you show up to class every day. Recommend 100%.

She is the best teacher I have ever had in all my years of schooling, and you can tell how genuine and passionate she is about her job. She has an amazing way of teaching and makes it very easy to learn, even when learning a language is not your strong suit. If you hated every world language class you've taken up to this point take this one. Trust.
She's amazing! She cares for all of her students and wants the very best for them! I highly recommend.
There were a lot of quizzes and exams, but they were useful and Mwalimu made sure that you had everything you needed to get a good grade. Participation is definitely needed.

She's a good teacher and a wonderful person. She's very passionate about what she does and rarely misses a class which. She's very funny and obviously a big people person which I know a lot of people appreciate so they can just sit back and learn without having to do a lot of the talking on their side. Absolutely would recommend!

Wendy is an amazing professor! She cares deeply for her students and the content. If you attend, pay attention, and participate in lectures, she will set you up for the exams. Do yourself a favor, so when I-Core exam week comes, you can devote your time elsewhere and still feel confident about the exam. She is amazing, don't overlook this class!

She cared way too much about the class. It is literally a leadership class and she would waste so much time going so deep on some of the concepts that didn't really matter. The exams were honesty easy but it was painful listening to her just talk at us during a leadership class. Thought this class should have been more student focused.

Wendy has clear grading requirements. The class/content is easy. Easy grade. Boring with certain topics, but cares a lot. Puts content from in-class videos on the test, so you have to go to class to get those questions correct.
Reads off textbook during lecture rather than extemporaneously. Class is annoying, try to take Walter if you can.
10/10 professor, super sweet and inspirational.
Wendy is an awesome teacher and a better person. She cares about the content and cares about her students learning and trying. Take her.

Really easy online class. Prof Pottgen was nice and really wants her students to learn. Some of the work is tedious and unnecessarily long (McGraw Hill), but it was easy and got me an A so I don't really mind.
Great professor, very understanding and outgoing and she actually cares about her students. Work load isn't bad at all, easy A as long as you complete them

Shes very understanding, designed her class for seniors who wont want to do a lot of work towards the end of the semester. 3 exams with the final not weighted as much as the first two. Presentations are easy; basically get full points if you just show up to present. Exams are simple and open note. Would take her again. Simulations are annoying tho.
Wendy was great! very understanding and assignments aren't too bad. Minimal effort for an A+

literally my favorite teacher here at IU. she cares for her students so much and made it so fun to learn. gives you amazingly organized notes to follow along in class. posts her lectures online as well! loved her, wish i could take every course with her.

Professor Propst is amazing! So knowledgeable and notes/slides are easy to follow along with. Definitely recommend open labs, super useful for studying. You will have to dedicate a lot of time to the course as it is memorization heavy and there is so much content per block but 10/10 course overall.

Kathryn is AMAZING! She is a very good lecturer and walks around asking how you are doing. She shows she cares and wants students to be sucessful. She didn't make things confusing and explained things well.

The class itself is not the easiest. There's a lot on content to remember, and a test every 3 weeks (5 total) for lab and lecture (2 separate tests). HOWEVER, Dr. Propst made it so much easier. Her lecture outlines and examples were so helpful. If you struggle with anatomy and have to take the course, I would definitely recommend Dr. Propst.

I loved Dr. Propst, she was an amazing professor and really wanted her students to learn. I would take her a million times again. She is such a sweet lady. Her practice exams really help you succeed in the class, and she does post the lectures so attendance is optional, but I recommend it. She gives a lot of extra credit, which is super nice!

I had classmates not perform well because they didn't show up or tried to use AI to answer the assignments. The guy is quirky, but he's shrewd and cares a lot about his work and cares a lot that you attend and pay attention. He provides reading materials pre-highlighted and gives test questions out in class. Just show up and you will do fine.

He is great, I don't understand some of the reviews here. He is pretty cool and chill, there wasn't a lot of homework and each class was just like a friendly chat while learning. He's pretty knowledgeable and definitely an interesting person. His dog Soots' is really cute.

He has unattainable deadlines and criteria. The slides are difficult to follow and never answers emails. Rambles and does not follow syllabus. Super unorganized and does not care about students needs. Acts like his class is the only class we are taking. DO NOT TAKE!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance is graded for easy points, and homework focuses heavily on in-class discussions. Lectures can be difficult to follow, but there is always a common theme that he will be looking for in your assignments. He's not that bad, but if you've had any difficulty in writing-based courses before, I would recommend a different course or professor.

He is a good person but his teaching is not good. First of all he said that attendance is not mandatory during the first class but he gives you a grade on attendance and if you miss a lecture you cannot do the weekly assignment. His lectures are so organized and goes from topic to topic you will lose interest so fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Every bad review is spot on, he's unorganized, lecture slides can range from 45-107 that makes absolutely no sense, you will be lost every class he rambles on and switches topics mid lecture. He doesn't follow his syllabus.  Because he's unorganized, me and other students did the wrong exam and he refused to give us credit, the exams are essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is absolutely awful. I have no idea why this person is still teaching. He makes up all of his material, he makes up his tests on the fly and is discombobulated majority of the class. He continues to grade horribly and teaches his students like crap. DO NOT TAKE

He was something else, I'll say that. Brought his dog everyday. No homework assignments, just 3 take home exams, open note. Take notes (he posts the slides but often will talk about other important info in class so probs go). Pretty sure he makes up all the information so don't google. Readings every week but skimming through them did me fine.

I wish I would have looked him up before taking the class. His lectures are very unorganized and his slide shows simply just don't make sense, he expects you to remember every single word he says in his lecture. He pushes his beliefs on you and judges you if you disagree with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I wish I would've read reviews before taking this course so I could've avoided the unnecessary stress of this class. He is very unorganized and blames his students for not doing better when he makes it so difficult to access the material and even understand it. He doesn't take suggestions well and argues with students.

BE PREPARED TO GET YELLED AT... He goes too fast, berates students & belittles them, yells at the only working students who actually care, and is just very sour. He wonders why nobody goes to class when he's the barrier himself. I could've saved myself a lot of anxiety had I listened to the previous reviews before taking this course...

This class is just horrible and I wish I had seen his ratings before I enrolled. They're extremely accurate: lectures are unorganized. I'm very interested in the Mayas and I'm still zoning out the entire class. I have no idea how to even start these essays and I've attended every class. I'm not going into debt for +10 years for classes like this.

Frankly, Dr. Castañeda does not deserve the absolute evisceration he has received on this website. I have taken multiple courses with him, including some of the ones listed in these reviews, and yes--he is unorganized, even chaotic if you will. But it's really not that hard, people. He's approachable and cares about students, just talk to him.

It is an interesting topic so I opted to take the class. However, I withdrew because there are 3-5 weekly readings ranging from 20-40 pages each. His instructions for his assignments are confusing and nitpicky about words/fonts. He doesn't have scheduled due dates for any of them. Due dates are hear-say in class. DO NOT TAKE HIM EVEN IF INTERESTED
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This guy is awful! I have never been as stressed as I am because of this class. He is so disorganized with his notes and his grading. He constantly pushes his beliefs and political views on the students with no regard to their beliefs. I will never take a class from him again. I hope that he realizes his mistakes and builds upon this.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This teacher takes attendance every class. Midterm and Final are each 25% of final grade. He is extremely unorganized and an awful communicator. I would not recommend his class to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I, personally, only went to class the first half of the semester and did just as well on my own as I did when I was going to class. I do recommend attending the discussions the TA's hold because they are the ones grading the assignments. You really do not need to read either. The only time I looked at the readings was when I was taking the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: My experience with this professor was not very good. His lectures were highly unorganized making it near impossible to follow his train of thought. You are graded by very few things which makes the tests even more stressful because he does not give you the resources to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I personally did not like this professor at all. I was very excited for the class at the beginning of the semester but the professor just made it awful. His lectures were pointless and he just expected his students to understand every random thing he said. His tests were difficult and heavily based on his opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: The semester is almost over and I couldn't be happier, because it means I will never have to sit in a class with this professor again. The reading expectations in this class are impossible but the midterm and final are extremely hard and ask questions about the readings. One week he wanted us to read 218 pages of articles and novels. it is not fun
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Not a good professor. His reading expectations are near impossible and he is so unorganized in class. He just reads off the powerpoint slides and then rambles about something off-topic. He is occasionally funny but it was very hard not to skip his class because of how boring it was.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He loves what he teaches and is always willing to answer questions and explain things. His lectures tend to be very unorganized, but he puts all the notes online so you can go back and try and make sense of things. Going to Lecture and Film showing is beneficial to understanding concepts, but not entirely necessary. Most  films are also online
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pretty good teacher. The class is different than any class I, being a bio major, have ever taken. You have to go to the lectures if you want to understand what's going on. The class is supposed to be about students seeing the world in a new way, but really students end up just seeing the world from his perspective. Not very open to other opinions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Frankly an awful teacher. He rambles on and on making impossible connections. The sources he provides are typically useless, or at least poorly written. I have never taken a class where, once finished, still didn't know the purpose of the class. I now know what that feels like. Despite his awful teaching ability, he seems smart and well intentioned

Be engaged and patient in lectures; everything connects when you follow what he's saying to the end. Read the book or look over lecture notes if you don't know what he's talking about. Don't pretend to understand if you actually don't, but don't be afraid to ask for clarification. He's very passionate about his work and willing to help if you ask.

While he tries very hard to explain his thought process, much of what he teaches is based on his interpretation of literature.  He allows for other ideas to flow in class but the Final and Midterm were based almost entirely on how he interpreted things. On the plus side, I never read any of the 10 books he assigned and I did just fine.

Very unorganized and tended to go off on tangents. Exams did not reflect what was learned in class. Required reading from textbooks we were not required to purchase and did not upload on oncourse. Class was way more difficult than a 200 level should be.

Very smart but VERY unorganized, all over the place. I never had any idea what was going on in this class. There were no notes and tests would have been absolutely impossible if he hadn't made them take-home at the last minute. I wouldn't take this class again for a million dollars. Class discussions were rarely relevant.

This professor is really passionate about what he is teaching, but is very unorganized, scatterbrained, and never posts grades. I would not recommend taking a class with him unless you have background info on the topic.

Probably the most frustrating and fascinating prof I've had. Don't take his class if you aren't interested! his reading expectations are completely unrealitic, & his exams are terrifying. But, his desire and efforts to help students in need is unprecedented & he will never be unfair. friendliest ever, funny, and completely human, awesome professor

I took Latin American Culture and Civilization and was forced to drop so as not to commit GPA suicide. He never posts grades or even has a consistent class schedule. The readings are overwhelming and the book is poorly written. His lectures are dull and he clearly just makes it up as he goes. He is the absolute worst professor I've had!

Overall fine professor for JavaScript. Lectures were a bit dull but quizzes are easy, projects were also easy. Must go to class every day for in class activities. You also must go to office hours every week to do a code walk through, its very easy though. Content was actually quite useful, you learn html, css, and JS.

**FOR CSCI-B 365** The only reason Prof. Qaaidi is a 4 is that he allowed me to retake a midterm I missed, which would have destroyed my grade in the class. I did not learn much from the class beyond some basic Python scripting and formulas. Lectures are very boring, and there are in-class assignments, although attendance wasn't mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really nice and caring prof that is always open to feedback. Fairly easy course and doesn't require as much coding as other CS classes. The labs & HW were a little unorganized sometimes with them not being published on time/autograder not working correctly but I found the HW/Labs pretty straightforward and they don't take a whole lot of time.

Love this proffessor but not neccesarily his teaching. Great guy, who takes feedback and helps you out. Only reason why I am giving 4/5 is because of his TAs. He grade some questions on my exam that went well, but TAs grade unnecessarily. I drew the entire linked list, pointers, values correctly, only one arrows was missing and the TAs give 0.1/0.5

Assignments and labs have vague instructions sometimes & I swear the TAs take off every point they can think of. Lectures are okay & slides are easy to follow. Idk why he says he takes attendance randomly, there's in-class activities almost every class which is a part of the attendance grade. Every assignment is 10pts and worth 30% of your grade

There is graded activity every single class. TA's aren't the best. One TA doesn't even speak, instead of solving the problem, the TA gives verbal clues. Sakher tries to explain but when asked question he says it is by the definition? each time.  Inexperienced Professor.
this dude's the goat, easy class if u pay attention, if you did good in Data Structures you should be good in this class.

Professor Qaaidi is very knowledgeable about Android App Development and cares for your success. Although the lectures are a little boring, make sure you follow along because he gives in class assignments based on the current lecture. Group Projects are 80% of the course so make sure you pick a good teammate.
Professor Pranger is a wonderful professor who truly cares for his students. He is wonderful at teaching, and if you go to his class and actively follow along, the class is pretty easy.

Dr. Pranger is by far one of the best professors that I have taken. Pranger's labs are very helpful in understanding course content. Pranger himself is a great, funny, and caring teacher. Note! Pay attention to when things are due. This class has a lot of homework and it is easy to forgot to submit something. The content is not hard, just a lot.

All classes follow the same textbook so that doesn't really matter, but he is a very passionate and caring guy that is very helpful. Very fun lectures that are full of good content that makes you want to come to class. Couldn't recommend more.

Dr.Pranger is a great professor! He is very helpful and funny and makes a very confusing class easy to understand. Make sure you attend class, its not required but if you don't go to class you wont have a good understanding of the topics. Take K201 with him!
He is very good teacher and actually helps when you don't understand something. Make sure to submit assignments on time because you will not get an extension.
Take this guy for k201. trust.

Dr.Pranger is a delighfull and supporting professor, although the prof does not matter for this class since every section is cordinated and the same. Would reccomend doing the textbook for extra practice and do sim exams.

Genuinely the best teacher for this class. People find the class hard, but he's incredibly helpful and will give you every resource to help you with it. Lectures are great, but please practice and do the hw they give, it's the only way you get through the class. Go to K-cove to meet TAs for help

Whoever says this class is hard...it's not. Just go to class and you learn everything you need to know for the exams/homework. Everything you need is in the online textbook. Make sure to get the easy 100% in lecture bc it really boosts your grade in the end even if you get a B on every exam. Pranger is an amazing teacher, definitely go with him.
Was dope! Knew his stuff and was passionate and nice! very easy

I might be cheating writing this review since I only peer tutored for him, but I thought I had a great K-201 professor last year, and I think this guy is better.  I would've loved having him as a professor last year.  All the students in the class generally seemed to like him, and he's probably one of the funniest professors I've had.

THERE IS NO BETTER K201 PROFESSOR ON PLANET EARTH. Dr. Pranger is the greatest K201 professor I could legitimately ever imagine, he is as funny as he is caring about the students and it is clear that all he wants is for you to succeed. It was an absolute privilege to be in his class twice a week and hear that awesome Southern accent. Love this guy!
Great teacher, highly recommend for K201. Takes a difficult class and breaks it down as simply as possible.
THE GOAT. Explains everything clearly and takes time to make sure everyone is caught up.

He is a very good professor. Go to the lab section. He goes through the content very quickly, but explains things clearly. He's funny and class often ended early, and he's willing to answer questions. Just go to class and don't fall behind.

I know K201 is a generally hard class, but I found it to be super chills. Do your work, ask questions and go to k-cove when you're confused. Dr. Pranger is so patient and truly such a respectful guy. I had a few issues AES wise with K201 and he was always super helpful and patient. Please take him if you can!
Lectures are very boring. Assignments are easy as long as you follow the rubric. He was gone half the time so we would watch lecture recordings

Take the lab portion of K201 with Dr. Pranger. He makes content that can be confusing very easy to understand. He moves through content quickly and class often ends early, but will stop class to answer any questions you have. He does a great job preparing for exams and offers practice tests that are very similar to the actual tests.
Pranger knows Access and Excel very well. He's friendly and funny, and he often got class done a little early and would let you leave. I would definitely take him again.

Initially, I was worried about K201 because I'd heard from others about the difficulty of it and STEM subjects were never my strong suit. However, Dr. Pranger made this class very manageable and enjoyable. His lectures are straight and to the point, funny, and he always is willing to help. Take him if you can!
He really cares about his students and is super accommodating. Always available for extra help or questions. He definitely makes a hard class a little easier to get through.

Most of k201 is out of the professors control but the parts the teachers control he did great at. At the start of class he'd make a joke or 2 and get right onto work. It was perfectly paced and helped a lot.

One of the best K201 professors. I had him for the lab and he was very straight to the point with his lectures and made everything easy to understand. Attendance isn't mandatory but I would recommend going to class, its only 50 mins and he walks through everything in detail. Hes also chill and approachable and if you have questions hes very helpful

Prof Pranger made what could have been a tough class fairly simple. I feel he was awesome, and did his best to keep class entertaining! He truly wants everyone to do their best and while I can't speak for other professors, I would HIGHLY recommend him for K201!

I had him for the online lecture so I can't say much but all my interactions with him were very positive and good. He is not lenient on late work, which is understandable, but he is super funny and always willing to answer questions for students. He made the online lecture as enjoyable as it could be.

Overall, I would say Professor Pranger is one of the best K201 instructors. As long as you show up to class prepared and ready to listen you should not have any problem getting an A in his class. He has a unique sense of humor that makes lab enjoyable to attend. If I could take another class with Pranger, I would in a heartbeat.

I believe that Dr. Pranger is one of if not the best professors for K201.  He does a great job at explaining the material even when gets complex.  The class itself is not that difficult as long as you attend and pay attention.  Attendance is not mandatory or tracked, however it is directly related to how well you will do in the class.

Dr. Pranger tries to engage with students to make lectures seem more interesting. K201 can seem daunting or hard to understand for some students. Pranger understands this and goes above and beyond to make sure students understand the topics. No pop quizzes or surprise assignments. He makes all expectations clear and wants students to succeed!

Great professor when it comes to teaching material.  Breaks it down well enough that as long as you go to class, it will make a huge difference when taking the exams.  K201 is a hard class but as long as you pay attention it is not extremely difficult.
I cannot stand his voice in the lecture portion of K201.

Don't take this class, trust me.

Her grading makes no sense. She makes up stuff as she goes. Whatever she feels is right goes. There is no rubric for homework. She is petty when grading. You will NEVER get full credit unless you write everything that could possibly be what she wants.

Most unorganized lectures I've ever seen and I can understand MAYBE 1 out of 5 words spoken, have to give my full blown attention and mouth read literally. Don't take this class if you don't absolutely have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is very difficult. The lectures are unorganized and you need to make sure you understand even the tiniest details that may seem unimportant for exams. She gives you a study guide outline for the exams, but most of what is on the exams is not reflected in the study guide. I would not take this class unless it's necessary.

Get ready to be constantly confused. She is hard to follow in lecture & difficult to understand, as well as unclear with assignment instructions and due dates. I wouldn't recommend her to even my worst enemy.
very unclear, difficult to understand. no one like her. avoid if possible.

The professor doesn't give you all of the information that Will be presented on the exams. She gives Exams on short notice and leads you to cram in studying. you will have to read your textbook and take notes and Do must work out of class and on your own because the slides don't cover most of the exam. She was also not easy to hear and would rush.

Rushes through slides in lecture. Does not cover a majority of exam material in class, so you have to do a lot of self-teaching. Also would talk fast and hard to understand at times. Exams are very tough with no curves and only like 2 points of extra credit are offered for the whole semester. Do not take this class unless you actually need to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: do not take this class unless u are majoring in something with nutrition. it is very difficult and the tests don't even match up to the lectures and it is very difficult to understand what she is saying. the ta also tends to grade hard
Genuinely the worst professor I've ever had. Exams are extremely specific and HEAVILY lecture based however the lectures are non-linear and hard to follow. This gen-ed is dropping my GPA for what?
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very unclear and very disorganized. Notes do not help with studying at all. Do not take this class with her you will not be smiling.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures were extremely non-linear and difficult to follow. The exams were heavily dependent on the lecture material and when I say everything needs to be written down and studied, I mean everything. Take this class online if at all possible. I withdrew after the first exam because of the points I lost because I didn't retain every single thing

This was definitely one of the most difficult classes I've taken and the course is VERY test heavy with exams being very difficult and requiring a lot of memorization. However, great professor and very knowledgeable in the subject matter. She curved some of the exams and actually cared about our grades in the class.

I took Professor Thiagarajah class thinking it would be difficult, but not impossible. Unless you have been exposed to nutritional facts before, you will suffer in this class. For one thing, she is not an english speaker. This makes it very difficult to understand her in class. Her exams are 55% of the grade and very specific questions. DO NOT TAKE
I love Krisha, but her TA, Elizabeth, is stringent on homework grading. I'm not even sure what I missed on the homework because all she does is state "incorrect" on whatever problem I had wrong.

I personally found this class to be over challenging, class is more difficult than it needs to be. Class is very disorganized with 5 exams worth 77% of your grade, with little time to prepare (max 3-4 days to prepare). If you can avoid the prof, trust me do it.
Lectures are hard to understand, and tests are hard for no reason. Class lectures and study guide do not prepare you at all. DO NOT TAKE CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Is a nice person and very smart but her exams are unnecessarily difficult and should not be considered undergraduate level. She does not teach/explain concepts well. She doesn't care how her students are doing as we had an exam average of an F and she did nothing about it. Do not recommend at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Our last exam average was a 58% and she treated it like it was nothing. I have never seen an average this low where the teacher does nothing about it. Her tests are way too difficult and she is clearly an experienced teacher,so it baffles me how she has not learned to accommodate her students,and them literally failing a course goes unfazed to her.

Took this class to fill gen ed natural science and it was one of the hardest classes in my life. The assignments were easy but the exams were insanely difficult. Ended the class with a 68 and asked her to round it but she didn't which is not her fault, but she is the first professor I've had that would not round up my grade that wasn't that close.

Professor Thiagarajah is extremely smart, and knows very well the material she teaches. She mainly lectures during class, and you won't be prepared for the tests if you don't go to every class. If you study the material often this class shouldn't be too hard, but it is definitely not an easy A science gen Ed credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There were so many things wrong with this class but #1 would be that you aren't given any of the resources you need. I had 40+ page study guides for each exam but the majority of info we needed wasn't taught in lecture, the textbook, or in any of the outside readings. It's like she pulled the questions out of thin air. I would rate a 0 if I could
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Class material is very easy, but lack of organization and hideous exams puts your grade on thin ice. Exams are a large portion of your grade each being worth 40 points, while "post-test" HW assignments are only 1.4 points each. Exam Review Sheets are unreliable, virtually no HW to help your grade. I pray for the poor soul who has to take her class
She seems like a nice person but gives extremely boring lectures and has pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was a very difficult class but it is definitely do-able. The tests were hard because a lot of the test questions weren't on the study guide. However, she provides you with all of the materials you need to succeed, you just have to take initiative and be motivated. She is an incredible woman and insanely smart.
hard to understand. Tests are extremely hard. extremely unorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very organized with assignment structure and is relatively easy to understand. Willing to help if you need it, and hosts optional pre-test review sessions outside of class time. If you do good on the 4 tests, you dont have to take the final. Two easy projects. Stays on topic, but shares personal experiences from Sri Lanka which I found valuable.

Dont take her class if possible. You learn few in the lecture and if you try to study the lecture slides by your own you will find is unorganized and hard to understand. Exams are hard and detailed . We dont even have review guide for final, need prepared everything we learnt from the lecture( I mean book) for the final.

The group work is rewarding and easy if you complete all the assignments. Dr Thiagarajah is hard to understand and her lectures are unorganized, making it hard to learn material. Exams are difficult. She is very nice, but lacks the ability to communicate  well and enthusiasm for the material being taught.

I really enjoyed this class; definitely something I am interested in. It is true that she does have a thick accent, but you get used it and it is not that big of an issue. Yes, the notes are incomplete, and are intended for you to complete them when you come to lecture-- so do it. Use the notes in conjunction with the book and you will do fine.

She is a very nice lady! Her accent is thick so its hard to understand her in lecture. Her notes are very scattered and hard to follow, and its all she does which makes it extremely hard to focus in class. Test are hard, not sure where she pulls the questions from and they are very poorly worded. She does offer homework that helps your grade though
Very hard to understand, you can never be prepared for the quizzes, tests are very hard, really boring class. Overall, I would recommend finding a different teacher for this class

Overall, I really like her.  Yes, she is hard to understand at times, but she is always willing to repeat things and she gives good notes.  I found the tests pretty easy. If you ask her questions, she is very helpful.

Being from Sri Lanka, it was incredibly difficult to understand her in lecture. This was the most important class of my collegiate Dietetics career, and I did no where near as well as I would have liked. Her tests rarely covered the most important material and were very inconsistent.

The tests were good because she always offered two extra chances for points. However the notes are very incomplete. She also has a very thick accent and is very hard to understand. She also does not understand any questions students ask and fails to comply when students do not understand the concept or what she is saying.

She has a VERY thick accent and it is extremely difficult to figure out if the word she is saying sounds unfamiliar because it's new to you or because her accent is making it sound strange. I did not get much out of her class which is unfortunate because nutrition is something that applies to our entire life.
It's borderline whether I'd recommend her or not.  I didn't get much out of her class but I got through it.
Her exams are kinda tough, and her notes are incomplete, but she is a really nice lady!
She is so hard to understand and is from Sri Lanka so she has a pretty heavy accent. She's also very very monotone. She's a nice woman, though.
Great, relatable professor! Very easygoing, likes to crack jokes. Very similar format to C101. You get a few free absences, but as long as you're showing up it's a very simple class.

Ted is a very entertaining instructor! C101 is a breeze, with most assignments being fully online, and sometimes open-note. He is relatable and cracks many jokes in class. He is very understanding, and as long as you're showing up you should do well. You get multiple excused absences.

AMAZING professor. His lectures are interesting, and he is knowledgeable in areas to relate to almost everyone in the class. Very nice, genuine, and a very easy class to take. Tests are at home online open book. I wish I could have him for future classes. 10/10, would recommend. Made me consider a career in the field.

Just a good dude to be honest. Most of the time you don't even need to pay attention but honestly, I found myself paying attention to his lectures at times.  He's a relatable guy, really shows his personality and makes a connection with students. Disclaimer: I did not take C209, it does not give me the option to pick C101, the class I took with him
Super sweet guy but lectures are definitely dry. All the tests and quizzes are online.

This class was pretty boring but he would try to make up for it by cracking a few jokes (even if no one laughs). It's intro so its hard to make it interesting. There were reading checks after every lecture and there was attendance at every lecture. He seems like a good guy who loves to teach about his passion.  Long papers to write!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: All time favorite professor, I have now gone on to take 3 classes from him. Super nice and caring. Has conversational lectures, you will get to know him. He gives great feedback and cares about his students.

Prof. Jamison-Koenig is a great guy. Very nice, tries to crack jokes during class. Lectures can be redundant, but are fully based off of the textbook. Attendance is determined by daily questions, and there's also reading quizzes daily. A few papers to write, but nothing super hard and the criteria/rubric is pretty clear. Definitely recommend!
He's nice and helpful when you need to reach him, but lectures are very boring. Easy grader and quizzes are open note and online, so I'd reccomend.
Ted is a great professor for students who come to class and talk to him when they are struggling!

Very good professor and understanding if you have a situation. In-class quizzes for participation credit and the class can be a little redundant because it's an intro class, but Ted makes it fun, adds good examples, and shares his experiences.
He is a newer professor but still a very good one. Attendance does matter but I never dread going to his class.

His lectures aren't the most exciting and he does do questions every class that count as attendance, but he is a very nice guy. He wants his students to succeed and his tests/papers are very reasonable.
Lectures are so mind numbing along with the rest of the class. Could definitely get more creative at how he relays material to really help people learn.

Prof Ted is a friendly guy, but he isn't a good lecturer. Attendance is required, but lectures are simply going through the book word-by-word. It felt like a waste of my time, so I did other homework during class. Prof Ted is knowledgeable so I wish he enriched lectures more. Also, the essays were pointless busy work. I found no value in them.
I don't know if it was him or the AI's grading but one of them was a very tough grader. I went over a paper just by a few words and was deducted too many points.

Shelley was a good teacher. She randomly laughs at her own jokes, which I thought was funny. The class is very chill and a good way to add another credit to your schedule without actually having to do more work.

I didn't have a good experience with instructor Shelley Taylor. It often feels like she doesn't really understand what her students are going through, and her overall vibe can be discouraging. To me, it doesn't seem like she enjoys teaching or connecting with students. I wouldn't recommend taking her class.

I took online yoga, & I was a bit dissapointed. I wish I had taken it in-person, to get more feedback and personally get better at yoga. Although my class size was less than 15 people, Shelley did not know my name personally or give feedback to anyone in actual class. She is nice, but particular on everything- & make sure you come to class also.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This class is amazing! Entirely online. If you have a heavy course load, consider taking this Yoga class to help you relax! Shelley truly does an amazing job at making Yoga fun, while also taking advantage of it as a learning opportunity. Most relaxing class I've ever had! She also lets you miss 4 classes without it affecting your grade.

This class is so easy. Shelley is a kind soul. All you have to do is show up and try. It's pretty much a twice a week yoga class that puts you in a good mood for the rest of the day. The only annoying part is having to carry around a yoga mat all day. If you're looking for a 1 credit easy class, take this one for sure.

He explains concepts very well and uses lots of in-class examples to try to make the subject easier. HOWEVER, he does not set you up well enough for tests. For example, he will teach you how to get from A->C but never mentions B. Then he throws B into the test and confuses you.

Rearick is a really good finance professor. I-Core is overall a very difficult class, but he does a great job of teaching the content. I wish he could've taught the rest of my finance classes because makes hard topics easy to digest. Finance professors after I-Core are much worse and overcomplicate topics. Go to class and study and you will be fine
content can be difficult but professor Rearick is great at breaking it down to simple terms
Explains everything throughly, very good professor. Show uo to class and you will do fine.
He explains concepts in lots of different ways to make sure people understand them. Just make sure you pay attention in class and understand the fundamentals.

Over explains concepts to exhaustion. I would have appreciated more quantitative examples in class that relate  to the homework content. You end up largely teaching yourself the math through the online textbook or ChatGpt.

Really nice guy. Exams are hard and he will rework them in ways that haven't been directly discussed but he pushes you to learn. Has office hours twice a week and goes over the HW problems. He will schedule time outside of that if you need more help. I just finished my third class with him. Definitely difficult grader, but I learned a lot.

Only had office hours for an hour a week on Fridays. We didn't have our final grades in canvas until after finals. Canvas site organization was the worst i had ever seen. He threw everything in files and did not organize assignments by topic. He also would overexplain the simplest topics and would not touch on concepts needed for hw.

If you're passionate about writing or English in general, would highly recommend taking a class with Samrat! The workshops in class were extremely useful, and his class discussions proved to be very informative and helpful for newly writers. Pretty strict with attendance, but in my opinion the class is fun, so missing class shouldn't be an issue.
An absolute joy to have a writing workshop with! Highly reccomend if you want great advice, a welcoming class atmosphere, and a great time!

This class was graded by participation and by four 8-12 page short stories. If you enjoy writing, Samrat is an excellent professor and gives in depth feedback on all of your work. The workshops in class are also a great resource and we had an awesome class dynamic. I felt as though I left this class a much stronger writer and reader of fiction.

Samrat is an accomplished author with so much experience to share. We wrote four different stories through the semester and had workshops for them, which were very helpful. His feedback is thorough and constructive. Participation is important to this class, so it's important to show up!

I won't deny that he can ramble sometimes, but his rambles consistently either expand on or lead up to insightful points about a student's writing. His feedback is extensive and detailed. The way he structures the class makes sure all the students receive feedback from their peers. He is a friendly professor who cares about his students.

Samrat is amazing. He gives extensive, thoughtful feedback, and is very honest without coming across as harsh, a hard balance to strike. He is also very encouraging of all types of creativity; even though my preferred genre is not one he has experience in, he met my work with enthusiasm. He's easily one of the best writing teachers I've ever had.

Samrat is an accomplished writer, having published two novels and two short story collections. In peer reviews, he has good comments, and writes thoughtful responses. He does have a tendency to ramble, but it is often insightful. He can be very direct with his criticism, but also with his praise--which are both important to a fledgling writer.

he's one of those guys who really doesn't know how to let students talk during a critique he'll ramble on and on and tries his hardest to bring up his own novel and short stories every time. he's probably a great administrator...but professor/peer review leader? not so much

Get to know him and he's very generous with personal situations. As long as you show up and don't scroll on your phone the whole time, you'll do well. Cares more about how confident students are then the actual data within the presentation.
He's so so so nice, would recommend for anyone. Class itself isn't too bad. The GOAT.
He is a super nice and caring guy and a great professor. Attendance policy is very strict but other than that he is understanding and clearly cares about his students.

Professor Deckard makes class engaging and fun. His grading on presentations isn't really tough, and he always give great advice before presentations and great feedback after presentations. Please take his class if you can, he will be your favorite teacher!

I recently had Trent as my professor for biz prez and I have to say that he is the greatest professor I have taken at IU. He really cares about his job and especially for his students and it is clear in his work. He is supportive and always available. If you have the option to take him for Bus-C 104 do it you will not regret it.
Phenomenal teacher that cares about his students and inspires them to learn in unique ways that arent just read from a textbook.
Loves his job relatively easy class if you work and do what is asked. Learn a lot. He is a very nice and amazing teacher.
I had a lot of fun taking this class with Trent he is an amazing professor to have. Super fun and gives great feedback, you can tell he genuinely wants the best for you. Best C104 professor for sure!

He is genuinely one of the best teachers I've ever had; he cares about you in and outside the classroom and really wants you to grow as a speaker. You can talk to him about anything, and he's always willing to advise about an assignment or just life stuff. You won't be disappointed if you take Prof Deckard.

Deckard is very knowledgeable and gives good feedback. He always answers questions clearly, you will never leave confused. His classroom is a very welcoming environment. Attendance is mandatory. Textbook is online!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Deckard. If you are not a great public speaker then C104 is going to be annoying for you either way. Two of the bigger presentations of the semester are based on assigned groups, but he does a good job of balancing groups fairly. His attendance policy is strict but he justifies it fairly well. Would recommend and take it again.

Trent taught a 2nd semester JLLC class called "The Big Industry of Comic Books." If you're in the JLLC, I highly recommend taking this course. There are only seven graded assignments throughout the eight weeks and Trent grades lightly. He is extremely enthusiastic about the topics which made me look forward to coming into class each week.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Deckard was easily my favorite teacher during my first semester. He's extremely talented in public speaking, which helps the student's taking his class. But more importantly than that, he genuinely cares about each one of his students. He wants to learn about your interests, and see what you need to improve so he can help you. 10/10.
My favorite professor at IU, caring, a good teacher, and a fair grader.

One of my most favorite professors of the semester. He was incredible! He learned everyone's name in the class in the first couple weeks of school and made it feel like he genuinely cared about you. Truly an incredible professor and I hope I get to work with him again in another course in the future. If you have the choice take his class!
Very caring, motivates you to do your best every day, guaranteed will make you a better speaker
Harsh grader but very nice

Professor Deckard is super friendly, and really does a good job of helping everyone grow more comfortable with public speaking. Tends to grade pretty generously early on, but it is a little harsher on the later projects (not unfairly harsh). High recommendation for Deckard, definitely try and take the class with him!
Gives good grading feedback and gives you room to improve. Highly suggest taking Business Pres. with him

He was caring, but I think he failed to realize some kids we’re trying their hardest. I felt like I’ve grown a lot in this class, but my grades on presentations didn’t reflect this growth. I will always have anxiety in front of crowds, and he doesn’t acknowledge this and critiques people on things indicating nerves like talking speed
Professor Deckard gives great feedback and you see yourself improve throughout the class. Very kind and cares about his students.
Prof Deckard was a super great guy. His class was interesting and also very fun. It is a great class in general for developing teamwork skills and public speaking skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Took his business presentations class. Great personality. Get ready to shake your nerves and stand up and present in front of others. Only thing you do is present to your class. Gives great feedback. Interesting class because you get to listen to others speak too. Eye contact & good volume are the most important things to this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Trent is one of the most caring professors at IU hands-down. He really just wanted us to get something valuable out of his class, which I think he did a wonderful job of doing. He is dedicated to giving you a good experience, and he has a very large comic book collection.
Super awesome professor, makes speaking in front of class extremely easy and relaxed. Perfect for any incoming freshman worrying about speech.

I was very scared of public speaking before this class. Trent is AWESOME and makes public speaking much less scary. He is very encouraging and provides detailed feedback of how to improve. A very funny man and an all around awesome person. 12/10 would recommend

He was a great professor and really cared about his students. This class isn't the best if you do not like public speaking, but he does his best to make the class manageable and fun. He was very inspirational and easily one of my favorite professors.
Great prof who will help you get an A. Clear grading criteria and interesting classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I never write reviews, but Professor Uebel is the best professor I've had. He's understanding, fun, and cares about his students a lot. The exams are soo clear and straightforward, and he makes the class easy to succeed in as long as you show up and put in basic effort. Easily my favorite professor. If you have to take this class, take it with him.

you can tell he really cares about his students and the stuff he teaches. he handles sensitive topics very well. there is so much reading. there is participation during class and if you answer questions he will favor you. gives feedback on almost everything you submit which is very helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's very sweet and really wants to make sure all of his students succeed, he wrote me and many other classmates really good recommendation letters. Attendance is mandatory and his lectures are pretty dry, but there's a lot of group work. He's a pretty easy grader and gives away a lot of extra credit, would defiantly recommend.

Professor Uebel has been the best professor I've ever had. He gives great feedback and is very supportive and encouraging of his students. Lectures can get a little boring every once in a while, but he's not bad at all. He really cares for students and is always willing to help when asked.

Professor Uebel is very understanding and a good professor, but his lectures are based on PowerPoints, which makes it a little boring. Besides that, he is very understanding and lenient. His exams are based on information from the powerpoints, which is easy. The assignments are easy too. He is also a very good grader.

Uebel is a great guy. He was the only professor I had my freshman year that made an effort to get to know everyone of his students. There would be times I would show up early and we would just sit and talk about something other than class. He knows his stuff and makes it easy to understand. Lectures can be strenuous but not because of Uebel.

Professor Uebel really cares about each student and is dedicated in making it so every student succeeds. He has a lot of Human Resource experience and loves to talk about his experience. If you're interested in HR definitely take the class with him! He gives a lot of extra credit and amazing feedback on assignments.

Super nice guy, the class is not too hard some topics can get boring but it is more because of the topic itself not because he is making it boring. Gives great feedback and really wants every student to pass

I had Professor Uebel for Spring of 2021 and our class was asynchronous, meaning we had zooms every week. We have a few quizzes and homework assignments every other week, but they prepare you well for the final! Lectures are interesting and fun and he really gets the class involved! I would take him again!

Uebel is pretty middle of the road. He talks slowly about simple topics which is kind of boring. Even so, he is a nice guy with a lot of experience. I recommend taking Grundmann for this course instead if you want somebody a little more engaging.
Professor Uebel is such a nice guy and cares a lot about his students. If you pay attention in class, it's easy to do well. He has a lot of real world experience that I found really helpful!

Mark was very friendly, personable and caring about the students. He made the world of HR seem simple and brought a lot of real-world examples to class, as he had served 25+ years in HR. Slides were posted online for use in studying. His tests were all multiple choice and were all all easy. Would heavily suggest taking a class with him!
Professor Ursula was insanely self-involved and liked to hear herself speak.
No good professor. I learned nothing. Negative towards her students.

Dr. Kuhar has an amazing personality and is obviously a very knowledgeable person when it comes to Arts Management. As long as you take notes, participate and be present during her lectures you'll be fine. Follow all of her instructions on assignments and it's not difficult to get a good grade in this class! A great introduction to Arts Management.
Spends more time stroking her ego than actually teaching. If you want a good grade, just make sure to laugh extra hard at her jokes. Otherwise, good luck.

Be prepared to use no personal electronics in the class, meaning no phones, earbuds, or watches. Laptops are okay, but will result in a lower participation grade. She will yell, no exaggeration, if you use them in an unpermitted time. OFten, she acts brashly and claims to show respect to her "Arts Managers," but doesn't.

If you want to spend $70 on an extremely unimportant textbook while listening to a passive-aggressive teacher lecture for an hour and fifteen minutes, then this class is for you!! Only cares to remember certain people's names even if you participate a lot and lacks the charisma she so desperately tries to project. Certainly lives up to her name.

I LOVE Dr.Kuhar!!!! Not only is she an amazing professor but she is also an amazing human being. Her lectures are very engaging and she is a fun person to have conversations with. She has a ton of knowledge and cares deeply about her students. If I can take another class with her, I will! As long as you do the work, you will pass the class.

Loved this class! Took it my freshman year and felt that it was a solid introduction to Arts Management. She does tend to pick favorites but if you participate in class and care about the things you're learning she will like you. She's very helpful and explains things very well

Dr. K demands a lot, but she gives a lot too. She's responsive to email and willing to help if you ask. Sometimes the content is very straight forward and a no-brainer, and sometimes it's intense, but isn't that in every class? She's well-connected and her students go on and get top internship and jobsso she's doing something right.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Skip the days with guest speakers. Its almost impossible to sit through them talking for an hour and a half. The class is too long w not that much material. Kuhar is also very passive aggressive and I don't really like her or her style of teaching. Make sure you always refer to her as Dr. and not Mrs. or Ms. or she will get pissed.

I've taken three classes with Dr. K. Her classes are demanding, but you will learn a lot. She treats you like a colleague and not like a child like other professors. She also brings in great guest speakers who are happy to work with students afterward. If you want real world prep, take her classes (especially the special topics A450s).

She keeps class going even after its supposed to be over and will expect you to stay even if you have a class on the opposite side of campus and then send you a passive aggressive email about her not dismissing you and then docking you for attendance even though you spent the whole class (and then some) there listening to her. Avoid Kuhar.

Arts Education with Dr. K is a great class! Youll learn everything from pedagogy to policy. This seminar tends to be on the smaller side, so theres lots of good discussions that you dont see in larger SPEA classes. If you have any interest in education and outreach, you dont want to miss this one!
Horrible, worst professor ever. Do not take a class with her.

Kuhar is very difficult to understand. You either like her or you really dont. If she decides she doesn't like you... good luck passing the class. She is not enjoyable to be around what so ever. She also talks too much about her personal life, when none of her students care or remotely want to hear about it.
Brings in speakers that are hard to sit through. If you take this class I reccomend skipping those days.

Do not take this class with this professor you will regret it. She picks favorites and will not be kind to other students. I highly reccomend taking SPEA A 163 with ANYONE else but her. Absolutely awful, worst professor i've ever had.

Prof. Kuhar is one of my favorites I've had at IU. She's enthusiastic and relays the information in a really engaging way. She's the epitome of sunshine! I will say that you MUST do the assigned readings before class, because she asks for feedback and gets angry when no one read, which is valid since that's typically the only homework you'll have.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Kuhar is one of my favorite professors I have taken class with at IU. She is hilarious and energetic about what she teaches. Definitely take a class with her if you get the chance! Follow her grading criteria strictly and use correct grammar and you'll be golden.

Take A163 with Dr. Kuhar!!! She is fantastically hilarious, is always in a good mood, and wants you to learn. She is passionate about the field in which she teaches and wants you to succeed. She is a fairly tough grader but just listen to her feedback and you should be fine.
Great, enthusiastic professor with real-world experience. Highly recommend taking a class with her if you pay attention and are willing to participate.
Best prof and class.  I changed my major to this field because of the energy and excitement this professor brought to the content.
The pop quizzes are IMPOSSIBLE! For one of them she had to do a 29 point curve and a 19 point curve for the other. They are more like pop tests, so be sure to keep up with readings and attend class!
prof kuhar is exciting about teaching and explains things well. brings in cool speakers and will help you if you make an effort.

Dr. Urheim was an excellent professor for Basic Physics of Sound. It will be a hard class, but read the syllabus and use it to your advantage (quiz drops, late homework, etc.). He's more than willing to help with questions via email or office hours.

He is super nice and gets really excited about the lectures. The lectures are kinda boring but not terrible. You can skip class every once and a while and it won't hurt because he posts all the slides, but he does occasionally have in-class quizzes. The homework isn't hard, but he doesn't always teach how to do the problems in class.

Not the best and not the worst. He speaks clearly and his lectures aren't hard to listen to. Get an old copy of the book even if he says you won't need it. They're super cheap if you rent online. Unlimited attempts on homework problems, a few quizzes (you usually get 5 or 6 points out of 10 just for writing your name) and three tests. Not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lab course the requires a large amount of effort about once or twice a week. Urheim was extremely understanding and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He was a very good professor. His explanations in class are very clear, but you don't actually have to go to to get an A anyways. If you follow along the book or have any back ground in physics at all, this is a great GPA boosting class. I would describe classes as the fun side of boring.

fairly demanding course, webwork every week which is always a pain in the ass. Hard to predict what's on tests, but definitely should study. The course curve is nice and you if you have an interest in sound then you at least won't regret taking the course.

I wouldn't suggest taking this class unless you have to. I thought it would be cool because I am interested in physics, but there is too much of an emphasis on music and sound. I don't know why I wasn't tipped off by the class name. He can be confusing at times, the most you will learn is from the classes before tests. Not terrible, has big curve
Super fun class, he loves to talk with students, in general he's the GOAT.  Favorite professor I've had so far.
Come to class prepared to participate and speak the language. He's tough to work with and learn from at some times, but if you know and enjoy the course, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: You only need to purchase the workbook and Die Band, the small white book is not necessary to pass the class.
Instructor Urena was a great sociology teacher. At is a bit mandatory since you need to get the notes for class but she makes sociology Very understandable and makes you like sociology.
love her!!! she's so sweet and just casual!! she's what it truly means to be a good instructor . her class taught me so much so grateful for her!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor. She genuinely cares about what she teaches and will always encourage discussion, different perspectives, and learning. I think that she has to be one of the best profs at IU and amazing overall. The readings are not bad at all and the tests are straightforward as long as you complete study guide.

Prof. Urena is amazing. So nice and sweet and very funny. her lectures aren't posted to canvas so you have to attend each one to not miss anything. the class structure is basically just having to memorize and understand all of the terminology gone over in lecture, but she makes everything easy to understand with good explanations. great class!

Professor Urena makes sociology very accessible and understandable. The course did not take a lot of extra time outside of class, even when studying for exams. There are 3 allowed absences for the semester but she does not post the notes, so make sure to get in touch with other people in the class if you miss lectures.

Amazing instructor. Extremely engaged with students - super instructive while remaining accessible and respectful of them as fellow professionals. His class easily had the most lively discussions Ive seen in the ILS program. Also, just a fun dude to listen to. Highly, highly recommended.

I loved this class. It's true he is a strict grader, but he cares a lot about the subject, he was super into it you could tell. I never saw him be rude to anyone, always really nice and always willing to work with me. Got to watch a lot of great movies, great talks. Thumbs way up.

This guy is interested in what he is doing, but pretends he is an English Professor. He likes papers and wants to grade as hard as possible on them. He likes group work as well. He is rude at times. For example, the professor and I were talking and he simply walked away in the middle of the conversation.

Jessica is super nice and does an amazing job teaching even confusing concepts. She's a lawyer and often shares stories from her career when they are applicable to the material which I found fascinating. Takes attendance via a question at the beginning of class usually over the assigned reading... get the book. This class made me interested in law!
She's very intelligent. Go to class and pay attention and literally it's so easy. But you also learn a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: By far one of the best teachers I have had at IU. She will not only put everything into terms that are easy for you to understand and relate to your own life, but she will also make the class interesting and fun so that you don't even want to miss a class. I highly recommend her

When I logged onto rate my prof to check out all the teachers I'd be getting next year to see what I'd be in for I had a shock. Jessica Ulm was said to have unconquerable BAR level tests and said to be the strictest grader of essays around. These things couldn't be farther from the truth.  TestsSuper Easy EssaysStandard ProfessorSmokin'

Jessica has power points everyday in class. Sometimes they are posted online, but a big part of the class is attending and discussing. You have a mock trial, a mock draw up of a contract, and etc. If you have an interest in going to law school, consider this class mandatory. If you have any questions, just ask her. She is always willing to help. :)
Knows the material very well & seems to enjoy it. Class was more difficult than I expected, but she was one of the best professors I've ever had...challenging & wasn't an easy A, but worthwhile.

She knows the material very well, however teaches this 200-level class like a class in law school. Her final is 100 questions from the Bar Exam! Heard the other 220 class if MUCH easier, and would suggest taking that class.

Professor Velasquez is a great instructor, and a lot of the things she talks about in her courses are really fun, engaging, and thoughtful. On the other hand, grading can feel kind of subjective, quiz questions can be really detailed and some assignment prompts almost felt misleading at times. It's a lot of work for a 103

This class isn't terrible, but for a 100-level gen-ed it demands a lot. Attendance is strict, though extra credit is offered. I missed an extra credit opportunity due to an emergency, and the professor was not understanding. There are better options to fulfill this requirement.

I took Work Hard, Pray Hard and I thought the readings were super interesting. Attendance does matter for your self-evaluation at the end of the semester and they also keep track of it too. It is a very easy class, just pay attention and show up to class. You only meet three times a week in total. Not many things are graded heavy, so try your best.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof V is amazing. You have a lot of reading, but class discussions are amazing, and will help you grow as a thinker as well as a "scholar" as she likes to call us. She believes in all of her students, and she gives you the freedom to write any way you wish. She truly allows you to use your strengths in the classroom. She's just incredible.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I took Work Hard, Pray Hard. There were at least 3 or 4 readings each week, and they were LONG. She doesn't believe in giving out letter grades, so I won't know what my grade is until break. The paper and the final presentation were easy. There were a few extra credit opportunities at the beginning of the semester. The lectures are student led.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Sonia is a great professor--super helpful and fun. You'll learn a lot.

Vanessa is fine as a professor; she explained the content well and made the grading criteria for the class very clear. The overall structure of Y103 can be annoying at times and the platform for the weekly homework assignments is ridiculously time consuming at times. Midterm and final are also 100 multiple choice questions which is....
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I hated this class. We had to read so much and she didn't even teach. She read directly off the slides. Her lectures weren't engaging or interesting at all. So boring.

This class was one of my more boring ones but I enjoyed it. Weekly readings/ quizzes covering the chapters and the lectures then cover the chapters. Midterm and final dictate your grade mainly but you get a "cheat sheet" on each of these. As long as you do the weekly quizzes and semi pay attention in lecture you should be good!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There's lots of textbook reading to do, and in lectures she mainly just teaches the textbook. There are options to participate in lectures, and review sessions before the midterm and the final. If you do most of the readings and are prepared, lectures are easy and the tests aren't too bad. You can write a paper for extra credit.
