Lectures take longer than needed and in-class "games" were poorly made. Homework is terribly made and graded. Extra credit leads to everyone getting an A. For before class assignments, just control F textbook and make a quizlet then you'll do fine on exams. Half the questions you miss on the exam will get removed because of poor wording anyways.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Incredibly enthusiastic but spends the whole class going over something that could be done in 15 minutes. Homework is super vague and graded hard. Gives a ton of extra credit but you need to go to class for participation, so just do other work and BS the in class assignment. Exam questions are poorly written and most questions get tossed anyway.
Hate is definitely uncalled for. She is an easy grader, a good explainer, and the content on the exams is directly from the slides and the textbook.

The professor is dedicated, offering extra credit and fair exams. Her assignment instructions are often unclear, delays in clarifications frustrate proactive students. Response times to emails are slow, leaving students confused and forced to redo work. Clearer guidelines and quicker, precise replies would greatly improve the learning experience.

Class time was extremely pointless and made me feel like I was in elementary school, and the 3 homework assignments were massive headaches and incredibly vague. Also she never gave us a straight answer to our questions and kept content on assessments as a secret. However, it was evident that she was genuinely trying and gave tons of extra credit.
Class content could be learned in a day but class is made unecssiarily time consuming.
Some of the feedback here is a little over the top in my view. Not my favorite professor or class by any means, but not bad. I personally have not experienced her to be rude.

Had Godfrey for M450, not M304. Absolute WORST professor I've had in my Kelley career. She micromanages students, changed the entire class structure based on an in-class survey, and assignments contribute absolutely nothing to the learning experience. Missed ICE's require significantly more effort than being in class. Absolutely ruined my semester.

This class was completely arbitrary, and the class felt like I was being talked down to for the entire time. The activities brought me back to elementary school with how pointless and time-wasting this class was. My time would have been better spent sleeping.

Exams and grades are completely arbitrary. Hands out significant extra credit in class, nullifying exam grades, and rather than rewarding hardworking students. Test structure built to trick students, in-class assignments daily which are not valuable or thought-provoking by any metric.

Mo is genuinely the absolute best professor you could take for an upper-level lab like this. He's incredibly kind, understanding, and wants you to succeed above all else. He explains things so well and thoroughly, and always gives ample time for any kind of assignment. I couldn't recommend him more, he made a daunting course (in concept) a breeze.
Such an easy prof. SO nice and caring, I stopped going to class after the first couple of weeks, but his lectures are super interesting. He doesn't take attendance. All exams online
Easy class. All the exams were online. Just do the work you need to do outside of class and you'll be fine.

He cancels class a decent amount if we are ahead and barely goes to end of class time. He's super nice and cares a lot about his students. I took Intro to Psych and all quizzes are open note on your own time and class does not take place on those days. Attendance isn't mandatory but he occasionally has ICAs. He posts slides every class.
He is so nice and wants all of his students to do well. I recommend taking a class with him. I believe having him as a professor is the easiest way to get an "A+" in a difficult class. Funny guy.
Great professor.
He's amazing

This class was so easy. Probably the easiest course I've ever taken. Attendance is not mandatory but there are occasional in class activities worth points, but "Mo" was one of my favorite professors. He is very understanding and will work with you if something confuses you, however everything is very straight forward.

Prof Zerrouk was awesome. He was so kind, caring, and funny. His class was easy to get an A in, and he genuinely wanted us to learn. He also clearly knew what he was talking about. I highly recommend taking a class with him!!

Easiest Gen-Ed. All tests are online and open note, and his assignments are very straightfoward and easy. You would have to try to not get an A. His lectures are funny and informative. Would 100% recommend taking psych 101 with him.

Prof Zerrouk is one of the most chill and kind professors I've had at IU. He understands that students have a life outside of class and is very flexible and willing to accommodate things for students. His class is very chill and there's no way you can get a bad grade if you literally submit anything. I recommend taking your capstone class with him.

Mo was one of my favorite professors I've had at IU. His lectures were always funny and engaging, and he did a lot to help us understand the material. He also provided several opportunities to get extra credit, and the assignments we did have were very easy. The tests were open-note and remote, and were easy to take if you put the effort in.

Mo is an amazing professor. I had him for P101, and his lectures were always hilarious. He's also really lax when it comes to assignments, and there's a lot of EC opportunities. All the tests were take-home and open-note. You could miss 90% of the classes and still get an easy A. Definitely recommend.
The best professor at IU! He's an easy grader and genuinely cares about his students and course material.

I would 100% take this class again if I had to. Best professor ever! The classwork is very easy and straightforward. There are exams, but the in class review session is very similar to the exam. Very easy A.

Dr. Mo is the best. If you want an easy A+ with minimal effort, he's your guy. However, if you actually care about psychology, it's very easy to take away a lot from his class. He's the easiest grader on the planet. All exams are open-book and online, plus you can retake any exam/assignment if you just ask. Plus, he cares about what he teaches.
He is amazing so far! Highly recommend he is very understanding.
I would highly recommend Professor MO. Best Professor ever! There is so much extra credit, along with open note exams. Added bonus, the class average was an A.
Great prof

This class and professor are amazing! He made me love psychology. This is one of the easiest classes you can take. To succeed in this class all you need to do is attend lectures and take notes! There are only small assignments and a few exams. I highly recommend this class! Mo is so funny and provides great lessons!
Professor Mo is an amazing professor. He has plenty of opportunities for you to increase your grade. His lectures can be kind of long and boring but he understands that. Attendance is VERY flexible!

If you want to take psych, definitely take it with Mo. Very funny, nice, and understanding professor. All exams are online and open note, he's very understanding of circumstances and responds to emails ASAP, always available to help and one of the best profs out there.
Mo was a great professor and one of the best psych professors I have had. He is super understanding and kind he wants the best for all his students and I recommend taking classes with him!

I loved attending his psychology lectures. He definitely is very engaging and his classes are an easy A. All exams and finals are online and open note so really the main drive to going to class is being interested in the topic. Solid professor.

Amazing professor! Super understanding. Funny, but it doesn't get in the way of lectures. There are 4 take home open note exams, 11 reflection assignments (only have to do 6), and occasional In-Class participation assignments. I wish I could take more classes with him in the future.

I had Mo for P211 and he was awesome! Methods isn't the most interesting course ever, but Mo makes up for it by trying to make lectures as engaging and comprehensive as possible. He cares a lot about his students and ensures you have access to plenty of exam review materials and guides for your paper.

I took his experimental psych class and it was GREAT!!! Not a lot of homework, there are just reading assignments (maybe one every 2-3 weeks), and 4 ONLINE exams even though this class was in person. And one final research proposal as the final!! Also, he is hilarious and keeps the lectures very engaging even if it's very boring material. TAKE HIM!

MO! Absolutely one of the coolest professors I've ever had! Going to his classes is like refreshing yourselves and your mind. They're super chill, so much fun and engaging and super easy too! He gives loads of extra credit opportunities, and his assignments extremely help in preparing for exams (which are again open note, and online). TAKE HIM!!

Very clear with how he gives information to students. I have seen people say the tests are confusing, and they are going to be when they're open note tests. Very funny and tries to be engaged with the students.

If you can get him for PSY-P211 do it! He is an amazing teacher and very understanding. His lectures are so interesting and he makes the reviews for exams so well that it really hard to fail any exam.

I had Prof Zerrouk for Methods & he was so kind, attentive, and understanding. The content for methods can be dull and he admits as much, but he did everything in his power to make this an enjoyable, engaging class. I appreciated his effort to remember everyone's names and his willingness to thoroughly answer any and all questions after class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took him for Methods of Experimental Psych, Mo was amazing and tried his best to make lectures fun. He gives good extra credit opportunities that really helped my grade. He cares for his students and tries to improve in any way he can. He also tries to learn his student's names and that makes him stand out.

Such an amazing class and professor! I always looked forward to coming to class. It is very interactive and there are many extra credit opportunities. He is also very considerate of outside-of-school events and wants to ensure you never feel overwhelmed with schoolwork but can get everything done.

I hated this class and "Mo" was a nice guy, but the exams were hard to understand, AND they just randomly change the due dates of assignments and give you less than 3 hours notice. I did not appreciate the stress this class brought on especially when it was supposed to be a gen-ed.
Mo is the goat, he is a very charismatic guy and is super easy. Take his class for a easy N%M credit

He's a great teacher no flaws, very invested in the students opinion and he involves them for certain lessons. Only issue with him is that he's a Manchester United fan but apart from that he's a real G

Professor Mo is a G! He is able to make lectures enjoyable with his humor and real life connections. Attendance is not entirely mandatory, but occasionally he will give an in-class question that will account for attendance. He is open to feedback with exams, questions, or scheduling. Assignments are weekly creative writing reflection (Easy).

I loved INTL210 with Professor Zajac. Her lectures were well-prepared and relevant to the assigned readings. Attendance at lectures is not mandatory but they definitely helped me understand the material. For discussions, you also get 3 unexcused absences but there is a participation grade so you still need to show up. I highly recommend this class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Justyna is a good professor, but her grading is tough and unclear. I would've passed if I attended 2 more classes but she won't budge. There was 2 different syllabus on canvas and the one I looked at didn't have clear grading criteria nor tell me missing x days results in a 0. I attended >75% of classes. Be prepared, tests and assignments are rough

Best professor at IU. She is incredibly kind and knowledgeable. She has the perfect amount of content prepared for class, and it feels like she rehearses her presentations. She grades fairly and explains her rationale for giving out assignments. She is kind, put-together, and inspirational.

Zajac herself isn't a hard grader and the course itself isn't that difficult, but her TA is an extremely hard grader and will not hesitate to dock points for arbitrary errors. Also, don't miss the first 10 mini quizzes (they actually count a lot for your grade).

Based solely off course content and lectures, Professor Zajac is 11/10 the BEST prof for diplomacy - every class is extremely engaging and fun to follow along even for non-majors. However, the grading structure is horridly deflated and very stressful - even with the extra credit, you will really need to work for that A

Professor Zajac is a great lecturer and she really knows how to engage her students. The course topics were interesting, but it was difficult to stay engaged since all the "tests" are open book and online. If you are good at self motivation you can still learn a lot though. It truly is what you make of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are very few assignments/quizzes that make up your whole grade with little to no extra credit. Her AI grades almost everything and gives back no positive feedback, making it hard to improve. Harsh grading too. No one got perfect grades. You will have to work for an A. It was my worst grade of the semester. Lots of valuable content though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Zajac is a good professor and explains complex political and historical topics in a clear way. The class is extremely interesting and I would say my favorite class so far here at IU. The class is graded by a few things though and is a lot of reading that I did not find necessary. The class is worth it if you are interested in government.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is one of the best professors I have had at Indiana University. Her lecture slides were clear and very to the point. She is always available if you struggle with something, and she makes complicated topics easy to understand. Also, the class I took with her definitely involved a lot of writing; writings were the majority of the grade.

This class is not too difficult but there are a few things to be aware of. The class is out of 100 points and 45 of those points are these short free-response questions that are almost impossible to get a 100% on. So make sure to try your absolute best on each assignment because due to the grading system it is hard to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super sweet. Polish accent but still easily understood. She is super nice, but very few points. Lectures were optional. One paper, 3 quizzes, and a final. The quizzes/exams are all open note but timed. Not terribly difficult but some questions are vague. If you email her, she will sometimes give you points back if you send pics from the notes.
I really enjoyed Professor Zajac's class! Lectures can get a bit boring at times, but her slideshows were very informative and she provided a lot of good insight into the topics we were studying.

Professor Zajac has great powerpoints that include most of the information found in the textbook, along with nearly all of the information on the quizzes. She makes studies guides that are useful and prepare you for your quizzes as well. If you pay attention and/or read the assigned text, the class is not very difficult, and you will learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I very much did not enjoy this class. Majority of your grade is determined by a few 10 point quizzes that have multiple correct answers but you're asked to choose the "best one". Lectures are extremely boring and the powerpoints do not provide adequate information to study with later on. Write down every word or you won't pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely respected in the intl sec community (read her academic papers). The AI (Prof Xia) is your best friend if you are genuinely interested in the topic. Few grades, and the quizzes are pretty tough ngl. Use the study guide she provides and make a point to ask follow-up questions abt current events or lectures. She writes good letters of rec.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lectures cover only same material read in textbooks, very redundant. She eliminated an entire session for our class. Your grade is also based on five assignments and a final exam, all of which are fairly difficult. She takes points off for arbitrary things. I do not recommend taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Zajac is amazing and one of the few that really stands out at HLS as caring, inspirational, kind, and unbiased in her teaching! She makes lectures fun by incorporating current events and some of her own experiences. Her class is well-structured, not stressful, and easy to be successful in!

Professor Zajac was very clear in her lectures, regularly reviewed material through short worksheets at the end of class, and consistently made sure to post study guides and be very clear about the information that students would be tested on. A very kind, sweet, and fair woman!! Take her class!!
The way she lectures is great, she has clear powerpoints and the tests are fairly easy if you study. A very sweet woman and would recommend her classes.

Love her. So nice and her class was both easy and straightforward. Show up to the lectures, take notes, get an A on the exams. 3 exams and 1 tiny paper that isn't hard at all. Her lectures were interesting and I enjoyed all of them. Takes attendance and will give extra-credit if you don't miss more than two classes. Definitely take any of her class
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Kind and funny professor. She definitely cares about what she teaches but has been doing it for a while, so may leave some things out sometimes. All material on lecture is fair game. Always do the Extra Cred. Might help to sit down and look over lecture BEFORE class. Review all slides/ EC/lecture quiz answers before exams too.

She is sweet but dont depend on her to TEACH u. She's fast n speak in a montone voice (also the building's mic fault for being old). U have only urself to rely on (or TAs/UTAs, they're so nice I love them). Just go to class for the attendance n do notes on ur own pace/some other classwork. Memorize EC exams, its helpful for the FC exams.

I had her and she was nice week one before the drop deadline and then I realized that she could not hear any questions being asked and would ignore them and then she started skipping nearly entire sections. She is fun in terms of having the absolute craziest stories ever like her dad trying to SELL HER?! Nice lady but BAD professor. SOOOO bad.

She was a sweet professor, but her lectures were often difficult to follow. Each class covered an overwhelming amount of material, sometimes 50 slides or more. Despite putting in significant effort to study, I couldn't do well on her exams. The only thing that helped my grade was the extra credit exams, which raised it from a D to a C.

She is very hard to follow in lecture, she jumps all over the place and just reads from 80+ slides every class. Discussions are very helpful to determine the most important information. Lots of extra credit opportunities but the tests are hard due to her weird word choice that purposefully confuses you.

Lectures are very straight-forward but she moves really fast so it's important to spend time outside of class learning the material. The tests are pretty average and she drops the lowest test and some quiz grades. Also, it's very easy to earn extra credit if you attend lecture and complete the extra credit exams.

Bless Prof. Chooi's heart but her lectures are boring and hard to follow. I highly recommend going to class for the attendance grade, but focus on taking notes from the provided slides on canvas at you own pace because she will spend an enormous amount of time on figures that aren't relevant to the quizzes or tests. However, she is kind and caring!

Professor Chooi is caring, smart, and funny. She offers multiple opportunities for extra credit up to 10% but you can't have more than 2 absences. It's not impossible to do well in her class, you just have to keep up with her pacing and do a lot of work outside of class.

Dr. Chooi is great! The lectures can be a little difficult to keep up with at first, but you get used to it. She always cracks jokes and cares about what she teaches. Just be prepared to study some complex topics and a quick pace. Extra credit exams and attendance are very generous and worth the extra effort. She cares about your success.

Chooi is a great prof and she's really smart and knows what she's talking about. Attendance is mandatory and if you miss more than 2 classes you cannot receive any extra credit. She's really nice and has great humor. The class itself is a LOT of memorization but other than that it's not bad at all. She also ends class like 40 mins early.

At the start of the year she said, "either you love me or you hate me." Sadly, I disliked her due to the mass amounts of material and poor lecture style it was hard to stay motivated and engaged in the class to succeed well. If you have loads of free time, then take this class, but it's very test heavy with little to no guide on what will be tested

Dr. Chooi is a great professor. Although her lectures can be a bit boring, you can tell she cares about the material and knows it well. She clearly cares about her students as well. Overall, this class is pretty easy as long as you study and go to class and discussion. There is also opportunity for a ton of extra credit which is great.

Lecture heavy but does not always cover material that appears as questions on the test. Many opportunities to gain extra credit in the class, and the quizzes are a great way to practice for the exam. Discussions were very helpful, and the TAs were very accessible for additional help.

Lectures can be a bit dry, but Chooi knows her stuff. Lots of extra credit and exam flexibility to balance it out. unstuck study was a lifesaver for practice questions - definitely recommend using it alongside the textbook.

Only take L112 with Yean Chooi if you already have a PhD in Biology. Her class is incredibly difficult to follow – there is no pattern to her teaching style, it is always completely unclear what you will be tested on, and her presentation skills are terrible for such an important class. Good luck if its too late to switch

Professor Chooi is very funny and informative in her lectures. Lectures sometimes drag or Chooi may start to ramble a bit, but the lectures are typically great and help with understanding of the material. Very few assignments outside of tests. Very generous extra credit (up to 10%). Prepares students well for tests, and cares about her students.

Lectures are very boring mostly reading off of dense slideshows. Exams where not open not and questions were ultra specific points from the slideshows. There was lots of extra credit through extra credit exams and attendance. The class is defiantly doable if you put in the work yourself to learn and memorize information outside of class.

The lectures were boring; she talked very quietly, and her slides had too much information. Her exams were mainly based on memorization rather than concept understanding. The exams were really difficult and had very specific questions on small details in her lecture. Please save yourself and do not take her class.

Coming from someone whose last bio class was in my freshman year of high school, this class was a bit challenging but nothing too bad. Professor Chooi has a soft voice so I'd suggest sitting in front for lectures. She gives a lot of extra credit; if you attend lectures and do the quizzes/exams, you can get a B or higher in the class.
Most boring lectures I have ever sat through, put me to sleep every single time. Skips around slides randomly and a bad lecturer in general.

She is fine. Her lectures are probably the most boring lectures youll sit through in your entire college career. At times you'll ask yourself if she even knows what shes talking about. Her lecture attendance is mandatory but she will probably be the worst lecturer you will have in terms of actually teaching. All the work in the class is easy.

Chooi applied a curve for the final that either lowers or raises your exam grade. She does that because she gives out a limited number of As. So if you are on the lower end of As, like a 93.1, the curve she applies will drop you to an A-. Happened to me and my friends. So be careful.
Lectures are boring and sleepy.
There is extra credit though.
dont recommend

She genuinely put me to sleep. I thought it was just me at first but I look over at many of my classmates with eyes shut as well. I used to love biology but she made an introductory level so hard for no reason. Her lectures don't help with what you'll be tested on. She offers lots of extra credit though.
Helpful, but the lectures can be quick, and it takes a lot of effort to do well in this class.

From the time I spent in class, Professor Choi seemed like a very nice person. However, I ended up having to drop the class. The lectures were incredibly hard to keep up with, even if I read the textbook beforehand. If you are not passionate about bio/not bio major, I don't recommend taking this class.

Prof. Chooi was amazing. The course was difficult but definitely nothing I couldn't handle. I had a b+ before all the extra credit was put in at the end of the semester and ended with an a+. Overall amazing professor that will make sure you understand the content and is available outside class.

Prof. Chooi is kind and passionate about biology, but I found the lectures to be very fast paced and mundane.  I guess this is how an entry level bio course works, though!  Lots of extra credit opportunities and small quizzes that help boost your grade, which makes up for the tough exams.  Don't fall behind on lectures.

Chooi does not deserve any slander she is such a sweet women who wants all of her students to succeed and always asks for our opinions and ways she can improve. Every class is a powerpoint lecture but she explains everything in depth and goes at a good pace. It is very easy to get an A, most quizzes are open-note and there's a ton of extra credit.

Pretty good professor.  She has a doctorate and is so sophisticated and knows a lot on all her subjects.  Very lecture heavy. Like the whole class is just sit and stare at the screen while they go over slides, but ig that's every class nowadays.  But she is a great professor and offers lots of extra credit and help.

She gives a lot of extra credit. The only way to fail this class is to not attend class and miss you major tests. Attendance is not mandatory, it is just extra credit. As long as you take the Extra credit exam, most of the test questions on the test is the same as EC exam that you can just search the internet for the answer

Chooi was incredibly knowledge about her lectures. While the material is dense and not incredibly interesting I always felt that I understood the material after her lectures. She has many extra credit opportunities and drops the lowest exam and quiz.

She skipped around in her lectures a lot which wasn't really conducive to learning. However, if you take bio 112 with her, you will most likely get an A. She's a good person. I don't really think teaching is where her heart is at. She knows a bunch of famous people and will tell you the tea on almost every biologist ever mentioned in her class lol

She is possibly one of the best Bio teachers here. She was very responsive to student feedback. Her class is lecture heavy, but with all the information she has to get across, it has to be. She would bring in things she found interesting outside of curriculum. The extra credit exams were amazing too. Very easy to get an A in this class.

Gave lot's of extra credit. All exams were taken online at home, open note and open internet search. All quizzes and exam were straight forward and right out of lecture. Discussion is mandatory and you take quizzes that are NOT open note, but they review right before and overall they're easy

Take the class with Chooi. She is the best Biology teacher at IU Bloomington. She's literally god-tier. She offers plenty of extra credit and exams are open-note, open computer, and on canvas. The only thing to watch out for about the class is that all attendance is mandatory; for both lecture and discussion.

All her quizzes and exams were open note, open internet, and open book and all were take-home. Even though it's open to anything, just know you still have to know some of the material taught because some things are not found online! She gives notes and her lectures are about going over them so she gives you hints on what will be on the test.

Prof Chooi is super nice and really cares about her students. She also gives up to 10% extra credit at the end of the semester. However, her tests can be a little difficult at times, but they are multiple choice. Overall, I would take her again!

I am not someone who is a natural when it comes to science. I found the quizzes and exams despite being open note, internet, and book, were still very difficult. Many of the questions contained multiple correct answers and asked for the "most correct" one. However, she does give a lot of opportunity to get help and gain extra credit with is awesome

I have never been a fan of biology but Professor Chooi made this class enjoyable. She gives lots of opportunities for you to succeed in this class and is available through email to answer questions and concerns. If you attend class and take advantage of the extra credit there is no reason not to get an A in this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: hated the lectures, no additional materials given to help, TAs were not understanding at all, don't take this class with her
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Chooi, is amazing. Lectures are mandatory especially if you want to receive extra credit towards the end of the semester. This class is test heavy but exams are open note/book. She makes sure all of students succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Chooi is a very good lecturer, funny and interesting. But her assignments and quizzes are far too easy. All quizzes are open note-open internet-multiple choice. We are learning about the complex workings of the cell and I didn't have to study all semester to pull an easy A.

There is a lot of extra credit and the tests were a mix of straight from the textbook answers while there was a handful of real life application questions. The discussion quizzes were really easy. I would recommend getting as much extra credit as possible with attendance and the extra credit tests and studying the extra credit exams to pass.

Took during COVID. We had to watch video lectures & take a quiz every week. Read the textbook. Her quizzes and exams can be randomly specific so you need to take notes over literally everything. She gives extra credit to boost your final grade by up to 10%. Lectures were boring but informative. Not an easy A, but if u put in the work you'll do fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved her! Shes funny yet knowledgeable, lectures are informative, study guides prepare you for tests, and extra credit is given based on attendance. One of the first classes I took in college and shes still one of my favorites.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very unorganized and will randomly skip slides and switch topics mid sentence. The TAs and UTAs were extremely helpful because Choois lectures are random and difficult to follow
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chooi is very knowledgeable about her subject, extremely detailed and slightly boring lectures but I feel like I've learned a lot. Lots of extra credit available if you have perfect attendance, no homework, and overall a very interesting lady. Always gives an extra credit exam the class before the actual exam that was great for studying!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Chooi is generally really boring in lecture, but randomly has really funny moments sometimes. Whole class is graded on tests, which are basically just straight from the notes. Gives TONS of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: kind of funny sometimes but so monotoned and absolutely no help. I showed up to her office hours twice and she failed to show both times. After this, I went up to her after class and she just told me to email her. Her tests are impossible and lectures are insanely boring. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: As a professor, I wasn't a fan of Chooi. She put me to sleep almost every day and all of the info for the exams was already on the powerpoint, so no need to take notes. That being said, it's very easy to get an A. She gives crazy extra credit (primarily based on attendance) and gives practice exams that are almost exactly the same as the real ones.

Lectures are very boring but try and pay attention and write notes. Discussion quizzes are easy but the exams are hard. Chooi herself is a very interesting and respected professor. You can tell she is very intelligent and knows a lot about biology.

Very easy class overall. Simply go to class and you will get a ton of extra credit at the end. If you pay attention to lectures, take decent notes, and do the review guides/tests it is an easy A. Plus, Chooi is absolutely hilarious during lectures.

I found her lectures to be extremely boring, since all she does is read off of the lecture slides, which are shared with you. The quizzes are really easy, the AI's give you the answers before you take the quiz. There is no homework, but there is a bunch of extra credit, such as extra credit tests, quizzes, and for attendance.

Professor Chooi is a very intelligent and interesting professor. She does have a strict attendance policy but its not hard to abide by and is a large part of your grade. Theres no homework, but there are tests and quizzes, which arent too bad if you attend lectures and study your notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable on the topic and likes what she teaches. Her class is very lecture heavy without much class engagement. She can be funny but it is usually because of her bluntness. The tests are very manageable. The content is explicitly from class. Reading the textbook really helps. She gives massive extra credit but you need perfect attendance

This class is pretty difficult. She gives lots of extra credit that can boost your grade but the tests are still difficult and there are pop quizzes. The lectures are really boring, I fall asleep sometimes. She is very sweet and super knowledgable but that doesn't make the class any easier. Unless you're a good test taker, wouldn't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you go to lecture all year she gives a ton of extra credit at the end of the semester, can bump your grade up at a lot. If you go to class the tests aren't too difficult
Funny, good teacher, very knowledgeable. Gives lots of extra credit, just pay attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very funny and invested in her classes

She posts lectures on Canvas and these are helpful to look through before class! Also, she gives a lot of extra credit! She is funny and really does care about the students and has help available every week!

She really offers a lot in the fact that all the quizzes are extra credit and she has an extra credit exam before every real exam and she will drop your lowest exam grade and it could be the final if you wanted it to be!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is really nice and caring but I would definitely go to her weekly and exam reviews because they really help!

Dr. Chooi gives crazy extra credit. However, you have to meet very specific things to get the extra credit. She puts the EC in the last possible day. I suppose this way students cannot question mistakes on EC eligibility that she made. She is very lecture heavy but is extremely boring. Test are difficult and very long. Final was over 100 questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Immunology is quite detailed and technical.  Professor Chooi enthusiastically presents the material and tells great stories to keep the class engaged.  She emphasizes important points and offers abundant extra credit, which is extremely generous for an upper-level course.  Studying in advance is key to achieving high marks, especially on the final.

Class is super disorganized. Show up to class and rack up as many extra credit points on the quizzes as possible. The material on the tests and quizzes is not clear. But since there is also extra credit on the exams it is not a big deal. The final exam was ridiculous. It was way too specific since the exam was cumulative.

I failed biology my first semester, so I retook it with prof Chooi.  Her tests were MUCH easier and she gives so much extra credit.  You have 3 tests and a final.  She drops the lowest test score (besides the final).  You can earn up to 10% extra credit just by showing up to class every day. Professor Chooi is hilarious.  I would take her again.

Professor Chooi must be one of my favorite biology teachers yet. Her class is set up in a manner where you are not having to worry about the delicate balance of your grade and therefore get to focus on the material actually being taught and expand from it. This is not to say that she hands you an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If u are struggling w a concept, she will flat out tell u she won't help. She doesn't cover everything in lecture that u need for tests. AIs get frustrated too.  Very bad teacher. I don't see how anyone passes her class.  The info in her lectures doesn't match the info in the book, someone is wrong.  She will do the topics earlier than stated.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Chooi does a good job of explaining tough concepts but can be off-putting when she inserts her stance on things such as parenting, abortion, weight, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: You can tell that she is only a professor so she can get her research paid for. She gets all of her lecture slides straight off of the internet. She has no plan when she starts class, and it's very unorganized. She gives extra credit to make up for her inability to teach.

she is very funny during her lectures, but also extremely disorganized and for the most part the actual lecture content is presented in a boring way. talks about her personal life and then rushes through the remaining material. she offers an obscene amount of extra credit, so it wasn't actually difficult at all.

She is a very intelligent woman, but as an instructor she is subpar. She usually flies through slides and spends a lot of time on things that don't seem all that important. It's easy to do well considering her tests and the obscene amount of extra credit given; however, I'm not confident that I learned what I should have from this class.

Chooi is probably the most entertaining Biology professor I will ever have. Her tests are poorly written but they're relatively easy, and given the amount of extra credit that she gives (I went from a 90 to a 98 after EC), I will not complain. Hardly takes any effort to get an A in this class. You won't regret taking it. Don't need textbook.

She had her AIs do all the work yet she was still the most disorganized professor I've ever had. Sometimes she would talk about the material, other times she would talk about her personal life. She treated us like middle schoolers during tests. We couldn't leave until an hour had passed so you just sat around. We couldn't use the bathroom either.

Very knowledgeable and friendly. Exams are fair. Lectures are peppered with extended personal anecdotes and long tangents that distract from material and result in a disorganized lecture structure. She offers possibly too much extra credit.  Though I like Dr. Chooi, I wish she had used her lectures to teach us more.

I don't know how prof Chooi could receive bad reviews. She was great for human biology and super easy to understand and hilarious. Plus, she gives extra credit opportunities for everything as long as you have perfect attendance! All assigned hw is ec and you get ec exams in addition to full credit. I thought I would fail but she spoiled us.

Prof. Chooi is hilarious. Class doesn't follow the book at all but if you study her lecture notes the tests are not too difficult. Very large extra credit opportunity however, you must go to every single lecture if you want the extra credit.

Your grade is determined by three tests so if you are not a good test taker do not take! Extra credit is given but you must attend every class to receive it. Lectures do not cover all that is on tests.

Chooi was an amazing professor. She gives out extra credit A LOT - attendance (but on a sign in sheet), EC exams, and quizzes. All the extra credit bumped me up from a C+ to an A. Lot of material, but she understands that, so she does well in explaining everything. You can tell that she is passionate about her field of study. 1010 would reccomend

Prof Chooi is funny and helpful. Her class was a great intro class and got me really excited about my major. She offers a ton of extra credit and even gives extra credit exams. Attendance is absolutely mandatory if you want the extra credit. Loved this class!

Gives an obscene amount of extra credit and genuinely wants everyone to do well. Lectures cover the basics, but time outside of class needs to be taken to get an  A (as with most classes). Class was slightly unorganized, but the class was always updated on changes. She made the class interesting and is very funny.

She is very smart and kind but her class is SO unorganized. I was never sure of her expectations. Provides powerpoints that are useless. Must read to understand, but the chapters are 50 pages long. Gives extra credit, BUT you cannot miss a single class. And the amount of extra credit depends on pop quiz scores. DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE.

Chooi is interesting and funny, but her lectures don't cover everything she expects you to know. My class was very disorganized (I don't know if that was a result of her or the AI's) grades took forever, important stuff wouldn't get posted, tests would be moved around. Lots of extra credit available, but I got pretty frustrated with the class

This class is pretty informative.  She gives you extra credit if you go to lecture, which definitely helps.  However, 90% of the class is based off exams.  STUDY. The material isn't incredibly difficult, but you will probably need to know everything about the processes or material you previously learned about.

There is so much extra credit available in this class. Chooi is hilarious, but her lectures alone won't help you very much with the test. Just do the assigned extra credit work and skim the chapters before the test and you should be fine.

Prof. Chooi is the best teacher ever! I don't really know what the person below is talking about. I thought all the material was very clear. She is kind, helpful and on top of that, HILARIOUS. Makes biology incredibly entertaining. At the end of the semester, you will really feel like you got a great education. The best at IU by far...

Arguably the worst teacher I've ever had. I attempted to take notes for the first couple weeks but just gave up because of how hard it was to make any notes in a logical order from her rants. She provides useless slides on a projector and quickly removes them before you can write anything down. Tests are hard and includes questions not in the book.

Although she is very intelligent, she is simply NOT a good professor. She spends most of the class talking about herself or going off on tangents. 2. Lectures via powerpoint which she doesn't know how to use OR she'll write in the tiniest letters possible on the board 3. Exams do not cover relevant material. If you want to learn, take a diff prof.

She is incredibly intelligent and knows everything about what she teaches. Unfortunately, she is a little unorganized so it REALLY helps to read the textbook and look over her online notes (her "skeletons" as she calls them). She offers SO MUCH extra credit too but you may only have 1 unexcused absence all semester. It is totally worth it though.

She offers ridiculously large amounts of extra credit. However you MUST attend every lecture or she will take it all away. She is extremely knowledgeable in basic biology, in fact much of what you learn in 112, she personally discovered when she did research at Harvard. She's entertaining and a little crazy, but really nice and loves to teach.

She makes many rude remarks during class but nothing too horrible. If you fail multiple test she will automatically fail you no matter what actual standing. She is a hard teacher to follow during lectures due to her rambling. I feel like her class was a waste of time and I will never take a class with her again.

She is kind of ditsy when it comes to daily lectures. But overall, easy if you come to class take advantage of ALL the extra credit she gives, read the book and take notes. I learned a lot in her class!

Interesting professor, sometimes ditzy and forgets what has been covered. Gives out MAJOR extra credit if you have perfect attendance, up to 10% of your grade. Make sure you take advantage of the book and the cd that comes with it, some questions are directly from the bio website she gives out on the first day.

Some exam questions are out of nowhere. Lecture is interesting and you will learn a lot of random things about biology. She's a nice lady, but she's way too smart to be teaching an intro class. I think she uses the same exams every year and forgets that there are certain topics we never covered yet they still show up on the exam.

Not only is she completely useless when it comes to teaching, she makes rude, jokes for 90% of the class.  The other time in class is her mumbling about things in an illogical order and showing charts that have to relevance to the class.
