I would NOT take this professor again. Her exams are difficult for a 100 class and her lectures are straight up from the textbook. There was only one real extra credit opportunity outside of class and the rest are just 2 point extra credit on exams which you have to get right to receive credit.

I would not take this psych professor again, only one to have in person 200 lecture test that are extremely demanding. Takes forever to get grades back. Be prepared to study for like 3-5 hours and know all the material. Also, there is fill in the blank with no word bank and if you don't put her answer exactly she wants you miss the point.
Professor Adams seems more fit to teach a high school class. She encourages participation but lectures are copy-pasted from the textbook and exam feedback is not given.
Lectures are basically copied from textbook which you read before class. Pretty boring but attendance is necessary for a good grade. She cares and is a good person but the class itself is average.

Lectures are super boring unfortunately and the slides are basically copy pasted from the online text. Slideshow is wordy and it feels like she isn't teaching but just reading to the class. Personally would not take again. A very lovely person though.

Overall, this class is a little challenging but prepares you well. I have gotten by this semester without reading the textbook but taking handwritten notes and going to every class. She does post the slides after but I find my retention is not as good if I dont attend class. Do the learning curves and extra credit opportunities when you can.
Do not take this class in the early morning. Lectures can be heavy and monotonous. Professor is really nice and understanding though!

Dr Adams is so awesome. Lecture slides are posted but are fill-in-the-blanks you get from attending lectures. Her class was also very easy and fascinating. She's super lovely and approachable, and you have plenty of opportunities to ensure you get a good grade in this class.

She is an amazing professor, very passionate about what she teaches. Her lectures are very informative but she does not post her lecture slides and her Quizzes are based off of her lecture slides. Other than that very hard to fail this class.
The course content is not difficult but he makes it difficult for people to go through. Absolutely red flag.
A very coercive teaching method

The teaching style in this course (and in his other courses as well) is highly paternalistic, involving extensive micromanagement. He seems to exercise his authority at every possible opportunity, and as a student, you do not feel treated like an adult.
He tends to ignore what students are interested and force them to focus on what he is interested.

A lot of articles and papers to read and write. Grading is super tedious. Participation affects your grade 100%. This class was an elective I took and was Harder than my computer science major courses. Take advantage of all and any extra credit he offers
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He uses a book, but he posts pdfs of every reading, so no need to buy the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great lecturer, but hard grader when he is the grader (typically in his upper-level classes he is the grader). Extremely knowledgable on the subject. A ton of readings, especially considering I only took a 190 class. Do the readings and you'll be fine for his tests. I wouldn't say that he is very accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Liff is a great choice if you're interested in global policies and business environment. He makes you think critically instead of just lecturing you on his ideas and opinions. It is a very enjoyable course as long as you keep up with the reading and participate in class discussions.

Professor Liff is by far one of the most influential professors i have ever had. However, if you want to pass this class you're going to have to work your butt off. Only a few grades determine your final grade. He is an amazing and very intellectual scholar and has very high expectations for his students.

I feel she is really passionate about her work, extremely knowledgeable, and kind. She is definitely old-fashioned: grades are not released on canvas and instead you will get your grade at the end of the semester. Regardless, her lectures are interesting and somehow go by very fast for me. Make sure to take notes, do readings, and participate.

I am taking the course Golden Age of Islamic Civilizations and overall the content is not hard to follow as long as you take notes and show up to the lectures. However, what I dislike about this class are the quizzes which isn't even about the content. She quizzes you on Arabic terms and there are so many! It feels like I'm taking a language class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are pretty dull despite the interesting topics that the course provides, but active participation can make the class somewhat bearable. Pro tip: you'll need to inquire about your early grades because they don't come to you willingly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof. Asma uses her classes to sell her books, that is just a known fact across all IU. She will make you buy them just to never use them. She is very opinionated and genuinely lacks credibility and honor. She never fails to surprise the class by making offensive remarks or just blatantly false statements. Avoid her.
One of the best professors I've ever had at IU. Just a genuinely kind person who knows what she's talking about. You do have to study for the tests but there's never anything unexpected on them.

Professor Afsaruddin is a well respected professor with great knowledge in Islamic studies. Pay attention in class and take notes and you should be fine. She dissects her topics with vocab, terms, definitions and dates to make it easier to understand. It is pretty much a class on Islam & Muslims and very interesting to learn more about.
respected professor read alot and course was based on discussion and essays
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: This course about Islamic Feminisms was informative. Group projects were the major part of the work. The reading load was normal. The professor was very helpful.

This class was about Islam and modernity. There were 6 textbooks, but all worth reading. The reading load was heavy, but I enjoyed the class and learned a lot from the professor. The course was very informative.

The professor was very knowledgeable of the subject. This class was about war and peace in Islamic tradition. I learned a lot in this course. There were more readings than other classes, but the readings were very well chosen, and I learned a lot from them. Overall, I benefited a lot and learned a lot from this class. Highly recommend this class.

One of the worst professors I've ever had. Absolutely nothing is on canvas. She never let the class know if discussion sections were canceled so many times I woke early on a Friday morning to find out that class was canceled. Have no idea what my grade was in the class because nothing is on canvas.

The whole semester passed and she didnt have not 1 grade in on canvas. I had no idea how I was doing in the class. Didnt let us know what we got on our midterm till almost the end of the semester. Racist towards Israel and has more negative opinions than actual facts. Supposed to be a Mid East studies class but she made it all about Islam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Afsaruddin was one of the most inflexible professors I have ever had. I took the course with absolutely no background knowledge and I fell behind quickly. You needed to have a background in Islamic philosophy and the Arabic language to keep up, but I did not. She was not easy to work with and made the course especially difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Wish I dropped. There are very few grade opportunities, the quizzes he gives are multiple choice but impossible. Will have multiple right answers or straight wrong facts, or the right answer will be off of political opinions (ex. refugees are bad???). All he does is read off slides and it is impossible to listen to his mundane voice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very monotone and boring professor with no passion for what he is teaching and is almost impossible to understand because of his heavy accent.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class is extremely boring, and he is very hard to understand due to a strong accent. He reads word-for-word off slides available on canvas in an extremely monotone voice, which makes it unbearable. He sounds as if he has zero enthusiasm or care for the class. I do not recommend taking this class at all and wish I had dropped it on day one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bad teacher all around. Doesnt care about you or your success. Hard to understand anything he said due to accent. Doesnt answer emails. Doesnt answer questions asked in class well at all and then will grade you super hard if you dont know stuff. He has no place at a school like IU.

Very strong accent, can't understand him well. Lecture heavy/boring and takes attendance. Tests/quizzes are online but hard. Essay portion is long (2 pages per question)...HARSH grader. Doesn't respond to emails and then grades super harshly and leaves rude comments. For reference, I am a very strong all A student. ESPECIALLY in writing.
He doesn't answer his emails which sucks. His class is really long and the lectures are so long and boring and his voice is so monotonous which makes it hard to go.

Professor Afoaku is extremely hard to understand with his heavy Nigerian accent. The midterm was a 10 page paper and the final was 11 pages. There were multiple choice tests online every Monday, which weren't too hard. However he is a critical grader on the papers. Very hard to pay attention in class, as he just reads off of slides the whole time.

You really really have to care about the subject material if you want to take this class. Otherwise, the lectures are going to be unbearably slow and hard to follow. The information was super interesting though. I think he likes to scare everyone with the first paper. Another instance of a super smart professor who's not an interested teacher.

He's a super nice guy who wants everyone to pass his class. Attendance isn't mandatory but he bumps grades up for people who regularly go to class. The grade comes from a midterm and final (both of which are take-home), a group project, and 5 random pop quizzes. As long as you put in at least some effort, you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE A CLASS OFFERED BY THIS PROFESSOR. I am currently enrolled in a class of his and I have never been more irritated at myself for taking it. You will absolute hate every second in his classes. Extremely boring, recites slides available on Canvas, and there is no objective grading. It's all writing. I cannot express enough how awful he is.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Though he cares about the subject, he gives unrealistic amount of reading and is a critical grader.  Also, he does not specify the page requirements for the group paper and his the test in the syllabus; be warned both of which are over 10 pages.

Although lectures are incredibly boring (everyone was on Facebook for the entire class), and he's easy to tune out, powerpoints are online and you'll be fine as long as you review them. In general, the guy knows what he's talking about and is very professional. Easy A if you show up and put in a decent effort.
Professor Afoaku is a wonderful professor. Though his class is not easy and he grades hard, he is very thorough and makes himself available for extensive consultation.

Love Love Love Afoaku!  I've taken two of his classes now and would definitely take additional courses if they were offered.  My most favorite teacher in spea so far.  Like others said, he tends to grade hard on the final paper, but if you turn in a rough draft, he'll correct it and steer you in the right direction.
Prof. Afoaku is a GREAT professor, I would love if I could take his class again!

Prof. Afoaku is VERY intelligent. Just read his "Full Vita" on SPEA's website if you have any doubts.  Yes, some may think his powerpoint-lecture style is boring, but he is passionate about what he teaches and that has been very inspirational! He is also very willing to help you individually if you are struggling. Great guy.

Extremely hard to understand. He reads the notes with his back to the class. Also posts them online. Overall this teacher is very hard to learn from. Gives pop-quizzes. Grades hard on papers with no real meanings behind the grades. Don't take this class with this teacher. I have heard other teachers teach it better from friends.

I would rather die than take this class again. You can't hear or understand him, he reads directly from the notes he puts online, and gives bad grades on papers that are unjustifiable. My friend had the same problem and we both dropped. Take V160 with someone else.
A good teacher but hard to understand and somewhat boring. Bring a laptop. Do better on the written part of his exams because he weights those heavier.

I had this Prof. at UNC and I thought he was wonderful!  Very encouraging and supportive and very intellectual.  He does have an accent, but I understand him just fine...One can't fault the man for an accent when he speaks 3 languages fluently!  Dr. Afoaku is upstanding and generous.
THIS GUY WAS TERRIBLE
hes really hard to understand because of his accent and make sure you bring a laptop to class if youre planning on taking notes because he goes through his overhead slides really quickly

Professor Afoaku is from Nigeria and is a bit difficult to understand.  His teaching style  could lull a screaming baby to sleep as he just reads overhead slides.  He gives pop quizzes which are somewhat difficult.  His test questions seem random.
Honestly, throughout the class I could clearly see how much effort the professor put into making the material as easy and accessible as possible. I did find the level of the class to be quite basic.

Quite literally the worst professor I have ever experienced at IU by a landslide. Terrible communication, speaks at a low volume, heavy accent, and is visibly socially anxious during lectures. Every lecture is required and painful to sit through. The final exam written portion for the course was far beyond the scope of the work we did in class.

Professor Ahn's class is about quantity over quality. He rushes through ten different ideas in one class, barely  taking the time to explain even half the concepts properly. He will explain things if you ask but he works on the assumption that you come in with all the ideas crystal clear. Don't take unless you have more than 30 hours in a day.

Prof Vicky is by far the best choice for Money & Banking. MBA-styled, with little focus on grades. Makes an otherwise tedious class really fun with lots of cool slides, group projects, presentations, and even life lessons. Quizes and the final are all open book - they are however very challenging, and the only way to do well is by going to class.
Great professor. Kind. Very nice. Lectures can get a bit complicated sometimes, but Vikram is willing to help you to get there. Not an easy class though.

Vikram is a bit of a mixed bag. If you go to class and do your work, you should be okay even if you don't do well on tests, because he curves everything in the end so the "low score" is something like a B minus. Having said that, I don't think I actually learned anything in the class, which is a real disappointment. Not good, but not awful, either.

He's very nice and makes the class somewhat fun and interesting. A little strange but that's ok. Though he was constantly contradicting himself. He would tell us the answer to something and then the next day change his answer and say that he never said the first answer and everyone would be like ???

He's a super cool professor. Not done with the course yet, but he's very passionate about the topics and is also hilarious in class! Don't really understand what the bad reviews are about because he is super helpful when you ask for help or are confused about an assignment. Would definitely recommend it if you have a love for science. 10/10
Assignments are insanely easy and he is a funny person whose class I genuinely enjoyed attending.
He is a great teacher that jokes around with the class. I don't understand these other reviews because he doesn't change his mind all the time like they claim.
Takes a while to grade, and give feedback, and email you back.
I cannot. That is enough for you to know to find a new class. Not this one.

He changes his mind about a lot. He will tell us one thing and will tell us it is wrong by the next class. He also doesnt explain instructions very well and leaves the class confused most of the time.

This man contradicts himself way too much. If you ask him for help he will give you an answer but then when he goes to grade it, he says it is incorrect. He is very nice but second guesses himself way too much. He also HATES to be incorrect which can be frustrating and when students prove him wrong he gets mad at them.

Affe is a joke. If you are looking to get by and learn nothing, take MSCH-a300 with him. If you care about your major, take with Rosner or anyone else. Don't take anything with Affe. WORST PROFESSOR IVE HAD AT IU.
Worst professor I've had. Do not take his class. Take with another professor.
Seems like a nice guy but blames Canvas for everything and is not very organized. If COVID was not a thing I'm sure the class would've been much better but do not take his courses if it is online.
really great guy with engaging lectures. kinda peaceful to have him as my first class early in the morning. good sense of humor and very knowledgeable about what he is talking about.
Lit.

Allows 1 page front and back cheat sheets for exams and overall is the funniest professor I've had at IU. His intermittent humor makes it easy to stay engaged and want to learn the topic he's presenting. He gives great examples for vocabulary so you don't have to reteach yourself the topic later. I wish he could teach every class I have to take.

I am leaving this review specifically because I have no idea why everyone is hating on Prof. Affe. My girlfriend and I have both had him and we both thoroughly enjoyed the classes we took with him. If you show up to the lecture he hands out review sheets. Also, he is constantly cracking jokes. People need to relax. If you come to class, youll ace.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: A majority of the things he covers during lectures are not the things that appear on the tests. Majority of the tests are T/F questions which makes it difficult. Only grades are the 3 tests and he doesn't enter anything into Canvas the entire semester. He is available outside of class, though and is generally understanding about things.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: One of my least favorite teachers I have had while at my time at IU. He refuses to put anything on canvas so no one knows what grade they will receive until they are put into the registrar, so you can't even argue your grade. His AI's have no idea what they are doing and are the ones that grade the tests. The lectures are terribly boring.

Not the greatest teacher for C207. His lectures are very random and they sometimes do not reflect what is on the exams. The exams are your only grades in the class, and you don't know what you get on them until he hands them back because he doesn't post them online. The exams are mostly T/F which makes things difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I really liked him, lectures are kind of wild and random, but easy to follow. At the beginning he says that you won't have homework or papers, but just come to class and you'll do fine on the test. Only bad thing is that he doesn't post grades on Canvas. 10/10 recommend Affe

What is taught in class & what is on the exam is completely different. the questions on the exam are completely random facts that he didnt even bring up in class. also most of the test questions are T/F which is awful & the questions repeat themselves just in different wording throughout the test. oh and its only 3 exams & thats it so good luck.

He doesn't know how to use a computer or canvas but he is willing to meet to talk about grades. He is a little quirky but a lovable guy. The tests were the easiest tests I have taken since freshman year of high school. The class is only three exams, not cumulative, and there is some extra credit. All you have to do is go to lecture really.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: A professor that will surely put you to sleep. Attendance is not mandatory, only 3 exams, no homework. He has no idea how to work a computer, very sarcastic, and the examples are incredibly dated. He's the only one that teaches the required A337.

Very easy yet boring class. Overall mediocre instructor. He has telecom industry experience, but a lot of his information and examples that he provided were corny, outdated, or just flat out irrelevant. Not a good choice for those who actually want to learn about modern approaches to media and business fields.

NEVER BUY THE TEXTBOOK. This professor says that you are required to buy his book and then never uses it. The books are super expensive and are over $200. He refuse to let them be refunded as well so you are out the money!! As a professor, he is ok. A lot of times, the questions on the test do not always reflect lecture. Only 3 tests and thats it.

C207, instructed by Prof. Affe is an overall mediocre intro course. Affe isn't very tech savvy, but bare with him. Your grade is based off of 3 exams - which are harder than you would expect going into them. You are left in the dark about your grade until they are finalized, because he doesn't post grades online. I wouldn't recommend this prof.

So he does not use an online forum for grades at all. He will use paper for everything (hands out syllabus, grades, study guides) so it will be hard to determine what he wants from you. BUT, he made sure everyone in my class passed (lowest grade was C-) so don't fret. He's a really cool guy. Go to class, he's interesting.

Affe is awesome. He gives you an  outline of the lecture every class. You don't need the book and he tells you that directly. There's no homework and he doesn't take attendance. The tests are a bit difficult and I'm not really sure where he takes points off but you're allowed to use a printed outline (so basically all of your notes!).

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! Enjoy Robert's class a lot, you can learn so many thing from him. knowledgable and international way of thinking, take his class in IUB it's such a joy. At the end of semester, he always love to share his suggestion about your future career.  You can't miss his class if you major in Telecom, top 1 reconmmend !

Robert Affe is the biggest legend as a teacher.  He should teach a class on how to teach a class.  Extremely nice and is hilarious in class and makes it fun.  He does not take attendance, but if you go it works to all of your benefit.

I honestly thought he was great when I took Tel-T 207. Yeah he has a cheesy sense of humor and  gets all "Dead Poets Society" on you about how he sees education and this and that, but overall we should be lucky to get to learn from a Prof. that has a lot of real world experience and who really enjoys the material he teaches. Also - No HW & 3 tests

Interesting guy but the course material wasn't quite what I thought it was going to be. We had 3 tests, all non-cumulative. I barely went to class and passed pretty easily, but it's worth going to class.

Great teacher, great guy.  This class is really easy but at the same time really informative.  You learn a lot about the movie industry and spend time studying box office results and watching trailers.  Favorite class Ive taken

An all around good guy and good teacher. He knows his stuff and he cares about his students. I took two classes with him at the same time and really enjoyed his teaching style. He also loved to tell little jokes and give meaningful advice. Quirky but such a good teacher. Take his class! pay attention! You will probably learn something too!

If you can surive through all of the bad puns and make it to most of the classes, it's fairly easy. He's also super reasonable/helpful. I accidentally slept through the final and he let me take it during a final for another class he taught and was really nice/cool about it. I would take a class from him again.
Robert Affe is a reasonable guy. I respected him because he was straightforward with what he expects his students to do in class and he followed through with those expectations.

Professor Affe is someone who you think you will love, but end up hating by the middle of the course. I did somewhat poorly on a test and received very poor advice from him when I went to ask for note taking and test taking tips. Instead, I felt reprimanded like a child. Oh, and the only grades were 3 tests. Have fun if you do bad on one!

His humor was just uncomfortable, and he even PLANNED bad jokes with the AIs. The tests covered some things that were not talked about. He is not at all good with technology, using 6 different powerpoints a day and using any website other than YouTube for videos. SO FRUSTRATING TO WATCH. Class is easy, but so boring.
Favorite professor at IU. No homework, no attendance. Pay attention to his lectures and odd humor and you'll be sure to get an A on one of 3 exams

Prof. Affe is probably the best teacher I have had in college. The class I took was Global Media Issues and he teaches relevant things that are going on in the world. I'm also a senior and he helped me figure out what is necessary to be successful in the work world. Easy tests and papers. Definitely take his classes.

Class was easy if you attended lecture every week.  His stories and odd humor made the class fun.  He covered the material very clearly.  The only grades from the class were from the three exams.  There was no homework, projects, or textbooks.

Easy professor... Almost too easy. Lays out the information clearly, and tests are cake assuming you go to most of the classes. Didn't really dig his teaching style of catering to the stupidest people in the classroom. Dry sense of humor and pretty weird. Take him if you want an easy A.

He was a genuinely nice guy. His awkward humor and side stories made the class interesting most days and fun to attend. I had the class early in the morning but I never would want to skip. His test questions can be worded oddly, but it is not a hard class to do well in if you can take notes.

Love this teacher, extremely helpful and interesting. Has a way of engaging the class and even though attendance isn't necessary, you'll still want to go, the class is fun enough to sit through! Highly recommended!
It was very difficult to know my standing in this course, test questions were confusing and pulled out of no where.  He's a nice guy, but gradind procedures were not really fair in my opinion.
Awesome guy with great stories and makes class interesting
he has been the most amazing prof ever-- i dont even care that i didnt get an a cause his class was just fun to take because of his entertaining personality

In addition to Prof. Affe having a refreshing viewpoint on the purpose of education, one that most students would agree with, he also has a way of simplifying material without throwing too much at you. Attendance is not required, though it is helpful. Only three tests and a paper. In my opinion, the finest prof I've had at this university.

Affe is a professional from the Telecommunications field who shows a genuine interest in the performance of his students. Makes the topics very interesting and relatable to the students. He also offers a great deal of advice and information to aid you in your career after college. Great teacher with an awesome sense of humor.

He is brilliant. He has a lot of useful information about telecommunication business. He teaches us with cool jokes in class and he respects his students very much. I love his personality, and he is just wonderful!!!!!!

Best professor I've ever had. Takes great pride in his work and is very interest in each and every one of his students. Has a lot of connections and experience in the industry and is more than willing to share his knowledge whenever asked. Will definitely take more classes from him in the future.
smart and nice guy but class didnt really have a point
Treats students like they are adults; worked in Telecommunications management and is not a career professor
wonderful teacher
good teacher
Extremely organized, well-prepared for class.  Takes a lot of pride in his work.  Motivational teacher.

i HATE affe with a burning passion!  I had no idea what criteria he graded  tests/projects on.  When i asked for my final grades (there were only 3 anyway, two tests and a project) he said that he didnt have them with him and then never got back to me with my grades.  No idea how tests were graded, i studied my ass off, and still got B-
Best Professor I've had
If you plan on taking another class of his? Keep your notes. Because it's the exact same class and an absolute waste of time.

I would like to thank affe for his wonderful grading policy.  In this class-- 2/3 of your grade based on tests-- essay tests that are based on his opinion of how well you wrote the essay, and the other 1/3 a project that costs 80 dollars!!! I pretty much hate this guy-- i learned a lot in this class, but have nothing to show for it...
No Comments
No Comments
Funny guy
Robert Affe Rules!!!
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

Janna will expect you to leave your comfort zone with projects. She calls the projects "experiments" for a reason. However, she grades very fairly and will grade based on effort not the final product. If you want to try something new in the realm of digital art, Janna is a great person to learn from and she won't grade you harshly. Janna is awesome
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor was completely absent from the online course and let all the work be done by the TA. She was also very unfair in her grading, and would give bad grades to work she simply didn't "like." The lecture material had nothing to do with the assignments. And she barely prepared us for any of the big projects. I basically had to teach myself.

I had such an overwhelmingly positive experience with this professor! If you have the chance, I would highly recommend taking her course. If you have a specific vision for your art piece, then Janna will try her best to help you in making work. She was positive, open-minded, and gave many great references and considerations to think about. Amazing!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's pretty nice and gives good feedback when you ask for it, even if it may not be what you're wanting to hear. Chill too, I enjoyed that we get non mandatory work days. Can be a slow grader, and some of the expectations of the assignments aren't always super clear, but you generally have an idea of what you're supposed to do. I'd recommend her.

She is a very rude and unprofessional. Expected students to follow rules before they were created, and still punished them for breaking them before they existed. This courses side assignments and lectures always had absolutely nothing to do with the actual course material, and where there was course material there were no guidelines on what to do.
Great class and a great teacher. Easy to get an A if you study the slides and try on the assignments.
His E331 class was my one of my favorite econ courses. No textbook needed. Just study the slides and do the assignment and youre set.

He was very bad about communicating with students about the course expectations and material. In addition, quizzes and exams are the only grades, and he expects students to take the exam during a specific hour but was inconsistent when and how many lectures he posted. Absolutely awful instructor and it was clear he wasn't spending his time working.

Doesn't respond to emails, and the rare occasions he does, it's a week past when you needed a response. Grades very slowly and says he'll curve, but come the end of the semester you will have no idea what your grade will be. No homework or assignments to practice on before the quizzes, and the grade is all quizzes and tests.
Cool professor, teaches very clearly. Take careful notes every class, and participate and you will get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lashkaripour is an incredibly average professor in every way. He sounds like he is always going to fall asleep, and speaks quietly. Attendance is mandatory according to the syllabus, but is rarely enforced. Your grade may seem rough on canvas, but at the end of the course he curves everything so things work out well. Not great, but not terrible.
He is amazing! I recommend any class with him! Top-knotch professor!

If you do the work, you will do fine.  That said, be prepared to read and make sure you understand the concepts before coming to class.  A lot of the class is discussion-based, so do not be shy.  Ahmed is always willing to help and will answer all your questions.

He was really a great professor. Be prepared to read (at least 40 pages over the weekend and 20 during the week) but he is very fair. Do not take this class if you are not willing to work for your grade or if you don't like showing up to class. Every class there is either a reading response or a free-write, so make sure you actually read.
Do the readings, respect his deadlines, ask questions when you need, and you will do fine.
Do the readings, respect his deadlines, ask questions, and you will be fine.
Bro was chill you just gotta pay attention. Extra credit came in clutch.
Very fair professor and class.
