reviews.comment: She's trying to make the exams really tough. We had a class average on a midterm of 65 and she is not going to curve it!  She is enthusiastic but Tough exams/ low grade isn't helpful at all.

Andrea is inspirational and enthusiastic about accounting. The materials are mostly about M&A accounting and I admit that they are not easy. But if you wish to learn something useful and applicable to the real world, this is the right course to take. The project is a wonderful opportunity for you to apply class knowledge into the real world too.
Andrea's class is difficult but you can do a lot for yourself by going to classes, and asking questions. Also, do the bonus points. They were the difference between a B+ and an A.

She loves accounting so much and is enthusiastic, but she takes no responsibility for her exams and her extra credit problems can be found on the web.  She will call random people out, and an incorrect answer can be quite embarrassing.  Her syllabus was not correct and she changed the grading a week before the exam.  Hard material to begin with.
worst ever

Would not suggest Andrea. She loves accounting, but makes most accounting majors hate it. She passes back quizzes two weeks after tests in which the quizzes were necessary to study. Makes you feel dumb if you answer incorrectly. She's a nice person, but you're basically out of luck for a good grade if you aren't a genius.
subject is VERY challenging - but is made to seem much easier. prof is goofy and loves accounting - which can make the class more fun
If you have the opportunity to take her, don't.
Highly recommend entertaining lectures attendance is mandatory but if you need to do class from home for the day you can.
This teacher has great lectures and is very easy to talk to. Exams are online. She is also very good a explaining the topics and gives you assignmnets that actually help you learn the material.

reviews.comment: All this class is, is a pass to do McGraw hill work for credit. Lectures are a complete waste of time and she doesn't teach a thing in class.

I've never written a review before but I had to for Professor McCaster. She's amazing! Her lectures and stories are meant to help you remember topics. She's knowledgeable, fair, and wants students to succeed. As long as you show up and do the work, you'll pass. Negative reviews seem to be from those who didn't attend or try. Highly recommend her!

If you want reasonable accounting teacher do not take this class. Difficult to follow not even with her lectures. Class wont get the tophat questions right she will still move on. Had her for 2 classes and it was my least favorite college expirence os far. Dont sign up for this class unless your spea, if you are, change majors.

99% of the class time is spent on her telling random stories unrelated to the class. Following every story, she talks about how great of a teacher she is, and how helpful all of her stories are. However, coursework is VERY easy, class could be 10 minutes long and accomplish the same or more.

Professor McCaster was a pretty good teacher. She rambles a lot in lectures, but has a lot of insight about life in general. She cares more about her class than her students do, which is painfully noticeable. Attendance isn't required, which is good if you need flexibility. Exams = difficult but straightforward if you've paid attention in lecture.

Professor McCaster is a horrible professor who wastes class time telling stories and talking about herself instead of the content. When she does lecture they are hard to follow and there are barley any resources online to help with course content. She offers no extra credit and her tests are confusing for no reason.

Professor McCaster was arrogant, condescending, and more focused on sharing her experience as a CFO than teaching. Extremely poorly written exams and homework, and pointless content. Read the TopHat and practice on your own, do not waste time in class.

Literally one of the worst professors I've ever had at IU. She spends most of the lectures talking rather than speaking as if she likes to hear herself talk. She takes no partial credit for late assignments, even for in class assignments when she's the reason we're crunched for time. Both her and her TA were condescending towards students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: An amazing professor that is super funny and kind. Genuinely wanted her students to succeed and you could feel that in class. Taught in many different ways so that no one was left behind. Actually pay attention and listen to what she says and you'll be fine. She doesn't like stupid questions that have already been answered.

Professor McCaster's class is just overly harder than it needs to be, especially for a 200 level class. She gives almost 0 feedback and is not pro-student. The class is just rather frustrating at times and it is hard to get a response from her. She also does not believe in any forms of partial credit.

Professor McCaster is awesome! She is very dedicated to student learning and success. All of the lectures are full of her personal stories and they're super funny. The grading policy is super lenient and you can bomb a few assignments without worrying about your grade. If you pay attention in class and do the work you'll do well in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor McCaster is genuinely the worst professor I have ever encountered. I. have witnessed her bullying students, especially those who are struggling in the class or have questions. She berated one of my classmates during a zoom appointment to the point that the student started crying, and then she ordered the student to STOP CRYING.
No extra credit opertunities, And forget it if you miss s homework by 1 minute there is no late policy. Also she never offers help like a lot of other professors.

Prof. McCaster is literally the worst professor I have EVER had. She's awful. Every time I ask a question, she makes me feel like an idiot when I am an Honors Student who actually does well in the class. It wouldn't be so hard for students if she acted like she gave a s*** about their success. I could go on forever about how I hated this class.

She is easily one of the worst professors that I've had at IU. She's barely accessible outside of her early morning office hours. Don't understand something or have something pop up in life? Don't even bother messaging her unless you want to be talked down upon. If you're able to navigate her system and get over her voice you'll do fine.

reviews.comment: just go to class and do the assignments and you'll be fine. content is interesting and she makes it seem easy. go to class to be able to do the occasional in-class assignments and tophat answers and you should get a good grade.

reviews.comment: Professor is story based with some lecture thrown in. She spends too much time on personal stories and not enough on professing. When she does teach, its average and rather dull. Nowhere near as difficult as A100 but professor's lack of ability makes them somewhat comparable.

Keeps class very entertaining with her sense of humor and is great at dumbing down accounting for those of us who struggle with it. It is very important to pay attention though because she moves quickly. But, she tells you everything you need to know and the tests are pretty easy.

I ended up with an A- in this class and the class is pretty easy. However, McCaster is one of the most unprofessional professors I've ever had to deal with. This is the first class I've been in where students are ridiculed in front of the class by the teacher for asking questions. She is not understanding or accommodating to students whatsoever.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's the worst. She doesn't explain or teach anything and if you reach out to her for help or clarification, she talks to you as if you're stupid and doesn't ever answer your question.

I failed A100 and got a B+ in this class. Her lectures are pretty miserable but there's little 3 points notecard assignments and extra credit clicker questions so you have to go. Exams must be curved FAT, because one exam I wrote some things down that barely resembled accounting and got like a 80%.  I'd definitely recommend her.

reviews.comment: Solid lectures and very engaging. Lots of opportunities for credit, but PAY ATTENTION. I've drifted off in several lectures and am now finding myself in not a great spot heading into finals. If you're taking this class, do the presentation! Well worth it.

reviews.comment: Awful

I had a hard time with accounting, but I don't blame this teacher. She is very clear, has useful lectures, and her clicker questions really do help (understanding wise and extra points wise). Work hard on the business section to build up your points. Drops your lowest exam score if you do group project. She is a very funny and unique teacher!

This class was a relatively easy concept to understand. She does make the lectures pretty engaging and is hilarious. Expect tough exams though along with a decent amount of reading and homework. She also offers a lot of extra credit.

Awesome professor! Come prepared to learn. Material is tough, but she goes over everything at LEAST 3 times if not more until you understand. Lots of extra credit. Hint: get all the points you can in the beginning, it will save your grade when you get to the tougher material. Got an A+ in this class! She also has GREAT stories, very entertaining.

Here's the thing. Do the reading. Come to class. Engage with her.  She's very fair and is willing to help you if you at least try to help yourself.  She tells relevant stories about government accounting in the real world.  She also doesn't pull punches so as long as you aren't rude you'll be ok.

Professor McCaster is not great at explaining some concepts, if you have not taken an accounting class before you may find it tough to catch on. She really only gives extra credit to make up for her inability to effectively teach. The tests are tough and she gives extra credit almost every class.

Worst professor. I'm a student that must work w/ Disability Services on campus & McCaster sought not to accommodate. Even when others were in need (ex:student had a seizure outside her classroom) she chose not to intervene when she was personally notified. And she saw her classroom as a babysitting facility when her young child was often expelled.

She is the best professor I have had at IU. Gives lots of extra credit, so go to every class because you never know when she will let you earn extra credit. Very entertaining professor, who has great stories.

Easy teacher but could not be more rude as a person. Take the class cause its easy and she gives tons of extra credit but she could not be more rude and condescending id much rather have a hard but cool teacher over a nasty rude easy teacher
SUPER EASY....got an A+ without doing anything....the amount of "extra credit" is unreal! HIGHLY recommend this professor!
Took as a gen ed and probably the only class I learned something new in. 10/10 would take again

Terrible teacher. Other reviews were too kind. This teacher graded my midterm saying that I had used AI when I had completed my quiz and would not listen to my appeals when I showed her proof that I had not used AI. This in turn caused my grade to go from a A to a D.

Really down to earth and is visibly passionate about the class and her coursework. Classes are lecture-style. She encourages participation a lot but won't cold call and doesn't penalize you for not talking. Lots of readings but you can get by without them; exams are surface-level and easy. Super approachable and friendly. Very little homework.
Super sweet but really encourages participation. Good professor for SPEA 183

This class is an easy A. You will have readings to do before class as long as you skim them and get a good idea you will be fine. Lectures aren't too long and she posts all the slides on canvas. She cares about all her students and is very personable. I loved taking her class and always looked forward to it.
Goated professor. I would 100% pick him over any other professor.
Nice professor and pretty easy class but doesn't grade any work.

No in-class quizzes and super easy workload. We often get out of class early. He's a nice guy, and it seems like he really cares about students finding the best path for themselves academically and career-wise.
Literally the greatest teacher ever. It is impossible to get below an A in his class if you do all the assignments.
Definitely take this class with Professor Parker. He is a super nice guy, not too much work, no quizzes, and we were often let out of class early.

Amazing professor and super easy class. Often let my class out an hour early since we had an evening class. He was always so kind and inspirational. Loved getting to know him. DEFINITELY take his class!! You actually will not regret it.

If you do all of the work, you will get a good grade. Dr. Parker makes everything clear and gives great feedback. He is very caring and helpful and also offers extra credit that is easy to complete. We also got out of class early most of the time. Defiantly go with him, great professor and straightforward class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Parker is definitely one of the best Compass teachers! The assignments were straightforward, easy to follow, and much less demanding compared to the other Compass 1 teachers. Attendance is mandatory but you will still receive credit even if you are late. Overall very easy course as long as you follow the assignment rubric.
Dr. Parker was an awesome professor and very good at getting information across in lectures. Very easy grader and very understanding. Would recommend everyone take him for Compass 1.
One of the best professors for Kelly Compass. Very easy class with useful information. Do your work and you'll have no problem, would definitely recommend!
I would recommend.
Easy class, Professor Parker clearly cares, assignment requirements are made very clear
He is pretty chill and nice. Make sure to go to class, he often lets out early. Assignments are easy and clear. Great professor.

The class is very easy. Just go to class, and finish your assignment on time. The assignments are all very easy. Attendance is mandatory though. If you miss class more than 3 times you are cooked. But very easy, just go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had this semester.
Andrew is such a chill teacher, assignments are very easy. He really does care about his students and it shows.

He is one of my favorite professors I have had at IU. He is so nice and understanding. He is very straight forward with assignments and doesn't make things difficult like a lot of other teachers. Take him for Compass 1 if you want an easy A and he lets you leave early most days when you can just work on your own unlike most other teachers.

There are many assignments, but they are all easy and teach you a lot of valuable information to positively build your personal brand. All Compass teachers are fairly easy but take Prof. Parker! He is very lenient and cares about all his students' futures.

Super kind and chill would recommend that he be your first-choice professor for Compass 1! He made the class engaging and fun, and I had it at 8 am, he often let us out early too. Compass can seem like a class with no point, but I would recommend that you participate bc some of the stuff we do does help later on. He does a good job teaching too.

Very chill prof. Assignments were a breeze and literally took like an hour to less than 30 min per week. I transferred out of IU but if i was still there i would so take him. i had 8am compass so i didn't feel like going sometimes but you only get 2 absences so you have to go unless you know people in the class. overall great prof!

Am amazing professor and basically the only option for compass 1. 1 smallish assignment every week that takes an hour or less except for the bigger project. Class often lets out 30-40 minutes early. Encourages class participation. 2 absences with no penalties allowed.
Dude is the goat. Doesn't assign a lot of work, grades easily, and lets class out early almost every week. Great compass professor and an absolute breeze of a class.
Very very easy class, do the minimal work and you'll get an a. You can tell Andrew cares about preparing us for our futures, and wants us to succeed. Easy grader

EASIEST CLASS I'VE EVER TAKEN. I've heard from a couple friends that their Compass teacher assigned a lot. That is not the case with Andrew Parker. There's zero stress whatsoever and he grades easy. Class ended early a lot too. He answers questions very well too. Do yourself a favor and schedule this course with him in the same semester as K201 ;).
Professor Parker is so chill. The class is 70min, but we usually leave in the first 10-15 min. Light work. Easy A.

I would highly recommend taking Professor Parker because he is straight to the point and tells you what to do. He usually ends class early and there is only one assignment per week. All assignments are pretty easy and do not require much thought. Overall, very easy and very great.

Take this professor!!! Professor Parker is fun and also very efficient when teaching. Many times we leave class within 10 minutes of it starting. All his assignments are intentional and useful. Not like other professors who give a ton of meaningless work!
Professor Parker was a very chill professor. As long as you do the work and it shows that you completed assignments with full effort, you will do great in the class.

Highly recommend taking Prof. Parker. It's a super easy class once a week, if you show up and do the work you usually get out 30-45 min early. He is very caring and it is not difficult. The only thing you can get points off for is attendance. Take the class with him if you get the chance.

Professor Parker is great, he would let us work on assignments due that week in class and would let the class out early if we finished the material. The assignments are not too difficult and it is mainly just making sure you complete them on time. Attendance is mandatory but it is only one class a week and it is almost never the full time.

Extremely easy class. Parker almost always let us out like 30 minutes early. Make sure you don't miss a class because he has a policy that he'll fail you if you miss 2 classes. The assignments are not hard just follow the directions and turn them in on time. Easy A.

I haven't completed his class yet, but wow, he is good. He makes me look forward to attending and seems like he genuinely wants to be there. This course is not difficult and you will get an A if you show up and do the work (which is less than 30 min a week). Everything he teaches is useful and serves a purpose. Great guy, highly reccomend.

Only graded on exams. The exams are very much based on the textbook and readings. Lectures consist of her skimming over vague, surface level topics and telling you that you do not know how to study (You went to IU law school, pipe down). Very vague and confusing wording on exam questions. Would not recommend at all.

Prof. Sellers is okay. I think she's a great lecturer and she makes herself very available for office hours, but your're only graded on 4 exams. I wish that she would impliment homework/attendance points so your grade isnt entirely test-based. I haven't heard of any other L201 professors who structure their class like hers.

reviews.comment: Wow, is all I have to Say. April Sellers? No, April will sell your grade. If you think you can get away without reading the textbook, you are mistaken. Take another professor, no test replacement or extra credit like the others. Your grade will thank you for doing that, and you will have an easier time maintaining your GPA.

Prof. Sellers is amazing. She is super knowledgable and gives great feedback to your questions. The classes are guided by few slides which leads to heavy open discussion. Unlike other L201 professors you cannot drop your lowest exam, but she gives practice and makes it clear how questions will be written. 10/10 would take again.

reviews.comment: Awesome professor and very knowledgeable in business law. If you go to class and do the assigned readings it is very easy to do well. She also lets you use a notecard for the exams.

Love April Sellers for L293! If you are a good student, you can easily get an A in the class. Just read the assigned readings and go to class and the exams are cake!! Regarding her other reviews, she does talk all class but it is all relevant and interesting. Def take her if you can because it's a guaranteed A.

Professor Sellers' lecture style is perfect for a smaller honors course. I would highly recommend her for L293, she clearly knows a lot and you won't be stressing about your grade. It is easy to just go to class and learn all you need to know.

Avoid her if you can for L376. Another boring monotone professor with no clear structure to her course. Midterm was challenging and screwed many students' grades. She's not a good professor, but also ethics is kind of just a silly class Kelley forces you to take. If you can afford to take regular take regular, if not just beware with this professor

"Don't take Sellers! I took her class for her high rate my, but it was a mess. No textbook is necessary but outside readings assigned will be on exam. Exams are more than manageable if u pay attention and take notes.She gives short practice quizzes in class that are similar to exam questions.

DO NOT TAKE SELLERS. Her rating perplexes me as she is the most unorganized professor I've ever had. She blames her students for doing poorly, but offers little help and has hardly any structure to her course. If you struggle listening to lectures do not take her because she has barely any words on her slides. Multiple people taking her had to drop

reviews.comment: Taking the class with Professor Sellers is very hard, but I feel like I learned more from her teaching than I would have learned from any other teacher. Great lectures, but the only grades in the class are from tests.

Her whole class is 4 test grades. The syllabus is the most vague syllabus I have ever read. Just because her and her husband are lawyers she assumes we already know everything. Do not take this professor her test are impossible and the whole class agree. Her lectures are all over the place and impossible to follow.

Honestly she makes her tests near impossible. She does not care. No point in even going to class her lectures are all over the place that no one in the class can even understand them. I feel as though she does not want her students to pass this class. Dont bother going to her office hours she will not help you.

I personally loved this because I would take notes on what she would say in class. A lot of people prefer a slideshow with bullet points. She can also be scatterbrained. I really liked her.

reviews.comment: A class I enjoyed coming to most of the time. However, she lacks organization and her grading criteria is confusing. If you show up to class and contribute to group projects, you will do well. Wish she could up her organization just a little bit, would make the material much more clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sellers is a very, very knowledgeable person. However, her teaching style is very hard to follow. Her lectures are all over the place, and she has no text book. Her posted slides have 5 words on them. I had to do lots of self-teaching for this class. There's no study guide or clear communication on what exactly is on exams.

She is a nice person and is willing to help students. However, there are no reviews for exams, all the questions are based on lecture content, and basically your entire grade is based on 4 exams. She only talks during class and will put those questions she mentioned once on an exam. Not terrible, but not great either.
She was an amazing teacher and her lectures are really good. She also helps students that need the extra help!

Most of L201 with Sellers is completing the readings she assigns. Her lectures are little to no help ever as she switches between 5-10 slides and just rambles on most of the time. The 4 exams make up 90% of your semester grade. She's a really nice person, but has no teaching ability at all. Find another L201 professor to take.

Prof. Sellers is honestly one of the best professors I have ever had. I have never written a review on Rate My Professor before and never planned on it but she made such a positive impact I felt the need to do so. She is the reason I am pursuing law after undergrad because she really cares and wants to see her students succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I survived and did decent in this class solely from doing the assigned readings and completing the reading logs Professor Sellers makes. Her lectures honestly were not of much help, as she switches between 5 slides the entire class and rambles on and on so I often had no idea what to take notes on. I eventually quit going to this class entirely

Her lectures were extremely tedious, attendance isnt mandatory but there are random in-class assignments for points, lowest two scores are dropped. Exams are not too bad and the final wasn't cumulative which was great. Pretty average professor
I would recommend taking April Sellers section of L201 over other instructors at IUB.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Sellers is a solid choice for IU classes and KD business law. She does tests every two weeks and assignments about every two weeks. The readings and lectures are not skimmable for those who haven't had law classes before. Tests were multiple choice and essay. The case studies were very important and must be studied.

Solid choice to have for an Ethics course. She does assign a good amount of readings that you'll want to read before class since you'll have quizzes based on them. Attend every class and put an honest effort in the work you do. Do this, and this should be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's great!

Professor Sellers was definitely a good choice for this class. However, her lectures are very boring and you have to go to them in case there is a quiz. Overall, I would say that she is one of the easier L201 professors
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I've enjoyed having sellers has my professor. She's very helpful if you have questions during office hours, plus it's almost mandatory if you want the points in participation/in-class assignments (20% of your grade). She's sometimes monotone however, but explains the material clearly. Plus, most of the time, you'll be able to leave early.
Long lectures, very dry. She gives quick breaks in the middle of class, which is nice. Her tests are all multiple choice and attendance is not taken.

Professor Sellers has made Business Law my favorite class. The topics we cover are interesting and are applicable to everyday life. She explains things clearly and provides many examples. She also posts slides, practice tests and study guides to follow while reading. Her class is 75 mins and she gives a short break in between. Would recommend
Does not grade assignments until the end of the semester . Will give you an A only if she likes you and if you are a good speaker

Don't take her. She takes forever to grade so you will have no feedback. Fully grades based on if your a suck up. She will yap all class and then at the very end assign a presentation and give you no time to work on it.

The other reviews are right - she takes FOREVER to grade. But, I would recommend taking her business presentations class. She grades generously, has reasonable expectations for students, and is forgiving to people with public speaking anxiety. Besides the presentations, the other assignments are super quick and easy.

If you take business presentations, I HIGHLY recommend Prof. Smith; she doesn't do jackshit and just gives everyone an A if you have good attendance. Don't expect to get any grades until the end of the semester. She'll promise to "be better" at grading and never do it, but you'll get an A if she likes you and you're a good speaker.

Such an amazing professor! If you're taking C104 and struggle with presentation anxiety, I highly recommend taking this class with Professor Smith. She goes above and beyond for her students. She spent extra time working with me one-on-one outside of class. If you do the work and follow her rubric, you're guaranteed an A.

The best prof at IU. Best class. 
If you have the chance, take my word no better professor out there. Even if you are bad at speech, Prof smith will give you many chances and ensure you succeed. 

Some people say she's a late grader but it doesn't really matter she's too good and give amazing grades as well. 

Best prof at IU
All she does is yap. The entire class can be taught in a 5 slide powerpoint. There isn't a need for a whole entire hour. Also takes forever to grade presentations.

All she does is yap during class and doesn't actually teach really well. Granted there is not a lot to teach, she still takes up the entire class time and takes time away from time we could be working on the group project.

Avoid taking Bus-Presentations with her if you are able too. Prof. Smith takes super long to grade presentations and doesn't give good feedback. However when you are presenting and already have those nerves she has no problem abousetly giving you the most gut-wrenching critiques in front of the whole class.

Professor Smith is a person she is very nice and cares about her students. However she is not the best teacher, she takes awhile to grade speeches, I had a speech that is still not graded then was done 2 months ago. It is hard to know what you need to work one when feedback is not given in a timely manner. However she is not a tough grader.
Very fair and had a great time in her class. If you do the work you should get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is my favorite professor at IU. If you attend her lectures attentively and prepare your speeches diligently, you are guaranteed to receive an A. If you are an international student, you should definitely make an effort to enroll in her class. She understands the difficulties that international students face with their spoken English.

Prof. Smith was great. If you show up and put effort into your presentations, you will end up fine. Grading criteria is clear, & she posts various resources for each presentation. Do the work, practice, make sure you know your stuff, and you'll receive a good grade. Attendance taken each class, best to show up.

This class was one of the easiest classes I took all semester however, there can be a lot of unnecessary projects or homework. Professor Smith hands out A's as long as you do your work and attend her classes. She often doesn't grade anything until the end of the semester, so you won't receive feedback on your presentations.

Go to class and prepare for your presentations and you will do great. This class is mainly about how well you prepare for the weekly presentations. Some people find giving presentations a breeze, and others do not. But understand that you will be graded on how well you have progressed through the year.
picks favorites and half the time the class is useless. gives u a grade based on how much she likes u
If you do not slack off, you will get an A+. If you skip class you will fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was my favorite professor I have ever had! I really suggest her for business presentations.

Her grading is easy but she is disorganized and hard to reach. If she does not like you, then you will know. You have to be fake nice/polite in order to avoid that. If she does like you, this class won't be a problem.

She is a great professor. She was very easy and class was always fun. Just prepare for your presentations and you will succeed. She gives everyone As but do not expect to know your grades because she takes the whole semester to put grades in.

Very disorganized, for the final group project she told us in class we had a full week left to finish a 20 page report, then on Friday sent an email saying Monday morning at 6:00 AM was the deadline. This was typical. Her feedback was opinion based but preached as fact. Anything related to technology she does not understand and ridicules

reviews.comment: Absolutely the worst professor I have ever had. She is rude and has no idea how to teach this course. An easy A? Sure, but I would 100% say it is not worth it. Find someone else, there are plenty of other options.
It's my first week of class, and I can already tell she's going to be one of my least favorite professors of college. She's incredibly disorganized
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was very easy but she is not a good teacher. She is unwilling to help her students and gets mad when they ask her for help on something. She assigns so much reading for each class (average about 40 pages) and you will never go over the readings but she still expects you to do them. She went off on me when I asked for help. Horrible

Teach a class on Slavery and this is what you get!!! The retreat to old stereotypes - i.e. - calling black people lazy. Really? But no worries, this is what's happening to Obama. And some students are so blinded by racism, they cannot even see when you have their best interest at heart. Sad AND Ignorant. It was a great class!!! Stop the hate people

This PHD CANDIDATE (not a professor) is THE most arrogant instructor I have ever had. She interrupts students when they are presenting and downplays everyone's contribution to class discussion. She needs to get back to reality because 1) she ain't a good teacher and 2) she is VERY lazy and blames students for her mishaps (losing attendance sheet)
also she refuses to look over test answers that have been misgraded!!

She is very lazy in grading and teaching.  She expects you to work hard in the classroom but makes up excuses for not grading so she just hands out A's to everyone.  I guess that's the only good thing is that she's an easy grader... be prepared to present alot and your expected to raise your hand.  She seems like she is **** towards white people
Great professor all around. A few of the lab assignments had confusing wording but overall I highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher. Very clearly explained all concepts and genuinely cares about each and every student he teaches. Very knowledgable and passionate about security and it shows in lectures. I would love to take another course with him if I could.

This Prof is hands down the best one iv had at IU. super great guy. However, he is strict on grading. If you go to his lectures it will help SO MUCH, if you do start missing them the class become much more difficult. Labs are pass/fail, you're allowed to fail 1 out of 5. If you fail two you automatically fail the course. Pretty much no hw at all.
Very Good Professor and very helpful. Recommended for graduate level courses.

Tests are graded unreasonably hard, he'll tell you to understand concepts at a "high level" and then expect you explain in detail on the test with multiple examples. Don't bother going to his office hours, he just says "look it up". Very unhelpful.. 8 or so of the 20 students dropped the class. Wants you to buy a book used for only 4 chapters.
Great professor, she's very understanding about missing class or late assignments and makes lectures easy to understand.

extremely nice and helpful if you need it. The tests are very easy if you just study the notes you take in class. The lectures aren't extremely boring and if you just write down what she says and an example youll get an A on the test. Super nice.
Tough grader, but really sweet and definitely cares about the class and students. Don't take this class if you're not willing to show up and do the work.
Very educational yet easy. Perfect for the course he teaches!
Trent is amazing and so are his Purdue jokes. Class was very enjoyable.!

Trent is one of the best professors I have had. He is hilarious and makes a ton of Purdue jokes. For lecture and lab you get a good amount of skips but his lectures are great and worth going to. He is also one of the nicest professors I have met and seems to really care about his students learning. Take a class with him if you get the chance!

Dr. Applegate is a very funny guy, and a semi-good teacher. I wish he posted his lectures online because that would be extremely helpful. He frequently gets distracted and his tone of voice is hard to understand sometimes. As long as you study his lectures, the tests should be easy. But, make sure you take notes because he does not post lectures!
Great professor. Two exams one in class and one take home. I would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I did not like his lectures at all. So boring. He's a nice guy though, very funny, but I swear it was like I was back in sixth grade and he talked SO SLOWLY. I made the mistake of getting overconfident though - study well for the tests! They can surprise you.

Dr. Applegate is a stickler for attendance but he's so funny he makes each lecture interesting. His First Aid class is a must take, it's very useful and if you pay attention you'll do well. Beware of the second test- the first test will be an easy A without even studying but the second requires studying, don't get caught thinking it will be as easy
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This course is worth your time and money. Not only is it a useful and important skill set learned, even if you're not majoring in anything related to it. Applegate is always excited to teach and is very experienced and knowledgeable in the field. You have three skills tests and three exams total. Practice and study what you're told and you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Trent is a great professor. He was very accessible outside of class and gave great tips for the test. Review sessions tell you what to study. Need the text books and packets. First aid is a great skill to have for anyone and this is a great way to learn it!
Great teacher, makes frequent jokes about Purdue to keep things fun and easy going. Class isn't hard if you do your work and study. Definitely would recommend

Very nice guy. Genuinely cares about the subject matter and teaches it in a fun way. Go to class and take good notes since the tests aren't easy if you don't prepare for them. Lectures and labs almost always end early and there are lots of days the class won't meet. Would recommend this class even if it isn't required for your major
Great teacher, very helpful and nice!
Professor Applegate is one fun guy! He made this course worth my time. Just take notes and study from the textbook and it's an easy A.

This guy is a former Athletic Trainer. He's been through a lot and really knows his stuff. He always cracks cheesey purdue jokes. If you come to lecture and take notes over important things or his "hint hint nudge nudge" you will get an A on the test. The lab section is just as easy if not easier. Just know "staying Alive" and youre good.

Professor Applegate is genuinely the nicest teacher I've ever had. The attendance rule is annoying, but it's worth it because he makes so many jokes.  Only thing I would suggest is not to underestimate the tests, its a super easy class if you look over the notes a few times before the tests, but if you don't the tests could be hard.
Trent is by far the nicest teacher I have had in my entire life. He is inspiring and makes you actually WANT to come to class each day. I'm genuinely sad the class is over :(

His class is pretty straightforward and by no means difficult. He makes lectures interesting by using humorous examples or by telling stories in general. One of his favorite things to do is tell Purdue jokes before class starts. Study your notes, and he will do okay.He sometimes also gives a "nudge nudge wink wink" about a topic that is on the test
Really funny and helpful. It's an easy class and I suggest that everyone should take it.

Trent is one of the best professors I have ever had. He makes coming to class fun, and a SG is given so you know exactly what will be on the test. I wish it were possible to take all of my classes with him. I'd be on the freaking Dean's list. Definitely take his classes. It's worth it.
He's very funny and a great teacher. If you're taking H160 I definitely recommend Applegate, makes the class interesting & he knows his stuff. Class is very easy as well.
Trent was a very nice and funny guy. The class was super easy and interesting enough to pay attention to. The lab was a lot of fun and never a drag. He gives a lot of absences which is really nice.
Good professor. I really enjoyed his class. He explains the material very clearly and also tells good Purdue jokes.
Applegate was awesome! He had a lot of stories to tell that related to the material he was teaching and made this class not only incredibly informative, but also fun!
Applegate is hillarious and the class is very helpful and easy. I hardly ever studied for tests and did very well.

LOOOVEEEE this class. You can tell that he loves teaching this class and is extremely hilarious. You are allowed 4 absences from lecture. Lab is where you learn the most but you get to miss like 10 labs because not everyone can take their skills test at once. I recommend.

Trent Applegate is a hilarious professor! He is able to mix in Purdue jokes with learning first-aid. He makes the information very clear. Attendance is mandatory for this class, however, I enjoyed it so much I did not mind having to go. The labs are very fun as well. I thought this was a great class! Notes are exactly whats one the exams.

Trent is a hilarious professor.  I learned so much and the tests are pretty straight forward. You have to practice for the lab tests (CPR, Rescue breathing) but it is so worth it. As long as you pass the Red Cross Test you are certified in AED and CPR. Great Class! It is definitely worth your time!

If you love Purdue jokes, this is your class. Attendance is required in both lab and Lecture, though Lab will have apprx. 8-9 days off for skills testing during the semester. Tests progressively get harder, but never anything too much to deal with.

Trent is a great guy!! He makes Purdue jokes almost every day and tells relevant stories to make the class more interesting. Above all, i believe this class should be required for every student because what you learn could save someone's life one day. Take the class!!
So easy, just show up and listen
Helpful and Genuine
So funny!

favorite class! you have to go to lecture & lab but if you go & listen the tests are super easy! lecture is also pretty interesting and trent stress the test info and is really funny too. pretty easy, little work - def recommend!

Applegate is the man! He is absolutely hilarious and the class is extremely easy... just come to class (which is mandatory), take the notes, and study just a little bit and you'll get an A... My favorite class BY FAR
Fails to get back with students in a timely manner.  Scheduled appointments; but fails to meet appointment time without any notice.
Recommend

Trent is an easy teacher. If you attend class (which attendance is taken) and write down the notes, it's an easy A. Most of the material taught in this class is common sense. I recommend taking classes with Trent.
Trent makes class fun and he's entertaining. The class(H160) isn't difficult-basic knowledge. I recommend Trent!
Great humor! Knows his stuff! Mandatory attendance not great, but it is definitely worth going!!!
Awesome Teacher! He's a funny guy! class is fairly easy- attendance is mandatory however you get alot of days off because of lab tests! One of the most useful classes you can take!
nice man, easy class. it's one that everybody ought to take, since what you (hopefully) learn will actually be useful.

Trent is a nice guy, really funny.  The class isn't impossible- but I hate that all of the test is based on lecture notes- he RARELY RARELY uses the book.  I actually would reccommend not buying it.  kthanks
Trent is the best professor ive ever had!!! Mandatory attendance sucks, but he makes it worth your while! He gives so many basically freebie answers! Take his class!
He's a good guy who knows what he's talking about. You have to show up for class, but every once in a while he will throw in a Purdue joke to make it a little more worth while.
It is a fairly easy class, but his grading scale is higher and an A is a 95%, lab is easy and lecture tests are easy. He makes a lot of jokes and gets of topic alot, but fairly easy class
Great teacher. Keeps things upbeat and interesting. Very clear on what will be tested on. Come to class and read=A
Very useful class.  Just pay attention and you will do fine, very fair and overall fun course. Love the Purdue jokes.
Sooooo easy!
Trent's Purdue jokes are hilarious!!!  He's an awesome guy and very fun...he makes a lecture hall of 300+ students entertaining!!!
He is cool.....i love his Purdue jokes!!
Most caring professor! Great jokes, and makes you look forward to going to class!
Great jokes.
WOW...I came to class for two reasons: 1. Jokes 2. CUTIE PIE! oh my god he is so cute. Take this class it is purty easy. cya
No Comments
This class is pretty easy, and the instuctor always has pretty good Purdue jokes... class is interesting
The class was fun AND lots of hot girls in there.
No Comments
WOO HOO!!!!!!
He made the class enjoyable and used varied teaching methods.

Goodwill Apiyo is the nicest teacher I have had in four years at IU.  He is kind, respectful of his students and their other classes, and overall is a great guy.  He's like the Gandolf to our Frodo he guide you. Ill tell ya what man, I loved consumer health, man.
Makes hard materials appear easy.
loved the delivery
Respectful and readily available to assist students in need of help.
Not a fair grader. Hard tests for something that was supposed to be easy.

April is super nice and is available online if you need help but her class is really challenging. We also had a lot of work due every week and the graded modules took a while. The service learning project was challenging and took a while but it's meant to help boost your grade so take advantage of it.
Has a lot of absences but other than that she's fine. She is retiring I believe.

April is a great person. She cares about her students and is always more than happy to meet outside of class. Although the subject of the course isn't always that exciting, she knows what she is doing and offers generous extra credit if you do the work. She has some health issues, but she does her best to inform her students. Helpful class.

I hated this class. The service learning project dragged my grade down a ton. She doesn't grade the review assignments, so I wouldn't do those in the textbook. The Access exam is kinda a drag, but the Excel one is cake. April had a lot of health problems, so she was frequently gone from class. I had her 8 AM, so we often wouldn't know until then.

To be fair, I think the professor for K204 doesn't matter, it is the same material for everyone. It is one of those classes where "if you get it, you get it" but if you don't, you'll struggle. Honestly, Moriarity is probably better because he sounds so much more lenient. If you get put on a bad team RIP, I barely got through.

This is the worst professor I have had in my first two semesters here. She does not teach the material well at all and then assigns difficult homeworks that end up taking way longer than they should. Also, for our final project, she assigned random teams that were favored towards her class favorites and yes was available a lot but isn't helpful.
K204 can be a challenging class freshman year. Although April can brush over concepts pretty quickly, she's always around for help if you ask.
Pay attention, she moves fast but is also available if you need help. Her K 204 class gets tough towards the end of the class so be aware of that.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: April is one of the most caring, passionate, humorous professors I've ever had. She treats all of her students with respect, answers all question thoroughly no matter how obvious the answer may be, and makes sure you truly understand the material. I came in with absolutely no computer knowledge, scared out of my mind, but she helped me out a lot.

April is incredible. I was one of the only people who actually came to office hours (which are virtual btw), so I was able to really bond with her and have great one-on-one conversations. She is also super easy to reach outside of class. Be careful, cause the class is hard. Take advantage of all the help resources they give you and you'll be fine.

reviews.comment: If you want to keep your sanity do not take a course with this profesor.

reviews.comment: April-Get comfortable messaging her on teams and asking for help and she will love you. The class-HATE IT, so much work you will never catch up. literally so frustrating!! If you're deciding between k204 and k201, do k201. K204 has so much more work to do. But if you're willing to do the extra work take k204 bc it has the same exams as k201
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Though K204 in general has a ton of work on a weekly basis, it felt much more manageable with April. If you message her on teams, she will reply literally within seconds to help and always offers to set up individual appointments for help as well. Her lectures are very clear to the point and if you pay attention, they guide you directly to exam.

April is great for K204. Good at explaining things and giving help, and very understanding if something doesn't go your way. Highly recommended. K204 has plenty of extra credit, so a good grade is very doable as long as you stay on top of things. Discoveries/Reviews aren't checked for completion but you should do them to understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: April is amazing.

So many amazing words describe April! She is the sweetest ally to have your freshman year, and I highly recommend her. April not only was available via email for my many questions, but has helped me in other areas of my academic success. K204 can be scary, but she makes you feel right at home in her class. She is a true gem.

April is the best!! I've never really had any experience with Excel or Access before and she made me really enjoy it. She loves when you go to her office hours. She is super helpful if you have questions and is a pretty cool person to chat with. It is really easy to do well in this class if you do the work and extra credit.

I had April for K204. She was extremely caring and accommodating with all students, and really enjoys if you go to her office hours. She is very helpful if you just ask. There is a lot to learn but if you do the assigned homework you will do fine in this class.

Very approachable, cares about students. (She even called herself our K204 mom lol.) That being said, she can be a little disorganized and unclear in directions and grading criteria. Reach out for clarification or extra help, and she is willing to help out. Also in general, K204 is not as bad as everyone says it is. Just need to put in the effort.

Honestly speaking, K204 is a painful class. It is difficult sometimes gets a little bit frustrating. With that said, April Heltsley is far and away one of the best teachers I have had in my academic career. She is caring and understanding, and she will go out of her way to ensure that you have the tools to succeed. Loved having her... best teacher

April isn't terrible, but from what I can tell the other profs, Carlos and Amy, are much better. The people I know from their classes always seem to know a bit more of what's going on both content wise and in the case competition. April is pretty notorious for cancelling office hours all the time and being unorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: April is perhaps the best teacher I have encountered at IU. Despite knowing a lot of the k204 material prior to taking the class, I found her lectures to be highly informative and engaging. Many students found the class difficult, but doing textbook problems ahead of time is the best way to be prepared for class and gain favor with her for the year

April is a great teacher. She was very available for help and very understanding and tried to get the best she could out of every student. However, she is an organizational mess. Of the thirty or so kids in the class, I have talked to roughly half, and not one consistently knows what's due, when it's due, or has any general sense of what's going on
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: K201/4 can be a tough class but April was an extremely caring and understanding professor that knew her material. She really helped us get prepared for the two exams and the TAs and peer mentors were beneficial as well. The group project may seem pushed on you last minute but the Mentors really help you get it done.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: April is the bomb. She's hilarious and is always there to help you out. You learn so much in this class and she gives lots of extra credit. If you put the work in you should get an A+.

April was great! She would respond to emails in the middle of the night to make sure that we knew what we were doing. You have to go to class and follow along to understand what is going on, but she will stop to answer any question, make more office hours, and stay after class. She wanted to make sure everyone knew what she was teaching.

While April might be a great teacher for K204, I feel like she falls a bit short in K360 with the teaching material. The class has a lot to offer, but some of the assignments are a bit unclear and the help that is necessary to complete the assignments isn't always there.

Simply put, April is the best. I came in knowing legit nothing about Microsoft Excel/Access and I came out with a decent understanding of the material, thanks to her. I've never seen a professor so willing to offer help to students that ask. Class is tough but not horrible if you put in work and definitely get with a good group. Fantastic professor

Whether you know quite a bit about computers or have no experience, you will learn something in April's class. I've never had a professor care so much about her students and honestly I wish I could take this class again. She's there to complain about mishaps in life with you, and to celebrate your triumphs. Best professor ever, by far!

April is the bomb.  I knew nothing about computers.  Walked out of that class with an A that I earned and that she helped me earn.  Learned much more than I thought I would or could.  The class takes up a lot of time, but a good grade pops out if the time is put into it.  I'd take April over K201 any day.  Best course I've decided to take so far.

April is truly amazing. Very unorganized and the class is confusing at first but as things become clearer she is the most helpful sincere individual and everyone loves her. Never had a more understanding professor. Also, if you do the extra credit you can guarantee yourself an A its actually almost ridiculous.

I took this class with almost no computer experience and it was definitely challenging at times. But there are lots of opportunities for extra credit and April was always willing to help! There is a tough group project and you need to really organized. I would definitely recommend taking with April. Good luck!

April was a wonderful teacher. Always there to help students - if you send her an email about ANYTHING, she'll reply and help you. The exams are tough but she offers enough extra credit to help your grade. Do the KCs for sure, and give yourself enough time to finish all of them. HIGHLY recommended professor. Best one I've had.

April is not only a wonderful professor, but she is also a saint.  She is incredibly helpful and understanding.  She does an excellent job of explaining what is completely new material to most of her students.  She really got me excited about material that I thought would be miserable.  I strongly recommend her.

Most unorganized teacher ever. She skipped lectures often and had her TA teach class. More like a 6 credit hour class.  Taught myself the content because she was so confusing and disorganized in class.  Took her FOREVER to get grades back.

April is an absolutely fantastic professor! The class content is somewhat difficult and unfamiliar, but if you listen to April's lectures and do the assigned work on time, you should be able to do well. April is always willing to help her students. If you have the chance, I highly recommend April's class!

April is a wonderful teacher who doesn't have a bad side.  Get on her good side, and she will make sure you land on your feet.  She's very approachable and down to earth.  This is the most applicable class I've ever taken.  Definitely recommenced to anyone who knows nothing about Excel or Access.
April is an amazing teacher! I was nervous to take this class being a freshman but if you do the assignments and ask questions when needed you'll be completely fine.
She is a great teacher and really fun. I couldnt care less about computers but this class was not as bad as I thought. I tell all my friends to take her.
April is one of my favorite teachers!  She makes the material very accessible and is always willing to help students.  I enjoyed her class despite my low level of interest in the material itself.
April is such a pleasure to work with! Although the material is demanding, I never felt that it was a chore or overly difficult. With enough practise and thought, it should come easily enough.

April is awesome! I came into her class knowing absolutely nothing about computers or any of the programs we went over, and I came out feeling like a pro! April is always calm, patient, and happy to answer any questions, and has a great sense of humor on top of it! I would highly recommend her class.
One of my FAVORITE professors ever!! April is so helpful! She does whatever she can to help you! Many extra credit opportunities! I definitely recommend her for K204! She is the BEST!!!

Super nice and helpful, but it is a hard class. You learn the basics in the lecture, and then must figure out the more advanced stuff for homework. If you have to take this course, I think she's the best teacher to take. She's always willing to help.
very helpful, very good class. material can be difficult and there's a lot of work, but i recommend April! she's great. a lot of extra assignments to help you get an A if you really want it
Best professor I've had in Kelley, April is awesome!
Pretty much awesome. K204 was tough, but she tells you exactly what you need to know to pass everything. Very helpful on the service learning project.

Pros: Always enthusiastic, reasonable grading, flexible office hours, wants you to do well                    Cons: Slow grader     Overall, she's a dang good teacher, better than most K201 teachers, i've heard.

April is the absolute best professor I have ever had.  She is amazing and should be given a medal for the most wonderful professor alive!  She was so helpful and always went way beyond the call of duty.  I wish every prof was like her.
April was an awesome teacher!!! I loved her class and she made it so easy and painless. She is very willing to help and is genuinely interested in her students. Take a chance on her! :)

April is always willing to answer any question right in the middle of class and re-demonstrate with examples.  Don't be afraid to ask questions or go to her office hours!  It takes forever to get grades back though, so watch out for that.  Otherwise, you'll learn a ton in this class and be prepared for X202.

April is one of the best teachers I've ever had. There is quite a bit more work in this class as compared to K201, but you definitely learn a lot more and it is worth it in my opinion. Also, there is no Friday lecture. There are more grade boosting opportunities and a lot of extra credit so it's pretty easy to get an A.

April is  a great professor. She is very helpful and always available. K204 is actually easier than K201 because of the extra credit opportunities, extra easy grades, and because there is no lecture portion. April is awesome, the class is a lot or work but it's a prereq for business and if you have to take it..take April's!
Professor Heltsley is focused on helping the student and is very understanding.
Very helpful, nice, clear teacher. This class is actually easier than K201 because of an extra research paper and a couple other grade boosters.
Really good professor.  The class is easy to follow and if you know anything about computers and keep up you'll be fine.  Relatively easy A.

April is an awesome woman--always willing to help her students.  She responds to emails promptly and will take time out to make sure you are on the right track.  It's not her fault, but the class by nature is just not fun and requires A LOT of work.  Do not fall behind in this class.  I worked my ass off to get a B+.
April is really nice and really helpful!! The class is hard but she really wants everyone to succeed. She's got a great sense of humor too. (note: she's only lab not lecture)
Terribly unorganized.  Not overly difficult, but the work is guaranteed to be confusing.  At this point, I would recommend K201 over k204

April is on my list of favorite teachers.  She is always willing to help anyone, is fair, and is entertaining.  This was one of my favorite classes because of the material, but the workload was a bit much.
Good teacher, willing to help you out if you need it.
Probably the worst lecture I have evr had to go to, maybe it was the class itself, it was awful.
Great teacher.  Very interested in her students.
April is as fair as a professor as you can get.  She responds to all of her e-mails and is willing to take time out of her schedule to help you with any assignment.
April is a  good down-to-earth teacher. Labs a little boring (as can be expectd)

April thinks she's hilarious and cool, but she's so confusing and sporadic. She'll take you on mandatory treks around Btown, so anyone not from here be warned, you will get lost and it will count against your grade. Group projects and assignments are ridiculously complex and poorly planned. Would not take any class with her again.
She does not use the syllabus at all. She may make one but she will never give record of when things are due and what to do. She is not clear on anything.
She was the best anthro prof I had in my program. Period. She seemed to be among the few that really took the time to help me on an individual basis.
Best archae teacher ever!
She is nice and very helpful.  Class was very boring, 3 hour class watching movies.  LOTS of reading, all of which is not interesting at all, I would rather watch grass grow then read those articles.

Great teacher; class is long (nearly 3 hours) but mainly involves watching movies. Class involved a lot of reading but no DISCUSSION of readings, which wasn't helpful. Taking P200 before is VERY helpful for understanding the class. Not a lot of points, so 1 bad score can destroy grade.

Great teacher.  Very nice.  Funny, enjoys what she does.  LOTS of reading in this class, but it's possible to work around it.  One day a week for like 2 hours and 45 minutes which seems long, but still fine if you watch a movie in that time period.  Good class for S&H credit.
