Each class allowed for discussion and reflection and he tried to close with a smile every day despite the weight of the material. Take this class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a whole, this professor is okay. I would take this class again based upon the discussions we had and the variety of different sources we looked at in class. However, the grading criteria on the papers could be clearer, such as including rubrics.

He's a great professor and I definitely recommend his class! He's a pretty tough grader on papers but is very willing to help improve your work. My meetings with him are the reason that I got an A in his class, so definitely take advantage of the opportunity. Lectures are when he points out important quotes for exams, so attendance is important.

I loved taking this class! He is such a sweet man & is so knowledgable in his field. I loved going to every lecture because he makes you really think & is very interested in you opinions. The 2 papers he assigns are very long but I had no trouble filling up the pages because he gives you so much to say. He genuinely cares about his students too.

If you get the chance to take any course with Professor Rosenfeld, DO IT! He is brilliant, warm, and one of the most interesting people I've ever met. I hung on his every word at each class discussion. As long as you keep up with the reading and participate in class, you will have an unforgettable experience.

Professor Rosenfeld is literally the smartest man I have ever met. Loved his class and learned so much. He asked me to be his research assistant after the class ended and I am looking forward to learning more from him. If you are a good writer, his class is for you.

Dr. Rosenfeld is surprisingly engaging and you learn so much in this class. He grades very tough on papers and is very particular about grammar and word choice. As long as you actively participate in discussion, he will like you and you'll do fine in the class.

For an honors class, this was easy. If you scan the readings and contribute a line to the discussion, that's all he's looking for. He's very picky on grammar. The subject is depressing, but the readings were interesting. Not much work for the class though, 2 oral reports, 3 papers total. If you're a decent writer looking for an A, take his class.

I am a senior and he is the ABSOLUTE WORST professor I have ever had at Indiana. He gives you a letter grade and does not follow up with why your grade is the way it is. He is not clear, is not consistent with his comments and does not care about his students success. He grades papers subjectively and if you think differently than he you won't pass
He has ridiculously high expectations that he does NOT communicate whatsoever. His prompts are vague yet he has a very clear opinion of what he wants to see. Even the AI agrees his grading is unfair.

Prof. Rosenfeld is a traditional professor who has much higher expectations of what it takes to do well in the course. Class discussions were helpful, and both he and an AI were available for help to students who requested it. This class really helped me refine my writing style and expand on my ideas.
No Comments

His expectations are very high, but does have some help to offer in terms of prose. I confronted him about issues with the course and he blamed the students. Perhaps he is overly confident in his ideas and unable to accept others. I would only recomend his class to people looking to be lectured about literature (not me).

First week or two will feel like a lot of homework but it is worth it if you enjoy music (interactive textbook is a requirement). It will take time to understand, but the information in the textbook is helpful though possibly too much. Write notes on what you don't know, her lectures will go over the textbook too. You will learn a lot, fun class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: I enrolled in this thinking I could kinda pass my way through but the assignments are hard and it is not easy to cheat on. I bet with chatgpt plus it is way more doable but without it, I wouldn't take it.

This class is asynchronous so its easy to slack off but there is a lot of work and its honestly pretty difficult for people who don't play piano. Quizzes and Tests are easier than the homework however.
Goat class. Take it asynchronous

Sheila genuinely really nice and very clear when it comes to explaining things. Sometimes when the textbook tries to explain a concept it seemed impossible but she would explain it so easy with tips and tricks. Genuinely caring and very fair with grading.

As someone who has no clue on reading or understanding any type of music, this class was extremely easy. It's a free A+, however there is a lot of homework assignments but its really doable. Get yourself CHATGPT plus and you won't complain I promise you. Also, there are 3 really easy extra credits that boost your grade by around 8-10 %.
I hated this class. It was not easy. DO NOT TAKE IT IF YOU ARE NOT GOOD AT MUSIC. ONLY TAKE THIS IF YOU WERE IN BAND OR CAN PLAY PIANO.

Worst class ever, endless technical glitches, and pressure to complete homework for no reason. After completing this class, you will be a better musician than any other musician, because the standard for beginners in this class is Chopin.

I took her for Z101. The class was an hour and half and she reads off powerpoints and tries to make kids interact but no one really does. Everyone treats this class as an easy A and a study hall. There are no midterms or finals and the listening quizzes are super easy. Make sure to do discussions on time along with the inquizatives.
By far the most amount of work I have ever been assigned in any class. More work in this one class alone than my other 15 credits combined.
There is a bunch of work you have to keep track of, but it is manageable, and Ms. Guntren is very respectful about student personal issues

I took this completely asynch which meant there were no lectures, just book learning, but there was LOTS OF WORK. Modules take a very long time to complete, as if you get even one question wrong, it drops your grade dramatically and you have to redo it. That being said, it was very interesting material and the prof made herself available for help.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you have not taken a music class or been in band before, don't take this class, it'll be way more work than it's worth. That being said, having been involved in music since a young age, this class was pretty run-of-the-mill. Homework was a bit long, but the exams were incredibly lenient and there was a multitude of extra credit. Would recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you've never played an instrument or don't know how to read music, don't take this class. It would be extremely hard. You need to stay on top of things and make sure to learn the material each week. I took this class as 8wks, online. She made herself available for office hours and was very helpful. Other than that, you don't hear from her.
Take z111 instead if you are not a Jacobs major. I am not rating the professor just the class.

The course is extremely hard for the work load. The online modules are very difficult to pass, and if you don't complete all of them you get a 0%. Professor nor TA replied to emails. Don't take this class. It is a 100 level and will take up SO much of your time trying to pass stupid modules.

V221 is not a hard class, but the lack of communication makes it awful. It's mostly group work, and even though only one person has to submit, make sure you submit everything yourself. I still have zeros on assignments I reported multiple times. It feels like a side gig for her. Do not take.

Amy Stark is what you would call a pretty normal professor. She's not bad by all means but not like a top notch professor. Not honestly much to say about her, very standard class and fairly easy overall. Little lacking on communication but nothing that really makes me dislike her. I would recommend if you want a smooth sailing class.

I enjoy Amy as a person, and she is very knowledgeable about the nonprofit sector and I can appreciate that. However, the class felt disorganized and we were often left not knowing what was going on in the course. The expectations for assignments were not made clear and the grading was inconsistent throughout the course. Only take V221 if you must.

Prof. Stark is awesome, she really cares about her students and cares about the material. She has a really good background and uses her own experiences to teach the class. The assignments are mainly papers but they are extremely straightforward and easy to complete. Would recommend this class to anyone.

Amy is truly an amazing professor, she is knowledgeable and pulls from her own experiences. She is understanding and has clear expectations. The work required is helpful and I looked forward to her class every week. Absolutely loved.

I absolutely loved Amy. She is an extremely caring and understanding person, knowledgeable, and is constantly applying her experiences to the class. It shows that she is passionate about what she is talking about. I would recommend her class to anyone.

Professor Stark is a nice and knowledgeable professor. The class is easy and does not require you to read a lot of readings. The papers themselves are pretty straightforward and a good grade can be earned if you understand the basic concepts. As long as you pay attention to the lectures you will be fine. Overall would recommend her and the course.

Professor Stark is very sweet. If you want a teacher that is passionate about what she teaches, this is the person for you! This class is primally papers and I know a few of my classmates that did not receive the best grades on them, however I found them to be easy and received A's. If you are ever confused, she is easy to get in contact with.

Passionate for teaching and the subject material. Caring and understanding. Assigns lots of reading so be ready for that, but grades easy if you do the work. One of the best professors I've had at IU.

I studied abroad with Dr. Nana in Ghana. She was an excellent leader and was very admirable. I loved her sense of humor and the time we spent with her! In terms of the course, we did have to attend and do some assignments, papers, and group projects but the instructions were clear and she was an easy grader.

Professor Amoah-Ramey is a little unorganized and the lectures that are required attendance are very bland and get old fast. There is also a decent amount of reading. However, she is an easy grader if she can tell you tried and you care about the class and I really enjoyed the content of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She forces people to sit through long lectures for participation, which are read word for word from the screen, and the participation is almost impossible to even take part in because theres no real back and forth or feedback. Shes also extremely rigid with due dates despite basically publishing the assignments the day before theyre due.

I literally did not read a single book in her class. I wrote all my information based off the movies and spark notes. I still managed to get an A. I wrote the mid term and formal essay in less than an hour and got an A on both. Keep in mind I had her remote though as well. I wouldn't say she has favoritism since I passed with an A and never spoke.

I was extremely outgoing in her class so I seen the favoritism that she would show towards me rather than the other students. It worked in my favor! She is kinda tough at times but overall a fairly easy grader. She also gives several outside extra credit opportunities.
She just issued an online pop-quiz in the middle of a pandemic. Does not care that some of us are struggling emotionally

Did not have a clear grading scale. Missed numerous classes & continued to complicate the schedule & bunched assignments together. Unorganized, lectures were bland. After all that, has the audacity to be a tough grader as well. Also, there is definitely an accent barrier. Difficult to follow.

I actually took LING-L485, but it wasn't an option to click. The coursework is difficult to understand, but manageable if you actually do the readings and try. As an undergrad in a class with both undergrads and grad students, I felt nervous. But she always explained things very well. She is very smart and easy to talk to. I recommend!

Shes SO nice. The lectures are just way too dry though. I get it, linguistics is hard to make a super interesting topic, but wow. Students who have above average (when compared to the rest of the class) Spanish comprehension skills will feel stifled.

Great teacher- always explained the tough concepts in a succinct and understandable manner. Used lots of tangible examples and made sure we understood the material. Utilized a variety of activities to keep us interested. Also did a great job of occasionally reviewing old material, so that we were ready for the final, cumulative exam.

Professor Amaral was probably one of the better teachers I've had here at IU.  Though she can be fairly boring, it didn't help that I had no interest in linguistics, she really knows her stuff and makes sure that her students learn it.  She is great at dumbing down tough material in a good way so that you understand the material.

Colton is a great professor and is very easy to reach out to if you need help with anything. There was an option to replace the final exam with Midwest Model EU for this class (highly suggest doing so), so if in person finals aren't your thing, theres an alternative. There were plenty of opportunities for extra credit!

He is funny and charismatic. He wants all students to pass, so reach out if you need help. His AI, Katie, is super nice and willing to help as well! Gave lots of extra credit throughout the semester. Doesn't give a lot of homework, so the midterm and final weigh your grade A TON. You have to do well on the exams to do well in the class.
Literally just show up to class and you'll have an A. Lectures are straightforward and funny, but there are a few guest lectures throughout the semester

Super chill teacher, but most of the class didn't know there were mandatory readings until midway through the semester (or that it required extensive notes). Slides are not available after class. Cool guest lectures, but I wish you could just listen to them instead of trying to write everything down.
Only a few assignments, but they're interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class was super easy and attendance was barley mandatory. As long as you literally show up you cannot fail this course
I believe that Professor Ames has a good way of getting to what he wants to convey. He sometimes rambles, but he already said he does that at the start of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great guy! The lectures were quite fun and the class work isn't hard at all. Just do the assignments and study for the final and you should have an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed having Professor Ames, he has a great sense of humor and a strong passion for the subject he teaches. There aren't a lot of assignments that go into the gradebook, and there is only one exam for the course (the final). There are also weekly readings that you will do prior to the lectures. I reccomend.
Good professor, take adequate notes and you should be good for the final. Essentially just a couple of homework assignments throughout the year that consist of easy, informal writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ames is very down to Earth and you will not have to dedicate a lot of time to his assignments. Work is very simple and straightforward, but the readings can be a lot so make sure you at least read them sometime because they will be on the only test given: the cumulative final. Would take again
Overall had fun in class and it was rather engaging. Make sure you show up, attendance is taken.
Chiller. About all I have to say

He tended to lecture a lot, but also had some great guest speakers and fun activities. Make sure ti at least look like you are paying attention because he would get very mad at people blatantly not listening to him and would call them out.

- For EURO-W 200, he is an amazing professor. He knows what he is talking about and always makes his class engaging
- Would highly recommend if you did any sort of AP history in HS, makes his class a cakewalk
- Overall chill and understanding person, he's very funny and is willing to talk to you if you need help
-100000000% recommend
Dude is hilarious, super interesting lectures, and clear and relatively easy work. Learned a lot
Professor Ames makes me laugh every day. His lectures are engaging and informative. Homework isn't hard, and he is a fair grader. Participation and attendance matter.
He was really relatable
He assigns readings throughout the semester, but I never read them. There are no quizes or exams in the class, just a couple writing assignments. He made his class very entertaining and enjoyable.

Colton is an absolute legend. He cares about his students and the workload is very minimal. Short readings each week and there isn't a single test or quiz throughout the whole semester. A few papers, a midterm, and a final paper is the hardest thing you have to do. 1 hour 15 min class goes by in no time he makes the class so enjoyable.

I love Dr. B! She is very passionate about what she teaches, and I honestly have such an appreciation for teachers that enjoy their work. Classes predominantly taught by Dr.B were very lecture heavy, but had a good balance with Dr.Halloran's lectures/readings.

Amazing professor. You can tell she genuinely cares about her students. She is super smart and knowledgable about biology. So many resources to help you succeed, I wish I had went to her office hours more often. Super sweet lady.

She is very sweet, but her lectures involve her reading directly off the slide. Often times too when you would ask a question her answer wouldn't be entirely clear on what she wanted. She would sometimes explain certain concepts in a way that all of biology disagrees with and it would make for confusing study sessions. The test drops are nice.

Professor Berndtson runs a challenging but rewarding class. Lots of resources and support to succeed, like office hours, review sessions, and TAs. Unstuck ai was a great study tool too. Definitely worth taking!

She is one of the most knowledgeable and passionate professors I've ever had. However, she talks a lot and takes a long time to explain simple concepts. I often just skipped class and watched the lecture videos so I could skip to all the actual notes sections. She's a very caring and personable lady, her teaching was just too wordy for me.

I love her- she is the most caring prof I've had. Her lectures were so interesting and you could tell she truly just wants her students to learn. Exams were directly from lecture material and readings, and group projects were actually fun assignments that were not too stressful. We made a TikTok video and a infographic so no papers or posters!

Amazing professor and genuine person in general. You can really tell she cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She makes seemingly boring material in class enjoyable, and she adds in tidbits about her own life that make the long lectures feel more genuine and interesting. One of my favorite profs I have had so far!

Professor Berndtson is amazing! Her lectures are engaging and well constructed, mainly because she has been teaching this course for decades and perfected it. It is definitely a lot of work, but it is not difficult if you keep up with it. I definitely recommend her!

She is a very caring professor, but if you want to do well in class you have to commit a lot of time and use office hours. This is not a class you can succeed in on your own. The lectures are quite boring and she just talks so it's hard to pick up on the material without getting help. She also explains things in the most complicated way possible.

Amazing professor. So many resources are available to help students succeed (office hours, weekly review sessions, TAs, extra credit), so if you want to get an A it is doable. The class does have a decently heavy workload, and lectures can drag, but Professor Berndtson does a good job. She is extremely knowledgeable and a fantastic person.

By far the best professor/teacher I have ever had. She is so kind and caring and makes it almost impossible to fail her class. She lets you drop one exam score and 2 quiz scores and helps you with other assignments. I really enjoyed her class and she made the content clear as well as her expectations for the class.

Stresses the importance of handwritten notes, but sprints through the PowerPoints, making handwritten notes with all the information impossible. Her PowerPoints are full of information, but be prepared to look at paragraphs of text on every slide, as the information is poorly presented and the figures are convoluted.

Amy is great! As long as you show up to lectures and take notes you will get an A in this class. DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK. All information on the tests is in the lecture notes. If you miss a lecture she has videos of all the lectures on canvas. Literally just take notes and review them right before the tests (which are online at home and open note).

Don't really use the textbook all that much, only for personal study so you can get away without it I haven't really used mine. Points were mostly from discussion worksheets which you get answers for. Attending discussion and lecture leads to good grades. Tests were open note but still could be challenging. She's very nice

Dr Berndtson is super sweet and it's obvious she wants us to do well in her class. Lectures are really content heavy, like just going through slide after slide and I have slept through a majority of the lectures. Tests and quizzes are open note and she gives us a lot of opportunities to ask questions. Her organization of the class is great too.

Professor Berndtson is absolutely amazing. She really cares that her students get good grades and makes it very clear how to do so at the beginning of the semester. Do your work, and youll do amazing!

PLEASE take it with her! She is a super caring professor. She provides so much EC and study resources that really help set you up to pass. If you do the work you'll be fine. She drops some quizzes and 1 exam. Exams open note but long, not crazy difficult. Lecture's can be boring but all of the notes are on exams and quizzes.

Literally loved Dr.B!! shes such a sweetheart and the kindest woman ever. Shes extremelyyyyy smart and knows the material and how to teach it. She actually cares about her students!! The lectures are posted online so if you cant make it to class its not a big deal. Love this queen

Dr. B is incredibly kind. She is always willing to help and gives tons of opportunities to improve. Her class has a few exams, but all are open note- even the final. Her lectures are long and can be boring, but she always points out things that are likely to be on exams.

Since now taking this class a second time with a different prof, I cant help but realize how awful this class was. It was very difficult and Amys lectures always put me to sleep. Her expectations seemed exuberant and I really struggled through the way she did things I would recommend others to choose a different prof if you arent strong in Bio

Dr. B is a great teacher! Most of the material on her tests and quizzes are taken from lecture notes and homework assignments. This class isn't difficult with all the help she provides but it's super time-consuming. I spent 5-6 hours per week outside of class.

Everything is online and the lectures and the amount of time you have to put into this course is the most ridiculous experience I've had in any of my Covid classes. If you don't really get bio you should wait until after campus completely opens up to take this class. I don't get half the subjects we're doing and the work just keeps increasing.

I have had Dr. Berndtson twice now for BIOL-L112. I struggled my first semester in her class, not because of course material but because of issues outside the classroom. I trusted Dr. Berndtson and she made me feel like everything would be okay. I retook the course in fall 2020 and was lucky enough to continue to have her support. Amazing prof!
This class was very interesting with her. There was a lot of material but she was always so encouraging and helpful and always made an effort to know her students, even when there was 150+ students.

She was hands down the best teacher Ive had at IU. She really cares about her students and wants to help her students succeed. Tests are a bit harder than the practice but if you go to class you will be fine.

This class was honestly a lot of work for the 100-level (especially the honors section) but she is so nice that it makes up for it. If you do everything you can do well, and she goes out of her way to help students succeed. You can tell she really cares about how students are doing in and outside of the class.

Prof Berndtson is truly a great professor, she genuinely wants you to succeed and do well in the class. She also gives so many resources to ensure that you do well, including study guides and practice quizzes/exams, study sessions, and a lot of extra credit assignments. She is so sweet and caring, take her!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: So kind, understanding, & genuinely cares about your grade & learning experience. Material is clear & easy to follow. Take notes, do the assignments, & study like you would any other class. She gives several opportunities for extra credit on top of EC on all exams. Holds study sessions for quizzes & exams which are extremely helpful. Amazing!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Berndtson is amazing. She is super nice and wants her students to do well in her course. Her AI's are super nice as well. If you follow her advice you can get a good grade in this class. Her lectures are interesting and she really cares about her students. Take BIO112 with her!
She genuinely wants you to succeed and understand the material. She gives so many resources to ensure that you are prepared for tests and quizzes. She is also super sweet and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class wasn't super easy, and the lectures could be boring, but attendance is important for class assessments and notes. Amy really cares about her students' success. She has weekly review sessions, and extra office hours before exams. Lowest exam and lowest 2 quizzes dropped, and many opportunities for extra credit. Very helpful and kind!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I had her my freshman year for biology. Really enjoyed her class though it kept me up for some nights. The material can be difficult but she is helpful and knowledgable about the subject
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Berndtson is an awesome professor who truly cares about the success of her students! She goes above and beyond any other professor I've encountered at IU by holding extra office hours, review sessions, etc. With studying, the class is very manageable! Although lectures may drag on, I highly recommend taking BIOL-L112 with Dr. B!!

Dr. B is an amazing professor. She genuinely cares about her students and holds weekly review sessions every week to help students, which are very helpful. She is an awesome teacher and really knows her stuff. Take with Dr. B!

Dr. Berndtson cares about her students. If you come to class prepared, pay attention in lecture (and take good notes), do the discussion worksheets (with ease), and go to office hours you'll probably be fine. You must understand the concepts pretty well to perform on exams but there's no escaping the memorization required.

If you took AP Bio in HS and did well, this class is a breeze. Amy's really sweet, and she provides lots of drops and a decent amount of extra credit on tests and worksheets. She gives you all the tools you need to succeed; work at it and you'll get the A. The lectures just get boring after awhile; they're really long. Especially at 8am.

Dr. Berndtson is the epitome of a professor who wants all of her students to have the brightest futures. I always felt cared for in her class, and she lets you know of any and all opportunities available, which is great for premed or any pre-professional students. Lectures are slightly boring, but necessary. Take her class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Attend class and keep up with your readings. Material can be difficult but worst exam grade, worst quiz grade and worst two discussion sheet grades are dropped. Attendance is not required, but quizzes and and class assessments (which students automatically receive credit for completing) are given very often. Most STEM majors will like this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lectures are long and boring but she provides you with worksheets for discussion to review all the material which is really helpful. Also, she personally holds review lectures before exams where she basically goes over what you need to know for it and you can ask questions if you're still unsure about certain info. Overall a super helpful prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She barely grades anything so every point counts. I calculated it and every point is almost .5% of your grade. Lectures are boring af and if you study and read the book you'll be fine but if you can, go with a different teacher.

Good luck y'all. If you have not taken AP Bio, you're screwed. This is the hardest class I've ever taken. She goes on long tangents about things you don't need to know. So many complex and implied questions on tests. So hard to focus when she uses huge words that most of us don't know. Very good at confusing people
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I was a junior taking this class having not taken a biology class since freshman year of high school so after the first exam I had a 66 in the class. For the love of god, go to her group office hours before tests and quizzes! Once I started doing that I got my grade up to a 90 in like 3 weeks. The class is hard, but if you put in work youll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Berndtson will do anything to help you pass the class. If you have always struggled by biology like I have, she is the best teacher to have because she gives you everything you need in order to do well. Take the time to do the activities she asks you to do, and you will no doubt get an A, even if you don't get bio.

This class is very lecture heavy but extremely easy if you have a solid background in biology and are able to think critically. The discussion sections really help clarify some concepts and I love my UTA for it. I didn't show up for half of the lectures and still did really well.

The class itself is pretty easy. She drops your lowest quiz and test score. Amy is a really great lecturer and available outside of class. Go to her group office hours because she hints what will be on the tests and the quizzes!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Some of the material in L112 can be dense, but Amy does a really good job of providing plenty of resources (weekly discussion groups, PASS tables, group study sessions, fill-in-the-blank notes, etc.) that make this class an easy A if you take advantage of them. Amy has genuine passion for what she does and really cares about her students' success.

Whatever you learn from her will be from the lectures. She grades very strictly and looks for certain key words in all her questions. Her exams were the toughest part of the class. Every point counts. There aren't very many points in the class overall. I was frustrated with the class and if I had a choice I wouldn't take it with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great lectures, go to class or you will be lost!!! Very intelligent and enthusiastic prof, tests are difficult but study guides are provided and study your butt off!!! I found the class pretty interesting. Not necessary to read the book, everything is covered in lecture slides.

Professor Berndston sets you up to pass her class - as long as you put in effort.  She provides slides that you fill in when you come to class.  If you study her slides/notes, study guides, discussion worksheets, group activities, and previous quizzes, you will be fine and should get an A. **GO TO HER GROUP OFFICE HOURS**she gives hints for quizzes

Dr. Berndtson offers office hours twice weekly and is available for communication. She really cares and puts a great deal of energy into her teaching. Really a great person and professor, highly recommend.

Berndtson is a great prof. Unless you read the text beforehand, like she recommends, lecture isn't going to teach you the material. I had to read the chapters in depth to really solidify it. Group office hours were extremely helpful. Berndston gives you everything you need to succeed, like study guide keys, etc. You just gotta put in all the work!

The class is extremely lecture heavy but her slides are mostly filled out so you can really focus on the lecture and write less during lecture. The discussion groups are very good for really reinforcing the material and she draws a lot of exam questions from DG's. Holds great pre-exam review sessions where she practically gives the exam away.
Very nice person. I had a habit of falling asleep in lecture though.
Drops exams, discussion section questions, drops pop quizzes, drops quizzes, and gives extra credit. Best Biology teacher thus far.

L112 is a hard & confusing class to begin with but Amy really does her best to make the material accessible & understandable. She has review sessions before each exam and makes herself available to you with 4-5 office hours a week! You get to drop 1 test and class activities and discussion group worksheets can pad your grade, but don't skip class!!

She outlines the course very well and pretty much tells you what to study for each test. As long as you're willing to put in work in then you'll definitely get an A. A lot of the test/quiz questions come from the notes, so make sure to go to class or at least get notes from someone. Doesn't take attendance, but gives announced quizzes/worksheets.
Really great intro course. Everything is clear.

Dr. Berndtson provides your run of the mill intro to biology course. Get the easy points you can, review materials for test and it's a pretty easy A. Provides review sessions for every test as well as detailed study guides. Awesome structure for a freshman level course.

overall she's a great teacher. gives great notes. although attendance is not mandatory I would go to class because she gives great lecture notes. there are also says where she gives quizzes or class assessments which are for a grade so make sure you check the schedule before you skip.

Lectures could be a bit exhaustive, but she did her best to make everything meaningful. Exams were easy if you worked hard by rewriting notesreviewingdoing the worksheets like she advises you to. You get to drop an exam, but make sure to try on all of them. All in all, I learned a lot.

Dr. Berndtson is super nice and helpful. Make sure to study ALL the resources she provides for tests to get a good grade. She gives a ton of EC and her group office hours are a really good way to review for quizzes. It's a lot of memorization and studying but she's an amazing professor and loves the subject.

Easy A if you attend lectures and discussions. Review discussion group worksheet and Class activities for the Exams. Only 3 exams and you can drop 1. The final was the hardest test. If you put in the work you can get an A.

Lectures were boring and i basically got nothing out of them. She talks way too fast and i had to just relearn everything from the notes. Practice quizzes and exam were nothing like the real tests, and had quizzes every week. However discussion group assignments were done as a group and could drop an exam. Not hard to get an A, just didn't enjoy it
She expects way too much out of you after barely explaining the material. Questions on exams are way too in detail and for the final she gave an exam of 50 questions over 16 chapters.

Lectures are long, but so nice that she gives her slides w easy fill in the blank notes.  She literally gives students EVERYTHING to be successful (answer keys to hw, study questions, and class activities), and feeds test material at her review sessions.  Spends so much time on the class, and it shows.  Would definitely take class with her again!!

Overall a pretty easy professor that was enthusiastic about her field. Sometimes the assignments are dull and dry but are easy, for the most part. Exams can be tough. Pretty fair grading policies though. Recommended to several friends.
Lectures were straight-forward with fill-in the blank powerpoints. If you pay attention in lecture and discussion and minimally study you should be fine as long as you are understanding the material.

I loved Berndtson's enthusiasm and genuine sweetness in class! The lectures are long and can seem to drag on but that could be because this was an 8am class. Either way, she is very helpful and understanding and the review sessions are a must-go! She basically feeds the test material to you.

Dr. Berndtson is very sweet and the class is very easy, however the lectures are very long and boring. The class does not engage the student. Lectures can be frustrating as you can essentially obtain the same knowledge  from reading. Tests are not bad. Very easy class if you do your work, read, and go to group office hours if you need extra help.
The professor was great. She is very helpful and sweet.

Dr. Berndtson gives a lot of work and expects you to do all of it. There's a lot of memorization, but everything is included in all her lecture slides and extra worksheets. Come test time, study all of the worksheets she created, not the book. Overall, she is very helpful and go to group office hours for sure. She goes over what is on the quiz.
She gives a lot of work. A lot of memorization is required and sadly her lectures are boring making them virtually useless.

I love Dr. Amy Berndtson. She is soo hopeful. Honestly her group study hours are way better than lecture. Only 20 people go it's great. She is soo smart and loves biology. She helps you get prepared for future classes. barely any professors care as much as she does. Take her class and go to group office hours they help!

Dr. Berndtson is a very nice lady and cares about her students. Unfortunately, she puts you to sleep during her lectures and it is very hard to learn while trying to stay awake and make out what she is saying (very soft voice). Her exams are extremely detail oriented, something unnecessary for a 100 level class. Too much busy work, not worth it!

I hadn't taken biology since freshman year of high school so this class was really challenging. Dr. Berndtson would just read off the slides making it almost pointless to go to class. She wouldn't go into much detail while explaining things. However her review sessions before every exam were pretty helpful.

I thought this class was really hard. I hadn't taken biology since high school so I think this might have contributed to this.  There was a lot of work, but it helped my grade so I'm happy for it.  I thought her tests were really detail oriented which was really hard for me.

She talks a lot, but makes it easy to get an A if you do her busy work. Much of the class is pointless, but it's required for med school admissions and quite a few science majors. Go to the weekly quizzes and turn in discussion. It's basically just a repeat of AP Biology. If there were an Honors, I would have rather taken that.

She gives out too much study info and says to focus on the study questions and activities, then pulls questions from other sources. Expects you to apply info in great depth after explaining it once and not in depth.
Dr. Berndtson was a really amazing teacher. She did everything to make the class interesting. Plus, she knows a lot and loves speaking to students. she's readily available too. a great teacher
Extremely easy, but again, 112 is introductory so easiness is expected.
Take her for 112.  She is super nice and the grading is really fair.  I dont suggest buying the book though; we didnt really use it.

I couldn't have asked for a better professor in my 1st semester. She genuinely cares about her students, and loves what she is teaching. Her notes, discussion group activities, and study guides provide you with everything you need to know for the exams. As long as you attend class and do the assignments you are set! I definitely recommend her!

She's a sweetheart, so willing to help you out with anything. The tests are not super easy, but you cant expect biology to be a breeze. However, if you use the worksheets and stuff she provides, you should get an a. I also took this class at 8am, so I probably was a bit biased in my rating about class interest.

Berndtson is really nice and helpful.  Her class has a nice flow to it.  She uses articles and activities that are extremely recent and fit in perfectly with the class.  Honestly, if you put the right amount of effort, you'll learn a lot and feel really good about it in the end.

She is extremely helpful! There is a lot of material, and she teaches it very accurately; but she provides many self-aids (study guides, worksheets, practice quizzes, etc.) and office hours to help you keep up. She does everything she can it seems to make sure you can learn the material regardless of your learning ability.

She is a very nice and I believe genuinly wants her students to do well. Unfortunately as far as teaching goes you could do just as well staying home and looking at her powerpoint online. Everything she presents in class is word for word read from her slides, and most of the time the test and quiz information is crypically phrased and irrelevant.

VERY HELPFUL AND NICE! She really wants her students to do well and she makes it easier than most biology teachers. She tries to simplify difficult concepts. She makes her tests way easier than most biology professors too! Definitely recommend taking her class for BIO-L 112!

While I do think Berndston was an excellent and fair professor on the whole, if you're teetering between a lower and a higher letter grade- she will give you the lower one if you've earned it. She definitely does not curve up no matter how much you went to her office hours. Also, don't buy the book- just rent it in the LS library!

Very easy teacher and very kind. She wants her students to do well in the course and she provides many cushion points. Spends too much time focusing on the very complex graduate level female reproduction system, which is her area of study and not important for the rest of your college career.

Absolutely loved Professor Berndtson! She really wants her students to do well. Make sure you actually study the discussion worksheets and chapter study guides for the friday quizzes because those can really lower your grade. But overall just do the work and you'll at least get a B. She's awesome!!

She was very helpful and her tests are fair but require some studying. If you want an A go to office hours, she will review everything. But she is very nice and obvioiusly cares about her students which is more than most could say.

The lecture notes are fill in hen blank, and there are alot of study materials.  If you do teh study guides and discussion worksheets and go through teh practice exams you will do fine.  Plus you getto drop two quizes and an exam.  Its hard to stay awake in lecture, she turns the lights down too low.  Recommend bringing a laptop to take notes.

Berndtson teaches really close to the book, so if you attend every lecture and review the notes before the exam, you'll do okay. HOWEVER! Definitely attend the review sessions she had before the exams - she always shows diagrams and information that WILL be on the exam. Exam covers stuff from lecture, discussion wrkshts, and review sessions.

A great enthusiastic teacher. She is very willing to work with you if you are struggling or have scheduling conflicts. She gives quizzes every week and her exams and quizzes are tough. I used the extra study guide and it wasnt much help. Just don't miss lecture + print/bring notes and you'll be fine. Awesome bio teacher if you're going medical.
This class was surprisingly interesting. Just read the chapters and keep up on the worksheets. Dr. B gives plenty of opportunities to do well in the class. Definitely a good prof choice.

Professor Berndtson is very enthusiastic about teaching biology and provides many opportunities (study guides, practice exams, etc.) to do well in the class. GO TO OFFICE HOURS - she goes over the study guides and answers questions. If you are willing to put forth effort and keep on top of material, she will be more than willing to help you.

Decent teacher, but she really makes every effort to give students a chance to get an A in biology. Notes are straight forward and the quizzes/exams come straight off the study guides, which she gives you answers to. Probably would learn/be challenged more in Rusnick, but I'm happy with the A. Book is rarely used.
Tests were very difficult, I attended every class and the information in class did not pertain to the tests at all.

If you are going to take BIOL-L112 then take the class with her as your teacher. She gives you notes that are fill-in-the-blank, she offers a lot of extra credit, and she is really good about explaining topics. It was tough to stay awake in her classes because she dimmed the lights too low.

Prof Berndtson is a really good teacher to a group, but is extremely hard to talk to one on one and isn't the friendliest of people. If you don't go to class it's your loss, but she def won't make you. quizzes every now and then, but her quizzes and exams are pretty easy as long as you pay attention and study appropriately.

She really wants all of her students to do well in her class and get good grades. You should be able to get a high grade in this class if you do the optional study guides. Class is optional. If you think the lecture material is confusing, then go to her office hours, she'll explain concepts in a more clear way.

Great teacher!  She is very knowledgeable and passionate about her subject and does her best to make sure everybody understands everything.  Getting an A is easily attainable.  She drops the lowest test grade which helps.  Highly recommended!
Awesome teacher! She's so nice and really works hard to make sure everyone understands. Yeah, the lecture itself is boring but the material is interesting and easy!

She bases her notes off the book, but you don't need to read at all as long as you take the notes in class (she gives slide outlines that you fill in). It's pretty simple, especially if you go to class and do the chapter guides she gives you. If you know those pretty well and go to class, you'll ace everything.

Her grading scale is somewhat easy, but L112 is just not an easy class. She doesn't present the material in a clear/interesting way.  Her lengthy fill-in-the-blank powerpoint notes are useless and she READS THEM WORD-FOR-WORD during lecture. So frustrating! Choose a different prof for L112, it may be more challenging but it's definitely worth it!
Prof. Berndtson is really nice and pretty enthusiastic about everything she teaches. She gives out studies guides from which 95% of the test and quiz material is pulled, so it makes studying easy.

She is a great teacher! She has so much interest in the subject. She also drops your lowest exam grade, quiz grade, and attendance check grade.  She also tells you before you will have an attendance check and then go over the answers with you before you turn it in so you automatically make a 100.
This prof gives students a chance to get an A in L112 unlike rusink and others. STOP COMPLAINING AND TAKE THIS CLASS! Its for the good of your GPA and college career

She is an easy teacher and clearly explains what will be on the test. Using masteringbiology will get you an A on most quizzes. She gives weekly worksheets to turn in during discussion but you go over the answers while you are there. Only problem was that she did not seem comfortable with teaching anything but the reproduction section.

First, I had her for Summer 1 so it might be different than a regular full semester course.  Dr. Berndtson was a very easy teacher and she made the topic (pregnancy) interesting as I just took the class because it was an N&M. She gives you EVERYTHING that will be on the test and there was tons and tons of bonus.  I did little work and got an A.

I really like Professor Berndtson. She is always willing to help during office hours. If you're serious about pre-med, you need to do well in this class and it's not hard. She tells you exactly what's on the exams and quizzes, down to the very types of questions that will be on it and gives extra credit.  You get to drop 1 exam and 2 quizzes.

She really has no idea what she is talking about. She reads directly from the overheard and even manages to mess that up. The class is pretty easy though, she let's you drop 2 quizzes and even a test too! A more interesting teacher would be much more worth it though if you like biology...

If you took Bio AP in high school and the class was somewhat serious, L112 won't be so challenging. If not, reading the text and doing masteringbiology will help a lot.She is not so organized so you have to print your notes right before class and she has a lot of trouble with lights.
She doesn't seem to be able to explain complex material clearly. The powerpoints are basically worthless, fortunately, her tests are rather easy if you read the text and do masteringbiology

Probably the worst teacher I have ever had. She never sounds like she knows what she is talking about, and she reads DIRECTLY from the power points. You will not learn anything from her!! Please take my advice and do not take this teacher!

While the class isn't ridiculously hard, her method of teaching is useless.  She gives you powerpoints to print with just one or two key pieces of information missing so you must attend class - then she READS the powerpoint to you with no supplemental lecture(i have used my entire print quota and it's not even been 8 week, btw) I can read!  sucks

SP25: Arnold was my first introduction to chemistry since HS. The notes were fill in and she explains the general yet broad topics very clearly. She can be a little intimidating to speak with, but she is really good at walking you through the material. The lab is annoying but easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: FA25: Arnold (& Porter) are incredible Chemistry lecturers. Notes are very easy to follow/fill in, practice exams are incredibly useful for exam prep. The final is 4 sections based on each midterm unit, if your final is better than your midterm, it replaces it. MOST IMPORTANTLY, they make the transition from 117 to 341 very smooth!

If you want to get an A in CHEM 117 take it with Arnold and Porter. They are by far the best chem teachers I've ever had. The practice tests they give you prepare you so well for the exams. I was actually excited to go to class. As long as you do you work, pay attention, and study, you'll get an A.

This professor explains concepts clearly and keeps lectures engaging. The class is challenging and exams are tough, but she is approachable and supportive. Workload outside of exams is light. Overall, a demanding but rewarding experience.
So much extra credit and grade help is given in the last week which is great. Lectures are quick paced in a good way. Lots of practice problems and help available.

I took C117 with Professor Arnold and Professor Porter (combined teaching). Professor Arnold was a fair, positive, and understanding professor. Assignments were relevant to exams, and there was always an opportunity for grade improvement. I have a brief background in chemistry, so I did not find the class to be extremely challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Good professor, only con is she explains things pretty quick and not as well as the other professor. Super nice too though

Good lectures, very reasonable grader, but my only complaint is that she is not very friendly. Students don't enjoy talking to her 1-on-1. She can come off as very condescending. But overall I keep taking classes with her because she is a fair grader and expectations are clear.

She is honestly my favorite professor I've ever had. She's funny, kind, and explains each concept clearly. On top of all of that, her style is so good, she comes in at 8am looking amazing. If I could have her teach all of my chemistry courses, I would. That's how much I enjoy her class.
Simply the greatest. Very respectful, friendly, and enthusiastic about teaching. Amazing and clear style of teaching. Very available for questions and provides many help opportunities.

Professor Arnold was super caring and clearly emphasizes all students support. She is enthusastic each day, and her lectures are easy to follow. She is accessible outside of class and gives feedback on homework and quizzes, when is helpful post tests.

Prof. Arnold is great. She very much cares about her students and wants them to succeed, and gives them many resources to do so. The notes are easy to follow and homework is genuinely helpful. They give out good advice in class, and discussion is worth going to. She is very friendly and will come talk to you if you sit in the front row.
Great professor, made the class super easy to follow.

I really enjoyed taking her class, the lectures were pretty straightforward, notes are provided (fill in the blank sort of style) and had interesting little experiments in class once in a while. She is very helpful and is able to clarify any questions. The HW in my opinion was fairly easy and helped with studying as well as not being overwhelming.

I took this class at 8 AM and despite that Prof Arnold made it enjoyable! She is very easy to talk to, so I recommend participating and asking questions to ensure your understanding. The material itself is pretty easy especially if you did some chemistry in high school. Show up to class and work on the discussion worksheets, they help!

Professor Arnold is a caring and passionate lecturer who explains material clearly and keeps the class well-organized. They offer strong support outside of class and are always willing to help. Exams and assignments are fair, and their dedication to student success truly stands out.
Undisputed goat

Professor Arnold is AMAZING. She's kind and cares so much about her students. If you go to lectures and discussions, you should have no problem in this class. There are also a million study sessions you can attend for extra help. Her and the teaching team are so encouraging and always willing to help. I can't imagine a better professor honestly.

She was a very good lecturer as she walked you through examples in class and filled out the notes with you. Her teaching team was incredible and all ready to help too. She is very knowledgeable and all her practice exams and examples in class are very similar to the tests themselves. I would 100% take this course before Chem-117 with her.
Go to lectures and study sessions and you'll do fine.

Kimberly Arnold is the perfect example of a good professor. She is kind, understanding, has very well thought-out policies and a system that works for everyone, and most of all, she cares. She cares about the student and sees the potential within her students. She is, so far, the best professor I've ever had. PLEASE take her for chemistry!
Very nice and awesome lecturer.

She is absolutely amazing! She explains things very clearly and her office hours are so helpful. She gave lots of extra credit opportunities too. Her practice exams were true to the actual exams and she records lectures which is so helpful for studying. I wish I could take every chem class with her.
hard class but I just finished my 3rd semester of chemistry and have had 5 ish different professors and she is by far the best. if you have to take this class GET HER IF YOU CAN

I loved Professor Arnold! She is very caring and understanding. She does a really good job of breaking down the material in a way that is easy to understand. While she doesn't require you to read the textbook, I would recommend it since it made understanding some of the harder concepts easier. Overall highly recommend her!
Kim offers many extra credit opportunities and has a great teaching staff. There are many available office hours for students to go to, to recieve help
There are so many office hours for the course so it's super easy to get help. You don't need to read the textbook, but it's helpful. The lectures are clear so it's helpful to go to them.

Professor Arnold is by far my favorite professor at IU. She is engaging and excited about the material. She's very clear with her explanations, and she is highly available for help sessions outside of class. There are extra credit opportunities on every test, but you need to study. She is a genuinely good person who wants the best for her students.

Professor Arnold is a skilled and captivating lecturer who organizes and explains information clearly. While chemistry can be a daunting subject to dip your feet into, Professor Arnold provides several resources for students to be successful, such as study problems and a wide array of office hours.

Professor Arnold is an amazing prof for anyone taking chem courses. Lectures are engaging and she posts them all during the week in case you miss class. Discussion assignments and homework help a lot with the material. Learn how to study early on, review lectures and redo homework and discussion assignments for practice for exams

Class was a great intro to chemistry, and Prof. Arnold was a passionate and effective professor. She worked out problems step by step and her slides were helpful for assignments and studying for exams. Discussion and lecture attendance are mandatory, but they are key to being successful in this class. Would recommend if you plan on taking C117.

I had a great time in Prof. Arnold's lecture. Her lecture's were very helpful and she had a skeleton note style which I find very beneficial in learning. Lots of office hours and discussions were mandatory. The discussion were pretty easy! All tests had retakes, besides the final.
Absolutely amazing, she seems to really care about her students. she explains things in a way everyone can understand. plenty of access to help from her and Ais. I loved her and the class.

10/10 recommend taking her class, she is very involved and a very good teacher. The lectures were engaging and I did not dread going to them. This professor is definitely one I would recommend for teaching generally chemistry.

Seriously one of the best professors I've ever had. Lectures are so helpful and engaging, and she does such a great job at explaining the material. She does grade for attendance, but you'll usually want to go to lectures anyway because they're entertaining and aren't draining or boring. She provides a lot of great resources for review as well.

C103 is not an easy class. But if it wasn't for Professor Arnold it'd be only worse. Your attendance at lectures matter as it counts towards 5% of your grade and it's much easier than listening to the recording. Professor Arnold is a phenomenal professor that actually cares if her students are learning the content.
Amazon!

Professor Arnold is one of the best chemistry teachers I have ever had. I couldn't tell you a thing about chemistry before I had her, and now I finally feel like I get it. If you are taking Chem 103, please take it with professor Arnold.
Overall an amazing professor. Very considerate but there will be lots of homework and the exams are difficult. Be ready to spend a lot of time studying and attending office hours

Still currently enrolled in the class for the final stretch before thanksgiving break but i have to say my experience with professor arnold has been great. she breaks down the topics at hand so everyone is able to understand although does go a little fast at times. c103 can be tough for students but i recommend prof arnold wholeheartedly.
This class set students up for success with helpful lectures, discussions, and lots of resources outside of class.

she was an amazing prof, i would have not passed c117 without her help and her notes. i learned more than i did in c117 lectures. The study sessions are so helpful for upcoming c117 exams, mastery assignment help. it was so helpful to take this class with c117 and prof kim made it so much easy, the way she explained was so easy to understand.

Prof. Arnold is an amazing professor! She is caring and wants her students to succeed. She holds office hours that are super helpful to get homework done and get extra help. C103 is not an easy class, you must put effort in to do good. I am annoyed with my grade because I put so much effort in the class but I am not a good test taker.

Professor Arnold is a caring professor. She truly wants her students to succeed and is even willing to negotiate test questions. She tries her best to have an engaging lecture. TOPHAT is used to keep attendance.
as far as chem professors go shes pretty good and knows what shes talking about

Professor Arnold gives helpful resources to navigate C117, but is extremely rude and difficult to approach if you have a question about the class. I would not recommend taking her class if you don't have to.

I really liked Professor Arnold's class! She was very kind and the lectures were helpful for the pre-labs and post-labs. This class is a lot of work for 2 credit hours, but as long as you do your work, it's pretty easy to get a good grade. I would recommend taking this class with Professor Arnold!

Professor Arnold was one of my favorite professors this year! Her lectures are well explained and very helpful for the pre-lab and post-lab assignments. She was very attentive and often stopped in during lab to make sure that everything was going well. I would absolutely love to take another one of her classes!

Her lectures were very clear and easy to understand. You have to attend class for participation. The exams all had a retake opportunity which was great. She really wants to see her students succeed. The class is not difficult if you attend lectures, discussions, and try your best on the homework that is due online every week.

I wish attendance wasnt graded, that is the only downside of this class. The tests were hard, but there is a retake opportunity and bonus points for all of them. She was very nice and able to meet, you just have to put the work in for this class.

She is an amazing prof. If you don't understand the material, go to her office during hours because they help tremendously. You can't just sit in the back and be silent unless you really know what you're doing. She's very understanding and will always work with you. I recommend her 1000%
Arnold is a great instructor, kind and patient in the learning process. Highly recommend for C101 Elementary Chemistry!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice and helpful. Go to lab hours for help!! It will save your grade no matter if it is with her or an AI.

Kim is super sweet and engaging. She's a great teacher that teaches chem the easiest way possible. She provides a lot of resources such as practice worksheets, practice exams, and quizzes which provide a lot of good examples of what is going to be on the exam. When it comes down to it, chemistry isn't easy. You have to study and cant get behind
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Arnold truly cares about her students and makes sure that everyone knows the material. I definitely recommend her. This course can get a little heavy on work but she has office hours and uploads her lectures on canvas so you can look back if you missed anything in lecture.

Kim is one of the most influential teachers I had. She motivated me to do well in her class and also my other class. Her Ofer ours are really beneficial if you are not understanding the material and its good to do every practice problems that she post and practice exams before a test. If you do that you will for sure pass the class.

If you have to take chemistry, take it with Professor Arnold. She explains things SO well. Her tests are not too hard and you will know exactly what will be on them. She is so so nice and if you need any help she is right there to help anyone!! LOVE HER

One of my favorite professors I've every had here at IU! I absolutely loved Kim, she truly cares about her students and she is always available outside of class. Just like almost every other chemistry class, if you put the time in then you will succeed.

No matter how hard my brain just could not comprehend chemistry, she really wants to make sure you pass and she is the only professor I've had that genuinely wants to see me succeed and really help me to do so.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Shes Lowkey kinda cute. But yeah cool teacher, I hate chem and it wasnt that bad.

She really wants you to succeed. he has three children and still managed to meet with me after hours to help me on concepts I didn't understand. She goes above and beyond to make sure you succeed. She not a research professor so that means she's strictly here to teach and she is awesome and has a great personality.I would definitely take her again.
Hardest class I've taken before. She's a very nice person but the class is very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: great professor for a not so fun class. she took a lot of time to get to know students and kept classes interesting. would definitely take her chemistry course over any other professors at IU
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Wasn't a fan of chemistry at all before I took the class, but going to her lectures it kinda grew on me and made the class more interesting. Clicker everyday with three drops, tests aren't too bad, class isn't too bad if you take time outside of class to go over material.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She explains everything in a very detailed and helpful way. If you attend the lectures, then the class is very easy.
A very nice professor, very straightforward. Not much that can trip you up, Just look at the syllabus and turn in stuff on time and you'll be fine. Class material is not very hard.

She is the sweetest individual, however, I learned nothing during her lectures. She went too fast and never got into detail. Sometimes I was better off skipping the lecture and reading the material myself. You NEED to read the book.

Professor Arnold is a great teacher. Her lectures are clear will print out notes that go right along with what she is saying. Th class can be a little heavy with work because there is a lab, lecture, and discussion but the work is not impossible. There are many AIs so getting help is very easy. Overall the class was very helpful.
She is very clear and helpful but it is a tough subject
It's an easy course if you go to class. Her lectures are easy to understand just pay attention.
Prof Arnold is great. Would recommend taking C103 with her before C117.
Really helpful and an overall great professor.  You'll get an A if you do the work

Very clear professor, powerpoints and office hours are helpful. Gives you the notes ahead of time so its easy to follow along. Lots of chances to drop points (8 lecture absences, 4 discussion absences, 1 lab drop). 2nd test was long and difficult with a C- average. Overall lots of points to pad grade.

I highly suggest taking this class with Prof. Arnold before taking c117! It was really beneficial and I had a successful semester in this course. It was fairly easy if you just put in the work. Lots of opportunities for office hours for the extra help. Exams are very easy. The labs are the only challenge, but even those are manageable.

She's very clear and easy to understand. I didn't need to go to office hours at all because she's good at getting the info across in class, plus the mandatory discussion section helped. Engaging and an easy class.
Clicker Required for attendance
She is very enthusiastic about what she teaches, and this transfers to the classroom. Offers help via office hours, and makes usually boring lectures interesting.

Professor Arnold was a great professor to have my first semester at IU.  Powervpoints were easy to follow and the class was basically a review of what I had done in high school chemistry.  The last chapter was more challenging but just do the practice exams, attend class and discussion, and you will do fine.

Prof. Arnold is fantastic! She's a genuinely nice and caring woman, who enjoys Chemistry and teaches it quite well! She puts everything in the most simplistic terms, which is helpful. Go to office hours, she's definitely one to get to know! Best advice: cushion your grade by doing well on CALM, lab reports and discussion points, go to class too!
Class was hard overall, but Professor Arnold did a really good job of explaining it clearly and providing enough examples. Cushioned grade with lots of extra points which was nice!

Professor Arnold is a very good professor to have as a freshman. She is generally clear and to the point, but can over explain some concepts at times with extra information. However, overall, just do the practice exams, go to office hours, and don't be afraid to ask for help EARLY in the semester. If you do all of this, an A is pretty achievable.

Professor Arnold is an amazing professor. She gives you the slides before lecture so you can keep up and take notes a lot faster. Tests are super easy as long as you go to every lecture and do the CALM homework. Great course but some material is learned very slowly since it's basically HS chemistry.

Like most science professors at this university, she's out there to trick you and nothing more. With the exception of the first exam, the exams were over material not even covered in class, which is no surprise seeing as how there is a limited amount of seats for CHEM-C 117.
Professor Arnold was super nice and she explained the material very well. Plus the powerpoints from her lectures are available online so you can follow along with her.

Professor Arnold is wonderful. She explains everything well and is a great lecturer. Her tests are nothing too difficult, if you put in an hour or two studying prior to the test, you should get an A or B easy. Discussions are also required and are easy. The laboratory portion, taught by prof Skrabalak is the subpar part of the class and is boring.

She explains the material clearly and very thoroughly. The lectures are pretty easy to understand. She  has office hours where she was very helpful. Also, the discussion AIs have their own office hours in case you can't make hers. Overall, she's really accessible and the material is pretty easy to understand at the pace the class goes.

She is a sweetheart, and is always willing to help however she can.  She gives the power points for you to take notes on. Tests are easy if you study. She goes at an easy pace.  She is very laid back, and easy to talk to.

Class is pretty hard, but she's a good teacher. She's a very nice lady and pretty clear when teaching. At times she's seems to go fast, but other than that she's a great professor. Be prepared to work in this class.
She was very clear, enthusiastic and willing (and wanting) to help students do well in her class.

Excellent lecturer!  Her power points are very clear and she goes to lengths to work example problems during class.  Assigned worksheets for discussion sections are very helpful.  Tests can be challenging, but not overwhelmingly so if you're paying attention in class.
really nice and helpful lady. pretty straightforward class. i would recommend her.

She is really sweet and takes the time to explain everything clearly. The tests were relatively easy as long as you can do all of the practice exams she gives you. Her office hours are helpful before tests. This is a good class to take if you're kind of foggy on your chemistry from high school.
Very nice and helpful teacher.
Very great teacher! Caring about her students even with 350 in a class! I'd recommend this class with this professor.
Good teach

Prof Arnold is extremely nice and helpful. I had a lab AI that was very strict with lab reports and she ended up giving everyone in my section extra points. Lecture notes are easy to understand and she explains things very thoroughly.
She is super sweet. Very helpful. Lecture notes are easy to go through. Test can be a tad difficult but nothing unmanageable.

She's very straightforward, helpful, and kind. Wonderful professor who is always making an effort to help her students. The class is very easy, but time consuming, and you have to study for the exams. Good class if you're not strong in Chem or need a N&M elective. I've hardly cracked the book, good thing I need it for 117 or it'd be a total waste.

She's very nice and her lectures are easy to understand. If you get 70% on clickers then you get 50/50 participation for the course. I only had a year of chemistry in high school and it was enough for this class, great idea to take before C117.

She's really nice and always finds ways to keep the class interested. She and her husband (who both teach this section) are always making jokes and doing interesting demonstrations. Good first step in the chemistry field.
Great professor! Fun and knowledgable about the course. Eager to help whenever. Material is clear and thoroughly explained. Great class to help prepare for upper levels.
No Comments
what a guy
Goated Professor. I love the way he teaches the class. I skipped almost every class because someone gave me the code. Final is open note (ifykwim).
DONT PAY FOR THE TEXTBOOK. I ended up not using it and wasting that. Other than that his class is good. Its the type of class that you get out what you put into it. Easy A.

1. Attendance is done through codes so it's often easy to skip, 2. All of his work can be done with AI's help, 3. Last exam is open note , 4. Overall he is a chill guy and just cares about what he teaches, 5. Easiest intro finance class ever
Funny guy. Lots of lectures.
Lecture heavy, but very very easy class. He is so funny! Attendance mandatory and classes can be boring but he makes it more enjoyable.
Lectures are long but can be interesting. Wants his students to succeed

Really chill teacher. Attendance is mandatory but you can get the attendance code from a friend. Lectures are pretty interesting and definitely helpful if you're unsure what career you want to pursue in finance.

Professor Arcot is a great guy! He finds a way to keep lectures engaging and is always ready to answer questions. Just do good on the practice problem sets in class and you'll be fine. Final is open notes.
Such a chiller. Made F100 a bearable 8am class, but on the content side, it's not as easy of an A as it used to be. Expect to have to do some actual learning when quizzes and exams pile up
Very friendly and taught well; attendance is sort of mandatory with you needing to enter a course code but you could honestly just ask a friend in the class; quizzes and final exam are open note
Good professor.
