Papers are easily graded as long as you use specific examples, I read 20 pgs max from each book and sounded like I knew what I was saying. Easiest class ever

Far, far, FAR too much work assigned for this class.  It was only a 3 credit course, but as far as workload- perhaps it should have been a 5 credit class.  Although he knows his material well and is enthusiastic about it, the instructor needs to realize that students actually have other classes and responsibilities than his class alone.
THIS WAS WORST CLASS EVER!!! He would have better off speaking in Chinese. I hardly stayed awake. DO NOT TAKE THE GREAT WALL OF CHINA.

Please save yourself the time and do not take the topics class on the Great Wall of China. The worst class I had this semester and it was a 103. Lots of readings and quizzes are strictly on memorization of useless dates, along with 5 long and boring papers. He knows his stuff but doesn't realize its a 100 level class and needs to understand that.

DO NOT TAKE HIS TOPICS COURSE ON THE GREAT WALL OF CHINA! For your sake, pick a different topics course. There was more work in this class than in any of my 200 or 300 level classes this semester. There are five papers in this course with quizzes in between. Readings are excessively long. Quizzes focus more on arbitrary memorization than learning.

He is so all over the place. His  presentation slides contain nothing. He didnt clarify which part of the study to focus on. He talk so much about crap stuffs which causes the students to get almost nothing from the lectures. Personally, he is a good prof. to seek for consultation but not teaching.

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS UNLESS YOU ARE EXTREMELY INTERESTED IN THE TOPIC! Atwood knows what he is talking about but he finds the Great Wall of China about a million times more interesting than the average person. I dreaded going to class and once I got there I could hardly stay awake. Avoid unless you are very passionate about Mongolia/China!

Atwood is a good teacher, but he makes the lectures EXTREMELY boring. There is a ridiculous amount of reading, and in my class, you needed five essays. Too much work for a 100 level class, in my opinion. However, he explains well and does what he needs to do to make you understand the material.
The class appears like it was going to be extremely difficult with tough readings and five papers. But his grading is easy. I would take his class again.
No organization...class is more difficult than any at this level
boring..... he made the bloody mongol conquest boring

Atwood is knowledgeable but it's difficult to stay awake in his class unless you're REALLY interested in the topic. Ridiculous amount of writing/reading required but essays were graded easily. You can get away with not really reading the texts. I still did way more work for this course than I should have for a 100 level class.
The class was extremely interesting. You must read a lot and write a lot of essays to do well, but it is totally possible. Go to office hours and he is really helpful.
No Comments

Avram is easily the most caring, kind, and thoughtful professor at IU. I have had numerous amazing professors at IU, but truly, Avram is a wonderful teacher who genuinely cares about his students and makes learning enjoyable. He has endless wisdom and really offers it to anyone interested or in need of help. Please take his classes

I took GIS with Prof. Primack, it was a fun class, very project-based. His class is very laid back, and sometimes felt like he was just rambling and making jokes rather than teaching. He's not great about responding to e-mails/canvas messages, but is usually available in-person. I felt like I understood what he was teaching most of the time.

Professor Avram is the best and most knowledgeable professor. His teaching style makes complex topics easy to understand, and he's always available to help students. He records lectures for easy access and is genuinely caring and supportive, making this semester a rewarding experience.

It was a ton of fun taking Dr. Primack's class. I learned a lot, and while taking online courses is always difficult for me, his approach to teaching made it much easier. He is a very kind and understanding man, I wish I could have taken his in-person GIS course!

Professor Primack is a funny and talkative dude. He made me laugh numerous of time over random stuff. However, I don't think I learned one thing in the class. He's not actually teaching but more just talking about stuff he knows. For example this isn't a fact based class but more his interpretation on conservation bio. Easy A class but didn't learn

Definitely laid back on most things, and simply shows you the steps you need to take to complete a task. There's a lack of clarity and professionalism at times. Grading and feedback are confusing and he can start rambling in lectures about things no one seems to know about.

He really is a caring professor. His quizzes are graded tough (ex. on a question worth 5 points he might give you 4.7; its hard to get full points), HOWEVER if you go talk to him in office hours he will happily go over and adjust your score if you talk to him about your answer or ask him to explain why he graded something a particular way.

Professor Primack was incredibly accommodating to all his students. The material is challenging at first as most students do not have GIS experience. However, Professor Primack holds daily office hours and is always happy to help students.

He's super interesting. Lectures seem like he's just rambling and I'm not sure if I really learned anything. He says he takes attendance but he doesn't really notice if you're not there. There are group projects and small assignments that he doesn't really give instructions/rubric for, and an end of year poster project. Overall it's ok.

The worst professor I have ever had at IU. Doesn't know how to use canvas and mis-grades things. Berates students during class. Showed our grades and went through them in front of everyone. Gives assignments that are harder than things we have to do in the real world. Do not take any classes with this man.
Never take anything with this professor. His homework assignments take 5 hours and his lectures are useless. You have to teach yourself everything.

Nice guy but really needs to step up his game. Class is easy to the point where you can't focus on learning. Often goes off track. Very slow grader with very arbitrary attendance policies and test formats. Get another professor that you will learn from.

While his lectures are random and the PowerPoints dont make sense from an outside perspective he is very smart. Hes so knowledgeable on the subject matter and loves to discuss and question everyones thinking. Hes just a sweet guy that loves to talk about the environment. Just show up and spark a conversation with him.

Professor Primack was a lot of fun and not too hard. Most information was pretty basic knowledge and he was easily accessible outside of class. Talk with him, meet during office hours, and you have a wonderful resource for recommendation letters.

I really liked this guy as a person (go to office hours and get to know him- quirky and funny) but not so much as a professor. His points werent always clear and his thinking was sporadic, but he knows SO much about his material, its almost ridiculous. He assigns reading and I did them for like the first two weeks and then stopped and I got an A.
reviews.rating_tags: LECTURE HEAVY--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Class  pointless; PPTs  messy, unrelated to "topics"; Read a few chapters in book per class  book never brought up and disregarded the rest of the semester; Time  always wasted; Prof  makes students uncomfortable; never gives a straight answer, you'll have to teach yourself; likes to offend; FIND ANOTHER PROF WORTH IT FOR PASSING/LEARNING
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. She is very kind to everyone and genuinely cares about her students. The homework is graded strictly, but she is much more generous when it comes to exams. The class pace is fast because there is a lot of material to cover, but if you need more help, she will gladly explain topics in more depth during office hours.

She moves really fast through the content because there is so much to cover, however if you have a question even from a previous class she will ensure that it is reviewed thoroughly so you understand. She genuinely wants her students to learn over everything else. Amazing, would rate 10/5 if I could.

It is very obvious that Professor Lindenstrauss knows what she's talking about. Her class is hard, but she is very helpful with helping you understand the proofs. The only downside of the class is the grader is not very clear on what you did wrong on homework
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are all proofs of important theorems you'll have to use or prove again on homeworks or exams.  The main difficulty is the clarity of the proofs when she doesn't leave enough time for examples.  Lindenstrauss is such a pleasant and nice woman, and besides the stress of all of the work this class had, I feel like it was fun and rewarding.
Very unclear speaker, she's pretty scatterbrained but is nice and soft-spoken overall.  Really good with giving partial credit on exams!

Pretty dry lecturer who follows the book. Mainly did proofs in class (this was a linear algebra course). She will expect you to do proofs on the homeworks and tests, although they are usually pretty simple. Tests are pretty straight forward. She's pretty much average across the board; there's nothing particularly good or bad with her class.

I took a Hispanic Linguistics class with Avizia last fall Fall 2013. The class was very difficult and I tend to do well in Spanish classes. She''s a very good instructor though and she always makes herself available to help you. I''m surprised she hasn''t gotten a pepper yet because she''s very easy on the eyes Take her.
Avizia is awesome. She is enthusiastic, funny, and extremely helpful. S280 was one of my favorite classes this year thanks to her (and I'm not even a Spanish major/minor).

Easy to understand, departmental tests are a little difficult, but she does her best to help her students get good grades. Participate in class and she will go out of her way to help you. Replies to emails really quickly, so there's never any question about what is going on in class! I would recommend taking 280 with her.
It is a Spanish class so that is  never really going to be easy. However she is really helpful and is pretty good at teaching the subject, the best I have had so far.

Super boring professor but his class is not that hard. If you use the study guide, he takes test questions right out of it so you'll be fine. He's interested if you get him talking about what he loves (schizophrenia). If you go to his office hours, he'll love you.

While Professor Ayer is a bit dry, he does his best to make the class interesting. If anything, it's made up for by easy tests. You don't need the book or study guide, you can just attend lecture, study that, and get As on the tests. Extra credit will help pad any mishaps as well. Easy case study report, easy class for a psych minor.
Very dry professor. IF you use the study guide then the tests are easy.

Everyone would always do terrible on the tests. She would say the best way to study for exams was to redo the connect exercises which would effectively teach you nothing that was applicable to the test.  My final wish on my deathbed is for her to be my doctor so she can fail me one last time. Do not take her class.
Worst class taken through kelley, class exam averages were failing, and not very easy to understand at times. Almost deterred me from continuing with Accounting.
She struggles to speak clear English, making comprehension of difficult material even more challenging.
You have to read textbooks in order to pass this course. Class average is about 60% which means that she gave hard quizzes and exams. Be prepare and read textbook.
Toughest class ever, worst instructor ever!

I'm always really nice, but she is just plain horrid. She really doesn't explain macro well. I knew macro already, and don't understand her explanations. Then, on the tests, the questions are like 20 times harder than any of the in-class stuff and it all just comes out of nowhere. Class average was a low C. Trust me, take someone else.
The class is really bad. She can't explain the material very good and she is strict with grading. Other reviewer is right: she cares more about herself than anyone else

Overall I must be honest the class sucked.  She cares more about how she looks and not at all about how she can improve her teaching methods.  She is inflexible with grades and questions.  She is foreign and hard to understand. I do not reccomend her unless you already know macro but its your choice

Professor Khazzoom is super accommodating and caring towards all her students. She will work with you if you and is super understanding. She brings her knowledge and careful thoughts into discussions and does not force anyone to speak who wishes not to. There is a paper due every week which is time heavy but other than that there is only two papers
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor brought a lot of knowledge about the middle east to life in our class. Class structure was slightly confusing it was not the same every day. I enjoyed that there weren't any exams however there was a paper do each week which was slightly stressful
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Khazzoom ties her vast sociological research and knowledge with her Israeli and Jewish experience to paint an amazing picture of whatever she is trying to teach. She is one of the smartest people I have ever met, and also one of the kindest. Every word that comes from her mouth is something to hang on to! You won't regret taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great professor for this course. Made the material interesting. Write good notes and do the readings and you will be well set.

The class is phenomenal, I liked the professor and the lectures were actually interesting. If not for me skipping the lectures a lot this would be an easy A. There's lots of readings but only 3 easy assignment. Exams were also easy. Don't miss lecture is my only advice
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A great professor, especially if your interested in ancient Greece. Though, there is a lot of reading involved and discussions on Friday aren't the most fun, but he is very passionate about ancient Greek history.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As long as you pay attention to lecture content and do the assigned readings you will breeze through this class. It was very interesting and the professor is great!

If you pay attention in lecture and read the homework you will breeze through the exams and get a good grade in the class. Beck is a really chill and funny teacher and the lectures are pretty interesting if you like history.

Great lecturer and clearly explains terms in lecture. Attendance is required but would recommend going regardless as without attending it is very difficult. Tests cover a LOT of terms, names and places and require more work then would be expected for a 100 level course. Material is not complicated just a ton of things to remember

Bill is a great professor who really understands the courses he teaches. Although attendance isn't required, it is a big portion of your grade. He is very understanding and will accept extra work to make up for poor attendance. If you like to engaging discussions, I would definitely recommend his class.

Even though attendance isn't mandatory, if you miss class you won't pass the tests. The study guides for the the tests were over 150+ terms, plus readings, lectures, and maps. This class was way too hard for a 100 level class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is very interesting if you are into history. Beck is a great lecturer, he clearly covers all relevant information and does a great job relating the lectures to current events when relevant. Overall he is super nice and easy to talk to if you have any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class was alright, tests were kind of hard and impacted a lot of the grade. Professor Beck was really nice. Pay attention during lectures and study a lot before the test and you should be fine. I wouldn't take this class again, but it wasn't a bad experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bill Beck is a super great guy, class is much easier if you like Greek mythology like Percy Jackson and stuff though. Overall just a few readings, a few maps, straightforward stuff. Kept the lectures fun too

Professor Beck is a very amazing guy. He is very passionate about what he teaches! The only complaint is I wish there were other things in the grade book to help improve grades. There is a lot of reading so if you don't like to read, don't take this class. He is very good at teaching but a lot of the questions on the exams are skimmed in lectures.

I found the class to be easy, but it does require some effort. I largely only went to lecture and skimmed the readings if I was absent. He is very helpful for review, and you do learn in the class so I would say it is worthwhile.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: hard class. Required to read several classical mythology books, and they can be quite hard to keep straight. He mainly just lectures the class without any visual aids. Test are your only big grades, and can be hard to recover after a bad one. Hes a very nice guy, but dont take this class unless youre very interested in the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Loves his mythology for sure. Nice and understanding guy and held helpful lectures. Take his classes if you're interested in classical mythology, don't take his class if you're not ready to read.

Although I didn't really enjoy the content of her class, Prof. Brannon is a great professor and is always enthusiastic about the material she is teaching! She is very available for questions after class, and the homework is fair.

I took Liz for Intro to IR, and I found her class to be incredibly interesting. I am pursuing IR as a minor and her introductory class only made me more interested in the subject. She gives you 4 free absences, is clearly passionate about her subject matter, and teaches a great class (given you like IR). Definitely take her and get to know her too!

Professor Brannon is a breath of fresh air in the department! 205 with her was a breeze, and she made the stats part easy. She is reliable and really cares about her work, and is super relatable with her students, making lectures really enjoyable.
caring teacher, class is mostly lectures. tests are based off the lectures which she posts, don't really need to do the assigned readings

Dr. Brannon clearly cares deeply about the course topic. The class itself really isn't hard. There are 4 unit quizzes, 3 short papers, and the midterm and final. The only thing is the AI is slow to grade papers. Also, two are on a current ir events that don;t perfectly match the assignment. They were hard to research at times.

Dr. Brannon was a great prof! Although the class content was not my favorite, she made it very interesting and engaging. The class itself is just weekly homework, attendance, a midterm, and a final. Would highly recommend taking any class with her, she is very knowledgeable and really can connect with her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Brannon is new and I can already tell she is an up-and-coming best in her field. She cares about the content even though it is boring, and she tries to make it as interesting and engaging as she can. She has breathed new life into this class! She values class participation, and you can learn a lot from her if you try.

I took this class as a gen ed filler, and it actually turned out to be a really fun class. There are some readings to do before each class, but they take no more than 10-15 minutes. There is a lab component which is fun, and the grading is easy overall. You have a few quizzes which are very simple over lecture material, no trick questions.

Dr. Kenderes is clearly passionate about her classes and cares deeply about her students. The grading criteria is always clear, and she is more than willing to answer any questions you might have about the material or anything else. She is a wonderful teacher and I would definitely take any of her classes again.
I loved her, she was for real my favorite professor this year. She really cares about her students.

Elizabeth is a great professor and person. Show up to class and you will do well. She does a great job at explaining complicated topics to a non-expert audience. No big tests, only smaller quizzes (not really cumulative either). You can tell she cares more about you learning the material than simply handing out grades. I absolutely recommend her!

Very enthusiastic, caring, and compassionate professor. She feels like your friend, and she is very understanding of absences. I think her class was very interesting and eye-opening. Overall, she is a fun professor that I would like to have again in the future.

Dr. Kenderes is genuinely one of the nicest teachers I've ever had, you can tell she actually cares about her students and wants them to do well. Every teacher should look to her as an example. The class was interesting to me and she doesn't try to make things harder on you. Would 100% have her has a professor again if I could.

This professor cared about students succeeded and she ensured that every student had the capability to pass the course. The lab was pretty dry, but this professor did a great job teaching the material.

E138 with Professor Kenderes is a great class. There is a semester-long term project that is relatively easy. Quizzes and in-class activities for completion make it very easy to do well. She is very passionate about the material and wants students to succeed.
Easy class as long as you pay attention during PowerPoints and fill it out. The lab was not as fun though, two hours long and the AI was not helpful.

Really good professor and teaches in a way that does not bore you.  She is really caring and understanding and offers so many extra credit opportunities because she does not like that students have to be given a grade.  Would highly recommend taking a class with her!

Lectures tend to go on for a while and some are about topics that aren't super important (like how to write and email) but overall I really enjoyed Prof. Behar's class. Tests are really straight forward and she reuses a lot of questions from her quizzes

Content is usually short but she will drag the lecture out really long or rant about the homework we turned in. I don't think she's really understanding when it comes to anything really. You can get through this class by just doing the work on time and doing other class work when the "lecture" is just yap.

I dreaded coming to class every day... DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. You will not learn anything, its 1 and a half hours of yap and she is so technologically challenged and explains the same thing like 500 times. Guest speakers are also not helpful at all.
My friend had to get emergency surgery and she would not excuse her or accept any doctors notes. Unacceptable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lectures are very enjoyable if you are interested in the subject. Professor Behar is very experienced and cares a lot about her students' success. Majority of lectures include guest speakers from the merchandising field, which is very helpful. Projects are graded easily, and you will get a good grade as long as you go to class and do daily quizzes.

If you enjoy the subject you will enjoy coming to class. Professor Behar is very clear about her expectations with assignments has a quick response even though it is a large class. A lot of assignments are small and tedious but add up if you don't do them. She has a strict demeanor, but don't confuse that with rudeness.

Easy (pointless) class, but this professor takes things extremely seriously. She is overall rude and not very understanding and her lectures are boring. She Drags on class time when she finishes her lectures in only 30 minutes and we still have 45 minutes left of class. Not a super heavy workload or difficult class, definitely annoying though.

I think this professor was my favorite professor my freshman year. She is very understanding of situations, and her exams didn't have curveballs. Her exams are over, the content covered in class, and if you pay attention in discussion, you should be fine for exams. She doesn't put any concepts not covered in class or in the modules on the exams.

To describe her simply, she is dedicated to her craft. Truly is one of the best professors I have had throughout college. She is the reason I am pursuing law school! I could not recommend her more -- BE PREPARED FOR THE WORKLOAD. There is a lot of reading. She is tough but fair, and reach out to her if you need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: To describe her simply, she is dedicated to her craft. Truly is one of the best professors I have had throughout college. Could not recommend her more -- BE PREPARED FOR THE WORKLOAD. She is tough but fair, and reach out to her if you need help. She is respectful and doesn't make you feel stupid for asking questions.

Professor Cate does a really good job. If you pay attention and participate you will do just fine. Always available for questions and she explains things very clearly. Put in some effort and your golden!

Professor Cate was amazing this semester. There is daily homework that is used as prep for the next class. While sometimes it is a lot of reading or long videos, they are very useful to introduce the material to you, and then the in-class lectures help you understand the material more and apply it to more situations.
Great class. God and Government is such an interesting topic and she handles it with respect and without bias.

I love Professor Cate! There was definitely a lot of prep work for this class, but it is worth it because all the exams are open note. The more notes you take before and during class the better off you will be. She is easy to reach outside of class and quick to respond. She won't hesitate to call on random people in class so make sure you prepare!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Cate, very knowledgeable and caring. Only complaints is that her class is somewhat difficult because you have a lot of prep work to do before every lec. if you want to actually understand the content, however I think you'd be fine if you just skimmed and slightly reviewed things. Open note on everything, but hard exams
One of the coolest professors I have ever had.

Be prepared to read A LOT! This is a level 100 class but it seemed like a level 300. I finished with an A- but this class was extremely hard, there was a lot of reading and new content each week. The exams are open notes but you really have to understand the content and apply them accordingly which is extremely difficult. Very law heavy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall great professor, you can tell prof. Cate cares about her students. Lots of reading but all very doable.

There was definitely a lot of readings and prep for each lecture, but I genuinely enjoyed the class and the lectures. She knows what she's talking about and does as much as she can to break it down and make it understandable (if you don't understand, ask!). I had her for a Mon-Wed 8am and I'd do it again for one of her classes.

Professor Cate is okay, she is smart and definitely knows what she is talking about, but she teaches the class like everyone there is studying law. She is very knowledgeable and expects a lot. You have to read  and watch hours of material every week and takes a long time to grade things so be ready to wait on your grade from half the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Cate was very nice and always open to students' questions and was very accommodating! Make sure not to get behind on the readings or else it will be tough. Exams were killer it tends to be a lot of application based so study hard, but overall Professor Cate was super helpful.

She is a lawyer, so she teaches the class as if she is talking to a room full of law students. She is very knowledgeable but doesn't break things down. It makes it very confusing as this is a required (100-level) course for a lot of O'neill students, and she made it seem like a 400-level course. She WILL cold call on you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I can tell that she is passionate about what she teaches, however, I couldn't stand her lectures. I thought they were very boring. The amount of reading and video watching she has us do for the homework assignments is outlandish. This professor would be good if you are actually interested in the class, not if you just need the credits.

Prof Cate is probably my favorite professor in SPEA. She is unbelievably intelligent and passionate about what she teaches, and is totally invested in her students' success. While this class does require a lot of work, the readings and videos, along with her in-class lectures, prepare you completely for the exams. Take every class with her!!!

Probably one of the most organized, caring , and fair professors I've had. Did a great job in an online environment and put a lot of effort into slides, presentations, and the lectures. I felt like some of the readings were uninteresting but you kinda got to read them if you want to do well. Definitely a closeted conservative
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, I took the 8am so I could specifically take the class with her. A LOT of important readings, but she elaborates on them. She takes awhile to grade because shes a very busy person, but with grading she understands that law is not easy and will work with you. She is very accessible to help you in any way that she can!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Cate is an incredible teacher. Shes extremely passionate, kind, and knowledgeable about the material, as she worked in the field for several years. I didnt want to take the class at 8am, but it was very worth it to have her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She took awhile to get grades in but she was an amazing professor. Is very caring and willing to help. ALWAYS take advantage of her offering to comment and do extra credit itll make for a pretty easy A

Beth Cate is probably the most experienced and passionate professor that I have had. She is very involved however she always makes herself available to students. She takes a while to get papers back to us, but she keeps us updated about what is going on. Cate is very understanding and is willing to accommodate us. Highly recommend her as a prof.
Professor Cate is amazing. Recommend her 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Cate was an amazing teacher, and has since been a great professional connection. She cares a great deal about the courses she teaches and the students that take them. I strongly recommend taking a class with her. Make sure you are attentive and go the extra mile to meet with her and discuss the class and your professional life.

Very knowledgeable professor but did not return any grades during the course of the semester and gave no feedback to students. The assignments were very difficult and not much instruction was given. Would not recommend this professor if you have a busy class schedule and do not have the time to devote to her class.
Beth is an outstanding teacher.  She was readily available for help and extremely willing to support her students.

A completely unprofessional teacher.  Once she says that she will have something back to the class, it takes her about a month on top of that to do it.  Cant keep her promises which screws over the student.  Look for someone else to teach this class or consider changing your major.  SHE CANT KEEP A PROMISE.
He cared about students learning and gave tons of extra credit opportunities to make grades better for everyone! attendance matters, you only get 3 misses, that is the only thing that was hard
Barbaro is cool, He's a cool guy butttttt its very lecture heavy (and the lectures are boring tbh)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Barbaro Martinez ruiz has been the best professor I have ever had during my time here at Indiana Bloomington. He sees the little things in people and cares about us outside of school. He gave a motivational speech to me and my two friends and we were all inspired to go out and do good in the world. Barbaro is a living icon who needs to be honored.

Barbaro is so intelligent and passionate about Latin American, Carribean, and African art! He is way overqualified with a phd from Yale and so is very well educated and respected around the world. But don't be intimidated, he is very sweet and takes an honest interest in his students!

A great man to listen to! He only really cares about his passion for African art rather than giving students a hard time with grades, so just go to class and show that you're interested. I do not like art history, but this class was fun and really easy, so if you need credit, I would recommend his class.

This professor is very strict, and I think I wrote almost 30 essays that I did well on but still failed the class. I think more than a 1/3 of the class dropped the class and then more than 1/3 basically failed the class. Do not take his class even if it is mandatory, take the summer course. That teacher is fantastic, and a great teacher.
