reviews.comment: Andrew is inspirational and really tries to get to know his students, even though there are so many of them. You get out of the class what you put into it and if you show effort in your assignments you'll get an A+.
Professor Bunger is the best professor to take for T-275. He is super laid back and approachable. If you do the assignments you'll get a good grade.

Bunger is the best! He doesn't assign a lot of work and is a fair grader. He just wants you to learn from the class.  The class is simple and much better than Compass I... The class gets a bad rep, but Bunger makes it bearable. I love him as a person and would definitely take a class with him again.

Worst professor I've ever had. My group did a very good job in the first presentation, but he gave us the lowest score across all sections. His comments on our presentation did not make sense at all, and he couldn't provide any useful suggestions. However, when we consulted other professors about our work, they all thought our ideas were perfect...

Burlingham really is a great professor- he cares a lot about his students and is good at explaining the content. Although you do have to put in some extra effort into the class, it has to do more with the nature of the content itself and not with Burlingham.
One of the best professors I have had. Lectures are very informative and easy to follow. I would highly recommend.

He's a great professor, I read the textbook before class with mild understanding and his lectures simplify what the book says to a point it just clicks. He posts everything online, making studying easy and missing 1-2 lectures possible without destroying your grade. Emails back within minutes. Overall amazing professor.

Very average cut and dry professor, straight grader. You are graded on discussion worksheets and exams with little to no extra credit unless everyone does bad. I like his hands-off approach (no attendance or "homework"), but don't expect any hand holding. (Also, Exams are WAY harder than discussion worksheets so be SUPER prepared for exams).

reviews.comment: Great lecturer, the best professor I have had. Do homework problems, the practice tests, and review notes from class to be successful. Attending class isn't required, but go, he knows what he's talking about and makes the course easier.

He works hard to make students understand the fundamentals and why things are vs just memorizing information. I think the teaching style is very effective for an organic chemistry class because of the difference type of thinking the class in general requires. Don't think that organic chemistry isn't a hard class, it is, and the content reflects it.

J section: lecture moves very fast and ramped up as the semester progressed. Optional homework but definitly essential to stay on top of material. Important to stay on top of everything. Weekly 3 questions quizzes with questions from the homework. Great to have so many practice exams so similar to the exams!
Good Prof. with good intentions, but failed execution.
Very petty professor, either likes you or doesn't.

Class was very difficult just due to the volume of material there was to cover, but he teaches incredibly well! Make sure you understand aldol, acetal/imine formation and their hydrolyses from Orgo 2. Practice exams are a lifesaver. I didn't use book problems, just practice exams. Take detailed notes beause powerpoints alone are vague. Do NOT skip!

reviews.comment: Would NOT recommend. Professor either likes you or doesn't. Often was late to his own office hours on test days. reviews.comment: Professor Burlingham is a great guy! However, lecture is very fast-paced, and it's hard to retain everything. If you don't have a good understanding of Orgo 1 (understanding, not just memorization), you WON'T succeed in this class. Exams are tough, but he's very willing to help students who are struggling. You have to WORK for a good grade.

Communicates all class expectations clearly and provides you with anything you might even think to ask about biochemistry. The course is very interesting, yet dense; Ben does a tremendous job to break down the material. Moves very quickly but he will always have time to answer questions - no student is left behind if they ask for help. The best.
He's a great professor and really good at getting across important concepts and breaking things down. He really knows how to teach!

This man is the GOAT.  Certified baller on foenem.  He is a super smart and truly knows the material.  His class is difficult, but if you put in a tiny bit of effort to study for exams you will be perfectly fine.  Also he posts practice exams, so you know exactly what is required for the test.  Take every single chemistry class with him.
Great professor

Great professor. While this class can be really difficult, the grading process does is not traditional so that it better reflects the difficulty of the course. Ultimately, if you put in the work, passing should not be a problem. Lectures expand on the textbook; he adds in helpful figures & real-life applications that make lecture very interesting!

Good professor. Attending lectures and staying caught up with course content is crucial to success on the three exams during the semester. Him and his teaching team are always available and willing to help with any questions you have.

Wonderful teacher. Very kind person and great at explaining chemistry/biochemistry concepts. He does write hard exams but gives lots of practice exams so they are really not that bad. Best prof I've had at IU.

Professor Burlingham is a very intelligent professor; however the lectures were extremely fast paced and it was often extremely difficult to follow along. I would highly recommend taking this course with Laura Brown, as she gives more diligent and easier to follow lectures that make this course more worthwhile and meaningful.

This class was very difficult. The tests were extremely hard and the curve was unclear during the semester, so many students dropped the class to take with a different professor due to failing. That being said, he was very nice and willing to help.

Exams were incredibly tough and mean and the lectures were pretty boring in my opinion. However, he is very nice and gives a lot of resources for students. Just be prepared to study a crazy amount of hours for 483.

He is a very nice professor, but this class is extremely hard. Only things that are graded are discussion worksheets and exams. Exams were very hard and in depth. He explains things quickly in lecture, especially for a class that has a lot of in depth material you need to know. I would advise not taking this class if you don't want to study 24/7.

reviews.comment: Burlingham is a great professor that sets clear expectations and will do everything he can to help everyone reach those expectation. He is always available and is extremely knowledgable. S342 was test heavy and required a ton of outside practice and reading in order to receive an A in this class.

Great professor who deeply cares that his students succeed. However, this is a very challenging course so you must put in a lot of extra work in order to do well. The exams take what we have learned and make it 5x harder, however he has buffer points in the exams. It is important to read the TB and attend lectures even if he does not enforce it.
He's a cool dude, but he gives a lot of work and quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Burlingham is a really great instructor and when he teaches, he makes sure to briefly reteach material as the content can get easily overwhelming. All the material in this class is compounded & you should take extra time in lectures to write down things he's saying to your notes (I took this class twice). Very accessible outside of class.
He had really organized notes and was overall a good lecturer. He made Orgo much better to learn! He was also really understanding about issues you might have.

Go to his office hours!! Hes so helpful and responds very quickly to emails and is even willing to meet with you at a time outside of his hours if you cant make it. hes such a great lecturer. He explains things very thoroughly and you can tell that he really cares if were doing well. This class is the hardest Ive ever taken, but he helps!!

Orgo1 is definitely a difficult weedout course, but he explains the material very clearly and wants what's best for you. He is willing so set up personal meetings with you when most profs send you to an AI. I wish I had the chance to take this corse with him in person! He does assign a lot of homework though, so be prepared to have no social life.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hands down one of the best professors in the chemistry department. He explains concepts very clearly and in an easy to understand way. He gives ample opportunities to study and genuinely wants his students to succeed in this difficult class. Very available over email and office hours.

Dr. Burlingham is one of the best professors I've had in the field of science. While his tests can be challenging at times, he's very available over email and office hours and is very good at explaining concepts related to biochemistry in a simple, yet applicable way. If you do the practice problems and tests, you're sure to get a high B or A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Burlingham seems to genuinely care about his students. Although his class is very difficult, most orgo classes are, he really tries to help students learn if they put the effort in.

Prof Burlingham is an incredible teacher. His lectures are super clear and make complete sense. I understood everything so well with his teaching. He also cares a lot about his students and makes that very clear if you reach out to him, he is very understanding and an incredible lecturer.

Prof Burlingham is the best chem professor Ive had. His lectures are organized and he explains difficult concepts very clearly. Exams are tough even if you know what youre doing, but he tells you which in-book problems are most helpful for quizzes and exams. Definitely take him if you have the opportunity.

reviews.comment: Prof Burlingham is one of the best professors I have ever had. His lectures are so easy to follow, so you actually learn so much, however, beware of the exams. They are very difficult, even if you do understand what you are doing. You just have to remember that the grade does not matter as much if you are actually retaining info! Take Orgo with him

If you are looking for a professor to take Organic Chem with I would highly recommend professor Burlingham. He makes everything so easy to understand, and the general content is difficult, but the way he teaches makes it super digestible. He is by far the best chem instructor I have ever had.

I referenced the textbook very little because his explanations were clear & made learning organic easier. He moves fast, & I wish his slides were a little more organized. However, it's clear he is knowledgeable & knows how to break concepts down. He is genuinely caring in office hours & is a wholesome person, looking to help his students succeed.

reviews.comment: Burlingham is a clear, straightforward kind of prof, although he certainly moves quickly. reviews.comment: Either he expects way too much or the class is meant to be that way, given we have 3-4 other STEM classes going on at the same time, the performance expected of us is unfair. Although he teaches really well, Id say he expects a lot on his exams because theyre just made ridiculously hard sometimes. His practice exams have stuff that he didnt teach much in class, and its just overall very demanding because he tests you on minor details. Hes very nice and helpful but this class is pretty difficult.

reviews.comment: He moves very quickly through lecture material, and lectures for the full 50 minutes. This class covers an insane amount of material, but he does a good job of explaining it. His exams and quizzes are fair, but you cannot fall behind at all or you will not do well.

reviews.comment: Prof. Burlingham was one of my best professors at IU. Amazing lectures with great powerpoints for studying. You don't really need the book to do well, but it helps on occasion. Biochem was very interesting solely due to Prof. B. Just study the lecture slides/practice tests and you'll do great. Prof. B is a must have professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Burlingham is one of the greatest professors. He's very helpful in office hours and gives amazing lectures.

Dr. Ben Burlingham is the man. His class (C483) was one of the few classes I've taken that really got me engaged and excited about the material. He is an extremely friendly professor and he dedicates himself fully to helping students. If you truly want to do well in his class, you will. He doesn't deliberately try to fail students.

Professor Burlingham overall is a good professor. A 400 level biochem class is definitely supposed to be difficult, and this class is no exception. His notes aren't very detailed so being in class definitely helps. Doing a lot of practice and taking diligent notes from the textbook is key to success. Work hard, you will be fine.

Dr. Burlingham is an indubitably smart professor.  His lectures and teaching style are effectively engaging.  His office hours are also helpful, as he truly cares about students.  Advance studying is critical, as his tests tax one's understanding of the material.  Although his class was very challenging, the material was absolutely fascinating.

I had Dr. Burlingham for Orgo 1 and C383. He's amazing. He's extremely efficient in lecture, and he never lets you "lose the forest for the trees". He takes the time to derive stuff so you understand it, but he always takes it back to the big picture so you can recognize patters. The tests are hard, but they're fair, and he prepares you well.
Had Burlingham for orgo 1. He was probably the best i could have asked for. He was very clear and an excellent teacher. The tests were also very fair.

Extremely ineffective lecturer. The first half of my orgo class was taught by another professor and, until Burlingham took over, I understood all of the material very clearly. After the switch I was totally lost even though I always went to class and discussion. He is also very unhelpful in office hours.

The class is definitely challenging, though of the chemistry professors, Burlingham seems to be one of the better ones.  He goes pretty in depth on topics and really tries to help you understand the foundation of what orgo to make the rest easier to learn.  The class is quick paced, but he is a good and fair professor.
he taught the material really well and made it enjoyable
Great prof. Clear and makes orgi understandable. Would recommend.

He's good. I was shocked when I got an A; I was sure I got an A-. On many tests, I felt like I knew the material, but was graded on the mechanics of the test. I just didn't think his questions were as straightforward as they could have been. HW helps but, won't really prep you but helps to begin to grasp material. Office hours are for specific Q?s.

Attendance isn't mandatory, but you need go for your own good. The course is curved. I had an 89.6% but still got an A. Final will replace your worst test if the final is higher. Tests are easier than expected, but you must do the practice tests. This class is largely memorization and application so do your work. He is a good teacher to have.

Burlingham is a very good professor. I felt like his lectures and the course itself were very well structured. Even though the course relies very heavily on the textbook, you get something extra out of his lectures. He gave us study tips that I still see people using in C342. I came out of his class liking organic chemistry.

Burlingham is without a doubt one of the best professors I've ever had. He makes organic chem much easier because he is so clear during lectures and engages students in class. If you're taking orgo you'll want him, he's very friendly and willing to help anyone.

organic chem is "difficult", but Dr. BTB is your ticket to an A+. Dr B lectures orgo like he is the founder of chemistry, the way he puts it is simple and easy to follow. he is honestly the BEST lecturer in the IU chem dept. hands down. i would go through grad school just to be his student.

There are chem profs who make fair tests or curved tests--Prof B. makes fair tests. He has excellent pedagogical skills, and I his lectures were always helpful. Keeping up with the readings and practicing the daily problems multiple times was a huge help to me as I progressed through the course.

Dr.Burlingham is a great professor, and everything made sense in lecture.  However, his exams were a bit harder than they could have been, and there isn't anything to cushion your grade besides quizzes.  Keep up with reading the book and doing the daily problems and you should do fine.

Professor Burlingham is a great professor who explains the complex concepts of organic chemistry in a way that is easy to understand and engaging. He obviously cares about his students learning and understanding what he's teaching, and is probably the best professor for orgo at IU.

The material in Orgo II is hard, but he's about as good of a professor that you can get. You need to go to class and do all the daily problems to succeed. But his lectures give you the understanding you need to do the hw, then the hw reinforces the concepts. Exams are similar to the practice exams with some added difficulty.

I've taken 4 classes with this professor and he is so helpful and a great lecturer. I would definitely recommend taking a class with him (especially organic chemistry). He uses powerpoints in biochem, which I don't like as much. He chose an awful textbook. Go to his office hours! He cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

I had Burlingham for three chemistry courses and he is an amazing professor. Super clear and is easy to understand. You have to work in all of the classes (standard with any chem class) but the work pays off with both understanding and good grades. Practice exams are very representative of the real exams.

Doctor Burlingham is always available, knowledgeable and funny. I've taken both organic and organic lab with him, and during organic I once showed up at his place because my car battery died at the library. He went with me to get it and boosted it with me. He also helped me a million times over in organic lab. Hes a great professor - and work hard

This prof knows how to teach organic chemistry. If you put effort into your homework, you will get a good grade. The course is tough, but he shows you how to succeed by teaching you lots of study tips. If you need orgo, take it with him.

Great teacher! His lectures are very clear and he works through a ton of practice problems to keep you involved. Organic is hard but he has so many practice worksheets and tests with the answers online that it's pretty manageable. This guy's doing it right!

BEST ORGO TEACHER EVER! I had him for Orgo 1 and Orgo lab and I loved it! He explains the material well, he gives a lot of practice problems, and he is very nice! He gives out a lot of work and bases his quizzes/exams on it. If you do the work, you will do well in the class. He is without a doubt the only good orgo teacher at IUB.

By far, the best professor I have ever had at IU. Organic chemistry is a difficult subject, yet he explained it perfectly and clearly, making it exceedingly easy to understand. Office hours were extremely helpful. Overall, a fantastic prof!

He is one of the best professors at IU. He is an extremely skilled, lucid, and knowledgeable teacher. Each class he briefly reviews important details about the previous class and then expands in a clear/detailed way. Go to class every day, devote an hour outside of class each day, and do all the homework and you will get an A.
Best teacher I have had so far.  Very helpful, very clear, very friendly.  He has high expectations, so don't be surprised

His lectures are quite clear, and he really emphasizes main points that will be covered on tests, however, this material is intense and as such grades are normally reflected poorly. His office hours are decent, however, if you ask him a question he forces you to come up with the answer. Overall he expects quite a lot so be preapred

Does he come on here and review himself or something? One of the worst professors I've had. Nothing personal. His quizzes and exams are different from what he teaches in lecture. I loved the lab portion, but the lecture was torture! His assignments are unhelpful and, guess what? Less than 24 hours til the final and there is not a review key yet.

Best professor I have had. He explains clearly and genuinely hopes that all of his students succeed. The material of this class is difficult; however, with his teaching, you always know what is necessary to know on exams.

Great Professor. He is kind, helpful, and lectures at a reasonable pace. The combination of lab and lecture material can be a bit overwhelming at times, but it is manageable. I enjoyed my C343 experience much more than I expected.

Great Professor. If you can take a class that he teaches, DO IT! He's extremely helpful and works well with students. You can clearly see how much he cares about his students. Also, if you can take an Orgo or Biochem class with him it's all the better, because he's very passionate about his field. But be warned: he will challenge you.
This class is really, really hard so don't take it unless you really know and like chemistry, then you'll be fine. Overall he's a good professor and explains things clearly
By far the best chemistry professor I have ever had!  He has VERY fair exams and explains the material very clearly!  Great guy too :)

He's an amazing professor. Explains everything so clearly and detailed. He just does not expect you to understand the book. he explains the book to you and provides details that the book has omitted. he provides review sheets which really reflect the exam content. extremely helpful in office hours as well. an awesome professor overall

Pass/fail system is bs. Why does it lower my gpa if I fail but not raise it if I pass?! Professor is alright, randomly decides if she wants to fail your assignment lol. Definitely don't look forward to this class and thrilled for it to b over.

She's very kind and cares about each student as an individual. The class is super easy as long as you participate. The most valuable thing I got from this class was the career chat. Just do the assignments as they are easy enough. This is a pass/fail class as well.

She is an excellent, sweet instructor.  You can tell she is there for the students.  Wants everyone to participate, but all you have to do is talk in your small groups.  I would definitely recommend taking her class.
She is such a sweetheart! Its clear that she loves teaching and really wants students to become their best selves.

reviews.comment: Very caring of students. Always willing to help and very accessible outside of class. Easy assignments and gives great feedback. Overall, would recommend as she's very kind.

Very student-oriented, she's a career coach, so that makes sense. Very understanding, but also treats you like an adult with adult responsibilities. Humor is very millennial-coded, but she's very nice.
Amazing teacher. Definitely recommend. Her class with the Walter center is a must.
She really likes making sure that everyone gets their voice heard during class. Gives good feedback as well.
She is a very nice professor and connects with students very well. Also very helpful and flexible.
Matrix!

Mrs. B is awesome. If you go and do the best you can there's no reason you can not get at least a B in the class. If you're prepared for your speeches you will receive an A. She can grade tough but if you ask what you can do to do better she will help. Great teacher!
She is great - and knows a lot about the Matrix.

One of the best professors I have ever had. She is super helpful and even though she grades a little tough she will help you with whatever you need. She is a really interesting person, make sure you get to know her as much as possible. She also trys to make class fun and relatable. If you can make sure you take one of her classes.
Great teacher, very helpful, and fun

I'm a psych major, and wasnt excited about taking Neuro. I didn't do well on the first exam, but once I started going to office hours (Dr. Bunner is very nice) I improved a lot. Even aced the last two exams. Totally doable class, just dont cram for exams
Don't cram for exams and youll do well.

Fun and makes it easy to stay awake. You do need to study, but if you attend and keep up, you'll do great. While there is a textbook, she posts her notes ahead of time. I mostly relied on my class notes and still got an A. That said, the posted notes aren't complete—she leaves some parts blank, so student have to attend class.
Dr. Bunner is awesome!!! Yes you have to study and neuro is a hard class, but if you attend class, ask question during class or in office hours, you'll earn an A.

reviews.comment:
Prepare to spend most of your time for this class. Attendance is not mandatory but sometimes uploads different slides and takes classes with other slides and without uploading right notes says “lucky that you are here today”. 
Even if you write exams well the grading is extremely tough, it felt like they are trying hard to not to give us grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Bunner is a good professor overall. The lectures move fast and often I would not really understand what was going on and would have to review. Tests are 80% of your grade and cover a lot of information. The good news is the test questions are very surface level. If you review the slides before the tests you should do fine and get an A.

This course is entirely exams and pop quizzes, with little emphasis on actual learning. If you want to learn the material, I do not recommend this class. Lectures move very fast, and the exams cover an overwhelming amount of information. Although Dr. Bunner is knowledgeable and kind, the material is poorly presented, and many students struggle.

Follow her study questions because the exams are almost based completely off of them, but make sure you also study small details because she will test you on little details tied to bigger concepts. Very funny and relatable.

Your grade is entirely based on 4 tests and 10 pop quizzes. The tests are extremely hard and cover so much information that it feels impossible to study for them. The majority of the class received D's or F's on the exams. Dr. Bunner crams so much information in a 50 minute lecture and barely goes over any of it. I would not recommend this class.

reviews.comment:
Dr. Bunner was very knowledgeable and really cares. I am a psych major, so I was not looking forward to taking Neuro.  While this course was one of the hardest I've taken, it was doable. Come to class, take notes, and go to office hours and you'll do well.

Oh and her "dad" jokes are so punny. But they help with retaining the info.
AMAZING PROF. she genuinely cares about her students and is SO knowledgable and passionate about neuroscience. taking her for a second time next semester.

Loved this class. Probably one of the harder neuro classes I've taken, I'm a pysch major, but content was easy to digest.  Dr. Bunner's very VERY knowledgeable about drugs and how they work. There is a final presentation, but clear grading criteria for it. 100% would take her again if I wasn't graduating.
I loved Kendra. She is super knowledgable about neuroscience and made lab fun. She gives amazing feedback and cares about all of her students. I plan on taking her class next semester.
Take this class with Dr. Bunner!!!!  She is hilarious and very knowledgeable. I learned so much in this course about drugs and how they work. Great course, learned a lot.
Was nervous to take the class, but after having Dr. Bunner, I love neuro.  Her "dad jokes" are korny but helped me remember the material.

reviews.comment: Love Dr. Bunner's class. Be sure to come to lecture and take notes. While her exams are very doable, you need to study for them in advance. She has test yourself questions after each lecture, know those and you'll be fine.  There are also tophat quizzes, you can drop like 40% of them, so if you don't do well it's okay.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bunner is AMAZING. She is such a likable person and she is one of the smartest people I've ever met. She cares about her students and gives everyone everything they need to succeed in her class. She is a queen and I would 11/10 take a class with her again.

Grade is made up of 3 exams and then 10 quizzes on top hat. Pay attention to what she says in class and what's on her lecture slides and you'll pass easily. She is very passionate and enthusiastic about the content.

Dr. Bunner is a great professor and her enthusiasm shines through in her lectures. However, beware that neuroscience is a tough course. Most of your grade will come from the four exams. There is a textbook, but it's optional, and exams are based on lectures. Attendance, taken by Tophat quizzes, is 20% of your grade, but there's some leniency.

reviews.comment: She rocks its a hard course but she makes it actually interesting

I loved Prof. Bunner! Her lectures are quick and too the point and you can tell she loves the topic. The topics are challenging, but coming to lectures and office hours are key to success. 80% of your grade come from 4 exams, so you have to make sure to keep on top of material

reviews.comment: Dr. Bunner is extremely knowledgeable and that is obvious when she lectures. I am in her 337 class, and there is a lot of material that has to be known in depth. She sometimes lectures for long durations on topics that do not show up much on the test, and then there will be small topics that show up more. She often shows up late to class as well.
Loved this class and swithched majors.  Dr. Bunner provides her lectures.  Pay attention in the class becasue all test material come from the powerpoint.
Loved this class.  While the material was hard, Dr. Bunner did a good job of emphasizing what you need to know.  Her in-class review sessions were extremely helpful.

I took PSY 346 during spring 2020 and overall it was a fun class to be with Dr. Bunner. Her lectures are fun and aren't a bore to attend. Her exams are fairly straightforward, you just have to study. Flashcards always helped me. I am also currently in her PSY 407 class. Pretty much the same format as P346.

Her lectures are interesting, and she's always enthusiastic. All of her exams come from the powerpoints, and she doesnt post them so you HAVE to go to class. 80% of the class is exams, which sucks. Also, there's a short answer part on the exam and a MC part. The other neuro professor had only MC, and seemed easier overall. But Bunner is still good

reviews.comment: Dr. Bunner is a personable and passionate lecturer who I'd absolutely take a future class with. The main downside is the tests - what you need to know often doesn't match up with what you're told to study for. You'll be told something is very important only for it not to show up, and instead be tested over something that wasn't emphasized.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bunner was very kind and an interesting lecturer. She never made class feel like a drag or like it was boring. The content is also very exciting. She genuinely cares about her students and does a good job preparing us for exams. This content is even still fresh in my mind after a few months.

Dr. Bunner, amazing! Her Neuro is not an sail, but you learn and you can apply it to your academic career. Ive never thought Id have so much knowledge over Neuro material. I didnt get an A, but trust me, I learned so much I feel like my B+ is an A. Test can be challenging, pay attention to Unit 2, learn it and learn it to apply it!

reviews.comment: Bunner was easily one of my favorite professors at Indiana University. She was very accessible outside of class and her tests were not overly hard for Neuroscience. She was awkward, but funny and always kept us entertained. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bunner is a saint. She has clear expectations for lab reports (most labs are participation-based). There is a group poster pres., but it's more fun than work! She is available to meet with students outside of class. Her office hours are always lit:) Dr. Bunner also gives fantastic advice about med/grad school. She is there to help you succeed!

If you're looking for an interesting class with an even more interesting professor, take Drugs & the Nervous System with her! She truly cares about what the class finds interesting. We once had an unplanned class discussion just because there was large interest in the topic. Meet with her outside of class if you have any questions. So approachable!

Dr. Bunner does a great job making the material easy to follow and is super enthusiastic. While she doesn't give out study guides, she does give out "test yourself" Questions at the end of each lecture, which are extremely useful. Take good notes, come to class, and you'll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great lectures, I think she's really funny and knows what she's talking about. Go to her office hours, and she can give you a whole crash course on the topic that day. I love the energy she brings to class, and if you find the stuff interesting then the class isn't hard at all. She basically gives 20% of the grade for solely participating.

Genuinely cares about her students and wants them to pass - she tries to make lectures interesting and is very good at teaching a difficult topic. Attendance is not mandatory but she has random quizzes that are worth 20% of the grade. A great teacher and a great person.

I am a psychology major and was not looking forward to having to take a tough science course for my major. Dr. Bunner made the concepts of the class easy to understand, and while there is a lot of materiel, Dr. Bunner does her best to make the class enjoyable. I would highly recommend taking this class with her.

reviews.comment: This is the hardest class to stay awake in. It is jargon heavy and very technical. Dr. Bunner is a smart woman, but doesn't make the material accessible or relatable. Attendence is sort of mandatory. She uses tophat so if you want to log on at home, you can to get the participation credit, but she also counts if it's right or not so beware.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bunner is so nice and tries really hard to engage with her students. However, her lectures are very boring and dry, so don't take her classes in the morning. She gives unannounced TopHat quizzes as attendance grade, so be sure to go to class. Don't get the book, I never used it. Memorize the concepts and you'll be fine!

reviews.comment: Dr. Bunner works really hard to teach the class the ins and outs about Neuroscience. She has a lot of experience in the sciences and she explains everything very well. reviews.comment: Professor Byrne is one of the easier K201 professors at IU. Super easy A+ imo, you just have to show up. If you still struggle to understand the concepts (very important!), go to K-Cove. Professor Byrne was easy to understand and follow along with. Surprisingly, I did worse in the lecture (92.5%) than in the lab (97%) 🤷‍♂️.

K201: Professor Byrne is a good teacher who genuinely cares about his students and is very approachable. Unlike most K201 professors, he requires lab checks and the sim exam to be taken in class without notes and under time limits. You must score 80% or higher on the sim exam or receive 0 points. He grades more strictly than most but teaches well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Not a ton to say on Prof. Byrne, he's like the perfect baseline-level professor for a course like K201 where success tends to come down to your pre-existing ability to grasp new concepts. I definitely took a couple of lab sessions from the comfort of my dorm bed.
As far as k201 goes its gonna be hard but he was a great teacher and nice guy

This professor would often refuse to help students if they weren't able to follow along. If you didn't attend class for a day you might as well give up because they have skill checks every day that are due on the weekends but he gives no instructions so you can learn outside of class. reviews.comment: she is so kind and thoughtful.

I loved Donyel. She is very knowledgable and passionate about what she teaches. She was one of the first professors I had at IU and one of the best I have had so far. reviews.comment: Donyel is such a great teacher. She is passionate about what she teaches and it shows.

I love Donyel! One of my favorite professors! She truly cares about all of her students and wants them all to succeed! She is very helpful and lenient with assignments and grading. She is also very understanding if you are dealing with mental problems and is willing to help you out in whatever way you need.

A lot of readings but they're definitely helpful when it comes to your assignments, but Donyel is definitely 10/10. By far the best teacher that I've had thus far at IU. reviews.comment: A lot of reading, but very informative. Donyel has an amazing personality and is very warm with her students. She is honest, caring, and expects a lot out of students.

Donyel is genuinely my favorite professor so far. Goes miles out of the way for her students, and is extremely approachable. Lots of group projects; very writing-focused, small, participation-focused class. She made me fall in love with the Social Work major. Be prepared for a class of almost all women, and 20 required volunteer hours (2hrs/week)

He expects so much writing and is just not a good professor. He also grades very harshly acting like his class expects top level writing. Further, the SWOT analysis is like 15 pages long and does not explain it well. He cant explain instructions to save his life. Overall terrible professor.

reviews.comment: He was late to every class and then kept us late because he just rambled the whole time. He missed first two weeks of class and then came in and said that he was a 10-year professor and "nothing you guys do or say can get me fired." This has been my least favorite class I've taken as a sports management major. Take the online version if you can.
This man is the goat. Dont sleep on talking to him after class. Lectures were boring, but study the powerpoints and get good grades.
Awful professor. Exam averages were around 60% and he didn't curve any of them. Lectures are extremely boring and don't make any sense. Would avoid this professor at all costs.

Professor Burks has easily been one of the best teachers I have ever had. She genuinely cares so much for her students and wants every single one to succeed in her class and beyond. If you have the opportunity to take her class, it is a must.
She genuinely cares about you and wants you to do well. Assignments were pretty clear, 2-3 bigger group projects. Lots of extra credit, overall great.
If you have the option of taking Professor Burks then you better take it, she is by far one of the best professors I have ever had.

Not even glazing but Professor Burks is one of the best teachers/professors I've ever had in terms of how much I enjoyed her class, how much she cares about students, and how genuinely funny she is. There is no reason you should voluntarily take another professor for this class (and presumably others).

Prof. Burks is one of the sweetest teachers I've ever had and she genuinely wants her students to succeed. The class is heavy on group projects but she is very generous with grading and is very easy to reach outside of class. I 100% recommend taking her class!
Gives a lot of extra credit, assignment expectations are clearly laid out and graded easily. Professor Burks is extremely kind and encouraging, she truly wants her parents to succeed.

reviews.comment: Professor Burks really cares about her students. She makes every class fun and is extremely supportive though her students learning. She sets clear criteria for her work so its easy to do well.
Professor Burks is one of the best professors I have ever had. She is SO funny and has a bunch of great stories. A great professor to connect with for recommendations and an overall great person.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Burks really cares about her students and doesn't make this class any harder than it needs to be. Not much help on the Target Project, I wish she would give more constructive criticism on papers & presentations. Grades can sometimes seem given at random, but I finished with an A-. Only need 1 of the 3 textbooks.

Professor Burks is one of the best professors I have ever come across. Not only is she great at teaching her subject but she also cares about her students. So you go into this class knowing that you are going to get individual attention and not simply be a number. She is very genuine and works very hard to make this class fun and interesting ! A+

Professor Burks is genuine. She comes to class every week with a smile on her face even when she is under the weather. People below me obviously didn't pay attention. Through case studies and target case we learn to effectively communicate with others, which is a value asset to have in business settings. Hard to get an A

Professor Burks is great. I don't think that she ever used the entire class period and she likes to schedule "library days" where you just show up the library and work with your group or leave. She is super nice but make sure that you speak up in class from the get go. She is fun and energetic and makes the class easy. Just showing up gets you a B

Professor Burks is probably one of the best professors in the Kelley School of Business. She really knows her stuff and is extremely effective at teaching you what is important. Highly recommend if you can get into her class!!! Great Professor and extremely willing to help
If you want to learn anything, I mean anything, do not take her class. It's a waste of time and money. But, if you just want to have a easy B, just take her class.
She is the best, sweetest nicest teacher I have ever had in the b-school!  She is extremely helpful and it is really easy to get a good grade.
so great

Great professor, who else to teach Biz communication than somebody who had already established herself in that area? She knows what is important and who is not. Be prepared to get involved in class and you will do REALLY fine. You will never sleep in her class cause she's so funny.
Awesome Teacher
Easy class! She really cares about her students. Loved the class!
Hot.  Just tear it up on the target project and you will be ok.

Her class is really easy.  Just come to class and she'll make you laugh.  Everything is common sense for the material and homework.  A friend recommended her to me and it was the best decision I made scheduling.
very positive teacher. extremely friendly

Professor Byler is one of the greatest professors I have had. It is very clear from day one how much he cares about every individual students success. He is also very aware of the fact that there are many different kinds of students and he plays it best to each person individually. I would highly recommend taking one of his courses.

Troy is easily one of my favorite professors ever. He actually cares about each and every student and is very forgiving. The class itself is easy and the discussions he has with students during class are genuine and thought-provoking. I learned much more than German when I took his classes.
Amazing lecturer! I definitely improved in all aspects of my German language skills thanks to him!

One of my favorite teachers this semester, always so excited to help out, ver engaging, and really pushed you to do your best! If you have any questions just ask and he will happily answer! Also the textbooks you use, you'll use for the 330 class!
I sometimes think in class how lucky we are that T. Byler is teaching us. It's cheesy but true. Great professor, who either truly cares about his subject and students, or is a phenomenal actor.

Herr Tyler is an amazing professor. He makes sure to get people involved in class, and while you might not start out getting the grade you want he'll help you get there. He's very helpful, a good speaker, funny, and prompt in response to e-mails. He won't kill you if you turn an assignment in late and is really understanding. Definitely recommend.

Professor Byler is very goofy and entertaining. I like how he makes sure to go around the room and ask if anybody needs help. He can be a difficult grader, but if you talk to him during office hours about things you don't understand, he is very helpful.

Professor Byler has a great personality and makes the class entertaining and is willing to help you - if you go to office hours. Some of the concepts, especially grammar, were not well covered in class and he is very particular about grammar in assignments. You must work hard to get an A.

Great guy! always open to help, always trying to squeeze questions out of you even if you don't think you have them! He conducts class in german (it is 300 after all), but if you find some instruction difficult, or if he believes its important enough, he will explain details in english. One of the nicest guys around, and GREAT professor.

He seems ok at first but things go downhill fast.  He is a stickler for details and takes a large amount of points off for minor details.  I received a C on one assignment because of 3 incorrect adjective endings.  This man is the reason I no longer study German!  I would never recommend him or a class of his to anyone!

He seems cool at first, and personally he is a great guy.  However, some of his methods are a bit odd.  He only shows the students their grades twice a 2 or 3 times a semester.  Overall, the class is just not fun, and going in for help during his office hours really don't help.
Very engaging lecturer, explains material clearly and makes the subject interesting.
He expects you to care about nothing but German. He forgets that many people are only there for the language requirement.
Difficult, but possible...good teacher.  Fun
amazing teacher. he cares about the students and about the language, and makes G200 soo much easier than G150. just make sure you do your work!

Awesome professor! He's very passionate about German and will take the time to explain difficult concepts in English, which I took for granted until G-400 happened and EVERYTHING is explained in German.
Very easy and helpful.  The workload isn't very heavy.  Do your work and you'll be fine.
Total Badass.  Very funny and helpful.  Always kept class interesting and assignments short.  Somewhat easy to get by without much work.
He really tries to help the students and also challenge what you know.

Byrne is a very nice and interesting man. Do not have to get book, but helps if you skim the reading. Graded by three tests. Is just as much a history class as a political science class, which I liked. Do not bother trying to take notes of EVERY single line on the slides. Just listen and learn. Go to the review sessions and take notes there.

You don't really have to attend class - just the review session and exam session (so 6 total). He posts all the powerpoints that he reads from to lecture, don't buy the textbook or read it. I used quizlet and passed all my tests. Take if you need credit and are willing to memorize info for a relatively easy A

Professor Byrne was a "boring" professor in the way that he could talk for the whole hour and 15 minutes, but what he says is very interesting. He is a very nice guy. Take notes and go to the review sessions, just study, and he almost always curves.

Professor Byrne is a nice and funny man, as a lecturer he can drone on for the 1hr 15. He is coherent, yet his lectures are saturated with information, much of which is not essential to learn for the course or exams. His exams are very much based on his slides. He gives a review session and tells you exactly what will be on the test. Just study.
Great teacher, one of my favorites. Funny guy, clearly a smart person. He is the kind of man we want as a professor. If you are interested in the material, you will love the class.

Was not sure if I should take this class or another for my POLS credit.. ended up LOVING this class. Take if you have any interest in current news/politics at all I hate classes where profs just read off the slides and he actually gives such interesting lectures. Cool background. Gives very unbiased view. Only 3 test grades. just listen+learn!

No need to read, tests are based off the powerpoints entirely. Material isn't too complex so participation is easy/worth it. Prof is a nice dude but occasionally says off-colored things. Grade based off 3 tests, final paper, participation, nothing too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Truly a knowledgeable guy with an interesting personal career. Class is more difficult than I expected. Graded by 3 exams, a book review, and participation. Prof does allow you to make your case if you thought you should've gotten an answer on an exam right. Definitely consider taking this course if you're a Poly Sci major.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Quiz, team quiz, & team class exercise every week. Class only once a week but you have to watch a bunch of videos before class & read the chapter to do well on quizzes. She grades very harshly on exercises/quizzes but if you ask a bunch of questions while doing it she usually leads you in the right direction. I dropped the class, material's boring

She requires homework, quiz, team project along the whole semester, and four exams. Go with the other professors, DO Not take her class. When I compare her grading standards and the other professor, it is extremely unfair. She cares about her lecture, but she doesn't care about the grades her students gonna get AT ALL.

She is the worst teacher ever. Classes are boring and useless. The way she grades is also very unreasonable and biased. She only pays attention to her favorites in the class. Extremely unhelpful and impossible to communicate with.
Nice and easy...
No Comments

he was very passive aggressive at times if you were one of his favorites. i actually dreaded going to his class. it is a lot of work and his grading system is nuts. he grades off of his opinion of your topic not your actual product. if you are looking for an easy class do not take it.

J331 was a demanding course with a lot of outside work, and Chad is a tough grader. However, I learned a tremendous amount, especially technically, and his feedback was always helpful and responsive. Glad I took a class with him! Overall, an excellent, knowledgeable, and experienced professor whose challenging coursework was very rewarding.
Grading system is insane imo, other than that he's fine

Class time here was pretty efficient and Chad was usually pretty peppy. Only critique for him is that some of the marks he would take off for audio assignments would not be in the grading criteria and would be purely subjective, which could be frustrating at times. Solid dude, wouldn't mind taking another course from him.

Chad was my favorite professor this semester. He made lab super engaging and although he is a tough grader, it helps you improve as a writer. This class is mandatory for journalism majors, so make sure you choose him as your lab professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Tough course but he made it fun. He runs the lab portion of the class, two other profs run the lecture portion which sucked but its a required course for Media School degrees. You have to manage your time and stay ahead of deadlines, I worked my ass off in this class but I like how Chad modeled it on a real newsroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: great prof, just be present in class and you will pass, lecture based most of the time, group project at end but it is not bad at all.

She was very nice and the class was relatively easy. You have weekly journals that are about 300 words that mostly feel like busy work. Overall, if you come to class and pay attention you will get an A

Shes very nice and cares about her students
Have to read lots and attend all lectures to do well in exam

good teacher, you can tell she cares about her students and what she's teaching but lectures can be boring. you have a short essay (300-500 words) every sunday that takes maybe 30 minutes but can be the difference between letter grades at the end of the year. Tests are easy just go over material and study guide AND go to in class review
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Such a sweet professor and truly cares about her students. Her lectures are definitely dry but she gives great study guides that prepare you well for the exams.

She is very knowledgeable about public policy, and she had a nice demeanor that made it easy to ask questions. It's easy to let your mind wander during lectures as they are very monotone, but her grading is pretty easy.

I really like her as a person, but you could definitely tell that this was her first semester teaching. She is knowledgable about policy, but her lectures could be disengaging and she didn't seem confident lecturing. She is great to talk to one-on-one and always willing to help. Follow along with lectures and you'll do well in the course.

Dr. Craig is an intelligent, funny, and down-to-earth professor who actually cares about his students' growth in the course. Although he can choose favorites at times, he tries to give each individual a chance to prove that he/she has improved over the semester. I would recommend this professor to other students.

Byron is really good at giving you feedback. He will be tough because he expects a lot but he also praises you when you do well. C106 is a lot of group presentations but he carefully selects your group.

Although I was intimidated by him at first due to the course syllabus I read before the first class, Byron Craig was an amazing professor for Business Presentations Honors. He was very encouraging and motivating in a class that can get nerve-racking, due to public speaking. His experience makes him very wise. I wish he wasn't leaving IU!
Genuinely cares about student success.

Byron is an excellent teacher. Really easy to get along with and very willing to help you improve as long as you are willing to put in the effort. Office hours were good for getting more specific feedback and even just to chat with him. You'll never catch Byron without a smile on his face. Definitely recommend his course.

Byron is a nice person, however he did not teach any material and gave minimal feedback. Since C106/104 is all about improving based on individual feedback, this is a problem. He also gossips about other students. On the other hand is is a very charismatic person and fun to be around.

At first I was pretty intimidated by Byron, but he was likely my best professor this semester. He has high expectations, but if you're willing to put in the time and effort he'll notice. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS! He loves it when students come to talk to him about anything. He's a professor where it really pays off to have a good relationship.
Byron is super enthusiastic about teaching this class. He makes public speaking less intimidating and is totally willing to help his students.  I highly recommend taking his class.
The best prof I have had at IU. He is interesting and understanding. I got an A in the class. Easy class if he likes you. Jokes around lot. Definitely would take him if you can
Byron is the man! just be involved in class and engage with byron and your classmates and you will be just fine!

Byron is the man.  In the course of 16 weeks he turned me into a confident presenter.  I highly recommend going to his office hours-he will help you! Very intelligent man and the classes are extremely informational. He can sometimes be a little strict on grading, but explains his reasoning well.

I really enjoyed this class. The readings that were assigned were complex, but really made for great papers. He does great helping those who really need it and he definitely knows what he is doing. I highly recommend him.

Love her! She gives harsh feedback sometimes but it's warranted and actually helps you learn. I feel like she likes to hear herself talk lol, but it's fine cuz I love the discussions and I like listening to her too tbh.

Great Professor for W131. She cares about the students' success and helps out whenever you are struggling. Feedback is awesome; incorporating it in your essays will give you a good grade. Most of the assignments lead up to the essay so when it comes time to write the essay there is not much to think about.
She is very understanding and takes the time to teach and to make sure people understand the assignement. Wants people to learn and to succeed so really tries her best to help you learn.

Take this class with this professor. She is very sweet and wants everyone to succeed in her class. The content she provided was interesting and relatable making the class easy to engage with. Assignments are not too bad as long as you put in effort, and she gives clear feedback on what she is looking for. Always available to answer questions.

This professor is absolutely amazing. Cindy cares about all of her students and hopes they all succeed. She has you do a lot of work but its only to make you better. All of the assignments are manageable as long as you take them seriously. I would 10000% recommend this professor, as she was my favorite in college so far!!

not sure what the previous rating is talking about, she canceled class for a whole week because of "family emergency" but besides that she won't cancel. my main qualm with her is she expects a lot of class participation but chose her class to take place at 8am.. we don't want to be here. have your class at a reasonable time. class isn't hard tho

the worst professor I've yet to have at IU. grades so hard with no explanation. gives no review guides and just expects you to know everything. She takes off points on exams for irrelevant reasonings. never canceled even when - degrees outside. She made a statement how her kids school was closed because it was so cold, yet she made us come anyway.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Cimera is such a sweet professor! She really knows what she is talking about and has a great sense of humor. Even though this class was online due to the pandemic, I felt like I learned so much about employment law and honestly I feel like I may even pursue it as a career! Highly recommend taking her!

She is a hardworking mom who travels to Bloomington twice a week to teach Employment Law. She has very quirky jokes every once in a while and wants you to succeed. The material is difficult, but if you pay attention and take time to study and MEMORIZE the material you will be okay! She also gives lots of extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I loved Cindy as a professor. Not only do they teach about anti-capitalism, but they implement those principles in class by encouraging students to take care of their mental health over the class. They took us on optional field trips to local museums and sightings, and made us feel like we could confide in them about anything. Best professor ever.

Cindy was a very laid back and chill prof. halfway through the semester she actually just gave everyone an A so that was pretty cool. She emphasized rest and that it was ok to skip out on class if you had other stuff to do. This class was pretty interesting though if you need a diversity in the US credit definitely take this.

They are very understanding and they actually care about there students. For this class they gave you an A on your papers as long as you met the clear criteria. The papers were not very difficult either. Overall, it was a nice environment, where you actually learn interesting material. If you want to get an A it is not difficult to do.

They really care about our workload and try not to over burden us with heavy readings every class. They had really good lectures and book recommendations. Grading seemed inconsistent however. For a research paper, a classmate and I got very different grades despite in my opinion being similar in quality. Also no 100s.

Really cares about his students but his lectures are super convoluted and hard to understand. Actually put effort into the homework because its based on accuracy. Office hours are super important for this class and I wish I went more. I understood so much better when I did go to office hours because he walks you through everything on the test.

Professor Ciucu was fantastic for teaching Intro to Probability and Statistics. He took the time to learn about each and every student in the course and tried to make the material as easy as possible. As someone who had struggled with this course previously, Mihai was a much better and more understanding lecturer. Highly recommend.

By far the worst professor I have had at IU. He did not explain the information clearly and would not allow students to ask questions. Went to go and see him for office hours and he called me stupid and didnt understand why I was confused. Spent hours each week with a tutor.

I got a B in this class, but man did I spend night upon night stressing, crying, and studying to even get a C or D on the tests. The homework is alright, just takes forever, fair enough. I know many that tried their hardest and felt unsatisfied in this course. Dont expect much sympathy for major life events that impact your studies.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Ciucu was pretty good, as far as finite professors go. He did his best to make sure that we understood the material and was really good in his office hours. There is a decent amount of homework but far less than some of the other professors gave.

Loved Professor Ciucu! He is such a nice guy and he genuinely wants his students to do the absolute best they can while in the class. I always go to office hours and he does a good job of explaining any questions I have and takes time to go back if I don't understand something! The material is where the difficulty lies but Mihai makes it bearable!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Will start off by saying how great of a teacher Ciucu is! I had him fall 2019 and he always brought enthusiasm to the subject. In terms of difficulty, if you study and go to office hours (I didn't go to office hours) you will survive the class. The difficulty comes more down to subject matter rather than professor IMO.

There are very few grades in this class so you must do well on the 4 exams throughout the semester. He lectures every class and does not take attendance but if you do not come, it will be extremely difficult to do the homework. However, once you get the hang of it, finite with him is not too hard or unbearable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Prof. Ciucu teaches a notoriously hard class, so in general, expect difficulty. But overall, he goes through the material and makes sure to engage with his 300 kid lecture halls. If you raise your hand, he will stop and answer your question. He makes you feel like a student rather than a body in a seat. I would recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is funny
Nice
good, very clear lectures. he prepares students well for tests which have a pretty generous curve because a lot of people still tend to do not that great

Sometimes it can be hard to follow his logic but if you ask him to explain it further he will. He doesn't assign quizzes so the only grades come from 2 exams, a midterm, a final, and online homework, so if you get a bad grade on one exam you're gonna struggle to raise your grade afterwards. I'm not a math person but I'm doing fine in this class.
Great Class. I hope I can take his class again
He explains things really well
Good

Get to class early and try to sit in the first four rows, because he's very soft-spoken and doesn't use a mic. Other than that, he wasn't the best, but as long as you pay REALLY close attention, it isn't the worst. Also, everyone else is taking it too, so you can suffer/succeed together.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Finite is extremely hard, but compared to other professors teaching it too he is a great choice. He's really friendly and caring and happy to answer questions. At times tough to understand but as long as you write exactly whats on the board down you'll be fine. I still went to the free tutoring in the dorms but know plenty of people who didn't.

Ciucu is great! He has an accent but if you haven't lived under a rock your whole life he is actually very clear to understand. Loves finite, makes the class just like solving little puzzles. Sit in the front and listen to what he's saying. The tests are not easy but use the weekly webwork to help you, a lot of the questions come from there.

Professor Ciucu is a great teacher! He clearly finds math very entertaining, and tries to get students to find it as fascinating as he does. He turns finite into a puzzle class, and is a nice guy in general. I think he is underrated, which probably has something to do with his thick accent, which is nonetheless perfectly understandable.

I relate the class's difficulty more to the subject matter, rather than Mr. Ciucu's teaching. Finite is a nightmare to takepass as it is. He seems to really know and love what he teaches. My only issue is that it was just almost impossible for me to understand a word he said; His accent is VERY thick, so definitely pay attention to his powerpoints

Professor Ciucu does a great job of teaching Finite.  Although he does write on the board more than necessary, he explains everything very clearly.  He seems better than most of the other Finite professors and he doesn't take attendance.  You should absolutely go to every class, but it's nice if you have to skip.

Mihai knows exactly what he's talking about and lays a good foundation for learning finite and the rest is up to you.  That is what finite is all about and you will not find a better professor to teach you the material. Webwork once a week and is very reasonable.

I'm pretty bad at math, and had trouble the entire semester but pulled out a B- with a lot of work. My advice: Do ALL the homework problems(even if it takes 5 hours/week), and go to Campus Tutoring Service before each exam. The sheets they give out explain everything.

Ciucu is more or less an ideal professor for anyone who's typically good at math. He teaches by going through examples, there's no attendance policy (I often arrived late), and the once-a-week online homework usually had ? retries. He has an accent, but any native English speaker should have no trouble understanding him. Overall, an underrated guy.

I definitely struggled going to his lectures. He's difficult to understand and writes way too much on the board. He also goes off on tangents and does an awful job of answering questions. I would recommend getting a tutor or trying a website like FiniteHelp to help you get through the semester if you're struggling teaching yourself.
Not helpful at all. Never provides any examples other than ones he already has on lecture slides. If you can teach yourself, he is fairly easy.

Good teacher! Other people commenting on this site probably put in little effort. I got tutored a couple times and was able to pull off an A. If you pay attention and actually attempt to understand the material you will be fine!

If you're good at teaching yourself material, take him. You don't have to go to class except on for 2 tests. He doesn't give quizzes, doesn't take attendance,& you can get all of his lectures (he reads them word for word) online. He only gives one Webwork a week and it's only 10-20 questions. FYI impossible to understand him, & he's a bad teacher.

Nice guy.... but the worst teacher I've ever had. The semesters almost over and his accent still comes off so thick that i often don't understand what he's talking about. The tests are IMPOSSIBLE no matter how much effort put forth into studying, the questions are so unlike the homework that it will catch you off guard.

Overall he is a great a guy, but he is not the best teacher.  Sporting a green sweater is a favorite pastime of Me-Hi. You don't need to go to class, teach yourself. Only 1 webwork a week, which is awesome. Probably one of the easier/less clear finite teachers.

MIHAI is the single greatest teacher in the history of Indiana University. His style, grace, and overall teaching demeanor, outshine his collegues. You will come to love and respect him as a teacher and his green sweater. I couldn't have made it through this first semester without his able guidance and unparalled knowledge of the subject.

I left the class. He doesn't speak english. He pretty much sucks. He goes over the same problem for 20 minutes and it is  annoying because you can't comprehend what he is saying. TERRIBLE PROFESSOR. CHOOSE SOMEONE ELSE. with an american name.

If you are good at math and are required to take finite, I would recommend him.  He doesn't give pop quizzes and has only one webwork each week.  Almost all points are on the tests so you really just need to watch the Finite Show to do well.  Don't need to show up to class at all.

His tests are very easy if u even grasp some of the info.  Don't need to go to class and there really isn't a point since he is hard to understand and there is nothing taught that you can't learn from the book or the finite show.
basically he doens't speak english, going to class is a waste.
Just awful. Hard to understand. Terrible teacher. Does not show up to office hours. Bad about getting back to you. So boring.
Pretty bad teacher, used lecture slides rarely uses any examples, and I couldn't understand a word he said

One of my worst teachers. Doesn't care about student success, but more cares about making sure he keeps his schedule how he wants it. Very hard to understand and doesn't like to repeat himself. States to message him for help but still hasn't responded to messages I have sent. Overall terrible teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Do not take his class. I could not understand him and his handwriting is terrible. He gets annoyed easily at questions asked during class claiming he will not go over it as he already has gone over it in the past even if you do not understand.
He was a bit confusing at times during lecture but allowed us to get some extra credit on the online homework portion of the class which many of my friends with other profs did not get.
do not, DO NOT take his class. I . wouldnt do it again even if you'd pay me.

Maria was by far one of the best professors I have had. She really wants you to understand the material, and will help you until you do. Also, she is always available for help outside of class. She gives great feedback on tests and homework and also does a great job teaching the criteria. She speaks in Spanish majority which is really helpful
Very explicit and clear in her grading criteria. She always wants the class to participate (but many people never really did). Tough, but good grader.

I absolutely loved having Ria as a professor. Her teaching style, to me, was lovely. She always conveyed things clearly and always asked if we understood so she could re-explain if we didn't. She really cares about her students and is constantly trying to get you involved and participate and ask questions. Wonderful person, highly recommend.

If you're reading this it's probably cause you just finished S105 and need to take S200 to satisfy your degree stuff. This class probably requires half the effort of S105. She teaches material well, and her powerpoints are effective. The two biggest things to succeed in this class are attendance and PARTICIPATION. Study like you would for S105.

Ria is really caring and tries to help you understand the information well. Every day, there is an online take home quiz. Bring your textbook everyday because we got through the entire book in one semester. Very fast paced, but she tries to slow it down and offers office hours if you need it. Attendance and participation counts.
She is not prepared for lectures and is not responsive via email

Hoffman is clearly an awesome, well-learned individual. Her lectures are almost always interesting to someone interested in psychology. The only thing annoying about this class is that the information feels a little dumbed down sometimes and you will not get a high score unless you can memorize information for essay questions.

Dr. Hoffman is an excellent professor! Her tests aren't exactly easy, but their contents are never a surprise; if you need to memorize something, she'll tell you well in advanced. I would recommend this class to any psychology major!

Dr.H is a great professor. She will provide you extra help, but you have to ask for it! It's completely worth it to go to her office hours, and she is more than happy to explain things. her lectures are interesting, and she says memorable anecdotes. Take P155 with her!
Boring, boring, boring. Ridiculously long homework and even more ridiculous exams.
Very very interesting lectures, I really enjoyed her teaching and I really learned from her. Very helpful in answering questions, as well.
She is very good at working with you on late homework.  Her lectures are very interesting and she is very nice when you talk to her.
She is extremely good at working with students, especially with late homework.

Great Teacher!! Very helpful if you go to office hours. Extremely organized! Hard class but if you read and take notes will be an easy class for anyone interested in being a psychologist. She posts 10 essay questions for tests on oncourse if you write them all out she chooses 3 very easy to get an A or B in class. attendance is mandatory.

Dr. Hoffman is very well organized. I love her teaching style and if you ask her for help she is more than willing to answer your questions. She is a tough grader, however I learned more in her class than any others. She makes it easy to take notes in her class. I plan on taking her for more classes. Especially stats her organization will be helpfu
She is a great teacher.  If you do the work you get a good grade.

I enjoyed this class. I didn't skip often, because I found the lectures to be somewhat interesting...and plus the notes are very long...instead of filling in blanks..she makes you write out the whole definitions.she gave out weekly quizzes.they're easy if you read. I haven't missed a single point on her quizzes. She gives out extra credits too!

If you hate math and have to take stats, take Hoffman. Her voice is sort of annoying, and she gives homework every week or so, but it's worth it. I went in hating math and came out with my first A, without really even trying.
Uggh....would not recomend taking classes with this prof unless you want to feel like youre back in high school.  gives easy points if youre willing to jump through hoops.

I found that the material in this course was fairly easy to catch on to.  Hoffman treated us like idiots and made us learn her way of calculating exactly, and if we didn't follow her steps, we got marked off--even with correct answers!!  Something about he
I loved her class!
No Comments
If you went to class and took the notes that she gave you on the projecter, you had to try hard to fail.  Easy class to want to skip, but quizzes and attendance will get you if you do.
The class was so boring.  She's hard to follow, a bad lecturer and kind of crazy too.
If you are enrolled in this class, drop it now while you still have the chance! It's my lifes biggest regret that I didn't.

The absolute worst class I have ever taken at IU in my entire life. She is the most boring teacher I have ever had and teaches her class like a Ph.D. class would be taught. The tests are all essay and it takes the full class time to take them. This class ruined my senior year.

This class is not interesting to me. She has an annoying voice, and she goes through notes very quickly, you have to be ready at all times to be flying through the notes, and some of the tests are very hard. It is a class that takes a lot of work, and it is only a 100 level class.
Easy class, most people just get notes from other people, so you don't even have to attend that many classes.
She's kind of a weird lady.  the would have been easy had I gone, but her voice made me want to skip.

This was the most irritating class I ever took.  Dr. Hoffman has the most grating and shrill voice.  She would often interupt her guests to put in her two sense on subjects that she has no clue about.  I could barely tolerate her...
so boring and totally unclear not to mention its pointless for me to be in there shes rude and somehow weird
Her class is not easy, but she's very helpful and a nice person. It's too bad she's gone from IU.
Unclear with notes and unaccesible.
She's willing to help if you ask for it and she teaches very effectively.  She is also a very nice person.

it would be bad enough to have her for one class in a semester...but i got stuck with two.  class is pretty difficult, and she is strange, irritating, and unpredictable and difficult with tests. boring and tedious
She covers a lot of material very fast.  It's hard to keep up.
This class is worse than an enema of razor blades and nails at its best. Its more of can we chase you away from being a psychology major?!?   :(
Dr. Hoffman is often available to help students.  Her homework assignments in statistics can be difficult though.  Good professor overall.
not the most helpful lady you are going to run into
kind of on the weird side to say the least
I went to office hours and recieved little help.  Very boring class.  Can sometimes be on verge of rude to students
Very unhelpful.  Tests are much harder than they need to be
This woman is awesome, she is hands down the best professor I have had at Indiana University.
No Comments
very unorganized and a little weird...
I disliked this class very much
very organized, go to class and get the notes, and that's the test basically
No Comments
