Go to office hours, because she is definitely willing to help you out and give useful tips. If you work hard and improve you should get the grade you want.

Paige Clark was my favorite professor of my freshman year. She was very committed to making the class fun. Be wary of the group you "choose", because she often just tries to balance it out. If you are nice to her, she will be nice back. She bumped me from an A- to an A, just because I participated in class and was nice to her. Overall, loved it.

Always pleasant and seemingly helpful but your fate depends on how much she likes your class andor group.  She assigned weak people to my group in an effort to balance teams and screwed me out of the full A I deserved based on their efforts.  She hammers you on "reflection" responses that have nothing to do with presentations at the end so beware.
Professor Clark was so nice to everyone and was willing to help whoever needed it. This course is mostly group work though, so be prepared for that.

She is an awesome professor. She truly cares about her students and wants them to become better speakers. I took it over the summer so she understood that we didn't have as much time to prepare and took that into consideration. She is a very fair grader and you definitely get what you deserve. She is very approachable and overall a happy person.

Paige was a phenomenal professor. She was always really engaging and seemed to care about her students.  She takes the time to make an otherwise "dry business class" fun.  Additionally, she has a great sense of humor and loves presentations that are goofy, yet professional. She's been my favorite professor at IU so far.

Paige is honestly the nicest person and professor I've had. She genuinely cares and wants to help her students be better speakers. I definitely without a doubt recommend her. She is a very fair grader, you get what you deserve. She also recognizes when you improve on something and acknowledges that. She is amazing.
Paige is fabulous! She knows how to give constructive criticism without being too harsh. Be sure to get to know her and ask her for help when needed. She's a really happy person.

Paige is a fabulous teacher. I was terrified of public speaking before... if this is the case, take c104 with clark. She doesn't grade as hard as other teachers, she keeps the environment very lo key, and you will end the semester a much better speaker and much more comfortable than before.
She is amazing!  Best prof I've had since I've been at IU.  Take her class she rocks!
she rocks
She is an amazing professor and an even better person! She's the best Prof i've had so far at IU! As long as you do the work sincerely, you'll get the grades! She is Superb!
Paige is an awesome professor.  I really don't think I would be as confident as a speaker if I wouldn't have taken her class. She is also really positive and funny and keeps class interesting!
Paige was an absolutely fantastic business presentations prof.  She was engaging and made the material and speech assignments interesting.

clark is real cool. shell help you when you need it and is willing to let you make up speeches. if you do what she tells to and improve from your first speech... youll definitely get an A. shes not bad to look at too...

She has been the best prof's I have had the last two years. She is willing to help you as long as you ask and very sweet. I would definitely take another one of her classes if I could. The grading is very fair and you get what you put into the class.
Great instructor!  She challenges you to work hard but I'm a way better speaker because of it.  She's also really funny and keeps class interesting.

Prof Clark has been one of the most incredible teachers I have ever had.  Class is never boring and she goes out of her way to help you in any way she can.  I was really nervous about giving speeches, but she helped me become so much more confident.
yeah got in a fight with her over the reading assignments at the start of the year but she grades fairly kind of wish she would take into consideration grade complaints better tho
Best professor I've had at IU!!!

Overall, she's Okay. Her grading standard is pretty subjective and discretionary. Sometimes I don't know what she expects. You usually get crappy score after you thought you did an awesome presentation. 3 star!
She is awesome!
Nice! Fun! Understanding!
Really helpful professor!
Best class I've taken!  Ms. Clark is really great!
Love her!  She is one of the best professors I have had!  She is really funny and definitely knows her stuff about public speaking!  She really helped me get over my fears about giving speeches.
hard graded, but great teacher
She really cares about her students and is always willing to help you out.  She also keeps class really interesting and fun!  Highly recommended!
She's really nice and is not that hard of a grader! She is also very good and improving ppl's public speaking skills

I loved taking this class with Dr. Kirkpatrick! A great lecturer, kind person, and a really fun class. He's always willing to reexplain difficult concepts in a way that makes sense. If you show up to class and actually try, you can definitely get a good grade. A great gen ed!

Cody is a good person, he means well, and he's very passionate about teaching weather. But, the class, it's genuinely one of the hardest gen eds i've ever taken. You have to really try to get a good grade. Everything that's on the exams, are not what we learned or questions that aren't meant to be confusing on purpose. Also offers no extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Bro is a chiller, loves the weather which makes me want to come to class since he is so passionate about it. I always look forward to the classes after a big storm or a cold/warm front is expected. He really is probably my favorite professor i have ever had. Not too much HW or quizzes, make sure you study a little before exams.

Great professor who somehow made a pretty slow and easy course into something to look forward to. He always managed to make concepts interesting even given how little we covered. I'd definitely recommend for a gen-ed, there's little to no work and it's interesting at the same time. Also it's nice to feel like a weatherman!
Great professor! I loved coming to class, and coming to class is very important; otherwise, you will fail. Would definitely recommend if you need an interesting science credit.
I had him to EASE144 and overall it was a very good informative class but he made it fun. I would have him as a professor again, even though he does give three exams and a quiz every week.
Professor K was a very fun instructor and made learning very engaging. 10/10 would recommend.
Best teacher and very funny. Class was actually enjoyable.

Highly recommend this professor and E-144. Dr. K is awesome, funny, and knowledgable. He makes the class really fun and engaging and you will learn a lot if you go to class consistently. I'm in Kelley and this the class I was the most excited to go to. Even if you aren't a weather nerd like me, I think you would find this class fun and interesting.
Prof. Kirkpatrick is awesome. Please take this course if you're deciding on it, you won't regret it (and it's quite easy).
Absolute legend. Incredible guy. Take his course. GOAT.
Literally the best. If you think otherwise, you are probably the problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take this course. My major has nothing to do with science, but he had me seriously considering whether it should. The lectures are so engaging and informative. Dr. Kirkpatrick is absolutely hilarious and intelligent and is definitely my favorite professor at IU.

If you are into weather and want to dive into it early C105 is a great course. Professor Kirkpatrick is by far the best professor I have had at IU and I am currently taking a harder level course by him now. SHOW UP TO CLASS! There are extra credit opportunities to redeem yourself on past quizzes and future exams. If you don't show up you're lost

One of the best professors I've had at IU. Super funny and smart. Easy to talk to. The textbook is free. However, the assignments get monotonous and there is 0 extra credit. The lowest score is dropped tho, and tests barely affect your grade. Interesting class but it is difficult. I wouldn't recommend taking it if you want an easy Gened.

Professor Kirkpatrick has a very fair and understandable grading scale. Attendance is optional, but you will be behind if you miss too many of his classes. There are quizzes every week or so that are pretty straightforward, and they keep you engaged in the course. However, if you are looking for easy gen ed, this is not your class.

As long as you go to class and take notes you should be fine. The professor does a fantastic job at teaching, and makes sure that the class gets key concepts. If the class is struggling with something he makes sure the class understands. Only homework is a weekly assignment that is usually 5-8 questions long. If you need a gen ed, take this class.

My fav class. Make sure to GO TO CLASS. It's impossible to learn if you don't go. You'll find that if he constantly repeats something in the lecture that it's on the test. BTW there isn't a crazy amount of math on each test, so try to really understand the content because the questions can be worded differently then the lectures.

Professor Kirkpatrick is the best professor I have had in my first semester. I am not a "science person" but he makes all the content very easy to understand and is extremely approachable and friendly. He wants everyone to succeed and will help you if you ask. Just show up, engage, and you will not regret taking him.
he is so funny and the best professor ever

One of the best! Made class so fun for students, even if you are not into science! He is always available to help out and is so genuine. The textbook is given to you in a PDF for free, so don't worry about buying one (you don't use it that much anyway). Very few exams also, I would take another class with Dr. Kirkpatrick in a heartbeat!

I loved Dr. Kirkpatrick! My favorite class and I'm a science person. He was always available for help and went through lectures slowly, the science was pretty easy and only 1 unit uses math. There are opportunities for extra credit and he really cares about his students. He's fun and makes the class feel smaller, even though it's a giant lecture.

This is the best class I've taken yet, he does the notes in real time which gives us the opportunity to stop and ask questions without feeling rushed. Going to class is very important to pass and if you just pay attention the material is not difficult. He is also hilarious and makes class enjoyable.

He's awesome! Super funny, chill, and overall just a really good guy. He teaches every topic in a way that's easy to understand and makes each topic actually enjoyable. The workload is just one small assignment each week, so it's not bad at all. Show up to the lectures and you'll get a good grade! Only 3 tests throughout the entire semester.

Truly one of the most kind and respectable professors at IU! He loves what he teaches and makes such an effort to get students interested and participate. There are weekly quizzes but he tells you what's on them and posts the notes from every class so attendance isn't mandatory. Content seems easy but can trick you sometimes on exams and quizzes.

Love this guy so much. His teaching methods are always on the money and get me where I need to be. He goes through problems/examples with rest of the class, working through it on screen & waiting for everyone to make sure nobody falls behind. Go to class, take some solid notes, listen to what he has to say, & you're golden. Can't recommend  enough!

One of the best professors that I've ever had. He clearly conveyed all the concepts in a way that was very easy to understand. His lecture style is the main reason for this. He would write the notes along with us in the front of the class and walk us through the concepts step by step. I preferred this lecture style to a normal PowerPoint lecture.

Please if you are considering taking him, do it! He is a very good teacher, and he gives the information off in an easy way. If you attend class, he notices this and you will get a lot back of what you put into the class. Sometimes, he does trick questions on quizzes but never to harshly damage the grade.
He is the best and is always there to help me when I ask. Definitely would recommend his classes, I've learned a lot.

Assignments are manageable and he works hard to shape the course content around the needs of his students. He's someone I could relate quite well to and he made the subject matter quite interesting! Highly recommend Dr. K as a professor.
The style of teaching made the class very easy and actually interesting for a weather class.

This has been my only professor thus far that has actually taught me a lot. He is amazing and cares so much about students learning the material. He takes the notes with us instead of just reading off slides, and it is so helpful. An amazing person overall. He's the best

Professor Kirkpatrick is seriously a great professor. I am currently taking him and Ive never gone out of my way to rate a professor but he is great. The class is fair and he makes class very interesting. Would totally recommend him.

Cody has a knack of teaching meteorology really well to a wide group of people. He was able to effectively communicate concepts in the class filled with engineers, mathematicians, physicists and meteorologists. His explanation of concepts are lucid and he leads the students from what the student knows to what the student needs to know.

He started class with a statement that he thought of all of us as adults and would treat us as such, then proceeded to spend the rest of class playing a condescending micromanager.
The course structure makes me want to stay, his attitude makes me want to drop.

He started class with a statement that he thought of all of us as adults and would treat us as such, then proceeded to spend the rest of class playing a condescending micromanager.
The course structure makes me want to stay, his attitude is telling me to drop.

Professor Kirkpatrick gives excellent lectures that are engaging, interesting, and helpful. It's not a crazy easy class, but if you go to lectures and do all the assignments, the material is quite simple to grasp. I really enjoyed his classes, and I highly suggest this class to anyone.

I am in my 3rd class w. Dr. K (W in 1/3). The material is not easy at all, but it feels very rewarding to learn. His classes are tough, but he does his best to be available to help everyone. I respect him as a person and a professor so highly that I have not been tempted to cheat once in 3 courses. 2-4 h exam prep. Curves on each exam. All Cs so fa

Dr. Kirkpatrick is so funny and tells great stories. He's always trying to make the material and lectures fun and interesting. Not too much homework but he does love using paper so be prepared to print things. Overall, a great class and professor!

He rocks. Very open to changing the his teaching approach to better suit the class. If you miss a quiz you can make it up, the day after exams you can earn some points back, and the "textbook" is free and super easy to understand (also written by him).
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. K teaches you the things that matter outside of the classroom. He also explains everything so clearly, although there are readings that you could do, even if you just go to class and pay attention (which is easy with him) you will be fine. He is also super accessible and helpful in office hours if something was not or if you miss a class.

Dr. Kirkpatrick is a good professor. As long as you complete all the work and don't miss too much class you will be fine. But even if you do miss it, he holds office hours you can go to. The material is pretty complicated at times but if you study for the exams, you will be fine.

He is an amazing professor. He is very kind, funny, and engaging. The information was very practical and helpful for day to day life. I never skipped a lecture so I never had to study outside of class. Highly recommend you take this!
Very good at his job. Makes sure everyone is engaged in the lecture, barely had to study for exams because I mastered the material in lectures

If you want an easy class, take "Weather and You". But be prepared to endure one of the most stretched lectures you'll ever have to sit through. Professor Kirkpatrick is a good guy, but the actual content takes 30 mins to go over and then the rest of class is spent doing the SAME examples and is very repetitive. 75% of the content is common sense.

Dr. K was seriously the nicest professor I've had so far. Admist COVID 19 and online classes, he made his class fun and engaging. He is super understanding and will listen to any concerns you have no matter how small. I definitely want to take another class with him.
He teaches in a way that is so easy to understand. He also is very good with reviewing for tests and making sure you do the best you can. Best prof I have had at IU so far.
Excellent teacher who you can reach in the middle of the night to ask questions, cares about the material, thoughtful & well put together lectures, with interesting material.

Dr. K is one of the best professors at IU and honestly one of the best in the country, both from a meteorological and human standpoint. Lectures are fun and interesting and he teaches in a way that really explains the topic so you can use it in real life which does not happen often. Best teacher/professor I've ever had

Absolutely amazing professor. Had him online due to COVID but was completely understanding and empathetic to all of us. He made lectures interesting and broke things down quite well. He made sure everyone understood the material before moving on. Tests and quizzes were fair. As long as you understand the lecture content, the class is an easy A/B.

Took COLL-C 105 with Prof. Kirkpatrick in Fall 2020. Amazing professor that makes long lectures fun to sit through. Lectures off of a clear and easy to follow powerpoint. Short weekly readings. Not much homework. Go to class, listen, take notes and you won't have a hard time getting an A.

He's a real gem as long as you're serious about the course. He's very understanding so long you don't cheat your way out. His lectures are amazing and fun. He's always looking out for his students because he genuinely cares. I absolutely loved the course and he deserves the credit for that.

He is one of the best professors that I have had at IU. He is amazing! He really cares about his students and what is going on in their lives. He is extremely accessible outside of class if you need help or have any questions. He is a great lecturer and is excellent at explaining concepts.

He is a very detailed professor, he goes in depth with each concept to make sure we understand. I like how he weighs the grades where our daily activites get the most credit because the activities are fairly easy and it gives us an opportunity to use reasources. Overall fun and great teacher that cares about his students.

Dr. K is the best he really cares about his students and obviously loves what he does. The class can be complicated sometimes, but he really tries his best to make sure you understand everything. Pay attention and try during lecture and you'll be fine.

I have had Dr.K for E144, A339, and A437. He is intimidating at first and picks people randomly, but don't be afraid, he's a cool guy and the further you get with him, the better it is. He has the MOST respect for students and totally understands what we are going through. I enjoyed having him in my favorite classes! Exams are FAIR, not too easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He did a really good job of taking feedback from the students to decide where to take the course. He was one of the most helpful and enthusiastic professors I've ever had. You can tell he not only cares about the material but also that his students are learning. A great class to take if science isn't your subject and you need a helpful teacher.

Professor Kirkpatrick is an amazing professor. I am horrible at science and had anxiety about his Extreme Weather class but it ended up being one of my favorite classes in college. He explains things very well so non-majors understand it perfectly. He is passionate, fair, and as long as you show up to class, take notes, & study, you will pass!

Professor Kirkpatrick is awesome! He goes in depth and makes sure you know whats going on at all times. You can tell he really cares about what he does and overall hes just a great teacher. Attendance isnt mandatory, but if you dont go you might feel behind. All the pop quiz dates are in the syllabus so youll never be surprised by one.
Very fun teacher! Explains thoroughly and so I never feel lost
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor K is awesome! He's super nice and his class is easy and informative. He really cares about his students, he even takes the time to know your name. The homework is pretty easy. You pretty much do not need to study for the exams if you go to lecture. He loves handouts, and the ones he gives you are super helpful! 10/10 recommend.

He is a very funny professor, however, in the class, you will assume the test will be similar to the content of the lecture & homework. But the exam will make you think you are in the wrong classroom. He just assumes that we know lots of things but actually, I don't (non-science major).

Professor K. was one of the best professors I have had. He makes a 100 level science class very interesting and enjoyable with a lot of videos and fun stories. GO TO CLASS! There are random quizzes that you will miss and get a 0 on if you skip. Tests can be hard but he curves a bit at the end of the semester. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: IF YOU READ ANY REVIEWS OF DR. KIRKPATRICK READ THIS ONE: He is the ABSOLUTE NICEST professor, or even teacher, I have ever had. He genuinely loves what he's teaching, he's funny, and wants you to succeed and makes sure you do. His class is very interactive and he gets to know you and your name. An all around good person and an incredible teacher.

Professor Kirkpatrick is very intelligent and cool with his students. I took this class to fulfill a requirement and thought I'd receive an A... Um, no. This class IS NOT AN EASY A. DO NOT enroll in this class thinking you won't have to put in any work. He is the king of trick questions and assumes his students knows certain things when we don't.
Amazing professor for general education course. His tests were hard but he always had lots of office hours the week before the test and always was available for help.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. K. is by far my favorite professor I have had at IU. Cares about his students and is willing tell help them do well in the class. No attendance, but there are random quizzes. Exams are pretty tough so go to his office hours and he helps you know the material you should.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. K is simply the best. He genuinely cares about whether the students understand the material, encourages interaction and gives plenty of opportunities to ask questions. The tests are harder than the homework but if you come to class and pay attention you'll get an A. Pretty generous curve.

One of the most down to earth professors I've ever had, gets on the same level as students and connects with the class. Going to lectures is optional, but if you go you pretty much pass the class. Offers a lot of opportunities to boost grade through redemption assignments and extra credit. Class can be boring or exciting depending on topic covered.

I this class with Dr. K for my last N&M and as a non science major I really enjoyed it. He makes lectures interesting and really cares about making sure students are understanding the material. The textbook was a $10 book which was perfect and informative. His test questions are difficult so I highly recommend attending class and taking good notes
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Kirkpatrick made the class really fun, while at the same time, informational enough to keep me (a science major) interested, and at the same time, respect the fact that it was a 100-level intro course.  Homework assignments are fair and straightforward.  Started the class with little interest in weather, but now I want to take another class!

He is a very sincere, and enthusiastic professor that  has much passion in his course. The class itself is enjoyable with an influx of videos and engaging in-class activities. However, the homework, lectures, and study guides do not adequately prepare the students from performing well in the frustrating pop quizzes, and tests.

I took this class only because I needed the N&M credit and It was defiantly not an easy class. I am also not majoring in anything to do with this class, but I actually enjoyed this class only because of him. He was an amazing teacher and even though I hated the actual class of it he made it enjoyable

Dr. K is one of my favorite professors at IU so far. I had a family emergency come up and had to turn an assignment in late. He was completely understanding and still gave me full credit. You have to go to class to really understand the material and tests can be misleading and tough, but overall I loved having Dr. K for G144.

He seems like a really nice guy, and he wants all his students to be successful, but he has strange quirks when interacting with the class. For example, during review sessions he would say "Everyone knows what _____ is, right? Don't say it out loud. Everyone knows? Good, okay.", and move on. Why is the answer a secret? It's a review session!

He's not as kind as he seems to be. Grade corrections for exam were last minute. Test are tough and nothing like the study guide. Gives homework that has nothing to do with the exams. Definitely wouldn't take his course again!!!!

Dr. Kirkpatrick is an excellent instructor that knows how to make others learn. Attendance in his class is optional but there are occasional (7) pop quizzes given throughout the semester that account for 20% of the final grade. It is imperative to fully understand fundamental concepts as his tests build upon them to come to the correct answer.

Dr. K is an excellent professor, who makes an effort to insure you understand the material and are well prepared. If you also make an effort to learn and understand the material you will do well. Dr. K is also always available for help if you need it!

I LOVED THIS CLASS. Cody is one of the best professors I've had at IU because he's obviously knowledgable in his field but makes everything really accessible to students and takes a lot of time for questions and making sure that everyone understands the material. He's also friendly and easy to talk to. Follow him on twitter for extra weather fun

I took this class for Critical Approaches and N&M credit. The topic of the course isn't what the class was about. Collaborative work is encouraged in the class but if you and partner have the same work than it is considered cheating. The study guides has nothing to  do with exams. Would not recommend him unless you have to take the course.

Not interested in the class I took with him's topic at all, but loved it solely because I was a big fan of Dr. Kirkpatrick. Great lectures, fair grader, still follow him on Twitter because he's just an overall cool guy.

Cody or "Dr. K" as we call him is arguably the best professor in the Geology department and definitely one of the better professors at IU. His lectures are engaging and interesting and he makes the material relevant and applicable to real-world scenarios. Homework is mostly reading and a few quizes. Read, go to class, and you will do well.
Probably the best professor I had at IU. Kind, funny, always willing to help and super flexible with homework stuff.

Cody is probably the nicest, most understanding teacher I've ever had in college. His class is interesting, if you attend regularly and do the warm up Q's you're pretty much set. Again, Cody is the man!!

Dr. Kirkpatrick is wonderfully enthusiastic about course material. He is always available to answer questions. He adapts lectures to fit student's needs and interests. Dr. Kirkpatrick wants his students to succeed, and it certainly shows.

One of the best instructors I've had in college. I've taken several of his classes and enjoyed all of them. He is very helpful to students and genuinely cares about students grades.  I would recommend him for any course.
Great man, great teacher, great voice.  Let the honeyed tones of Dixieland wash over you as your mind is opened to the transcendent wonders of the Earth's atmosphere. Roll Tide.

Best professor I've had on campus thus far. I've had Dr. Kirkpatrick for 3 semesters now and he is a really great guy. He genuinely cares about the success of his students and is a great overall teacher.
He was a really good teacher, and his tests weren't that bad. He had a lot of warmup questions which were easy points that help your grade a lot. I would recommend taking him if you can!

I took G109 to get some of my natural science requirements out of the way. I started the class with very little interest in the subject but learned so much and found Professor Kirkpatrick to be a great professor. As a young professor he keeps the class interesting without seeming like he doesn't have control over the class. Definitely recommended!
Amazing professor! Kept the material interesting and his lectures were hardly boring. Go to class and take some notes and you'll come out with a good grade.

This teacher is awesome!  He took a topic that I didn't know a ton about and made it easier to understand.  He genuinely cares about his students too, he is on first name terms with almost everyone!  Probably the coolest teacher I have had on campus so far.
Class is overall very easy, and he is very approachable. Lets kids makeup labs they missed and really just wants the best for his students.
Amazing instructor for CPR training. Doesn't make lectures and labs longer than they need to be and explains things perfectly. I heavily recommend taking this course with him.
I loved this class, other than easy A. Lab times were very engaging and the instructor was very patient and was willing to let you repeat over and over again what you didn't get
very funny and easy to talk to, especially if you're considering a career in something adjacent to an emt! show up to labs, the skills you learn are important and I think attendance is taken there!

best prof ever! Lectures are "required" but no attendance taken. Make sure to show up to labs and there is no outside work. Prof Coy is so hilarious and very kind. He really does care for his students' well-being and is understanding of other classes.

Dr. Cochran is one of my favorite professors. I've had her for 212 and 235 and do not regret it. Some of the homework is busy work but none of it is hard. You can only miss 3 classes but they are anything but boring. She has one of the best personalities I've seen in a Professor and truly does care about her students.

She has limited real-world entrepreneurial experience but presents herself as a broad business professional (literally runs a quilting business). All course materials and exercises come straight from another professor's book with minimal added insight. The workload is heavy and time-consuming with no value. The class itself is easy

She is an incredibly knowledgable prof, and really cares for each and every one of her students. The lectures itself can be long at times, but she started adding in more interactive activities to make them more interesting. Moreover, you take a lot away from this class and with her as a prof.
My goat, shes so sweet and genuinely cares about her students.

This class is not difficult at all, the majority of the stuff she teaches is very basic. However, she makes it more difficult than it needs to be. The work in the first half of the course took hours and did not teach me anything. I took this class thinking that we would be hands-on, but the majority of the time it's just her lecturing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Boring lectures. Attendance is mandatory but you can miss up to 2 times, no questions asked. Lots of tedious group work in class and outside class. The individual homework assignments she gives take ALOT of time. Extremely unreasonable person and very harsh grader. Does not give clear instructions for assignments and has very extreme expectations.

Nice prof. Many people enjoyed the class but I found it repetitive and boring. Topics could be taught in 8-weeks. Focused too heavily on theory of entrepreneurship rather than steps to run business. Homework assignments first 8 weeks took hours. An easy A but if you actually want to learn how to run a business, you wont learn much in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Considering that Dr. Cochran picked up from where our class left off after 6 weeks due to our original professor's absence, she did a good job. She's reasonable with workload and you can tell she wants her students to do well in class. She doesn't heavily weight exams which is nice and plans good in-class activities. Only issue is she grades late.
Dr. Cochran was amazing. Her grading criteria are very clear and her exams are not too bad.  She is very involved with each student. If you take W-212 take it with Dr. Cochran!

Dr. Cochran is a great professor and mentor. Her class was very discussion heavy, which was refreshing. We talked a lot about biases that investors have that can affect the success of minority entrepreneurs, which was kind of discouraging to me as someone who wants to raise capital one day. I did learn a lot from her class and would recommend it.

She teaches entrepreneurship courses but has only had one (failed) online business. For the shortened Spring 21 semester (during COVID) she gave a final exam the week before finals week and then used finals week to assign a group project. It was incredibly cruel, especially for a 200-level class, and then she failed everyone on the project.

She cares about her students. However lecture was just all over the place. Notes had no structure, and she also would go through slides at rapid speed, like less than 20 seconds a slide. This makes it kind of hard to study for the exam.

She was overall an awesome person. You could tell she really cared about her students and wanted us to succeed. The grading criteria was very fair and literally sets you up for success. There is a lot of reading and videos, but if you do that you should be fine for the exam. The first semester was pretty slow, but the second one was better.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cothran is very enjoyable, she cares about the course and about the students in the class. It seems that she loves to talk to students before or after class, especially when it is related to something we learned. She grades generously, gives many opportunities for extra credit, and most of the test questions are pulled from class/practice

The class overall was not overwhelming, but there were a lot of readings and videos every week that are crucial to your understanding and success in the class. Also, some of the sources/readings were not clearly reliable and felt biased on many topics. She does care about her students and what she teaches which is great and always answers questions
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she cares about her students, and is a sweet person to talk to. I went to every single lecture and still did not get a good grade on the exam, though, she offers extra credit every week that boosted by test scores to end with an A. Honestly, if you listen to her she gives you tips on how to succeed in her class.

I didn't go to half of the classes and recieved an A or something idrk, when i was there she helped prepare for the exams really well and the final paper is EASY. all i know is that Alpha Kappa Lambda is bouse and every dude there is ugly af

She's very caring and attendance isn't mandatory but if you attend her lectures then you will receive good grades on test. She's so sweet and I love her. Her lectures are engaging and interesting if you're interested in the topic and she makes class fun.

The material wasn't very difficult but the way in which it was presented made things more confusing than they needed to be. There wasn't too much homework and the assignments and projects were all very reasonable. She is nice and does try to make lectures engaging but I often found myself bored. The test questions were super vague and ambiguous.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The content of the class was pretty easy to grasp.  The assignments weren't difficult just lots of discussions and readings to do. Exams were difficult and were nothing like what we learned in the lecture. She is a great person, cared for students and our overall well-being but just can't really teach well.

Very nice person and is enthusiastic about the topics in lectures. As long as you pay attention in class and do the readings you should be fine. Study as you go throughout the semester and focus on answering the essential questions & applying what you learned and you should do good on exams.
Good teacher- tests are mostly what she goes over during class.

Although this was an intro course it was slightly challenging for a few reasons. Two big exams that didn't really pertain to much of the coursework . The exams were originally 40% of classes grade but then got changed to the horrible class scores . Other than that and the boring lectures the class was fairly easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are long and get boring. The class is exam heavy, and she does not provide help to prepare for the exams, of which there are only 2. For the first exam the class average was around a 60%. Theres no final just a final project that takes 2-3 hours. Discussions become also become very repetitive.

This class might have the most boring lectures of all time. Attendance is mandatory even though the lectures are pointless, and you don't learn anything, nor can you keep up to take notes. Instructor is nice but the class is just so structurally awful. Hard to study for the exams when you don't know how or what material to study.

For the 1hr 15min we meet in class her voice is very annoying and puts many students to sleep. Class is unbearable, attendance is mandatory, just blows through the lecture slides, hard to keep up to take notes, exams are very hard and hardly pertain to in class material, don't forget to do the weekly discussions, if you don't they tank your grade.

She is constantly changing her class, but continues to get worse and worse. She will say your writing is written by AI. She flagged my friend for not being detailed enough, then flagged them again for being too detailed. On Exam 2, everyone improved, so she said that everyone cheated. Find a way not to take this class with her.

Lectures are long (lots of notes). Only 2 exams. Multiple discussions and online quizzes. She did not provide the PowerPoint slides the first 8 weeks. Dos not provide any help to prepare for exams. First exam the class average was around a 60%. Changed grade distribution after exam 1 to make exams weighted less. No cumulative final.

I was asynchronous. While Dr.Cothran is very kind, lectures can be confusing at times. She talks fast and doesn't truly hit on things that are relevant in the tests. I would take it again because I feel like I could handle it. Also starts the class right on time, if not early. She will start a lecture immediately so beware of your time!
Not a lot of work. The quizzes didn't make sense to me since it didn't correlate with the lectures and often not with the readings/videos. No exams. Discussions become very repetitive.

Despite messing my grade up a few times, Professor Cothran is a professor that genuinely cares about how her students are doing. This course has a balance of challenging and not too stressful. Don't underestimate the difficulty of the take home quizzes, it's the only reason I didn't get an A.

Her class is a nightmare, you MUST go even though the lectures won't help you at all. She grades attendance because if she didn't, no one would show up. Assignments can be difficult since she doesn't go over what you actually need to know in order to prepare. It's an easy A class but she turns it into a class that takes tons of effort to get an A.

as Dr. Cothran does make the lectures engaging and interesting, the take home quizzes have almost nothing to do with the lecture and its all off the online readings she gives us. Unless your required to take this class (I had to because im a sport management major) don't take it.

Cothran expects you to slave over her class like it's the only class students have to take. If i knew how difficult she would make the open note quizzes, I would have preferred to take in person tests
Cothran is one of those professor that gives you a crap ton of work, and on top of that, it has absolutely nothing to do with the quizzes. Avoid if you can
Dr. Cothran is an amazing lady, but the class did struggle to match with the quizzes we took. The final project saved my grade a lot.

Dr. Cothran was a good professor but her lectures were completely useless. Aside from the quizzes and discussions, you are pretty much screwed for your grade. The bi-weekly quizzes are so hard and nothing she covers are in them.
Nothing that she taught in class was needed to do homework or quizzes. And because of this, going to class was just a big waste of time.

Donetta is a great person. On several occasions I was able to talk to her about issues I was having in and outside of class. She is not a great professor however. Lecture notes don't line up with the quizzes at all making them very difficult. Discussions are hard to receive full marks on. Also didn't round my 83.94 (B-) to 84 (B).
She is such a nice lady and was always so exicted to teach during lectures. The class is easy if you do the work on time.
She is very bad. Lectures and lecture notes are useless. The quizzes are so hard since they don't line up with the lectures at all. Do not take this class unless you have to.

She is SO bad. Lectures and lecture notes are useless. The quizzes are so hard since they don't line up with the lectures. You basically do this class on your own with nothing to refer back to. Never take this class unless you absolutely have to.

Donetta is a great person, but not a great professor. The canvas modules are very confusing and her lectures do not match up to her quizzes much at all. She uses unnecessarily long discussions as a good portion of overall grade. I would not recommend taking this class.
Unreal boring class and so much work that wasn't meaningful at all. Don't take this class unless you have to.

Solid class. Mine was asynchronous online. If you did the readings and watched her lecture videos (I typed notes) you will do fine on the quizzes but they can be a bit difficult. Weekly discussions were never hard and had 3 community research projects that were just time consuming. Do the work and you'll turn out fine. Caring professor!

The weekly quizzes can be taxing. They are early in the week too, so spending 5 hours reading on a Wednesday will get old quickly. Is very accessible, but the quizzes are what makes this class unbearable sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The material learned is interesting, but lectures and readings did not always match up with quizzes. Discussion boards were not fun, but manageable. I enjoyed the class, but not the teaching style.

Soooo much busy work. Gives you a week to read like 5 articles and watch another 5 lectures take a quiz that has nothing to do with the articles or lectures (quizzes are due Wednesday so not even an entire week) do a solo discussion each week (due Thursday) and have useless projects that have nothing to do with kinesiology. Terrible professor.
Intentionally hard quizzes worth only 20% of final grade with unclear questions, impossible to get a hold of for office hours and defers most of the grading to the TA's who are also students.....
Professor Cothran made the class very interesting and left me wanting to learn more. I would recommend her and this class.

Dr. Cothran was a good professor, she's nice and cares about her students. Lectures tended to be boring and didn't really correlate with what was on the exams. The exams were challenging, as it was hard to pass no matter how much you study. All other assignments were very easy. This is a pretty easy class, expect an A/A-. I recommend her.

She's a nice person, but her lectures could get super boring. Almost everything on the powerpoints had nothing to do with what was on the exams, they were just examples/stories. The online work was doable but it was a lot. The exams weren't super difficult but you have to study hard to get a decent grade.
Very boring lectures, very tough grader. Dont expect to get As on both exams because no matter how much you study there will always be material you dont know.

She really cares about her students and you can tell she wants you to do good. Only 2 tests and the rest is attendance group questions which are always so easy and not for accuracy or anything & then a couple easy quizzes that she gives you answers directly in the module. She cares about your mental health too and understands if you need to miss.

Very confusing. Nice lady, but is so focused on the wrong things. Literally have to search for assignments & due dates, and she randomly announced in class WEEK 5 that her first slides were the test questions. She was so unclear on what was due and what to study, and when students asked what to study, she gave us "hints" which made me so frustrated

Donetta seemed to be a fun and energetic professor while also trying to help make the class easy enough to get an A. The exams were fairly challenging, but the quizzes, homework, and projects were extremely easy (every answer to every quiz was choice A) so it makes up for it. This is a simple class and she makes it easier than it needs to be.

Tests are way too hard. Is not open to help students and shows no respect when students ask for help and show initiative to do well in the class. Shows no sympathy towards students, has no feelings, is not human.

She is a good professor, but she is very unclear about what she expects you to know on the exams (there's only 2). Attendance is mandatory. Online quizzes and discussions. Study your butt off if you expect to get better than a C in the class

Donetta (God forbid you call her that) was a very interesting teacher. She seems quite out of touch with her teaching this year and was not clear nor willing to sincerely help a lot of the students in my class. Make a good first impression because if you don't she will judge you for the rest of the year very negatively.
very chill and nice

For W241. Corny and a lot of sarcasm. Tries too hard to be relatable so it can come off as annoying. Class isn't that bad but he makes it so much harder than it needs it be. Lectures are almost pointless if you do the reading. Also a grad student so he talks a lot about his dissertation which is annoying too. Nice guy but lacks good teaching.
Truly an awesome guy, the class is a great experience. The type of class you look forward to in your day.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's an easy grading grad student lab instructor. The real tea is who he is as a person. He's sarcastic as all get-out but in a good way. And he truly cares about his students. I had a breakdown after class one day over a nonrelated topic, and he stayed long after class to talk and make sure I was okay. He's amazing as both a person and teacher.

Why is 95% of the grade in this class from exams? Doesn't make sense at all and participation isn't credited so really no incentive to show up. If you want to actually learn about psych don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Crystal's lectures were hard to follow because he mainly just reads off the slides. The tests are based off of the textbook though. You honestly don't need to attend class to get a good grade, just read the book and look over the slides he posts. The final exam was questions from the first four exams. He curves all the tests too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are boring, but he does discuss things that are on the exams, so its worth while to go. He is very nice and answers any questions related to the exams. His exams are not hard, if you read the textbook and go to lectures you will do fine. He posts all the lecture slides in advance and everything is clearly labled and explained.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a sweet man that is enthusiastic about what he teaches! He brings in demonstrations that made me laugh. The lectures were posted online, and the only grades were based on exams. However, there was a curve at the end of the semester that brought my grade up a letter. Attendance is not mandatory, and the class really is not hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are so boring and he just reads from the slides. He over-explains the simplest things such as how to bubble in a scantron. Attendance is not mandatory, but content from lecture discussions is on exams. I never went to class, but did not know some questions on exams.
Boring and dry lectures, but he posts everything and none of the material is difficult. I never went to class except on exam days and got a 104%.

I didn't like how your grade was only the exams. I felt like some of the questions on them were slightly unclear, however he does allow you to ask him questions on the exam and will clear up the information. The entire class is lectures, and they are posted online. He gives good analogies for the information and is easy to talk to after class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class was a fairly easy A for me but there are very few assignments. He gives example essays for every essay, so as long as you read and mimic those it's easy to get a good grade. The class is boring, and he grades for participation. I almost fell asleep every day, and before class you're supposed to read these dense and boring research papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super easy course. Attendance is not taken - he records lectures and uploads the notes. I skipped most days and did great in the class. There is no homework but we had to participate in a few on-campus studies. He drops an exam grade and the final was recycled questions!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Out of four exams he drops your lowest one. The tests aren't too hard as long as you study. I didn't go to lectures all the time, but he posts his lecture and slides on canvas. He also gives an amazing curve right before the final. We had another exam for the final but it was very easy. I got a B- last year in high school psych but A- in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Your grade is based off of 4 exams, you take 5 (including the final) and the lowest grade you get is dropped, which is extremely helpful. His tests are from the book and the final was just questions from old tests. I didnt go to class at all and ended with 105%, so i recommend his course. Hes a good guy.

this class is very independent, he just reads off of the slides. dont bother going to the review sessions (he doesnt go over any content)! i liked that attendance isnt necessary because he posts the lectures on canvas :) i thought this class was an easy A - just watch the lectures and take notes
Do not take this class find anything else or a different professor Caz its just 4 tests and no assignments or studyguide this was my worst grade

Prof. Crystal is so so smart and really cares about the material he is covering. To do well, you have to show up to class and read the textbook, but I feel like that isn't too much to ask for. He gives breakdowns of what every exam will cover, and is very reasonable as a teacher. I have done very well in his class, and would take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In order to do well in this class, all you have to do is read the textbook and study the material. He basically goes over the exact words of the textbook in class, but not all of the textbook so reading is crucial. His tests are basically vocab exams and are not hard however they make up your entire grade. Not an easy A, must put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Although Crystal is very nice and understanding, all he does are exams. He reads off slides and theres no point in going to his classes. His tests are often worded very poorly. The only good thing is that he will respond fast to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do not take psych with this professor! If you are looking for a easy class to get your requirements out of the way he is not the one to do it with. Just reads off the slides and gives no help on review day for the exams, expects you to know everything from two chapters with each exam. Reading barely helps because each chapter is more than 25 pages.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Doesn't curve, give extra credit and no open notes.

thought for being a 100-level course that this would be just a little more challenging than highschool psych,I was SO wrong. This was the hardest class I took all semester. He reads right off of his slides in lecture and "review sessions" are nothing but him telling you how many questions are on the test. TESTS ARE HARD AS HECK, too hard for a 100

Good professor who is very informative about cognitive psychology. He gives three papers, which he is generally fair with grading, and a final exam in an essay format that is rather straightforward. He enjoys discussions and hearing critiques from students.

She is very kind but her teaching style and personality I feel is better suited for high school or even middle school. Class is easy but you must be in attendance or you lose -30 points. She also had us put our phones in a "cubby" at the front of class or you would get points off. It is pass/fail.

Professor Emily was very kind and welcoming. She made the class decent for what it is. I think improvements can be made on the course not Emily herself because she did everything she could to make us not hate it. I don't think this course should be mandatory.

She was fine. I personally didn't like her because I felt like some of the stuff she had us do was unnecessary, but it was probably because of how the class is structured. Most of this class is a waste, especially if you know what you want to do with your major/career. Also, turnaround for major assignments is fast at the end of the semester.

She is a very nice professor; however, this class felt very childish. Most things were common sense and it was a waste of time 99% of the time. I felt like I was back in high school for the majority of this class. Its very easy to pass, so at least you'll have an easy A.

Emily cress was such a great teacher, she always had a fun warm up to the class, so it never felt awkward working with people you just met. Her class leads you in the direction you want for your career and helps you build up the skills to do so. I definitely recommend her class if you are struggling to find a direction or major to your career.
Very good teach, very easy class! It's a pass/fail class and everything is self explanatory.
Love her. Easy class and she actually cares!

I loved Emily! You do quite a few 5-10 minute assignments in a workbook that reflect on your career goals, well-being, and ambitions. As long as you try, she will give you all the points. Emily is very caring and understanding. She brings in snacks and lets the whole class have a rant session if needed. No stress at all!!! Highly suggest! No tests!
Professor Jesse Crombie is a good lecturer and gives a lot of good advice. This was an intensive writing class and it was fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Easy A but... Jesse is a student working on his PHD, and he will not stop talking about it. He grades projects MUCH too seriously, and though youll get an A, he'll be condescending the whole way through. Nice enough guy, but his class is worthless and he takes it way too seriously. The group project is also a slog, much like his lectures.

You HAVE to put in participation effort in class. In class activities pretty much every time centered around a big group project that should be easy as long as your partners are cool. Show him you are interested and trying (or lie about it, he doesnt care) and he will pass you. Also not too painful to talk to him about non class stuff as well.

Loved this class and professor. Lectures are engaging. DO the study guides, they are helpful and you will always do well on the quizzes and exams. The homework is like a game, it doesn't feel like a heavy task compared to other classes. Class covers interesting topics and the course layout is straightforward from day one.

She's amazing and will recommend going to office hours with a TA and they will explain how she formulates questions in quizzes which can be confusing at first. Do the study guide and print the lecture slides before quizzes because everything in the quiz is on her lecture slides. Loved the content of this class super interesting and interactive.

Attendance is mandatory (Tophat). Lectures are just her basically reading from the slides but I still learned a lot. Labs are super interesting but boring in the beginning. I learned a lot from this class and enjoyed her energy.

A very enjoyable class for me! She makes a wide range of topics very digestible through lectures, textbook readings, and supplemental readings. The textbook does cover things that the lectures do not so it's important to read it. Basically everything is open note so take good notes, read, and pay attention!

This class isn't bad. The lectures are pretty interesting and clear. If you pay attention and take notes, the quizzes are pretty easy. Labs are also interesting and are directly related to the lectures so it benefits you to go. The inquizitives are super annoying but can be completed without actually reading the textbook.

I absolutely loved this class. Professor Cullin was amazing and she really cares about what she is teaching. The homework was all online and it was sort of like a game so it was not bad. There are no tests there's just in class, online quizzes. There is 7 of them with the 7th being the final and the are all open note. Labs are fun and not hard.

She's a good person with interesting lectures. Homework and most material is completion. 5 quizzes for 45% of grade. You can know the content and struggle with the quizzes (not knowing what you got wrong) she won't open up the quizzes for you to actually learn.

Most of the class is straightforward and her lectures are not bad. The only problem I have are the questions on her quizzes seem to be purposely confusing for no real reason. There are 4-5 quizzes, all open note, for 45% of the final grade. She never opens the quizzes for you to go back and see what you got wrong, which I hated. Do the work = A

dr. cullin is a really good lecturer. in this class i found some of the topics really interesting and others boring, but u can tell she knows her stuff and is as engaging as possible. slides are available before class to download and follow along. quizzes aren't too bad and theres always a study guide beforehand. overall a good class :)

The Professor is very passionate in what she teaches, so the lectures are not too bad. The class is very quiz heavy counting for 45% of your grade. They are open note and she provides a very helpful study guide before every quiz. One weekly homework assignment that takes no more than 30 minutes-1 hour. The class is interesting but boring at times.

Super clear lecturer, although they are lengthy. She outlines everything you need to know from day 1 & sticks to it. No surprises in her class except for the occasional extra credit opportunity! Buckle up on your discussion group attendance and participation & your in-class quizzes, as these make up a HUGE chunk of your grade.
Terrible professor and probably a bad person in general. Legitimately doesn't care about anything besides wasting your time.

TERRIBLE! Please do not take him. ICORE professors are supposed to be respected and this guy is a joke. Does not care about feedback from students, and he is super rude. Whatever you do, try and not take him. Can't believe that this guy is teaching ICORE classes.

Rex is the goat fr. Don't get me wrong - the class is very very hard and makes you want to cry while preparing for the exams, but this professor is by far the best. He manages to take hard material and add a flare of comedy to his coursework to make it all a lil more bearable. Oh yeah tests are curved a ton, final was a wreck.
The goat, if you take Icore and don't take Rex you're playing yourself. Worth tuition to listen to this guys jokes and great teaching style.

He managed to spend the first 10 minutes of every class rambling and making bad jokes. He also goes on random tangents throughout the class. I think it would be more beneficial to skip the class, read the chapter, and go through his notes by yourself. It was a waste of time every morning twice a week. He wears so much plaid.

Easily the most engaging i-Core lecture to sit through. He does a great job keeping lectures light and funny. That being said, you don't really have to go to lectures, all of the work and slides are posted online, and I did most of the studying for Ops on my own.
Rex is the man. Very personable and creates a great relationship with his students. Make sure to come with Ops jokes to class.

Terrible professor.That isn't to say he isn't a good person,he is funny, and likeable.But he couldn't explain drying to paint.All he does is talk about how much he is getting paid. If i wanted someone to read off the slides,I'd go sit in with an elementary school teacher.came to college to be taught not to be TOLD. HE CANNOT TEACH ONLY REGURGITATE.
Very funny guy but his class is incredibly difficult. Introduces the concepts in class but you will have to do a majority of the learning on your own.
The best professor overall! He makes the class fun and explains the logic very clearly!

Coming to Cutshall's class was like attending a free stand-up comedy show where I was learning at the same time. I looked forward to his class every day. He truly does a great job at making ops engaging, and I almost considered switching my major because of him. The midterm was pretty easy but the second half of the class is extremely difficult.
Rex is awesome

Professor Cutshall is the GOAT. If anyone had a problem with his lectures, they're weak-minded, soft, and sensitive. He makes lectures extremely enjoyable and funny and I probably laughed every single lecture at least once. The coursework isn't hard either. Take any class that has to do with Professor Cutshall.

He's really funny, and his ability to make operations a lecture that people don't hate is a skill that should be applauded. The class is difficult no matter what, but he does an alright job teaching it I suppose. I'd recommend buying the course packet to have for notes, but other than that there's not much else to say, ops is hard
You will have an opinion on Rex. I thought he was funny af and made boring concepts less terrible. 2nd half of class was tough.

Professor Rex is the king of Dad jokes, be ready to laugh. He uses personal stories that apply topics from class to the real world. This made the material memorable and prepared me for exams. He also provides amazing material to help prepare his students for exams.

The course: extremely well designed for (1) content and level, (2) delivery pace. Very efficiently taught. Professor Cutshall weaves appropriate amount of theory, facts, experience, and fun to keep the lecture light and balanced, while useful at the same time. The course teaches a lot of high level skills. Home works and lectures ensure learning.

The course material is tough, but the professor is fair in his grading and gives a lot of good feedback when you're struggling on questions or concepts. His homework assignments are a bit vague, which had me pulling my hair at a few points, but they're not impossible to do as long as you pay attention in class and read the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A really terrible professor in my opinion. His explanations of concepts are super vague and his exams are really difficult. He always seemed like he was just "phoning it in" to our class too. Our lecture took place online and the guy never even bothered to turn on his camera.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Probably one of the worst professors I've had at Kelley, which is sad because almost every other Kelley professor I've encountered has been amazing. This man cannot clearly explain concepts. He just reads straight off the slides and expects you to somehow understand the material. Overall it just seems like he doesn't really care about his students.

Rex simplifies a tough subject. His lectures are entertaining and he explains the material very well without overloading on work. The tests are killer but if you go to class and do the practice problems and homework you can easily pass. He's the better choice between the two Ops professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Funny guy, tough class. Just showing up to lectures is not enough to understand the material, you will have to study it outside class in order to do well on his exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Rex wasn't great but I will give him that he's very clear about how to pass.   Every class ran about twice as long as needed so I wanted to bang my head against the desk a lot.  A fine teacher  but don't expect to be on the edge of your seat.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Explains the material very well and is very knowledgeable of Operations. Make sure to keep up-to-date with the exercises and homework, or else you will struggle for the exams. I did bad on the midterm, but I feel my grade does not represent my knowledge of the topic as I've felt I've learned a lot through this class.

Cutshall isn't bad. He's relatively a funny professor and attempts to engage his students. Unlike a lot of ICore his class is definitely a relevant topic to learn about. His lectures are kinda confusing and you can tell he struggles to explain a few concepts, other than that he was a nice teacher.

This is not an entry level class.  You MUST have statistical background to do well or be prepared to play catch up. The book is horrible and the lectures are even more cryptic.  The homework is time intensive and sometimes just plain elusive even when consulting the lectures or textbook.  Not a recommended professor group.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Rex did a great job team teaching this course with Kari Johnson and Doug Blocher.  I would highly recommend.
Do ALL the readings. He does not cover everything in class

In my opinion, ops is the hardest section of icore. He doesn't give up a lot of hw, but the exams are brutal. He's a good teacher, but the exams don't reflect what you learn in class. He's really funny and likes to make fun of Spea, which is always funny to listen to.

Rex was a good professor.  He was responsive to questions through email and in class. He was helpful when anyone had questions or didn't understand.  The lectures were very helpful and were necessary for anyone to do a good job on the homework.
funny, tough, and wears a lot of plaid

I wasn't a big fan of Ops until I took his class. He's a great teacher and he's really funny in a not funny way. Read his supplemental lecture notes multiple times to do well on his tests. The tests are tricky, but they're doable.

I had zero interest in ops before this class. Now I am double majoring in it. Rex is hilarious in his own weird way. He also knows the material extremely well. He talks very fast so it is important to really get a grasp on the material before he moves on to the next subject or you will fall behind. Tests are pretty hard. Know the concepts well.

I supposed you could say he makes the boring topic of Ops a bit more interesting. He enjoys talking a lot of trash, and he wants to see you fail his exams. He talks about it explicitly. He throws questions in about minutiae to get you to screw up, which really bugs me. You might understand that content 100%, but don't expect to score that on exams

He was one of those teachers who purposely tries to get kids to screw up on his exams. I am in school to learn not to split hairs on an exam over some insignificant part of the course. Sometimes interesting but overall not a great teacher

Lovable goof.  Passionate about what he teaches and makes a class that could be boring survivable.  Understands and teaches the material at a deep level. He should give up teaching operations management and do stand up. His efforts are credible though the jokes aren't. Good prof

Exams are fair, he's very approachable, and he finished class early a bunch of times. Overall a great teacher.
ICORE-ASAURUS Rex! Easily the best ICORE professor, funny jokes, easy material, fair exams, and straight-forward lectures. TAKE HIM if you can!

ICORE- It's not as bad as everyone makes it out to be... Rex brags about his tests being hard b/c he took a test a making class and has PHD in education, but they're not that bad
Rex is the man.. he says stupid jokes, but can be funny.. class usually ends early and he was the MOST reasonable on the first exam.

Smart, Quick, Witty, Funny at Times, Challenging. This was a good class with really boring material. Talk to Rex outside of class, he wants to talk with students.

he's a great professor, gotta some good jokes, just some, but he tries very hard. go to the 1:00pm section, it's always shorter than the earlier ones, cuz he cuts down his bad jokes. Great guy!
Sexy Sexy Man

Really funny guy; has a dry/dark humor.  Knows his stuff.  As a friend put it, he is "an evil little man."  That's good, though!

If you still plan on taking psych select a we based class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

No help or any assistance coming from the professor himself. Everything is graded by the TAs who are extremely harsh and unprofessional. Be prepared to read 300 pages and write 1000+ words each week.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Cullather is the most dull & monotone professor Ive yet to have. I literally fell asleep once in his history lecture because it was like he was giving a speech, not lecturing students. I feel like he had unrealistic expectations of students for a freshman level class. This 100 level class was my hardest one of the year, which is saying something.
Boring boring boring boring boring. Only attended the first few weeks of his lectures because the course grades come exclusively from things done in section discussions.

Professor Cullather is one of the worst professors I have had while at IU. And this class (the Kennedys) is awful. I am a senior history major and I got a B+, and I actually really liked the Kennedys before this class. Cullather made the course dull and boring. For a freshman level class this course was ridiculous. Steer clear of Cullather!!

It is not so much the professor, but the class that is awful. I mean Prof. Cullather is pretty terrible and I am not saying that because I failed. I got an A in his Kennedys class, but he is an awful professor that has no idea how to lecture. The tests are ridiculous worth 25% each and two papers worth 25% as well. Avoid this class and professor!

Dr. Cullather is a very good teacher, but don't expect this class to be a breeze.  All of his grades are the essay tests and a couple papers as well.  I enjoyed his lectures and the class material, but don't expect to get by easily in this class.

Professor Cullather was an amazing teacher. I took his class on the Kennedy family and even though it was the first year of the class it seemed like he had been teaching it for 20 years. He is extremely knowledgeable and makes the material very interesting but be prepared to put in the work for the papers because they require a lot of research.

Cullather is really great! He knows so much and has such interesting stories about his topics. I took him for his Kennedy's class and am taking his American Military History class. Just make sure to take good notes!

Prof. Cullather is very brilliant. He is very knowledgeable on a variety of topics, and certainly desires to share this knowledge with his students. He is very helpful and has taught me a lot about researching history through personal interaction in the classroom or office hours. Taking his classes is a challenge - so expect to work...a lot.
Awesome Class.  Professor Cullather is super understanding when it comes to papers.  3 short papers, and 2 tests, really easy and fun.

Be prepared to work hard for an A in this class. Tests are essay tests and require the ability to critically analyze information heard only once in lecture. No study guides are provided, and good lecture notes and attendance are a most. This class is difficult for a 100 level class.
Excellent Professor who is very intelligent.  Sitting in one of his lectures is like an hour of story time.  They're very interesting.  Minimal assignments and tests.
EXTREMELY difficult class! He is an expert but does not simplify it enough for a 100 level class. Everything is fair game on exams, no study guide!

Expert in his field--he really knows his stuff. Class will be very interesting for those who bother to attend. grading is extremely difficult, however, he relies on his ta's for much of the grading, which leads to subjective standards.
He sucks...he uses his TIs to do all the work and he is never clear on what he wants...Very tough class if your not expecting alot of work.
Knows a lot, but your A.I will do all the grading.  Be lucky.

Vietnam War, though he is a good lecturer Cullather isn't very accessible. I doubt he knew one of his students names and he had about 5 TAs doing the grading. As well his essay questions are not the greatest in terms of clarity. For example we had to analyze an interview with Robert McNamara and it was one of my least favorite papers to write.

Very interesting lectures, however he's a bit too intelligent for a 100 level class, so unless you really want to work hard, I wouldn't take his class. He also doesn't use the textbook for this course, but 4 boring novels.

No Comments
Excellent teacher.  Some think he grades hard, but I disagree.  Simply keeping up with the work will give you an excellent grade.

Outstanding Professor.  Challenges students to write on higher levels.  Keeps his lectures very interesting through the use of random things in class.  I would definitly look forward to taking one his classes in the future.
A very hard professor but he is worth taking. You will learn a lot, if you are willing to work. I highly recommend him

History of the Vietnam War. Lectures were very clear and essay assignments brought insight. Fascinating subject matter and explained well. However, TA's did all the grading and the prof himself was not very accessible.
Wow....bring a tape recorder or you'll miss stuff....He's Uber Smart

Dr. Cullather is one of the strongest professors at IU. Be warned, however, you should not take one of his courses unless you are prepared to work very hard. But if you are willing to do the work, you will learn a great deal from a very wise and witty guy
insanely smart, very interesting, very difficult
No Comments

GREAT UNDERSTANDING OF HISTORY; BUT CLASS IS ILL-ARRANGED AND TIMES BORING

This professor is Chinese (from Jiangsu Province). Because of Jiangsu dialect is blurry, he had strong accent when speaking English. But he is patient and knowledgeable. reviews.comment: I took a class of his for my minor and enjoyed his class so much I took another class of his the next semester for fun. I'd gladly recommend him to anyone!

I had this course at IUSB (South Bend). He is very passionate about his course and genuinely seems to care for his students. There is a lot of reading- a ton of reading.
