reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Listens to every question and gives great feedback. Enthusiastic about the subject and easy to follow. I'd definitely take this course again.

Lays out all criteria for exams and how to approach subjects well in advance. Takes time to make sure all questions are answered and gives great feedback. Clearly details structure of grading scale. A lot of reading but can cover the subject entirely in lectures. Participation and attendance are keys to this class.

I had her for ENG-R 398. Great professor, really clear on what you need to do to get a good grade. A lot of writing but it is managable if you plan ahead. Really interesting course topic too. Would recommend!
Cynthia is the best. she is so funny, brings interesting material to the course, and most of all is passionate about what she teaches. I'd recommend her for any course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The only decent thing about this course is this professor. Assignments and formats are sometimes vague and confusing, but Dr. Smith's upbeat energy somehow made the class bearable. If class is mandatory, take it with her. She may be strict with grades and assignments, but will help you do better because she actually cares about student success.

I would recommend to not take COLL-P 155 with her because she was a very tough grader when it came to speeches. HOWEVER, she was a great professor and obviously cared about all her students. I think in different settings I would have enjoyed taking her class more.

Cindy is one of the most supportive & understanding professors I have had the pleasure of having at IU. She genuinely cares about each student's learning and well-being. She implemented a grading system during COVID that motivated me to do my best work and actually engage with the material. I took 2 classes w/ her, if you like rhetoric take her!
This class was awful. That isn't her fault since she isn't the main professor. What is her fault is how she teaches it, and her lack of care for her students and their grades.

Very helpful.

Cindy is fantastic. She is very passionate about the subject matter (architectural rhetoric and public memory) and is very helpful to students.  I have taken two classes with her... bother were great (B/B+).  You will learn so much from her.
Cindy is so quirky and hilarious! She's also super passionate about the course subject and makes class discussion interactive and exciting.

Cindy is awesome!! I would recommend her to anyone regardless of their major.  She creates a positive atmosphere and make the subject matter fun.  Reading response due everyday to spark discussion, but she drops the 4 or 5 lowest scores.  She is incredibly nice and helpful in and outside of class.
Great professor. I took this over the summer, so it was intense. But she could not have been more helpful or accommodating. She gives you the exact recipe to do well.
So nice and just a nice, approachable person! Take her class if you can.

I was dreading taking public speaking, but she made class extremely fun and comfortable. She's hilarious and she's very encouraging when you're giving your speeches. Super nice, fair grader. Made me not mind speaking in front of the class at all!
awesome teacher, try like hell to get into one of her classes

Oh my goodness.  She is the most hilarious professor I have ever met.  And incredibly nice.  Had an IW course with her, and she made the topic incredibly interesting.  Despite the work load, this is my favorite class because of the positive atmosphere she creates.

He's my grandpa.

I thought Jim was great. Lectures are easy to understand and range from 20-75 minutes. There are 40 potential extra credit points if you get additional hours from participating in experiments. this dude makes quizzes due at 11 am like, man, nobody else does that. unbelievable.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF. take psych through a different professor and you should get an A. Take Jim if you want to struggle to get a B-

Attendance not mandatory but if you miss you will struggle on tests. Lectures are boring but overall not a terrible class. Opportunity at end of semester for a decent amount of extra credit. No homework aside from reading quizzes. Lotssss of reading and lectures. Exams are hard and attendance is needed to pass them. Not particularly friendly or encouraging

Just warning you all, this professor is boring, inconsiderate, and condescending. He makes psychology class very boring and difficult to enjoy. He is bad at lecturing and doesn't care about his students whatsoever. 100% do not recommend!

This class is just fine to be honest, wasn't bad or wasn't great. There is a ton of quizzes and extra credit so you should be fine. He is extremely boring but I will say the exams and all aren't too hard and if you don't do too hot on them there are so many opportunities for more points.

Honestly the worst professor I have ever had. He is not nice at all and he expects us to know everything. His tests are very hard for a 100 level course. He wasn't understanding when people made mistakes.

Professor knows what he's talking about, but I never talked to him 1 on 1

Very informative during class. Loved this class. There were a lot of quizes on top of tests but that was only homework required. Gives extra credit for completing all of online quizes at end of semester. Definitely would take again.

If you read you will do more than fine in the class, his questions are not meant to trick you.

he is by far my fav iu professor, he is so kind and really wants you to succeed, i am in his class as we are doing distance learning and he makes himself and his content so available i feel like he is the only prof i have who actually cares. he also has really interesting stories/examples. take his class!!!!

Made lecture interesting, although you don't have to go regularly for a good grade in the class. Gives study guides and exam lecture notes which help a lot. The homework is super easy. He also gives a lot of extra credit towards the end and on every test.

Hardest 100 level class Ive ever taken. Worst professor Ive had. Lectures will physically & mentally exhaust you. 5 tests 80 questions each, & they arent easy. reviews.comment: I was not expecting this class to be as hard as it was. The tests require hours of preparation and are SO difficult. His lectures are extremely boring, and there are online quizzes that have to be completed before every lecture. IF you have to take this class DO NOT take it with this professor, there are so many better professors for this course.

The class is hard for a 100 level. Requires a lot of reading and many quizzes prior to lecture. However, Cuellar is hilarious and his lectures are extremely informative. Harder class than expected, but you learn a ton. Put in the work and you get the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: WORST PROFESSOR EVER!! I have never disliked a class and a person so much in my life. His tests are extremely difficult and take so much preparation. Even if you think you know the material he finds a way to make it soo confusing to the point that you second guess everything on the test. He is so much worse than all the other professors at IU.
Very difficult class would never take it again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are typically fairly dry. The structure of the lectures does not match up with the structure of the exams - important concepts have few questions, finer points have many. Exams are not well-written. However, Jim has experience in the field, is happy to answer questions, and is passionate about the field and teaching of psychology.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: do the practice tests they are usually very similar to the exam

Doesn't take attendance and his lectures are just repeating the textbook. If you get an A on the first test, there's no reason to attend lecture. If you read well and take good notes, then you should be fine. The lectures I did attend weren't awful. Has clinical experience and does a good job creating real-life examples of topics. I would reccomend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Cuellar was, overall, a pretty good instructor. I found him very funny and knowledgeable. The only thing I didn't really like about Intro to Psych was that we had to do a ton of outside reading and online quizzes. Other than that, it was a fun and fairly easy course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Nonmandatory attendance but lectures include info that is not in the book! I enjoyed his lectures & found the material interesting. I personally enjoyed Cuellar but some of my peers weren't huge fans. He gives a lot of good examples to relate the material back to yourself. DO THE PRACTICE TESTS, very similar questions & some the same as the test!

Professor Cuellar did a great job teaching the material. Theres a bunch of reading and online quizzes, but its an interesting class if you can keep up with it. Some of the tests can be difficult, so I advise that you attend lectures and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cuellar is a good guy, but a very boring class and lectures are exhausting. Illustrates good examples for material but is still hard to connect to the material and learn it. Quizzes online every week and tests are graded heavy, in a sense that if you fail a test you will fail the class. One of the harder P101 professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Expect 4-6 quizzes a week that are online. You have to take these quizzes before you even have a lecture on the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Class is one long, boring infodump after another. Most of your grade comes from quizzes on the online tool he uses, which he did not create and has little control over. Lecture occasionally contradicts reading and is notoriously dry and hard to follow. Does not go over tests, even if half the class got D's and F's - he sees that as your fault.

I hated every second of this class. It is ridiculously difficult for an Intro class. You are completely on your own, as his slides contain paragraphs instead of bullet points and his delivery is dry and dull.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The exams are very hard

Lectures were kinda boring, and he puts way too much info on one slide. However, he's a nice and funny guy, and he has clinical experience, which is cool. It's not super necessary to go to class, so if you're fine with reading, you probably don't have to.

Nicest guy. He's got gym teacher energy. Fun but respected. Questions from lecture show up on exams. But, all homework, readings, and quizzes are done through the online textbook. Don't bother buying a hard copy of it. I recommend him.

Best part of this class is textbook and lecture are identical. I loved this because it made it easy for any learning style to succeed. I only went to class on test days but I read a lot outside of class. For those who don't like to read, go to class and pay attention and you'll be fine. Lectures are kind of dry but great guy who tries to be funny!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hes very nice and good at explaining things. Plus he says a lot of dad jokes.
I skip every class but its still really challenging. I still study for the exams and do the homework
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took 101 last semester with a different prof & it was horrible! I decided to take psych 102 & he made me love learning psych again! He has a lot of personal stories & examples in the field & his lectures are very informative & fun to go to. He also gives bonus points on tests & quizzes if you complete all of them so do it! Awesome dude

If you attend lecture, and take all the notes he provides, you'll only pass with about a C. Also, make sure not to miss any of the online quizzes because even though there's a lot, they really matter. He's a good guy, and knows what he's talking about, but really boring & the exams are horribly worried and he's not that good of explaining concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very nice guy. If you go to him outside of class he is enthusiastic and willing to help.

Class was very on-your-own kind of deal. I went to class the first 3 weeks and never returned unless it was for a test because you don't learn anything in lecture anyways. Read and take notes and use the study guide he posts online and I can guarantee you'll pass with a C or higher.... Prof Cuellar does not teach his students, thats all on you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I hated this class. It was unreasonably hard for an intro to psych class. I had friends that took Psy101 with other professors and passed with doing no work. The tests are worded terribly and I hated the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cuellar is awesome! His class is usually huge but he does  great job of getting to know students if you make the effort. Attendance isn't required but it puts you at a better advantage for tests which are HUGE. Tests are all multiple choice and really easy if you study and do the work. He made psych so great that I'm adding a minor in it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cuellar is a nice guy, but his lectures are very lengthy and boring. My biggest complaint is probably how you have to go to office hours to see your test which is hard when the AI is never there, so I didn't know what I was doing wrong. Also the exams are way too hard for a 101 introductory class.

Cuellar is a nice guy but a very boring professor. His lectures put anyone who actually shows up to sleep. Never showed up to class, but as long as you do the reading and go over everything in the book for the exams, you'll do fine.

Tests every other week but they're simple if you do the homework and read the chapters. His lecture is B O R I N G and D R Y. Able to skip if you study outside of class and are willing to still do the work. Homework heavy but simple quizzes (busy work). Take him if you want a easy A or B.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Psychology is my favorite subject and I have almost nodded off in each of his lectures. He reads directly from the slides stating that this will be on the test then moves ahead far faster than any person could take notes. He plays a bunch of REALLY old videos (which in psychology can get outdated quickly) I wish I could switch to someone who cares.
Jim Cuellar is a very fair professor and his lectures are interesting. He doesn't take attendance, but he occasionally slips things into the lecture that aren't in the textbook.

Tells in class if you had to rank questions on difficulty 1-3, majority of his exam questions are 3's. Went into the final with an A, got an A- on the exam and got a B+ in the class. 1 question from an A and he wouldn't consider a bump-so don't bother asking. There are easier professors to be had. Other than that he's a  good professor

Best professor I've had. Engaging, caring, respected, and intelligent. Cuellar's lectures are very clear, and his exams are very simple conceptual based questions. There is extensive online quizzes, (find the answers online), but other than that he is one of the nicest people here on campus. It is very easy to excel.

Prof Cuellar is one of the most knowledgeable and intellectual teachers I've ever had. He answers every question presented to him and really knows his stuff. The online homework is not difficult and is very manageable. The lectures are long and have lots of information so you have to keep up. Would recommend to any student 100%
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great guy. Extra credit on tests and tests are curved. Interesting lecturer and keeps class engaged. Highly recommended.

Jim is literally the WORST professor I have ever had here at IU. He is very hands off with his class. He puts everything on his AI and if you have problems with homework he will tell you to contact IT support so he doesn't have to deal with it, even though what is wrong is on his part. He is a HORRIBLE professor. AVOID him if you can.

I personally enjoy psychology a lot and Professor Cuellar lectured with clear knowledge and enthusiasm for the subject. He puts up PowerPoint slides in lecture so it's easy to take notes but he does not read directly off them. Overall I really enjoyed having him as a professor.

Good instructor and a funny guy. The class is based entirely on lectures--engaging but not fantastic (drags a lot). However, if you do the reading, you'll easily pass. Attendance isn't mandatory, and he gives really clear grading criteria and study guides! I only went to class occasionally, did all the reading, and got an A+. Lots of easy points!
Long boring lectures. He releases some of the slides. Loads of online homework that doesn't take long to finish. Exams are pretty much from the slides/what you talk about in class.

Lectures are long and tend to drag on but attendance is not necessary. Gives a lot of easy points which also means a lot of busy work. He tries to make lectures as interesting as possible and he is a good instructor.
Lectures were very long, but not mandatory.  I did skip a few and had no trouble picking up the new information through reading.  Be sure to do all the online quizzes.

By far my favorite psych class I have taken. Jim makes the lectures interesting enough and releases many of his slides if you didn't get a chance to write all the notes down. There are 5 tests and an optional final. He gives a very clear and specific study guide and all the homework is online. Never got below a 95% on any tests, very easy!

Lectures are long and he goes too fast for proper note taking, Going to class is not mandetory and honestly not that helpful. Test are 80 questions in a 75 minute class. Hardest psych class I have taken. Would not recommend him.

Just another easy psychology class that you don't need to attend to pass. I started going in the beginning but ended up never going except for exam days. There's 5 exams and the final is option (replaces a bad grade if necessary). His lectures are dry and long. Homework is online but remembering to do it is hard. Take for easy A.
If you go to him with a question, he usually just sends you to his TA.

Professor Cuellar is by far my favorite professor thus far at IU. The lectures are long simply because it's a long class, but he makes every lecture interesting. He also makes all material very easy to understand. Going to class isn't mandatory, but very helpful.

Prof Cuellar is a nice guy, but lectures were long and dry. I only attended class because sometimes there was material he would discuss that was not included in the book. Otherwise, he lectures straight from the book. I was about average in the class but my grade could have been higher if I read more. Expect online quizzesactivities each week.

Lectures are long with a lot of videos, he basically takes everything word for word out of the textbook. But he makes everything very easy to understand. His test study guides are always very clear, so that's a plus. Tests are normally pretty easy, my friends and I all got an A with minimal effort.

Very good Professor. Easy class. You don't need to go to lectures as they do get long and dry but I always went anyway. Do the online work, study, and read and you will be fine. Tests are straightforward and fair. Take this class.

He is a very well-spoken teacher, but lectures do get boring. You really need to know the concepts because a lot of the tests just give random situations, and you have to use context clues to figure out which answer best describes the situation. This is a class you dont need to attend to do well in, but you really need to know the material well.

His lectures can be dry and long. He runs through the slides faster than you can writetype. The book is pretty dull as well. Most other students liked the class but it didn't fit my learning style, I guess.

Prof Cuellar is awesome. His online sources are organized and very helpful for tests and his expectations are clear. Lectures are engaging and enjoyable for all. Class attendance isn't a direct part of your grade so if you miss a class no big deal but make sure to check the released powerpoint. The final (for my class) could replace another exam

Cuellar is a really awesome professor! He makes what's expected of you clear, and makes really helpful study guides. Basically just show up and take notes and do the launchpad assignments. Not super difficult and you can tell he is really knowledgeable in psychology. I'm taking him for psy102 next semester!

Professor Cuellar is a great professor. He gives five unit exams plus an optional cumulative final exam. He not only keeps lectures interesting and clear, but he gives really good advice to people who are pursuing a degree in psych (if they take the time to ask). He really cares about his students! I am taking him again next semester.

Cuellar is a wonderful professor. He makes the lectures interesting, even though most psych 101 lectures are quite large. He uses an online program called LaunchPad, which is where all assignments are located except for exams. He provides study guides for the exams, and overall the class is enjoyable and easy. I recommend taking his class.

Prof Cuellar is awesome, and the class is pretty easy. His lectures are straight out of the book, so either go to class or read the book (you likely won't need to do both). I chose to go to class because he usually made the lectures interesting and I got more out of it. Homework was easy online quizzes, and there was extra credit. Would recommend.

EASY PROFESSOR. I stopped going to class after the first test and received an A+ in the class. All you have to do is read the required reading in the textbook and take the quizzes online. Attendance is not mandatory, very very easy course.

AWESOME PROFESSOR! Definitely recommend taking psych with him. The lectures are literally straight from the book but he makes them so interesting. He is really funny and makes class worth going to. If you read and study the exams aren't too bad!

AWESOME TEACHER! Lectures come straight out of the book but he makes them very interesting. If you read the chapter and come to class you will do great. His exams aren't hard either. He's really funny and great about answering questions in class. Would recommend!

Great professor! His exams are extremely easy if you read the book and so psych portal assignments. He explains everything during lectures and knows his material WELL. Keeps lectures interesting and funny! Answers questions and is a very friendly about it. Would definitely recommend him as a psychology professor.

Professor Cuellar is one of the best I've ever had. He makes his lectures really interesting, and is always willing to explain things more if anyone has a question, which impressed me for it being a 420 person class. Tests were super easy, but I took AP Psych so the entire class was basically a review. Would definitely take another class with him!
Professor Cuellar is excellent at teaching! He is interesting and his class is very easy! I would definitely take more classes with him.

I really liked Professor Cuellar. His class could be boring at times, but he was always willing to explain things more if someone in the class asked. He would always try to crack jokes, and we watched a lot of videos. The tests were pretty easy as long as you went to class and looked over the notes. Overall, I would definitely recommend his class!
Pretty good professor. He's extremely nice and tries to get the class involved. He can be boring at times, but overall he's good. I'd recommend him.

Cuellar is a great guy. His lectures follow the book exactly, so if you read the chapters & take good, detailed notes before class, the lecture basically re teaches you everything you already read. Tests are easy if you study the book & use psych portal!

Great Professor! You don't need to show up to class (even though I still did because he doesn't post the notes online). Very easy class if you put in the time to read the book and study! Offers lots of extra credit. Highly recommended.

He is a great professor! He really knows his stuff and makes lectures interesting most of the time. Even though it wasn't mandatory i still went to class because he doesn't post the notes which is the entire exams.I would make sure to write down examples he gives because they are usually on the exam as well!it can be an easy A if you try a little!

Nice guy but don't even worry about attending class. I taught myself the information better to know it for the test in the 1 1/2 I would've been sitting in class but instead reading the book in the library. Don't slack off either. More difficult than you think!

Easiest class I've ever taken. Don't go to class, just read the assigned chapters, review the released power point slides, and study a little with Psych Portal learning curve under an hour and you'll get an A.

Whatever you do: do not waste your time going to class! All you need to do is read the chapter once or twice before the tests and you'll get 100%! His tests are the most straight forward I have ever experienced and he even offers 25+ points of extra credit thoughout the semester.  Easiest class ever!  Just don't forget about the hw and experiments!

If you are looking for an easy elective, take P102 with Cuellar. So easy, if you have any previous background in Psych you'll be fine, if not, everything is straight from the book. There isn't much homework and the tests are easy. He lets you drop your lowest test. Take his class
Had him for P101 and P102. Easiest classes I've taken at IU. Tests are incredibly straightforward. Studied at most for 2 hours per test and got 94-100% on every single test of his.

Professor Cuellar is an amazing professor.He is funny,very knowledgeable, down to earth,and makes everything very easy to understand.His lectures are always interesting and very organized.I think the lectures are important to attend because he gives additional information.All around,I highly recommend taking his class.It's very enjoyable!

He is adorable. Also he explains things very well and he's a nice and understanding person. The tests are pretty hard, but you dont have to go to class. He gives out a study guide and as long as you do it and read the book you'll get an A
He's a good teacher but the homework assignments were pretty pointless and the tests are challenging.  You have to study ALOT to get a good grade.

The tests are pretty decent. He gives small homework assignments that are so easy and they help boost your grade. It is good to go to class, but you don't have to unless you need to turn in a homework assignment. No papers or quizzes or anything. Pretty straightforward class.

Professor Cuellar is really cool. The class that I took was extremely large so that's one downside because you don't really get any one-on-one time. But he really does make the class interesting and there's super simple homework, literally copying word for word. It's a great class to take to get to know if you're interested in psychology.
Some of these ratings are unfair. She very much cares about you and the reading. Give her your attention and you will have an amazing time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Very interesting content but not taught in an easy way. She does not respect her students and enjoys seeing them struggle. Obviously passionate about the content but does not understand we all may not feel the same way. Do your best? Not enough. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Terribly structured class, reading would be assigned and then we'd quiz over it and then lecture over the reading and material. Very frustrating when sometimes you don't really understand the reading and start to understand after the lecture, but its pointless because you already quizzed over it.... Literally no point of even going to class.

If youre taking this class as a Gen Ed... take another professor. Seriously. Grades are heavily based on quizzes which are over a 20-30 page chapter and are 10 questions in 10 minutes. Not only that but they are unnecessarily hard. This class is not up for a student to succeed so do yourself a favor and dont take her class

Professor Bannon is by far one of my least favorite professors throughout college so far. Her quizzes are made so that you can only take one question at a time and cannot go back. This is so incredibly not beneficial. She also is a very biased grader and only gives you a good grade if you have the same opinion as her. Do Not Take This Class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She does not listen to the feedback from most of the students. She also is not prepared for the transition into E-Learning, which is only exacerbated by her unwillingness to help the students succeed in the class. Some examples: quizzes have unclear questions and not enough time and zoom lectures are monotone and uninspiring.

Grading criteria is difficult but not unreasonable. She makes a good effort to grade blind, which is much appreciated. You really need to put some hours into this course to get a good grade, but you also really learn a lot in the process.

Professor Bannon is knowledgeable in her field of study. However, as a professor, she is very poor. I do not think professors should take pride in humiliating their students in front of others or making them feel bad. She treats you with a condescending tone if you do not know something which is ridiculous since the class is a introductory elective

Dr. Bannon is a good professor, however her classes are extremely challenging so I wouldn't recommend her if you're looking for an easy A. However, I did learn a lot by having her as a professor. Reading is mandatory and she has tough Top Hat questions that you won' t pass if you didn't read
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Bannon truly cares about her students' success. She was always willing to meet with me to help me with anything and everything. The material is interesting and she's EXTREMELY knowledgeable. She is one of my favorite professors I've ever had here at IU. Her classes are challenging; she expects you to put in as much work as she does.

I love Bannon.  You have to do the readings and homework, as well as attend the lecture to do well in the class, but really what do you expect? My only complaint was she didn't quite understand how my disability accommodations were supposed to work, so if you have memos be clear when you meet with her.

Avoid taking any class with Prof. Bannon at all costs. Despite always attending lecture and filling out every study guide she gave, I found the class to be unnecessarily difficult and exams to be impossible, as they rarely touched on the study guide material. She seems to enjoy making students feel inadequate on tests, poll questions on homework.

She is EXTREMELY knowledgeable about Roman history and is very passionate at what she does. You have to go to class for clicker polls. There's daily homework that she collects once a week (randomly) so you have to do it. Tests are composed mainly from clicker poll questions, and aren't too hard. I didn't enjoy the topics, but enjoyed the professor.

Professor Bannon made me hate Rome. She made this class unbearable. Changed the syllabus three times to make the class harder. Incredibly rude to students when they have the courage to answer one of her questions. Clicker quizzes everyday that are hard and most of the time the majority of people get them wrong.

Clicker quizzes are worth points and will change your grade so make sure you attend class. She gives good feedback on homework and is willing to help you if you ask. She's very passionate about Roman Culture and if you are too then take this course. It is a little harder than should be for a 100 level but students can get a B or B+

I actually learned a lot in the class.  She packs a lot of material into each of her lectures, but she is extremely familiar with the course material and tries to teach as much of it as humanly possible.  Pay attention in lecture and try to do well on the clicker quizzes in class each day. The end of the semester is prime for extra credit.  Easy A+

Expect a lot of material to be thrown at you and thrown at you quickly. The professor is extremely enthusiastic about this class and is extremely knowledgable on Roman Culture; however, she teaches this class harder then I feel is necessary for a 100 level class. You definitely need to go to class if you plan on passing.

Overall the class isn't super difficult.  You have to go to class though.  There's no way out of that.  Luckily at the end of the semester she'll start feeding you more participation points to help your grade.  Tests are somewhat difficult but are definitely passable.  Reading is long and tedious. It's a very hard class to get excited about.

She is a very elegant woman and you can tell she's very passionate about Roman Culture. However, 40% of the grade is participation through clicker polls. You have to go to class, and she gives you so much information that it makes your head spin. Tests cover all information in the readings, if you have a good memory and like history, you'll do well

I realize that I'm a minority in this, but I actually really liked professor Bannon. I enjoyed listening to her lecture, and I found the test material to be pretty consistent with what she talked about. The timelines weren't difficult, and while there were some dates that weren't in the book, she always corrected those mistakes in class.

Prof Bannon completely ruined Roman culture for me. She is very ineffective in her teaching and goes off on subjects not related to her slides. She assigns timelines that have nothing to do with the slides and answers cannot be found in the book. She teaches the class as if everybody already knows the material. Overall, just a terrible teacher.

She teaches the class as if everyone is a classical major, even though most students are taking the class as a gen ed course. She often skips through slides during lecture and assigns timelines to complete that have events not covered in the textbook or lectures. The tests aren't consistent with class material as well. DO NOT TAKE C102

I would not wish this teacher on anyone. I am moderatley interested in the classics, but she is terrible. Her tests do not go along with lecture material and have to do a timeline assignment over chapters that are not even in the book. She wants dates for terms that are not even available in the book then it is wrong on the internet. DO NOT TAKE!

Professor Bannon often contradicts herself and makes claims that are inconsistent with the assigned readings. There is little class structure; she relies upon discussion, and she frequently strikes down what students say even when it comes word-for-word directly from the assigned readings. I do not recommend this professor.
took this class during Fall 2025, and that was an extremely tough time for me in general, but i'll never forget how understanding she was about my situation. an absolute saving grace
Funny. She's cute. She uses great analogies and examples. She's also young (30?) and well-traveled. I enjoyed the class.

Her color-coded notes were amazing. The exams were awful although with the curve and one dropped midterm exam you could still get an A in the course. Her lectures are pretty entertaining. Co-taught with John Beggs

Was a little flustered at times but truly cared about their students. They added some very interesting examples to the lectures that made it more fun and I enjoyed their little tidbits and ad libs in lecture as it made me feel more at ease. Exams were awful but the class was very curved so not too hard to suceed as long as you put in the work.

Prof Grundmann is funny and passionate about his course. While lectures are heavy, they are filled with life anecdotes and posted afterward. Exams are only difficult if you don't do the readings. One weekly paragraph, a few real-life projects, and three exams make your grade. Super approachable, cares about students, and will give career advice.

This class is based on only 400 points and 300 points come from tests. The exams are extremely difficult and many of the questions come from his personal life stories. The professor also thinks life is a joke, and this can be seen through the fact that he lost his finger to a chainsaw accident. It's pretty clear he wants his students to fail!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. G is my favorite professor at IU. This was my second time taking his class, and I was not disappointed. Get ready to read and invest into the concepts- just because he is fun does not mean it is an easy A. Exams are difficult but often open book. Prof G willingly works with his students and cares about our success. 100% recommend.

This is the BEST professor ever! If you ever get a chance to take one of his classes, please do! You can tell he loves what he does and is very passionate about his work/experience. He makes lots of jokes in class, so be ready to laugh. His lectures can be boring, but he makes sure to keep students engaged.

Professor Grundmann is my favorite professor I've had yet.  I looked forward to going to his class each week and it was easy to be engaged. He uses his own experiences working in HR to simplify and contextualize HR concepts, while using humor to engage the class. I learned so much about HR and am very excited to take another class with him.

My first class at Indiana University where I left with actual knowledge on a topic, Professor Grundmann doesn't hand out "busy work" or useless assignments, his work load is very reasonable, and grades very graciously. His lectures are amazing, even through some of the boring topics he always made it entertaining. Exams are online which is a plus

Funny guy, definitely knows his HR. My issue with his teaching style is it prompts zero engagement from the class. I have sat through 16+ lectures by now with only the same three people contributing to the discussion while everyone else is on their laptops, sleeping, etc. It seems as though he doesn't really care about the students in this sense...

Professor Grundmann was extremely knowledgeable regarding HR. His lectures were hilarious and very engaging. Be sure to keep up with notes and assignments to score well since there are not many grades in the course.
This is my favorite professor at IU. His lectures are worth attending to hear all the stories he has to tell. He truly cares about all his students if you put the effort in during class and show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I don't normally write reviews for professors, but Professor Grundmann is 100% worth a good review. He is absolutely hilarious and has a unique sense of humor. You can tell he really cares about HR and makes the effort to know his students. Make sure you keep up with the textbook because the exams are straight from the reading. Great human-being.

Such a funny professor with great stories and is very passionate about HR. He is very engaging in class and is always including the students perspectives throughout. Can get a bit boring and he will even admit that. Attendance is not mandatory but it does count against you grade wise if you miss too much. Will be taking a future class of his.

If you pay attention in class and do the readings, your class will not be difficult. He knows a LOT about HR and I would highly reccomend aksing him questions. His lectures are hilarous but still informative and he will always answer your questions. I cannot reccomend him enough

Professor G was amazing! I loved the structure of the class. The workload was pretty decent and manageable. He's pretty funny too! Sometimes the lectures got a bit boring but he worked super hard to keep you engaged. He was generous and helpful too. Recommend this course, I learned a lot!

Overall he was a great professor. Be prepared for a lot of reading and watching videos outside of class. If you do the reading and put effort into the class there will not be a problem. He grades fairly and provides help when needed. His classes are mainly a discussion and are not included on the test.

One of the best professors in SPEA. Grudmann always brings energy to his lectures and knows how to crack a joke or two when he notices he is losing the classes attention. Very interactive professor. There are weekly assignments that involve a fair amount of reading to succeed, but he is also an easy grader.

I would go to this class for this man's outfits alone. His style is amazing. He also has a great sense of humor and makes class fun. He is by far one of my favorite professors and the class isn't bad at all! I highly recommend it!

Fav professor by far. Go to class & participate! You'll get the most out of his entertaining lectures. Lots of material, but he explains overall logic & understanding which helps immensely for tests. This is the one class I can say I will take with me to my first HR job. Currently using all I've learned in job interviews, and they are so impressed.

Not sure what the hype is, but I thought he was just ok. First why is an A a 94 instead of a 93? You'll like lectures and the overall ideas of teachings. Way too much reading. The modules have at least 10 different readings and hour long videos for each chapter. None of readings go with his tests. My study guide was 40 pages long, tests are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really enjoyed all the lectures. Readings were useful. The grading scale in this class is a little different, in that, the grade 'A' starts at 94% as opposed to the traditional 93% in most other classes.

Funniest professor I have ever had, he made class exciting, utilized real-world examples, and truly cares about his students which shows through. Fair grader, tests can be tedious but are very straight forward, and he offers many resources to help with studying. Would recommend this professor to anyone that needs to take an HR course.
Loved his class!!! Super understanding and easy class.

He is one of the funniest professors I have ever had, but some of the things he mentioned in class had nothing to do with the tests. There is not enough points in the class, so try and get as many as possible. He is a great guy/spirit, but the tests blind sided me.

Although he goes on a lot of tangents, I really feel like I learned a lot in this class and am more interested in HR as a result. He never fails to make me laugh and has great experience in the HR field.

A really really genuine guy. He is passionate about his work and hes hilarious and loves to make jokes. However is a tough grader his exams arent a walk in the park and he knows that. Pay attention and show up and hell be the best professor youve had.

He is an amazing professor! He has a story for everything and always has a joke to tell. While he can be a bit disorganized his lectures are still great. Do yourself a favor and read the terrible photocopied handouts he has. The class is difficult but its still possible to succeed.

He is such a nice guy and definitely makes you laugh in class but don't let that fool you into thinking the class is an easy A, it is not! Study, read, go to class, really work hard on those assignments because he can be a tough grader at times.

He is a hilarious professor. He is always joking, while the material is very dry he is always trying to put in a joke to lighten the mood. The material isn't easy so when group projects arise you'll get stuck from time to time. But he is always there to help. All of his exams are online so it's so nice. Overall, pretty good class.

Professor Grundmann is very enthusiastic about his lessons and draws on his past experiences in the HR field. He really tries to engage all students in the room and will make you laugh at least a couple of times. Lectures he delivers mainly are conceptual. He does not challenge my thinking a whole lot which makes for a relatively easy class.
really nice guy! hard to focus in lectures sometimes because he gets off topic but his tests are very easy as long as you review lecture notes

Bring two notebooks: one for notes & another for quotes. Professor Grundmann is quick witted, very relatable, learns everyones name even in a Ballantine lecture hall, and is an overall fantastic teacher. He brings course material to life by masterfully tying in his HR management experiences into class topics.

Very enthusiastic in lectures and passionate when it comes to HRM. Tendency to get distracted and ramble off topic, but as long as you actually pay attention you'll be fine. Suggest no laptops because it's too easy to feel you can browse the internet. Attendance isn't mandatory but counted as participation. Tests aren't bad & would choose him again

The way he lectures makes it a little hard for me to be focused and take notes (he doesn't use powerpoints, just an outline on MS word), so you really need to take notes on the things he says rather than just what's on the board. But he is hilarious and will always make class interesting! Definitely READ. It'll help you out the most with the class!

Dan Grundmann is awesome. I finished this class and told him that he should take a job teaching other professors how to give a lecture. He gives great stories of his life that directly relates to class concepts. I had his class at 9am and never struggled to go. He is hilarious, very knowledgeable about HR, and I highly suggest taking his class.

BEST PROFESSOR IVE EVER HAD. This guy is great. I had him for an 8 a.m. class and sometimes those can be hard to stay awake in, but never with him. It gives so many real life examples that make you really think about what he is teaching you. Don't miss the opportunity to take this professor.

Took the class because there was good reviews on here and HATED the prof.  His stories are irrelevant to HR and he goes on frequent tangents.  His exams are mostly definition, but are still tricky. The whole class is a bore and you feel like you don't learn anything.

Dan knows what's important when learning about HR. It's not meant to be hard, it's about knowing what to do in certain situations. He has tons of stories that correlate with the material in class. He's nice & he's always down to talk with you, even if it's in an email or in a bar. Great class & I recommend him if you are going to take this class.
Grundmann is the man!!! This class is absurdly easy but I actually learned a lot and his wacky stories got me thinking every day in class.
good guy

Don't miss a class with this professor. I'm a senior about to graduate and he is easily one of the best professors I have had here. Very goofy and made a 2.5 hour night time class not just bearable but even enjoyable.
Unique teaching style that is entertaining yet intelligent and helpful. One of, if not the best teacher I have ever had. He should be teaching other professors how to lead a successful class.
This guy's the best. Seriously.

Best teacher I've ever had! I am a super senior and had never had a class as early as 9:30. I thought for sure I would hate attending, but I don't at all! The class is amazing- and Grundmann is hilarious! The topic is dry and it says something that he can get so many students involved in his class.
Hands down best teacher I have ever had in college. I ENJOY going to class and get sad when I have to miss... that says something! Fun, entertaining, wants you to succeed.
I really enjoyed his class...he taught with stories and it was very entertaining. I was laughing every class, the whole class.

Grundmann is the perfect teacher. Class is mandatory, but hilarious and fun...entertaining. He has the most outrageous stories, but they help you remember all of the HR concepts learned in class. He learns every persons name in class, and makes an impact through this personal, fun learning environment. If I could have him teach every class, I would

He teaches through stories rather than lectures, which makes it actually worth going to class! He's actually an HR professional for Bloomington, so he knows his stuff, and presents it in a way that i'll actually remember. Love this class, its not a waste of my time!
He rocks!! Makes class fun & interesting with his life examples... keeps things relevant. Awesome!! quirky & cute!!
This is my first day in class and I want to be this man when I grow up.  He is insane and its awesome.
He was so much fun! He taught his lessons with real life stories which made the class go by fast. I recommend Grundmann to all of my friends. Definitly take his V363.
This guy rocks
Awesome professor! Helps with anything, very easy class.  As long as you come to class you should get an A. Favorite professor in the last three years!

One of the most useful courses I have taken in college. He's an amazing professor, and his lectures are laid back and full of relevant tangents that help you remember concepts. He's really on the ball with human resources. I really enjoyed the class.
Awesome teacher.
No Comments
Grundmann's class easy as it may be, is still very usefull. I will definately take the knowledge I learned in the class with me to my future job.

If you need a CJ elective, I'd highly recommend this course. It's 2.5 hours once per week which can be a lot, but the lectures are interesting and the grades are very easy. Prof DeBrota does his best to make lectures as interesting as possible and gives students many extra opportunities to boost their grades
One of my favorite professors at IU. DeBrota uses his extensive experience as a criminal prosecutor to help digest the topics covered in class.

Professor Debrota is by far one of the best professors I have had. I took Famous Crimes and Trials and for being a 2 1/2 hour lecture it definitely did not feel like it. There were no exams, but there were post lecture and homework quizzes. There was also a term paper  broken up into two parts, but it was very easy if you put in the work for it.

I took Famous Crimes and Trials as well as Cybercrimes and Digital Evidence with Professor Debrota. He is one of my favorite (if not my favorite) professors in the department. His classes are so interesting and relatively pretty easy. He is funny and knows so much about the field. I strongly recommend either/both of his courses!

If I could take a million classes with Steve Debrota I would. You can tell he is truly passionate and extremely knowledgeable about everything he is teaching. The lectures are soo interesting and so is he. If you have the chance to take one of his classes, sign up right now.

Steve DeBrotta was by far the best, most interesting professor I have had! I absolutely loved his class and looked forward to hearing the stories he would incorporate into each lecture. He is so humble about the significance of his involvement in a lot of big cases and you can just tell how passionate he is about what he does!
Very fun class and an awesome professor. I took this class in 2020 and IIRC, attendance is not mandatory but I like to attend for the fun of it.

Steve DeBrota is AWESOME! This is the best professor I've ever had, and I am actually taking another class with him next semester. It's really easy to get an A+ as long as you pay attention to the lecture, and put forth effort when doing the projects, which are actually really interesting.
An incredible professor with an impressive amount of knowledge and experience. Would recommend taking ANY class with Professor Debrota. He is truly amazing!
This guy is the best of the best. His class seriously does not feel like class. He's that interesting. Excellent all around with a ton of knowledge to learn from.
One of the best classes I've taken at IU! His lectures were always interesting. Very knowledgeable in the field and I highly recommend!
Professor Debrota is amazing! Really great professor, loved the class.
Long class but it's super interesting. Great professor
Very helpful.  Easy course.  Come to every class--missing just one is a lot since it's three hours.  If you have an A+, A, or A- going into the final, you don't have to take it!
Super easy class if you attend. Great instructor, very knowledgable and likable. The projects are fun, too! Pretty easy to get an A.
Knows his stuff. Class is project based, and lots of fun! It's a long class but he makes it interesting. Good guy and good instructor!

He is very knowledgable and his class is so interesting. This year he had mored projects than anything else and they were so much fun and gave us a lot of hands-on experience. I think it was a lot better than just taking tests. The topics are interesting and the class is so worth the almost 3 hours.

Very knowledgeable and smart about cyber crime, also about law and criminal justice in general. It's very easy to make an A in his cyber crime class if you take notes and do the homework. Textbook is needed only for the open-book exams. Gives a lot of notes which are also needed for the open-book exams, but if you take them down you'll get an A.
For the people who take K201 during their Freshman year. She is the one that make things easier for you.
She is an amazing professor and she makes the class entertaining

She is great. She really cares about her student and wants them to succeed. Class requires a lot of work but is the same for all professors. She makes the class fun and has good jokes. Highly recomend
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Cindy Stone is an amazing teacher! I was nervous about K201 because it's supposed to be very difficult, but Cindy went through everything we needed to know during class! She talked extremely fast, but if she didn't, we wouldn't have finished all of the material. She even knew my name the first time I went to office hours, which was very impressive!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Cindy is a great professor. She taught my lab portion of k201 and describes the material very clearly so that you can follow along. She's funny and encourages hard work! Awesome prof for a tough class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Cindy goes above and beyond in her lectures to help students understand the material (which can be extremely difficult). She also makes herself very available to students when they have questions or need help. If you have her for class, you'll get through K201.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I wouldnt recommend her... She's good at teaching concepts but have a very difficult personality.. hard to approach.. never accepts her fault.. just bad
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's very nice. I would recommend.

Cindy Stone is an amazing K201 teacher. She teaches many k201 classes throughout the week, but still brings a ton of energy that makes you want to achieve more. K201 is hard and you have to put in work. If you listen to Cindy and do what she says  you will pass with a breeze.
I would definitely recommend  this class with cindy. She is one of the best teachers i have ever come across.
She's funny and teaches you what you need to know in an easy to understand way. Can't complain about anything about this course or how she taught it.

Cindy is a great experience teacher for K201.  She 100% has a business attitude which I like.  "College is hard, unemployment is harder," definitely my favorite quote of hers and one I've lived by this semester.  Also I recommend following her on Twitter.
she's funny, loves red sox and mark cuban... gives great examples to help remember important thing. loved her lab classes

K201 is not too difficult, but it takes a lot of practice outside of class to really master some of the skills. Cindy is an excellent instructor because she really knows what she's talking about. She can be somewhat intimidating, but she genuinely wants all of her students to succeed. Keep up with her pace & don't be afraid to ask her for help!

This class wasn't difficult, it was just a lot of work. Go into Cindy's office hours and she will help you AND MORE. Going into office hours is necessary if you want the best feedback and how to get your questions answered. Overall, great professor who made the class much more fun!
Amazing teacher! Got an A in this class.

K201 is a basic class every business student takes. It is essential that you know the topics, and the book is mandatory. Cynthia was an okay professor, wasn't the best or worst. Helped when needed, but she was very loud and would make fun of students if they didn't understand. It was awkward.

Professor Stone is great! She makes classes fun and purposeful. I will say, if you are not interested in Excel and Access, the class will be tough, but it will be tough with any professor. Stone is a great professor to have.
Cindy is always willing to help out her students. Class is very entertaining! I looked forward to it each day.
She is not lying to you on day one when she says not doing the work will make you her best C+ student ever.
She's a great teacher, class is hard though. Lot of time required.

Professor Stone knows her stuff, and is passionate about it. She is also smart enough to see through your bs, so don't try to fool her.  The material is not really that difficult if you attend all the classes and do all assigned work on time, even if it's optional. While attendance is not mandatory, it is absolutely crucial to get a good grade.
Best k201 lab teacher out there!! She is so helpful and so nice. She will do whatever it takes if you need help.

I was struggling in the beginning of the semester, went in and talked to Cindy, she mapped out a study plan for me, brought my C- up to a A-, which is usually impossible but she made it happen for me. Cindy is truly the best, always willing to help and always there for you.  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
She's very condescending towards students when they don't understand things, but she only wants the best for you as a student. She will call you a C student if you don't do your work.
Prof. Stone was great! She's very passionate about teaching and about her students, and she makes that very clear!

Stone is great! If you want a teacher that gets right to the point, is always prepared, and is super knowledgeable, this is your lady!! I would definitely recommend taking the class with her. I learned more in this class than I did in my entire major.
Great teacher. Would definitely recommending taking K201 with her.

Cindy Stone was absolutely phenomenal.  A seasoned, educated, well-informed, knowledgeable professor that WANTS to see you succeed and tells you what is expected up front and is direct with you in a good way.  Attendance is not required but you're lost if you don't show up.  Anyone with Cindy who doesn't slack and pays attention gets a good grade.

K201 is definitely what I would classify as a weed out class, but with having Cindy as my teacher I was able to get a good grade despite receiving a D on the midterm. If you are struggling and Cindy sees that you are trying, she is more than happy to help and will do whatever she can to help you be successful in the course. Thanks for everything!

Very helpful. K201 is known as a Kelley weedout class and theres a substantial amount of coursework compared to other freshman-level classes, but if you put in the time and utilize the huge amount of resources/help that Stone makes available to you, you will get a good grade. Stone  is a great professor, very helpful, passionate, and knowledgeable.
Cindy is an incredible professor! She genuinely cares about each student and does whatever she can to ensure their success! If you're taking K201, you want Cindy! K20-Fun!
Fabulous Professor! Really nice and helped me learned a lot during the semester!

Professor Stone is one of the best. Definitely take her if you're going through K201. She's willing to work with you as long as you attend class regularly and try hard. K201 is a tough, fast paced course but pay attention and make sure to do the extra credit; it could be the difference between a A and A-.
Professor Stone was very entertaining and helpful when viewing the K201 online lecture. I loved her enthusiasm and how she really cared for her students! Take Cindy Stone as your lecture professor!

This is a very challenging class if you don't take the time to study. Cindy does a great job with examples in class and is glad to help out in any way she can. Everything I learned in this class can be applied to real life and will be used everyday in the business world.

Prof Stone is one of my favorite professors here at IU! k201 is a tough class in general but Professor Stone made it fun and bearable.  She genuinely cares about her students and wants to help them succeed.  If you have to take k201 take it with Prof Stone, you won't regret it :)

Take her class. The class may seem more overwhelming than it actually is at first but you should stick to it. Cindy is a great professor; her teaching is clear to the point and she offers a lot of extra credit opportunities to boost your grade. If you put some time into it, it is not hard to get an A. Plus, her TA Michael Tretter is really helpful

Cindy Stone is an overall excellent professor! If you don't do well in K201 its because you are not going to class or not putting in enough effort. There are a million different resources available to learn the material as well as extra/practice exercises... Professor Stone is consistently active and engaged in letting students know whats going on.
This woman is brutal. Very condescending, sarcastic and egregious. Her attitude is very off-putting. This was my least favorite class.

Tough material, but really understanding and helpful teacher! Practicing was key for this course, and Professor Stone taught us everything we needed to know! Just do all of the pre-labs and review problems and listen to Professor Stone; she knows what she's doing! Go in for office hours for help before AND after classes!
Cindy is a really great teacher because knows her stuff and she wants her students to succeed. Go to her office hours and ask for practice files. I wouldn't have passed without her!

Cindy is one of the best professors I've had at Indiana University. She is fantastic at what she does, and is one of the few teachers that I'd actually enjoy just casually talking to. Very nice, very good at teaching, and just a great person all together.

I absolutely love this woman! She uses humor to relate to her students. She also really takes the time to help her students achieve. She hates to give bad grades and is always announcing her office hours for extra help. Although, I took K201 in the summer and it was REALLY fast pace she made sure that I received the grade I wanted on the first day.
Obnoxious, annoying voice, mediocre instructor. Take with someone else. That was a painful class.

Cindy really took the time to help me out and put more effort in to the class. If it wasn't for her reaching out and asking if I needed help I probably wouldn't have passed. She's funny and makes the material pretty clear. She is always willing to help a student! Great Professor for K201!

Cindy genuinely cares about her students and is willing to do anything to help them succeed.She also isn't one of those teachers that tries to make her course your life-she understands we're college students with lives.She gives out coupons in case you mess up on a lab check which was really nice.She is monotoned and tells alot of pointless stories

One of the best teachers I have ever had. Consider yourself lucky if you have her. Don't think she is easy though because there is no "easy" K-201 teacher. Everything is departmental. Just go to all the classes and always pay attention and get extra help when you need it and you'll be fine.
Go to class!

Cindy is an amazing teacher...she loves what she does and is always willing to help her students and reward them. Although the class is not easy, her explanations are clear and as long as you keep up with the work you will succeed! Cindy is definitely one of the best teachers I have had at IU!

The most helpful and caring professor I have ever had.  After struggling on the first lab practical she personalized a study plan that enabled me to end up with a B+ in the class.  Sincere and clear she is the BEST professor ever.

Hands down the best teacher I have had at IU so far...she loves what she does, and if you want the best teacher for K201, Cindy Stone is your lady. She explains everything perfectly, and will meet with you one on one whenever you want. If you go to class, and do the post-labs, there is no reason you can't get an A.
It is a challenging subject and Cynthia is the best when it comes to teaching it. You will also have many opportunities for bonus points in her class.

Cindy Stone is simply the best K201 professor there is.  K201 is NOT a hard class if you pay attention and do the work.  Cindy makes paying attention easy in class.  As a peer tutor for K201 now, I notice that Cindy's students tend to better than other's because as I said before, she is simply the best.

Warning: pay attention the entire class! Seriously though, this class goes by really fast, and if you pause for even a few seconds you get behind. Just stay focused and this course is easy. Cindy provides helpful examples, excellent clarity within lectures, and was very helpful when I contacted her via e-mail. I would definitely recommend her.

Cindy is very proficient in all of the topics she covered, but sometimes liked to single out some of the students.  She also seemed to treat the international peer tutors like they were 4 yr old's.  I actually thought she might be a little crazy.  I was happy to just get my A and leave, avoiding conversation.

BAD BAD Instructor.She treats international students terribly-she even tells international student go to Bloomington center to get extra help and pay extra money in their native language instead of English. WHAT! Every time when i try to ask her problem after class, she IGNORED ME!!! WHAT An AWEFUL teacher. Also, she it not easy to talk to at all.

Cindy Stoner (as she would tell us to call her on the GPs) is a fantastic Access/Excel prof.  She is very good at making computer lingo understandable for the everyday student and she always uses fun and applicable examples.  The class is tough, so it will take work, but Cindy's light-heartedness lightens the load.

I really appreciated having Mrs. Stone as a professor! She clearly is interested in what she's teaching, and she is always more than happy to help you if you have any difficulties during the duration of the course. Highly recommended!

Cindy Stone was a terrific professor. She was always willing to help and extremely enthusiastic about the class. She was always prepared and was willing to do everything to help you succeed if you were willing to put in effort. I highly recommend this professor.
A very good, caring and interesting lecturer. Constantly checks on students' grades and checks if they are following the class. Never will miss this class for anything else!!
Teaching a class that has a reputation to be a "weed out" course, she is great and enjoyable to listen to and learn from. She really makes the material interesting even if it may not be.
Great teacher, enjoyable to be around
She is a great instructor and makes this tough class fun and interesting. Her review files for exams and printout classes note are usually helpful. Go to her class and you can get good grade!!
GOOD

Class attendance is not mandatory but you will fail if you dont go.  She really cares about her students and will do anything to make sure that they succeed.  Class is very hard but she makes it as easy as possible.  Overall i would rate her as outstanding and would definitely recommend taking her class.
She is perfect
Cindy was a great teacher.  I learned a lot in her class and she helped me understand functions I wasn't getting.
awesome
I thought she was annoying,  but honestly she was a decent teacher of the material. Not the best, but not horrible. She gives great cheat sheets for the exams and a lot of extra credit.

I had to retake this class because Banks is not a good X201 teacher. Cindy on the other hand actually helped me to really understand the material and I did a lot better. She gives some extra credit and as long as you pay attention, you'll be fine. Plus, the cheat sheets for the practicals are awesome (practicals in X201 are open book unlike K).

Great professor. Extremely helpful and willing to spend time with students until they understand the material. She is FAR from obnoxious! She keeps things interesting. I would highly recommend her. If you go to class and get help if you don't understand something you will do well. Take her class!

Cindy did an awesome job this summer with us.  She really made it fun and she gives a lot of help and support to all her students.  A bit goofy at times, but definitely a good instructor.  I'd recommend her to anyone having to take K201, she's not phoning in it, and really cares about you!

Cynthia is a baller. Seriously, shes one of the better, if not the best, k201 lab teachers out there.  She does her best to turn an inherently dry class into one with some pizzazz. She teaches as well as any teacher I've had as well.  All in all, if you can, sign up for Team Stone.
She's okay, I've heard from other students that their teachers were more helpful. Annoying voice but very helpful and tries to help you learn with tricks.
a little too peppy for me. She makes it really hard to listen to her and will talk to you like you are 5.

I agree with one of the last posts, I really couldn't stand being near her for more than 10 minutes. She is extremely obnoxious and annoying, and from what I heard from friends with different professors, their lab sessions were MUCH more useful. Avoid getting Stone as a professor if you can.
awesome class! she is an amazing lady, get to know her and you will love her!! do your work and getting an a is cake

Cindy is the BEST K201 teacher there is. She genuinely wants you to learn the class requirements and she makes it FUN, even if you're computer illiterate (like me). GET HER FOR LAB if you can!! She's fabulous.

She really wants you to succeed, and she's good at explaining the work, though the way she talks is annoying sometimes. I saw her name on the list of trustees when the Godfrey Graduate Business school was built, so she's probably important.

Cindy is amazing!  She teaches the material in a way that is easy to comprehend.  If she see you are struggling in the class she will take the time to tutor you herself especially if you did not do well on the first practical.  I would recommend her as a professor and also she is a great contact to have within the business school!

Cindy Stone did a a terrific job as our instructor.  She is fun, she brings in goofy things to class, really makes us learn the material. Riding around the room in cardboard bus no less!  I recommend her to anyone, she's great

Stay on top of the work and go to a few help sessions. It's not too bad- but don't slack  because she does random work checks. My problem with her is that she talks to you like you're stupid, and like you're five years old. Plus, she has this obnoxius voice that discourges you from paying attention. switch to another teacher because she's annoying.

Professor DeLong was a great professor. Honestly, the lectures didn't really relate to the content, but he is a great public speaker and passionate about his students. You'll do well in this class if you don't write your speeches using ChatGPT like pretty much everybody did. Just follow the guidelines in the textbook and you'll be fine.

Honestly, this class was just fine. Brian DeLong was a very personable, easy-to-work-with professor, and I liked the class size. However, he didn't put in any grades until after spring break, and the assignments didn't really line up with what we were learning, during lectures he rambled for so long about what felt like random stuff. Easy class.

Lectures are pretty much pointless to show up to unless you have a speech or group work that day. He is impossible to reach outside of class and never answers his emails. He also seems very uninterested and unimpressed by his students and their speeches. The class is not hard, just overall pretty boring.

He is a passionate professor. I didn't mind his lectures and the first speech was pretty straightforward. The second speeches didn't go as well and it felt like that really change his attitude towards the class. He seemed annoyed whenever I asked him clarifying questions and generally acted unimpressed by the whole class? Fair grader though.
Doesn't actually discuss public speaking rather discusses things such as philosophies. Most of his lectures begin with enforcing his political views on students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Brian DeLong is a below-average professor teaching a course that is otherwise taught by very good and well-liked professors, so only do this if you have no other choice. Besides being condescending and pompous, he's also impossible to reach outside of class, will assign you multiple group projects, and doesn't actually evaluate them individually.

While some reviews say Professor DeLong's lectures are boring or long-winded, I feel like he genuinely cares about the nuances of the material and it can just come off that way to people who don't feel similarly.

Professor Delong's reviews are unnecessarily harsh. I have enjoyed his classes. He's clearly passionate and extremely knowledgeable on the subjects he teaches. He's willing to accept differing viewpoints but wants you to actually engage in discussion about your criticism or disagreement. I think if participate and are thoughtful, you'll be fine.

Brian is awesome! Lectures can be hit or miss sometimes with lack of participation, but he will spice things up with a magic routine from time to time. ITS A CANT MISS SHOW. Would definitely take again.

He will sit in class and just talk and not do much of anything else. He is very biased on every topic, not just politically, on every topic he is biased and shames people who doesn't agree with what he thinks. He will make subtle marks and make fun of people and laugh at people who may think differently.

Professor DeLong gave unclear grading criteria and was honestly a difficult professor to work with. When asked questions he would give answers that would lead to even more confusion. During the group project in the class, a majority of the class was unsure of what was expected. Lectures (dry) & midterm (difficult)did not relate to course content.

One of the worst professors I've ever had. Going into the final in December, I still had things ungraded from August. Very disorganized and gave me and my peers grades we didn't deserve in the end. Also did not give empathy and care when sending emails unsatisfied with grades.

While Professor DeLong's class was relatively easy, he gave directions that were completely unclear and I feel that he didn't care as much about his students as other professors. When we were working on group projects at the end of the semester, it seemed that a lot of groups were unclear about the instructions and he failed to clarify them.
This class should be easy but he makes every assignment hard as instructions are not clear. Lectures are not helpful as the test is only about the readings.

The most convoluted lecturer and pretentious professor I have ever had. Horrible at explaining assignments and doesn't post them till the last minute. When you ask a question he makes you feel dumb. Basically debates with himself for a whole hour and fifteen minutes and you don't learn anything that would be relevant for curriculum or the exams.

Professor DeLong is possibly THE most disorganized and unclear professor I've ever had. You don't need to pay attention in class at all but lectures are dry and not relevant. His assignments do not have clear expectations and when you ask clarifying questions he makes you feel dumb. He changes what he says to do 40 times so no one knows what to do.
Great knowledge of outer space and the commercial space industry. Fascinating lectures and would highly recommend to everybody.

Prof. Delong is really nice but the class is pretty much all lecture (other than speech days) and is quite boring. No tests during the semester except the midterm. Most speeches are about 5 minutes and the topics all relate to public affairs. You really don't need to read the book except for the midterm. Easy A, I would definitely take again!
Great Professor learned a lot from this class.  He also teaches a debate class thats very good!
Brian is really chill if your looking to learn about public speaking and stuff.

Dr. Kelly is a difficult grader, but if you go to lectures and follow the rubrics, you shouldn't have a hard time getting an A or A-. Follow the rubrics provided, and don't use Chat to write everything for you. If it's human written and clearly following the criteria, she will give you a deserving grade. Start strong and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I am a senior now and I was compelled to come back here and write that she was one of my least favorite professors I ever had at Kelley. I felt her grading was very unfair and it was def dependent on if she liked your group or not. She also graded way harder than other. I look back at the hours I spent in this class and feel they were wasted.

An astonishingly bad course run by a professor who treats grading like a random-number generator. Scores feel fabricated—pulled out of thin air on emails and written work. The rubric is meaningless, feedback is dismissive, and any attempt to understand or discuss a grade is shut down immediately. Hostile, punitive, and demoralizing throughout.
