While she can be kind, Prof. Emilie Passemar is a terrible lecturer and fails to explain fundamental physics topics clearly. Further, her tests do not reflect the homework well, making it difficult to achieve a high score. Overall, take someone else for Physics 221 if you can! Also beware of the 8-10pm exams of P221, its a rite of passage!

Prof Passemar is caring about the course and is quite a fun person. However, the mix of a very thick accent and very chaotic teaching style made it difficult for me and many others to follow along with the material at hand.

She's actually a really sweet, kind person. Many people were frustrated with the language barrier and a few times she was anxious while teaching. But, she tries as much as she can to help you if you ask her questions. She even emails later to follow up. She intentionally made exam 3 and the final easy and asked us if we felt it was okay. She cares.

Just because she is smart does not mean she should be teaching a P202 class. No one can understand her. There are 36/180 people in the lecture right now. It is shameful of the whole department to allow teaching like this. Do they seriously not think of how the students learn? All my friends stopped going to lecture months ago and I cant blame them
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very hard professor. First test went very poorly and at first she refused to curve. However, she decided to allow a slightly easier retake exam. I appreciate the challenges of this class, I feel like I've learned a lot, however I do not think I would take this class again. Lectures aren't the worst but I find that I'd rather just read the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Passemar was one of the worst professors I had during my time at IU. She refused to curve an exam where the average was around 50% to punish us. Avoid her at all costs.

Emilie strictly teaches verbatim from the textbook and is often flustered when a question is mentioned that is not pre-written in her "script". She is incredibly difficult to understand and is quite negative as she degrades students behind their backs. She also takes no responsibility for poor exam grades despite trends of her being the instructor.

i loved having jacob! he is so obviously passionate about what he teaches and extremely knowledgeable about anything you could ask him. beyond that, very entertaining and made class fun to come to/participate in. there is a lot of reading, but nothing too extreme given the level and subject. one of my fav classes this year for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Jacob is forsure an expert in his field, however he is definitely not the best professor. Throughout the entire course, we had NO idea what our grades were, which I don't think is fair and helpful. Also 50% of the course grade are reading checks and they focus on very obscure, easy-to-miss things. If you take, definitely stay on top of the reading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class as an Intensive freshman seminar, so it was 3 credit hours in 2 1/2 weeks. There was a lot of reading. He was not a harsh grader and was always willing to help you understand what you got wrong and why. He tried to make things fun, but would like to ramble on about things and somewhat get of topic very often. Fun class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: He wants the best for his students. Good teacher; his lectures were engaging and deep. Got lunch with his class a couple of times. My only complaint is that he assigned an insane amount of reading, so prepare to be stressed out many nights.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: I found the readings very long and hard to get through. Literary concepts were only mentioned once in class and then never reviewed. Overall, felt very confused and stressed throughout the course but somehow got a good grade.

Jacob is an expert in his field and it can be overwhelming at first. Sometimes his lectures run on, but at least they're interesting. There are only a few assignments, and he does not post grades on canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I absolutley loved this professor, he made class interesting and was super friendly. As long as you're ok with a ton of reading, I think it's an amazing class

I took his Sci-Fi literature class and really enjoyed it. Dear god there was so much reading, generally a novel a week, but if you are interested in the subject material and have the time to read, it's a really great class. The professor is extremely smart and friendly, and is always willing to help during office hours/responds to emails fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a good prof and you can tell by the way he speaks that he's smart as a whip and an expert in the field. If you ask him for help, he'll help you, but you need to reach out first. Expect to read--a lot. Classes will probably also run over by at least 5 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A lot of reading and lectures can be difficult, but I got a 98% in the class and I don't think I could even tell you what it was about. If you're good at bs-ing things you'll do fine in this class, and some of the material was pretty interesting.

This is an absolutely amazing class and professor! The material and lectures are really really interesting. I learned much more than facts; I learned new ideas and ways of seeing the world. I highly recommend this class, or any class with Professor Emery.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: LOTS of reading required, some very difficult to understand. Attendance IS mandatory for discussions. Lectures are very rambling & almost too abstract to understand. Thought this would be an interesting class but the coursework & topics discussed were all over the place. Not what I expected by the university's description. Tough class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The material for this course will fundamentally change the way you perceive the world. Every topic is interconnected and used to understand the next. The way he was able to bring complex, abstract, philosophy down to a freshman level was just amazing to watch. If you have an opportunity to take a class with this professor, DO NOT PASS IT UP.

If you're looking for an easy class to finish your gened requirement i do not recommend taking this course. The readings are really long and tough. The only reason I know whats going on is because i pay attention during discussion and just write down everything he says. Attendance is a must or you might miss a group quiz or writing assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: He speaks so abstractly that you have no clue it is even related to the class. It is a class that I dreaded going to, just because of his lack of engagement. He has no clue what's going on outside of his world and doesn't do a good job connecting with students unless the student is someone who wants to talk about a philosopher.

This class was one of the most difficult things I've ever done academically, but it was also incredibly enriching.  The skills I obtained from Professor Emery have made comparative literature a breeze. Sure he rambles in class, but it's all important stuff. Overall my favorite professor so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Nah

My only real criticism of this class is it is definitely NOT set up as a 100 level class. Do not take this class if you are looking to breeze through your critical approaches requirement. Being honest, the work load is similar to a lot of my other 300-400 level classes. Definitely some tough stuff to conceptualize, so discussion section is crucial

This class has reading every weekend, and some is really confusing (or even disturbing). The lectures don't help with understanding bc he speaks so abstractly that you don't know what to take notes on. But take notes! They will so help when preparing for tests and writing essays. He is helpful though if you seek it.

Jacob Emery's "Dreams Come True" class was easily one of my favorite classes ever taken. Alright, so he's going to talk about very conceptually challenging ideas and you will be required to read hard philosophical texts. However, he will spoon feed you exactly what you need to know. He is an amazing lecturer and extremely considerate and helpful

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. easily the hardest class I have ever taken in my life.  Readings are extremely difficult to comprehend and lectures are confusing. He expects you to write 6-9 page papers using all abstract thinking.  If you are an abstract thinker on your own, this is your class.  Otherwise, avoid at all costs.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. It is not about dreams at all. It is a philosophyliterature class. You must be a deep thinker for this class or you will have a very tough time with it. His lectures went over my head and were more like ramblings, and be prepared to read ALOT. The concepts are very abstract and the papers are very open-ended. AVOID.

avoid at all costs. there is such a clear intellectual divide between the Professor and the students it literally is impossible to keep up with. they tend to grade the papers on the harder side. if you aren't great with philosophical courses this is is NOT the class for you. don't trust the title- no dreams involved.

Don't let the stats fool you--Emery was an amazing professor for a critical approaches "Dreams Come True" class and I'm sure that carries over. Yes, the class does deal with very complicated philosophical themes. Yes, it does get confusing sometimes (he's brilliant; we aren't). But if stimulating lectures and good lit is your thing, take him please

I took Prof. Emery's "Dreams Come True" Critical Approaches.  Prof. Emery is very intelligent, but the class was hard to follow.  It was hard to decide what to take notes over and lectures could get pretty boring.  He also never really gave us feedback on our grade, I found my grade out 2 weeks before the end of the semester.

Highly recommend! Fyfe brings so much energy to her lectures. Her tests are fair and she does a review day before tests. There's a small extra credit option. She doesn't give many assignments. She lets you drop the lowest test. Very fair attendance policy. No textbook. I spent about four hours outside of class studying each week for this course.

Professor Fyfe is amazing!! She is my all time favorite professor and you can tell she loves to teach by all the energy she has. The way she teaches psychology is so good and she uses great examples to help you remember/understand. I would recommend her to anyone!!

Emily Fyfe was super energetic during her lectures. If you do not attend class, it will affect your grade. She was a great teacher! She explained things clearly and would give you a multiple days heads up with due dates. She is a fair grader and her lectures were interesting. She keeps you engaged and thinking the whole class.
literally just go to class and pay attention and you'll be fine. dr. fyfe is so enthusiastic and the points in her class are super black and white. loved
She was amazing during her lectures that it made me actually want to go to class

Dr. Fyfe is an awesome lecturer, and if you go to class you'll be set for the tests. No outside reading required. We have weekly online quizzes w/ 2 attempts. She's super energetic during class, and makes the material digestible/easier to understand. Takes attendance randomly. Tests are in person, but not difficult. Again, attend lectures!!

Dr. Fyfe is one of the most knowledgeable professors I've had. She is clearly passionate about developmental psychology and wants everyone of her students to do well. Dr. Fyfe were very accessible both in and outside of class for help. Going to office hours also will make a huge difference in terms of preparation for the exam.

Professor Fyfe is an amazing teacher. She puts so much energy into her lectures that they are actually enjoyable to attend. I do recommend attending class because she explains things very well and does review sessions for exams.

the class wasnt hard tbh its just theres surprise material on the tests that wasnt on the study guide which i HATE. i study for tests all week and do the whole study guide and i still get a mid grade. other than that shes very energetic and enthusiastic which makes the lectures better. reading the book will help sometimes when taking notes

Best professor I've had so far. Honestly, anyone who has complained about Professor Fyfe likely does not study nor attends lecture. If you attend lecture, take notes, and use the study guides she gives you, you will succeed. She is very clear and a very reliable professor.

Loved this course so much and Fyfe is such a good professor! She is passionate and enthusiastic. Explains the material super well. The course is not necessarily easy but if you really listen and attend lectures you will do great. Make sure to write down a lot of what she says in the lecture, most of it will be on quizzes and exams.

One of the best professors I've ever had!

None of it is challenging, but she takes points off without giving any explanation, and never provides the proper guidance to complete assignments. She is not a good professor, she does not explain concepts and wastes a lot of time. 0/10 DO NOT RECOMMEND.

Prof. Kovacs is super friendly and makes her class very passable if you participate and do the basic readings and homework. If you don't like something in the class, she is open to hearing feedback and will actively take it into consideration. Even after the semester ended, she was still willing to meet with me and offer career advice. 10/10 choice

Erica was available and offered valuable career advice. If you come to class, you will get a good grade because many questions in the exam came from the lecture. I didn't like the activity with the UK students, but overall, I enjoyed the class.

Erica is an incredibly sweet professor but her classes are long and can be hard to get through. Be prepared to talk a lot in class as you are constantly being paired up with other students. The class is not that hard and she gives a fair amount of extra credit. Overall I would recommend taking the class with her as it will be an easy A.

reviews.comment: She was ok. Nice enough, but had a weird policy about having us hand-write group assignments and rarely letting us use laptops. Attendance not mandatory. reviews.comment: Attendance not required but if you miss a class, you miss a question on the exam
One of my favorite professors at Kelley

She was fine. You have to attend class in order to pass. There is no where to find the information that she talks about. You have to be in class actively taking notes in order to get a good grade. Her slides only have questions on them and no content. Make sure to show up to class and take notes.
One of my favorite professors at Kelley.
One of my favorite professors at Kelley. I learned a lot about different cultures and now I am applying the concepts while studying abroad.

reviews.comment: Prof. Kovacs is one of my least favorite professors I've had a Kelley so far. Her discussions are uninteresting and doesn't help you understand the material any better. She talked about business practices in other countries and I liked that the professor was very passionate about the subject

reviews.comment: She tries to make the class fun and I enjoyed how she brought examples of the recent events. It helped me to understand the content. The book is boring and the assignments are toughly graded. She was always available outside class when I didn't understand. Never miss a class and take notes of everything. Many exam questions come from the lecture.

Honestly, this class was not as bad as the other options for D270. Her lectures are extremely boring but it is important to go if you want to do well on the exams. Just go to class, pay attention, and you'll do fine.

Professor Kovacs is easily one of the worst professors I have encountered in my time in Kelley. Her lectures are horrendous and consist of either uninformative Kahoots or her throwing a beach ball around. Erica Kovacs actually sucks. She will just rant about Brazil the entire time and play useless videos in class while throwing a beach ball around. reviews.comment: She is a tough grader. She cares about her students and was always available for office hours. However, don't miss class because many of the questions are lecture based. One of my favorite professors at Kelley

Just do not waste your time taking her. Typical Kelley class that is completely useless and you learn nothing in. Might as well take it with a professor where getting an A is a possibility. Her tests are insanely hard and there is no reasonable way to study for it.

reviews.comment: She is BY FAR the worst professor I have ever had at Kelley. Not even any remotely bad professor comes close to how awful she is. She needs to be fired asap. Do yourself a favor and DO NOT take her class ever.

A pretty good class. The homework is reading/watching a video about the topic and doing a playposit quiz. In class she lectures and then you do a group activity. Also there is a group project that you get the whole semester to work on. Dont wait until the last minute. She gives extra credit & if you pay attention in class youll do well on exams.

reviews.comment: I liked the fact that she encouraged us to participate and bring our ideas to class. She kept us engaged, and the class is very interactive. Make sure you come prepared to class.
I lost half of my points on a group project when more than half of the members gave me 100s on peer reviews. Late to meetings and poor speaker.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Kovacs has a lot of enthusiasm and passion for what she does, and really cares about her students. The exams were fair and she kept us engaged, despite the transition to online classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Kovacs is not a bad person, but she is a bad professor. Expectations are unclear and always last minute. A student who is organized will hate her teaching style. Each week is a guessing game for what assignments are due. She does not consider class opinions. Her experience is relevant but her teaching ruins that.

Her lectures are engaging and she does a good job paying attention to how the class feels every day, whether it be our understanding of the topics, or our energy levels/ability to actually pay attention. Helpful In-class group work every day, so don't miss class. My only annoyance was that her expectations on papers were a little vague.

Lots and lots of homework and readings, but at the end they helped me to get prepared for the 3 exams. She has international experience (useful when teaching cross cultural management), cares about the students and responds to email inquiries promptly.

She is quite literally the worst teacher I have had at Kelley. Her exercises in class are kindergarten-level difficulty and nothing you learn in class really ends up mattering for the finals besides what is explicitly on the slides. Her tests are riddled with grammatical errors and ambiguous choices. Didnt learn anything useful from this class.

Don't let the low scores scare you, Erica is an incredible professor with great industry experience. Her Brazilian accent is one of the easier accents to understand, and it adds to her credibility teaching a class about Brazil. The exams are very easy as long as you keep up with class content, and the group project makes up most of your grade.

One of the best professors I've had during my time at IU! I took her for two classes: D270 and D271. She had less control over D270, but she still made the class fun and dynamic. For D271, she was always organizing interesting learning activities. She cares about students! Warning, though: a lot of readings + exams q's are not straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: This is a class that is based solely on 2 test grades. While this is aligned with many other business courses, the material on the tests was not covered in class. The tests contain many ambiguous questions that you could argue a right answer for each of the answer choices. The professor is difficult to reach but is very friendly at least.
She is hard to listen to. Her test are challenging a lot of questions from the lectures and the book. The practice quizzes are useless for the final.

No joke probably the best professor that you will have. Very understanding about many different things that life throws at a student, lectures are interesting, and the class itself is not difficult if you just do the assignments given. Would 100% recommend if you need an elective (Kelley or not).
Genuinely the best teacher I've had. Would recommend taking a class of hers if you get the chance.
I could not recommend Professor Eskew more. Even if you are not in Kelley (like me), you have to take one of her classes if you can. Easily the best professor on campus.

Professor Eskew is my favorite professor that I've had at IU. She is very passionate about what she teaches and cares a lot about her students. There are no exams and the class is more of a conversation than a lecture. If you can take Eskew for Ethics, do it.
Professor Eskew is the best prof I have had at IU. So kind and relatable and genuinely cares about her students. Took as a LEAD elective with ICORE and was very manageable. No exams only projects.

Amazing professor. She is extremely passionate about the topics discussed in class, and she shares great real-life experiences from her career. I loved when she brought in guest speakers from the industries related to what we were discussing in class.
Outstanding prof. Lots of engaging discussions, gives really good feedback on projects, and overall just a great human. Cannot say enough good things!

Prof Eskew is extremely caring & kind. She is clearly deeply passionate and is well prepped for class. That said, L302 is on environmental justice, which I wish I had known ahead of time. How enjoyable class is depends on the attitudes of your classmates & groupmates - it is very political and debate-heavy. Would rather have taken L319 in the fall.
Super passionate and you can tell she cares about her students.

She is super nice, passionate about the topics, and tries really hard to get everyone involved. The before class work is pretty easy to get done and the project isn't too hard. However, she can grade pretty harshly at the start of the project so don't slack off on the first assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Absolutely fantastic and brilliant. This course was life-changing, and I would recommend any class she teaches. She is the most interesting and kind professor, only assigning the most engaging materials and never wasting a lecture. She encourages the most fascinating discussions, making it feel as though she is learning alongside you. love her.

So caring, knowledgeable, and passionate about her class. Gets connected to every class member and really inspires everyone to do their best work. There are a lot of readings, videos, and other lecture prep, but as long as you do the work as expected, grading is very easygoing. Would absolutely recommend all her classes, not just this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I wish rate my professor didn't have a character limit - I would never run out of good things to say about Prof. Eskew. So incredibly intelligent, compassionate, and generally passionate about student learning. Really focuses on material application, which makes the course so much more interesting and usable long term. Can't wait to take her again!
This is the best professor I have had at IU. So knowledgeable and kind to students.

Learned so much relevant information about business law.  Many interesting cases were addressed in the book and during class.  Exams are easy.  Kelly clearly loves the subject matter and that shows through in her lectures.  She is able to answer all kinds of questions about law which made live sessions very interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved this prof! Incredibly kind, incredibly knowledgeable. Lectures were fun and interesting. Her tests were SO easy if you went to class and payed attention. But I learned so much about business law because I wasn't stressed about my grade. I would choose her over any other prof for L596.
Hands down the BEST professor at IU. She is the most caring, intelligent person and professor. I wish she was my mom. Take every class you can with her.

Kelly doesn't take attendance but you won't want to miss a lecture. Classes are discussion-based with lots of input from students, and she appreciates those who participate. Most assignments are video or article-based and take about an hour to do (I did mine in the mornings while drinking coffee). One of the best professors I've had in undergrad!
Dr. Eskew is a brilliant professor who cares deeply about her students and the material she teaches. Tests and papers are easy and generously graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Never had such a wonderful teacher as Professor Eskew! She is THE BEST! Not only does she make Business Law fun but truly ensures that the knowledge is being imparted to the students in the best possible way. She cares deeply for her students and goes above and beyond to look after their best interest. I wish I had her for all my courses!!

Kelly Eskew is my single favorite professor I have ever had. She cares deeply about her students, about the world, and about the environment. This shows in the classes she teaches (Global Poverty Alleviation, Sustainability & Public Policy, Renewable Energy, etc). She knows her stuff and keeps classes interesting no matter the topic. THE BEST!

Prof Eskew is hands-down the best prof Ive had. She is passionate about the class material and made everyone feel valued. She is willing to work with you if youre struggling as long as youre trying your best. Lectures are thorough and well-organized. Brings in interesting guest speakers. Class based on a group project & exams. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Kelly Eskew is the coolest person on this planet and shes an amazing teacher. Best professor I had at Kelley I could not recommend taking a class with her more. She made my experience at this wack school so much better.

Professor Eskew is definitely one of my favorite professors at IU. I took her Personal Law class and learned so much from her. She loves her students and is one of the few that will actually learn everyones names, even if the class size 100. I wish more professors were like her! I recommend her 11/10, can't say enough good things about her.
Easy to get a good grade, fun class to take, would recommend to anyone interested in law in any way.

Professor Eskew is by far my favorite professor here at IU. She cares for all her students & always makes class interesting. Class work is easy if you do the readings, and they're actually interesting. if you have her, you'll WANT to go to class! if ur reading this & deciding whether u should take her class-- do it!

Kelly is my favorite professor of all time. Cares about her students. Very very smart. I took her personal law class and I learned more in that class than any other one in my life. She is wonderful. Befriend her and you will pass with flying colors. Easy quizzes and papers.
Prof. Eskew is AMAZING! She cares a lot about her students success and makes class so entertaining. The work is not too difficult, if you do the work you will get an A.

Professor Eskew was awesome. She is fun and knows the material inside and out. She is always willing to joke around with the class, and take the lectures in directions the class is interested in. She does take attendance but you'll likely want to be there. Overall one of the best professors I've ever had.

Absolutely loved having Prof. Eskew! By far my favorite professor this semester. She was able to take a subject that I was honestly dreading going into this semester and she made it interesting and meaningful. She made a point to make it a very discussion-based class and you will benefit if you participate.

Professor Eskew was Probably my favorite Professor that i had this semester. she is super funny and will make anytime for students. some of the lectures are a bit long but she invites so many guest speakers to make things interesting. the 'class prep' homework is always easy and the exams weren't difficult either.

Professor Eskew was an awesome first professor to have as a college freshman. Very good sense of lightness and humor, and very caring about her students. I looked forward to her classes and would definitely take another class from her if I could. Such an awesome professor and person overall.

Was not looking forward to taking the required ethics class for Kelley but ended up looking forward to attending her classes. Classes and projects are all manageable and well laid out. Not too difficult to get a good grade if you keep up with the assignments. Definitely would take a class from her again
she has 0 tolerance with missed work and picks clear favorites

Very good teacher.  The material is sometimes goofy and she definitely has a certain political leaning and that is usually very clear.  Despite that she seems to love what she does and enjoys the material.  She is also an extremely nice person and is more than willing to help out with anything.

Prof. Eskew is perhaps the best teacher you'll find at Kelley. She cares SO MUCH about her students. Her lectures are engaging and filled with real life examples. If you go to the office hours regularly and keep in touch with her, she will help you when you're in a tough spot. Best teacher I've had till date at IU!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Eskew is the best professors I have had to date.  She has a great sense of humor that really brightens up the room.  There were never any dull moments in her class; I was always looking forward to her discussions.  One of the few profs who learn students' names.  Go to class and share your opinion.  Honestly one of the best classes yet.

One of the most caring and understanding professors at Kelley. Genuinely wants to get to know her students and always available to help you. The class itself is a long of reading and writing, but if you put in the work you'll be fine. She's a fair grader. I highly recommend her.

Kelly is absolutely amazing. She's had a very interesting career path and she has a lot of wisdom to share when it comes to the law. All her lectures are engaging and relevant to our every day lives. Tests can be kinda difficult, so definitely go to class and take good notes. Get to know her! She's such a lovely person that genuinely cares.

My experience was not a positive one. The class is monotonous, if you're not a native speaker you will also be at a disadvantage. Approach with CAUTION!!!

I never wore my seatbelt on my way to this class because I didn't want to make it to this class..

Professor Vieira has been quite disappointing. My main concern stems from her grading approach, she  awards a standard A- without providing constructive feedback. reviews.comment: Great Professor, there is a lot to learn from her. She was the most important professor for me, I learned about what she is passionate about!

I had Prof. Estela my sophomore year and originally I though she was nice and the course easy but then I had my first exam and and essay grade. reviews.comment: She is an absolutely amazing professor I learned so much in her class. She is very caring about the overall well-being of the students and honestly, she just seems like an amazing person. One of the best professors I ever had, I was always excited to go to her class and learn from her.

Emily is by far my favorite professor I have ever had at IU. She is truly the most caring person and professor. She also uses a very clear rubric, and you are guaranteed an A as long as you do all of the assignments. There is quite a bit of group work, but honestly it wasn't bad at all. I cannot recommend Professor Esola enough for C204.

Professor Esola has a unique grading style that guarantees you an A as long as you do every assignment. She also allows you to redo any assignment if you do not do well on it. She also really cares about her students. I definitely recommend her for C204.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is the n

- Everything is graded on a clear rubric
- Can redo all major assignments
- Uses an alternative grading system that is meant to help you as a student

Emily was great, she communicated main writing and conceptual points of c204 without being overwhelming.
Her innovative grading system allowed students to actually care/focus on what they wanted to submit, resubmit, or earn as a grade with a split between participation and effort. Low stress class which was beneficial compared to other 204s.
Emily is verrry nice!  Such a sweet human and very easy teacher.  Everyone in the class gets As, C204 was a breeze compared to my other friends with different C204 professors.

Professor Esola is heavily accessible outside of class - she has great tips on how to improve your writing. She is honestly one of the best professors I have ever had as she deeply cares about her students' mental health and their learning and development. She made C204 stress-free and heavily enjoyable.

Emily is a very good professor and is very reliable with office hours. She allows revisions for most work to ensure that you understand the material and is very helpful with questions. Take her class if you are in Kelley!
Great professor for C205. Workload is very light overall and she's very flexible with due dates. 60% of assignments are for completion.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Esola is a very chill professor who will help you succeed. You just need to visibly make an effort and show that you care. It's an easy A if you ask for feedback and implement it. She lectures a bit in the beginning of the semester but then the class is mainly focused on group work. Definitely take her for C205
Best professor ever! Always care about your mental health and interesting lecture.
Best professor ever!
nice teacher but can be a tough grader

C205. Beware that this professor can be a harsh grader on the projects that matter. For our final project, she refused to give anyone a grade higher than B+ and even had the audacity to tell us that an A just isn't possible in the time that she gave us and that we would've needed an extra 8 weeks to submit a report that was an A. Horrible teacher.

Expect to never know where you stand in the class because she doesn't use Canvas at all. She claims that she gives feedback if you go to her office hours, but even when you go in to talk with her, and revise with her suggestions in mind, you find out at the end of the semester that you have a crappy grade and you never know why. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Emily is one of the best instructors I've had. She recognizes students who give effort and really helps them out. Best advice? Show her you work hard and you will be good to get an A. She is very open and willing to meet with students. She lays out instructions clearly and doesn't waste time. This class is heavy on group projects, no major quizzes.

Hopefully you get a good team because you'll be going groupwork with the same group the whole semester. You learn a lot, but make sure to correct your mistakes after every assignment bc at the end you do a huge final submission with previous work/corrections need to be made. Make sure to stay organized- I suggest doing all work on Word.

The class isnt bad, you have to work a lot, but Esi is the worst prof. Ive had @ IU. Shes condescending, rude, & gives unclear feedback (& blames it on you if you dont understand her). She doesnt care if a member in your group isnt working. She nitpicks everything from your work & doesnt explain it. Never got a 100 on anything in the class.

I didn't think this course was as difficult as some of the other reviews make it out to be. In my opinion, the weekly quizzes weren't difficult at all. Just be sure to look through the material for the week. The workload was manageable. Sometimes she assigned short deadlines, but it wasn't unbearable.

This class is entirely group project-based. You'll have the same team for the entire semester. So, if your team members aren't contributing - good luck! Esi is an extremely sweet individual and gives plentiful feedback, but this feedback is often extremely unclear.

Esi is the worst professor I have ever had. This class is based on group projects that is so difficult and she never explains them. Do yourself a favor and never take this professor. She changed all my grades at the end of the semester also just to lower my grade. Horrible professor and she makes no sense.

Professor Thompson is a good person, but not a good teacher. Her class work is super demanding and it was based on group projects throughout the semester. Her instructions were unclear a lot of the times too, which made things harder. The weekly quizzes were insanely hard. Her class took up so much of my time outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Thompson is a nice woman, but a bad professor. She is unclear with directions. Her instruction are ambiguous and contradict what she says after you've completed your work. She gives sample assignments and then tells you not to follow the samples. Her quizzes are frequent and difficult. They test your memory not knowledge. Overall bad prof

Professor Tuna is the absolute best. S308 is a tough class, but he is the person you want to teach you. He genuinely cares about his students and will go out of his way to help them with anything. You also get a zoom option which helps manage some awkward time slots.

Tuna was my favorite professor I've had! He was so caring and kind to all his students and even took the time to remember everyone's names. He made the material easy to digest and if you have to take this class you HAVE to take it with Tuna!!! His exams are based on slides and very fair. He's also super willing to help you as long as you ask.

Very caring professor. S308 can be a tough class if you have no coding experience. He took his time and explained all concepts and was willing to go over things as many times as needed. Tuna made lectures interesting with real world examples and use cases. It was a fun class.
Professor esen helped me a lot in this class. When I have any question, he will teach me patiently after class.

Prof Tuna is one of the purest souls I've met at Kelley. He is constantly available to help and give feedback and I've never heard even slightly agitated or upset about anything. The class is a lot of work and is fast, start the homework far in advance but other than that, take this class with Tuna. He really cares and is a genuine human.

Professor Tuna is one of the most genuine and caring professors I've had at IU. He is extremely engaging in class, clear about what he expects, gives very understandable and complete lectures. He is very willing to help us when we are stuck on labs and assignments, he also listens to students ideas and really wants everyone toget an A in this class
Really great professor, always helpful after classes. His lectures were very well prepared and he clearly wanted everyone to do well.

Esen is the best. K303 is a work-heavy class but he really, really wants his students to succeed. He emailed me multiple times throughout the semester encouraging me to turn in assignments I hadn't yet. He makes sure there are plenty of office hours available to you and provides recordings for problems not shown in class. Happy I got him for K303!
Very difficult to get a good great. Lots of busy work. But my spanish definitely improved. Such a sweet and caribng professor.

So much hw, I felt like there was never room to breathe. Honestly I don't recommend unless you like Spanish or plan to major in it. It's not necessarily hard, but requires so much time dedicated and constant energy/engagement/participation, zon't zoo it. so much out of class prep.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Francisca is an outstanding teacher, I highly recommend her to anyone taking Spanish at IU

FRANCISCA IS AMAZING. She's the sweetest Spanish teacher you'll ever meet and loves what she does. I had horrible high school teachers and she showed me that excellent Spanish teachers really do exist. Pick her. Pick her. PICK HER. Can someone hand this lady her teaching award already?
Francisca was amazing.  She made us laugh and kept our interest piqued.  She's one of my favorite professors and she deserves a Spanish teaching award.  Pick her! You won't regret it!
Francisca is awesome! She is so helpful and wants to make sure everyone understands what she is teaching. She goes over the homework in class which is extremely helpful. Very nice lady

Absolutely the worst professor ever. She does NOT know what is ever going on. I can not stress this enough, do not take q200 with her and if you get screwed over and get stuck with her just drop the class and take it the next semester. I would rather take organic chemistry again before ever taking this class.

I'm currently in Q200 with her and I wouldn't recommend it if you can avoid it. She is often confused at her own material and the whole class is very confused 90% of the time. Projects aren't always explained well and due dates for homework aren't either. She lectures a lot and the class is almost 2 hours long...

Words cannot describe how horrendous this class was. DO NOT TAKE Q200 WITH ESTHER. She is the most confusing and unorganized instructor I have had so far. There are so many assignments with vague rubrics, she will take points off your work because you did not include something that was not in the rubric. She is rude and did not teach us anything.

professor is outstanding and caring. if you show up to class and try then you'll get the grade that you desire. going to office hours helps also.

reviews.comment: Gather round, honors icore students, as I relate my tale of woe; Fairchild's lectures are so disorganized, I gave up on learning long ago. We get grades with no feedback and rubrics with no detail; In the end, a final exam, which the class was doomed to fail. Hark! my dear friends making your way through honors icore; Avoid Angie Fairchild for J304

2019 Brandon Knight, Pandemic P, Lakers Westbrook, 2011 Finals Lebron, Josh Rosen, Saints 1/14/2018. This pretty much sums up Angie's performance as a professor. Utterly an embarrassment to this school as a professor. I sometimes sit and wonder how she is even employed as a professor.

I have attended almost EVERY class since freshman year. I am a strong believer that you can get value out of any class, however, THIS CLASS IS THE EXCEPTION. Professor Fairchild spends lectures writing irrelevant information down on a whiteboard without explanation and grades unbelievably hard for how straightforward the content is. She is BAD!!!

Honestly an embarrassment to the Kelley Honors Program. Absolutely no structure or consistency in class. She spoke down to students and overall created an unwelcoming atmosphere. 

At the beginning of the semester, I was excited about taking a strategy class, but this was disappointing to say the least.

Would not recommend. At all. I don't think I have ever had a prof more ambiguous. She is knowledgeable about strategy but cannot connect with students or explain the material in a digestible way. 

She talks to us like we are dumber than her. We may not be as "knowledgeable," but we are still SMART. Class discussions were cold and unwelcoming.

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS! No study material, no slides, doesn't grade her own assignments, made the final very difficult and didn't tell us how to study. Unnecessarily hard class. Avoid her as a professor.

First time teaching a class and didn't have anything organized. No notes, no PPTs.

Teaching was terrible and asked questions on exam that weren't taught.

Her exams are unreasonably confusing. The way she frames the question is like making a very simple thing very complex.

Not at all a student friendly teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Wang is a very easy grader with only a handful of essays/assignments that get long over the course of the semester. The actual class covers a lot in a short time, but she does a great job explaining it all; I personally learned a lot. She is also super generous with extensions so do not be afraid to ask for them.

Professor Wang is a great person to take a class with. She is very funny and grades easier as the semester goes on. There is quite a bit of reading assigned, but you do not need to do it all; I skimmed most of the stuff I was not interested in and I was fine. Just go to class and make an effort. She also gave multiple extra credit opportunities.

Professor Wang is not only kind and caring to her students, she is very clearly knowledgeable and caring about her subject. She is very funny, and her class is dynamic, so you never lose interest over the semester. She does require a textbook, but it is cheap and very readable.

She was so kind and funny. She organized her lectures in very effective ways to where I was able to understand and comprehend what she was saying. I enjoyed this class very much and would take more classes like this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Honestly, I only decided to put a review to counteract the last one. We've literally been in class for a week, it's beyond me why that review is so negative. She left a great first impression on me though. She's super friendly and the course material looks very interesting. She clearly wants the best for her students&wants us to enjoy the material
Good

I like his lectures and he explains stuff fairly well. However, I've noticed some of my peers say he does not explain anything, which I am confused. I think if you pay attention to the class, you will be okay for the tests.
Very human professor. I liked the lectures and found them very close to what was covered in the text. He makes very, very clear review guides for each exam, and they're not hard to do well on.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class was overall meh. I wouldn't really recommend it unless you're wanting to learn some basic MATLAB and elementary numerical analysis. Theory was mentioned but not explained well and I found that the professor was somewhat lazy. It doesn't really matter though since I believe he's moving to a different school next year.

I think the class is a little misleading. You don't really end up learning much, just how to code in MATLAB. Unfortunately, the homeworks and exams are night and day different in topic from each other, so you'll need to attend lectures to truly understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you're taking M211 Calculus, take it with Christopher Felder. He does a great job of lecturing and accommodating to students when necessary. The class is hard, a lot of homework and 3 midterms. it's only because Calculus in general is a difficult course but I believe Professor Felder does an amazing job with trying to make the class manageable.

Overall, solid professor, he rounds at the end if its above 0.5 to the nearest whole number. this class was not the easiest though and he did have a lot of homework. had to teach myself a few times but he tries his best. dont reallt understand the hate but maybe hes changed

lowkey dude should be a student himself, he gets something wrong every single lecture and relies on other students to correct him. other than that, he is an OK calc professor - better than others. a lot of homework to do but you get 5 mercy passes. overall, he is a good guy and posts lecture notes for every class
I personally loved Dr. Felder, if you actually go to class and participate you will love him too.

He gives a lot of Edfinity homework but I honestly found it helpful. He didn't take attendance so if I felt comfortable with the material that day, I skipped. He wants his students to do well and honestly was a pretty good professor to have M211 with.
Tests arent hard but the lectures are super boring and you have to go to all of them because there are random pop quizzes that you cant really do if you dont go to class.  Only A- i got freshman year
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Is not good at explaining and is very hard to understand. The exams and homework are very different from the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I didn't find this class too difficult because I had taken calculus before but I will say if you are someone who struggles learning math, you should probably go with a different professor. The homework also was sometimes different than what we learned in class.

I don't remember have to spend lessons on economics before when I took calc in high school. I learned marginal cost and equilibrium in in AP microecon, not calculus. His attendance is random pop quizzes worth 2 points each, but it's not a big deal if you miss. His homework makes no sense, and there's not many guidelines in the notes if you're lost.

I think that the other reviews on Dr. Felder are harsh.

A calculus lecture is never going to be particularly interesting, but Dr. Felder goes as slow as he can within a 50 minute lecture and works to make sure that everyone is understanding the material. He answers questions and also always stays after class to help.

Exams are also not that hard.
HE DOESNT EXPLAIN ANYTHING. REALLY BAD AT REVIEWING. SUPER FAST WITH NOTES. DOESN'T TEACH ALL ASPECT, HYPOTHETICAL, AND CONFUSING.
Worst Math professor ever! Avoid at all costs. Has ridiculously hard tests compared to the department exams.

Professor Felder comes off as a very nice guy but I just don't think teaching is for him. If you don't have to take him please don't. He expects you to know everything after one example and stated multiple times that a class average of 45% was pretty good. Again, very nice but please stay away.

He frequently shows knowledge of the content, but that's where it stops. Rarely does he explain anything, when asked questions he ridicules you, and he assumes you understand the concepts after one example (if you are lucky enough to get one). I learned everything on my own outside of class with other resources, his lectures left me more confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seems to be a kind man but when it comes to teaching he does not believe in explanation but he believes in understanding. He will tell you for example the history behind a certain equation and will leave you to figure out the rest on your own. I learned the material on my own time, and always needed help. Everyone in my class greatly struggled!
His exams are beyond hard. All my friend's grade average is an 80% while his are 45% at most.
straightforward class.

Professor Orejuela is a genuinely nice guy. I took Survey of Hip Hop purely online on Zoom. Was it the most exciting class? Definitely not. Is that his fault? Not necessarily. I think the lectures were really hard to get through but the assignments are pretty straightforward. GAs are pretty lenient on grading and reasonable.

For an entry-level course, there is an excessively high standard. The professor is also very rude to students. He laughed at us and acted like the class was dumb when an in-class poll was structured incorrectly. He also wrote the textbook if that says anything, and many things he said in class were contradicted by other historical and academic text
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ignore the review that says this class isn't an easy A - it is. My only gripe with this class is that the prof. was a little @$$hat sometimes. Mostly you just have to turn a few things in on time (if you don't the class is super lenient), a bi-weekly quiz and show up to the Zooms. I didn't pay attention half the time and did fine.

very knowledgable and wants to help you succeed. class was discussion and lecture based so make sure to read and be ready to talk about it. projects through the semester that are fairly open ended and creative. easy to talk to after class and doesn't require attendance, just make sure to catch up what you miss. tests are hard though

A good professsor for any gen-ed class. He does fit in the stereotype of 100-200 level professors being insanely nitpicky/strict, but his survey of hip-hop class was a breeze. His zoom has random polls but easy to notice when they are happening, quizzes are easy and so were the assignments. TBH ignore all bad reviews, if you have him its an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His assignments make absolutely no sense. I feel like I spend much longer on trying to understand his assignments than I actually spend on doing them.  DO NOT take this as an "easy A" class. I would explore other options way before I took another class taught by him.

Professor Orejuela was an amazing instructor. He takes the field seriously and expects you to do the same. It's not an easy class but its doable if you embrace the challenge and communicate with him. I had a major issue during the semester and he worked directly with me and was very encouraging.

If you are not obsessed with every little detail about hip hop, this class is not for you. There is not much work, but that means there are not many points. Instructions on the work is confusing and seem like multiple assignments that were combined into one. In addition, he only gives you 6 minutes to complete quizzes which is not enough time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I hated this class. The content is somewhat interesting, however not for someone who does not care much about every single little detail regarding the hip hop genre. The papers and assignments had such confusing instructions and the GAs give absolutely no feedback as to why they graded the way they did. I DO NOT recommend, also the quizzes are hard
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Absolutely hated this class. There isn't too much work, but the work that is assigned is papers that have confusing instructions which make it hard to understand what exactly he wants from you. His expectations are way too high for a 200 level course. If you are looking for a laid back elective credit.. DO NOT TAKE THIS!!!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS, if you are looking for an easy gen-ed. I took this class looking for an easy-A to fulfill my requirement. The professor expects WAY too much from you for a 3 credit hour class, as well as the graduate instructors that grade EXTREMELY heavy for no reason. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Taking this class was an easy GPA booster for this semester. We would only be graded on quizzes/papers and at the end of the semester there was a ton of extra credit that boosted my grade from a B+ to an A+
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Didn't use the textbook at all, only looked at the review slides, and didn't attend class. He takes attendance so you have to be there; I would just record my desktop and go nap. Never watched any of my recordings but the review lecture (so maybe attend that). The night before your exam, do Quizlet flashcards. Biggest tip, do ALL the extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Every week, there is around 50-70 pages of reading on topics that do not relate to anything. The tests try and draw conclusions but make leaps from whats learned in class to whats taught. Assignment instructions never made sense so he had to change them constantly. Forces you to go to bars to watch live music. Overall, a terrible professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This guy is no joke. He''s incredibly smart and takes the class and your individual education seriously. I learned an amazing amount from him in this class. If you're actually interested in hip hop or ethnomusicology, take his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Overall a great prof. really knowledgable about hip hop, and I was thoroughly entertained and intrigued during the online lectures, I think he teaches the class well. Helped that I knew about hip hop before, but tests aren't too hard if you study the red in the lectures. Papers were confusing, but doable. Take advantage of the EC, goes a long way
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Orejuela is very knowledgeable and passionate about hip hop, and it shows in his lectures. He says to study the red font from his powerpoints for exams, but  I suggest reading the book that goes in more depth. Do the weekly quizzes, take notes during lecture, and don't procrastinate on the 3 papers! This is a fun online course and you learn a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Orejuela was clearly educated on the course topics. However, I feel he placed a little too much emphasis on details when I feel the midterm and final were mostly overarching concepts. Reading is pretty unnecessary for this course. Overall, an easy A if you do well on the assignments and pay attention to lecture.

I feel that this professor was very rude to most students. He does not make you feel comfortable asking questions in class and his lectures are all over the place. He also takes away 3 points for every absence and 5 points on discussion days. He also grades YOU based on how much OTHER PEOPLE talk during the day that you lead discussion.

WARNING! DO NOT TAKE THIS GUY FOR FOLK-101! Regularly this elective course is an easy A. There is proof of this in the IU grade distribution, however, with this professor this 100 level class is unreasonably more difficult than it should be. If you are not going to major in folklore  (90% of people) do not take this course with him. To much work!

This was one of my favorite classes I have ever taken. Orejuela is extremely knowledgable on the topic, and him and his TA's are always there to help. The essays aren't too hard, and I got an A+ on both exams. If you pay attention and study the red terms for the test, it should be an easy A. He also gives extra credit somewhat frequently.

You don't need to know a lot about hip-hop prior to taking this class. However, it definitely helped that I did. Got 100% in the class because he gives a few extra credit quizzes, and the weekly quizzes are quite easy if you pay attention. Tested material is all highlighted in RED on the slides. I didn't read the book at all

Fernando is actually quite rude and I did not feel comfortable asking him questions. He's also very strict on his grading policies so be sure to make no mistakes. I honestly wouldn't recommend taking this class unless it's a requirement for your major. It's said to be an easy A, but that's not true. The first exam is difficult so be prepared.

You have weekly quizzes 2-5 questions, so read the book it really helps and you should attend the online lectures for clarity. I recommend reviewing the material weekly so you don't have to cram for the midterm and final all at once. I thoroughly enjoyed having him he was very knowledgeable !

Really cool guy. However if you don't have an interest in music it might be very boring. There was an insane amount of readings for homework but I didn't read one. The papers are tough but it wasn't a bad class.
Really cool guy. Assigns an insane amount of reading. I didn't read one thing he assigned for homework and I did fine. The papers are long which wasn't fun. Definitely not a blow off class.

Pay attention to the items in red from his powerpoints- that's how he makes his tests. Overall, loved the class. Interesting subject and he made it fun. Lots of stimulating classroom discussion which is nice in such a small class.

He's very rude to students which caused myself to never ask questions. Lectures were extremely boring and somewhat unorganized at times. All important information is given in the powerpoints but you still have to "attend" class for attendance points. There were also only two tests which were both kind of terrible.
Class is a joke. Just download all the Power Points and read what's in red and you'll get above a B+ guaranteed.

I enjoyed the lectures, but there were too many writing assignments, in my opinion. He isn't very clear on when those assignments are due either... Otherwise, he is an easy grader and, while I didn't read many of the articles we had to print out, what did read was fairly interesting and he made discussions about the material very interesting.
Somewhat interesting, writes in red exactly what you can be tested over. Fairly easy final and midterm but the writing assignments were time consuming.
HORRIBLE does not care to embarrass students who get an answer wrong. Makes learning about Hip Hop a chore!
Unless you REALLY love all hip hop EVER made, the class is awful.  Super boring and hard to pay attention.  Unreasonably hard.  He doesn't grade any of the papers either, leaves it to GAs

lots of really dense reading. much harder than any other 100 level class. many writing assignments (that require "field reporting" activities on your own time) and weekly quizzes during the discussion. thought this class was going to be a lot more engaging and fun, but it was a little bland and difficult for me.

If you are evaluating him strictly as a professor, he's a very average professor. But I think my rating of average is slightly skewed due to the fact that FOLK F101 is hands down the most boring class you could ever take. Not a 100-level class, I recommend not taking it with other heavy classes as this class is a real burden on your coursework.
Great teacher, extremely helpful, awesome sense of humor and knows a lot about the subject. As long as you do your readings and study the powerpoint slides, this class is super easy

GREAT TEACHER. Keeps class interesting. Didn't know much about hip hop going into class, but got a B in the end. He types everything in RED on the slides that could be covered on the test so there is no reason you shouldnt know what to study. Highly recommended.

Horrible! Don't take a class with this professor unless you want to be treated like an idiot. His syllabus and assignments are not clear at all but he expects you to read his mind and know what he wants. If you have no prior knowledge or have never taken a Folk or Ethnomusicology class i wouldn't recommend taking one with him.

He is very knowledgeable about hiphop but the class is VERY hard for a 200 lvl. Only 2 tests&2 papers make up your grade&the tests are HARD. lectures are confusing at times & he doesn't seem to like student input on changes that should be made to the course. If you have no prior knowledge in old school hip-hop you might want to take another class.
Fun class, kinda rough midterm. Very nice professor though. Class online is a new concept to me, but its pretty cool. Easier for sched. since i can attend pretty much anywhere there is internet.
AMAZING!! Class is fun and easy. He is a great teacher and very easy on the eyes :)

Do not take COLL-E103(Youth Music Scenes)sounded fun but he is terrible at teaching it. You can't keep up with the notes and he won't post them on oncourse. As a professor,he is nice,but needs to be teaching something else that he actually cares about..no book for the class,you just print out tons of articles that aren't easy to comprehend
Good teacher that's interesting, understanding, and easy to approach...I had him in an online format which made it really nice and easy
This class was awful.  Way harder than it should have been, impossible to stay focused on watching the online lectures.
Very good professor.
So awesome...so hot!
You need to attend the online class. It was difficult to stay interested though due to technical difficulties.
Online class.  Should not have been as hard as it was.  Make sure you attend the online lectures.

Very smart and experienced, but the class can be hard to follow. Mentions his ambassador background often. Doesn't like grading and gives little feedback, which can be demotivating. Don't expect much support outside of lectures. You'll learn, but it's mostly on your own. as much as i loved his lectures I dislike his manners toward students

Like the other reviews, Istrabadi is a very qualified professor, homie has his own Wikipedia page. He isn't teaching INTL250 for the spring semester and let's just say Amen. If you're a real nerd about INTL-L try to be his bestie, if not just go to office hours to act like you actually care! Sort of a hard class but his AI is an "easy" grader!

Professor Istrabadi is an extremely qualified professor. He does not care about the students. He canceled class numerous times, which made a mess of the syllabus. His lectures are boring asf which made it hard to even stay awake. I wouldn't take him if I didn't have to, but if you have to it's not the end of the world if you put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really wish that I could rate him well, but I just can't. He canceled 6 classes and claimed that we would make them up but never did. It took over a month and a half to return our first papers. The class itself is interesting but requires an expensive textbook that he expects to be memorized. I wouldn't take this class unless you have to
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
I was so excited to take this class. However, while it wasn't always his fault, he canceled class 5 times & we were only 6 weeks into the semester. This put us very behind on the syllabus, he said over the weekend he would find a way to catch us up, he never did. 
Again, this wasn't always his fault, but it makes it hard for students to succeed.

While the class is hard, with all of the homework, with the exception of 2 papers throughout the semester, being reading, it is a very note and reading heavy class. However, the professor is absolutely amazing and if you can take his course, I would recommend him 10/10 times.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Istrabadi is an amazing professor with all the experiences he has had in life. And he is obviously passionate about what he is talking about. But your grade was based on a midterm, final, two essays, and participation, and this class is not the easiest to participate in. Take the class if you are ready to work very hard on a few things.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor al-Istrabadi is a good professor. However, the course is graded on very few things. All of the grades come from essays. There are three short essays throughout the course and after explaining what they are, he will give you very little notice or remind you of when the others are due. Showing up to class is definitely important.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is by far my favorite professor I have ever had the opportunity to work with. Participation and consistent engagement is not only going to help your participation grade but also he tends to adjust your grade to reflect your effort in the course!! The readings can be dense but his lectures tend to break them down well and will really help!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I love Amb Istrabadi. He is definitely my favorite professor at IU, but I don't think he is for everyone. He really respects his students, his lectures are interesting and full of anecdotes from his time at the UN, and he grades fairly. Never had a textbook in one of his classes, instead, he picks articles for readings. Highly recommend his classes

Took INTL-L 250 with Prof. Istrabadi in Fall 2020. Respected professor that knows his material extremely well. Assigns quite a bit of difficult readings. Has high expectations for his students but grades fairly. Not good at communicating through email. Make sure to go to office hours for important questions. Takes VERY long to return essay grades!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Istrabadi is brilliant and an interesting professor. Lectures aren't always on topic and tend to ramble. Participation and attendance are large parts of your grade but he gives extra credit to balance it out. Midterm and exams are just one essay question. Three 5 page papers assigned, won't mention in class, keep track of syllabus.
She is so kind and works with you. Take her for all spanish courses
does daily participation activies, isnt judgemental on your spanish accent whether you're native or not. Provides clear feedback and is kind.
Class interesting, lots of discussion, professor approachable and helpful. 10 page paper to write, but can choose any topic in any Spanish work. Watched many films outside of class.
She is the best spanish professor I have had at UofL! She is friendly and cares about her students but you also learn a lot. She's from Spain so you will laugh a lot when she tries to speak English!

Great teacher! Makes the class interesting and fun! She is willing to help you if you need it. There are few grades in the class so if you don't do well on one of the papers or on one of the participation grades it can be hard to come back from.

super kindhearted and understanding! she is passionate about what she teaches, and brings many valuable lessons to the table. although her course is required for SPH, i would recommend her to EVERYONE. the reading material was equally as valuable as her lectures, and i feel like i learned so much more in this class than in any other class. love her

Tough Grader, but does offer revisions. Does not do exams, but does quizzes. Easily reached outside class, and is understanding to inconveniences. Has late work leniency. She often brings her dog to class, huge +. Respects students and encourages all students to do their best.

Dr. Feske was such a caring and respectful professor. She asked us to determine class expectations. Lots of time to get work completed but there was not much work at all. No exams but there were weekly quizzes. Weekly readings but not bad. If you knew what you were learning and talking about you're fine. Stress-free and amazing class and professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Fecske is a great person! Her class did feel like it had a lot of work but it was mostly busy work. All tests are online which is nice. She does in-person assignments so attendance is mandatory, but is made easier when she brings her dog to class. Overall is was a good class and she is a great prof.

Professor Fecske was a great professor. There were a fair amount of assignments each week, but most of them didn't take too long to do. She is a super fair grader, and is really understanding of any conflicts. Highly recommend!!

This was my first time ever taking a physics class and assumed it would not be so difficult considering it was an introductory level course. Often times I left lectures very confused and didn't know what questions to even ask. Exams were difficult. It seemed that he disagreed with the other professor on how to grade the class. No curve.

Herb is one of the most cold-hearted professors I've had. He has a fun-seeming personality in class, but he watched as 60% of his introductory class failed and did nothing. He failed us, but treated us like we failed him. He even went so far as to refuse his partnering professor's requests to curve the class grade. He wasn't communicative. Awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Not the best professor honestly. He does theoretical physics and so he often made basic physics much more complicated than it needs to be. BUT, his exam (the only one he wrote for the class) was super easy and all plug and chug. So attend class, do homework, and you'll probably do well on his exam.

At first i be like dayuuummm, graduate quantum mechanics?? But this hobbit size baller was all like i got you covered. Every lecture was like woah, except in a good way. Now it all makes sense now and i can tell all my friends i know quantum mechanics. Definitely up there on the hotness factor too

Field is fine, just do not use AI in this class at all, not even to gain more understanding of the reading. If you are a strong writer, she may think you potentially used AI, so just don't do it. Cases were fun to read, first quiz was HARD but final was easy. Just half pay attention in class and do the assignments bc there's no late work allowed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: super duper boring, easyish assignments, SUPER STRICT WHEN IT COMES TO DEADLINES (does not accept even reasonable excuses for late work- honestly ridiculous)
Overall a great person and professor. I would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Field has extremely long and dry lectures but the material was not bad. There were weekly quizzes on textbook readings that made sure you read it, and case briefs that can take a while to get used to. Not a ton of direction and wasn't super clear about some assignments but as long as you had the general idea, you will do well.

He was a very nice professor and you could tell he appreciated feedback that we gave him about assignments, but the classes were lectures and there wasn't a clear topic of what the lecture would be about. A lot of times, the lectures would be very redundant and he would give quizzes on them.

He genuinely cares about helping his students and cares about your feedback. He is a yapper, so classes can be hard to pay attention to sometimes, but it's because he doesn't settle for mediocrity. One of my favorite professors and he is very personable and passionate.

Had a bad grading distribution until our class had to read him his own syllabus and make him change it. Has no structure to what he is teaching or doing and grades assignments super hard for no reason. He made this class the most unenjoyable it could be.

Very nice guy as long as you aren't on your phone during class. He has 2 really big issues tho. 1. His lectures are really long over things that do not need that much time. He will talk for an hour about something that could have been taught in 5 minutes; it's hard to pay attention. 2. He takes an inexcusable amount of time to grade.

Doesn't know what he is teaching. Learned absolutely nothing in this class. Classes are no tech allowed and he just talks the entire time about nothing then gives quizzes on it. Slow grader, unclear about what he is looking for in his assignments. Lets you use AI for all writing assignments but I got worse grades on the ones I actually wrote myself

reviews.comment: Prof. Fisher has been my favorite professor at IU to date. He's one of those profs. that really cares about the intellectual advancement of his students. His assignments are geared towards real-world dilemmas that students may face in their business careers. Well respected and all around great guy. This is a prof. that everyone should take.

Great guy and will be using for recs in the future. C204 in general is kinda meh but dave is the goat. wants to hear your opinion and is willing to work with you to get the grade you want. wanted to get to know his students and cared more about you growing than grades (he gives almost all As). You only have 3 misses in class but has makeup work
He makes class so fun and genuinely wants his students to get better at public speaking.

Darren cares a lot about his students and makes the lectures pretty engaging. I liked this professor. Simple and easy class if you are looking to fulfill an N&M credit. You'll work with the people at your table every day and hoenstly gain some knowledge about the environment around us. Pretty fun class.

Ficklin was a great professor. Took this class solely for N&M case credit but I didn't mind having to go to lectures every week for the mandatory group assignments. Super chill professor and very easy class if you need the credit.

Dr. Ficklin is a great professor; he truly cares about his students and tries to foster a sense of community. Most homework will be completed in class outside of weekly quizzes. Otherwise, the class work is very manageable. If you are interested in a career in geography, I would definitely take this class!
Very chill professor. All assignments were completed with groups which was nice. Exams were pretty straight forward and easy if you pay attention.
Love him, readily available and wants to help his students. His lectures are fun, as fun as lectures can be, and his explanations are clear

reviews.comment: Darren is really chill, but he still pushes you to do really good work. I'd highly recommend taking his matlab course if you want to a really good introduction to coding within climate and geological sciences.
