reviews.comment: I had Darren in conjunction with Majed Ahkter for water security and sustainability. I think he is a great professor who is really straightforward in what he's teaching and what he expects from students. The class required textbooks that I barely used and there was semester long group project, but it was interesting and spaced out well

Would recommend Professor Ficklin to just about anyone. He's relaxed and is clear on what the course demands. Seems to like group projects so depending on your group this could be good or bad. Always there to help, and he really lets you decide your grade. If you work hard you'll be rewarded fairly, if you don't then don't expect otherwise.
Great professor, although I got stuck with the worst and laziest grad student in history to be my group partner. Just a bad situation for me. Take his classes though.

Take his class. He clearly explains the material, tests are open notes and book. Book is unnecessary unless you want extra info about the subject. He will give leeway on late assignments. Office hours are very helpful also.

She seemed like a nice person and a nice teacher in the beginning, however it slowly changed as the year went by. reviews.comment: My favorite professor at IU so far. She genuinely cares so much for her students and is so willing to help people if they need anything. Her class was one of my favorites, and I feel like I learned so much and a good part of this is because of her. If you have the option, you should take her class 100%
Elite Professor, the best I've had at IU so far, goat prof

YOU'LL BE MAKING A HUGE MISTAKE IF YOU DON'T CHOOSE PROFESSOR FISHER! She was one of the best teachers I have had in my life. She wants you to succeed and public speaking is such a valuable life skill. She also really cares about all of her students like they are her own children. I love love loved her and you definitely will too!

Fish is hands down one of the best professors! She cares about everyone in her class and is always available to help. Her lectures are engaging and help you learn a lot. She is such a mom to her student and most of the time she brings things she bakes to office hours so def go!

Fish is one of the best professors, I couldn't recommend her more! She genuinely cares about every student and is always willing to help. She's a fair grader, and you learn a lot from her class. She builds relationships with her students, so def go to her office hours. She feels like a mom to all her students, in the best way possible.

Really, really great professor. She genuinely teaches you true life skills, but also is just a really nice person and a helpful professor. Very understanding and truly cares for her students, would highly recommend.
Great! Highly Recommend
Genuinely cares about her students and is just a lovely person altogether. If you can, take her. The class prepares you for the future in a fun way and overall is a great time.
I took Prof.Fisher for D271. She was passionate about the course content (Doing Business in Ghana) and motivated us to do our best work! Definitely take her!

Take with her. She is very understanding and a great teacher. The class is a lot of work but it is beneficial things that you need to know. If you don't want a lot of work though don't take her, but she is a pretty easy grader.

I had her for D271 in Ghana which wasn't an option for this review but SHE IS AMAZING. Like seriously such a kind and understanding professor who made the class so much fun. Not a lot of work at all and you learn a lot about Ghana. If youre looking for a fun, easy and interesting D271 class, take it with professor Fisher!

I LOVE HER THIS IS MY GIRL. Best bus pres professor and an amazing human. Regardless of ur existing skills, she makes everyone a better presenter and business student. Fair grading, clear instructions, brings snacks to class. Maintains relationships w her students.
Professor Fisher was so caring towards her students and always made herself available if we had any questions.

Mrs Fisher is easily one of the nicest humans I've ever met. She truly cares about each and every one of her students and wants them to grow. I'd say her grading is fair - she clearly highlights mistakes and offers ways to improve.

Professor Fisher is one of the best professors you could ever have. She is kind, and creates an environment that allows you to feel confident. Absolutely take her for business presentations, she is amazing.

Professor Fisher made her expectations very clear from the first day. You will earn the grade based on the effort you put in and she truly cares about her students. Professor Fisher provides great feedback and wants you to grow and she establishes an encouraging environment to do so.

She is the most amazing professor I've ever had. She is so considerate and kind to her students. I had an 8 AM presentation class with her and she made me excited to go to class. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN. She grades pretty easy on everyone. get to know her during her office hours because she is a very interesting and helpful person.
Theirs a reason she's rated so highly...

Prof. Fisher is easily one of the best professors at IU. She gives a "mom" vibe in the best way: she's incredibly caring and wants all of her students to succeed, but has expectations and can be stern when needed. She provides great feedback on presentations, and is always willing to help brainstorm presentations. I highly recommend her!

Professor Fisher is truly the best professor that IU has to offer. If you get the chance, I would take her class in a heartbeat. She makes you feel comfortable while presenting and offers you all the help and resources you could ever need. She is an easy grader and makes it very clear what to do for each presentation and how to succeed in class.
Professor Fisher is fantastic. Fun and friendly, gives great presentation feedback, and isn't harsh with grading. Take her class if you can!

Professor Fisher is absolutely the best C104 professor out there!! She was so welcoming, and cares for every one of her students! I was so nervous for this class, but she made this class easy. She is so kind hearted and makes you feel special, 10/10 would recommend her for anyone!!

Fisher is one of the best bus pres teachers out there. She treats her students like her own kids, and she is the most caring teacher ever. Public speaking is hard for me, but she made it fun. I will miss this class, and I would definitely recommend her.
Spectacular professor, she actually cares about her students.

Such a phenomenal professor who truly cares about her students. This is by far my only class that I am excited to go to class for. She wants to see everyone succeed, and she really shows us how to grow no matter what skill level we start at.

Mrs. Fisher is a great business presentations teacher. I have a fear of public speaking and often freeze but she was able to help me overcome my problems and become a better presenter. I would be lying if I said I dont get nervous for presentations anymore but I definitely feel more confident in my presenting skills moving forward. BEST PROF!!

This class is the best class I have taken in a while. Professor Fisher makes it extremely entertaining and fun to develop public speaking skills. She makes me just want to give her a hug because she genuinely cares about her students and wants them to learn. 100% recommend taking this class, you will look forward to going, even when you present.

reviews.comment: I hate public speaking, and yet this was one of my favorite classes I've ever had. She is honestly one of the nicest and most caring teachers out there.

Honestly, my favorite teacher I have had ever. She loves what she does and this is shown through her dedication to making personal connections to each one of her students. She is super fun and caring and makes you actually want to become a better public speaker. If you are reading this, TAKE HER CLASS.

10/10 recommend Professor Fisher for C104. She is very caring and provides helpful feedback. She is happy to help her students with anything and is very understanding. The class was pretty easy. Just make sure you do your part for group assignments.

Professor Fisher is the absolute best. She genuinely cares about her students and wants you to succeed. As long as you put in the work you will do well and she is always happy to help. Definitely take C104 with Professor Fisher.

Maybe my favorite freshman year teacher (C104), gives great feedback and very easy to meet with outside of class. Can tell she genuinely wants you to succeed in class. As long as you give a sufficient effort on projects/speeches and don't fall behind on easy assignments, class is pretty easy minus some case competition prep work.

Fisher is a world class Professor! I could not recommend her enough for students taking C104. As long as you put in effort, she will reward that. She cares about all her students and wants everyone to succeed and become better presenters.

One of the nicest professors/teachers that I have ever met. She really cares about her students and helped me to become a much better speaker and presenter. Not too difficult but you will need to put in the effort.

Best C104 professor! She really cares about her students and will work with you so you can succeed in the class. The projects are the same regardless of the teacher but she makes class fun and interactive and isn't a super harsh grader. Love her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof. Fisher was my favorite professor this semester! She really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She is always available for help and gives great feedback on presentations. Fairly easy grader for the course as long as you put the effort in.

Professor Fisher is one of the best C104 professors and I would highly recommend her. She gives very specific instructions on what she expects and is a relatively easy and fair grader. There will be some group presentations that take a lot of time and work outside of class but I found this to be one of my easier classes.

Kathy is extremely nice and enthusiastic. She cares about her students and really wants them to do well. She seems to really enjoy teaching the class, and is always willing to help outside of class. She probably grades on the easier end compared to other professors for this class.

Kathy works individually with students to make sure they are learning the content needed in order to do well in her class. She is very open about when she has office hours and is very efficient and helpful when you come into office hours, either to talk about ideas for a presentation or run through a speech with her. Overall a great professor.
Love her class, it's not overly difficult if you put in the work
Best teacher Ive had at IU. Really cares about her students and is super fun.
Kathy is an incredible teacher. She genuinely cares about her students and gives helpful feedback.

reviews.comment:
If you ever wanted a professor who can teach finance, crack jokes, and give you life coaching all in the same class period, Prof  Fitter is your guy..

His stories are wild, his energy is unmatched, he drops business wisdom.   The advice sticks with you long after the class ends!  

 exams tough? Yes. so is the real world, he reminds you of that!

Professor Fitter is by far the best professor I have had the privilege of learning under so far. He is absolutely hilarious but also super successful and knowledgeable within the business world. It got to the point where people who had other finance professors had to stand in the back of the class because everyone wanted to learn from him.
Great prof

Professor Fitter is a MUST take professor. His lectures are easy to follow, very in depth, and he's always available for extra help and questions. Professor Fitter brings joy and humor to class every day that helps ease any stress or frustration with the course content. If you have the opportunity, work your schedule around to include his class.

Professor Fitter is by far one of, if not my favorite professors I've had in Kelley so far.  His lectures are funny and super engaging, and he really seems to care about his students' success.  Students in other finance core sections choose to attend his lectures instead of their own, which is a testament to how much students love his class.

F370 was my first finance course.   I was nervous it's my major and I know it's a challenging class.  Prof Fitter is the best. He sets clear expectations up front and runs his class deliverables just like in business.   On time, all the time.   He makes extra effort for office hours. Attending live lecture & practice problems was key for me.

Great professor. Advertises his LinkedIn where he posts (mostly awesome) market recaps and discussion posts. He has mentioned politics which I think is inappropriate and unprofessional. I would not think that a distinguished professor of finance would openly support the annihilation of the CFPB. Absolutely wild.

F370 is going to be hard no matter who you take, but Fitter is the one who teaches it the best. Try attending his lectures if you can, even if you have Rearick and Oakes. You will learn a lot more from him about finance, and it will prepare you well for the exams, which determine if you can major in finance or not (C+ final grade requirement).

This class is super hard, but I think Fitter is the best to choose from. He does this job because he wants students to learn, not that he needs money. He literally was retired and then people were like com eteach because we love you. Take it with him if you can, much better than others.

Fitter is one of the best finance professors at IU, he is both funny and explains concepts really. F370 is a difficult class but Fitter breaks it down pretty well so would highly recommend going to class even though attendance is not mandatory. He also goes over the main topics and problems in class which is another incentive to attend.

F370 is a tough class no matter who you take. At least Prof. Fitter made it an enjoyable class throughout the struggle. He seems stern from his demeanor but he's just blunt and is real. Despite all that, he does round up and makes the loads of content seem more fun if you attend his lectures.

F370 is hard no matter who you take, but Fitter is passionate about the subject and is a far better professor than the others. Really knowledgeable and does a good job explaining problems, also keeps the class engaged with jokes and other stories. Only problem is some days he would come hopped up off too much coffee and would go too fast in class.

Professor Fitter has so much knowledge with Finance and makes this hard class manageable. One thing I did not like about him is that it was sometimes hard to get ahold of him via email - he would either not answer at all or answer after days have passed with little information. Besides this, he was very personable and professional. I recommend.

He is the finance bro final boss. He has great passion for teaching finance and he is a very charismatic person. Today was the last class I had with him and I will greatly miss coming to lectures. Goodluck trying to get in his class before the slots run out, but if you do manage too, you're set for success.
While one of the hardest classes I've taken so far, Professor Fitter made it a joy to come to class each day. Highly recommend.

Fitter is a great professor for ICORE. His lectures are engaging and he is passionate about the subject. I started going to his classes because the professor's class I'm originally enrolled in (Oakes) is horrible. The difference in their teaching methods is truly astounding.

He is cold and rude when you ask for help, ignores student concerns, rushes through example problems making it near impossible to keep up, and only allows 1 "check my work". We don't even get correct answers on self checks and homeworks, even after the homework is graded so there's no way to know if you're doing it right during review. Abyssmal :(
Insanely good professor

Joe Fitter. Not to be confused with a PBJ or a PBR. He is the greatest finance professor at IU. Extremely knowledgeable, passionate about the subject, and makes the lectures as engaging as possible. You'll learn more about stonks from him than anyone else.

Fitter is easily your BEST choice for F370. Coming from someone who finished A306 with a C+, I never thought finance would be one of my highest grades this semester. However, Fitter does a great job explaining concepts, and will help you get 100s on homework. His exams are VERY difficult, but he's your best chance at finishing this class w/ an A!

The midterm was extremely hard and he did not properly prepare us for it. He's a funny guy in class but communicating with him through email has been extremely frustrating. He either ignores emails or responds in a very condescending, rude manner.

His exams are easily the hardest that I have ever taken in my life. I know a good amount of finance, and have held an internship at a top company (Citi). And yet, his exams are harder than anything I have encountered both in school and in my professional career.

I love Prof Fitter. He is by far the best finance professor! Although I'm not great at Finance I actually looked forward to his lectures. He is a great professor and is super respected throughout Kelley. I would go out of my way to take another class with him, def choose the section with him if you can!

As a person, Professor Fitter is amazing. His Gucci belts and humor will always make your days brighter. You can tell he cares for his students and is passionate about the subject. As a teacher, Professor Fitter could be better. F370 is difficult no matter way, but his ability to go through excel in class isn't the best and can be confusing.

This was a hard class, but Fitter explained hard concepts in easy to understand ways and made sure every question got answered. His office hours where he walks you though homework problems, which he often goes over his scheduled hours for is why he is GOATed. Also very funny and nice guy. He was as helpful as a professor can be.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Joey Fits is the goat. He always shows up ready to rumble and has some stories. The class itself is somewhat hard and will get ahead of you if you don't keep on top of it. Exams are meh but the homeworks will take a long time if you don't know what you're doing.

Joe is the best professor I have ever had! He is passionate about finance and makes you want to learn. He tells personal stories that apply in class topics to the real world, making it memorable and applicable. I wish he could teach all my finance classes.
Joe is the bomb. Super passionate about teaching and willing to help you through any questions/comments/concerns.

SPH-B310 

be ready to write. 
i think i wrote 2 papers a week, a 30 page final, and a "final exam" that was all writing and i did not get intensive writing credit for this class. Worst prof ever!
All exams are take home, the homeworks were weekly but very easy. You can miss 10/12 attendance checks which are random by the way.

Professor Finley is such a sweet person, but also a great lecturer. 318 is an interesting elective to take since you will learn about every drug. I would recommend this class 100%! This professor is so sweet and always comes to class with a smile on her face. She was very eager to teach us about each topic and you could tell that she knew what she was talking about. The homework is so easy and takes less than 30 minutes each week. The tests are all at-home and online. Loved this professor!

I personally did not enjoy going to this class, but that was due to not enjoying the content and the people in the class. Professor Finley was extremely caring and easily accessible by email. I enjoyed that the exams were online and open note but I did not care for the amount of busy work we had to do for homework.

reviews.comment: I recommend this class and this teacher to anyone who has the option to take it!! The class is not very hard, but I learned so much and it was really interesting. The teacher cares so much about what she is talking about and is very informative in her lectures.

This was the most interesting course I took last semester, and she clearly knows her stuff. This was the only course that I attended every single class. I would recommend this class to everybody. It is a very manageable class and she is the cutest and sweetest lady who really cares about what she is talking about.

Professor Finley has been great. Class is extremely easy and also you will learn a lot about every type of drug out there. Class has a focus on 3 online test. Also, there are 4 research papers and the final is a paper on the research papers.

Professor Finley's class was enjoyable and easy to pass (and do well in) as long as you do the work. There were a few papers, but they weren't super long and she didn't seem to grade them that hard. The hardest thing about this class was the tests because a lot of the material wasn't covered in lectures, but they're open book so it's not too bad.

She really knows a lot about this course and is very helpful and responds to emails fast. If you attend class it's a very easy A there's 3 papers which aren't too bad. There's in class activities that you have to be in class for but you will get 100% on them if you are there. Tests were online. I recommend her!!!!

Professor Finley is awesome! She is so encouraging and knows so much about her subject. Her lectures are pretty interesting, and the course material is easy. For this course, be ready to go to the lectures, complete the major project, and put in your own work for online days (most Fridays if hybrid)!

Kathy is very kind as well as an engaging professor. She can be quite lenient if you miss an assignment or even an exam if you're a good student. She knows her stuff and the material covered is interesting and helpful to apply if you want to be healthy. Most assignments are easy and not too time consuming. Fairly easy and enjoyable class. Recommend

ILOVEHER. sweet lady, very knowledgeable on the topic. there's 10 in class asgmts that you can only do if ur in class, if not you get no credit. They're easy asgmts typically from a video. Her lectures are easy to listen to and theres minimal hw. theres only 3 exams and are MC. she gives a study guide thats already posted on canvas. also 2 papers.
Prof Finley did well with this class online. It was barely any work each week and every assignment is basically just completion points. A very easy A.

Kathy is a wonderful person. She is very warm and welcoming. She encourages everyone to ask questions and to discuss topics with other students in the class. I enjoyed learning about my body and encourage everyone to take this class. It truly is important to know about your own health. Kathy makes it fun and interesting. Def recommend
Excellent teacher especially if you are interested in health. She is extremely knowledgeable about health and takes an interest in her students' health.

Kathy is a great teacher. She clearly knows a lot about health and expertly teaches it to her class. The class is all lecture, so it can get dry at times but most of the topics are interesting. It says you need to get the textbook but we didn't use it once. 3 tests and one paper the whole semester and they were all easy.
She is very caring for her students. Study for tests and you will pass.

LOVE Finley! She is a kind and genuine person, who is very intelligent in her field. She makes class fun and is always very lively. I bought the book but never used it because her tests are from information in her Powerpoints, which she posts on Canvas.

I really genuinely like Kathy. Grade wise, all you have to do is let her know what you are struggling with or what you want her to look over for you and she's there 100%. Really caring, answers questions thoroughly and quickly, even through email. Tests were kind of all over the place, need to "make the jump". But if you show up, you'll get an A.

Great teacher and very kind if you respect her and the rest of the class.  If you show up to class you will pass. If you want an A, you need to read the textbook for the tests.  Has in class activities on random days, so attendance is a key to get a good grade, but isn't technically "mandatory".  Would highly recommend for any health class you can
She's cool. All you have to do is go to every class, read the book or look at the slides and do the homework.
