reviews.comment: She is very nice. If you put in the work you will do fine. If you go to class you will do fine because she does random assignments for attendance. Read the textbook for tests. Do all your homework.
The exam requires a lot of reading. The class is extremely boring. Overall, I won't recommend her.
Worst class and hardest health class I've ever taken in IUB. Mean teacher and tough grader. Tests don't even cover information from the slides.
had a great experience, learned a lot. teacher cares. just come to class and it's not hard to do well.

Finley is hot and cold. At times, she's nice and fun, then other times, she's yelling and mean. She takes the class way too seriously for it to just be health, and her lectures are boring unless there's a guest speaker. The class itself isn't too hard but you have to study for exams, don't sleep, don't text, don't work on other hw, and you'll pass.

WORST teacher.She was incredibly rude,disrespectful,immature,inappropriate and unprofessional.Overheard her speaking poorly about students to the assistant and she treats her students like children.She snaps and embarrasses students in front of the entire class.The class material is easy, but not worth taking if you have to deal with Kathy Finley.

First off, she is beautiful and a good speaker, so coming to class isn't bad. You also get attendance points. Class is pretty interesting and if you just do the assignments and study a little for the tests you'll get an A or a B easily. Learned quite a bit about drugs also.
Grades hard. Good looking teacher but assigns ricdiously amount of arctles to research for the last assingment. Also, tests are difficult
She is a pretty good instructor and I enjoyed her class.  Pretty good looking as well.
Finley is a solid instructor, not outstanding, but I certainly learned a lot. Also, she looks a bit like Cheryl Hines from Curb Your Enthusiasm.

She is a great teacher! Always available for extra help. She grades her papers easily, gives extra credit attendance checks in case you miss a class where one is given, and curves her tests if the class does poorly. Make sure to study the powerpoint slides and watch the videos; those = all of her test questions.
Love this class. Finley is great and knows what she's talking about. Really worth while course, not hard, excellent teacher.
Easy class.  Pay attention and you'll do well. She's a good teacher, and actually works in the field.  Very knowledgeable on health topics.
Class was pretty interesting. Tests were kinda hard, but read the book and you should do fine. More info from the book than the slides on tests. She's really pretty sexy too.
My class with her was one of the most enjoyable of the semester. I enjoyed coming to class each day!
Prof was very helpful and easy to understand.  Attendance was not mandatory but we did have periodic attendance checks for 5 points each. Overall easy A

She is a nice lady, don't get me wrong, I liked her very much.  But this class was awful.  Tests don't cover notes or lecture, but rather obscure information from the book that is never used or spoke of.  Also, tests and assignments are never spoke of, rather just given or picked up on their day and never spoke of again. Most awkward class at IUB.
Great teacher-made leactures really interesting and I enjoyed this class a lot.
Interesting class, good teaching, hard tests
Awesome teacher. Makes the class really interesting.
He often made me feel like my questions or comments were dumb. He will call on random people to answer his questions. He seems like a nice person, though.

Will call on you then cut you off mid-idea to tell you why you're wrong without fully letting you flesh out the idea. Class does not want nuanced ideas, only obvious statements. "Blend in and agree" to get by. The professor is a nice guy besides this, wish him the best.
Learned a lot

Finlay was a mess this semester. He communicated with us less than 10 times throughout the whole semester. I have to take my final tomorrow and there are 16 ungraded assignments that date back to February, so I have no idea what my standing is in this class. He never uploaded lecture videos and rarely responds to emails. Do not take his section.

I learned absolutely nothing in this online class. There are no lectures or office hours. The grade is almost solely on discussions that do not help you learn the material. He suggests you only skim the EXTREMELY LONG readings to complete the discussion. Then, you are expected to know very detailed information for the final. Do not take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Finlay is unlike ANY professor I've ever had. He's a caring, inspirational and very driven human being that's willing to be straight up with you in a way other professors aren't. He cares more about genuine education, not boring powerpoints with dry information & terms. He teaches you to reflect on how real world issues affect society. Amazing.

Brandon is a super relaxed and approachable guy. He explains topics thoroughly and wants you to succeed. He gives a lot of extra credit. If you show up to class and take notes, you will be happy with your grade. There is no final, which is awesome. Only 2 tests and 4 papers.

Videos aren't very long especially if you put them in 2x speed. Homework and quizzes are super easy and he is very helpful and understanding. If you ask for an extension he will typically give it. You can tell he likes stats. He does do a lot of discussion post though.
I took stats with him last year. He shows you how to do the work in the assignments and is so nice & will give you many chances. math is so hard but it was the first math class i got an A in

this professor was really nice but he threw like 7 assignments at us during finals week to complete when we could've done them throughout the semester. all assignments are kinda hard because jmp is difficult to use and assignments are only worth like 1-5 points. lectures are just reading off slides that don't really make a lot of sense
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This class was so freaking boring. Do not go to lecture, attendance is not required. I have gotten absolutely nothing out of this course and it is all busy work. The software used is outdated and difficult to get the hang of. Also ironic how he is a biostatistics teacher yet, he is, well, a bigger guy.

He is not very considerate about the student's time and does not consider their courseload for other classes. He also does not follow his own syllabus. His lectures do not bode themselves for learning. They have way too many words in them. He just takes paragraphs from the book and pastes them into the slides. Lastly, his voice is not engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: very nice. very easy classes. good luck using jmp its kinda hard. liked the class up until he dropped 8 big assignments the last two weeks of the semester because he didn't plan very well.

This class was not extremely hard, however the lectures are pretty boring. You are only listening to him talk and are supposed to follow allow. The homework and exams are not that hard because he allows access to the internet and other resources giving you a week to complete them. He is also really friendly and helpful if you need anything.

The professor can go on to talk in the lecture for a long time. Making the class feel long but is helpful if when you ask for guidance. Is very easily accessible and will help you with the homework in office hours. Recommend going to office hours if don't understand to do homework he will give you the answer with guidance.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pretty hard to keep focused in class, his lectures are a bit long-winded and hard to understand if you miss anything; however, he is very accessible outside of class and will make sure you are helped if you need anything at all.
Amazing teacher honestly one of the best teachers at IU she would help all of use on our work while also helping us read if we slipped up a bit on a certain sentences.
The worst teacher I've ever had at IU. She lost papers from our class, never taught out of the book, and almost always showed up late. Avoid her.

Easily the worst teacher I have ever had at IU.  Her lectures were like listening to a nervous student presenting useless information for an hour twice a week.  Hardest grader considering class level. And when approached for help regarding class information, we never received straightforward answers.  You have been warned.

Worst class I have ever taken here. Extremely disappointed in the level of teaching. I was confused a wide majority of the time. Very unclear. The papers are a joke..unless you're really in to this topic, don't take this class, because no matter how much you participate, you will not get an A.

Amanda's awesome. She's funny and cracks jokes a lot, she likes to feel like one of the students. For her outlines, just write your whole speech out in outline format. Its not so much the content of your speech as it is the delivery so focus on that and you'll do perfect.

Amanda's an awesome professor. Really laid back and chill. If you ask her to look at your speech before you turn it in, you'll get a lot better grade for basically no work. When she says speech outline, she wants the speech in outline format. Great class, a lot of fun.

THE WORST PROFESSOR EVER! YOU HAVE NO IDEA WHAT THIS CLASS WANT. IF YOU WORK HARD ON SPEECH. SHE WILL ONLY GIVE YOU 30/50. SHE WILL GIVE 40/50 AS THE HIGHEST SCORE IN CLASS. SHE PROMISES SHE WILL GIVE YOU AT LEAST B IF YOU WANT TO APPLY FOR KELLY. BUT SHE NEVER DO THAT!SHE GIVE VERY LOW GRADE WHICH WILL HURT YOUR GPA A LOT!
She is an impossible grader. she just marks off points for fun and never meets with students.
Amanda was a lot of fun.  The class isn't easy so her lectures were good.

Professor Finn's class was VERY test heavy. I think the grading scale was 90% tests, 5% assignments, 5% experiment participation, and half a point of extra credit available with each unit. If you listen to all of his lectures, though, you should be able to do great on the tests!

Professor Finn was always able to help outside of class when I emailed him. I did this class through a hybrid course where we met once a week and he posted all the lectures online. The tests were worth 90% of the grade but were pretty easy if you actually watched the lectures. Professor Finn is always energetic and an amazing professor!!

Professor Finn is a really funny and interesting person. All the lectures were online and you really only had to go in-person for the tests. 90% of your grade is based on 5 tests and the extra credit adds up to only 2.5%. The tests weren't hard, and all the material came straight from the slides. It still requires some studying though.
This class was easy, but you are basically only graded on exams. I got a B on one exam out of 5 and my grade ended up as a B+. Only take if you are a good tester!

I was struggling and Professor Finn was willing to meet with me weakly to make sure i understood the concepts. Was very kind, caring, and willing to help. Only got As on exams after meeting with him. class was also enjoyable and easy to understand, you can tell he just enjoys psychology.

Professor Finn is mean, for a lack of better words. He basically degraded me in a email, inferring that I was a bad student and stupid. He sent me three emails at 1 am at night attacking me, telling me horrible things. I would not take this class unless you want to get bullied.

I never listened to the lectures. You don't need them. As long as you look through the slides, all of the exam questions are on there. I took this class for an easy A and it definitely was, so no complaints.

Dr. Finn was a good professor. His lectures were interesting and easy to watch. He only grades by exams, assignments, and research credit, but he does give extra credit. The exams are hard if you don't know the material but are very doable. I would take any psych class with him because he isn't a boring lecturer.
Dr. Finn is a really funny guy and clearly lays out what will be on the tests. This class was completely online and he spaced out the lectures over the span of a couple weeks
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i loved him as a professor. he made the class easy by giving thorough lectures, providing examples, and always answering his emails. i'm about to attend graduate school and still read over my notes from his class to refresh. they have been useful with the current job i'm at also; i'm a behavioral specialist at a middle school.

His lectures are him reading off slides so just put the videos on 2x speed, listen to see if he says anything that isn't on the slides like real world examples. Otherwise, tests are open note so you can just download the slides as your notes and you'll do well. He is super nice and I wish I could have taken a class with him in person.

Professor Finn is a great teacher! I was unsure that I would not do well as it was an asynchronous class but his lectures and assignments were all so easy! He sends a recording of the lectures every week, and also gives out many extra credits. If you need to take a psych class, take it from Professor Finn. 

P.S. he is hilarious

Prof Finn makes tests like 90% of your grade, and all you have to do is take the time to watch the lectures and take notes. I am not a great test taker but I barely studied after watching the lectures and I got As on every test. He didn't assign any readings , only 1 short easy assignmnet
Lectures are amazing, he knows how to make class fun. Super nice guy and really cares about his students, easily one of the best professors I've had.
love him! incredibly sweet man who always makes students smile!
Professor Finn's lectures are interesting to watch and he makes the class very easy as long as you watch the lecture recordings. I really enjoyed his class and I highly recommend him!

Love this online class!! Professor Finn seems like such a cool dude, I almost wish I would have taken this class in person.  Very minimal assignments, lectures are straight to the point, tests are easy.  Professor has a lot of cool stories about his life and seems like a very nice and interesting person--he drives race cars as a hobby (so cool)
Finn is the best Introductory Psych teacher

I would definitely suggest this class to another person or friend. You will be totally fine and receive a great grade as long as you watch the lecture recordings! That is key to doing well in this class. The exams (content all from lecture recordings) are really the only grade in this class, so it is important you do well on those!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took P102 this spring and I really enjoyed his course!  I did the online asynchronous and it was not too demanding at all.  He posts video lectures for all the chapters that are fun and easy to follow.  The homework is straight forward and he provides extra credit opportunities for each chapter.  Looking forward to other Psych courses with him.
Very easy class, nice professor
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There is about 1 assignment every two weeks that is about 10 questions. Tests are worth 90% of your grade, so definitely watch the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His class is one of the easiest class I had this past semester. Since this was an online class, his lectures were pretty much what he tested us on. There were no quiz, just homework, experiment assignment, extra-credit assignment and exam. His exam are also open notes, so as long as you prepared beforehand, it is hard to fail his class.

Notes were a strong blue with neon yellow, professor had monotone voice in lectures, made me fall asleep. Material covered was interesting, just wish I had a different professor. Emailed him to see what my final grade was, and he specifically implied that I can't do basic math in his email back. Very unprofessional and hope I never have him again.

Dr. Finn is one of the most laid back professors I've ever had. The class was seminar based and attendance and participation was mandatory. Overall the class challenges you and prepares you to read and understand scientific literature. If you show up to class you will pass!
Don't have a lot of points for opportunities but still a great professor.  Very helpful and accessible, and makes lectures interesting.  Would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Good professor, but you're graded on few things, so it's hard to support your grade if you do poorly on an exam.
Exams were open note (for online class) and was relatively simple, as long as you read the lecture slides and did the homework
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was the best professor I have had thus far. He solidified my choice in majoring in Psych. He is an amazing lecturer and makes it extremely interesting to learn. Fast email responses and does study sessions out of class and if you go to a lot/all of them then he will give you extra credit. Do the work and you will succeed.
best professor ever!!! definitely take p102 with him!

I took Dr. Finn's Psych102 class online and it was great! His lectures are very easy to watch and entertaining. He responds to emails very quickly and does not want you to hesitate to reach out. As long as you watch all the lectures and take good notes you will do well in the course plus he is a super nice person.
Please take him if you get the chance!! The most I ever have learned from one course!!
Lots of watching videos, but honestly, such a funny guy, so helpful and is very helpful with time conflicts. Best prof I have ever had!
Such an amazing professor!
Love Dr. Finn! His lectures were engaging and his commentary much appreciated.

Prof Finn was the best I have ever had. He cares so much about his students and did amazing doing this class during the pandemic. He explains everything well and if you reach out to him, he will not let you struggle. An amazing teacher!

Super easy if you show up and listen in class, might as well give away the test answers. Really awesome teacher, makes lectures interesting and super easy to reach out to for help. Solid 10/10 professor.

Dr. Finn has some amazing stories to tell, and his lectures are very engaging. His tests are clear and to-the-point, and as long as you study the powerpoints he posts and actively listen in class, you are guaranteed an A.

One of the best professors I have had. Funny and gives great lectures plus some extra credit assignments. He does a great job of meeting one on one with students if they need extra help. Grades are test heavy, but if taken seriously and with a lot of studying it is a decently easy class.

An easy class if you're familiar with basic psychology. The tests are multiple choice, extra credit is offered every section, & the homework is easy. His lectures are fairly interesting. For my class, eventually he made students email him to let him know they were in class in order to get the full lecture notes however, so attendance is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Finn taught me how to take psychology exams. I finished PSY101 with a C+ and thought I would never be able to major in psychology. After taking his course and with his help I was able to succeed in 102 and further courses. He met with me outside of his scheduled office hours to go over his lectures for a second time to make sure I understood!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Finn was pretty great but as someone who took AP psychology in high school I knew most of the material so I pretty much just coasted along. Exams are worth 95% of grade so be wary of that. But other than that he was very engaging and fun, but having it at 8am kinda sucked.

Professor Finn was one of my favorite professors on campus. He is intelligent, funny, and truly cares about his students. He tries to make the material as interesting as possible, and he really does want his students to succeed. I definitely recommend him as a prof.

Professor Finn is awesome! He's hilarious during lectures and just in general! He's a great professor and has great lectures! Don't miss your chance to take this class, iIhighly suggest it! It can be challenging but if you study and do all the extra credit ops you should be fine!!
Great person in general, very intelligent, willing to meet but is a very busy person, gives amazing feedback, office hours are great, much of lectures are on exams so do NOT skip them

He is really understanding and tries to keep things interesting, considering it was an 8 am class. He's really energetic and passionate about his job. He also has really interesting personal anecdotes he shares often. He's just really great! Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Prof. Finn was a pretty good professor. He tried to keep his lectures engaging and interesting. He also provided many examples for difficult concepts we discussed in class. His tests were pretty straightforward but definitely require some studying. Overall, his class was fairly easy and he offers a lot of extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Brilliant person in every aspect, always available to speak to outside of class. Lectures can get a little boring though, especially at 8am
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: very easy, lectures are a bit on the boring side. nice enough professor, though.
This class was very easy but he did not provide very engaging lectures.

Professor Finn is an awesome professor.  His class was challenging but rewarding because he expected students to contribute and actively think. I would recommend Dr. Finn simply because he cares about each and every student  and wants you to learn and take away information after class, not simply memorize things.
Dr Finn is a great teacher. His lectures are interesting, helpful and funny. He's always willing to help students who come to class and make an effort.

Professor Finn was an excellent lecturer and made it clear from the beginning that he would be there for students that need more guidance. His tests are straightforward, based mostly off the lecture slides. Show up to class and you will be fine.
Super helpful with anything you need clarification on, especially if you meet with him during office hours.

Professor Finn is THE BEST psychology professor I have ever had and most likely the best professor in general. His class is structured very easy come to class and listen and you will pass with an A. He makes it super interesting especially his section on abnormal psychology. If you get the chance TAKE HIS CLASS I promise you won't be disappointed.
Make sure to go to class! The book is basically worthless. If you are struggling, GO TO OFFICE HOURS. You will get the help you need and it will be worth it! Very nice professor!
Very, very clear about what you need to know for exams and a super nice guy. Exam questions are nearly word-for-word with notes. Go to class!!!
He's a really engaging and open professor.  Go to class, take notes in lectures, do the book assignments, and you should be fine.

Favorite Professor so far. Super easy class. Go to lecture and he gives you tons of hints for the test. Don't read the book. Just do the five online assignments (graded on completion) and put a little bit of time in studying the night before the test and its an easy A. The 5 test are scan-tron and no cumulative final!!

Professor Finn is my favorite teacher so far at IUB. He is extremely clear in what you should do to prepare and know for the test. While attendance is not mandatory, make sure you come to class to fully understand concepts and gain extra knowledge that is not in the book but on the test. He makes his class very enjoyable to go to as well.

Buying the textbook is essentially worthless - everything on the test is lecture-based. He is very clear in lecture, but the tests are more challenging than other P102 tests. Tests are 95% of your final grade as well.

Dr. Finn is pretty straightforward. Attendance not mandatory but stuff in class on test that isn't in textbook, and he tells you whats on test, or hints. Interesting enough lecture. Grade is of four scantron tests and four completion grades. Make sure you do the online completion stuff, or else your grade super drops.

Dr. Finn does a great job of explaining the material and the tests aren't too hard but you can't blow them off. Attendance at lectures are not mandatory which is nice if you want to sleep in but he does give test hints at lectures so I'd say attend as many as possible.
Very funny and personable guy. You don't even need to attend class he puts all his power points online and they already say everything. Study the power points for the tests.
His test questions are from the book and from lecture so go to class. He's boring, but not a bad teacher.

He's funny, easy to relate to. GO TO CLASS!!! I punted off the PowerPoints for the classes I missed and didn't understand the concepts well, but I food it easy to remember most of the details from the classes I attended. The tests aren't easy, but they're manageable. He's nice. One time I slept through a test and me let me make it up the next day. Do connect & the psych experiment participation. I like the way he says sorry
All round good teacher. Tests are pretty straight forward and lectures are well organized.
He's a bit boring, but not a bad class.

Professor Finn is a really great teacher. He's funny and interesting most of the time. I really didn't find his class or tests difficult, but I did take AP Psych in high school so that could be a factor. If you attend class and read the book a bit before the exam, you'll be completely fine. His tests are fair.

He is a fun, enthusiastic guy. He taught very well and as long as you go to class and pay attention and study for 1-2 hours before test, then you'll be fine. Also, be sure to make use of office hour if necessary, he's very helpful! Great professor! Don't understand those juniors who said his class was too hard!I took this class in my freshman year.
He's a good guy.
Don't take this class.. he speaks above your head considering he teaches a 100 level class.
The required text is easier to understand than he is. His lectures aren't as detailed as his tests
His tests are hard. Seems to be a bit challenging for a 100 level course!

What a great professor! This guy is funny, enthusiastic, and has an awesome Canadian accent. The class is ridiculously easy. I don't know what the deal was with the junior who said it was super hard, but it's not. I didn't read the textbook at all. Go to class, take notes, study for like 2 hours before every test, and you'll be fine.

He's very helpful if you go to office hours - definitely go to class even if you're tempted not to. Most of the exam material is from his lectures, class is easy because he posts partial slides beforehand and then fills them in during class, but also be sure to read the book!
His tests were way too hard for a 100 level class. He only brushes over each topic you are required to know. As a Junior, this is one of my most challanging classes I've taken. Aviod if possible!

Great professor, really made me feel like i could approach him with problems; which i did and he solved so much! Overall, just definitly need to go to class (IMPORTANT!) and make use of his office hours hes so nice and helpful
His lectures are clear, but you HAVE to go and pay close attention or you won't get good grades on the exams.  It's as simple as that.

Peter Finn is an excellent teacher.  This class is so easy, but I'm a psych major.  All you have to do is pay attention in class and read the chapters, and you'll get an A.  If you don't go to the lectures, you will be lost!! I recommend him if someone is looking for an easy p102 teacher!
Really funny and nice guy.. I enjoyed his class!
Great! guy. Period!
Great! guy. Perdio!
The best professor I've ever had!! His classes were fun and engaging. He is enthusiastic and connects well with student.
One of the best professors you'll encounter.

Fleissner is a kind professor and has a lot of passion for teaching. The downside to her classes is that she does not put grades in the gradebook. She also grades things based on a weird check point system so it makes it very frustrating to know where you stand in the class. Get ready to read A LOT (too much), write, and beware of hard exams!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Favorite professor at IU! She's brilliant, and she seems to love teaching.

I honestly liked her as a prof, the only reason why i can't give her a high rating is because she assigned us a FINAL PAPER AND EXAM. BOTH. she did the same with midterms. She was very nice and I liked her lectures but those exams are NO JOKE.

Professor Fleissner is extremely knowledgeable and will make sure you understand what she wants you to gain from a text. BE READY TO READ. seriously dont take this class if you dont like to read, as I found myself reading every single day for hours to catch up with the reading load. She is a tough but fair grader with loads of feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Fleissner is the best lecturer I have encountered in IU's English Department. The way she is able to peel back the layers of a book is remarkable and somewhat inspiring if you're really into literature! But that's pretty key, though: don't take a class with her unless you really like English. It's a lot but completely worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Fleissner facilitated through-provoking class discussions. Brilliant and engaging, she pushed us past our pre-existing ideas about Nineteenth Century American Literature, and she got us to see many classic texts in new ways. I would take another class with her in a heartbeat.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Did not like her at all.  Tough grader on papers and assignments.  No feedback!  Received As in all my English courses except her class!  Stay away or your GPA will drop!

Fleissner's great. She's a super lively person and lecturer. She's also super intelligent so if you're not REALLY  into studying literature you might want to watch out- things can get sort of heady in her class. Very kind person and takes a lot of interest in her students. Quite easy grader and gives super helpful feedback.

L202 Spring 07.  Amazing professor!  She tries to get the class involved in discussion, and she is always energetic, welcoming original ideas.  Not to mention she is absolutely brilliant.  If you're not used to English classes, it can be hard, so go to her office hours and she'll help as long as you're willing to try!
She's really nice and knows what she's talking about. Going to office hours definitely helps you understand the material and boost your grade. One of the nicest professors I've had at IU.
EXCELLENT. BRILLIANT.

The class was fun and she encouraged discussion. She really knows what she's talking about and is a very helpful person. You can easily go to office hours and improve your grade. One of the nicest professors I've had at IU.
Very difficult class, and not a great professor in my opinion.

Professor Flocke made a very difficult class quite enjoyable. She really enjoys teaching P250, and that comes through in her lectures. She's passionate and engaging in a largely technical and boring subject. She also tries really hard to spend all the time necessary on complicated concepts--which is really important in a class this complicated.

Professor Flocke's teaching is mediocre at best. She does not read the audience well and often fails to see from the perspective of her students. Her high ego and low self esteem shine through her controlling and inconsiderate behavior. Highly recommend not to take her classes.

The material in this course is difficult and philosophy majors are required to take it, which is not a good combination. She does a good job for what she teaches. She respects you so long as you respect her. If you must take it, do all the assignments yourself, three times over. I worked really hard for my A-.

Vera is an extremely difficult professor. Her coursework is hard, but that's not the worst part of her course. She is not great at answering questions and is very passive aggressive. She glosses over hard concepts and expects her students to pick them up immediately and if you don't, you're already behind. Stay away from her classes at all cost.

She clearly knows her stuff, but I usually went to the TA for help first bc they made more sense. When I took this class she was a newer professor, but man this class was ROUGH. All of her assignments are 90% or fail, and you have to be DEDICATED to do well. P250 may be better in-person, but this is the hardest class I've had so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Puts a lot of effort into the lectures and other recorded videos to help students understand topics. There's lot of homework questions but lecture is us going over the homework problems before they are due. Students present answers to problems and we learn from there. If you don't get an A on 2/3 of the exams though you can't get an A which sucks.

Amazing professor. Succeeds at creating disciplined students of logic. Her class is a ton of work, but the material isn't that hard. She is also refreshingly clear about what she expects. Goes over problem sets in class before they're due, so HW is easy. Spec grading is unfortunate though. Still, if you study, you will pass the exams.

WE ARE IN A PANDEMIC taking this online. The exams is out of 25 and you can miss 2 points MAX to pass. It's an A or B- (or lower) and nothing in between. You can invest so much just for the bare min in this class and your grade will NOT reflect the work you put in. You can get an A on everything and a high B on all exams and you'll finish with a B-
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have not seen any bad prof like her ever! she makes every single philosophical concept hard. She has a weekly assignment. her grading system is the worst ever. grading every work based on pass/fail is not a bad idea, but it is the most stressful when she makes pass to be 90%!!! DONT TAKE THE CLASS WITH HER.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I signed up for this intro class because it gives me a break from business and sounded interesting. Prof. Flocke makes it unnecessarily hard considering it's an intro class and should be avoided at all costs. IU GenEds are easy for the most part but this class was so difficult and consumed so much time that it is not at all worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is designed to be almost impossible to pass unless you have been studying logic your whole life. I have never been more stressed out by a class and would avoid taking it at pretty much all costs. The material itself is already hard enough to understand, but even harder when you aren't being taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs. She's a new professor who is clearly trying to figure things out, but a 90% is considered a passing grade and anything below could kill you. Flipped class format is ineffective.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is so sweet and really cares about her students. She's a native speaker so that really helps with learning the spanish language. Participation and attendance are both very important. Lots of activities with the textbook. Bottom line is that it's GenEd class, so at least she makes do with the material she's given and makes it fun and inviting.

Florencia is a sweet teacher, but she does not give students enough time to read/interpret many of the questions and prompts on the board, so as a result, only 1-2 students end up answering every question, every class period. Expect homework about every night, and know that even if you participate during every class period, an A is unattainable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She would ask for volunteers to answer question, so it was nice that she never randomly called on people. Attendance is weighted 7.5% so make sure you go. There was homework every night except for a couple, but it's straight from the book. She was really nice and helpful if you had any issue. I would highly recommend.

Florencia is a really nice Professor and student. She is actually really laid back compared to other Spanish professors, for example she usually doesnt call on people who dont raise their hands. Attendance points are taken and you can expect homework almost every night. Overall she is a great professor! I would definitely take her class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Great guy. Not too difficult, and he provides a lot of answers to homework in class. If you put in effort, you will succeed. Couldn't recommend him enough.

He's an amazing professor, so nice, and truly cares about his students. Homework and 2 quizes are on McGrawHill and are very manageable. There are two cases that were also pretty easy too. You don't have to come to class, but showing up helps so much and you get the answers to the in-class assignments. I couldn't recommend him more!

Great professor who truly cares about his students. His application-based approach makes the material easier to understand and connect with. One of my favorite professors on campus, and I highly recommend him. If you struggle, just ask—he's always willing to help and makes himself available to everyone.

He is super nice and cares about his students. He encourages questions in class. Attendance isn't mandatory he only takes occasionally and it's to make sure students are okay and coming to class. You need to go to class to do well in class though. There is light homework and final is a project.

Attendance isn't needed but he gives you answers to assignments in class so just show up. Two cases aren't bad and the online quizzes aren't hard. It's a summarized version of Financial & Managerial Accounting so the class is basic. Attend, do the homeworks, and understand the different pieces of the case then you'll do well on the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Shaun Fleener is literally the best professor I have ever had
very kind professor however I really struggled in the course and test are worth most the grade, if you have him go to office hours and pay attention!
Prof. Fleener is probably one of the best professors in the accounting department tbh. Makes the lectures engaging and tells you what you need to know.  All around good guy.

Without question the best professor I've had... ever. Caring, knowledgeable, much more. Made accounting for non biz majors highly understandable and even fun. Lots of real-world application used in class. Attendance not mandatory but you WILL do poorly if you don't show up, much of homework/exams are from in-class presentations. Take Prof. Fleener!

Really awesome professor! Very nice and actually cares about the class. I came in with zero accounting knowledge but an interest after taking K201 and I'm happy I took it with Fleener over any other professor. Sorta test heavy, each midterm is 10% and each final is 25%. He walks through the assignments so id recommend actually going!

Truly an amazing professor and my favorite during my four years at IU. The class requires a lot of work outside of lectures to really understand the material, but it is clear that he genuinely cares about his students and makes an effort to get to know each of us individually. I really appreciated the time I was able to spend in his class.
Was very encouraging and cared about student's success. Always available for office hours. Exams accounted for 70% of grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Go to lecture. He usually does in-class assignment homework with you in class. He makes sure to give examples that you can relate and understand and he just genuinely cares about students. If you can take him for accounting it would be a mistake to choose not to. He frees up his time and works with your schedule if you need to see him and get help.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you can take him, DO IT! Attendance wasn't really tracked but trust me you want to go to his lectures. As someone only minoring, I didn't know Kelley had professors who cared so much about students. He goes out his way to make sure you know the materials and will sit you down and help you understand it but not in a way that makes you feel dumb.

Shaun is the best professor I ever had. He truly cares for each and every one of his students. The energy and enthusiasm he brings to class is unmatched, and all of his lectures are packed with incredibly usefuly information. If you have the chance, take one of his classes - you will be glad you did.
Very informational and willing to help if student did not understand a topic. Was able to relate to students and adapted to ways of learning that was easiest to the student

Shaun is amazing as long as you PAY ATTENTION IN THE LECTURES!!!! Do the textbook homework and chapter assignments, and you'll be fine in the tests, they are basically from the lecture slides. If he knows you are working hard to get a good grade in the class, he will provide you with every resource that you need to excel.

Mr. Fleener was an amazing professor. There are two homework assignments per week plus a longer assignment at the end of every chapter. He says that the textbook homework is mandatory, but honestly you can do great in the class without it, watching the textbook videos is substantial. Tests are straight from homework or from the slides in class.

Good person, truly cares, and explains material in a way that just makes sense. Professor Fleener gives a lot of practical life advice throughout the semester and is definitely a funny guy. The material can be difficult at times, and exams are a large chunk of the grade, but I highly recommend taking this class. Show up and listen and you'll pass

Professor Fleener was very helpful throughout the semester and cared about each individual student even though he had hundreds. He always ensured the material was understood before moving on and wanted every student to succeed. Overall, I would love to have him again and recommend him to other students.

Professor Fleener has been great in this class. The material is very hard but he explains it in a way that is very understandable. The class is heavily test based so if you mess up on a couple of tests, you might be cooked. His slides include some great visualizations that helped me understand the material. Overall great experience.
Good teacher and good person

Fleener is a nice guy but a bad professor. He gives lots of homework, gives poorly constructed lectures, and is very old school. He has a very monotonous tone of voice and his lectures can be overly generic. He uses examples from his past jobs to explain topics but they don't help explain the course concepts very much. Avoid him if possible.

Amazing guy. If you are strong in the basics of managerial accounting, this class will be a breeze. All of the quiz and exam questions are from the slides. If you go to class and listen carefully, you will have no problem getting a good grade. Also, he gives a lot of valuable practical advice. If you're ready to learn, you won't regret this class,
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: made mjor mistake joining lab. not someone you'd like to kno. no care about students only money
One of the worst professors to work with in the Chemistry Department.

Very sarcastic-- you can tell he loves what he does. Material is explained relatively clearly. You need to make sure to keep up with the book, will help clear up the grey areas, and there will be some. Office hours are not as helpful, unless you have 30 min to get one question answered. He likes to give a lot of logic with his answers.
Good teacher, sarcastic attitude but a very good at delivering the material.

If you have the opportunity to have him as a professor, do it!! I love love love his class. He is thoughtful, and very informed in any topic regarding education. He grades fairly, and accurately, and is very friendly and open to student feedback.

I loved David! He is a clear and kind in his grading, and really wants his students to succeed. He is a very chill and outgoing guy, who is very approachable. If you have the opportunity I would definitely take his class!

Flinders is the bomb. One of the only great professors in the education school. Don't miss the opportunity to take his class! He's goofy, chill, and knows what he's talking about. You will learn a lot from him!
He really helped me when I needed it. I think he's a great guy.
One of the greatest professors I've ever had at IU. Just a profound sense of the classroom and how to engage students.

Proffessor Fort is a wonderful teacher and person. While this class was very easy and I wasn't all that interested in what we covered, I enjoyed having Fort as a teacher and hearing his stories of his impressive past. Grade consisted of some weekly readings quick discussion posts after, one presentationand a final research paper. Easy A

Professor Fort is probably the best professor I've ever had. His attendance wasn't necessarily "mandatory" but there was a participation grade for class. His lectures are amazing, he cares about what he does so much, and is so engaging. He gives a ton of great personal stories. There is not much homework, and I found it relatively easy overall.

Fort's classes are graded off of three papers with one being 50% of your grade. The textbook he uses is also written by him and his lectures are essentially a mirror image of what is written. Fort is not a bad professor as a whole, but you should probably take ethics with someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Professor Forts White Collar Crime and Corporate Ethics class as an elective for online MBA. The class was not that difficult but was still very interesting. Professor Fort is very knowledgeable and gives examples from the real world or his life experiences. I will look for his classes when registering for electives in the future.

Tim is a really solid professor. He cares about his students and is very knowledgable about business ethics. He is very established in the field. This being said he has high expectations for his students. Grades fairly tough. Find a friend in class because the projects/papers are a lot of work on your own. The class is OK overall.

Professor Fort is one of the best professors that I have had at IU. He has many good stories to tell about his experiences with business ethics and does a very good job at keeping the class interesting. As long as you are engaged and participate every once in a while you should do well in the class!

Professor Fort is very kind and extremely knowledgable on what he is teaching. He uses great examples and the exams are fairly easy if you pay attention, and they are all open note!  He's a great person to know, so try to take his class!

Professor Fort is one of the best professors I've ever had. He is not looking stress you out by overloading you with work. He gives a fair amount and explains everything very thoroughly. He is very open to suggestions about how his class runs and always keeps the environment fun with lively stories that relate to the material!
Amazing Professor, but she played with the first honors exam (beware of that).

Beth is such an awesome professor. Class is really interactive & engaging and the in-class activities are great bonding moments with your team. She brings a lot of energy, explains the material well and preps you thoroughly for exams. No busy work but cool consulting-style projects instead for HW. If you have her for I-Core you're golden!

Beth was truly a kind, intelligent, and humble professor. She really feels passionate about what she teaches and wants to relate to the concerns of her students as much as possible. That being said, the class itself can be a little difficult, especially for the simulation. Overall a fantastic professor for a relatively tough class.
Beth is one of the nicest professors I've encountered at Kelley. She is so kind and you can tell she really wants you to succeed!! Seeing Beth always made my day better.

Beth is one of the best professors I've had. Her energy is extremely contagious; it can be seen throughout the classroom with the amount of student participation. She takes the time to provide feedback that allows students to learn effectively through assignments and projects. Above all, she cares immensely for all her students and checks in often.

Prof. Fossen is an outstanding professor, especially for marketing. She's incredibly engaging, energetic, and knowledgeable, and her assignments are very applicable and relevant. The assignments take time and are challenging, but involve interesting companies and industries. She also takes time to give feedback on work. Exams are challenging.
Super nice and an easy grader. Really wants her students to succeed. Take her if you can you will not regret it. 100% best English teacher at IU.
Foug is such a great professor, she gives clear criteria for her grading, and you will enjoy the class a lot and your writing will improve a lot.
Foug is a dawg. Overall great professor and gives good feedback. Would reccomend.

Foug is an amazing professor when it comes to helping you and inspiring you to write papers. The class is heavily based on essays but is very helpful with her feedback. She lets kids know what they need to do to fix their essays. She is strict on deadlines but will work with you if you need it. SUBMIT ON TIME.

P155 is a horrible class to take BUT TAKE IT WITH KAYLIE. She is the only reason I did good in this class because she actually took the time to help her students. She isn't the main professor so she doesn't control the criteria, but she makes it so much more manageable and genuinely cares about her students. Will forever be one of my faves
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is an honest grader. Her rubrics are clear, and she grades based on quality, but if you try hard, pay attention, and use the materials given, you'll be fine. She is very kind and open to suggestions for the class. She is much better than other public speaking profs I have heard about.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I loved Foug! She was kind and cared a lot about her students and what she taught. She is a bit of a harsh grader and sometimes the assignment criteria aren't super clear. But I really recommend going to her office hours, she is super helpful and this will boost your grade, especially for the speeches.
Probably the biggest nerd you will ever meet when it comes to English composition, a good instructor overall. Tough grader, however, put in the work and you'll do just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Very good at giving advice, but expects a lot out of students when it comes to essays over topics that are typically foreign to new students
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Easiest class ever. Simply just cares for her students and wants them to succeed.
Stress Prevention & Management online. Used cengage. Super nice, caring lady, made the class as easy and stress free as possible. Such a kind lady and one of the nicest professors ever.

Certainly an interesting experience, but not like any traditional class I've ever taken. Chill, funny, easy to talk to, and a very eccentric personality. Good crazy aunt energy! More emphasis was placed on open discussion then grades. I more or less went to class to listen and not because I feared for my gpa. Overall a really good time.
Best professor ive ever had. Gina is super funny and makes class enjoyable . I have learned so much from her this semester. Give this woman a raise

Loved loved loved this professor and this class. As a sophomore, she made me feel very welcoming in the class and course as I had just recently changed my major to something in the school of public health. I definitely recommend taking this course with her!
She's funny, but to the point of being annoying. Good human but bad instructor. Treats everything as a joke. Didn't learn much but got an easy A, so hey! Pad your GPA with her!
Dr. Forrest wants you to do well and get an A! Definitely take her class.

Gina is such a caring professor. She doesn't make her class assignment heavy at all and has been extremely understanding during COVID. All she wants is for you to take something away from her course. She's very knowledgable and makes class entertaining. If you can take a course with her, do it.

Gina is by far the best instructor I have ever had at IU! She is very hilarious, caring, and is in touch with the real world! She gives amazing advice and cares for her studies truly! I would HIGHLY recommend taking her class and it is an easy A. (just do the little work she requires)

She doesn't see the point in buying textbooks knowing you won't use them. She's very caring and understanding if there are life conflicts with her class. she's a great person to go to for advice as well and she's funny! She knows how to keep the class entertained. Love her!!
No homework ever. Only attendance points. She is the funniest person ever. Highly recommend.
Too hysterical. Easy class though
Gina is hysterical but lectures well. She uses humor to grab your attention. She makes the class funny and interesting. Definitely take her if you get a chance.
Only grades are attendance, some documentaries, and weekly quizzes. Very easy class and Gina is very funny.
Legendary professor. The greatest I have ever taken. Such an incredible person.

Brian is such a kind professor. The class is very easy and I ended up getting over a 100 in the class. He does "projects" but they are very easy and require minimal time and effort. He is very passionate about what he teaches and he definitely likes an engaged class. He will give extra credit randomly if you just show up, so I recommend doing that.
Super genuine teacher. Cares about his students. One of the easiest A+'s ever.

Easiest class you will ever take. I finished with 105%. He offers tons of extra credit, and the in class assignments are very easy. He doesn't take attendance but sometimes he offers "pop up activities" to see who's really in class. The last class before thanksgiving he gave everyone who showed up 30 extra credit points. Cancels class very often.
Professor Forist is the best!! He cares about everyone, even though his class sizes are big.
He is amazing and I strongly recommend that everyone at least meets him once or twice! Love this man.

Best professor I have had at IU so far. He is so funny and makes sure to engage with students. When you are in his class you can relax knowing you can destress for the hour the class goes on. He is a genuinely nice person and an amazing professor. If you need an S&H credit or just want to take a fun and not stressful class take R200
Loved this professor so much. He gave lots of extra credit opportunities, super fun course content as well.

Simply put Brian is one of the sweetest professors you'll ever have.The class has no note-taking, no quizzes/exams, just easy assignments and 3 main projects which are basically middle school level work. Class does a get a bit boring from time to time but when you go to his class you know you can rest easy and just have a good time tbh. LOVE HIM!!!
Professor Forist is amazing! The class was fun and involved going outside on lovely days to do easy activities. He is an easy grader and wants the class to be fun!
A great professor! Super nice and caring! Very passionate as well!
He's so nice and if you need any help or just want to talk, he'll happily do it.
Mr. Forist is simply the GOAT. Enough said.

Dr. Forist is such a genuinely kind and empathetic professor. I had him for a completely online course and for the first time ever I wish I had to go to class. He creates a safe and inclusive environment and he's just so sweet. I really recommend taking a class of his.

If you take a class with him, I promise you will get an A. The easiest class that I have ever taken at IU (and I took the honors verizon). If you want an easy class that is a break in your schedule, I would highly recommend, but also, you do not learn that much in his classes and can get a little boring.
Great professor. Great class.

brian has a lot of fans, but i'll be honest: integrated resource management with him wasn't valuable to me. to be clear, he is so lovely and kind and funny, but i learned very little. he loves to use experiences as teaching moments, so there are some field trips. maybe this just isn't the class to take with him? def an easy A but nothing special.

professor forist absolutely changed my life. he is incredibly kind, caring, funny, and genuine. his classes focus more on real-world events and lessons that are applicable to more than just the course. his projects discuss many topics that some professors and instructors are too afraid or hesitant to discuss. plus his class was easy. TAKE HIS CLASS

such a great guy, truly cares about the wellbeing of his students. he is so fun and kind, gave really great assignments, and allowed for an escape from my other stressful classes. definitely get to know him, as he is a wonderful human being. go blue!
Amazing professor!! 10/10 recommend. He cares about his students, has a great sense of humor, and makes lectures interesting. If you are able to take one of Brian's courses, please do.
Perfect

If you have the chance to take health and happiness, DO IT! Mr. Brian is amazing and cares so deeply about his students. The class is very easy and fun-- take advantage of this. I have nothing but great things to say about this and him, plus I recommend this to everyone I know. P.S. there is an honors section offered for this course!
Easy credit course! No reading(no books or a lot of text). Love his energy and is so welcoming!
He is really a great teacher. He cares about his students. Assignments are very easy there are 4 projects but they really aren't that hard at all. I recommend this class!!

Brian is awesome. I took his IFS class Happy Hoosiers and I had an amazing time and I learned a lot. I am definitely hoping to take a class with him again. He was very chill and honestly makes learning fun. This class was online the first 2 weeks, but it was so great!
Great prof. Very laid back. Make sure you go to his class or you will miss out on a lot of points.

Professor Forist and his class made this semester so enjoyable, and was a breath a fresh air compared to my other courses. I'll keep this short and sweet and say that if you have the opportunity, I'm 100% sure that you should take one of his classes.

Dr. Forist is the best professor you will ever have. He is incredibly caring and treats you with respect if you do the same. He gives tons of extra credit and the "exams", quizzes, and projects are really simple and do not take up too much time. I learned extremely well because of the accessibility. BEST PROF YOU WILL EVER HAVE!
Brian is such a wonderful professor! His class was very easy to understand and you can tell how passionate he is about his students and what he is teaching.

I love Brian!! He really made my first semester enjoyable. The class work is super easy, and very clear on what's expected. Most of the projects and tests are created based on what students submit/create. He really cares for his students deeply. He also wants every student to pass by giving many extra credit opportunities during the semester.

Brian is a amazing professor and he really care about his students. He is very lenient with his grading and connects with each one of his students on a personal level. Class is very informative and there are plenty of elective activities that can give you extra credit when only required 5. Clear grading process and gives good feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The best professor I've had at IU, heartbroken I won't be able to take another course with him. Highly recommend, even if you aren't interested in the class you will take something of value away from his lectures.

Brian is one of the best professors I've ever had. He's kind, friendly, and so knowledgable. I learned so much in the class that I took with him, even if it was only two and a half weeks. He is such an interesting person to talk to, and I'm so grateful to have been able to take a class with him. He's a real gem. Take a class with him if you can! :D

Brian was one of the sweetest professors I have ever met! He is very understanding and gave lots of opportunities for xtra credit. The class was pretty easy but not boring at all. He is very engaging and makes the class super fun. I remember signing a sign in sheet most of the time but I don't remember if it was mandatory or he wanted to keep track

Dr. Forist is a wonderful professor and person! He is really passionate about what he does and you can tell he wants his students to succeed. I would definitely recommend taking a class with Dr. Forist.

This has been one of my favorite professors ever. He is so nice and actually cares about you more than school. Whenever I had a problem, he always helped me. Overall an easy class, just do the homework and study for the tests and you'll be fine.

Brian is one of the sweetest, most down to earth guys I've ever known. The stuff he teaches in class can sometimes be confusing as to why you're learning it (bc it doesn't seem important) but his positive nature makes classes worth going to
Very kind professor! He will absolutely work with you to achieve your maximum amount of success!

Brian is the best professor I've had since transferring to Indiana University. He cares and wants you to do well. He cares about the topics in class and can go into depth on various ideas. Brian Is one of the most interesting professors as well his personal stories help bring understanding to the class.

Brian is without a doubt the largest asset to the ORPHE program. He is kind, intelligent, and passionate about his work. I have taken a class with him every semester for two years, including an independent study my last semester of college. He is a wealth of knowledge and a compassionate individual. Taking a class with him is a privilege.

I will always recommend Brian to fellow students. Even if you aren't in the orphe program, he is worth it to fit in. The most genuine professor I have ever had. He truly cares and wants you to succeed. He is hilarious, the class is ALWAYS a joy. I wish I could take every class with him.

Brian understands the life of students. He doesnt make anything too difficult & gives plenty of notice/instruction on assignments. If you have a question ask & he will gladly help you. There are a lot of assignments, but you never will feel overwhelmed by them.

Brian is an amazing person. He cares deeply for his students and doesn't give tests because he knows people have test anxiety. I'm taking another class with him this coming semester and I'm excited to see him again. This is an easy A.

Brian shows a clear passion for what he does and for the students he is teaching. He is always so fun and energetic. Having spent most of his life in parks, he really knows what he is talking about and loves to incorporate that into the lecture. He is also really good about giving second chances.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests? Not many--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is amazing. Hes so passionate about teaching and his approach to teaching is different and effective. Hes by far my favorite professor at IU. Him alone makes me want to study parks and rec instead of THEM.

I have had Brian for a few classes now and I am 100% honest when I say he is one of my favorite professors at IU. He really does invest in his students and understands when things get rocky that a different approach might be needed for each student. I really respect him and look up to him. Totally awesome guy!
Brian is top notch. An amazing person, and cares greatly about his students and their endeavors. Participation in his class is very important to him. Best professor I've ever had!!!

He's really caring and a nice person, just not the best teacher. Not much structure to the class at all, we did random things that didn't connect to one another. Also the material taught is very basic. An easy A however, and an overall nice professor.

Brian Forist is one of my favorite professors I've had at IU. He is hilarious, relates well to students, and genuinely cares that everyone succeeds in his class! I love seeing him on campus. You don't need the book but checking Canvas regularly and coming to class are a must (I took this class as an 8 week course so we couldn't miss very many)

Niki is a freakin rock star. She is passionate about her field, and knows what she's talking about. She is super respectful of differing viewpoints, just be sure to participate! (Its not difficult) Gender and Media is super interesting, and a great class to take for gen ed credit!

My favorite Media School professor! She understands what is relevant to students and teaches social scientific theory in a clear, understandable way. I've taken 2 of her classes and I can only sing her praises. Would highly recommended her classes.

One of the best professors if not teachers I've ever had. She talks to her students in a normal, friend-like, but professional and appropriate way. She's understanding and truly wants to listen to student's comments and opinions.

I LOVED having Niki as a professor. She clearly knew what she was talking about (in terms of sex in the media) and truly wanted her students to learn. Class was engaging and interesting and I appreciated that it built up to a big project at the end of the semester

Professor Foster was really nice but her lectures got boring, instructions for assignments were unclear, and TA's did most of the work. The class was nice because there were no tests/quizzes so it was really easy.

She was nice but her class was really boring and her lectures were hard to sit through. I personally had no interest in any of the subjects in this class. The work she assigns is easy but toward the end of the year her assignments become harder and her directions get really unclear. TA's do all the grading so it also matters what TA you get.

Easy A. The class content was pretty nonpartisan which was impressive given the subject. The lectures were interesting and it was easy to succeed and actually learn while not taking much time outside of class.

Professor Foster is one of my favorite professors at IU. She really cares about her students and wants to hear what they think. Assignments include a lot of reading but are fairly easy to complete. No tests. I really enjoyed the conversations I got to have with Professor Foster and the class was very eye opening.

pretty easy class. no tests/quizzes/final and everything was posted online, and since participation didnt matter i only went to a handfull of classes. easy grader. id reccomend an easy gen ed blow off class
She made us look solely at her research and was a pretty boring teacher.

Prof Foster is by far my favorite professor! She taught a section of the ASURE program, and I do not think I have learned so much new & fascinating information before. She is very caring toward her students and really cares about the subject she is teaching. I think that the discussions were incredibly valuable and it was a great course.

Laura is a great professor and knows what she's talking about. I'd highly recommend her to anyone looking for a professor who's ready and willing to hear your opinions and give you new things to think about. This class was very interesting and all of the readings/lectures helped in understanding the main ideas.
This class makes you think in new ways. The readings are interesting, and Laura really cares about her students. The class is part lecture and part small group work, and always interesting topics.

Majority of the class is spent lecturing. Very long readings with equally as long quizzes that are in abundance. Makes you buy the book SHE WROTE (which is unnecessarily dense and pretentious) and then makes you take equally as dense quizzes over it all while referring to herself in third-person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She was very passionate about the class but couldn't really transfer that passion to all of the students. Would spend the majority of every class lecturing. Pretty nice and understanding, but is also a pretty tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Laura really cares about student learning and success. I learned to think differently and to think for myself in this class. I loved the mix of small group discussion and Laura's insightful lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is clearly very knowledgeable and passionate on the topics she focuses on, but the way in which the class is structured makes it so she isn't doing much lecturing and sharing that knowledge. 80% of the class time was used for discussing homework (usually reading quizzes) in small groups and the amount of time spent was excessive and unnecessary
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: love her. 10/10. so helpful in and out of class.

Avoid taking any classes with this professor at all costs. She is clearly educated in the field of gender studies, but would hardly teach. The majority of classes were spent in groups where we discussed the homework/readings, while she taught for the last 10 minutes of class. Also barely responds to emails and doesn't have a clear attendance policy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Laura is a very qualified person to be teaching a class on the intersections of Gender, Sexuality, Race, and the Law. Our class projects were challenging but entertaining and relevant. Course reading material was heavy and difficult, but she was very helpful in the analysis of the content. She's very reasonable and friendly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: My favorite professor thus far.

Doesn't have definite answers for most of the students' questions, but she expects us to have definite answers for the exams. Assigns a TON of reading and it's out of an expensive textbook. Made Lady Gaga and Taylor Swift videos required viewing. Talks more about race than gender and baits people into saying controversial things. Voice is annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Good at explaining course topics
Laura Foster was very nice and friendly. She assigns a lot of reading but it is manageable. The class overall was pretty easy. I would recommend her.

Her introductory Gender Studies class isn't too bad. There's a lot of reading, but most of the readings are very interesting. It's really just like any other college class. A tad demanding, but nothing too extreme. Laura Foster herself isn't particularly fantastic with her work, but she grades fairly easily and obviously cares about her work.

This class is only really difficult because she's teaching you to think differently and look at the topic with an open mind. I really enjoyed this class, the difficulty of this class really depends on the TA you have.

Worst professor I've ever had. She's condescending, but she also cannot articulate her ideas well. Papers were unnecessarily hard with a 2 page limit. Professor Fulton is an expert in the field of diversity workforce management and one of the best professors I have ever met at IU. I will definitely choose professor Fulton's course again if I have another chance.

Professor Fulton is enthusiastic and always made class engaging! The workload for this class was very manageable. I highly recommend this professor to anyone needing to fulfill the nonprofit management course.

My wonderful experience in IU. Prof. Fulton has a clear grade policy and makes the lecture an interesting subject for students. I highly recommend you guys to take this class. You will learn a lot not only about work, but also about life.

My wonderful experience in IU. I would highly recommend you guys to take this class. Prof. Fulton has a clear grade criteria and makes the knowledge an interesting subject for students. You can learn a lot in this "diversity" class.
Amazing professor! My favorite professor in SPEA.

From Day 1 until the end of the course Professor Fulton was very involved in the project and was always accessible to have discussions outside of class. Awesome and chill professor
Professor Fulton was accessible and gave thought provoking feedback. If a student had an alternate perspective he listened and continued the conversation which encouraged participation.

Dr. Fulton is a great project sponsor for this class. He gives clear objectives on what needs to be accomplished. reviews.comment: Dr. Fulton was one of the sponsors of this data capstone class. He is very knowledgeable and supportive. We worked with him throughout the semester on his current project. I worked with Prof. Fulton as part of a project for data science. He was engaged, helpful, and articulate every step of the way. Since the project's dataset was unique and demanding, his solid understanding of its nuances was critical. Prof. Fulton is sensitive to the technical side of things and was overall a genuine pleasure to work with.
Dr. Fulton is a fantastic, entrepreneurial, and visionary professor doing great things in study of the non-profit sector. He is engaging and invested in student work and is a pleasure to work with.

Professor Fulton is an engaging, available professor. Dr. Fulton provided excellent direction in our course. In his role as project sponsor, he guided our understanding of the field of philanthropy and provided us with the framework needed to succeed. He helped us work through choices on alternative approaches. He is very approachable. and cares about the success of each student he instructs.

Professor Fulton was my thesis advisor for the Honors Thesis Class (V499) and I couldn't have asked for a better advisor. Fulton is a great professor and advisor!

It was a pleasure working with Dr. Fulton in the DSIP course. Dr. Fulton is knowledgeable about the data, open to new ideas, and gives great feedback for improvement. The Project Sponsor, Dr. Fulton, is a leading expert in this field of research. He is very approachable and typically provides most of the subject matter expertise the project needs. He is a great professor and super helpful. The class taught me a lot about starting a nonprofit from the ground up. Professor Fulton is a very good professor! I learned a lot in this class and I enjoyed his teaching style. Would highly recommend his course.

Professor Fulton is a real gem when it comes to teaching. This class has been one of my favorites so far at IU! Prof. Fulton really helps you engage in what he is teaching and makes his assignments connect what you are learning to the real world. Great teacher! Very knowledgable about the nonprofit sector and very willing to help students in any way necessary. As long as you pay attention and do the work-- you will succeed in his class! Would take again

Professor Fulton must be related to LeBron James, because he is the goat. This not an easy class to teach, as we discuss touchy topics who a lot of people have strong opinions about. Amazing professor, teaches wonderfully, utilizes real-world examples, funny, and truly cares about his students and it shows. I learned so much in this class. Professor Fulton was enjoyable to listen to and really encouraged participation in class. I would definitely take another class of his.

Dr. Stecher is AMAZING! I just needed an English credit and I heard this course was an alternate approach and it was actually really fun.
