Professor Gass is the best I have ever had and I never want to miss class. He's always funny and sometimes scandalous and has a fantastic collection of video clips to express his points. Best class ever.
Gass is awesome.  Turns learning music into loving music.  If you leave IU without taking one of his classes, you've missed out on an incredible experience!
solid holid enjoy life and learn about music and love him for what he preaches
Glenn Gass is the coolest man on the planet. Hands down.

Best professor!  Classes are always enjoyable, even if the music being studied isn't your favorite.  Never wanted to skip class, always guaranteed a laugh.  Just listen to the music and the class is amazing.

The Beatles class was AMAZING. He is so knowledgeable and passionate about the subject, that it makes you interested. He is one of the best professors at IU, hands down. If you can get into the Beatles class, then take advantage of it! I didn't want to skip class EVER.

History of Rock & Roll.  It is 15 years after graduation, and I still think about this class more than any other I had at IU.  Outstanding professor, who will teach you how music has shaped our country, culture, and lives.  If you read this Glen:  Thank you.  You are what made college a great experience for so many of us.

With the title THE HISTORY OF ROCK AND ROLL, you'd think you could skate through this class. NOT! Glenn Gass is a HISTORY teacher who specializes in music. Highly rate him -- he keeps students involved, intriqued and informed. (Tests were decently hard and easy.) LOVED the guest lecturers, too: Lou Reed and Kenny Aronoff.
The Beatles class was the best class of my college career! By far the most interesting and entertaining class there is! TAKE IT! Changed my outlook on many things!
Best class I had in the 8 yrs it took me to get my undergrad.

By far the greatest professor at IU. Take every class he offers. I've never met another professor who has so much enthusiasm and passion for teaching. Glen Gass is truly a wonderful man who cares so much about his students. I've never had more respect for a professor.
Coolest Class Ever.  Best professor ever.  When I don't have stuff to do, I am going to sit in on it for the next two years.  Not hard if you don't go to class, very easy and fun if you do.
Wonderful teacher. Obviously loves the class and teaching. Wish I could take this class again!
Absolutely amazing! I would take this class again in a heartbeat! I've been in college for 5 years and he's the best I've ever had!

By the far THE best teacher at Indiana University. His knowledge, passion and enthusiasm is unparalleled.  He routinely gets standing ovations in class.  I couldn't imagine another professor teaching the courses he does.  His Beatles class will be the MOST interesting and engaging course you will ever take in your life.

there are places we remember all of our lives...balantine hall is one of them! awesome beatles class, loud music, passionate Glen!!The girls love a big teddy bear...I know what the Lennon legend is...I always knew...all you need is love, that's right Glen!!! Rock on...
He is probably the best teacher at Indiana University.  Take his classes!

amazing teacher, amazing class. gass is so passionate not to mention his adorable sons are showcased in slideshows. seriously, BEATLES is amazing. come to class, take notes and listen to the albums. amazing stress relief
Hands down the most passionate professor at IU. I'd attend his classes even if I wasn't getting credit for them!
Awesome Class.  Lots of fun and professor loves the music and makes the students love it too.
Hands down best professor at IU. Take Beatles. Remember to go to class, take notes and listen to all the music.

AMAZING class!  He's very enthusiastic and passionate about what he teaches.  Knows his stuff and has lots of stories.  Even got Mellencamp to come.  He didn't cancel class during a tornado warning because he had to teach the evils of Yoko Ono :-)
Great guy, great guy.

the most awesome, funny, passionate, and enthusiastic professor i've ever had. he made a job of his passion, and performs it exceptionally well. class was fun; i WANTED to attend. to pass beatles tests, you MUST attend class; this may seem like a blowoff, but if you don't attend class, you won't pass the tests.
Lectures are really, really long and somewhat boring.  90 minutes is too long.  Otherwise, great class.
Glen is the coolest professor you will ever have. Period. His knowledge and passion of the subject being taught is unreal. TAKE HIS CLASS.
Best professor I had in college.  I can't say enough good about him or his classes.  If you leave IU without having him as a teacher, you're absolutely missing out.
Great teacher
Not a complete blow off class, but if you have any intrest at all, probably one of the best classes you'll ever take!

This class was the best class of my college career!  Glenn is a kick-ass professor and knows so much about music!  I absolutly loved coming to this class.  Our class was on Tuesdays and Thursdays and lasted until almost 9pm.  Even on Thursdays that auditorium was full!!!  Take his class!!!
No Comments
Amazing professor.
Best professor of my college career.  Looking at history through the lens of music was enlightening and having an intelligent, enthusiastic professor to lead the way was invaluable.  Thank you Glen!
No Comments
I still miss that guy... Do yourself a favor and take his class!!!  You'll never forget it.
Glenn is the man.

Glenn kicks mad ass...  I'm not one for class attendance, but I made sure to make it to all of his classes!  His classes are some that I can honestly say I got my money's worth out of - tons of great music that I still listen to!
No Comments
Gass for President!
No Comments
Glenn rocks!
Very awesome and easy.  Very fun to go to class.
excellent
Best class ever, best professor ever. My Beatles class is my stress relief- I absolutely love the class
awesome guy, very enthusiastic
Absolutely, hands down, the best teacher I ever had.  So much passion and care for his students.  Anyone who has the opportunity to take one of his classes should.

Despite my pleas with my high school and the powers-that-be in the Gwinnett County School System, i cannot convince them to make the History of Rock and Roll a required Social Studies course.  I'm envious of anyone who gets to teach such a class.  Very pa
Any instructor who jumps up ON TOP OF the table as he's getting really into something gets my vote. Very passionate and wants to share it with you, and always available to help you get it.

He is the best.  If you come to IU, you MUST take a class with him.  I loved the Beatles going into his class, but I'm going out of it with a far greater appreciation for them.  He goes above and beyond any expectations you could have!
He's the best!  I learned more in his classes and apply it to life out of college more often then classes I took for my major! Take his classes!!!
Most amazing professor/teacher I've ever had.  No one cares more about making the student *really* get it.  If you go to IU and you don't take a course(s) from Glenn, you are missing out.
Greatest class ever. Greatest professor ever. As in 16 years of school, makes all other teachers look dull, greatest ever. I wish 1% of teachers cared this much about making education fun.....
Best Teacher ever...changed my outlook on music and made me fall in love with the Beatles!  glen gass rules!!!!!
Unbelievable teacher! Dr Rock rules.
If you don't take a class by Gass, your whole college experience has gone to waste. He is and will always be the most memorable and by far the best prof I will ever have!
GREAT PROFF
Best class i had at IU
I can still remember his twelve bar blues medley on acoustic guitar
jumpin glenn Gass is a gas, gas, gas!
No Comments
Excellent and energetic teacher
I have never had a better, more enthusiastic teacher.  This guy is awesome.
A BLATANT EXAMPLE OF WHAT A TEACHER SHOULD BE; GLENN GASS ROCKS; (OAK!!!)

He always reminds you that he is available before and after class. He is very accessible and incredibly sweet! Lectures could be boring, but he is incredibly generous and gracious. He also breaks down problems in various ways to help you understand content more.

Prof. Kattner did a good job teaching finite despite how quickly he paced this course. The lectures are loaded with important information; even though they aren't mandatory, I highly suggest attending them since the uploaded lecture videos are much harder to understand. Homework is a small part of the overall grade but really help with exams.

Easiest math class I've ever taken. He was a very kind but slow teacher and I attended a third of the lectures because they barely helped. If you do skip lectures, just keep up. The curve is also massive.
He was aight. Three exams worth your whole grade. Would not take again. Lowkey made be cry like 6 times.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Kattner knows the material very well but assumes everyone else also understands. His lectures are very fast-paced, and missing a class can easily put you behind. Taking notes during class is important, and reviewing them ASAP is crucial. I strongly recommend taking EDUC-X101 with this course; it's basically a booster class.

He is a nice man. I didn't struggle in this class as much as some other people but he absolutely does not know how to teach. He just talks at you and is so quiet. I recommend pass sessions because unless you already took finite that is the only thing that will save your grade or the only way you will actually learn.

Best math professor. Had him for calculus, and at first I was skeptical but after taking him for calc realized it wasn't the professor himself but the subject. Was always available for office hours. I took another math class after calc with a different professor. He helped me even if I was no longer in his class. He REALLY cares for his students.

You should take Professor Kattner for M119 if you have the option. He's very direct and makes learning the concepts easier because he breaks down steps well. That being said, I would highly recommend doing the B or Better Program at CTS (group sessions/exam reviews.) Clear notes and it makes the class easier to comprehend, Bill is the BEST teacher!

Good guy, but his teaching style was not very effective. He doesn't do a great job of breaking down concepts for a beginner to learn, rather selecting problem examples and working them out in his own fashion. Also, as there are so many students in the lecture hall it can be hard to hear. Exams are multiple choice & curved, which is helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The department itself is terrible. However, from what I've seen, Gregory is the best you'll get. His curves on his exams are the only reason I am passing; they are generous. If you cry Infront of him (because again, math department sucks) he will pretend to not see you. He is not the most emotional person. He's the type to have ham on thanksgiving.

I cried in his office hours and he acted like he didn't see it. Besides that scenario, he seems like a pretty cool dude. The IU math department is not good at all (look at the grade distributions and you'll see what I mean)

This man is one of the nicest people and best calc teachers.  He goes into depth in his explanation and is always willing to spend time in class to answer questions.  His tests are strait forward and about what we learned in class.

Professor and TA's were difficult to reach and very condescending. Assignments were graded harshly (and oftentimes unfairly) with requirements that were not in the rubric. The course already has few assignments so there is little margin for error. Lectures drag on and have random, mandatory polls to score attendance, with no grace for missing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The only reason I attended the Zoom was because she does random polls. There is a textbook but I did not purchase it and did good. There is extra credit at the end of the course but still do not recommend.

I chose this class because my advisor recommended it to me. I regret not dropping the class after the first few weeks. The professor was very condescending and very hard to reach any time you needed help with something. The TAs also were no use most of the time, and were very condescending. There is also mandatory AI use on some assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class legit took years off my life. no words. I wish someone would have warned me. Busy work is graded like its a senior capstone.

Oh my glob help me. Assignments are simple, but explained so confusingly, theres like 3 pages of instructions on how to write a 400 word essay. TAs never answer any questions, always just ask you to email outside of class when a 5 word answer would save both them and me a load of time. Professor looks bored. very bored. also mandatory AI use :(
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've had the displeasure of having in IU. Do NOT take this class, I got 1/4 of an assignment grade taken off for not including a works cited page, when it was never asked for in the assignment. Then they said it was in the student code of conduct therefore it was our responsibility to include one anyways. Nobody included it.

DO NOT TAKE SURVEY OF HIP HOP WITH THIS PROFESSOR. Genuinely crashing out rn with how strictly they grade assignments. It's like they aren't even caring about what you write as much as they care if it follows the specific requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very rude instructor, the material had nothing to do with the topic of global popular music. She intentionally made the class more difficult than it needed to be

So awful. Never done one of these before and it's so bad I've been motivated to do this. The lectures are mind numbingly boring, and the instructions one the papers are needlessly confusing. She grades incredibly tough even though this is a gen-ed music class with a ton of Business and STEM majors. This takes more time than any course from my major
It was just bad
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take a course with this teacher. Have papers every 2 weeks simple but very time consuming. Had to reach out to Dr. Graper and she was very rude in the email back and told me to figure it out on my own when i emailed back to further explain I never received an email back.

This was honestly one of the worst classes I've taken at IU. While there's not a lot of assignments, getting through the class was absolutely miserable. The lectures were boring and the material we've learned does not correlate to the course name like you would think at all. She's also very politically biased and makes it obvious from day one.

If you need an  A I would recommend this class she always give extension when I asked which was really nice as i was talking 18 credits and she give bonus and easy discussion quizzes you just have to show up and answer the best of your ability the lecture are kind of boring but everything she says is basically on the exams

This class had very boring lectures with a lot of seemingly useless information and contained an extremely political aspect. Professor Graper was not enjoyable to hear lecture. Exams were graded very hard. Graper made exams at inconvenient times (first day back from Spring Break) and asked about information that was very specific.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you need an easy A or gpa boost this class is perfect but the lectures do get boring sometimes. Attendance isn't mandatory since notes are posted online after the lecture. Also, a couple of extra credit opportunities were helpful.

Not a lot of little assignments always long annoying papers and tests. More work during finals and midterms than any of my 300 level major specific courses. It's clear the teacher knows her stuff, but I don't think she understands the amount of effort this class takes for a 100 level class. She expects us to live and breathe the listenings.
Lecture boring. She gave me academic integrity ;( Too much work to do

I literally would not take a course with this professor again. She seems like she might be a great person if I met her outside of her job, but her class was literally something I dreaded going to every day. She may know her stuff about the topic, but literally it is an elective, it's not that serious! There were so many papers and tests were crazy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is nice and cares about the material she teaches, but she talks very fast and flips through her slides before you can write everything down. It is not a hard class, but you have to put in a lot of effort if you want a decent grade.
Fun Course!

An absolute horror of a professor. Terrible in every way. She starts class 10 minutes early. She only reads off of her slideshows every class for the entirety of class. Before every class she assigns an unbelievable amount of reading. She grades much too harshly. She does seem like a sweet lady but she is an absolutely terrible professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Graper's lectures and discussion were genuinely a treat to attend, the topics we read and talked about were all interesting and she doesn't grade very harshly. As long as you do the readings and are prepared for the reading quizzes you will do well. Other than that the final project wasn't too difficult but applicable to event plans IRL.

Class was very politically biased, hardest gen-ed I have ever taken. Tests are really hard and written portions of the test are graded hard. She reads off a slide and talks really fast. I would not recommend taking this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She literally just reads off the screen every single lecture over the most confusing stuff. Expects you to know things already before the class. Such long assignments. Most people take this class as a credit and she treats it like its for our major. Lots of outside reading, and not interesting stuff at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This course is far too difficult for a 100 level course. The lectures are structured by her fastly reading off a transcript with super difficult vocabulary so they are barely comprehensive. Then the writing prompts, which are graded WAY too strict, have little instruction to them and barely any correlation to course material.

The class is poorly structured. The lecture materials have very little to do with the multiple large writing assignments, and the papers are excessive for a 100 level course. The lectures themselves are awkward, convoluted, and generally revolve around you memorizing terms in foreign languages. I feel like I've learned little and wasted my time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I felt that the class was very unorganized and I never understood what to do for anything.

Reviews are outdated (Ex. Didn't really use excel). Attendance is big for your grade and do the practice problems. She let us use a single notecard for each exam w/ notes to make it even easier. For a senior class with people that just want to graduate, it's pretty easy to memorize a few problems' processes and repeat them for the exam.

Prof. Gupta's class was a mess to take. She has a rudimentary understanding of excel, and bumbled around in class. She ran over the class periods, and made attendance mandatory (threatening to fail students for 6 missed classes). Insists laptops aren't allowed, paper notes only. Consistently rambled off-topic and didn't focus on material enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is a really nice kind professor and tries to break down an overall tough course. She adds extra credit to exams to balance out silly mistakes. Attendance is taken every class. Overall, she is very funny and personable but I think the course itself is challenging by nature.

I have never been more upset with a professor before in my entire education. Professor Gupta fully lacks any understanding and respect for her students. Myself, along with many of my peers felt extremely disrespected, picked on, called out, and made uncomfortable by Professor Gupta. A professor like this has no place at Indiana University.

One of favorite Finance Professor at Kelley. She is really helpful and gives alot examples, current events during the lecture. She actually makes me interested in International Finance. Lover her and pls dont make fun of her dresses.
Does not provide any useful help. Can't distinguish between which topics are easy and challenging to studeny. Often wastes timeless hours explaining subjects incorrectly and in-fluidly.
Impatient and seems uninterested in helping certain students during her office hour.

She is really good for an English composition class. The workload is not bad. A bulk of your grade comes from a few assignments. She gives honest critical feedback. She really wants you to do well. If you show up consistently you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's the absolute best! She gave great feedback for her essays and shows she cares for her students. Be prepared to do some work fs, but overall a good class.

Professor Gunn is extremely sweet and cares about her students. It is clear she wants everyone to succeed and puts in the effort to get to know each student. The material itself is super manageable and she is very understanding with deadlines.

Ms. Gunn is a solid new professor at IU. She's fun in class and is accessible outside of class. You can ask her to look over a specific part of your essay but she won't look over the whole thing. Don't be fooled by a slow start in the beginning, you will make up the points as the semester goes on. Overall, not a bad option for W131.

The sweetest professor I've ever had. Jikeli is insanely knowledgable and is clearly an accomplished academic. He makes himself so accessible and is incredibly down to earth, and he explains things in such an understandable manner. Don't take this class if you're not okay with a bunch of group work. Overall great class and an even better professor.

Professor Jikeli is a great professor. He designs the course to fit the class attendees. Class itself is participation heavy and pushes education through discussion -- its very Socratic. There are still weekly assignments that aren't bad at all, and also, there are a couple projects.

Course code wasn't available so I had to pick this one, had him for a class about Israel on social media. He is extremely knowledgeable, very passionate, and cares about his students. You'll have a good experience as long as you show up and put in a little effort.
dont do it to yourself.

I had a bad experience with Professor Jikeli. We were social group. Before class we would socialize and when Jikeli entered the room, it was as if all our energy left our bodies. He could not give clear instructions and was not capable of navigating our research project without taking over and causing further confusion. Take any other ASURE course!

I have never met true incompetence until I met professor Jikeli. He would go on random tangents during class, assign random projects in the middle of week, couldn't schedule correctly and we ended up having to write our final research paper (worth 25% of our grade) during the last two weeks leading up to finals because he couldn't time manage.
passionate about his and very knowledgeable. Kind guy and open to different ideas. I had him for a course not listed on this website so the course codes different but I'd recommend it.
great lectures. Leaned a lot. Very balanced approach to the history of antisemitism and racism from different perspectives. Fair grader

I feel as though this class had the potential to be really interesting, at at points, definitely was. That being said, I feel as though Dr. Jikeli's lectures often had no direction and were pretty boring which made coming to class very difficult. There was a LOT of reading for this class, especially being that its a 100 level class.

This class is extremely reading heavy. There are weekly readings followed my peer graded kritik assignments where students grade hard for no reason. Lectures are boring, and I did not find the class interesting. Professor and TAs are extremely nice and eager to teach the material. Unless you are super passionate about this material, stay away.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: White Supremacism and Antisemitism on Social Media was my least favorite class this semester, and I took finite math. The class is extremely reading heavy, and Professor Jikeli's lectures are not interesting enough to make you want to show up at 9am. Most homework involves peer evaluating on Kritik, and it's very time consuming. Avoid this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was on Antisemitism and White Supremacism in Social Media. It was a very enlightening course. Dr. Jikeli is an incredible professor and has lots of experience. There will be some reading and videos to watch throughout the course, but the information you learn is essential. There is also a discussion section, which I found to be quite fun

Professor Jikeli is good overall. His lectures are alright but can have little direction at times. In the class I took, we did a LOT of reading and discussion sections were all about participation and groupwork.

The class has no exams which was nice. You do a lot of in-class discussions which can get old, but it wasn't hard. There was homework for each class which was kind of time-consuming but not too hard. The professor was always quick to respond to emails which was helpful and he was chill.
Quite disorganized which makes it hard to figure out how you're doing in the class. Arbitrary grading.
Lectures were quite dull. Did not find course interesting.
Would not recommend

Such a phenomenal professor. From the start, it was clear how genuinely invested she is in both the material and the students. Her depth of knowledge made the class a really positive learning experience. One of the most passionate and supportive professors I've ever had. Also super cool how involved she is as an advocate for disability rights.
Phenomenal Professor, truly one of a kind. Highly recommend taking L293 with her. You will inspired to look further into the law after this class!
She is OUT to get students. At some points, she didn't include the due date on Canvas and then docked points for being late. One miss and you're struggling to get an A.

Professor Guevara is one of the best professors I've had at IU! I had her for Ethics and she made the class really engaging and interesting. At the same time she did not assign much homework (1 short assignment for weak and some "mandatory" readings). Her attendance policy is great - she encourages attendance but allows you to make up for misses.

Professor G was great! Knows so much about the law and applied it to class with interesting examples. Class format made it easy to feel comfortable speaking in class and offering your opinion, and I never felt stressed going into class. Really great teacher, and if you have the option it is a no brainer to take her!

Prof G is one of the best business professors that you can get, especially for any law class. She is so understanding and enthusiastic about what she teaches and truly puts the students first. Everything is very manageable if you study and show up in class, as she gives many clues as to what will be on her quizzes. Great teacher overall!

Professor G is one of a kind. This woman will change your life so take her class!!!! This is the one class that I actually felt I was able to learn in because of how she taught. She cares so much about her students and wants you to actually succeed and learn.

Truly a gem of a professor, one of the best you'll ever see in your academic career. She's incredibly kind, helpful, and polite, all you need to do is ask for help. If you have a question, she wants you to ask it because it makes her a better teacher, a mindset I have never seen from other (research) tenured professors.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a great guy; you can tell he cares about his students.
Such a kind and understanding individual! Highly recommend taking his class!

Fantastic prof and all-around great person to be around! This class is probably the most fun, exciting and un-college like class ever and I would heavily recommend taking it with Prof. Gus for your Gen Ed's. Many hands-on projects (arts & craft, a film, a storybook etc.) and not a hard grader; this should easily be your most enjoyable class.
Profe GW is the kindest, most understanding professor I have had. She wants everyone to do well and makes a genuine connection with every student. She truly cares.

Laura was great, at first I was hesitant about her friendliness but her approach grows on you. The class was super interesting, I became great friends with the people in it, and exams and assignments aren't too difficult if you show up to class and does the reading.
Amazing professor. She was passionate about the class and cared about her students.

Profe was a great teacher, she really seemed to care about her students. She would rarely ever cancel class. You do have to do a lot of work in preparation and there was a lot of homework in her class. To be fair, I expected to hate linguistics, but I was pleasantly surprised and liked this class more than I expected

The class itself was a little difficult since the instructions for assignments were vague and it was almost impossible to get a response by emailing her. I wouldn't say she's a tough grader, but the homework assignments are each worth 5% of your overall grade (35% in total), so doing well on them is super important. Prof. LGW is super nice though!

She is really such a great professor! Very interesting lectures and really emphasizes student discussion. She truly cares about her students inside and outside of the classroom. Definitely recommend taking one of her classes!

I fell in love with linguistics after this class. She is a fantastic teacher, who really cares about you. Just pay attention in her class, and you'll do really well. Go to office hours because she's just an awesome person.

(L250) I wanted to like Gwen, but this class was the hardest class I've ever taken. She doesn't allow us to translate the homework, which is astounding in a Latin class where the most important thing is translation. She takes so much time on trivial stuff that we've already gone over and what we say we don't need to go over, which is frustrating.

(for L250) strict for no reason. in a translation class, we cant have translations. yeah that makes sense. very condescending and she treats the class like theyre in elementary school which is just belittling. she purposefully creates tense or dramatic situations in the class. and again, her expectations for sight reading are impossible to meet.

I really wanted to like Gwen. She's very smart and obviously extremely knowledgeable about Latin. However, she basically refuses to help students who are struggling with outside circumstances and she is extremely petty about small things (like asking for extensions). I do not recommend her class at despite how much you may enjoy Latin or history.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The professor is very helpful and truly makes students feel like she wants them to succeed. I have been enjoying the course thus far and recommend students to take this class if they have an interest in urban ecology.

Genuinely one of the best professors here. Very available and understanding. Allows you to turn in any missing assignments late for credit. She gives you her actual phone number if you need to reach out to her. And overall teaches the course very well. Highly recommend!

Dr. White is easily one of the best professors at SPEA and one of my favorites I have ever had. She is incredibly smart and has an impressive resume of past work across multiple fields, making her a great mentor. She cares significantly more about the student and how the course material is resonating with them than about their grade.

A professor that actually cares more about how much the student participates and learns over their grades, She is an amazing human who will work with you on any deadlines. She is very knowledgeable in the course and has an amazing feel for class participation. Overall a very caring professor.

One of the best professors I've ever had. She cares about her students. She wrote me several recommendation letters without hesitation. She's supportive, flexible, and understands the demands students face outside of class. 10/10, don't miss the chance to take her class!
Loveeee this Professor. She is such a nice person with a real passion for environmental studies. I would say one of the best I've ever had.

She is an amazing professor. She is so understanding and sweet. She is not tough grader and is always willing to help you out when you are struggling. I love that she is always available and she takes time to get to know her students.

I think god sent Gwen Maria White down from heailaven to be the most angel professor. She is so sweet, smart, and caring. I would recomend her to anyone taking this course. Shes very understanding, and if you do the little work required in this course you could not fail.
Gwen is an extremely understanding person. Definitely take time to get to know her while you have the chance. I would have taken all of her courses if I could.

Awesome is the word I would use to best describe Professor Gyabak.  She has clear guidelines for grading and sticks to them. She was fantastic at reminding students of due dates and clearly explained all assignments. Professor Gyabak was an outstanding instructor.

I really enjoyed the education class that I had with Khendum. She was always available when I had questions, and I felt that she was really fair with the amount of work that she included in the class. I would definitely recommend her to another student.

In tune with what is going on with education. I learnt a lot from this class especially in terms of technology integration for K-12 schools and have developed prudent ways in thinking about technology for teaching and learning.

I may be biased since I am a Law and Public Policy major, but I really enjoyed his class. Super informative in his lectures, but be ready to write hand-written notes and pay attention (no tech and slides are not posted). I think it was because my class was in the evening, so sometimes it would be boring - but Hansen is super knowledgeable!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Rich is a really cool guy, you can tell he knows a lot about this topic. You have to do a few case briefs, but other than that the grade is mostly made up of exams that are multiple choice and easy. He gives out pop quizzes, which I didn't do well on, but won't tank your grade. Definitely read ahead of time though.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance is not mandatory per say, but all information comes from lecture slides that will not be posted. You have 3 pop quizzes (he drops your lowest quiz grade), 3 exams (he drops your lowest exam grade), and a case brief that is graded super easy. You do have quite a bit of reading, and it will greatly affect your test grade if you don't do it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hansen is a funny and nice guy who knows a lot about law. He's approachable and easy to talk to. He treats the class like an intro to law school course, which some may find beneficial but I did not as an NP major. Very lecture/reading heavy with no tech rule, so get ready to take notes. Really generous with curving, weighting, and dropping grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hansen was super chill and nice. His class was one of the most laid back classes I've had with few assignments and clear guidelines. He provides clear feedback and has his TAs hold a review session before exams. More than anything, he's kind and absolutely hilarious. I recommend him 100%

Professor Hansen's class is one of personal favorites. He is lecture-heavy but his experience as a prosecutor makes them easy to listen to and you will learn a lot. There are few grades in the class, but he sets extremely clear expectations. He is very easy to talk to and clearly is very passionate about law and what he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I like Hansen as a person he's a nice guy but I do not like him as a teacher. You have very little grades in the class. You have three tests 3 pop quizzes(usually the week before the test) and your case brief. I did not like the lectures. He read off of slides and went fast. If you miss something tough he won't go back and doesn't post slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the most interesting professors I've ever had. He makes it very clear how to succeed in his class. If you pay attention and take notes, you will do well and learn a lot. I took V184 with Prof. Hansen and then went out of my way to take V339 with him because I liked his class so much.

Professor Hansen expects you to take really good notes for the test but then proceeds to fly through each slide so you don't get all the information. He doesn't post the lecture slides so definitely try to keep up! This course is based on 3 tests, 3 pop quizzes, and your case brief. The test are almost impossible if you don't understand law.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Hansen uses lectures every class, but always has interesting stories from his career/life to share with the class. He also usually curves exams which really helped!

It is true that you must show up to class in order to get the good information, but his personality makes up for the trip. The tests are self explanatory if you do the reading. Case Briefs aren't that hard. The only people that don't enjoy this class are the ones who don't do the work and don't pay attention.

At first, I wasnt a huge fan of this class especially the pop quizzes. But I learned that if you take really good notes in class (keep up with powerpoint slides, you wont see them again!) and pay attention you will do well. Professor Hansen is very kind and cares about his students. Tests are short which also scared me but he gives extra points.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: As Lady Gaga once siad, "Talented, brilliant, incredible, amazing, show stopping, spectacular, never the same, totally unique, completely not ever been done before, unafraid to reference or not reference" This is how I would describe Professor Hansen. Take this class with him, you won't regret it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Truly the best teacher out there. He is so straightfoward with his expectations, and loves to give a "hint hint wink wink this may be on your exam". This is not a lot of work. If you watch the lectures and take notes, basically if youre conscious during class, you should pass. Great guy and a great teacher

Rich is a funny guy but also no-nonsense. I loved this class freshman year because it prepared me a lot for other high-level law classes. Tests are simple if you study and the case briefs are graded pretty easily. A good class and professor overall.

Be prepared for a mature class that requires staying on top of the readings. Get ready to read a lot of court cases and take notes during class. Professor Hansen is not going to baby-sit you but rewards good note taking when it's exam time. Get ready for challenging material but I definitely recommend. This dude knows a ton and so will u if u care.

He's a good professor but can be kind of long winded at times. He is open to answering any questions you may have and does a good job explaining what will be on exams. He does not post slides until a few days before exam and he only posts some of them, so take good notes to help study. Exams are tricky but he curves them.

Great professor for LPP students (but also any student!) Very interesting lectures; you learn a lot. Very cool guy. Hardly any homework at all, but only midterm and final, and 2 papers so points matter. Still an *easy class! Second time taking him (also V-220) and I would take many more. Gives freebie points at the end to help grades.

Lectures are dry and no slides are put online to study. You frantically have to right all notes down. There's pop quizzes. He gives 0 coverage as to what will be on all 4 exams, on the final you have to study literally every micro concept mentioned. Exams have open ended questions and absurdly nip you of small points. Difficult and boring teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Attendance was never taken. You only need to read and write a briefing for the one case you will be assigned and then you need to show up on the day it was assigned for to talk about it. There are three tests and a guest speaker who's day will be counted as a test grade so there are only two days you actually need to go to class. Tests on canvas.

I took Rich for V220 that was about two years ago. I bought the book, but did not actually need it. He had practice versions of the final and mid term that made them ridiculously easy. You should go to class because of the quizzes. Overall I liked this class so much that I am going to take another class he teaches this semester.

If you take V220 you need to take it with Rich Hansen. He uses really simple and relevant examples to explain concepts and he's actually really funny. I got a 94% and 98% on the midterm and final and I didn't buy the book. There's weekly quizzes (drops lowest 3) but once you take a few it's easy to anticipate what he'll ask from the lectures.

I really enjoyed this class, and Professor Hansen is a great teacher and very engaging to listen to! Although there were many lectures, they were interesting and easy to understand. This was my favorite class all semester.  You will pass as long as you read the materials and pay attention during lectures.
There are lots of class readings and homework to prep before class. There is a small quiz almost weekly.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Mr. Harrison is an awesome teacher, if you are willing to learn and grow as a writer. If you are used to getting easy grades on writing assignments (and be honest with yourself about this), you will not enjoy this class. But if you are willing to put in the work, this class is incredibly redeeming and will absolutely improve your writing ability.

A lot of the lectures felt pointless, and he would tend to ramble on for an hour about different topics. He requires everyone to participate 16 times in the semester, but he has a tendency to forget to mark down when you participate. He can be a tough grader but wants to see improvement in writing skills.

He is a good professor, insightful and nice. Pretty light class though he does mostly talk at us in class though participation matters. If you go to his office hours consistently, he WILL give you very helpful feedback of how to improve your papers. If I did this earlier I would've had a higher grade. I would definitely recommend.

He was a nice professor, and very helpful when I would show up to office hours to go over my papers. His approach to class was interesting, and he clearly wanted us to succeed. But he's a super tough grader, and there were a few classes where I genuinely came out with nothing learned because he rambled or repeated himself.

This professor will literally talk the entire class about stuff that is completely pointless, for example we analyzed a video of a guy sitting still on video for an hour. Class is complete brain rot, I don't mind a hard class but the "hard" work in here doesn't teach you anything at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you actively participate in class & go to his office hours for extra feed back you'll do great. The topics he chooses that we read from are always interesting. He has pop quizzes, but he'll hint at when they are; it's an easy way to boost your grade. He lays out requirements for essays very clearly. Overall, great teacher and engaging class.

Tough to figure out what he's looking for in assignments. Tough grader and extremely strict attendance policy. Nice guy but I dreaded going to this class every day and listening to him talk about rhetoric for 50 minutes.
This is one of the worst professors ive ever taken. STAY AWAY

Tough grader but definitely saw improvement in my own writing by the end of the semester. I appreciated his feedback and his knowledge regarding improving my writing skills. The readings were a bit boring in my opinion, making the papers difficult. Other than that, decent class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Harrison is very knowledgeable in many different things! He grades very harshly and doesn't just give grades for completion. Reading quizzes aren't bad at all but sometimes pop quizzes over in class material you have been covering. Only had to write 4 mini essays and 3 major essays. Overall not bad. Tends to ramble often.

Definitely a lot of work for a 100-level class. Lecture time is spent with him rambling on and on about things that may not matter. There's a ton of reading outside of class to do and he's a tough grader. Would definitely recommend taking this class with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very good professor, however, not so good for a 100 level class. I took W131 with him because the professor for the section was not yet specified when I had signed up. A lot of effort is needed to do well in this class. There are daily quizzes on readings and frequent essays. Although he is very smart, he rambles on and on every class.

You must be able to properly take constructive criticism to enjoy a class under Prof. Harrison. He's extraordinarily intelligent in areas even beyond the scope of W131, and he's extremely helpful to talk to at office hours. He'll remind you a C is average work, whereas an A is beyond average work. My W131 section wrote about social media addiction.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Yes, Professor Harrison is a tough grader but he literally turned my mindset and work ethic around. I took this class first semester of Freshman year and  I HATED IT at first. Everyone saying he has stupid lectures and is arrogant, etc. is wrong, he is literally telling you how to succeed in the class and is extremely intelligent.

I wouldn't recommend for a 100 level class, but beyond that, he's an amazing professor and truly wants to see students improve, which is why he's so direct about readings and quality of work. As long as you're literate and capable of listening, you shouldn't have a hard time.

The attendance policy does suck a little, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Harrison is one of the best teachers I've had in my life. He is no-nonsense, and gives great feedback. He truly wants to help ground each student in developing their own critical thinking skills. His lectures work in excellent advice for strengthening your perspective as a writer and person. Great music/film/book recs, and funny, too.
He's funny and very nice :) but he is a pretty tough grader. Gives good feedback though, especially if you go to his office hours

Don't you dare get sick or have a personal emergency in this man's class. He seems to to think him droning on and on about the same information he makes us read about on our own is more important than being with loved ones. He has the most ridiculous attendance policy I've ever encountered here at IU. Whoever said he's caring is a bold faced liar.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I think Mark is under the impression his lectures are more valuable than they actually are. He doesn't count medical illnesses as a valid excuse (in fact, NOTHING is an excused absence) and starts to knock your grade down half a letter for every class you miss after 2. You won't learn anything going to his class except that he's a pretentious dick
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Content isn't hard at all but it seems like he grades harshly in order to make up for that. The attendance policy is so strict which is pretty silly, considering the lectures aren't very informative or helpful in any way. Overall, I'd recommend taking this course with one of the other professors who teach it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mark is a great professor. The lectures are very helpful, and he also is pretty reliant on attendance so don't miss that many classes. He's understanding, and if you show up and participate in class he'll be a little lenient with late work, but don't count on it. Office hours are helpful. The work load isn't terrible, I'd take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: give him a chance. he's a tough grader for sure, but as long as you do the work and participate you'll do just fine. if you want to do well, just read through the comments on your paper and ask him during office hours if anything confuses you. he doesn't want to see his students fail, he just wants to challenge us. he's a cool prof. you'll be okay.

Professor Harrison is amazing! He's always super understanding regarding personal issues and extensions. He's always available and gives amazing feedback. He's super knowledgeable about everything and I love the way he fuses his own experiences and stories with his lessons. The best.
He is hands down one of my favorite professors at IU. I had a lot of hardships with my mental health and COVID and he was always caring. Also, he is a great professor to create bonds with. 10/10

Not the worst prof I've ever had, but also not the best. The way he graded papers was a little intense, and the feedback given wasn't super helpful. Reading was 40-60 pages per class, so if you're not going to read, I really wouldn't take this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I came into this class with a positive attitude, despite the negative reviews. Professor Harrison truly cares about his students writing and wants them to improve. However, his grading style is OUTRAGEOUS. Its crazy on how hard he grades papers in a level 100 class. He makes you feel stressed about reading and writing. Find a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's being not easy just because he doesn't want to be. I mean, you can learn something, but you will also see the dark side which is... pretty annoying.
This professor is the most stupid teacher I have ever met in my life.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: You can really learn things in Mark's class. But you have to work hard to get good grade. Suggestion: go to the office hour.  It's really useful!

Professor Harrison is a genius. He expects everyone to read, annotate, and discuss the readings outside of class. Expect to read a full book per week, and ACTUALLY read it. He has high expectations for writing assignments and projects, but he fully prepares you to succeed if you do the work and pay attention to his lectures. He's always available.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: To be honest, he is the most ridiculous professor that I have ever seen. What kind of writing profess can make their students totally lose the interests of writing. Tons of homework and reading requirement.  Every homework only receives 60% of the average grade.  The lecture is pointless but has a strong police about attendance.

Harrison is one of the best professors I've ever had. Completely down to earth and really knows what he's talking about. He expects good quality work from his students but is fair with grading. I would love to have him as my prof again.

He is one of the most friendliest professor's i've had at IU by far. He really understands the writings and is very very helpful. If you are considering a good professor for multi-lingual section I would strongly recommend him!
A424 is a hard accounting class. professor has a great approach. professor is always open to questions and to give help
Good professor! She is very responsible for her students and care much about them. Her lecture is very useful and help you digest the dry and complex audit theories much better!

Dr. Hagerty is a great professor and is clearly passionate/knowledgeable about tax. She explains concepts clearly and gives fair quizzes that only cover one topic at a time. In class, she also points out ways she may quiz you. Quizes are always very similar to Top hat/HW/mock quizzes. The topic list she creates are a godsend. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class moves quickly & she talks fast but she adds a lot of information to the slides and does examples so take notes. She also points out tricky parts of the material and these are often tested. I went to class and studied the review materials she posted and did well.

Makes you read textbook, slides are too dense with a bunch of info you probably don't even need for the exam, and the exams expect you to have memorized the entire tax code as if you're a CPA. She's so nice but covers unnecessary content making the class harder for no reason. Make sure to attend for Tophat points with some questions on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hagerty knows her stuff, but lectures were basically just her reading off slides. Audit is really boring, and with a few exceptions, she did not make it any better. She did incorporate feedback well, so I would expect this to get better (this was her first semester teaching at IU).

First time professor this year (2025) and she did a great job! Could tell very obviously that she cared about the subject and her students. She engaged the class very well, encouraged attendance but did not require it, and put out very helpful homeworks. Overall a great professor that I would highly recommend for audit or any other course.

I think Prof Hall is super nice and does care. This class was extremely difficult because of the way things were explained. He over-explains a LOT, so easy topics become much harder to understand. The tests are really long, with not enough time in the class to even finish them, so you have to hurry.
Take with anyone else. So many exams and they are short answer and very difficult. Also the professor over explains the easiest topics to the point where it confuses you.

DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM!!! He will ruin your GPA. I have never put more time into any other science class and got the worst grade I have ever gotten in my entire college career. I think I would rather drop out of IU than take a class with him as my professor again. Everyone in the class was fighting for their lives.

I can see how a lot of people didn't like this professor. This definitely isn't an easy/blow off class. He is a strong believer in putting time and effort into the class. He definitely cares about his students and puts time and effort into the course. Do review sessions, do discussion worksheets, and ask questions, you'll do great in the course.
literally awful. take bio with literally anyone else.

Spencer was nice and knowledgeable, but his class was literally a nightmare. The concepts were not difficult, but he wasn't very good at explaining them and the exams were genuinely awful. They were multiple choice, but every question could have one answer, more than one, or it could be none of the above/all of the above. Would not recommend.

Professor Hall is caring, enthusiastic, well-organized, and an amazing lecturer. Hall provides several resources and opportunities for student success. However, many of those resources are mandatory, leading to a heavy homework load each week. If you attend lecture and complete required assignments, you will do great and become knowledgeable!

So happy this class is over. He seems to make everything SO much more complicated than it needs to be. When you really study the material you find its not that difficult its just the way he lectures and the work he assigns. The exams are way to hard for a 100 level class, the final absolutely destroyed my grade. He's just doing too much.

I would not take this class by Spencer. The final is worth 25% of the grade, and exams are incredibly difficult. The discussion packet would take hours every week and the exams were so poorly written and difficult to understand. Trying to decipher what the problem was asking was so much more difficult than the actual material.
He was ok. The content was hard and not taught in the best way. Discussions took forever to do. Exams were difficult.

Exams were all multiple choice which sounds good in theory but Spencer loves to add none of the above or the potential of multiple being true for all exam questions. The class was way too hard for a 100 level, he always compares how it will help with upper-level classes but as someone who has taken many, this class was too much work and not needed.

If you can avoid taking this class with this professor, do it. It is not worth the time and energy. I spent way too much time out of my weeks on this class and in the end, the time I put into this class didn't even matter. He gave us so much work and not enough time to do it. TA's were the only reason I passed.

Bro what an odd fellow... he's just odd.He needs more AIs and office hours, it is hard to find a time that works and he also puts too much work on them. If you're reading this and must take his class- DO NOT SLACK ON THE DISCUSSION PACKETS!!! get hem done AHEAD of time and see an AI! However, I can tell he really likes his job and is passionate.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a very enthusiastic professor and goes over very helpful notes with an energy that I really appreciated. His lectures have accompanying notes sheets that will help you all retain and collect the info. It's defiantly not the easiest intro bio class, but if you come to lecture and take advantage of resources it's far from impossible.

He can be nice, BUT the discussion sheets took way too long, quizzes are due after every class, and his exams were far too difficult. On the eams, he tries to trick students with the question wording. They're all MC with "select all" and "none of the above." Can't use process of elimination on any question, and they're all about a paragraph long.

I am about to be done with this class, and while I am doing well, I could not be more excited to be done with Spencers teaching. His class is far too difficult for a 100 level, and his questions are paragraphs long worded so confusingly. If you are foolish enough like me to forget to submit your AP Bio score and skip the class, good luck.

this professor caused me insane amounts of stress. the discussions took around 3 hours and were quite confusing. the test questions were worded confusing and even if you studied for awhile they still wouldn't go well. if you missed class once you are so behind. I do not recommend this professor. it's almost impossible to get a good grade.

Spencer didn't answer questions clearly in class and the way he worded HW/exam questions sometimes made no sense. You need to study a lot for this class and attend all of the lectures. It's not an easy intro bio class, but if you do your HW and actually try to learn the material, it's not bad. The tests are curved and he gives many drops on work.

The class is 4 credits, so it is to be expected that it is a lot of work. I went to every lecture and did every discussion, which he structures, so you do not really have to do much studying for the exams. I found this class to be relatively easy if you just actively participate. There isn't much outside research you will have to do. I recommend.

This professor is so strange. Not in a good way. He often messes up on slides, papers, quizzes and does not correct them. He also complicates very simple ideas and concepts. The way he grades is so redundant. He does not word questions clearly?often have to clarify what he means. Bad class, take any other class then this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
The lectures for this class were so poorly paced (some classes were virtually content-void, while others were speeding through complex material) and the exams so disproportionately difficult that I'd never recommend this class.

PRE-MED STUDENTS: do not take this class! It covers little/no MCAT materials & will likely tank your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you want to take a very difficult class with content that you learned in AP Bio but be very confused at how it's taught, then by all means take this class. You work harder than you have to for most classes and still don't get your desired grade. If your options are to only have Spencer as your lecturer, then take the class at Ivy Tech.
Spencer is by far one of the worst professors here. He gives little to no help and gives so many worksheets. It's like high school. If you miss one lecture, you're done for.

Whatever you do, DO NOT TAKE SPENCER for L111.

He rambles during lectures, the homework assignments often have to do with stuff you learn on the day they were do. He words things so confusingly that it sets you up for failure. He's also unaccessible outside of class. He's a very harsh grader and it is nearly impossible to get a good grade.

If you do the work and pay attention in class, you'll be fine. His lectures can be a bit confusing and hard to follow and also his tests and quizzes have questions that are confusing which can get annoying. However, he gives you three levels of practice on almost every topic, has tons of office hours, and always has q&a sessions before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
What can I say in this short response box?
I took AP Bio in high school and came into class with a large understanding of biology. His homework and test questions are worded very confusing and makes it hard to understand what he's asking. His lectures are all over the place and hard to follow. Bottom line, don't take him if you can avoid it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I’ve gotten A’s in all of my biology classes, bio major here, but this class is ridiculous. VERY oftentimes rambles. You have to study VERYY HARD in order to do good with his exams. Doesn’t include drops till week 12. His exams are super confusing and wordy on purpose, he *literally* says that. For the love of god, don’t take his class!!!

Professor Hall made me question my capabilities as a student and as a person. I've never been made to feel more inadequate. I'm a biology major, and have gotten consistent A's in every other biology class here. However, the difficulty of the exams in this class is ridiculous and the lectures are 90% filler, & 10% poorly explained material :(

It's always hard to rate a prof harshly, however, I hope that what I have to say is constructive. Professor Hall was clearly very enthusiastic about his class, but barely ever was able to verbally explain more complex/nuanced topics. Ideas that are relatively simple are made so convoluted that it makes things even more confusing.

Spencer is a great professor who genuinely cares about the success of his students. I passed the class with 103% because he offers tons of extra credit. This class did require a lot of time to complete 1-2 quizzes and discussion packets weekly on top of watching pre-lectures before live lecture, but the busy work left me well-prepared for exams.

He is an amazing professor. However, he will definitely make you work for it. Not only does he teach you the material, but he teaches you how to think. You will also learn other helpful skills from this class. Such as how to use excel, how to read graphs, and some stats calculations. Overall, a great class. Hard work pays off in this class.
Not great

Spencer is great. He puts in a lot of work to make sure the class has everything they need to be successful. The class is a big time commitment, with multiple assignments due each week, and problem sets due every weekend. It will seem like a lot of work, but youll be glad you took the course in the end.

Spencer is an amazing professor, super knowledgeable interested in you succeeding. However he purposefully challenges you by: wording questions in a difficult manner, long discussions (mini packets of 10-24 questions), and hard exams. Even though I loved his energy and his passion I wouldnt retake his class  too hard. Seriously tho, great guy!!
Tests are absolutely awful.

This class requires a lot more work than a typical 100 level class and at times can be super difficult, but it was so worth it. He creates a solid foundation that will help you excel in your upper-level courses. He is very passionate and knowledgeable about the topics covered in class. I wish I could take his class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Hall was a great professor. He clearly does a lot of outside work for the class because the note templates, slides and worksheets are all well made. Though, the homework is a little heavy for how easy the class is. But if you do all the work and pay attention in class you won't need to study for any of the tests and will pass easily.

Spencer is very energetic and very knowledgeable in what he teaches. However, he does ramble a lot in lectures which can be confusing. The class is very work heavy and you need to make sure that you understand all of the work he gives you. He does not give study guides for exams nor does he round grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I was thrilled to see Prof. Hall had positive reviews on her. However, my experience was much different. His lectures were all over the place constantly, and his exams were intentionally worded to mess you up. The homework assignments took me 5 hours each week, and in all, this class led me to have immense stress I have never felt.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is a great professor. He offers Q & A each night before we take a test. All his tests are multiple choice and two extra credit questions are at the end. The test can be difficult because of the way he words the questions sometimes. Discussion packets are great study tools to prepare for tests. You want to come to every class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He was seriously the best. He made notes for you that followed along his helpful, detailed powerpoint that you could fill out during class. As long as you review all material you've received from him before a test you'll do fine b/c the homework he gives you certainly prepares you to do well. His questions do try and trick you, just take you time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: L111 is typically a freshman class, which is why I feel Spencer has a lower rating. A lot of students do not come in knowing how to study and prepare for college. Spencer is the right instructor to break high school habits. Work hard, attend lecture and study, this is what leads to an A. He is brilliant and passionate about Bio. Would take again!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I highly recommend Spencer for BIOL-L 111. Every week there is a discussion assignment, which can be lengthy and tough but they aren't always too bad. In addition to the discussion assignment, there is some reading but it isn't over the top. There are 4 exams, with the lowest dropped, plus a final exam. Spencer is very motivated and dedicated.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Spencer was a really great prof, but dont expect a cakewalk. You have to work for it and put the studying in, but he gives you the preparation needed for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Spencer is a great individual! He is passionate about his students success. That being said: he is a lecture heavy teacher, has many many many papers, especially for discussion, and I would recommend never skipping his class! He has random note card quizzes to see who's attending and has frequent canvas reading quizzes online!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: People writing these bad reviews are students who are too LAZY to study. Spencer is an amazing person who cares so much about his students and is willing to help. GO TO OFFICE HOURS! Don't expect to fly through this class, but put the work in and it will pay off. The material is not difficult, you just have to be willing to actually study.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took this class as a junior for an extra bio credit, thinking that after taking advanced bio classes, an intro class would be a nice refresher. I can honestly say I've never had a professor do such a poor job of running a class. Yes it is work heavy, but the problem is that the work doesn't help you learn the material at all. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Spencer Hall was a great professor. He gives supporting homework that helps with tests. He is very personable. If you do the work you will be fine. I was a little worried about this class because I am focused on cell biology and DNA, but he made ecology and evolution very interesting. Definitely go to office hours!
This is the usually the first time freshman have to do any work in a class and are often caught off guard. Go to class, go to office hours if you're confused, and you'll do fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Spencer was a really passionate prof. He cared about the stuff he taught, so it automatically made the class engaging. Also, he moved around during lecture, which was more engaging. He's helpful during office hours. Basically, if you care about your grade you'll do fine. An added bonus is he adds Game of Thrones references sometimes.

His lectures were very engaging. If you like GOT and Star Wars, he'll occasionally work those into lectures. He often gives quizzes in class, which are just to see if you're there. Don't skip lectures, you'll need to know the info for discussion worksheets. He's very helpful at office hours and is funny.

I think Spencer gets way too much flack purely because lots of people see 100 level classes as ones that are supposed to no work at all. While I do agree this class does surpass the expectations of a 100 level class in many ways, if you work for an A it is achievable. Spencer makes himself very available. His lectures are super fun.

He is a great guy, is very passionate about biology, and really want's his students to succeed. Unfortunately, I would definitely not recommend this class. Discussion papers took 4-5 hours every week, and the tests were extremely challenging. Other people in bio would look at my hw and be shocked by the difficulty of material we were learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor can not be bothered to stay on topic for more than 5 minutes. Professor constantly pressures own political and personal views onto students. Professor likely spends 5 minutes preparing each lecture as his powerpoints are full of errors. Does poor job of explaining complex concepts. One saving grace of having plenty of study material.

As a person he is entertaining, he relates biology to things everyone can understand, and seems to care a lot. But He literally talks about checking this site all the time, and it makes people uncomfortable. The way he worded things was confusing, and this L111 takes much ore work than others, but he really does prepare you if you are a bio major!

Spencer is by far my favorite professor. His tests are hard, but if you study you can do very good on them. His lectures are entertaining and he really is a great teacher. He makes you work for your grade because he expects his students to learn and grow from his course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Spencer is great, his test formatting is poor however. I enjoyed his course, and was immersed in the material. He is available often. However if you do not attend class and play telephone with the notes, you probably won't do well. The test are similar to his discussion work, but his wording and selection choices are maniacal; may cause discomfort.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Avoid him at all costs. This class is WAY too much work for a 100 level class, but I didn't think that would be an issue if I actually put the work in. However, putting effort into this class does NOT translate into your grade. This is because everything is meant to trick you. You could study and try to do everything right and still get a B.

You have to go into this class with a basic understanding of the material or else you will not do well. He doesnt teach, he goes over material like you already know it. If you dont understand, he makes you feel stupid. This guy made me cry.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Spencer is an amazing professor! He is super animated  engaging during lectures. While I do agree his tests are difficult and there is a lot of homework, he does just about everything he can do to help you out. Extra credit problems on tests, turning exam Qs into extra credit, review sessions, huge office hours, surveys asking your opinions, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Bio-L 111 with Spencer is a very demanding class as far as Freshman classes go. Prepare to spend a lot of time on this class to ensure a good grade. Though its a lot of work you will leave feeling like you understand the fundamentals of Bio. He does everything he can to help prepare you for the tests (discussions, Podcasts, study sessions etc.)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Difficult class for a Freshman entering college but left with a better understanding of how to improve as a student. He was fair and did about as much as he could to help you succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Overall, Spencer is a nice guy. My main complaint would be how confusing the test questions are. I go in feeling solid about the material and leave wondering if I had even learned anything. Discussion was a lot of work due to problem set assignments. Constant worry about different things being due. A lot of math and graphs used as well.

Spencer Hall is a fantastic Foundations of Biology teacher. He really lays down the foundations to give you a good platform of knowledge to then be successful in many other Science, Math and even Economic classes. He helps open your eyes to the "big picture" and he is excellent at synthesizing everything you learn.

The tests are very confusing, even if you know the material its hard due to the way he words questions.  You have no idea what to study for the tests.  I just stopped trying to study.  Discussion is a nightmare, they are like 8 page packets that you have to do a ton of reading for.  He just makes the course much more difficult than it should be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Spencer was a real eye opener for me coming out of high school. I realized after the first test I actually had to study multiple hours every so often WEEKS before the exam to understand the material and to actually get a decent grade. He wants his students to succeed but he will not give anybody a grade to help at all. You have to earn it.

While his tests can be hard his lectures are really interesting. If you go to class and do the homework you'll be fine. He is definitely willing to help if you ask for it. He was my favorite teacher my freshman year.

Having Spencer as a prof was definitely an eye opener. Coming in from high school, I realized after the first two tests that I could no longer glide through like I used to. Not the kind of class you can study for in an hour. It takes tons of time looking through the material, and actually UNDERSTANDING it. And discussion is hard so be ready.
