Spencer was an amazing professor and really helpful as long as you were the one reaching out to him. In a large lecture is hard to follow and if you arent on top of things you wont have an easy time in this class. Tests are hard but doing the discussion problems help a lot.

Very boring class in general. Some of the content was interesting, but most was very boring. Most of the weekly discussion assignments are very difficult, especially for those who have discussion on Monday. In general, the tests were pretty difficult. A harder 100 level bio class.

My first test I got a 48%. But he truly made realize what actually learning the material is. At the end of the year he became my favorite professor ever. I didn't realize how much I had actually learned in the class. And when he saw me improving very quickly he sent me a personalized email. That really made me have respect for him.

I went into this class nervous because of comments I had read on this site but Spencer ended up being my favorite teacher I've ever had. That being said, this is not a class you can just get by in. You need to do all of the work you are given and actually pay attention in class. If you are passionate about the material this class is for you.

The tests are very hard. Tests are based heavily off lectures and discussion assignments, so studying these will be your best chance. He has plenty of office hours  and review sessions before exams so getting help shouldn't be a problem if you need it. He is very smart and has trouble relating to kids who don't understand material.

Very hard for a 100 level course.  You have to work for every point you get.  Lecture is boring, and the test are very hard due to confusing wording.  Work sheet are 8 pages long and there is graded questions due before every lecture.  I would not recommend this class or this professor.

If you expect to be spoon-fed just like in high school and to get an A without any effort, this is not for you. But if you show maturity and do your part, you'll get an A and learn a lot from this class. Spencer is a great instructor. He makes you use your brain (are you willing to do so?)... and if you struggle, he'll help you.

In my entire experience at IU, I have never been more frustrated with a professor.  He is a little all over the place with his material, Exams are pretty much impossible to pass, and the discussion requires so much work it should count for 3 credit hours alone.  He can be rude at times. Take a different professor.

Although he is very enthusiastic about his work, he is probably one of the most confusing professors I've ever had. Extreme amount of graphs (SUPER messy), extremely difficult exams, too much homework, TOO MANY EMAILS and unprepared AIs. The entire course I spent worrying; I ended up not studying and wound up doing better. It's THAT kind of class.

SUCH A GREAT PROFESSOR! You can really tell he cares for his class and spends a lot of time with his notes and the material.  You have to work hard and his tests are difficult but if you really study an a is possible.  Highly recommend him. He's funny, and makes class really interesting.
Hard exams that are meant to trick you. discussion worksheets are long and difficult. Not very clear on material and he like to answer your questions with a question. My advice, don't take his class

Super confusing, and makes you do the most. Section worksheets are like 6 pages long, exams are ridiculously hard.  He tries to trick you (lots of none of thee above all of the above questions).  He is enthused about material, but a 100 level course should never be this difficult. Not helpful, rather condescending.  Answers questions with questions

This class was very hard.  His tests are terrible, even if you spend hours studying because the way it's worded.  This was the only class i have ever gotten a B in.  He doesn't explain concepts well, and is very hard to get help from.  If you ask a question he just asks you it right back; that is so frustrating. Let's just say, I'm not a fan of his

He is a cool guy, but the tests are unreasonably difficult for a introduction course. People are already screwed for med school because of their first biology course. I understand that he is trying to prepare us for the future, but we have to start out small. Not a full blown fail-out-of-biology first semester.
Material is difficult but he has a pretty easy teaching style. Go to class and you will probably get an A.

He makes you write and observe graphs, which literally confuse you more and make no sense. He goes way off topic and constantly talks about kids and his studies which are no where near what he needs to talk about. The tests are hard. He makes no sense in class. There is no structure and you have no idea what to even study for tests.
He does not teach the material well at all to students, he teaches it according to how it "clicked" for him. The tests do not cover the majority of what was learned and are very poorly written.

Goes off topic a lot, does not follow the book (no point in buying book or E-book) discusses what he currently studies as an ecologist which is not what we should be learning in L111. Difficult tests.

Kooky professor.  Likes to talk about his kids and how he's a "scientist".  Makes students take lots of notes and draw graphs, which can often get really messy.  Test are very hard, but there is always a large curve to make up for it.
Teaching a new class and has absolutely no idea what to do.  Nothing on tests is relevant to what is discussed in class.
He is charismatic and friendly, but his exams are difficult and often not what was heavily discussed in class.
Very enthusiastic, funny, really into the material, but the tests are very, very hard
no textbook, friendly guy, pretty good teacher.  go to class and do the study guides and you should get an a.

Take other ratings with a grain of salt. The "high" workload is just standard engineering rigor, and the class fulfills the core writing requirement. Those complaining about their grades are the same ones relying on ChatGPT for everything, so I don't know what they expect. Her rubrics are clear, and her feedback is thorough; just put in the time.

An impossible class. Professor Hanson wants this class to be something it's not. People take ENGR100 to meet the requirement, not because they actually care about the content of the course. I respect the want to make it something more, but when only the teacher cares about that, the experience is miserable for every single student involved.

Hanson was a terrible first-year experience. Her expectations for a 100-level are that of a 400-level. No matter how good you are at writing, Hanson will take points off arbitrarily. The expectations are beyond unreasonable, the deadlines are impossible, and class itself is a drag. Don't take this.

Dr. Hanson is not a great teacher. Every single assignment, you will lose points for reasons that are incomprehensible to the human mind. Her reasoning isn't sound, and will make you question your writing. You can write, Dr. Hanson just can't grade coherently. The assignment deadlines are not realistic for anyone taking more than her class.
Overall, she is a good instructor, but her grading criteria is very strict, making it extremely difficult to earn full points. I don't recommend taking her class.

Kelly Hansen was genuinely one of my worst experiences as an undergrad. Unclear expectations for essays, lots of work with no clear learning target, tough grading that didn't make sense. Her lectures were monotonous and boring to top it off. Trust all the other experiences on here and don't take her class.

Do NOT take ANY classes with her. If you are one of her favorites, good! You might get a B+ or A-. If you are not, forget it, just drop the class. The whole purpose of taking a class is to learn the content in it. Dr. Hanson makes you never want to write a report again. Her grading is utterly ridiculous and unrealistic. Save yourself the trouble.

Very accessible outside class and is always helpful when you need it. Only thing is that she gives a lot more work than other C204 teachers. I found myself spending tons more hours than my friends with other C204 professors.

Do NOT, under any circumstances, waste your time taking any type of class that Dr. Hanson teaches. She takes points off of every single assignment for seemingly no reason and has unrealistic grading expectations. In comparison to other professors for the same course, she gives irrelevant busy work. Save your GPA, because she screwed mine

Professor Hanson is NOT AT ALL as bad as others here make her seem. I went to her office hours often and she really helps you with improving your writing. Some assignments were boring but overall easy class. Just go to class, ask questions, participate, and go to office hours and an A is not hard to get. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Horrible teacher, do not sign up for her classes unless you enjoy getting points off on projects for no reason at all.
She was ridiculous with her grades. My team and I worked extremely hard on a report and it was definitely A level work, but we received a C as a grade. Do not take her as a teacher!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Hanson. She really taught me a lot and helped me improve my writing and speaking skills. This class, however, was unbearably difficult. She gave Ds and Fs on in class activities for almost no reason. I ended with an okay grade but I had to seriously work for it. Get ready to do a ton of work. She also doesn't tolerate stupidity.
Learned a little from her, but ruined me a lot. never want to see her again

I would not recommend this women to my worst enemy. She picks favorites and if you're not one of them drop asap. unreasonable grading expectations, unreal amounts of busy work that are graded simply way too hard. I'm in Kelley, I'm not dumb but she sure will make u feel that way. If you take her class prepare to lose 10 points per misspelling.

Not only is she the most boring teacher I've ever had, she also is the hardest grader I've ever had. No matter how much you follow what it says in the book she will find a way to give you a C, at best. She gave one student in my class a 40% for spelling one letter in her name wrong. She also gave another student a 60% for mislabeling a file name.

One of the Worst teachers I have had. Does not specify how assignments will be graded, and leaves a majority of every paper open with "professional points" but essentially amount to if she likes you or not. Don't bother going to office hours she will just waste your time.
She is the hardest grader I have ever had. Expectations for papers were completely unachievable.  Lectures were very boring, and talks in monotone the entire class
Very tough class, but you do learn a lot.  Expect hw
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Hard class, but I really liked her. She dealt with some unsavory people in the class really well. Always made me laugh.
Terrible grader. Best grade given in class was B. One person got that and everyone else got B- or worse
Love her!

Genuinely such a nice woman. I and many other classmates have failed all of our tests though. I usually have to put little effort into exams but for this class even with intense studying still ended up with F's on every test. The available study guides and practice exams do not correlate to what is on the tests she writes.

I loved Dr. Hanratty, and L311 wasn't too terrible. The worksheets take long to complete. my UTA was very stingy w/ points. The lectures are long&boring, but as long as you understand the material on the slides & the worksheets, you should do well on exams. She provides lots of practice and old exams. Long exams but you can still do well. Luv her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor is sweet, but there is so much work. The class meets 4 times a week (3 lectures, 1 lab) and there are 5+ assignments a week (3 participation, 1 MGH lab, 1 prelab wkst (3-15 pgs), and often a lab worksheet as well (~10 pgs). She is not super tech savvy, so turning in assignments can be difficult (who uses fillable pdfs anymore?)

Dr. Hanratty is amazing as a person, but I did not enjoy her class. Since it is online, none of the exams were multiple choice and took 3-6 hours on average. The exams were long and tedious, but very similar to problems done in discussion sections and/or the practice exams. If you have a busy summer, do not take this course!
Professor Hanratty is a very nice woman when you speak with her outside of class. Her lectures may be monotone however the content is there. Show up, take notes and you'll succeed.
Her lectures are very monotone, not very engaging. Quizzes and tests can be kinda tough. Make sure you pay attention and review your notes often.

Biology majors should avoid Dr. Hanratty's Genetics class.  I am a research scientist and faculty now myself.  Even when I was a student, it was evident that Dr. Hanratty's course was insufficient as an upper level genetics course for science majors.  It is a disservice to dedicated students who need exposure to professional methodology.

This class is lecture heavy, Prof is really sweet but very monotone. This class should be 6 credits because there is at least three things going on at a time throughout the whole semester between lab and lecture. Be prepared to give this class most of your time. You do get points for going to lecture, but she posts all the lectures fully online.

More of a framework for learning than a class. He assigns hundreds of pages of readings weekly, and has heavy quizzes on them twice a week. I think I'd probably have a much better time learning if he lectured the material instead. The class schedule doesn't make sense - you often need to do projects before reading how to do them. Overall very bleh.

Quizzes required 20+ pages of reading and unfamiliar math, making it hard to know what would be tested. However, I did well on exams by attending office hours because he skipped concepts that were not on the test. That made me know what to study. Memorizing homework was key to passing tests, not understanding the material. Overall, I did not enjoy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is one of the best professors i have ever gotten. He explain really complicated topics in very simple terms. He truly cares and wants his students to learn
I really loved his teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He will assign twenty pages of readings to do about number theory and complex  algorithms and expect you to memorize specific words from each definition that he randomly removes from it. His exams are lazy and he just copies and pastes the homework questions on it. He doesn't copy the useful ones but only the ones that don't really matter.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely so difficult to follow during class lectures. Basically just reads off of the slides. We had to go to Mitja's Lecture for 2 weeks because he was sick and I honestly don't know why Mitja's rated so low. Mitja is by far the better teacher amongst the two because he is way more interactive with his lectures. Hamid's not a good teacher.

At his best he is really good. Teaching probability rules by making bets with us was great and engaging. Showing the birthday principle with everyone's birthday in class was too. But most lectures were confusing and frustrating. Frequent and confusing homework was due too soon relative to when we covered the material.
He reads from the slides. Fairly monotone, but if you pay attention in class, you'll get the content. Office hours are a must for some homework assignments.

Professor Hamidreza Bahramian has easily been one of the hardest teachers to work with for me from not answering emails not going over important topics or even just in the way he grades. For this class, the curve is over 50 percent to just achieve a passing score. If you have the option take this class with a different professor.

Professor Bahramian was great and truly explained how to do proofs and broke it down nicely so it wasn't as hard. Easy to get help from him too. The only thing I disliked about the class was how the TA's graded. Extremely precise and there were times I wrote down what the professor wrote down and they took points off for it being wrong lol

Had fun interactive/hands on activities to make us understand concepts better. I was not good at writing proofs before his class, and he helped me a ton now I am. He cares for his students and I recommend him for future students.

The proffessor is great in terms in explaining the concepts. However his accent might confuse sometimes. He is slow when compared to Erik Wennnstrom english speaking skills. Also he really cares for his students, and explains better during the office hours. He loves students who consistently show up to class, but attendance isn't mandatory.

Attendance matters a lot, because of in-class assignments. C322 is not neccesarily difficult, but it is a lot of learning from coding to a tools and technologies like Render, Postman, Dbeaver, Javascript, HTML, CSS. attention to detail is a very useful skill in this class. if you don't have prior experience it in these tools it will be difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: really cool professor who is much better in office hours when compared to class. he will do whatever he can to help you succeed if you actually go to his office hours and ask for help. will go out of his way to help you out, and provide with coding resources, and give you feedback. if you don't ask for feedback he will not help on his own.

Agree with the aspect that we had to make multiple repos. if you want to actually learn the content, and the tools used in the class like docker, postman and render, dbeaver. Take this class with him. If you a fun ride with medium to low level effort take it with adrian german. depends on what your end goal is. both the professors are excellent

Terribly organized. have had to make multiple repos (2-4) for each assignment and submit so many links. Despite being about "design patterns" the majority of the actual effort goes toward writing HTML/CSS because he doesn't give a skeleton or anything. The springboot stuff is interesting enough. Requires Canvas code/tophat for every lecture/lab.

the summer class goes by at a rapid pace, but he provides with all the resources to succeed in it.  prof. is very sweet and accessible outside of class, and explains the concepts even in office hours, if you ask him. However, you can't get help if you don't ask. Seen fellow students struggle because they never went to his office hours

Course content was very applicable to mobile app dev in real world. Bad prof though. He would extend deadlines bc homework had contradictory requirements/ impossible tasks. Lectures were nap-inducing. Tests were unnecessary & a grade killer. Final project was pure torture. TAs came in clutch. Massive curve at the end to save his grade distribution.

Someone known for their research but not for their teaching. Difficult class to get by with constant sets of code problems (10 a week on leetcode for multiple weeks [5+]) and does not allow laptops to take notes or follow along with in class. Shares code after class but does not allow anyone to follow along in a app development class which is weird

He is just really not great in teaching. The way he teaches is just like minding his own business showing us what code he writes and not really explaining what it is and then we have a project due in a week based off of the thing he supposedly "teaches". Also, what kind of mobile app development class not allow their students to use their laptops??

The class was extremely homework heavy, and would reccomend stay on top on it if you aren't good at discrete math, and understanding how to write proofs is the essence of this class. The prof isn't funny or quirky, but does the job of explaining really well. At the end of day, it is Computer Science class and not theatre.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of our first classes, he was trying to give an example of something and asked a girl her weight, which he quickly followed up with, "haha I should not as a girl that". He ignored emails and did not give full credit back on exams for "rounding errors". The program we used, STATCRUNCH was confusing and didn't allow me to actually learn stats.

Loved Professor W. Very funny and actually cares about his students succeeding. Stats is not a very fun subject to learn but he made it quite engaging and made it very easy to understand what was important.

Hands down the best professor here at IU. Very funny and very knowledgeable on what he's talking about. Always available for help if you need it. Never a boring class. HIGHLY recommend taking this class with him.

SPEA-K 300 is honestly a really difficult class, but Professor W. does such a good job of making it enjoyable. He gives lots of resources, and the exams are almost identical to the online homework and quizzes, which can be hard, but it's helpful to know what the exams look like. He also doesn't make attendance mandatory and is very flexible!

I am not a big fan of statistics, but Professor W made this class so enjoyable. He is so fun and really encourages his students to participate. He really wants his students to succeed. He is truly the best professor! If you take STAT- K300, take it with Professor W! He is hilarious.

Prof W is a very funny professor that makes a boring class pretty enjoyable. he will call on you during class. technically attendance isnt mandatory but i would go because he shows you how to do your homework and quizzes. i am very glad i took this class with him.

I would take another class with Prof W if I had the chance. I'm usually not confident in math, but he was super supportive. If you're struggling, I recommend going to SWAITS, especially in the week leading up to the test. Go every day if you can. As long as you stay on top of the homework and make use of those resources, you'll be in good shape.

Says that the tests should be "easy" and then the average is a C. The practice tests are not like the actual tests. He will throw questions on the test that were not in the homework's or quizzes. There is no study guide for any of the tests so you could be tested on anything. Best advice is to go to the SWAITS. If you don't go to class, good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is one of the most caring professors I have ever had, super nice and will give you extensions. Really just wants you to learn the material, and he will do whatever it takes to get you to. Super funny as well, the best lectures. Will make your day better.
mr. w is awesome. great professor, great class. only annoying thing if he gives homework quizzes after every homework and they are weighted pretty heavy.
One of my fav prof I've ever had. Class is hard but prof w makes it pretty easy. if you don't go to class it doesn't really matter, it is only 2% of your grade and everything is accessible on canvas

Henry is a great professor. Stats is hard but he teaches it in a way that you can understand. He will not let a student fall behind even if that means calling them out in class. The practice exams are just like the real exams.
I took the asynchronous version of K300, and although I didn't interact with him face to face, he was very open to giving extensions, and helped me out with an issue I had during the test. Good guy.
Professor Wakhungu cares about his students, is incredibly lenient with extensions for those who need them, tries to make a difficult subject easier to tackle, and encourages the use of math tools.
Great professor
Henry Wakhungu was my statistics professor at SPEA. Some professors know the material well. Some relate to the students well. Henry Wakhungu is masterful at both.

Dr. W is one of the best professors in SPEA. He genuinely cares about the students. Feel free to reach out and ask him for help or extensions because he will give them to you. He's a super funny guy and also a widely recognized guy in the world of academics so don't be afraid to ask him for help outside of stats too. I really enjoyed his class.

Henry used constant put downs towards his class for not understanding the lesson. Maybe if his lectures were effective we would know how to do the work. Every problem I would have to go to YouTube and teach myself because he never explained even basic concepts. He also would call out students names in class making it a strange learning environment.

Professor Wakhungu is one of the best professor's at IU. He keeps the lectures very interesting and connects really well with his students. He's not strict about turning in late assignments if you show up to class. Would highly recommend taking one of his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr W really cares for his students and as long as you put in the effort to do well, you most likely will. He's very accessible outside of class and responds fairly quickly.

If you need to take a K300 class, take it with Dr, Wakhungu!!! This course is mostly all online and attendance is not mandatory. Youtube is your best friend for stat crunch and all you have to do is learn how to use it. The tests are just see if you know how to use stat crunch too.

Prof W was great! I took this class asynchronous online, but whenever I needed help he was easily accessible and had many resources to learn. Being able to use Statcrunch for everything and a cheat sheet on exams was super helpful. It was relatively easy if you just kept up with work and got help/clarification when confused.

I was nervous about taking a 300-level math class, but implementing the use of Statcrunch on quizzes and tests helped immensely, definitely learn how to use it properly and you'll ace everything. Lectures weren't mandatory and were not very helpful (I did have to learn how to use Statcrunch on my own time), but he was a really fun professor!
He's a great professor and you can tell he cares for his students. The only negative thing i have to say is that if you struggle with math, take this class in person, if you are able to

Prof. W is easily the best professor I've taken so far!! His lectures are actually entertaining and actually wants you to do well. He is extremely available outside of class and will give you an extension no matter what. He is so personable and really wants you to do well. I am not a math person and did very well in this class because of Prof. W.

Take any class with Dr. W!!!! I was originally in a different professor for statistics and I switched classes because I could not understand any of his lectures and from the first day I changed into Dr. W's class I understood everything so much more. He cares about all of his students and really wants you to succeed in the class.

Probably my favorite IU professor. Regardless of what others say, take his class; it is the easiest statistics class available. He is extremely compassionate and entertaining, and he truly wants you to succeed in this class.

Take SPEA-300 with Dr. Wakhungu!! He inspires students to do their best and is very accommodating with student's needs. There are many resources to help students succeed in this course. I was nervous about taking a stats class but Dr. W wants every student to succeed and you have all the resources needed to succeed.

Prof Wakhungu is very caring and understanding. Nicest prof I have ever had. Online class is asynchronous except for in-person exams. One homework and quiz due at the end of each week. Not difficult at all. Prof and TA are very lenient with due dates just email them and they will help you out. Material can be difficult but many resources to help.

This is my favorite professor I've ever had, despite the fact that I hate math. Class attendance is not mandatory but you should go because is genuinely so funny and especially kind with deadlines if you make a connection. All of the homework and quizzes are so much easier if you understand StatCrunch, so ask for help with it or go to SWAITS.

Professor Wakhungu is awesome! He really cares about students understanding the material. He also cares a lot about his students and takes time to learn every person's name. He also starts every class with a joke of the day and just loves interacting with class. If you pay attention in class and do the work you'll succeed.

Professor W is really funny and obviously cares but he really did very little for me during this class. He can be difficult to understand which isnt his fault obviously but it definitely makes lectures harder to listen to. This class isnt awful but it is math so it definitely is not fun

Absurd amounts of homework, lecture mandatory but useless. Homework is online and unrelated to the exam. Gives you a review guide of what's covered on the exam only the week before. The jokes he makes are funny in the beginning, but you get tired of him joking all the time pretty quickly. If you don't have Chegg you'll spend hours on hw like I did.

Funny/Nice guy, but terrible teacher as he doesn't take lectures seriously, forcing you to learn the material on your own. Weekly online quizzes and homework that doesn't account for rounding errors with limited time on quizzes. Suggests you use Statcrunch or excel, but can't use either on test, forcing you to do by hand.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wakhungu is often the suggested choice for a major requiring stats. He can be funny at times, but it often makes it hard to focus on an already difficult topic. I wish he would take lectures more seriously as he is knowledgeable on the topic. He grades leniently on exams. Weekly homework gets a little tough near the end. Major group project.

We STAN Dr. W, this guy is the funniest prof I've ever had. Be ready for a "joke of the day". He keeps you engaged, and he's super laid back and understanding of students. He really cares about them and wants them to do well. The HW/quizzes are online. There is a big group project at the end of the sem. Also gives you formula sheets for the exams.
Constant dad jokes keep you engaged.

I took the online version of the class and at first was really confused how to submit the homework or find the resources. I thought I was going to do terrible in the course til I went into his office hours. He really helped me figure out how to do better and I ended up doing way better than expected! Awesome and caring guy if you go to office hours

Dr. W is one of the best professors at IU. He's the nicest guy and really cares about his students. However, his classes were difficult to stay awake in and there was so much homework. The group project will basically determine your grade so make sure you have a good group. Ask questions if you don't understand. If you don't he'll just keep going.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Funny, personable, relaxed, and unique man. Really cares about his students. As entertaining as he can be, I wish he'd cut it out and teach the material a little more sometimes. I'm just a little impatient and wish class time was used more effectively.

I have never enjoyed math, but he really made statistics seem simple.  He gives plenty of examples during class and is always willing to help.  Probably one of the best teachers you can get for stats.  Only bad part is an unnecessary group project at the end of class.

Dr. W. is the best stats teacher I could have ever imagined. He provides many tools to help with the online homework, quizzes and StudyPlan. There is a bit of effort needed for this class, but Dr. W. is very understanding and wants all his students to do well.
Dr. W is really awesome. He genuinely cares about his students. Tests are easy. There is quite a bit of work to do, but overall, this is going to be the best Statistics class you can take.

Henry is by far the best professor i have had. I was scared to take this class because i struggle with math. However, he makes the material so easy to learn and is super understanding of his students needs. He makes lectures fun and provides some great resources for homework, tests, and quizzes. Definitely take stats with Henry!

I've never had such an amazing professor as Dr. W. He goes above and beyond to help his students. He learns each of their name in a lecture of over 100 students. If you were to have the slightest problem over stats, he always makes himself available to help his students. One of the few professors who genuinely cares about his students.

Dr. W is the nicest guy ever. Always willing to meet with students and accommodate any concerns or extensions. There's a lot of material, but the exams were fairly short and simple. The only semi-challenging part of the class is the group project, but it's an actually interesting project.
Easy.
Dr. W is the best professor ever, cares about his students and is very much allowing of extending assignments if you need it. If you need Stats, make sure you take it with Dr. W
Best professer ever.

Quite possibly the best professor I've had at IU. I was completely dreading statistics before I walked into his class, but he somehow made the dull material entertaining. He also makes students WANT to come to class, which is a great quality to have as a professor. The group project is a lot of work, but it is definitely doable.
EVERYONE loves Dr. W. If you have to take stats, take this class.

By far one of the best professors I had at IU. Definitely go to his office hours, he will help you out with any homework question and he's great to talk to. Make sure to do the exam review, because it is pretty much the same as the exam
Dr. W is the man, one of my favorite professors at IU. Class is a breeze.

Dr. W is by far the best prof I've ever had.  The class and material is very boring, but his jokes make the class more interesting.  He's very approachable and encourages students to visit with him during his office hours to just chat. I took advantage of this opportunity and learned a lot about his culture, as he's from Kenya. Very interesting man

Dr. W is the man. Started teaching the class halfway through wish he was there the whole time! He will learn your name even if there are 100+ people in your class! He is a great guy and I would love to have him teach me again.
Truly a unique and inspiring individual.

Dr. W is awesome! He started teaching my class midway through the semester and I enjoyed the class so much more with him. He gets to know everyone's names in a class of over 100, it's pretty cool. He really wants everyone to do well, and genuinely cares about his students. Make sure you know how to say "hi" in African (jambo!).
Dr.Wakhungu is funny!! He wish the best for all of his students. If you take the class, you will not fail!! His lowest grade is a B-.

Ahh Henry.. what a guy.. He's extremely friendly,and once learns your name he will have conversations with you in the middle of class! Although he is a little hard to understand (straight from africa), he is very smart and enthusiastic about statistics.. good teacher!
Dr. W is the Man! Take his class!
If you hate math and have to take statistics, take Wakhungu's class. He's one of the best professors I've ever had
No Comments
Very Inspiring and caring!

If you didnt take calculus in high school then dont take this course. If you did then this course will be a cakewalk so the professor doesnt matter. I didnt mind professor hendrickson he was fine, still not the greatest teacher though.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Often times he would skip over slides and rush through them. He didn't explain things that well and would often make jokes like "are we alive" that had no purpose to the class. Overall he doesn't do a good job of teaching the material and the slides he goes through to fast that I can barely take notes and write down what he's saying.
please do not take this course.

awful teacher

He was not a good professor, teaching math with powerpoint. It was very hard to follow. The homework was harder than lectures. He did not care about students wellbeing, understanding or time. Took forever to grade exams and unclear about the way assignments were going to be graded.

Tests will make up the majority of your grade. Test grade averages are consistently very low. Openly criticises students publicly. You will have three weekly homework assignments that take at least an hour each. Do not take unless you already have a strong understanding of the material.

Jim is a great guy, but I did not like his teaching style at all. It's very difficult to follow along and he's just not the greatest teacher. Do not take him as a teacher. Worst experience with a teacher I've ever had. He does not teach well and is of no help if you try to clarify anything with a question to him.

Finite is either very easy or very hard for some people; that being said, Mr. Hendrickson is very nice, but his lectures are fast-paced. Actually the worst professor, he had to take over as my professor and repeatedly told us that he did not want to teach our class. Hendrickson is possibly the worst professor at Indiana University. Not the end of the world if you get Hendrickson for Finite. Hes not the greatest professor by any stretch of the word, but it is possible to do well in Finite with him. reviews.comment: Jim is a really interesting dude that's super passionate about math. I can say that you don't need to attend most classes to do well, just be prepared for the extensive online problems. Contrary to what other people say here, he does teach in class and it covers the quizzes. But you have to work to know the material and his class won't be easy.

I had to retake finite and if youre in the same boat Im in, dont take Jims class. We only had class 2x a week and homework 3x a night which ranged from 18-30 questions PER ASSIGNMENT. Jim is a nice guy and hes funny but ignore the good reviews, if you want to have a life outside of finite and not stay up late due to workload, avoid this class.

Jim is one of the best professors I've had. I wasn't that great in math before taking this class. The only downside what that there was a decent amount of homework, but its not nearly as bad as other people are saying and it prepared you well for exams.

Finite is a hard class no matter who you take, but Jim was overall a good professor. His lectures aren't the best but he is always very helpful and available at the Briscoe ASC. the guy's a complete jerk. thinks he has more power than he does.

I stopped doing the homework to write this, that should say something

He does easy problems in class, then assigns homework not even related to what we learned. Khan Academy is more useful than showing up to his class. If you have this teacher, have fun teaching yourself everything.

Hendrickson should not have the ability to be rated on this site because he is simply not a professor in any sense. Pretty much teach yourself with insane amounts of homework. Doesn't teach what is on the homework and doesn't deal with struggling students at all. If you get put in this class drop or try and change professor.

He's a pretty cool dude but he gives way too much homework and doesn't teach well. I have to spend hours completing the homework because the majority of it is not even from the lecture and you're left trying to learn the material on your own

simply put, my classmates and I have been teaching ourselves. He's a nice guy and knows what he's talking about, but he's not good at teaching it. He moves too fast with notes and doesn't make the concepts easy to understand. The lecture has very little correlation to the homework for that night. It is a huge struggle just to complete most of the homework. I'm normally a good student and this class tough.

Insane amount of homework and tests have so many different answer options. Much harder than the other profs. He bullies students.. he once threw an eraser at a student who fell asleep and he will call you out in class.

I liked his class a lot, he explained materials very well, I attended every class this semester. He gave heavy homework and it is more difficult than other professors, but if you did everything he gave, you would pass. Jim is that he assigns a ridiculous amount of WebWork and has very difficult exams with 11 options for each question. Lectures were never interesting but sometimes he would teach well. reviews.comment: Overall this class was alright. Jim assigns rediculous amounts of webwork and he makes his tests WAY harder than other finite professors. His tests have 11 answer choices per question, there are 15-25 problem 3 times a week, he doesn't curve tests when others curve over 10%, his examples have no answers, and his practice tests have no answer keys. Overall, my peers and I are expected to learn the same material but those who have Hendrickson, have a much harder situation to excel.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Jim Hendrickson. Where do I begin? Allegedly, he is the greatest finite teacher of all time. He's at the ASC literally every night and actually cares about u.

I really enjoyed this class. Hendrickson made the class exciting with his hands on experience. There's one final and it was very easy, and the last half of the class is a project which was easy and you can ask him questions throughout the semester. He really cares about his students and the material.

I would never take a class with this professor again. He does not provide feedback and finite is a class you need to have feedback on to move forward. Made a lot of jokes that were not funny and I don't need to come to a class where all my professor does is make stupid jokes and call students out instead of teach. Doesn't explain anything either.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He is a very nice and funny man, but does not teach all the necessary content. It was hard to follow along in my opinion. But very nice guy and helpful if you utilize his office hours.

Don't buy the book. You won't need it. Jim gets off topic during class and tries to be funny. He often gets annoyed that someone is not paying attention, so he just skips that lesson and you get very confused during homework. He embarrasses people in class. Avoid taking this professor. ONLY benefit is more tests so better chance at raising grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Jim is a fantastic professor. If you go to class and pay attention to his lectures, which are more entertaining than your average lecture, you will succeed. Attendance is not mandatory, however this is the reason most people struggle in this class. His lectures are very informative so if you attend class and pay attention you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Jim is a great professor! He is always willing to help people. I went to the Academic Support Center in Briscoe, and Jim helped me with many problems to prepare me for the tests. Also he says jokes in class to try to keep math entertaining, they are hilarious. Highly recommend this professor.

I was able to see Jim at Briscoe, where he volunteers his time to help everybody.  Lots of people complain about Finite, but it wasn't so bad. You just have to think on your feet.  Memorization, which might've worked in high school, does NOT work for 118.  I got an A just doing the homework and the practice exams. No need for a tutor.  Save your $!

Mr Hendrickson is a great guy. He's smart & personable. The lecture hall is huge & intimidating though. Go to see him at office hours or at Briscoe; he has good explanations & is very helpful. The test questions are exactly like what he says they'll be. People who don't go to class don't do well; too bad for them. I recommend Jim highly.

Jim gives ridiculous amounts of homework, but class is enjoyable and mildly fun. I would have no qualms about skipping this class (it's an 8am) if it weren't for the fact that I genuinely enjoy Jim's teaching. Friendly, approachable, and a bit of an oddball, he's the best Finite teacher possible.
