reviews.comment: He doesn't do much in teaching stuff. He just talks through quickly as if you are supposed to know everything in his ppt. At the end, you will have to go trough text book yourself to understand what he is talking about in class. Bad bad teacher. Worst experience. Plus, he assign tons of webwork. 4 times as many as other teachers.

This dude loves homework. He is like 40 and has no wife so I'm convinced he is married to homework.  Doesn't do a great job of teaching stuff but he gets the job done.  He makes his tests pretty easy too which is nice.  He assigns 4 times as many homework problems as other teachers and makes them very difficult.  I have no respect for him at all.

Hendrickson is a competent enough lecturer, but does spend a fair amount of time trying to crack corny jokes in class. Tests were fair, study the material, though be warned, I found the third exam to be considerably harder than the rest. Biggest negative is the immense amount of Webwork. Easily on average 30-60 problems a week, many multi step.

This class was actually fun to go to-- weird to say that about a math class.  Jim really knows what students need to know, and classes are relaxed and well run.  Hopefully I still feel the same after the final :-)

Pros: Excellent and approachable Instructor.  Jim's always at the Briscoe help sessions,and he can help with everything. Cons: He gives one more test than everybody else and there's plenty of homework. I got an A so I'm happy.

I had Jim for 118 and 119, B and an A. Jim is a light-hearted guy and is more than happy to help out but he won't spoon-feed material. In class he introduces the topics, however, you learn through WebWork. He assigns a ton of problems but the practice is how you succeed. I didn't use a textbook all year. If you fail its simply a lack of effort.
Would not recommend. Poorly planned lectures that do not prepare students at all for the homework or tests.

Thought his class was fair. Homework and quizzes are there to cushion your grades so put effort into them. The online homework is difficult, so don't procrastinate on that. I thought he was very engaging in his class: he knew all of our names and had volunteers come up to complete problems. As long as you put in the effort, you should be fine.

Rather rude and does not teach the material. Just walks around and tries to make jokes. Treats material as if everything should be obvious, but it isn't. Withdrew from his course one time and took his class again a year later. Also, strict policy on "looking bored." He reprimanded me in front of the entire lecture because I didn't look interested.

The midterm was the hardest test I have ever taken in my entire life. Never post grades, still don't know what I got on my 3rd Exam and my final exam. You get the sense he tries to make the class as hard as possible.

I ended up passing the class with a C but this was due to intense studying for the final and third exam. Students in my class began crying in the midterm. Lectures are  confusing and no one really understands what is going on. He gets off topic a lot and I feel that the material is never thoroughly covered. Nice enough guy though I guess.
Good notes.  Plenty of homework.  Not very many quizzes.  I always felt ready for the exams.  Hendrickson was generous with his time and always available to help, especially at Briscoe.

He is really funny and entertaining and makes the boring math lectures less rough. He seems like he wants to help us understand (even though a lot of the time none of us did, except for the group of people who always sat in the 1st row). BUT, beware, if you always check your grades obsessively, he never puts them in!!! And he's a bit unreliable.

Jim is an okay teacher, but if you go to his office hours he is more than willing to help. I would say if you struggle with math especially with basic arithmetic (no calculators are allowed) find a different finite teacher. Jim's tests are hard.

Jim is hands down one of the worst teachers I've ever had. Finite is honestly not hard if you put work in and pay attention. Given this, Jim is not the professor for Finite. He is overly sarcastic, embarrasses students and is generally unhelpful. At office hours, he barely helps and in class he goes off topic way too much. Choose someone else.

Although the lectures are huge, the learning truly takes place in this course when you do your homework. Hendrickson attends briscoe's academic help center everyday for 4 hours and he is really willing to help you learn. Put in the time and you'll be good.
Seems like a great guy, keeps you awake in class, has a decent sense of dry humor to make you giggle on occasion. Homework is due every other day. You need to work for this grade.

Too much homework is all you need to know. Assigns 25 problems regularly while all other teachers only assign 5. Tests are insanely tough and he doesn't curve tests other than the midterm and final, while all other teachers curve generously. Don't make the mistake of taking his class.

Jim is honestly a good guy. He means well and if you meet with him at the beginning of the semester and establish a relationship, he will be there for you. Finite gets a bad rep in general but he is one of the two good teachers for the course. I would definitely recommend taking his class. Even if you aren't his biggest fan, theres nothing better.

Although you may leave the class a little confused at times, he does a great job of explaining things either after class, during his office hours, or at the tutoring sessions he heads almost every weeknight at Briscoe. Honestly by far the most accessible professor and if you go to the tutoring sessions at Briscoe THIS CLASS WILL BE GREAT!!!

I found him to be unhelpful. He constantly compares things to baseball and does nothing but makes jokes that aren't even funny. He doesn't teach at all, and is very unhelpful at office hours. He's condescending to students. He gives incredibly easy examples during class and then the homework is nothing like what he teaches. HORRIBLE PROFESSOR.

It doesn't seem bad during classes, and honestly the class isn't too horrible, Hendrickson just isn't your best route. He goes pretty fast and doesn't clarify things that really need to be. BUT go to the study sessions at Swain East from 5-7 on weeknights. They are the only thing that got me through the class!

Excellent, 5 stars!  I had him for 118 and 119, B+ and A.  There are quizzes every Wednesday; they're sort of tough, but they don't count for much.  Clickers every day, so attendance was kind of mandatory.  Liked the slides.  See him at Briscoe; it really helps!
James Hendrickson is a really good teacher. The class was fast-paced, so I didn't think I could miss a day.  Does NOT like students to memorize problems, so don't even try.

Always trying on unrelated, no-funny-at-all jokes. Not teaching clearly and not in detail. Give ppt with more than 100 slides every lectures which can make students more confusing. Students should not play with their phone, that's true, but if you do it in his class, expect to be embarrassed by e.g. phone being confiscated, solve Q on blackboard.
He does a good job, I think the class itself is just tough

The course M118, or Finite Math is difficult all on its own. The course requires hours of Webwork homework assignments that called for hours of tutoring outside of lecture. Jim is good at explaining methods and comparing math to understandable, played-down stuff. Pretty chill, funny guy. He helps ALOT at tutoring sessions, which I deeply suggest.

I'm not much of a math student but I actually enjoyed going to Prof. Hendrickson's finite classes. He's extremely helpful (lots of office hours and review sessions in his off time) and clear in his lectures. His exams and quizzes can be challenging. He has a kind of silly sense of humor that keeps class actually very funny and entertaining.
Makes multiple choice quines and exams with like 8 options. Very Clear in class but Exams are so much harder then the examples he does in class. Good Guy . Recommended!
Great teacher! Explains things well and tests are what you would expect. Definitely recommend.
Good teacher, clear explanations. Did a lot of stuff for us. Review sessions before every exam, put all his slides online, had lots of office hours. His exams (so far) were nicer than the midterm.

Very frustrating professor. Tries to be funny in class and moves at an extremely fast pace. Class notes he provides don't always help with Webwork. I'm usually very good at math, but I am struggling with his class.

The most helpful professor I have ever had, go to his office hours.He truly does care about his students. His class may come off as challenging but it will be rewarding when the midterm and final come around.Quizzes may seem difficult but they count as a small fraction of your overall grade and they really test your knowledge of the subject. STUDY!

Prof. Hendrickson made light of the dull subject of finite through humor and enthusiasm, but sometimes the clarity of the lessons suffered for it. The quizzes were unreasonably difficult. He holds his class to a higher standard so the midterm and final material are easier than his personally written tests.

I would highly recommend taking this course with someone else. Although Hendrickson was energetic and could be funny, he could also be rude and extremely confusing. His tests were not representative of classwork, homework, or practice tests.

Hendrickson made a relatively dull subject in Finite interesting with his enthusiasm and humor during lectures. He thoroughly explains topics in class while keeping them lively. He does give quizzes, but they are easy if you study and they help prepare you for exams and the departmental midterm.

He's a really nice guy and very jovial. However, his constant attempt to be funny interferes with the clarity of the curriculum. He's very good at math, but assumes that you know everything while failing to go into enough detail to make sure everyone understands. False sense of easiness while his quizes wreck you. Do not recommend.

Hendrickson is a really great teacher! He gives extra credit for doing the exam reviews, going to class, and is super helpful during office hours. (If you need help, GO TO OFFICE HOURS) He really tries to help you understand the material. The class isn't difficult for me, but he makes it understandable for everyone.

First of all he makes his class more difficult than that of the department. His test and quizzes are much harder. I like math however and liked the challenge. I got an A- but I think I knew the material well enough for an A+ in any other section but his. He really is a nice guy and great in office hours. Sometimes was not the best at explaining.

Had Jim for both M118 and M119.  He's Very helpful, especially if you go to see him at office hours or Briscoe.  Tests are similar to practice exams, but not exactly the same.  He does teach chapters in a different order, but it made sense to me. Quizzes are hard but they're worth only a little part of the grade.

I've had some horrible teachers, but this dude might just take the cake. Doesn't explain things well, or at all. Focuses on jokes he probably planned ahead of time. Didn't even inform about webwork hwk in FIRST week of classes, so I got 3 zeroes of the bat. Goes over examples and say now how about that on the test, and test is extremely difficult..

Defintely wouldn't recommend. Spends to much time trying to be funny instead of teaching the materal. Teaches as if we all took calculus in high school. Disinterested and unhelpful during office hours. Writes much harder tests and quizzes than the department. Overall, pretty immature and unpleasant.
Wouldn't recommend for calc. He tries to be too funny during lectures and it interferes with the learning because the material isn't taught in detail.

Awesome teacher. Math is a pretty rough subject to say the least, but Mr Hendrickson made class bearable and you will get a lot out of it. He's a pretty funny dude too and wants students to do well. Highly recommend.
To say he is unique is an understatement. Tests and quizzes can be hard. Helpful in office hours.
class can be somewhat challenging at time but if you do the online homework and take the time to review/study before tests you will do good in this class
He is a great teacher. Will always offer help if you need it. Highly recommended for finite. He is a pretty funny man, although some of the lectures can get long.

He is a good teacher. He really seems to want you to succeed. It is a hard class, but he does whatever he can to help. He is one of the few teachers that will hold free review sessions before exams. He is also good at keeping your attention during his lectures, because he is a funny guy.
Really good teacher, good notes, lots of office hours and review sessions.  Quality :-)

He teaches material that is not required for the midterm and final. His teaching methods are not good at all, he does not teach exactly how to do problems. The worst experience I have ever had with a professor.

Had Jim for the fall semester in Finite and then had him in the spring for Calculus.  He gives plenty of opportunities for help, and make sure that he gets to know you because that will help out.  He is a must have for both m119 and m118.

The subject - M119 - was hard but he is definitely one of the better math teachers I have ever had. He understands many students hate/struggle with math and tries to make it more bearable through his lectures. He also cares about students' performance and offers great help. His quizzes were definitely harder than the tests though...
Jim is by far the best math teacher that I have ever had and really cares about all students. I recommend going to his office hours and getting help from him in the evenings at the ASCs.
Truly cares and wants to help each student perform the best they can. Great teacher and great guy.
Jim is the most helpful professor that I have encountered. He has a great sense of humor and is always willing to go above and beyond to help you understand.

Jim is by far my favorite teacher at IU. He really wants to see everyone succeed and has a lot of office hours available. He's funny and knows most of the student's names by the 3rd week in a lecture class of 200!

Jim is extremely helpful. He does his best to learn as many student's names as possible (he surprised me when he knew my name when I turned in the first quiz). His lectures are extremely relevant, and made the homework, quizzes, and tests easier.
Jim is a great teacher.  He knows nearly everyone's name out of a class of 200, and wants every student to succeed.  I don't think I will ever have a professor better than him.
Hendrickson is fun, makes the class interesting even though I hate math.  He makes a lot of baseball references and basically wears a Brewers jersey everyday.
Jim is the best. He is funny, very intelligent, and extremely clear. He will go beyond what is expected just to help his students. I hate math and I actually enjoyed his class. RECOMMENDED.
The best teacher at IU?
This guy is the man. I've never enjoyed math, but I've always understood it. Now, I understand it AND I'm even considering a minor in Mathematics. Jimmy Hendrix-on is awesome.
Awesome math teacher
Awesome teacher great at explaining. Go to office hours!
Probably one of the best math teachers to roam the world

Lectures were boring but it's calc, what do you expect? I had to retake calc and this time he made everything much clearer and explained everything very well. Go to office hours to get 100% on homework and right before exams because he'll tell you what's on it. Calc sucked but Jim was a great professor.
hes boring

He was not the best teacher but I think the subject matter is just hard to teach in general. So because of this I think he is definitely one of the best teachers you can have at IU.  He truly wants his students to do well in his class.  Homework he allows you to get over 100percent in.  He is a little bit strange but incredibly nice!

Jim is a really good guy. Very funny, but odd. His tests are very difficult and he never gives enough time. Quizzes differ from hard to easy depends on the mood he is in. He also will memorize your name, which at times can be creapy. GO TO HIS OFICE HOURS. He changes scores on tests and quizzes all the time if you go to office hours.

Jim is cool as a regular guy but as a teacher i find him very annoying in class sidtracts off with stupid jokes no one cares about and doesnt actually test your ability he jsut tests how fast you can divide and multiply weird numbers FAIL
Nice guy, it appears he wants his students to do well. However, his quizzes and tests are ridiculous.
Really good teacher, and completely cares about how well his students do.
Best teacher ever
Best math teacher I have ever had.

JIMMY HENDRIX IS THE BEST MATH TEACHER AT IU!!!!!!!! If you have him you should consider yourself lucky. He is hilarious and has a way of making calculus fun ( which is NOT an easy task ).  He cares a lot about his students and will know everyones name 2 weeks into the class cause ... he's just awesome like that. GET JIM AS A TEACHER!!!
Makes math easier to understand.
Jim rocks da house
superb.  wonderful teacher, very helpful.  wants students to succeed.  put in a decent effort and you certainly will.
Very nice guy - friendly and fun.  He is very willing to work with you so that you understand the material.
No Comments
No Comments

The homework is super helpful for studying and the tests are super straight forward (all multiple choice). She is great with answering questions during class and reviewing problems if people dont understand.

She is one of the most organized professors I have ever head at IU! She makes her expectations and assignments extremely clear throughout the whole semester. You have 3 in person exams but if you follow along with the packets you should do well. Great experience!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. If you pay attention in class and do the homework, you'll do well. I knew nothing about accounting going in, but she makes the material easy to understand and answers any questions. She is fair and clear about her expectations. Though her class is online, it's engaging. It requires your full attention, but it's not stressful.
You will actually learn if you pay attention, exams sometimes tough but she gives you more than enough study material and sets you up nicely. Definitely recommend.
Very sweet if u pay attention! Just do the work and you will be fine. She is strict on due dates though.

Would never take this teacher again! Throughout all my years of school I have never had a teacher with as little empathy and understanding as Julie. Her lecture wants to make you fall asleep and she is just not funny. A200 itself should be a straight forward class but she has found a way to make it difficult.
Wasn't bad at all! She gets a bad wrap and I don't know why

Really enjoys teaching. Makes it easy to study for exams by giving clear rubric and gives access to a lot of material for revision. Is strict with due dates but easy to get good grades if you do what she tells you to do.

I went into accounting with no knowledge of what I would be getting into. I am now leaving loving accounting. Julie is kind of much but she is an amazing professor. Attendance matters. I never did the readings and I did just fine. Pay attention in class and form study groups! Overall 9/10. Plus its online! Choose Julie!!
Worked through many problems in class, so it was clear of what was expected during homework assignments and assessments.

Made accounting interesting. Not an overly difficult class. If you pay attention to and engage in the lectures (which is sometimes difficult because of the online component), you should succeed. Grade is heavily reliant on exams (2 online, rarely curved; 2 in person, slightly curved though our first in person exam was heavily curved).

As someone who knew nothing about accounting, I am happy to say that Professor Head was an extremely passionate teacher who helped me start to understand it! The content is difficult at times, but she provides many opportunities to practice and ask questions. If you take notes and actually listen to her lectures, you'll be fine!

Prof Head is a tough but fair instructor. Attending class is a must, but the lectures are engaging and genuinely helpful. Utilize unstuck study and the provided exam prep materials - they're key to success in this class.

This was the first accounting class I've ever taken and it was pretty easy. There are 4 exams (2 online open note, no curve and 2 in person no notes, slightly curved) all of which are easy, I got between a 94-100 on all of them with minimal studying. Just rewatch some lectures, be able to do most of the homework without resources and you'll be fine

She is a nice woman, and she seems like she is trying, but when it comes to homework compared to classwork, it does not translate. Expect to use outside sources to be able to understand the homework, and don't rely on your notes for the online midterms, as the finals are in person and no notes. A very confusing class overall and not one I recommend

Prof. Head does a somewhat ok job teaching material, but you'll have to rely heavily on your notes packet--which you cannot use during exams. Other than her consistent backhanded comments toward her students whenever they ask questions or deal with personal issues outside of class, she's not a bad accountant, just not the best at teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She cares a lot about her students and is a really wonderful teacher overall. She provides students with everything they need to succeed and tries to ensure that they do. Very positive energy, organized, and makes the material very easy to understand. I would have gotten a much worse grade without her. One of the best professors I've had at IU.

Julie makes the most of a very difficult class. She's genuinely a great professor and is very polite and caring. However the class A200 is milestones more difficult than A100 with the Mcgraw Hill HW and the in person exams. The class is insanely hard and you will need to invest many hours into studying to pass. But Julie is awesome, take her class.

Julie is an alright prof. The lectures bounce around very quickly, there are many assignments, and she doesn't explain things very well. If you have taken A100 or any accounting course you'll be fine though.

Professor Head is one of the best teachers I've had at IU. She keeps students engaged on Zoom. She provides numerous office hours if you're struggling. She asks students daily on how we're feeling about the material. She genuinely cares for us. Exams were difficult for me, but there's so many assignments to bring your grade up. Take A200 with her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor who knows her stuff. Entertaining, actually cares for her students, gives great lectures, and VERY clear grading criteria/expectations. Same assignments due every week. I cannot say enough good things about her. One of the best professors I've had. Watch class videos & do smartbook/connect assignments again to study for exams.

Truly an amazing professor that cares about her students. Super clear instruction and explains material very well. You will do great in this class IF you take good notes and do all of the work. Be prepared to put in time, but if you study well and pay attention you will do great. There are plenty of office hours and tons of resources if you need.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
Professor Head is amazing! She is always willing to take time to work with a student. A200 is dull, but she manages to keep it interesting.
Workload is low, but the assignments ensure understanding. Attendance is small part of the grade. The readings help.
I hate accounting and because of Prof. Head I still find myself excited for every class.

Fav prof. If you had Healy for A306, Prof Head will be MUCH easier. Discussion and class material is actually on the exam so as long as you show up to class and do the homework, you're already doing similar problems to the exam. There's more homework (smartbook+prerecorded videos) than A306 but it's all to your benefit. Stay away from Prof Carson

Do the graded connect homework, attend lectures, and pay attention to the content videos. She also explains the content very well. For a person who barely passed A100, she makes her content is very engaging.
Julie head is the goat. She truly cares about her students and will do what she can to help you out. Definitely not an easy class, but she does everything she can to make it easier

A304 is not an easy class but I think you have a better shot of getting an A with prof Head. Attendance is required and she is strict about it, but she is very available if you need help and wants her students to do well. I recommend following the exam help sheet and doing the hw, also re-watch the class videos before the exams.

Great accounting professor. Not too much work. Really important to attend lectures as they are mandatory and beneficial for learning material. Exams are challenging but she gives a lot of practice beforehand which are similar to the test questions she gives. TA's are also very helpful.

Really good choice for A304. Her expectations are clear and tests are fair in general. Only thing I'd wish is that she'd actually teach the content in class rather than relying on video lectures. We're past the pandemic now!

Professor Head is a great lecturer. Lectures aren't a waste of time. They actually help you learn more. If you're looking for a professor that doesn't require attendance, don't take accounting with this professor! But I loved having her personally. She's always there to help and she has really good TAs.
Teaches really well and the test genuinely has questions based on what she teaches in class and doesn't ttick you/throw you off. Just pay attention in class and you're good.

Professor Head truly cares for her students. Her exam expectations are clear, as she provides a list of commonly missed topics before each exam. She spends most of class going over practice exercises, which are extremely helpful for exam preparation! As someone who struggled in A100, this course was easy to understand.

This class has a lot of material, but if you go to class and do the exercises and the homework, it will set you up for good grades on the exam. Some topics are difficult to grasp, but professor head answers questions really well. Main thing is do the homework with purpose because it is just like the exams.

Julie was super sweet as a professor, and probably the best accounting professor at Kelley. The material is just difficult and the way she teaches the course doesn't make it easier. I'd recommend meeting with the free tutors during each unit in preparation for the exam.
Very knowledgeable professor, but lots of homework. Explains concepts really well, but sometimes, exam content doesn't line up with class content

This class is not set up in a way to help students succeed. A large majority of your grade is based on exams even though there is a lot of homework. Outside of class, you are expected to teach yourself the material. Time in class is not used correctly and doesn't cover a lot of the material you are tested on.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Accounting sucks no matter who you take it with. Julie Head makes A304 the most bearable. Yes is super exam and homework heavy but that is the same with every prof. She has the best grade distribution and overall is your best shot at getting a good grade in the class. Come consistently come to class and study the exam packet it will be okay.

Prof. Head is a decent teacher and knows her stuff but the class structure is pretty bad. The tests are a lot harder than the smartbook and connect exercises and it's very unclear how to study for the exams. The class is mainly based on 4 exams and hurt those who aren't good test takers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You need to go to class and pay attention otherwise the tests will be hard. Also do the homework because it really does help. Tests aren't horrible but you need to study. One of the better accounting teachers.

Julie really is a great teacher! She clearly knows all the ins and outs of accounting and is great at explaining that to her students. You can tell she is very passionate about teaching and wants the best for you. Accounting is difficult for a lot of people so I recommend doing all the course packet work and attending all the discussions.

Great accounting teacher. Accounting itself is a difficult course regardless of the professor, but Julie does a good job at communicating the topics clearly. Very prepared for class and ready to answer any and all questions.
Head isn't bad but exams way more difficult than necessary for this class. Take the class online through community college instead of Kelley, will be way easier.

I loved professor Head. I think the biggest reason people do not do well is because they are not sure how/what to study. Use her packet reader! It lays out the most important concepts. The smartbook is not always useful since it's not like the test. Head hand picks the most important concepts and puts them on her exams. Just don't get behind!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Julie is a good teacher for A304, but I will not lie the class is pretty terrible. You will have to go to office hours and do work outside of class in order to do well. She explains the material well but make sure you keep up with the work as this class moves fast if you let yourself start slipping.

Julie is a solid teacher; however, the class structure as a whole isn't great. This course as a offers very little flexibility and is mainly graded off of four tests. Beyond review session a few days before an exam and some of the discussion classes, there is really no class specific preparation for tests other than what you do yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Idk why people don't like her so much. She was a solid professor and was able to explain concepts well. It seems like she wants to see her students succeed. Prof. Head can be a bit awkward but as long as she is able to teach that's not a problem to me.

A201 was one of the hardest classes I have ever taken. With classes being online this semester, it definitely made it worse. Prof. Head didn't really teach anything during our one live class a week and the lecture videos were just her reading the notes from the course pack. Take the class with a different professor if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is not as bad as some people make her out to be. She explains concepts fairly well and puts out a lot of resources to help you succeed. This class is really about how much time you put in. Just be sure to keep up each week and make sure you practice a lot of review problems. Also don't skip discussion as it helps explain concepts in more detail
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Teaches ok but exams are very irrelevant to the coursework from Smartbook and Connect. Her brother apparently works at the IMU bookstore in which she will half force you to buy course packets from there. Wondering if there's anything fishy between her brother and her collaboration.

Notes for incoming students: Disregarding bad study habits, most students do poorly in this class because of what happens in the first 3 weeks. The first exam is CRUCIAL to success in this class. If you can put in extra work on the first exam, you will understand most of the concepts for the rest of the semester instead of playing catch-up.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Julie is your only choice for A201. She's a solid teacher. If you want to do well, you will have to read the textbook, it's the only way to actually learn the material. To study for tests, do/redo the packet exercises, they're very similar to the type of problem you'll see on tests. Discussion is where you reinforce what you learn so don't skip.
Professor Head was outstanding. She really cares about her students and provides so many resources to help them succeed. I would highly recommend taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Julie Head was a pretty solid teacher. Class is pretty exam heavy so you have to really put in the work for each and every exam. For exams, redo all the packet exercises, connect problems, discussion assignments, and the textbook because she will take some odd questions from it. Overall, you will need to put in a lot of work for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Julie is the only prof for A201, so you're stuck with her. A201 is really hard but she tries to help you understand the basic concepts. But her tests are HARD and you really aren't prepared for them even if you do all the work. I did every single assignment that we had and I still got consistent 70's on the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I thought Professor Head ran this class very well. There are so many different resources available for you to practice and understand the content. I am now studying for the final and feel that I don't really need to study too much because you will inevitably retain a lot of knowledge practicing through the units.

If you don't do every homework assignment, I'd say your chances of getting an A are pretty slim. She's a good professor, I think people say she isn't because the class is pretty hard, but nothing wrong with her. She can clarify any question you have and has done a great job adjusting the class with COVID. Would not suggest taking it as a freshman.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A201 isn't that tough if you spend time reading chapters every week and do the practice tests before exams. The course package includes all the slides, which summarizes the textbook. Professor Head gives students tips of preparing for each exam and lists out all the resources and help sessions before exams. Her lecture is heavy but really helpful.

Not bad at all. She did a great job adjusting the course to the COVID-19 situation and curved the last two exams. She also rounded up. Definitely knew what she was talking about in lectures and explained hard concepts pretty well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Head put a lot of effort into structuring the class carefully for the students to be successful. If you put time into reading the chapter each week, going to lecture, and doing the work she suggests, you will be fine. She is knowledgeable about accounting and is ready to help. She's truly a nice person and can be pretty funny sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Personally, I was not a fan of Professor Head. When it came time for exams there is literally no way of knowing what will actually be on them. Exam questions are FAR more difficult than what is in the course packet. Going to lecture felt like a waste of time. I admit I could have put in a bit more effort, but I was not a fan of this class/professor
Please take this course online. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Just take it in IU East

A201 is a very hard subject be prepared to put in the work. Attend class and ask a lot of question during your discussion class. Seek help if you need it, it is out there. Attend class, read the book to get a better understanding of the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I don't not like her as a person, she really does try to be nice, but her jokes are consistently awkward, and at times she's passive aggressive. The material of this course is hard so naturally it is difficult, but she is not the best teacher at least in my opinion. I'd avoid unless you're confident in your accounting skills and ability to learn it
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very difficult course and many struggle, but if you have taken any accounting in high school, the course may come easier. You do not have to read the textbook, but make sure to extensively review the material and do all optional homework. Utilizing practice problems and reviewing the lectures are much more useful than reading the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Accounting is definitely not my thing. This was the hardest class I took this semester. I think there should be a small amount of extra credit or less weight given to the 4 exams. Especially since the before curve average on one was a 75. This is a hard subject. Be ready for a ton of reading.

This class was very straightforward and gave a solid overview of financial accounting. Julie was a great professor who clearly explained many of the concepts and used examples to do so. Very important class to build your knowledge of accounting.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I enjoyed her class. A lot of work, tough, but fair. Some opportunity for extra credit.
I like Prof Head a lot. Her jokes are kind of lame but it is clear that she loves accounting and the class is not too difficult.

IF YOURE NOT AN ACCOUNTING MAJOR TAKE THIS THROUGH A COMMUNITY COLLEGE. If you don't think the same way accountants do, you're screwed for the exams. You have to know the material in and out and if you don't see accounting in the same perspective Julie Head does, you're guaranteed a W on your transcript. Save the grief kids, don't take it here!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring and not very helpful. Exams are much more difficult than the practice problems given. Make sure to do the online homework as you learn the material and don't wait to do them until the last minute because it can be very time consuming. Some exams had a 60% average. Gave a curve at the end of the class.

By far the worst class I have ever taken. She gives practice tests that arent like the actual tests, which have very specific theoretical questions that arent gone over. Its not enough to do practice in course packet, tests, and discussion. I did that for practice and got a B. Read the textbook and understand it. Doesnt go over whats on test
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are a little tricky and some questions are based on material she only talks about in lecture. You need a solid understanding of computational material and an even more solid understanding of the theoretical material. Prof Head is incredibly caring, but does not do a great job of explaining.
Her lecture is useless in terms of preparing for tests. Terrible professor, terrible class to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I hate accounting but Professor Head made it a little better. I thought she was funny and definitely cared about her students. A201 is a very hard class, but there are lots of resources for help.

This class was by no means "easy." But, to be fully honest, you should be able to do fine if you put in the work. I didn't do any practice tests for the final and got a near perfect on it ( I did practice tests for the first three tests and didn't do so well). If you understand WHY things work + the entries then you should be fine. Julie was great!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Julie's lectures are dry and unhelpful. Her practice tests (when she decides to give them to you--didn't for the first test) often do not correlate with the actual test and lecture material. But, those practice tests are your main study material. Only the easiest material is covered in lecture.

This has been one of the worst classes I have ever taken at IU. The lectures are extremely unhelpful. Her practice tests (if she decides to even give some out) do not correlate with the actual test despite being "old test questions". She does not prepare you for the test at all. Extremely disappointed she is the only A201 teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Prof. Head is your only option for A201, but she teaches a good class nonetheless. My one problem with this course is that all the toughest material is covered RIGHT before the exam. Make sure you really understand the early material so you have plenty of time to study the harder stuff. Do all the practice problems, the coursepack is your friend.

Make sure to never be behind in this class or else you will suffer. The material is taught relatively quick, so make sure to get help as soon as possible whenever you need it. Being an Accounting major, I've enjoyed this course and thought the professor did an excellent job teaching the material.

Julie cares for her students and wants them to pass. If you go to her for help she will always be there to help you and go out of her way. She also offers so many resources to help students study and pass.
loved her lecture, most helpful thing in A201 period

Julie is a solid professor and I'm pretty sure she is also your only option. You don't have to go to your assigned class time which is nice, so if you got stuck with the 8 or 9 leave space in your schedule later in the day. Do the reading always go to class and discussion. My TA was awesome so I didn't really have to study that much for exams.
Very nice, go to class and you'll be fine

I think Julie is a good professor. The course packet is compiled well to highlight key concepts and she does a good job explaining them. There are homework assignments before and after a chapter which are tedious but could save your grade. The exams are not tricky but can be if you are unprepared.
Julie is great. She makes the class interesting, which is difficult with accounting. Cares about her students. She's pretty funny too.

Accounting is a tough class, even worse due to the large size. However, Julie really knows how to communicate clearly. If someone complains about the class, it's because they didn't do the reading and homework. She designed the packet, discussions and lectures to flow so well. It is very time consuming, so watch out for that.

This class is tough and people have to be prepared to put in the time to understand the concepts. Her lectures arent bad, but I would suggest reading the book and doing the questions in the back; the practice tests are too easy. Overall, your gonna have to put in a lot of extra time on your own if you wanna do well on tests.
If she's the only teacher then your stuck. Accounting is accounting. Read the book and read through the slides every now and then. don't fall behind doeee
Go to lecture, discussion, and read the book and you'll be fine.  It's a hard class, but as long as you actually take attention and put in effort you'll do fine

She will not go out of her way to help you, because she "has too many students." She is rude, selfish, and overall a very strict professor. having said that...she is predictable. Go to class, go to lab, and read the workbook. You'll do fine.

Classes aren't very useful, she just talks about concepts when everything is based on examples she fails to show you how to do. Puts all of that on the discussion leaders who are grad students that barely remember how to make a journal entry.

Overall a good professor for a TOUGH class. She's sarcastic and kind of blunt which made for better explanations of the material, and I found her course packet to be useful. Only minor complaint was that I felt like I was inconveniencing her the couple times I went to her office hours, but the course is structured enough to potentially do well.

The coursepacks used in class are supposed to be filled in during class. So if you miss class for whatever reason, she structures the coursepacks in such a way that it makes it extremely difficult (if not impossible) to learn the material on your own. My A202 teacher didn't try to further screw students who missed class... not sure why she does.

Julie is very energetic and friendly but her voice is not the first thing you want to hear in the morning. Can get by without doing the readings. The lab is most helpful. She tells you all the tricks she will throw at you in class so attend class. Tests are somewhat challenging and the final was pretty difficult (curved the final overall grade 6%!)
Great teacher! She knows what she's talking about and is very helpful. I highly recommend taking her class.
She sets strict rules. If you're late, you might need to sing IU fighting song:( However, she clarifies most stuff in class and keeps tracking your process.
Not a terrible teacher, lectures are useful, although she makes a point that you can't be late to class

Not as good as Tiller, the A201 teacher.  Tests are hard and she messes up a lot in class which tends to make you confused.  Not a terrible teacher by any means but make sure you go to class and read the book as well.
This prof is a good one, but the tests are tough. The class and lectures are taught at one level and the tests are a few levels above that. You HAVE to read the book if you want a good grade.

Professor Head is an amazing teacher -- she explains concepts better than all the other professors I have had and uses real-life examples from her experience as an auditor at KPMG. However, I recommend that you do NOT go to her office hours. She is hilarious in lecture, but if you go to her office hours be prepared to not think of her the same...

The worst teacher ever. All she does is go on about her personal life (NO ONE CARES!). The class seems easy but when it comes to the tests, they are hard. She doesn't prepare you for any exam. WORST TEACHER EVER!

Best Professor in Kelley School of Business. Very helpful, but will not let you slack. Do your work and you should not have a problem in getting a good grade because of how clearly Mrs. Head explains the subject.

she is a talent! she knows accounting very well.She explains cost accounting very well in class too. but she is very arrogant to students. she doesnt care student's feelings. sometimes she is mean(but not very often). exams are extemely hard!! so if u really want to learn sth, take her class. but if u want to have a good grade, probably u dont!

Julie Head is a very helpful and understanding professor and she provides good examples but her tests are a completely different story. For A201 be prepared to put in a lot of hard work outside of class to get a good grade. She expects you to know accounting like its yours religion. Class average on the midterm was 77% , She does not curve :(..
Read the book and pay attention in class...you should get a decent grade. Most importantly, she is FAIR...unlike some other A100 teachers!!

Absoloute worst accounting instructor I've ever had. She's patronizing, and rambles on like a radio when she teaches. She just expects students to understand stuff in lecture, without giving anyone time to let the material sink in. I hated this class.

Exams and class materials provided were clear and to the point.  Students more or less knew what was expected for the exams.  An overall quality professor who cares about her students and their success in the class.
Julie Head is hilarious, plus she knows exactly what she is talking about and relays it to the students well! No complaints!
A bit on the boring side. Hot for a prof.
A good professor that can explain the material in a way that a beginer can understand it and use it.  If you listen to what she says, you will be all set.
I seriously wish I had someone else for this class.  I pity the children taking her in the fall.
Great professor.  Has her own handouts and does not teach out of the book.  Very fair exams and has a lot of energy.
I have absolutely no opinion of this woman whatsoever.  Very bland.  Very vanilla.  And other various descriptive words to describe a somewhat boring person and subject.  Blah.
Overall not a very hard class.  Takes attendance, so attend even if you can learn most of the material from the book.
doesn't teach, she deposits info through books and lectures
If you read the book it's a really easy class.  She's a fair teacher, if you show up late for class you don't have a right to turn in the homework
There were four homework assignments, midterm, and a final. If you don't read and memorize stuff as you learn it you will be screwed. A fun proffesor, but sometimes a little cranky.
i think she's really funny, it's just the class that sucks....
The tests are weighted too much, and pretty tough as well. But otherwise she's a nice lady.
I mean...look at the material. She makes a boring class rather fun. In the upper 10% of the professors in IU.
Everyone told me told me I was unlucky to have her, but she's lot better a professor and a lot nicer than people make her out to be. The key is keeping up with the reading, do that, and you're set
She's a good teacher, compare to other teachers here at the school....I suggest you take her than the other ones
Ms. Head is a great professor who is interested in her students.  Although the class is difficult, if you study and keep up with the work you will do fine.
really enthusiastic, the class isnt as hard as people make it out to be-- just keep up with the readings, thats all.
she is the most akward looking person i have ever seen.  looking at her for  50 miutes made my head hurt.
She is nice but too dingy. She always went off topic talking about her kids. To me the exam wasn't like anything she lectured about.
Very knowledgable and professional.  Come to class and you'll learn a lot!  Best prof at IU that I've had yet.
I wish I got quizzed on what sports her kids play and how much she hates her sister in law.
Although I disliked her for A100, she is an Excellent teacher in A305.  Fairly easy, very useful!
Professor Head is a wonderful teacher and I highly reccommend her. Her course is quite difficult but there is help out there. Go to lecture and practise what you learn.
Skims over material in class and expects in-depth answers on exams.  Seems like more of a grade school teacher than college prof.
She's great - hard class, but prof it great.
I know more about her kids than she does!
No Comments
Very charasmatic; great teacher. But class is too easy compared to exams.
She is hot! A great teacher!
Worthless class.
Class was not very interesting.
Treats students like in elementary school. Talks to much about her kids.

I had her for Q295 and she was honestly just so chill
Participate a little bit in class and you'll be a favorite

I had her for Q295: Design Your Life and Career, and she was a great professor! Cares about her students and wants to make sure everyone passes. Creates a very welcoming enviornment, can only miss two classes, otherwise can impact grade. Pass/Fail.
I took Q295 with her, and she is a good professor. This class is mandatory, and it is a very boring, pointless class. However, she tries her best to make it fun and interactive.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took Q295: Design Your Life and Career. She's super sweet and the class is really easy. Just don't skip very often and you'll be fine.

She is the goat. I was struggling to find someone to talk to for one of our assignments and she gave me her friends email so I could pass the assignment. She plays music from the classes combined playlist that we made at the beginning of the semester. Overall so chill and relatable. Take her if you can.

Lindsay is a great professor. Her class is very easy in itself and the only way you can really hurt your grade is if you don't attend class. Very flexible, understanding, and honest professor. Easily one of the most chill professors I've had and she's very easy to like. I enjoyed taking her class a lot.
Queen!!! Very chill, obviously cares about her students. Wonderful atmosphere in the room. Plays 10/10 music before class. Take her !!
Professor Heben is by far my most flexible professor. She is always willing to work with students in and out of class. Her lectures are also very enjoyable!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a great professor who cares about forming relationships with students. Her lectures are engaging and allow for the students to get to know each other better. All of the information she gives you is very useful for the business world.

Fortunately I didn't have as bad of an experience with him as other reviewers. He wasn't the most coherent with his lectures, so I would wait until the morning recitations to actually try to learn the material with the recitation leader. Unnecessarily loud, but still kind and patient to students who weren't understanding the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Absolutely one of the BEST professors on campus that I have ever had the FORTUNE of meeting. He NEVER answers his email which is perfectly fine because I didn't need my question answered anyways :) He also so kindly teaches in the most confusing way ever which definitely helps! For sure take this class with him if you do not care about your gpa!
Not a good teacher at all makes you feel bad about your questions and doesn't make sure students understand and teaches more in German than English.
Offers office hours that are completely time generous and massively beneficial. If you put effort into the class, you'll do well. Very kind-hearted and generous professor.

I had prof Hendrickson in 2016 my freshman year of college for finite. I struggled in this class but went to every single office hour he had to offer. He truly cared about helping students. If you put the work in, you can be successful in this class. He helped prepare me up for the rest of college and set me up for success in life.

I took Algebra and AP Calc in high school, which are the two main topics taught in this course (along with Finite), but he teaches it in a way that is so roundabout that barely anyone can understand. I didn't learn Finite before and learning it with him for the first time was the worst experience. My friends also couldn't understand.

He presents this class and his teaching style as a "review session." Make sure you know how to do the material in this class because he expects you to know what hes talking about. He's very nice and funny and let us out early. Go to his office hours very helpful. Hw was harder than tests and long. Tests weren't that hard, but the optional final was

Genuinely a nice guy and he wants you to do well. His powerpoints weren't always helpful but if you studied and reviewed the practice exams from previous years, the exams weren't bad at all. 3 exams, all multiple choice, ranging from 12-14 questions. Study, use AI for the in-class activities and the homework (not on exam at all) and you'll be fine
Was not a good teacher. It's easier to study by yourself.

Seems like a nice guy but just a horrible teacher. In class activitys are wrong sometimes. Homework is so much harder then what is shown in class. Teaching math on a slideshow is a joke. Tests are very difficult too. Would not reccomend one bit nice guy but terrible teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is like that one scene from captain underpants when they had saturday class. You are better off fading and self-studying if you want to be mentally sane...The way he teaches is a joke, lectures have horrible pacing and he yaps about random stuff. The assigned homework is like the code of hammurabi. In-class activities are ALWAYS WRONG.
I would of thought a school like IU would have higher standards for their faculty than this.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Might be the worst teacher at IU. Very unhelpful, never responds to emails, his in class quizzes are almost always wrong, his powerpoints are unhelpful, and his teaching style is awful. If you don't have a religion, get one and pray for a good grade because that is all you can do. Let alone 12 questions determine 22% of your grade with this course.

One of the worst professors I have ever had. He teaches through PowerPoint, and it's just awful to follow along. The only good thing is that he is nice. Take another teacher if you can, because this class is pure self-teaching.

Mr Hendrickson is nice and likes to joke around in class, his tests are not too hard if you know the basics of what he's teaching. He's not great at teaching the content but if you took calculus in High school it's easy. I found yt videos online more helpful for studying than his classes. He posts practice exams and if you can do those tests are ez
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Made a lot of jokes in class but his teaching isn't great. Did good because I already had credit for Calc I-II and Stat and found out I didn't need to take this later. Can't imagine taking this without knowing anything beforehand.

He is not a very good professor. he can be funny but his main problem is his slides are unhelpful and the homework takes forever. 10-25 problems are given per class and you have a week to complete them.
I would not take this class with this teacher.
The homework is super long and it auto corrects your answers, but the auto-grader is wrong half the time. The stuff on the homework assignments usually aren't taught in class either.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seems like a nice guy but teaches content poorly, and the homework is completely different

He seems like a nice person, but the class was awful. The randomly-generated homework was riddled with glitches such as impossible problems that not even my tutor could solve and assignments not submitting even when you click submit. He was openly aware of these issues but would never do anything. I will say office hours were helpful for review.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: (History of Math): I thought Jim's lectures were pretty entertaining, and he's personable. But the exams were the worst kind of history, reciting random trivial facts rather than focusing on anything meaningful. The math on the homework was often not touched on in class. The grader (who was not jim) was overly picky, and grading took up to 8 weeks.

Not a good math teacher. Teaching math through PowerPoint is a joke. Hw is harder than his lectures and not really correlating with what is currently being taught. And somehow all of it combined and the practice tests provided still isn't helpful enough. Don't have him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a really bad actual teacher. When a student would ask him to explain something, he would respond, "Were you not listening? Why weren't you listening?" and then not answer the question. He also did not explain the topics very well and went very fast. The math site used is unhelpful, and he has such weird deadlines.

GO TO OFFICE HOURS! Math is hard, but he isn't a bad prof. at all. I went to office hours, and it made the world's difference. He is super funny and caring. IU has a difficult math program in general, but he is actually a great prof that I would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lowkey I don't know how this dude became a professor. His slides were one of the worst slides that I have ever seen in my life.

IU finite is seriously hard, no matter which professor you have. Hendrickson definitely knows his stuff, so going to his office hours will definitely help u prep for the exams, it helped me a lot more than I thought it would. He likes to include weird graphics and facts about totally unrelated stuff which really confused me.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think Professor Hendrickson taught a difficult course very well. IU Finite is no joke, but I always felt like he thoroughly went over content and answered any questions students had during class. I never went to office hours, and I still did well on tests and homework simply because I took thorough notes. Show up to class and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: his lectures are not helpful, the homework is significantly more difficult than anything reviewed in class, overall, one of the worst professors I've ever had.

Finite mathematics at IU is already notoriously hard by itself, but having a bad professor adds to the rigor even more. His lectures consist of him quickly clicking through premade slides and not really adding to them much at all. Office hours are an absolute necessity in order to do decently well in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Hendrickson is one of the most frustrating professors I've had so far. He gives many examples during lectures but none of them apply to the type of work you would do on both the homework and exams. Lots of homework. Lots and lots of homework. He does review before every exam but only does it through Kahoot, which is extremely unhelpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: James is a wonderful person who deeply cares about his students, I only went to office hours twice, and he even greeted me by name before some lectures. He is a very talented mathematician. A student asked a question and he wrote a PROOF on why something works. If you show up to lecture, take good notes, and seek help when needed, you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: When questions were asked during class, just a simple clarification or questions about the homework, he made the students feel dumb. It wasnt a space where I felt comfortable enough to ask questions which is an issue for a class like finite. Definitely recommend taking any Professor other than him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Make sure you go to office hours, find the free online textbook. Thats where you learn how to do the harder homework questions. Jim is a funky but cool guy and is super nice if you get on his good side. Make sure you actually go to class, finite at IU is notorious for being difficult. And it is, but its manageable if you take care of your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hendrickson is actually from hell. The most unenjoyable experience of my college career. Genuinely a bad person. Take someone else.

James did not teach this class. He put a slideshow up on the board and rapidly clicked through the slides. Between the slides, James would attempt to make corny jokes in which the classroom responded to with silence. Seriously. The whole semester not one person laughed at a joke of his. I had to spend money for tutoring because I didnt understand.
Gives a lot of homework compared to other finite profs, but not the worst. He is pretty funny and tries to make the class more fun, but he can be really confusing in his explanations.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: worst teacher ever. never answers emails and gives lots of homework. his tests are insanely hard and he doesn't care how his class does overall. we have far more exams/quizzes than other students. lectures are pointless and useless. goes way too fast bc he thinks everyone understands his god-awful notes. news flash jim, we don't get it!

does not respond to his emails he has a lot of students so he doesn't really care if you are failing or not. webwork is a lot of problems and he assigns a lot but if you know how to do those then you will probably do good on the tests.
if u skip this class, the note that he posted on canvas is not the same as the one in class and he make sure of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: WORST TEACHER EVER, if you have him switch
He is a really nice guy and was a fun teacher, but the class was very difficult and he didn't help with that very much.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I would not recommend Hendrickson for anyone that isn't good at math. He isn't a very good teacher and gives a lot of homework. Going to homework help in the dorms and paying for campus tutoring is how me and my friends passed.

This prof made finite wayyy harder than any other finite class Ive talked too. He never responded to my emails and tests were much more difficult than other classes. The worst part was that his weekly lectures were only ever used for kahoot quizzes that were basically pointless. Worst ever do not take his class.
Made his tests very hard and they had nothing to do with the massive homework assignments we were given. the final had nothing similar on it to the final exam review.

This semester was very different and challenging for everyone. Hendrickson did not make it any easier. He did not put students first. He was rude and short in emails to students when they asked him questions. He obviously knows the topics, but acts like we know everything as well. Would recommend trying to get a different professor.

Not very responsive to emails even though class is all online. Only finite class I know of with weekly quizzes and most homework out of all courses, also his lectures are useless. Definitely would not suggest taking his course, all the other professors are way better from what I've heard
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hendrickson is a complete disgrace to even regard him as a teacher no textbook use no help and extreemly hard grading with little teaching to even allow for it. He ignores students and regularly ignores emails if you want to take M118 take any other professor avaiable and dont make the mistake I did you will regret it.

Professor Hendrickson makes no attempt to help students even during these difficult times. Lectures are simple and easy problems, yet the 20+ question homework assigned 3 times a week are problems NOT TAUGHT IN CLASS, IN LECTURES, OR IN NOTES. He does not reply to emails there are so many reasons to not take this professor but it' too many to list.

He purposefully deviated from the other professors when giving exams and routinely assigns much more work than necessary. He offers little help for students with questions and has even muted people that try to ask questions during zoom lectures or kahoot practices.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Take any other available professor, trust me. Even if youre great at math Hendrickson is a huge disadvantage to have as a professor. The disparity between his course and all of her finite classes is beyond unfair. While some classes are allowed 3 attempts on exams, we were on lockdown browser, werent allowed out graphing calculator, or our notes.
Horrible. Never responds to emails, even during pandemic and online class. Keeps grades locked all semester and does not update you on your grade.

Has easily topped my list of worst teachers ever. He is very knowledgeable, but is horrible at conveying how to solve or understand problems to students who don't happen to have a career in math. Boring and hard to understand lecture and an unnecessary amount of homework. Finite is hard enough as is, and he doesn't help your case whatsoever.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hes incredibly lazy. I went to his office hours to ask for more specific feedback on my test and he told me to take it to a tutor rather than going over the problems.

Finite is hard, but he helped as much as he could. He made class fun, and he got the class involved in lectures. Ive taken finite 3 times, and I can honestly say that he was my favorite professor. I actually passed exams. The homework is what got me a C. Do the homework, study and you may get a B or A.

I am currently in Hendrickson's M118 class a I did not do well on the first exam. The exams have about 12-13 MC questions which does not give you much of an opportunity to get things wrong. However, there are multiple exams allowing you to get your grade up. I highly recommend meeting with him during his office hours; EXTREMELY helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Finite may be a tougher class for a lot of people, so a good professor is very important. I liked Hendrickson a lot. I lived in Briscoe, and he was always there helping out kids.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Hendrickson definitely gives more homework than any other finite teacher at IU, however if you can keep up with the work and go to his lectures, you will have a better understanding of finite than any other section. I was literally tutoring other kids taking finite with other professors as I was in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have ever had, at any institution. Takes forever to grade exams and provides zero feedback about the curve and the actual exam itself. A truly sad case of laziness. Has no passion for what he does, and it shows. Luckily, the material itself isn't very difficult or else the class would be impossible as he doesn't know how to teach.

If you want to be good on math, just DO NOT take his lecture. He is the worst math lecturer I have ever seen. He also tries to make unnecessary jokes. He is way too busy making jokes in the class. JUST DO NOT TAKE IT
He tries to make unnecessary jokes and he will pick on people in class.
Cracks way too many jokes about foreign pop stars and how he doesnt have a wife. Seems like a nice guy, but I just could not understand most of the things. That is my fault not his.

reviews.comment: I had Hendrickson this fall for 8 am and originally was not a fan but if you attend lectures, go to extra help, and do the webwork you will learn. He tries to make it simple and although he makes some pretty bad jokes he is a great guy and good professor. Would take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: His tests consisted of, at most, 14 questions, mostly multiple choice, each question has 11 options.  It's fairly obvious that Mr. Hendrickson is a smart man. But because he has such an intuitive grasp of the subject, he has a hard time conveying the subject to people who aren't as mathematically inclined.

I can not stress enough when I say: Do not take this course if you have to take it with James Hendrickson.  He gave us 40 problem homework assignments when other classes had 8 problems. He ended lecture early out of spite. My last class of the first semester of school ended with him telling us to leave 20 minutes early during a final review.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Hendrickson gives an obscene amount of homework compared to other professors. Webwork tends to be around 20 problems and each problem will have 20 parts within itself. His notes and lectures are not helpful or organized and he usually takes around a month or so to get in test grades. He also gives weekly quizzes and clicker questions.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Jim doesn't make sure every student understands. He is way too busy making jokes in the class. He also doesn't hand back grades or keep the grade book up to date so you will never know what you have in the class.

During class he is too busy making jokes back and forth with certain students who already understand stuff and don't need any help. Gets distracted in class pretty easily, especially when a girl cusses at him and he entertains it instead of kicking her out and continuing to teach. He doesn't give back grades so you have no clue where you're at.

I do not recommend taking his class. Creates extremely hard quizzes and tests. He made the midterm and it was the most failed test in the history of the class. He will give you help if you go to office hours tho, so do that!
A good teacher, but a tough course. He explained most of the material well, and has plenty of office hours for help. Also, take the homework seriously and stay caught up and you'll be fine

Jim was sincerely my least favorite professor. His explanations of math were fine for me; however, he was so annoying trying to be funny that I dreaded attending lecture. If you struggle with math and don't find "so stupid its (not) funny" entertaining, I warn you against his class. I will also say that I am very good at math and barley got an A.

James is a pretty good finite teacher. I understood the material just from listening to lectures without going to office hours. He's pretty dorky and always wears a baseball jersey to class but he'll occasionally make a funny comment.
He is a great teacher and you can tell he really enjoy finite and he really tried to help his students to get better grade! He held review section before midterm and final!

Professor Hendrickson is probably the worst math teacher I have ever had. He tries way too hard to be funny instead of ensuring that the students are actually understanding the material. He speeds through major concepts and doesn't explain how he arrives at his answers.  If you have ANY difficulties with math at all DO NOT take his class.

He is very available to help and goes out of his way to make sure he is helping you in every way he can. (That is if you go to his office hours and show him you are willing to work.) works at the dorm help sessions like Teter and Briscoe as well as hosting office hours in rawles, test reviews etc. quizzes aren't impossible if you go to class.
Very clear

Honestly really weird, but he has an absurd sense of humor that I found funny. His examples made me laugh out loud sometimes and he is extremely willing to help. Do your homework and you're set. You can also tell he really enjoys Finite. I'm also taking his Calc class because I liked him a lot.
Very helpful
A little weird, but very friendly and you learn a lot in this class.

For F317 btw. Professor Hirsch is a funny dude - you can tell there is no one he loves more in this world than himself. He will speak about his investment banking/ceo/lawyer/part time god stints as if he is a higher being than quite literally everyone else on earth. But there lies professor hirsch's charm. Id rather learn from him than a nerd prof.

Became one of my favorite professors I had at Kelley. Was more than fair with grading, let kids make up quizzes and GAVE AN AMAZING extra credit assignment at the end of the year. Very passionate about topic. I also personally feel he was very caring and wanted people to succeed.
Prof Hirsch is the best teacher at IU. He brings real world experience and really teaches you things that will be applied in the real world and in jobs. GOAT!

*F317, not L375* I had a great time, it is not a difficult class, a lot of material, yes, but hard no. he has a lot of real experience. To me, the complaints I have heard about this course are dumb and not his fault. I really enjoyed the class and felt like I learned more here than in most all my IU classes. Would take and rec to friends
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Absolute stud

He makes the class incredibly easy as long as you show up and put in minimal effort, getting an A is a given. but some of the things he say in class have made many of my Asian friends uncomfortable. At times, his comments give off a sense of white superiority That said if you're a white student, this professor might seem absolutely perfect for you.
Super cool guy, he has so much experience and insight it is amazing to learn from. Class is basically just sitting and participating in lecture, and he makes it engaging so it is a very easy class.

Professor Hirsch is one of the best professors I have had at IU, especially for a business law class! He truly cares about his students and does his best to make sure his course prepares you for the "real world."

Anyone who says he doesn't teach, or is a bad professor honestly probably got a bad grade. I never went to class, I studied with ChatGPT study guides the day before every test and got an A. The curves are insanely generous, Mr Hill is literally the goat. My final exam got curved from a 77 to a 91, goat material right there
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Michael Hill is an okay professor. He is really slow when teaching which can be helpful for some, terribly boring for others. For M-119 he will randomly have in-classes quizzes worth 10 points (he drops 2 typically), but if you miss more than the 2 your grade will be significantly impacted. In addition to that, most of your grade is based off exams
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: was not a bad professor/explainer of concepts, but the homework assignments were way harder than the actual exams. the textbook was good, though. as long as you have a basic idea of what you're doing for each unit/section, you should be okay.

never took clac in highschool but had a hard time understanding the topics, his examples in class were nothing like the test. never knew how to study, the exams were so hard and edfinity took so long. he is overall a super nice guy, just not a good professor

This course is poorly structured.
