Professor Hunt is one of the most knowledgeable individuals regarding Chimpanzees and Primates in general. His class is not hard just have to read the lecture slides from last lecture and the Finals are made from the slides so you will find everything there. Amazing Lecturer, Engaging and very down will work with you if you have issues that arise

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!! I took this class for GEN ED credit and it quickly become a nightmare. There are quizzes every class and the final and midterm were atrocious. The final and midterm were based off random philosophy mostly and most questions were not lectured about for an appropriate amount of time. No extra credit, no curving grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hunt is knowledgeable & tells his own stories in lecture that are fun. Attendance is not mandatory (he posts slides), class grades made up of 3 exams, gives practice exams w/almost exact questions. Bumps grades with exam improvement! It is a difficult class, but it was my favorite this semester as a first year student!

Dr. Hunts class is very easy and not difficult to pass whatsoever. You will need to show up to do well however thats not a lot to ask. Take notes and youll be fine. He gives quizzes every class however they are super easy and only two questions! I thoroughly enjoyed this class and found it very interesting! Would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Hunt is a very nice and knowledgeable man. However, that does not make up for his awful lectures. Be prepared to not only sit through lectures of upwards of 99 slides, but to be weeks behind on material, and learn about material which has very little to nothing to do with the description of the class. The level of the class is highly deceptive.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Trust me, do not take this class. Way too much information for a 100 level class, I thought it was going to be easy but was the worst grade I have ever received and so hard. Don't waste your time
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This man is a menace to society. He is here to sell his textbook and fail you. Drop immediately.

Worst class I have ever taken. If youre looking for an easy gen ed dont take this class. Way too hard for a 100 level class. It is ridiculous how much information you are required to regurgitate for a class that has no real life application. Some of the information given has nothing to do with the subject. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROF!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take sister species with him. Took as a gen ed requirement for fun and got a 78. This is the lowest grade I have ever received before and he makes this class absolutely impossible. Very hard exams and quizzes every day in class without notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hunt is bad at time management but very knowledgeable about primates. I am sure he would be a fine, if not excellent, professor for one of his other lecture classes but this class is a two and a half hour seminar. We had 13 kids and he never once got through all the discussion questions. Only thing you do in class is answer questions. Very dry.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is awesome! He has a lot of experience in this field and is willing to share. He's very enthusiastic and willing to help students who are struggling. He is an interesting lecturer and will often tell stories about his studies in Africa.

If you want to learn about field research or primates, or any study of animals, I'd suggest taking this course. Professor Hunt is incredibly passionate and knowledgeable about chimpanzees and there's a lot to learn here. Readings and attending class is a must if you expect to do well on the two exams.

He is clearly very knowledgeable about chimpanzees and his lectures are fairly interesting. You have to show up to class because he gives out quizzes randomly. The only negative is that there are only 2 tests, so if you do bad on the midterm it can be hard to recover.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: His enthusiasm is contagious. He wants you to do well in his class and is willing to make adjustments if you talk to him in advance. His lectures are fascinating. It's not too difficult if you pay attention and go to class. Get ready to know more than you ever thought you would about every aspect of a chimp. This was probably my favorite class.

While his teaching style may not be for everyone, if your willing to put in the effort he is more than willing to work with you to help you succeed no matter your difficulties. Considering how big his class can get it's impressive how much he is willing to pay attention to each student.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Clearly passionate. Well-spoken. Often rambles. Posts lecture slides, but that doesn't mean you should skip - you'll want credit for the weekly quizzes. Focus on his presentation & do the work if you want to do well on the cumulative exams (& enjoy his class better). The lab exercises were fantastic! Toughest class that semester - but I loved it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I've had Professor Hunt for multiple classes and he is definitely one of my favorites. He is very personable and he wants everyone to succeed.

Terrible class. He got so behind at the beginning our first test was 2 weeks late, he told us the wrong date and then changed it TWO DAYS before the test (one less week to study), a big project wasn't assigned until a month after it was supposed to be, and the lectures are SO BORING and way too many slides. Class description also VERY misleading.

Professor Hunt is a nice guy but oh my GOSH are his lectures awful. His PowerPoints often run upwards of 99 slides, he speaks very soft and overuses the word "sexy" (someone please tell him to stop referring to chimps and other primates as sexy). Like I said, nice guy, but an awful professor.

Professor Hunt is very interested in the subject he teaches. There are some really cool parts of this class, but the majority of it is boring. I suggest going to class because he has a weekly 2 point quiz, which if you paid attention to the previous lecture you'll do just fine on. Not the best, but he's there to help. It's a gen-ed for science too

This is the best class I have ever taken at IU! You have to be really interested in chimpanzees in order to do well in this course. Prof. Hunt's exams are not easy, but if you take really good notes and study the PowerPoint slides, an A is possible!
Unorganized, uninteresting, bad lecturer, terrible grading system based off of two cumulative tests. This class has made me hate chimpanzees.

He gives the most interesting lectures out of almost any professor I've ever had. He's a good guy who is extremely helpful; he wants to see his students succeed and he'll take the time to help you. However, he's very disorganized and your grade rests on 2 tests (the final is cumulative) and 1 group project given at the end of the semester.
His class is unorganized and it's hard to know what he really wants you to focus on. The tests are cumulative as well. There is a lot of reading but if you find chimps interesting then it's not bad.

I was so excited because I love Kevin as a person, but as a professor he's way too unorganized and it's hard to know what he wants you to focus on. Readings are long and tests are pretty tough. This is my focus area and I'm having a hard time in a 100 level bc of his methods

Kevin Hunt is the bomb-diggity! His lectures are almost always interesting and he's just a friendly, easygoing guy. If you need to fill a Critical Approach requirement, I'd definitely recommend this one. Just make sure you study well for your exams.

I was excited to have Kevin as a professor, but I have been disappointed and lost interest in the subject as a result. His lectures are full of disorganized trivial information that he fails to tie to a larger picture, and he assumes students have some knowledge of anatomy and even primates. Also, the entire grade is base on the midterm and final.

As a professor very helpful and direct with regard to the material.  He understands the students position as being one of transition and not directly involved with the academic debates or other concerns that dominate the academics lifestyle. Do well in his class and he will do well by you. Ask questions.

Gives the best lectures I've ever heard, in any subject, any department. Laid back and perceptive, lives for student response. Teaches far beyond the technical aspects of his fields, but includes the social psychology of its scholars, as well -- useful lessons for ANY budding researcher. Beware: wicked amounts of reading.

Sooo hard but I learned more in one of his lectures than in any other class in its entirety. However, his expectations of knowledge both coming into the class and for exams is slightly unrealistic and unreasonable
Not helpful, when struggling

For a class on chimpanzees it wasn't a very easy class. You really must do the readings which are manageable. The class was very interesting and cool. Grade based mostly all on midterm and final and was tricky multiple choice.
The man is a primatological god.
No Comments

One of the best professors IU has. If you have an interest in Primatology his classes are an absolute must. Take a class with this guy if you have the chance. The material is difficult but his teaching style makes it easier than it could be.

Professor Hunt is the greatest Professor ever.  He is the nicest and most helpful person on this entire campus.  He's really nice yet not one of those Profs who want to be your best friend rather than your teacher.  Anyone disrespectful of him seriously should shut up and have their head examined.
Dr. Hunt is an amazingly great guy.  There is a lot to be learned from him.  Just sit back, listen, and feel your brain swell with knowledge.
No Comments
nice guy
Loves what he teaches and tells you what to study and be prepared for exam. Only downside is classes online he cold calls.
Very nice and the class is overall not that hard. Would recommend this class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The most personable professor I have ever had. Additionally, as far as online lectures go, Tony consistently sets the standard for how good they can be. Might not be the most interesting course content, but I would happily take a course with this man again.

Prof Huang is definitely trying his hardest to make this class better. However the online format can be very difficult especially when cameras are required to be on. Homeworks were always fairly easy and exams were not bad. Lectures seemed long and most slides had nothing to do with course material. Do well on the exams and you will be fine.

I loved Professor Hurley!! There is lots of information to take in during this class, but she makes the lectures interesting. She hosts review sessions for quizzes, and really isn't too crazy of a grader. She is amazing!!

Professor Hurley is just lovely! Her passion during lectures is just palpable and always left me feeling invigorated after class. I think her assignments are adequately challenging and her Friday discussion/activities were both fun and made the material all the more memorable. I miss her class so much!

Professor is nice and cares about students, but is an extremely picky grader. If something isn't answered exactly the way she wants, she will take points off. Discussion and weekly questions are half of your grade, so cant skip class. Class material isn't hard, just her grading makes it harder than needed.

Professor Hurley was one of my favorite professors! She was so kind and sweet, and deeply cared about her students passing the class. She responds to emails fast, so if you have any questions, you could get that answered fast. I 1000% recommend taking her. There was quite a bit of homework but their were take home quizzes which is nice!

I took Z460 Spring 2021 online. She was one of the most caring professors at IU, and if you ever need anything or have a problem dont be scared to reach out. Assignments can take a lot of time but instructions are clear and assignments and due dates are consistent throughout. Overall 10/10 recommend!
Hurley is a great professor an I highly recommend her. She wants her students to succeed. Study lectures and homework for her exams and you will do great.

Professor Hurley's class is almost a guaranteed A if you can remember the examples from class. Exams are easy. Projects are practicing everything already taught in other biology classes. Homework can take a while if you actually try to answer the questions but my AI basically graded for completion. Easiest biology class I've ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class was interesting, and not very work intensive. The tests were extremely straightforward, as long as you studied the lecture notes. The lectures could get long at times because they were 1 hour 15 min, but overall the class was worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you have to take this class for your major, Dr. Hurley is fine. Lectures are easy to understand and the tests are easy. She also holds 2 review sessions before each test that help a lot. However, she gives weekly homework that takes at least 2 hours to do, and she also gives you almost no direction for the huge final project.
Laura is a great professor! Class is definitely difficult but if you pay attention and try it's easy to get a good grade. Make sure you study the book for the tests, she will ask questions from it!

Professor Hwang teaches with great passion and will help you out if you need it. However, he speeds through his lectures so quickly that it's hard to grasp what he's saying. In addition, he won't explain assignments in full, and deducts points for weird reasons. As long as you show up and contribute to group work, it's a pretty easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He doesn't explain instructions for homework very clearly and takes off points for the smallest things that he doesn't like in the assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took the 8 week, async section and that was a huge mistake. The class isnt challenging or engaging and as a geography student, I was extremely disappointed in the quality of the course. Answers for the midterms are literally provided in the study guide. Taehee eliminated key aspects of the course bc he thought our class was too far behind

Teehee is a great professor. G237 is a great choice for a science credit. No outside lab component so only lecture. Minimal HW assigned. Getting an A is very easy if you show up, contribute to group work, and study. Half the test questions come VERBATIM off the study guide. Everything you need to know comes from his mouth during lecture so show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Progessor Hwang clearly cares about his students but lectures can be dry. He offers plenty of easy points, but does tend to deduct points for silly things at times. Tests are based on the provided study guide and are easy if you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor. Group works were fun. Lab works were a little tricky. Lots of homework. But if you do them, you will get A.

He's a fine professor, but I think he cares more about his Hydrogeology classes than he did this one. The reason I say that is because he never really seemed interested in the material, and for most of his lectures he seems to be just trying to get through the powerpoint. That being said, if you show up and do the work you'll probably get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Hwang is a good professor and it is clear that she is passionate about what she teaches, however I feel like she disregards our personal lives and our other classes. She assigned an entire book over a weekend, made the midtern due on Halloween, and assigned an entire book over Thanksgiving break when we were supposed to be getting a break
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Hwang is very knowledgeable and kind. She is so sweet and always open to help or guide you no matter how silly the question. Lectures are long and there is a lot of reading but overall the material isnt difficult and she is a fairly easy grader. Definitely cares about her students success and loves what she does. Love Prof Hwang!

An engaging class covering interesting topics of sex and gender. Lots of readings, but they are interesting. Class is basically a big discussion over readings and flushing out ideas and concepts. Exams are few but require a lot of work when administered. Good choice of professor and is helpful and open.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: The readings were interesting and she does a good job explaining material. never makes you feel dumb for asking a question.

I didn't expect much from this class, but it ended up being my favorite class because she mixed lectures with visuals and class discussions. She does make you talk in groups, but over time, you actually make friends. The exams were super straightforward, and she gives you one week to work on it. She really cares about her students doing well!

Amazing professor. So clearly invested not only in her work, but also so heavily cares about student's diverse opinions, experiences, and thoughts. Her passion is most certainly sociology and she loves to share it. Take this class, with no doubt. A little bit of a strict grader, but she's very accessible outside of class.
In-class assignments but rarely any out of class assignments on canvas so attendance does matter. This course is lecture heavy but very interesting and clear-cut.

Professor Kwon was an amazing instructor (SOC-S335). She is very well spoken and is knowledgeable about the subject. Class participation is your attendance grade, but was very insightful and led to great discussions. Essay exams were easy as long as you did the readings. I definitely recommend the class. One of the best professors at IU!

Sociology of Race (S335) was eye-opening! I never realized how deeply race shapes every aspect of society until this course. Plus, the class was surprisingly easy to follow! The concepts were clear, and the discussions helped me understand the material. I recommend this course to anyone interested in learning about race and its impact on society.

What truly sets Professor Kwon apart is her ability to navigate complex and sensitive topics with grace and empathy. She facilitated discussions on some of the most controversial topic, making sure that all viewpoints were heard and respected. she really demonstrated genuine care for her students' well-being!

I took SOC-S 335. The course materials were interesting and Dr. Kwon held productive lectures that always involved a discussion group. This class is pretty easy. You are graded on 3 exams (short essays) and 1 project. If you do the readings, you will do great on the assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Highly recommend!!! I love Professor Kwon - she very personable and kind and good at keeping her lectures engaging. Just show up to class, take notes on her lecture slides, and you will receive an A in this class. The take-home (online) exams are relevant to content reviewed in class so it's SO important to take notes and pay attention in class.

She is great! just take the class and you will know I what mean. She is definitory busy, but once you talk to her about your circumstance, she will hear you out.  Having a take-home exam is also great; I loved everything about this class.

Professor Kwon was the BEST professor I've had at IU. She really hears and values our perspectives. The course materials are thought-provoking. As someone with aspirations to work with children in the future, this course has been incredibly beneficial to me. I highly recommend taking Professor Kwon's class- you won't regret.

Dr. Kwon is a great professor. The class is essentially doing a (sometimes way too long) reading and then answering discussion questions that are included in the lecture on it with your groups that are formed in class. Three exam essays and a final project are also part of the grade. Easy A+ if you put effort into this class.

reviews.comment: Dr. Kwon's Sociology of Childhood class was definitely heavy on reading, but reads were interesting if you took the time to invest. There is no text book, and the class largely revolves around discussing of assigned readings, in addition to personal experiences.

Amazing stats professor! Emphasizes that this course isn't math based and focuses on learning the concepts. There's weekly lessons and the workshops always covered the course material needed to complete the homework. He wants the best for his students and is very accessible for help. Take his course if you ever get the chance!

Amazing professor for stats! Emphasizes that this course isn't math based and focuses on learning the concepts. You get weekly lecture quizzes, very short and always has a feedback quiz for more help. Workshops always covered what ideas to complete the homework. He really wants the best for his students. I would 100% take this again!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: My favorite professor I've had so far at IU. His lectures are amazing, and his teaching style and humor makes tough content easy to understand. I've emailed him with questions about the homework several times throughout the course and he has always responded within the hour. I seriously cannot recommend him enough.

I highly recommend this class and especially the professor! Lectures were engaging even on days when I didn't find the subject matter as exciting. The workload was not overwhelming, but it is heavily group project based. Overall, I cannot recommend this professor enough, he is so helpful and gives great feedback!
rick was a super funny professor but I think the class was just a lot of work than I was prepared for as a first semester freshman - and this class made me switch majors!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is so genuinely kind. He truly cares! This class was pretty easy but still challenged your thoughts on things like articles, truths of science, etc. I would recommend :))

Greatest of all time! Do not take statistics with anyone else. His lectures were great and he emphasizes understanding the concepts/applications rather than brute force memorizing random formulas/math. He was very helpful and is super chill if you talk with him.

man is best Professor in IU !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

i never rate professors here , but this is a must .
if u dont take stats with him , im sorry for u .i am very very sorry for u

The ratings don't lie. Rick makes a usually hard class palatable and understandable. He's funny, clear, and such a kind man. He encourages communication when you need help and makes sure you know what you're doing every step of the way. He reiterates that his stats course is NOT a math class, and he means it. I cannot recommend Rick enough.
This professor is great. His lectures are both fun and interesting. It is also very clear what he expects and is extremely fair in terms of grading
Such a nice, fun and engaging professor and is always willing to help you out. wants to see you do well! highly recommend!

Rick is a cut above your typical professor. Passionate about his field, makes an otherwise difficult concept accessible to anyone willing to do what is asked of them. P-value is the probability of obtaining test results at least as extreme as the result actually observed, under the assumption that the null hypothesis is correct. Ratings don't lie.
Literally awesome. So understanding and good hearted too!

Professor Hullinger engages with his students in a critical way while remaining respectful and engaged with their needs. Overall, I disliked the content of the course he taught, but Professor Hullinger more than made up for it. My only complaint is that there were many small assignments, which were sometimes difficult to keep track of.

Rick is a fantastic professor! While I didn't love the content of the class, he managed to keep my interest because of his lecture style. He's very engaging, interesting, and funny. I loved having class with him and would 100% take a class with him again.

Stats can be intimidating, but Rick breaks it down well. In the hybrid course lectures were online, and we met once a week to apply what we learned. Test material is very clear, and Rick is available to provide extra help. He is passionate about statistics and includes corny jokes throughout lectures in attempt to entertain students...and himself.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Rick is absolutely hilarious. He's very personable and accessible (feels more like a friendly mentor than a daunting professor). He tends to get super excited during his lectures and get off track. Sometimes I can't tell if what he's talking about is actually supposed to be taken down as notes or not. But he's incredibly enthusiastic/ great vibe!

I can not recommend to take stats with Rick enough. He is the best professor I've ever had and makes class enjoyable. He's so funny and down to earth and you can tell he really loves stats and wants all of his students to do well. His class is setup perfectly to make sure you are actually learning but not overwhelmed with work.
Cannot recommend him enough. The best professor I have had so far (sophomore). He wants you to succeed and do the best you can do. Highly recommend him.

TAKE STATS WITH RICK. Listen: rick is an amazing professor. I hate stats but he made it 10x more enjoyable and bearable. He's funny and makes his lectures more enjoyable and he's super accessible through his office hours or emails. Super kind and understanding and willing to help you through the course. I'm telling you, take stats with rick!!!!

Professor Hullinger is hands down the best lecturer I've had so far. He truly cares about the wellbeing of his students and you can tell that he's passionate about the subject matter being taught. He provides clear feedback and is a speedy grader. Additionally, he has a great sense of humor and a very positive vibe. I can't recommend him enough!

Dr. Hullinger is an excellent, engaging lecturer. This class is a lot of reading of scientific papers, but this just comes with the territory. He is very personable, which makes him more approachable when you need help with assignments.

Rick is approachable and truly wants his students to succeed. You'll have to put in the work and attend lectures obviously, but he provides you with all the tools and information you need to do well on labs and tests. No surprises!! He's very energetic and funny, so it's pretty easy to stay awake even if the lecture is boring.

reviews.comment: not even a real stats class, only concerned with the semantics of it, you will learn absolutely nothing so go take another class instead of having to memorize phrasing just to get a good grade, AIs are not helpful at all and will let you screw up the first exam instead of telling you what to change before

Rick is the best lecturer I've ever had. He's easily my favorite professor at IU and as a senior, I've tested out a lot of them! I truly felt like if you listened in class (which is easy because hes a great lecturer) you don't need to put in much study time outside of class except for a quick refresher before tests. He's a really good guy.

Easily one of my top 3 professors of all time. Rick made this class comical & entertaining for something that, going into, I suspected would be very boring and monotonous. His exams are fairly difficult and require that you pay attention to lectures and in labs, but all course expectations are fair. Attendance via TopHat are easy points.
Such a fun guy that clearly cares about student understanding. Easily the best professor at IU. Lots of nerdy jokes. If you ever have the chance to take a class with him, be sure to!!

Rick is super fun and makes stats interesting, I'm definitely glad I had him as my prof! Among other things, he is really good about improving himself and accepting feedback. He has an anonymous feedback form where you can ask him a question or voice a concern anonymously and he addresses the feedback directly in lecture. I wish more profs did this

I had Rick for K300 and I could not recommend him enough! He is patient with the students and will explain anything you're still confused about over and over if it is needed, without making you feel dumb for not understanding and without being annoyed by the confusion. He is also super entertaining and funny! His lectures always brighten my day! :)

Rick is incredible, truly one of the top two teachers I have ever had in my entire life. I didn't think I would enjoy statistics, but he makes the subject fun and interesting and the funny examples he uses makes them easy to remember. Tests can be tough, but it is easy to meet with him in office hours where he will make sure you are prepared.

Rick was a really great lecturer! I really enjoyed going to his lectures! The only thing is he legit only lectures, the AIs go through actual assignments and grade all of the essays. So I really enjoyed him (and my AI) but you dont have a choice in lecturers for this class, but hes great
Lectures are unhelpful but you need to go for the attendance credit. This class boils down to your AI and their standards for the four papers which are the majority of your grade.
Great prof and super easy to ask for help with him. His tests can be challenging, but if you work, you will do fine. The lab section is annoying and not to helpful imo.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great professor & class. Loved the way it was structured. One in class group assignment and one homework assignment per week. Tests have two parts: 1. in-class, concept-heavy 2. take-home, problem-solving. Allowed 5 free absences and participation is only 5% of grade and lectures are recorded. So going to class isn't that important.

Great Professor. Class is pretty easy if you keep up, nothing goes deeper than a 101 level. AI's grading varies so find one with good reviews, one of them grade way tougher and this well very much effect your grade. Tests are way easier than you think, you'll probably over study for them.

Rick is by far the best professor I have ever had. Shows up to every lecture fully prepared, & is there to help you succeed. He is extremely accessible outside of class & will answer your emails within the hour. I took 2 classes by Rick this semester & do not regret it. Makes terrible classes like stats & methods of experiments a LOT better.

The papers are not easy and are graded by A.I.'s instead. While Richard may be an okay professor, my AI was very poor at describing the things we needed to do and there was lots of ambiguity to what we were supposed to be doing. Richard is only 15% of this class, the A.I is the other portion. Don't procrastinate. Ask questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Rick was awesome, he was great to talk to if you needed help and always gave good feedback. He does make you read a lot but it isn't too terrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Love this guy, makes class interesting, no pressure to go to class (8 skips allowed), easy course material
Professor Hullinger is one of my favorite professors. He makes class enjoyable and engaging. He's hilarious and actually cares about his students. I would highly recommend a course with him!

Rick is the best prof I have had in college so far. He always makes sure students understand the content before moving on, but has no problem going back to discuss it. The lecture of P211 was at 9 am on Mondays, but I didn't have a problem getting up to go to Rick's class. Great prof for a mandatory psych class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Rick is one of my favorite professors.  I had him for both P211 and K300 and I passed both classes with an A (easily).  He makes the material super easy to understand and really encourages questions and comments.  He is also hilarious!! Even though attendance isn't necessary, I go because he honestly just brightens up my day.
Richard is a very well-liked professor :D

I thought he was great! I love the way he explains things so that I can really understand. Professor Hullinger is very clear and patient. If you pay attention and ask questions, you'll be fine.  We had no text book.
Rick is awesome! Loved attending his lectures. So clear and organized. Can miss 3 lectures (they are only once a week) and still get full points for participation for final grade.

I hate math with a burning passion, but I had to take statistics through the psych department. I went in with a less than excited attitude but Rick definitely helped change that! The classes were actually interesting and Rick is hilarious. I went to office hours weekly and got A's on my homework.
By far best teacher I've had at IU so far. What a nice guy

I took P211 with him, and although I pretty much already knew all the material he covered, I was still intrigued to pay attention to his lectures. Super nice guy, would take a different class with him in a heartbeat.

P211 can be dreaded by some, but this class was actually really enjoyable and Rick is a very approachable and funny teacher. Have him again this semester for Stats and really excited! Take this class with him if you can!

Minds and Machines was a great class with Rick! Hardest part was lab section and trying to learn basic coding. He also had anonymous feedback so anytime you were unhappy with something you could send it to him anonymously and then he would read it in class and everyone got a chance to weigh in.

One of the best professors I've had throughout my three years at IU so far, right next to Irene. If you take P335 with another professor, expect to hate the content and possibly not even do well in the class. He records his lectures, and attendance is not mandatory, but attend class if you want the quizzes and final to be a breeze. You'll love him!

Rick is totally awesome! Hands-down the best teacher I've ever had. I took psych 101 with him in Fall 2014 and I absolutely loved it--I was actually super sad when I had to miss any lectures. His tests & assignments are very straight-forward and he is happy to explain any material if you ask. Send him cat videos through anon feedback.

He's hilarious, lectures were fun (how he managed to make stats fun is still a mystery) I hate mathnot my best subject but he is so helpful, knows how to explain things clearly. Go to office hours--seriously, he'll check your answers. I wish he taught more things because he was the bestfavorite professor of my college career.

I took his Brains and Minds, Robots and Machines course to fulfill a science credit and it was one of the most enjoyable classes I've ever been in. I never missed class because the lectures were incredibly fascinating. The labs could be hard at times, but if you worked hard at them and got help then you would be fine. I can't recommend it enough.
Hilarious and super fun to look at. Keeps his lectures interesting, but I found the tests to be pretty difficult.
He was friendly, open, helpful, and intelligent.  Possibly one of the best professors I've had yet.

The class is recorded and put online. I only went to the first 3 lectures, and then only showed up for the test. He often goes off topic and I rather skip through that part online. Also he is somewhat condescending towards his students and tends to talk about himself multiple times per lecture. You can pass the class by not going to any lectures.

The best thing about Rick is that he really wants you to understand the material.  If you take stats in the math department, your assignments will be much different than Rick's.  He often asks you to explain a process or calculation like you were talking to a child or your grandmother, to really ensure you understand why you're doing what you do.

Rick is very enthusiastic about psychology and clearly has a lot of teaching experiences. Lectures are funny and to the point. You have to take online prelecture quizzes, but don't waste time reading the textbook. It's insanely long and only constitutes 10-15% of the test material. Go to lecture instead. Uses anonymous feedback all semester.

Rick is one of the best professors I have had! He explains everything very clearly and his lectures are easy to follow. He can also be quite entertaining which definitely helps in a class like statistics. Take a course with him if you can!

Rick is awesome! It's no secret that stats can be a pretty boring topic, but he found a way to make class super enjoyable. He made the entire class laugh during every single lecture. He is super helpful and open to questions, both during lecture and office hours. Online textbook is necessary for homework assignments.

by far the best professorteacher I have ever had, period. He made intro to psychology way more interesting than I could have ever imagined, and my friends in other P101 classes find it hard to believe that I could actually look forward to going to my introduction to psychology class. Always gives information in a funny yet clear way. 1010 overall

Great guy and even better teacher. Explains everything thoroughly. I wasn't even supposed to take his class, signed up on accident and he made me want to stay! Very funny guy and makes class interesting. Definitely recommend him!
He can be kind of rude sometimes but the class was extremely easy and clear cut.
I love his lectures, his tests aren't super tough. He's super funny and keeps class very interesting. I would defiantly recommend any class he teaches!

Such a great professor. I can't wait to have him for another class, I would recommend him to anyone who asks. He is strict with his guidelines and due dates for this class, but if you get them done then it is super easy. he makes a routine class seem very interesting

Best professor I've ever had, period. Always manages to make class super interesting, and his lectures are almost like stand-up comedy routines.  He even taught us how to survive in a Saw-esque death trap. You go, Rick. You may have just saved our lives.
Awesome Professor! Really enjoys the material he is teaching and always finds a way to make it interesting. Very funny and engaging. Take a class with him if you can :)

Probably one of the best professors I've ever had. Extremely funny and helpful. Very understanding when any kind of issue arises. Tests are challenging but fair. His office hours are very helpful, so use them if you're struggling! He lets you check your homework answers with him.

He is excellent at explaining statistics in a way that is interesting and easy to understand. He really cares about how students are learning in the course and has anonymous feedback and polls to get students input about the class. Exams are not too bad, and he is understanding when a test was too long or the average was a little low.

While his classes are super easy, you will get nothing from them. He has an average mind. Rick is more interested in Pop-Culture than Science. What's more, he is unbelievably anal regarding test responses. If his desired response is not written word-for-word, it will be marked incorrect; even if you have demonstrated a firm grasp of the concept.
Really awesome professor! He answers any questions during office hours and will personally walk you through homework problems or any other question you have.
He is an awesome professor.  He really loves what he is teaching. Makes the info really easy to learn.

Rick is very good at what he does. He lets you check your homework at office hours.. so there's never a reason you shouldn't get 100% on all HW assignments. He is very good at explaining things and he definitely made stats as interesting as he possibly could. I look forward to taking more of his courses.
Very lucid teaching styles. Made the students interested in psychology. He is one of the sole reasons I am a psych major. Best teacher at IU.

AWESOME! Keeps things interesting and tries to keep everyone engaged. I tell all psych majors to get him for Cognitive so that they don't want to die every time they go to class. Class notes are almost always online. Seriously just a fun, down-to-earth, caring guy who happens to be an amazing professor. If you have the chance, get in his classes!
Funny and Personable

Great guy, teaches incredibly effectively and utilizes tech like powerpoint and records lectures that he uploads for online access, very helpful, funny, completely open to criticism and change of class to better suit students, best professor at IU
Excellent instructor. Very helpful and passionate about his field

Rick has a wide knowledge base and is very competent! If he can't answer your question he goes out and finds the answer. Lectures were very entertaining and informative, tests are cake if you go to class or watch the lectures on echo. Witty, engaging, and unique; highly recommended!

Best professor I will ever have at IU, 100%. Extremely knowledgeable about his field and wants students to be successful. Tests/exams are straight-forward with no tricks; could be a stand-up comedian if he didn't teach. If you can take a psych course with Rick Hullinger, you should do it.

Rick is hands down the best professor at IU.  He is an awesome individual and he makes you WANT to go to class every morning, even if it is a 9AM. Tests are very fair and they reflect what was taught. He explains the material very well and makes sure that all his students have a solid grasp and if not, he welcomes questions.

He was the BEST professor I have had at IU.  He is INCREDIBLY knowledgeable, helpful and enthusiastic about teaching cognitive psychology (any course for that matter). No textbook; bring your knowledge hungry self and be blown away! I would most definitely recommend him to everyone! Not to mention, he reminds you of Harry Potter on a daily basis!
Very clear teaching style. Very straightforward and entertaining. However, he has an irrational affinity for cats.
Easiest class I have ever taken at IU. Rick is very engaging and makes a not so interesting class very intereting.
For a required course he was very clear and listened to students concerns.

Rick is very helpful and knows what he's talking about. I rarely attended the lectures, but when I did I took good notes.  Going to the labs on Friday isn't required exactly but his assistant does help you with the pleos and Starlogo labs.  Rick also helps during his office hrs. There is a midterm and a final exam
This is a pass/fail class, and there's not a lot of work. You have to use a clicker. You have to go to like ten classes and do like seven of the assignments posted. Easy easy easy.

Rick is an awesome guy. Vain but awesome :) Strict in some respects but very receptive to students' concerns and needs. One of the best IU professors. There is only one way to take statistics at IU...with Rick.

Great guy. His lectures were informative and very fun, didn't want to skip class. Tests were about 85% lecture and 15% book, lecture complimented the book. Tests seemed very fair to me, but I actually studied. He's the reason I've decided to be a psychology major.
Not the easiest class, but Rick is a good guy.

Nice guy, cracks some jokes during class that ensured me staying awake at 9AM. The class was fairly easy. The readings were scattered and at times unnecessary, and the material was explained very well in class. It had the feel of an introductory class for a long time until I began studying for the final and realized how much I'd actually learned!
Great professor. Not the easiest psychology class, especially for an intro to psych. Grade is based on three exams and a cumulative final.

Probably the best instructor here at IU. I was very fortunate and had him for 2 classes this semester (COLL-C 105 and PSY-P 102). He's very intelligent and great to talk to. His tests are very fair and he is welcome to any and all feedback. Great guy and I look forward to having two more classes with him next semester!

Rick is a great prof. He's very friendly and approachable. His lectures are interesting, funny, and relevant to the tests. I really enjoyed going to class, even though it's not mandatory. The class isn't too tough either. It's very straight forward and only tests count toward your final grade.

Rick is the best instructor I have had at IU.  I looked forward to going to his class because he is funny and made the class interesting. I recommend Rick, if you are unsure about taking his class, DO! You won't regret it and you'll learn a lot.

Rick is great, he understands that it is an intro level class and does everything he can to help the students (anonymous feedback, recording lectures etc). He truly cares about his students and effectively lecture! Tests are straight forward and simple.
Awesome teacher, a lot of fun, always making jokes to lighten the mood, very good teacher, knows what he's talking about and has fun teaching (which makes class more interesting)

I absolutely loved this class.  He made is so interesting and made we want to attend class.  He did not take attendance and his class was recorded everyday, however I found myself in class every single day.  He was a cool guy and an outstanding teacher!
He keeps class interesting and informative. Does all that he can to help you understand something. Humorous, informative, and overall great professor! Just pay attention and you're golden!
If you can take one of Rick's classes, do! He found the perfect balance between informative, interesting, and humorous!

Probably the best professor at IU - I wish he taught more useful classes. Explains everything clear, straightforward exams. Does everything to make sure everyone understands the material. Just show up and pay attention and you're set. Weekly homework, only a couple questions. No stupid projects like other stats professors.

He is SO GOOD!! If you are worried about taking stats take it with Rick because he is extremely helpful, his lecture notes are to the point, and he will help you if you have questions. You can have a cheat sheet for the tests. He is really reasonable and funny! Take him for stats and no other teacher!!
Very normal! not a crazy, mean, senile teacher like most of the other stats professors. Easy to relate to.

Rick,is the best stats prof you could have. Willing to help students exceed in his class. He will help you succeed if your willing to. plus he makes stats funny and he is cute to. Take stats with him if you get the chance. Attend class, go to office hours and review sessions. One awesome prof.

BEWARE: not an unkind man, but very prone to tangents. you WILL be behind in class, because of his tangents and repetition, but he will not change due dates. assignment grading VERY unclear, but papers were easy. you won't get a clear response from him. email or verbal, it doesn't matter. class is pretty useless but required for grade.

I easily could've only gone to my drill class with the AI instructor and learned everything or even understand things better. The amount of work is kind of insane and there is no grace for students. He literally just exists. He talks to himself in Korean and reminisces about his past while failing to interest students. He doesn't entice attention from his students and honestly just talks. He also makes really terrible dad jokes, but he has no excuse cuz he is not a father.

I don't like the way this professor teaches, There is no variation and he sends us quizzes asking how to improve but then explains to us why he can't do what we wanted to do. If I wanted to learn Korean on my own, I could have. His lectures goes into depth of the material, but the culture points are out of date and the lectures are confusing.

One of the best professors I've ever had.  Genuinely a nice person and really excited to teach Korean. He's the driving force behind the Korean program  in EALC. He's always there to help, and you should DEFINITELY get to know him, as he always gives recommendations if you ask.
the nicest guy ever! i learned so much.

Extremely excited to teach Korean. He tries really hard to make the class interesting by adding facts, clips, and jokes about the culture and history. He is very organized and knowledgeable. You'll know from DAY 1 exactly what will be on tests and homework. You will also know exactly when there are tests, which is pretty much every day.
He's a good guy. But the class is really boring.

Do not take Hyunna unless it is your only available option.  Her lectures lack structure, and she often seems to have difficulty explaining the material she is supposed to know.  The lectures provide very little benefit and yet attendance is still required.  You will have to study much more if you take her since you get much less from lectures.

Throughout the course, her lectures were frequently disorganized and incoherent. She often seemed confused while explaining fundamental economic concepts and material. I wouldn't recommend anyone take her class unless you are open to deeply unreliable and sometimes inaccurate teaching.

Jin Hyung To is, without contest, the worst teacher I have ever had in my nearly 2 decades of school life. When I go to his lectures, I am better off staring at the wall than actually listening to him speak, since there is nothing of substance to gather. I do all my studying on my own, and he does not give any makeup opportunities. He is the worst.

Jin is a sweet man, but he's not a good teacher. I don't normally get bad grades, but i did in his class. I went to 99% of the classes with a few exceptions and I still didn't understand the material. I got a tutor outside of class to help and when he would bring up specific material we should've learned, it was no where to be found in my notes.

your grade is based on only 4 total exams, which likely come down to a total of under 100 problems. no makeup chances. this would be somewhat acceptable if the guy could teach, but he just copies the textbook onto the board. he knows the material, but can't teach
Hardest Math class ive taken just because of the professor. You can't understand him and he does a TERRIBLE job explaining things. Students constantly correct him off his mistakes.

Jin seems like a nice guy who understands calc well, but he simply can't teach. He is nearly impossible to understand due to his thick accent and because he mumbles while lecturing. I've had to get a tutor due to this and I'm typically a decent math student. All in all, avoid this guy at all costs.
Not a very good teacher. Super smart just doesn't teach the subject very well.

This is the worst teacher ive ever had. It is almost impossible to understand him. He frequently doesnt even understand his own work and gets confused. The students are the ones to clarify the problems to him. I am so confused every time i leave his class. this class has brought me so much stress mostly because of the professor i have.

JIn is Very hard to understand and doe snot explain well. I go to every office hour available, but I leave still confused every time. The explanations are not helpful, and you are better off skipping lecture ad learning form the book. Constant mistakes during class are corrected by students. Super nice guy, but bad teacher.

Very hard to understand. No help to students. Messes up a lot. Brushes over many things and doesn't explain hard concepts well. Worst professor I have ever had at Indiana University. I recommend finding other options.
Calls on people and will stop the lecture until the person she calls on answers. Just a waste of time being there.
She really explained some things well, though it was kind of hard to understand. Some times the pop quizzes she gives to everyone for extra credits are heaven for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: she wouldn't buy me a pizza from toppers
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is very knowledgeable about the course, and she explains clearly each step of the way.

She prioritizes learning for the students as much as the progression of the course as a class, she was very effective with time management. She engages with every student in the lab session and walks around the room to answer questions. She is a really nice professor and gives her best to ensure you understand the course.
She is really helpful whenever you ask for help, she goes step by step with us in the class. I like how this course covers solving problems and has equations revolving around financing and budgeting.

Shows up to class without lesson plans and blames class for being behind. Awful at teaching so lecture prof has to reteach everything the week before the exam. This class is the biggest joke at the university. If you are choosing between a lab at an awful time and taking a lab with this prof, do yourself a favor and choose the inconvenient time.

She is very unorganized with lectures and the lack of communication between her and the V186 professor is visible. She expects for all of us to know all the information after one example and doesn't thoroughly explain how she got an answer. There are quizzes every other week, she doesn't prepare us at all. She's also hard to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly the worst professor I've ever had. Class discussions made no sense, didn't respond to emails or answer questions, lots of quizzes but nothing was ever graded. She messed up so much in the lecture that I don't think she understood the content she was teaching. I normally have straight A's but this class is impossible.

Best professor I've ever had. She's been my Arabic prof for 2 years and it's clear that she cares a lot about her students. Has a tendency to be a bit disorganized, and there's a lot of homework, but if you put in effort you will get a good grade in her class. I've learned so much about Arabic and Arab culture from her.

YES YES YES 

Dr Iman is LITERALLY the best professor you will EVER have in your entire life. She cares about her students as if we are her own children and makes sure we know it. She is also the most inspirational, educated, and kind human being. I could write a novel about how amazing she is, but you would understand as soon as you meet her.

Very informal prof, inconsistent grader across students, pressures you to go to events outside of class times. Made me not want to learn Arabic
Disappointed, I heard good things about her but if there was one word to describe this prof it would be unprofessional, don't take this professor. Heard another professor call her "unfit to teach"

If I could give Dr. Alramadan more than 5 stars I would. She is of the most caring and encouraging professors I've ever had in my whole college career. The class definitely requires time and attention, but it was so fun, she truly pushes everyone to be their best. You can tell that she loves what she does and truly does care about her students.
Dr. Alramadan is amazing. I recommend her as an Arabic professor 100%. She pushes you to always be improving and really cares about every student in the class.
An amazing woman and teacher
my favorite professor.

Dr. Alramadan is a great professor and really cares about the students. She goes above and beyond for the students and is always available to meet outside of class if you need it. Make sure to do the homework and ask any questions that you have, since learning a language requires you to work every day. Make sure to participate and you will do well.
One of the best teachers ive ever had. she really cares about your progress, and will make sure youre progressing. i loved her!

Dr. Alramadan is one of the kindest people I've ever met. She cares for her students and does all she can to help them learn a challenging language. If you want to learn Arabic, she's the professor to take!
I love Dr. Alramadan. She is kind and understanding. You can't help but smile, and she makes learning a difficult language easier.

Wonderful professor who shows a genuine interest in her students. She is a difficult grader, but if you want to learn the material, she is the perfect choice. She is willing to be flexible in meeting with students outside of class, and doing so is very useful. I suggest finishing assigned homework early and utilizing office hours to discuss.
HARD grader! She MAY curve your class at the end, but don't bet on it. Nice lady and does care about students, but those that are adverse to hurting their GPAs should look elsewhere.

Extremely difficult grading.  Shows a genuine concern towards students learning, but does not reflect with the grades.  Nice lady.  Difficult professor who knows the material.  Take it interested in learning material to fullest ability but willing to sacrifice grade.

She is very demanding. You can do well in this class but you have to do a lot of reading and preparing outside of class. She's fair, but definitely not easy. This was easily the hardest I've ever had to work in a language class.

She is a horrible professor. She is way too difficult and she expects you to know EVERY word after reading a novel full of new words. She makes you feel like an absolute moron and when you go to get help she gets mad at you and is NOT helpful whatsoever. don't take a class with her!!! You will end up hating spanish and probably hurting your gpa :(
She sucks, her class is way to hard and she grades on grammar even though its a literature class.  I withdrew so it wouldn't destroy my grade, you should do the same.

You will learn a lot in this class, but it is hard.  She expects class participation, but goes through the material so fast that it is impossible to keep up with her in the notes and participate at the same time. She always teaches straight from the book.  This class is not an easy A or B.  I would definitely avoid her at all costs!
Professor Impey rocks: she does her job; you'd better do yours.

I hated this class, she's really hard, you really don't find out what your grade is until the end of the semester and by then it's too late, and almost every day she found a way to tell us how stupid we were.

Professor Illas is so great. He would assign us readings or movies to watch, and we'd spend the class discussing. The discussions were always very engaging and you could tell he is very passionate about what he teaches. He was a very easy grader on the essays (the only tests were essays), and valued your thinking and opinion over memorizing facts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a very funny and kind professor. makes class very engaging and fun. make sure you do the reading and participate, it makes class so much more engaging! tests were take home!

Professor Illas is very accommodating and will grant extensions if you email him. The class itself is only okay, as it is mostly discussion based and hard to follow if you do not understand the content or read the books, but Professor Illas attempts to make it as interesting as possible with the books he assigns. Most of the grading is fairly easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Illas is the best professor I've had from the Spanish dept. He is so nice and very funny. He talks openly about his life in spain and makes an effort to get to know his students. He expects participation and attendance but I found class very enjoyable to go to and talk in. He is a fair grader and class materials are always interesting.

Overall, a nice prof who actually cares about teaching his students and their well-being. Hes really knowledgeable about what he teaches. Prepped us extremely well for every single exam so I knew exactly what to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Illas is the director of the Catalan language at IU, but he also teaches this Hutton course called War Gone Viral: The Dark Side of Globalization. For an honors class, it's decently easy, just make sure to do the readings because it is very discussion-heavy. Some readings very interesting, others boring. He is hilarious but disorganized.

Ilana tended to go off on a lot of tangents that didn't help me learn. She was a tough grader on papers and doesn't allow for online submission. She wanted us to turn in our papers on our 'off days' in her mailbox before the office closed, which was inconvenient. Never gave a straight answer on anything. Everything was hypothetical. Not a fan.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She makes the topic super interesting / relevant and is gifted in leading an engaging lecture. The class always went off on tangents and she rolled with it. Would totally recommend

Took this class as a freshman and kind of by accident. Wasn't a huge fan of the topic, but stuck with it because of the prof. She really cared about us learning; went the extra mile to make sure we weren't overwhelmed and made sure all the work we did was beneficial to our learning. Also really funny and just an awesome person in general. 10/10

Ilana is an awesome professor and is doing some very cool research outside of the university. She is extremely knowledgeable and pushes us to be the same, but she stops and will take as long as she needs to go over concepts again and again. Really loved the class and love her. Make sure you do the readings!!

She is great. VERY knowledgeable on course topics. She really knows her stuff. She has degrees from Stanford, Cambridge, and U Chicago. She's also a well-respected researcher and author in her field around the world. Her class wasn't too difficult but attendance and readings are very important. She is very willing to help students
Awesome teacher. By far my favorite class I have taken at IU. Uses great and funny real-life examples.

Prof. Gershon is very nice and laid-back.  The film clips she uses are helpful examples and she is patient in answering questions.  The readings are mostly interesting and not too long.  There's lots of class discussion on interesting topics.
Great professor. Uses film clips to relate the material. Makes class very interesting. Highly recommended.
No Comments
Amazing!  She is so laid back.  Attendance is a must but there is very little outside of class work.

I was very happy with this professor until the final. His examples and the things he told us to expect were not what appeared on the test. He also take well to students challenging grades, but he does teach.

Liviu is an awesome professor. He's really funny and straight-forward. He does go really fast though, so be prepared to take a lot of notes. He does teach what you need to know though and is really entertaining to watch. He made me want to go to Finite.

Liviu isn't as bad as some other finite profs. He really does know the material well but his sarcasm comes off as rude ALOT. Honestly as long as you GO TO CLASS and ask questions when you need help there's no reason you shouldn't get at least a B.
Great guy, very smart. Can make some mistakes but he is never offended to have student input, which is a great trait

Liviu is a brilliant man with a slightly nervous yet conversational attitude towards everything. Like "A Beautiful Mind". With him being so brilliant, he can leave you in the dust if you don't pay attention. However, his office hours are a HUGE help if that becomes a problem. And when he asks if anyone has any "questions?" DONT BE AFRAID TO ASK.
I think he is one of the best professors I have had. Very funny, very clear. I recommend notes because it is whats on the tests. Do what you can to get Liviu.
liviu was hilarious, and he is very fair with his tests. I took calc in high school and his class helped reinforce the material that my bad teacher skimmed over.

Liviu is a great math professor. He explains concepts clearly and he's hilarious (in a mathy sort of way). His class is fair and he's clear about what kinds of things you should know for exams. Still, you really have to make the effort to keep up with the material, otherwise you'll get left behind or won't know what's going on in lecture.

Extremely rigid and unresponsive to students. She deducts marks in ways that genuinely make no sense, especially for the course reflection, an assignment that should evaluate learning, not punish students. She gave unusually low scores, even when reflections were sincere and based on actual course content.

The course is online based and the most of it is just self-study. It involves many readings and watching videos, but many materials are outdated and I did not see how those things would relate to real business or academic practices. Not recommend. Better learning free online courses than taking this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Course is structured to cover multiple topics throughout the 13 week time frame. Highly recommended course if you are interested in Big Data. Assignments are easy and act as a starting point for the concerned topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The course was mostly self study. There was at best 20% involvement from professor. The course is challenging as it touches almost new technology every week. The assignment and quizzes are long and difficult. In nutshell, you read a bunch of PDF (a lot), watch videos and google search to learn anything out of this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Really nice & truly cares about your success in the course. Will always work with you when issues come up. He cares more about the long term success of students & doesn't power trip over small things that dont matter like other professors do. Highly recommend!

The weekly quizzes are harder than I expected, but he offers a good amount of extra credit. He goes around and helps during the lab times, which I've never seen a professor do. He is very personable and makes me feel comfortable asking him questions during lecture or lab.

Dr. Innes is passionate about genetics and makes sure that students know the material. There are weekly quizzes online that help to prepare you for lab. The lab reports are very extensive and graded by the AIs. This class takes a lot of time between quizzes, lab reports, and exams. In order to succeed in this class you really have to put in time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He was a great professor. Easy to get in touch with ourside of class and very understanding. Also passionate about the subjects and easy to follow.
No Comments

Patty is an incredibly wonderful lady. She cares so much about her students and their ideas. L371 is a hard class but Patty teaches it in a way that makes you want to learn more and really makes you appreciate literature. I have never been more proud to be an English major than in Patty's class. She makes class fun and relatable. You will love her.
Amazing! Very friendly and open to hearing student opinions and ideas. Makes Arthurian Legends even more interesting. Easy to schedule meetings with her outside of class, very easy to talk to.

Very very helpful professor.  I was always in and out of her office with questions.  Professor Ingham is just an understanding professor, if she knows your really trying she'll be willing to give you the grade your working for.  Just really knows how to teach.  Very SEXY too

I was not looking forward to taking literary theory (I heard nothing but horror stories from other English majors) but Ingham teaches the subject with a lot of clarity. She really wants her students to understand!
Nice, relaxed atmosphere in the class, she made a boring subject interesting and thought provoking.  Great professor and a sexy lady.  Two thumbs up.

Prof. Ing is hands down the best lecturer I've had at IU. The Hawai'i course is awesome and I can't think of a much better person to teach it considering he's Harvard educated and a Kanaka himself. I loved his Hawaiian shirts and just the way the man speaks. He's incredibly smart and every lecture was entertaining. Make sure you attend class!

Dr. Ing is an excellent lecturer! He made his class about Hawai'i very engaging, and I learned a lot. Do expect to attend lecture, study hard for the exams, and complete the weekly readings/videos, as there are weekly quizzes and a lot of content to memorize.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you get lower than 75% on attendance, you fail the course! Weekly quizzes over the 5 hours of weekly reading, for a 100 level course? SKIP!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He somehow made a rather boring class somewhat entertaining, absolutely recommend. p.s.

Great professor, you can tell he really cares about what he teaches. Expected to be engaged in the course though. Attendance mandatory, technology frowned upon. Participate in discussions, bring the readings. Fun course if you're interested. Only complaint was a lack of clarity with the first exam on how it was going to be graded. Lots of writing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Ing is a great professor and I would recommend anyone take his Intro to Hawaii class if they need the credit.

Professor Ing has been my favorite professor I have ever had at IU! You do have required attendance and readings, but he makes class fun and you can see he really cares about his teaching and his students. I learned a lot and wish I could take another class with him. Would 100% recommend taking his class on Hawaii!!
Professor Ing is super entertaining! Very few assignments with clear instructions that are easy to complete.

By far one of my favorite professors here at IU! Incredibly kind and gives very interesting lectures that keep you engaged. Despite the large class size he would talk to students and try to get to know them. A lot of reading but most of it's interesting. One of the only professors to actually care about my disability accommodations. Love him!
Horrible.

I really enjoyed this class, the lectures were always very entertaining and I was never bored. Professor Ing was very fun to listen to and had a lot of cool stories. The workload wasn't too bad if you spread it out throughout the week. Definitely recommend taking this class, it was my favorite of the semester.

The assignments were simple yet very effective, and the midterm/final exam is surprisingly my favorite part. He is funny, caring, and respected. I would a thousand percent take his class again and am currently trying to take another class he is teaching. He inspired me to double major in religious studies. PLEASE TAKE HIM YOU WILL LOVE HIM!!

Hes a great guy with wonderful lectures. The only thing that is difficult is to keep up with the readings and write summaries. However, the reading and writing actually helped me improve in my grammar and sentence structure. Hes very down to earth and a very nice guy.

Professor Ing was incredible to have as a professor. He's very funny and helpful, and whilst some of the material can be incredibly boring, he does his best to make it entertaining. The lectures can be somewhat heavy, but he tells a lot of stories to keep everyone engaged. He genuinely cares about his students and he wants to see everyone succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing. Humorous, understanding and intelligent. Professor Ing is someone who genuinely cares about making a class interesting and about how were understanding the course material. While the class may not be easy, he tries to make it as easy as he can. Hes accessible, fun and it was a delight to be in his class. 12/10 would take again
I had Ing for IFS my freshman year of college. He was a fantastic teacher; he was funny, incredibly intelligent, and he always had a story to connect a concept in class to the real world.
Amazing human being
Love him

Professor Ing is fantastic. He makes lecture worth going to knowing that many students are only taking his course for gen ed requirements. He is very accessible outside of class and accommodating to everyone. I loved this class. There was a lot of reading but it was interesting and not difficult at all. You can definitely skim it and still pass.
Absurd attendance policy. Lenient grading, but beware of the mid-term which is short answer. It was very difficult. Very condescending and uppity professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I loved taking this class with Professor Ing. When I read his syllabus I worried that he would be a tough professor, but he loved to have fun in class. He is very kind and the class is incredibly easy to pass; there are only 2 papers, 1 exam, and as long as you do the weekly summaries of the readings, you should excel!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Would take again

reviews.comment: I thought going to learn in medium depth about Asian religions.Instead its a lot about how the effect Indiana. Id rather know about the religions. Also first paper (papers make up 50% of your grade)the bulk of the class got C's because "itll help us learn by being harsh" sorry i didnt think this was an english class. Class dropped.

Mara is by far my favorite professor that I've ever had. She is first and foremost there to help you learn, not to shove meaningless projects and curriculum down your throat. She wants to see everyone in her class succeed and is always available to meet to discuss classwork or to just talk about life. She is very relatable and overall fabulous!

This was one of the most useful classes I've taken at IU-I would highly recommend it to anyone and everyone! And Mara is really the best- she cares SO much about all of her students! She even met with me outside of class and helped me with my resume for an internship. One of the smartest and most dedicated teachers I've had so far in college

Mara is the most fabulous, yet down to business type professor I have ever had. As a young woman, I find myself looking up to her not only in the classroom, but I feel like I am able to talk to her on a personal level. 100% my favorite class this semester.

Mara is one of the smartest professors I have ever taken a class from. She knows everything, about everything. She is always willing to help. She gives great feedback on papers and makes the material applicable to real world situations.
Amazing professor. Teaching was interesting and very informative. She has a great personality and is chill. Her service dog is gorgeous. She knows a lot on what she's talking about.

She is very educated. Extremely unclear though, and when she lectures in class it is almost as if she is always uncertain about what she is saying/responding to questions with. Meet with her multiple times before you turn in your paper, especially the final assignment.
If you have to take this course, and most of us do, try and get this professor.  Lots of applicable knowledge, unique, and gave good feedback.
She was just really cool and knowledgeable
Hated this class and always dreaded going. Was very rude when I requested help, and I always felt bad for not understanding the content.

Her teaching style was very unique compared to the other courses I had taken this year but I absolutely loved this class. Desiree truly cares for all of her students and will do what it takes to help you succeed. Class discussions are constant and working with your peers is a large factor in this class!

I loved Desiree! She is the absolute sweetest and really cares about her students. The coursework can be difficult, but she did a really great job of making us all feel prepared. She provided a lot of resources for students who needed help as well. She is very quick to respond to emails and is very helpful. I could not recommend her more.
Couldn't recommend her more for N101! You'll feel confident in the material without being stressed out or overwhelmed.

Cool hip guy- very socratic seminar style class. Grading expectations were a bit unclear so do your best on everything. Not many assignments but the project deliverable was LONG so don't wait to start on it. Mandatory participation. Grind for the final bc its hard to know what to expect on it. Chill class just be able to lock in when you need to.

He's a nice guy outside of class, but the lectures are useless and the test is difficult and is a lot of your grade. I ended up with a grade I'm happy with but it was the hardest I-Core class just because he doesn't give a lot of good instructions and is unclear about grading
95-5 rule would best describe his lectures (95% waste of time, 5% content). The ENTIRE curriculum of the class could be taught in one or two class periods. The rest of the class is a waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bro is a joke, will tank your participation score if you aren't a suck up in class; if you do suck up, he's weirdly tight with students (literally found out yesterday he personally texts 1-2 students while they're still his students …); his class is literally laughing stock of Kelley/I-Core classes but thinks he's teaching rocket science

The glaze from some of these reviews is crazy. He's a cool guy, definitely funny and charismatic. However, he would spend 90% of the class discussing random topics and then skip through all the content.
