People should expect more from professors when we pay thousands of dollars to be in their lectures. Also, deliverable 2 is ridiculously long.

Farhan is so obnoxious, constantly calls on the same 3 people, class was worthless (serious high school vibes). Worst part is that there're 3 assignments and he's such a lazy grader (someone asked to see where their participation score was at and he goes (to the class!!) "yeah that's a lot of work for me, I'm not gonna do that").  Avoid ...

Iqbal is engaging, funny, & passionate. He values good work, yet it can be difficult to participate in class, (and it matters so much) since the discussions get sidetracked & only the same 5 people talk. Hard to prepare for the final when there were no other quizzes/exams. The paper was hard but interesting/good to write. Take him if you can!

The best professor I've had at Kelley. Super relatable and funny. Some of his jokes involve picking on students but if it bothers you, just let him know and I'm sure he'll stop. While the class material is pretty easy, it's important to pay attention to do good on the final. Participation matters in the sense of being present and off your phone.
By far one of the best professors I've had at Kelley. Created an amazing classroom environment where I had amazing discussions on genuinely thought provoking topics with my classmates.
Great teacher, the negative ratings you will read are just written by very soft individuals.

Farhan made me question why I was spending $20k in tuition to go to Kelley; class time is a joke, multiple classes had dozen people walk out of because he never got to actual content; also heavy on participation but calls on same 5 people each time; openly talked about how he is now teaching b/c he (allegedly) was (maybe?) fired in corporate world.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Discussion heavy class, but he's a funny and engaging guy that makes it easy to participate. Treats the students with respect and is very available and adaptive.

Awesome professor. He facilitates great discussions in class, and knows how to push back on points while being respectful and inviting further elaboration. He gives very personalized feedback for big assignments and truly does care about students. Also quite funny - he keeps you on your toes.

Dr.Iqbal is the most understanding professor who wants his students to learn and do well. In efforts to engage class in the evening, he supplied us with snacks & candy. Dr.Iqbal's shoe game is also fire. Highly recommend his courses to students. It's refreshing to have professors who care about students and go the extra mile.  10/10 a king

Decent. Liked Iqbal for majority of semester. However, his jokes tend to be dry and offensive. Says belittling things towards students. Wasn't a fan of him assigning a huge individual project during the time we were meant to write our business plan. He's highly respected by most and gives accurate slides when helping you study for the final.

A professor truly invested in each of his student's success. Engages the class letting students lead discussions rather than himself. Not afraid to hand over control of the classroom to students which creates a unique learning environment. Professor Iqbal is focused on student's results, not their grades.

Professor Iqbal truly cares about his students and their success. He is the most responsive and honest professor, and while he asks a lot of his students, it always feels insightful and fair. He redefines the standard for professors, a true leader in the classroom.
Great professor with an understanding of how class should be run. Thoroughly enjoyed the seminar style of his class.

Pretty good experience. Her class wasn't hard and she had great notes. I would recommend taking Microbiology with her. The tests are open note and attendance can get you some easy points. She's also fun and engaging

She was amazing. The exams were take-home, but you had to make sure you took good notes during class. Even though the exams were take home, they were very in-depth. Other than that, it wasn't bad, and there was also Top Hat, which was worth points.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Irene is a great professor and the exams are fairly easy if you look through the lecture slides and take extensive notes during class. Come to class so that you can participate in TopHat and get some easy points.

SUCH an easy class, especially if you're a junior/senior. If you know how to use a micropipette, you'll be good. Also, the time block is like 3 hours, but it always got out early (2 hours MAX). Irene is brilliant, and she teaches with the enthusiasm of a grade school teacher haha! Also gives EX. CRED. just for answering questions in class!

Irene is super sweet, funny, and energetic. Very passionate about teaching and has made the class very fun and doable. This is one of the best lab classes I have taken yet where Ive actually learned rather than cramming. Irene is very intelligent and truly a caring professor!

Professor Galarza does a very good job making a comfortable environment for learning. She's very good about making things accessible and organized. She's very knowledgeable and patient. Overall a very good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class overall is pretty easy. Most of the grade is based on weekly homework assignments so do get those done. The lectures are pretty easy to understand even when the professor is speaking spanish. She does a great job teaching the course and will do anything she can to make you successful in the class. This class contains 2 exams and 2 ICWs.
Professor Galarza is a well-rounded professor! She is kind and very understanding. I would highly recommend Professor Galarza for Spanish!
I have nothing but positive things to say about Prof Galarza! She is great at explaining material and creates a positive class atmosphere! If you can get her as a teacher, do it!

I thought she was great.  She was very understanding and did not grade our papers crazy hard but also did a great job in class helping us understand material.  She is also very nice and understanding with anything you need to ask her.  If you can get her as your 200 or 250 professor, do it!

Iraida is extremely passionate about linguistics, and she manages to make a scary course really engaging and easy! Take 326 with her and you wont regret it. She's funny, smart, and her lectures are always very high energy.

Iraida is amazing! Her Spanish is surprisingly easy to understand. She is incredibly helpful and encouraging and is very enthusiastic. This class was easy and fun- I was definitely intimidated at the beginning of the semester by the oral presentations but they weren't bad at all! My speaking skill improved a lot by the end of the semester.

I've never had a Spanish professor at IU that I didn't like, but Iraida is nothing short of awesome. She explains everything well in the classroom (expect Spanish only) and answers her emails surprisingly fast. If you do the work and participate, you will have no problem. Would take again!

I loved Iraida! She's so helpful and engaging. She clearly loves teaching and her spanish is easy to understand. Her lectures improved my fluency and I really appreciated her teaching methods. She gave clear instructions, was VERY available, and helps students. She expects participation, but it's not hard to give because she's so engaged!

My favorite teacher so far! While she does teach entirely in Spanish, she is very easy to understand and it actually really improves your fluency. She is very straightforward and helpful, and she's hilarious too. Highly recommend this course with her as the prof, and I hope I get her again sometime.

Iraida is great, she is one of the better foreign language teachers I have ever had. I took her 280 class, which is completely centered around grammar so a lot of teachers would have made this boring, but not Iraida. She always kept us engaged and there were lots of opportunities for extra credit and to improve your grade if you will put in work!

Usually young teachers are inexperienced, but definitely not Iraida. While other 326 profs teach difficult parts in English (it's a linguistics class in spanish; not a spanish class), Iraida does it in Spanish. I actually find myself interested in the material while my Spanish has drastically improved. She's also funny, friendly and helpful
She was great! I had to compliment her on her class because she has seriously been the best Spanish teacher Ive ever had!
She was really great at preparing students for the tests, and made the class as enjoyable as it could be
Iraida is probably the best professor I've had at IU so far!  Wish I could take all the remaining spanish classes that I still have to take, with her! She is the nicest and easiest of all!
Best spanish professor at IU! Extremely helpful and approachable. She actually made the class fun. Homework is all online and is very easy. Go to class, she makes it very easy and fun!

Iraida is the best foreign language teacher I've ever had. She is very nice and does everything possible to help her students succeed. She has a lot of energy and manages to make a class that most people find boring fun. She somehow managed to make Spanish class the highlight of my week. And it doesn't hurt that she's gorgeous.
An amazing teacher! She worked hard at what she did even though some students were extremely rude to her.
I loved Iraida, she was an amazing teacher even though she had to deal with some pretty crappy stuff from some immature people. I wish I could have had all my spanish classes with her!

Really enjoyed having Tiana as my U215 Discussion professor for the Hudson & Holland class. Ordered us pizza multiple times and hosted online classes on Zoom whenever she couldn't be present for class. I always felt very welcomed in her class and felt a community was built amongst myself and my fellow classmates.

Not hardly any group work. The information provided has been meaningful. She really cares about each student and has provided information to help me transition to IU, Luddy while learning about myself. This course has been informative and relaxing. She is a very caring person.

She has no idea how to teach, I can't remember a single thing that I learned from this class. She has you work in groups you can't choose, and since the class is so unfocused none of your group members try at all and you end up doing it yourself. The classes are all busy work that she claims teach you how to get a tech job but it won't help at all.

This is a course to help you learn and develop as a tech leader! Not meant to teach coding. Talk with other students like myself and I will tell you how great of a person Tiana really is! Get to know her if you can, you will not have any regrets. Caring, personable person! Also this course is 1st semester not 2nd semester.

This was one of the most understanding faculty members I have taken. You will get experience working with companies and teach your peers. Great experience not sure what the one disgruntled student is talking about! Take this course and learn!!!!

The Y101 course for the Luddy LLC is entirely unfocused. It feels like it was put in place out of necessity rather than utility, and it shows; you are quizzed on HTML even though this is not even remotely a tech class; I cannot think of a single tangible thing I learned in this course, and Tiana does not seem very interested in this class either.
Taking the class now! She is informative, knowledgeable, and energetic! Take the class if you can, already we have gotten great resources. Best professor I have had so far!
Great course!
You learn about yourself and technology!

There are so many great C104 professors that you can take, so don't take Irvine. She isn't horrible, but she will purposefully give you bad grades on certain speeches so you can "show improvement." She is also super intense about technology, timelines, and attendance. Overall, she's a nice person, just a little intense.

By far the worst professor I have ever had at Indiana University, very unreasonable, and hard grader.  Do not take this teacher as you will regret it.  She made this class way harder than it should have been.  TAKE A DIFFERENT PROFESSOR.

She does too much. Prepare to have presentations every single week. She barely lectures and is a really tough grader. Most of the class is her making you do random speeches in class. I would've rather taken C106 and gotten honors credit, as she treats this class as one. I hadn't even signed up to have her as my professor. Do not take her!

As nice as she is, her class is just too fast-paced and unforgiving. Little to no outside study resources as the lecture slides, handouts, and assigned readings for every class are only available in person and are not on Canvas. If you miss class for any reason I hope you enjoy writing a sizeable paper on top of your already large workload.

Prof Irvine is probably the only professor at IU who actually cares about her students and wants them to succeed. There are weekly readings/document analysis worksheets & weekly quizzes, none of which are too hard. She will give you the midterm/final before hand - both are all open-ended. Pay attention in class, take good notes and you'll be fine.

Challenging course - weekly doc. analysis sheets, readings, quizzes, and the amount of material to remember for the midterm/final - she gives you the midterm/final material. Irvine is a nice, caring lady and wants all of her students to succeed. Note/lecture heavy - goes through the slides fast. A lot of work, but worth it. Really solid Professor.

Professor Irvine & her course is mentally draining. Lots of reading and FAST note taking. Talks for full 75 minute class and then some every single time. Requires students to complete a make up assignment if they miss class, which is an extremely ridiculous paper. Does not require textbook, but highly encourages it to understand different concepts.

Honestly the class is not that bad if you do the readings like she asks you to do. You will see that the slides aren't as important if you read the textbook. Some of her policies may seem wack but if you put in effort and do the work you will get an A in this course. No Papers or Essays and the she gives out the entire midterm/exam before hand.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She would not allow anyone to drink water nor allow you to get slides even with accommodations. Tina would not spend any time on notes and told us we did not need certain slides that we actually needed.

Professor Irvine was the worst! I usually give all my professors a try and she mentally drained me within the first week of being in her class I had to drop it. She spends less then 60 seconds on a slide and wont even share presentations with you. She wouldnt even let you take a drink of water. She goes over time and gets upset if you pack Up.

Dr. Irvine is amazing. Her classes can be challenging, but if you put in the work it is worth it. She tries to get to know all of her students- even if her classes consist of over 50 students. She did not sugar coat any history, and I learned so much from her class. Decent amoutn of work, but so worth it.

Great class, great professor. Iram is such a funny and interesting Professor, she makes the class interesting. As long as you show up and pay attention you should be good. The tests in the class follow her powerpoints exactly, so pay attention to those. I would highly recommend this course and professor.
AN ABSOLUTE GEM! Iram is such a good professor! She's cares about her students so much. I laughed so hard in that class every day. She is the best! Also, class is an easy A and is fun!!!

Iram is very intimidating but i promise you get used to her and end up liking her. she will put you on the spot so pay attention. just do what she says, and youll be fine. exams are very easy, straight from powerpoint slides. shes very caring about if you understand the lecture and tries to help a lot. shes scary but she makes you learn.

I loved Iram! She has been one of my favorite professors at IU. She has a lot of interesting stories, she's hilarious, and has great lectures. Most importantly, she cares about her students more than anything. She's always willing to help. Urban Problems was an easy course as long as you showed up to class, took notes, and studied for exams.

She is probably best professor I have ever had. Really cares about the success of all of her students, actually teaches a topic you can tell she is knowledgeable and passionate about. Clear grading and performance standards. I would highly recommend.

Super easy instructor! She makes everything crystal clear. She knows her stuff. She wants you to succeed, truly. She even gave a third make up exam and took the best 2 scores out of 3 exams. She is GREAT!!

An amazing instructor!   Iram Tariq will teach you things about her home culture that you couldn't imagine ever happening here in the US. Like most instructors her lectures can be disconnected from what is on the tests, but the stories and information she brings to the table is  above-all-else. Instructors like Iram are why SPEA is great.
Very nice lady, claims to have known shady people back in her home country.
BEST TEACHER. you won't regret having her. she has an accent but she really cares about you passing.

Iram is very cultured and knowledgable. What she discusses in class sometimes is off track, but the information you get from her is so unique and rare because of her life experiences. Do the reading from the assigned pages in the book and you will be fine. Iram is hilarious and one of my favorite teachers I've had at IU so far.

Iram is interesting to listen to and often very funny. She has a little bit of a Pakistani accent, but is usually easy to understand. Unfortunately, what she teaches in class often feels very disconnected from what's on the tests. To study, just read the chapters and ignore her lecture slides.

If you have the chance to take a class with him, do it. There aren't many reviews, so trust me on that. As others have said, he genuinely cares about his student, both as academics and as people. He is a bank of knowledge, yet funny and down-to-earth. Caring and approachable and helpful. He truly represents the best parts of academia.

If you have the chance to take a class with him, do it! He is probably the best professor I have had at IU.  Very intelligent, yet funny and down to earth.  We got to visit the Lily Library, Art Museum, and Opera.  He helped me finally understand poetry and was more than willing to help me with my papers.  My writing definitely improved

Dr. Irmscher is a great professor.  He is one of the most down-to-earth academics I think you'll meet.  He makes himself available even though he's very busy.  Although he's native German, the man speaks English better than me.  The class is engaging; attendance is highly encouraged.  Take a class with him! You won't regret it.

Christoph is an exceptional professor. An advocate for his students, he desires to see students succeed and schedules individual conferences to help papers become the best they can be. I've taken 3 classes with him. I would recommend him to anyone.

The class is engaging, and he shows a real passion for his topic. Though he is often busy, he makes himself very available for his students and is willing to help with papers and such. He has reading for each class period, but it isn't excessive. There were several enjoyable visits to the Lilly Library to see original copies.

The best professor to introduce you to Arabic. So understanding and makes the class very accessible to learn. He values learning and improvement over perfection which is so genuine and makes the class so much more enjoyable and in turn makes learning and understanding stronger. He makes a daunting language so engaging and fun to learn! 100% rec.

I had him last semester and he is genuinely one of the sweetest professors ever. He cares about his students and really wants everyone to understand the material and does not overcomplicate anything. I regret taking A150 with another professor.

Issam is really nice & it's obvious he wants his students to succeed in learning Arabic. There is a lot of homework & studying a lot is basically a requirement, but it's worth it. He gives feedback & is pretty lenient with the assignments (just wants to see effort). Would 100% have him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Issam is an extremely kind professor who genuinely cares about his students. Learning Arabic is hard, but he makes it a lot easier, and he is very patient with students that struggle with the material. He is a very easy grader and mostly just wants to know that students care and put in effort.

Shaami dialect with Ustadh Issam is very enjoyable, as he works hard to engage students with the everyday uses of Arabic. He gives students many chances to practice using the language through scenarios and video submissions.

Issam is very enjoyable to take Arabic with, as he really hopes to teach students the basics quickly. Students would probably benefit from doing more individual reading on their own to supplement the level though, looking back from the higher levels, it doesn't seem like enough.

Ustadh Issam is so caring and kind– he makes the best possible environment for language learning. His class totally reshaped how I though about language learning. His class feels more like a group of longtime friends who decided to learn Arabic together and have fun while doing it.

Dr. Issam has been extremely supportive to students who are learning Arabic for the first time, taking care to clearly explain important grammar concepts. He focuses on all aspects of the language, and focuses on activities in class where students practice together. There is a large amount of homework but  it is necessary while learning Arabic.

Great teacher and very generous grader. There are lots of assignments which aren't long, but are there to help make sure you're on track with learning Arabic. Makes difficult concepts easy to understand and reviews new content numerous times to make sure no one is confused.

He teaches language the way it should be taught! He put very little pressure on tests and quizzes because he genuinely wanted us to enjoy learning the language and it was honestly more motivating than if there had been big difficult tests. Loves all his students and really wants them to succeed.

I love Doctor Albdairat's class so much! Very good at explaining complex concepts, and if you're in class every day and participate, you'll learn what you need to learn. One caution; there is a lot of homework, but if you go to class it's pretty easy, and the assignments pad your grade a lot.

He's the best professor ever! He's totally passionate about his job and has a great personality. He breaks something as complicated as Arabic down to simple ideas. You will learn that with hard work and dedication, he helps you learn one of the hardest languages for English speakers to learn. 1000000/10 experience

I had a misunderstanding with Dr. Katona, and I rashly wrote a bad review. He is a great professor. You learn how to read scientific papers, and it is super low commitment. If you attend class, you will get an A. He is super knowledgeable on research/grad school, so if that's the goal, Dr. Katona will be great. If not, its still a fun class.
This is to offset my bad review from earlier. Seriously, if you need an upper level neuro class, it is a great one to take. Lower commitment than most others I have taken!

I took two classes with Dr. Katona - "Intro. to Molec. and Cell. Mech. of Addiction" and "Adv. in Molec. and Cell. Mech. of Addiction". 

While material was dense at times, he always ensured that everyone understood the material. Very patient and kind. Grew and learned a lot in his class. 

Put the work in and ask good questions, you'll get an A!

Istvan is easily one of my favorite professors. He's an expert in his field, passionate about teaching, and genuinely cares about students. I'm disabled, so can struggle with attendance, but he never made me feel bad. Instead, he asked how he could support me. He loves getting questions and made me feel extremely welcomed in classes. A++ professor.
his work was hard to understand and unclear

Dr. Katona is very interesting and insightful, but he clearly has favorites. If you are not one of the people he deems important, he will not care about what you have to say. Overall, a decently easy course, but I would not recommend to someone else in the future. You would be better off to take another class with another professor.

Dr. Katona has been one of my favorite professors at IU. You can tell how passionate he is about the class (molecular, cellular, and circuit mechanism of addiction) and welcomed any question. The class was data heavy for being an 8 week class, but it is very doable to do well regardless. Put in just a little effort and be present in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Katona is one of my favorite IU profs by far! He is so intelligent and kind. His lectures are simply brilliant. This course was fascinating but very data-heavy. If you take good notes, ask insightful questions, and tell him when you don't understand something, you will be just fine. Cannot recommend enough!

I think that he is very knowledgeable about the subject and cares deeply about both the subject and his students. However, he can be very intense about wanting participation and student learning. Make sure to read AND answer the questions before class. The concepts are not hard to grasp since it's current event focused.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Isaac cares deeply about what he teaches and other people learning it. His lectures are very informative to listen to, and the readings are very insightful. He has fairly high expectations, but they're not impossible to meet, anything extra he expects of you is easy to recognize quickly. He will be blunt if you're wrong or didn't read.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Very thoughtful, very caring. Facilitates discussions exceptionally and makes sure every student has room to speak.

Always willing to listen and provide feedback.
Decent class.

Prof Isaac goes above and beyond for his students: sharing optional interesting articles, adapting the syllabus to follow current events, and arranging for relevant guest speakers. I don't think he is harsh or thinks highly of himself, but he pushes his students who he knows are capable of more. He is a professor who will challenge you to think.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Y-212 with him and his class is fine overall and pretty easy, but my god, is he annoying. As someone else said, his god complex is crazy. He gets mad at students for not participating when he asks the most inane questions. If you can avoid him do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Isaac really knows what he's talking about. He's opinionated but is always willing to listen as long as you have the facts to back you up. Didn't have to do nearly as much writing as I thought I would (3 short papers, 1 take home final of 2 essays) and he always gave detailed feedback w/line edits. Definitely take his class!

Professor Isaac is someone who is very interesting to learn from: but his god complex is literally insufferable. He expects students to treat his class like the only in their schedule, guilt trips those who don't participate & picks apart students when they're brave enough to participate. I would've enjoyed his class more if he didn't do this.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Thick accent and constantly makes simple mistakes during lecture, consistently 2-3 per class. Prepare to be talked at, not taught. Will get really confusing if you don't immediately understand the content.

I'm not good at math and this course definitely isn't easy but I managed to do okay. She is a decent professor, she sometimes is hard to understand but she is very nice and helpful if you ask her questions. She curves very favorably for exams where a majority of students did poorly which helps alot. Overall she is worth taking for B110.

Professor Demeter is very nice; however, she doesn't explain things the best. In this class, you will need to teach yourself most of the content. The homework is usually way harder than the test questions. On the bright side, her grading is very fair, and she has printable note packets that will help you stay organized.

If u don't pay attention or skip class u will fall behind. You get a week to do the HW, but do them the day they are assigned, and don't use AI. The HW is harder than the tests, so if u understand it ur good. Her office hours are SO helpful so go to those about questions on the homework you don't understand. She cares and wants you to succeed.

Has good intentions but is honestly a little hard to understand at times and often mumbles during lectures. It's a hard class no matter the professor, so don't worry too much about who you pick for this one.

She was new to teaching this class and did really badly. The only reason I got through was that I already knew everything. If you are bad at math do NOT take it with her. She doesn't even teach; she just talks at you for 75 minutes. Wouldn't recommend

Her lessons are hard sometimes, especially if you are not great at math. You need to go to office hours if you are confused (they help a lot). Study a lot for her tests. If you study and do all the homework (which is graded on completion) then you should have a good grade. She is also super nice and a fair grader.

This class is okay! Iulia takes time to answer questions in class and the examples are pretty clear. The homework can take a while but it's helpful in understanding the content and you have unlimited attempts to get it right. Attendance is not mandatory but it helps to show up.

I would strongly encourage to go to class as Julia makes the lectures easy to comprehend. She provides notes and is always open to answering questions from students admist lectures. The class does require a lot of work, but she is understanding and makes us aware of things about the Webwork, if if we need to round up or if the numbers will be big.

Iulia made a class that I was told would be difficult into one that was super easy to understand! Her lectures were extremely helpful and her material was very easy to follow. She gave plenty of examples in the notes, and when it came time to take exams, there were TONS of practice exams and questions available (with answer keys) to practice with!

Iulia is a fantastic teacher, her lectures are very easy to follow and she explains all of her material very well. She is very willing to explain more difficult concepts and is a great teacher. I would recommend taking her if you are in M118.
Really good professor, class is difficult for most, but it's not nearly as bad as people say it is. Go to office hours and you're okay.

Finite is such a hard math class, but if you have to take it Iulia is a really good teacher to do it with. She explains the information so you can actually understand and makes it possible to actually pass the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you think you are going to struggle with Finite, take her course. She is amazing at explaining difficult topics and made this class a breeze. If you come to class, pay attention, and look over the practice exams, you will pass this class.

If you want Finite to be easy, take Iulia. There are a few concepts that are confusing but she goes above and beyond during her lectures to make sure you understand the material. She also does the best pre-exam review days and if you pay attention, you should get an A on the exam.

This class is very very very hard... pay attention in class but honestly, most of the learning will come outside of class when you do practice problems. I studied for 2 weeks leading up to the final and fortunately, I saved my grade. If you want an A in this class, you'll need to put in a lot of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I never went to class because I got more confused when I did. TA was great for the class, and she offered a lot of out-of-class resources. I got a perfect score on the first exam but bombed the third one using the same study tactics.

Had to retake finite bc my prof last year sucked, and she is wonderful and def the best teacher for finite. She gives retakes for tests so you can improve your score. Very funny and a really good instructor. People just give her a difficult time because she has an accent, but I loved her. All of her material is on canvas, which is super helpful!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: her lectures are a 10/10 because of the helpful examples that make the homework easier. compared to my friends, she is the best finite professor. her office hours are super helpful, and i usually finished my homework in them

if you're figuring out who take for finite, TAKE HER. she is undoubtedly the best lecturer of the material and explains in a really understandable way. she prepares you pretty well for the midterm and final and then her 1st and 3rd tests are easier than the content she teaches so they should be a grade boost. go to class and pay attention.
Pretty good professor for finite. Explained things well in lecture and practice tests were very similar to the exams. If you have to take finite, she is one of the better options.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Iulia is always there to help students succeed. I really struggled throughout finite, it really is as hard as everyone says, but I attended all of her office hours and she really supported me and a few of my peers all semester long. The class sucks, but she is definitely willing to help and made me a lot more confident in my abilities

This professor is the one to take finite with! She is very good at explaining the content and her practice exams match well with the actual tests. If you do the homework, practice exams, and put in the work, Demeter makes it an easy class.

Iulia is such a gem!  Finite is hard any way you look at it, but most people I know wished they had Iulia by the time the final came around. She's super nice and approachable; you just need to pay attention in lecture. Beware there's only 5 grades for finite (4 exams and your online hw score). The exams she writes are harder than final/midterm tho
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a great professor. Her accent can be tough to understand at times and you have to really pay attention to get the content, but she really knows what she's talking about and lectures well. She is one of the only professors that uploads her written notes to canvas! Going over them again helps a lot. Tests are hard but manageable. Take it!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: In terms of finite courses, Prof. Demeter is probably the best you'll get. She teaches by doing the lecture notes with you which is helpful and if you miss a lecture, she uploads the notes but don't skip cause it'll be hard to understand. Do the practice exams because they are similar to actual exam questions!

Her methods of teaching during the lectures were horrible and never did she allow students to skip a test even if they had a positive COVID Test. She made it horribly hard to study in class as lectures were barely interactive. The only good thing was her lecture notes and how useful it was to use them as they had everything.

5/10. Very Average

Best professor ever. She is extremely helpful, especially during office hours. She doesn't give extra credit but at the end of the semester, she'll release a webwork package to complete if you missed any questions before. The course itself is hard but if you attend all lectures, do all homework, and solve practice exams you should be good.

This professor is a horrible teacher does the work on the board without explaining how or why she did it. She doesn't teach you at all. Prepare tospending money on tutors because she doesn't teach at all. She has to get corrected by students every lecture because she can't do the math right.

I really liked having Prof. Demeter as my finite professor. The class is just hard. But if you pay attention in class and do the homework and practice exams, you should be fine. Her exam review packets are really good and her midterm + final practice problem sets are super helpful.
don’t do it. gave homework due on saturday every week, impossible to understand, the other day a girl asked if she could go over a problem on the board and she literally said no. thumbs down
Very nice teacher that explains things well. Just make sure to go to class and ask questions and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Found the tests that she made significantly harder than the departmental midterm and final. She explains the material well you just have to pay attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: if possible choose a different professor. She will not help you pass and will not work with you. Her class is 10x harder than all the other finite professors. avoid at all cost
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had her for finite, one of hardest freshmen classes. She tries but gets mad when students don't understand. Definitely pay attention because finite moves quickly. Get a tutor. Study hard for exams. Do the homework. This class makes you work if you want a good grade. Deadlines for homework are not negotiable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She wants you to do well, but you need to recognize when you need her help. Office hours helped me IMMENSELY; she will walk you though anything that you need help with. She gets frustrated when you don't initially understand something but keeps going until it sticks. Her accent is a nonissue if put your phone down and pay attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Iulia was one of the best finite professors. Many wished that they had her. Her review guides are extremely detailed and she gave extra practice tests that had very similar problems to the midterm and final. Those that came to class are the ones that got the As because she hints a lot in class about what you need to know for her tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She gives the notes and what she presents on the board before class and the filled in version after class. Compared to other professors, people in her class get higher grades on tests and overall. I HIGHLY recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Finite is a tricky course but Iulia explains concepts very well and does her best to make the numbers on exams small since finite doesn't allow calculators.

Iulia was amazing and always there to help students. Her office hours were after class so it was the perfect chance to get some webwork done while having her there to ask questions. I put in at least 5 hours every week outside of class and still got a C+ because pretty much the whole grade is exams. Best prof you could take for an awful class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Finite is a hard class in general for most students. Her accent takes a week max to get used to. She walks through all types of problems in class and provides multiple practice exams for each test. She is also available outside of class often to answer questions. As long as you do the webwork and pay attention, you will be fine.
na

She was definitely a time. Positives: her lectures were usually organized alright, and she was always willing to help outside of class. Negatives: If you are HOH or have trouble with accents, she has a thick accent that takes a minute to understand. The worst was when she would "forget" certain things and students would have to figure it out.

Honestly, because this class was online I did not attend lectures often. However, from what I did attend she was not too bad, her notes were pretty helpful and I could typically teach myself using that. The class is just difficult and being online has its pros and cons. Get as much outside help as you can, study hard.

Professor Demeter is a good professor, even though she is hard to understand and gets frustrated easily. No matter what, Finite Mathematics is a difficult topic and about 50% of people drop the class due to difficulty. Only grades are tests and an overall homework grade at the end. Be prepared to get help outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Iulia has an accent, but if you go to class and pay attention it is not hard to understand. I'm not sure why finite has a reputation for being difficult, it is essentially high school math with a few new topics. She provides so many practice tests that it is really all on you if you receive a bad grade in this class. Watch the Finite Show.
She is by far the most difficult teacher I have had. Combine her thick accent with the speed at which she teaches it is almost impossible to grasp the concepts she tries to lecture on.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Finite is hard, no doubt. Iulia is an amazing teacher though. All notes are posted in advance online and then she often re-posts them with her filled in version for class. For every exam she provides you with at least 5 practice exams. Yes she has an accent but it is in no way a bad thing in my opinion. Very sweet and is as prepared as possible.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I actually can not begin to explain how bad of a teacher she is. She goes way too fast and gets mad when someone asks questions or asks her to scroll back up. CONSTANTLY makes mistakes during the lectures so it is so hard to follow along. I am a pretty fast learner but she just breezes through everything assuming you know what is going on. Awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Finite is a difficult course but Iulia is not more difficult than other professors. Sometimes she teaches the hard stuff before the easier stuff which makes it a little hard to follow but if you do the problems in the book before class it makes it easier to understand. Her accent is different, but she's very accessible outside class and cares.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: If you have this professor I recommend trying to switch out of her class. Many of my friends have resorted to attending other professors lectures because she is so bad. She constantly makes mistakes, is impossible to understand under her accent, and overall is just boring to listen to. Finite is hard don't make it harder on yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I am taking this class as a gen-ed, and I could not have been more disappointed. I have put a lot of time and effort into this class, and I just simply don't understand the concepts. I never get good results no matter how much work or time I put into this class, and it is extremely frustrating. She seems to be extremely nice, but what a bad teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: People tend to judge her negatively because of her accent but I actually went to her office hours and got to know her and asked how I could preform better on the exams and she helped me ALOT! She is a great person! Finite isn't an easy class at all so there will not be a professor who will give you an easy A. You have to work hard and study a lot.
Very hard to understand her because of her thick accent. I would not take this class with her again, even though she is a nice person.

Iulia has a thick accent and hard to understand. She teaches straight from the book. Sometimes she teaches the hard way to solve a problem and then the easy way, which confuses a lot of students. Definitely have to do the homework if you want to succeed. I always went to group tutoring sessions before tests and they teach a lot of easier tricks.

She has a very strong accent, kids are going to complain about finite but if you just go to class, take good notes, and do the homework the tests aren't hard. An A in this class is certainly not easy, but it is very possible. She's a very nice lady and knows the content well, you just have to pay attention.

She does a horrific job teaching the first couple sections and makes mistakes in class and throws off the students. It's very hard to understand her and it seems she doesn't comprehend the material fully herself. One of the worst teachers I've had since I've been here.

The difficulty of the class depends on the person you ask. I did fine, but a lot of others don't. Iulia is very hard to understand sometimes, especially in a large lecture with several people talking around you. She is relatively understanding of your problems, but she won't baby you.

She is a little difficult to understand but as long as you aren't sitting next to a freshman boy who just cant get over talking about how much he loves his new frat, then you should be okay. She puts notes online so all you have to do is print them off, take them to class and follow along. Its not that hard. I love this class. Shes a great teacher.
If you have the opportunity to have someone else, take it. She's not impossible though.

She is the hardest teacher to understand in this school. She is not only unclear about how to do class work and homework but half of the time she is confused herself and doesn''t know how to do the problems. Absolutely awful explanation skills and only confuses people more.  Doesn''t speak English well.
She's keeps you up studying until 1 or 2 most nights because she does not know how to teach!

His lectures and long and a bit boring, but its clear that he wants his students to succeed. I am not good at econ so went to office hours often, which are one on one which really helped me understand the content. 3 exams make up most of the grade, but there are clear study guides provided, also a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Ivan is def a nice person but be prepared to get a tutor. His lectures are not aimed at teaching the material because he expects you already understand it. The exams have FRQs which other econ classes do not have so take this as your warning

I would rather walk for an hour in freezing weather, barefoot, on concrete, than take class with this professor. Does FRQ on exams, which NO other teacher does. Also has very few assignments/extra credit, so tests are your grade. This course felt like an exercise rather than education, and it hindered my ability to learn the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ivan is a nice individual, but I feel obligated to warn others. In this course, you will be teaching the material to yourself. Following along in class is impossible- doesn't explain things in depth for someone with no prior knowledge to understand. Talks fast, fails to emphasize key topics while harping on things unrelated to course.

To start things off, Ivan is a good person and tried to teach to his best but he was often unprepared for teaching the class. He would explain different topics really badly and me and my friends pretty much taught ourselves reading the textbook. Studying his study guides also didn't help much when it came to the exams.

The class is manageable, I wouldn't worry about his rating score. Yes, he has an accent but he's a decent teacher and as long as you show up and do the work, chances are you'll do fine. + the extra credit you receive is a nice bonus. I recommend looking over the slides + TopHats + Canvas quizzes to prepare for tests. It's really not hard.

ACCENT. Our class average on the first midterm was a 70% with no one getting a perfect score. when a student asked the class if anyone received an A no one replied yes. he refused to give extra credit or curve. he is very sassy i was not impressed with his teaching style at all especially because many students are trying to get into Kelley.

This teacher had an accent which was difficult to understand. He did not curve the first test that many students did poorly on which we thought was unfair. Would not take this class if you are worried about getting a low grade that will take you out of Kelley. Lectures are fast and confusing. Have to do a lot out self-teaching outside of class.

Econ isn't an easy class but Ivan tries hard for everyone to succeed. Classes are lecture heavy and exams are difficult, but big curve for everyone. Thankfully there are tons of opportunities to pad your grade with weekly at-home quizzes, online modules, extra credit, ect. Go to his office hours if you are confused and you will be fine.

I thought that professor was solid overall. He cared about the students in our class and would make an effort to help where he could. Despite this, he does have an accent which can make it difficult to understand and sometimes he goes through the lectures quickly. Even though he was tough, he was a good guy and I would take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He rushes extremely too fast during his lectures. He isn't very good at explaining things, especially to people who aren't familiar with economics. Additionally does curve his test but at the hand of the fact that the class average on our first exam was 68%. I would not recommend him to anyone.

TopHat readings were so much better than this tool of a teacher. You could honestly skip every class and still end up with the same grade but unfortunately there are points for attendance. The only good part about this class was the massive curves on his tests because most people failed them.

Absolutely awful time with his class. Rushes through topics so much that I could barely understand what was needed for the test - and every test had a huge curve because of the amount of mistakes he made on each one. Not a single moment did I want to be in a lecture when he taught - amazed I even got a B-

Heavily recommend Prof Ivan for B251. Yes, he has an accent and may sometimes stumble, but he summarizes all material into easy-to-understand bullet points in his slides, with straightforward exam questions to boot. Gives extra credit, but also curves your exams up unlike any other prof. You will not need to touch the textbook at all with Prof Ivan

Ivan is a great guy and the P240 class involves very interesting topics. But Ivan moved through his lectures extremely slowly, which limited the topics we covered (sometimes it was the same 1-3 ideas for all of class), and engaging discussions we could've had. The class is fairly easy, 2 exams, 2 essays, and free 100s on the class assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ivan is great at making himself available for students in and out of class and has a real passion for teaching/helping students. He's funny, down to earth and I'm finding his class very enjoyable. He teaches difficult topics but does his best to make things clear.
Super cool and interesting guy. Makes me actually want to think about philosophy.

Ivan is a cool dude. He structures his classes to be more interesting than the textbook. He seems weird at first, but he's a good guy. He makes it clear that he is always available in office hours and such. Exams are fair/more than fair as he often gives hints. Would recommend.

I think he is a grad student and he tries to explain things but he simply is not good at it. Do not bother expecting a timely response on an email as he is very slow to respond to them. I had emailed him multiple times and I would have to go up and ask him to respond to my email. Definitely not a class you should take, critical thinking sucks!

Ivan is a nice dude. You can tell that he is passionate about his studies, and he tries hard to connect with the students by swearing and stuff like that. He's an easy grader and seems to really want everyone to have an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class was time-consuming because students had to learn most material outside of class through videos, which weren't always clear or efficient. However, the professor's goal was to teach real-world learning skills. He was very available for help, and ultimately, you get out of the class what you put into it.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You read two 10-30 page readings and/or studies a week, typically followed by a lecture on them. There a three assignments, two of which are pretty much participation the third is very easy and requires roughly half an hour of thought. The other 90% of the grade is the two exams, both essays; they are extremely easy if you pay attention and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Listen to the reviews!! I didn't and regretted it. You only get 2 grades the whole semester (but offered EC). He teaches with zero enthusiasm. The 2 weekly readings are like 20 pages long and dense neuroscience garble. Unless you are super passionate about linguistics, do nottt take this to fill a requirement!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
*on hands and knees, crying and screaming in a puddle of my own vomit* DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS.
Grade based on two assignments, he "teaches" a coding language to students with zero prior knowledge of it through videos, and sits there in front of the class waiting for people to ask questions, rather than actually teaching a single thing. Don't.

You know that meme of the guy talking to the brick wall? That is how every class I had felt. Every class was just the most monotone and unengaging PowerPoint I have ever seen at my time at IU. Most of, if not all, other SLST staff are engaged in their topics because they are passionate. He could care less about bilingualism and linguistics.

Mike's teaching in this class is absent. He disregards students' needs and has perfected providing no help or clarity. In order to combat AI, Iverson has decided that his class should be based on 2 grades (midterm and final.) In class presentations provide only bits and pieces of what you will need to gather on your own from endless readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mike, as much as I thought his humor was hilarious, was a terrible professor. He once told us that in college, he used to sleep through his classes. It shows. For a 100-level class, this class was actual torture based on the fact that your grade is solely dependent on what you get on your final exams. If you wish to take a GENed, DONT TAKE THIS ONE
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Course objectives unclear. Class grade was based off of just two exams. Iverson refused to make exam study guides unless a student gave him a template, and even when someone did, he just said to review the syllabus, which has 30+ papers/lectures linked. S112 is a cakewalk if you know the bi/multilingual experience, otherwise I don't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mike is a really chill and funny guy, but do not take his class. It completely relies on 2 tests. You have the opportunity to do extra credit but its a pain especially since he doesnt really teach so you dont know anything. I have shown up to every class and still barely know anything. DONT TAKE HIS CLASS SAVE YOURSELF THERE ARE WAY BETTER GEN EDS!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a super chill and nice guy, however I didn't get the point of the class at all. He gives you a bunch of readings that you just are expected to know the vocabulary used in them. Furthermore the majority of your grade is based on a mid-term which is short answer questions and a final which is two in class essays. I do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: actually the woat. everytime I had to go to that class I prayed the F bus would run me over on the way there. I literally dropped it after seeing him sit in a chair in every class for a month for 40 minutes and bark at us students to go watch some dumb videos he made 5 years ago. avoid at ALL costs. there is NO reason to take the class.

Very funny guy who makes lectures more entertaining. Your entire grade is basically dependent on two tests.He's honestly not a hard grader, the essay test is directly based on the slides and readings which people just don't do. The class is set up more like a 300 level course in my opinion, I wouldn't recommend taking it your first year of college.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a really funny person and I liked him as such. However, he was not a very good lecturer and expected you to know a lot more than he provided in class. Textbook readings are challenging and not very interesting. Jumps from topic to topic.

Took his SLST-S 204 course. Class was very straightforward you put the effort in (which was not complex) you'll do well in his course. I really didn't have to much at all and still got a great grade. If your too lazy to do the bare minimum of course your not going to get a good grade it's that simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't take this professor at all. Very lecture-heavy, he just reads off of slides and teaches like he doesn't care. This makes you not want to show up at all to his class. ALSO NO STUDY GUIDE, which is so annoying because when it comes to taking the midterm and or finals you're stressed because of not knowing what to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Everything is on a "do it yourself" basis. He does not teach the material and instead you expected to learn off of videos he made a couple years ago. EVERY CLASS he just sits there and you go up to him if you need help. Also, there is quick turn around time from having to learn all the content from the videos to the first assignment.

If you actually pay attention in this class, not treating it like a gen-req that you slack in, he is great. As a non-STEM major, I could've easily been frustrated by the scientific readings assigned, but I never felt that bc Mike always took the time to explain. Gives clear feedback and lecture is engaging, most people here just didn't bother LOL.
He definitely wrote the only good reviews about himself. His teaching style is making you watch videos that he made years prior, then judge you when you're confused.

Professor Iverson is a nice guy, but the class was not well scaled for the level. Even when asking more pointed detailed questions to clarify topics, he has a very hard time explaining these to students, he seemed to just brush over questions at times.

I took Language (In)tolerance with Prof Iverson and was excited for the subject matter, but didn't end up learning much. He doesn't seem to care about teaching and just reads off lecture slides most of the time. But, he does seem like a nice person.

I really wanted to like Dr. Iverson. He is a very personable guy. This said -- the class was absolutely mis-leveled and a lot of material was questionably hard. Diving into neuroscience papers with no knowledge of neuroscience is daunting and makes learning more difficult than it is worth. Also, hands down the WORST MC exam of all time!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Not hard,but annoying,You have a12page paper to read dueTuesday and two papers due onThursday,one7pages,the other14,We just cover the material in the papers in class,If you use tools to understand them, there is no need to show up,He seems self centered exWe had a whole lecture about him publishing a paper,He talks down on other linguistic models.

DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE

Facts:
1. 100+ pages reading within 1 week, not a worth it course for Gen ed elective.
2. The exam grade will come out AFTER the last day to drop with W. 
3. His quote:"I want to make the A more valuable."
4. Not good at teaching to be honest (no review guide, intended to fail u instead of encouraging students to learn)

Easy coursework of a lot of medical readings. Mike is a nice guy, but not good at teaching. Acts like we already know the basics an Intro level course and just goes into complex topics, then proceeds to give hard exams worth a huge part of your grade

Multilingualism and the brain- DO NOT TAKE WITH HIM! He will screw you over at the final and give you no preparation for what he wants or how he wants it done. Rubric is so general it is not fair to any student.

If you want to have a good semester DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! He is very passive and when grading he does not give a rubric or he changes the rubric after submission. Towards the end of the semester, he changed the grading scale which dropped all of our grades by 10%. It's not worth the credit when he barely teaches and expects you to know it by now.

Professor Mike is a genuinely nice guy and is genuinely knowledgeable about linguistics. However, the organization of Multilingualism is not good at all. The assignments are fairly easy, but the test was completely different from material reviewed in class or the readings. There is no midterm but the final is a killer.

Mike is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is HILARIOUS and extremely knowledgeable about the subject matter. I looked forward to his class every single week and I often found myself thinking about the course material outside of class because it's just that interesting. I wish I could take Multilingualism again. TAKE HIS CLASS!!!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!! It seems like an easy A at first bc homework is for completion, but when the final comes around he expects you to know way more than you should be expected to know. The multiple choice was overly difficult and the short answer/essays were graded very harshly. His lectures are boring and he's late to class most of the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Iverson is the most laid-back, hilarious prof I've ever had. Homework is to take notes on the reading and is basically just for completion points. You would have to be brain-dead to fail. No quizzes or tests. The only exam is the final. That being said, I have no idea if the final will be hard or not since most students just skim the reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He is very knowledgeable however, this was hands down the most boring professor I've ever had. It was a miracle I never fell asleep in that class as the only interesting moments were when we got to listen to music. My biggest complaint though is how inconsistent he grades. Sometimes he's harsh, and other times not so much
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors in undergrad.  I still miss waking up and going to his class - no better way to start the day than with coffee while listening to his smooth British accent.  Oh, and you learn a lot, too.  I suppose that's important.  :)
Prof. Ivanovitch is very intelligent and knows the material that he teachers very well.  Lectures themselves are boring, but his lame jokes and accent make coming very worthwhile.  I loved the class.

He gives a wonderful lecture. both very serious and detailed about the subject matter, while free-spirited and entertaining! He responds quickly and thoroughly to emails, etc. If you want to learn a lot and enjoy what you study, take a course with him!

LOVED this class.  Ivanovitch keeps things interesting and applicable.  Learned to see music theory concepts in a new light.  NOT an easy A, but I hate the idea that college should be easy. I wouldn't have it any other way.  Also, he has high respect for students, VERY approachable, VERY amiable. I'll miss this class a lot.
He was very sweet and funny but during class he showed examples that were not very helpful. The class was interesting but it tended to be unrelated to what we were tested on.

Wonderful teacher. He knows his theory and is great at explaining concepts. Hilarious man, too, if you listen to what he is actually saying. The man made a reference to Great Expectations when lecturing on form (the Parallel Interrupted Period, aka, P.I.P.) Funny guy, great educator.
Amazing Professor. Especially in a small setting. Very charming, smart, and helpful. Really a genius in his field.

Love him! The Ivonovich dance in lecture is funny! I understand what he's saying. Love the accent. Can't make up hw, but can turn it in late for a 3 point deduction.  His AI, Simon doesn't really teach well, but there are others.

Very decent teacher.  The British accent will keep you awake in class for at least a couple weeks.  His lectures are alright and he likes to discuss the emotional value of any concept he introduces.  The tragic failure of his less-than-funny jokes just serves to make him more adorable.
Probably the most uninspiring teacher I have ever had. Boring jokes, made the material painful to learn.

He knows his stuff, but he expects you to make theory your world. he also gives one homework a week, which sucks because you cannot re-do it. Make sure he doesnt see you leave class, he gets offended. We got a nasty E-mail from him about it. Over all though, he knows theory. and loves mozart

He is a very nice guy but he pretty much says the same exact thing in every unit. Hard to pay attention in class and he does track attendance. His tests are essay form and its very hard to know what exactly he expects. Nice guy and somewhat interesting but I wouldn't recommend the course.

Least favorite professor I've had while at IU.  The class dealt with dissent but it did not stop him from disrespecting opinions that differed from his.  A very liberal professor.  Exams are online essay exams and are very difficult; the questions were often far from what was expected.  Very hard to get a good grade.

Dr. Ivie is great! Highly recommend his class! You will get something out of it without a doubt. He is a bit old school but give him a chance. He will make you think. Not a hard grader, very  reasonable expectations. No tests, just papers. Reasonable grader, there is a B- average in his class. Sign up for his classes quick cuz slots will be gone!

This professor has a lot of assignments that usually lead up to 1000 points and it seems like a lot of time and ways to have a great grade but she grades very strictly and has no problem giving an F on an assignment or exam. She expects a lot out of this course and grades essays by the sentence. I liked the course but wasn't fond of the professor.

Laura is an excellent teacher. She's always willing to take time to help a student, and will go out of her way to help you if you're struggling. She's always willing to work with students, and has a way of explaining difficult concepts in a very clear manner. Her courses are difficult, but also incredibly rewarding.

I originally took this class because it looked like a blow off, but I absolutely love it. She's really nice and knows a ton about movies and tv shows, and most of the topics we discuss are really interesting. Plus I only missed 1 point on the 200 point midterm

I would say that he not only understood the materials, he made sure we understood the materials. With showing different student examples in class and the way of breaking down the mathematics, it became clear to a lot of students. Without his aide, this class would be more difficult. He is an instructor who genuinely cares about our learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I liked how this instructor was very understanding, personable, and thorough with his lessons. He also had our best interest at mind with learning the material and asked plenty of times if we needed help. He was also very available to answer questions and went above and beyond to reach out if we were struggling.

I liked the way this course made me think about math in a unique way. I liked how my instructor was very easy to talk to. He also was very responsive and open to being able to help me with the course. He responded to emails very fast and very flexible in terms of asking questions about assignments.

The instructor was really nice and cheerful, it was very nice to be in class each day. He was very clearly cared about us as students, and the class work would obviously be applicable in future jobs. The course itself was very interesting to me. I enjoyed learning how to think from new perspectives.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He was very welcoming and had high energy while teaching. He made our learning a very big part of the course and you can see how much he wanted us to improve. The course was structured by doing a lot of examples and practice problems which were helpful too. However, it was sometimes hard to understand the material (math is not my strong suit).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He worked very hard and taught the course well. I liked how the course put us students in the shoes of our future students, and the instructor emphasized the fact that our future students won't have the understanding we do, so we need to think like them. He was always willing to help students no matter how long it took until they fully understood.

The instructor was open to any questions the students had, and made sure they understood the topic before moving on. We went over many problems that enhanced out learning, and the instructor taught each portion of this course well. I am glad I got the instructor I did, and would strongly recommend him to other students.

The class itself was not hard, however, Iwan made it hard. He spent the entire hour and 15 minutes talking about the homework and would give us the next homework as if we spent the class period talking about what to do. I taught myself everything, and I taught it to myself and other classmates easier than he did. He can't explain or teach well.

What I thought would be a sort of mundane class ended up being something I really looked forward to. ProfK leads you to think in new ways. He gives great feedback on papers and tries hard to make lecture interesting. A lot of dense reading, but the actual writing assignments aren't too bad. Take-home final. Plus, he's got great memes :)

Ive had Professor K for multiple classes now and Ive enjoyed all of them. There are interesting and thoughtful lectures, and Professor K leads interesting and thorough discussions. His classroom is a very comfortable and intellectually stimulating environment, overall just a really interesting and nice professor
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof K. made L260, an intro class, incredibly engaging and relevant. His lectures always led to interesting class discussions and analysis, and he genuinely cared about what students had to say. His feedback on essays and tests was always thoughtful and helpful--it's clear he cares about his students and wants them to improve as writers.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof K is really caring. L260 is a large lecture-hall class, but he did his best to make it interesting and engaging. Gives great feedback on papers and is very accessible for any questions whether or not they're about class. Funny, down-to-earth and tries to relate to students in a way that comes off as genuinely cool and interesting. Great prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor K is a wonderful discussion facilitator who will make you feel comfortable and even eager to pitch in with your own opinions, even if you usually aren't much of a class participator. Plus, all of the assigned books were great reads. Awesome professor and great class, for majors and non-majors alike! Highly recommend. :)

Clearly very passionate about his subject. Good lectures, leads discussion sections well. Blowing off the reading is a bad idea -- but the assignments are nice, interesting reads, so don't worry. Tests/quizzes were challenging in the kind of way that tests your learning but they weren't arbitrarily difficult. Gives great feedback. A+ for Prof K!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was my second class with him, and he always manages to inspire me with some new passion for literature. The material, although often dense and lengthy, was made approachable and understandable by his great lectures. He's very funny (and rather political), so if you don't like a professor that comments on pop culture+ politics be warned.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He knows the material well and does and effective job at helping you grasp the content if you're willing to put in the effort. If you are not comfortable with professors talking about politics during lecture than I would recommend avoiding him. But if you are willing to tolerate it then by all means have Professor Kreilkamp. He is very committed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Prof K was able to make works from the 17-18th century engaging, covering  the interesting aspects in class. Professor K is wonderful! He encourages students to participate, is approachable and friendly,  &  gives good and constructive feedback on papers. Examsvery fair. Taking a class with him was one of the best decisions I've made in undergrad!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I didn't expect L371 to be my favorite class of the semester, but Dr. K made that happen. He helped us see how literary theory applies to more than just novels and poems, which meant we could write about music, film, or politics if we wanted. He was always available outside of class to provide feedback as well. I would take another class with him.

Prof. Kreilkamp is a wonderful teacher. His class is challenging in that it requires students to personally grapple with theorists. You do not study for the test, you do not regurgitate information he taught you--you must think, and so long as you make it clear you are thinking and trying, you will do well. Great learning, excellent material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof. Kreilkamp is amazing.  He's very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject, and goes out of his way to help students learn.  He made me care about material I thought would be utter torture. The readings can be dense, but Kreilkamp makes them digestible with lucid, conversational lectures and a friendly, accessible presence.  Recommended!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Do not recommend!  Four papers and an incredibly difficult midterm and final exam.  He is a tough grader.  Always had only negative things to say about my writing, when I have consistently earned A's in all my other English classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Interdisciplinary Approaches to English Literature for the spring semester was fantastic. Professor K knows a ton about graphic novels, and he made the course very interesting and relevant to modern culture. Don't mind the previous review, the peer review was only for a rough draft, and we had almost 4 weeks to work on it before the deadline.

He taught the Interdiscplinary Approaches to English Literature this spring semester, focusing on graphic novels. but the class was so disorganised, we had to do peer reviews for a monday 2:30pm class when the deadline was sunday night and he couldnt work the tech. readings were good at the beginning but got boring. gives awful feedback on work!

This was a two week seminar for incoming freshmen. Ivan ran the class as a discussion of the assigned readings, and it was actually really fun. We had assigned readings (poems) and short writings due every night, but it wasn't bad at all. He is a really nice guy and knows his stuff. He made poetry really interesting for me.

Ivan is the best English professor I have had so far at IU. He has an incredible talent for keeping discussion interesting and relevant, and is open to alternative points of view. He is always available for extra help and I could not have asked for a better teacher for such a difficult course.

I took L348 (19th century British fiction) with Professor Kreilkamp.  The reading material was challenging but extremely compelling.  Prof Kreilkamp is a sharp critic with the unusual knack of keeping discussion relevant, useful and interesting.  If you put the time into the reading and engage in class discussion, it is a great course.

This class had a somewhat challenging syllabus, but Dr. Krielkamp makes success absolutely attainable.  His expectations about his assignments are clear and his grading is fair.
