Nicest and most caring professor I've had at IU. Her lectures and course content are very straightforward. There is also plenty of resources if you need help. I'm shocked so many students struggle in this class especially with such a great professor.

This course is all about whether you put in the effort. Regardless of who your professor is you need to put solid hours into studying outside of class for an A. Not an easy class but not impossible. Judge is friendly and knowledgeable. She lectures fast so that would be something to prepare for.

A304 is a class that fully depends on the effort you put in. There is limitless amounts of help if needed. Prof Judge is a great teacher and makes it clear what you should know. I recommend taking A304 with her.

Professor Judge explains financial accounting on a basic level. The class is slow-paced and explains concepts from multiple angles. The textbook/class notes are free (unlike some other teachers) and provide a cookie-cutter template for taking notes in class. Very nice teacher and happy to explain concepts after class if you are confused or behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: worst accounting professor I have taken at Kelley
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof Judge is honestly super nice and competent, she can explain most concepts well, however her lectures can be hard to understand due to all the abbreviations she used. Tests are incredibly hard, harder than A306 imo.

She is honestly not a good professor. Did not seem to care about what students had going on in life. All my other Kelley Prof would stay after class and talk with students about interests, Judge just wanted to leave. Would not bend rules for anyone regardless of situation. You're just a number so realize that and do what you must.

Prof. Judge was a really nice professor. She's truly passionate about accounting. She can talk fast but for me it was a great speed. If you do your homework and study for tests, they really aren't awful. Discussions are pointless though.
Lectures are kind of pointless, almost everything can be taught to yourself online. Class is easy but exams are not and there is no option for extra credit.

Prof Judge does a great job of explaining all the concepts, although she talks a bit fast. 75% of the course grade are on the exams, 25% on HW and others. If you do all the HW, going to class regular, spend a decent amount of time reviewing the materials before the exam, you would do very well in that class!

Overall, Professor Judge did a pretty job of lecturing she is really enthusiastic about accounting but wished she would slow down sometimes and better explain stuff. Tests are tough even as an accounting major, the average on the first was an 80, the second a 79 and the final was curved. I do recommend her though, but you probably won't get an A.

Professor Judge just honestly does not know how to teach people who aren't already amazing at financial accounting. lectures are incredibly fast and a waste of time but if you do not go you have no access to her notes. very unclear on what your being tested on with few resources. would NOT recommend taking A304 with Judge.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She doesn't care about her class one bit. She doesn't understand her own content well enough to teach. Bad advice in her content. Also, any personal misunderstandings and your grades suffer. School doesn't really care about the bad feedback too.
Professor Kniola is awesome. Her lectures were somewhat boring, and she did give a lot of busy work, but she cared about her students and was very lenient and understanding. Great person.

Personally think that she is over-hated, I could also be slightly biased because I got a good grade too. She always had a big smile on her face and was usually accommodating if you had good things. I do disagree with certain things which are taught in the class such as the resumes (not very career specific). However, good stuff to do nonetheless.
Genuinely shows no empathy towards her students and grades however she feels that day. No consistency and will show no leniency.

Bro this is Kelley Compass not the army. Super strict for a compass prof. Going to this class was the bane of my existence and you legit could not skip bc you'd miss something that's 50pts. Resume and cover letter advice were bad. Grading was inconsistent. Should've stuck to being a flight attendant.

Unnecessarily difficult for what should be an easy class. Overlapping assignment dates, unclear criteria for grading, and strange weighting on assignments that can tank your overall score if you aren't paying attention. What a hassle.

She's not horrible, but more strict than other compass professors. She lectures for a long time and assigns much more work than others. I'm not sure why but she grades very strictly. Compass shouldn't be as hard as she makes it. If you have her, try to switch!

Not too sure what her credibility for teaching this class is...flight attendant doesn't seem to correlate to what most of us are recruiting for. How can you teach a career class when you haven't even worked in the industries we actually want to go into? Don't take any of her resume advice; she gave me a 70 on my resume when UCS said it was perfect.

I'm still not sure what qualifies her to teach a professional development and future career centered class considering she has never been apart of any career field students are trying to enter. Would've rather put in a shift at a coal mine than go to her class every week.

So much busy work. Has no clue what shes doing all of her advice is wrong. Super tough grader literally got a 75 on my cover letter. I dreaded coming to her class her voice is also so annoying. Listen to the rest of these reviews they're right. take anyone else but her avoid at all costs if you love yourself!!!!!!!!!!!

If you have this professor, RUN. She is an incredibly unfair grader and there is no consistency in the class. Truly there is no professional development in the class. She has no idea what she's doing.

Horrible teacher, would never recommend taking her class to anyone I know. Every time I showed up to class I wished I had stayed home and done anything else. Her advice is horrible and will ensure you never get a job. Make sure you undo all resume advice and listen to anyone else at Kelley.

This is supposed to be an easy class. However, she really made it difficult, and provided more, homework than necessary for the class. She also does not have adequate knowledge of what the professionalism in the corporate world entails. Rubrics for assignment also make no sense and are super nit-picky.

super easy class, awful prof. basically a repeat of compass 1, some assignments are the exact same. she talks to students like they're 4 years old, refers to them as "my friends". didn't feel very respected, occasionally says questionable things. only allows you to miss 2 classes. just pick a different professor.
Lots of busywork and extremely boring lectures. Assigns more work than other teachers but overall about what you would expect from a mostly useless compass class.

The class was ok. Compass 2 was a pretty useless class the entirety of the semester was just irrelevant busy work besides like 2 assignments. She was nice enough but not open to accommodations and she accused us of using AI on a team project which we didn't do. Also you can't miss 3+ classes or you fail from non-attendance. Take someone else.

She's a decent teacher but is so repetitive in her lectures. She also gives so much unnecessary work outside of class that is absolutely useless. It's a compass, so it's easy to get an A, but there's a lot of work outside of class. She also isn't that great of a person.
So frustrating to have. Claims to be big on mental health but does not care about her students. Deleted my textbox homework submission and when I emailed her about it, she said she del

This professor does way too much. She gives a lot of work for no reason. She has an awful personality. She claims to be mental health advocate but could honestly care less about her students. Would not take again and she would not let students miss even though we have 2 built in misses which made traveling hard for many during breaks.

Professor Metz is passionate about sustainability accounting and knows her stuff. Sometimes the material seems out of touch or harder to conceptualize as there's "alphabet soup" in ESG reporting, but you will learn in class. Attendance isn't always mandatory, and there are three projects in place of exams as well as a final group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took her sustainability accounting course and was disappointed. She's engaging but talks about IU football or basketball every class. No tests, but four projects that are time-consuming, and she grades very harshly with no clear rubric or explanations. Chill elective, but don't expect to learn much.

She is probably the worst professor I have had throughout my entire college experience. No matter how hard you try, she doesn't support you to get the grade you deserve. She makes it impossible to score high on projects and uses the justification "we don't have tests" to support her poor grading. Good luck if you have her.

Im shocked she has a 5/5 on this website, wouldnt be surprised if she wrote fake comments to boost her score. She's a really tough grader and can take points off for the dumbest most smallest things. As a prof, she sucks. Even though theres no tests, she more than makes up for difficulty by being a bad lecturer. Seriously though, this 5/5 is SUS

Her A 304 summer class was supposed to meet 22 days for 110 min each time but she decided to only meet 10 times and always cut class short making an already rushed course extremely rushed. There wasn't enough class time to learn the content and tests were harder than class work. I would've learned much more had I taken the class with someone else.

Awesome professor! I hated accounting till I took A310 with Prof. Metz, and I'm grateful for having the chance to take a class with her. I love how she focuses on real-life applications through her projects versus forcing us to memorize a bunch of random formulas for exams. Literally taking her again next semester for A329 because she's the best!

I would never have expected A329 to be one of my favorite classes I've taken at Kelley. I was so nervous about this class but she makes the course material practical and interesting and is super welcoming to students. I absolutely love her teaching style and how she designed the class to be collaborative and research-based.

Metz surprised me. No exams, all group work. Should be an easy A right? Wrong. She somehow made the content challenging enough that students didn't just brute force all work and take advantage of the class structure. Combine that will being extremely social and welcoming to students, and you have one of the best professors I've had at Kelley.

The rest of the professors at Kelley should watch how Katie runs her class. We work on a group activity relating to material from a 20 minute video from the night before. I learn more through her group assignments than I have during any other Kelley lecture. No tests, just large group projects that force you to apply the material which I enjoyed
Tough class but professor Metz was great
Excellent tax professor, explains difficult concepts in class. No exams, just group projects

A lot of the material taught was applicable to the real world and current. A lot of group work and most homework done IN CLASS. Biggest downside is that there are a lot of papers to write, especially the final project, for which I wrote over 2,500 words. Pretty relaxed class and professor, despite the massive papers. No tests which is great.
Unorganized and unprofessional. Lack of communication.

This was a fun class to take to complete the D271 Kelley Pre-req. You will meet twice a week for 3 hours total and rarely every do work outside of those 3 hours. No textbook! Everything in this class is very case study based. The schedule does get confusing because everything is based on current events so you cant really work ahead.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: This class is unnecessarily hard. There are quizzes in every class of material she's just finished teaching, and she expects students to learn the material before even coming to class. It's a very backwards teaching style and I would not recommend taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I love her as a professor because she is super accessible and is a great mentor. Sometimes things weren't explained great in class, but going to office hours is helpful for not only learning the concepts better but also getting advice about life. Her tests are very manageable. She gets that we are busy college students so she is very understanding.

I really enjoyed having Prof Metz for A311. The class in itself is challenging, but just study and prepare well for the exams. She has a tendency to read off the slides, so some classes are fine to skip but every week there is a small five point quiz over what was covered in the previous class.

Overall, really good class but a lot of work. There was an assignment due almost every class. Group presentations are a lot of work, so don't wait until the last minute. Very specific rubric and she cares a lot about your visual. Gives good feedback and tries to relate to students. Never any notes aloud and will deduct points if you look at screen.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Katie is a tough professor, but I learned so much and have real respect for her. I struggled with public speaking but she is very approachable and if you show her you are working hard, she will reward you. If you get on her good side from the beginning and ask questions, you will succeed and form a great relationship.

Katie is great. Get on her good side from the start and you'll be fine. ask questions and be willing to work for the grade you want. Take feedback and go to office hours. Very personable and friendly and wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Awful as a tax professor- does not explain concepts clearly
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: She is not only a very difficult grader, but she also doesn't provide feedback on your grades half the time. Her mood goes 0-100 so quick and it makes you walk on egg shells in her class. She doesn't answer emails for days. She offers help if it doesn't interfere with her own time outside of school. I would never take a class with her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Prof Metz is one of the best professors for C104 in my opinion. She's a tough grader, and she really makes you work for an A, but if you put the time in, she can tell. Go to class. If you miss 4, it's a 10% grade dock. Miss 5, you fail. Overall tho, she's a great choice for C104 and I really enjoyed her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Katie is a tough grader for a beginner level speaking course, but she really pushes the development of her students. I know that at IU there are better teachers to take, if you want a easier, higher grade in the class. By no means, can you skip class more than two times because your grade will suffer.

Don't take Professor Metz if you think you're going to slack off and get an A. She is a tough grader, but if you go to office hours and pay attention to her feedback she will help you improve. She creates a very laid back and friendly class environment which is great for this class.  You may not get an A in her class, but you will have a good time.

Katie was a great, albeit tough-grading teacher. I'm sure I could've done better with a different professor, yet I'm glad I took the class with her as she was on the personable and not intimidating in the slightest. The class really improved my public speaking and she played an important role in that improvement

Professor Metz is extremely approachable and friendly. Her guidelines for presentations are very clear. You have to work for the grade you want but she's always willing to help you along the way as long as you ask for it. I would definitely recommend her.

She is very nice and a great person. She will do the best she can to help you succeed in her class and outside of the classroom. She is a tough grader and can be nit picky, but she expects a lot out of her students.

Katie is a great professor and very relatable. She may grade a little tough, but I think I got really lucky with her. She made presenting not so stressful and sets a good environment for the class. I would definitely take a course with her.

Katie is a great professor. Yes, she can be a tough grader, but ultimately she wants everyone to do well. She's also just a really cool and nice person. I would definitely take her class again, even though I hate presenting.
Katie does a poor job of preparing you for the actual speeches, and is very critical and nitpicky. Be ready to be grouped poorly for ITP and Macy's.
Metz is a very tough grader in comparison to other professors that teach this course. Though she's really easy and fun to talk to beforeafter class.

She is a tough grader but makes it very clear on what she expects from you in your speeches and then how to improve through the feedback she gives you. You definitely will learn a lot in her class. Also if you go to office hours and talk to her, she will help you out on the final grade and round.

Cares about her job but very tough grader. Nobody got an A in my course this semester. Presentation must be perfect (no breaks in speech, perfect presentation, dress up, loudness, persuasive, etc.) to get an A, otherwise you'll get a C in the course.

Professor Metz is a great teacher. She is passionate about the material and she teaches it well.   However, many students say that this is an easy class. If you are looking for an A in the class, this is not the professor you want. You will learn more in her class, but your grade will be lower.

Prof Metz was a great teacher and extremely helpful. She answers emails like 4 seconds after you send them. My only minor complaint is that she is very strict about time penalties, which can affect your grade.

Nit-Picky grader- It seems impossible to get an A on a presentation- great professor though- fun class- prepare for the speeches and do all of the homework and you should expect a B, B+, or an A-. Favorite class of the semester. Loved Metz and my group. Make sure you get her.

Great teacher! She's really funny and nice. She definitely wants everyone to pass and although the work is hard, it will be for any of the business presentations class. She is super helpful in the planning process and is always available to meet. Definitely recommend!
K-Metz is the bae

She talks alot, and is a pretty good teacher. I never went to her offic hours so i didnt utilize her to the full capacity, but personally i would say she is an alright teacher and assigns alot of work and sometimes you would think it is unnecessary.

Professor Metz is absolutely unforgettable. She keeps class interesting and is extremely supportive. Don't go looking for an easy A, she's realistic about the grades she gives and always supplies valuable feedback.

Not only was Katie an amazing professor, but she has served as a mentor to me since I completed her class. She recently wrote me two letters of recommendation (one for a scholarship and one for studying abroad). I definitely recommend taking her class and staying in touch with her after!
Nice professor. She is very close to our age so she likes to talk a lot of stuff that is related to our life.

This class is tougher than it apears but it's an easy course overall with grades. I struggled at it and sometimes professor Metzdid some screwy things. She is really into vizuals and will give you a bump on that. Her grading was a bit askew but she is a good professor overall. She is among the better c104 teachers though. made class fun at times.

I really wasn't looking forward to taking C104, but professor Metz made the class really fun and enjoyable!  She truly does help you become a better presenter and she is always willing to help you with anything.  I would highly recommend her for C104!

I absolutely love Katie Metz!  She was a wonderful professor, who taught me to be a much better public speaker.  She is very easy to talk to, and made coming to class enjoyable.  I'd recommend her to everyone.
Soccernomics was such a fun class! she knows how to keep the students engaged and never makes things too difficult. and she's always there to help. great professor!
She's GREAT!!! I love her class and my speech skills improved a lot through the course. If I could take this course again, I would choose her again!

Professor Metz is by far the best teacher I had my freshman year. Definitely loved the group projects. Very interesting. She is also very willing to help with those projects if you are struggling. P.S. if you help with the video camera, you get extra credit points. Attendance is key in her class so attend every class AND meetings you have as a team

Soccernomics with Katie was so easy!  You have to write one paper, which sucks, but she gave every single person in the class an A.  Just get the paper over with early and go to class.  Katie understands the meaning of a 1 credit hour class and makes the material fun and interesting even for those who don't know anything about soccer.

K Metz is great!  She is so relatable and ready to help whenever you need it.  She takes an interest in her student's lives outside of the classroom and helps make their college years great.  Definitely take her class if you get the chance.  Put in the work, be professional, and ask for her help when you need it and you'll be golden!

Katie is a great professor.  You do have to work for your grade but she is very laid back and more than willing to help you become a better speaker.  I would 100% recommend taking her for X104. You'll learn a lot plus she makes class fun.

One of the best teachers that I've ever had! She's eager to help each of her students that go looking for help and her class structure is absolutely great! A laid back and cool professor, she's the one I would recommend for X104! It's a  fun class, you learn a lot, and the grading is pretty fair to the effort that you put in. Best professor ever!

She's really nice and relatable, but she also grades very much like a college professor. A lot of in-class activities (with the exception of speeches) are really laid back, but you do need to work hard on presentations if you expect to do well. Professor Metz is extremely helpful in office hours. I'd recommend her to anyone taking X104.

Professor Metz is the best teacher I met this semester. She is a easy going person, and always encourage you to improve yourself. Her X104 class is the best class I had. I really want to study in her class again. I recommend her class to everyone.

Prof Metz is just simply awesome! First, textbook is not needed. Second, her class is always happening and cheerful. Third, she is such an easy going professor. However, in order to play the game well, you got to follow the rules.
Katie is awesome. Fun class. A little stressful but still a worthwhile class.
The best, simply the best

One of the best teachers in Kelley.  Katie is extremely down to earth and is real easy going.  If you can dress up and talk to an audience with confidence, you will get an easy A.  Best X-104 professor out there.  I would recommend her for any other class out there.  AWESOME PROFESSOR

Kelly is energetic and classes are entertaining; however, they are a little bit hard to follow and sometimes can be difficult to understand what is expected for assignments/group projects. There is a good amount of outside work - it isn't very hard, but it is very time-consuming. She would also often make unnecessary passive aggressive comments...

This class was miserable. Do NOT take this class at 8 am with her. Constant frustration/confusion. She didn't know what she was talking about and stumbling over her words all the time. Assigns so much useless work and takes off points for silly things because she uses an automatic grader instead of actually looking at the work. SO MUCH GROUP WORK!

Cheesiest professor at Kelley. This is supposed to be an easy elective, and it has potential to be a fun class, but not with Professor King. Attendance is mandatory, we get assigned a ridiculous amount of busy work, and the lectures are insanely boring.

Firstly, Econ is a hard course, but if you want to make it less hard, take this man. I would name him the most generous professor. Do the assignments on time, study a little bit, and with his generous extra credit, you will be good. If his class is open, take him and thank me later. Don't fall for famous professor names for econ, just take him.

Firstly, Econ is a hard course, but if you want to make it less hard, just take this man. He is the saviour and GOAT! I'll name him the kindest professor of all time. Just finish all the assignments, study a little bit, and with his generous extra credit, you can easily get the grade you want. If his class is open, just take him and thank me later.

I've only heard of one other econ professor being worse than him. Yes, there were many extra credit opportunities, but even if you take them all, you might not get an A. His tests are very difficult to understand, and his lectures are often boring and not particularly helpful. He makes fun of students when they answer questions, right or wrong.

Lectures are easy to understand if you pay attention. Gives so much extra credit that even if you fail a test, you'll be fine. He gives lots of quizzes that are helpful for tests. Has a funny personality. I would recommend taking his class.

It doesn't matter if you show up to class every day but miss tophats or if you finished an assignment on time but forgot to submit it, even when you show proof the document was last updated before the submission was due. he WILL give you a zero, on top of that he shames his students for getting questions incorrect.

Horrible professor. So rude to students and never prepared us well for tests. He made this class so hard for no reason and insulted students when they got bad grades. At the end of the class he realized everyone was doing bad and attempted to give extra credit to make up for it.

I believe it was Professor Hassan's first time teaching. Course was very lecture heavy, variety of assignments like quizzes, exams, and Packbacks. Many opportunities for extra credit in the course. Would recommend taking his class.

I really liked Khoi! He was very funny and made lectures interesting! Usually ended class 20-30 minutes early. There are no exams which is really nice! However there are small quizzes every week and they can be difficult. About 3-4 group projects but overall they aren't bad. Mostly essays and one presentation.
He's nice enough, lecture is boring though. Major part of grade depends on group projects so if your group sucks, good luck.

He's a nice person, and lectures are usually interesting. No exams, but group projects and many short quizzes in place of them. Unfortunately all projects are group projects, so your grade HIGHLY depends on the rest of your group. You also keep the same group the whole semester, so if they aren't good you're stuck with them.

Kirk is philosophical and talks a lot, which some might find boring. He grades whole course based on four tests and gives multiple choices without partial credit so grades often does not reflect your ability to do math. Single mistake can cost you 3% of the course grades, so just a few of these and say bye bye to grade A. Materials are well taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kirk is a very well-spoken teacher who makes an effort to know his students. He has a funny sense of humor, and is always open to corrections for his common mistakes. The only points come from tests, and he has a unique style of explaining questions, though it didn't take long to understand. 312 is a very slow-paced class but overall enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Kirk is an older professor with a laissez faire approach to teaching. No homework or quizzes, so grade was 100% determined by 4 exams. Attendance not required, but he'll make comments about spotty attendance or coming in late. He has a great sense of humor and a talent for explaining confusing geometry stuff. Overall good.

Professor Kirk is very invested in his lectures, and has a great sense of humor that makes the class more interesting. He is very good at helping students view 3-dimensional examples. He does grade very hard but gives a curve for every test. Like he said in the beginning of the class, if you don't do any homework outside of class, you won't pass.

He is a tough grader and he doesn't explain how he made the exam. He will cover the material on the exam that he specifically told you that he won't include it. His final doesn't have any partial credits but he said there will be partial credits. Don't trust anything he said until you see the exams.

He is a wonderful professor: explains things well and answers question clearly. Has a dry sense of humor and cares about his students. BUT he gives multiple choice tests that are all-or-nothing regarding points. So missing ONE questions gives you an 85 IF you got everything else correct. Very tough grader!

This Professor has a very rude and an unusually direct casual way of talking to students outside of class. Nonetheless, his lectures were somewhat beneficial, although I have not attended the majority of them and surprisingly managed to take a hundred on one of exam. Reading the text book really helps.

Professor Kirk has a real passion for what he does. He wants students to truly understand the material. I thought his lectures were helpful and he gave good examples. He has very dry humor so be prepared for that. There is no required homework but if you don't work on the examples in the book on your own, you won't pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really has a passion for math and likes to try and share it with students. I thought that he gave really good lectures and used good examples to explain things. There was at least one quiz every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Kirk makes lectures enjoyable, mainly because he is hilarious. Be sure to show up to class, because there is no required homework. Reviewing the example problems he gives in class and completing problems on your own from the textbook is the best way to familiarize yourself with the material. The grading is weighted by 95% .

Prof Kirk is horrible. His lectures are useless as you do not learn anything in them. He goes way faster than the other calc3 profs and has EXTRA exams. I had to teach the entire class to myself. Ended w a C and have gotten A's in all other math classes. He is also rude and arrogant, even talked bad about a specific student to the entire class

Awesome math prof, and just one of the best profs I have had at this university. Makes lecture actually interesting and his sense of humor is on point. He has a monotone voice, but that makes his delivery of sarcastic jokes so much better so you don't really get tired or bored of it. Don't skip class, come in late, or have your phone go off.
Finite is pretty DIY, but Prof. Kirk is very good at demonstrating how to work through example problems. He sounds just like Ray Romano, though, so be ready.

Class is challenging, but Kirk does his best to help students. Answers questions clearly when asked. He has a monotone type voice, which can be annoying, but he tries to crack jokes every now and then to lighten the mood. Very nice guy. If you're taking Finite I recommend Kirk.

He's a very laid back teacher, and spells things out very matter-of-factly. He's a nice guy but the course is confusing if math is not your strong suit going into it. Going to office hours/Teter help is always a good idea!
Kirk is a very nice guy and helpful teacher. I went to his office hours a lot and studied pretty hard to get a B in the class. Finite is a tough subject, but hes a good prof to get for it.

He helps his students understand what is needed for exams. He also is funny most of the time because he jumps around with his examples. He also can be very understanding with students. If you have to take finite take him!

If you are choosing between professors for the dreaded finite, choose Kirk. He does a great job making sure that his students know only what they need for the test. Other teachers do ridiculous amounts of webwork problems, but Kirk only does what is necessary to learn the material.

Professor Kirk is one of my favorite professors by far. He's very laid back and makes the classroom comfortable. Only thing he hates is people who walk in late and cell phones. He's also only so-so in office hours, but he makes himself very approachable so asking questions in class is no big deal.
He is very nice and fun,I really enjoyed taking his class this semester.
He's a good teacher and a nice guy. I'd take more classes taught by him I given the opportunity.

If you want an easy A or someone who holds your hand through everything, find a different professor. If you want someone who understands exactly what he is doing, challenges you constantly, and makes you a better mathematician, sign up.
He is a very cool professor. Didnt learn a whole lot from lecture but the book really helps.
not helpful, sounds like the "Dry Eyes" guy, hard grader, do not take his finite course.
The professor was great
Just finished this course and I liked the professor.
Enjoyed his class
Great professor! Unless you don't understand English :)
Normal K201, Class/tests were hard. If you just do well in the lecture section and do all your outside work you should get a pretty good grade. This professor was cool and did care.
cant speak english
I'm taking this class and the professor has been very supportive and cares about students' success!
Although Prof. Kanyi had over 200 students last semester, he still remembers me and will stop whenever he sees me on campus to greet me! I enjoyed his class and he was great!
Although I did not do as well as I would have liked, Prof. kanyi was great and in my experience he cares about his students

I personally loved this class! If you do the readings before and after class and pay attention in class, learning the material is no trouble. The amount of effort you put in matters so do the extra work because it will help you understand the content you need to succeed! Will Kanyi was also a super nice and helpful professor!

I really liked his class and him as a teacher, he was very accessible outside of class and would totally take it again. For reference, I found that K201 is mostly a self-study class since it needs a lot of repetition, for my first Kelley class I'd say he is pretty good. I got a C+ on a exam, but the rest I got A+ so I ended the class with a A
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Would take Prof. Kanyi again.
best guy oat, i love him my goat
Great class

I took this course with prof. Will, fall 2025! Just completed the class and I recommend him if you are taking k201 in the future! My experience in his class and anyone I know in the class thought he was great.

Do not listen to the negative reviews. Professor Kanyi, for Discussion/Lab, is a great instructor and person. Probably one of my favorite professors so far at IU. He teaches the content well and thoroughly. I almost took a different prof because of the reviews, but I'm so happy I didn't. Just do the discoveries and practice, and you'll be great!

Don't listen to the negative reviews. Professor Kanyi's lectures are extremely clear and to the point, and he will help you with any questions on topics of the class you might not understand in his free time. He took time to get to know me and my group partners, and it went in a long way into establishing a great connection and class environment.

Coming into K201 and hearing all the mixed reviews for this class intimidated me, but I'm so glad that Will is my professor because he was able to simplify all the concepts. He is such an amazing professor, and he provides extra review practice before tests. He is also willing to help answer questions in and outside of class. Would def rec!!!

He's a really great guy, cares about his students. He gives extra optional review for exams that other profs don't give and if you ask him questions he's very approachable. He pushes his students to participate in class but doesn't make the class feel stupid. Would definitely take his class again :)

He genuinely cares about how the students interpret the content. He made additional videos to summarize each chapter which were helpful for quick revisions. He also had an optional project that enabled us to get real-world experience with data analysis and introduced me to group projects in college.
You put in what you get out of it. Also he's hilarious and making sure he knows your name in a positive way goes a long way. He likes to joke around and he explains things well.
he is a tough grader especially for gp's

Will Kanyi is an Amazing Professor. He was available to help when I had questions about the course. He genuinely cares about the students as long as the students care about their education. I'd definitely recommend him!

He was very clear when teaching the material for K201, and I was always able to meet up with him for office hours to go over my exam and homework. I loved his class and would gladly take it again, but the pop quizzes definitely were rough but didn't impact my grade much. I don't know why his rating is so low, he was great!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very inflexible with attendance (though attendance is not mandatory), unclear expectations for assignments, and harsh grading
He's doesn't care about you and super difficut to work with.
I enjoy this class and learned a lot, I'd recommend professor Will.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Currently taking this class, prof. Kanyi is great!
I would recommend the class

He's incredibly hard to access outside of class. He is not very welcoming to students asking for help which is honestly something you'll need because his instructions for the projects and assignments are so unclear. In class he reads off of slides which don't really help you.

Don't take this professor. He's not a good teacher. I took the class because his rating on here seemed good. I think some of these comments are made by him because there is no way we had the same teacher. He focuses more on students' faults rather than actually teaching.

Honestly, a horrible teacher. He reads off slides. The class isn't hard, but Kanyi makes it feel like a humiliation ritual with the way he talks to students. He doesn't care about you or your grade. He seems miserable and makes sure you are too. The class was online, but somehow Kanyi still left a horrible impression.

I honestly believe the people on this page with good remarks for his K201 class are bots, because there is absolutely no way you learned anything in that class with the way he doesn't even teach. His tone is condescending, with him constantly punching-down on students EVERY CLASS. He's impossible to get a hold of outside of class or even in class.
I would take Prof. Kanyi again, I learned a lot and made the grade for Kelley admission.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Online lecture can be challenging but I had a great time in Prof. Kanyi class

I have taken 2 course with professor Kanyi and I'm surprised to see so many negative comments! He has high expectations and emphasizes students responsibility in the learning process but I learned a lot from his classes.
I took K201 lab with prof. Kanyi....he was great and would recommend him.

I almost dropped this class but after meeting with Prof. Will, he encourage me and gave me strategies that made me succeed in this class. He was always available and willing to meet even outside office hours.

Prof. Kanyi class was tough but to his credit he set the expectations on day one! Although the exam were challenging he did exam reviews and literary told the class where the questions will come from. Assignments have extensive rubric, if you follow the rubric, you earn perfect score!
I enjoyed k201 and I felt the professor did a great job! The class is fast paced, make sure to keep up!

Very caring, nice, and knowledgable professor. The class is tough, as long as you keep up routinely with your work you'll be fine. The large group project is a little tough and unclear on the objective. Attendance isn't mandatory but you will get behind if you stop out. Weekly teams meetings were useless.

He was a kind person but a TOUGH grader. You will get mad if you want an A because he's very particular about the group projects. Highly suggest asking him for examples and connecting with him so you can succeed. Tests are kind of stupid because they're specific to details like GDP numbers and random ALDI facts. It's easy to pass though :)

Honestly nobody likes D271 but he is a good choice for the class. Instructions are not very clear but if you ask questions he is very helpful. The class is a pretty good amount of work but that's how every D271 class is. I think based on hearing how other profs are for this course, he is a good choice. Just be ready to participate

Although this class was challenging, professor kanyi was a great instructor! It can be a frustrating class because it goes too fast and a lot of new concepts. If you keep up and seek help, you can do well
n j5fb jwqerc3d

I absolutely loved Mr. Kanyi for K201 lab. He was super funny and easy to talk to. He's very available for questions before and after class, and does his best to help you understand it on your own. K201 as a class is very homework-heavy and challenging, but Mr. Kanyi is a great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I am taking this class currently and it's very well organized. The professor is great, easy online class if you get work done.
Taking this class now and the professor has been great! Almost dropped the class but it's been a good experience so far.

This class was great and I attended and connected with the professor during office hours! I requested and he  completed my recommendations for my transfer to another school! I would recommend his class.

This was the worst teacher I've ever had. His lectures were useless, offering no valuable information, and he constantly complained about students emailing him for help. His TAs graded insanely hard and were completely unwilling to assist. It felt like he had no interest in teaching or helping students succeed. Avoid his class at all costs.
I attend to a couple of office hours with Dr. Kanyi, I would recommend taking his class. If you get your work done, this is an easy A class.
I had a good experience in this class last semester! The professor does hold students accountable but if you get your work done, lecture is an easy A, lab is challenging!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took professor Will class in the Fall 2024 semester. I learned a lot from his class and had a great group for my ALDI project.
Prof. Will was recommended by a former student and I took his class in the Fall. I enjoy his class and did very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor was knowledgeable...I would recommend his class.
I took online lecture in the Spring of 2024; the class was Ok, but lab was challenging. FYI, the class is virtual over MS Teams and does not use Top Hat.
Had a great semester in Prof. Will class, would recommend him. He is always trying to reach out to students in his lab class.
This class is project based and it easy if you are in a functional group. I noticed a lot of negative comments about the Professor, I took the class this Fall and thought he was great.
I retook this class with Prof. Will after failing the first try and I liked his teaching style. I would recommend him.
I learned a lot from Prof. Will lab class,this class is great intro to business technologies.

Professor Kanyi is passionate about his email inbox but not about the course. He spends too much time discussing improper methods of contacting him than the actual content needed to earn a high grade. He is intimidating so it can be difficult to ask questions. Some peer mentors and TAs are harsh graders and the little points lost can really add up.

MOST ABHORRENT PROFESSOR I HAVE TAKEN, he was incredibly bad and made it clear he didn't care much for his students. When individuals couldn't get into the zoom meeting he said “that's not my problem” and proceeded to continue the lecture. His tophat questions are also for accuracy and are super specific from 7 page articles. SIMPLY TERRIBLE.
Lecture was an easy class, meets once a week. Just get the assignments completed on time and its an easy A. Group project can be challenging if your group members are not working together well

I had a great semester in professor Will class. This class can be tough if you don't keep up but professor is always reminding students of their responsibility. He was always available anytime I reached out, never had an issue scheduling a meeting the professor Will.

Since this is a fully online lecture class,I learned early how easy it is to lose focus on what I needed to do! My advice for this class is to pay attention..I feel professor did a decent job of making sure students succeeded in this course.
Professor Kanyi's guidance during K201 helped me a lot. He explained the course material efficiently and in detail. Would recommend taking him for K201 lab.

Professor was very knowledgeable and explained topics very clearly, and If you dont understand the way he explains it there are phenomenal TAs to help. Course was fairly easy as well just make sure to show up and pay attention.
Just completed professor Will lab class! It was a tough class but I really enjoyed his teaching style! If you need assistance, he is flexible with his office hours, just let him know.
He's the worst, he s not accessible outside class. He's not reasonable and doesn't help you out. Take any professor but him for this class. You will regret taking his class for sure.
Professor Will was my favorite teacher this Fall. Enjoyed his class and teaching style. You have to be responsible to succeed in his class.
This was one of the easy class for me. It can be challenging if you can't manage time and task, but it should be easy if you get your work done.
I put above average effort in this class and it's an easy class. Very clear instructions and a lot of help! Btw, professor always respond in less than 24 hours on canvas

K201 has no attendance policy but his lab checks are based on attendance. 
What happened with me was that one day I was 2 minutes late to class (I had a 11:30 AM) and the prof closed the lab check at 11:40 so you only get 10 minutes on a RANDOM day btw to answer 5-6 questions. He doesn't even offer a makeup if you were absent.
K201 lab has been very insightful  and learned useful excel skills. Enjoyed professor Will class!

I think this class is easy if you pay attention. Professor Will is very clear about expectations! People complaining about responsiveness here are just ignorant about instructions on how to contact the professor! Professor  responds within 12hrs on canvas.

I have Will for K201 lecture and he is absolutely terrible. The class material itself is easy but he is unresponsive to emails and does not care about his students. The lecture portion of this class is already so pointless and he makes it extra miserable.
You have to take responsibility to succeed in this class! Professor made it clear during the first week and continued to emphasize the point.
Enjoyed the class.
He's the worst professor, do not ever take him. Like he s the worst. He doesn't give any extensions or helps out. He s not nice at all

Not a difficult class. Had the lecture at 8 am on Friday and did fine. Weekly quizzes used the textbook so it was easy to get perfect scores. End of the year project was easy and the TA's provided feedback on ways to improve. Don't know why people didn't like him, if you put in the work then the class was easy.

Was the worst professor I have had yet at IU. Kanyi was my K201 lecture prof. He was unnecessarily harsh on students, was unclear where points were being deducted, and sent the snarkiest, rudest emails back to students with genuine questions/concerns. Luckily this class was only once a week. Overall, not great.

Will is a bore to listen to and while the lecture component and points are fairly easy to earn, it is a genuine struggle to make it through this class every week. He drags on and on in a monotone voice, and this class would be a lot better with a different professor.

Never reviewed before, but this class frustrates me and is conducted exceptionally poorly. All assignments are explained terribly (if at all) and expectations are extremely vague. Assignments are a waste of time and you learn nothing. The content is useless but the assignments are overly confusing/complicated. Will also doesn't respond to messages.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Solid teacher.. A lot of K201 can be done just by looking at the textbook, though. He's extremely nice, and if you show even a moderate level of attendance, he might even be lenient on things like missing attendance or smaller assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had. All he does is complain about being unable to answer his emails and the TAs for this class were hard graders and unresponsive as well. Pretty much on your own for this course if you have him for the lecture or lab. No remorse when it comes to assignments as well. Do yourself a favor and pick a different professor.

I have never given a 1.0 rating with a 5.0 course difficulty to any professor before. But Will Kanyi is the closest to accomplishing that pathetic feat. Couldn't be any less helpful, does not respond to any emails or canvas messages. Convoulted course content, only made difficult due to his style. Would rather watch paint dry then to listen to him.

Will was not helpful in the slightest. His lectures were a big waste of my time and every day I was forced to go I felt like it was time I would simply never get back. Nothing I did here felt important

He takes up all the class time talking about Canvas and complaining about students. When someone asks him or his TA a question, they get confrontational instead of respectfully answering. This is in context to a question about the assignments being hard to keep track of which frankly is true. He barely gets any actual lecture in.

The worst professor I've had! His class is organized awfully, nothing is made clear, and he spends 10 minutes of every lecture complaining about emails. You aren't allowed to ask for clarification even though this is the worst-organized class at IU. Both he and his TA are pretentious and talk down to you. I'm shocked he still has his position.

Felt a lot of time was wasted in class about him complaining regarding emails from students and students joining class late. Didn't feel like I learned much and if he wasn't complaining we were mostly just put into our respective breakout rooms to work on the project.

Had him for lecture portions of K201. Not a good professor, only uses Canvas Messages as student-professor communication, inaccessible outside of class. Doesn't teach and wastes 50 minutes of class time: spends 30 minutes of class time to scold people for joining late & emailing him on outlook, 5 minutes teaching, then 15 minutes group work on zoom

Was always complaining about people emailing him and some people not doing the hw well making it seem nobody was doing well. Until the last class were he clarified that it was only certain groups which was bad teaching but besides that it was fine.

K201 is split into a lab and lecture component; each covers separate material with no overlap. Will teaches the online lectures, and while I've learnt barely anything at all, he gives the least work of all lecture sections (no discussion forums) and also readily dishes out 100% for the final project just for completeness (w/ a clear base rubric)
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He talks down to students who would dare ask a question in class, he refuses to answer emails, and whines about people emailing him for 10 minutes at the beginning of every lecture. It's honestly astonishing that he still has his position. K-201 is a required course, but avoid Professor Kanyi's online lecture portion like the plague.

Since this class is required, do not take Will if you can help it. I literally learned nothing in his class. He does not care about students, or the class. He's impossible to understand in terms of speaking, and he's impossible to reach outside of class. DO NOT TAKE HIM. I don't understand why a school like IU would keep him as an instructor.

Quite literally teaches nothing. Don't try to email him, because he will spend 30 minutes of the class yelling about emails. Learned nothing, useless course. K201 lab is awesome, lecture adds NOTHING to the course, and Kanyi arbitrarily grades, giving you incompletes and taking credit for the tiniest mistakes even though he says "minimal effort".

The class is not hard. However, I've attended every class and I've learned nothing from him. Kanyi himself is a difficult teacher because he does not care about his students whatsoever. You cannot reach him outside of class and asking questions in class makes you feel like a nuance. Also passive aggressive and talks down to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he is a good professor and most people just do bad if they stop attending classes. just go to class and you will do good

He is the worst teacher/professor I have ever had. At first, I willing to see him through and thought he was just a no BS guy, but it's quite the opposite. He spends half the lecture complaining about receiving emails and he is unwilling to provide any help to anyone. Avoid his class at all costs. He rejects any criticism on his teaching.

Will is probably the worst professor at Indiana. He loves to talk about how none of the grades distributed are his fault and that we shouldn't waste our time trying to email him because he won't answer. The only grades we received in K201 were the group project grades, although they are basically graded on whether you completed them or not.
Professor Kanyi is difficult to work with. His online lectures consist of him bantering about students and their emails. He is a nice person but not understanding.

There is only 50 minutes of online course every week and he decided to use the first 25 minutes complaining about students asking questions via email and do not distribute lecture properly. Quizzes are useless as the wrong questions were not shown no matter what, there is no way to improve yourself from this course.

Do not take this professor if you can try. His lessons are essentially pointless and he doesn't actually teach, more of him just telling you how everything you are doing in class is wrong. If you're doing it wrong, it's not your fault. He doesn't give clear criteria's, instead gives vague instructions on his assignments. Cannot contact him easily.

Lectures were mostly pointless. First part of the class is spent lecturing about how we are doing everything wrong while contradicting himself. Instructions are not clear and he stresses not contacting him or TA's outside of class. Only reason he doesn't get a 5 for difficulty is because a lot of the points outside of projects are easy.

This professor is VERY difficult to work with. He spent the first 15 minutes of EVERY class saying he won't respond to your emails because whatever you ask is somehow stupid. He's so hard to get in contact outside of class and TA's are overworked and they take forever to grade assignments. The actual lectures are useless, just do the assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Will is a very stern professor who is very hard to reach outside of class. He refuses to respond to emails regarding in class questions and he is very hard to understand in class regarding procedures. His lectures cover the material you need to know for the projects, but you are left completely on your own to figure out how to do the projects.

I felt he did a good job of explaining everything in class and is easy to follow. Lots of people stopped going to class which is why many people found this class difficult. If you go to class and do the discoveries you'll be fine.

I really liked Kanyi and he was a very nice guy. I think it was fairly easy and not much work was even put into the class. Make sure you just follow the instructions for the assignments and you will be just fine.

Good teacher that was helpful to students. If you attend all labs (even though it is not required), you will get a good grade in this class. Just keep up with work and attend classes. Kanyi is an amazing professor and goes through everything in detail.

K201 with Access is probably the hardest class you'll take at Kelley.  But Will himself was a very good and nice professor.  The lecture portion is pretty useless and boring, and it's confusing at first, but very easy to get full points when you figure it out.

Professor Kanyi is a great guy. Although almost no one likes k201, he is there for you throughout the semester and is always available and happy to help when questions arise. It is for sure a hard course, and with any professor, a lot of work will be needed to be put in for k201. He is very friendly and makes the class as enjoyable as possible.
He will blame students for his errors. Sorry the quiz didn't relate to the textbook and we all failed? Makes absolutely no sense and posts assignments at the last minute

Prof. Kanyi is a great professor! He has a great background and is very knowledgeable about Access and Excel. This class is difficult. However, if you get feedback in class and ask questions you'll be fine! Stay on top of your homework, get GPS done early, DO THE PRACTICE TESTS, and ask for help. Prof. Kanyi will be more than happy to help. GL!

Avoid! Blames students for his own mistakes. Never makes it clear on what is due on what date and has often times changed it without letting us know. Canvas site is a disorganized mess despite him talking in classes about saying he will not change anything. Not very accessible on email for outside of class.
He creates very difficult ways to grasp the concepts in class with lots of unnecessary group work. Although K201 is a difficult course, his teaching style makes it harder than it needs to be.

Look K201 sucks. Professors have to give every student the same assignment and has very little control over your grade. That being said, Kanyi will go out of his way to make sure you succeed. If you show up at class and just talk to him he will do everything he can to make sure you understand what is happening. He is a great professor!

When I had Kanyi it was his first time teaching K201, which is a difficult class already. I didnt do well. I didnt necessarily blame him until I had to take it again this semester and just realized how much better my professor is. I feel like Kanyi will get better over time, but my experience with him wasnt the best. Really nice guy though.

Will's a great guy, really funny in class and explains the concepts fairly well. Definitely do the lab challenges and discoveries/reviews, as those make up for any misunderstandings or holes in what's taught in class. Does have a tendency to randomly take attendance but he always posts it as a Canvas assignment the day before, so you'll know.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I dropped after my access practical, didnt do that well on it. It was his first year teaching and I believe he wasnt a great professor. Had trouble explaining difficult concepts at times and was confusing. There are much better professors out there. Nice guy tho.

Stay far away from this program, unless you want lots of unpaid work, messages at all hours of the night and an overall chaotic experience. This program has potential, but not in her hands. She takes your paid students and gives them to unpaid teachers for 'class credit' instead of actually paying them for their work. Find literally anything else.

Skip this class. Students must teach JVA lessons unpaid for 40% of the grade while other JVA instructors are paid. There is also a required outreach project and an extra 25 hour project if you take 3 credits. The course title suggests outreach and professional development but most of the work ends up being unpaid teaching and admin. What a joke.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Students must teach JVA lessons for free (1 student per credit, 12 lessons) worth 40% of the grade. JVA is run by the instructor. Other people get paid but you don't. Also requires an outreach project and a 25 hour project for 3 credits. Workload far exceeds the description and this is not what the course title suggests.

The GOAT of the IU philosophy department. Classes are rigorously academic; you very much NEED to read the material before class to fully understand the material and admire his teaching style. Strongly encourages students to think for themselves and question the material. If you really want to become a better philosopher, you need to take his class.

This class started out fine but he gave a midterm and a final, which I have never had in a philosophy class. He was also a tough grader. My biggest issue with this class is that he assigned a group project, 10-15 page paper, and a final exam, all due within the last week of school. I would not recommend this class.

Prof. Ludwig is a great professor. The class was probably the most difficult I've ever taken, though he was great about making adjustments throughout the semester to ensure that he wasn't pushing too fast for the students. The material in the class that I took was his specialty so I feel as though he may have had a hard time slowing down sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: -really cares about student learning -difficult readings, but he makes them easier to understand via handouts -long lectures but they are helpful to understanding the material -good feedback -difficult essays -a funny and caring person
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Classic philosophy professor; can be dry at times, but makes an attempt to remain interesting. Super knowledgeable about the subject and a great professor to engage with outside of class. Overall good choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very kind person and does a good job of making bland content interesting. Highly recommend.

Super easy class and very nice. Would let you take an alternative time for the final with no problem(it was like the day before). But, no laptops and the class is EXTREMELY dry to get through. My desk looked like a prisoner's stomache on a life sentence.

Kleshinski is a great choice for Z304. Material she teaches is relevant to management and you'll learn a lot of unexpected insights about being a leader. Accessible for help outside class. Low amount of homework. Tests are easy if you study.

Outstanding Professor for the Applied Fintech course. He was very fair with deadlines and really made sure to give students enough class time to answer individual questions. Exams are fairly easy if you do the work.

Don't get me wrong... Kristoph is a good guy but sucks as a lecturer. He is a research professor, so by nature expect a little less on the totem pole, but this class was a little outrageous. The class average on the first exam was a D+. He pulls all of his material from NYU and because he doesn't make the materials he sucks at explaining it. BEWARE

I'm a junior with a 3.8 GPA... I've had some bad professors before. Kristoph is the worst prof I've ever had. Imagine giving a homeless person $250,000 to give a lecture. There's no structure, no organization, nothing.. he just talks. In every one of the three exams, he changed at least 3 questions during the exam.. while we were taking them. Chaos

I highly recommend Professor Kleiner for F305! He is a phenomenal professor! Get an A in this class: 1.) Go to class 2.) Print out lecture slides ahead of Class 3.) write down what he says that not on Slides 4.) DO the ProblemSets 5.) Do they inverses of each ? from problemset and quiz (most ? exams are inverses) 6.) go to office hours, ask ?s

Prof Kleiner is extremely nice and very knowledgeable. His slides aren't the best but he does a good job explaining them in person so be sure to attend class. Exams are difficult but that is due to the nature of the class, not him as a professor. He is very easy going and willing to help. He adjusts exam time/date to better fit peoples' schedules.

Not an easy course, but no matter who the professor is, it will be a difficult course. Kristoph genuinely cares about his students and his learning. If you go to class, do the problem sets, and ask questions when you have them, then you should be fine. His tests are similar to class examples.
Kristoph is generally a nice guy who's willing to work with you. His lectures are boring but as long as you read the slides, you'll be ok.
Awesome professor-would definitely recommend taking his class! His explanations were very clear and to the point

He's tough but also very available and knowledgeable. I've learned more in his class than in any other. He likes when students answer his questions. His slides are very wordy but they are still better than buying the 100$ textbook.

His tests are extremely difficult, and practically gives you no material to study for exams except for his 500+ slide, slide deck, which is full of text and confusing examples. Not much help at all. Unfortunately exams determine your grade in his class since pretty much everyone gets the homework, quiz, and discussion points if you go to class.

Smart guy, but the class is poorly organized. All his grades are worth 1 point besides the exams so pretty much only the exams determine your grade. He overestimates what his students know so he flies through slides and everyone ends up failing his exams. Probably the hardest class I've taken at IU.
Great class and he is so knowledgeable about the material.
Great teacher and so knowledge about the information!
Worst professor I've ever had.
lots of reading and discussions so make sure you g to class. 20 service hours are crucial
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: lots of reading and discussions
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Elyssa is one of the nicest professors I've had so far. She really cares about her students and how they are doing. This class is extremely easy, not much to do besides the Reading Responses every so often. All classes are discussion based. I made up almost all my service hours too. Just participate and she will like you
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Speaks to his female students in a very demeaning way. Laughs at inappropriate jokes directed at female students. He is a poor role model for his students.  Klug is rude , talking during auditions and recitals when female students are performing.  Surprised the music department has let him get away with this all these years.

If you're a serious musician studying music, you understand that some teachers work better for certain people, but not everyone. Howard Klug is not a teacher for the masses a not everyone would be a perfect match for him. Those of us that have the right personality, drive, & raw talent understand his ways. Great teacher, produces great musicians.
He's brilliant, but expects hard work. Anyone who complains about him wasn't doing the work required.

Even though he is a hard-ass sometimes..he is a wonderful and helpful teacher. It may not make sense to people as to why he is a very stern and demanding, but thats his only way of teaching. So just STFU and deal with it. If he was the only person you had left to study clarinet with, then swallow you pride.

Very demanding and critical teacher. Is very unclear, moody, and inconsistent with his teaching. Will ruin your desire to play clarinet or even continue in music. Only take lessons from him if you are truly amazingly talented.
good teacher

Rated a recital of mine years ago.  Wasn't even supposed to be on my jury.  Very mean comments.  The other to jury members gave the recital A's.  Needless to say, the performance was selected to be played on a major NYC radio station, so I guess Klug doesn't what he's listening to are talking about
Mean, mean, mean person. Stay away from Klug. He'll ruin your life. Blah!
No Comments
No Comments
terrible teacher.  NEVER take his class.

Great teacher. Surprised there are not more reviews. She has great PowerPoints where most of the questions from the test will come from. Also tries to get you involved with group activities, and encourages you to be comprehensive. Tries to put you "in a situation", which is great because that is the whole point of this class really. Awesome teacher
Very well spoken and knowledgeable.  I would highly recommend.
This class was awesome.  She was very helpful and knew everything she talked about.

The lectures can be interesting, but you have to fill in the powerpoints. A lot of times I found it hard to pay attention because she's quite dry and boring. I didn't even bother reading the annoying readings after a while, didn't find that it benefited me much.

Best teacher I've had so far! Her lectures are very clear and she is very easy to talk to. A little hard on grading, but you can sometimes talk to her about it and she might give u a better grade. Any class taught be her is bound to be interesting

Her powerpoint lectures are dry and long.  Her attendance is mandatory.  She is not very fair in terms of grading and does not reward students for giving effort.  At times, I felt hopeless.  I would not recommend taking a class from her.
Class is relatively engaging although boring because I feel like we talk about the same thing everyday.  She's really nice but the class is challenging.

Lisa was one of my least favorite Italian professors. I hated going to her class. She thought she was being a good instructor but not really. The book, the tapes and a friend are what helped me get through. I was taking 2 Italian classes that semester and once asked her for help in the other - big mistake.

Aw Lisa is a great teacher. If she knows that you're willing to put forth the effort, she will be there for you every step of the way. If you're a slacker, I don't blame her for not having any patience.

She is extremely snotty and moody, and she plays favorites on a regular basis. In the event of taking another class with her or getting AIDS, I'd still take the class...but I'd agonize over whether or not I'd made the right decision.

The exams were really hard, so make sure you have both a conceptual and quantative understanding on managerial accounting. Super nice professor and wants to help, but sometimes class can get a little boring.

I found A309 difficult due to the lack of practice problems & help available from the professor. The class was much more difficult than A306, and I would recommend taking that instead. Also, our end of course curve was unclear, and going into the final, I had no idea what my final grade would be.
GPA will go down.

Prof. Knisley is a nice professor, but his lectures are inconsistent and disorganized; sometimes he goes too fast or too slow. He makes his exams very difficult and they are not like the homework. He also provides limited practice questions. Lastly he fails to show up to office hour appointments and is slow at responding to emails.
Julie Knapp really gets you prepared with your resume and interviewing skills. This course was amazing and very helpful.

One of the worst teachers I've had here at Bloomington. Lectures are boring, lack substance, but you are still forced to attend due to in class activities which are equally pointless. Homework comes in the form of "explorations" where she expects a 2 page essay every week. 

Couldn't recommend less.
Julie is an amazing professor! She is so thoughtful, kind, and genuinely wants to see all of her students succeed! I would take any class taught by her!
Julie is very kind and helpful. There are a lot of assignments but they are easy and you will pass if you do them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: such an easy class but you have to go to It. julie is so kind and a great teacher, i would recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: In class activities are way too easy. Class material is obvious and redundant. Too easy of a class, but it's a requirement for the internship. Julie is very sweet but makes careless mistakes.

Dr. Knapp is a great professor and really cares about the success of the students. Some of the in-class assignments could be removed from the course, but most of the stuff you learn or do in the class is very helpful for future internship/job searches.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Julie is a very sweet and very helpful teacher. She is a great resource and loves to help students find internships so ask her if you need any help throughout the course of the semester. Her class is extremely easy. There is an in class assignment worth 5 points every day so attendance is a must. Buy the online book before the first day of class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Very Helpful and fun class. Show up and she gives extra credit -  especially before holidays

The career and internship preparation class will be the easiest course you will take during your time at IU. Julie will know your name by the end of the semester! While I felt most of the material was obvious, I supposed it was worthwhile for students who had no prior knowledge about the job/internship process,
SHE IS AWESOME!! Internship prep was the most useful class ive had in college. She is willing to help, really easy to talk too and understanding!
Very easygoing, and extremely helpful.  Worth taking a class with her!

This was the internship/career prep class and was very helpful.  I am more confident in my ability to search, apply, and interview for future positions.  Julie is very helpful and a good teacher. DO NOT PURCHASE THE BOOK, it is not needed at all and was a waste of my money.

I took the internship prep class and it was one of the most helpful classes I have taken in my college career. Julie gave me all the tools I needed to feel comfortable applying for a job in the profession world.

Very knowledgeable professor and internship coordinator. She is so nice and funny. I love the stories she tells about her past experiences in her careers. She has taught me a lot about managers and how to be professional for internships.

She is a great person but she is a bad teacher half the time in class it's like she doesnt even know what she is talking abt she came from a career in fashion and it makes me question why she is even teaching criminology when i was in class i could tell how much students hated it the fact that students would get up and leave as fast as they can...

Nice and caring professor, though her lectures could get very boring and monotone, which made it difficult to focus at times especially if you sit distant from her. Extra credit given just for attendance, and most of your grade comes from the tests, though they are extremely easy so long as you do the readings.

She is a bad professor, I took her criminology class and she was the worst in my opinion. No one answered her when she asked a question, her lectures are boring, she reads directly from a slide, she's passive aggressive, her TA's are bad (they don't help). You use the book basically ONCE, ridiculous class. DONT TAKE.

Although her class is very lecture heavy/a little boring, she provides a study guide with everything to know before each exam. Attendance is extra credit and she sets it up in a way that if you go to all the classes and do well on the exams, you can skip the final. There is only 1 project and its honestly fun. She wants you to succeed and cares.

Prof. Knight is very sweet and caring. I really appreciated the sociological work she detailed she's done in the CJS. Therefore, this is a great person to learn criminology from. However, I really dislike the way the class is structured. Three required textbooks is insane. The children's book project reeks of high school. Otherwise, great prof
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is very knowledgeable about what she is teaching. And sets you up for success, the insturctions for the tests are clear and so is the study guide. I barely read anything, so you don't have to read everything assigned to do well in the class. As long as you follow the study guide for the tests you'll be set.

This is not only one of the most interesting classes I've taken in my entire four years of studying at IU, but the professor also is great at her job. Going into exams you know exactly what to expect, she sets you up for success with study guides and straightforward rubrics. I learned a lot in this class as a true crime fan. I'd 100% recommend.
