reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This professor is not terrible. She is nice and knows the subject well but the amount of reading that is assigned is just ridiculous. You are required to read three books for this course. If you have books to read in other classes it just adds up to way too much reading. The exams are on paper.

I love professor Knight! She's very funny although her class is very reading intensive. She's very sweet and is very willing to work around any life issues or personal reasons as long as you communicate with her. Definitely take this class but you have to go to class and listen!

Professor Knight is a super nice lady and she's super chill! There are knowledge checks at the end of every week on the material learned in class and it is typically always very straightforward. There are 7 allowed absences per semester, but I would recommend going to class as much as possible. Overall a really good professor and I recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Criminology is an intensive reading class. You can get by without having to read all of the materials, but the readings are very interesting. Discussion and quiz every week with 2 papers throughout the semester. No final
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Knight is the best professor I have had the pleasure of learning from. Her passion for social justice is inspiring and contagious. She genuinely wants to see her students succeed and will go above and beyond to facilitate this. She spoke with me at length about my career goals and was always happy to offer advice.
Lectures are long and not organized or to the point. Also grades harshly with vague rubrics. Lastly does not respond to students in a timely manor.

Professor Knight was always available to help and went out of her way when our class had to go online because of COVID-19. Class was interesting and although reading was needed to pass the class, it was not an overwhelming amount. For the person complainign that she asked questions on things covered a few classes before- REALLY this is college.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is highly inaccesible outside of class. You can message her and she replies you weeks/months later. Her reading checks makes no sense, especially the way she phrases questions and suddenly questions you on not the reading itself for the day but on readings from few classes ago. Like who can remember those readings from ages ago??? Overall, bad.

Interesting topic material and exams questions are clear and easy to understand. Study guides are provided. She is super caring and passionate about what she is talking about. Lectures are kind of dry and boring at some points but overall interesting if you like criminology/criminal justice. I recommend her if you are looking for a passionate prof.

I liked Sexual Diversity and found it really interesting. Professor had good lectures with video clips and activities. I took this class because it was required, but I am taking other sexuality related courses this fall because of how much I liked this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Syndee is very nice and has a lot of talent in other fields, but she simply isn't qualified to teach a class on Sexual Diversity. The material had a chance to be engaging and she didn't make it interesting. She had a really hard time getting participation from our class. She was also unreasonable when it came to grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Connor is incredibly informative about all things IU. X180 was wonderful with him and I will be taking X190 with him as well. Assignments were easy, criteria was clear, and its almost impossible to not end with an A in his class. Also learned more things about the campus that no other X180 professor discusses.

Connor was a great X180 teacher and I would recommend taking a class of his to anyone who has an opportunity. He has a very dry sense of humor and doesn't show a ton of energy in class, but he's very funny and good at getting information across. I definitely enjoyed my time in his class as much as any other this semester.

Professor Knapp was a great professor to have during my first semester at IU. He has a dry sense of humor, is very knowledgeable about Bloomington and a bunch of other stuff. The class was dull, but Prof. Knapp did what he could with it. I would strongly recommend taking a class with him if you can.

In his Business in the 21st Century class, assignments and rubrics are very clear and easy to understand. The content is interesting and he makes it relevant to students by bringing in current events and encouraging class discussion. Weekly discussion posts and a final paper are pretty simple to do well on, as long as you show effort.

Professor Knapp gave great feedback on the resume building we did during the first weeks of class. Always very straightforward and to the point when going through the class slides. Not a bad professor to have as a JLLC student taking X180.

This course was so hard. Over 1/3 of my class dropped out by the time I dropped the course. You have so much homework, which was a little confusing to follow. The tests are so difficult, and the course is basically dependent on exam scores.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Entirety of course is memorizing minute details of every piece of information given. His method of teaching is essentially hurling as much information at you as possible and expecting you to memorize all of it. Lots of memorizing phylogenetic trees, diagrams and definitions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was graded off of 3/4 exam scores and the exams were full of miniscule details from the lectures that didn't really seem to contribute to my understanding of vascular plants at all. One of the worst classes I've taken at IU. Don't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Knox is extremely knowledgeable about the field of botany. However, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU DO NOT HAVE A BIOLOGY BACKGROUND. There is an insane amount of memorization and a HUGE portion of the grade is based on tricky lecture exams. I was completely overwhelmed and had to study almost 4 hours Monday-Friday to keep up.

Worst class i have ever taken at IU. Expect to memorize every genera of Vascular plants and draw them on a tree. Tests are full on minute details and he expects you to spend 4-5 hours a night on material. Does not provide power points or a study guide, basically a horrible class, take another lab lecture if you possibly can!

Amazing professor! Took 2 of his botany classes (B300 and B364) because he's that good. He makes it so easy to get an A. He tells you exactly what to expect on tests and is always there to clarify and help. As long as you go to class and pay attention, it's easy to do well.

It is important to note that there are two upper level Biology classes that Prof. Knox teaches - Vascular Plants and Summer Flowering Plants. I took Vascular Plants. 90% of the tests and quizzes were memorizing cladograms. Lab is identifying sticks. It was miserable. I've heard Summer Flowering Plants is vastly more enjoyable.

Professor Knox is one of my favorite professors! I would recommend this course to everyone. I had no background in plant biology, but loved this class. We took two field trips a week to really cool sites in Indiana and had lab on the other days. It requires a lot of memorization, but if you go to class and learn the vocab it's a pretty easy course.

Prof. Knox had very interesting lectures. He is very straightforward about the information you need to know which makes the tests very easy! The textbook is necessary for the lab portion, but the other two books are not used in the course at all
Dr. Knox is an extremely animated and interesting lecturer. The amount of memorization was very tough, but the class was very rewarding and enjoyable along the way.

I would recommend this course to anyone who is a biology major. Dr. Knox really makes you appreciate the diversity of plantlife, especially the plants that provide us with food. The lecture material is not hard to comprehend, but I would suggest making your own set of notes in order to adequately prepare yourself for the exams.
Dr. Knox is fantastic. He is articulate, his lectures notes are useful, and he is pretty hilarious. If you simply follow his study advice, you will likely succeed.

Prof. Knox is goofy but don't let that fool you. His tests can be tricky and require a lot of study time. If you want a good grade you really need to be proactive and not wait till the last minute to study.

Summer Flowering plants should be a required freshman course.  He makes you respect the underappreciated nature of southern Indiana.  He can be a bit long winded and mono toned, but its forgivable due to his passion for plants.  Takes a lot of work, and most of the course is rote memorization, but you learn at TON!
His teaching style takes a little time to get used to, but it's pretty good. His supplementary notes definitely help when you're trying to learn the huge amount of info. He's pretty silly/funny.

Doug is an amazing professor who has been tenured at Indiana University. He cares a lot about what he teaches and he wants his students to care as well. In his Wilderness class, there are a lot of classes held outside in nature preserves which is super fun. His tests can be hard and the class has a lot of readings (optional).

Doug is by far one of the best profs I've ever had. His class actually made me decide to change my major to outdoor rec. He cares and he wants you to learn. His labs are wonderful and they make you appreciate the surrounding wilderness. His tests are notorious for being "fair," but if you study there's nothing on them that is out of context.

Doug is a great professor and an even better guy. He makes things fun but you also learn a lot in the process. He has a large amount of experience so he can provide real-world examples of different things. Doug is the type of professor that you wouldn't mind hanging out with after class is over.

Doug is a good guy. Knowledgeable in regards to Environmental Ed and Outdoor rec, but more than a little misinformed on ecology and has a hard time adjusting his views to reflect accurate science. Sometimes, probably inadvertently, uses his charisma to persuade students to agree with his point of view. Great guy, lots of fun, but he's no ecologist.

Had Doug all through undergrad. Tried to take at least one of his classes a semester and usually took more than one. His tests are hard but fair. He loves what he teaches and it shows. By far one of the best educators I've seen. Made me love what I do and goes above and beyond to help his students.
He is a great guy but his tests are very hard so it is not easy to get an A in his classes.
very fun class... tests are challenging but you can still earn a very high grade with study
Doug rules, I try to take one of his classes every semester so I have at least one enjoyable class.
Doug rocks
I auctualy GO to class because i WANT to. You make my day doug.
Intergetic, lively, and fun, way to go DOUG!
No Comments

Professor Sarah is amazing! I love her lectures, and her prompt question are always attractive and inspiring especially during the beginning of the semester. There are primary sources to read, but is fine and most of them are short, so reading before classes do not take much time.

The professor gives 11 writing assignments throughout the semester which are randomly given at the end of class so attendance is mandatory.  These are graded by the SI's and very very difficultly.  Assigns about a chapter of textbook per week to read by yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved taking Hist of Birth with Professor Knott. She is so knowledgeable and kind.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her lectures are actually so interesting since we look at a lot of primary sources instead of focusing on the textbook. She is so well spoken and offers a unique perspective on American history since she grew up in Europe. There is minimal homework and no exams, only papers. Expectations are very clear, but she is not a tough grader.
prof knott was a good teacher, but her CA was a tough grader. didnt give good feedback on assignments. theres no tests/quizzes, only short assigment papers.

Professor Knott was a fantastic mentor for the first round of my capstone and really let me explore a topic that did not have a lot of source material. She helped guide me through a new field while still being incredibly kind and resourceful to all of the other students in my class. I would 100% recommend taking her for either Capstone if you can.

Great lecturer, and makes her expectations very clear. Makes sure you have all the resources to do well on the tests and essays. She does sometimes interject feminist/white male guilt views into lectures, but very encouraging and accepting of differing viewpoints. Participation/attendance not mandatory, but sometimes there are in-class assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Boring course.

The subject is interesting and she tries to make it interesting but fails. The field trips are interesting. The class is extremely dumbed down so it's super easy. If you want an easy class and are willing to sit through boring, repetitive lectures while the same 3 people talk and ask questions, take it. Otherwise, skip it.

Professor Knott is a very easy going teacher. She is very nice and you will like her. Shes very passionate about this class. its not a hard class, it mostly consists of class discussion and what you pulled from readings. Assignments are fair. Field trips! I wouldnt take again because it it just a little too boring for me and not my interest.
I did not read one page for this class and received a B+. There is a lot of reading and in class assignments are crucial
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: What she says in the lecture matters, so be sure to go to classes. She has a unique view about American history. She would encourage us to think through the meanings behind a lot of historical photos during lectures. She assigns short responses during lectures, so be sure to read ahead.

Great professorlecturer.  She is very knowledgeable about U.S. History and I found her lectures to be fascinating (partly because she's got a sweet British accent).  She sporadically hands out in-class assignments throughout the semester so make sure to not miss too many or else you'll fall behind.
Good class if you don't like remembering names and dates. She emphasizes source interpretation. Plus she is British which is impressive considering she knows a butt ton about American History.
Lectures are really interesting! Engages the class, definitely my favorite class of the semester

GREAT professor. Her lectures are interesting. You must go to class. Class notes and what she says in class is essential for the tests. She lets you use a page of notes for each test which is great. There is a lot of reading and a moderate amount of writing, but if you read and stay current with assignments, you'll do well
Excellent lectures. There is a high demand of reading, but that is standard for a history class. Lets you use a page of notes on the exams! Great class, learned a ton!
READ, READ, READ
No Comments

Involved individually with every student and very good at helping everyone succeed and making sure the interests of most students are addressed through course material. The best lectures I have heard at IU.

She is an interesting teacher, but you have to go to EVERY class, b/c she gives in class assignments. also she has SI that grade so hard...be prepaired DON'T take this class if you aren't EXTREMELY good at reading and writing, b/c you do a lot of it!

Dr. Steffy is the reason I am a sociology major. He's incredibly kind, caring, and enthusiastic and knowledgeable about sociology. I love the course too. The application assignments are very fun and help you develop into a better critical thinker. There are no tests or essays, just two video assignments and weekly quizzes. Don't skip lecture!!!

Despite the fact the class was very easy, and I only took this class to get it out of the way for the pre-med track; Dr.Steffy turned me to be extremely passionate and interested in sociology, his class made me feel all ranges of emotion because of intense he made the content. I would absolutely recommend anyone taking sociology takes it with him.
I liked him. I never read the textbook, went to every single class, and had no issues at all. He is a good guy and wants you to understand, if you go to class and take notes you are fine.

I took this class last year, but I really enjoyed it! the assignments were pretty easy and I think made certain topics in the class easier to understand. steffy was a fun professor and explained things well! he tried his best to give a clear one! the tests are a little difficult - they ask very specific details from the slides.
He is a good and easy sociology teacher, took this class as a gen ed and barely have much to do for it just weekly assignments and quizzes. No tests, online quizzes.

Professor Kody is a passionate and understanding professor. His class is easy to earn an A in as long as you do your 3-5 pages of reading a week and short weekly reflections. Besides for these, the entire grade is dependent on your final essay, which is straightforward and fairly easy, and your participation/attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really nice guy. However he's changed his teaching so SOC-S100 is no longer an easy A freebie gen ed. He made attendance mandatory and your grade is pretty much entirely determined by an essay. Class can feel kinda tedious cuz you have to maintain a journal and analyze short essays. You can still do well but its not an easy A.

Professor Konisky does an alright job teaching what can be an extremely boring and information-heavy course. This class is hard and requires a lot of time studying for the exams, which are all handwritten. Attending class helps because Professor Konisky often gives hints as to what he'll ask about on the exams. Do the extra credit too!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Really nice guy but oh my goodness the tests are so hard. I got a bad grade in his class despite studying for the exams for hours. Also, 10 essay questions on the final is pretty brutal. I wish the exams weren't a large percentage of the overall grade. Very strict graders

Konisky is one of the best professors I've had, and his class has been one of my favorites. The content is challenging but interesting. The tests are hard, but they never have any surprises. There are 2-3 big assignments outside of the exams, but they are not too difficult or time-consuming. Do the extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I think it's a testament to the prof that much of the class still shows up, despite not requiring attendance and posting all slides online. Attend class and you'll likely do well, although many people do find the tests hard, so make sure to do the EC and study. I was a fan of how the assignments (of which there are few) were set-up as well.

I love David, I enjoy this class and have been learning a lot about US Environmental Law! I would recommend the class but I have a few pointers: DO THE EXTRA CREDIT and STUDY HARD for exams. The average for our first exam was a 60.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: konisky is an engaging and knowledgeable prof. two exams & some projects, super lecture heavy but his delivery is good, the content is interesting imo. the avg for the midterm was 43%, but i ended up okay. he's honestly just a nice guy and does want you to succeed, but if you skip class you won't. attendance isn't part of grade but you need to go.

Prof is knowledgeable and well-spoken. Although attendance isn't mandatory he often gives out hints for the exams during class. Exams are graded toughly so make sure you are well-prepared. I went to every lecture and still got a low C on the midterm. Luckily (or unluckily), the class average for the midterm was around 40% so we got a retake
Dr. K is a really great guy with a ton of knowledge. The midterm and final were extremely tough but he actually let us do a redo after my class bombed it. He is a great guy with a lot of knowledge.

Tests are all short answer or essay, imo it was pretty difficult (not impossible but still) and I went to all of the classes. He is very smart and nice. Overall the class was just ok not bad but also not amazing. I think the average for the first exam was like a D but he did slightly curve it

The exams are all written, but if you study the main things and topics most emphasized you are good to go. There are a lot of readings and I don't think he expects you to read them all. Prof. Konsiky is always well-prepared for the classes and passionate. Attendance is not taken I suggest going to class because of the exam content!

You are expected to attend and participate every class. He assigns a lot of reading and while you can skim and not do all of it, it is really important to pull out the important information because he can sense when students are blowing class off and will do you precious participation points. His tests are all writing so know your stuff he is great
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Best professor ever I love Konrad
I love Konrad so much!
Good class
Great professor! The project was a unique way to put our learning in action, I learned a lot from the it and it really helped for the final exam.

I got my first ever A- in college because her exams were so specific to what she says in class. You can only get 10 questions wrong combined for both exams in order to finish with an A. Make sure to write down the specific examples she says in class because a lot of the exams are to see if you are paying attention in class, rather than the content.

Pretty good lecturer and really enthusiastic about her field. Material conceptually wasn't bad whatsoever. But, nearly half of the questions on her tests are from super niche examples from class that you wouldn't even expect her to remember. The class gets so tiring trying to pay close attention to every example she gives for an hour & a half.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The exam-content is so undefined that not attending lecture spells death to your grade. You have to assume that anything in lecture is fair game, which gets tedious considering half the content is nonsensical. While the professor has great enthusiasm, the overall class structure makes the course near-impossible to enjoy.

You'll see a lot of bad reviews about her due to exams but thats not really her fault, the course structure just sucks. Shes a good lecturer, passionate and knowledgeable about her courses. The engagement assignments are super easy and there are only a few readings. IMO the only thing you need to do to get an A is go to class and take ok notes
she thinks very highly of herself. and tests suck.
She is a very intelligent professor who cares a lot about what she's teaching, in large part because of her personal background. If you go to class you will do pretty well, she is great!

She is so passionate about Greece and the class overall. Puts in a lot of time and effort to make sure everyone understands the content. However the exams are just filled with random content that is so useless for Business kids to know about greece.
She is a very personable professor and makes you try and understand the material. The 2 exams and final project are the majority of your grade, and the project was not necessarily straight forward.

She is amazing. i love her as a person. Her tests though werent about much content and were about how much you paid attention. If I didn't take extensive notes and ask someone after class who had photographic memory exactly what was on each test I would've failed

One of the harder classes I took this past semester. She is very knowledgeable and wants her students to learn but she can be a lot at times. She openly criticizes America. Also the tests aren't terrible but they have very specific examples from the lecture that are only shared once so it is important to catch them.

This class has frustratingly simple exams that do not reflect learning objectives accurately or meaningfully. Tests revolve around international business examples that you must remember but simply testing over the information and not the broader, more relevant context makes studying for this exam extremely boring and frustrating. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was genuinely the most ridiculous class I've ever taken. She cares more about attendance than learning. Roughly 30% of exams are based on niche, meaningless examples from class “which company did we not talk about..” which does not test your learning or knowledge. Exams are also horribly written and unclear. Good person, horrible professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tatiana is passionate about the subject, which I like. But I dont like anything else. Since English is not her first language, she speaks somewhat broken English making it incredibly hard to really understand what she is saying. The midterm and final are both 35 questions, each test question is worth 1% of your final grade, which is insane.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BUS D271 courses are often difficult. They are 8 weeks long and information on tests is very specific. That being said, Professor Kolovou is the best professor for this course. She teaches from experience, as someone from the country that she teaches about. She is also extremely caring and is very responsive to feedback, as long as you participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Exams are hard, but not impossible. The class is very engaging and fun, but your grade could suffer if your group for the final project suffers.

Great teacher, always positive and supportive and easy to build a connection with. This is a class where you have to basically write down everything she says as it is all fair game for the exams. Be sure to watch (and rewatch) videos and take good notes as those make up most of the exam questions. Put in the work in class and you will be rewarded.

Professor Kolovou is not capable to be a collegiate instructor. Her slides and lectures are riddled with errors, typos, mistakes, etc. She shows up late often and is highly unprofessional. Her exams are worded terribly and also full of typos/mistakes. She will claim that something will not be tested on and sure enough it'll show up.

I liked the way Professor Kolovou taught, however her exams made me very mad. She told us specifically that there would not be things on the exams that were on the exam. I studied off of what she said, and she straight up lied so that made exams extremely difficult. I went to every single class and studied hard and still didn't do the best.

Kolovou is the creator of D271 and it shows. The course is horribly organized, she is awful at communicating expectations, and does not prepare you for her exams. In her "review" she tells you to focus on the wrong things for exams. She is nice and passionate about the topic but is overall disorganized and makes the course unnecessarily difficult.

Attendance is absolutely mandatory, and if you attend the exams are made extremely easy. Many examples used from class, but she just wants to make this material make sense to her students. The textbook is online and published through Canvas, so again made very easy for the students. Show up to class and you will realize that it is easy.
She is passionate and qualified. The exams had questions that were very specific to things covered in class. Take notes on the names of specific companies and countries that are talked about.

Tatiana is a great person and she is easy to make a connection with, but she purposely makes the test too hard to get higher than a B/B+ on. A lot of her tests have two answers and have questions that either haven't ever been talked about in class or talked about for one second but are so irrelevant you would not think to remember it.

Prof. Kolovou is passionate about her work internationally. She is very inspirational and tries to engage her students. The class' setup relies on exam scores for all D270 classes. Attendance doesn't go towards your grade, but she puts examples from class on the exams. Overall, she had a good attitude and I would take her class again.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tatiana is very kind and passionate but her class isn't the most enjoyable. Many test questions are completely random and if you do not get a good group you are screwed. If your group doesn't pull their weight you go down with them. She cold calls so make sure you do the reading. Make sure you know everything on her slides and videos for the test.

She is a very nice professor. That being said, she structured this course terribly. The material that was tested on exams has quite no benefit to me outside of this class. I went to every class, read the book, and took notes in class - there was no way to answer all the incredibly specific questions given half the material was inapplicable.

Great teacher but makes unnecessarily hard tests. Went to class every day, took notes, and even recorded lectures on my phone and went back while studying and still struggled on test questions because of small details. Wasn't an accurate depiction of our knowledge whatsoever.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was my second class with Tatiana and I love her even more now. She is the sweetest teacher and allows you to build a close connection with her. Wants every student to succeed and really has your best interest at heart. Any class I can take with her in the future I definetly will. She is going to write a letter of reccomendation for me.

Don't take this class if you don't go to class and take excessive notes. ?'s on tests include random things that test if you went to class as opposed to international business. Example "On the first day of class I showed a video of a prime minister that mentioned two countries, which of the following were the two countries he mentioned?" Unwingable
Very nice, makes the topic relatively interesting, engaging class, fair grader.

She is genuinely so passionate and kind. She responds insanely fast and really cares about her teachings. The only problem with the class is that if you don't get a good group for the country analysis, your grade will suffer. I did very well on everything and did okay on the country analysis because of my group, which greatly hurt my grade.

Fine class. Has you do many more speeches than other professors and makes other students give you feedback instead of doing it herself. Class is on a 1000 point scale and I ended up with 929.5/1000 points. This amounted to a 92.95% in the class which she wouldn't round up .05% to give me an a instead of an A-. She is cruel.

Tatiana is a great professor but she requires much more work than other teachers. My friends in other C104 classes were breezing through while I was spending hours on presentations, and sometimes her point deductions on assignments don't really make sense and aren't well explained. She definitely helped me improve as a speaker, but she is tough.

Professor Kolovou is the best C104 teacher. But with that said, she is a very harsh grader. She assigns so much more work than other teachers and you will get tired of how much you have to do for her class. She really pushes you to be good at speaking, but sometimes her class makes me want to die. Amazing person and amazing speaker.
She is great and very well-informed and well-spoken. Gives really really good feedback, but definitely is VERY nit-picky and a tough grader.

Professor Kolovou is one of the best professors in Kelley, and puts in way more effort into a 100 level class than she needs to. She's a great speaker, very kind, and I would recommend her to anyone who genuinely wants to improve their presenting skills. That being said, she expects more out of her students than any other C106/104 professor.

She is really kind and inspirational. Since I was the only international student in her class, she always gave me more chances than others and some special treatment to encourage me to improve my English and confidence.

Professor Kolovou is my favorite professor at Kelley! She really cares about all of her students. The class size is small so she takes time to get to know everyone. She can grade kind of tough, especially in the beginning, but it's because it helps you improve and get better grades later on (larger point value assignments).

Professor Kolovou led my favorite class of Freshmen year. Be ready to learn and to improve your speaking by a ton! She grades tough, but the experience you gain with her is invaluable. She is a great choice.

Tatiana is the most caring professor I have met in college so far. She cares about every student, and she always gave me helpful feedback. She's a professor and speaker who I really look up to. She's a tough grader, but you'll learn so much from her class and get a good grade if you work hard. Definitely willing to take her class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She the professor for my first class as a Freshman as Kelley. She set the tone for professionalism and ambition is at Kelley. Never had an professor who was more energetic and involved not only within the classroom but also in the business world. She is truly a great contact and mentor. Yes the class is bit more challenging, but it's worth it.

Tatiana has a reputation of being tough, because she is. You have to work really hard to improve your speaking skills, but she is so personable and gives you all the tools to do so. Easily the best professor you could get for C104/C106.

I LOVED Prof Kolovou!! She was a difficult grader but you could tell she really knew what she was doing. She gave a lot of positive feedback to balance any negative comments which was really nice. There are 2 big group presentations which kind of suck depending on how your group is, but I learned so much from Kolovou. Wish she taught another class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Kolovou is awesome because she's passionate and is very accomplished. She doesn't hand out A's, but if you work hard she'll take care of you. She makes you do a couple quizzes but they're not graded. She's clear with what she wants so if you do that you'll get good grades. Be careful- she doesn't like giving A's & docked people's grades at the end
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Tatiana was an amazing professor who consistently pushed me to do better. She definitely makes you work for it. However, in the end, my presentation skills improved dramatically.  Get to know her!

Professor Kolovou was on of the best professors I have had so far at IU. She knows exactly what she is talking about. I came in barely able to make a 1-2 minute presentation, and now I feel confident giving 10-20 presentations in a group or by myself. Highly recommend taking anything that she is teaching. Get ready to work however.

Professor Kolovou is an outstanding professor. You can tell she really enjoys the material she teaches and she gives great feedback. I went to her office hours a few times and she was so helpful. You'll feel much improved by the end of the course.

Tatiana is a great professor and one of the most influential women at IU. She strongly believes in professionalism and the equality of women and men in the workplace. She taught me multiple skills that I will use in the future. While intimidating and tough at first, she does it so that you will respect her. Make sure to go to office hours!

It's a lot of work, and by no means is this class easy, but it's the most rewarding class I've taken so far. I'm a far better speaker now than i ever was. I used to not be able to stand up in front of people without freezing up and freaking out. Tati is the best.

I had heard a lot of terrifying things about Professor Kolovou going into the semester.  It's true that she's very strict and that the class is hard, but she is an amazing woman inside and outside of  class. She gives really good feedback, and I left C106 a much more confident speaker. Taking this class with Kolovou was well worth the extra effort.

One of the best professors that I have ever had. I came into the semester a stumbling mess and left a poised and confident speaker. She is extremely helpful and goes out of her way to make time for her students. Clarity-wise, it is not her who is not clear but, rather, the topics are very general and make it a little difficult to find direction.

She is absolutely amazing. From the very first class, I liked her. She is there to help her students and honestly wants us all to succeed. Her class will be difficult, but she challenges you in a way that you will definitely benefit from. She is a great speaker, and I loved going to her office hours.

Kolovou is a tough professor, but actually grades group presentations fairly easily.  You will definitely have to work hard in the class, but don't get too frustrated with your grade early in the class.  I started with a B-, and only missed an A by 1 point.

As an international student, I was barely comfortable in English when I took her class. By the end of the semester (and a lot of hard work), I was as comfortable in English speeches as in my native language.

I started off my semester terrified of her. She is a very strong willed person and makes ypu work for everything you do. By the end of the semester though, I really appreciated everything that class put me through. I promise if you stick it out til the end, you will not regret it.

Professor Kolovou really pushed us hard to give our best, but was very rewarding when she was satisfied with our work. A small compliment from her is more valuable than endless praise from any other professor. Very good professor that I would recommend to anyone who needs to learn how to properly communicate.
Pushes you to better yourself and only takes your best work. Well worth the effort though - Prof. Kolovou is an amazing person and mentor to have!
If you want an easy A, it's not her. But if you want one of the best connections in the Kelley School of Business and an amazing teacher, it is her.

She explains things clearly and gives good feedback, but you do 3 times the work in her class than with any other c104 teacher. Plus, you can most likely get a better grade in another class for less work.
Tatiana is very friendly and willing to help students that show effort. She doesn't give any free passes and appreciates the effort you put in. Her class was difficult, but rewarding.

Kolovou will make you work harder than any other C104 professor. However, I will say that everybody in the class saw their speaking ability grow, often significantly. She REALLY knows what she's doing. If you are willing to put in the extra work in order to improve, Kolovou is the easy choice.

Don't take Tatiana unless you want more work than literally every other C104 prof. My class had to do 3 presentations that no other class did. She is a good teacher, but save yourself the headache and take someone else.
Kolovou is the best teacher I have had at IU. She isn't as easy as other C104 teachers, however her teaching and professionalism make up for this.

Tatiana is by far the best professor I have ever had in Bloomington. The class is tough but if you're willing to put in the work she will do so many things for you to help. If you have the opportunity to take her class, DO IT
C 104 as Tatiana teaches it is not an easy class, but she has immense care for her students.  Her combination of experience and passion makes her class interesting and insightful.

Tatiana is an amazing professor and has a passion for helping her students. You will learn a lot in her class and if you take advantage of the resources she gives you, you will not only do well but also improve your speaking abilities a great amount.

Professor Kolovou's Business Presentations was by far the best class I've taken my freshman year. She goes out of her way for her students and she's very professional and prepared. I really recommend taking X104 with her.

You will take things you learn in this class and apply them throughout your public speech career, Kelley or not. Tatiana is super helpful and willing to work with people on an individual basis to improve. Definitely recommend this class.
Mrs. Kolovou really taught me a lot about speaking. Tough grader though. Got my lowest grade in this class as a B.
Professor Kolovou definitely knows what she is talking about. While she does not just hand out A's, you will find that your final grade will end up higher than you expected.

She knows what she is doing, however, she does not just hand out A's.  To get anything above a B+ you really have to try.  Sometimes unclear about all of the aspects in a speech (especially the Macy's Speech). Overall good, but I would advise picking another professor if you want an easy semester.
Amazing teacher and she connects with students and cares about them without having favorites.

Awesome teacher, absolutely loved her.  X104 seems like it'd be easy but she doesn't give out A's unless you work for them.  She genuinely cares about her students.  Go to office hours as much as you can.

Very knowledgable professor. Genuinely interested in your success. Not the easiest grader, very hard to get an A. Put in the time and PAY ATTENTION to what she says/likes and you can get a high B - low A.
She is a pretty strict grader, but very helpful and very friendly, so you learn a lot in a good atmosphere
Highly knowledgeable. Best x104 professor there is.

Very professional and will definitely make you a better speaker. You have to put in a lot of hard work and A's do not come easily.  Attendance is mandatory, 6 individual speeches, 2 group. If you want any easy A take CMCL-C 121 instead.

Prof. Kolovou was an amazing teacher/coach. She will push you throughout the semester. Do not be upset when you receive lower grades on your Impromptus. Towards the end of the semester you end up having outlines due (free points)  that match those speeches points wise. Work hard and show her that you are trying your best and you will get an A.

At first I really liked her until she was extremely rude to me. She made fun of me in front of my classmates and basically made me feel like an idiot. However, if she doesn't have something personal against you like she appears to have with me, she's a pretty good prof.
Tatiana expects you to work hard, but she's willing to help you the whole way through. No busywork, just some readings and about 6 or 7 total presentations. EXCELLENT professor!!
Best teacher I've had at IU so far... Grading is fair... pretty hard to get an A but you probably won't go below a B-

Basically, if you follow the guidelines on the critique forms, you will do great.  She loves athletics and health issues--key in on those.  And if you are getting docked points early on in the semester, talk to her personally and see what you can improve on.  It will show her that you really care and she'll probably like you after that.
Very strict attendance policy. You can only miss two classes or you will start losing letter grades. Other than that - decent class.
She teaches X-104 and is really easy going. I really enjoyed going to class most days because we would do group work or play a game or something fun. She is an easy grader too.
I felt he was a good professor. He read off the lectures, and they aren't too concise sometimes. But, it is straightforward, and the practice exams are good.

Honestly, I really loved this professor. He really tried his best to help his students. The class is challenging but if you pay attention and apply yourself then you can succeed easily. His practice exams are very similar to the exams. Overall, great professor and person!
Couldn't understand a word most of the time, exams were pretty similar to the practice ones he gave out.

Yo Krishnan, if ur reading this, I would travel back to your part of the semester if i had a time machine. Like i thought u were the worst, but no. Hill's downright the worst of the worst. U got an elderly voice that makes me fall asleep n missed attendance points for weeks. But, Ur practice exam was similar to the exam, n i luv u for that.

Pretty chill. His side of the course was really easy. If you apply yourself you can exceed a 100 on exams easily. Lectures are boring and the notes were well organized. His coursework is mostly conceptual based, so go to lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a pretty okay professor. Mostly read off the slides but they were available on canvas and organized well enough to understand without lecture. Tests are super straightforward just do the practice exams.

His lecture slides are wordy but great content when it comes time for exams. Explains everything well and has lots of knowledge on what he teaches. He is a little hard to hear, but if you pay attention and put some time into his practice exams, you should get a good grade. I enjoyed his part of C117.

Not the best professor I've had, but his notes and practice tests are very clear and concise. Things not explained well in lecture can be easily learned with the notes. Much better than the second professor for this course.

his notes were GREAT compared to Sarah hill's where you have to fill in a lot of the notes but he actually went through all concepts and posted all content on his notes. he is a monotonous lecturer and you DEFINITELY can't hear him from the back even though he has a mic on (its always misplaced). sit in the front, trust.

He is a knowledgeable professor and clearly has a vast range of knowledge about the chemistry field. His lectures are MIND NUMBING due to the fact that the entire content that is on the slides is pasted directly from the textbook. He posts all the lecture slides online so don't worry about missing class. But do the top hats.

Breaks down problems and ensures that students understand the concepts. Practice exams are very similar and provides plenty of material to practice and learn with. A 1 of 1 chem professor that actually cares and he literally spent a whole day of lecture to go over the most important topics found on exam 2.

Prof Raghavachari was great. His lecture slides have everything you need to know for the exams and his practice exams set you up for the real exam. He's a little quiet but if you actually listen and pay attention he really explains things well. He gets a lot of hate for no reason, and he gives you everything you need to have an A .
Great professor. A little hard to grasp idea of lectures at the beginning but after some time it comes easily. Makes wonderful practice exams. Would highly recommend.

Lectures are boring and confusing to grasp the first few times, but if you spend time going over the practice exams, you'll do fine. They're structured exactly the same. Overall a very nice professor and even took an entire lecture before the second exam to review. Doesn't deserve the bad ratings.

This professor provided so many resources and example problems to, not only help you ace the exams, but also gain a thorough understanding of the material. He genuinely cares for every student, and he was also probably the most accessible professor I have had.
his lectures are not fun but he cares about his students and the practice quizzes are basically the exam.
Exams are fair and he provided extra credit on every exam, along with allowing you to drop an exam. Do the homework multiple times and the practice exam, and you'll be fine.
Mind numbing lectures
His lectures smooth out my brain they are so bad
He cares about his students. His lectures are a bit bland though.

I didn't consider him a great professor, but he was much better than the professor who taught the second half of the course, which is saying something. I did appreciate that he always told us about upcoming assignments and exams. The practice exams were extremely helpful and he went over commonly missed questions.

he reads off from his slides, and you have to spend a lot of time outside the class to learn the content on your own. mastery assignments sometimes can be a lot, but his practice exams are very helpful during the exams. Make sure you study the practice exams before the actual exams.
He reads off the slides but they're good slides
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures were not very engaging but he did provide resources that are really helpful on his exams. His sample exams mirror his actual exams and his notes are much better and very helpful. He provides extra credit on the exams, which are not too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a nice professor, but he simply read off the slides, and they are disorganized. The tests are straightforward if you do the practice exams, but I basically had to teach myself everything. He is very knowledgable but doesn't seem enthusiastic about teaching.

Practice quizzes were exactly like the test, and the slides he made were somewhat helpful. Those are the only positives, as otherwise he's a very dull professor. He read directly off the slides during class and was very bad at answering questions and would just tell you to ask someone else. Khan academy and the AIs are your friends.

Get ready to sleep for 50 minutes. The guy hates his job he just stands there talking in the most monotone voice ever. He makes the quizzes impossible with how vague the questions are and how open ended it is, making it impossible to get exactly what he wants on canvas. The absolute most boring professor I have ever had. DO NOT TAKE WITH HIM.
Dude just hates his job and shoulda retired years ago. Shows absolutely no emotion throughout lecture and causes class to remain monotone and half asleep.

Bad professor. Hard to understand, boring lectures, unhelpful. Take another professor for C117. Only good thing about this class was the practice exam. The canvas page was disorganized and the average for the last final out of 600 students was a 61%, literally a failing grade. The final was also worth 30% so it dropped everyones grades.

All the people leaving reviews are buggin. He taught the first half of C117 and was not a good lecturer but the tests were literally exactly like the practice exams. The people getting bad grades are simply just not studying and doing homework. Don't be stupid and it should be a relatively easy A for chemistry. Prof Raghavachri very sexy too

Prof. Raghavachari was probably the worst professor I've ever had. Difficult to understand, spoke way too fast, and he was a ghost outside of lecture; never posted announcements on Canvas and took the entire semester to grade our homework and exams. He is an amazing chemist, just not a good professor. His way of teaching was reading off of slides.

Lazy teaching, every Lecture I went to felt like a waste of time, the professor read directly off the slides and provided no further elaboration. The AIs basically ran the course, professor had no direct line of communication to the students, and the grades were a mess. A professor should teach me, not YouTube videos and other students.

This professor was horrible. I had to take the course with him because he was the only professor teaching. Worst semester and course you could imagine. Couldn't understand him during lecture, and pretty much learning every single concept through youtube videos and khan academy. Don't waste your time going to lecture, it's not worth it.

This class is awful. The prof. did his best to explain the material but honestly it just didn't make sense. Lecture is pointless, you basically have to teach yourself everything. Exams are pretty difficult.

His slides are very disorganized and tests can be difficult. He explains the concepts, but doesn't really explain them to help you in a test setting. This class requires a lot of outside work, especially because lectures don't really help. The only thing that really saved me was having taken AP Chem in the past.

Took this class online, no live zoom other than discussions with AI's and office hours. His lectures were all pre-recorded videos and he read straight from the slides with little passion. He has an accent that makes it hard to understand what he is saying, takes some time to get used to. Hopefully the post covid in-person experience is better!

Prof Raghavachari was a boring lecturer. Read straight off the slides but I thought he explained the content relatively well and was a good prof. I heard the textbook was helpful but I never read it and I still got a good grade. Do the homework and practice exams. Exam questions tend to come from practice exams and previous quiz questions.
LOVE THIS PROF. boring lectures? yes. practice exams EXACTLY like the actual exams? yes. do the homework, lecture quizzes, and watch the lectures and you seriously should get an A or B.

So bad. This class is mostly math, and yet he never works out any of the problems! That is such a lazy way of teaching, and a waste of time. Not one bit of grace because of the pandemic, like every other professor does. Doesn't care about his students, teaching, or apparently what people think of him. His AI's do everything for him.

Had him for half of a semester before he had to have another professor take over. Extremely thick accent makes it hard to understand him. Teaches like we are senior chemistry students. Online homework had seemingly random due dates that do not show up on canvas. No notes or books with exam. Online exams are proctored.

Prof. Raghavachari simply reads off of the slides for lectures and never works any sort of example problems. I never learned much from lectures, so I always needed to thoroughly read the textbook. Homework and exam problems could be challenging with little place to look for help. Especially being online, I feel like I taught myself in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible professor. He doesn't understand that a student taking this class is learning this material for the FIRST time. Expects the students to know everything after one terribly explained lecture. Goes through material very fast and does not explain anything. Don't watch the lectures, skip through them and read the textbook and look up videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are useless. You won't learn anything so you have to read the book or you WILL fail. Honestly did well in the whole class without watching a single lecture because they're hard to follow and not explained well. Class was disorganized. It's annoying how I pay for this class bc the prof doesn't seem to care. Not a bad guy but terrible prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Raghavachari does not care about teaching at all. In his recorded lectures, he bluntly read of the slides, adding a few more words here and there. Does not care about technological issues in an online course. Do not provide extra credits and the test is not curved. When we visit his office hour, we hides not seem to know what he is teaching.

Absolutely terrible. I searched for this website SOLEY for comment on Prof. Krishnan Raghavachari. He mopes around like he hates his life, lectures are lacking examples (he'll show them to you but not work them out,) and there is little to no supplemental material to help students out. Even other teachers would tell you HE DOES NOT TEACH WELL.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Raghavachari's lectures were boring and the slides contained a lot of extraneous information. He constantly asked if we understood the material and explained it in different ways when we didn't. The tests are hard but manageable. Make sure you get as many homework/participation points as possible because they'll come in handy in the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Honestly he lectured too much over stuff that wasnt in the course. Talks too fast and hard to understand.
Hes very soft spoken but hes a nice guy and he really cares about your grade. Exams are exactly like the practice exams so as long as you understand all of those questions you should be fine.

I loved Mr. Raghavachari. He taught in a way that was easy to understand, and I will never forget the day he told us to not laugh as his wife wanted him to take selfies of him teaching. In the chem dpt many profs are blunt and can be perceived as rude, but Raghavachari was always soft spoken and kind. I wish he could teach all of my chem classes.

Raghavachari was very boring and didn't explain things well at all. He read straight from his unorganized slides. Each section I was taught by youtube videos, not the guy I'm paying for. Get all of homework points and top hat points as you will really need them later in the semester for cushion.
Very boring professor. He reads straight from the slides and it is very hard to stay engaged in his class.

Lectures were sooo boring. he does clicker questions so be sure to do them. ALL OF THE INFO IS ON POWERPOINTS!unnecessary to go to lecture since he reads from slides anyways. exams are super hard but extremely similar to practice exams so be sure to do them. very hard grader bc exams are multiple choice and require lots of work to complete problems
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A really good guy, and helpful outside of class! He reads straight from the slides so lecture gets a little boring, but exams are straightforward despite the incredible amount of info on them. Study hard, and you'll do well.

I took this class SP 17 semester and dropped and am now taking it again. I have to say, it's been a lot better the second time around! I don't know if maybe he changed his teaching strategy, but he started making the formula sheets on exams a lot more comprehensive. His slides are also a lot easier to understand. 10/10 would recommend
Such a sweet and soft spoken professor . I loved him. Monotone but will occasionally crack jokes that are hilarious . Must study hard for the tests but he does pretty well at explaining things

Raghavachari was a good prof. I racked up so many bonus points from his exams, which were already straightforward. They weren't easy and had soooo much info to study but if you know your material you will be good. His lectures were monotonous and straight from the slides (& I slept a lot) but the slides have all the info you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: It was hard but, he was a great teacher. He was very nice and accommodating. If you are struggling chegg was helpful and worth it, always do the mastering chem!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I personally thought he was a great professor. Everything you need to know is on the lecture slides. He's pretty monotone, but all his information is there and plenty of opportunities to learn the material are provided. The content was difficult, but his lectures made it bearable.

Teaches first 1/2 of CHEM C117 only.  The first test is hard (my grade is not final). Clear lecturer. Everything he says is on the Power Points. Usually gives 2-3 clicker question throughout lecture (rarely at the beginning). Doesn't cover the math much, more conceptual. HW is PearsonMyLab's Mastering Chemistry. Seems like a nice/helpful dude.

Raghavachari is an excellent professor and I don't know for the life of me that people are giving him a hard time. He is as clear and concise as possible with what you need to know for exams. If you put in the damn work and actually  show up, study the class notes, and do practice problems on mastering chemistry then you should do really well.

Must get 70% of clicker questions correct. Clear grading criteria. Lectures aren't required, but you should go to make sure you really understand and follow the concepts. Kind of a boring lecturer, but not unbearable. Most semesters theres only one choice for C117 professors and he isn't awful. If you have him you'll be fine

Worst. Lectures. Ever! It was impossible to understand to any of the the topics that he lectured about. He was very monotone and reads straight from the slides. He  didn't stop to explain any of the example problems. I had to go to a lot of office hours for all of my homework and other questions because nothing was learned from the lectures.

Krishnan is an awful lecturer.  Everything he says is word for word from the slide, and it's boring and hard to pay attention to.  He has examples of problems on slides but the work is already pre-written for you and sometimes he doesn't even talk out how he got to the answer he did.  You need to go to class to get points other than tests

He goes through the slides too quickly, so I stopped taking notes. He didn't really stop to explain when people looked confused. He made it seem like you should only ask him questions as a last resort. I understand he had a lot of students, but it was frustrating at times.

Lecture notes are taken straight out of the book and he reads right off of them. Absolutely horrible accent and does not like to stop to explain when clearly the whole class is confused. Avoid if possible, if not, go to AI office hours and read book on your own.

The material he teaches is very difficult and is very abstract. There aren't many applications for the topics. He focuses on quantum mechanics and thermodynamics. It is very difficult to learn the formulas and quantum #s. He goes through the slides pretty fast and doesn't review the material well. He expects us to do complex math to study.

He really does want his students to do well but he is so hard to understand and pay attention to. He talks very softly and has a hard accent to understand. It really is so hard to pay attention to him and before you know it an exam will sneak up on you and you'll be so lost. He really does mean well but be prepared for a challenge

I thought Raghavachari was very clear and thorough when lecturing. All slides were provided, which allowed me to follow along very well and add my own personal notes. I did many of the assigned practice problems and consistently did well on the exams. Hint: Attend all classes and seek help if needed. It IS POSSIBLE to get an A in the course.

Professor Raghavachari is great. If you pay attention, do practice problems, and study lecture notes, you should at least get a B on exams, depending on your intelligence. He is very helpful and allows students to get As if you work for them. Anyone who thinks otherwise simply did not try hard enough and would do no better with a different teacher.

raghavachari was great! if you pay careful attention to his slides, you will do well. i cannot stress how important it is to go to office hours every week. even if you dont need the extra help, it is important so that you can get bits and pieces of what exactly he might ask on the exams.
Horrible at lecturing. Avoid at all costs.

Great prof but MAKE SURE YOU GO TO CLASS!! it's super easy to fall behind and if math isn't your thing (like me) and you find yourself having a hard time GET TUTORING OR GO TO OFFICE HOURS. The class moves fast and builds on itself so if you don't understand something the class will get harder and harder for you if you don't figure it out
Awesome teacher and good course, I'd recommend anyone who wants to learn Intro stats to try and get this professor

She is a great professor, and wants the best for the students. The subject matter is a bit boring but she tries her best to give good lectures. The class is test-heavy but the first exam is pretty easy. The second exam and final should be studied for, but they aren't too difficult either. Everyone that gave a bad rating probably didn't go to class.

Worst teacher I have had at IU and has my my semester here 50x harder. As a Kelley student where this class means nothing but credit, she has ruined my chances of going abroad. Extremely bad at her job, tests are impossible, and hours of homework. AVOID AT AL COSTS
She gives a lot of extra credit and takes feedback from students very seriously. She makes econometrics fun to learn!
Didn't take stats in HS but still found content manageable. Exam 2 was fair but needs to be studied to do well. Exams are heavily curved, and she gives around 6% in extra credit.

She was my favorite professor I have had at IU so far. She is extremely caring and really cares about her students' success. She does a great gob of going in depth and teaching the content in a way that  makes it easy to understand.

Ignore the negative comments about her. She is genuinely one of the best professors I have ever taken. The material can be tough so you really do need to study for the 3 exams (final is cumulative). She gives a ton of extra credit which helps boost your grade. She's a very caring professor who wants the best for her students. Take E370 with her!!!
very easy class. Gives ~10% extra credit and exams are very easy.

Nice person but not a good professor. During the semester, the room our class was in had a leak so we were online for half of the semester. She did not do a good job at managing an online class. She posted her lecture videos from Covid but were hard to follow and blurry. Also her accent can make the lectures difficult to understand.

Very test heavy. Teacher really tries to help students do good in her class, but since class is hard and she doesn;t explain that well makes it hard. Gives a lot of extra credit which helps your grade and HW is easy.

Prof Krukava was amazing. If you take this class take it with her. She is extremely kind and knowledgeable and wants you to succeed. Does great at lecturing the content. Gives loads of extra credit in class that make a big difference so definitely attend. Only have great things to say about her, favorite prof that I have had at IU.

Krukava is extremely caring and also an amazing professor - able to break down tough concepts into digestible Eli5 bits. S370 Stats Honors was really rewarding as well - you'll learn slightly more Excel and work on some additional modelling projects compared to E370. Leads directly into BUS-G 350; highly recommend for BEPP/Biz Analytics majors!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I did terrible on all exams (not her fault at all) and still ended with a B. She was very understanding in office hours and offers plenty of extra credit both in and outside of class.

If you are willing to go to every class, you will really like her and your grade will not struggle. However, if you skip classes you will easily fall behind and there won't be much to help you catch back up

Krukava is an incredible instructor, exceptionally kind. Her lectures are packed with valuable information, offering extra credit opportunities. Exam I is a breeze, and Exam II is manageable with effort. Completing extra credit quizzes and attending for bonus points are musts. I highly recommend her; she's my favorite professor this year.

Take her for stats. She's much easier than all the other professors. She provides a lot of extra credit, which gives you tons of security heading into the second and final exams, which are both the toughest in the course.

Offers extra credit that can change your grade up to 10%. Content is pretty easy to teach yourself just from her slides alone. Her exams are also pretty easy not sure why people say exam 2 was hard just study and you will be fine.

Super nice lady. Always checked in with us before class. Has a strong accent so sit in the front. Focus up for lectures-I wish I would have paid more attention as it would've helped my exam scores. Tons of extra credit which is nice but doesn't amount to a whole lot in the end. Score as high as possible on Exam 1, the other 2 exams will wreck you.
Great professor, really nice lady.  Gives so so much extra credit!

She gives extra credit quizzes that are very helpful as they got me a B- in the class. She honestly seems like she cares about her students. The homework is long but they contain every concept that will be on the exams. Stats will be hard for any professor but she is a solid pick if you can get her imo she is worth picking an early time slot for.

Super caring professor who is passionate about what she teaches. Tons of resources on canvas and plenty of extra credit. Exams are difficult, especially if you've never taken a stats class before, but well worth taking her class.

She is very difficult and her exams are even harder. There's a lot of extra credit which doesn't completely make up for the no-curve rule from her. My class averages on exams have been 63% and 68%. She cares about her students a lot but she is very difficult.

You can tell professor Krukava truly cares about her students and their success in her class. She is very accommodating and willing to help outside of class if necessary. Her exams are difficult, but she also gives lots of extra credit opportunities and videos/slides on canvas to help with the material.

Prof Krukava is a fantastic teacher! She no longer does general exam curves however she does offer a lot of extra credit which will help your grade. She clearly knows stats very thoroughly but more importantly she knows how to condense it in a way that you will understand. She is also a very funny teacher. 100% recommend!

Favorite math teacher I've ever had! She was very good at teaching in a way that made it easy to understand for someone who had no background in stats. She's also just the sweetest woman -- she was extremely helpful when I missed a couple weeks of class, gives lots of extra credit opportunities, and engages with students. Love her!

Professor Krukava is easily the best statistics professor you can get for E-370. The class consists of a lot of extra credit that will propel your grade in the long run. Studying for her exams can be challenging, but she is accessible outside of class and easy to get in touch with. Her accent is distinct, so make sure to sit in the front.

The nicest professor I have had. Cares about her students and the material. First exam is easy the rest are tough with low class averages but overall with extra credit and curves it is a very manageable class. She gives you the tools to succeed. Would do anything for her students. It is hard to not appreciate her apparent passion for her students.

Krukava is probably the best you'll get in terms of stats professors. She has given out so much extra credit to make sure you do well in the course. That being said, I don't believe I have learned much of anything. She is super passionate and quirky when it comes to stats so if you don't like that I wouldn't recommend.

She's very very nice, but I believe a lot of her recent positive reviews have to do with the fact that school was online for 1.5 years, so grades were better. All I have to say..... our second exam had a class average of 64%. Class is super difficult so prepare to work with her.

E370 was a cakewalk. Just make sure to do the extra credit and you should be more than fine. Prof Krukava does a great job explaining all of the material. I would definitely take the class with her over anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Nastassia really cares about her students and provides so many resources for them to do well. If you take advantage of her help (review sessions, extra credit, etc.) you will do well in this class. She wants her students to succeed and it is so clear. Hands down the correct choice if you have to take stats.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This is definitely the best stats class to take. Exams are practically identical to the homework, and there is a lot of extra credit. She explains the concepts well and there's lots of opportunities to bring your grade up. Would definitely recommend.

Nastassia is seriously an incredible professor. Lectures are always clear & concise, assignments are straightforward, and you know what to expect on tests. You can tell she really cares about students -- she puts considerable time into making her lectures and questions are always answered in high detail. Take S370 if you can, smaller class size.
Great professor and very nice and caring person. Recommend her for sure.

Professor Krukava is amazing. She genuinely cares for her students and wants them to do well. Highly suggest going to her office hours. Make sure to stay on top of the assignments as they can get a little hectic.
Really nice and helpful. She offers a lot of extra credit so make sure to do all of the quizzes.

First and foremost, go to class and you will do well. She teaches everything needed in lecture for the homeworks and tests. Additionally, Professor Krukava is easy to talk to or email outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is hands down the best professor to take for statistics. She really cares about her students and will make the class super easy on her students. Literally gives more than 10-12% extra credit throughout the semester and gives easy exams. If you put in a little effort, there is no reason why you should not end up with an A or even an A+.

She was a great professor and really wanted her students to succeed. She gave almost 30 points of extra credit and the homework assignments were not too challenging. Attendance is taken, but it is helpful to attend anyways. The tests are somewhat challenging, but there a lot of other assignments and extra credit to help save your grade.
One of the best professor I've ever met at IU. She really cares about students. The lecture is clear and concise.

She provides intuition for statistics without which it can be such a mechanical and boring class. Decent amount of extra credit. Her knowledge of the subject is vast. She has an accent but if you look beyond it, she is an amazing teacher.

She is the best professor I've ever met at IU. Go to her office hours. She cares a lot about her students not limited to academics but beyond. None of the materials are difficult nor hard as long as you spend time on doing homework.

She is one of the better E370 teachers. She does a good job with hard material. She knows the material well and makes herself available to students when they need help and often extends her office hours. Go to class and do the homework and you will do fine in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: People don't understand the nature of the course she teaches. Wake up! This is stats! It is supposed to be boring and difficult. Can you find a teacher that does better in such course? Good luck... She explains technicalities in a clear and accessible way. Provides intuition for math! Example are simple to learn the concepts. Glad I took stats with

Technical and boring lectures that come directly from the book. If your read the book and do the homework, you will be fine. The only reason I attend is because she grades on attendance. THICK accent, so try to avoid, but not the end of the world if you have to take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Kreft is an good lecturer and shares interesting real-world examples. The exams focus a lot on memorization of the slides, so staying on top of the material and reviewing consistently is important for success.
You'll never hear stories like his.
The GOAT. That's all there is to say.
Certified Chiller.
He was a good professor and shared funny stories. Made lecture more interesting on typically boring content.

Steve is the goat of Kelley. I didn't skip a single one of his lectures, even missing a huge event in my life bc this guy is so goated. His life stories he tells during lectures are so amazing, I still think about them. He's such an intelligent, funny guy who makes the material really simple. I'm taking him for another class coming up, SO excited.

No matter if you take him or ellie. they both will teach one of the lectures every week. Just print out the ppts and study for the exam. focus heavy on exam 1, that will change your grade if you do bad !!

reviews.comment: I feel they were not fair and hated this class take the other professor option if you are smart.

Everyone complaining here is just crying because they do not study enough. The class is strict yes, and they may not be flexible, but they are definitely fair. Everything is mentioned clearly in the guides and they are not unfair in any way. It is not an easy class for sure but everything is in the slides.

he picks on students, and makes dated or flat out inappropriate comments and references frequently

i cannot stand him
His parts of the lecture were really engaging, and helped me a lot when preparing for the tests.
Not much to say. He is funny, engaging, and knowledgable. Class just isn't the best.

Started the class with 0 knowledge, and ended the class feeling well-informed. There are weekly self-test quizzes (8/10 gives full participation points) and really prepare you for the exam. Memo assignments were applicable to real-world situations, & discussion prompts allowed us to critically think about macroeconomic issues - overall great class
