No memorization or grading here except attendance. The course is structured over presenting current scientific papers and his explanations are clear. Always stops and asks if we have questions.

You get to drop an exam and there is no final which is pretty great. Has lots of power points which a lot of text on the slides - really bad if you wait the last minute to read all his stuff. All exam questions come from his slides. Long lectures can be boring. Nice professor over all. Very knowledgeable.
Exams are all multiple choice, he drops your lowest test, he rounds up your grade to the next percent. What more could you want? Fantastic

Professor Kumar surely knows a lot about Molecular Biology and presents the material well.  I have enjoyed his class tremendously and learned a lot, but not without learning to study smartly for it.  His exams are MC, and they definitely gauge students' understanding.  I highly recommend attending his office hours, as they are quite helpful.

Studied a hell of a lot for this course.  It is unlike some other biology classes with simple regurgitation.  His questions can be analytical, this is what makes this class challenging.  Dr. Kumar is fantastic, one of my favorite teachers despite some of his tests being hard af.  GO TO HIS OFFFICE HOURS!  His hours helped me get an A.

The exams are pretty difficult, but if you go to office hours every time it will be incredibly helpful. I received an A in the course but I probably would have gotten a C if I did not go to office hours. He is an incredibly nice person and a great professor you just have to put in the time and effort.

Overall, I really liked Kumar and his class. Kumar is a really nice guy. If you read the material before you go to lecture, Kumar's lectures make a lot more sense and are very helpful. The class was made more difficult this year, but I believe this was done to weed out people who aren't qualified/serious. If you study hard, you should get an A.

The exams are what matters in this class. And the averages are 74, 71, 66 through the first three exams. This class isn't for the lackadaisical and if you start studying a few days before a test you will inevitably fail. Study the pp a week before at least, because they are incredibly dense.

Prof. Kumar is probably the best molecular bio prof at IU, but that's not really saying much. He's a really, really nice guy, and the AIs (at least my semester) were pretty helpful. Class was hard - but if you memorize every single line on every powerpoint, you should get an A. Little comprehension required, but lots of memorization. Hard class.

Kumar is a very fair professor that expects you to know the material well as the tests he creates definitely test your knowledge, you need to know the material very well to answer the MC questions. He is very good at explaining things and his office hours are very helpful. If you put in the work you will be fine.

Professor Kumar does a great job explaining molecular biology and always has an example (invariably fruit flies) ready to illustrate a concept. The only downside to this class are the exams. The exams are difficult and require you to know very particular details. If you aren't willing to work hard (or hate fruit flies) choose a different professor.
Practice Exams were so much easier than the actual Exams.  The exams are super dense and hard.  Don't go to class or buy the book because the slides give you all the help you will ever need.

Very friendly. Textbook is NOT required, despite what he says. Basically requires memorizing and understanding about 10 PPT slides a day. Good teacher. Has several TAs so that if you need help someone is around. Tests are multiple choice based off PPTs. None cumulative final. Can drop one test.

Dr. Justin Kumar is a prime example of a fair professor, who would rather have his students learn than fail. the materials are extremely relevant in modern day science. A lot of techniques/assays are used in labs. and most materials are from recently findings.   Ended up with A+ because of his extra credits.  What a nice guy!
Awesome professor, provides amazing clarity on tough topics.  Always more than willing to help students.  Tests are hard, but he wants you to do well!

Kumar is so great-- very thorough and very clear. The lecture powerpoints are really all you need. Skip the book-- way too technical. I do think that if I didn't go to lecture, the class would be much harder, as the presentations themselves contain more information than what we are expected to know.
Kumar is so patient, kind, and willing to help anyone. Such a great professor who truly loves to teach (which is rare these days)
Great class!
Best...teacher...ever!
Kumar is AWESOME. He is the most kind, helpful, and CLEAR teacher. Hands down, the best biology professor at IU.
Great teacher with incredible knowledge of the course material. Tests are very hard.

I'm a horrid multiple-choice test-taker so this class was not for me. You don't need the book at all. His lectures are Powerpoints and I seriously didn't miss anything when I slept through his class occasionally on Fridays. I was intensely bored and sat in the back the whole time. I didn't enjoy it and was way too excited to get away from the class

Easiest class I have taken thus far. All of his tests are multiple choice and he posts his lectures online word for word for you to print out. You do not even need to attend, I stopped going halfway through the semester. The book is useless and very technical.

TAKE HIS CLASS!! This guy is amazing. I forgot what it was like to have a lecturer who actually made complex ideas easy to understand and interesting! He explains everything so clearly....has really great analogies that make molecular biology easy.  You don't need the book; he posts all the lectures online so you can skip if you want...fantastic.
His lectures and exams were very boring. I once lost my interest in molecular biology.

Absolutely knows his stuff. Incredibly intelligent and conveys information very clear and concise. Pay attention in class and you don't even need the textbook. Thoroughly enjoyed his class. Wonderful lecturer.

Professor Kumar is the best lecturer I have ever had. His lectures are crystal-clear; course material is explained so thoroughly that the textbook is not needed. Exams are very fair. It's a tough course, but if you come to class and pay attention you should be fine. I highly recommend this class if you're interested in the subject.

Great Professor. Explained the material as if he came up with it himself. He had us buy a textbook however I never once opened it. If you take very good notes and attend all lectures you wont need it at all. Extremely nice and approachable. Grading policy is fantastic. Course material is very interesting if you like biology. Enjoy!
If you force yourself to pay attention and take very good notes during class you Should do very well. The material can at times be dull, but his course as a whole is very fair. I would recommend him.

All you need to do is to attend and pay attention to all of his lectures. It's a little boring, but if you just study his slides the tests are easy. The good thing is you never have to read the book. Not the best class ever, but taking it with him was a decent experience.

The previous comments couldn't be further from the truth. Professor Kumar has a passion for Biology that is truly remarkable. If you follow his notes you will do well. Make sure to write down side notes as he is giving his lecture. Study those and you will do fine. Professor Kumar has been the best teacher I have had.
extremely boring, the book is the driest literature on the topic, molecular biology just may be a boring subject to begin with.  Would recommend taking class with another teacher

JK's exams are very challenging, but he is very helpful at answering questions and clearly enjoys teaching.  Reading the text can be helpful, but there is so much covered in the text that you should just read on lecture topics.  Very tough class, but if you put in the time you will do well.

I love molecular biology after taking his class.  I had heard kumar was a really hard teacher so I was pleasantly surprised that, despite one of them, the tests were exactly what he said would be on them.  The hard test he ended up dropping because everyone's grades improved on the next test.  He could NOT have been any more clear in lecture.

While he seems a nice guy, his class is?strange.  Lecture are boring (but are HIGHLY necessary for success) and focuses a LOT on flies. Tests are poorly written and frequently do not contain correct answers. Book is awful. Find another professor, if possible. (Note: this isn't blackballing because of a bad grade;I got an 89 with minimal effort)

Knows the topics inside and out and presents material clearly. Is very clear with what he expects you to know, repeats important points several times. If you go to class, do the reading, and study for tests, you'll do great.

The class was pretty difficult and involved a lot of studying, but you do learn a lot.  Towards the end of the class, the professor did not explain the material as clearly.  If you study hard and come to class every day, you can pull off a decent grade.

Regardless of what anyone else has said, ****ar is an excellent Professor.  His material is difficult, but he all but gives you what to study before you take the course.  Simply read his slides before an exam/quiz, know that material, and you will do well.  If he ever returns to teaching BIOL-L211 his course is definitely worth taking.
He can make the material pretty obvious based on his lecture notes.  However, as the difficulty increases he FAILS at explaining correctly and writing accurate exams.

This class is not as bad as everybody says it is. Kumar actually explains everything in great detail so that there is no confusion. There were no big surprises on the tests. The guys who are complaining obviously spend more time partying than they do studying. If anyone puts in any effort into this class, you should get at least a B. My A was easy.
Dr. Kumar is nice enough, but he often gives details that contradict the textbook, and his lectures aren't very clear, the practice tests aren't very helpful.

Completely random and specific questions on tests ("what if..."), goes on endlessly about fruit flies, has no teaching skills! Going to class didn't help much at all. Myself and FOUR friends failed this class due to awful teaching and poor tests. Don't bother.

I have never studied for a class so much before in my life.Lectures were very dull and boring, which wasnt the problem.His "specialty" in research is drosophila, so if you have him, make sure you know about drosophila, because it definitely was not in the reading. Molecular Biology is very hard, but this guy makes it nearly impossible to succeed.
Don't take class with him. Your grade is entirely tests and quizzes, many of the questions of which are stated poorly or flat out wrong. Getting a C is easy, getting an A impossible.

He is terrible, rarely replied to emails, all multiple choice tests with questions that are very hard to comprehend. No matter how much you know and study, your grade is based on your ablility to read his queations. Very uninteresting!!
Very vague and boring.  Tests didn't match up with lectures at all.

If you are bad at multiple choice do NOT take this class.  Every point you earn towards your grade comes from a multiple choice question.  His tests are not easy and does not cover what he says will be covered.
i totaly agree with person below. his test is extremly hard. i don't recomend you to take this class with him

I wouldn't take molecular from him. His lectures are VERY hard to follow, and although he says "don't worry about details", the tests are super detailed as well as very poorly worded. All MC tests, which doesn't really help with learning such a complicated subject. Nice guy, but really bad teacher.

Fabulous teacher. Professor Adams is a really nice professor. I completed the class during IFS. He is accommodating and always available. Class is interesting and very easy to get an A+ if go to class, participate, and complete all assignments.
He is really intelligent, and shares it with students really well.
I loved his class & his homework policy rocks! I might have messed up the course number.
overall a good professor. he's funny and makes class interesting, though didn't advertise office hours or help outside of class.
No Comments

Was really clear on expectations - as long as you're reading, doing the practice problems, and watching the videos per module you'll be in good shape. Lectures were brief and to the point and there weren't many surprises on exams. Personally he's funny and tries to make economics entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Kyle is an AMAZING professor, knowledgeable on what he teaches, kind and caring individual, and cool person. Grading is fair and he is clear on expectations, though his class was not easy. Classes are interesting. He provides very detailed instructions and feedback on projects. The Kelley EMBA program is fortunate to have a professor like him! A++

Loved Professor Kyle.  Not "easy" but not hard.  Very good professor with great lectures.  Changes it up to make the econ work interesting.  The math involves calc but honestly, nothing out of range for an MBA and he does a great job of teaching it.  Would definitely take again.
Very interactive and engaging.
Cares about students.  Good professor.
No Comments
Some of the readings were long and difficult to understand. We had a midterm and a final paper.

If you are looking for an easy class, this professor is not for you. If you are looking for someone who is knowledgeable about life, who will challenge you, who will inspire you, and who actually genuinely cares about not only education, but changing your perceptions on it, then take his classes. This professor changed my life.

I have him for my Intro to Theater class which he teaches with 3 other people.  He is by far and away the most engaging of the four and really stresses the bigger picture which is something I really appreciate.  He really helps to turn the mundane subject matter into something I care about. Overall, He's an awesome guy and teacher.

Arguably one of the most knowledgable guys about theater I've ever met.  He was an A.I. for script analysis, and I wished he taught the class instead of the professor: his comments were better.  This guy truly understands theater and what is demanded of an actor.  I would take him again in a heartbeat.  It would be wise of you to follow suit.

Lots of unnecessary busy work. Do NOT take this class as a marketing major... it will be the bane of your existence. Her slides are chaotic and unorganized. It's annoying to try and follow her train of thought. Her attendance policy is strict, especially for seniors
Too much work, take someone else if you can
Way too much busy work.

She's super sweet!! I am not interested in sales as a career (took this for marketing), but she tried to make the class engaging and truly cares about her students. Brought in guest speakers, always shared internship opportunities, gave career advice...GREAT prof. I feel like I actually learned something and the class wasn't difficult either :)
Dr. Jenny is so much fun and I thoroughly enjoyed her class! No exams and no textbooks. A great introduction to theatre.

Dr.Lale was an amazing professor! She cares a lot about her students and about the theater as a whole, which makes her class very fun. Make sure you attend class because you can get extra credit from participating. Take this class for a fun and easy arts and humanities credit!!

Taking Professor Lale in my first ever theater class was an amazing choice. She had the most engaging and funny lectures I've ever seen on top of making the content easily accessible for those will little knowledge about the subject. I will likely try and take another class with her in the future as I enjoyed it quite a bit.
Best elective class I've taken! Such a nice woman, easy grader and if she knocks out points clearly explains why. You can tell she loves what she does!!

Dr. Jenny is an AMAZING professor to have in the Department of Theatre! She is funny, hilarious, and an wonderful lecturer to have. She makes the class entertaining and the final project is so fun! Definitely take a class with her if you can!
I don't like theatre but she made the class interesting. She is really nice and always willing to help. Plenty of extra credit opportunities.
she's a really nice person and a good professor. the lecture content can get rlly boring but she tries to make it as engaging as possible. easy class if you need A&H.

Dr. Lale is an amazing professor, and really cares about her students. Provides tons of extra credit, and her lectures are funny and engaging. She will meet you where you are at, and tries to help you as much as possible. UTA's and AI's are wonderful as well. Easy class if you are at all interested in theater, if not I still recommended it 100% .

I couldn't have asked for a better professor. As soon as I walked in, I knew this class would be great. Professor Lale always had energy and was willing to go above and beyond to ensure we would succeed in class. She even towards the end gave us opportunities to do well and make up days if we we had been absent before.

Very passionate about her work and the class which makes it easy to succeed. Assigments are easy and don't take that long and the rubric is very clear. Easy for people who just need an Arts and Humanities credit and fun class too overall.

I loved taking Introduction to Theater with Dr. Jenny! She was so personable, funny, and obviously passionate about the material. If you show up, show interest in the material, and participate, she was more than willing to help you earn an A in the class.
She was the nicest person and if you just attend you get so much extra credit. Just be ready to participate.

If you're taking this class for a basic general education credit and have a tiny bit of interest or idea of theatre, then take this course. It's super easy besides reading some of the plays that she posts. She uses TopHat for attendance so be sure to attend lectures.

This is my GIRL! She is so passionate about her subject matter. She always checks up on her students, even after they've taken her class. She is such a great sport for theatre majors. I cannot recommend her enough.

I LOVE Jennifer Lale! As a theatre major, I was already excited about this course but she exceeded my expectations! She is a very passionate professor who is always checking in on her students and getting them involved in the course material. She's a pretty easy grader, so as long as you come to class and do your assignments you'll be good to go!

So many lectures and they're so long. She tries hard to get class engagement, which I appreciate, but it just isn't enough. Plays we read were alright, all boring. Quizzes weren't hard and neither were papers. Just a really boring class overall. Definitely wouldn't take this specific one again, but I would take another Professor Lale course.

Professor Jenny is really fun and energetic. She makes class exciting and tries to engage everyone in the lectures. The coursework is pretty easy, just make sure that you do it all on time because it's easy to miss those small assignments. Would recommend both Professor Jenny and this class!
Super easy and fun class. The only real work is reading plays and they're usually pretty short and simple. Great teacher and super passionate about the work. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Jenny was a fantastic professor! I'm not a theatre major/minor and I had a great time in this class. She cares about her students and is very understanding. You do have to participate within the class and work in groups, but it's all very reasonable. She's an amazing professor to have whether you're super into theatre or just interested in it!

Very passionate teacher! Loves what she does and does her best to try to get everyone involved and just as passionate as she is. This semester she had Pop Quizzes (6 total), which was an easy grade booster. As a non-theater major, I would suggest taking this with people you know to make it more fun. Attendance highly recommended only at end 3 weeks
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Jenny is really supportive and genuine and cares a lot about what she teaches. She is really nice and accommodating and is overall a great professor.
She was very entertaining and passionate about the subject.

Dr. Jenny is a very kind professor, but she brings up her political opinions in class when it has nothing to do with what we are learning. One time she said that her pet bird's last dying wish was to see Joe Biden become president (100% serious). Also, be prepared to see a bunch of plays that go against Christian beliefs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I love her. She's so kind and understanding of so much. Probably my favorite professor at IU.

Hands down, best professor in all of IU. Non-theater majors (like myself) might view Theater studies as boring or uninteresting. Dr Lale does her absolute best to make the subject seem more appealing, and she does so in a fun and inviting way that makes students genuinely not want to skip class because how fun the atmosphere of the class is.

I am so glad I had Dr. Jenny as one of my teachers the first semester of my freshman year. She is so caring and roots us on with whatever we do. She helps you out whenever needed and is just so kind. I would highly recommend taking her class.

Dr Lale is an amazing professor who really cares about her students and makes an effort to get to know everyone. She is also fairly consistent with the work assigned and is available for help and to answer any questions. As long as you do the readings and attend the plays required for the class you will be good.

She's the best! Take her if you want to have an easy A+ (with your grade even higher than 100 since she will give you plenty of extra credits and drop at least 3 lowest quizzes and writing assignment). Cannot be easier. I really like her. If you have any issues or want to extend deadlines, just talk to her, she'll help you. She's extremely caring
Dr. Jenny is such an amazing professor and genuinely cares about her students. She offers many opportunities for extra credit and listens to student concerns and opinions when they are brought up.
Very kind person, top tier kindness I have ever seen. She wants you to do well. Very great person, cannot stress this enough.

I totally recommend taking this class with Professor Lale as an A&H credit. The class is spread out nicely with about 1 reading and 1 online quiz a week. She does not take attendance and posts every lecture on canvas. Professor Lale also offers several extra credit opportunities. No exams, just one group project. Easy A.

Professor Lale is so amazing! She loves to hear students' perspective on anything. She is very open minded and culturally aware. Super respectful, and she tries to make each class as fun as possible! If you ever need clarification on anything, she is very helpful and responds in a timely manner too.

She is a literal QUEEN! so energetic and truly cares for her students. She makes lectures and activities fun with the class the exams are not that hard. THIS WOMAN LOVES PUPPETS!and gives great explanations and provides so much help for students. SHE WAS ONE OF THE BEST PROFESSORS OF MY FRESHMAN YEAR! plus seeing shows is a major plus for the class

YES YES YES. This class was the highlight of my freshman year. Dr. Jenny is such a fun-loving professor, but at the same time is very informative and knows how to effectively give a lecture. I would take chemistry honors if she was teaching it.

Awesome professor! She is so fun and outgoing and REALLY cares about her students. My favorite class of the semester. There is a lot of note taking, but there is also a lot of other fun in class activities. She gives SO MUCH extra credit so take advantage of that! If you think this class will be about acting and performing its really not.

Dr. Jenny was a great professor. She's very funny and makes her lectures very interactive and shows you real-life examples. She will notice if you are talking or on your phone and she will call you out! Go to her office hours! She's even more down to earth and will help you! She made me tea and basically talked to me about life. She's awesome!!

One of the best german professors that anyone could want. Coming into G250 Professor Langjahr completely lived up to the expectations that I had. She is a difficult grader but grades many things at the start of the semester for completion. Really take the time to understand the grammar and other language concepts or it will come back to bite you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She was overall super nice and does not show any sort of favoritism. The G-330 course requires us to read a book, but the way she has us interact with the book makes it super digestible. Frau Langjahr is accepting of all students at all levels, just make sure to participate in her class and do your homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Nikole is a great instructor! I had her for G375 and G333. She is a strict grader. All assignments have very specific guidelines to get full points; if you follow them, you will have no problem. She is very helpful in understanding German culture as she is from Germany. She is also very good at responding to questions outside of class. Participate!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Frau Langjahr is an amazing Geman professor; however, be warned, she is a super hard grader. She wants you to do well. If you struggle with previous grammar concepts, see her in office hours. She has a pretty easy way of knowing what you should know. Class is conversation heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. Langjahr is incredibly encouraging and kind! Expect to be pushed to participate. Class includes some group projects and lots of conversation, so how engaged your classmates are will affect your experience a lot. I wish that she let people get away with less, because sometimes people tried to say as little as possible, and class got slow.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Langjahr is such an amazing professor and definitely makes learning German fun. She is super passionate and is always willing to help. Most exams are take home and has easy participation points.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor. She really cares about her students and her department and wants you to continue German. She wants you to do well, and will troubleshoot any problems if you'really not. Some of her assignments are a bit hard, but if you ever need help she's avaliable to re-explain things.

Had 3 or 4 classes now with Prof. Langjahr. This class was really focused on accents and conversation and she made sure to be available outside of class to help us practice and prepare. Not that hard of a grader, but does expect  you to do the homework completely. Great teacher.

Frau Langjahr makes her expectations clear. It's not hard to get a good grade; participation has the most weight on your grade. In class essays and take home tests help getting an A even easier. Just doing the homework is enough to prepare you for class so always do it!

Frau Langjahr is very nice and helpful.  IU German classes are very assignment-heavy, but tests are take-home, so that helps.  She is very friendly and goes over material very well. I've enjoyed the two German classes I took with her.
Super nice and helpful! not hard, not easy. just do the work and go to class and its fine

Excellent teacher who takes the student's opinions into consideration. Her topics relate to everyday life in Germany and were interesting. She is German and being able to understand and converse with her greatly improved my fluency.

She is from Germany, so she is able to really explain how things work in German and idioms and things. She's nice and is really helpful. She is one of the better German teachers that I've had, and she leads the German department at IU.
She's great - very friendly and helpful. I had her as a freshman, and my language skills improved immensely in this course. If you need help, see her office hours!!

very good professor, definitely cares about students and course material. not particularly easy but if you have a genuine interest in learning then you will improve considerably and probably get a good grade.
Decent professor.  Nothing more, nothing less.
No Comments
No Comments

Professor Langjahr is a great teacher.  She really likes teaching and will take time after class or in office hours to explain anything to you.  My German really improved during this course.  All of the conversations we had in class were very applicable to real life and our essay topics were always really interesting.

Jeff is a great professor! He is very knowledgable about French and his tangents about topics are very interesting. The content of this class is hard but he does everything he can to make it digestiable.

Overall very tough grader and his assignments don't have super clear instructions and the class is not super easy to understand regardless of a language barrier. The AI for the class SUCKED, she was not helpful and didn't seem to have much knowledge in that field. This class is setup very poorly and the students suffer because of it.

Prof Lamontagne is super knowledgeable, very kind, willing to help, and laid back! His Canadian accent was difficult for me to understand, but it was cool to have a professor who spoke in a slightly different dialect. Class was not too difficult- all tests and most assignments were online. I learned a lot and really enjoyed this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I think that Jeff is a great instructor, but this was my first French class ever taken in college and I definitely recommend to not take this until you've taken other 300-level courses. It is clear that he is very passionate about the course, but be wary about his Canadian accent which was very difficult for the class to understand.

He was deeply passionate about his work, but an extremely tough grader. Additionally, he would become frustrated when students struggled to grasp the material. His classes often felt like a one-sided conversation, where it seemed as though you were being lectured rather than engaged.

Many students struggled to participate in lectures due to a lack of understanding, particularly with concepts requiring prior knowledge of French linguistics. Despite attending office hours and participating in drill sessions, we received little support from both instructors. Additionally, weekly 'research papers' were graded very harshly.

Jeff is an amazing instructor. Although this class was no feat for the weak, he is ALWAYS available for his students and it is very clear that he cares tremendously about not just their performance in his class, but their wellbeing all together. He is very good at breaking things down into smaller components and re-explaining things when necessary.

Honestly amazing professor. He presented the topic with so much enthusiasm & knowledge. There were weekly quizzes about 3-5 questions, and were kind of difficult but only took 5% of the total grade. The grade was mostly 5 papers and 3 oral projects. The papers are not easy but the prof was always available to answer questions.

Dr. Weaver is kind, passionate about cell biology, and really gets to know her students. She also offers lots of extra credit, especially if you attend class. She drops the lowest exam and you can bring a notecard to exams. Her exams cover a LOT of content, but if you read the book, attend lecture, and understand the study guides you'll be fine.

Did not find this course to be difficult at all. If you are in stem: biochem, orgo 2, microbiology, this is SO much less effort than any of those. UNDERSTAND THE STUDY GUIDES SHE POSTS (its like "be able to describe..."). I don't attend lecture, but have found success in watching the videos, doing the study guides, and utilizing the big notecards.

This class is way more difficult than it needs to be. Practice exams aren't provided, just concepts and quizzes with no answer key to check your understanding. Homework and exams were also graded very harshly and occasionally I had points taken off due to a misunderstanding on the teaching teams part.

This class is just ruining my mental health. The AIs grade so incredibly difficult for no reason there have been so many instances where i've lost so many points for seemingly no reason on the exams and homework. It's so brutal

The grading is just really rough by her and the AIs, and it's a very difficult course. I'm taking honors Biochemistry and honest to God Cell Biology is more difficult. She is actually really nice and knows all her students by name but please do not take it. She's a research professor so she's not quite concerned with her class or students.

Genuinely one of the most heartless professors I had in my IU career. She had no room for sympathy for her students and she was almost the reason I could not graduate. PLEASE DO NOT TAKE HER IF U CARE ABOUT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH. She has no care for you as a student. (Her TA's are also weirdly rude and passive aggressive)
Where do I even begin? Do not to take this class. It doesn't teach you about cell biology and Dr. Weaver and her TAs are not friendly.
I used to walk in middle of the road hoping I wont make it to my bus so I can be done with her lectures that felt like long 1 way speech that she was mubling to herself.
Very pretentious and makes things difficult/confusing for no reason but to say it's difficult and confusing. Hope IU switches professors.

Absolutely do NOT take this class with Professor Weaver as an undergrad. You will only be graded on a few things, even though you'll be doing A TON of reading. Basically your entire grade will be based on 2 exams and a big project, and the exams are awful and crazy long. Seriously, don't risk your GPA or mental health on this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love Lesley, the only thing was that this course had a lot of work that I found unnecessary but I learned a lot!

My favorite professor at Kelley! He gives more work than other c204 profs, but it pays off at the end because you have less work for the final report. Utilize his office hours and make an effort to speak to him. He genuinely cares about you and your progress.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best prof I've had at Kelley, really cares about his students. Your experience is def dependent on your group, but he will work with you if it's not good. Wanted to go to my 8am and interact with my group outside of class. May seem heavy compared to other profs but really pays off in the end when ur not slammed with the final report. TAKE HIM
nice prof, but not good if you're introverted because he cold calls a lot

Genuinely the best professor ive had at IU. he's so funny and cares about every single student. if you really put the effort into the class, show up, and work hard on the group project, you'll be fine. be participative from the start and he'll like you. go to his office hours and he'll be more lenient with grades.

I liked Professor Leppert at first, but he assigns WAY more work than any other c204 professor out there. Now with the new Kelley grade requirements, he grades a lot harsher with a lot less feedback. The work is beneficial if you are really trying to learn. He can get pretty sassy and passive aggressive at times, and attendance is very mandatory.
GOAT. take C204 with him you wont regret it.

Best professor I have ever had. Actually cares about his students and wants to get to know them. Have it at 8am and WANT to go every time. Lots of work and harder than other C204 but worth it lowkey. Super strict about attendance.

Professor Leppert is the absolute best. Without a doubt, he is my favorite professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about each individual student and will encourage you to grow as a writer and a person. He makes the class funny and easy to sit through. While there is a lot of work, if you put in the time, you will be fine. Take his class!!

tbh probably my favorite teacher i have ever had at kelley. he is extremely accessible, funny, and truly cares about his students. the course itself is not that hard, however, if you have a bad group, then it will lowkey suck. that being said, through all of my crashouts, leppert was there for me and usually made me laugh when i wanted to cry.
Leppert is the man, he cares a lot about his students. Grades are more focused on self-improvement rather than performance. Could not recommend him enough for either C104 or C204.

From day 1, Professor Leppert was amazing. He is inclusive and wants to see everyone succeed in and outside of the class. If you attend all of the classes, dedicate time to your team, and bring your best everyday you will do fine.

Professor Leppert is literally the best professor I've ever had. It can be scary to participate in class but he makes it normal from day 1 so you dont even think about it after a while. If you put in the work to participate and be active in class, it will be reciprocated and you will get a lot out of this class. TAKE C204 WITH HIM!!!!!
He has an attitude and isn't the greatest person, although sometimes he acts like he is. Not that hard of a class but has anger problems
one of the best professor i had at IU!
Best guy you can have for C104. Actually cared about your learning instead of just the grade.

Leppert's an extremely caring professor that ensures that every student is participating and learning overall. Very capable at giving advice about presenting. Highly recommend taking him if you want a fun and engaging learning experience.

Professor Leppert was my favorite professor this semester and business writing was my favorite class. He took the initiative to get to know each student and make the material interesting and applicable to our needs. His class was an amazing experience, and I highly recommend! Business Writing can be a lot, but it is an easy A with Leppert
Goat.  C204 was the best with Leppert.  All time favorite professor.  Going to miss him

I would give Leppert a 10/5 if I could. He's truly like a friend to me and many of my classmates. I feel that I can text or email him whenever wherever or for any reason, even today. I even switched my schedule to take business writing with him next semester. You need to go to class but trust me you will want to anyways. Grateful for him.
Such a cool dude!

He was an amazing teacher and cared about all of his students. He taught me a lot about public speaking and I gained valuable knowledge through the semester. If you can take his class make sure you do it!
Professor Leppert is tough and intense, but pay attention in class and listen to feedback and you will be golden.

Professor Leppert is an incredible educator. He is extremely personable and wants the best for all of his students. If you improve over the semester in public speaking you will walk out with an A. He does get slightly upset if you show up late so do show up early or on time. Overall he had a great relationship with all the students in my section.
Such a good guy.  Go to all the classes and try your best on all the speeches, you'll get a B+ at the very least.  My favorite professor this semester I'm taking his C204 next year he's a dawg.

Will occasionally drop the hammer if class is lacking (people not showing up to class, particularly on presentation days, regardless of if one is presenting that day), but if you show you care, he is the man and will be there for you and do all he can to help you grow and learn. Highly recommend.

I love this guy, I had him in Fall 2022. Mr Leppert really shows in his actions that he really cares for his students, he makes the class very easy and helps with students anxiety for presenting very well. On top of all of that, he can be a bit blunt, but I respect him for it. If you take C104, you want this guy, he's the best, my fave proff at IU

A very nice professor who explained the material nicely. Easy class too. He had a nice sense of humor but he will call you out if you're late (which is understandable). He does his best to soothe students' anxiety about public speaking.
Down to earth. Go to office hours, you'll love the guy.

Amazing professor. Prof. Leppert is amazing at what he does and it is clear he cares about every student. He does an amazing job trying to make everyone as comfortable as possible in a class that is trying to improve something many people fear. If you reach out to him he will always help you out and he is very understanding.
Professor Leppert is the best! He really makes an effort to connect to all of his students, and as long as you improve from the beginning of the semester you should get an A.

Amazing teacher who does a great job using his own experiences in order to teach students better ways of presenting. He keeps you engaged the whole class and isn't afraid to call you out. Skipping class is a bad idea but he made the class time so beneficial and fun that I never even thought to skip. Smart and funny man who I'd love to have again.

Attendance 10000million percent mandatory, he will email you if you don't show up. He will also make you do extra work if you don't come. He's funny and cares about making sure you learn. Teaches well, 10/10 teacher. I would say 9/10 personality. Funny & laid back but serious too, gets hostile fast if something happens that he doesn't like.
One of my favorite profs. and he always gave good feedback. Prof. Leppert always wanted to see you succeed so he will do all he can to help you improve.
He is easily one of my favorite professors. He gets to know every student personally. He was funny and his lectures were engaging. It is an easy A class and he makes it fun.

Professor Leppert is a very understanding person, he takes into account if you're an anxious person or hate presenting. He wants to make sure you can present to the best of your ability, so you are prepared for future presentations in your career. Attendance is mandatory, and there is a make up assignment if you miss an important day.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing at feedback, know what he is teaching. Very fair with grading.

Professor Leppert is easily the most engaging professor I've had in my academic career. Although his course was the easiest I've ever taken, I also got a lot out of it. Great sense of humor and the type of professor to feel comfortable swearing and telling it like it is. Easiest midterm and final I've ever taken.

He is one of my favorite professors. He is very dedicated to helping students who aren't naturally good at presenting. He is very understanding, and always makes an effort to get to know each of his students. He also grades off of improvement, so if presenting isn't your strong suit, he takes that into account. I would recommend taking his class.

Mr. Michael Leppert wrote a book, and he will take every opportunity to tell you about it. Whole class is about being a good speaker and how to keep people engaged during presentations, yet every single person who listens to this man's lectures wants to blow their brains out. Very strict about presentations, but you'll pass if you show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I don't know if she was a meh professor or if I just am bad a chemistry. I asked lots of questions and she was very respectful.

Dr. Brown is awesome! I've had her for both J342 and J343, and I think her lectures are great. She does a good job breaking down complicated topics, and she truly cares about improving her teaching. I hope to take as many chemistry classes with her as possible!
Laura Brown is an amazing professor who makes a pretty complicated concept relatively easy to follow. I'd definitely recommend her for any organic chemistry class!

Orgo 2 was always going to be a difficult class, but Dr Brown really did make the material digestible and engaging. She is incredibly smart and has funny lectures, but also genuinely cares about her students. If possible you should take chemistry with her. You won't regret it.
She is an amazing professor. She breaks difficult concepts down, making them easier to understand.

I really enjoyed this class. Organic chemistry is a difficult subject, but she has clear explanations and expectations, and she genuinely wants everybody to succeed. She moves pretty quickly during lecture, but she records them all and posts them on canvas. If you show up to class and put effort into the material, you'll be just fine.

Dr. Brown is a sweet professor but her exams are insanely hard.  Organic is a tough course so the difficult material is to be expected.  She could definitely make the exams, more doable than she does.  I would recommend her but there are definitely other options in the chemistry department to consider.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had Laura for C341 before this. I was impressed before and I'm impressed again. She manages to be a very inspirational professor with very clear instructions and an ability to make extremely difficult material easy to understand. My only minor criticism is that she can be hard to follow along with during lecture.

Having Laura for ASURE was a fantastic experience. The class had real research implication while still teaching concepts of an organic lab. She was also very helpful in giving feedback and answering questions on assignments and about the project. She is very caring and willing to listen. I would recommend taking a class with her.

Laura Brown is an amazing professor for an ASURE lab. Her work is relevant to real life and the lab skills she teaches you have great potential for any professional career. She is always willing to provide feedback on your work to make sure you know what is going on. I would highly recommend her!

Prof Brown was very funny and great at teaching orgo! The textbook for this class is an absolute GEM, make sure to take advantage of it. Exams were fair but also worth most of your grade, and the class wasn't super homework heavy.

Very good professor. Stay caught up with the class as everything builds off itself. Lots of office hours and very available outside of class and email. Very much enjoyed Organic Chemistry with this professor!

I had Dr. Brown for the ASURE lab and she was extremely helpful and just hands down the best professor one could have. She is very clear on grading and very willing to help to make sure that you understand the concepts and to help you improve for the future.

Laura Brown carried the entire semester for me. I do think the method of learning can be odd at first but that could've just been me not understanding. Laura cares a lot about her students and if you take a class as hard as organic chemistry, i'd recommend this class with her for sure

Writes unbelievably difficult exams even the other teacher who teaches the class complained about struggling with. If you're going to teach a concept, you need to make it clear what needs to be learned for what's 70% of your grade, the exams. Very harsh and polite but strict. People resore to cheating to pass. Doesn't curve either. Worst professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Laura for my ASURE antibiotics lab last semester and she was one of my favorite classes. Being able to work on an actual research project through a class seemed a little daunting but she made it a great experience. She was always very understanding and wanted to make sure we were comfortable in the lab and understanding the material.

I LOVE LAURA BROWN!! I hated C117 but loved this class so much. O-chem is so hard but she really wants the best for her students and makes it easy to learn. Lectures are fast paced but recorded, and she truly gives you everything that you need to study. She gives you all the tools, but if you want to succeed you actually have to use them. Love her!

prof brown is an amazing prof, orgo 2 is very hard class and you have to keep up with all the lessons. prof brown provides so many resources which can help you in the class, and going to her office hours every week will help you a lot to be successful in the class. 70% of the grades come from exams, this class is graded mostly on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Orgo II is a very, very difficult class. Prof Brown makes it manageable as she records lectures and provides a lot of things you would need to do to succeed. The class is very difficult and her class is based primarily on exams. As long as you keep up with the material, you'll do decently because she does a lot to try and help you

Orgo is gonna be hard no matter what, but tbh not content hard just the sheer amount of content is difficult. You fr can't get behind. That being said, Laura is the best orgo prof you could ask for. Getting an A in her class is much easier bc her exams are the only things graded for accuracy. TAKE HER CLASS. Just work hard and you'll succeed

Dr. Brown wants you to be successful, however, organic chemistry by nature is not going to be an easy A. Dr. Borwn will make it crystal clear what you need to do to get an A in her classes, and will be available for support every step of the way.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If you need to take a chemistry class, take one with Laura! She is incredibly caring and provides countless resources for preparing for exams (go to office hours!). Orgo is such a hard subject but it is clear that she truly wants everyone to succeed and believes that we can. This class is a lot of work but Laura makes it enjoyable and manageable!

Amazing professor. Even though I don't love organic chemistry, I am going to miss taking a course with her after I'm done with orgo 2. Lectures are recorded so you can go back and rewatch any content covered in class. The course is very organized and the exams are fair. Overall, so thankful to have learned organic chemistry with Laura.
Fantastic professor for an absolutely horrible and difficult class. My only advice is to just keep doing practice problems and listen to her lectures.

I was so worried about taking Orgo 1/2, but Laura is amazing. She is a great professor and gives you every needed resource to succeed. Orgo is a lot of work but she helps out so much and gives other ways to boost your grade if you do poorly on exams. I definitely recommend taking Orgo 1 or 2 with her.

Orgo is a very hard class that requires a lot of effort, but Dr. Brown clearly wants everyone to succeed. She has organized the class well and provides numerous resources, such as recorded lectures, practice exams, and book problems. I would highly recommend attending her office hours, as well as the weekly discussions, for more 1 on 1 practice.

Such a caring & sweet professor, but the class was just too fast paced. Lectures are sped through and did not prepare us for discussion. The retake opportunities were only for the smallest portion of the exam, which was usually pretty easy if you understood the basic material. You NEED to prepare outside of class in order to understand material.

Honestly the best professor I've ever had in my life. Dr Brown organised the class well and made it easy to find and access resources. Additionally the exam 100% reflect the material taught in class, it's really hard to fail , and if you do there are so many 1-1 tutoring sessions offered and a discussion session once a week.

Orgo is a difficult class, so you need tons of practice outside of her lectures. She's a good lecturer, but most of her lectures are fast and sometimes hard to follow if you don't read the book beforehand. You need to always study a little everyday and put in extra effort if you want a good grade. It's a hard class but manageable with studying

Laura is a fantastic professor! Don't be too scared of this class. In my opinion, the material is not very hard to learn, you just have to put aside the time to do lots of practice. This is not a class you should cram for in one day. Laura is the best orgo prof at this school, so if you can take this class with her do it!!

This class has so much material and the only way to do well is to put in the work. Dr. Brown cares about students and is a good lecturer. Since there is not much homework, she expects that students do practice on their own time using the book, which is hard if you aren't disciplined. The utins were also very helpful

This is a very hard class, but she's the best professor you can hope to have for it. She gives tons of practice material and is a great lecturer. She's very fair with grading and assignments. On top of that, she's extremely nice and encouraging. One of the best professors I have ever had.

The course is hard but Laura does the best she can to help her students and make sure they understand the material. Exams are most of the grade and there's no drops or curve but Laura gives a lot of practice exams and prep work and is always available for office hours. Overall hard course but I wouldn't want to take it with anyone but Laura.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is an exceptional professor and if you are able to have her for organic chemistry you are very lucky. She is so caring and knows how difficult the course is so she provides a lot of aid through videoing her lectures, and giving lots of practice problems. She explains things very well and everything you need is super accessible on Canvas.

This class is hard but if you  go to every lecture and really pay attention, you will do fine. She records lecture so if you miss anything or want to review, you can and it really helps and get any extra tips she adds that you missed. You have to study outside of class and ask questions in discussion if you want to pass. DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS

I was nervous about taking orgo but taking it with Laura Brown was the biggest blessing. Professor Brown cares about her students' well-being & is willing to help them succeed however she can. She explains everything in great detail & provides many resources for students to use to succeed. The exams are very similar to the practice exams & quizzes.

I was scared for organic but prof Brown is the best! She really does want her students to do well and goes out of her way in order for them to do so. Lots of opportunities to excel in the class. She is nice and very inspirational.

If you have to take any chemistry, I definitely recommend going with this professor. She is the best lecturer and professor in the department. Grades exams 110/100 (you could miss 10 points and get a 100%), she lets you drop exams AND gives retakes. Caring, charismatic, and very well-spoken/understandable lectures.
Dr. Brown was great. Worked w students, very intelligent and easy to reach. Made C341 easy

Professor Brown was an extremely caring and involved professor. She continually asked the class how she could improve both her lectures and the format of the class to assist in learning. She clearly demonstrated her dedication to the class by going above and beyond what was necessary of her to ensure her students excelled.

Dr. Brown really does care about the success of her students. The material was difficult but she did her best to help in any way possible. The practice exams are similar to the actual exams. Do the practice problems every day even though they're not required. Review the book after lecture because she goes fast. You can't cram for this class.

Professor Brown is an amazing professor who tries to make organic chemistry understandable. The material is very difficult, so you have to rely on yourself to study and do problems in the book. Do not fall behind, or you are going to have to spend hours before the exams studying. Professor Brown is so sweet and she tries to offer lots of help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Teaching style is very hit or miss. Some people like her and some don't. I don't learn very well through the textbook, but she doesn't go through topics very well or clearly in lectures and goes extremely fast, forcing many to resort to the textbook to learn the topics instead. Discussion was always quizzed over material from the past week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Respected

reviews.comment: Amazing. Organic is hard but you can really tell that she cares and puts in the time to help you learn. She is by far one of the most caring professors I have had. Be prepared for difficult exams. She gives you the tools to succeed, you just need to use them. Discussion sections are a little pointless to downright awful if you have a bad AI.

I love Professor Brown. I do not like chemistry, but she's the first professor that made me enjoy it. She's very good at explaining concepts and showing relevant examples. She wants you to succeed and there are so many office hours if you need help :) Please try and take her class she's pretty awesome

Prof Brown is the reason I loved orgo lab. Initially being in the lab for chem majors as a bio major was overwhelming, but I began to enjoy the topics of IR, NMR, etc. The experiments were cool, the exams weren't too hard, and she cared and listened to her student's needs. She's a kind lady who wants to spread her love for chemistry.

I couldn't have ask for a better professor. She's so kind and actually cares about teaching. She goes really fast in lecture, so it's necessary to read the textbook before class. Some people think it's annoying but it really helps you learn so it's worth it. She actually works out problems unlike other professors and gives you a ton of resources!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown taught the first half of my organic chem class and did an amazing job. Organic chemistry is challenging, but I never thought after getting a C in my previous chemistry class (C117) that I would get As on both tests given by Dr. Brown. Go to class, discussion, and review the material outside of class and you'll pass with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really wanted to like Dr. Brown. She is so nice but she is a terrible professor. She explains things so fast that you barely have enough time to process what the material is. This class is a flipped classroom; you learn from the textbook then in class she goes over problems so fast. I don't know what everyone thinks she is an amazing professor...
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Brown for Organic Chemistry 1 and this class is not easy by any means but she made expectations very clear and taught the material in a way that made sense. A lot of material is covered every day in lecture, but as long as you pay attention in class and put in the work to study, you can definitely pass.

reviews.comment: THE BEST professor I've ever had, period. This class was definitely no joke, but Dr. Brown provides amazing lectures that simplify every concept down to exactly what you need to know. She provides activities and assignments that actually really help enhance your learning and don't waste time. I can't recommend her highly enough, take her classes!

reviews.comment: She was clear on what she wanted us to know and what was optional. She also gave us everything we needed to succeed in the course like the peer review assignments, discussion quizzes, and practice tests. She was very understanding of the difficult situation and was open to helping us in anyway she could.

Professor Brown is one of the best professors I have ever had. The material for this course was pretty difficult, but she did an amazing job at explaining it and highlighting it. She has also done an amazing job organizing this class. She has made it as easy as possible to get a good grade in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very elegant professor and to be honest, one of the most kind and understanding profs you will ever come across in your life. The class is difficult and the onus is on the student to do well. Having said that, she provides good examples during class and definitely puts you in a great position to do well. Exams are difficult but are very doable.

Honestly, I recommend this lab to anyone that will listen to me. The honors orgo lab with Dr. Laura Brown was amazing. So glad I took this course. She is so much fun and it isn't as stressful as the regular orgo lab. 10/10

Laura Brown is very kind and her style of teaching is pretty decent. The class will definitely make you suffer because there's no possible way to cover all the topics in this class, if it were the only class you're taking, it'd be a piece of cake. But with the very large amount of coursework, you will want to be on top of EVERYTHING and go to Of Hr
Doesn't give enough practice for her hard exams and class time isn't used wisely. She has a decent attitude, but that's about it.
