She just expected WAYY too much out of her students, who were just trying to get the intensive writing credit. Yes, she is an extremely easy grader, but it doesn't take away from the workload. Assigned essays on Friday due Sunday multiple times. Expected to read 3-4 poems before each lecture class, even on the Monday following an essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: You can tell that she genuinely cares about the topics we cover throughout the course and she has taken the time to carefully plan the syllabus. Her time management is very poor during lecture. Not that the lectures really matter for success in poetry, but she is very passionate about in-class discussion and often runs out of time. Love her though!

I loved having her as my professor. She is so kind and genuinely cares about student well-being. She is very well-spoken and explains expectations clearly for all assignments. She recognizes some of the requirements for W131 (that she has no control over) are difficult to achieve and is not a hard grader at all.

This was an easy A class and especially with Ms. Nixon, she's super easy going and lenient on assignments. We had weekly discussions and a few papers but it wasn't bad at all. She's a really nice professor and I 100% recommend taking classes with her.

10/10! I took this eng GenEd with mrs Nixon and she's great. she's young and in school so shes VERY understanding. There's only 4 essays, no final and extra cred opportunities. She cares about her students. She isnt a hard grader and isn't nit picky. If you're a incoming freshman TAKE HER CLASS YOU WON'T REGRET IT!

Worst professor I ever had. If you push back on her beliefs and ideas, prepare to be punished in your grade. Extremely subjective content in courses that she insists on inserting her own views. Absolutely no accountability. Even worse when you have her assigned as your counselor.

You don't need this class for any major. so drop it before its too late. She will fail you if you are late turning in assignments or dont cite stuff her way. And her teaching assistant is useless and does nothing to help you succeed or prepare for quizzes. you will not do well in this class cause she acts like its your only class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This teacher is as bad as they say she is. her class is harder than it should be with all the extra books and disorganized readings being out of order. She thinks everyone cheats and has so many rules that you will mess up. you will get a terrible grade so dont take this class unless required. no study guide for quizzes either.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is designed to make you drop it before the final drop date cause if you stay in you will lose. You can't keep up cause the assignments are too close together. You get penalized for anything late. take some other credit class; you dont need this one. dont be fooled by the weak encouragement the first day of class she is not supportive.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Don't take this class if you don't want to fail. If you major in labor studies just take intro to economics in the economics department and avoid dealing with this instructor. this class is taught poorly. no chances for extra credit and surprise quizzes you wont be prepared for.
One of the worst teachers I have ever learned with. Do not take her

Professor Duggans Courses are challenging - as all college coursework should be if you are to learn anything useful that will improve society. Her classes teach students how to be better citizens. She does not teach ideology. Her work compels students to consider their own perspectives and worldview. This class is challenging if you have 18 hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She was one of the worst professors I've had so far. She was not willing to help, and she seemed aggravated when asked questions. If you didn't agree with her opinion, you were pretty much wrong. Grading criteria was ridiculous. Directions were not clear. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!

She is the most unprofessional professor I have ever had. Not only is she unfair she doesn't care what you need help with. She is one sided and it's her way or no way. By far the most unorganized, worst professor in IU. DO NOT TAKE HER!
If you think she is bad as a professor...you should see her inability to function as a counselor.  The main reason I transferred to IUPUI to finish my degree.

LOVE HER!  For an online course, she manages the classroom excellently.  Uses her resources wisely, and creates a great collaborative learning environment, provided that you actually do the readings.  There is a lot of work in this class, but you will learn a lot if you put in the effort.
So unorganized.  Worst professor I've had at IU. She should not be a professor.

Unfair and nonsensical policies in posting to the forum, extremely non-helpful and inconsiderate to students who ask questions and need help, one-sided opinion on material taught and has extremist ideology full of lies and is completely unrealistic. Ideology is alarming and breeds narrow-minded students. I was afraid of my class.

Extremely biased class with no room for putting conflicting opinions. I felt like I had to put up a front in the class because I would get penalized for not agreeing with their extremist ideas and comments about politics. This class makes me uncomfortable with the interpretation of the material she teaches.

Lynn is one of the best labor studies professors.  Classes are online and you have to do some work, but it's not impossible.  She's VERY helpful and knows her stuff!  You'll be glad you took her class.

RIP to the best prof I ever had. Went from goofy finance student with no aspirations to wanting to get my J.D. to be just like him. I am now getting my J.D. He was an inspiration and a joy to everyone around him and I am grateful I was able to take his class.
Rest in peace to the best professor i had at IU. This man truly inspired me to push myself further than I could have ever imagined. He was definitely a unique character, but I will miss him dearly.
He is great.

This is quite literally the best professor I've ever had. He is such a nice guy and very understanding. HE will challenge you and make you explain EVERYTHING. The class is all cold-calling (which sucks if you don't care), but honestly FORCES you to learn. Isn't that what we go to school for? Awesome teacher, wish he taught all of my classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The first half of the class was engaging with meaningful ethical discussions. Since spring break, however, it's felt like 99% busywork with little real content. Much of what we've covered seems added just to fill time until the semester ends.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible. Incredibly biased, there is not point in asking questions as he will chew you out.

Prof Lopez is one of the few professors I've met that makes content I wouldn't find interesting really fun to learn. He is very enthusiastic and towards the beginning of the class a little intimidating, but he truly cares for his students. There are daily pop quizzes, so be sure to read and take notes on the online textbook that's given.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class is almost entirely discussion based, final grade is partially based on participation. He will cold call. The topics covered are extremely interesting but during the discussions, you basically just have to say what he wants to hear otherwise you will get chewed out. It's not too hard to get a good grade, but I dreaded going to class every day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
L375 is a must have w Prof. Lopez. He creates an incredible environment for ethics discussion where everyone willingly participates and learns from, critiques, and respects each other. 
A great ethics class heavily based on discussion and worth your time to show up and learn more than you would in any other L375. One of the best Profs at Kelley.

Do not take this if you look to coast to an easy A. Do take this class if you are willing to learn, immerse yourself in conversation constantly, and can embrace some discomfort. I firmly believe that when I graduate in 1 year (and beyond), I will look back on my time in college and say that this was my favorite and/or most meaningful class I took.

Very conflicted on Professor Lopez. He is good at lecturing and is great at making time to meet with students outside of class. That said, he has a big ego and is a close-minded ideologue. He's difficult, his class is difficult, but you will learn a lot. Take that how you will.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Do not take Professor Lopez. The first class of the year he speaks like his class is going to be a transformative process but it's really just him projecting his opinions and rambling about whatever comes across his mind. He makes it seem like you can say whatever you want but will quite literally interrupt and act like he has the definitive truth.

right now we're starting a project and looking for topics  with my group. we gave him 7 topics that were all extremely reasonable and he shut them down for no reason other than he doesn't like us, so we finally submit one that gets approved and 10 minutes later he decided to change his mind and UN-APPROVE because someone else wrote the next email.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lopez makes it seem like you are free to speak your mind, but will be quick to call you out if your opinion doesn't align with his. The readings are too long for an ethics class and 99% of the time you can get away with just blabbering nonsense that goes with his agenda. I've dealt with tough professors, but Lopez has been the most frustrating.

Prof. Lopez is passionate but has tough exams and requires extra time outside class. He is willing to meet outside class and holds review sessions at 8 am on Friday. Compared to other L201 classes, he requires more work, time, and energy. He cold calls and picks on students often. Honestly, he is not worth the time and energy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Lopez is a fantastic teacher who is truly passionate about his classes. He cares about his students and does a good job of accommodating with different learning styles. I would definitely take his class again!
Best professor I have had, hard class but gives you enough resources to get at least a B+ / A-. Funny guy who makes class fun. Most I've learned in a class.

Professor Lopez was the best professor I've had at Kelley. He's tough but wants you to succeed. Do the readings, participate, and you will do fine. TopHats daily seem intimidating but if you read, you'll find they help your grade. Hosts quality review sessions in person and zoom before exams. Extremely good Professor, felt I learned very much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Awesome Professor. He made me want to learn. He knows how to keep a class engaged. Cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Professor Lopez exhibits a god complex that can be quite off-putting. His judgmental demeanor creates an atmosphere where students feel compelled to speak in class solely to appease him. I would not recommend taking his law class, as some he is not a good prof. These observations are made without spite because I got a good grade in the class.

Don't take this class if you are looking for an easy A. That aside, he cares a lot and wants you to learn. The cold calling isn't a huge deal because there's so many people. Just do the reading beforehand and take notes and stay on top of the work and you are guaranteed at least a B+.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Best professor I've ever had. Class can be intimidating at first, but there is no one at IU that cares more about his students than Professor Lopez. Incredibly knowledgeable while being very accessible to his students and providing every resource you could possibly need to get an A in his class.

You will get so much more from taking classes from Professor Lopez then just the material covered in his course.  He is available outside of class and is easy to work with if you have scheduling conflicts. Fantastic professor and has an amazing sense of humor. You can tell he enjoys teaching and has found his superpower (teaching).

Professor Lopez's class is daunting at first when he tells the class that there will be tophat quizzes every class, but Professor Lopez is the only professor I've ever had that makes an extreme effort to help their students.
Was an amazing professor. He truly cares about his students and is a very knowledgeable person.

Professor Lopez was one of the most outstanding professors I've had at IU. However, be ready to work hard, as you will not do well without reading and taking notes before class. He cold calls a LOT during class, but he doesn't try to make it stressful. I would 100% recommend him, but be ready to work.

Lopez is amazing. He cold calls and expects you to read the material before class. He is so dedicated to helping his students and wants to see everyone succeed. This class is tough and different compared to other L201 classes, but if you want to learn more about yourself and challenge yourself then take Lopez.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's tough but a very good teacher.
Best ethics professor

Lopez truly cares so much about students and knows what he is talking about. He speeds through his lectures but tells you exactly what will be on the exams. If you want to do well in L201, just do the readings before each class, take good notes on the readings, then supplement them in class. While this is a bit tedious, it will guarantee you an A.

I LOVE Professor Lopez. His lectures are so engaging and he will explain things as many times as you need until you understand. However, his class is not easy. If you want an easy A, take someone else for L201. If you want to grow as a person and student, take Lopez's class. Know that this class is reading and participation intensive.

Took this class during a difficult time in my life, reached out to Professor Lopez for some guidance and he treated me like his own child. He will do whatever is necessary to help his students, even scheduling regular checkups outside of his professional schedule. He will demand your respect, and let me tell you he deserves every single bit of it.

Phenomenal teacher and makes the material interesting through his lecture style. If you are looking for an easy A then don't take him but in my opinion, getting a lower grade in his class is worth it for the experience you get with professor Lopez. You will have to work hard for your grade.

Professor Lopez is a tough but caring professor. He will expect a lot out of you because he cares about his students. Get to know him because he an interesting person and gives great advice. This class was a more demanding, but I enjoyed it and would take it again in a heartbeat.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I have never felt the need to leave a rating on here for any past professor, but for Professor Lopez I do. This has by far been my favorite course at IU, thanks to him. Discussions in this class were extremely impactful. I would without a doubt take it again if I could. Writing-heavy, but so worth it. Participation will make or break your grade.

The best class and teacher I've had while being at Kelley. The discussions and things you learn about through this course are incredibly impactful and make a difference. I'm not saying this class is easy, although I'm also not saying it's the most difficult. What I will say is that no class at IU has made me look forward to class like this.

This is a tough class. But honest to god professor Lopez has been my favorite professor at IU. He is really great at teaching. Reading before class is a big thing you need to do if you want to do well on the tophat quizzes. If you take this class and give the bare minimum, even skipping many readings, he teaches it so well you'll still learn lots.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Extreme amount of homework. Excessive reading, discussion posts, etc. Professor Lopez is a kind and understanding person however, who puts his heart into the material. Occasionally biased, however would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Honestly, he is a good guy but not a great professor. He does not really teach by his syllabus. Often time we get off track and talk about other social issues. He tries to plug it back and keep it on track, but I feel he doesn't do a great job in teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Lopez's L375 is discussion-based, so you will do a ton of reading for homework, but class is mainly used for discussion. In the beginning, I really dislike him because of his cold-calling and assertive personality, but he is actually an amazing, experienced, guy who wants the best for and appreciates the insights of his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Lopez comes off as pretty intimidating and cold calls right from the start, but it is so worth it to take his class. One of the most genuine and caring professors I've ever had. Really respected guy and has written several recommendation letters for me. Definitely go to office hours, he loves to help his students!

Inspiring, brilliant, and a great overall teacher but makes you work for it, is intimidating, and has a lot of "tough love" for his students. That being said, he is a great, kind, and gentle person and that is just a facade he puts on to motivate students. Overall, great instructor.

I took Prof Lopez for C550 KD Direct online. Absolutely fantastic and highly recommend. Read the material, watch the videos, engage in weekly lectures and it's an easy passing grade. Brings many years of relevant experience, breaks it down into digestible pieces, and delivers the material with humor. You want this guy!

Professor Lopez is one of the best professors at IU. He balances a large course load while maintaining peoples attention with memes and roasting kids in class. If you work hard you will succeed and he is very fair with grades. Just know he cold calls and quizzes readings from before class so make sure to do those.

Really cares about his students and wants them to do well. Definitely rewarded for going to office hours. Reading the book is helpful, but the only mandatory thing to do in this class to pass is going to class. It's not an easy class, but you learn way more than other sections and you get your money's worth.
Had him for L201 and he remains one of my favorite professors. His ethics class is easier than his L201. Caring and creates an engaging and welcoming classroom environment.

He is the best professor I have had in Kelley so far. It is VERY reasonable to get in A in the class as long as you show up to review sessions and office hours. Reach out to a TA because they help a lot!!! Best professor I have ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Such a great professor. He makes you earn your grade but you'll learn more law than every other section of L201 combined could possibly dream of knowing. He also reads test questions/answers in office hours and review sessions if you bother to go. Such a great professor who has amazing stories too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Lopez is an amazing lecturer. He structures his class and teaches material in a way that makes you like law, even if you didn't like it before. He has quizzes every lecture based off of the reading assigned for the previous night, but his abundance of office hours and study sessions make it to where you can easily get help if needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lopez is the BEST professor I've had in all of Kelley. His class is challenging and you have to work hard for the A (take notes on the readings/go to office hours), but you will leave the class with more knowledge than all of your other classes combined. No other professor cares about their students as much as Lopez... he'll change your life!
I really enjoyed L201 with Lopez. I spent A LOT of time on the readings and preparing for his exams but overall really enjoyed the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Lopez is a super nice guy, and he really cares about his students more than any other professor I have had. That being said he is very difficult and somewhat inconsistent. Assignments and quiz/test questions will often be posted/written wrong by him. The review sessions help, but if you want an A take another prof. If you want to learn take Lopez.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Arthur Lopez is arguably the best professor I've ever had.  If you have a sense of humor, he is hilarious.  He also genuinely cares about their students and their grades, and is ALWAYS accessible.  He will meet with you outside of class, in office hours, over skype, has tons of review sessions, and so on.  He also is great at conveying the material

One of the best professors I have had in Kelley. L-201 is a hard class but he makes it fun and interesting. He is the most accessible teacher's and holds ton of review sessions. Definitely recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The book is giant and you pretty much read the whole thing. Going to class is a must, there are quizzes on note cards covering the reading in every class meeting that count for points, and they add up fast and can help if you did bad on a test. He will meet with you outside of class a lot even on short notice and holds a lot of review sessions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had.  He shares and creates a supporting environment for other students to have some of the most genuine conversations I encountered in any classroom.  He's very bold with his teaching style and not easy, but he is one of the most genuine professors I had.

It's lucky to have him in Kelley. He is my Top 5 in Kelley. You may think his teaching style is hard to understand at the beginning, but you will love him at the end. His talking about his experience can teach people a lot as well.

Professor Lopez's first time teaching this course was a success. He was always extremely helpful and open to suggestions from all the students about how to conduct the class. Tests were a bit difficult, but overall tested knowledge and application of the subject well. Made sports and entertainment law applicable to everyone.

Professor Lopez gave a quiz every class period over the reading, so you have to make sure that you read your assignment every night. However, before tests he is willing to meet with groups of students in his office and do review sessions as well as regular weekly review sessions you need to go to (especially before tests)

BEST professor. Really passionate about business law and that passion is contagious. It's definitely a lot of work - you have to keep up with readings and attend class, but you learn a lot. Professor Lopez works with students and does everything he can to help students to do well. Great class with an amazing professor.

Absolutely amazing professor that is always available to help. He even set aside review sessions the entire semester on Friday and Sunday mornings taking out his own time to help us. He makes it clear at the beginning of the semester that it is going to be the equivalent of law school so you will learn a lot. Hilarious and accomplished. Would take.

Professor Lopez is the man. He cold calls all the time and expects everyone to participate and isn't afraid of joking around in class, but his lectures are fun. You have to read the material before class or else you will not do well on the daily quizzes. If you listen in class, do the readings, and utilize his office hours, you'll do well.

Professor Lopez is a great guy, and he shows he truly cares about his students by making himself available for help at all hours of the day. However, he just isn't that great at conveying the material. You read a lot outside of class, and then he doesn't explain it well in class. You take quizzes every day, and a lot of the time is focused on that.

He's a great professor. He has a lot of experience and he utilizes that in his lectures. The tests are hard but he's there for office hours and they really help. Go to class it really helps and he makes them so interesting, but do your readings because you have daily quizzes.

Lopez brings a law school flair to his classes and finds a way to entertain every day.  A bit intense (he'll call on you for an answer in the middle of a lecture), and class is by no means easy, but he makes himself so available for help that it's on you if you don't get the grade you want.

Lopez does everything to ensure the success of his students. He really cares about how his students do in his class and in life. Amazing professor, would recommend. Just expect a lot of reading and you can't skip any classes - there are 5pt quizzes every class.

While Lopez is a good person & may have been a good lawyer, he's just a terrible teacher. Can't figure out how to use Canvas to save his life. Took 7 WEEKS to grade final papers. Forces you to talk or you won't pass. Textbook is atrocious. Not clear about how he grades or what he expects. Too much of a stickler for not having his own stuff together

I really like Lopez as a person. He has an interesting background in law and isn't an academic. He is a little harsh and a huge portion of your grade is based on participation. The subject of the class is pointless but he is really interesting to listen to. I've heard there are better professors but it's worth taking him just to listen to him talk.

Lopez is the best, and really cares about his students' success. Do not expect an easy A by any means, unless you can read law stuff and soak it up like a sponge. But he really goes the extra mile in helping his students and makes himself available by any means. My friend and I used to Skype him before exams at like 10pm. He's funny too.

Lopez is a great guy outside of the class room and he genuinely cares about his students. You will need to read and be prepared each class because there is a quiz every class, sometimes 2. Tests are difficult if you do not prepare. You are able to argue your case on questions you think are wrong. Grace points if you attend his review sessions.

Prof Lopez is a pretty cool guy but he's fairly new to teaching and his class is difficult. Daily quizzes, sometimes 2 quizzes in one class, so make sure you do the reading and show up to class. He puts you on the spot, so be ready to get called on. A bit strong sometimes but he has a sense of humor and does his best to make class entertaining.

Lopez is the man. He came off very strong at first, but then realized that he isn't teaching a bunch of law student. He holds review sessions twice a weekend, is very helpful, and is always willing to go the extra distance for his students as long as you work hard and show effort. MAKE SURE YOU READ YOUR BOOK. There are 5 questions quizzes everyday

The class in general is hard no matter who your professor is, but Lopez doesn't make you read as many cases. He gives you a 5 question quiz over the reading every class, but if you read the material they're easy. He's a really good professor and very engaged. I'm not one of those brainiac people, but if you do the assigned reading you'll be fine!

She's really nice and caring. She's really good at relating to students, and the final project was fun because we had a ton of freedom with it. Lots of readings, but lectures aren't exactly engaging. Makes the final exam seem harder than it ends up being. Class isn't really necessary but there was an attendance grade so I went. I would recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: She's super nice and she is very enthusiastic about the material, but I always found it hard to follow the lectures. She is a pretty easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Lahey Zakel is a top notch person and professor. Would whole-heatedly recommend her courses!

I took Professor Lahey's class and got and A. As long as you do everything and turn it in on time and make sure to meet the assignment requirements, you'll get an A. There was lots of readings for the class, but after meeting with the professor, she helped me organize and prioritize how to read for the class.
Professor Lahey is an amazing professor. She really cares about her students and it knowledgeable about many topics. Almost all her students get A's as long as you give effort and do your work!

The class is easy, it's geography AND online. But, the prof provides ridiculously long readings. It's not great. I think she wants you to know everything about the regions of the world. Hate group work? And papers? May I present to you the group paper! That's right, your final is a group paper with three people you've never met/had class with!
A lot writing and tough work, but he cares about students and always is helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The work load overall isnt hard but compared to other 131 classes it is more. When it comes to essays he is a tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class is easy if you read the text book and follow the guidelines for all project exactly. Grades very harshly. Class is really boring and unnecessary to attend.

Russell Lyons is one of the best, if not the best math professor I have had the pleasure of learning with here at IU. He's tough but fair - he doesn't hand out A's, he makes you work for it. But I can guarantee you'll be a better mathematician and have a deeper appreciation for the beauty of probability theory when it's all over.
The most helpful professor I've ever met. He can explain complex materials so well!

This prof single-handedly motivated my interest in stats.  His course, purely BECAUSE of him, was THE most invaluable course I took in college as a math major.  He's tough but fair & wants every student to succeed. I cannot recommend him enough.
He is the best lecturer in my academic journey.

This class was a lot of fun and not extremely difficult. As long as you've taken at least three years of high school Spanish, this class is pretty much a walk in the park. The instructor is so much fun. He's really nice and he brings his dogs to class sometimes. He cares about you, your life, your education, and your experiences in college.
if you have the opportunity to take jim, DO NOT miss out. he is by far the best professor on campus. rate my professor doesn't lie.
Jim is the goat. I love him

Jim has been my favorite Spanish teacher that I've ever had!! He gives you his cell number at the beginning of the semester, and will do anything to "set you up for success".  S280 definitely has some difficult material, but Jim makes the class very bearable, and you can still get an A even if you don't do well on the tests!

Would not recommend taking S280 with any other professor, the class itself isn't the easiest but he makes it bearable. Homework is done for completion, the toughest part are the three exams, he preps very well though and has review sessions that he literally goes through the exact exam questions. He also gave me a great letter of rec!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: At the beginning of the semester he gives you his cell phone number and lets you know that he is there if you need him. He truly WANTS his students to pass. Make sure you get the textbook as occasionally he assigns homework from it (but will ALWAYS tell you if he is going to 'randomly collect'). There are very few profs who care this much.
nice overall
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: My high school teachers would tell me, "Oh in college your professors won't care about you." Jim 100% disproves that. He legit cares about his students and wants all of us to succeed. Jim is the reason I studied abroad in the Dominican Republic. Definitely one of my favorite professors ever.

Awesome professor. He actually makes a spanish grammar class interesting. Great at explaining the subject matter. Also very available for help or writing rec letters even after you have him as a professor. I wish he could teach all of my spanish courses

Jim is an epitome of a professor who wants his students to succeed. He gives you everything you need and will help you get that A. Granted, he counts on you being fully there mentally and participating, but you will be rewarded in the end.

Honestly this teacher needs an award for how amazing and helpful he is. He really has student's backs (which he tells you) and truly means it. He really wants you to do well and does everything he can to make sure you understand the material. Nicest guy and really is your friend. Take this class just to experience how awesome of a teacher he is!

Jim is so helpful with anything you want to know-spanish or otherwise! He tells you lots of practical vocab and phrases-way more than just in the book- which is awesome, and he doesn't give much homework!
Jim is awesome! He makes this grammar class more interesting by bringing in culture and ways to apply what we learn. This class is not difficult, but you still learn a lot.
He's the best Spanish teacher! I love learning from him, and he barely assigns homework. I love that he teaches us slang for real life Spanish. He's super kind and hilarious.
Super helpful, fun, funny. Overall good guy.
If you don't take S280 with Jim, you will probably regret it.  He is my favorite professor.

I took S280 with Jim and absolutely loved it. He is very relaxed about homework and assignments and makes the subject easy to understand.  With Jim as a teacher this class is definitely an easy A. Plus he's a really nice guy overall. I would highly recommend this class with him.
I took reading and writing class with him two years ago. One of the best teachers ever. He taught a lot of students that I know, and everyone loves him !!

Not only one of the best professors I have had at IU, but one of my favorite teachers of all time. Its almost impossible not to get an A in the class, he is very easy going and also makes class really fun. Definitely worth an earlier class just to have this professor.

Jimmy Lynch is quite possibly the greatest professor you will ever have at IU. He is very funny, extremely helpful, loves his students and will do just about anything to make sure you succeed in his class. I highly recommend him!
If you have a chance, you should take this class! I think he makes S280 class very interesting and easy:) He is smart, funny, and very helpful. he has very flexible office hours as well.
great great great great teacher!
Professor Lynch really cares about his students.  He is also very enthusiastic.  I always looked forward to attending his lectures.  He's also a great guy.

He's so funny, always keeps class interesting, and is always saying "I've got your back guys."- and it's true, he does. He's crystal clear about his expectations, and seems to understand how busy we are as students. LOVE his class.

Awesome! The students in parallel classes come to Jim's help sessions because he really lets us know what's on the tests and how to prepare. It was a low-pressure kind of class. Jim really knows how to relate to students.

Makes Spanish somewhat interesting and easy. You can always go to him for help anytime (call him, e-mail him, go to his long office hours). He creates a laid-back atmosphere for the class so everyone is more willing to participate and speak Spanish. Take his class! :)

jim was a very helpful and funny guy. he did an amazing job of recognizing when the class didn't understand something and helping us to figure out what we were doing wrong. his tests aren't too  difficult, but if you study it will be an easy A. if you have the chance, get jim as your professor!
Very fun and laid back spanish teacher. Makes sure you understand everything before the test. He convinced me to get a minor in spanish. Highly recommended!!

Jim is energetic, enthusiastic and obviously enjoys teaching.  He always sends practice exercises through e-mail and will always e-mail you back promptly to answer your questions.  He is pretty laid back and cracks jokes occasionally.

Professor McNellen did not provide that much leniency when it came to issues that were out of my control, showing a clear lack of consideration for her students. I understand that it is not a requirement to do so, but in a class like Kelley Compass, professors should put more effort into communicating with students, instead of just using AI.
Only a one credit asynchronous class yet required a lot of unnecessary work. Required unnecessary hours of meeting with your group. She responds to emails with AI. Lot of people got bad grades.
Uses AI to respond to emails and doesn't care for her students. Vague directions where you have to follow exactly if not receive a 0 on the assignment. Not good at her job.

I Liked Professor McNellen.  I think I got a lot out of her classes.  I feel though that some of the grading criteria was someone confusing and there isn't much leeway when it comes to grading.  Also she doesn't allow phones or computers in class while she is lecturing, this does not bother me but im sure some people dont like it. overall solid

She's such a nice professor and pretty good a lecturing overall. This class is mostly busy writing work and group projects but she made it mostly interesting and was a fair grader. Would recommend overall.

I took Brenda’s class back in the fall of 2017. Honestly, her lectures a very conversational. If you want to become a better writer, think critically, and learn from a professor who will tell you how to improve, this is the class to take. Her office hours are helpful and she is very approachable. I found her to be a rare gem in Kelley

She was very unrealistic in her expectations of the students as any idea I came up with for the semester-long case paper she outright rejected. Very vague in giving feedback and graded very harshly in my opinion. Lectures were very dry and I didn't gain much from them. There is a reason she is only allowed to teach C204. Avoid her at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Brenda was a great teacher and really cares about her students. If you go to her office hours and show that you care about her class she will go out of her way to help you succeed. Highly recommend!

Brenda is a nice lady and cares about her content. When it comes to grading, she is not very good. Her directions are incredibly ambiguous and often leave students confused. Her office hours consultations don't provide much help as she still doesn't explain things as they should be. You have to put in a lot of work for a mediocre grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very vague in instructions and expectations. She's a kind person but odd in the way that she conducts class and things. The worse part was the fact that she often wasn't clear with her expectations and then would grade very harshly.

Very vague instructions and expectations, grading often does not get higher than an A- and B+ and it is not clear how to get above that grade level with her. Brenda is a very smart woman and a very interesting professor and she is willing to help you out. The whole C204 class period is dedicated to group work so don't expect too much instruction.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: My only complaint about this class is that Brenda often fails to make her expectations for assignments clear up front. Also, expect to receive a lot of A- and B+ grades regardless of quality of work, especially on group projects. Overall a helpful professor and engaging lecturer. Would recommend despite difficult grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Brenda was one of the best professors I had during my time in Kelley. She was extremely helpful, even when she was not clear initially. The most difficult part is the final group project (used to be Target), but she is very liberal with her grading. Definitely a recommended professor

Brenda can sometimes be unclear when it comes to communicating assignment guidelines/due dates but she is also willing to take the blame when she makes mistakes. Listen to her feedback and you will do well in the class--she tells you exactly what she wants to see and is impressed by creativity and practicability. Highly recommend!

Brenda is an awesome lady and is very very sweet. Overall, she's a good professor. She is sometimes unclear in her assignments and takes a pretty long time to grade assignments, but for me it was an easy A.

I feel she grades you based on how she thinks you should do, not based on the quality of work you perform. I constantly received grades that were 1 point away from an A no matter how large of an assignment. She is helpful, but vague at the same time. Overall, not a bad teacher, but I would look elsewhere.

She forms stereotype based on race and people. She grades you based on her stereotype to you, not the quality of your work. Averagely 5 people will drop the class out of 23 students, and she determines who's that 5 at the beginning of the semester.

Brenda was helpful and she stated things clearly regarding the  assignment, projects and the Target case expectations. She had many interesting topics to share in class, and she was knowledgeable in her area of expertise. Go to class, and you'll ace C204

Although she was always keen to offer help, I thought most of her directions were vague or conceptual at best. Details and deadlines were often misunderstood, and she often had problems understanding why her students would miss them. Very knowledgeable of her subject and a talented presenter herself. Would recommend over all.

Great communication professor. She was very kind and was willing to help if needed. Learned a lot from her. Although a book is "required" it really isn't as she covers the book during some inclass lectures. Lots of work in this class, however, just keep on top of it!

Overall, Prof McGraw is a good guy. At first, he seemed a little rude. He tends to just ignore people when they same something incorrect or not what he's looking for, but once you get to know him you realize he just wants you to succeed. He's not a tough grader, just make sure you meet the requirements. Final project for H270 is long but doable.

Prof. McGraw changes emotions very quickly, at a rapid speed. If you don't participate, he will unwillingly call on you. There are readings that don't go along with a particular "course material" but are just things he found that he wants to discuss in class. We talked about abortion, climate change, and Hitler all in the same week. Structure lacks

If you're a decent student, you're fine. If you respect him and his class, he will respect you. W200 is an easy A, he is NOT a hard grader in any way, and most of the class is just discussion of the readings. Just do the work and go to class and you'll probably get an A+

If you show respect, you'll earn it. Don't rely on technology when you are in class, rather have written notes in front of you. If you are disrespectful (i.e. on your phone in class, show up late, miss without sending an email) he'll cold call you more. Very straight up which is honestly refreshing. Dry humor & loves Bad Bunny.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Don't even bother to look at the syllabus; says "3 lowest in-class grades are dropped to account for illness" which was not true. I got extremely sick for a week and my grade has to suffer because he did not drop anything. He automatically thinks your a slack off who uses A.I. unless proven otherwise. I spent hours doing work for this class.

He is generally a nice guy with a good sense of humor though there are times he can be a bit rude. As long as you do the work and participate in discussions, you'll be fine. He also seems to be fairly understanding when it comes to late work. He has very strict policies when it comes to attending class.

A lot of people view Professor McGraw as intense but personally I loved this class. Make sure to complete your assigned readings and attend the lectures. The most important thing is participating in class. I participated during every lecture and he bumped my grade to an A+ and sent me a kind email!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: McGraw can be tough and force you to think more and be uncomfortable in your response, but I think that is good as it causes you to further critically think about what you're learning. He can be somewhat cold, but overall if you try your best and participate, he will respect you and help you out. I really enjoyed the discussions in class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor truly hates students. He will go out of his way to embarrass those who do not completely understand his "teachings". He also barely teaches. We get two readings each week and are expected to know it perfectly or else we will be humiliated in class. Did I mention this is a 100 level class?

this professor was one of the rudest people ive ever encountered. he's so condescending and purposefully embarrasses kids in front of the whole class. if u take this course be sure to do the readings and take notes on them bc he WILL COLD CALL. very pretentious and scary
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. He is a commanding educator but if you work to synthesize the material into your questions and responses, he will respect you for it. Do not expect to float by this class but if you put in good work you could find a strong advocate for your success through McGraw. I bet a lot of negative sentiment is from those who did the former
Wasted a semester of my life and my tuition on this professor.  The WORST not only professor but person I have ever met. Do not take.

He wasn't a bad teacher at all. Not great but his material helped give ideas for papers in other classes. There is one tough grader (Andrew) and one nice grader. You have to get lucky on who grades your papers. If You Hate Writing Do Not Take This Class. I enjoy writing so I was able to achieve an A-. They also dropped the three lowest grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Reading these reviews before I took the course was def scary, but the professor is very interactive and honestly he's a chill guy, just make sure you are keeping up with assignments because he does tend to randomly call. He can be a bit passive aggressive at times, but honestly very good professor. As long as you keep up with assignments ur good!
Terrible.  The worst professor ever encountered at any level.

Not sure why he has so many negative reviews. I thought he was a great teacher. Very invested in his students' success, really makes you think in discussions. You definitely have to participate. I'd recommend taking notes on readings before class if you want to impress him. Overall good intro to the history dept. I learned valuable research skills.

From the first week of class I could tell I'd have difficulty with Professor McGraw. The way he used his own books was frustrating. His constantly condescending demeanor was discouraging. The key to success is to lay low. You dont know a prof could be so rude until you meet him. At first I thought it was me or my views but he lacks understanding

He is a great professor, just show that you care about the class and put SOME effort into his class and participate in his lectures and you will be just fine. Dont expect to not do any work and get a good grade.

This professor tried to fail me for attendance, based on an "attendance policy" that was not specified in his syllabus. EXTREMELY rude. Will dismiss your thoughts if they don't match his political views. Never answers emails. Has so much potential if he could change his attitude.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He was super awesome and chill.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Professor McGraw was a great introduction to History at IU and is all around a good guy who just wants to share his passion for History.

I think Dr. McGraw is knowledgable, but very unhelpful and frankly rude. reviews.comment: You have been warned. Beware of this professor.

reviews.comment: Always super helpful and responsive to emails if you need help with the project. Participation is a big part of grade so skipping class is a no.

Prof McGraw WILL be intimidated if you are a smart individual and take out him intimidation on you. I wouldnt recommend this guy to anyone. Not at all a helpful or valuable professor. My dog wouldve been better.

Prof. McGraw is the single worst professor I have ever experienced. Indiana University ought to be ashamed to still employ this joke. reviews.comment: The grading criteria was not clearly conveyed. Waited til last day of finals to post a ton of grades. Canvas grade differed from what he put into final grades. 5 point discrepancy from the two! No transparency when it came to grading or how he grades

Yes, there is a reading due for every class. Yes, there is a two question quiz about the reading. BUT HE LETS YOU USE HE NOTES AND GIVES YOU A SHORT LIST OF QUESTIONS AHEAD OF TIME. Maybe this is an adjustment he has made to theclass. He responds to my emails within 12 hours and is very friendly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: I would not take him again. He was unhelpful and unapproachable when I needed help his response was to say it was easy and he could do it easily. Which needless to say was not helpful. Some criteria of the final project was vague. He came off as exceedingly arrogant and rude.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: 2nd worst teacher I've ever had. Unbelievably rude and offensive. Never replies to emails, never updates grades, never is helpful. He only preaches his political views instead of teaching. If you disagree with him then he shuts you down and looks for someone to agree with him. If you want a quality teacher, then look elsewhere. Just horrible.

There are literally so many readings in the class. The worst part was the in-class quizzes! They were too specific from reading at times and too much of a hassle. Very passionate about the subject and pushes you to think critically. very very slow with grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The worst professor I have ever had, and that is not because I am failing. I have an A in the class but Professor McGraw is the rudest and most unclear professor i have ever had. He gives very brief instructions on assignments and then when I ask a question he replies in a snarky way, making me look like I'm asking a stupid question.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor McGraw makes you do a lot  of reading, but doesn't require participation.  If you have to skip a few readings every now and then, you won't get marked down (as long as you finish them before the test).  He asks the class good questions and creates an atmosphere for discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I liked the subject, so it was easy for me to get him. But I really enjoyed him as a lecturer, he really showed his passion of the subject and explained his theories and analysis really well. Interesting guy and pretty funny too, I would take another class with him as the lecturer.
Will kick you out of class if you don't do the reading

Incredibly knowledgeable, if you have an interest in Latin America at all its essential to take this class or another one of his classes. Definitely one of the most interesting (though challenging) classes I've taken!

Straight forward and clear lectures. 3 exams, 20%, 20%, 30%, then 30% for participation. Must do assigned readings and participate in discussions. Easy class if you do the readings and take good notes.
Most boring lecturer ever.
Prof McGraw was very helpful and made it easy to come in for office hours and go over what I missed when I was absent.  Really enjoyed this class and I definitely recommend him.
Helpful, nice, does not deal with Bs, must do readings, had for American Studies A 100,a lot of reading books, not text books, good professor

Alexus brightened my day each and every Tuesday and Thursday mornings this past fall. His crisp outfits to class and sharp lecture knowledge made him my favorite teacher of the semester. Great TA grades work; there is not much work, be careful, 2 assignments weigh 80% of the grade. If you study, go to class and read you'll get a 95+. No sarcasm.

The tests are pretty difficult, but I would say the study guides are more than enough to prepare for the exams. There is barely any homework for grades, so make sure you are doing good on the homework and midterms that you actually do have. He talks very fast, and is very passionate and knowledgeable, so be prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Slide-heavy lectures. I had a hard time understanding his lectures, as he is clearly educated on the topic and assumes that you also have his level of intelligence. Everything is found on the slides, and the class was extremely hard to follow along with, so boring tbh.

Professor McLeod is clearly passionate about the material, but his lectures can be hard to follow because the main points sometimes get lost in filler words. The class has a midterm, final, and two reflections, so not much room for error. If you stay organized and put in the effort, you'll get the grade you work for.

Professor McLeod is well versed in the topics discussed. However, you might not know what he's talking about unless you really lock in and do some research out of class. You basically have 4 grades in that class so you have to do good on them. If you aren't interested in learning about religion then you'll likely find it boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class felt so pointless. I feel bad because he does seem like a genuinely good guy. However, his lectures make no sense, and the discussions on Fridays are a drag, but they do help you understand the material more. Your grade basically depends on the midterm and the final, which aren't terribly hard but take an extreme amount of memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is one of those where you need to attend the lectures. He just talks the entire time about the reading that was assigned and provides notes on the slides that gives you all the answers for the exam. I honestly didn't read a single thing for that class, but you don't have to read if you just pay attention in class.

He is very smart and knowledgable, but long boring lectures that are a waste of time. Never any work. 2 reflections for the semester with no rubric, so be ready. Midterm/Final are 80% of grade, but he gives study guide which is actually on the test. A portion of tests are random words, so hopefully you're lucky and know it. Did well but pure luck.

Professor McLeod is a nice person, and he is very knowledgeable in the subjects he teaches. The only problems come with the midterm and final being 80% of the grade. He gives "Question banks" which show up on the test, but there are other aspects of the test that pick at random information. If you don't get lucky with questions, good luck passing.

Professor McLeod is a good professor, but the course itself is questionable. The midterm and final are 80% of your grade, but he gives question banks for both so you have some form of studying. The content is interesting and he is very knowledgeable on the content, but I didn't find his style engaging. The discussion section is also a waste of time
No

reviews.comment: This is an amazing and informative course. However, lectures involved zero class participation, which is good but also boring when the class is 1 hour 40 minutes. reviews.comment: i mean this lady just is awful. please don't take this class she makes it so difficult for students to succeed. She is rude and tests are absolutely ridiculous. this class was so hard for no reason and ruined my gpa. Thanks rosemarie! I hate king arthur!

reviews.comment: Exams are worth over 75% of your grade. The tests are 10 questions with 5 parts to each question so essentially 50 questions and you have to complete it in the discussion time which is 50 minutes so if you think about it that is 1 questions a minute so your writing down one short answer question every minute.

Class is miserable. Maybe if you're interested in King Arthur, even then IDK. Don't take it to fulfill a requirement. Talks for 50 minutes straight, just reads right off the slides, which go by far too fast, so good luck even trying to write stuff down. Incredibly demanding for a level 100 course. Total trap when I'm sure every other 103 is a layup
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: this lady needs to be fired. she is so passive agressive and is terrible at teaching. Now maybe she realizes something is wrong because the entire class failed the first exam.

reviews.comment: I did not enjoy lecture, as she read straight from the screen about readings. Test questions are based on quotes/scenes from readings. Attendance to lecture and discussion count for extra credit so it is really really easy to do well in the class.

reviews.comment: This class has more reading than any of my 300 level courses. Expect 3-4 hours of reading for each class day. Assignments and exams are very easy, and grading is pretty much dependent on your TA. Lectures are boring

reviews.comment: Just don't. Too much homework, 80-100 pages of reading + 20 in-depth questions a week. tests are too difficult, 50 free response questions in 50 minutes. Lectures are exceedingly boring and just reiteration of the book. Too difficult for its level, do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 5 required books, 2 additional readings, 3 movies (your own time). Homework (20 questions, provide quotes for all, weekly), tests (10 questions, 5 parts each, 50 min.). reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you need to take a C103 class for credit I highly advise against taking this class. On paper, a class on King Arthur sounds fun. You get to learn about cool knights that fight with swords and magic right?  No. Don't take this class if you want to enjoy your semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I want to be as respectful as possible and just list the requirement for students, keep in mind this is a level 100 class. You will be expected to read at least 150-600 pages a week, your discussion leader in your best bet because in the words of mine, "Professor McGerr does not help with problems/questions". Please dont take this course.

Homework will take about 6-8 hours each week. You will have to buy every book that we use in the class because we have to use quotes in our homework and the page number have to match her book. The tests are ridiculously long and an average writer will not be able to complete the whole thing in the amount of time given to you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Just Don't. On average, I spend about 6 hours doing the discussion questions due EVERY Friday. The exams? Terrible. The lectures? LONG. reviews.comment: Do not, I repeat do NOT take this class. I am currently an economics major and had to take this for the credit. Tests consists of remembering tiny details from reading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Her lectures are beyond underwhelming. The PowerPoint she puts together each week lacks focus and isn't inspired. Worse still is the delivery. What's the point of coming to class if all we get is a deadpan recounting of what's stated in the PPT? She doesn't seem like a bad person, just really worn out and lacking motivation as a teacher

Professor McGerr is a delightful person and really knowledgeable about her topic. She mostly lectures in large classes and generally relies on AIs for discussion sections and grading, but her lectures are really interesting and its worth taking the classes just for that

She does not condense the information in her lectures down at all and reads off the powerpoint for 50 minutes straight. You will be stuck doing homework for an average of 5 hours each week and it isn't enlightening or fun in the slightest. About 100 pages of reading each week with a boatload of discussion questions to answer for friday discussion.

reviews.comment: She's passionate about what she is teaching. She is easy to get a hold of and is helpful when visiting during her office hours. She cares about students understanding of the subject.

Why why why why did I take this class. As a big history buff, I figured this class would be fun way to earn credit and still do a bit of history but man, was I wrong. The reading is never ending and horrendous, the lectures are dull, and entire idea of the class is numbing. Do not take this class.

reviews.comment: The King Arthur class was the worst thing I have ever gone through. This 100 level class had more reading and homework than anyof my 400 level classes. She makes little sense and the lectures are difficult to understand at best. Do not take this class

She teaches a 100 level course but treats the class as a 400 level. The class falls into a general education requirements and everyone was there for the requirement. reviews.comment: This class was quite literally the worst decision I have ever made. This class sucked the living soul out of me. It is tedious and the work load is never-ending.
