reviews.comment: Dr. McGerr is very friendly and eager to help students but her lectures are barely helpful for completing the coursework. She also has a tendency for going over time and then getting mad when students start to leave after the scheduled end time (?).

Every lecture l would fall asleep in because all she does is talk about the chapter were going to read over a PowerPoint which is pointless and hard to stay awake on. At least 100 pages of reading a week along with study question that need quotes and disussion questions that you havent to refer to books thats youve read throughout the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class requires A LOT of reading. She goes over the reading in class but you will need to read to answer all of the study guide questions. The homework takes a lot of time. The tests have a weird format. As long as you have a good AI you should be fine, they do all of the grading. The course load is heavy but the grading is definitely 100 level
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's really smart and passionate about the material, but the lectures are tedious and monotonous. Grading depends on your AI. The reading material was really interesting, but the weekly assignments were a lot to go through. The tests are rather difficult. Still learned a lot, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Each homework question takes a lot of thinking and book-reviewing and citation-transcribing, and there are 30+ questions like that per week. Tests are crazy, too. 50 short essay questions in 50 minutes. Everyone writes nonstop until last second. I don't think this kind of hardness is necessary for a 1-level class.

Had class on King Arthur. She is very knowledgeable on the subject, and not a very tough grader. AI's do most of the grading and some of the teaching. Fun class if you get good AIs. Get ready to read though, as you probably wil need to buy 3-5 novels for the class. Don't have to read them all though, only a few selections.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I didn't mind the professor. She often goes WAY over her time limit, "Just a few more slides now!",  and she literally reads directly off the screen. I had this class for King Arthur, and you literally don't need to take notes. Just read the book and go to discussion. AIs are helpful occasionally, but she's often disconnected. All in all, not bad.

There's a pretty big disconnect between Prof. McGerr and her students. Her lectures are extremely boring. She stands & reads off the PowerPoint, usually for longer than her allotted 50 minutes of lecture time. If you miss anything, your only option is to go to her office hours. The AIs were invaluable, though. Go to them for help first.

This was easily the worst class I've taken at IU so far. She's very passionate about the material, but she often puts in her own input and skips very important parts. She reads straight off the powerpoints, and is very dull. Also the tests are very difficult and not clear what she wants.

Really nice! If you have any questions or need help she is the lady to see. However, she is very particular about taking pictures of her power point in class and she will yell at you, so don't do that! Tests are graded pretty hard but other than that she's vey clear and very helpful. Very knowledgeable and passionate.

Great teacher and really knows her stuff.  You don't even really have to take notes, just go to class, do the readings and participate in the discussion section.  However, she does give a lot of frivilous info. in her lectures and they are pretty boring.  But overall, easy and interesting class.

I had this professor for class called "King Arthur: the Once and Future Hero"  She was very enthusiastic and you could easily tell that she loved the subject.  Attend lectures and discussions portions and you will be fine.

The class is easy. If you just pay attention in class, you will do fine. If you like class discussions, you will not like this class. If you like power points that you can mindlessly copy down and passively absorb the information, you will love this class. McGerr is really smart and loves her subject. She knows what she's talking about.

Rosemarie is a really good teacher who is REALLY into what she teaches! Medieval lyric gets a little boring, but she keeps her enthusiasm high. Make sure you GO TO CLASS! Take good notes over each poem and what comments she makes and you should have no problem on the tests/papers. The tests are mostly a regurgitation of what she says.
She is so prepared!  I really loved her class.
Knows & loves her subject, and her classes are rather easy as long as you take good notes and attend classes every day.
i adore joey! a very funny guy who cares deeply about what he's doing and his students. very accommodating if you have stuff going on and flexible with due dates. cannot recommend enough

Professor McMullen is a very passionate teacher. He makes it clear he is available to help students in the essay-writing process, and is generous with deadlines. He does his best to make you feel welcome. He has high expectations for assignments, but grades kindly. He puts high value on original ideas. Do all the readings and you should do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never thought I would have this much fun with an English prof. Lectures were always engaging and funny -- even in a large section -- and he felt like a real person who was truly passionate about the class. Discussion sections were less fun than lectures but overall a great time.
So smart and so funny. Great person who is genuinely interested in what he teaches. A LOT of reading but it's not completely necessary as long as you know the story well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: took him for C103 and it was such a fun and easy class. he is very personable and very easy going. if you enjoy fantasy and the lord of the rings you will love this class - if not this class is still very entertaining.
Professor McMullen is outstanding! I took his TOLKIEN class and it was one of the best classes I have taken yet at IUB as a senior!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Joey is my actual king. I didn't think I was gonna like this class, and honestly if you had showed me the reading list I would've been like ew no way that sounds crazy hard, but this dude just makes it all so fun. He's really sweet and understanding, smart and funny, incredibly chill with extensions, just a serious g all around. slay
Joey is an absolute gem and knows how to make a student feel loved and supported. :)

Joey is a phenomenal teacher. He is truly so intelligent, kind, and funny, and he makes what we learn genuinely interesting. With that being said though, the readings can be challenging as well as the questions he poses in class. It definitely can be confusing at times, but you learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Hilarious--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Joey's course, but I felt completely out of place in this class. The class is discussion-based and your grade will suffer if you do not participate often. Joey is super nice, but the class is not the most welcoming. As a minority student, I felt so uncomfortable, but the course is interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Love Joey! He really goes the extra mile to allow for student discussion, but that being said, you probably will do best in and get the most out of the class if you participate regularly and do the readings (poetry, short stories, plays, and a novel). He also cares a lot about you. Fast to reply to emails and slow to grade (good feedback though)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Joey is such a good teacher. For papers you can ask him for help and he'll respond quickly and do his best to help you. His classes are mostly discussion based, and with his positive, happy attitude, he manages to make the class interesting.

Joey was absolutely fantastic especially to his students during COVID and the adjustment to online learning. His feedback on papers is thorough and you can tell he spends a lot of time on his feedback. READ IT. Joey also is very timely about replying to emails and any other questions outside of class. His lecture arechallenging yet rewarding. 10/10

Joey's probably one of the best professors there are at IU! He always has an uplighting, positive personality, which makes his lectures interesting. He's also a genius of English, can explain concepts and ideas very well, and open to others' ideas. He does take a while to grade, but he does provide excellent feedback in papers and discussions.

I took Intro to Fiction with him and it was the least boring English class ever (and I'm an English major, so I like this stuff already). Very group discussion oriented, let us choose between books to read. Clear essay prompts. Takes awhile to grade but provides amazing feedback. Very funny and very knowledgeable.

Overall not a super hard class, but make sure to prep for the quizzes because those have the biggest impact on your grade. Without breaking site guidelines, I would say the worst part of this class was the TA by far. Truly wish him nothing but the worst. Most of the grading is done by the TA so keep that in mind.

Make sure you do your reading before class, because if nobody answers she will cold call. Expectations are sometimes unclear on rubrics for major assignments, and she sometimes has to review what her AI grades. Overall not super hard to do well if you read and show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is kind until you disagree with her. After that she will be rude to you, stare at you, and embarrass you in the classroom. I have only seen people act like this on TV. She is very opinionated and unwilling to think about things from other perspectives.

Professor Melnyk is very nice and super caring, and is willing to help at every turn. The class is very easy, but attendence is mandatory and the class can be super boring. Otherwise, it is a very easy A.

Dr. Melnyk is extremely passionate about Ukrainian history and culture. Slav-U223 taught me a lot about Ukrainian culture through history filled in with fun tidbits and person anecdotes. The material required for reading is easy and not time consuming, but it's important you do it...there are quizzes. Loved every second of this engaging class!!
Very easy gened credit. The quizzes are all open note and none of the assignments are that hard. The TA can sometimes dock points but other than that you should get an A.

Professor Melynk teaches alongside a TA for SLAV-U 223. Professor Melynk is an incredibly caring and nice teacher. She is very passionate about her lectures and loves when students gets involved with class material. If you show effort, she will do whatever she can to help you out. If you show up and give an effort, it's a relatively easy A- or A.

In my mind, this online class was perfect for college students. If you simply wanted an easy grade/easy credit, then you don't have to invest that much time and energy to get it. However, if you are actually interested in the topic, you can easily learn a lot about it as well as many resources connected to it.

I took U223 for the A&H as it looked like an easy A. The class is largely easy -- nobody pays attention during lectures and she doesn't seem to care. There is homework but no more than an hour per week. Big things: "creative project" (not bad) and an 800 word movie essay. Can't comment on the difficulty of the final as mine was open-note (COVID).
Professor Metaxatos is the kindest professor I've ever had. A lot of reading, but not too many assignments and essays (1 mini essay and another "big" essay every 5 weeks). Strongly recommended!

Robert is a super caring, easy-going professor! He gives a lot of great feedback on your essays. There are 3 mini essays and 3 main essays. Some of them build on each other, so you really don't have to do that much writing. There are a lot of readings you have to do, but most of them are fairly interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Robert is a good teacher, not the best at grading things in a super timely manner but he can only do so much. The class is engaging except the reading can be alot, overall I would take any class he offered
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is very understanding and as long as you communicate he will understand and help you out the best he can.
Awesome class, would recommend to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Sometimes the classwork feels excessive, but it is very easy to get a good grade in the class.

Robert has been a chill and helpful English teacher. He is the perfect teacher to have to complete your general ed requirement. You get engagement points and there are reading journals that gives you points and helps balance your grade. He is a great teacher and only a few essays. I really recommend!

He is a great professor, take him for W131. All his units are really interesting (One is comparative analysis, second is film scenes which was my favorite, and the last one is music video) and that makes his classes so much fun. I became a better writer. He grades leniently, I would just advice to turn in all the assignments and don't skip any!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The class is setup for students to learn and do well. The professor is very caring and understanding. Some lectures are in person with group activities and discussion, some are dedicated to review. There are quizzes every few weeks instead of exams. The information we learned was very interesting, including relevant guest speakers
Dr. Murphy cares about her students, and it shows in her course. Everything is set up for you to succeed, and I'm very glad I participated in the ASURE program with her.

She is an amazing teacher! Her class is incredibly engaging and she genuinely wants her students to grow. Now she will give very clear feedback and as long as you follow it you should do well in her class. She is truly one of the best profs in this department and just phenomenal.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Murphy is genuinely one of the most caring teachers I've had the pleasure of learning from. She is extremely friendly and encourages her students to do their best. She gives good feedback, and since this intensive writing, it helps. I'll miss spending time with her and the crickets. Couldn't recommend this professor enough!

Dr. Murphy is AMAZING!! She really does get to know you and your research project individually, and will go above and beyond to help you reach your specific goals. I learned so much in this class that I feel like is necessary to know but that I don't think I would have gotten from other classes. I can't recommend her enough!
Megan really cares about her students. She really helps you grow in your research and writing skills. She is always available if you need any help and is super knowledgeable in her field.
Unnecessarily harsh grader
Nice guy, but he grades subjectively. He is a tougher grader than other bus prez teachers
Subjective grader. Annoying personality.

It was a great class and he was a fabulous professor. He will clearly articulate what he wants from you for each assignment and is very knowledgeable about whatever topic he teaches. I would highly recommend him, he's one of the best professors I've had at IU.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Not like the other C204 classes because he doesn't do any presentations only writing assignments. The work is pretty tedious and boring imo but he guides you pretty well on what he wants out of your work and he's pretty lenient on absences and makeup work. Overall a super nice and chill guy.
He is the man. There are a couple hard projects, but unless you are a horrible speaker and writer you will be fine.

Take this teacher. Morrone is very intelligent, and treats you like an adult. He will make you a better writer and speaker. He has a great sense of humor, but has no room for stupidity or bad work. If you have good writing skills this class will be a breeze, if you are a poor writer then don't expect to get a good grade.
Nice guy, cares about the class, but in the end everything we did was useless
Easiest C104 professor there is. Super nice and laid back guy, we only had to dress up for 3 presentations.

Class structure is strange, assignments are vague and he rarely responds to your emails. But he's really passionate about the material and he really wants you to learn the material and get a good grade. There are a lot of opportunities to redo assignments.
He is a great guy, but never explains things clearly and class structure is a joke, but overall I approve

Morrone is probably the best professor I have had at IU this far. I had him for my lamp seminar and he made it extremely interesting and enjoyable. He is very laid-back, and will help you out if you need it.

great professor. VERY LAID BACK!!! easier than any other x204 section for sure. He is a moderate to hard grader but I don't put in too much effort and am getting b+/A- ranged grades. i would DEFINITELY recommend him

well i'm not really sure about what you people are talking about because morrone is the absolute man. looks like the peanut gallery here needs to wake up and realize they're in college, not middle school.

He does a horrible job of explaining things.  The class is very unorganized and you never know if you have something due.  Almost no one gets an A.  If you can get a B in the class it is equal to getting an A with anyone else.  If at all possible take this class with someone else.

Very nice guy.. little werid but look at the grade distribution, this guys hasnt given a c in like 4 semesters, show up to class and do your work automatic B  Fair Grader (too fair).  It might b hard to get an A but its even harder to get a C
Good guy; fair grading.

awesome guy and teacher! the love he has for what he does is extremely evident and makes you want to participate all the more. taking SBFK truly changed my outlook on a lot of things and cannot stress how amazing the entire experience was.

If your thinking of thanking SBFK, take it. It's amazing class. Monte gives good lectures and cares about the students. He puts the person before the grade. It was a great experience and life changing!

I only received such a low grade because of personal matters that were happening during the semester. He is such an amazing professor and truly cares to help you in any way he can. When I wasn't turning in my assignments, he checked in on me everyday and always made it clear that he is there if I need help.

Keep in mind this grade was only because of personal mistakes I made throughout the semester. Giving him no reason to believe I could do well, he gave me the opportunity to make up for it. He puts the person before the student and is very kind and understanding, I couldn't thank him enough. You can easily get an A with consistency and hard work.

(Poverty in the US) - Monte's assignments are straight-forward and gives you the whole week to finish. Two online discussions each week with a paper every once in a while; the class is A LOT of writing but overall it's not that bad because the topics are interesting and you can write what you want. Definitely take if you don't mind writing - easy A

Morse is a sweet caring prof but she makes the worst comments. she cold-called a girl to tell the whole class her height, weight and # of cals she should eat. Homework forces you to count cals. If you at all struggle w eating/body image you cannot take this I literally had to talk to my therapist about how bad this class made me feel about myself.
super sweet lady but class is boring unless you acc need this for your major. like 1-2 hours of work per week reading and answering questions in the textbook. definitely a gpa booster
Very kind woman who is clearly passionate about her subjects. She can be a boring lecturer but she makes up for it in her kind nature and personality.

Professor was okay, it was an easy A, I haven't felt like I learnt anything in the class. If you genuinely want to know more take it with a different professor or something. Lectures were so boring and ass but the professor was really caring and she gave everybody extensions on there assignments whenever one person asked.
Didn't learn much of anything because the lectures were just one sided conversations. Nice lady but not a very informational class, very easy A.

had for both n231 and n120. super nice older lady, but she does not know how to give a good lecture. lectures are mostly side tangents. i have no idea what is actually important and what i need to be studying, feel like i haven't learned anything. i dont know what to take notes over because so much info is just irrelevant. try to take w/ diff prof
She is very kind but does not know much about technology.

This is the nicest professor I've ever had at IU. She is such a spunky lady, and this class is a breeze. Do the work on time, use the power points to your advantage, and you're chillin. She's so passionate about her field of work, and actually wants to HELP her students. I highly recommend her!

SO EASY!! gives out extra credit for participating in lecture. exams are online and open note. mild amount of homework (on mindtap) but all the answers are on quizlet. she will extend deadlines for everything if you ask her. attendance is just signing a sheet that's passed around so you can get a friend to sign for you. EASIEST GEN ED EVER!!!

SPH 231 is such an easy gen ed credit and Morse is the best to take it with. All exams are online and basically open note, barely any homework and she does give extra credit through study guides. Lectures are very boring though and I always did other homework during them. She is very sweet!
very easy, but she isn't tech savvy or confident on things she does. everyone stopped going like 4 weeks in. easy class but could be taught by someone better.
She is amazing!

Dr Morse is a really, really nice lady. She gives extensions on basically every assignment. Tests are open note, homework takes about an hour a week, theres one paper over a video, and a few discussions. Attendance is taken in class, but she usually forgets. Extra credit is handed out like candy in lectures so sit up close so she can hear you.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy grader. Grade is determined based mostly on Cengage Mindtap online book questions, which take about an hour of work per week, attendance not required. She's very lenient about grades, and will give extensions almost any time someone asks. Study guides are extra credit; they are worth a lot but also a lot of work so good grades are given.

Professor Morse is super kind and wants to see her students succeed and get an A. She gives lots of extra credit and all of her tests are online, take this class to boost your GPA. That being said, her lectures are very disorganized and it's not even really worth trying to take notes or go to class. Would not take her if you want to really learn.

Professor Morse is a really caring professor who really wants her students to succeed. However, she will forget the attendance sheet countless times or seem confused throughout lectures. The class is really easy if you do all of the homework and study for the exam by looking over the power points.
She was amazing, she gave so many opportunities for extra credit and made it clear she really wants students to succeed.

Getting an A in this class was so easy that it just made the class kind of pointless. Take this as a GPA booster, not a class to explore a major in nutrition. Tip: use quizlet for cengage questions but take notes on her slides during class to "prepare" for the tests. You shouldn't be doing more than 30min of hw outside of class per week.

good professor but since the tests are online, you need to do a lot less work than it seems at the beginning. the textbook is not worth reading, just study off her slides since she's the one making the test. attendance was mandatory for the first 3/4 of the semester, at least for my class. she gives a lot of ec and is accommodating with deadlines.

This class holds no value when taught by Prof. Morse. The presentations are too wordy and she just reads the slides. She made the honors section do a service project that was very unorganized and took up an extra 3-5 hours a week. Expectations are too high and she does not consider other classes students may be taking.

She is such a sweet person, and she will always go over things again if you aren't understanding it. She is also an easy grader, and she gives opportunities for extra credit. Make sure you do the online assignments because that is what will be on the exams.
Professor Morse is a very kind lady and you can tell she cares about her students a lot.  If you need an easy A take this class! She is a very funny lady and will definitely keep you interested.
I love dr morse. She is simply hilarious and very engaging. She is not great at responding to email, but if you need her, just talk to her in person. She wants you to get an A!

Dr. Morse definitely goes on tangents often during lectures, however, they are humorous and often still informative. The class is not difficult as long as you participate in labs and projects - you get to eat food!

She's a sweet professor and seems like she enjoys teaching her classes. Honestly, the lectures are kinda boring but all the info you need to know is available in the ppt slides. Attendance is required but you do learn interesting things from time to time. Study for the tests and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Mrs. Morse is a very kind lady. For example durning the semester we switched to online classes due to caronavirus and she was very accommodating. You cannot miss class though unless you talk to her. If you have a good reason and notify her before hand she will let you miss. Attendance was 1/3 of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr Morse WANTS you to do well. She shares ALOT more pertinent information for the actual career side of dietetics. (more so than Vicky) I wish I had her earlier. She seems goofy but she's actually very accomplished and very smart. She also will majorly help you with anything if your struggling. She is the very definition of beneficence.

Dr. Morse is actually awesome. She gets off topic sometimes during lecture, but it is usually about a related topic that she is passionate about. Some of her tangents can also show up on exams. Her attendance is 3 points per lecture and there is no drop attendance grade. This class had 3 unit exams, a final, and a few super easy and short papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: Martha's class was very easy. She is extremely understanding as well with grades. If you listen to her lectures you will actually learn a lot. She is a character which made her lectures very tolerable as my class was always joking with her and doing funny things. I highly recommend this class with her.
She doesn't give wiggle room for attendance and lectures are awful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This has to be the easiest class I have ever taken and she knows it which is why she makes attendance 40% of the grade but the exams are easy and just common sense.  Listen to her drone on for 16 weeks and you have yourself an A.  Compared to other professors who teach this course it is a walk in the park.

Lectures are straight from powerpoint, and she usually gets off topic throughout the presentation. No need for the book because the slides cover all the material. You can't have computers or cell phones out in class unless you get permission. Easy A though if you fill out the study guides.

Reads straight from her very very long PowerPoints, is very disorganized. Study guides are really long but if you do them you will pass the class. Does not allow electronics in class unless she gives you permission. Textbook not required so do not buy it and waste the money.

does not let you use electronics. Uses powerpoints but puts way to much information on the slides. Reads directly from the slides when she "teaches."  we created Google Docs for each exam so never bought a book. Study guides where lengthy and usually had too much on them but if you did the study guide you can pass the exam.

Morse is one of the nicest professors you will meet. She cares about all of her students doing well and makes sure you know what to except on exams. She can be a little scattered with her lectures but its pretty funny most of the time.

Martha's class was soooo easy! If you are looking to boost your GPA, take this class. She was kind of disorganized and lecture was very boring because she just reads from power points, but it's worth it for an A.

Dr. Morse's class was easy. Her tests were a breeze if you worked through the study guide, and easy homework points were given. However, she's... Interesting. Very scatterbrained and we were always behind. I was excited to take the class, but did not learn much at all from her. If you want to learn, read the book.

Chill guy. Can tell that he really cares about what he is teaching. I didn't understand fully understand a single topic in this class, but still got good marks on essays/projects just by talking abt the class content in them. No final or tests. Easy class overall.
Amazing Professor, cares for his students, class is chill
His lectures are very engaging and encourage students to talk among ourselves. He values everyone's perspectives and gives good feedback, too!
He is a great professor and leaves great feedback! Would take this class again!

I do not recommend taking B251 with him if you do not know a lot of Econ to begin with. He oftentimes talks about international trade and is always sidetracked from the topic he supposed to be talking about. His style of teaching is not suitable for most students.

Bro is just lost in the sauce honestly. He doesn't use numerical examples and he gets confused on what he was trying to explain all the time. If you take this class you might as well be taking a college class on Khan Academy
Easy class if you attend lecture. They are boring but he gives pop quizzes for extra credit. Lots of opportunities to improve your grade through retests and participation.
Most boring class ever. DO NOT TAKE. The midterm and final are horrible.... all writing. Thought would be a joke class. Papers are easy.

Really easy course will cool content. Eva is a great instructor and gives thorough lectures. Everything on the exams is covered in class. She's really passionate about the subject, which makes it easy to pay attention. Definitely recommend this class to anyone needing to fill a GenEd or taking it for fun.

Professor Mroczek is friendly and enthusiastic, but I found her class to be pretty boring. She tends to take a rather narrow scholarly approach to the Bible that does not leave a lot of room for imagination. Much of the same material that is taught in her class is taught in a much more engaging manner in ENG-L367.

Eva is one of the greatest professors I've every had at IU. Extremely passionate about the subject and extremely knowledgeable as well. Great at creating discussions. Tests are easy as long as you come to class. Lots of writing, but she grades easy.
Eva was awesome. Her class was interesting and morally neutral. Perspectives can be gained not only on Judaism and Christianity, but on the formations and basis of religions in general as well.

I received the last registration date in the entire university and was stuck with the most ridiculous combination of classes. This was the only class I enjoyed on a class by class basis. Her enthusiasm makes the history so unbelievably interesting, and as an agnostic with no background in Jewish readings she made Jewish studies an enjoyable fit.
She's the best prof! Class was actually fun even on friday morning
Eva is awesome! I'm not a religious person at all, but this was my favorite class. The only problem is she developed a cult following of annoying girls who won't shut up in class.

She's incredibly passionate, hard to follow at times, but she repeats the material until you understand it and willingly answers all your questions. Hands down my favorite class and I'm not a religious studies major.
Great, knowledgeable professor. Passionate about the subject, and teaches from a religiously neutral perspective.
Prof. Mroczek is amazing! She is so dynamic and fun, and I will never think about the Bible in the same way. Take her Intro to Hebrew Bible class!
She was funny. I spent so much time studying outside of class and going to TA review sessions. The TAs were definitely more knowledgeable than her on K201. I've heard of better professors.

she cannot teach for her life!!!! k201 is a generally easy class but she does not even know the material and my TA was correcting her EVERY class. if you can, maybe avoid her, but if you HAVE to take her, you can get a decent grade. just lock in outside of class because her and her dad jokes would take up more time than her actually teaching.

She was more than excellent. Just make sure you're working through the discoveries and reviews, and you'll be fine. Don't be afraid to talk to her or have conversations with her, she's prob one of the chillest teachers ever.

Professor M is sweet and lightened up every lab with a dad joke. Lab checks were doable. Just go to class and you will be fine she explains it well and is open to questions before and after class. Go to class tho

She is excellent and explains all the concepts in Excel and Access in a way that's super easy to understand. As long as you go to class and practice before the exams, it's hard not to get an A. I don't feel I would have done as well as I did without Professor Mwakalindile.

love her- she's super funny and helpful w answering questions. even though classes are short and fast-paced she makes sure they're engaging. STAY ON TOP OF YOUR WORK. it's so easy to fall behind bc everything you learn is cumulative, so pay attention and do your readings/assignments when you're supposed to
A very nice professor with easy, interesting, and informative course material. Her Kenyan accent can be hard to understand but I understood her just fine.

Let's just say, I wasn't a fan. Like, at all. She was an extremely difficult person to work with, wasn't inviting or helpful when you would go up and ask a question. If you had a reason as to why you were missing class, good luck, she wasn't willing to work around you missing class for being sick/etc. Would never take it again. She was difficult.

reviews.comment: Her communication was horrible she would say one thing and then do another. You have to go to all the lectures she takes participation in multiple ways and sometimes would make whole class stay after.

Do not take this professor. Took 343 with him and he doesn't believe in curves while the exact same class taught by another professor gives you lecture slides and a curve for the final exam. Spends 75% of class asking students questions about his own incorrect code instead of teaching. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. TAKE THE OTHER PROFESSOR FOR C343.
Teaching style? Um, none. Half the time the dudes asking the students what the issue is with his code?? Like dude I don't know I'm here to learn from you.
Requires attendance but would rather spend my time outside of class learning the material. Overall just a very boring prof and reads off the slides. Seems nice
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Every class I have taken with this professor has been extremely difficult due to poor organization and unclear expectations. He is one of the most disorganized professors I have had at IU, and the experience has been very stressful and negatively affected my mental health.

MY GOD this guy cannot teach. I'm sure he is a great and very knowledgeable person but I REALLY don't think I can stand another lecture of his. I don't know if this is just a thing with all CS profs at IU but they are all so passive aggressive. Why do I have to put up with their resentment because of students who can't read simple instructions???

A 0 would be generous. Bring a pillow to lectures so you don't hit your head when you fall asleep in lectures. Mind numbing lectures and tests heavy when he literally doesn't teach. TAs grade the class as if they have a vendetta against them. Avoid at all costs.
He is not overly hated. I believe his rating should be a 0 in a 1-5 scale. He has no good qualities a teacher should have
D321 - Assignments and exams aren't fair, THIS PROF IS CANT TEACH, HE READS OFF THE SLIDES! Please don't take any class with him
Ridiculously terse. That's all he deserves as a review.
NEVER IN YOUR LIFE TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROF PLEASE OR YOU WILL SUFFER YOUR WHOLE ENTIRE SEMESTER

Muazzam is has by far the easiest-to-understand teaching style of any professor I've had and is generally friendly, but straight-forward. His teaching style unfortunately makes his lectures extremely boring if nobody is participating. The homework can be strenuous and time consuming, but is possible. If you go to class, you will know the material.

Muazzam is overhated to be totally honest. I had him over the summer for c212 for lecture only. Participation was optional, but made up 5%. He was by far the easiest to approach out of all the professors, and was pretty helpful. However, the lectures were very boring at times and hard to follow. Good guy, but bad lecturer.
Lectures were fine, nothing to write home about. Assignments are hard and long, but doable, and office hours are helpful.
His lectures did not teach me anything. I had to learn the material on my own outside of class. I would not take a class with this professor again.

Please, Never ever ever take this professor  ever!!!!! Can't  teach !!!! He does not care about the student grade ! Terrible  Teacher !!!! tought assignment!!! useless labs !!! trust me Avoid this course at all cost

very approachable, nice to talk to, wants the best for his students. However, NEED TO ANSWER his in-class lecture questions or lecture will be very boring. Participation is tophat, questions not spread evenly across lecture days so attend all/most if can. Homework got easier over course of semester. Lots of board work, bring notebook and computer.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lectures were terrible and boring and hard to understand. Assignments were annoying and very difficult and time consuming. This is easily my least favorite class I've ever taken and I look forward to a life without this class in the future.

I agree with these reviews. He does not have emotion talking about computer science stuff, he is a teleprompt reader. We do lab on friday where we take a quiz and the quiz question is too complicated of a question to be asked for 1) The 10 minute timeframe given. 2) The topics we have talked about in class don't correlate in terms of difficulty.

- Lectures are unbearable to listen to.
- Lacks any human emotion and reads slides like they're on a teleprompter. 
- Puts up poorly formatted tophats, which are required for attendance.
- A vast amount of homework that fails to teach any practical uses of SQL. 
- Class is at an ungodly time with no alternate times available.

avoid this proffesor as much as possible, highly arrogant, doesn't what he is talking about, always grumpy, literally can't explain anything - reads slides off during the lecture. Doesn't give extra credit.

Read slides made by other professors in mandatory 8am lecture. Daily tophats where 80% of the students consistently put 'idk' as their answer, and just moved on, clearly not caring about the students' learning or success. The class material, homework material, and exam material were all so different they may as well be 3 separate courses.

Nice guy but horrible professor. Just reads off slides going over super easy examples then the homeworks are super hard versions of the topics discussed. Do not have enough time for quizzes. He is just a bad professor.

Most arrogant professor I have ever seen. He never helped me with my doubts regarding assignments and exams. I had sent him almost 10-15 emails and he didn't even care to rely to a single of those emails. I would strongly recommend to NOT take his class.

The homeworks started off easy but the difficulty levels skyrocketed all of a sudden. The professor explains well but he goes over the easy examples, when the homework is extremely hard. The TAs are extremely unreliable, office hours are cancelled most of the time, doesn't response to inscribe, and takes FOREVER to grade assignments.

The professor does not grade work in a timely manner. I thought I was doing well in the class, because grades weren't put in until 2 months after I turned in assignment. A week before finals, grades started finally being entered, and I learned I wasn't doing well. By then it was too late to receive help. Lectures are awful.

He just goes through our textbook in the lectures and the labs(a second assignment) are impossible to finish in the time given. You will have to learn everything on your own and sit through boring lectures that won't help. We spend way too much time with the easy concepts and rush through hard material at the end. Avoid this professor if possible.

The first half of the sem was easy as we went over stuff like loops, methods, and recursion which we already learned in c211 or c200. After that the class was hell, labs were extremely hard, and assignments were vague and super hard as well. You don't learn anything in class and it is extremely boring but attendance is compulsory.

This man only reads off of his slides which are directly from the textbook and does not go above what is written on the slides. In addition, when he does explain a little further it is extremely monotoned and makes no sense. Attendance is required, and its the biggest waste of time going to class, I have to teach myself everything anyway.

Assignments and quizzes with vague questions that required constant feedback between students and TAs/Professor to get them resolved. Lectures consisted of him reading slides that were created by other professors.
By far the most generous and compassionate professor ever! Had him for both C212 and B461
His problem sets were unreasonably hard, and his final project was filled with bugs and discrepancies that were not fixed until days before it was due
Namely he is an okay teacher but in terms of IU he is one of the best
This professor was great at teaching and allowed for extra credit and makeup assignments. Overall cool
Awful, just awful.
He is a very nice professor and his lectures shows that he is passionate about what he teaches. He makes sure to take time to answer student's questions and is generous with extensions.

Professor Siddiqui is actually a really great person. His personality is great, and I personally find him quite entertaining. HIs main down fall, however, is that his lectures are incredibly boring and uninformative. He always just reads through his lecture slides which rarely prepares us for the weekly problem sets.
Little to no technical instruction was given, completely hung to dry when assignments were given with no resource to learn from. Easily the worst educator Ive had.

The proffesor was fair in all grading even if the labs could be seen as long and sometimes tedious. He offered quiz and lab drops and didn't require attendance at the time I took this class. In comparison to other cs professors Siddiqui is a solid choice.

Some of the labs in this class were obscenely long. Most of them were not super difficult, but be prepared to spend 2-8 hours on the labs per week, depending on its size and your affinity with Java. Not to mention the fact that some of the labs and the Final Project came with poorly-worded instructions and overall bad programming design.

This class would not be bad if the exams and final were not so ridiculous. The practice problems he gives you are useless and the problems are just coding on a piece of paper over stuff we hardly covered. Final project was awful too. Overall, sloppy and annoying class but the labs for the most part are doable. Everything else is bad.

The midterm and final were unnecessarily difficult for no reason and the TAs all graded differently and canceled their office hours during the final project and did nothing to help in regard. The final project was a mess and the guidelines and rubric for the project weren't finished, there were missing blanks and things that said TODO on document.
I barely understood the lecture, I looked at the slides and watched online courses to get all the hw done

Class was alright at first but the last few weeks are bad. Labs go up in difficulty by a lot and the end seemed rushed. He gave us a final group project and a final exam. The instructions are weird and he just started slamming us with stuff out of the blue. He is a nice guy, but cmon, all your TAs cancel their office hours so it's not fair.
Class was easy at the start of the semester the labs were really long but he took the feed back and made them shorter which was really nice. After that the class was really smooth.
There is a lot of reading, and the PDFs or access to articles were always provided.

This professor is very accessible outside of class, and knows the topics really well! One thing to beware of is there is a lot of grading where you either receive 10, 7, or 0 points out of ten for big portions of your grade. Small mistakes cost a lot in this class. Interesting topics and easy class though overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Very interesting lectures, the exams were very straight forward, and was super kind! Sometimes felt like the content was a little "duh" but othertimes was great! There is a final group project but its honestly really well set up and a good project (as someone who hates group projects). Not too difficult of a class, I recommend.

Professor Mueller is a great professor. She cares deeply about her students and their success and was always active in our discussions. She is very responsive to emails and other messages and the class was not overly difficult. I loved this class. I'd recommend taking it if you need SOC credits and want to learn more about healthcare inequalities.

Professor Mueller is very passionate about this course. There are lecture videos, readings, discussion posts, and a quiz every week. The exams were a little more challenging and the book report and final project required additional time. Overall, Professor Mueller is a caring professor that is easy to reach out to if you have any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about what she teaches and you can see that. Lectures at first were very clear and easy to follow. Towards the end where we started to use Excel, she sort of assumed that everyone already knew how to use it and its basics. The lectures that involve you using excel are fast paced.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took this class online asynchronously. Each week we had group assignments, which were pretty straightforward if you watch the recorded lectures. The professor is passionate about the material, and she can be a bit quirky at times. Even though some of this stuff (excel, survey work, data analysis) seems hard, she makes it pretty easy.

This was a very good online class, especially for those desperate for an easy N&M credit. I was assigned a group and I have to work with them every week on weekly assignments. Exams were open-note and untimed. Assignments were not overly difficult. Class may be different in person but if you pay attention and keep track, you shouldn't have trouble
Unfortunately, Jeremy's lectures are much better when he's following the structure of a textbook, like in Intro to Networks. OS lectures felt very scattered and it was hard to follow along.
Jeremy is really where the rubber meets the road in terms of teaching.

Likely my favorite professor at IU. He has superhuman knowledge of the networks course material. He's very passionate and can hardly fit all that he wants to talk about in each lecture, which makes them very engaging, but fast. Projects could use more explicit requirements, especially the last one, but he offered a lot of leeway.

Really interesting lectures, super smart and funny. Logistically, the class could not be run worse. I refuse to take another class with him because of this. You need to chase him down to do anything including asking questions in office hours
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jeremy is so so precious. Best proffesor I have ever had during my time at IU and luddy.
The only prof whose ramblings make sense. A super smart goofball. He somehow makes stuff like assembly easy to learn.

The Return of the Diet Coke King! Excellent course with great lectures. The group final project to create a custom ISA was fun (even though I had to hard carry my randomly assigned groupmates.)  My only complaint was the slow grading, but if you *really* care, you can run the math yourself on the autograder results.

Honestly one of the best Professors in Indiana University Bloomington for computer Science. Really knowledgeable in many System classes and doesn't make the class super difficult. No Mandatory attendance, and doesn't make the classes extra difficult like some professors. In Summary he really wants everyone to pass!
My dude loves diet cokes and OS operating systems way too much. Course is P436 - Operating Systems

Insistent on making his own auto-grader, set the class back 5 weeks. Multiple easy assignments that should have only taken a week to complete were given weeks. The final that was supposed to get a month, only got a week. I say I have an A+ but I have no idea, we are on the final and I haven't even gotten back project 3 (Feb), much less the midterm.
If there is one class that you can take as a Computer Science major. It has to be this class.
LOVE Jeremy.

One of the best professors at IU. Makes the material really approachable, and makes it super easy to get a good grade. Extra credit for turning in assignments early, and generous curves and low weight on exams. Super fun to talk to and a good lecturer.

Musser is top dog among the CompSci lecturers. He clearly has an incredible passion for the subject matter and is willing to do whatever it takes to help you along the way. He loves explaining things, so there is no such thing as a stupid question when at his office hours. He won't judge you even if you're clearly behind on your work.

Jeremy teaches extremely difficult technical concepts, but attending his lectures and doing the assignments, going to his OH, interacting with TAs will fool you into thinking that class is easy. The class is extremely difficult, but if you put in the effort. Every single lecture will be worth it! I had a 100% attendance in his lectures cause of him
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Jeremy's a sweetheart and a really cute professor.
The diet coke king himself. You should take a class with him just because he's teaching it. Absolutely legendary lecturer.
The CS department GOAT, give my man a raise and unlimited Diet Cokes
My CS and ISE Guy. Dawg's the best on god.
Jeremy has a really goofy energy, which I absolutely love.
335 is a difficult class for sure, but worth the ride if you are taking with Jeremy. Jeremy is an absolute favorite among everyone.
Taking his class right now, and absolutely love him. Definitely my all-time favourite professor in and beyond IU. Legit the best!!
the GOAT!!

I absolutely love Jeremy and the way he organizes his classes. I've taken his CSCI-C 335 class, CSCI-P 438 and currently in his CSCI-P 436 class. You can tell he not only enjoys the content but wants you to understand it. While the labs/assignments are pretty work heavy, he has a very generous grading policy. 100% recommend all his classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best instructors I have ever had at IU. Cool and challenging labs that actually taught me a lot about assembly, threads, processes, etc. He is always available to help in Office Hours, lab, or by email. I would definitely take his class again

Professor Jeremy is the best professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his class, to the point where he'll stay up until 4AM making slides and run into class if he's running late. If you're curious about a subject he will encourage you to explore it, and even give you pointers if you choose to. You probably cannot find a better prof at IU.
Best professor at IU. If you have the chance to take any class with Kate...DO IT!!!!

Katie is the best Informatics professor in all of IU. She cares about her what her students take away from class and is all you could want in a teacher genuinely. If you have I210 and I308 upcoming, pick her to instruct you. I've never written one of these things and don't like sites like this- but she legit deserves respect on her craft.

Had her for I308 and I301, amazing professor. Extremely understanding and will work with you through anything you're going through. Heard she's teaching I211 next semester, take it with her. Pay attention, do your assignments, communicate if you're having trouble and you'll be fine.

Kate is a seriously great teacher. I had pre-existing SQL knowledge but I still learned a lot. She's very helpful, approachable, and reasonable, and brings snacks to class for course milestones. I was worried about a group-work class, but the way it's executed works really well. I didn't have any problems, but if you did there are systems in place.

Kate is one of the most caring professors ive had at IU. She reminds me of some high school teachers I had in the fact that they *wanted* me to succeed. She sets the students up for success, and the only complaint I have is that her grading scheme was pretty strange. Forgiving, but strange. Shes a must have for this course!

Choose a good group for the case study throughout the duration oft the semester and you'll do very well in the course. There are some comments about the lectures being confusing ... speak with him for 5 minutes after class and everything will click. He's a really nice guy and has a lot of knowledge about the advancement of AI in marketing spaces.

Although Prof Shaik was lovely and personable, he was not a great Prof for this course. Lectures had nothing to do with game content, quizzes were quite difficult, and general concepts were explained in a very complex way that left people more confused. However, if you participate and generally try, you will do well in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you come to class, participate occasionally, and ensure that you have a good group/setup for the simulation that runs throughout the entire semester, you will get a good grade in the class.  Also the exams are so similar to the practice quizzes he runs through in class - very easy A and nice professor.

Seems like a nice guy, but he is a terrible prof. He can't explain anything in a way that students understand. Everyone is confused after he goes over a concept. Lectures are very boring and he interrupts students as they're asking or answering questions.

First time professor has ever taught this class. This is for M450, not M303. Had the class at 8am, so I may be bias, but lectures were a snooze-fest. Grades participation every day through annoying top hat questions. Long case projects, hard exams, and expensive textbook and simulation. ($150+)

Best professor I've had at IU. Extremely helpful, walks up to students in class to make sure they are doing a good job. The class assignments reflected exactly what was on the exams and he went in depth about explaining all the classwork. For someone who is terrible at math and has no experience with statistics, the class was surprisingly pleasant.

Very passionate & knowledge, but creates a hostile classroom environment which is really a shame because her huge ego takes away from the material and the potential for insightful discussion. reviews.comment: Myers says she welcomes questions and says she wants her students to succeed, but constantly berates and puts down students. She clearly doesn't thrive in the classroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: this is a professor who clearly despises students. she is rude, condescending, assumes the worst of their ability and desires, and has little patience for being asked questions on unclear/uncertain policies. she parades herself as a champion of mental health by telling us to "breathe". it is disrespectful to us.
be ready to be publicly humiliated. attendance is mandatory. you can't be a freshman in this class.

reviews.comment: Evident by syllabus week that Professor Myers does not respect her students. Questions are "welcomed" and then met with disapproval and in some cases public humiliation. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Amrita Myers was the most disrespectful professor and instructor I have ever had in the entirety of my academic career. She was rude, unforgiving, ableist, and condescending. I could have taught this class (the entire class was either wasting time in class, or having her grade what we had to say about the readings; she did not need to be there).

Dr. Myers is an excellent professor and very passionate. She is very strict on grading the annotated reading (we read 3 books) and grading the 4 papers. The workload is heavy and you will be doing 30-50 pages of reading nightly. Due to this though, I feel as though I learned a lot through her class and I am glad I took it, but it is difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Myers is a phenomenal professor who deeply cares about her students and the material she is teaching. That being said she is very direct and blunt with how she speaks or offers criticism, so if that is not your thing maybe pass on this class. I really enjoyed the material covered in class and I am extremely thankful I took it.
You get four chances to pass this class through long essays. The grading system and her critiques are very tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Myers cares a lot about her work, that is obvious, but because of that, she is extremely hard on all of her students. She's rude, condescending, and if you ask a question she answers in a way that makes you feel dumb and inadequate. She has ridiculously strict rules about formatting and actively looks for reasons to dock your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Myers is so condescending and will NOT be understanding if you're going through personal stuff. She takes genuine pleasure in tearing students apart. I don't recommend her if you have anxiety. She rarely lectures and prioritizes small group discussions. She's also very particular about papers and will count you off for small formatting mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. Myers was the most condescending professor I've had at IU. She made multiple students cry. You'll spend more time learning her specific paper format than actually learning history because she rarely lectures during class time, instead using class periods to force discussion about the purposes and motivations of source authors every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Myers is amazing. One of the best professors I have ever had. She is so understanding and is a great teacher. You will learn so much by taking her class. The only issue I had with her class is that some of the grading guidelines were not abundantly clear, but other than that, absolutely spectacular.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I've seen a lot of people on here saying that Dr. Myers is very condescending and it's not wrong but it's not the whole truth. She's extremely understanding when it comes to personal situations and mental health and very good at giving back feedback. If you need help just ask! If you want an easy A, she isn't for u. But if you try, it's worth it
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The most condescending professor I've ever had. She is very passionate but she also puts students down for simply having trouble or a question. Terrible teacher and terrible AI who is just as cocky as she was. Her head is so far up her arse that she can't see her students being miserable. The subject was interesting but her teaching style is tragic
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Amrita Myers is the worst professor I have had the displeasure of being in class with while at IU. It is a rare occurrence for her to leave class without having made at least one student feel inadequate and unintelligent. Stay FAR away.

reviews.comment: Lots of readings, 60-80 pages a week as well as a 1-2 page analysis over every reading(twice a week). The readings are always very relevant and interesting. reviews.comment: Amrita doesn't leave herself open for criticism, in fact, she is more likely to make you feel ignorant for asking simple questions which makes it hard for everyone to approach her.

reviews.comment: Very bad.

reviews.comment: She is a really tough grader, she gave participation points and you would never get full points unless you say something that "inspires her". It was so disheartening. She didn't give any cushion for missing class, and was rude. I would never recommend her to anybody and last I checked a group of students were going to the board about her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Myers was easily the best professor I've had at IU. She's clearly passionate about this subject, and it makes the coursework much easier to do. She also focuses on engaging her students outside of the classroom, and would regularly share local events of interest with us and encourage us to do the same. I wish I could take her class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is a very hard grader on participation and papers!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Myers has extremely high standards. You definitely have to do all the reading and have to say something good to say every class. She grades you on what you say and how you say it. She is very passionate about everything that she does. Do not miss class and do not think you can get through a class by just skimming the reading.. it wont work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is awesome, but she is very serious about her class. Participation is Suupper important. You MUST attend class or you will Fail! She gives tough love but, you definitely feel the love 3
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of the most inspirational professors I've had. Prof. Myers really makes you think in-depth about the material. If you're not willing to read and delve into the assigned readings every week, don't bother because she will know--she can smell fear. She is insightful and a wealth of knowledge, so take advantage of that and don't be intimidated.

WWW is a great course, but tough for a gender studies course. There are four papers in total. You cannot miss a class with small group work or you will lose about 1.5-2% of your grade. Have 1-2 insightful lines about the reading for EVERY class. Get ready to read 30-50 pages for every class. Learn CMS citations. All of her lectures are brilliant.

Dr. Myers is one of the most inspirational people I have ever met. She is so passionate about her mission of equality for all people regardless of race, gender or sexual orientation. I went into this class with what I had no idea was a closed mind and am leaving so much smarter and aware. And it doesn't hurt that she dresses impeccably.

Dr. Myers commands the utmost respect with her extreme intelligence, beauty, and witiness. Her class was so amazing + informative that I ended up adding a double major in History. You can NOT survive in these classes without doing in the reading, but if you do the work, it can open your mind and really help you to become a better person entirely.

Class with Dr. Myers is unlike any other I've taken. She is incredibly bright and passionate, and she expects you to have put the work in (this is not a class you can skate by in without reading). If you're willing to put in the work, you should walk out of class a better student and a more aware person. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

She's extremely knowledgeable, insightful, & her subject is very provoking. I've enjoyed the class & attend every day. Dr. Myers asks you to read every single day of class, & prepare a small outline of what you read. If you didn't read, you're useless--i really like that approach. Discussion based. GREAT, INTERESTING class. Highly recommended.

I took an honors section with Dr. Myers. If you don't want to come to class or prepare readings for every single class, you shouldn't take one of her classes. That being said, my writing improved dramatically and I learned a ton.But I also doubled the workload of any class I'd ever taken. She is very nice if you get to know her, but don't cross her
very quick witted and eager to teach/learn. Provides many outside sources. A lot of reading required, as well as attendance.

While she may not have been the easiest grader, as long as you do all the assigned work and attempt to participate there is no reason you should't get at least as an A- if you listen to her comments.
