reviews.comment: Solid lectures, good explanation. He does expect some level of participation, as a class not individually. Personally I found the lectures to be pretty accessible and even interesting for an 8am class. Seriously, they put the note outlines on the website for a reason, use them!

HE is a decent proffessor, he makes u work hard. Tough exams, so u really need to UNDERSTAND the material well. Only problem is the class at 8AM !!! Gives bpnus points, but those are hard, and quizes every friday. Labs are fun, lectures sometimes boring but u learn a lot. He is knowledgeable, intimidating somehow and expects u to work hard!

While I am really not a fan of the "two of the above" option for almost every test question, Rick is a pretty approachable guy. Towards the end of the semester he got fed up with the low participation and started lecturing really fast-- but not impossibly fast. I learned a lot in this class and studied hard in the process.

Very interesting course. GO TO CLASS! He doesn't curve you only get bonus points for going to class (you have to sign in while you are there or you don't get them). Tests are very hard, study in DETAIL! Very interesting course though, he is a pretty good teacher.

Really awesome teacher! The class is hard but he gives plenty of opportunities to earn bonus points. Mynark is very approachable and willing to help anyone who puts the time and effort into the class. Overall I really enjoyed it, and having him as a teacher!

Avoid him if you can...He makes everything so much more difficult than it needs to be, particularly with exams. They typically have nothing to do with notes taken in class and assume you've magically gained vast knowledge of physiology on your own. Horrible.

Exams were so hard! I studied so long for all of them, but the best I could ever pull off was a C+. THe notes dont really go with the questions on the tests. Every question has "two of the above" as an option.

Overall, great professor. Tests are difficult, but challenging. I really enjoyed his class. You never need the book, so don't bother buying it. Just show up to get bonus points, and study hard for exams. Overall, great guy and great class.

Exams were EXTREMELY difficult. Attended class every day, took good notes, went back over the audio from lecture he posts online, studied hard and still did horrible on his exams. the lab part of phys saved me! he did not help me when i went to office hours...made me feel worse than i did coming in to get help.
Tough class but great at explaining the material in a way that makes total sense even if you don't have a strong science background. Challenging exams, but in a good way!
great!

Mynark is a great professor. He posts the audio from lecture online for you to listen to and provides alot of clinical examples in class. I didn't have much interest and feel like I definitely learned alot. The tests had alot of "two of the above" choices, but you have to really understand the material.
Great professor.  He keeps the class interesting and has some hilarious jokes at times.  Highly recommended.

He is an unbelievable professor who makes you look at learning in a whole new perspective. Taking this class will change the way you study and you will get an A if you go everyday. Also, he doesn't incorporate a lot of anatomy, so those who didn't do well in anatomy will not have a problem. Overall, I recommend taking his physiology class.

Mynark is an awesome professor. He is very knowledgeable in the subject so he explains topics very well and in numerous ways so you can understand. He puts lectures online so you don't even have to go. don't buy the book. tons of extra credit so even if you get B's on all the tests you can get an A+ in the class
I enjoyed having professor Mynark. His tests were a bit hard, but I think I learned a lot from him.
A little dull but overall pretty good.  Exam was difficult

He's a really great professor. Really smart. You basically have to write your own notes because he rarely gives you fill in the blank. He gives out extra credit because there is no curve for this course. His tests/quizzes are challenging because he uses "two of the above are true".
He gives you the help you need, and makes things interesting. The tests are challenging but he offers a lot of extra credit to compensate.

Mynark is by far the best professor I've had in college. He is very easy to understand and if you attend lecture you'll barely need to use the textbook. His exams are kind of difficult, but if you study a decent amount you should be fine. He's also very helpful in office hours and always willing to meet.

Nice, laid-back professor. His teaching methods were different than the previous professor (4 different professors teach the course); I wouldn't say he was a bad professor but a little boring at times. Pretty friendly though. The director of M131.

This class was great!  It's divided into 4 parts each taught by a different professor--- whom are my fave 4 at IU thus far.  They are all very intelligent, friendly, and you can tell they have real experience in medicine.  Take this class!!!  Even for non-science majors the info you learn is simple and useful for anyone with a human body! :)

She honestly super awesome! The class was very interesting and pretty easy. Since it was an online class she was quick to respond to emails and even offer her phone number to me. I would take her class a million times over again I was very satisfied with all parts of the class

I've taken 3 courses with My and she is incredible! Truly a mentor in the field of scuba and super willing to work with you on anything. Her professionalism and expertise will surprise you with how relaxed and personable she can be.

Mylana is hands down one of the nicest instructors I've ever had. She is very patient and takes time to make sure you understand everything. She loves her job and really takes pride in it. This class was extremely fun and I will definitely take more of her classes in the future.

Easily the most amazing instructor I've ever had. Being involved with the Underwater Science Department at IU has changed my life. Mylana is absolutely incredible. Such a smart and inspirational person. Take her classes.
One of the best instructors at IU. Really knows her stuff, especially in SCUBA!
Amazing teacher.

Mylana is an amazing teacher. She has a lot of experience in a lot of different SCUBA-related fields and really knows what she's talking about. Her class is super chill and she's really laid back, but you still learn so much about diving. She is very personable and easy to get along with.

I loved this class with Professor Myrick. She kept lectures interesting and explained material well. If you attend classes and do the readings you will get an A. I definitely recommend this course and I recommend taking any course with Professor Myrick.

Myrick was awesome. The class had a lot of work, but most of it was pretty easy. As long as you skim the readings you'll be fine and able to answer the follow up questions. There is TONS of extra credit and the majority of your grade is based on in class writings and reading response. Got an A+ in this class and it wasn't time consuming at all.

Just do the assignments and you should not have a trouble getting an A, if you study for the tests they are not difficult. Myrick is really nice and sweet, and manages to make the material interesting. I would recommend her!
Fun Course, don't blow off assignments.

J110 isn't the most interesting class but Myrick makes her lectures fairly interesting. Take notes and study those because they are basically the tests.  Attendance isn't nesessarily mandatory but there are in-class writings over her lectures everyday. Overall, if you show up, take notes, and do your homework it's an easy A
She's super helpful and interesting, even though the class isn't very interesting! She's so cute and little and so funny!

Myrick is really nice, and while the material may be boring at times she makes it interesting. Study for the tests (theres usually a lot of information on them), but they are not hard as long as you study. Overall would recommend!

Professor Myrick is very passionate about what she does and really seems to care about her students. If you're interested in journalism, you should have no problem getting an A. The class itself can get a little monotonous at times, but makes sure you show up, because there are in-class writings every day.

J110 is a basic overview of all things Journalism, and Prof. Myrick does her best to make each topic interesting. It's easy to do well in the class, and if you are struggling, she is more than welcome to meet outside of class. Definitely recommend her!

The content itself is pretty boring, but Jessica makes it as interesting as it's going to get. She's a great teacher and really helpful. There is a daily quiz basically for attendance, but there is only two large tests in the class. She's great!

Jessica is awesome! I feel as though the course could have been boring if she was not my professor, but she made the information fresh and interesting. She is knowledgable, fun, and helpful. I would highly recommend her to any prospective Journalism students.
Loved the readings. Had no papers to write. Tests were just like notes from class. Go to class!
Easy and enjoyable. Myers is funny and kinda cute.
Really easy class if you read the readings and attend the lectures.
Good stuff. Makes myth interesting. It's much easier if you go to lecture regularly.
No Comments
Great Class. He's cute too. :)
This is a stress-free class with effective stress management techniques, a great professor, and an easy workload for 3 credits.
Awesome teacher who cares deeply about her students' well-being and how to make their lives stress-free. Highly recommend this legend!

Great professor that is so nice. Deeply cares about every student hoping they learn something from the course. It's a blowoff class, the workload is very little which it is meant to be. The classroom is a very relaxing setting and kept a safe space.

Namoi is a great teacher and a great person. I took her Stress Prevention and Management class during the spring and I learned a lot about mindfulness and managing my time. She is an awesome teacher to have and a great person to talk to outside of class if you need advice. Definitely take her class!

Hard to understand during lectures. Weekly quizzes are hard. Exams are really tough too. Getting a good grade is possible if you learn the material entirely on your own or with the TA since he is better than the professor.
Goated class

Data Science On-Ramp was by far the worst class I have ever taken at any level of my education. It felt like a rip-off, to an extent I found frankly offensive. Nasim and the TA's were not useful at all. Almost every week our homework assignments would focus on stuff we hadn't learned yet. Learning materials were thrown together with no forethought.

Professor is okay, but D321 is not an easy class. Weekly quizzes are difficult. Homework is even harder. It's very difficult to stay on top of everything especially with other difficult classes on your schedule. We get 1 homework dropped but no quizzes. I feel like the material gets rushed through and it's difficult to learn everything that quickly
Struggles with clearly conveying topics, and quizzes every week. Be prepared to spend time before class relearning what was taught.

The professor is actually very knowledgeable, but her presentations  might not be engaging. But her slides are very good. Its informative and easy to learn for exams. There are weekly quizzes which might take an hour to review but it helps exams. If you need anything talk to her, and she will help you pass the course with a good grade.

reads off slides and doesn't teach well at all. Weekly quizzes are easy, but homework is a little harder. 
No cheatsheets on exams even though she covers so much material. Expect the exams to look nothing like the practice. If you ask her nicely she'll give you an extension. No drops except for 1 homework I believe.

DO NOT TAKE DATA SCIENCE ON-RAMP! The sub-courses are some of the worst organized I have seen in both my undergrad and graduate program. The content in the modules does not help to solve the assignments AT ALL! I have never done so much external research to try and complete assignments, let alone for a 1 credit course!

I took this class just for credits and was very satisfied with it. The instructor was nice. i liked the way the themes developed in the  materials intersected.  And, we learned various cultures in various parts of the world. however, he was very strict with attendance but fair in grading which is not bad though

He takes attendance everyday, and monitors participation daily. He posted a course description that said the class would be about Harry Potter type novels, but we get there and it's about African misfortunes. Also, his class is a major trigger- topics of rape, incest, and killings. He doesn't care if you have disability services either. AVOID HIM.

I really enjoyed this class this past semester and I learned a lot. I was introduce to various cultures. I enjoyed every novel we read and movie we watched and will definitely recommend it to others. Again, thank you Professor!

Take his course!He is a Good prof. He really cares about doing a good job.I took his culture class and I loved the way discussion and lecture were balanced.He always makes it easy for every student to get engaged with the  class discussion.I got to know what culture really means to people. This course met my expectations.
Good teacher! Clear and very fun! I would highly recommend this class and highly recommend this teacher.Very enjoyable class !Only thing is strictness with absences. I took this class last year.
Absolutely the worst prof I've ever had. You cannot understand a word he says and he is very rude. Quizzes on irrelevant topics and unwilling to help. Dropped this class after second week.

Class is entirely discussion based.  He'll give more time than needed to discuss a question and yell at you when your conversation stalls.  He asks openended q's and looks for 1 specific response.Raise your hand to answer a question, he won't call on you, but on someone else.Makes it hard to get participation points if he won't let you participate.
Ndour is very stubborn and uninformed about university policies. The quizzes asked random and unimportant questions. He was hard very hard to communicate with.
didnt learn a thing

Moe is my least favorite professor I've ever had. All of the assignments of this class are completely busy work. I have learned nothing from this class. He doesn't give a rubric for any assignments so you have to go to class to know what to do. Constantly brags about the same things over and over. I could quote things you'll hear but I have no room
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: As a freshman Kelley courses are tough and mostly weed out courses but Moe is the best professor Ive had. He cares about IU and cares about his students. I highly highly recommended this class if youre doing ANYTHING in business.

He is one of the worst professors I have ever had at IU. Half of his assignments do not come with rubrics. It is literally a guessing game with him when it comes to grading. He teaches the class to what he thinks should be taught, and he enjoys bragging about his career. Absolutely avoid his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Moe's a dope dude. He loves IU and business. The class is honestly not hard. He takes attendance 4 times a semester but if you miss class you won't do good on the tests. He won't put answers to the lecture notes online so you've gotta go to class. Tests are straight from the book and lecture. He gives extra credit. Final wasn't hard got a 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Moe is a really good lecturer. His class can be really interesting and he brings in some cool guest speakers at the end of the year. The only problem is that his class is really big and it can be impersonal at times. Nothing Moe can really do about that, but he still tries to keep students engaged.

Moe was a great guy.  He gives enjoyable lectures and has some good stories however do not take this class. His criteria makes no sense, none of his notes are in complete sentences, and with every assignment you are left guessing that you did it well enough for his standards. Do yourself a favor and take a different D271 class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Moe is a great professor. He gives everyone a great opportunity to do well by offering extra credit and clearly defining what will be on exams. If you take an hour or two to study for an exam, and show up to lecture and pay attention, you will do well.

Moe is a great guy, but his lectures don't really make sense. He jumps from one topic to the next and says "fundamentally" an unnecessary amount of times. Reading the chapter before each class really helped me understand each lecture better. The most frustrating thing was he tested you over his own opinions. If you don't agree with him, good luck.

Mo Kanning is the worst teacher I've ever had. Extremely unclear on grading criteria and vague in lectures. I've legitimately learned nothing in this course, other than the fact that the world will be vastly different in the year 2020. He loves to talk about this even though what he says makes very little sense. Also loves to brag
Hate this guy, talks alot. Makes stuff up. annoying. Not clear in what he wants from the assignments. Avoid his D271 class. He should not come to IU to teach. DO NOT TAKE

easiest class i ever took. all the assignments were extremely easy the guys who got bad grade in his class are basically dumbasses. he gives the easiest assignment to make brief swot and pest. He won't require you to make full report, just a basic analysis.

Great instructor and very helpful. He is also very resourceful and is willing to do whatever it takes for the students to succeed. He does a fantastic job of explaining the material and is just an overall amazing professor. I would highly recommend him to everyone. Paint for Extra Credit.
he is really good; he regards student as customers if you really want to study, he will try his best to help you. His lecture is interesting engaging students to participate with some bonuses

Moe is a great guy. He is willing to help you as long as you are willing to do the work. Go into his office hours and listen during the power points and you will be fine! There are 4 tests and 1 project, he is really big into school spirit and extra credit!
Do not take his D271 class... he's a puffy guy, not sure if I can trust what he teaches - credibility and reliability  is missing.

I took X100 when I was undecided and it is the reason I'm minoring in business. Kanning was enthusiastic and I enjoyed his lectures. Would recommend him to anyone. Do the readings and go to office hours if you need help. He helped me out when I slipped up on one exam.

(Part 3) There is also a review sheet for each exam 1 until 4 for the vocabulary. DO THEM!! There is also extra credit for the term project so you do not need to worry a lot. I ended up getting 248250 because of the extra credit!!! Also, bonus points for painting your face. Thank God, ended this class with an A+ :D DEFINITELY RECOMMEND FOR X100!

(Part 2) Always make an appointment to see him as he will provide you a study that is VERY VERY helpful and most of them are in the test (You only get this if you see him, you'll never get it in class). He also provides slides that need to be filled in so you SHOULD come to class. There are exam review session right b4 exam which is VERY HELPFUL!

(I am willing to make 3-4 parts of him because its worth it!) This is part 1  Moe is such a good professor. He always encourage his student to participate by giving chocolates. Overall, this class is not bad at all. Put effort and time to it and you'll be fine! He provides the textbook online, no need to worry about it

I can sum him up in one sentence.  Awesome person to network with but shouldn't be teaching.  He has some great insight but the seemingly randomness of his grading and the lack of any clear set instructions outweigh that ten to one.  He will claim he doesn't have instructions because you won't in the business world so prepare for random grades.
You never know what's going on in the guy's head! So when he goes to grade your projects and assignments it's a complete guessing game because you never really know what he wants or expects

Most painful lectures I have ever sat through. Literally says the word "fundamentally" in every sentence and probably a minimum of 20 times a class period. Does not answer questions clearly. Does not give directions clearly. Makes the worstmost boring PowerPoints I have ever seen.

I love Mr. Kanning! What a good guy, he was always eager to teach students every morning & was very helpful during office hours. He always had a positive attitude & knew how to explain complicated concepts by putting them into simpler terms. He also was inspiration when it came to motivation and becoming a leader. He had  a straight focus in class!

An man who does not know what Burundi is should not be able to teach international business. Slides were impossible to read because of cluttered backgrounds (maps, navy seals, etc.), and when you could read them, they were nonsense. Gave no feedback until very end of semester when he gave half the class bad grades. TLDR - I learned nothing.

Moe overall is a good professor and knows what he is talking about.  His tests are difficult and his lectures wont help you with tests at all.  Read through the e-text before exams. The extra credit on the term project saved a lot of students grades.

I wasn't very interested in the class itself. Only took it because it was required. Gives extra credit for participating beyond the average. Less work than the other d271 class. Biggest complaint is grading on the project which is worth 50% of your grade. If Moe wasn't such a terrible grader, I would take him again.

He is a kind man and I wish I had met him outside of the class room because he does not know how to teach. He waisted my time by going through the exact same lecture 10 times throughout the course of the eight weeks. Also he has no clear planning or criteria for grading.

do NOT take his D271 class. He provides the grading rubrics AFTER you submit your assignments and then does not give reasoning for taking off a significant amount of points. Everything he teaches can be condensed down into 1-2 classes. Wasted a lot of time listening to his fluff.
As the other review said, do not take his D271.  He's  delusional and it seems like he uses a random # generator to determine how many points you get on an assignment.  It's a joke.
He is the reason I am graduating a Kelley major this Spring.

I don't know why he has such great ratings! He might seem fun and cool at first, but then he tries to hard to be liked by us. His lectures are ridiculously boring, the only thing that actually makes sense is the review class before the test. But otherwise, his presentations are really disconnected and hard to follow.

Moe is a great guy. Extremely helpful and wants to see everyone do well. There are several big "themes" throughout the course that repeat themselves exams and if you get it, then it's not difficult. I found the class to be an easy A, but everyone is different.
DO NOT TAKE HIS D271

Mo's a great dude but tests are some what difficult and the term project is total BS. Make sure you turn it in early because you get 20 bonus points but TAs grade them and I had Mo review mine days before turning it in and said that it looked really good and I got a 217/250 before the bonus! Luckily the bonus brought it up but the TAs are useless.

Moe is an amazing professor i would definately reccomend this class to you guys. He looks for ways to help if you seek him out. He speaks his mind and is always real with you!! Definately take his class. It is not an easy A, but if you study for the exams and read the chapters its pretty easy.
This class was not near as easy as people made it seem. It actually was a pretty tough class that I didn't take too much away from, but Mo is a good guy.
Great guy, knows what he's talking about. Overall enjoyed his lectures, he isn't one to bore you to death. Also pretty easy, I hardly studied for the tests in all honesty and ended up with a B.

Mo is  a great professor. He speaks his mind in a respectful way and makes class interesting. As long as you study the fill-in-the-blank slides he gives you and memorize definitions from the book you should be just fine.

This class was exciting, but almost to the point where you couldn't understand the lecture. His slides are basically all of his thoughts randomly thrown together. So much so, that even the TAs couldn't even answer any of the questions he asked. I would not recommend this class to anyone, unless you are VERY good at "reading between the lines"
awesome teacher, is truly passionate about what he is teaching, cares about his students, makes class enjoyable and interesting
One of the best men I have ever met in my life.  Moe is a great teacher who genuinely cares and tries to get to know his students.  Amazing human being who wants you to succeed.

Great experience overall taking this class. I felt Moe really spoke from experience during class, and that the material being taught would be really applicable in the real world. Workload is very manageable, and it's a fun class as well which I'll miss taking.

Moe teaches an easy class for the athletes to take.  The class is very doable but it is annoying to hear him talk about how great of a business man he thinks he was.  Seems to really care about his students though, liked him as a person but not as a teacher.

Moe is the best professor i have ever had. Don't need to buy a book he gives it to you online. Turn the term project in early. No homework,random attendance checks exams are kind of hard. Go to the review session and you'll get at least a B. Take Moe if you get the chance he is awesome!

You don't really need the textbook because he says everything in class... but he is amazing by far my favorite Professor here at IU.. he is energetic and fun...and he really does try to interact with his students... Take his class

Moe is absolutely amazing! He really engages the class during lectures and enjoys knowing his students so stop by and visit during office hours! As long as you know the basic concepts and study the vocab out of the book you will get an A on the test. By far my favorite professor at IU, you will regret not having him!!

Love this guy! He has a lot of real world experience with what he teaches, so it makes it more interesting knowing that he knows what he's talking about! He also has a very good sense of humor! It's fun and you learn a thing or two! TAKE THE CLASS.

"when i was in corporate america" is a phrase you will hear the most in his class. He Barely refers to the textbook, and includes questions such as "what are moe's office hours" on Exams, which affect our future, so basically if you dont share his insight on the business world, but read every page of the book and master it,its absolutely no good.
This professor was helpful and made the class as simple as possible so that everyone was able to keep up. Overall, the class was enjoyable and fairly easy. I enjoyed it.

Moe is the man! He really is a great lecturer and makes the class interesting and fun. Pay attention in class and study before tests and you'll do fine. I recommend you visit him in office hours he really loves getting to know his students and will help you get better at his class.

One of my favorite teachers at IU. Hilarious and the tests aren't impossible. Make sure to turn in the project early for extra credit because its worth it, do the extra credit painting and write down the review. Best class I've taken here so far!

He isn't a good professor whatsoever, He is so full of himself and thinks too highly of himself.  He needs knocked off his high horse.  He doesn't follow anything with the book, and insist on bringing up how "great" he is and how "he's never been wrong about a business" blah blah.  Arrogant, self-centered.  Take this class with Rubenstein. Easy

He is a REALLY SMART business man and makes class fun and interesting. Be prepared to answer questions in class. Get candy. Take all the notes (including the review class), study for only 20 mins,and you'll get at least a B. You can apply what you learn in his class in real life and in many other classes. One of the best professors I've had at IU!
He is one of my favorite proffesors so far!

Moe is a knucklehead! But he's a really great professor who cares about his students and their success.  If you go class you shouldn't have a problem earning an A or high B.  "Think like a CEO" and "Eat the Frog" are two of the many trademark quotes Moe has to offer.

He is very outgoing and very enthusiastic about what he teaches. I do feel that he should teach from the book for certain things that are hard to study for the tests, but overall he is well-organized and really is someone you should have if you are starting business. Watch out for the term project and read what is on the syllabus.
Best first class ever! He actually offered extra credit for painting our faces during the football games! Glad to have started IU with his class

do all extra credit assignments. they really help when it comes to your final grade. also try to get to know him on a personal level. the better he knows you, the more willing he is to help you out when you need it. really great guy. but, if the class isnt required for your major, its pretty useless.

One of the best classes to take at IU whether a business student or not. It is fairly easy if you go to lectures and the review sessions. He gives out extra credit sometimes for going to class and then for being a Level 5 fan which is pretty sick. This class is easy to get a B in if you just try a little but to get an A you have to put in the work.

Moe is an AMAZING teacher. Even if you are not interested in business this is a class that you should take! His approach to the business world is very revolutionary and exciting! He is very easy so long as you study hard at least the night before the test. Moe is my homeboy now!
Very entertaining, doesn't take attendance just gives you extra credit sometimes if you go.  Easy class overall.
MOE is the man, plan and simple. He makes class fun and is a great teacher.  Go to class, listen, and do your term project on time and you will get at least a B. MOE is a phenomenal guy
Professor is fun, but I love the TA's in the 9:30 class

MOE is one of the best teachers I have ever had, class is not mandatory but at least go for the last half hour for the quizes, tests are easy if you go to class the day before, DO your term project EARLY with lots of detail I quaruntee you get an A. Plus he gives out candy
Moe really knows what hes talking about. He's very enthusiastic, which makes the class more interesting. I learned a lot in this class.

Definately recommend taking Moe's class.  We has a biased opinion on business but he is very enthusiastic in his teaching and loves IU sports.  The class is very easy if you read over the chapters.  Highly recommend since it can help you get into kelley.
Good first year business class.

Moe is awesome, as long as you take his notes in class and study them the class isn't hard at all.  The term project is lengthy but not ridiculously tough or anything, fair grading, good class, good teacher
Moe is cool guy...knows what he is talking about but makes the class fun.
Moe is the dude.  He's a shining light in the pile of turds that comprise the rest of Kelley Business School's teaching core.
He's average, semi interesting but hard tests
Wow... NO Homework， but Term Project...
He's a great guy!             Go to class, study the stuff from the "X100 PHD's" and you'll do good...  Oh and work hard on the term project
STUDY FOR THE FINAL! its much more difficult than the previous exams!

one of my fav teachers.... knows his stuff... he is a great teacher and loves teaching..... tests not THAT easy but easy .... project is time consuming but again kinda easy..... easy b.... work for an a.... class is so fun too.... he throws candy and stuff
Clear concise and helpful.  Take MO he's awesome.  Aced 2/3 exams so far.  Just show up and you should have no probs getting an A
Myron could be the best teacher in the B school, he is easy if you read the material once or twice, B+ AND UP IS EASY. Go to class and you will get an A.

I love Myron's class. It has been a full year since I took x 100, but looking back I learned a lot and enjoyed my time in class. Moe is a great professor. The tests were hard. The project was difficult, but to this day I still go back and reference the project that I created in that class as a template for other things that I do.
He's kinda a weirdo, but really friendly and entertaining. He goes really quick and there is a lot to STUDY. Go to class, take notes, and pay attention and study hard.
Moe is hilarious and keeps the class entertained.  Go to every class because the test has questions he spells out in the lectures.

Moe is amazing. He wants everyone to succeed in his class. If you don't come to his class, you will not do very well. Tests are college level tests, and the Term Project is critical if you want a good grade. If you show up to class, take notes, and STUDY, you will do very well.

Moe's class is a lot of fun and he is a funny guy. It is not hard if you look over the chapter before class and take notes in class. Tests aren't bad but you still need to study. WORK HARD ON  THE TERM PROJECT! IT IS IMPORTANT AND WILL HELP YOU TREMENDOUSLY IF YOU DO WELL!
He has such a great personality. Actually made class interesting and loves IU football.

If you don't get an A in this class it's your own fault.  With all of the hard classes that you have to take before ICORE, you are stupid if you don't take advantage of this one and get the A.  Myron is a great guy who knows his stuff, as he works in the field.  You will learn in there.  Make sure to get your project reviewed by an AI.

Moe is a great guy, he throws out either candy or something else every day at class and even plastic shot glasses sometime, he calls them "mouth wash cups". He knows what he is talking about, he consults businesses all over the country
Very easy. Show up to class take a quiz and get an A
easy class, but pretty fun.
great teaching, subject matter a little boring at times.
he is a good teacher, explains things well and is very willing to answer questions...first test is harder than I expected, but by no means impossible

Myron is an awesome teacher. He gives out prizes in class and always makes fun of Evansville and Fort Wayne students. His tests are kind of confusing but you figure it out as you go along
myron is one of the best profs i've had. he explains things clearly, and lets his students know what is expected of them.

Myron is great!  He teaches a 2 1/2 hr class, but it never even lasts 2 hours.  He gives prizes in class and is very personable and funny.  What a sweet guy.

Tammi is an amazing professor. I truly learned so much from her class, and she has inspired me in many ways to become the best social worker I can be. She encourages learning through making mistakes and is always there when you need to talk.

I had Tammi for 3 different classes. She is a great professor. She cares about her students and is willing to work with you if you work with her. She can get confusing at times with her assignments and doesn't always explain them the best when asked for clarification, however her classes are not hard. Mostly group discussions and papers.
Good class! Read the syllabus throughly considering some of the assignments critera don't match the syllabus and you are graded by the rules on the syllabus.

This class has a lot of discussion posts and a set of 5 essays due over the course of the semester. There are also journal assignments and other essay like assignments. Overall not a bad class, just a lot of assignments.

reviews.comment: Tammi has been my FAVORITE professor in my college career. She genuinely cares about her students' success! Her feedback was incredibly inspiring to me and encouraged me to challenge myself. Show up, do your work, and participate and you will do great in this class. She is a great reference and is willing to guide you after you take her class.
Tammi is amazing. She not only cares about how youre doing in her class, but how youre doing overall. She goes above and beyond to help. Just do your work and youll pass!

reviews.comment: Tammi is the best professor I have ever had. I'm a SW major, and I've learned most of what I know from her class. She prepares you for real world scenarios, and gives helpful examples from her experience in the field. She expects a lot from her students, but is more than willing to be flexible with late work as long as you communicate with her.
Tammi offers up tons of real life experiences and is very accommodating if you need help, extensions, days off, or just someone to talk to.

Tammi is obviously knowledgeable about the field.  She can be unclear at times, but if you're willing to ask she can be very helpful.  She isn't the same as a traditional professor and that throws a lot of people off.  Be flexible in the way you learn and you can get a lot out of what she teaches you!

While a nice person, she is not the best professor.  Her class is always group work (which is normal for Social Work!) but all instructions given in the majority of assignments are unclear.  There are a lot of small assignments due, and there is a lot of discussion work, and assignments only accepted in person in class.  A lot of role playing.
He will make inappropriate comments, but he's funny. You would think Jazz is light, but there is so much content and be prepared to memorize songs that sound identical.

An amazing human who knows so much about the music industry. He really cares about his students and puts his all into teaching. I have had Dr. Nelson three times and have learned a lot each year. I strongly recommend taking his classes.

Prof. Nelson is a great person, but the worst professor I have ever had. Lectures were a jumble of improvised word vomit, and slides that he did not read off of or refer to. (he did not supply the class with these slides) Often times the exams pulled from completely random concepts that were not emphasized in lecture at all. Do not take Prof Nelson

Literally just tests that count and they are NOT easy. He does not post lecture notes so be ready to write down literally everything. The tests are over random stuff in my opinion. Also make sure you can kinda easily memorize the names and artists of jazz songs, because you gotta know like 40 total.

reviews.comment: Just don't take it.

Professor Nelson is among the kindest and most interesting professor's I've had here. If you are entering Z190 for an easy A&H credit you won't find it here. Many of the ratings given prior for this class though are not fair to Professor Nelson. He is clear about the difficulty of the class and informs students of this prior to the Non-W deadline.

Dr. Nelson is an amazing individual with an outstanding personality. But as a professor, I'd never recommend him. He gets off topic in class, doesn't prepare us well enough for quizzes/exams, and lacks communication with resources available inside the class. Take this class if you wanna fight for your life in a Gen Ed.

Its a tough class so you gotta lock in to really even potentially get an A. crazy difficult class for a gen-ed and he even knows it and tries to make it like that on purpose.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Nelson was the kindest, most inspirational, exciting teacher I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his students and their success in college and in life. In Z190, 50% of your grade is the two exams you take. I finished the class with a B+ but since I did the EC concert review he bumped it up to an A. Highly recommend Prof Nelson!

Oliver is the homie, he's an inspirational speaker and has you ready to run through a wall. He understands the difficulties of being a college student and prepares you for the class if you put in the effort and show up.

Professor Nelson is an amazing person! He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed after college. He gets off topic but usually its because he is actually trying to connect with the students instead of reading a slide. Will you learn a ton? Not really. Will you have fun and pass the class with flying colors? Absolutely.

I didn't learn a ton in this class because the lectures were unorganized and it was hard to figure out what to study, but Professor Nelson is such an awesome person that it makes up for it. It is such a chill class, and always made my mornings so great. He is so inspirational and really wants to do everything he can to help his students succeed.

He's funny and his class is awesome. Every Monday and Tuesday morning I get to wake up, grab a coffee, and go listen to jazz to start my day. Extremely relaxing. He rants a lot and isn't the best educator, but if you need a class to knock out a humanities requirement, this is the one.

Dr. Oliver Nelson Jr. was originally an alright professor. However, he would go off on tangents that made it close to impossible to take understandable notes. His syllabus claimed he would drop the lowest grade and when I requested he do so, he said he no longer felt it was necessary which hurt my GPA. Overall, super caring but not cut out to teach

This class was incredibly easy as the professor doesn't care about attendance and the tests are super easy. However, I could not tell you a single thing that I learned in this class. It seems like he cares about what he's teaching and he's nice but this class is a joke.

If you signed up for this expecting legitimate knowledge on Psychology tough luck. This class focuses more on the neurological aspect and there's low effort in the class. Attendance isn't mandatory, quizzes take home, exams are online, and final was on completion. If you want to learn Psychology take a different class. If you want the A, take this.

Straight forward and for-completion assessments make this course very easy. However, if you want to gain a deep understanding of psychology, do not take Neff's course. Neff's anti-GPA rhetoric is apparent in course-content; he teaches you according to his personal agenda rather than traditional psychology. There is clearly not much carry-over info.

Neff is easily one of the best teachers I've had. He really cares about his students and strongly encourages students to reach out via email or come to office hours. His eagerness to mentor students goes beyond the classroom and really exhibits his character as an all-around stand up guy. I can't recommend his class enough!

You will not learn anything in his course and he uses lecture time to talk about whatever he wants. 60% of your grade hinges on two tests (one is dropped) so you better do well. Don't attend lecture, self study the book and pass one of the two tests and you won't have to learn anything else. Felt like a waste of time and didn't learn anything.

Amazing professor, he actually cares more about you learning rather than a letter or number. He is one of those few professors that you would actually want to stay behind and talk to about other things or even more about the subject your learning. He makes sure that everyone has a chance to pass the class with a decent grade. very nice guy overall.
Neff is a great professor and this is a great class if you care about nothing in psychology. He believes grades are not real and he likes to play basketball. Easy A.

Didn't teach absolutely anything and believes grades are fake, so basically the easiest A you will ever get. Don't recommend for psych majors as I didn't learn anything really, but def a good elective to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want an A without having to learn or do anything, take his class. If you want to learn psychology and be prepared for future courses, avoid this man at all costs. He doesn't teach, just rambles on why psychology is dumb. For someone teaching a psychology class, I'm amazed how much he seems to hate the topic.

I assumed it would cover the typical psych 101 content; however, this was more of an intro to NEURO psychology. None of it was bad information - just not what was advertised. Weekly quizzes and exams were taken directly from his textbook - just look at the book. Also, he played around with completion-based grading. Easy class.

I have never met a professor who claims to know so much without being able to back it up. I don't know why IU allowed him to teach an introductory psychology class. Maybe he would do well in a biology class, but even the information he provided on neuroscience is wrong. I shared his textbook with other professors who all said it was inaccurate.
Very enjoyable and easy class.

Neff was a great professor for NEURO psychology. This isn't a traditional psychology course. It's a fair amount of reading. He doesn't do attendance points which is very convenient. This is an exam focused class, but many of the exam questions are from the text book. For one exam and quiz set you'll be completion graded.

textbook is his own with grammatical errors left uncorrected. good thing is the extra credits and completion-graded assignments he gives. you could do well if you self-study for this class. don't waste time going to his class, there's usually about 5-10 people interested, just come to exams and you'll be fine. avoid him if possible.

I never leave reviews. But Professor Neff is my favorite professor I've had at IU. Classes are not mandatory, but he made them fun and engaging especially towards the end of sem. There's about one quiz due every week that is not hard at all. He gives a helpful study guide for Exams. You will not regret taking this class with him!!

Professor Neff was very accommodating, you can tell he cares about students. No homework at all, weekly quizzes, which are very easy, only 5 questions. His lectures are amazing and it is very easy to pay attention. He is very understanding, I would recommend this class and would take it again myself.

He's a great lecturer, super engaging, and he tries to teach you to challenge experiments and results which is a great critical thinking skill you can take out of the class. Psy-101 is a neuroscience and cognitive based course so if you want traditional psych take 102. If you put even a little effort into this class, you'll pass, its not that hard.

Has no business teaching. During lectures, he taught that nearly all of psychology is out of date and wrong. Convinced me, and a few other students, to not waste their time getting a major in the "antiquated subject" of psychology. Didn't seem to able to answer any questions that weren't related to his own textbook.

He basically spends the entire semester degrading the field of psychology. He uses a "textbook" that he wrote that doesn't make any sense. I purchased an actual psychology textbook to learn all the material that he doesn't cover so I'm prepared for future psychology classes. He also grades exams on completion... so why do any work for the class?

Lectures aren't required, but they make the world of difference in this class. Neff wrote the textbook so once you learn his method of teaching, you're golden. He is honestly super funny and caring. Anyone who complains about this class wasn't willing to put in the work. He values input and is constantly trying to evolve the class.
Great professor all around!!

I don't know if this is a flaw of the instructor or the department for lack of oversight, but this is not a psychology class. The course description does not match anything he teaches. I am very concerned that I will not know what I need to know in more advanced classes because he is not covering what should be taught in P101.

I'm dropping the class due to personal reasoning (unrelated to the class) but when I have asked or emailed about something he's been understanding. While the teaching is sometimes hard to follow you can see he cares about the student input. I would say to people going to take his class, ask him questions and he'll try his best to answer back.

Professor Dao was a little difficult to understand due to language and her lectures took the majority of the class time. She assigns quizzes, tests, homework, and a paper. She allows a cheat sheet for the midterm and final. I would prefer more hands-on teaching, but just take notes and pay attention. You don't need the textbook but it helps.

She was a nice lady, but overall, she was a terrible teacher. The material was extremely hard, and she did not make it any easier to interpret the information. Everybody was super disrespectful of the language barrier, but they were just mad that she cold called. She was difficult, not helpful, a tough grader, and can't teach stats.

Worst professor I've ever had. Absolutely terrible at explaining concepts and literally no one in my class knew what she was talking about and no one respected her. I dreaded this class and just made it out wanting to pass.

You will not achieve the outcomes of the syllabus but will be perplexed the entire time. He can be very defensive and dismissive if you want to clarify anything. I don't know why he is teaching.

A lot of the negative reviews come from his zoom classes. I took INTL-I220 in-person and it was a great class. Professor Nemes cares about students doing well and is passionate in his lectures. I did not like this professor at all. I took his course online over the summer and it was terrible. His instructions are not clear whatsoever but has the nerve to grade hard. Also, his TA graded some assignments and was also a hard grader. Take another course if you can. Pls save yourself.

The professor doesn't grade anything, the assignments are graded by the TA and the grading criteria is never clear. The TA grades harshly even when the instructions are not clearly stated. Mandatory attendance and lack of assignments. No structure to this class I dont even know what i have learned

reviews.comment: He was just okay. Lectured in class, didnt really interact with the students much, but other than that it was an okay class. Also, class has NOTHING to do with politics- NOTHING.
He showed up late to class on daily basis. We were graded on a few assignments that all had unclear expectations. He did not respond to emails well and took attendance every class.

IF your counselor signs you up for this class honestly do your self the favor and don't take it. This is your fair warning and you will not regret it. I don't know he's still teaching at such a competitive university. There are so many other teachers more qualified and who can actually teach.

Didn't learn anything literally at you will be paying for a credit and a grade and nothing more. His AI wild all the work. He's is never on time and never apologizes for. Get ready for 2nd grade questions on your final because that what hell ask. Had no clue what grade was before the final cause he was holding over half our grades.

Did nothing through the first 10 weeks of class then decides to give us a ton of stuff all at once. Also, lectures are awful. Taking the final tomorrow and my grade is unclear because he hasn't put anything into the grade book.

reviews.comment: There were no assignments until the 12th week of classes, which makes it impossible to have a good grade in the class if you do poorly on only one assignment. None of the readings are relevant in the class until the final, since he covers no material, and rambles on for 75 minutes. Least favorite class by far.

reviews.comment: He is a very funny guy and can be quite entertaining but often he just gets distracted and we rarely go an entire class while actually staying on the subject at hand.

If you want culture and politics, you will be disappointed. We only talk about culture and have generally irrelevant lectures that are large tangents. There is no point in reading because you never get quizzed over it. The TA does all the grading and really all of the work. If you are considering this class, change your mind.

I am currently only halfway through his class and am hating every second of it. He talks down to the students who ask questions for clarification, and makes you feel stupid. There are 5 assignments total. Don't take his classes.

reviews.comment: The class had a total of 100 points which made the little projects have a lot more weight. I don't agree with the grading scale but I enjoyed taking the class and learned interesting things.

He taught Research and Design class for int'l studies majors. His lectures rambled on, group projects dominated the grades, and he was generally unclear when it came to criteria on assignments. He's a cool guy, but his teaching style did not work for me. I still got an A despite group members not pulling their weight so I guess it could be worse.

Nemes is a very intricate thinker that relies on discussio based curriculum for his students. If you do not like discussing complex ideas in a group setting I would steer clear from his courses. Nemes is very intelligent and if you show up and pay attention you will learn a lot, but he very much likes discussion so always take that into considerat

I took this class because i was interested in the topic & needed to fulfill a credit. I am extremely disappointed. Nemes is a cool guy, but the syllabus and assignments are terribly confusing. There is only 100 pts/sem; 25 group, 50 tests, & 25 annotated bib. Would not recommend unless its required for your major
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I enjoy nearly every class I have taken here at IU, except this one. Maybe the dryest class I have ever taken. International studies should be an interesting class but this class came up extreemly short. The Syllabus and assignment papers were ridiculously confusing.

I was nervous about having group projects at first, but if you have a good working group there is no problem. Lectures can feel boring but taking notes is perfect for the 2 exams he gives and his study guides are perfect for prepping.

Lectures are long and boring and about easy subjects, but that's the nature of a 100 level class. Nemes is a very smart guy and very knowledgeable about his subject area, taking a higher level class with him would be interesting. However, he does get a little political sometimes which is annoying.

too much nonsense reading. I was passionate about the topic and I am so disappointed with it now. He gives to much assignments for reading and what he talks about in the class has nothing to do with the reading assignments. He tries so hard to be funny but he isn't but will give a credit for trying. has no power Point presentation, notes, or.......

I had Prof. Nemes for I205 which is the intro class for the Arts and Communication thematic concentration for International Studies.  His class lectures can seem long but he usually tries to make them interesting for students by relating to our means of communication.  Overall he is very interesting to listen too and there is hardly any work do to.

I would not recommend this class  to anyone looking for an easy 100 level class. A ridiculous amount of information has to be memorized for exams. Dr. Nemes is very cool though. Just wish his class was too

I enjoyed the professor himself, but the class was not something I would recommend if you're a discussion based learner.Its a lot of lectures with many concepts and there is no room to be distracted (there is a technology misuse deduction from your grade).If you love group work and lecture note taking then this is for you. If not, then steer clear.

He teaches at Alma college in Michigan. If you can even call it teaching. The lectures are very hard to follow, the verbal barrier doesn't  help. He didn't make us buy a book but I wish he did so I would have something to teach myself with. He gave us the same exam he put online as a practice exam. Class average was a 70%. PS: I hope he reads this

Most people understand that the topic of Macroeconomics is difficult, but he makes it a lot harder. He doesn't clearly explain topics and will  not explain it in a different way. At my college this is an intro economics class that many people have to take but he is teaching it like a a higher level class so people are failing it, NOT GOOD!

The only way you could get him to answer your questions and actually teach you something is to corner him and make him explain it. The class lessons dont flow together and dont actually teach you things that he puts on exams and the exams are extremely hard. You can't even self teach yourself. Dont take this class.

He is one of the worse teachers I have ever head! Even though he might be smart, he has really poor teaching skills: his lectures are disorganized, unclear and a waste of time. He is always behind the schedule and you will not learn a thing without the textbook. If his class is the only one available, wait for the next term!

Never take his class. I understand that his English might not be perfect b/c he's not from the U.S., but I don`t like his teaching style and the disrespectful way he treats his students. He is so condescending, and his lectures are awful. They make no sense at all.

Awful. Uses slides right from the book. doesnt explain the subject well. bad examples. couldnt understand him so taught myself everything from the book. go to class to get the quiz grades (15%) but bring a computer or other work because your not going to learn anything from him.

Classes, not on quiz days, are not worthwhile enough to go all the time. Read the textbook for the tests and the readings for the quizzes and you'll be fine. Better than some stories heard of other Macro profs
Nice guy who wants to see his students do well, some of his examples are a bit fuzzy and unclear but will help you one on one if you need it. I'd say he's one of the better guys to get for E201.
I took Macro over the summer. Class notes/ slides come directly from the book. Just read the book, and your guranteed to do well.
No Comments
Go into his office hours. He is a really nice teacher and can teach you alot better if you are one on one.
He is very hard to understand and extremely difficult.

Prof. Njau is a great geology professor and the textbook he requires for the course is very helpful. I definitely recommend reading the materials before each lecture since the layout of his lectures can be confusing at times. His labs are quite simple, though they do still require effort to get a good grade.
He is a good professor just at times not reachable and neither are his AI's and it can be a hassle but other than that he is good.

I love Jackson, he's a very interesting funny guy. The lectures are kinda boring but the lab is pretty interesting. I would recommend this class and also just talking to Jackson he's very cool, and he likes you more if you put effort in.

Pretty easy class in my opinion. Material was easy to grasp and lectures were clear. It might be hard to pay attention due to just being off slides but if you do pay attention you'll be able to understand everything pretty easily.
Hes him
I love Jackson Njau. He is the best teacher on Earth. Very funny man and easy class. Take this class.

sometimes the lectures can get repetitive but its helpful since there's quizzes after every class. he brings in stuff to look at thats relevant to the class so thats fun. pretty easy you just have to go to class.

Labs are 50% of the class and it's not that difficult to do good on the labs. The only downside is that the slides are very repetitive and boring to listen to. While it is not a difficult class, it is a very boring class lecture wise.

If you are looking for an easy Natural Science credit A then this is a good class for you. Labs are 50% of the grade and they give you most of the answers. Tests are not too difficult if you study and there is almost zero homework. Only downside is Professor Jackson talks in circles and the class is super boring. Its literally a class on rocks.

I took Evolution of the Earth and dont be fooled the class is just about rocks and how they collide. I could have done better if I was interested in rocks. Nice professor he just is confusing to understand sometimes and hard to pay attention to.
He is nice but talks in circles and is not good at translating information.
A very kind professor!
Jackson is one of the most kindhearted people you will meet, the class is not very hard so long as you put in the effort, and he is more than willing to help you at any point when you need it.

Jackson is very knowledgable about the history of Earth and the processes that it has undergone over billions of years. The main problem is that he tends to not give students a significant amount of time to ask questions or interject if they have something to say. The material in the class was interesting but I was hoping for more of a challenge.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Jackson is a nice guy that gives pretty basic lectures. Sometimes it is difficult to understand the point he's making, but he's incredibly upfront about what the important idea is and what is on the test. The lecture is graded by a few scattered assignments, with the bulk of the grade coming from labs, but I found the lectures to be enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Overall a very easy class. Jackson was very sweet and passionate about the material. Definitely manageable to score a high grade. Just make sure you get all of your labs turned in, as they count for a majority of the grade.

Jackson is a very sweet and helpful professor. Although his lectures contain a lot of material and you might not understand at first, he posts the notes online. The class is fairly easy and attendance is non-mandatory, but every so often he will give short in-class assignments which count towards your grade. Overall, its a good class!
This class it really easy and Jackson is really nice. There will be 4-6 random i class assignments that are 10% of your grade.

I had him for Geology last semester.  He's honestly a boring professor but try to show up because he might give a pop quiz every now and then.  The class isn't that hard though so if you want an easy A, this could be an option.

Expect a high B or A in this course, with minimal effort.  The tests require some studying.  Jackson is very boring in general, but nice and helpful.  Attendance is randomly taken.  Some of the lab AI's are completely unreasonable and grade your work like they're grading the work of grad students, so do well in labs.  Overall, pretty easy course.
Genuinely the worst professor i have ever had in my entire life, doesn't teach anything, can't learn anything, makes up his own grades.

His form of in-class notes might not be everyone's cup of tea but he is very available for help outside of class which I would recommend not waiting till the final to take advantage of like I did. Super nice guy, would take another class w him if I wanted to torture myself with more math.
He is a great guy and he is very smart. His lectures are sometimes difficult to follow but if you go to his office hours he will help you a lot. I would recommend taking calc1 with him.

Dr. Mandlik is a really good math professor. As long as you show up to class, do the homeworks, and practice exams you are guaranteed an A on the exam. He left in the middle of the sem due to personal issues, so the new guy we got wasn't great, but if you can, take B110 with Dr. Mandlik!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: MY GOAT he is very reasonable with grades and wants the best for his students. Some people say his accent is a little thick but tbh the course material isnt hard to teach urself. just watch organic chem tutor. this guy is actually my goat and I hate math

He is hard to understand and his notes make no sense. I would not recommend taking him if English is your first language. His notes give a extra problems that won't even be on the exam and rarely line up with the homework
You cant understand or read this guys handwriting. He also has no clue what he's talking about. Avoid him
asks students for answers for his own problems

Had Prof Mandlik for Calc 1. Was a good professor, lectures were alright but homework was never too difficult. Be ready for exams, take all practice exams when they are posted and do the homework and they wont be too challenging. Probably not the most "entertaining" professor but would take again and gets the job done well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a great professor. If you have to take calculus he makes it a good experience. Did notes on iPad so they were easy to read, great lectures. He curved exams on top of giving retakes for all exams. This is the class that allows you to learn from mistakes. The final was very difficult but I could've done better if I prepared more. Utilize MLC!

*Calc 1. Ended up dropping because I failed exam 1 and exam 1 retake. Math is usually my strong suit, but his teaching style is...sort of nonexistent. He rarely explains what is going on and just solves problems on his Ipad. Had to spend hours outside of the class teaching myself content. Recitation wasn't helpful. TA overcomplicated the problems.

I was scared to take Calculus M 211 however because of Nishad Mandlik I am doing well in the class. His teaching style is great and as long as you take notes from lecture you'll do well. Every exam has the opportunity for a retake except the final. One of the best professors I've had at IU. Go to office hours, ASC, and Math department tutoring.

For calc-1*

Someone who took calculus before told me he didnt learn in it. Doesn't go over key concepts enough. Test had 1-2 from the practice exam, some not even on hw and only in textbook. Had to teach myself at home. He's kind. Recitation's also bad, just quizzes. 3+ q's on exam on negative exponents. No talk about those in class and not on hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very Organized, Lots of notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I would never take this class ever again. It was disguised to be a helpful course. But it just ended up being tedious and annoying course to deal with. I always would take more time with other assignments than this class.

She assigns weekly homework; discussion posts, textbook readings, and group projects, and grades them strictly. It doesn't really feel like a college course because she treats students like kids. This class should help students transition into college, not make them feel like they are back in middle school.

She always made the smallest things seem so much bigger. She would blow things way out of proportion. The homework is very tedious and not fun to do but is somewhat easy to do. The reading and discussion posts are somewhat simple but very tedious and not fun to do. Would never take this class again unless I had to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: LLLC-Y102: Mandatory attendance, required events, kitchen cleanings, weekly assignments, multiple projects, discussion posts, and a textbook for a mere 1.5 credit hours. Constant treatment like an elementary student. Not worth it.

Most passive aggressive professor I have ever had. Will snap at students for small things like fidgeting with string or laughing. She will purposefully pick students out in front of the class to lecture. If you reading this you probably are in the technology leadership class and I'm sorry it's a requirement for the llc but good luck

The class felt like a chore to go through every single class period, any noise in the classroom and the class is stopped. Homework was pointless and always added to the stress of dealing with core classes for majors. Although the LLC was a great experience, she made the whole thing feel not worth the money put in

I love the Luddy LLC, but not the class. You're treated like a middle schooler: assigned seats, stopping class for technology use, and mandatory attendance. Never put anything other than you're feeling good on the online attendance because they will email you constantly until you reply that you just had a cold. The class made me want to quit.

Unfortunately, even though this lecture is required for LLC credit, it felt like more work than necessary. Every minute of class is used, the course has a required textbook each week, and some in-class activities felt more like middle school. Many assignments felt unnecessary. This class should inspire learning, not make students dislike coming.

The entire class is set up to be tedious busy work and there is no real skills that can be learned. Along with that she treats her COLLEGE students like middle schoolers, i.e. assigned seating. The TA is much better.

She treats college students as middle schoolers. Assigned seating, tedious busywork, nothing useful is taught. She expects things that are impossible. Not everyone can be a leader at the same time. She also tries to make sure you are sitting next to no one you like.

This class was not hard at all, but the way that this professor went about this course made it ten times harder to sit through than it ever needed to be. Students were treated as if they had never left elementary school, and many students who had this professor agreed she had a major superiority complex. Glad to be done after this next semester.

I'll preface that this class was relatively easy, but by no means was it enjoyable. This class has no real meaning, and she treated us like middle schoolers. All the assignments could be completed in 10-30 minutes and felt like a waste of my time (it a 75 minute lecture). You will dread attending, its only worth is a small GPA boost.

Easiest course; dreadful attendance. You will relapse to second grade. The time slot is longer than a typical course, e.g., math, and when I say you will do nothing productive, I mean it. All work is external, the class is a time waste. It's a 75-minute WikiHow presentation for the easiest assignments, with an attendance QR hidden. Devices away!
She's a stickler on technology and talking but the work is easy and a GPA booster.

The class is extremely easy, but she treats everyone in it like middle schoolers, gets mad or annoyed very easily, and takes things such as talking quietly during class or making jokes about the class itself extremely personally

His lectures are very slow and hard to sit through. His TA is an extraordinarily hard grader; one question wrong takes off like 5-10% of the entire assignment grade. The tests were weirdly difficult, and you definitely have to work for a good grade. I would probably recommend finding a different professor.

I hated the idea of taking stats but he made it approachable. Even when i missed class the videos he uploads allows me to catch up quickly. Tophat is how he figures out participation and attendance which dropped my grade a bit but i still maintained an A so not to bad. he is very easy to talk to if you dont understand something.

he's so funny and kind wanted to take him for stats but can't. attendance is 7% of your grade, your allowed to have a cheat sheet for the exams, lectures are recorded. he is such a. good professor you will want to go to class but if you can't make it there are options.

Love him as a person and as a professor; he has a long way to go in making his lecturing more meaningful. At the moment, it feels as if he has slides with SOO much information, and he is just going over that information, not teaching. You'll get the same thing from just reading the lecture slides as you do from going to the lecture.

Lectures could be pretty boring at times and the class seemed a little slow paced for me personally. However, he tried his best to make it the best for all types of learners whether you needed more or less time and added interesting facts and breaks to break up the material. Exam grading expectations were a little unclear but overall I recommend.

This was his first time teaching P335. He was a great professor, his lectures were very engaging, and he allowed cheat sheets on the exams which made them a lot easier to get through. I recommend actually looking through the extra stuff he includes in each module, it is so interesting to look at, plus it can be used in the tests.

This was his first time teaching this specific course. Attendance is mandatory, but his lectures are super engaging and easy to follow. The exams are hard, but there are only 3, and he allows cheat sheets on them. All in all, I would definitely recommend this course with this professor.

Overall he did a good job of explaining the basic concepts of statistics. Homework is once a week and you have 6 days to do it, and it's all online. There's lecture participation quizzes that are all online and open note. The lecture feedback at the end of the week is easy points. In class exams are all FRQ and take home is using excel and JASP.
Professor Sam does a wonderful job keeping students engaged by asking us questions and his quick sense of humor. I would recommend his classes to anyone.

Sam Nordli is awesome! He is so laid back and wants everyone to succeed. His lectures were straight to the point and he made sure to go over material extremely thoroughly. Tests were one half in class and other half take home (open note and could do it with classmates). Highly recommend this class with Sam!

I really liked professor Nordli, but I hated stats. They say it is not a math class but it is. The homework assignments  are sooooo long, use difficult software, and do not really make sense. I also felt like the grading was very tough. They say that your answer is right, but take off points for it being wrong? It wasn't him though, it was the TA.

Respectfully, he is a nice guy. He'll help you when you ask, not a ton of homework, but it takes at least 2 hours to get it done. The lectures just make no sense, and the review is nothing like what will actually be on the test. I do pay attention and show up, and it isn't enough. i would take online stats or find another professor.

Offered a zoom version of class which was very nice, in case people didn't want to or couldn't come to class. Posts so many resources which is helpful. He is very kind & tries to make stats fun. Lectures were a bit disorganized sometimes though. There are weekly quizzes (6-7 questions), and 1 homework a week.

He is a good professor and obviously knows what he is talking about but at times he would move very quickly through the lectures and would have a difficult time saying what he wanted to say. Very chill and laid back. Super funny guy too. Exams were super easy. Quizzes every week. Very open to feedback.

He was great! Honestly my favorite professor I've ever had. The lectures were detailed, and the slides were helpful and also funny. I was thoroughly engaged, even for it being a stats class. Extra credit was offered, and he was very accessible outside of class. He gives great help, too! Overall a great class and an even better professor.
Funny guy. Gives decent amount of extra credit opportunities. Grades pretty lightly. Attendance taken through Top Hat. Lectures pretty well, exams are almost word for word from lecture material.

He is super laid back and super funny.  He likes memes and includes funny pictures and quotes in his lectures that go along with it.  He explains things very well and you will pass this class if you just attend the lecture and he's always willing to answer any questions and doesn't make you feel dumb.  He's very understanding and accessible.
Very harsh grader and can often not tell you how you actually lost your points, so it baseless.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Put in the effort and you should be fine.
Grades way too hard for a gen Ed English class. Find another professor
Bad teacher and grades way too harshly.
dont take this class.
do not take.
Fun guy, clearly very smart

Professor Snyder wasn't necessarily bad, but there were definitely a lot of times where I was very confused. Our class averages were consistently pretty bad and I found the material to be really hard. Not sure what could really be changed but it's more the material than the professor. Super nice and funny guy though!! Really helpful in office hours

In the online format, this class was really difficult. In person, I think it would be a lot better. Be aware that EVERY assignment except for the midterm projects are group work. You have to learn LaTex and it's super confusing for the first two weeks. Explain EVERY answer on the homework- like a paragraph each if you want full credit.

Noah's really great. I haven't finished the class yet, so I don't yet know my final grade, but I have an A right now, and he has done a terrific job. I took his Calc 1 honors section, and he breaks everything down intuitively and makes you really understand what is happening with most theorems and rules. Not highly recommend, but recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Tough Grader

Every day, I looked forward to coming to this class. I had it for half of a semester, so the workload was a lot, but never too much to handle. I plan on taking more of Professor Denbaum's classes again because it was so enjoyable. Profe cares about her students and tries to make the class as engaging and fun as possible.

Super nice lady and cares a lot about her students.  She speaks really good Spanish for not being a native speaker and is super passionate about what she does.  Participation is important in her class and she doesnt judge anyones proficiency or lack thereof.

Super sweet, definitely cares about students. Put effort into written work, she grades that harder than spoken work. Sometimes a little disorganized. Always ask for rubrics for every assignment. Genuinely kind, Mom energy.
She is the problem with college.
She might be the worst teacher and person I have ever dealt with in my whole life.

She's just the worst. Doesn't give two about her students. She is rude and annoying. If I had to chose between being dropped off a boat in the middle of the pacific and taking her class again I would chose the first option.

Really good proffesor and course! Not to sound pretensious, but CJUS P245 really did change how I see the world and was engaging all the way through.
