We had to buy three books, which I was a little grumpy about at first, but the books are actually really good and informative reads, so I'm happy to have them! I can easily recommend this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. B. She was so funny during lectures and made them less boring by telling funny stories and interacting with the class. Her exams were very straightforward and as long as you reviewed her slides, it is easy to get an A on them.

Dr. MB is really funny and she makes a huge lecture feel small by interacting with us so much. She goes on a lot of random tangents that help to break up the lectures. Her tests are very straightforward, not really cumulative, and there was no finals. There are IA's but they are great. She's really cool and clearly knows what she's talking about.

Honestly, Dr. B deserves a higher rating. As mentioned in other comments, she thinks she's funny (and she is), but her self-awareness is what makes her even more funny. Her lectures are super chill, understandable, and educational. She doesn't trick you on exams (I really appreciate that), and she cares about her students a lot. Take her class!

The worst teacher I have ever had in my entire education career. So rude and unhelpful. Most teachers actually try to help students when they are confused about something in the course/ their grade. Emailed her and she straight up sent me to a website that said "Don't email prof student questions". DOES NOT CARE ABOUT YOUR WELLBEING/ EDUCATION.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class was extremely easy for a 300 level course. Two big exams, both take home, open book, and online. Lectures were very interesting and I feel like I learned a lot. Miriam is very knowledgable as well and HILARIOUS. I'd love to have her as a professor again.

Honestly one of my favorite teachers at IU. As long as you pay attention and actually participate you will do well in her classes. She's really funny which makes lectures interesting, and is clear with what she expects from her classes. She is also very insightful and going to office hours is a very good idea.

More than knowledgeable about the subject and overall not a poor lecturer. However she was upset at the amount of A's in her class and completely changed test formatting halfway through the semester. When students brought the issue to her, she was very rude and defensive in her demeanor.

Honestly one of the worst professor I've had here. She is overly rude, unhelpful, and weirdly paranoid. She somehow managed to make criminal justice boring to the point I dreaded the thought of going to class.

She is hilarious and often keeps the class entertained by telling stories about her family. Attendance isn't mandatory per say since her lectures are all posted online/doesn't take attendance half the time, but it's definitely recommended that you go to class and hear her explain everything more. Exams are pretty straight forward

The content isn't hard it just is hard to pay attention in class. There aren't many tests (3) and only 2 assignments so you can easily mess up your grade. She is your typical professor. There are TAS for the class.
She is a bad teacher. Yells at students despite the fact that they have done nothing wrong. She makes certain promises, then does not follow through on what she said.

I enjoyed this class for the first half of the semester and then she decided to change the way she ran the class, going against her precedent, increasing how hard the class was by making us unprepared for our third exam on purpose and is refusing to curve it, so everyone in the class would not get an A, all so she would look good as a professor.
Very easy class but you must go to it because of random quizzes. Don't bother buying the textbook because you will never use it since her power points are posted online.
Professor Bohmert is amazing. I am a Criminal Justice major and taking this class did nothing but encourage me to pursue a degree from the College of Arts and Sciences

If you need to get gen ed. requirements out of the way, take this class with her. Easiest class I've ever taken. Don't bother buying the textbook, anything that's on the tests can be found in the powerpoint slides, which she posts online. She also doesn't just read off the powerpoint slides and can keep your attention during lectures.

Norman Levenberg is a great guy who is genuinely funny during lectures. Unfortunately, his ability to structure and teach a math class is abysmal. He teaches verbatim to a textbook, assigns copious amounts of homework from said textbook, then gives tests that don't resemble what he taught in the slightest.

I learned more from the Organic Chemist than I learned from this professor. It wouldn't have been a problem if he was ever available, alas it seemed he was always on vacation. I hope nothing bad happens to you, because there are no exceptions to his homework and quiz policy if you miss.

Do not take this class. I spent 18 hours a week outside of lectures for this class and still got median scores (around 50) on the exams. He doesn't have office hours either so you are left to figure everything out on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He makes everything so difficult. This class was is just not it, he gives tons of hard problems on the homeworld and doesn't teach any of those in class. Worst prof ever
Awful at teaching
Have fun looking every problem up in your homework if you have him he teaches you nothing and makes me what to kms.

In my own words let's say he was teaching a kindergarten class and taught them what 1 + 1 was and how to do easy addition then in the homework and test he gives you 50 x 3 + 2 - 1 / 4. He gives you the most easy explanation and then expects you to know everything he knows because he is lazy and is only there to get paid.

Professor Levenberg is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about math, however this makes class intense. His lectures move quickly, so be prepared to spend much time studying outside of class. Grading can be harsh since only quizzes and tests are taken into account, however class participation is valued.
This class is insanely hard if you don't enjoy math. I gave him 4 stars just because I have absolutely no reason to dislike him other than how hard this class is.

Norm is a horrible professor. His handwriting on his lectures is essentially illegible. His ability to explain concepts is poor and he often in his own words is lazy in finishing problems on the lecture slides. His exams are written to be incredibly difficult and the average is always a failing grade, sometimes below 50%.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He treats this class like everybody is a math major and nobody is a full time student. He expects you to be an expert in trigonometry and prior calculus, which is just not realistic for anybody other than a math major. I find it difficult to find time for my other classes because of the workload and the tests have material we hardly covered.
Avoid at all costs. Makes tests ridiculously difficult compared to other profs and moves extremely fast in lecture. Go to office hours and use Khan academy if you want to end with a decent grade.

I do not recommend taking norm for calculus. He is funny and engaging with the class, however his exams hardly ever are over the material you covered in class or in your homework which makes the class extremely difficult
Norm explains everything clearly with plenty of examples. He effectively prepared to me to succeed on the exams in the class. Would recommend and he's hilarious!

Norm is one special gem. And a real looker too! Norm really knows how to maintain the attention of his students and really makes M119 a breeze. I would highly recommend him for Calculus I. He really knows what he is talking about and is absolutely hilarious! Gotta love Norm!
He knows what he is talking about and explains it clearly  and gives students many opportunities to ask questions
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He does fly through the material. Highly recommend rewriting your notes to review what was learned in class and go through the problems at your own pace. He gives a lot of homework, but helps you understand how to do the problems. If you've taken Calculus before, he's a pretty good professor.

Prof Levenburg is obviously very knowledgeable but teaches fast. Littleno partial credit on exams. Only 1 midterm and 1 final exam. If you show up and work hard on homework though, he will do whatever he can to help you. Grades more like a grad school class. Plus he is super nice. I'd say take upper level math classes from him, not lower level

Norm is definitely interesting, but he is a horrible teacher. He sped through the material and expected you to know a lot of calculus concepts already. The test questions were much more difficult than the in-class and homework problems. I learned more the day he was gone and the TA taught the class. Don't take M119 with him!
He uses so many examples in class and he makes the concepts very easy to understand. he doesnt curve tests and has 5 pop quizzes. loved him

DO ANYTHING BUT TAKE NORM FOR 119. He flies through the syllabus, he doesn't explain the concepts well and his tests are extremely hard. The grading curve isn't much of a help. I would advise you not to take him. I'm stuck with him and can't wait to see the end of the class.
Do not take M119 with Norm Levenberg!Tests are nothing like the hw or the test reviews.

Horrible. I had not taken calculus before this, but was told I didn't need to. It would've greatly helped, since Norm just expects you to understand everything before. He does not do a good job teaching, writes tiny, gives pop quizzes on the board that no one can read, and his tests are way harder than any other teacher's. DON'T take him.

Professor Levenberg is an interesting professor. I recommend if you're not strong in calculus to NEVER take M119 with Levenberg. He flies through the material with no respect to the student. In my opinion, he should not be a teacher, but he is very intelligent. Good luck if you're stuck with him! May the odds be ever in your favor.

I'm currently enrolled in Norm's M119 class now. Almost all of the reviews are accurate. He really does start the first class off by saying not to email him. I had my first exam last week in his class and the first class after the exam, he taught us one of the questions on the exam. It was from a chapter that we werent responsible for knowing.

I have always been good at math, but it's been 3 years since my last math class, so I needed some refreshing...but he was so awful at teaching. He assumed we knew things that most of us did not. He's so excelled in math that he's not good at teaching it. And he write tiny on the chalk board so good luck seeing; even from row 2.
Very little to no help to students. Knows what he is talking about but class is unbearable.

He is horrible, he knows his stuff..but is no help when you don't understand it. If you go to his office hours he is not helpful and just does problems the same way he did in class. Also he makes you feel incredibly stupid if you don't understand something. I would not recommend you take him. Over half our class was gone after mid-term!

He knows his stuff. It does seem that he doesn't often see the class from the point of view of people that do not know the material before hand, such as students. So, he moves very quickly and frequently assumes everyone else is on the same page.  It's manageable for me, but I took Calc in high school.
Norm is probably the worst teacher I've ever had. Don't take his class if you want to survive math.
hated him, he cannot teach for the life of him. however, i did love his running outfits he wore to class
Terrible Professor. He is the reason why I had the worst grade of my life.

His class was challenging. The tests were difficult only because of how they were graded. If you miss one question, 7 points are deducted?-no partial credit. The midterm and final exams were difficult too. Norm is obviously knowledgeable, but the material he covers in class doesn't often come up in exams. If your good at calc, you'll do fine.

This class has made me hate calc.  Honestly, the man is a joke.  He doesn't explain the material and doesn't seem to care about the class in general.  AVOID his class if you don't want to spend countless hours teaching yourself.  Also, if you want to save yourself the disgust of seeing a man wear short shorts and cutoff shirts AVOID his class.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!! He is absolutely horrible. I got a B with Norm after getting an A in my highschool calc class. Norm does not explain things clearly at all. He starts the class by telling you never to email him. He is very unprofessional and wears holey cut-offs and short shorts to class. If you want to understand, avoid his class.
Norm is terrible and should not be allowed to teach. He isn't very helpful, and discourages you from emailing him. I don't mind challenging instructors, but Norm is simply awful.

Norm is an awful teacher, he writes ridiculous tests that half the class fails and he curves them by maybe by 4%. I barely squeaked by with a B- only cuz i aced the final and midterm- which he didn't write. My lowest grade besides calc was a 95%. AVOID NORM AT ALL COST! AT ALL COST! he's a GPA wrecker

If you struggle with math, get the hell out of his class.  The book taught me more then Norm did all yea.  His shorter then should be jogging shorts and cut off t-shirts are very distracting. If you're happy getting a grade you didn't want, and willing to read every lesson from the book, then you can do okay in this class.

Largest gray t-shirt collection on this side of the Mississippi.  He would be a great teacher if I was a mathematician, but sadly I am not.  I hardly understand his language.  Plus his hairy shoulders are distracting when he wears his cut-offs.
Dr. Levenberg is a conscientious prof who works very hard for his students. Who cares how he dresses, not relevant. I am thankful I had him. Losers who are failed students diss him. He is great!!!

Norm is a terrible teacher.  He doesn't teach.  He simply goes over examples over and over.  If you dont understand what he is doing on the board then you are out of luck. He is virtually unavailable for help and simply does not care.

Creepy outfits aside, he is a not a good teacher. Does not teach formulas! Does not prepare you for the midterm at all. He will answer questions if you go in for office hours, but the tests are still impossible.
Funny guy

He was my first math professor i had so i dont really have anything to compare him to. There are a few things i can tell without comparison. If you cant figure the problems out on your own you will not be able to succeed. Another he thinks he is funny but when you dont understand (or failing the class) it is not funny, its serious.
He uses notes from one of his friends and goes extremely fast
Do not take him. Do not take him. Do not take him. I feel as if I was cheated out of my grade. He's by far the hardest M118 teacher. Tests are very hard.

Hardest teacher in the Math department, look for someone else or wait a semester. First half of the semester is difficult, and the tests are impossible! Mid-term and Final are easier because he doesn't make them. P.S. wears the same 2 outfits, cargo shorts and a MICHIGAN t-shirt
He was hilarious and very helpful. You never use the book and don't have to show up (as long as you make a friend in the class). Pop quizzes make for easy points, all homework is online.

This was the hardest class I had ever taken in college.  Levenberg is not very helpful.  The first half of the class seems to be the "weed out" part.  After the mid term it gets much easier.  Tests are REALLY hard and now calculators are not allowed. Take this class as seriously as possible especially for bus majors bc getting a B will be hard.
No Comments
WORST teacher i have had in my entire life.  DO NOT take this class with him!  i would take an 8 am friday before taking his class. seriously.
Great at explaining in depth questions with examples!

Strange man.  I still don't know what "junk times stuff" has to do with Calculus. His witty sayings like that were never helpful.  Get to class early, so you can catch up with all the problems he writes on the board before class even starts.  Hey Norm, have you ever heard of making outlines?  All the professors are doing it...except you.
Not helpful whatsoever.  Tries to entertain more than teach and glazes over every subject, working problems that have no helpful impact on most webwork let alone departmental exams.
stands in front of what he writes on the board, wears cut-off tees and shorts, gives pop quizzes, hard to hear, not available, my least favorite class

Goes through material quickly and at a rigorous pace. But, always willing to answer your questions in class and at office hours. He wears his running clothes to lecture. OMG...his short shorts and muscles shirts are freakin' wierd. And he has as much body hair as a silverback gorrilla. But he is a great guy!!
Very good teacher! He really break it down and goes fairly slow so you can learn the material!

I would not recommend Prof. Levenburg he was unable to convey class material in a digestable manner. I only passed because i could read the text,which wasn't helpful. His class policies also only hurt your grade.
No Comments
Flat out I don't like him.
Terrible teacher, does not teach well, is not helpful, moves to fast, and finally does not prepare you well enough for possible exam material.
he was absolutely horrible, and yes, he really didn't wear any shoes
He was the worst math teacher I've ever had.

Moves fast, and talks with abstract variables when teaching equations.  You have to pay close attention to make sure you understand everything.  Nice guy, pretty cool but do not screw around in class as he will come embarass you (don't leave early either, he will call you out)
HE Sucks!!!
bad

He moves way too fast. If someone asks a question he uses ridiculous math terms that no one understands. He's hairy, gross, and doesnt wear shoes. The quizzes' and tests' grading scales are stupid. I had to drop his class and pick up an 8 week course. Grr.

Comes to class in jogging clothes then takes off his shoes.  Has hair all over his body.  Uses a slideshow to explain everything which doesnt really help.  Finite is hard to understand anyways and he doesnt make it much easier.  At least he is American and not completely boring.

Not bad as far as math teachers at this school go. If you go to class and do the webworks, you should have no problem. His reviews for tests are helpful because he goes over exactly what you need to know. If you have trouble in math or don't care, you will have a problem no matter who you have, at least he is American.
I had Levenberg for Finite, his lectures are hard to follow.  His tests are somewhat simple, and his quizzes are basically his way of taking attendance.
Dont expect to get much help from him in his office hours. He is extremly unhelpful when it comes to student relations.

Words cannot describe the incoherency and uselessness of his teaching methods...  he moves EXTREMELY quickly through lectures and inadequetely covers and explains the material of the day, and he does not go and show how to actually solve the problem, merely quickly saying how and then moving on.
No Comments

Nico is a GREAT professor. He is very strict about doing the work on your own and attendance, but then for the rest he's very kind. He is taking a lot of his time to help you and always makes you feel good about your work. He grades very fairly, he admits his mistakes and he is very funny. I really hope I can have him again in the future.

Great professor with a lot of empathy. He is strict about certain things like attendance/participation and doing the work on your own, but he's very dynamic, passionate and caring. He is very engaging and creates a safe climate for language learning. I think he's been the best professor I've had so far.
Nico Noe is the FINEST professor I've ever had. Just being able to look at him during class made all the homework and participation worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher. So genuine and really cares about the students. A very good example for future educators and I enjoy going to his class.

Dr. Nussbaum was incredible. I really enjoyed taking this class online with him because he made it organized and had some really great lectures. He also was very understanding when I had to ask for an extension on an assignment. There is a good amount of reading but the topics are important, especially since they are on the teacher licensing exams
Professor Nussbaum is extremely supportive and understanding. Instructions were clear, and he grades generously. Although completely virtual, I extremely enjoyed this class and his teaching.

THE BEST PROFESSOR. I have never rated a professor ever but this professor was worth it to me. He has such a beautiful soul and is SO understanding. I felt like he wanted all of us to succeed which inspires me as a future educator. He pushed us into deeper thinking and had great wisdom. Highly recommend!

THE BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE HAD! Although the class was asynchronous, he always responds to emails and the class itself was super easy. I felt like I am learning all the information without going overboard or getting tired of the info. From his recordings he seems super kind and funny and genuinely cares. As long as you participate you will do good.

I took K435 for my coaching minor and it was a surprisingly interesting class. You don't need to take any notes and there's only one "test" at the end, but there are a lot of papers. They aren't long ones, the max was 800 words, but you will have one every week. He was very entertaining to have

Professor Nussbaum is the best. Class was always super fun, no notes, just participation. He cares about all his students and makes learning fun. Very laid back and a good all-around atmosphere. Only work is a short paper over a reading due before the second class of every week. Highly recommend taking this class

I took this class for my minor, and Prof. Nussbaum was wonderful. The class was very laid back and the atmosphere was just fun. Kind of more like a HS classroom. No notes, just participation is expecting. Some reading a papers, but basically if you write a paper and give it some thought, you'll get points. Never worried about my grade in this class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Nubli is an excellent K201 instructor. While the content can be tedious... attend ALL the lectures, do your homework, and you will succeed in this class. Nubli presents the content with great detail and is very open to answering questions. He provides really great review materials for exams (slideshows with exam tips, additional practice exams)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super good dude. His class is slightly fast paced but I imagine every K201 class is. Go to class, pay attention and don't fall behind, and if you need the help get it before you advance to an even harder unit.
Great dude. Just show up and pay attention, because his lectures are very helpful.
Be prepared for lots of dry dad jokes. Grading is fair and if you show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: did not find him to be very kind or understanding

He is a grading Nazi, but he's amazing. The video final project sucked, but be sure to work with people you can rely on and stand to work with. He's helpful if you put forth the effort to go to him for help. Besides, 215 beats a year of 200 and 250

He's enthusiastic about Italian, almost too enthusiasic. Really doesn't want us to speak English at all, but I feel like that could be helpful when we don't understand something. He's a good teacher, but not the easiest out there.

Terrible. Do not take any class he teaches. He's a total dweeb. The classes and tests are hard. You have been warned. I've found that your success in the Department of Italian is contingent on who you take the class with. I'd recommend Alicia Vitti. She's fair and understand you are a STUDENT and not a native speaker.
Challenging but fair.  Excellent class.
He is very tough grader, but an awesome teacher. He will teach you a lot but do not expect to get an A. It is very difficult class.

Class was disorganized and prof. dean showed very little enthusiasm for teaching. The labs themselves were fine and honestly the class content isn't horrible but the organization makes it super frustrating. If you need to take 337 good luck because he is pretty much the only teacher.

Do not take this lab with this professor. He does not care about students and makes the worksheet out of one point. You either get one point or a zero. The optional extra credit quizzes are nearly impossible and never responds to emails. Good luck if you do decide to take this course. You'll definitely need it.

It's terrible. Every assignment is out of 1 point. Notebooks are an easy 1/1 as long as you include everything he asks for. Worksheets are a nightmare. You'll spend hours on a worksheet and get a 0/1 with little to no explanation as to why. Not fair to students. Terrible at replying to emails. Optional quizzes are near impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: WORST PROFESSOR IVE EVER HAD!!! Took this part online and his canvas page looked like it was made by a elementary school student. If possible do not take this with him!!!! He does not prepare whatsoever for your assignments
I'd give him a zero out of five if it was possible.

Honestly one of the worst professors I've had at IU. My lab class averaged a 50% on our first two lab reports and he didnt care. The exams are completely irrelevant to what was taught in lecture. The people saying he was good definitely got easy grading AIs. Cross your fingers and hope you get a good AI if you have to take him.

If you are a student that is pre-need, and is actually smart enough to be pre-need, you will get an A in the class. The tests are easy if you understand the concepts in C117( got As on both) and the worksheets are applying concepts you learn in C127. Everyone that gives him a bad rating are people whos grades didnt get rounded up at the end.

The absolute worst class I have and most likely will EVER take. Norman makes the class way more difficult than it needs to be for a 100 level. The midterm and final are not relevant to anything learned in lab. He does absolutely nothing to prepare his students for the exam. Avoid this professor at all costs. No amount of effort is enough to do well

He is an awful professor. No matter the amount of effort you put in to the hw and tests your grades will not reflect it. He does not have a straight forward grading criteria. The AIs grade all differently. The midterm and final are extremely hard.

Was by far the worst professor I've ever had at IU. He doesn't care about his students and actually takes pride in his students doing poorly. The lectures are not helpful and the assignment instructions are unclear.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: His exams are very hard and are nothing like what is done in class. His lectures are literally word for word from the book yet his exams are completely different from problems gone over in class. Avoid this professor at all costs.

He uses the slides provided from the book, so there is legit no need to go to class. The book sums everything up. The discussions are not helpful. We essentially do worksheets and the AI has no idea how to answer our questions. The exams are tough and sometimes you have 90 problems due, an exam, a lab report, and a quiz , all due in one week.
Taking his class made me question why I was a Chemistry education major, as well as my existence.

Norman Dean is teaching an unnecessarily difficult course. The fact that this course is 100 level is totally misleading - if you aren't on top of your game you will do poorly. Exams aren't as bad as people suggest, you just need to know / refresh material from C117. I actually did worse on the labs than the exams (I aced both). Get a good AI.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: If you can take the class with anyone else, do it. I would say this counts for any class Dr. Dean is teaching. I have not had a more incompetent professor in all of college.

Lectures are fine. Material is fine. Labs are kind of cool. Quizzes are based on reading and are fair. Exams SUCK. they are full of trick questions and material that was not covered. Your only hope is a good AI. My understanding is that if you are CHEM or BIOL you cant avoid him. So go to office hours and make sure to do well on quizzes labs.

I hated this man. He was awful. He didn't give you anything to go off of for exams, and would deliberately try to trick his students into doing badly. I tried to talk to him at office hours and he was horrible. AVOID.

Norman's lectures are pointless, but I went and he would sometimes give out answers to pre-lab quizzes.  Grade depends on your AI.  Mine graded easily and gave us old test questions for midterm & final that he would sometimes reuse for the next year.  His tests aren't impossible if you go through introduction and post-labs carefully.

He seems a bit arrogant and does not make himself available to students, so your whole experience with his classes will be dependent on your AI. His lectures are not necessary because everything is explained in the lab procedures posted on canvas. His tests are very difficult to study for, but not impossible.
Dr. Dean is one of the most caring professors at IU. He is VERY intelligent, and his office hours are a great resource!
Studying for the midterm and final is near to impossible because one does not for sure know what will be on the exam. Best advice is to do really good on all pre and post labs to get the points.

I found it really hard to study for his exams-you never really knew what to expect. Focus on understanding the purpose of the experiments and know the lab protocols very well in order to get a good grade. To get an A make sure you put in a lot of time on the lab write-ups/post lab questions since they make up most of the grade.
Everyone seems to hate him but he is actually a really awesome dude. His tests are hard but he compensates with ridiculously easy labs that make up most of your grade.

His lectures cover info that is sometimes useful, so I recommend going to them, but if you miss a few, it's no big deal. I had an amazing AI who seemed to really dislike Norman Dean just as much as the students did, so he really did his best to help us out. Grade heavily depends on who your AI is. Dean himself doesn't do much for you/your grade
Could have been worse. Dr. Dean tries to be friendly & helpful, but students seem to receive him poorly. Exams are tough, but I've heard they have gotten easier over the years.

Midterm and finals are not as bad as everyone says, though I agree that Norman does not prepare you very well for them. Tests are rigorous and thoroughly test your understanding of underlying chem behind each lab. Grading is unfair since most important grades will be your lab reports, which are graded by A.I of varying strictness.

Norman Dean is the worst professor I have ever has at IU. His exam are ridiculous and he himself takes no pride in his students doing well on his exams. Luckily, I had an amazing AI that helped me with the post labs and questions during lab. He was the reason I got a B in the class. Overall, Dr. Dean is a horrible professor.

This class is hard, but not impossible. Your grade depends on who your lab AI is and how they grade your post labs. The exams are impossible and the only thing that helped me to study them was to go through the pre-lab quizzes.

Honestly, the lab itself is not difficult. Many people do not attend the once-a-week lectures but they are actually extremely beneficial to your understanding of the following week's lab. However, his midterm and final are RIDICULOUS. You are allowed to use your lab notebook on them but some of the test material is not relevant to the labs at all.

Norman Dean does not care about his students. He doesn't care if they pass or not. Every email I ever sent him received no response, and asking questions during lecture result in the students embarrassment because of the way Norman Dean treats them. What sucks is that you need his class for C127 lab, there's no way around it. So just be ready.

I would suggest going to lectures unless you want to study the experiments outside of class. The test questions are all related to the concepts that he explains in the lectures and that you have to know to understand the chemistry of the experiments. If you attempt to understand what is going on and do the post-labs etc., it should be an easy A.

Dr. Dean is not a very strong professor at all. The lectures give you some concepts that you should study for the midterm/final, but they usually have no relevance to the lab. You will spend most of the lab time trying to figure out what you are even doing. AI's are no help. Don't bother studying, exam questions have little relevance to lab.
The midterm was impossible not even worth your time to study because nothing on it was taught in lab

Attendance to the lecture is not mandatory, but very helpful if you are wanting to succeed in the lab. Attendance to the lab section is not required, but if you'd like to pass you must go to complete the lab and the corresponding materials. Going to the lab, participating in the lab, taking notes, and attending lecture will be very helpful.

Course is difficult not due to the material but you do not know what you will be tested over, as the tests usually cover things that were not really discussed in class. AIs grade lab reports and can vary from different AIs. Would highly recommend to go to all review sessions as he often gives insight into the tests.

Your grade depends on who your AI is. I had a tough AI who graded harshly but my friends had sweet ones who graded nicely. However, professor dean was nice enough to bump my grade up which helped. The pre-lab quizzes were awful, but he gave some information about them. As long as you attend lecture and labs, you will be fine.

Worst class I've ever taken and worst professor. He acts like all the students are stupid and he has so much more knowledge that he is doing us a favor by giving bad grades. Unfortunately, this class is mandatory for science majors so be ready to not learn anything and to not get a good grade even if you try. I don't have anything good to say...

What is wrong with the tests in the course? It does not matter how much you study, it seems almost impossible to get a good grade in the tests. Horrible class. I barely learned anything, and the tests were just plain awful.

Most of his lectures have little to nothing to do with the actual class.  The lab reports are not too difficult, but that is undone by the difficulty of the the midterm and final (which account for roughly 30% of your grade).  Most of the midterm and final are based off obscure conceptual details from the experiments, which makes preparing tough.

Tests are pretty difficult but they're not worth that much so it won't affect you greatly.  Just nail the lab reports and you should at least get a B.  With an average amount of effort I got an A-.  By the way don't go to his lectures because they are absolutely useless.
Not helpful one bit. Makes tests that have nothing to do with what you did in lab. lectures are long and boring. Not sure how he still has a job. Absolutely terrible teacher to deal with.

Easily the worst professor I have ever had. He will say things in class (like "there will be a curve for the class") only for his head AI to contradict him. So basically you have a very unclear way of how you will be graded. If you can get any other teacher for this class, it is in your best interest to do so.

Norman Dean is a worthless professor. No one passes his exams, he is on academic probation, he will not help you with anything, and has to curve the class to cover himself. There are only two exams and they are the most vague, unrelated questions you could imagine. Avoid him at all costs.
His test are horrible. He grades very harshly. He has to curve very much in order to look better, because he is on academic probo. NOTgreat at all

He just shows up to lectures and is very unclear about what we are to do. Gets aggigated when students ask him for help. Not sure why IU keeps him around. My lab AI is the only reason I even got a C in that course.

I had heard of the horrors of Dr. Dean, if he even deserves to be called a doctor, but I was skeptical. The first lecture was ok, but the rumors were soon confirmed. Dr. Dean is the saddest excuse for a professor ever. He is extremely condescending, not at all helpful, and is generally just rude. Change your major before you take his class.

Professor Dean is not very helpful at all. Try not to ever interact with him. Attending lectures are your only hope of passing the tests. Take very good notes. Study all of the lab worksheets and take his practice tests to do well. I got lucky and had an AI that grades the long lab reports pretty fairly but my friends weren't that lucky.
Dr. Dean is not the most helpful. His AI's all grade differently and there is no structure to the grading.

Dean is terrible. The labs werent explained in lecture at all. Barely any guidelines were given for lab reports and the grading is done by AI's who have no idea what they are doing. The two exams look like they cover material that we did in labs, but no matter how much you study, its almost impossible to do well.

Dr. Dean is NOT that bad, and you barely interact with him anyway. Go to lecture and AI office hours, research labs beforehand if possible, and have a good attitude. It's a difficult class but it's not impossible.

The actual lab reports, post labs, and pre-labs are what saves everyones' grades. A majority of the class failed the final (he said there would be a curve, I think it was curved about 3 or 4 points). Best advice: work your butt off in labs, on lab reports, and post-lab assignments. Don't rely on tests for anything. Going to lecture is 50% helpful.

Offered to regrade the final exam that the AI's originally graded, never got back to me, and didn't regrade it at all. Left my grade the way it was which I believe would have been higher had he actually cared to keep up with his offer.
Extremely inconsistent and lazy. Awful professor.

Norman Dean is not a good professor at all.  He has a sense of arrogance that makes him completely unable to relate to students and not a good resource for help.  He will make you look and feel stupid for asking questions and even act mad that you did so.  His lectures are long and painfully boring, and his tests are pretty tough.  Class was curved

The final exam was entirely unrelated to the chemistry that we learned in lab. This is an introductory chemistry course and I was expected to understand chemistry that we didn't even cover in lab. The practice exams are also nothing like the actual exam you will take. AVOID if at all possible!!

I have never seen a teacher ask test questions so loosely correlated to a course's content. Many do not relate to the labs or lectures at all. Not sure how this is justifiable.  Score well on your post-labs because no one does well on tests.

This was a very subjective class and your grades are highly dependent on AI's.  Tests are very hard, especially given the fact that you never know what will actually be on them.  The grading of them is also very mysterious and not very well structured.  Post-lab grades are also very dependent on your AI.  This class lacks structure and uniformity.

An overall difficult class. Success in lab is very much dependent on your AI. The problem is that the prof doesn't prepare students very well for application type questions on the exams, which is all we're really tested on. He speeds through notes and there aren't nearly enough practice problems to help you prepare.

basically you have to reteach yourselves everything you know about chemistry. His test are the most random collections of question that half the time dont even go with what we "learn" through the lectures and the labs
his exams are ridiculously tough and no amount of studying can prepare you for them.

Dr. Dean is not as bad as everyone makes him seem to be. The fall 2014 C-127 seems to have been partially revamped, making the class somewhat easier than previously. Put plenty of effort in initially and then gauge where your grade is and where you want it to be. The tests can be difficult, but group and head AI office hours were helpful.

Get ready to rely on your AI. Dean is the only intro chem lab professor, so if you're a science student, you will have him. He writes his exams the morning of which basically consist of free response questions sort of related to the labs you've done. Pad your grade with good prepost lab scores by going to your AI's and prepare for hard exams.

Dr. Dean. Upon the utterance of his name the words conjured include terrible, horrible, annoying, gross, unhelpful, stupid, and destroyer of everything fun you thought chemistry would be. Get ready for tests that ask about things no one has ever learned ever in multi-paragraph essays. Crying, clawing of eyes, and extreme depression included free.

Professor Dean's lectures teach very little to help you write a lab report about what you do during labs. The extent of his usefulness does not go much beyond providing the procedure and safety tips. After that, you are for the most part on your own unless you have a good AI. His tests don't correlate well with post-lab assignments.
Dr. Dean is extremely fair and really cares about students. I think a lot of students are not prepared for this class and that's why they struggle.
Norman Dean assumes that you've have an amazing background in chemistry and so tests you over things that you probably have never seen in class. Get ready to teach yourself chemistry.
A very helpful professor, willing to help if you have questions.

Dr. Dean is a good professor despite what people have said before. I was nervous about him being tough, but he is a really great guy. The class has changed a bit since the 13-14 year. Pre and post labs are a lot easier and attendance is not required. If you need help he will definitely help you.

Norman Dean actually goes out of his way to TRY to make students fail. He is completely out of touch with students, teaching, and reality. His exams are schizophrenic with no way to effectively study for them. If you are required to take the class be sure to get an AI that speaks english well. Tip, secure a TUTOR immediately if required course.

Attending lecture is not necessary to receive A's on lab reports or understanding how to do lab. All the required information is in the write up. He does not respond to emails from students. Exams are beyond difficult, not because of the material, but because he is very ambiguous and does not specify what needs to be studied. Brace yourselves

Norman is the worst professor at IU.  He told the AI's that the students should be failing the class.  Lectures do not help at all, he just talks about what he posts online.  Thankfully, I had an awesome AI who helped during lab and graded really nicely, ending up with A's on assignments but failing the exams.  Let's hope there's a curve.

Such a horrible teacher. He is not helpful at all and his exams have been the hardest I have ever taken! He does not explain material and pulls random questions out of nowhere and tests you over them. I have averaged A's and B's in the lab portion but because of the midterm and final, I will be lucky to even pass this course.

Lectures are pointless. I attended the first two and decided to never go again, because they were that useless. The questions on the exam do not all relate to the labs, and the exam is open ended. Though, later exams are being changed to multiple choice, because this exam average was a C-. Labs are easy, the two exams are the difficult part.

He is a cynical man who enjoys the agony coming from failing students. Attended Saturday sessions because this is the only way to get him to teach. Great head AI but I can tell he hates him too. Go to office hours with an AI who isn't extremely full of themselves and just pray you make it through.

He is the worst! his lectures are pointless. He has an optional saturday class that is actually not optional if you want to pass. Many things he says in the saturday class are not repeated to the full class in lecture. Most of your grade will depend on if you get a good AI who actually speaks english.
He is an awful professor, heard he's getting fired.  My grade won't be saved but at least students in the future will have a better chance at learning

The concepts are relevant, the labs are okay. The issue is the disconnect between Prof. Dean and the rest of the world. He is cheerful during class, but disrespectful and uncooperative outside class. I have received almost perfect scores on the Labs/reports. Got an AVERAGE grade on the exam, D, and will  get a C. This class is a major requirement.

I took this class last summer, and Dean was in charge of lecture. Being a summer class, the material was kinda cut down. But I do like how he writes out everything on the board, and will stop and go back if there are questions. I have had more clear instruction, definitely, but he isn't terrible. Make sure to keep up with the problems.
Disappointed to see he is still teaching even if he does have someone else assisting.  Not because I am mad about my grade, but because the cycle of his awfulness will continue.

Lectures pointless. Promised a curve for the class multiple times and never applied one. Some info on the midterm & final was never taught. Happy with D averages on tests. Doesn't communicate well with AIs. Expectations not clearly explained. Has review sessions before writing the tests. Awful. Try your best to never have him

WORST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD AT INDIANA UNIVERSITY. I got an A on all my pre labs, post labs, and lab reports, but got a C in his class because his midterm and final exams are terribly difficult. He does not curve these exams either, no matter how poor the average is. Nor does he respond to emails when students want extra help or assistance.

Professor Dean is one of the worst professors I have ever had. He does not care about student grades and he acts condescendingly towards students. He tests over material not taught in class and he grades the tests harshly. Try to avoid him if you can.

The professor's lectures were useless. He failed to describe anything clearly. The grading on the labs was extremely difficult as he refused to hand out rubrics beforehand. Tests were also very hard because the problems were never covered anywhere else in class.

If you want to sit through a lecture with no attendance that has nothing to do with anything useful, take a midterm and a final over nothing he has ever taught in lab or lecture with 20 point questions that are impossible, and a class that offers no rubrics or helpful advice toward lab reports, exams, or lab practicals, then I highly suggest him.

Professor Dean is legit the worst professor I've ever had. His lectures are completely useless; you learn nothing in them whatsoever. For the biggest lab of the semester, he told the AIs to not help us at all and to actually tell us that we didn't have to do certain things when we did. Don't take this class if you care about your GPA.

He gives out grades without telling you what he wanted. It's like guessing what a random number generator is going to pop out; the right answer is 'a number' and that's the closest you get to help. The best you can do is put all information humanity has accumulated, ever, on the lab reports and tests, then maybe you'll get an A. Maybe.

Everything that has been written so far is a dead on description of prof. Dean. His lecture are useless and he just rambles at you, review session are hopeless and midterm was impossible. He is not helpful so unless you have an AI who is willing to help you out, you will struggle in this class regardless of how well you do in 117. He is awful

Dr. Dean is terrible. He only teaches one class, and he should be teaching 0 classes.  His help session are not helpful.  He is averaging an overall rating 1.0 for a reason.  The chemistry isn't hard, but he makes it hard to understand.  He isn't fair in his grading. He decided not to curve our midterm which averaged a 65%. Try to avoid.

He is the worst teacher I have ever experienced. I completely understand the chemistry behind each experiment (A+ in C117) and yet Dr Dean confuses me. He also made my lab AI lower all of the grades in my lab section (because it was above the average) without reading any of our lab reports to see if he disagreed with my AI's grading.

The. Worst. Dr. Dean doesn't care at all about how the students do in his class. The midterm/final was ridiculously hard and his lack of providing any type of rubrics for the lab reports or other work proved his unwillingness to help any. He would just say GO and then grade horribly. His lecture is very boring and completely useless. Avoid him.

He is not helpful to the students whatsoever.I think this approach helps us in the long run though. The exam was crazy difficult, but if you TRULY THOROUGHLY understand why the chemistry is happening, then you should be good. I believe the above negative responses are students who are not accustomed to this level of difficulty.
Literally doesn't care about how terrible exam scores are and even laughs when class averages are low. Completely useless as a professor.

He will be of no help to you at any point throughout the semester. He is not concerned with how his students are doing or how they feel about the course. I asked him a question about a lab once and his response, was rude, unhelpful, and condescending. The average exam scores were low C's and high D's. Overall,  worst professor I have had.
Terrible professor. Constantly contradicts himself. Review sessions make the tests harder to take. Refuses to explain material and answer questions

Professor Dean is extremely unorganized, lacks the ability to explain things clearly, he is unable to understand the needs of his students, the list could go on forever. NEVER take a class with Professor Dean

He once lectured about why you should never give someone CPR. He is legit the worst person ever. Don't take him your first semester, you won't be ready for such a terrible man. Take bio or something. Everyone hates him. He's unreasonable and teaches you NOTHING.
Don't waste your time going to his useless lecture. He somehow turns what should be an easy lecture into impossible because he's an ass. Awful. Just awful.

He cared about how well students did, but did not teach well. Would get confused, ask students if he did problems right, and think too much of himself nonetheless. I got a good grade, but I learned entirely from the book. Take another prof. Him caring isn't enough to get good grades.
Many people scored well even though always absent from class. He is an easy going prof. But, if you are really want to learn something new, go for another.
You Can Get A+ Even You Do Not Attend Class. He Is Not A good teacher, but is a good person who can give you very little homework and very easy Exam!

He is a very good professor! He sets easy tests and 20% of your grade counts towards webwork which he hardly gives (1 every 2 weeks). He helps you out a lot over office hours. His accent might be a bit of a problem but that is something you will overcome over time.

I posted the last comment and wanted to repost. Although I was upset about the error on the test that definitely hurt my grade on that specific quiz, he's not that bad. He has an accent, but you get used to it and he wants you to do well. He's really not a bad guy or a professor and I recommend taking him. It's just a hard weed-out class, thats all

Has Accent, can't teach, he assigns ridiculous amounts of webwork -  like 3-4 times what the rest of the teachers assign. assigned hw due the day of the midterm and it took 4 hours to complete. he Fd up a question on the first test by not giving the right answer as an option and it made me get stuck on it and have to rush through the rest
Terrible Teacher. Stay away from this guy
very confusing, not helpful, and hard to understand.  overall a terrible teacher

I've always been an exceptional math student, but trying to learn from this professor was near impossible.  Contradicts self frequently, does not explain things clearly at all.  I'm unsure that he even understands the course material himself.

Dr. Ochoa's very passionate about her course material. She tries to foster community in her class and is overall very sweet. The course is an intensive, so there's a lot of work in a short time frame. Even still, she's good about offering feedback and help. Things are graded thoroughly, but she wants you to reach your full potential and succeed.

Professor TO was very knowledgeable about the course and was very funny and entertaining during in-class lectures. While it was a challenging class as it was an IFS class, TO made herself available for students to ask questions and get the help that they needed. While this class prepared me for starting college, TO is a tough grader, so be prepared

reviews.comment: LOVE her, she gives clear instruction and expectations for work, makes the classroom feel like a safe place gives plenty of time to complete homework/projects, she is super nice and funny, she connects with the students well, and notes are easy to take
She is absolutely wonderful and you can tell that she is genuinely passionate about what she's teaching! I would 110% take a class with her again.

I had Dr. Ochoa for Psychopaths born or made. The course was difficult with timing. We would have 30 pages to read and type notes on the same day. She did accept my late work and gives u chances to redo work. She is a sweet lady and I loved her. The TA and her had a miscommunication because one would tell me how to do one thing and it was wrong.

reviews.comment: i took this class for IFS. she was super sweet and caring for all students. this course wasnt necessarily difficult, but the lack of clear instruction and demonstration made it awful. she is a very tough grader and everything has to be her way and id recommend asking her various questions about assignments. she will take points off for ANYTHING.
I absolutely loved Dr. Ochoa! She is hilarious and so sweet. She is willing to help anyone. It is note heavy though, other than that, I very much enjoyed her and her class.
The best way to start off college, TO is so sweet and I learned so much from her class. As long as your work is extensive and scholarly, its an easy A.

The laziest professor. She will not give extra credit. TO will avoid ANYTHING to do work. Students had to do her job. We never even learned in this class. We just did a movie project. Just a tip of advice, if you're in this class DROP IT. If your thinking about it, run away. Words to describe... unqualified, confusing, inconsistent, unprofession

Dr. O was very caring and willing to help my whole class. We were only together for a couple weeks for IFS but she really bonded with all of the students. There was a lot of reading for the class but it was paced well.

reviews.comment: she was great, totally different than the reviews.  Would recommend taking any class with her.

reviews.comment: I was terrified to take K306 after seeing the reviews, however I think Ochoa was wondeful. I had a smaller class but she was nice, respectful to students, and helpful as well. The tests are a bit difficult, but each test is only 5% of your grade. A lot of busy work though.
She is a really tough grader. The assignments can be difficult and she sometimes expects more than what can actually be done (i.e. all students getting low grades on notes or tests).
No sympathy for students. Very condescending. Terrible teacher.

worst professor i have ever had. She treats her students like they have learning disabilities and is very inconsistent with her expectations. She is very unclear with what she wants and is extremely full of herself.

Very unorganized for a doctor...very contradicting when it came to making rules. She offered lots of help but was hardly available. She only had ONE hour for office hours. I felt like we spent alot of time learning irrelevant topics. Lectures too much. Occasionally interesting. Has a sense of humor though

I agree that she wants a lot out of her students but that is only because she wants her students to suceed.  If you truly are passionate about becoming a special education teacher, Ochoa teaches you the important background information (i.e. law, etc.) that you will have to deal with.  She is a very intelligent professor and I would reccommend her.
Extremely disorganized. If you accept fault for everything, even if it isn't your fault, she will be nicer and your grades will be better.

She is extremely chaotic. Her class changes almost ever day and she rarely warns the students when they have a major assignment due. She makes up different rules in the middle of the course and expects you to know what she wants, even when she doesn't tell you. I would NOT take a class from her ever again. She is intolerable.

She really wants her students to succeed. However, her rules change week to week and she is very inconsistent with what she wants from the student.  It becomes chaos when trying to figure out what you are supposed to do assignment-wise.  She does get snappy but will admit when she is wrong if enough people push her to do so. I don't suggest her.
Agree with previous posters.  Would not take another class from this professor.

She is never very clear about what she wants until after it is too late. And the example paper isn't always the most accurate thing to follow as to what she wants. I busted my butt for this class and learned nothing.

She is the WORST professor I have ever had. She misleads you, is extremly disrespectful, demanding, and irrational. I was excited about this class prior to meeting her. After the first class session, I never wanted to go back. She is an unhelpful, power hungry professor who feels her way is the ONLY way. Do not take a class with her.

She is the worst professor I have ever had at IU.  She is supposed to be a SPED instructor, but she uses very offensive language when talking about students with special needs.  She requires a TON of busy work, but doesn't actually read any of the work you put in.  She contradicts herself ALL THE TIME. I suggest finding a different professor.
Worst professor of my college career.

She is the meanest teacher I have ever met.  She will call you out in class for asking your neighbor which page to turn to.  Not understanding at all, and is on her "high horse" from day one.  I suggest getting another teacher.  Her attitude makes you want to skip class because she's rude, obnoxious, and VERY presumptuous.

This was by far my most challenging class this past semester, but it was also the class I learned the most from. You have to work hard to earn a good grade in this class, but it can be done. Go to every class and take good notes, and you will do just fine. I would love to take another class by Ochoa.

Dr. Ochoa is extremely disrespectful, irrational, and unapproachable. She treats both her undergraduate and graduate students like children. She turned K306, which is supposed to be a valuable course, into a stressful and unproductive learning experience. I highly suggest finding another professor for this course.

Ochoa really knows her stuff.  At first, I hated the class.  You have to do chapter outlines before every class and write a reflection on each subject.  She expects a lot out of everyone, but you really learn a lot.  Overall, I'd say this class is hard but definately worth it if you're interested in special education.
Dr. Ochoa is a very very nice lady. I have more respect for her than many of my other teachers. She does demand a lot out of her students but it is worth it in the end.
I took this course a year ago.  She is an awesome professor and very helpful. I have so much respect for her. I would really enjoy taking another one of her classes.
Demands attendance.  Gets mad when you are 2 minutes late.  Talks in circles.  Extremely boring class.  All she does is lecture.  Overall very Poor Quality.
Prof. Ochoa was a tough teacher, but she only wanted her students to succeed.  She knows a lot about her field and wants to make her students better in this area.
Dr. Ochoa can be failry demanding of you academicallly, however you will learn more in her class than most other classes combined. It is worth the extra work to be in her class.
HORRIBLE, contradicts Kauffman
No Comments

Just don't take this class with Ochoa. She's slow, boring, heavy accent, uninspiring, etc. Material isn't necessarily hard but the tests are confusing and ridden with grammar and sentence structure mistakes which is embarrassing. Reads off slides the whole class, just very lackluster.

Professor Ochoa is not an engaging lecturer. It was hard to pay attention in class. She saw that we all struggled on the first exam and acknowledged something was not going well for the class and then did not change anything about her lectures. I would take this class with someone else if you want to learn this material. Not an exciting class.

All she did was lecture, literally, which made it hard to learn since there were no supplemental activities that allow you to enhance your learning. Then she would ask you to apply things you learned in papers which was barely anything because you just heard her talk all class. Overall she was disorganized and was bad at communicating clearly
Oakes really isn't that bad. His class is pretty boring, but if you show up and pay attention, you should do fine on the midterm and final.

Oaks is an ok prof for Finance Icore. He is pretty smart and has been at iu for a while but he's slower  these days. He would show up to class a few mins late sometimes and would then rush class without making sure things made sense. There were a few times he was not doing a problem right but went too fast for anyone to notice.

The class is always going to be relatively hard, but Oakes makes it harder. He knows the content but doesn't do a great job explaining. Relying heavily on the textbook is the only way to succeed in this class. Oakes is very condescending to students who ask questions and treats people pretty rudely. Avoid him if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Oakes was the worst teacher I have had at IU. His lectures weren't even correct and he didn't even use slides. I didn't bother even showing up to class after the midterm and just taught myself everything instead. He is also rude when I tried to reach out and email. He also graded me incorrectly, and ignored my email when I pointed it out.

Oakes might be one of the most out of touch professor I have had. The ICORE finance exam is nothing like the class material, homework, or learning checks. Whatever you do, do not take his ICORE section.

Oakes is honestly the worst professor I've had. He's old as shit and can't really use Excel, makes mistakes all the time, so we end up studying the wrong material. He says exams are “a step harder” than class, but he barely teaches, so good luck. I'm sure he wouldn't even pass his own exams. I love when I pay money for shit professors.

Oakes is a good guy who seems to know a good amount about finance. Despite his knowledge he provides some of the worst test preparation I've ever seen. His whole gimmick is that the test questions are one step above of what he teaches. I've gone to every class, looked at every spreadsheet and homework and still was unsure on tests. Good luck.

reviews.comment: Retirement might be the best option for Oakes. Half the class spreadsheets are wrong. Made F370 hell especially as a finance major who needed to do well in this class. Honestly, would rather jump off a bridge than take F370 again with him, best decision is to take Fitter. If your not religious, pick one and pray. Save yourself and dont take Oakes.

Don't get me wrong, Oakes is HILARIOUS. But the fact that he has 0 real world finance experience shows. He literally has no idea what he's doing. I attended Fitter's class to actually learn the material, and then went to Oakes just to be entertained.
I am as close to 100% sure as possible that he would fail his own tests. He is the Joe Biden of the finance department. Needs to be fired!

Heiner tek. Doesn't know crap it's actually brutal. Super nice dude but should not be teaching this class. Actually gets fully lost on excel sheets expecting students to correct him and his explanations of problems are shallow. He makes his own questions with errors, corrects them, and somehow still has errors but acts like it's not his fault.

Oakes is such a sweet guy. Yes, some of these other reviews are accurate that he makes occasional mistakes on Excel but his lectures are still interesting. He cracks jokes mid-lecture and prepares you overall for the exams. #cutiepatootie

Preparing for finals and this guy gives us a weighted quiz with a question that refers to one of many excel problems done in class. most of the class misses the question because he in no way clarified where to go to find the information. told us it was our fault. this is in addition to a ton of other sad mistakes. Students know more than this guy.

We are about halfway through the semester and he continues to mess up simple excel calculations and problems and has no clue until students correct him. The class is easy, but boring. Additionally, his HW and Learning Checks he gives will be nothing like the midterm or final exam that you will take. Overall, not a good professor.

He will make mistakes at times which can be frustrating but nowhere near as bad as most of these reviews make it seem. If you actually go to class, do the homework without chat, and study for the exam you should pass. Only thing that made me really mad is when he locked homeworks until Friday at 5 and made them due monday morning.
Great guy and great professor. He is always there to help out students. If you go to class and pay attention, you will be fine. Other reviews are from students that fade class.

Very unorganized, constantly putting the wrong info on the slides. Can't even do the example problems he gives us and is often corrected by students. Hard learning from someone who doesn't understand the material. Wrote most of the problems wrong on the test prep excel file. Poor at communicating concepts and making them make sense
I love paying out of state tuition for nothing and thank you for yelling at me oakes.
Makes the class very boring and gets mad when people dont show up to class. Its a great class to grind clash royale in but not much else
teacher made 67 joke on first day

If you attend class you will be fine. I think people over exagerate about "how awful" professor Oakes is when in reality those are the dummies who don't show up to class or do anything until the week prior to midterms. Do your homework, ask questions and make sure you keep yourself in the loop. If you need help take 30 min out of your day for OF HR

reviews.comment:
- Rudest professor I've ever had.

- Told me and others to “stop relying on him” when we had questions about class.
- Convinced he didn't know material because asking him questions was like nails on a chalkboard. 
- Worst professor. Never again.

Tries to be funny but jokes fall flat a lot of the time. Seems like a chill dude tho. Go to class u will be ok, exams are overly difficult but still challenging. Just wished his slides had more conceptual content, for that you will have to read textbook.

Oakes is by far the worst finance professor you could have for ICORE. He doesn't know what he's talking about in his own lectures and is confused when people don't want to show up for his class. Oakes is the worst I-Core professor by far. Doesn't know how to teach excel properly and constantly makes mistakes. The majority of the midterm exam was filled with problems he never taught us in class. Recipe for disaster. Avoid! Avoid! Avoid!

Oakes is a poor finance professor. Lectures are unorganized with errors and little correspondence with other material, homework and quiz problems are not comparable with the other F370 classes or with the exams. Oakes students did significantly worse on the midterms. Avoid him and take the others.

Wow. Prof Oakes is an awful prof to teach Icore. He cares very little about student success unless you make conversation with him and attend office hours. He almost never seems prepared for class and it almost seems like he's reading off of a script sometimes instead of actually knowing the material he teaches.
If you miss his lectures you won't pass, it's as simple as that. If you do show up an ask a relevant question or two, he will ensure you move along well in the course.

Does not know how to use Excel, and had to ask students in class what he did wrong. One of the only finance professors that thinks operating cash is NOT on the income statement.  Awful at replying to emails. Gives practice tests that have the wrong answers. DON'T TAKE I-CORE WITH HIM
Oakes was often unhelpful and class and was rude when questions were asked. Multiple answers he showed on the board were incorrect- at least 1 per class. Explanations were not very clear.

While Professor Oakes cares about his students, his examples in class do not prepare you well for the exam. The exam questions were far more challenging than anything we did in class or the homework. He will put stuff on your icore exam that you did not learn in class. Be prepared for an exam of nonsense.

He makes a lot of mistakes during his lectures and on the Excel sheets he provides. He also cracks lame jokes about partying in college. His homework does not reflect the difficulty of exams. He is not at all helpful when asked questions during class or during office hours only says "You're on the right track" even when people are completely wrong.

reviews.comment: While some of the material in the class is a little difficult conceptually, if you learn to just apply what he says in Excel you'll do fine. Be engaging with him and he'll be more than happy to help you.
Oakes is a bit livelier than Masson and is easier to understand if you are new to finance. Overall, he's a good guy and makes a long class fun to attend.

His valuation coursework and problem sets were very well laid out. The beginning of the course was a bit of a refresher on C540. After that, it delved more deeply in to valuation models. The text is a bit of a tough read (Damodaran on Valuation), but it's kind of to be expected. Also, the text doesn't have practice problems, but Prof. Oakes has...

reviews.comment: I would not recommend this professor to anyone. I missed a few classes for personal and professional reasons and that set me back. The assignments are difficult even with a tutor to help. Unless you have hours to spend doing these assignments there are better professors to teach this course.
Don't listen to the bad reviews below. It's a 300 level course- there's an appropriate amount of work for it. Professor Oakes is a fine professor, and if you put in the effort, you'll do fine.

He writes all of his own questions so you can't just look them up. Professor Oakes is a great teacher that I would recommend to anyone.
Very lecture heavy. Lots of reading and the group project at the end of the class is completely trial and error, even though you might fail it. He was available to meet, not that it helped too much.

reviews.comment: She was an excellent professor and a total babe. She made going to class enjoyable. I highly recommend taking basic English with her.
This course is dry. But Randi makes it enjoyable with great looks and easy classes. Did I say great looks yet? It's your basic english class.
Great teacher! Just do what she says, keep your papers focused, pay attention and engage in class and it will be a breeze.
This class is difficult for a 110-level class. Oberlin is annoying and moves a bit too fast. She expects a lot.
A lot of reading outside of class. Some of the articles can be dry and lengthy.

she talks sooo fast, and doesn't let you bring your computer. so you'll be writing a lot. she takes pop quizzes, too. there's too much course work, though, for a 101 class. the class is decent, but not the greatest. i wouldn't really recommend it.
Great instructor. Really knows her stuff. Very helpful when not understanding material.
She's a good teacher and willing to help if you ask.  A little heavy on the readings, but they're necessary to lead class discussions.
She's a good teacher.  Just do the readings and go to class.

This course was not well set-up, the professor has clearly not updated materials, and the language is confusing and jargon-heavy for a course that is supposedly on linguistics. The lectures really need to be updated, and recorded lectures would be incredibly helpful for the course content. Needs LOT of improvement. Very disappointed in this course.

This class was hybrid, with online lectures and mandatory discussions. As long as you take notes during discussions, you'll be fine. There were only two assignments and four quizzes (not including the final). For the assignments, you get to choose from a list of prompts and only have to write 2-5 double-spaced pages, so it's pretty light.
Half of the time the class wasn't set up. When this was brought up he would get passive aggressive.

The professor only engages with students through canvas announcements. The lecture section was online, while the discussion was in person. The discussion section was very dry and had mandatory attendance every week. There are 5 quizzes and 2 assignments. The class was a little disappointing, but overall it was an easy class and easy to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Obeng is a wonderful speaker and makes his lectures interesting and accessible. The timeline of assignments was disorganized and stressful at times, but the assignments were all fairly easy. If you're confused on something, email or set up an appointment with him.
This class was really boring for me and was not cause for engagement. Homework was not difficult, but it did involve a fair amount of writing.

Prof Obeng cares about his students and prepares typed notes for every lecture because of his accent. C103 does not have many areas for points, but each area is manageable. Two paper assignments, discussion participation (lecture attendance was taken, but not graded), quizzes and the final were all that was graded. Quizzes were directly from notes.

Professor Obeng is really a sweet guy. He worries that students won't be able to understand his accent, so he types all of his lectures notes. It is important to attend discussion, but attendance is not taken regularly in lecture. For the quizzes and tests, just pay careful attention to the lecture notes and you should be fine.

This was for the COLL C103 Language & Religions class. Not much to say here. Lectures were really boring and he took attendance sporadically, so its technically not mandatory. Most important part is to go to discussion sections because thats where the quiz & final material are covered in detail. Quizzes & final were online. Easy class.

No tests, just field work. Get to know your informant well! Prof. Obeng is very interesting; he will go off on tangents, but they are always informative and illustrating some point he is making. Easy if you deliver what he asks for for the papers. Be sure to get lots of data to work with for your papers, even if you don't use half of it.

Tests have many tricks in them. Example-True/False question on scantron, A is false, B is true. Things like that can be annoying. Otherwise, he is fairly good and textbooks were seldom if not never needed in my case. He said he was "hot" so I'm rating him as "hot."
Lang and Pol: Rating below right on target.  Textbooks completely unnecessary.

Language and Politics: He's not too bad but it's really easy and there's no point in going to class.  If you're interested in the subject material, you'll get extremely bored and hate it.  If you're just trying to find a class to take, this is the easy on to do.
A delightful instructor. Good energy, humor, and skepticism in approaching the material. Very approachable and good natured guy. The class was easy and enjoyable.

Don't take Language and Politics.  It was a horrible class, I totally agree with the other two people that wrote about it.  He never responded to anybody's e-mails and his tests were so poorly worded that you would miss questions just because the language made no sense, and then he refused to change it.  DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS.

This was my least favorite class this semester. Most class time is spent listening to Professor Obeng read his notes off Oncourse. The notes focus mostly on memorizing vocab words, which we could (and should) do outside of class. Quizzes are multiple choice, though the material would be much better suited to essay tests. Don't take this class!

Language and Politics: He's not that bad of a teacher but it's really hard to understand him.  He also tends to go off on tangents about abosolutely nothing.  The nice thing is that he puts all his notes on oncourse so if you don't understand what he's saying, you can at least read the notes and talk to the discussion leaders.
THIS GUY MAKES NO SENSE!!!!  He rambled on and on about absolutely nothing!!!  weird guy.
His accent adds to the character of the course and he keeps you interested with his funny stories or sayings. great professor, great class!
Amazing professor! Wants students to do well. Makes class easy, yet I learned a lot. Accent isn't too difficult to understand. All around great guy.

Samuel Gyasi Obeng is my favorite teacher this semester. He is so easy going, postponed a paper for a week, then decided to postpone it again for another week. He is from Ghana, so his accent can be a little hard to understand when he gets in one of his African talking rhythms. Take Language and Politics
Easy class, quizes are easy and assignments are interesting. Shows lots of political videos has interesting stories.
His lectures can get boring, but his notes are helpful.
Great teacher; knows so much about his field.  And, I like the accent.
