reviews.comment: Get ready for a lot of writing in the course. Every assignment revolves around writing. TAs are extremely tough graders, and for a 200 level class, definitely look elsewhere for World Culture credits. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took this class for my WC credit and wouldn't reccomend doing that. Extremely difficult for a 200 level class. Lectures are boring and provide little material outside of the readings. My AIs for this semester were horrendous. Gave different students exact same feedback on assignments and were remarkably inconsistent. Avoid this course and prof.

Trying to take a get a world culture credit? Skip this class right now. Her TAs are extremely tough graders and wrote the same feedback on multiple papers with varying grades. Her lectures are boring, hard to follow, and she never turns the microphone on so you can't even hear her. She also can be extremely rude during class. 10/10 don't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Pergher is respectful and really funny. Her lectures are great! There are 3 readings for the class, however with this topic, I thought they were pretty interesting. You need the lectures to pass, but I liked going to her class. I'm not a history major and had to work hard, but I really liked Dr. Pergher and the class and the work pays off.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Inside Nazi Germany is a great class. All you have to do is read the rubric and the test requirements and you'll get a good grade. Go to lectures so you can answer tophat questions. Shes not mean unless you give her a reason to not like you.
Worst class I have ever taken. Teacher is extremely rude, tells people to shut up. Her lectures are insanely boring. Too hard for a gen ed class. AVOID.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Pergher was one of the best professors that I've had in college. She's extremely knowledgeable about the material that she's teaching and doesn't just read off of the slides. Attendance is encouraged because most of what she talks about isn't on the slides. Tests are short answer/ID. 10/10 would recommend taking a class with Dr. Pergher
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly so great. She knew her lectures by heart and were very knowledgable. There was a good amount of reading due each class (about an hour or two) and we were questioned on it in class through Top Hat, and the exams are literally all written. But, definitely worth it if you want a passionate, experienced prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This course is taught as though most students are not taking it as a general education (world culture) credit. She is a very uninteresting lecturer to say the least and can be short-tempered. Not only are the lectures uninteresting, but the material is not what a student would expect. Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very boring lectures. Tests are all short answer/essay questions. Randomly takes points away on papers/tests with very little to no feedback. Class is way too hard for a GenEd and requires a lot of reading. For a lack of better terms, she doesn't come across as a very nice lady. 10/10 avoid, may be my least favorite professor ever.
The BEST professor I'll ever have. Ever. I love her so so so much. I'm on her same career path and we go out for coffee and discuss history. Goals.

She posts all of her lectures online after class so in class I would just pay attention to what she's saying. The material is sometimes hard to follow because of her accent but overall if you pay attention and do the reading you will do good in the class. Make sure to do the reading BEFORE  class and pay attention to the reading.

This is by far the worst professor I've ever had at IU. Her CA's are HORRENDOUSLY tough graders! She is useless at office hours. She said she would review my paper, only to refuse to read it. LOTS of quizzes that ask the most specific details of reading assignments. Prepare to memorize tons of useless dates and unrelated info. DO NOT TAKE!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She  knows her stuff, she doesn't need notes or her slides to go into great detail. She clearly is passionate about what she's teaching and I found that amazing. As far as difficulty, the class is very easy if you go to class, do the five 300-word homework assignments and make a conscious effort on the exams, which can be papers. Would recommend.

This was the best class of freshman year.  Her lectures are long but very informational and interesting if you like history and she shows a lot of interesting film clips.  Her diatribes about participating in class get old.  The readings were interesting as well.
Assigned a 10 page rough draft due two days after Spring Break.  Her comments: "oh, let's discuss what you shall be working on over break."  Ridiculous.
Her lecture is confusing and makes no sense. Hard to follow. Seems to get lost in lecture.

Requires a LOT of reading. She really knows her stuff, although she can be a bit monotonous. She is pretty easy to get along with always open to answer questions. Most work is done on your own time and she doesn't go over the reading's.
There is way too much of homework. Like I got between 85-100 on every single test but god the amount of homework. Just because of the homework my grade got cooked and I will end with a B or a B-.
Highly recommend. Gives lost of homework, but it helps you understand it. Gives practice tests that are pretty similar to the actual exams. Mr. Pilgrim is very intelligent

Fav math prof! Homeworks for every class but rly hammered home topics if you're up for the grind, great lectures, I'm not super math inclined but was able to lock in with his help. Had to miss exams with advanced notice and he was v accommodating to it. 4 exams, 3 homework a week but def worth it. Lotsa resources to excel in calc at IU, use them!

Legit one of the best math teachers I ever had. Had him for Calc2 and can say hes def 'a good one.
Cant make his office hours? email him and he'll schedule a time to meet at a different time. dont understand a problem? just ask and he'll help you through it
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pilgrim is a really amazing professor. His class is relatively challenging, but he still makes it enjoyable. Going to lectures is very important. Lots of homework, but mostly all from the textbook and is a large percentage of your grade. Exams are exactly like the reviews, with a couple more challenging questions at the end. Definitely recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The honors course is all about understanding why calculus works and the meaning behind why we do what we do. I recommend only taking it if you've taken calculus before. You can retake all exams once and the study guides are just like the exams just slightly different (numbers, etc). The homework is kind of graded unfairly and hurts your grade.
He was very clear and helpful. He def. goes the extra mile to make sure you understand the material. The HW is challenging, but he opens an online forum and encourages working with others.

Professor Pilgrim is incredibly smart and knows the subjects very well. He isn't very approachable, though, and often sounds angry at students for asking for help. He certainly doesn't manage time well, either. Tests and homework and quizzes are fair, there really aren't any surprises. Prof. Pilgrim explains the material well, too.
Professor Pilgrim is a fantastic teacher that truly cares about his students. He is always ready to help, even with other math classes. I definitely recommend taking a class with him.

I found this prof's classes pretty infuriating at times. He constantly makes mistakes in class and has mandatory quizzes at the end of class that he runs out of time for. Also, his reviews are unhelpful; for the final, he said to "do the midrange odd number problems in our book" Could have figured that out myself.

He does not make time for students.  He schedules you and then rushes you out because he doesn't budget his time well.  His review sheets are the exact opposite of his exams.  He makes many errors and won't admit it and then take points off and he NEVER GIVES THEM BACK.
If he gives you a review for an exam, don't bother looking at it.  What he puts on the reviews is exactly what he doesn't put on the exams.

Professor Pilgrim sincerely cares about his students and their performance.  Classes and office hours are both very helpful.  He goes out of his way to make sure students understand the material and are able to apply it in the real world.  He's passionate about his subject.

I spent hours studying for every single test and somehow did not get better than a 85%. The tests are extremely hard and questions are worded very confusing. I have talked to many other people with different professors for this same exact course and they said they barley study and the class is super easy. Do not take this class with her.
Just go to class and study, and it's light; the class itself is super chill. Pickernell the goat
very funny and nice. class is easy if you pay attention.

Overall, Dr. Pickernell was a great professor whose class I would take a million times over. Her lectures are extremely entertaining, engaging, and highly applicable to her exams. The exams themselves are very straightforward, if you attend the lectures and take notes, it's easy to get a good grade. I truly couldn't recommend a professor more.

She made the class very fun/engaging with her enthusiasm and jokes which i really appreciated. I genuinely enjoyed her lectures. Assignments and exams are very straightforward and simple (no surprises). She puts bonus questions on exams and drops the lowest score of the 4. Highly recommend using Notebook LM to study for exams in this class.

Dr. Pickernell is a great lecturer. Her lectures made me actually want to go to an early class. The class is based on few grades and in ours we couldn't drop an exam, but the exams were very fair and as long as you listen to lectures and the review sessions you will do fine. Focus on the extra credit too it can be very helpful. Loved this class.

She is a great professor and made an enjoyable class. Her lectures were engaging because she is so funny and caring. She explains concepts clearly and makes sure you understand everything. Class work was easy and simple. Exams were easy and studying for them was not difficult especially with her study guides. Highly recommend her!

SHE WAS AMAZING! The class was easy if you just attended the lectures and did a quizlet a few days before the tests. Her lectures were entertaining bc she's always trying her best to funny and really loves the topic. Highly recommended for this class!

Amazing teacher. This was my first lecture class, and I was very happy with how she taught it. She is engaging, genuinely cares about her students, and is very kind, with a great sense of humor that makes class enjoyable. Attendance is mostly mandatory, since she provides helpful insights beyond the slides that deepen understanding.

She was a great professor and really engaging during lectures. Exams are so easy, all I did was make a quizlet off the study guide and study that the day of and I scored consistently well. If you miss class, slideshows aren't guaranteed to be helpful, plus she takes participation grades, so you should definitely just go.

She is AMAZING. Every lecture was engaging and she is hilarious and so loveable. The tests are easy to ace if you study, and bonus questions help your score a lot (my 3 exam grades were 102%, 99%, 99%) I prepared extensively for exams but it is all just easy memorization. During lectures, take notes on the slides, and USE HER STUDY GUIDES.

Dr. P is an excellent professor who really cares about her students. She is very good at keeping lectures entertaining and humorous. Exams were not difficult unless you knew how to prepare. Make sure to pay attention to more than the PowerPoints provided since some of the exam information is verbatim.

Honestly, really easy class, only reason I don't have an A is my doing, but the exams are super easy to study for, and for the most part her lectures are really easy to pay attention to. She does make a lot of weird sexual jokes, but other than that, her jokes are funny. It's clear she enjoys this topic and will help if you have any questions!
Love her, the class is hard its neuroscience, but she makes me want to do well in the class
Would definitely take again. Go to the lectures. She expands on what is in the textbook and is very good at answering questions.

She was energetic, bold, hilarious, and was happy to take questions no matter how weird and I actually felt welcome to ask my own questions, even if they weren't totally related. Understood lectures really well and she clearly knew what she was talking about
Very easy teacher and subject, def recommend. The tests are based on the powerpoint slides presented in class.
great professor

Dr. Pickernell is very loving, caring, and funny! She loves to make jokes about neurotransmitters to class and is very engaging. I would recommend anyone to her. Class is based off of research papers, and "take home" essay exams. She was very open to answering questions and was extremely clear. I love Dr.P!

She is very understanding and gives lots of time to get assignments done. While it is test heavy, the tests are pretty straight forward and taken right from her lectures and text book. The textbook isn't really as important, but I would definitely study the tables of information for each section. She makes class fun which is refreshing.
I really loved her.

Dr. Pickernell is very sweet and tries to keep class light-hearted. The class itself is pretty easy imo if you take notes during lecture. She takes attendance once a week so you kinda have to hope that if you skip you're not missing one of those days. Don't get the textbook—everything you need is in the slides

Reads PowerPoint too fast
It gives us an exam and practically gives us no method or way to efficiently study the material, as the test questions are application style based, and the notes she gives are quote-on-quote definitions of said terms.

I absolutely lovedddd dr pickernell. She was clearly very passionate and knowledgeable about neuroscience and made it more interesting for me when I was learning. There are only exam grades and unit project grades so you MUST do good on exams. The exams are very much possible to get an A in as long as you study lecture slides and go to class.

as long as you go to class and take notes you will be fine. 4 exams and one easy open note quiz every week. shes a silly girl and her random jokes always helped me remember material. just put forth the effort and it's really not too challenging.

Dr. Pickernell is the sweetest professor I have ever had. While her lectures are long, she tries to keep them engaging and you can tell her really loves her job. She helps you as much as possible and is super nice if you have questions! There are also 3 projects throughout the semester that are really easy points to get and extra credit on exams.

Class is easy, professor is chill, a little quick with the lecture slides but that's okay. Class is pretty heavy on the take home quizzes and exams, so just get the quizzes done and study and you'll be fine. Don't buy the textbook

While Sara is nice, her class is so extremely test heavy & attendance heavy. She takes it randomly 12 times throughout the semester, and does allow you to drop your 2 lowest attendance & quiz scores. But, lectures are lulling and I find myself unmotivated to participate.

Didn't like how the total grade was based on four exams, 3 assignments, and attendance. She tells you to read the textbook before the lecture, but while in the lecture, she says, "Your textbook goes over ___, but we won't be covering that." I felt like I was wasting my time reading 20 pages. A lot of people dropped the class after the first exam.

One of my favorite professors at IU!! Lectures  are lengthy but she does a great job at keeping students engaged by throwing in jokes. The class is test heavy, however if you attend lecture and study I don't find them to be too difficult.

A great and funny teacher. Her lectures can get a little boring, but she tries her best to engage students. Her Halloween costume and candy-for-answers lecture was super fun, and she cares about you as a student. Fast responses to emails, + rare AND fun assignments. Only issue that tests are a little difficult.

Prof. Pingel is a fantastic teacher and guy. Super kind and understanding guy, completely saved my grade. Super passionate about what he teaches, and does his best to make the material seem as interesting as possible. Homework isn't too difficult, and the final exam is a take home.

Prof. Pingel is awesome. Super kind and understanding. Weekly routine of assignments consist of 2 question quizzes and either an exploration or 15 question short quiz. Every quiz is open book and open web. He does Top Hat every week so technically you want to get those points but he drops a bunch of your lowest grades. Take a Pingel science class.

You do not learn about aliens at all, whatsoever in A103. If you want to learn about aliens, this is NOT the class for you. Took this class with my boy thinking this would be about aliens the whole time, its Week 10 of class and there have been no aliens. Easy A.

I highly recommend him and his class! I thought his lectures were super interesting, and I always enjoyed coming to class. I also like how he switches up the types of assignments done for homework. Participation is key since he does TopHat questions for points.

This class was pretty easy. He does take attendence through top hat but other than that it is very easy to get through (and even then, attendence is such a small portion of your grade that it doesn't matter.) The content is quick to learn and he is very open to helping students. Easy credit for sure.

This professor is GREAT. He really does understand that we have a lot of responsibilities to shuffle. A very caring person who just wants you to succeed. Even though I took this class for the gen-ed credit I feel like I got a lot out of it. Take this class with him 100%
Very boring lectures that don't really help you learn.

Pittsford is really boring and his class takes forever. Tests were really hard and the math was nothing like any other class I have taken. Some people get it naturally, but if you don't, you are going to be putting in hours of work..
Pittsford is a very nice person who is very chill. He treats people kindly and knows the content well. He is very down-to-earth and helps students succeed.

Prof Pittsford is the goat. The class is hard no matter what, but he is so willing to help all of his students however he can. If you actually pay attention and follow along during the lectures, it will ACTUALLY help you understand the material far better. Crazy concept but it's true. And he's pretty funny.

Professor Pittsford is great.  Ops is a hard class, but I think he does a good job of explaining the materials. Have a convo with him if you can; he's a pretty relatable guy and also pretty funny.  I know some people that say his lectures are somewhat monotone, but I think if you really pay attention, you'll really enjoy the class.
Broc is the man. Obviously, Ops is a hard class, but he is a smart guy. He also gives out t-shirts in class for participation. Would recommend taking him if possible.
Hes the boy, pay attention in class and have conversation with him and you will do fine.

Ops is a hard class regardless of who you take, but I have heard Broc is one of the better profs. He can sometimes be boring, but overall he is a good guy and knows his information. He throws jokes into his lectures and seems like he truly does want us to succeed. I recommend going to class and studying for this test as much as F370 -- sneaky hard.

Pittsford was direct and a good lecturer with experience. However, midterm was somewhat of a disaster between tech issues and being difficult with a very poor average. Did not feel it accurately represented the material learned. However, the P370 staff did a great job communicating issues as well as adding a buffer to the grades to help alleviate.
lowkey the worst, P370 is a mess in the first place but he is so bad at lecturing and soooo boring

I honestly love excel so I truly enjoyed taking this class. The prof explained the concepts really well and I liked that he never gave away the answers but instead he guided us on how to approach it. Would def recommend taking him.

Professor Pittsford is an outstanding professor for I-Core Operations. He keeps his lectures short, but makes sure to go over every concept that you will be tested over. The exam was simple, and they pulled questions from previous quizzes. While the course can be challenging, Prof Pittsford is always available to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was an overloaded, jumbled mess. All in all, pretty disappointed because I genuinely enjoyed the material but it was structured very poorly - I got 95%+ on every test but getting an 85% on a stupid group project cost me the A. I tried working with the guy, but he wouldn't budge. Also, teach services not manufacturing, it's not 1985.
Professor Pittsford is a great professor. He actually cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He answers questions during and after class & is very helpful. Would recommend for K303!

Broc is the best k303 prof!!! He is always nice and respectful even if you ask dumb questions. He brought us donuts for filling out the course eval! He is great and makes K303 not so bad! Highly recommend!

Marty is one of the best professors I've had at IU! He truly cares about helping students be better people versus just getting good grades. He is insanely accomplished in his own life so there are plenty of cool stories he'll tell. The only thing is that we had 250-word assessments and preps for every class but they're essentially for completion.

Funniest professor I've ever had. Lectures did not teach me much, but attendance is mandatory. Three exams total, but he gives helpful tips in the class before you take them. Overall, very easy class and would recommend

Marty is a fun guy with an interesting background but he doesn't teach J375 well. All he wanted to talk about was football. He is also super unstructured as we didn't have a syllabus until 3/4 through the semester. The class is easy if you do your work but don't expect to learn anything. Attendance is a big part of your grade.
This is for J375. He is awesome. Really great guy, cares about the students and really likes getting to know everyone in the class. Really easy class, and a fun professor.

If you want the easiest professor for D271, absolutely take him. His class was a breeze and he's a great guy. That being said, I don't think a learned a single thing from this class. It was just go to class, listen when he tells you what's on the exam, finish the exams in 15 minutes.

Professor Pieratt takes away from learning and course content when a majority of the class time is spent going off on tangents. Your learning 100% comes from the textbook which you can buy for $150 instead of paying at most 1500 for taking this class. I learned a lot from the textbook. No attendance gets dropped. He is really funny too.

Professor Pieratt is a nice person, but his class is a little strange. He lets you use your time as makes sense to you which is cool, but can take away from learning. He will go on tangents about his personal life often. Unlike most Kelley classes, you get zero free / excused absences which can bring down your grade. Overall he is just kind of mid.

Professor Pieratt is the perfect teacher for this class. He has past entrepreneurial experience and relates that to the class. Class has weekly class preps over each chapter of the book as well as with other topics. 3 Test : each covering 4 chapters up to 12. Chapters are quite long but you can skim read if you wish. Attendance is mandatory

Marty is a great guy and very funny.  Only downside to his class is crazy amount of reading, but u can get away with skimming if u understand general concepts. Also, he will tell you exactly what class slides to study for exams. I got 50/50 on the midterm and final. Marty has great stories and is very fun to listen to, but class is not a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Literally the goat. I wish u could take his class every semester

Marty is a greta professor- he is funny, engaging, and genuinely just wants his students to do well. The work for the class is very easy and straightforward, and he makes class very fun. Would definitely recommend.

Although Marty often got distracted and talked about topics irrelevant to the course he made class enjoyable. He is an easy grader. I learned a lot from the books we read. There are 4 tests (only worth 5% each) and a few presentations. Most of the work is before class prep work and class assessments (easy 250 words). I would recommend Marty!

Marty is a very nice guy but I cannot say that I learned much from his course. He has many great connections that he brings to class and will jump on any opportunity to give students an experience they normally would not have. I think he cares more than the average prof and wants to offer life advice which is a welcomed change from other profs.

This is by far the easiest class ive taken through Kelley. He is very funny and is easy to pay attention to. If you do the assignments in his classes and show up to class, you will easily get an A. You NEED to take D271 with Marty!!

Marty is very easily distracted. He runs class talking about seemingly random things, many completely unrelated to the subject of the class. Would not recommend if you want to learn about entrepreneurship, not random things from Martys head. Class time was a waste, the only value I got was from reading the books he assigns. Take a different prof.

I didn't know what to expect when I signed up for class, but I've never enjoyed a class more.  He has great outside experiences, and he does a great job of engaging us and allowing us to actively participate.  He has inspired me to start a business.  MUST TAKE PROFESSOR!!!

No midterm, no final, and she doesn't track attendence. Each week there are three online assignments, which are all relatively easy. Professor is also super nice and approachable, she's super passionate about her teaching which made me not mind going to class. Lecture heavy, but none of the assignments are difficult.

Easy class, attendance wasn't mandatory and quizzes are open web so there's no excuse to do bad. Otherwise the few times I went to the lectures she seemed pretty chill. Weekly explorations are tricky sometimes but there's no midterm or final exam.

Caty was an excellent professor for Stellar Astrophysics. Despite the advanced material, everything felt very manageable and was presented clearly. Homework alternated between regular problem sets and Python assignments. She was very understanding of student circumstances throughout the semester.
BUM
Dont take this class

This class is extremely hard for a 100 level class. There's a discussion post, assignment, and a quiz every week. The assignments and quizzes are only worth ten points, so if you mess up your grade drops. The assignments are the most difficult I have ever seen in a 100 level course. I would not recommend this class to anyone.

Professor Pisano is very passionate about theatre and always showed up to class excited and ready to teach. She does take forever to get back to emails and has confusing instructions on her assignments at times. Show up to class for those bonus points!

Very easy classes for A&H credit, one assignment a week that is super easy and has nothing to do with what she talks about in class. a few plays you have to attend and write essays about, but super easy to get hundreds on. The professor is so understanding and sweet and her lectures are not mandatory, but are pretty interesting!

Prof. Pisano is such an enjoyable and kind professor (very much a breath of fresh air after taking Kelley classes). She makes it very easy to succeed in her class and offers multiple opportunities for bonus points making an A+ in her class extremely achievable.
Professor Pisano is so knowledgeable and passionate about theatre, making the classes interesting and engaging. She's very kind and approachable! I would love to take more classes taught by her.

Linda is a great professor. She is very engaging in her lectures and I found them helpful, although attendance isn't mandatory. The class is very easy in itself and you shouldn't have any trouble getting a good grade.

The best professor ever met. She is the BEST. I knew nothing about the class, she helped a lot. Messed up assignments, she allowed me to resubmit later. Also she is the most caring professor ever. Just take her would not regret.

Dr. Pisano is a lovely and dedicated professor who is very knowledgeable. T125 is very lecture-heavy and dragged on at times, but Dr. Pisano made the class as interesting as possible. If you love multiple group projects and 3 page single spaced essays, this class is for you! Regardless, if you show up and do the work you're guaranteed an easy A.

Pisano is very knowledgeable and interactive. The workload is light yet interesting. I am not into theater at all; however, I enjoyed the class and would recommend it for a GenEd. No textbook, 2 group projects, and 1 assignment a week. Having absolutely no knowledge of elements of design, I still got an A+ as she teaches well and grades lightly.

Decent professor. Very nice!! I did not learn a lot in the course though. I felt like either way I would do well in this course. I would take her again especially if I was interested in design but I needed the class for my minor. It was okay.

Super annoying and incredibly passive aggressive. Isn't willing to work with you if you are unable to make office hours. I sent her an email asking a question and it took almost  two weeks to get a one-word answer back. This class is the reason I am no longer a theatre major.
Linda is everything.
energetic. know your vocab for test.
Awesome prof - she has high standards, but will take into account existing skill levels and other factors.  Always helpful and cheerful.
She is awesome

The nicest men you will meet seems his logic on the topic got in the way of anyone in the class having a life. He wants you to be able to explore the projects yourself.came to the point where the directions would be unclear even to him. In the end most of the class was confused what was the goal. Be prepared to stay whole class period maybe longer.
Really nice, really passionate about his stuff, great professor to learn under even if a little awkward. Gave me super useful feedback on my projects, I felt like I really grew in that class.
Very kind and helpful instructor. Invest some time and effort into your and he'll notice and you'll do just fine.

He's kind of loopy and doesn't always know how to express what he wants for certain projects.  Overall, the class was okay.  We spent a lot of time on still-life at the beginning of the year and then rushed through a ton of stuff at the end! Don't take this class if you don't have a lot of extra time (10-15 hours a week) to spend on homework!

Amazing class for history lovers and photography lovers! You have to do a fair amount of reading outside of class (and there are quizzes on it but she tells you what articles will be covered and the quizzes are easy). Great prof and great course - highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Delight of a professor, only reason I did not get an A is because I procrastinated the final paper and got a grade reduction, outside of that the class was a cakewalk. While the lectures tend to be boring, its clear she has a passion for it, there are weekly quizzes but she always gives you 3/5 of the questions ahead of time, highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a very intelligent and passionate person, but her class is excruciatingly boring. Attendance is taken on TopHat and if you miss more than three lectures or questions it will tank your grade. She has the class download LockDown Browser fro five question quizzes and the software is absolutely awful and difficult to work with. Easy A though.
If you are looking for an easy A, this is it. Do nothing, learn nothing still get an A. This is babysitting nothing more.

Prof. Wolfskill gave me hope in all other professors. She was AMAZING, kind, smart, funny, thoughtful, and so helpful to me as a student. I had a super hard semester and still passed with an A because she was so respectful when I reached out to ask for time/excused absences, etc. Her lectures were so engaging, and this was only an elective for me!

Prof Wolfskill was so wonderful!!! Super accessible, kind, and wants to hear what you have to say. If you go to class, participate meaningfully, and try you will have a great experience. I learned so much from her class and enjoyed it so much! The readings were very interesting and course topics highly varied.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Wolfskill is the LOML. Her lectures are so interesting and you can tell she deeply cares about what she teaches and her students.

Professor Wolfskill is the LOML. She does such a great job teaching her class and makes every lecture so interesting. I definitely recommend any art class of hers. She doesn't give any homework, has easy assignments and exams, and posts all her lectures online. As long as you participate and try in the class, she will pass you. :)

Professor Wolfskill is a great teacher and she's very passionate about her subject matter. Lectures are kind of on the repetitive side and readings are super long, but you can usually get away with just skimming them. Exam material comes almost exclusively from the lectures. Papers aren't too hard and the requirements are made very clear.
I have taken 4 of her classes because she is so incredibly educated and a great person. I love her and 100% recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I like her a lot. She is interested in what we have to say about each of the works. It is fun to see her slides and to hear the story behind each work.

Prof. Wolfskill is very knowledgeable about her subject and likes to have in class discussions. Not super difficult readings that you can sometimes skip but the major paper (6-7) pages require sources from the readings so be prepared. Lectures are fairly interesting and thought-provoking.

She's very passionate about her subject, her lectures are well-constructed, and she is generally well-spoken. The lectures provoke critical thinking and it's very easy to earn an A in the class as long as you're a decent writer. The readings for the class do get mundane, but if you come to class, unnecessary. I'd take another class with her.
Really engaging and the assignments are not difficult. Be prepared to speak in class as it is part of the grade.

Professor Wolfskill is a white woman who teaches African American and Diaspora studies classes. While this is not an automatic failure necessarily, her lack of first hand experience with Black culture is obvious and creates a serious divide. She has a tendency to cut off students who are talking, and to discount opinions that differ from her own.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You aren't allowed to take notes on computer which is difficult since it's a class about images (hard to keep track of what the notes when the image isn't there). She is a hard grader with little to no explanation as to why you were given that grade. Very slow to answer emails and very few assignments to decide grade. Don't bother buying the book
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Wolfskill remains one of the best professors I have ever had! Listening to her lectures left me feeling informed and inspired! Her direction for tests was clear and guidance on papers insightful. You are never asked to reference the readings in the tests; They are just there to foster class discussion. A dream come true!

Forbids use of electronics in class, my primary way of taking notes, despite her checking her phone during class regularly. Lectures generally not helpful and would not go if they weren't mandatory. Very few grades; a midterm, final, and 3 papers in addition to attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I feel as if going to class is a waste of time. I for some reason don't get anything out of her lecture and end up having to teach myself. Shes loves to answer your question with another question in which you have to answer, she has a acent aswell.

Professor Wakhungu is incredible. You can really tell that she cares about her students and wants them to succeed. The class itself can be kind of tough at times, but if you go to class and do the assignments you will be fine. Wakhungu is always available to help you and will make sure you succeed in the class as long as you ask for help!

She is very caring and tries to explain the material though slightly difficult to understand. Overall a nice professor and will give extensions. People that complain are the ones who never show up or don't try so don't be deceived !

Absolutely do not take class with this woman. You cannot understand a word she says, and she is incredibly racist. I had a friend with whom I sat with, and she called us racist and misogynistic for laughing in class (she was talking about O.J. Simpson in a stats class). She proceeded to tell us to not come back to class except for exam days.

She cares deeply about her students, and thats where the good ends. She's impossible to understand in class. She also teaches stat crunch which is useless outside of this class and unavailable after you graduate. There are videos on how to use stat crunch but they are terrible videos that show people clicking buttons with no explanation.

When you have to take K300, make sure it is with Dr. Phoebe Wakhungu. Dr. P is one of my favorite professors I have ever had. Just looking at the material, it is kind of daunting, but she does an amazing job at explaining everything very clearly. She is also an incredibly caring person. She takes time during lectures to give valuable life advice.

Dr. Wakhungu was my favorite professor my first semester. Her lectures were amazing and she was always happy to explain more complex things or slow down. She really cares about her students and understands that life can sometimes interfere with education. She will let you turn in late work if you have an actual reason why you could not get it done
Such an amazing professor. The class is tough but she is very willing to help. Cares a lot about students.

Dr PW is the most amazing professor I have ever met. She is very passionate about what she does and since this was an 8 week class, I found it very hard to keep up. However, Dr PW made time after class to help me with whatever questions which I had. She does not only treat you as her student but she also sees you as a real person with real feelings
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor PW is awesome. The material is hard, but if you put in the work and go to office hours, you will do well. She is extremely caring and has high expectations for her students. Due to work I was unable to attend her normal office hours, so she took extra time to meet me outside of class. I took it as an eight week course and Im glad I did!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. PW is an amazing professor and I would take her class again in a heartbeat. She made statistics, which is traditionally a hard course, applicable to every day life and made sure her students didn't fall behind so long as they put in the effort. One of my favorite professors at IU.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Very nice guy who wants the best for his students but keep in mind that it's a very large class. If you struggle with econ make sure to study hard for this class as it's harder than B-251. Focus on the cases as lots of the exam questions have details from them. He gives plenty of helpful material to review for exams plus they're all curved.

Prof. Powell is the GOAT. His lectures were very interesting and he did a good job of engaging the morning classes. The course is structured like an MBA course, with case studies, that are tested on the exam. If you can do the self-test quizzes and study the review sheet he posts, you will be just fine in the course.

He's the GOAT. Genuinely loved the dude. To study, I would watch every topic video and watch every office hour video until I understood everything. Definitely go to class and pay attention on case debrief days. If you don't like him, then you're the problem.

Professor Powell gives THE most amazing lectures. He is energetic and incredibly passionate about what he teaches which makes even the most “boring” topics interesting. I will admit that this is a very exam heavy course and, despite the name, it is almost entirely economics based. For exam prep: OH, review quizzes, and look at the exam prep sheet.

Test-heavy class, but so much better than Krefts and gives nice extra credit for harder exams. Just read the slides and do practice tests, and you will be fine. He is also super energetic and experienced.
no structure as there is no textbook and slides barely have content to study for the test
