SO HAWT
The class was really easy. I highly recommend that you show up to every lecture and take notes, that will guarantee a good grade. I never used the book or had to study for tests.

EASY CLASS 3 Test and a Final. The tests are all based upon daily slides. You can skip class all term, take pictures of all of the slides 2 days before the test and study, and still get an A. She also offers easy out-of-class ExCred  5% final grade boost. She is super boring and monotone.

The only thing that saved me about this class was that it started at 1pm, I would have fallen asleep if it was any earlier. Lectures are done from power points and it is very boring. Don't buy the text book, readings aren't required or tested on and I didn't open the book once. Tests stay true with the notes so try and pay attention to the lectures

Dry, monotone like the other comments say. Sucks the life out of astronomy, though her husband is really funny and clearly passionate about astronomy! She kind of just scowls at his antics though haha Overall, she is nice and has good information, but it's a very no-nonsense "here are the facts" type of class

Professor Lugger is possibly the most boring teacher I've ever had. That being said, her class is pretty easy as long as you take notes and copy everything she has on her powerpoints. Don't count on getting out of class early because she will teach until the last minute. Overall, she's not a bad professor, but her class isn't interesting.

Professor Lugger is extremely boring to listen too. It is a struggle not to fall asleep in her class. However, the class is not extremely hard. You do have to study for the tests but they are not the hardest I have ever taken.

Dry, monotone, annoying speaking voice. Knows what she is talking about & presents it clearly. Easy format for notes. Allows for meeting in office hours to get missed notes. Has in-class participation grades. Uses all class time (no leaving early. deal with it). Tests multiple choice, but must study a little. Curves enough to bring up a few points.

She is incredibly dry with NO personality when teaching her dull lectures. She puts a timer up on a projector to count down the last possible second until you can pack away your things to leave. You're considered lucky if you leave 10 seconds early some day. The exams are not easy, but not the worst. Bottom line, don't take her unless you HAVE to.
Relatively easy class, doesnt require strenous effort. But the prof. talks like she is very sad and uninterested in the topic. Would appreciate some unmonotone-enthusiasm every once in a while.

I feel this class could have been more enjoyable but Prof Lugger was not a very good lecturer. The class was not terribly hard but no one was really engaged in the material all that much and lectures were dry, making it difficult to sit through a lot of the time.
easy class..barely have to study for tests..she freaks out when people are talking though
Great prof!
Fairly easy class...lots of notes to take off power point but slides are given. Limited homework and limited thinking required.
No Comments

Professor Plymale is enthusiastic, caring, and offers an amazing Spanish class. She offers you plenty of opportunities to grow as a Spanish learner and be successful as a student. As long as you complete assignments and participate in class, you will do great and become better!

Professor Ari was an awesome Spanish teacher. The mindtap assignments make up a majority of your grade, so do them! Go to class and get easy participation points. The worst part was doing the oral exam, but professor Ari gives you resources and practice in class. It is mainly all in Spanish, but professor Ari made the time go by quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Kind and understanding, lots of homework and quizzes.

Nice to talk to in person and reasonably knowledgable. However, if you try to reach her electronically, she's completely unresponsive -- a critical issue if you're an online student in her course. If you're taking her residential course, you're probably fine. If you take her online course, she's unresponsive and unprofessional.
Good Course, Good Project, Good Papers, Bad Teaching. Will recommend the course for reading papers and a good project. Avoid the professor, I should have visited this site before.

I learn nothing about the subject from her class except her scary laughs and irrelevant discussion about how many good research projects she works on. Based on her knowledge, I feel she is more of a third-class manager and is wrongly in a professor's disguise. Would not recommend any of her teachings unless you want to enjoy a reality show.
The most pathetic professor I ever had. The most funny is, she covers her ignorance with a scary laugh.
extremely condescending and self-centered.  late for meetings, blows off students! AVOID!
rude, arrogant, and disorganized . . . avoid at all costs!

Professor is nice to talk to, and a fun person, but very confusing during lectures. Questions are rarely answered, and material is very badly presented. She needs to be more way more organized, your better off just reading the book than attending class.

Everything was great in her class and I like the way she taught. But I was disappointed about my grade. She gave me B+ and I think i deserve A- at least because I have completed all the assignment on the syllabus. Highly RECOMMENDED.
A real joy. A great professor and a brilliant scholar.  Her budget project instructions may seem vague...but just go talk to her, she is always ready to help.

This class was my favorite so far in Library Science. She was very helpful and I enjoyed being in her class. I never felt like falling asleep, and this is a huge problem for me at work and in classes. Very pleasant class experience. Thanks!
Pnina is great at guiding a class discussion but not dominating it. She has set forth very interesting projects and assignments that are very real-world examples of possible management situations.
Pnina is great.  I really don't like the subject matter of the class but she usually makes it interesting enough for me to stay awake!
Pnina is really sweet and always ready to help you out if you have any questions about the class. She also has a great sense of humor.
One of my favorite professors. She genuinely wants everyone to succeed and to do their best and is very clear about how Kelley wants her to grade.

Dr. Powell is an amazing professor. She is so kind and really wants you to succeed in her class. Even if you don't like presenting, Dr. Powell makes the class very easy and manageable. Go to office hours and speak to her after or before class - she really enjoys talking to her students and seeing you put in extra effort!

The best teacher I've had at IU yet! She truly makes an effort to know her students personally which is so rare at such a big school. If you put in the work on presentations outside of class you can totally receive a good grade at the end of the semester.

Amazing professor! Super kind and understanding. Can have some small pointless presentations which is annoying, however they aren't graded that hard. Sets clear expectations at the beginning of the semester.
TOUGH grader due to Kelley new policies class average can't be higher than B+. Feedback is great but will bring you down. Isn't all the best as people says she is!

One of the best C104 professors. She is extremely caring and respectful while still giving good feedback. She genuinely wants to see her students succeed. The course can seem intimidating heading into it, but she is able to make it so much simpler by being approachable, understanding, and fast at replying to emails. Please take her.
Love, so good at explaining projects and expectations for a class that's a little bit intimidating for most. She's also super understanding and easy to talk to. Would highly recommend.

She's actually the boy. So helpful to her students and actually cares about how you do. She helps make sure everyone is treated fairly, responds to emails right away, and is super understanding about everything. Not a tough grader too. Take her if you can.

Ms. Powell is amazing. idk why it didnt let me put it but I had her for business presentations this semester (BUS-C 104) and the class was so chill. easy grader and she understands that public speaking is not easy for many people. she's super willing to help, seriously this woman is a total sweet pea. i love her!
Very interested and informed about the topics she teaches. Enthusiastic and very helpful! You need to read the books to pass the class but very easy reads.
I LOVE MICHELLE POWELL. She is by far the best professor I've had at IU and her trans politics class was amazing.
Really cares about the topics and giving good quality readings. The class is participation heavy so if you don't like talking it may not be for you.
She's the greatest and I hope to take a class with her again.
Professor Podgursky is so knowledgeable in the subject, lots of content and there are a couple exams, and assignments that are easy as long as you attend lectures, 10/10 overall!

Fantastic professor. Super chill, really knowledgeable about the subject, and lectures are very engaging. You can tell he cares about students a lot, and always very friendly to questions, also really funny guy. Definitely recommend.
Chiller, great lectures and very entertaining. Very helpful when answering questions and very knowledgable.

Fun and easy class—used GarageBand to create different music pieces, background tracks, music loops, and more. He lets you resubmit assignments as many times as you want to get the grade you want. Good option if you're looking for an easy A&H, though it sometimes felt like a lot of work since we had to record a bunch of videos for various projects.

Took Z209 with him this semester as a freshman and he is AMAZING! Super chill and lenient with everything, approachable, kind, assignments are fun to do + based on completion, his feedback is positive and encouraging, you can tell he cares about his students. he's also super well versed in his subjects and experiences and is honestly top-tier.

I had him for Z209, but that doesn't matter. He's one of the best professors I've had while in college, and even though I had his night class. He made me want to attend his class every day, even though he never took attendance. He was a great professor, & human being, and you would be glad to have him as your professor in any course he offers.

Didn't really talk to him much on a personal level, but the class was super easy. He gives extra credit on almost every assignment for no reason other than that he enjoyed it. Would recommend if looking for an easy gen-ed.

Jeremy gave very insightful feedback in our private lessons that was clearly rooted in a knowledge of diverse musical practices. He pushed me to try new things while also celebrating my personal style. My studies with Jeremy imparted lessons that still inform my work today.

Podgursky is an extremely good professor. More than grades, he wants students to learn the art forms that he's teaching and is extremely passionate about what he does. Attendance is mandatory, yes, but if you email him first about missing, he usually doesn't mind if you miss. Also, he's lenient about deadlines only if you ask!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: An awesome class with an even better prof. Jeremy gives you complete creative freedom (with small exceptions) and this class is perfect for anyone that is interested in music production. Go to class, you will pass.

Super nice guy that you can have genuine conversations with. Not big on phones so don't have them out or he will call you out for it. But a really easy grader and I actually enjoyed the cool things we learned in his class. If you are interested in music or remixing things take this class and even if you're not it's a fun topic to mess around with.

I think this was his first time teaching this and was not supposed to, but he did great! He is very funny and makes the class interesting. However, this class is honestly pretty hard. What we have to know for tests always makes my quizlets over 100 terms. I really like this class it is fun, but I know a lot of people who had to drop it.

Dr. Podgursky is an excellent professor! He teaches from a place of experience, and you can tell that he is glad to be there teaching. He is very fun to have as a professor, and I would take another class with him, no doubt!

Jeremy's super laid back, always willing to help his students and grades projects based on effort, not skill. He struggled with having correct due dates in Canvas, as we often were taking the weekly quizzes (not worth much) before learning the content the quizzes were on. Overall a decent class to take as a gen-ed.

Professor Podgursky is by far the best professor I have ever had. His class was very project heavy, but he gave you all the necessary information and skills to receive an A. He encourages creativity and is very passionate about his field. If you have the chance to take his class, do it. You won't regret it.
He is a great professor and is passionate about music. He is an easy grader. This class is an easy A and I definitely recommend him and this class.
He is a great professor. He is a very easy grader and is passionate about music. He is very helpful and wants everyone to succeed. Definitely recommend this class and professor. Easy A.

Steve Presson my GOAT he is super cool and he knows what he is talking about. I know that he wanted me to succeed and he worked hard to give us all of the opportunities possible for us to excel. I have really loved being in his class.

Absolutely do not take this class Bad with timing, does not add due dates. Had a random in class quiz worth 30 points that is not on the syllabus he does not care if you have a reason to miss class you cannot make it up. Lectures are long and boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Notes slides are always available after the lecture, and tests are open-book and open-note but weighted very heavily. Easy to drift off since it's a 2.5 hour class, but also easy to find the material you missed. He's also very willing to help with anything and offers study sessions for each test. Going to his lectures is important for success!
Do NOT take his class, it's so long and he is not helpful when it comes to trying to learn new material.

Slides are usually like 100 slides long, which makes sense since class is 2.5 hrs once a week. Definitely go to class, if you do you'll be okay on tests. They are relatively hard but there's always a curve. Random in-class extra credit pop-quizzes. Nice guy always available via email.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A very fair professor, and a good lecturer with personality. I got a lot out of this course. My favorite professor I had at IU- but you must show up for class in order to do well.

One of the best professors I've ever had, he inspired me to look further into criminal justice and is the reason I chose to minor. It is extremely important to attend class, for they are once a week, because he uses multiple comprehendible explanations to better understand the criteria. His energy made this class interesting and enjoyable.

Professor Prieto was amazing. She is so intelligent and it shows in her lectures. They can be a bit boring because of the challenging material, however, she does a great job at including examples that help understand the material better. Lots of extra credit applied and the exams were very straight forward from her study guides!

Dr. Prieto is great! The content in P466 is super interesting, and she sets up the class so that students do well. If anything is ever unclear, she's very easy to access or talk to. Overall, one of the best professors I've had at IU.
She is amazing. If you're planning a career in academia, I highly recommend her upper level neuro classes.

Anne is an amazing professor. As long as you show up, ready for class, she teaches the material very well and is super clear although this is typically a difficult topic to learn about. What you put in you get out. She offers so much extra credit, is very flexible about office hours and (and is willing to make time outside of it). I love her. 10/10

Dr. Prieto is very sweet and knowledgeable. Her tests were very fair and straightforward. She posts diagrams prior to tests so you know exactly what to expect. She also offered extra credit AND dropped the lowest exam/4 quizzes. Her lectures were a little monotone but you can tell how passionate she is about NS. I highly recommend her!

Dr. Prieto is amazing! She really cares for her students and wants them to succeed. She even offered 15 extra credit points to add to your lowest exam, and you also get to drop your lowest exam grade! Lecture can get boring, but she is very knowledgable. I would definitely take this again with her!

Professor Prieto was amazing! She makes the content so easy to understand and her lectures are extremely helpful. She provides A LOT of review materials for her exams. She is unbelievably smart and made this class very enjoyable. Also, she offered extra credit that went towards our quiz grades as well as our lowest exam grade!
She was an amazing professor but the course itself is extremely difficult. the grades consisted of only exams and quizzes so defirbe
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Prieto is a great professor, and while her lectures can be a bit monotone and boring at times, she cares about the material and her students. The exams are take home, and as long as you take decent notes in lecture, they are very doable.

She is a sweet lady who really cares about her students success, however, she speaks in a monotone voice and lectures are very boring. Since it was all asynchronous and lectures were not mandatory, I did not learn as much as I wouldve being in person.

Sweet lady who knows what she's talking about and wants her students to succeed. Go to class, take notes and you will definitely get an A. Very molecular and cellular (in the title of the class) so make sure you enjoy that stuff if you are thinking about taking the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Class is based off of 4 take-home exams and an oral presentation with a partner. Grades take-home exams really hard. Class was really boring, and she assigned a LOT of reading. I would recommend attending class so you know exactly what she wants for the take-home answers. I regret taking this class because I learned nothing & take home exams stink.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Feels like a lot of content but it's really not that hard. Tests are pretty easy. TONS of extra credit available on each test. Professor is very accommodating.

I thoroughly enjoyed this class. It is evident that Dr. Prieto is very knowledgeable passionate in what she teaches. Although all tests are take-home, they take a good deal of time. There is one presentation that you do with another student during the semester. Attend class, take notes, and do the tests, and an A will be a likely outcome.
Hands down my favorite professor at IUB! She knows her stuff, is funny and provides you with all the information during her lectures that you need to succeed on the take home tests!

She is a good professor and explained things clearly, which was helpful for the dense material that was taught. All of the exams were take home, and as long as you take notes and use the readings to complete the exams, you will do well. There was also a class presentation that was graded by her and other students in the class which is gradedlenient

I was really nervous about taking neuroscience because the topics I s so intimidating! Dr Prieto is an amazing teacher and broke down the material so I got it. Just study whats in red text on her PowerPoints and you'll be fine. I went to 1 class and i was totally fine!

A LOT of reading, A LOT of diagrams, and A LOT of understanding is required to do well in this class.  The good news is that her exams are very fair; I made a B in the class without too much of a hassle.

The only downside to this class was that there were only four exams that went into your grade. I got a C on of the exams and it brought my final grade down to an 85 percent. Very disappointing. But it was my fault for not studying. One thing is for sure: you NEED to study for this class. Love Professor P, though!

I loved this professor. I was so nervous to take neuroscience but she helped so much. Taught very clearly and questions on the exams were only over the most relevant topics. Also, lots of extra credit on exams. Definitely manageable to get an A, just study, read, and go to class and you'll be fine.

I'm still not sure how I feel about this class. I got all A's on the exams but I feel that lectures drug on A LOT. Interesting content, probably could have a had a little better professor. She knows everything on the topic though.

She's very knowledgeable and really wants every student to do well in the class. Gives practice exams and has review sessions before tests. Reading the textbook takes a lot of time but if you read the chapters and attend lectures it's easy to get an A. She's eager to give students extra help since it's a hard subject. Grade is avg of 4 exam grades.

Prieto is a wonderful professor. She's enthusiastic about teaching and she has a wealth of knowledge about her field. Tests were fair (and take-home!) and she interacts well with students. Nothing but good things to say about this prof.
Excellent professor and brilliant researcher. Her lectures are very well-crafted and very clear. She obviously has a lot of enthusiasm for neuroscience. Grading is very straightforward and fair.

The class is pretty easy to get a high grade in if you put in the time. The only offensive thing I noticed was towards the middle to end of the semester she would laugh at students questions fairly often, sometimes it was a dumb question but not always. Lectures are boring and straight from the book.

Dr. Prieto was an amazing teacher.  She really wants her students to achieve in her class.  Lectures were sometimes boring.  Her tests are super easy.  She gives you a practice exam and quiz beforehand and then goes over them with you before the test and she puts like half those questions on the exam!!!  you can also drop one exam

She's a tough professor, but she really knows her stuff. Doesn't expect anything over the top from her students but wants them to learn as much as they can about the subject. She is passionate about her material since it's what she studies in her own lab, so that helps a lot with the interest level of the material. I'd say take her class if you can
3 take home tests and a presentation determines your grade. She grades hard, but if you put in the work and lots of it for the tests and presentation then you get an A.

I loved him! He's so sweet and helpful. I was intimidated by a stats course but he made this class as easy as he could. If you pay attention and do well on the in-class assignments then the exams are really easy because they are basically the same thing as the assignments and the practice exams. He also allows cheat sheets on exams.

Great prof and great class! There is a textbook that I looked at like twice but it's not mandatory since his lecture slides have all of the information. I truly don't think it would be possible to fail this class unless never come to class since he let us make a cheat sheet for every exam. He was really nice to talk to as well.

Nice guy. Bad lectures/class time is waste and DOES NOT prepare you for test at ALL. Neither does the homework. Only thing valid is the practice exams. The Exams are bogus as there is no partial credit- 0 or 4% per question. He follows the department guidelines for everything so grading is fine. Avoid but it'll be fine. Ruined by 4.0 this semester.

He just is not a good teacher. For whatever reason, he things it's smart to give really easy problems on the in-class assignments and hw. Then, when the test comes, the questions are so much harder than what we did in class. Avoid this dude. You can't understand him in class, and all he does is read off slides.

Very easy if you want to get stats done, only a couple of homework assignments, 2 exams and a final which you get a one pager for all. Highly recommend, also very accessible and explains things clearly. If you want a clear cut class this is it
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I mean he's a nice guy, and he cares, but like he just is not good at explaining concepts. The videos on Canvas are often overly confusing. It just seems like he is lazy and just an unneeded video just to say he put something. In class, he reads off the slides, and with all do respect, I can't understand a single word he says. Avoid if possible.

He's really not bad, lectures were him reading off the slides and then doing an activity with practice problems. The one TA is horrible and doesn't give reasons for points marked off. Exams huge part of your grade but they're just like the review questions. Didn't take notes and still have an A+.

this teacher only reads off the slides and is not good at answering questions. luckily, the slides do have good information on them so be sure to pay attention in class. the exams are a HUGE part of your grade, so really focus on those.

Class was async but he seemed helpful. HW was ok. You do have to do some hw by hand (incl excel formulas). Exams are proctored by honourlock and are pretty fair tbh but are harder than the practice tests. You get to use 1 'cheat' sheet, but the number of sheets isnt checked afaik so do what you will with that info. exams=50% weight. 2 tries for hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I took S303 in the summer and Pulindu was EXCELLENT. He was very clear with his examples in lecture and they matched up well with the lecture quizzes and homework assignments. He was quick to respond to questions over email and gave us a practice midterm and final so we felt prepared going into those as well. 100% would recommend stats with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This dude never replies to emails and just reads off the slides for 45 minutes with no real teaching or engagement. Then we get handed some random activity. Grading is super strict — no partial credit even for minor things like rounding errors. Easily one of worst prof ever. if u take him your bound to drop out ... #shrink this dude

this guy is so bbg HAHA but fr he's really nice and always willing to help. his lectures are kinda boring and he over-complicates stuff, but overall not bad. there isn't much homework and the exams aren't bad. he allows cheat-sheets for exams which helps a lot. just make sure to keep up and you should be good

Pulindu was a kind professor, but he sometimes overcomplicated material and I would have to re-teach myself material. He was a very knowledgeable man but there was a graded assignment at the end of every class and the lowest 3 are dropped (you can miss 3 classes).

kinda hard understanding him at first but he means well & will help you during or after class. There is not a lot of home work, the in class activities are more important than the HW. If you show up its not hard a class and i suck at math. the slides he uses are easy but he can over explain sometimes, but overall a good class and very manageable.
he is such a sweetheart.... dont listen to the other reviews

Professor Ratnasekera is incredibly nice and willing to help; however, he is terrible at teaching the subject at hand. He simply reads off the slides, jumps around and moves on. You can get by in the class with a B or C+ by showing up and doing all the homework's but do not expect to do well on the exams.
He is a good person, not a good professor. He does not teach, he just reads off of the slides. He is not very clear and sometimes hard to understand.

Prof. Bose is exceptionally well-versed in postcolonial studies. She makes an attempt to assign diverse readings. They are long so be prepared to read a lot. Classes are seminars, so participation is expected. She gave four quizzes and one final paper, for which she was very helpful and gave insightful feedback.

Professor Bose was kind and very interested in what she was teaching, but the lectures made no sense and were difficult to follow along with. She expects students to be an expert on the topics of this course. There are four quizzes and a paper, so the final grade is hard to improve if you do poorly on any one of them. Wouldn't recommend this class.
you can tell shes not an educator. Just a smart person talking about english. theres no structure to her lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She definitely has a specific outlook on the material in the lectures, and it shows. She made testing easy as she usually talked to us about the material, and the study guides were ALWAYS the test. Final readings are the only thing you really have to read because its on the final. She is extremely nice, takes time to learn names.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bose will work you really hard and you NEED to come to class prepared and ready to discuss. She also is not at all afraid of letting you know exactly what she thinks about something. That being said, she taught me more than any professor I've had at IU in my 6 semesters here, and helped me develop so much as a scholar. Take her class.
She was hard, she'll make you work, but her perspective is amazing. She's passionate about what she is teaching. It's a class that you'll look forward to going to.
She does expect you to read a lot, but you don't really have to because she goes over it in class. She also takes notes on the board so you just have to show up and copy that.
Bose is an asset to the department.

She has VERY high standards and is not afraid to call you out for not knowing anything for about the reading you were not supposed to prepare. She is very Femisnist and Left and it shows. HOWEVER! She is a great professor who knows her stuff. Do the reading, go to class, participate, know the material (use them study sheets) and you will do fine.
Although Professor Bose has high standards, they are easily met with participation. As long as you go to class and actually listen, the class can be quite enjoyable.

Professor Bose is an extremely difficult teacher with expectations that are almost impossible to meet. Views are very evident in class and in tests. Go to class, talk as much as possible, and study hard. You won't get an A unless you spend all your time on her class alone or know everything there is to know about corporations and societal issues.
You know what to expect but you have to work hard and do the research. She likes people who talk in class.

Purnima is definitely not the hardest professor I've had the English department, precisely because she's so clear with what she's looking for.  She expects a lot of work out of you, but you're never going to wonder why you got the grade you got.
Too much historical background and not enough time spent on the novels. Hard grading scale and very picky with papers.
Grading scale is ridiculous.  95% is the lowest grade you can get to earn an A.  What a joke.  Insists on spreading her extremely liberal views.

She was the most challenging prof I had in the English dept.  I thought she was very passionate about what she was teaching and really wanted to get that across to her students. The history she gave in class was to clarify the reading material. She very much wants to ameliorate her students and give them a more global perspective and understanding.
Purnima is a very challenging prof and expects the best from her students.  This is what makes one of her classes worth taking, you will learn in her classes.

The man left halfway between the semester for some personal reason but he was an outstanding lecturer, his slides were the best Ive ever seen, and he was very funny, passionate, and understanding about your problems. Mass Spec will plummet your score, and the class requires the time expected for a 4cr class. Enough effort will render you fine.

Pete makes lectures more enjoyable than they should be. I took the Survey of Organic Chemistry with him (CHEM-R340). This course is graded heavily on exams, Mastering Chemistry homework, and quizzes. If you want to receive an A in this course, make sure to familiarize yourself with Mastering Chemistry. He provides practice problems early-do them.

Pete is easily one of my favorite professors at IU! I had to take orgo a second time because I just couldnt grasp the material but Pete broke the material down to where orgo was easy and dare I say, fun. He gives a lot of wiggle room for error on his exams and quizzes which helped TREMENDOUSLY. I seriously recommend taking his class.

Pete was honestly one of the best professors I've ever had since being at IU. He is super nice guy and almost feels like a friend more than a professor. He makes a boring topic not only enjoyable, but fun as well. The only down side to his class is that it is a lab class so their is a lot of writing for lab reports. But other than that I recommend.

It was a privilege to take his class. Most caring professor I have ever met. Knows every name of his 600 students. Responds to e-mails in 5 minutes, regardless of the time. Office hours whenever you are available. No textbook because he clearly condenses the material into notes for you. do his worksheets and you will get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: She does a good job in making a boring class more interesting. She also really does want her students to succeed.

Great teacher! The class isn't too bad and she make tells you everything you need to know to do well. I personally would just skim over the readings and would be fine because we would discuss it in class. There was a semester long project we did that was kind of time consuming but I found it interesting so I didn't mind. Would definitely recommend!
Lindsey cares about her students and material, and gives great feedback. She offers office hours and in-class review sessions for tests. Really a great person and professor.
Awesome instructor.  Made a god awful class fun and saved everyone's asses with her final study review.

Great professor! Passionate about what she is studying and how to help others as well. Go to office hours and can help you with just about anything. Tough grader for intro course, but do your work and it'll pay off. Teaching style is beyond relaxed when lecturing.
Don't take her!
Lindsey is great. The class is hard but she tries to make it as fun as possible.

Honestly, I think this class is well worth it. Be prepared to do plenty of reading (but don't worry; there wasn't a single one that I didn't enjoy). Jennifer has an incredibly bright mind and wasn't at all as "commanding" as people seem to think she is. I have actually found the content from her S338 class to be applicable/helpful in other classes.

The absolute worst teacher I've ever had. Yeah the class was hard and u have to put in a lot of work, but that's besides the point. She made me feel extremely bad about my opinions (even though she'd asked for them). She made fun of students and spoke so highly of herself. Everything related back to her life. if ur opinion conflicted, urs is wrong.

This course was structured in a slightly juvenile way. For example, she would present very elementary concepts in class. However, the readings were interesting and more engaging. The course was Gender Roles and was taught with a substantial feminist tilt. Jennifer has potential and is bright, but can be a bit too commanding at times.

I enjoyed this course. Jennifer really knows her stuff. At times, the structure of the class felt like high school. Like every week, we had to answer reading questions in class. But if you read, you will get the answers and the reading question and other activities will count towards 20- 25 % of your grade.

There were too many assigned readings and specific test questions based on the articles.  Lectures require attendance and participation.  Overall it was too much work for a 100s level course.  However, she was nice and available to help.

Good Professor. Very good at lectures and discussion. Open to opinions that are not her own. Students would try to ask her opinion and she would not say it to encourage student discussion. She teaches sociology, which is something that may not be the most kosher thing, if you get offended easily by social facts don't take a soc class.

She is a great prof. S100 kids are freshmen and don't understand the concept of selective reading. haha. She is helpful and encourages discussion. People would get into heated convos in this class sometimes and she handled it very, very well, especially since this is a touchy topic. She's really friendly and helpful. Very interesting class!
Great teacher, clever and interesting. Willing to provide additional help.

Not too bad as long as you do the readings which there are A LOT of readings so be prepared for that, but a lot of them are interesting. She's a nice teacher who cares about her students. Sometimes the powerpoints were a little boring, but a lot of stuff we talked about was interesting.

TURN AROUND NOW AND CHANGE YOUR TEACHER! ITS A HORRIBLE CLASS! IT IS HARD! IT IS UNFAIR! IF YOU WANT TO READ 50 ARTICLES AND 10 CHAPTER AND FOCUSED TO GO TO CLASS AND TALK EVERYDAY THEN TAKE THIS CLASS. TESTS ARE HARD AND WORST SOO MUCH OF YOUR GRADE. ALL YOU LEARN ABOUT IS SEX, GENDER, AND HOMOSEXUALITY. EVERYTHING IS RELATED ABOUT TO WOMEN AND GA

Awful class. She gives way too many readings and chapters to read every night. Then in class, we don't go over the articles and instead talk about her personal feelings about matters. Tends to finish people's thoughts. Tests are hard because you won't go over the articles. She likes to relate everything to homosexuals and gender-related things.
absolutely awful worst teacher iv ever had. I could not learn anything in there. If you have the chance to take this class make sure you pass on it.
No Comments

She portrays the information accurately and is pretty thorough, but can be dry.  Class participation is part of the grade, and she tends to talk down to students  and finish their thoughts for them.  Overall, it is a good class and easy to earn a good grade if you do the work and take notes in class.

Far too opinionated. Instead of teaching the material, she uses her status as a professor to preach her own personal views. I consistently left class feeling personally insulted because of my race and sex.
Avoid this class at all costs. He just reads all lecture, doesn't even write anything on the chalkboard.

I took this course in the very first semester. Not so easy course per say. Boosts your thinking and is more challenging. Unless you are really good at maths and C programming, you will berate the Prof. here. Prof is really cool though. If you are serious enough to do homework and attend office hours, it will pay you off in finals.
The book does not prepare you for exams. The prereqs for the course do not teach you how to code in C. The project is impossible unless you are really good with C.

He reads from the book for 1.25 hours, expects you to know how to code in C for the project, and gives ridiculously difficult exams. The book does not help at all for the exams, nor does the professor or the AIs.

Easily the worst class I've taken at IU. Reads math equations word for word out of a book for 1.5 hours. Final project is almost unsolvable unless you've have extensive experience with C. Lecture does nothing to prepare you for tests.

The worst professor I have had in college. DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE! He expects you to know how to code in C for the project even though none of the prereqs teach C. He reads from the book for 1.25 hours. The book itself is the book he wrote which is very dry and hard to follow. He might be incredibly smart, but being smart doesnt mean you can teach

Smartest man I have ever met, but poor teacher. Don't be suprised if he accidentally puts a question on an exam that is impossible to solve, then requires a full mathematical proof as to WHY it is impossible to solve to get credit. Note: He reads the textbook for class, but that will not help you in exams. At least he tries hard and isn't a jerk.
He sits in front of the class and reads the book.  Rarely gets up and writes anything on the board.  The lecture is useless.  I want my money back!
Go over the old exams he gives you for the midterm and final.  But don't count on much help from him or the AIs... And good luck with the later assignments.

Challenging coursework with no help from him, but I DID learn what I was supposed to learn.  Trying to figure out what was in his pockets was the main reason to attend class.  (There should be 'very unhot' ratings.)
Poor lecture: 70 students start, 9 came to class regularly. Poor book. Bad class

He has an accent but you get used to it. My biggest problem was when problems get complicated he gets lazy and just says "you can finish it, I'll leave it as an exercise" when he hasn't even taught you how to do that type of problem even once. First Math class I have ever struggled in. Luckily, all the home work you have unlimited tries to get 100%

Awful teacher. Uses examples directly out if boon so attending class is useless. If you ask gin to clarify he never knows what you're asking. He doesn't seem to care about students and is super uninteresting. He always says proving things is beyond the scope of the class but are necessary to understand the material.

Don't do it - he is always behind the other classes and I could not understand him a lot of time.  Just before the test you will be doing tons of homework to get caught up.  He is also not available for office hours and you cannot e-mail him.  Those that have been recommended to me for Finite:  McKinley, Hendrickson, Parks or Kattner.

Mano was an awful teacher.  Understanding him was not really an issue if that is what you are worried about.  You think he is a decent teacher until you take the midterm.  He doesn't prepare you at all for the questions on the midterm.
MANO! He's a great teacher. I took him for Finite and M119. You have to get used to his accent, but he is an overall great professor. I enjoyed his class
Very good teacher he uses real life examples to make understanding the material easy. He is an easy and helpful teacher. Yes, he has a little bit of an accent but still easy to understand.

Mr. Mano (as he told us to call him) is very nice, but he doesn't speak english very well and doesn't understand what you are saying when you ask him questions. Finite is already hard and he made it 10x harder then it should have been.
Absolutely the worst math teacher you could ever ask for. Completely incomprehensible and his English is atrocious.
You get used to his accent.
Really hard to understand and the math is already hard to begin with. His famous phrase is "suppose say" and he likes doing examples involving deer????
Brutal exams. No curves.

Not a good professor, at all. Does not actually teach how to do the problems but would rather focus on lecturing on the nuances of classical physics to non-physics majors who genuinely don't care. Exams are nearly impossible to do well on -- Roger told the class that the average was a failing score on the midterm, but that was still "too high".

A 65% average is too high??!!? Was happy with stuents getting a 57% average on the exam, he wants the ego boost of having a hard class without being a good enough professor to actually support doing that while not having the class be torture

reviews.comment: Very clear and well spoken. A fair grader whose goal is to teach, not give you crippling anxiety. Refreshing.

reviews.comment: Took him w/prof Warren. Has a British accent, but can be understood. Lectures were informative/easy to follow, but could get boring. Material was tough, but he gave us the tools we needed to succeed. Very available & helpful in discussion and office hours. Got a cheat sheet 1 pg front & back; fear the material, not the prof! Physics is just hard.

This is a VERY DIFFICULT class, be warned. This class, along with organic chem, are meant to weed out premed-alikes. This class will test your deductive reasoning and pattern recognition to a limit. My suggestion? Do every single book problem and bust your behinds studying.

He likes to write exam problems that are meant to trick you. I don't care for that in a prof. HMWK is easy, exams are HARD. Not much continuity there. So far, there has been no hint that there might be a curve. Last test average was a 10/20. You know something is wrong when the average is an F. I'm not saying make it easy, just make it fair.
Horrible Teacher. Exams are nothing like the problems in class. Stated in his lecture that he wanted to trick students. Horrible at explaining ANYTHING. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!

Great prof. no complaints except to study harder than I did the first 2 exams. intelligent, well-spoken, super strong background, and confident in his subjects. go-to advice guy as well. pay attention, take notes, and show up, and it'll be super interesting.

Professor Preston is one the best professors i've ever had. He is very knowledgeable on the information which makes learning from him so much easier. He is engaging and truly wants you to learn the material and succeed in his class. I look foward to his classes and I highly recommend taking his class.

Professor Preston is an amazing professor. He is so knowledgeable of every topic and actually wants students to do well. He gives study questions for the tests and doesn't veer away from them. I cannot recommended taking his class enough as he actually wants students to succeed.

Easiy one of, if not the best professor at IU. Definitely would recommend taking this class if you are looking to learn and not just waste time. In my opinion, the world could definitely use more professors like Daniel as he encourages discussions in class, holds you accountable, and is so knowledgeable on a vast majority of topics.
10/10 for me.

Professor Preston is the most knowledgable and best professor I have had at IU. You can tell he cares for his students, and also cares that they are not wasting their money on an education. His classes are beneficial to attend,  and the structure of his class is clear. The tests are kind of difficult, but the resources are there to succeed.A+ Prof.
Top 5 Professors I have had at IU Bloomington during my three years here thus far.

If you want a professor who is going to hand you an A just for showing up, do NOT take Daniel Preston's class. If you want to learn, DO take his class. He has a wealth of knowledge and is always happy to clarify any course material he goes over. There is a lot of homework and written responses, but just do the work, and you will be fine.

reviews.comment: He is great and all of his lectures have been very interesting and engaging. if you show up to class, engage in lectures, and prepare/study you should get an A.

Professor Preston is a great professor. He is meticulous and detailed in his lecturing. You can tell that he extremely knowledgeable on the content he teaches due to his prior and current work experience in related fields, and best of all, he is personable and cares about you as an individual. If you have to take V-182, take his class.

Great professor, 182 goat. Best prof to take for this class. Very engaging lectures. Light homework outside class keeps you on track to prepare for exam. Exams aren't too bad if you pay attention in lecture. W

Professor Preston is an amazing professor who sets clear expectations for his students and is very knowledgeable on his subject. With plenty of professional experience and a skill of speaking, his lectures and class are easy to understand and are always interesting.

Dan was legit the best professor I have ever had. The way he bases his class is completely fair, he uses many videos instead of readings to keep you engaged and uses studies to see what students enjoy and engage with. Dan is an amazing professor that actually teaches things that are useful to your life. I 100% recommend taking him.

i love this man. he is very accessible outside of class and if you meet w him he gives you so much advice. exams are pretty difficult but as long as you study the lecture slides and quizzes you'll be good. also gives a cheat sheet for final. take dr p

Dr. P is awesome. He is absolutely an expert in his field and explains policy in a digestible way. His lectures are very interactive and engaging, with lots of videos and small group discussions. The exams can be difficult, but just do the reading, pay attention to lectures, and make sure to study well and you'll be fine. Take V182 with him!

reviews.comment: Had him for V100 as well. Excellent professor who is extremely knowledgeable on the topic. Course is combined w/ graduate section. Content is approachable and he makes it easy for non-finance ppl to get an in-depth understanding of how global IDF works. Even as a Kelley major, I would STRONGLY recommend his class. 2 tests, 4 HW, 1 final project

He held a lot of discussions within lectures, and was quite good at leading them. The tests aren't too difficult, however the wording can be somewhat tricky so look out for that. Just show up to class and take a few notes, the class will be quite easy.

Preston has a great teaching style that makes lessons relevant and applicable in the outside world. I would advise actively engaging in class to get the most out of it. You learn the most in lectures. Readings are not hard or long. Exams can be kinda difficult but nothing out of the ordinary.

By far and away the best professor I've ever had in my academic career. I just created an account solely to leave a review for this guy, he is so legit its not even funny. 

Prof has 50+ 5 star reviews for a reason.

He is extremely well versed in international affairs, and is very well qualified to be teaching this course. Do the homework!!! All of the homework assignments were incorporated into the in-class lessons very well. Participate in class, he loves participation and breakout discussions. I would 10/10 recommend this course, he is the best professor!

I really liked this prof. You can tell he's passionate about what he's teaching and lectures were interesting and engaging. Readings are a little long but you can just skim. If you pay attention during lectures you should get a good grade.

Lectures are important, as that is where you'll get the best notes. The chapters you're supposed to read for the textbook assignments are VERY long. Overall, not super hard as long as you keep track of your work and ATTEND class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Preston is an incredibly humble and intelligent man. His lectures are very detailed and informative, and he is very passionate about his course subjects. Tests can be tough, but pay attention and take good notes and this will not be an issue. Professor Preston is the only guy I would recommend taking V182 with

Professor Preston is amazing and very knowledgeable. Lectures go in-depth into interesting topics. Exams can be tricky and he doesn't round. The study guide really is just a guide to go into depth about the topics in the guide don't just look up exactly what it's saying and you'll do fine. Trickiest exam is the 1st one then you get used to them.

Preston is a very knowledgeable professor, he always talks about his personal experiences living internationally to help the class understand more about the topic. The exams are kind of annoying, with multiple choice questions consisting of "select all that apply" and you only get partial credit if you choose 1 option correctly.

I love Dan Preston, he's highly intelligent and makes his lectures extremely interesting and engaging. There is a lot of reading and homework in the class, but half of the homework is watching documentaries he assigns that helps you understand the material and is actually so interesting to watch/learn about. I would recommend him as a professor.

reviews.comment: really enjoyed this class with this professor. as long as you show up and do all of the work, you should be fine

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class! The material was very interesting, and he made sure to divide the material up between group discussions, videos, etc. I also appreciated how all of our quizzes were take home ones, and we could use some notes on the tests. The tests were difficult, but I feel as if he gives enough opportunities to balance out your grade.

I would highly recommend taking Prof. Preston! This was the only class I had that I was very engaged in the entire time and he is definitely one of my favorite professors I have had here at IU. Tests are moderate and if you pay attention you will do fine. Quizzes and homework don't take very long and are used in class when lecturing.

I loved Professor Preston! This class was one of the few I was completely immersed in. He uses a lot of real life example to demonstrate topics that he discusses in his class. The tests aren't bad if you study and pay attention in class. He is a great mentor and is always willing to help any student. I would retake his class if I could.

Literally amazing! I had him for IFS (International Dev Finance & Financing the UN's SDGs) and he uses a lot of academic articles instead of textbooks. He'll show one argument and then show you the complete counter. Super accessible outside of class and always willing to impart wisdom, share his experiences, etc. Best professor I've had.
He's a gem professor. Makes you work real hard for the grade and gives one a lot of insights that are required in the business and after college life.

I may be biased because his class was a topic I was extremely interested in, but the instructor is a pretty good illustration of what a professor is. Professional, knowledgeable on the subject, real-world experience in his topic, articulate and good at explaining complex concepts. Class does challenge you with papers and projects.
Just don't guys, dont do it.

I had Professor Preston for Spring of 2021 and our class was mixed, meaning zooms once a week and optional the other days. We have weekly lectures, quizzes, and discussion posts once a week for class and then 2 papers and a project throughout the semester. The exams are tough and he is a tough grader, so be prepared for that. I struggled in V182.

reviews.comment: His exams are basically impossible to study for because the format of the questions are so wordy. I could go on and on about this class, but if you have the opportunity... choose a different professor.
