reviews.comment: Ignore the good ratings, taking a class with Professor Preston is NOT worth it. His tests are completely unfair consisting of primarily "select all that apply" questions that were not even topics on the study guides he gives you. Lectures are boring and feel more like you're being required to listen to him brag about all of his accomplishments.

His tests are absolutely ridiculous. He blames his scheduling time on the university when literally all other professors chose their own times. Who schedules a final at 8 am on the final day of the semester? A literally crime against humanity. Not to mention the tests are 100 questions and "select all that apply." Good lecturer, bad test maker.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Preston was by far the best professor I've ever had. He fostered an environment that enabled students to delve deeper into topics and go beyond just the basic understanding of comparative and international policy. He was always available to meet and discuss class topics or future endeavors. I would highly recommend taking his courses!

this was my favorite class this semester. Very interesting and few homework assignments aside from two short papers and a project. The tests are very difficult and detailed in my opinion but I still highly recommend Preston. He is also accessible out of class to answer questions.

When choosing a professor for Ntnl and Intl Policy, go with Preston. He's incredibly knowledgeable and respected in his field, and a great resource if you take advantage of his office hours and time after class. This course is a fantastic introduction to all things policy, and Preston inspires his students to learn and lead with heart and humility.
He is kind of awkward but an amazing lecturer. The tests can be hard but as long as you make a study guide off of the slides its a manageable A

Love love love Danny P. He has absolutely incredible lectures and is so interesting and knowledgable. Tests were pretty tough- you have to sink in a lot of studying. It is possible to get an A, but you work for it. Definitely recommend him for National and International Policy- it was truly awesome!

Class was difficult but Professor Preston made himself available outside of the classroom to help. Tests were very hard because of the way he words the questions but there were other graded assignments in the class so your grade wasn't reliant on the exams. Attendance and participation in class are considered in your final grade.
Every class is a lecture, so be ready for that! The exams aren't "hard" but you should study!

Loved this class (V160)! The lectures were really interesting, but you HAD to pay attention or you would miss something important. The tests were near impossible no matter how much you studied or understood the material and are worth a lot of your grade. Even with 100% on tests, consulting project, and participation, test grades hurt overall grade

Screw this guy. His class makes me fall asleep everyday. Attendance is so important and he will count you absent if you're caught on your phone. His tests are actually impossible and in his eyes, a 75 grade is amazing because he knows how difficult his exams are.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: If youre trying to take National & International Policy, try to choose a different teacher. His lectures are very easy to follow and study, his homework is easy reading questions, only two papers. However the exams are insane. 50 questions formatted: A, B, C, A & B, B &C, all of the above, none of the above. (on every single question). Its awful.

Preston is a baller. Attendance is mandatory and participation is recorded in the final grade, so be engaged. The tests are adequately hard, but the group project is graded harshly. He puts together solid power-point slides and provides insightful commentary on real world issues. One of the smartest men I've met and it reflects on yourself.

I was a total nerd in this class, which I usually am not. I loved his lectures though. he was always interesting and has a special way of explaining material to our age in a way we understand. he has any credentials that set him aside from other professors. TAKE THIS CLASS!  wouldn't call it an easy a but is enjoyable and a definite doable a

favorite class and professor this semester by far! I found the course material to be relevant and lecture & discussion to be really engaging  NO TEXTBOOKS EXAMS weren't particularly hard and he adds points if you participate in class really cool person! talk to him after class if you have the chance!
Best professor I've had at IU. Taking a third class taught by him now. His classes aren't "easy" but if you go to class and pay attention, you're in the clear

Professor Preston's course is structured to get students involved in discussions. This class got me into politics and made me like reading the news. There are two essays and three exams. He is a great professor and keeps his class engaged. Do not sit there on your phone. Ask questions and enjoy learning about wars, government programs, & ISIS

Preston is an awesome prof. His powerpoints are interesting and well organized. He also breaks up his lectures with videos to keep the class engaged. The class has two exams,two short essays, a group project, and then the final. No quizzes or other assignments. The exams are easy as long as you pay attention in class and study the powerpoints.
I loved him! Just really study the slides and you will be okay! Also, at least read through the articles once.
The tests are extremely hard compared to the lecture! Questions on test are VERY hard!
Prof. Preston is definitely a great professor and a mentor. He has a great knowledge on public affairs. If you really want to learn something on this class, you should choose him.

Thought this class was going to be easy  but it definetly wasn't.  He intentionally made the multiple choice questions on exams really hard and the exams were overall pretty difficult for a 100 level class. I suggest picking a different class if you are looking to fulfill a gen ed requirement

This class was supposed to be my major but fortunately helped me realize that SPEA is not the place for me. He's a nice guy, just not a great professor. It would've been useful to have a textbook. Lectures were ok because of interactive component, though I often loathed going to class.

Professor Preston is by far the best professor I have had at IU thus far. He really cares about the students and encourages visits to office hours to clear up any and every question that comes up. His real-life experiences make the class more interesting. He is very well informed on every subject that  is studied. Definitely choose him for V160!
Professor Preston is very interesting, knowledgeable, and has an incredible amount of understanding on national and international affairs. This is a great introduction course into SPEA.

Prof. Preston is seriously the best at IU! Learned so much and had fun while doing it. He's very laid back and has a lot of life experience. Attend class, take notes and you'll do fine in this class. Keep it up Prof. Preston!

Prof. Preston is by far the best at IU. He is very engaging and you will learn so much from his course. If you take any of his classes, get to know him! He'd be a great mentor. Study the slides and pay attention in class and you will do fine. Also, he's pretty damn gorgeous.

This was my first class with Professor Preston, in his Policy class. He is very thorough during (mandatory attendance) class. He shows a couple video clips to split up the lecture and some group work. I rewrote the slides and studied all lists (countries, tactics) and got As on all of the tests. No book, just keep up on current events.
Favorite professor at IU
seems like a nice guy up front but then is shady when it comes to grading.
Excellent prof! One of my favorites.   Very helpful and makes class very interesting

This is my 2nd class with Preston. He is a great instructor and has a lot to offer. I have learned more about finance from his class than any other finance course I have ever taken. I highly recommend him for any class he teaches. This topic was International Development Finance

BEST PROF YET!!! Super interesting. Has amazing stories from real world experiences. Haven't had one boring class yet. Always learning new things. Pay attention, and study the slides, and you'll get an A. Keep it up Prof Preston!

Great class that isnt very time consuming. the material is really interesting and he makes everything so easy to understand. a couple of papers and a group project, but nothing too bad. kicking myself for the a- i got because if I had studied a little harder I couldve gotten an A!! exams r straight from the slides - study those and ur golden.

Awesome Professor! You learn a lot in this class and he has many great real-world experiences to share. lectures are interesting and tests are curved heavily. One of my favorite classes and professors

Preston is an amazing professor! has a lot of real world experience and knowledge which makes the class very interesting. He is helpful and cares for the students not to forget how good looking he is! Tests weren't too bad, just go over all the slides..couple papers as well. Take his class, you'll love him!!

Awesome prof, has a bit of a god complex but it's ok because he's hot. Made class enjoyable and explained material well. You won't consider skipping the class if you get a look at him. Speak up in class if you're knowledgeable about the material, he'll like that and most likely give you a good grade. Definitely recommend him and his courses.

This was my favorite class last semester by far. I highly recommend it, no matter your major! Preston is an incredibly knowledgeable guy. Policy issues can be pretty complex, and he does a great job of breaking them down and making them understandable. You can get by without doing the readings as long as you study his .ppt slides before the tests.

This professor is great! Best IU course I ever took. I learned so much and it wasn't too difficult! He has so much experience and good stories. He?s really interesting and so is the course material. Take this class!

Professor Preston is awesome! Great guy who genuinely cares about his students. Teaches very well and has so much experience and knowledge about the course. He's also very hot! Class is not difficult at all although you do have to study for the exams. He's very fair with grading though. Favorite professor at IU for sure. Wish he taught more classes

Daniel Preston is a fantastic professor and mentor. He is young and approachable and always happy to help. I took his class on a whim and now it is the reason I am a SPEA major. I still visit him to talk about my future and hear his insights on the World.

Daniel Preston is the greatest instructor I have had.  Although I have only take 1 class with him I still remain in contact and visit his office hours.  He is the definition of an expert in International Policy.  The experiences and information he brings to class are invaluable.
My favorite SPEA teacher of all time!
Excellent teacher, I really enjoyed the class. I was actually sad when it ended.

This professor is definitely great! He is erudite and care about students. Although his stuff is not so easy for international students, I still regard his course as outstanding. Preston is always happy to help you, even your question is about another academic topic. Soooooo nice and excellent guy. You can feel the world in his class!!

Knowledgeable. Informative. Helpful. Cares about students. Widely traveled and often brings his experiences meaningfully into lectures. I learned so much in his V160 class--he greatly enhanced my understanding of national and interntl news and events. He is a nice guy too.
this teacher is awesome. and so good looking. he is very knowledgeable
He is very knowledgeable about the topics discussed, is a very caring young professor. There are attendance points, a few tests and papers. Over all not to difficult of a class

He is very knowledgeable on all topics discussed in class. It can sometimes be boring be he is a great teacher. Tests aren't bad as long as you know all the things on the slides. I would definitely recommend taking his class.
his exams are straight off the slides.. no book required, just the readings he posts online and the slides he goes over in class.. highly recommended, easy A!
My favorite teacher ever!!  He is so helpful and a great lecturer.
He's a great teacher with a lot of real world experience. The test were pretty easy if you went to class and the papers weren't bad either....
Her classes are not hard, she is a very nice professor, really sweet.

Professor Pyburn is the number one professor I recommend. She is one of the only professors that encouraged me to assess information critically and think for myself. Shows students great respect. I got more out of her classes than any other class - she imparts students with a perspective that is valuable in all aspects of life.

Dr. P was very knowledgable, yet her AI's did most of the work. She really just lectures and has them grade and lead the on campus field trips. This class was easy as long as you showed up, did the readings, and participated in discussion. Best if taken as an 8 weeks class.

She's really sweet, really knowledgeable. It's clear she's had a lot of global experience, but in the readings we were assigned (the papers she wrote on her research) make her seem quite arrogant and irritating. But it was an easy and painless 8 wks class :)

Incredibly knowledgeable on all things Maya. If you're looking for a class where you learn "the facts," Pyburn is not for you - she provides a huge synthesis of material and lets you draw your own conclusions. If that bothers you, stay away! Okay lecturer. Easy assignments (some are busy work), and flexible on due dates.
Amazing class! She is hands down one of the best Profs I've ever had.
Amazing class! She is hands down one of the best Profs I've ever had.

Thought she was a good teacher UNTIL after the class was over and I found out about a grade that wasn't explained well or possibly at all on the syllabus and she wouldn't change it, explain the grade given, email back, or meet with me just to clarify a possible misunderstanding, and was rude when I emailed her. It was very unprofessional.
Terrible course had nothing to do with topic.  No point to anything I learned.  Looks nice, but she has a nasty side.
Dr. P will change your life if you let her. She's the best professor I've ever had.

I LOVED her. She was amazing. I took this class as a total blow off class to go with my schedule.  It was an easy class, but I actually learned a lot by just showing up! The prof is so knowledgeable. This is the first prof at IU i've thought deserved to be rated. You guys, TAKE THIS CLASS!

Anne Pyburn is hands down one of the best professors you can take a class from.  If you have a problem doing well in her class, it can only be because you are not putting ANY effort into it.  She is very smart, very kind, lenient if you just talk to her, and makes you think more than any professor I've had in my 4 years here at IU.  She's amazing.
Horrible. Not about the subject it was supposed to be on. Rambled on and on about nothing in particular. Gone for 3 weeks of an 8 week class to visit her husband.
Very knowlegeable and sweet.
No Comments
No Comments

He was okay. Not completely my favorite, but sufficient for an intro-level professor. I could have done without his sometimes condescending attitude regarding a few topics. He seems to get frustrated when he doesn't feel like the smartest person in the room. Otherwise, the class was easy and provides a thorough basis of knowledge on Script Analysis

He is a wonderful professor, he always makes things different. If you don't like presenting in front of a class this is not the class for you. If you do like presenting or it doesn't bother you, I highly recommend it!!

He provides a unique way of explaining the material.  He even go as far as to realte the material to real world examples. He's a tough grader on the papers, but if you read the plays you'll get an A. (I read about half and got a B)I highly recommend Tim Pyles!
A great teacher. All the tests are exactly like the reviews and if you dont understand a topic he will take the time to make sure you do before he moves on.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Shi Qiu has created a course that is both engaging and challenging in all the best ways. He's a brilliant teacher and is incredibly personable. I would recommend him to anyone taking E370. It isn't an easy class, but there isn't a section of E370 that is. His sections scored higher on every exam compared to every other professor.

He doesn't know how to teach. The class average for the last two exams were around a 65% and he wouldn't give a curve. The first couple of classes, he talked about communism as the perfect government. No one really knows how to prepare for his tests.

Worst professor I've ever had. What is written in the exam is not exactly the same with what he explained in class. It was my first economics class and he started by asking the students if prostitution is a good or a services. Discussion helped in understanding the concept but lecture is boring.

I started  off with a rough, elementary understanding of economics, familiar with things taught on the first test. But throughout the lectures, I became confused on even the simplest of ideas. whenever someone have a question, he would tell them to read the book, and when they said they wanted clarification, he told them it was simple and moved on.

Shi simply does not know how to speak English, so the class is pretty difficult. I was able to get a pretty good grade due to my understanding of economics before I even took this class, however most of the students who were taking economics for the first time struggled majorly due to his broken English and unwillingness to help students.

He is absolutely THE worst teacher you could ever ask for. He would spend half the class talking about some complex math equation and then afterwards say that we don't need to know it. for class right before the midterm rather than review he taught new material that was just as incomprehensible as the rest of his lecture.  Switch if you get him.

First of all, as a Kelley undergrad student, I did not enjoy showing up to class to hear my professor remind us all how much he "hates Kelley students" every day. Additionally, the fact that he managed to incorporate his political beliefs (which are skewed) into every lecture detracted from learning at best and were incredibly offensive at worst.

It should be a normal statistics class. However, he completely made this class as a math algebra class which drove us crazy! Most of students who take this class because of business major, but we don't know why he did tremendous math on the board and he was sooo happy when he was looking at his non-sense math stuff on the board. Don't take it
No specific text book. Go to class. Refer handouts by professor. Complete assignments. Learn by googling topics that are not clear from handouts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I took Cloud Computing under Judy - The course content is good - Overall teaching was not impressive - Grading system is very easy
Awesome subject. Professional projects. Nice Prof.

This is probably the worst class I have taken at IU. The book is outdated, the lectures are impossible to follow (mandatory attendance), and the assignments are not interesting. This class is ridiculously easy though. I would not recommend taking this class to anyone.

So...I don't want to be harsh here because I think Prof. Qiu is probably very intelligent and a great research professor. But this class had probably the lowest learning-to-information ratio of any class I have ever taken in any subject. Period. Lots of concepts thrown at you; let's hope they stick to the wall. Not difficult but frustrating anyway.

Judy Qiu is a very nice person, but her teaching leaves a lot to be desired.  The assignments are very difficult, but her lectures do not prepare you for them at all. This was my least favorite Computer Science class I've taken at IU.  Everything is extremely confusing and unclear in this class.

Prof. Judy Qiu taught us this course in the Fall of 2012. She is an incredible teacher. She really knows her subject. Quite helpful. Exams and assignments are tough and requires deep thinking. Prof. also has knowledge outside usual course content. Class participation and project involvement matters. If you are lazy, you won't like this course.

Judy is a very nice person, but teaching just isn't her strong suit.  Lectures were a confusing mess and assignments were worse.  Her explanation of topics was very shallow, yet assignments required very deep understanding the concepts.  On the bright side, she did respond to email and answer questions during one-on-one meetings

Instructor is great one on one but was lost in the larger section required to teach by the university(60 people in a lab!). The requirements and expectations of the class were often confusing and it was harder to figure out how to turn in the homework then it was to do the homework.

Overall poor stats professor. Though he is very knowledgable and willing to answer questions, it is near impossible to understand his english - it's as if he is speaking a completely different language in lecture. The only reason to go to lecture is for clicker points. Only take his class if you're willing to put in a TON of time teaching yourself.

He was absolutely unorganized, spoke very poor English, and did not explain material well at all. Worst professor I have had at IU. If you have no previous knowledge of Stats, I would not recommend him at all.

Tough to understand and follow material. Do not take if you are not willing to put in the work to teach yourself or are a bug, specifically a cricket. Clicker points are the biggest motivation for going.
The worst professor at this university.

This professor made S-301 the worst course experience I've had during my time at IU. His inability to speak English blocks any chance of being able to understand his long, monotone, boring, lectures. He fails to bring any sort of enthusiasm to the classroom and lacks any ability to hold the attention of his students. Take ANYONE but this professor

Far and beyond the worst professor I have had during my college career.  Professor Shan has no grasp of the English language whatsoever, and therefor understanding the material is extremely difficult.  It may seem harsh, but while he may be speaking English, it seems like an entirely different language.  Do NOT take statistics with this professor!

Professor Katherine Rhode was one of the best professors I had in the astronomy department here! I really enjoyed her extragalactic class, because of her great lecturing and accessibility outside of class. She is a harsh grader however, and her exams are difficult. But if you know the ins and outs of the content, you should be all set!

Wow, what a disappointing class and professor. Doesn't let us check our answers on tests and homework. This is a level 100 class and yet it grades like a 400 level. New students, BEWARE. This class is not worth the headaches. The material is interesting but you'd be better off with a better professor.

Prof. Rhode is a solid choice if you're taking A105. Lectures were clear and she made review guides before each exam that are extremely helpful. Part of your grade is determined by classwork, but you complete the questions in class and she walks around to help students. Easy A as long as you show up and pay attention
You get exactly what you expect out of a 100 level course. Easy material and fine professor.
Professor Rhode is super sweet and really takes time out of class to help the students who need it
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Rhonda is understanding and helpful. She'll hold you to high expectations, but will also cut you some slack when you deserve it. She's experienced and passionate, and has several stories about her time as a high school teacher. Definitely worth taking her.

Rhonda taught EDUC-M341 while Dr Barton was on sabbatical. Rhonda usually does M300. Because of this, our curriculum was Dr. Barton's design, not hers. Rhonda is a good and experienced teacher, who has an example for EVERYTHING. She's reasonable and will hold you to high expectations, but is also understanding. Not easy, but worth the effort.
Instructions for her projects and papers are the most vague instructions I have ever been given in college. Be prepared to ask a lot of clarifying questions.
All readings are online articles.  She really cares about teaching and helping her students.
Her class is so easy if you do the homework and participate during class
Good

This class is pretty easy. It is an easy B but it's hard to get a solid A. Very little homework. Nice teacher. I got an A- but deserved an A. I would suggest asking around for easier graders, but if you just want a B take her.

If u want to get an A, take another teacher b/c u certainly won't get 1 from her.Very difficult grader, takes off points 4 no reason, expects too much.Theres absolutely no rounding/curving of grades or final grade, so u could have an 89.9 & she would not give u the A-, which seems pretty heartless to me;Shes boring,heard other teachers r way easier

Dont really think she is a strong teacher.  Very bland in the classroom, and I really dislike her teaching style.  She always finds something wrong with a speech, even if it appears great to other people.

Teacher is ok-easy. You have to work hard to earn your A. You can't really slack off and make up speeches on the spot. If you listen to her, and try to do everything that's said on the rubric, you'll get an easy A.
No Comments

She is a very easy grader. I've heard about other X104 teachers giving Ds on speeching and my worst speaking grade in here was a B+ and I got several A+s on speeches. I would definitely take her if you want a good grade. She is also very nice and understanding but has a very soft voice so listen carefully or you might miss something.
Only gave out As and Bs, easy grader, friendly, speaks quietly so listen
Really cool prof!!! take japanese jujitsu, its an awesome, fun class.
Great teacher. Made me love finger locks. Take this class!
The man. Take his class!
Comes off as rude to his students and has an inflated ego. He is very lecture-heavy, often without slides to follow along.

He has been super understanding and a great teacher. Sometimes his lectures feel a bit pointless but I think it's mostly because I had to take this class and feel I don't need to know most of what he's teaching. Overall though, super nice guy and good at teaching!
so incredibly hot

He is SO nice and understanding of our hard semester this year! I am taking this class during the COVID pandemic and he has been insanely supportive of our needs and very flexible. I will say that the lectures and content in C207 is not very interesting, but it is necessary for anyone who is a media major! We also only have one assignment a week!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He is so awesome and its a pretty easy class with a LOT of reading. He is very understanding and wants everyone to succeed. We had discussion posts every class and 2 papers. That was the entirety of the course!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is really nice, like others said, the class is highly outdated. She still teaches Photoshop and Illustrator and teaches u things that look so mid and take 5 seconds to make with AI these days. Some weeks you have 8 hours of work, and some weeks not even 30 minutes. Its also really boring and i think this course can go more into case studies etc

Took the practicum course with her - nice Prof and intelligent person, but very disorganized with the class structure and the weight of workload. We would have random weeks with unbearable loads, and then not work at all. She is very light on feedback, even when you lose points. It can be difficult to improve and is generally frustrating.
Took her for digital content practicum and hated the workload, Course is all over the place and instructions are unclear

Professor Simone is absolutely amazing, she is so sweet and helpful. She is always smiling and genuinely cares about her students. Her syllabus organization is also amazing, even with multiple group projects course work does not feel like a lot. A lot of creative freedom is awarded. She also brought her dog to the class once, it was soo cute!!

You would not want any other professor for M344! She is the best! There are a lot of assignments, but if you do them, you are getting an A. She will be there for you every step of the way! Absolutely the best!

She was such a great professor and this was an amazing class!!! She assigns a good amount of homework but majority of it is started in class and the homework is to finish or add something. She likes to make class fun and I looked forward to this class everyday. Highly recommend taking this class with her.
Loved her! Fair grader and is really passionate about her students and the learning process.

Overall while this is an easy class & she grades fairly easily, she is just kind of mean. She is very dismissive of students' concerns & does not consider that students have lives outside of the class. She would assign group projects on a Thursday & then expect them to do the group project over the weekend & have it done by the next class session.

A lot of reading and if you don't read you will be even more confused than what you would've already been, the readings are super confusing too. Not much to grade in this class and the essays are heavily graded, you get a lot of good feedback though. Not an easy class, you will have to put work in.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was truly fascinating and managed to told my attention even though its a late and long class. I learned so much and the class honestly changed how I think. That being said, it not easy and you have to put in effort to get a good grade. I don't think the TA graded terribly hard and he gave good clear feedback which I appreciated. Take it!

He's not a bad teacher; he's really knowledgeable about religion. However, the material gets very boring. Buddhism is really interesting to me and in the first unit I loved the class, but throughout the class, it started making less and less sense. If you're looking for an easy Gen ed, I would find a different one.
If you get sick while taking this class, you are screwed. He does not post his lectures or anything about them online. The only way to get caught up is to go to his office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Guys, this class isn't bad. Nance is funny, especially if you imagine it's Barney Stinson teaching you. Now, if you can't or don't want to write, then yeah, it's gonna be bad, but put some respect on his name! #NanceandBenjamanarethegoat
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: All of the other reviews are spot on. The class is interesting but the TA is a horrible grader and leaves rude comments. Currently meeting with my advisors because my grade in this class is threatening my scholarship and I am not even a religion major. do not take this class

The teacher himself is interesting but the grades are TERRIBLE. This is such a defeating and discouraging class. I needed this for a gen ed credit and it ended up ruining my grades. I would never take this again ever. Take literally anything else and you will be happy

Shocked that THIS is the guy who teaches BUDDHISM ???!?!!!?! He's literally so mean



?????

Still debating with myself trying to see if what he did to me counts as bullying or not as it was a pretty weird experience. Wouldn't recommend. He may treat you better though. All depends on who you are? I guess?

Professor himself is good and nice guy. He keeps lectures interesting and entertaining. The TA grades papers ridiculously hard and since there is so few assignments it leaves little room for improvement. For an intro class everything is graded too hard. Would not take this class as a gen ed.
Participation isn't necessarily required but I would strongly suggest it. The information taught in the class can get pretty dense so be weary if that's not for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Nance is extremely knowledgable about his topic and his lectures are fascinating and humorous. There aren't many assignments in this course, but as long as you do the work, you'll get a good grade.

READ THIS: I am taking REL-B414 and have taken his Intro course. His course's require ACTIVE engagement to succeed, and IT IS WORTH IT. Buddhism is hard to learn, but he makes it an incredible experience. Always available, always kind, and my favorite prof. You will not think the same after taking his classes, but in a good way on your own terms.

I literally created an account just to talk about Professor Richard Nance. I am currently taking his Introduction to Buddhism class during the Fall of 2020 (during the pandemic). While all of his classes were recorded lectures, THEY WERE SO INTERESTING. His class made me fall head over heels for the study of Buddhism. Readings were fascinating.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The beginning of the semester was fun and interesting but as it went on, it got so hard and tedious. There are so many readings, so much memorization, and the tests are extremely hard. Tons of papers, graded harshly. This is way too much work for an introductory class. I'd advise against taking this course. Take something else for world culture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Nance's Intro to Buddhism class was definitely the hardest class in my schedule. He definitely knows what he is talking about and reiterates everything he says making the class a little drawn out. He is a great guy but if you don't take precise notes & attend every class, you will most likely not do well on the exams or essay assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's pompous and has a superiority complex. If that doesn't bother you, what might bother you is that the AIs grade your papers ridiculously hard and the final exam is way too unreasonable for an intro level course. He is good at lecturing and keeps it interesting, but seems like he wants people to struggle in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nance takes what for most kids is an elective course way too seriously. The class was super easy right up until the drop deadline. After that, he just laid in on us without mercy. The tests are nearly impossible and the final exam is obnoxiously difficult. Don't take this course for fun because when it comes to grind time its anything but.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I am currently in Nance's religion RELB-210 class (Intro to Buddhism).    Nance is a very entertaining professor.  His lectures are lively and pretty entertaining, he loves taking questions from students, and the tests are very manageable if you put some time into your studying.  I currently have an A in the class and I have not read once.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He was a great lecturer. Entertaining, engaging, compelling. He showed interesting movies in a few classes. A class I remember distinctly years later as my best lecture class. Disclaimers: Yes, I got a good grade.

This class was very interesting, but way too difficult for an intro buddhism class. I took it with already some background knowledge on Buddhism and did all of the readings. I went to all the classes and studied, and still received a low grade. The amount of information needed on the tests was completely unreasonable. Not recommended

I would never recommend his intro to Buddhism class to anyone.  The amount of readings assigned is ridiculous.   The way in which he explains some of the material is overly complicated, and being that most people know little about Buddhism he does not make the subject approachable.

I really like his lecture style as he is good at teaching the class, and I found it interesting and very informative. These feelings quickly dissipate after the 3 exams that make up 80% of your grade get passed out. Very brutal grader, very brutal tests, and way too much to memorize for an entry level class, and no curve. Do not take this course.

Professor Nance always uses a thousand words when one word would suffice, yet he manages to rush through a lot of the most important details. The study guides for his first two tests were helpful, but the study guide for his final exam basically said, "Study everything." I would never recommend this course unless you absolutely need an REL-B class.

This is a great class! The material is difficult, but Nance does a great job of explaining it in class. Attendance isn't mandatory, but you will not do well if you don't get the notes at least. You will do really well if you do the readings and attend,  but you can get by with skimming. If you study using his guide, you will do well on the exam.
Really energetic, good lectures.

This is the hardest course I've taken at IU, but I would recommend it if you're interested. Prof. Nance is a great educator, and if you work hard, the class will be rewarding. Don't even think about taking this class if you aren't dedicated to doing the work. As always, make use of office hours - he isn't here to trick you, but to help you.

Do not take this course if you have no interest or do not want to put forth the effort to understand the material. Prof. Nance is not an easy grader, but a fair grader. If you have questions, go to office hours and he will help you. Must work to come to terms with assigned readings, but it's a rewarding class if you are interested and dedicated.

Do not take this if you have a problem working for a good grade or have no interest in the material. This is a complex subject, but the professor is engaging and super helpful. If you have questions, go to office hours! An A is not a default grade for not screwing up, a C is. If you want an A, you need to work. Highly recommended professor.

Class was fun to attend however became more difficult. The course is based on three test grades for the most part. If you want to do good in the class, you must go to each class and take notes and read all out of class assigned readings. More work than i anticipated. First two tests were easy without doing assigned readings. The final killed me. F

Class is too difficult for an intro 200 level class. Professor doesnt allow you to take notes in class via laptop, but goes through very detailed power points but refuses to post them online. Tests get harder every time and the final will tank your grade. Went to EVERY class and out of a class of 206 people, only 10 had an A- or above. Do not take.

Nance is a very interesting teacher, and you will enjoy the class material if you are curious about Buddhism. Like other reviews say, though, it is hard to get an A. Only 2 people out of 149 in my class got an A. I am an A student, worked HARD, and got an A-. You'll understand the themes, but the tests (mainly the final) cover nit-picky details.

I took this class as an A&H thinking it would be somewhat of a GPA booster. I went to every class, took notes, studied quite a bit, and still received a bad grade. Would not recommend this class to anyone, not very fond of this professor at all.

I took this class thinking it would be fun, easy and very interesting. It was a little interesting but not at all fun and easy. If you are interested in Buddhism or religion I would recommend this class. But for me, it was supposed to be my fun class but it turned out to be a lot more complicated with a huge amount of work I had not anticipated.

I really like him as a professor.I didn't think the class was going to be very fun or interesting,but his teaching blew me out of the water.He's very good at catching my attention and I like how he is very real with us about the material, which is frustrating and confusing, but his is my favorite class this semester. Go to class and you'll do fine.

THIS CLASS IS NOT AN EASY A! It's definitely an easy B, but do NOT take it if you need an easy A. Nance is brilliant and well educated in Buddhism, however, this is not an intro class. His teachings are way above those of an "introductory" level. The rubrics for the papers and exams are extremely difficult and the AI's aren't that great either.

Although attendance is not taken, it is de facto mandatory. If you don't go to class you'll probably fail. Don't add this class thinking it will be an easy A. First two tests are relatively easy--third is hard, so really do well on the first two. Nance sometimes throws in multiple choice Q's that require you to have taken detailed notes.

I cannot think of a professor that I have less respect for. Class is way too difficult for an introductory class. Grade is only made of three exams, including the final which is cumulative. He needs to get off his high horse and find a real career. Maybe developing some sort of actual skill or even helping people.

Prof. Nance is extremely sharp and provides well structured and engaging lectures. He requires lengthy but worthwhile readings, and does not offer a lot of busy work. He is very helpful and encourages asking questions and going to office hours if additional help is needed. You should attend class and complete readings if you hope to do well.
Brilliant professor. Has a serious skill for teaching
SO funny! Looks like Barney from HIMYM. Is so willing to answer questions and help!

One of my favorite professors so far. Definitely the most entertaining and the funniest. You have to take his class seriously to do well, but it's well worth it. Readings are a bit heavy, but if you're careful there are some you can get away with not doing. However, make sure to attend every lecture or get notes from someone.

He's definitely passionate about his job and knows the material well.  He is a bit erratic while lecturing which is entertaining, but leads to confusion about what he really wants us to know for the tests.  Overall though, a good teacher.  You have to go to class, or you will fail. Without question.  So go to class.

Nance is an amazing professor. He explains everything very well and even if you don't get it, he stops and encourages students to ask questions. He really, really knows what he's talking about and that helps a lot. Plus...he is like an exact replica of Neil Patrick Harris!! I would definitely recommend taking this course.

This teacher is in his own world of academia and cannot come down to make the class approachable to students. The topic of tantric buddhism seems interesting, but was in fact boring as taught by this prof. He was very unapproachable and too busy to meet and discuss the three papers our grade was soley based on. Don't take this course.

Grade is based solely on 3 exams and they are not easy. Very important to attend class regularly, take good notes and think through the materials discussed. A very good class as it offers interesting discussions from an introductory view. Prof Nance explains things interestingly. Expect good laughs sometimes.

A great professor! Discussion is very interesting. Material can be quite challenging at times. Attendance is not mandatory but it's at your own risk, considering that your grade is based on ONLY 3 exams. Attend lectures regularly, take notes, do the readings and you'll do fine.

Pretty interesting guy. Class was mostly pretty interesting. There were a few classes that were dull but he warned us. Attendance isn't mandatory but you'll fail if you don't go. He mentions that on the first day. No homework, just three tests. Not easy but definitely manageable.  Would take a class with him again.

Class is always very interesting and engaging. Your grade is based solely on 3 exams, which kind of sucks,  but the class was so interesting that it made up for it. You do need to go to class if you want to get a good grade. Take a course with this prof if you get a chance. He's great!
Very funny and witty, clearly very intelligent and relevant. He is extremely engaging and interesting, his class is my favorite. You do have to do the readings!
Class based solely on 3 exams, no busy work. Exams get harder as class progresses. Attend class, take notes and go to the review sessions. Reading the material isn't necessary if you go to class.
He really is such an amazing professor and is so kind, just SO MUCH WORK.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best professors, but NOT AN EASY CLASS (quiz=weekly+HARD+DETAILED+TAKE GOOD NOTES, tests=hard+accumulative, presentation=not bad, lab reports= please start early & go to office hours to save blood, sweat,& tears, notebook = update it weekly because they pile up fast). Prof. is super caring and understanding if you talk to him. Good luck!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS OVER THE SUMMER, WORST DECISION EVER. 1.5 HR LECTURE EVERYDAY, PLUS LECTURE RESPONSES, PLUS EXTRA VIDEOS/HANDOUTS, PLUS STUDY QUESTIONS AND READING. 

AGAIN, EVERYDAY!!!! My summer was wasted taking this course that's definitely not introductory, this should be at least 200+ course. 

So much work.

Dr. Holdeman was my favorite professor! I took his genetics lab course which was a lot of work, but you learn a lot of interesting material and he helps you understand it pretty well. He likes to share about himself/his life so you truly get to know him and he does his best to get to know his students too!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super cool dude, well structured class but definitely not an easy class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great professor, great experiments, and great humour. He will make you laugh, which is good, because he also makes you suffer for a good grade. One of the most time consuming classes, and the exams are not easy (he makes you think unlike many other bio classes). If you put in the work, you will learn more in this class than any other bio class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great teacher and man, really connects to the students and makes lecture fun! A lot of work, though.  He makes it so if you put in the work you will definitely get an A.

Dr. Holdeman is incredibly intelligent and gifted.  He is also one of the kindest, most supportive professors I have ever had.  His standards are high yet clear.  Genetics laboratory requires several hours, especially with writing reports, updating the notebook, and studying for quizzes.  However, the learning experience is absolutely fantastic.
Great prof. Hard work for the level of the class, but tests were fair (if difficult). Incredible knowledgeable and kind man. I learned a lot from him.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Rubin is by far the most qualified teacher I've had. Compared to L201, his class focuses more on logic and how the law can be applied in various situations (aka. no memorization of cases). Grading structure is tough with nothing for completion, but his lecture style sets you up to succeed in I-Core. Will fondly remember in years to come.

Need to know WHY X outcome occurs / law applies and every step of reasoning. Exams are page-long stories and the choices could all be 'yes it applies, but for ___ reason'. You NEED to take notes of what he says in-person, which are more important than the book or slides. Despite not taking attendance, this is the one class I'm most scared to skip.

L304 is probably the most difficult LEAD class, since 2/3 of the final grade is the final exam. There are Quizlet's that do a great job of examining the concepts, so use these and do additional research on specific heuristics and fallacies for the final. His lectures aren't great, but it's not mandatory and you can still do well without going.

Professor Rubin's senior year workshop class is interesting; the first half of the class material would have been better learned a year prior; however, the second half material is very interesting. The class is super participation based; he expects you to speak and you will do cases in front of the class. He is very fun and enjoyable to listen to.

Professor Rubin is one of the smartest professors I have ever met. His goal is to take you outside of the academic setting and "learn by doing". His lectures are dry; however, he does a nice job using examples. He gives incredible feedback and is always willing to help his students through their situations. I highly recommend his workshop classes!

DON'T take Rubin unless you are into Law or trying to get into the consulting workshop. Toughest grader in L293. DON'T trust the grade distribution, 29/41 people chose to pass/fail his class in 2020. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

If you plan to take L201 take his class...he provides examples to each concept and group work actually makes you learn new things. Glad I took his section!

If you are debating if you should take k303 or k304, take k304! Prof Sarah is super sweet and understanding. Also, we learn more than students in k303 which is helpful if you plan on adding bus analytics as a co-major. Your grade is mostly made up of four projects, a final project, and "check-points" (in class quizzes) and I got 100% on all but one

The class can be challenging at times, especially when projects are due but once you get the hang of the class, it is pretty easy. We have 4 checkpoints in class with a self-grader and the lowest one gets dropped. Pretty chill I would say
The class can be challenging at times since projects are pretty vague, but once you get the hang of it, the class is pretty easy. Would recommend taking this class
Sarah is a great professor. The class can be very difficult at times, but she is always there to help you with any questions you may have. Absolutely take her if you can.

Sarah is one of the best professors at IU. If you are someone who struggled in K201 definitely take her. She works hard to make sure each student is individually succeeding. Tests are open book with a grader. Projects are difficult but she provides class time to work on them and answers any questions you have. Lowest test grade is dropped.

Sarah is such a nice teacher. She's very caring about us and helps you in every way. One module checkpoint gets dropped, all projects are online, and it's a great class to take. Genuinely useful knowledge and great experience with Excel. Definitely would take again!

This class is harder than k 303, but I would take it again. As long as you spend some time on it, you will get a good grade. Make sure to be friends with people in the class to work on projects with. Also, Sarah really loves what she teaches, and you will be able to tell. She wants everyone to take something useful out of class, and you will.

This class is definitely recommended if you want to know more about data analysis without getting too deep into it. The lectures are very helpful, the readings are not, and Sarah will help you whenever you need it. Make good friends in the class so you can check work together.

Great prof. Really felt like I was learning new things every time I came to class. Super caring and wants to see you succeed. Keeps class engaging even if the material isn't that interesting. Definitely take if you have the chance

When I enrolled in K304, I was terrified because excel is not my best friend. Sarah, however, made the class much more meaningful by not only teaching the material, but also placing you in situations where you might need this knowledge. The projects can be tough, but she gives you time in class to ask questions.

K304 is definitely a difficult class content wise but Sarah makes it so much fun. The content is somewhat complicated but as long as you make an effort, you will succeed. She drops assignments and her TA's are always there to help. It's a very chill class and she is the best teacher you could have for K304

May be the best professor I've had so far. Sarah is very engaged and passionate about the material and genuinely wants you to learn. The class is very laid back and conversational. Assignments can be challenging, but you'll have plenty of opportunities to learn before any major assignments. As long as you put in some effort, you should get an A.

Intelligent, kind and humble, Sarah is a phenomenal professor, and person. This class is difficult, but she goes out of her way to make it easy. She will always push you to do your best. Asks great guiding questions to get you to an answer w/out just giving it to you. TAs are understanding and wonderful! 100% absolutely recommend her to everyone!

One of my favorite IU Professors. Clearly passionate about her students and cares about the material on hand. Projects and reviews are difficult but she is more than willing to help you do well in the class. Would definitely recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Sarah is super nice. K304 is a really open-ended class where you are given very little instruction for projects, however; if you have a question, she is more than willing to sit down and look it through with you, even on the capstone project where you essentially design your own. She's on my top 10 list of professors easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very very kind professor. During the pandemic she dropped our lowest test grade and was always so understanding. Incredibly smart as well.

Sarah was one of the best professors I've had at Kelley. She was very helpful and accessible throughout the semester and truly cares for her students. I got very sick in the first couple of weeks in the class and Sarah was very caring and helpful and gave me enough time extensions to complete my work and even helped me in those assignments.

Sarah is amazing! During lectures, she will walk you through everything that you need to know. To prepare for quizzes and modules go through the practice assignments to prepare and hone the skills. These excel skills you learn are amazing and you will use them in the future. I would completely recommend taking K303 with Sarah.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This was by far my favorite class this semester. Sarah is such a sweet person. She gives clear explanations and is willing to answer something more than once to make sure that all students understand. I would love to have a class with her again one day.

Sarah is one of the best professors I have had. She was really friendly in class and didn't make it feel like a boring lecture. She is really understanding and caring. I had missed a couple of major assignments because of a medical emergency but she was very helpful and gave me enough time to complete all my assignments.

Worst upper level prof ever. Unorganized,doesn't show excel formulas, and has ugly decks for a former consultant. Had heard good things from k204 students, but k353 with her is a nightmare. She moves SO quickly through excel, quizzes you on things not focused on in class, and refuses to post completed files. This class is unnecessarily difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Sarah's lectures are engaging and interactive, and she always comes to class with an energetic attitude.  She holds review sessions prior to the two lab practicals which is helpful.  Overall, this class is definitely tough.  The lab practicals are 3 hours long and rather tricky.  The group projects are a good indicator of what will be on the exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Loved Professor Sherry's K304 class during the FA16 semester. Her consulting background allows her to bring a unique perspective to the classroom. In class practicals are tough, but she offers plenty of extra credit opportunities! Great teacher who really cares for her students and wants to see them succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Sarah is very approachable and makes coming to class worthwhile. She's encouraging and helps apply what you're learning to the real world. She was also always willing to answer questions. Class always lets out early. Don't take K303 with anyone else!!

Sarah is pretty cool and brings a lot of energy to k303. The class has a lot of tests and projects but they aren't very hard as long as you have an idea of what is going on. Sometimes Sarah rambles and it gets confusing to what is important and what is not. But she cares for her students and is easy to work with.

She knows a great deal about excell. I'm very interested in the course and she gives lots of help to you if you ask for her a question. I'll probably get a high A and I love doing this material, so if you love computers you should take her.

Great teacher, as with everyone else in this department. She wants you to do well. If you get behind at all, go to her office hours and she will get you back on track and maybe even ahead of the game. Not a joke of a class, but an easy A if you pay attention in class and do not get behind.

Absolutely amazing professor. Has a great attitude even at 8 in the morning, and maintains a high energy level throughout all of class. Sarah uses interesting , practical examples in lab that help to keep your attention. One of the few classes I find myself not dreading going to. Definitely try to get Prof. Sherry!

By far the worst teacher I ever had. She claims she is a fair, understanding teacher but she is far from that. She doesn't respond to emails, and even sent me a hate email after i had to email her supervisor to get her to respond. She also has a terrible condescending voice that is sarcastic and annoying. She clearly doesn't care about her students
Great teacher.  Always has a lot of energy but helps it keep it from being boring.  Helpful and although her skill checks are annoying, they help you do well in the class.
wonderful
Very Good Teacher
She cares about students and often encourages students to improve.
Helps students out and enjoys teaching. K201 is hard class in general to master, she really prepares you for the tests, just do homework assignments and redo graded projects before practicals
She is a great teacher! She really cares about the students. I have been with her class in both K201 and X201, and found much easier to get A in her class =)

She is amazing.  I have peer tutored for her for 3 semesters after I had her.  She is a great genuine person who likes to make class fun even at 8 am. Her office hours are very helpful, but then again you can stop her in class and she will be glad to go over it all again. Get her for this class or anythign else she teaches and appreciate her!
Amazing professor. In my top 10. If you have the choice, get her.
GREAT TEACHER! she is really helpful and makes the material fun to learn!
Very Helpful, Excited to teach you!
Sarah is great! She is always willing to help, and many times met me outside of her office hours for some extra help. She is really nice and cares about the students.
Nice and very helpful.

Sarah is such an amazing lab teacher.  She is so helpful and so energetic.  I took the class at 9am which made it difficult to come to class, but Sarah was always so lively and spunky.  I DEFINITELY recommend her!
She's very helpful with the quizzes. Energetic and she knows what she is doing. Definitely reccomend her.
She is a great person and a great teacher. Be glad if you have her and sad if you don't. She explains exactly what you need to know and does a great job doing it. She also teaches X201.
Nice and helpful
good person, good will, unfortunatelly i hate the name Sarah for personal reasons

Her class was very difficult for me & the workload was intense. We had a quiz over every chapter and lots of homework from the textbook. There were multiple times I had to relearn something after it was explained incorrectly or insufficiently in lecture. I ended up failing her class, and my second time around I got an A with a different professor.
Great professor I would highly recommend. She's fun and know what she's doing. I don't believe she teach 341 anymore but she knew her material well and was prepared to teach each day.

Cate is the best professor I have had at IU. Ochem is hard no matter what, but she explains things so well and is always accessible outside of class. Build a relationship with her from the start, go to office hours, and you will be just fine. Her lectures are also super engaging. I would take any class with her.

cate was a great professor! i think this was her first time teaching the course and you could really tell how much she cared about sustainability and she made it genuinely interesting. there were no tests or quizzes, you don't really need to take notes, but you should still listen to her lectures.

Organic Chemistry is a hard class no matter what, but Cate is an amazing professor and wants all students to succeed. She listens to feedback and helps students understand the material with multiple approaches. If you are taking orgo one take it with Cate. I also recomend taking the orgo help class with it!

Cate was amazing! You can tell she really cares about her students and she explained content very clearly. At times I felt that her pace was a little fast, but as long as you read the textbook and do practice problems, you'll be fine.

I have no bad things to say about Cate. She is very direct with what she expects from you, is very encouraging, and wants you to succeed. She tries her best to make a very difficult class manageable, and is always open to helping you further your understanding. If you put in the work, this class is very doable with Cate by your side!

She's ok. I feel as though people rave too much about her. Yes, did she explain concepts well, but she went super fast and constantly was rushing. Also felt like I could never ask her a question without her being rude and making it seem like I should've never asked to begin with. Super enjoyable class if you go to lecture and do the practice exams

She was an amazing teacher for Orgo and I would have learned a fraction of what I did without her calm, composed style of teaching. This is the hardest class I've taken yet, and would strongly recommend taking the Orgo help class (C240) for the entire semester along side this course.
Professor Reck teaches this difficult class very well and is very likable.
She is excellent at preparing you for what you need to know. She knows that orgo is hard for many students, but she provides more than enough resources to help you learn.

I have had Cate for both 341 and 342 and have had an amazing experience. Although Org O can be a hard topic she gave you every opportunity to succeed with great lectures, and practice problems that accurately showed what you needed to know for the exams. She is a fantastic professor and deeply cares for her students and their success.

Was lucky enough to get Cate for both semesters of organic chemistry. She is the best, and puts students first and cares for them all. Exams have lots of extra credit to adjust for the difficult course content, and her notes and practice problems are great. She is also very funny and energetic. Take orgo with Cate if you want to enjoy it!

If you want your life to be easy take Cate Reck she's absolutely an amazing teacher. She breaks down the content well, not making the lectures long or boring. She's also super nice if you seem to be confused on the material go to office hours and ask for help. 10/10 recommend
Best professor I have ever had. Took her C341 (Orgo 1) with her also. She is a great lecturer and very kind. Get to know her!

I love Cate! I had her for both 341 and 342. Orgo is not an easy class but Cate is as helpful as she can be with plenty of practice materials, and she also keeps the lectures interesting! She is super understanding and helpful and shows lots of care for her students. I hope to have Cate again in a future chem class.
Very funny, entertaining, and knowledgeable professor. 10/10 Love Prof. Reck

Cate Reck is my savior. This class had some crazy content, but Cate is so wonderful at breaking it down for us. She's highly respected, almost everyone loves her. Her lectures are entertaining and grab your attention. She can be scattered, but we're all human. LIVE LAUGH LOVE CATE.
Cate is a phenomenal professor and person. She is super helpful and a no-brainer if you're taking Orgo!
Fantastic professor! During the rare problems us students ran into in her class she corrected and put forth the effort to make things right!
Take Organic Chem with her if possible. Although it is a difficult class, she was great at teaching it and is very easy to talk to. Taking Orgo 2 with her right now and it is going just as well.

Professor Reck is engaging and committed to helping students succeed. The workload is heavy, but she provides great resources like practice exams. unstuck AI and the textbook are also super helpful for studying. Overall, a challenging but rewarding class.

SO GOOD if you have to take organic, try to take it with Cate Reck. She is very approachable, funny, and genuinely cares about her students. She is amazing at explaining tough concepts and her lectures are fast paced, but enjoyable.

Cate was one of the best professors I have had and she cares a lot about her students and how they do. They material is hard but she gives you every resource possible to suceed you just need to use them. Do the Practice Problems all the time and try not to get behind. Lectures are recorded but you benefit so much from attending the lectures.

Cate has been the best professor I have had in a long time. While organic chemistry is difficult, she makes taking the class so much less painful. She truly cares about students in every aspect, and will make sure she is doing everything she can to help you learn. I would retake organic chemistry just to take her class again.

Dr. Reck cares about her students inside and outside of the classroom and wants all of her students to be successful. Listen to what she tells you to do, and you should have no problem doing well in organic chemistry.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Loved having Cate as a professor. She made the material easy to understand, and there are many resources given to us to help with studying outside of class. She's also very funny and made lecture interesting.

Cate was a great professor! She is super engaging in her classes and very nice. If you have to take organic chemistry, take it with Reck! Her lectures are more helpful than the textbook, but she will give you potential practice problems to use from the textbook.
Best professor I had at Iu. She made organic chemistry super easy.
AMAZING! MADE ORGANIC CHEM OK!

Professor Reck is amazing! This class goes at a fast pace, and studying on your own is necessary for success. Take advantage of discussion worksheets, book problems, and practice exams. If you put in the work, you'll succeed in this class. Quiz and test are heavy, so really prepare for those!
Professor Reck is great! Her teaching style is fairly quick but if you stay caught up you will be fine. There are very few things you get graded on so make sure to prioritize tests and quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best people I know (and best professor). Without her I would not have made it through last year. Every student should take a class with her because she is such an amazing person and teacher. Wouldn't trade last semester with her for anything.

She is the best professor I have had at IU. Orgo is difficult, but she makes it clear what will be on tests/quizzes. The textbook is also helpful and so are her worksheets. She is so kind and encouraging and makes a challenging course less stressful.

The other reviews about the retakes aren't her fault; she didn't even want to do MC but was required to. She is extremely helpful, patient, and willing to answer. She is very good at explaining things in an easy way. The content is hard, but her tests are mirror images of the worksheets and textbook problems. Do the worksheets. Attend office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Cate's very kind, however she is so disorganized and changes what she says constantly. We have now MC exams, she said we would have retakes on the whole exam, but she changed it to just MC. Then she changes Exam 4 to be full short answer no MC. She also spends a solid 5-10 minutes venting about how she has 500 emails in class.

Cate is one of the best professors that I have ever had. She is so kind and actually cares about all of the students as more than just students-- she encourages us to take care of ourselves and always leaves nice notes at the end of her announcement posts for the week. C341 is a challenging course, but Cate makes it so much more bearable!

She expects you to know everything and is very dismissive when I asked her questions, answered like I was stupid which brought down my self-worth and willingness to learn by a lot. I personally am a slow learner and not naturally smart and many of my friends feel the same way but every students deserve to be treated with the same respect and equal.

Great prof. Super funny and definitely cares about the students. However, expect this class to cause you emotional trauma and take up the entirety of your focus and time. No fault of the professor, the material is just super hard. Put in practice every single day and really spend a good amount of time doing the problems and worksheets.
She is super funny in lectures and genuinely cares about the students. She also explains the material very clearly.

Cate is a wonderful 1on1 professor and she makes sure you understand the material, so I do respect her. However, the way she structured the course is new this semester where has a MC portion on the exam now. This seemed great, however many of the statements she said to the class fell through due to disorganization and lack of proctors.

Cate is so amazing. Orgo was very difficult, but cate helped so so much. If you are freaking out, go to her office hours and just tell her how you feel. I did this, and she offered me lots of support and assured me that I could perserverse! I bombed the first two exams and finished with an A-. I could not have gotten that grade w/out Cate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Reck is an amazing professor. This class is scary for good reasons but she made it a lot less daunting. She is great at explaining things and isn't just black and white in lecture. She will make a joke or put in interesting applications to the material.

reviews.comment: I wish Reck was the professor the whole semester of orgo. I like professor Brown as a person but I think she does a poor job at explaining things. Reck took her time and explained lots of things well. I seriously think that if Reck was the professor the whole semester, I would have gotten a better grade.

Organic 1 is not an easy course to teach, but Professor Reck is amazing at it. I took this course in Spring 2020 when we had an abrupt transition to online. Prof. Reck did everything in her power to help us out and it really showed. Of course this class isn't easy, you really have to work for it. But she provides great lectures and is accessible.

Took this class couple years ago and came back because to add a rating because she was my favorite professor at IU. I came in dreading C341, but it ultimately was my favorite classof at IU. Go to class and office hours. You have to spend the time on the material but Prof Reck is very available outside of class and really cares about her students

reviews.comment: My favorite professor at IU. She honestly cares about her students & about them succeeding and learning. Dont take a class with her if you dont want to put in the work, because you have to work in order to succeed in her classes but she is awesome and fair in everything she does & I can truly say she taught me something & bettered my education.

Acts way too nonchalant about the extremely hard course and has a bit of a passive-aggressive attitude. reviews.comment: Cate makes her lectures click with each other, which makes it easier to see the bigger picture. Her slides are clear, & it helps to look at them/print them before class. reviews.comment: She never would answer any questions in class, she wouldnt include examples close similar to exam questions in your notes. She always told us to learn the material on our own if we couldnt understand it in class because she would not go over material twice.

Professor Reck is awesome. People who struggle in this class are the people who are afraid of hard work. Go to every office hour possible. Get close with your AI. I had Zoe and she was the BEST. I also used the Organic Chemistry as a second language book and it was really helpful. It's really not as bad as people say it is...

NO amount of work prepares you for the exams or quizzes as they are filled with tricks after she says she doesnt trick students.

reviews.comment: I took C117 with her, and she was rather rude when students would ask her questions during the lecture because her work was wrong. The exams were not very fair, and there were no packets to study from or anything like that, so you MUST use the textbook questions in order to study if you want to actually do well. Study the textbook!!!!!!!

Cate is amazing. Her exams are very straight forward and in the same format as the packets she gives; I am now at IUPUI and the orgo profs here do NOT do that - be thankful. She also provides positivity and encouragement to students. Bottom line, organic chem is hard and you have to actively study and attend office hours to excel.

Rude and condescending, pretends to act like she cares when in reality she does not. Her lectures are all over the place and difficult to understand. She explains things in a complex way rather than a simple easy way.

This is a very hard class. Thankfully she posted lectures online so you did not need to go to class, but you need to watch lectures. You think you know what youre doing until its time for exams... retaking the class

Reck is an awesome person, but explains things in a very convoluted and hard to understand manner. Exams are challenging although not impossible. Does not have mandatory homework, so that's a win. Definitely requires a ton of out of studying to do well -- YouTube is your best friend. Great person, very knowledgeable, but a little unapproachable.

Professor Reck explained concepts really well, taking care to backtrack when someone had a question in class. She was clear about what she expected us to learn for the exams; she did like to put a few trick questions in them, but overall, her exams were fair and based on material we covered in the textbook.

reviews.comment: Professor Reck is incredibly funny and covers material pretty well. The only reason she isn't getting a 5 is because sometimes during lecture when a student would ask her to explain something again, she would say "We don't have time for me to go over this again. Read the book." which was frustrating, especially when it was on a difficult topic.

really loved having her for gen chem. She always wants everything to make sense to you and can really tell she cares about her students a lot and wants her students to do well. She explains everything with general concepts you need to know from each topic then by real world examples. I totally recommend her if you are taking gen chem.

She taught the first half of C117, which includes some difficult topics. She did a good job at explaining the difficult topics and making sure all students understood the material. By doing book problems and the discussion worksheets over and over, you should do fine in this class. Cate is a good professor and if you out the work in you'll be fine.

The only reason I did poorly in this class was because of Reck. Jarrold's topic were explained clearly and thoroughly while Reck's were all our the place and she doesn't differentiate topics in chemical bonding well. I do well on all of Jarrold's exams but poorly on Reck's and I studied harder for Reck's so what does that say???

reviews.comment: I am retaking c117, this time with professor reck and jarrold. Reck is very caring, will stop if you have questions, gives many updates and lets you know exactly what to do to succeed and is a GREAT professor. 100% recommend her. Study hard, do the practice problems and go to lectures.
She is a passionate professor who loves chem. Its a really hard class, so just make sure you don't fall behind

She is one of the best professors that I have had at IU. She does a really good job at explaining topics, and the exams look very similar to the problems in the book, on the worksheet, and on the lecture notes.

Exams are so much harder than anything she will ever explain. She often says "the exams will not try to trick you" This is a blatant lie. I studied for a week straight before the second exam and I still got around 50%. Explains concepts horribly DO NOT ASK QUESTIONS OR ASK ABOUT HER MATH SHE WILL BE VERY MAD. Does not care about this class at all
I wish I could have her again and again for chem. Its the hardest class I've taken, but she made it worth it with her weird humor and emails.

reviews.comment: She's honestly a great person and professor. Makes a really challenging class easier to handle. Love her
