reviews.comment: Although in the previous years I did not like Cate, she handled C343 with lots of grace and class after our instructor left 6 weeks into the semester. She was truly open to reason and made everything more flexible to us and did try her best to help us get acquainted with a new instructor. Although still difficult, she made the class easy to go.

Got Cate for the other half of the semester after Pete left. God bless this woman honestly. She was understanding, very reasonable, and made the transition as smooth as possible. Amazing with communication. She cares about the students and handled the unexpected transition like a queen. Fair w/grades & exams too. Cate Reck for president of IU.
Makes a daunting organic class seem fun but is also blunt and straight-forward. A great professor and a great person.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Worst chem professor i've ever had. This being a lab course wasn't helping any. Some people teach concepts in the easiest to understand fashion, and some teach them in an overly complex manner. She's the latter.

I've had Reck for other chemistry classes and she teaches those much easier than C343. I know I am not speaking for only myself when I say that she should NOT be teaching C434 as her tests and lab structures are way too difficult. Many labs throughout the semester were unfinished by many and the test averages were terrible.

I changed my major because this class was so bad.

reviews.comment: I have no idea why people speak so highly of Cate Reck. She makes her classes unreasonably hard. She comes off as funny and personable at first, but quickly turns to condescending as soon as you ask her a question. She's very full of herself and will never take the blame for her mistakes. Made my college experience significantly less enjoyable.

she is a good teacher but makes everything way harder than it should be. she took over orgo lab because she thought the guy before her was making it too easy. reviews.comment: Reck is the best professor I have ever had! She gives you everything you need to succeed in the class. Just seriously make sure you are studying correctly (active studying like flashcards and practice on whiteboards rather than reading concepts over and over again)

Seeing other profs makes me love her... She makes a powerpoint and actually goes by it. Apparently that is a daunting task for most of the faculty. Pretty low bar, but Dr. Reck is the only prof who seems to pass it. Congrats...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Green book is completely useless. Lectures are too shallow to prepare you for quizzes/exams. somewhat funny but definitely rude. Not sure why she gets amazing reviews because her teaching style is awful. Retook at regionals IU campus, prof there was 100 times better at teaching this class than Reck. Reck overcomplicated an otherwise easy class.
She is an overall great professor. The class is pretty difficult though. You need to go to class and make sure you keep up with the material by studying every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's a very good professor for Organic Chem. She expects a lot out of you but I feel like that's what comes with this class. Study consistently and you will do good!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cate Reck phenomenal. Her lectures are amazing; she takes impossible problems and makes them doable. Her class isn't easy; you have to practice every night, but she sets you up to succeed if you work hard. She's hilarious & always cheering you on. She understands what it means to be a student, and wants everyone to succeed. Would take her again!

I read these comments and was exited to take her. However, I do want to warn. She flies through the content and only gives one example of questions that are on test. Most of her questions are reasonable but you must memorize every small detail because she expects you to use your knowledge to "figure out the chemistry behind problems".
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I love her, she's amazing. She teaches a difficult subject, but I feel like she teaches well, and so far I've done very well! I wish she taught C342 because I would love to have her again :(
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Reck made Orgo 1 a walk in the park. She literally gives you everything you need to succeed in the class (practice problems, worksheets, and awesome AIs) and truly cares about her students learning the material. Could not have asked for a better prof for the course!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's an awesome lecturer; however, as a person she is all but that. Very defensive of her mistakes when students point them out (quick to say "oh, I'm just human"). Also has massive attitude problems. But that's outside the spectrum of her teaching abilities. She's a good instructor & that should be really all that matters. Get your grade & run!

Cate makes the quizzes/exams, but her AI's grade them. She is so sweet and truly cares about students passing, she also has a great sense of humor. It is a lot of lecture, and I only used the book for practice problems. The exams are hard because they usually are worded or add in different concepts she didn't talk about. Pay attention, take notes.

This class will make you work but I absolutely loved Reck. She was obviously on top of the material and was able to address the main issues that students tend to have. I was really nervous about it but it was actually a great class. Textbook isn't that important, but can be useful. DO THE WORKSHEETS
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: C341 is rough no matter who's teaching it, but Professor Reck makes it almost fun. She reminds me of a cool aunt who will show up at family gatherings and get just tipsy enough to be fun to hang out with. Makes a lot of so-bad-they're-good chemistry jokes. I didn't bother to buy the textook - she put's everything you'll need on Canvas for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Reck was the best professor I have ever had at IU.  She made the hardest class I've taken the most enjoyable, and was always there for help.  She holds office hours 3 days a week for an hour and a half at a time, where she is willing to help! Use office hours, go to class, and WANT to do well, and she gives you every resource to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the hardest classes at IU by far but she's a great teacher and is willing to help her students whenever she can. She presents the material clearly and precisely. DO NOT SKIP if you want to pass this class, it's too hard to get caught up once you get behind. Take her if you want a good teacher!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is an amazing lecturer with a wonderful personality.  Explains things clearly and concisely, and repeats any important information to make sure you know what to study the most.  Reck  rocks!
I love this Teacher.

The whole first half of the semester I got all C's on everything and spent 10-12 hours a week, once I formed a good study group and with all the extra points I got up to finish with an A-. The synthesis is the most important for review, also use other textbooks too besides McMurray and actually go to discussion. Cate rocks

Cate Reck 100% cares about the success of her students. She gives you everything you need to succeed & more to pass the class. She was a great lecturer & made organic enjoyable. Everyone talks about how they put in 20 hours of work a week, but I put in 3-4 on regular weeks & 8-10 on exam/quiz weeks & was fine. REWRITE NOTES & do the worksheets.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her lectures were fantastic with examples that you can learn so much from. This is a tough, tough class; you need to put in at least 12-18 hours a week for an A. Read every word of Klein BEFORE class, do every problem on the worksheet and in Klein, and review for every quiz and exam. The second half can be overwhelming; keep calm and study hard!d
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Reck is one of the best professors I've ever had! The class itself is not easy, and she will be the first to tell you that. Reck cares a lot about her students and is fairly straight up about what will be on the exams. She is hilarious and very easy to talk to. Organic would have been miserable without her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Reck is extremely rude when dealing with students who don't come to her all the time. She tells you one thing will not be on the exam, then magically, it's half of the exam. She is not funny, she tries way too hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Orgo 1 sucks, but she's a good teacher. Her notes are pretty good and her exams are usually fair enough.

Amazing, amazing professor. Catherine Reck is a true gem. Not an easy course, and she'll tell you that herself. She will, however,  help you succeed if you are putting forth the effort (which will be a lot). Don't miss lecture. Do all the problems in the book (yes, all of them). Do all of the past exams. Do everything you can, and you'll do fine.

Very tough class, but she made lectures pleasant and the class bearable. I only had her for the first eight-week of orgo, she did great with teaching the beginning material but not sure how she is with synthesis mechanisms(later in the course). She is a very kind lady and really does want her students to succeed. I would definitely recommend her!

Was afraid of how I would do in orgo. Gave a great intro to orgo and made it simple and clear. Very good lecturer - humorous. Tests and quizzes also are very clear and concise. Discussion worksheets are key to success. Wonderful professor. Kindhearted and wants you to do well. Take orgo with her - you won't go wrong.

Professor Reck is the worst. People only like her because she's "funny." She is condescending and rude and acts like any question you ask her is a burden.  She does not convey the material well and teaches it fast, as though she's reviewing, not teaching it. The book is your best friend. If you can, take it with another professor.

Awful. Just awful. Lecture notes contradict each other often. Exams are just poor - poorly worded, petty, and her keys are flat out wrong for several questions. She barely skims the surface in lecture so it is anyone's guess what she expects you to learn for the exams. I had her for 117 and loved her - but at this level, perhaps take w/someone else

Reck has amazing intentions for her students. She knows that the material is hard and she does all that she can do to make the subject easy to understand. You know what to expect on exams and quizzes.
Great professor and her notes and discussion worksheets reflect the quizzes and exams.

I absolutely love professor Reck. Not only is she an amazing professor, she is hilarious and makes learning organic not so completely terrible. If you get a chance to take  class with her, do it. Hands down one of my favorite professors at IU.

Professor Reck as northing short of outstanding. She is the most sincere professor I have had the pleasure of learning under so far as she genuinely wants her students to not only succeed in the class but also outside of the classroom. Patient, kind, and hilarious. Can only pray that I will get another professor as great as her again.

The class has a negative stigma for being hard but if you go to class and do the problems she recommends it's pretty easy. She tells you what you need to do to get a good grade you just have to do it. Awesome professor!

Love Reck as a person, hate her as a professor. She does not follow the book at all and makes orgo so much harder than it should be. She is hilarious, but not a great teacher. Taught myself from the book in addition to going to lecture and averaged in the 60s on all of my exams. It would be so much easier if she followed the book & was organized!!!

Professor Reck is awesome! She is hilarious but also a very in depth teacher. She has definitely prepared me well for Orgo 2 even though I wish I had a better grade. Definitely re-write the lecture notes and do the DG worksheets. It is all on the exam. Practice, Practice, Practice and you will succeed.

she tries to make the lecture easier and uses a lot of information from lecture for the actual exam, she is good at explaining. also fun sometimes during lectures. if it wasnt for her, i probl wouldnt have passed the course.

This class is hard - it's just the nature of Organic Chemistry. That being said, I LOVE PROFESSOR RECK! She is really engaging and her lectures make the course so much more manageable. You will have to do (ungraded) homework to pass and her office hours help A LOT. She's also really sarcastic, funny, and relatable.

Reck is one of my favorite professors on campus is also a very nice person to get to know as she also is heavily involved in undergraduate groups. She teaches organic but makes it very enjoyable and easy to learn, for a difficult course. Highly recommended she is probably one of the best chemistry professors, homework is essential in the course.

Dr. Reck is such an amazing professor! She really tries her best to help you pass, but I think we can all agree that orgo is not a walk in the park. She's wonderful, but you have to work for your grade. I personally struggled but I used clutch prep which really helped me better understand.. It saved my grade. But def take Dr. Reck!

Reck has easy to follow outlines that you fill in as you go. She tests mostly the material on the outlines and the discussion worksheets. Make sure you fill out the outlines, they're important. Reck herself is a bit dorky, and funny, she does her best to help students though she is intimidating to approach. it's a hard course so do the work.

Even though I did not get the grade I was hoping for, she is a great teacher, and she taught me how to love orgo. Go to her office hours (- if not anything else, make sure she knows your name-)! She only gives a curve to students who "deserve it", so make sure she knows you are working hard or you will be left out.

Organic chemistry is a notoriously hard class anywhere. Professor Reck is probably about the best professor you can have for such a rough class. Clear, funny, helpful, and optimistic, she will make you feel good even if you're failing. Attend every lecture and discussion, do every practice problem, and read every chapter and you can pull an A.

She's kind of intimidating in office hours but still very helpful. For the most part very friendly and approachable, and a really, really good teacher. Makes orgo easy with the way she explains things. Really helps you understand the material instead of just memorizing.
Prof. Reck is as helpful and clear as they come. Organic chem is hard, but she is extremely helpful.

Class is tough, but required. Dr. Reck is by far one of my favorite professors at IU so far. She's organized, clear, and knowledgable on the topics presented. She is very clear about what's expected of each student and is very willing to help them get there. With that being said, she doesn't accept BS or curve tests. What you know is what you know.

Reck is a very approachable professor and is humble about her knowledge. She honestly wants everyone to do well and gives encouraging emails weekly. As long as you do your part, she will respect you and help as much as she can. If you do all of the chapter worksheets and read the chapters before lecture, you should be able to get at least a B.

Prof. Reck is easily the best professor I've ever had. I've never gotten so close to another instructor, she's an amazing teacher and even better mentor. The lessons I learned from her stretch far beyond Organic Chemistry. Do ALL suggested work, read for clarification, go to office hours, and get to know her, your life will forever be changed!

Hands down best professor I've had at IU.  Cares about students, extremely knowledgable about chemistry and will go above and beyond to help students. Challenging course, but with Prof. Reck it's enjoyable and if you study hard, do all problemsworksheets an A-A is feasible on all exams. Take C341 with Prof. Reck if all possible, won't regret it!!

Reck is hilarious and relates to students and makes lecture interesting and fun.  The class still isn't the easiest and you need to do your homework problems, but if you do and study you should do fine.  She is super sweet and willing to help students and wants them to do well in the class and learn about chemistry.

Best professor I have ever had hands down. Organic chemistry is a hard subject with lots of material, but she made it easy to understand. Attendance not mandatory, but you definitely need to go if you want to do well. Plus, she's hilarious! I talked to her after class every time I was confused, and she always explained it with so much clarity.

Dr. Reck is spectacular as a lecturer. She is clear, concise, funny, engaging, and very down-to-earth. Exams are demanding but fair, given how much quality preparation she gives students in a variety of ways. She makes every effort to get to know students by name and treats them as colleagues and friends.

Reck reminds me of a high school teacher in the best way possible. She's there for you. She'll know your name. She doesn't expect us to be geniuses, and is more than willing to stop lecturing to explain something. Although it is important you do a lot of work outside of class, Reck tries very hard to make Orgo as comfortable as she can. Just great.

Dr. Reck's overall teaching ability is very high. She is genuinely interested in her students to do well; however, she will not curve exams to boost grades. Attend class as much as you can because she did occasionally do bonus point activities. Labs are difficult, but this class isn't designed to be easy.

By far the most efficient, clear, entertaining, and helpful lecturer I've had for chemistry. Questions are welcome and she eagerly learns students names as well as what the class is struggling on in order to better explain what we're talking about. I would highly recommend her; she make organic chemistry, dare I say it, fun.
Hands down, the most energetic, genuinely helpful teacher on campus. She deserves even more credit than she receives. I have never had a professor be more trully excited to see her students learn.

This class is hard, the averages on all of the exams are around 70%. Dr. Reck is very nice and willing to help clarify material whenever she can. I would definitely recommend use of office hours with professors and AIs to clarify anything you don't understand. Reading the text is not very helpful, but the end of chapter questions are.
Very helpful professor. She does a good job trying to keep the lectures as interesting as possible. Funny as well.
Amazing professor! Super nice and helpful.

Dr. Reck is a great professor. She has a genuine interest in the course and wants to see students do well. She can be tough, but you'll get an A in C117 if you put in the effort. Go see her during office hours- tons of help!

Dr. Reck knows what she is talking about and is more than helpful for students who choose to ask for it. However, the class is hard and the exams are harder. There aren't many points and if you don't constantly study you won't do well. She WILL help you though and even though I hate chem she made lectures interesting enough that I paid attention.
She's the best! So freaking funny!

She was alright. compared to orgo 2 her exams are super easy, but they didnt seem like it at the time. her notes were ok, but I learned a lot more from the book (*in order to do well on the quizzes, study the book). Also, her office hours are useful, but she wont ever recognize you if you go. I didnt like her as a person but the class was ok
Amazing professor! She explains everything so it's really easy to understand and she is super helpful! She's funny and makes it enjoyable to go to class. Best professor so far!

Very well versed in the material and will take the time to help her students despite her extremely busy schedule. She's also very good at rephrasing things in ways that are less confusing than the textbook. Do the recommended work, study, and ask her questions you have and you'll be solid.

Probably the best chemistry professor I've ever had. Explains the material very clearly and keeps the lectures interesting with her personality. Tough class and exams, but if you put the work in you'll do fine.

Reck is a decent professor and has great notes but ZERO sympathy for her students as real people. If life gets in the way of your ability to do the work for her class (e.g. death of family member), don't expect her to work with you at all.
Reck lit the blackboard on fire a couple days ago so I'd say she's pretty cool.

I loved Reck when I started this class because she has a fun personality and relates well with students. It was great taking this class in summer because she made it easier on us. She did kind of get lazy toward the end; she even forgot about evaluations. I also didn't like that she often said, "I don't know. I just wouldn't know."

Organic chemistry is a tough class. I actually enjoyed taking this class with Prof. Reck. Tests and quizzes are extremely difficult. Even though I did not pass the class I felt Prof. Reck really helped students to understand the material. I would definitely take this class from her again.

Dr. Reck is extremely unorganized.  She talks to her students like they have no background knowledge and dumbs down every concept to the point where you arent even learning, except for her useless memorization techniques. She is NOT punctual, helpful or quick at returning grades. If you love chemistry dont take reck. You will not learn chemistry.

I failed the class but loved the method Professor Reck utilized. She is an outgoing individual and explains the material clearly; nonetheless,practicing problems out of the book is EXTREMELY VITAL and a MINIMUM of 15 hours for studying is most beneficial for you!

This prof is hard but only because she knows that her students are up to the challenge. She's an awesome teacher (I had her for C117 as well) and is always willing to adjust her hours and make time to meet with students. No curves, so study hard! But its worth it!

I have had Prof. Reck for 3 semesters now- she literally is the only teacher that has TAUGHT me science. she is extremely tough and so are her exams so if you cant study 20 hrs a week- dont take her. for a premed student- she is AMAZING. she cares, works hard and if you put in the effort,  she will too.
Professor Reck is quite possibly the best Chemistry professor at IU. She's funny and very helpful. Only drawback is her exams are very tough, so be prepared to put in the hours (or days) studying.

I was terrified to start organic chemistry because of its reputation but because prof. Reck is such a great teacher and cares so much about her students' success that I love it now and have actually switched my major from bio to chem. Overall highly recommend her, she's awesome!

Organic Chemistry is a difficult subject for just about anyone, but Reck makes it a little bit easier to understand! Her exams are pretty difficult, but as long as you utilize the book, go over her lecture notes, and use Study Edge for their practice problems/chapter reviews, you will definitely get an A.
Awesome professor!

Best teacher I had. Out of a class of 600, she knew me personally and went out of her way to make every lecture interesting, funny or both. I liked her so much that I signed up for her Organic section next semester.
The best professor I've had at IU.  Highly recommend her.

Great teacher, but incredibly difficult tests. You could study for hours and still get a B. She liked to think that once you understood the theory you could understand every application of the theory, so there were things on the tests that you may never have seen before.
Professor Reck is a great teacher. Chemistry sucks and the course would be hard no matter who taught it, but she explains the material well and offers tons of help resources.
Prof Reck was an okay teacher, but her tests were awful. Half of the time the correct answer either was not an option or their were more than one correct answers. I do not recommend her for C117.

She is very helpful and teaches well. The only thing I found difficult in this class were the tests and quizzes. Oftentimes she had questions on the tests and quizzes that weren't directly covered and could be very challenging.

Wonderful professor - she explains things very clearly and makes chemistry very simple. She is also very humorous. The only bad things I can say is she tends to not put the right answers for math related problems on some exams quite often, but she throws the question out. some of the questions were not directly covered and are tricky.

Organic is a hard class.. don't expect otherwise, but Reck makes it understandable. She breaks things down to the point where a monkey would understand it. That being said, a lot of people WILL fail this course. If you try hard, go to office hours, and study your butt off.. you will not fail. Anyways, Reck is great and a lot of fun.
Good teacher. Organic chemistry is supposed to be hard, but she makes it as easy, fun, and interesting as possible.

The material in this class is very hard but Professor Reck makes it fun. She really wants students to find enjoyment in Organic Chemistry like she does. She isn't trying to make you get a bad grade either- she just wants you to learn the material. Go to office hours!! Ask questions and DO NOT GET BEHIND!! Practice problems help alot!

Reck's the best chemistry teacher I've had so far.  The material is fair and she will explain it to you if you need help.I have literial heard her say to a atudent asking about trick questions,"I wont write a question to purposly trick you..."I almost got out of my seat and clapped. IF you fail c117 or C341 with reck you did study and its ur fault

Reck is the best professor for C341. A student asked her if there was anyway to make a trick question from some material, and she literial said back to him, "Im not here to trick you, Im not going to make a question that is trickly on purpose".I almost got out of my seat clapping.IF you fail C341 or C117, then you didnt study and that is your fault
If you put in the time to do recommended book problems and get your lab reports checked over during office hours than the class is hard but manageable. Reck is really nice and helps out a lot.
BEST professor I've ever had. She was very available during office hours and explains the material clearly. She's also funny and really nice and personable.
The BEST chemistry professor I have had.  If you get the chance to take a Chemistry class with Reck - DO IT.... she is one of the best and most clear professors.  She also is helpful in office hours.

I second what the person before me said, she is one of the most awful professors in the entire world.  She does not help her students when they need it.  Her lectures make no sense and she does not provide us with enough information to complete most of the labs done in this course.  Terrible professor.  Worst I have ever had.

she was honestly awful. Worst experience with a professor yet. The class was poorly organized and the professor had trouble understand my questions. I feel Professor Arnold who taught the lower level should have also taught this next portion.
Though class material was generally overexplained, other information such as what was expected from students was neglected. This is a very rigorous course.
Having anyone else other than her for lecture makes life rough in Chem 117 ~ run fast if you see the name Prof. Tate ~ the final is very HARD
She is easier than most other chemistry professors. She is bubbly to say the least, which you may or may not like. Chemistry is hard in general, but she will do her best to help you succeed.
Prof. Reck is a really good teacher and makes lecture interesting by using real life examples. She also has a good sense of humor. Her exams are challenging.

She makes things crystal clear and most importantly she makes her expectations clear.  I absolutely enjoyed Organic because of here (which is saying alot).  Her fault is that she may make things slightly too easy in comparison to the people who teach Organic II.  I currently have Martha Oakley and have had to study much differently...and harder.

In all honesty Reck is probably the easiest organic chemistry teacher at IU. Needless to say if you go on to take organic 2 with pellerito you are probably going to struggle since she is much more difficult. I recommend taking honors organic 1 so you don't have a rude awakening with organic 2.

Not a bad professor, but the class is dreadful. ONLY take 341 if it is absolutely 100% mandatory. There are options for non-majors that I didn't know about. I probably could've killed R341, but I didn't know about it so I'm stuck with a C in 341. Reck is a great professor though, it's just tough subject matter.

GREAT TEACHER!! Lecture is awesome, very thorough explaining concepts. Sometimes pace of class seems slow. In-class quizzes are a little stressful, because they cover a lot of info in a short time period. Provides old quizzes/exams and lecture notes. Make organic fun and shares interesting "real-life" applications. Tests are fair, but are long.
Dr. Reck = Legend

I love Prof. Reck! She is a very fun person. I thought I was gonna fail Orgo but she has made the material very easy to understand/follow. I would definitely recommend her if you are planning to take a class as dreadful as Orgo.
She's extremely funny and she knows how to turn lame dull organic chem into a fun saucy subject. One of the best. She is very helpful and she encourages 2 way response in class.
A good professor on her own merits - looks even better when compared to her coworkers.
sweetest lady in the world. very helpful...she is warm and inviting for question and help. there for her students like a mom. take her class.

Professor Reck is GREAT.  Very fun, really cares about her students, always there to help or clarify, etc.  Capable of explaining things in more than one way.  You definitely get out of it what you put into it.  All you people who said bad stuff about her are just mean.  I would get her for every class if I could.  Thanks, Dr. Reck!
So nice!  Will make a great mom someday.

Of course Orgo Chem is hard...but Dr. Reck made it very interesting and was always willing to help.  Anyone who talked poorly about Dr. Reck is bitter because they didn't do well in her class.  If they did not do well, it was their own fault, not Dr. Reck's.  She is always available to help you out and clarify any material.
Great professor. I loved the class. I didn't do as many of the homework problems as she provided but I recommend that you do them! Study, go to class, and you will succeed.

What a great prof. Her office hours are money. Orgo is tough but she'll help you out. Do the problems in the book because she sometimes asks them on exams VERBATIM. On the downside, she's determined to stop any kind of cheating, so don't do anything stupid, or else it'll get real ugly. Really cares about students, great person to get letters from.
go to lecture and she explains everything. built in extra credit on exams. not that hard if you actually study

It's orgo. Of course it's gna be hard, but study.  She does a great job explaining, she cares, she posts old exams and quizzes (VERY HELPFUL).  Study hard, you'll do fine.  Best prof there is considering the difficulty of the material.
I think reck is an amazing teacher. end of story.

Extremely fair, very personable as long as you don't get on her bad side. Posts tons of old quizzes and exams (which is what I focused on most when studying; they're very relevant to what will be asked). Don't let your guard down in the beginning--it gets tough with all the reactions in the second half of the semester.

Great Teacher, but material is very difficult.  In the beginning she says that you should study Orgo every day.  She's not kidding, spend AT LEAST 4 hours a week on this class and you've got an A.  She's very helpful and posts plenty of relevent quizes/tests online.  USE THEM!

She is easy and the most fair a chem professor can get. She gives you all of the old quizes and test, you don't see any new material on the quizes and tests. The only reason you wouldn't do well in her class is if you do not study the material like you are suppose to. If you do book prblms, all practice quizes/ and tests and go to all the classes y
She did a great job, but the material is still difficult!

HORRIBLE! I ended up dropping her orgo class because she skipped around too much in the book. No common pathway to learning the material. Tests/Quizzes were hard. I took the class in the Summer with a visiting professor and ended up getting a good grade. i would not recommend her at all. If you have to take it, do it the summer with someone else!!!

I had her for C117 and could at least tolerate her. Yet, in orgo she was unbearable. She tries to make jokes but they are just dumb. She says "does that make some amount of sense" every 5 minutes. And you don't get a thing out of her lectures, she goes thru the material very fast and in no detail what-so-ever. I learned more from reading the text.
She is a great prof....  Go to her office hours and make sure she knows you!  This will come in handy when you have questions in and out of class!  Study her notes AND the book!
She was fun to have as a professor.

She was nice and funny and made lectures fun, but I don't feel that she prepared me adequately for organic II.  Make sure you study the material a lot and know it inside and out or organic II will be a nightmare.

It's a difficult course, but Dr. Reck is easily one of the best profs on campus.  She genuinely cares about her students and makes every effort she can to help everyone understand the material.  The tests are easier than the quizzes but the class still requires a ton of work and effort in order to do well in it.

Well, guys, its organic chemistry, its not a cakewalk. I liked her though, she did a very good job. I really didn't go to lecture religiously, but you can learn just as much from the book as her lecture. Tests are pretty easy, quizzes are kinda hard. Just study, pay attention, and youll be fine
Her tests are easy but you have to study her notes. I haven't looked at the text book yet. But overall I liked her motivation and dedication to teach the class.

I slacked off a bit in the beginning, but fortunately I caught up, because you should really study for her tests. Quizzes are just evil, because AI's are the evil graders! I do better on the tests...Make sure to study the notes a lot!!! don't skim through stuff...study thoroughly...
pretty good
Great teacher! The only issue I have is that she doesn't use the textbook quiet enough.
Reck is an awesome professor.  But be prepared to work hard in your class or the tests will kick your ass.  Your grade definitely depends on how much work you put into it.

Makes no illusions about the fact that the class is extremely difficult, but lets you know what you need to do to succeed. Always willing to meet and answer questions, really wants students to do well. Makes class better by cracking jokes, very informal. Great teacher!
She is the****:)
She was a very good teacher and very helpful.  When I needed help, she was there and willing to help.  I never thought that I would enjoy chemistry as much as I did this past sememster
No Comments
...feels like youre back in high school.  very "cutsie" and quiz oriented.  good i suppose if you dont learn well on your own

I had her for Inorganic and she was a lot easier than my first inorganic prof so I liked her.  I moved on to Orgo 1 with a VERY difficult prof, while others had her for Orgo 1.  In Orgo 2 (w/o Reck), those who had previously had her were lost.  She is a go
She is the best teacher out there. Help me so much in organic and explains the material very well! I learned so much from. If you can get Reck do whatever you can to have her!
Inorganic Laboratory Teacher... Not an easy class by any means due to the subject material
She would go extremely out of her way to make sure you understand material.  Very knowledgable and gets points accross much easier than the book ever could. A wonderful teacher!

Although I got a good grade in Dr.Reck's course, I didn't learn a thing from her classes/teaching. Absolutely no education& fun from her side..with 2 semesters of involovement with Ms.Reck, I strongly feel she should go back to teachin' in grade schools.

she gives a first impression that she cares for her students but later fails them without care/conscience.Also she's dumb and has a remarkable history of screwin' lectures with no prep.I'd rather do self-learning than go to her class. HER RATING:D-------

she's so boring and ignorant of even basic chemistry stuff..in my class, she was'nt able to answer even simple science questions.it was my AI who helped me overcome a dorky/so called stern teacher who fails students liberally.  AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS!!!
Dr. Reck is awesome! She is extremely helpful and realizes when you don't understand. She makes lecture fun and entertaining. Best chemistry professor I've had so far!!
Dr. Reck's lecture's are entertaining and very understandable. She's really helpful and fair. Best teacher in the chemistry department!
Very lively and good natured, makes class fun.  Always willing to help every student, but the class is not easy!

No devices allowed, and you must have handwritten notes. But the class is super interesting. The in-class essays are very doable, and the rubric is super clear. I loved him as a teacher. When people participate and discussion flows, the class is really enjoyable. Would recommend and take a course taught by him again.

Dr. Comfort is a kind person but his lectures over interesting topics are excruciatingly boring. Attendance is mandatory and there are no laptops allowed. Notes must be taken by hand, which is inconvenient as all of the assignments are online. He asks for participation often while students are not engaged, which makes the setting awkward.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class material is very interesting but somehow the lectures are very lifeless and excruciating. There isn't enough time in labs to finish the workload in time. He is strictly against laptops and you have to take notes on paper. Projects are always in groups and it can definitely be stressful to meet deadlines. Guest speakers are nice though.

Every project is a group project which is aggravating when you don't end up w good partners. Lectures are boring and when students asked questions he would sometimes be passive aggressive. Your TAs grade harshly and there never is a super clear outline for the projects. Make sure you watch the handout video on modules for help with the labs.

The material is not hard at all. If you study and attend class, you will be perfectly fine, trust me. He has a monotone voice, but he sometimes throws in jokes that are hilarious. There is no homework, 4 exams, non-cumulative, and 6 unannounced quizzes (2 dropped). I really recommend it if you want an easy pass and to learn interesting topics.

It was quite difficult to study for exams because his slides aren't very informative unless you attend lectures and pay close attention. His monotone voice and tendency to go on and on made it hard to stay focused and pick out the information to note down, especially since exams include many specific examples and studies he briefly mentions.

The way he teaches makes it hard to connect and understand lessons. Only attendence and 4 exams for grade. I found it hard to understand that he spoke in a very quiet and monotone voice because to be honest, I couldn't pay my full attention even though I sat in the first three front rows all the time. Good luck taking it though!

Overall, Professor Rydell was a pretty good professor. He has a very monotone voice, but his hilariously dry sense of humor makes up for that. He dropped the textbook for this past semester, and your grade is made up of only attendance and 4 exams. The exams were fairly easy and your grade will reflect the amount of effort you put into studying.

His lectures were very enjoyable, his stories were the best part of the class. The material was fairly easy to learn and the tests as well. Attendance is a fairly big part of your grade. Good course, good professor.

I loved this class! Not only was it so interesting but I didn't find it stressful at all. There is no homework at all and grade is based on attendance and four tests. The tests are very easy if you study and he even posts a practice exam. He is also just very knowledgeable and tells funny stories.

BJ is an interesting teacher. He will literally tell you the mood that he is in during a class and if he wants to grade your assignments a certain way due to the fact. Therefore, students in my class felt like he wasn't very consistent with grading assignments. There isn't a rubric sent out either.

Professor Rydell made this class really entertaining with his stories and jokes. The class is only graded on 4 exams throughout the semester, but they are pretty easy to do well on. The review sessions the class before exams covers all of the information from the unit that will actually be on the exam, so show up to those for sure.

This class was easy, unless you aren't good with tests (all grading is through exams). However, Dr. Rydell is very monotone when lecturing, making it hard to pay attention. He also is rude when students approach him after class or during office hours. If you rely on a prof being friendly, this class isn't for you.

It's an easy class because concepts are easy, but if you're a bad test-taker, it could be difficult because tests are the only grade in the class (because of COVID situation). Tests are multiple-choice with one essay question, but none of the exams are cumulative (not even final exam).
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Made lectures memorable by giving us stories that went along with what he was teaching. Really made me enjoy class and feel respected by him.
Great prof. Show up to his classes before exams and his reviews basically tell you everything on the test. Funny dude. Easy class and I'm dumb.

I was nervous at first when I saw on the syllabus that only attendance & exams would count towards our grades, but as long as you go to class & take notes it's not difficult to get a good grade. Dr. Rydell is a bit of a pessimist, but a humorous rather than insufferable kind. He always had interesting stories to tell & made the class entertaining.

Professor Rydell was a great professor. His ability to communicate with the class is unparalleled. Tests are easy if you show up and take notes. Study the powerpoints and the vocab words in the book if you really want to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's hilarious because he's really pessimistic and it makes class super interesting when he randomly throws F bombs out there. But on a serious note, he makes it clear what he's testing on and is a great prof for this class. He makes it interesting and fun to learn about. Either listen in class or read the powerpoints- either way you'll pass.

Professor Rydell was very knowledgeable about social psychology. He knew what he was talking about and kept the class engaged with funny stories and connections to the class material. Very easy going and an overall genuinely cool guy. Would definitely recommend his class!
I loved this class. I thought that the lectures were entertaining and when I had an issue, Prof, Rydell was helpful and open to discuss the issue. Social pyschology

At first I wasn't sure what to think of him, but I found him to be funny and knowledgeable. One thing I really liked is that he admitted when he didn't know something instead of making it up.  He's very clear and likes to back up the teachings with stories and studies.

Dr. Rydell teaches a very easy class. The tests are based solely off lecture with a couple questions from the book. I found him to be insolent, depressing, and did not exhibit enthusiasm for the course material. He further was rude when trying to come to his office hours.

Such an easy class! He only takes attendance 4x per semester and will regularly tell you the class before he plans on taking attendance.  His slides give you all the test question answers and he always does a review before each test.  What a great and easy class!  Rydell swears in class which always keeps it light and fun! I really enjoyed it!

I extremely enjoyed this professor. He is really laid back and funny. The class was always interesting. I never dreaded going (and I had him on Fridays). I would definitely recommend him as a professor to anyone

Explains information clearly. Really funny, and seems to enjoy what he teaches. If you go to his office hours he is willing to help you if you need it! Going to class is VERY helpful when studying for exams.

This class is easy and interesting. If you follow the review and go over powerpoints you really don't even need to read the book and can still get As on the tests. He posts the powerpoints online so you don't really have to go and take notes either, but you don't know which 4 days he'll take attendence. This is a great class
I really liked social psych with Rydell.  He's funny and does his best to keep lectures interesting.  He's also very clear about test content which is helpful.
Pretty fun, he does his best to keep the class interest. He gives lots of examples so if you go to class you'll be fine. Also just try to bring up According to Jim, he really hates it.

I thought this class was pretty easy. you definitely need to read and look at notes, but there were only four exams, no final, and he takes attendance randomly four times, but won't take it before a big break or anything. I think it is worth taking with Rydell because he is pretty hilarious.
Social Psychology with B.J. is the best. You learn so much.

I TOOK HIS J-343 CLASS. Genuinely one of the best professors I've had. Loves to talk to/help students if you ask for it. Textbook work is boring, but photo projects are great. Projects seem intimidating but as long as you submit something, you get credit. Final is project based. If you are interested in photo reporting at all, TAKE THIS COURE.

Dr. Comfort's class is the best class I have taken at IU. He made learning very interesting by bringing media from outside the class for every unit. He didn't allow technology use in the class, so we had to write all notes by hand, but it was honestly not bad. He always waits for everyone to finish writing before going to the next slide.

He is a harsh grader, and the lecture quizzes are annoying. You must attend class to take the quizzes as there is a code for each of them. His lectures are quite boring but he is definitely passionate.

Prof Comfort is nice but his lectures can be long and boring. The class consists of 3 projects that require you to use computer skills with editing and work with camera equipment. If you don't know how to use an 80D camera or adobe editing, it can be frustrating. Also there is a quiz after every class with a code so you need to go to class!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class wasn't helpful. He didn't really help with anything and would often say to ask other students who also didn't know what they were doing. He would never tell you if you were right or wrong and also had a lot of attitude and would give "hints" that wouldn't be helpful. Heavy attendance he will take lots of points off for missing.
If you were considering taking this class... DON'T. His class is useless and he does nothing, petty, and worst of all has a strict attendance policy if you do miss his classes.
Please do not take this class, it will save your time and energy to just study in your own time.

Absolute worst guy ever. Pointless class, wasted time and energy, acts like a child and the guy doesn't even teach at all. Like the other comment says, "Blind leading the blind' he does almost nothing and whines when he doesn't get his way. Stingy about attendance when the class is worth almost nothing alongside with what he does.

his teaching style is terrible and you won't learn anything in this class. me and my classmates have a joke that this class is the exact definition of “the blind leading the blind” because he doesn't actually teach, we just have to figure it out. sometimes i wonder if he even knows math. if you actually want to learn math, do NOT take schaben.

FA25: Bracewell was approachable and nice, though his lectures were very content heavy and were not posted prior or accessible during lecture. Highly recommend typing notes and/or going back and analyzing them more in depth as he also goes quite fast. His TA was not great at explaining the heavy concepts in discussion. Exams are doable in 50 mins

I would say he is a good professor who loves what he teaches. But the lecture is him just reading off of the slide and it's posted after class which takes a few hours sometimes. I would've appreciated it if he uploads it a day or a week early so it'll be easier to go through and understand when class time rolls around.

Dr. Bracewell is great! I personally never read the textbook and felt fine on the tests (+ you get one drop). The TA's and AI for the course were great and both Bracewell and the AI had office hours for additional help. I would recommend him for this class! He is engaging during lectures and will go off on random tangents about insects on occasion!

His lectures can be heavy at times, but he tries to make sure everyone understands and will answer any questions. Tests aren't too hard, but you have to study the lecture slides. Every test has 3-5 extra credit questions and are usually curved 5-10 points. Overall he's a very nice professor and is avaliable if you need to ask any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good professor, if you want the only BIOL L 111 who won't make your life hell it's him. Discussion assignments that are fairly easy and useful weekly, exams should go well if you study the notes, and attendance to lectures.

I love Prof. B!! The class itself is easy, and as long as you study the lectures you'll be fine. He is super nice/helpful and his TA Camille is amazing! Usually one homework and take-home quiz per week. 4 exams + cumulative final.  Drops lowest test score, quiz score, and homework score. If you have a bio background, you're totally fine.
Fantastic teacher, but make sure you study for the exams and attend the discussions every week—no extra credit.

I absolutely love Dr. Bracewell! He definitely pushes his class, but is also very reasonable and will always help those who ask. As long as you put in the work, go to class and discussions, and ask for help before you start falling behind, you will be fine.

There are no assignments for this course, so the grade you get on exams is your grade in the class. She does give quizzes, one for each exam, so there is that, but it doesn't help your grade much if you do bad on exams. The lectures seem pointless as she just reads off her slides AND posts the notes. It is overall a hard topic.

Ryder is not a bad professor, but lectures do get a little boring for this class. Attendance is mandatory as there is some form of participation or group project almost every class. Exams are not bad as long as you read the textbook and understand the notes.
good class if you care about health

Not a mandatory class, but were assigned groups making it harder to skip. The group assignments/exams were very repetitive and it felt like you didn't get much out of them. Tough grader because she rarely gave full credit on my assignments (unless they were group assignments). In other words, you really have to put in the effort in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Awful. If I knew we would have her every semester as a semester I would have changed majors. You won't learn anything you dont already know. Basic personal training principles you don't need a degree for. What I hated most is she looks down on all her students and thinks she's always right and was not open to new concepts of the industry.

just another repetitive class in the major where you barely learn anything unless you dont know common sense. the only way you can fail the class is not showing up because she takes 10 points everyday for case studies you can do in your sleep and by submitting weekly reflections you can just ramble and still pass with an easy A

I can't even believe she considers herself a professor. she may have a doctorate and wrote a textbook but she treats  her students like theyre idiots. Her 300-400 level classes are so easy, theyre easier than 100 level classes. dont get the books because you won't open them. just go to class cuz of participation points or skip cuz you won't learn

Her lessons were pretty unclear and when I asked questions to clarify she would tell me to "look it up in the book or slides." I didn't learn as much as I would've liked to in this class. Also, the group work tended to be the same thing every time and kinda pointless.

Dr. Ryder follows the syllabus very thoroughly and reminds everyone what is to be done each week and reminders for upcoming weeks. Her class is simple and easy but be prepared to study for exams. She does give study guides and it's almost impossible to do bad on an exam if you study. Questions are very logical for the material.

Dr. Ryder is definitely a professor who will challenge you. Many students in my class did not like her, but their reasoning was based on how much time they had to spend putting together projects and papers. She makes you work, but she definitely cares. Be ready to back up reasoning with evidence!

Dr. Ryder is a very good professor who knows exactly what she is talking about. Only problem is she holds her small microphone to her mouth and it sounds very fuzzy and annoying lol. But very pretty and will help you in many ways.
Fun class with good practical experience.
Tests are nearly all trick questions, even though the material seems ridiculously easy as it's being taught.

Mr. Lally cares deeply about his students and their success in the class. He provides honest and valuable feedback on assignments and is always available for help when needed. I would 100% take this class again due to him being just an amazing teacher. He always tries to keep his lectures entertaining and give work that will help you in the future.

Ryan Lally is a great guy who genuinely cares about his students' success in class. He is also available to provide feedback on all of your essays before submission, which makes it more attainable to achieve a good grade on them. He provides interesting conversational topics and makes English more enjoyable.

I used to hate English but gotta give it to the man I loved his class even if it was basic college English. Not too hard of a class, just put in some good effort and ask for help when needed, super available and has an optional day that's like office hours for just your class. If his class isn't filled up try to take him, saw improvement in myself.

Professor Lally was always available when people needed help, and you can tell he actually enjoys his job. Which makes the class so much more enjoyable, the class is also interactive so its easy to pay attention.

Ryan is super nice and chill. Class isn't THAT hard, but there's a lot of reading and sometimes super long essays but overall, this class isn't that hard. He loves to crack jokes during class and if you need help he will surely give it to you. Overall, really nice guy and very good at what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Mr Lally has been a fantastic teacher for Eng W131. Im not going to be able to write as much as I want to about him due to the character limit though. Hes a super down to earth teacher. He shows that he truly cares about everyones success in the class and gives detailed feedback on what we need to improve on. If you do the work, youll pass.
Lots of material covered in a short time. Don't miss the lectures, and be ready to have to read the online textbook for clarification on lecture notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice person, fairly easy class, makes a few mistakes but he is still new to teaching and I feel he did a good job.
Hard to understand doesn't help if you get answers wrong

He's nice. He has a difficult time explaining concepts in a digestible format. He often makes simple arithmetic errors on problems and won't realize it until he finishes the problem, which ends up confusing the entire class. He doesn't offer retakes but curves the midterms by a significant amount. I sometimes felt frustrated even tho I took AP Calc
She just took points off for no reason. Try not to take her. It's not like the prof does anything anyway
Annoying and sassy.
Disappointed. Try not to take her she literally did nothing the whole class except take points off for no reason

I have never left a review on rate my professor, for this class it feels necessary. Grading expectations were unclear, and points would be deducted without a given reason. Minor errors would dramatically lower the given grade. A class with content this manageable should not be difficult to get a good grade in if strong effort is put in.

Always deducting points with no reason.The final reflection should have been simple, show growth & write clearly for full credit.Instead, the class felt excessive for a 1 credit career tips course.She said only “significant dedication to outstanding performance” earned 100 for our final reflection.A reflection?The next highest grade for it was 91%.

I have never written a review about a Prof before, but she deserves one. Truly so mad about the way she graded. Rarely gave 100% even if she had no comments on why points were taken off. There is no reason you shouldn't be able to get an A. Truly worst professor I've ever had by far. No reason I can get an A in ICORE and not Compass??
Do not take

Grading expectations were unclear, and points were often deducted without explanation. Small mistakes resulted in excessive point loss, making it difficult to earn an A in what should be a manageable course. When asking for clarification by email, responses were vague and not helpful, making it hard to improve.

If you get the chance to take C104 with Professor Ryan, take it! She makes the class so much more enjoyable and offers great feedback. She grades pretty lenient, as she is more focused on each person improving individually rather than how good they are at public speaking in general. She is extremely caring and a great professor!

Professor Ryan is a very good professor. She will make this class easy for you if you put in the work. From my experience, this class isn't hard overall. If you put in the time, especially if you are not comfortable with public speaking, you will do fine. Attend her office hours. Professor Ryan will always give feedback on your presentations.

Take business presentations with Professor Ryan. She provided valuable feedback and was willing to help on every presentation. If you show up and do you work, your grade will be fine. Furthermore, she is very accommodating and a nice person to be around. She wants to see you succeed and you will actually benefit from being in her class.

I really enjoyed having Professor Ryan. She is a professor with a lot of words, however she really does care about her students and wants us to succeed. Definitely would recommend taking this class with her! Very sweet.

Posted negative review several times but it keeps being removed for some reason. Katherine Ryan is by far the worst professor I've had at IU and a complete embarrassment to the Kelley Honors program. Avoid her class at all costs. All grades are subjective and she would without a doubt fail her own tests.

Truly one of the best professors at IU. I do not like writing much, but professor Ryan made C204 an enjoyable experience. She assigns manageable assignments and breaks the case project down into smaller parts, and even agreed to meet with my team on a Sunday when we made the final 4 of the case competition. Pretty easy A if you do the work.

Truly one of the best professors at IU. I do not like writing much, but professor Ryan made C204 an enjoyable experience.  She assigns manageable assignments and breaks the case project down into smaller parts, and even agreed to meet with my team on a Sunday when we made the final 4 of the case competition.   Pretty easy A if you do the work.

Dr. Ryan is really nice and sassy, and she spends most of the class talking about things that are off topic. The class is just one long group project, and she is willing to help as best as she can. The class is pretty boring, but she makes it fairly interesting. Take the hybrid option if possible (you only meet once a week)

This class is difficult because of the Target case but Kathy is really helpful. Try to mirror the resources and samples she gives to get good grades on assignments. She tends to ramble on a lot in class but she is very helpful in office hours

I love professor Ryan. I learned a lot in this class because she actually cares about us learning something and not just making us write papers. We only have to go to class once a week, she's a very easy grader and we don't have to give presentations except for Target. P.S: This class will be a lot of work with whoever you take it.

Good teacher.  She is definitely friendly and has the intention to help.  My only quam about her is that she tends to talk A LOT.  Once she starts on a topic, she just keeps talking on and on and on about topics that definitely don't need that much clarification.  It is easy to zone out.

Excellent professor. Go to class, ask questions if you have them, and you'll do well. Do the required readings - there aren't many and they're only at the beginning of the semester, but good grades on the quizzes help in the end. She talks a LOT, but she's great at explaining things & she's incredibly helpful. one of my favorite profs so far at IU.

Dr. Ryan is a wonderful professor. She is one of the most down-to-earth people I know and is very approachable. She is a very easy grader and also very understanding about students' concerns. The Target case is a pain with any teacher, but she makes it as bearable as a professor can make it.

Wonderful lady! She is excited about teaching and helping students. She makes class interesting and really cares about students. One of my favorite teachers at IU! She makes the target case do-able. I absolutely recommend her.
Shes super nice and is a really fair grader. Her class isn't that hard except for the Target project which is just takes a lot of time.

One of the nicest teachers I have had.  X204 really doesn't teach you much, just refines your business writing.  It all comes down to group work for Target and other projects.  If you make an effort in the class, she will respect you and help you with whatever you need.
Take Her Class! Fair Grader, easy B, very involved with her students, very helpful and clear explanations for assignments!
Good teacher- Easy grader- Overall enjoyed her class

Very nice professor, genuinely cares for her students. She gives a lot of prep. time and feedback for the Target project. Fair grading scale and allows a practice presentation day unlike some other X204 teachers. Highly recommend.

Very nice and kind teacher. Clear and helpful in her approach. Made the class very bearable. Pretty easy grader too. Hint: on the tests if there's a short answer you don't know FILL IT IN, she gives credit even for wrong answers!

Genuinely a very funny and caring professor, but his lectures sometimes bordered on tangents. A lot of class is spent on concepts or derivations, but going to discussion will genuinely help immensely. Overall a good professor to the students he's right for. What he lacks in teaching, he makes up for with charm.
I had a vendetta against physics until this professor. His lectures were very entertaining, and he explained concepts very well/in detail. Sometimes he would do demonstrations in lecture

He's not a bad professor, but was not right for me. If you have never taken a physics class before this, I would urge you to seek a different professor. The lectures were funny, but often did NOT focus what we covered in discussion and needed on tests (there were a few times I came across a question on an exam I had no idea how to even begin). 4/10
Genuinely an awesome professor, he makes students laugh, gives extra credit if you ask a good question, and checks in on students during labs

The professor is kind, hilarious, and makes the class enjoyable. He clearly cares about students, grading 100+ exams in one night, offering practice exams, and responding quickly to questions. Lectures are clear and engaging. He also is vigilant about cheating, so as long as you do your own work honestly, passing the course is quite easy.
Doesn't teach test material in lectures, practice exams have no similarity to actual exams, class averages are always very low and he refuses to curve. Labs are useful, but irrelevant to exams.

For H221 -- super great guy; he's really nice, actually cares, and he only cares if you learn, rather than do some arbitrary assignment. Grades super nicely (logic over pure correctness), and he's always helping out. Abstract lectures, but interesting. Doesn't get on you if you're doing something else in class. Lots of work, but would take again.

Very invested in our work and taught speech structure well, but she graded things harsher than would be expected for an introductory course. My team asked her about the quality of our slides before a presentation and were told they were really good just to get points taken off for it. Very nice person, but if she doesn't like your group it shows.
I haven't actually taken her class this is just my boyfriend's mom but she's amazing and everyone should take her class.
Incredibly kind-hearted and forgiving professor. Professional in every aspect and understanding of students' naiveté.

Professor Scott-Harmon provided a great environment for a presentations class. I felt like I got a lot out and was able to learn without much risk. I am an introverted person. She helped me some with case competitions, and you could tell she cared about all of her students. Her grading is lax, but that isn't the reason you should be taking her.

I took her 8 am class thinking it would be awful, but she made it very easy. She grades everything on completion so you just need to show up and do the simple assignments to get an A. She's also very nice and it's apparent she cares about her students.

Professor Scott-Harmon is amazing! I took her 8 am course and still enjoyed class every day. This class is graded pass/fail, so as long as you complete the work on time and follow her directions you should have no problem receiving an A. Professor Scott-Harmon is also an incredibly caring and kind person, I can't recommend her enough!

Professor Scott-Harmon is such a sweet person with a positive attitude. She is always very caring and understands when students mess up a presentation or have problems with an assignment. There are few actual homework assignments, and it is easy to do well in the class.

Professor Dr. Shelly Scott Harmon is THE BEST professor I've had all year!! All the business presentation professors are great, but Scott Harmon really made it a joy to come to class everyday and brought an amazing attitude and smile to class every day. She truly cares about her students and her new grading system makes it pretty easy to get an A.

Dr. Scott-Harmon is the most AMAZING professor for C104; extremely caring and engaging, gives great feedback for every activity, & her new grading system encourages participation and effort whilst taking away the stress of chasing for points. She's an amazing mentor to have - take her for Biz Pres! Her 8am's filled up even faster than other 10am's

I wish I could take her again! She is awesome and makes all her students feel comfortable. She is funny and engaging, brings stress toys to class LOL. She also graded on participation this semester.. but I think she is changing that. Please taker her!!

Dr. Scott-Harmon is the GOAT!! Definitely take C104 with her. She has a very clear grading agenda and will give you great feedback. Participation definitely matter so put in as much effort as you want her to put into the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This semster we got a new completion based grading system made getting an A as simple as just doing the assinments. Professor Harmon is wonderful a very nice and caring person. Despite the participation based grading she gave real feedback. Homework is very light but highly dependent on how much you have to prepare for the speeches.
Scott-harmon may seem strict at first, but she's definitely the easier one out of all the C104 professors. Super nice and tries to make class fun!
I COULD NEVER SAY ENOUGH GOOD THINGS ABOUT HER! She is the sweetest, most kind, and caring professor!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I absolutely love Professor Scott-Harmon! She was welcoming and always energetic about what she was teaching... even at 8 am!! She brings her dog into class frequently. The other day she asked if any of us were not going home for Thanksgiving break and if we wanted, we could stop by her house and eat with her family. She cares about her students!

Probably the best professor I had during my first year at IU. Very energetic and nice. Extremely approachable. Dr. Scott-Harmon was always available outside of class time to help me with my future presentations. 100% recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor SH is one of the best. Although public speaking can be scary to people, she makes such a welcoming and caring environment for anyone. She genuinely cares about her students and is always available outside of the class for anything. She actively engages us, and warms us up before presentations with fun minute voice games or brain games.

Dr. Scott-Harman is one of the best business presentation professors that IU has. She creates such a great classroom culture of participation. If you have the opportunity, I reccomend you take her class.

Dr. Scott-Harmon has been one of my favorite professors. Even though she is a tough grader, if you ask her for ways to help you do better, she has a whole list of helpful resources to make you a better speaker and student, she also had a great teaching style. This class may have been hard work, but I am glad I got to take it with Dr. Scott-harmen!

Dr. Scott Harmon was one of my favorite professors my first semester at IU. She is extremely caring about her students, gives great feedback, and truly wants her students to grow. I would definitely recommend her for C104.

I was terrified of public speaking coming into this class but Dr. Scott Harmon was super caring and understanding. There was a decent amount of homework and speeches throughout the semester but it was definitely doable.

She is an amazing professor. I came into this class very unconfident in my speaking skills and I honestly hate speech but she was super understanding and encouraging. She is an easy grader and gives completetion for the most part on small asignments. She is the best!

One of the best professors I have ever had at Kelley. I always recommend her to every freshman I meet. She is the kindest professor and really cares about her students. She is always willing to meet to give more feedback and help you grow.

Shelly is the BEST professor you can take for C104, none of the other ones compare. She has clear guidelines on what she wants you to complete and doesn't play any games. She has high expectations but is an easy grader. There is no reason why you shouldn't end up with an A and learning a lot in her class!

Fantastic professor who will turn you into a selling machine. Class was dry at times but compensates for that with unmatched nonverbal body language. Look out for this, she will frequently allude to things in class with this!

Dr. Scott-Harmon is a phenomenal teacher for this course. Compared to the rest of the teachers, you will get the most out of C104 by taking her class. She is very dedicated to helping her students learn and inspires you to do better. If you're looking for an easy A though, you've got the wrong teacher.
Difficult to get feedback from her. Told my group that a presentation was our "best yet" only to give us our worst grade.

So passionate about making her students better, she tries to inspire you. I came out of this 10x better at presenting because of her. It's not too difficult to get an A if you put in a decent effort but you do have to try. Honestly was a ton of fun, usually laughed for a good portion of class. If you're shy you won't be for long. Must take for C104
She gives you all the easy presentations (she cuts out the hard/useless ones) and doesn't give as many strict requirements for presentations as other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Harmon is a fantastic teacher. She has a lot of patience and gives great feedback. Like all C104 teachers however, she does get a little nit-picky towards serious points in the semester. Her grading is pretty reasonable, and if you work hard, it shouldn't be too hard to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Tough grader, but enjoyed her teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's a good teacher I learned a lot.

He is a pretty average professor, but his lectures are pretty boring. During class, you have to respond to a Canvas prompt, and you don't know the question unless you're in class. These assignments can't be made up if you're not in class, which was really annoying, but you get a couple of free passes. The out-of-class assignments are pretty easy.

Boring lectures. Fairly easy class. Refused to round my 89% to an A- even though the syllabus never states there is no rounding, so just beware of that. Attendance is a grade but you get 3 skips and usually he cancels class randomly throughout the semester. Not my favorite professor but tolerable.

Attendance wasn't mandatory but I got the vibe that he will start to require it. Super cool guy, and the class is pretty interesting. Def not the hardest class ever but you need to watch the lectures to pass. Exams were pretty easy, all through there was always one random question that I swear was never mentioned.

I really enjoyed Professor Freedman and found his class super interesting. You do not have to go to class because he posts his lectures on Canvas, but I found it helpful to go because he tries to be really engaging. Tests were fairly easy.

I really enjoyed having Professor Freedman in class. I felt that I learned a lot of useful information that will be helpful in the future. He provides clear criteria for everything. Plus, hes super friendly and shows how policy impacts real life issues. As long as you complete the readings, take notes, and do the assignments, you will do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He makes difficult concepts really easy and understandable. Attending class is important to get all the notes you need for studying.

I actually really liked this course.  I found health policy to be an interesting topic although his lectures are a little dull.  No book for this class.  Can skip class if no notecard attendance check is given (just check the slides he posts the night before).  No tests- only short quizzes and easy memos (1-2 pages max).

Do not take this course. Lectures are difficult to follow and often irrelevant to the coursework. Nearly every concept is taught and must be executed using the pre-2016 Office Excel. Exams take 10-15 hours apiece, and the amount of homework is extreme. This class is unnecessarily difficult and not applicable in the real world.

Go to class helps majorly with exams and projects. Most of the people that wrote bad reviews either did not show up to class or procrastinated exams. It feels really work heavy at first but things get better as the semester goes on and he is always available to help. He cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

He makes this class unnecessarily difficult. His lectures aren't worth going to because he just rambles the whole time. The exams are extremely time-consuming and difficult. There are weekly quizzes and projects. He also doesn't let you use new excel functions which makes it 10x harder. He also takes forever to grade everything. Miss of a professor

He is such a messed-up professor. Nothing that he teaches in class is actually useful on his projects or exams because they're so much more complex. He makes the class so much more difficult than it has to be due to his shitty teaching style and time-consuming exams.

Exams can be difficult and long, but Paul is very accessible outside of class to help. Make sure you get a good group though because its about 40% group based. If you have a bad group its better to just leave them and go solo. If you actually go to class it makes everything so much easier. This class is also pretty useful.

Make sure to find a good group. Most of the grade is between take home individual tests and group take home excel files. The class is helpful but lectures are boring because it is him talking and you follow along if you want. If you do skip class or don't follow whats going on you get screwed because files can be very complex and not intuitive.

Lectures can be kind of dull but Paul is kind and knows what he is doing. About 40% of the class is group work so find good teammates.
