Sklar is a nice guy and keeps class interesting but his tests are difficult and his Study Guides aren't the most helpful.

Honestly, he is one of the best professors I have met. He is a really nice person, and always tries to make some funny jokes. (usually people don't laugh though) He gives out several extra credits, that are enough to raise your grade by significant amount. He gives out study guides, and if look into details about them from book, you'll just get A.

Like any college course you must put some time into studying. However, Ben does an amazing job of covering a ton of material during lecture! If you are not lazy or careless you can easily get good grades.

Ben is a great professor, he likes to joke around and tries to get students involved in lectures. He often gives extra credit for attending lecture and if you pay attention, do the online work, and read the chapters you'll get an easy A.

Real nice guy and throws some extra credit in there.  Gives study guides but the information given to study on is too abundant.  His tests are more difficult than you would expect and some questions will catch you off guard.  By the way, no curve and no rounding of grades, so don't ask for it

The tests are tough and the lectures are boring. He offers extra credit if you go to class. Attendance isn't mandatory but is highly recommended. I wish I would have attended more because my grade probably would have been higher.

Ben isn't the most interesting professor ever but the class isn't difficult. If you either read the book or go to the lecture you'll do well on exams.  Make sure to do the online homework, and talk to Ben if you're having trouble.

Despite the fact that he was not the most helpful or interesting professor ever, he clearly cared about what he was teaching and he tried to keep the class engaging. Take notes on his lectures and you won't even need the book. He kept asking for a chili pepper, and I think he deserves it for being one of the better professors out there.

Ridiculous class. Professor Sklar was incredibly boring with his lectures. If he wasn't reading the textbook-provided powerpoint word for word, he was showing movies to do the same. It may be just the content of what he was teaching, because he is a very nice guy. Easy A? Take this class. Something interesting? Look elsewhere. No pepper for you.

Lectures were interesting, although not well attended.  I really enjoyed having Professor Sklar, but he is one of the more difficult P101 professors at IU.  Tests were challenging, but there are lots of extra credit opportunities to boost your grade.  Pay attention in lectures, many of the test questions are from lectures, but are not in the book.

He's a total sweetheart and keeps the lectures interesting. He's also very reasonable and has a good sense of humor. You can tell that he's a man who has worked hard for his accomplishments and is very knowledgeable about his field. I highly recommend him, and I'm giving him his chili pepper!

This class was pretty easy and the tests weren't too hard. I got a solid A in the class just by reading the chapters I was supposed to. The questions on the tests come straight from the book, so if you read and pay attention in class as he clarifies it, you'll be fine. Class could be boring at times which made me not want to go.

Ben's class was fine but you need to attend and take thorough notes, as well as review in the book. A lot of concepts used in this first class are (obviously) covered in more depth in later psych classes so psych majors can get a lot out of paying attention. Overall the class was fine.
Dr. Sklar is the best! He deserves a chili pepper! What a great guy, and i learned so much from the class. Definitely worth taking!

Ben was extremely awkward. No one would laugh at his jokes and he would always talk about random things that didn't make sense. I think hes getting past his teaching prime.. He was fairly nice but I just couldn't stand to listen to his voice. The tests are kind of confusing and theres a lot of tricky questions.

Class was pretty easy, but you have to read the book and go to review sessions if u really want to get an A. Sometimes he gives extra credit in class when no one shows up. I like the corny jokes he makes because it makes stale material less boring and more interesting. he's a cool guy and really nice. hes willing to help u out if u ask for it
Ben was friendly and always understanding! He even offers extra credit and is very funny during the lectures! Best P101 professor ever!
Sklar is knowledgable about the material and is pretty funny. BE SURE TO READ THE BOOK, or you will do poorly. Very easy to get an A if you read and study.

If you want to take this class, just know that how you get your information for the exams will be directly from the book. Don't bother going to class, he just goes over the material in a long and drawn-out way, making more dumb jokes than teaching.
Go to class, pay 40% attention, get an A. That easy.
He is awesome.

I loved Ben! I thought he was super funny and a great guy. The 2 negatives about him would be, he goes through powerpoint slides way too fast and also towards the end of the year he basically just played videos instead of actually lecturing.

PICK ANOTHER TEACHER. this class is so easy but he is so boring its like scraping a cheese grater against my forehead for an hour and fifteen minutes every time i go. Its a pretty easy class, but there are easier teachers who give more extra credit who are way less all in all terrible. Also, he is kinda mean and he makes bad jokes and its annoying
Big fan

He spent more time joking around in class than actually teaching. I learned more not going to class than I did sitting through his lectures. He posts his powerpoints online, and those are helpful when having to teach yourself this subject. I wouldn't recommend taking him for this class.
Good power points, but they don't always cover everything that is on the tests. Do reading for online HW and go to class for extra credit opportunities.
Awesome class you have to take social psych!

he's a great teacher really cares about his students. His tests are easy, if you read the textbook. He puts all his power points online so missing a class isn't a big deal. I would recommend this teacher! Easy A, and interesting course

ABSOLUTELY GREAT professor! Uses great and helpful examples, and is just an overall fun guy to be around! His office hours are more fun than one would expect. He loves humor, and loves to use in class examples, and loves students who discuss in class. He will go above and beyond for you if you need extra help. All his tests = the study guides!

Not the most interesting but he tries to make class enjoyable. Gives extra credit often in random classes. Attending class is not necessary. Exams are pretty easy and he gives study guides for every exam and almost always has review sessions that are really helpful.

He is a great professor. People keep leaving his class feeling bored which is pretty disrespectful. He is extremely smart and teaches well, you just have to follow the class and read. He is definitely NOT boring with his funny personality and interactive lectures. Choose him for Psych 101 for sure!

He was definitely one of my favorite professors last semester. A lot of people in his class were noisy and did not give him the respect he deserved. I enjoyed all the Youtube videos he incorporated into his teaching and enjoyed attending his lectures. If you come to class and do the study guides, you should be able to do good.
He was boring and didn't try to get the students involved. All of my friends loved their psychology teachers except me. Try to take someone else.
one of the worst profs I have had. read all these comments about how his class was easy, so he changed it and screwed everyone! dont take this guy if you want to enjoy class and get a decent grade.

Professor Sklar, I wish I had participated more actively in your class. I regret missing so many lectures... I feel like if I had attended them I would've done a lot better this semester. But... I remember what you asked for at the beginning of the year... Thanks for being a cool guy!!

Dr. Sklar is interested in what he teaches, and you can't ask for much more then that.  If you go to class and read the book he will give you everything you need to get an A.  He regularly inserts humor and perspective on the material, and can make the subject matter very interesting.

Class it pretty casual... He starts giving random extra credit and in class pop quizzes about half way through the semester and it really helps out if you are there for them. His lectures are pretty standard and it would definitely be the class to take if you need to take psych101.

Prof. Sklar's class is what it is for an Psyh101 course in a large lecture hall.  He uses humor to engage his students.. may be a bit un-original, but funny none the less.  His tests are easy if you read/understand the material.  He gives pop quizzes on occasion.  He's been prompt with me on answering email ?'s when i have them.  cool last name!

It seems as if he lost all interest in teaching. I have sent him 10 emails and have not received one response. Easy teacher, although he did not give as much extra credit as he said he would/other teachers. Tests are fairly easy especially if you go to class since he says exactly what will be on it.

Excellent prof, his lectures are extremely witty and very hilarious. Just don't get caught being rude, texting, or talking in class, as he will put you on the spot then ask you to leave. Extremely funny guy, very reasonable - but NEVER try to BS him

His classes are horrible.  I feel like I should go to the classes I am paying for.  But, every time I leave thinking why didn't I just stay in my dorm and read the ppt and book.  He does nothing but read the ppt. to you in class.  Really needs to change the way he teaches
Not not help one single bit. Just stay home and read the ppt and   you will learn more...
Funny and overall pretty good prof.
Proffessor Ben Sklar is an outstanding eduacator whom I consider highly
THis was a pretty fun class
Hilarious man.  Class is very very easy, just go to class because he gives a lot of extra credit, and no one goes so you get it a lot.  Tests are easy, quizzes are online.
Go to class, he gives extra credit to the people who show up and his lectures are really not that bad.

Easy prof. If you read the book, lecture really isn't necessary. He makes powerpoints and reads them to you, which makes class pretty boring. Provides study guides, tests are pretty easy. Offers in-class extra credit. Most quizzes are online. Overall, if you want an easy teacher for psych take Sklar, but he is pretty boring in lecture.

The best psych teacher at IU. Easy quizzes and tests, just do all the study guides. His jokes are actually usually pretty funny as opposed to what everyone else is saying. Oh and...he looks exactly like Milton from Office Space. It's hilarious. If you're going to take P101, get Sklar.

Sklar is a really great professor. He is really funny and makes the material very interesting! He is respectful to students and his exams are cake if you do the study guide. Attendance is kind of needed though because he gives pop quizzes, although they are really easy if you are there!
boring class, but sometimes his jokes are funny.
He makes class fun and psychology interesting.
Looks Like Milton off of office space.... ma ma my stapler? haaahh

Character: Jolly, jovial, open; the biggest/worst complaint about Prof. Sklar is that he makes "corny/lame/unfunny" jokes. The more anal ones will complain about his tardiness/ill-preparedness. He tries to relate whatever he's teaching about to real life as much as possible, no matter how insignificant it may seem. He loves using Youtube videos. :)

Unbelievably easy class. Unbelievably ill-prepared professor. Going to class is a complete waste of time, Ben just summarizes the reading assignment, and is incredibly uninteresting while doing so. The tests come completely from the study guides, don't even bother reading the whole chapter.

You can either attend every class and take notes and never read or never attend class and read the book and you will get an A as long as you show up when there is a quiz but sometimes he puts them online so then its amazing. he tries to make it fun but can't really control the class all that much...
easy and fun class
Good class, easy teacher. There are 8 quizzes and 6 tests and you get to drop 3 quizzes and 1 test. There is some extra credit. A guaranteed A if you read the book.
Sklar is hilarious. There are 10 quizzes, 6 tests, and you can drop 3 quizzes and 1 test. He offers a bunch of extra credit and gives out comprehensive study guides before every test. He's a baller.
Funniest, best professor out there.. Enjoy going to class, he's hilarious and gives online quizes. Drops the 3 lowest quiz scores and lowest test.. Highly recomended
Best teacher ever! He makes psych so fun, I actually enjoy going to class!
He is a great professor. He is very enthusiastic about his job, and makes the class very interesting.

very interesting lectures, lectures are not boring at all, uses slides in his lectures, at least for p101 course, makes the material more interesting to study. helpful anytime. one of the likable profs.
This mans legit
Good professor; understands what college students need and does his best to make a note heavy class interesting.
Fun Teacher, Easy Class.

Funny teacher, OK class. Interesting material. Warning: 10 pop quizzes! Lots of notes; bring a digital camera and take pictures of them...it's much easier than trying to write it all down before he changes the slide. Huge class...rather annoying people, esp. if they are loud or out of control. Tries to control them SOMETIMES. Good book, funny jokes
He couldn't control the class so it was a lot like a high school sub.  He spent way too much time talking to the class about random stuff rather than what would be on the test.
tries to keep class fun
He's a really nice guy. He tries really hard to have the class participate and laugh.  He will do whatever he can to help.  His notes are definitely good for tests.

I thought the book was very easy to read and follow, and his tests were extremely fair. Also, he and his AI made some fatally boring material bearable, occasionally even fun, which is saying a lot for the 3-hour class I was in. Nice man, knows a lot about his field. His jokes are terrible, but . . . that's why he CALLS them "Bad Joke of the Day."

really not getting your money's worth here--he couldn't control our class to save his life!  he relied on the AI to tell us to be quiet--his lectures were worthless--no one payed attention.  he clearly did not earn the respect of his students!  there are better pysch 101 teachers out there--find them!
He covers a lot of material and tries to help everyone get a good grade by giving study guides and easy quizes.  Very responsive to student needs.
Awesome class. Very easy if you just do the reading. Very experienced and helpful professor. I would recommend to him to anyone.
Nice and funny.  Fairly easy class

Going to class is completely worthless, except his pop-quizes.  Lectures are mostly his sick, non-humorous jokes.  You could learn more reading a psychology book you than you could taking his class.  If you want an extremely easy class and don't mind going to the boring lectures again and again, go for it.
He's a very nice teacher but I do agree that his jokes aren't the best.
Good Teacher + Bad Book makes it hard when you dont go to class.
Recommend this professor for an easy A, only bad thing is that his jokes suck. Other than that, his class is real easy. You really don't even need to go to class to make an A.

Skylar treated me pretty unfairly in this course. She is horrible at explaining what she wants out of an assignment and grades harshly even with poor instructions and expectations. She is unreasonable with grading sometimes and very annoying to listen to for an hour and fifteen minutes.

If you are an international student? Please do not choose her class. If you already did, drop it. Sincere advice. I tried to ask her how I could improve my grade. She simply said "well, you are an international student, it's good enough you can get a B+." She just simply wont offer you any help.

Very easy teacher to get and A in if you grew up speaking English.  Not clear on assignments but also not graded difficultly at all. Cares about her students, will learn a lot from the experience itself more than her guiding you through it.
Class is boring and she doesn't like Asian students. So unfair
Classes are boring but she is an extremely easy grader and wants everyone to succeed. Easiest C204 teacher by far
All Asian students in our class drop the class.

Best prof. I've ever had.  Easy A, she really cares about every one of her students.  You learn a lot, but at the end of the day shes a super easy grader and extremely nice and genuine.  Will go out of her way to help you

First exam could use a full page of notes, the other 2 exams were take home w/answers found easily in the book or from powerpoint slides.Can miss a few classes w/o loosing points, she is friendly and gets off task easily and she has plenty of interesting stories. However, there are random quizzes but they are easy. Overall a good professor!

Took her for organizational psych...class was spent chatting about student's previous work experience and she'd spend the entire class on the same power point slide...reasonable and fair, gives extra points on tests and at the end she allowed our final to be open note...easy class but unorganized

Kennon is by far the best professor I've ever had. Her lectures are very interesting and I love attending them. I'm not a huge fan of history, but she makes it so fun to learn about. Also, the exams are easy and the final project doesn't take very long.

Kennon is wonderful! I took D323 as a non-design major, with no previous SOAD coursework, and I loved it! Grading is mostly based on the two exams and multiple homework assignments, along with attendance and a final project. Kennon is adaptable and keeps lectures interesting. She made me want to show up!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kennon is one of the best professors we have in the design program. She makes HISTORY interesting to sit through. She is caring and respectful to all of her students. I cannot recommend her highly enough if you are required to take design history for your major.

Kennon is the best professor I've ever had. Her teaching style is incredibly clear, making complex concepts feel simple. She explains everything thoroughly and is always open to questions, ensuring every student feels supported. Moreover, she is understanding when it comes to extending deadlines if needed, showing genuine compassion.

She is the best teacher I have ever had at IU. Ive had her for Design History I, II, & III. She is the most understanding, kind, and funny teacher. she genuinely loves her students and is so passionate about what she teaches. Her tests are easy and she sticks to the syllabus. Ive never met anyone that doest love her after taking one of her classes.
Absolutely love her!

I absolutely love having Kennon as my professor. She brightens our class every morning and her passion for the topics she teaches is super inspiring to the class. The lessons are understandable, and so are the homework and class activities. I always feel super engaged in her class and I hope to have the opportunity to have her again in the future.

Kennon is so nice and engaging! This course was hybrid and she understood that was difficult and still made the class fun. Homework assignments were weekly and not too difficult. Somewhat lecture heavy and would need to read textbook for help on homework. She isn't too tough of a grader either! Overall, would take one of her classes again!

Kennon is so awesome. She is engaging, entertaining, respectful, and a great person. I really enjoy both classes I've taken of hers and feel like I was able to learn effectively. Highly recommend her.

Wasn't bad at all! She really cares about the material, and she made me want to learn more about the subject. She did tend to get upset when students didn't participate and she did start cold calling. Overall, the class was very manageable.

Professor Smyth is manageable, but lectures are long and tend to not cover the material that is supposed to be taught. All assignments are projects and essays which are graded with very critical rubrics. Overall, there are some interesting topics but not worth taking unless its required.
Very nice teacher. Class was fun and you'll learn a good amount.
This course had so much homework its not even funny. Other than that though, shes a pretty chill professor and is pretty lenient. Lectures were interesting as long as you care about the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I would parrot everything that was said in the other review for Y332 from 12/10. Professor Smyth was a bit messy and all over the place. The grading criteria for the research assignments was not clear, and she graded all my work at once in December. Some podcast sessions were held outside regular class hours. Wouldn't take a class with her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great professor, well educated in the subject area, and a good intro political science class.

Very knowledgeable but very disorganized. Syllabus was irrelevant by week 8. Lots of outside time required as she opted to have podcast projects outside of class time. Shamed people for not coming despite scheduling the stuff during hours of other classes. Kinda condescending about questions too. Papers are repetitive too so class got boring quick

For a 100 level, yes, some say the classwork is a little much, but it is SO EASY. Smyth knows what she is talking about and is very educated in her field. There's no tests in this class, just assignments. She uses top hat for attendance and lets you work in groups so definitely take this class with a friend or meet people in the class.

I liked her, I did. My experience got ruined by a group project in which someone copied MY paper, and my total grade got taken from a B to a C. Also, the TA, was awful, she left though, but her grading was beyond harsh for a ONE HUNDRED level course. Prof. Smyth also tends to go on tangents that have nothing to do with the course.

Regina was a good professor and is very knowledgeable on the content. Yes, she can get sidetracked more often that not by talking about current events while lecturing, but she's a very nice person and I thought she did a good job teaching the content. The course has a ton of readings so keep that in mind I guess.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She has a tendency to get stuck talking about case studies outside of the graded content, but is very knowledgeable and informative in her field. Main issue I had was with the T.A, who I believe left. Grading was inconsistent and rubrics weren't provided until the final paper. Definitely a class you have to lock in for.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very knowledgable professor and applied the course contents to real-life events. However, her and her AI were definitely tough graders, and there were only a few larger writing assignments which really impacted overall grades. Didn't like stupid questions so beware of that!
Very inconsistent grading with a lack of clear guidelines. She is very nice as a person but her grading system is far too complex with little to know explanation.

This professor has to be the worst one I have ever had. She grades papers in 2 ways. If you do great you will get full points for a section. But if you make a single mistake on a section you will lose all points for that part of the rubric, before papers you will not receive one.She will give you in class instructions and you are told to memorize.

Regina was an excellent professor, I had her for two different classes in the same semester and she was great and keeping things clear between the two.  If I wasn't graduating, I'd likely take a class with her again.

Professor Smyth is super knowledgeable about political science, with a specialty in Russia and Eastern Europe. There are no tests or quizzes, only essays, worksheets, and attendance. If you are a decent writer you will not struggle in this class.
Very unpleasant to deal with.

Professor Smyth is very knowledgeable about Russia but can be a bit intimidating. In 107, we did not have to do the required reading but she said she would change that for the next section and add quizzes. The papers we had to write were interesting but she graded those and other assignments a little hard. Overall great professor and class.

Professor Smyth is an exceptional scholar of Russia. Taking this class when the Russo-Ukrainian War went hot sure was an experience! Quite a bit of reading, but manageable. Class culminates with a research paper on a topic in Russian politics. However, this paper is a process with her giving much guidance over the semester. Highly recommend!
She is a fantastic professor and scholar on Russia, and her class is very manageable. I had a lot of fun in her class, and she is very good at getting students up to speed on the course material.

Probably my favorite teacher I've had at IU. She is very knowledgeable on Russian Politics and is always willing to help if you ask. Her grading can be a bit tough, to her a B is the new A, but if you do the reading and take good notes it isn't that bad.

I loved this class because there was a big focus on things currently happening. The paper topics gave you choice in what you wanted to write about specifically. She grades the papers pretty tough, but if you participate in class so she knows you and you develop your argument well she will give you a good grade.

She is super nice and cares about her students doing well! Participation and attendance matter, but she is very understanding about missing class for sickness and other emergencies. She is incredibly knowledgable about Russia, but I know nothing about Russia, so I was lost a lot of the time. However, I still have an A in the class! Take this prof!

Very lecture heavy, some classes had a little bit of group work which was a nice change. She is very tough on participation, because I speak up a lot and i still only got 80% participation at the end of the semester. No final, which is nice. Her focus is Russia so prepare to learn about them a lot. Make sure she knows your name by the end.

I did not know much about politics before, so for me this class was pretty difficult. Mostly stressful because she assigned lots of readings and I understood basically none of them. She knows a lot about Russia and is always available for office hours! Nice and sweet professor overall.

Regina is honestly super cool and knows SO much. I had her for comparative and the reading was pretty hefty but thats given with a poly sci class. I felt like it was pretty hard to get an 50/50 even if she just gave you a 49/50. She has a focus in Russia so if that doesnt interest you, her lectures will be pretty boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Smyth has high expectations, but if you attend class and complete the readings then you can do very well in her class. Her lectures are extremely interesting and she's highly intelligent. Very enjoyable class.

This class does require a lot of reading and paying attention, but I learned a ton from it! Smyth knows everything about Russia and her lectures are actually very interesting. The material seems advanced but she teaches it well, but I recommend lots of note-taking. My only concern is that the essays have no rubrics and the prompts can be too vague.
She knows everything about Russia. Insanely smart, easily one of my favorite lecturers to listen to
Really good professor.  I highly recommend her!
Great teacher!

Prof. Smyth was terrific. I loved her comparative class. The material seems advanced, but she simplifies it for better understanding. She's extremely knowledgeable and makes the class very interesting. Tests are easy. Highly recommended.
Didn't know this guy taught econ, he was my professor for my beginner's guitar class. He didn't seem to know what he was talking about, and he always obsessed over A minor.

reviews.comment: Would have gotten a A+ if I was a minor :/
A natty wasn't enough for this man, he had to meet the Stein himself for future guidance.
Great guy. Always willing to meet outside of class and gives a lot of extra credit.

Found myself alienated at school because I graduated early from highschool. But Professor Self was the only one that treated me like a proper adult and was very understanding of my situation. Although, I did enjoy the fact that class would be often be cancelled for “an emergency situation” but he would try and get undocumented one on one interactions.

Genuinely the only bad teacher I've had at IU. Lectures were just sad and insanely boring. However, class was often canceled because he went to jail for "holding scheduled office hours with lil kids". 10/10 would take again.

Professor James gives extra credit to freshmen!
James offered lots of credit which is great, it including bring your sibling under the age of 18 to class. If you were 18 or below you got a automatic A+.
Would I have passed if I was a minor

should have known something was up when he kept asking about my little brother. Weirdo.
I hope to god no one pays the $500 bond
Professor Self offers..extra credit. Building a relationship with underclassmen is particularly important for this professor.

This class was going well until he decided to ask whether anyone has any spare baby oil. Not sure why, but ever since then, the vibe of the course has felt odd. He also didn't show up to class this week.
Should have known this squid was a pdf.

Creep belongs in jail

reviews.comment: I would not recommend taking this class if you haven't learned micro beforehand!!! I learned absolutely nothing from his lectures. I didn't take notes or come to class half the time, but still ended with an A. If you study really hard for exams you can do well in the class because he curves so so much. His voice will put you to sleep.

Professor Self was a very nice professor, but his class was very difficult. Exams didn't tend to align with the study guide very well, and lectures were very boring. If you get A's on the homework, you can pass the class even if you fail exams.

Self is growing on me the more classes I take with him. He really knows his stuff, and his lectures are packed with relevant information. His method of using a wide variety of different assignment types may feel overwhelming at first, but it does help with remembering the content. Practice exams were helpful, and every exam is generously curved.
Avoid this professor at all costs, he is not very engaging and exams are weighted heavily. There is also little to no prep for exams. If you take econ with this professor just know your cooked.

Prof self puts the least amount of effort in teaching, there are constant errors in the practice questions and information in the lectures does not apply to the test. However, if you want an A in this class you can definitely do it. Just focus on the information on Pearson (textbook) and actually read and take notes on them. Just keep ur head up.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Everybody praises paying attention to his lectures- he talks in circles and goes off on long tangents that dont apply to class material. If you manage to tune out the fluff of the lectures, the fluff of the class powerpoint, and the fluff in the textbook, THEN you can piece together what will actually be asked on exams

Some people keep flagging legit criticism over this teacher because he is “nice”. That should tell you enough about this class where students defend him just because of his personality rather than his teaching which you are paying him to do. Also tests are nothing like the study guides or graded class problems so have fun.
Terrible class with even worse professor. going to the class can be very similar to losing your parents in a car accident. This class has ruined my life.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Massively overhated. People who write bad reviews under his name are just those who don't pay attention during lectures, or the homework. Yes his lectures are boring, but you don't even need to show up to class if you pay attention to what the homework teaches you. Gives an insane curve on tests. People who rate him low are just salty.

Yes his lectures are boring and attendance is taken by random quizzes. But do the reading assignments, like actually read them, and try to pay attention during lectures and you will be just fine.  He makes everything clear and will explain why you got an answer wrong clearly.  Grading isn't vvery harsh either.

Honestly, his lectures are super boring and hes very monotone, but he does pack a lot of good information in there. He gives an in class quiz once a week so attendance is basically required. Other than that, as long as you show up, do the homework, and put in a little bit of effort to study the class is VERY easy. He also curves tests by a LOT.

He is just not good at explaining things. Most of the knowledge you get comes from the textbook and online homework. The lecture is required, but most don't get much from it, as it feels like someone who obviously knows what they're talking about is just talking and talking, but you and everyone else have no idea what they are talking about.

The rest of these reviews are not wrong. When taking this class I care most about my grade. My final grade was the most important to me. The class is for sure do able, however Professor Self is one of the worst professors I have ever had. His lack of motivation and effort towards students is unbearable. I hope the economics sector of IU fires him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Having taken AP econ, I was familiar with most of the concepts taught in class, but I feel Prof. Self did a wonderful job not only explaining but applying the theoretical concepts to everyday life. His class is very lecture-heavy, and the weekly Revel homework assignments did get monotonous, but the exams are heavily curved. Overall great class.

Here's what you need to know. Yes, his lectures are super boring, he somehow has both an annoying and monotone voice. Yes, there is a lot of homework and readings you need to do. If you want to succeed, go to class especially because of the "Active Participation Quiz" (pop quizzes, basically). Curves tests massively, thanks to that I got an A.

He's a nice guy but oh my days his lectures are so boring. His monotone robot-like voice puts me to sleep every class. He gives a lot of pop quizzes and homework is due every Friday. He also puts all his due dates at 10 pm, which is annoying. He tries to make this class interactive, but just talks the whole time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Homework is doable—about 2 hours with a week to finish—but quizzes and the final don't have anything that goes with the study guides he gives (my experience). Lectures are pretty boring, and attendance is tracked through random in-class assignments. Grades aren't updated on Canvas, and the class feels too exam-heavy for non-econ majors.

Terrible professor, what is taught in class does not line up with what is on exams. I had over 97 pages of notes and reviewed and studied them then when test came I failed. Not to mention other friends in the class used the notes and failed aswell. Use the text book.

This class ended up being pretty good! The tests are hard, but curved generously. There's reading homework every week, but it's not difficult. Professor Self is helpful during office hours and not mean at all like some of the reviews have claimed. Show up to the lectures, work hard, and you'll get at least a B in this class.

The class sucks and studying for exams, but the weekly work isn't bad and isn't much really. The concepts don't always make sense, but he curves the exams. He is really nice and cares about the subject and gets too much hate.
When I missed exam 1 simply because I skipped class and was honest with him about the reason he allowed me to retake it. Very forgiving and an incredible professor

Professor Self isn't the greatest, but he gets a ton of hate on here. If you do your work and learn the material, you'll be just fine. Weekly assignments are not terribly grueling, and honestly relatively easy. He does his job, which is to lecture, but sometimes it can get boring. Do the work and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Weekly online work was straightforward, and lectures reflected topics covered by the online textbook. Lectures were easy to follow and provided additional practice problems. The guided notes provided for each lecture were great for studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Random in class quizzes which kinda forces you to show up to class and pay attention. Teacher is chill and clearly explains what is asked of students to succeed in the class. Lecture heavy so he ovbsiouly talks a lot but he tries to make the class dynamic. The class itself isn't that hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would not recommend Dr. Self. To name a few issues: long, boring lectures; poor communication skills; condescending attitude; and lackluster teaching. His teaching style was not well-suited for introductory microeconomics. He also gave pop quizzes on content covered that day—unacceptable, IMO. Luckily, he gave generous curves on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I don't know how this rating is so low. Clear about what you had to do and when it had to be done, lectures explained concepts in easy to understand ways, and overall a nice guy. 99% chance that the people giving out 1s here never showed up to class, didn't pay attention if they did, and didn't study or do any of the work (which wasn't much).
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This is genuinely the worst class I have ever taken. The weeks leading up to the exam are hellish, as I work for hours to cram everything he's ever said in class, written in a presentation, or assigned in the textbook into my head only for none of that to even be on the exams. Dude legit has a fetish for watching people fail.

Professor Self's class is a mixed bag. The lectures can be dull, but he brings up interesting real-world examples. Lots of busy work, quizzes, and tough tests, so staying on top of the Pearson assignments and study prep with tools like unstuckstudy ai is key. Overall, a challenging class, but doable if you put in the work.

Self is over hated on here. If you are a solid student, you are going to do fine. His lectures can be dull at times, yes, but he can be very funny as well. Interesting concepts, libertarian view, actually learned a lot. He is very smart and brings up real world examples. Grading system is wack, only know overall course grade twice before final.

He is overhated. Not the best but not the worst either. He gives out many short assignments to boost grades. He also does in class graded problems, but they are always on the topic he just talked about. The one thing I didn't like was using view em for grading, which is too rarely updated to be useful. His lectures are fine, but can be dull.

reviews.comment: I had him for Econ, and it was the worst class of my life. His lectures are painfully long and he just talks and talks. It was so hard to listen and pay attention to. reviews.comment: Professor Self made me feel bad for asking questions in class. He gave almost no explanation of the information on his slides, rather, he just described what was present on the screen.  The course did not reflect a beginning-level micro course. Get used to Pearson, it's why I passed, but he expects about 7 hours a week on there plus weekly quizzes.

reviews.comment: if you can, take any other prof for econ. dr self is not only annoying to listen to, but he doesn't teach anything tbh he is awful. if you have to take him, good luck
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Teaches in a format different from the book he is teaching out of. Spend many hours on homework each week. Makes it difficult to differentiate the 30+ different lines you HAVE to know to put on a graph. Abbreviates everything.

reviews.comment: The teacher tends to not teach and when questions are asked he hits you with some sarcastic reply assuming you should know the correct answer.

reviews.comment: Terrible professor. The lectures did not help one bit, I learned entirely from the online textbook (which was very helpful). I went to all the lectures because he does pop quizzes, but did the homework in class. The tests were fair and not difficult if you study. Overall, bad professor but the class itself was not hard.

Awful teacher. He is a close-minded individual who's teaching style complements his worldview: shallow and tunnel-visioned. There were numerous typos per test, reflecting how much he cares about the education of his students. If you want easy credits, by all means take this class, but if you are looking for quality education, steer away from Self.

Self is a very generous grader. He always curves tests so if you have a B you will get an A. The final exam was hard, I got a D( 68)but he curved it to an A- (91).Weekly homework and random in class quizzes so attend every class. Key to excelling is reading the Revel, take very good notes, do practice sample questions, see the TA. You will be fine.

reviews.comment: Honestly, he is boring to listen to. But, all necessary material is provided; you can succeed on your own. Weekly homework is time consuming, but Excel is helpful even if you can't use it on the exam. In-class quizzes about every other week are short and not that hard. If you can learn on your own or somehow pay attention to him, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Self is a smart guy and sometimes his lectures come across as hard to understand, but if you apply yourself and ask questions you will be fine. The course can be tedious, but Self is helpful and makes it manageable. For all the people that left a one-star review for him, I guarantee didn't frequently show up for class or actively pay attention.
He's a smart dude. A lot of the bad rating come because people don't care to understand economics. You're not learning rocket science, it is an intro class to micro or macro economics.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor cannot instruct the material required to pass the class. Everything you learn for this class is from the online textbook. reviews.comment: He is not as bad as people on here are saying. They have probably not taken other STEM classes. He gives a formula sheet on the exams and if you take notes, go to class and do the homework, you're fine. There is a decent amount of homework and pop quizzes, but just pay attention and you will be fine. It is a STEM class, most of them are like this.

reviews.comment: Overall awful teacher who does nothing but lectures the students. Homework is helpful, but you won't learn anything in the actual lectures.

reviews.comment: Dr. Self has some very impressive credentials. However, I did not have a good experience in his E370 class. Lectures were unclear. He expects specific answers and content for his projects, despite his instructions being ambiguous. Exams were a disaster for many, despite the relatively simple course content. Avoid this professor at all costs.

Professor Self clearly knows a lot about economics but he is not able to convey that information to students. The lectures are useless, but the textbook is interactive and very helpful. He is a generous grader with a nice curve. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he gives pop quizzes on random days. The class isn't difficult if you can teach yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Throughout this semester, there were many times where things were not graded correctly or went missing and I find that to be unacceptable. On the final exam, there were three different instances where the test had to be changed due to errors in the questions with key number statistics. Professor Self is one of the worst professors I have ever had.
He's a great guy and an easy grader. Be ready to listen intently in class and take notes on the online HW. Quizzes every week, and in class graded problems every week or so.

reviews.comment: Manageable if you pay attention in class and do all of the extra work which is "non-graded". Good luck if you don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things
