Professor Self seems like he'd be an interesting guy if he wasn't so uptight.  His voice is completely obnoxious to listen to.  He make the class harder than it needs to be.  If you study the book and go to class to get the attendance extra credit, it's manageable.
Strange Grading System, but he fixes grades and requires other who teach to do so too

I took him again for E202 because the CL will boast your grade so much. He is really boring so take his class in the morning and sleep. He knows what he is talking about and he is willing to help you if you ask him.
Sometimes he doesn't explain things in the clearest way. But in E201, his grading scale was so generous it was ridiculous.

My roomie and I have come to the conclusion that he was a dinosaur in a past life (he looks like a T-rex). The CL sessions are dumb and don't really help because the leader cannot either a-Speak english or b-doens't know how to do the problems. The grading system is wierd and too hard to figure out, so basically you have to trust him.

He made it clear on the first day of class that he was a Navy Seal and could kill each and every one of the 200 students in the class with a Pencil, a rubber band, and a thumbtack. He scares the piss out of me! Don;t take any of his classes.

For Public Finance (taxation) E390 the class sucked.  I had a 89% going into the final, and he gave me a F for the final, and an F for the entire course becuase I literally looked at someone that farted during the final exam. This guy is extremely weird. I was Econ major but didn't enjoy the course, his lectures, homework, and he's a marine.
Always got bored at his lectures. Never know the scale he works with. Be prepared for his first test, it's all about wording.
Very boring and not really fair. He ‘fixes’ his grades so they they are around a 2.4 gpa. He is also very anal and strange.
Biggest complaint is strange grading. He intentionally makes sure grades are low. So beware when you take his class.

Sort of a weird guy. His lectures suck, take your laptop to class so you can do productive things online (you can learn more by searching the economic phrases he talks about in class on Wikipedia)   the class involves a lot of web based homework. The grading scheme is akward, based on your homework grade you change the weight of your final.

"How much pleasure will you get from the 1st milk shake, 2nd milk shake?  What happens to your amount of pleasure as you consume more?"  Talks about "pleasure" in an economic sense are the only highlights of his otherwise slowly taught, monotonous, boring classes.
He is definitely NOT funny.  He is a monotone speaker and very boring.  Nearly half the class falls asleep.  Just a weirdo in general!
No Comments
he talks like jim's dad from american pie and hes very hard to follow. its also boring sitting in a class for 1 hour and 15 minutes listening to him.

He's a good teacher and knows his stuff, but he is the most boring person to listen to. He goes straight by the book and I dont go to class because I can learn just as much by doing online work and by reviewing the material myself. If you are serious about Economics then this isnt your guy. if you are looking for a class to just have as a filler, then this might be the one for you even if it does come with a littel bit of work.

He is hilarious whether is trying to be or not.  he raises questions about whether or not you can consume a shoe.  I got a B in his class and i didn't even really try.  I laughed a lot in there because he is so funny and it was really distracting
Professor Self is an awesome teacher for intro to microeconmics if I could have had him for E202 I would have. Highly recommend this professor.
Very boring, which makes it harder to learn. But econ just sucks, so it is not all his fault, and I guess he can change the fact that he is boring. He seems to look down on people too.
VERY boring.  tests seem harder than departmental tests.  He has a funny voice and keeps holding his hand up.
Good prof., just a little boring.
This guy is really boring to listen to, but he does know his economics. I thought his tests were harder than the departmental tests. His voice does resemble dr. evil's.
Lectures aren't exactly entertaining but they are very clear. I took this class on a whim and actually found the material very interesting.
No Comments
Economics is a dry subject, and Dr. Self doesn't make it any better.  His lectures are VERY boring, but he does know what he's talking about.  And his voice sounds like Dr. Evil.
No Comments
Hard to stay awake during lectures, but he does help you if you ask.  Tests aren't too difficult.
His class is all lecture and very boring.  However there are no surprises on the tests.

Smiley cares about his students so much. He is such a nice guy and is well respected in the THEM major at IU. Though i do agree he can put more pep in his step during lectures, I for one know I learned a decent amount this past semester, maybe just not as much as I should have.
super nice guy. sometimes a little forgetful but cares a lot about his students. lecture and group project heavy. grades pretty easy. loved him!
Professor Smiley is very friendly and caring. There are only three exams with no final exam.
Professor Smiley has rarely ever come to class prepared with his own thoughts or knowledge. He listens in on conversations students have and lingers throughout class without offering much help.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class made me see some realistic components of entrepreneurship. Smiley is unorganized and assignment instructions & due dates are not clear. Make sure to study for the tests and to attend the review sessions. Smiley is a nice guy and is willing to help students and meet outside of class.

I had Professor Smiley every semester while I was at IU, it was nice having him and seeing him come to graduation, he is very familiar with the stuff he teaches, ask him questions if you get lost he will answer them. He is very laid back (which I enjoyed) but some times you just have to ask questions if you get behind, don't hesitate. Great Prof

I love prof Smiley, he is educated and funny. His lectures are straight forward and everything you need to know is on the slides- read those and skim the chapters in the book for the test and you will get an A. He is the sweetest, understanding and caring- treats you like a real person. He has experience, connections, and good stories to share.

He is really laid back, what you want for a college professor. BUT sometimes it takes awhile for him to put grades in which can be stressful. tests are harder than the rest of the class so be prepared

Super laid back, if you understand the material you will pass with an A, easy. If you get confused at all- you're kind of screwed. You can talk to him in his office and he will get you squared away, but just hard to follow for projects and tests are hard. EVEN if you study and he allows cheat sheets.

expect group work! class consists of lectures and guest speakers. lectures are not often engaging, so it can be easy to lose focus on the material. Provides opportunities for extra credit, but often requires attending an event so it is not always beneficial or easy to do. easy grader and provides good feedback. can be hard to get in contact with.

Smiley is such a great professor! He is one of my favorites and seems to really care about his students and that they grasp course concepts. He does love group projects so if you are not up for that you may not want to take his class. Book is not needed but he does do a few in class assignments that are random.  Would highly recommend him :)

This guy is mostly worthless. Avoid his classes if at all possible. Countless ambiguous directions, and lecture after lecture where he rambles. His "relevant experience" is mostly a sham. He can't give you explanations on course topics beyond a textbook definition. Shame on the University and Department for allowing him to teach.

He's a great teacher if you respect him. You have to listen to what he says and you'll learn things about the industry from all of his experiences. However, he is laid back and students often take advantage of that.
Phenomenal instructor

Easy class, easy A. While lectures are not mandatory and can sometimes be dry, he seems to genuinely care about the students' understanding of the subject. Also, he's very fair and partial when dealing with students.

Avoid him. His expectations are ambiguous. He will make countless assignment, class, and test schedule changes without notifying students online or with an updated syllabus. Very frustrating. He expects group work on a project for which he doesn't release a project description, expectations, or requirements. Heavily relies on foreign case studies

I have taken three classes with David. He is by far my favorite professor that I have had. One of the most understanding and helpful persons. Classes is fun. Material is interesting. If he isn't clear, just ask. He is always willing to help clarify and help out.

This class made me see the rewards in event planning. Smiley is unorganized and assignment instructions & due dates are not clear.  Make sure to study for the tests and to attend the review sessions.  Smiley is a nice guy and is willing to help students and meet outside of class.
Very much enjoyed this professor. She went so far as to invite me to apply for the excavation she is assistant director for. Very kind and very passionate about her job.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Allison's class. Weekly quizzes (very easy) and three short papers/projects are all the work in this class (you choose what you want to write about too!). You get what you put into the class: if you are interested in the topic, you will love it. If not, it will be a very easy class for general credit. She is knowledgeable and very nice!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class can get a little long/tiring with how much content there is versus how much of it is important. The slides have a list of vocab words at the end so make a quizlet with those before each exam and you'll most likely get an A/B. The professor is really passionate about the topic, but sometimes goes too in-depth for the class level.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Although her lectures were long, I found them rather interesting. If you have an iota of interest in mythology, the class will be enjoyable. You are only responsible for knowing a small amount of information, however she teaches about a lot more if you're interested. Attendance not mandatory, always write down the vocab list, and take the TopHat.
Boring but easy to get good grades. Lectures every class, but she posts them so you can skip. Quizzes once a week on TopHAt.
One of the best professors I have ever had! He pushes your ideas, encourages creativity, and guides you through any challenges. He's also extremely understanding.

Malcolm loves teaching but not at IU he would rather travel and give his time to other people who pay him for short residencies than his struggling majors and graduate students. when he decides to show up he treats himself like a celebrity and will wait till the end of the school term to tell his students he doesn't approve of there work for thesis

Malcolm is a genius artist!! He is extremely intelligent in ceramics and will hype you up with his large worded dictionary and ideas! However, I found him ambiguous due to unsteady involvement in my work. I received little positive affirmation/encouragement. He is an intimating person- I fought internally to overcome my anxiety around him.

Malcolm is a great professor. He isn't easy and expects a lot from you, but if you want to grow as an artist he is the professor to take. He's exactly what I want out of a professor. I personally think he's phenomenal.

He is incredibly knowledgeable in ceramics. The only thing is that you as the student must take the initiative to ask how something is done. If you ask he will provide multiple examples. If you want a good grade complete your assignments on time and have intelligent reasoning for  your project during discussions.
He has the potential to be really nice and a real jerk. Dont take his class.

Nice guy very informed with material, lousy teacher.  Spends more time surfing on ebay during his work week then teaching or helping students.  He also has mood swings and is very diffcult to judge whether or not he is in a good, neutral, or bad mood (usually very grumpy).  Not very accountable.

Malcolm was not an "easy" teacher. But he did his job incredibly well. He had interesting assignments and incredible knowledge in his field. He was always honest, driven, and intelligent. If you have a chance - take his classes.

Not a bad professor at all, but she is definitely a tough grader. Small details that are left out can cost a point or two. She also has surprise in-class writing exercises, so if you do not do the readings assigned the night before you are definitely out of luck. If you are really interested in Black history, I'd recommend it. Other than that.. no.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Kind Professor but overall, it was just a difficult class. There is heavy lecture and take-home content and she loves to give surprise in-class writing assignments. The course was interesting but only take it if you are seriously interested about the content of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith is a good professor, don't get me wrong. She also is a harsh grader you might need a few AP English classes under your belt to get a A in her class. All papers except the final are handwritten and if you're not planning on reading I wouldn't bother. If you miss 1 detail it'll cost you. I recommend this course for someone TRULY interested!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I enjoyed the class for as long as I was in it, she's a great lecturer, but she's an extremely tough grader. If you miss a class or reading, you are definitely bound to get behind because of how much material there is (main reasoning for why I withdrew). But, if you are extremely interested in Black history, I recommend taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment:
Her class was wonderful! Very open to discussion, and we talked about my hard subjects in current events. Learned many things from various authors I had never read before.
I took AAAD-A408
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved the content, but she was a very tough grader. You forgot one thing in the short response and she takes a point off. It felt like I could not succeed in the class because there was always something wrong with what I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this course, however, it was very difficult. Prof Smith is an amazing instructor though, I just believe that her class and grading was very tough. I learned so much about Black History, and I am happy I took the course overall. Beware of pop quizzes.

Most criticisms of Dr. Smith are based on hurt feelings and anti-Blackness. Candis Smith is a phenomenal, intriguing, and insightful lecturer who compels students. People should be grateful to step foot in her classroom. Treats material with care and will improve you as a learner.

Although it was a very interesting class and I learned a lot I would not recommend taking this course unless you are really interested in Black History and diaspora studies. She is a great professor, however with the Coronavirus pandemic going on I felt like she could have been more lenient and not assign so much work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She honestly doesn't care whether or not you had a bad day or whatever. You come to class and be quiet and wait for her to call on you. Such a terrible course

Not an easy A class... Favors African American students over white (sorry but true) Highly critical and not receptive towards in-class discussion topics Do not take unless VERY interested in black history
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith is a great teacher but her class is hard . it is not a regular black history course and will be difficult. don't skip class you will regret it . Exams are long essay format but no too difficult . although the class was not easy its worth taking
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class was very test-heavy (75% of the grade came from tests). I felt like Tom often just told us things and expected us to figure out the how or why, which in organic chemistry just isn't possible. There was built in extra credit and practice exams, which made the class possible.

Almost impossible to know what will show up on an exam (which is 75% of the grade) with him saying “this isn't important” and then a direct question on the exam of the topic, this happened frequently.

Lazy professor (almost none of the scraps of discussion worksheets, notes, even exams were his own) and zero guidance (NO UTAS or UTINS!!).
This class is fairly lecture heavy due to the high amount of content. If you go to class and pay attention the exams shouldn't be extremely difficult, they are also curved 15% automatically.
Great person, decent teacher. Tests were straightforward, never trying to trick or surprise you. Lectures are not recorded which kinda sucks.

Good teacher, tough class. Exams have extra credit built in so that helps. Most exam questions came straight from slides or were *slightly* different. Attendance isn't mandatory but good luck if you plan on missing a ton. The book is great for practice problems, which you'll need because he is usually slow to upload practice. Overall, he's good.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sem is not over, but I'm barely hanging on (and I got an 89% in 1). He only grades four things total—1 gets dropped, 25% is discussion, 75% is exams. He's funny, but lectures felt off with the iPad, he should've stuck to chalk. No attendance, few office hours, no UTAs or lecture recordings. If you're independent, you'll be fine—if not, good luck.

I really liked Snaddon. If you like chalk talks and non stop lecturing, this is the professor for you. Hes very passionate about chemistry, and is also pretty funny. Ill never forget the time he said I love stereochemistry more than I love my children.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Snaddon was one of the best professors I've ever had. Just take good notes; use different colored pens to correspond to the different colors of chalk he uses. And review those notes regularly. Yes, he gives pop quizzes, but those quizzes (and honestly the tests too) rarely contain something that he hasn't explicitly worked out in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Snaddon is a caring professor and ultimately wants his students to do well. The exams are challenging but doable if you study a lot. Go to office hours if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: IDK what the other people are saying, they must just be butthurt, but Snaddon gave a small curve this year that actually bumped my grade from an A- to an A (barely XD). His grading criteria could be more defined, but his lectures were good, although I wish he published notes online. A funny guy, was overall a good teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Snaddon was a great guy, but lectures were scattered and repetitive. BY FAR the worst professor I had when it came to handling the COVID situation. Promised a curve, saying that an A would be an 85%, but without letting us know otherwise decided not to, leading to my solid A to be an A-. He screwed us all over with grading at the last minute.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love chemistry, but this class was a nightmare. Lectures are incoherent, repetitive, and not engaging. I can see that he is an intelligent and approachable man, but this does not translate into his teaching. Both Snaddon and the AI promised that C's would curve to A's at the end of the semester, but no curve was ever given. Still feeling ill.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: For this class he will start out really slow with a lot of review material and race to the finish at the end of the semester, but overall the class material is not that difficult, and he makes sure you understand it if you ask the right questions. Solid guy. If you can take honors orgo with him, do it.

Professor Snaddon explained concepts well in lecture but overall the content and exams were very challenging.  Going to my AI's office hours and working through problems was the only way for me to understand the material. Make sure to work all practice problems and ask questions. Exams are focused on application rather than rote memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: By far one of the best organic chemistry professors in the department. He explains well, is very funny, and is personable. If you have questions, he is very good at explaining and willing to help. He knows organic chemistry is a hard class, and he wants his students to succeed. If you have the chance, take his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Absolutely horrible lecturer. He INSISTED on "chalk talks" in the largest chemistry hall in the building. His handwriting poor, his quizzes had very few problems worth FAR too many point, and his grading criteria was immensely unclear. He is poor at writing problems that ask what he actually wants.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The general consensus of Spring 2016 Orgo 1-- ReckSnaddon.  Snaddon is a good guy, but I didn't like his teaching style or notes. He is sometimes kinda funny, and his accent is nice. But he's rather hard to talk to because he's stubborn and a little condescending.

I liked Snaddon much more than Reck. Reck was all over the place and had sloppy answer keys with lots of mistakes that she refused to fix. Also, Snaddon's tests were more straight forward than Reck's. A vast majority of the material on Exam 3 and the final came from the notes. Snaddon seemed like a pretty good guy, but I never went to office hours.

He had a rough start to his portion of the course; however, he soon became more comfortable, which was reflected in his teaching. He is a very intelligent chemist which often affects his ability to break things down in simpler terms; however, overall I feel he has prepared me for the rigor of more advanced chem courses. Study lecture notes!!

Point distributions in exam questions were awful. Lectures are okay. Puts up notes two minutes before class starts so bring your notebook. Online notes are confusing. Sometimes incorrect as well. No discussion worksheets - tells you to use MCMURRAY. Nice professor, not a great exam writer. Does teach well and help whenever he can.

Snaddon is a great guy!! In my opinion his exams were easier than Reck's, but were harder due to point break down. His tests required you to really understand the material rather than memorize facts. He really prepared us for orgo 2 because he made sure we knew why things happened. If you have the chance, take orgo with him you'll learn a lot!!

Snaddon is the best orgo professor! Don't listen to the people who say he's awful. He's super nice and willing to explain things if you ask him. His exams are okay, but make sure you don't memorize the stuff and actually understand it. Unfortunately, you have to deal with Reck (who is awful) for the first part, but then you get him which is nice.

Orgo 1 this semester was team taught, Dr. Snaddon took the 2nd 8 weeks. The transition was rough but once Dr. Snaddon was comfortable, he was great. His exams are straight from his notes so focus on those. Plus he is Scottish, so that accent is amazing. As long as you want to learn and don't just ask for answers, he's more than willing to help.

Thought he would be cool because of his accent, turns out he is the professor from hell. These reviews that say he's great are ridiculous. He tries too hard to be funny and in turn spends more time on jokes than on explaining course material. Often says 'this isn't important' and then asks detailed questions about it on exams. Do not recommend

Snaddon is hilarious and charismatic in lecture; however, he barely gives partial credit and his overall grading criteria is horrible. My whole class bombed the last exam in orgo, but he still refuses to curve anything. I wouldn't recommend Snaddon, unless you're a flawless test taker.

Dr. Snaddon seems like a super nice guy in lecture, but there have been multiple times when I have had questions over material where he has been very disrespectful to me. He is rude and very unhelpful. I DO NOT recommend taking any class with him. His quizzes and exams are reasonable, but the grading is ridiculous.
Never went to class, got an A+.
Came to IU from Cambridge, so he only gives tests and some quizzes. Test make up the majority of your grade, and we got to drop one.
He is an exceptional professor with excellent office hours. And he is easy on the eyes with a dreamy Scottish accent. A true Clooney of the academic chemistry world.

Professor Snaddon is awesome! He is such a nice guy, and he really wants you to do well. He is really knowledgeable, and he is very good at teaching. His lectures are very engaging. If you are struggling, I would highly recommend going to office hours or arranging time to meet with him outside of class.  Class is tough, but it's totally worth it!

Before coming to college, everyone warned me about ochem. If I didn't have Professor Snaddon,  I might've hated it like them. He's passionate about the subject and that carries over into his teaching. At the end of every lecture, it was like an epiphany. If you find yourself struggling, his office hours are extremely helpful.

Dr. Snaddon is SO wonderful! He's my fav teacher at IU.. He is v. funny, Scottish (accent isnt bad), helpful, and cares so much about his students. I thought CHEM-S 341 was gr8 and appropriately challenging. I spent a very considerable amount of time on the class, but it was totally worth it. ORBITALS AND RESONANCE ARE IMPORTANT! Pretty large curve

He is the sweetest guy, probably in the entire department. He just wants you to understand organic chemistry and orbitals, and will help you do whatever you need to learn. Yes, this is the honors class. Yes, it was hard. It was so worth it. I decided to go into ochem grad school after this class.

Great professor - very accommodating to students who need some extra help. His accent also manages to make Organic a little more interesting :)  All you've gotta do to pass is read the book before lecture, take notes in lecture, do the practice problems, and go to office hoursschedule extra office hours with him when needed, and you'll be fine.
Snow is amazing. He's a smart guy and his lectures are almost always interesting. Make sure to pay attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor does not effectively communicate and goes off on too many tangents in his lectures.
Takes forever to post grades but is a good teacher that's teaching hard material. I found his class interesting and difficult but definitely not impossible to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Snow is not an effective teacher. During class, he would be lecturing and even confuse himself on his own information. This class is already hard, and the fact that he did not know what he was doing half the time made it a lot more difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Snow makes microeconomics easy to understand if you attend class. Anyone who attends the lectures and reads the chapters should have an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty arrogant teacher I must say. If you meet with him during office hours, he is not very helpful and overall just acts cocky. Exams are nothing like the practice exams we are given. Do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Snow as a Professor is one of the best I have had. His enthusiasm makes his lectures truly enjoyable to listen to and take notes over. He's always willing to have a discussion about economics whether it relates to the course material or not. Overall, you can really tell he cares about the students.

Snow really cares about having students participate in a real dialogue that gets them thinking and engaged. He's very knowledgable in his discipline and knows his views, but he never pushes those on students. Instead, he's always looking for pushback, counter-arguments, and good questions. Basically the Socrates of Econ professors.

I had him when he just came to IU so we did not have any practice exam for any of our exams. The extra credit from CL did not help me at all because it only helps if you do badly on the final. For me, I did better on the final then the normal test. Also his teaching style just did not click with me.

The best economics professor I've ever had. Made me love economics and showed me theory and empirical work that I had never before considered as well as new methodology. If you're looking for a combination of inspiration, intelligence, and hard work in your professor; Nick Snow is the man to go with.
Snow is very knowledgeable and exciting. I loved him as a teacher. He made me love economics.

Overall a solid professor. The topic can be hard but he makes it fairly enjoyable. There are multiple extra credit opportunities along with a final exam replacement policy that's very beneficial. Recommend him over a lot of teaching assistants.

So I took his honors class and it was a completely different experience from what I'm seeing in the comments. The class was very manageable, and Professor Snow was an excellent teacher. I would recommend his honors micro class to everyone, even if it's not required.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Snow gives fantastic lectures (energetic, constantly encouraged students to push back, ask questions, etc.) LaunchPad code was only useful for its quizzes (not part of grade). His practice exams didn't help prep for exams, and he didn't give out older exams. You could only see your old exams by going to office hours (didn't give them back to you).
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Nice, sure, and not too difficult if you understand basic economics, but I would rather snore through a boring textbook neoclassical economics course than endure weird libertarian Austrian nonsense.
This teacher was really nice but his class and lectures sucked and was really hard - tests also sucked lol

Snow is a cool guy but his class sucks. He isn't helpful and is condescending in office hours, his practice tests are nothing like his actual tests, and his in-class lectures are barely worth attending unless you need extra credit.

It's a shame that the department is allowing this guy to teach graduate level physics courses. He's extremely poor in mathematics. Skips core concepts and talks useless nonsense things in lecture. Writes on board by using a piece of paper and still it's disorganized. Gives you wrong answer if you ask any question. Worst Prof. I ever met!!! Run!!!!!

Professor Snow is my favorite professor this semester.  His lectures are awesome, and he is very helpful.  Lectures are fun and he uses a lot of examples and stories to teach physics.  I highly recommend this professor!

Great Professor, extremely easy class. You can tell he is kindof disgusted with himself for teaching this material so slowly. Class had more than 50% A's, I hope this grade inflation isn't prevalent all throughout the Physics department at IUB. Good lectures with cool demos, clicker questions mandatory. Grading is very lenient, homework is easy A

Engaging lectures, humorous at times. Seems to really know his stuff and how it fits into a larger framework of physics in general. Not a big fan of the 'flipped' classroom approach, although his version is mellower than some other bad experiences I've had. Textbook use optional, although online access is mandatory and purchasable separately.

Professor Snow was great and very enthusiastic! He brought relevant demonstrations and explained material very clearly. I strongly recommend him. While attendance was taken, 8 absences were allowed between discussion and lecture. The course was weighted fairly and made an A very attainable.

I had bad history teachers in high school and took her class my first semester, but her class was so interesting that now I'm planning to minor in history. She obviously really likes to teach this topic.  As long as you take good notes during lectures (her powerpoints are only images), and try hard on papers and tests, then you should do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof Snyder is by far one of my fav profs yet. She is engaging and makes everyone feel comfortable even when discussing tough subjects. She is very open to questions and discussions. She is really helpful to go to if you need the help. Overall she is excellent and I picked up a minor in the subject to have more classes with her.

Professor Snyder is one of the most engaging lecturers I have ever taken a class with. She's incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about Native American history and makes the topic very understandable and interesting. Although I wish we had more chances for discussion, she did the best she could with a large class. Highly recommend!

I very much enjoy Dr. Snyder's lectures. Her pacing is good and she makes each lecture relevant and interesting. One specific strenght of this course is that she assigns readings from many different sources. I have especially enjoyed reading the primary documents. I reccomend this class.
Dr. Snyder's lectures are amazing! She is so knowledgeable and makes every lecture relevant and interesting. I wish I could take more classes with her!
Boring.

Lectures have the tendency of being boring. There are times when the lectures keep your attention, but not many. Picky grading of the exams by the AI's. Interesting class, it definitely has its flaws though.
She nearly always got our class into a lively discussion and peaked our interest. Tests are cake if you have been paying attention and doing the readings.
She's a wonderful professor. Definitely recommend any classes with her!

Easily best professor I've had at IU, if not best instructor throughout my whole school career. Hilarious, caring, and down to earth, he makes lectures fun and interesting and pulls even the most shy students out of their shells to feel a bit more confident by making class a comfortable space where every1 can speak without feeling judged I

Sorensen was by far my favorite professor I've had for any class here at IU. He keeps class easy to be engaged in by games and interesting opening questions at the beginning of class. I fell back in love with learning German after having him as a professor. Very caring, wants to get to know his students. I recommend taking any classes of his.

Great prof. Very real personality. He genuinely cares about his students, accommodates their needs, and wants them to learn. When we were having problems with the coursework, he welcomed feedback and adjusted the curriculum so that we were actually learning and enjoying the materials. Made effort to make class entertaining and worth attending.

I love Sorensen and am so happy I took his class as a freshman. He keeps classes light but interesting and you end up learning a lot. The class made me think I wanted to minor in German... then I realized it was mostly the prof that had me looking forward to class.

Lane is excellent. He grades relatively easily and is amazing at explaining abstract German grammar concepts. He does not expect perfect German, just so long as you make an effort. The class had a manageable workload as well. I learned so much, and I wish I could take every German class with him!
Best German prof at IU. Grades very leniently and genuinely cares about students.

Lane is an amazing professor. If I have the ability to take a class of his again, I will. The Vikings and Sagas course was amazing in terms of his teaching and passion for the topic. There were readings every day and papers, but not too difficult. He is knowledgeable and is caring and understanding to his students. You cannot find a better teacher!
One of the best german professors at IU. Hilarious guy and you can tell he cares about the students.

Amazing teacher. Lane is one of those teachers that is a good teacher but also a great friend. Very accessible outside of class. He is super funny and will swear in class. If you're debating taking G300, take it as long as you have professor sorensen as your professor.

Lane is a fantastic professor who really builds rapport with his students. He is easily likable and will bond quickly with everyone. Lane also makes every lecture fun and will keep you on the edge of your seat at all times. You will know exactly what is expected of you and just how to complete every assignment, and will have plenty of time to do so

Such a great guy. I struggled this semester with life in general but he was so understanding and accommodating. I wish every professor was like him. He cares so much about his students and does his best to make sure you're understanding the content. Awesome guy, awesome class. Take if you can

I had Professor Lane for IFS: Vikings and Sagas and he was simply amazing. His lectures were engaging and interesting. He is very passionate about what he teaches, and he is very knowledgeable of the subject. You can really tell he cares about his students, and always gives good feedback. Be aware though, you will have to read a lot for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lane is an amazing professor who's passion for his subject is clear. I looked forward to class, and I always learned something new. He required a lot of reading, but I also took an accelerated course, so his semester course load may be different. Anyone who has the opportunity to take a class with Lane definitely should!
Lane makes an environment where effort is more important than accuracy. Extremely including and puts energy into all his lessons.

There is so much to say about Lane Sorensen and his course Vikings and Sagas. I entered this course having little knowledge or interest in Vikings. Lane's strong passion for the course content fueled my classmates and my interest; feeling our professor's intensity, we became eager to learn. I ran out of characters; Lane is an incredible professor!!

Lane Sorensen has been the best lecturer I've ever had. He gave me the confidence to learn and pursue language when I was feeling very doubtful of myself. His number one goal is to make sure you're learning in an accessible way for you. His teaching style is great and he's super encouraging and patient!

If you can take a class with Lane at least once, I suggest you do it. He is very nice and cares about his students and wants you to walkout with an A. He's very laidback and understanding. Show up, do the readings, and discuss and you'll easily pass with an A as well as have fun in his class!

This is the greatest man I have ever had the privilege to be enlightened by. His views on Nutella and Manta Shrimp are nothing short of inspirational, and his hairdo will transcend the test of time. Lane Sorensen is my role model.
Deb cares for her students and their success. She gives students her energy and time to help them do well in a hard class such as chemistry. Def take her!

This prof is the queen of chemistry!!! She's an amazing lecturer and practice problems are very similar to quiz questions! I don't really understand why lots of people say her tone can be rude because I do not agree. She on time with submitting grades and throws so much extra credit out it's very difficult to not get an A in the class! Take her!!

Prof. Snaddon is an amazing elementary chemistry educator who well-prepared me to move onto upper chemistry courses. Her lectures are very thoughtful, though she can go through them quite quickly (given the amount of content she needs to teach). I suggest to go to her officer hours to clear up any confusion.

I actually loved this class and professor. She made this course as easy as she possibly could and also gave a lot of helpful resources for struggling students. She also gives an insane amount of extra credit just for showing up or answering questions. My only critique is she can get a bit annoyed with stupid questions so dont ask them lol.

She is very good at explaining the processes of things in ways that are easily understood. Homework is due once a week designed to mimic exams (makes them way easier). She also posts EVERYTHING on Canvas. You will never have to wonder what is happening because she will tell you. Tons of easy extra credit opportunities as well.

Professor Snaddon is a good professor however she can be very condescending and judgemental every time you ask a question. When she teaches problems she tends to explain it in the most difficult way necessary and then makes a snarky comment when you ask a question because you're confused. I would not recommend her as a professor, personally.
Explains things fairly well in lecture. Not the most personable but she is okay.

Horrible Professor! She was gone for a whole month back in 2021 and the AI's had to teach. She was very rude and sarcastic to her students. I remember she made a study cry because her question was 'stupid'. Would not recommend. I took orgo and passed with a A- but this class was so much difficult because her teaching was horrible.

She really exemplifies the night and day difference a good professor will have on your experience. Even with the relatively fast paced class she utilized the time to thoroughly explain all the important parts of each topic. There are plenty of examples and guided practice opportunities. 

Also she's just a really cool lady, highly recommend!
She was such a good professor! You actually have to go to class though. Although attendance isn't mandatory, she teaches the topics really well and if you want to succeed, you should go to class.

It's a hard class, but the professor is amazing. Gives plenty of practice and practice exams, so I always knew what to study. Go to lecture, she's amazing at teaching in a way that makes sense. She also gives drops for exams and quizzes, and there's retakes. If you have to take C103, she's the best option.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Not the worst prof I've ever had but definitely not the best. Hard to access outside of class.
I went to class a total of 4 times in the semester. If you do the homework, go to discussion, and go to every quiz/exam you will almost certainly get an A

Cares about students' successes? YES
Offers extra credit in lectures? YES
Condescending? YES
Fun to talk to (1-on-1)? YES
Bends rules? NO
Professional & Organized? YES
Allows the use of gadgets in lecture? NO
Great office hours? YES

Reaching out to classmates that seem to understand the coursework better can be a big help.

Snaddon really cares about her students and their grades, so she sets the class up in a way that makes it hard to get anything but an A. However, she is very rude and condescending, so it may be hard to ask questions when needed. Doing the homework and practice questions and showing up to discussion is what sets students up for an A.

Professor Snaddon was really caring to students from the first day of class. Throughout the semester she would send us emails telling us that we were doing a good job and that we could pass this class. She gives lots of practice quizzes and exams. The homework reflects the lectures, and this class does require lots of outside practice.

Professor Snaddon was no nonsense, but she was kind. The work moved quickly but you just have to stay on top of it and take notes and you'll get through it. She was a very good teacher I thought all the lectures made sense. She also gave extra credit which really pulled my grade up so stay on top of it. Highly recommend her if you have a choice!

Prof. Snaddon is a pretty good instructor, but I don't like how she set up MC. They are so pointless in helping us prepare for quiz/exams. 

I would recommend to watch the discussion videos and solve problems along with it to prepare for quiz/exam. GO TO THE OFFICE HOURS, she answered any questions on MC. Doing this was how I passed this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I hate chemistry and didn't really go to the lectures as often as I should. If you just take the time to sit down and actually learn and practice the material you will be fine. All extra credit helps, honestly that's probably why I passed. She gives lots of things to practice with and is very clear when you have a question.

If you want to study for hours upon hours on end before exams and then still fail, then this class is the one for you. I've worked harder than I have for any class for this level of chem and still haven't had a positive experience.

For a 100 level, this class is ridiculously challenging. It's supposed to prepare for 117, but is beyond difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Syllabus was clear & she was verbal about what was expected from the course. Her teaching style is learning through examples & practice problems, which for me, was helpful. She provides loads of (optional) workbooks and plenty of practice material to make sure you understand. Office hours are super helpful & she offers extra credit occasionally.
I personally do not believe the method she uses is an effective teaching method
I was very apprehensive because she didn't allow ANY devices in class, this means if you take notes on a tablet you're kind of out of luck.

Professor Snaddon has a clear and organized outline of the course and if you do all the work provided on time, the class is super easy to follow. Snaddon's office hours are definitely extremely helpful, you can tell she's devoted to making sure students are able to succeed. participation isn't mandatory; but lectures are so so helpful.

DO. NOT. TAKE. CLASS. WITH. HER! She was an awful teacher. She wasn't sympathetic and was very rude to me personally. She also left for a month without warning and made us learn from the AIs, who literally did not care about the class and were very unprepared. I failed the class because of a mental health situation, and she did nothing to help me.

She seems very blunt at first, but she really is just straight-forward with the expectations of her students. If you are confused with the material, she will gladly help if you go to office hours. She was in Scotland for about a month, so it was slightly more difficult to learn the content at that time. The textbook is probably what saved my grade.

If this is your first time taking chemistry, DO NOT TAKE IT WITH SNADDON. She does not use class time wisely at all. She literally showed us a video about caves for an entire class for no reason. She left for Scotland for 4 weeks and left us in horrible shape for the final. She does NOT curve and does not care about her students. SAVE YOURSELF!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I wasted five credit hours taking this class. Professor was out of the country for a month. Her aides were awful. She has no compassion for students who dont understand the material. Avoid this woman like the plague. Is there any wonder why college enrollment is own 3.8% in Indiana? How can we keep students enrolled? Maybe actually TEACH!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Although she was absent for 4 weeks, she gave zero leeway to her students. This in-person massive lecture became a clown show led by 22 year olds who turned lecture into a laughable free for all. No late assignments are ever accepted. Office hours via zoom have 90 plus students waiting to answer questions. Not a good learning environment. Avoid!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Snaddon was amazing, she really cares about her students and her lectures are well paced and easy to follow. I would not say attendance was mandatory, but missing a lecture is a lot to make up sometimes. Textbook is used and I recommend keeping up with the reading, or you may be a bit confused during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Snaddon is amazing! She provides many office hours and is always ready to help. Practice problems are a huge key on succeeding in this class, so make sure you do them!! Exams have problems very similar to the practice exams. Overall, she is a great lecturer & going to lecture is very important!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Snaddon is awesome. Her lectures are very helpful and she offers a ton of extra credit points. Her office hours are extremely helpful, as well.

If you have taken an ap chemistry class, you'll have an easy time. If you haven't taken chem since sophomore year you may struggle. The lectures are over material you should study before class so you have access to all the info at home if you don't go. The tests are major but if you prepare a lot in advance you'll pass with a good grade.

Professor Snaddon is amazing. I don't like chemistry, but she finds a way to make it interesting and accessible. She does offer extra credit so an A isn't impossible, however you do have to work for it. She offers amazing advice and it's best if you listen. She is no nonsense, but it's absolutely worth taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: entirely asynchronous online except for the shortened lab half of the semester. how can i be expected to put effort in and care when the professor couldnt be bothered to hold class over zoom. Hard to stay motivated this year and things like that are so discouraging.

I took this class online and dropped it after a month with a B+ standing; I felt that no matter how much effort I put in, I didnt understand the content. I felt that she talked down to concerned students and her lectures were very vague and did not pertain to the HW or exams; please save yourself a mental breakdown and wait to take it in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Prof Snaddon online, so I never got to really meet her, but she sounds super nice from her lectures. Her lectures are very clear and easy to follow, and she gives good problem examples. She gives a lot of extra credit at the end of the semester. But, be ready to put the time in for the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS IF YOU HAVE TO TAKE C117 and you were even a little bit unsure about the placement exam. It will help you so much, AND c103 and c117 uses the SAME textbook, c103 does the first half and c117 does the second half of the book. c117 profs will already expect you to know the first half either way (its ALOT). dont do ALECKS, u wont learn anyth

Loved having her for C103! She's very organized and has so many materials so that you can practice (DO all of it). If you want to get an A in this class, make sure to read EVERY chapter that you learn BEFORE the lecture AND do the practice problems in the book (lecture will be so much easier to understand). People who don't do well don't practice

I absolutely loved professor Snaddon for C103. She gave great lectures and provided so many extra resources and practice if you needed/wanted it. Towards the end of the semester she gave many extra credit opportunities on top of the drops she gives for assignments. She encouraged students to do their best and it was obvious she cared about us!

I took this all online during a pandemic and hated every second of it. This course is extremely lecture heavy, it felt like she was reading from the textbook in every video. There was a large disconnect between her and the students (I didn't speak to her once). If you do the practice questions/homework and watch the lectures it's a very easy class.

Professor Snaddon was very pleasant to have. She gives lots of extra credit opportunities. Truly wants her students to be successful. The only complaint is her lectures and the AI discussions are quite boring.

I just do not like chemistry. I did not like that this class was 100% online besides the lab. Professor Snaddon did not respond to emails in a timely manner and sometimes she was quite rude. However, she was always willing to host office hours, and even host extra office hours to make sure we understood the content of the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was amazing. Easier than C101 I took in high school through IU. Offered SO much extra credit and offered exam redos for those who did poorly. A+ in class was not difficult just take notes, watch the lectures, and actually try. As arent handed to you, you need to work for it. Super sweet and truly cares about her students.

I took this class during the pandemic so it was all online. She had prerecorded lectures and she spoke in them as if she was too smart to teach this class. She expects you to know everything about chemistry already. I spent most of my time in this class. There are so many things to keep up with. I couldn't understand my AI so that wasn't helpful.

PLEASE READ!!!!! I took this class during the pandemic so that means this was all online. I would say doing this online class was AWFUL. Her lectures were prerecorded and spoke in them as if she was too smart to teach it. She doesn't know how to teach this class to students. I cant understand my AI. I spent 20 hrs a week doing work for this class

This will be my third rating lmao but I LOVE HER! She has given SOOOOO much opportunity for extra credit! I think I'm going to be able to raise to grade to an A! But for real she is super sweet and she does care. You have to study. Do everything she gives you PLUS do your own studying. You cannot pass any chem class without studying.

The thermodynamics topic was insanely hard! She did NOT teach us stuff and questions that are asked on homework. This whole topic was not taught well AT ALL. Honestly I think that the topic should not even be taught in 103 and should be saved for 117. My grade and GPA is going to suffer because of this, and as a pre-med it SUCKS. I'm super upset.

I took this online during the pandemic. Yes, it was a lot of lengthy lectures and a lot of work, BUT! It was worth it. Ive learned a lot of information from professor Snaddon, especially information important for C117. All of the work isnt for nothing. The work did help. I always took book notes BEFORE lectures and took notes over the lectures.

During the pandemic this class was very difficult to take online. With countless assignments and lengthy lecture videos, it was hard to stay organized while jumping around through her canvas page. AI were difficult to understand during hw explanation videos. The class consumed most of my time to the point it became hard to study for other class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Shes a hilarious and amazing teacher. She gives so much extra credit.

I really grew to appreciate how much she cared about all of us succeeding. Yes she was blunt, but she gave us a ton of opportunity for extra credit, and during office hours (even when they were full) she spent time giving everyone help. I didn't take chemistry in hs, but was able to succeed in advanced levels of chem bc of her.

I love Professor Snaddon - she's incredibly caring and really enthusiastic about helping students succeed. The material was challenging at times, but there was always plenty of practice problems to do. I feel very ready for the next level of chemistry I have to take in preparation for physician assistant school. Great class.
She goes through the lectures really fast and does not give people the chance to write down the problems. And she also skips the problems she puts on the lecture slides.

she has a thick accent which can make it kind of hard to understand some things but overall shes a really good teacher. chem is just a hard subject for me and I kept a decent grade through the year. Even if you do bad on tests, as long as you go to discussion and lecture you will be fine bc of attendance points. & doing good on HW is easy points
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Snaddon was a really good professor. I would highly recommend reading the book before lecture because lecture can be confusing if you dont. There is a lot of extra credit, the final was EASY. If you read, go to discussion, and ask questions, and definitely do book problems you will do fine. Again, DO THE BOOK PROBLEMS!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Snaddon is nice and all, but I'll be honest, I learned more from my discussion AI. I suppose if you need a super supportive instructor she's good for that. She holds frequent office hours. There were so many extra credit opportunities. The lecture portion isn't too bad at all, its the labs that are tough. Prepares well for C117.

Snaddon always makes herself available for tons of office hours every week, especially before tests. She gives 5-10 EC points per test, 2 EC points for answering questions in lecture, 10 point EC pop quizzes. Have to practice a lot on your own, but she's always willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Sweetest lady ever

She is a quiet talker and also has an accent so it can be hard to hear at times if you do not sit towards the front. The example problems she gives in lecture are usually not all that helpful when it comes to completing the mastering chemistry homework problems. Quizzes given every 2 weeks in discussion section that were hard. Extra credit given!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amazingly sweet woman. LOTS of EC and seems to really care. She sometimes would say things were easy to make it seem more doable but it did the opposite. Class supposed to be a weed out for those good at chem to continue and those not and change major. Homework harder than exams. need many practice problems. if not continuing chem, take C101.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: You have to attend lecture or teaching the material yourself is very confusing. The class is doable but it is a lot of work. Do the multiple choice packets and all hw problems to study. She goes through lecture really fast and deletes the stuff she writes on the slide so thats frustrating but overall a decent professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her class was not too hard but she made me and everyone around me feel dumb, and would always say that everything was so simple, when it wasn't. She was very unfair with different things. The homework was doable, but so many lecture slides and she would skip most of them. You have to do the MC packets and the book questions to pass.
Amazing professor. Definitely takes a little time outside of class to do well but it's chemistry so what else do you expect
Shes a really good teacher but the course she teaches is just really hard.

Dr. Lee is very nice and means well, but her A100 class is extremely tedious. Readings each week are long, and you need to do them since there are seven pop quizzes throughout the semester. This class is also very left-wing biased, so be aware of that. I will say I love the structure of the class. Just one lecture and one discussion a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Enjoyable class, readings were somewhat lengthy but overall interesting. Dr. Lee is passionate in what she does, and held interesting discussions in class. She is also an easy grader if you have a decent understanding of the course materials. I would take another class of hers if possible!

Its not even that the work she gives is hard, its just that she SUCKS at grading. I haven't gotten a B since my sophomore year of high school and this was the first B I've gotten since then. The readings are usually ~40 pages, but you can honestly use AI to summarize it. She wasn't lenient at all with the midterm grades and the avg was a D/C.
Just read it, you'll be fine. She's a nice human, I had the honors discussion and I really appreciated it, I felt comfortable to talk in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVED Dr. Lee, she is so kind and genuinely cares for her students and wants them to succeed. There is a good amount of readings, but they are really interesting and don't take all that long. She does random pop quizzes so its important to do the readings. Overall, she is a great person and is super accessible!

Professor Lee is genuinely a nice person. She is very passionate about her work and it shows, but passion brings bias. The course is very politically sided. There is loads of reading, more than anyone can reasonable finish in a week. Assignments have strong prompts that make differing view points struggle. There is also a massive lack of grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I would NOT recommend anyone to take AMST-A 100 with Dr. Lee. Find another course to fulfill your requirement! If you do not like reading I suggest you skip past this course. Articles are long, boring, and pop quizzes are only a couple points. Lecture and discussions are a waste of time. Midterm and Final consists of silly essays, no feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is very passionate about what she teaches and it shows in her lectures. She encourages students to speak up and engage with the material. If you do the readings, participate in class, and submit the assigned work, you will have no problem passing. A201 convinced me to get an American Studies minor, if that tells you anything.

Professor Sonia Lee is a top class educator. This is not a course for students who waste their time and money by checking out during class. It is a course for those who want to THINK about identity, society, and positionality. Lee makes this accessible and downright fun. Reading heavy, but it's compelling. Participation is emphasized. RECOMMEND.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Assignments for this class are time consuming and a waste of time. Very political and grading can be tough if you do not follow exactly what she wants in the rubric. I would take something else for the diversity in US credit.

I hate to give bad reviews of professors, however, Dr. Lee was all over the place. She is very opinionated and if you do not think the way she does about certain issues, the class will be almost impossible for you, so much for college allowing you to think on your own. So much useless readings, tough assignment, and boring topics for the essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Can't believe that Dr. Lee was not on Rate My Professor. She is one of those rare professors who isn't just a professor, but an EDUCATOR. She cares so much about her students and is invested in their personal intellectual development. I would really recommend her course LATS-L 250, it's easy yet still academically stimulating. Discussion-heavy.

This class is not as bad as people make it seem, it's just boring. Sonita is a very sweet lady, but she tends to just read from her notes. Her tests will be difficult if you don't study, but the study guides she provides cover the materials on the exams. I can't really say what the purpose of this course is with confidence, but it's not bad.

She is a sweet and knowledgeable teacher, always seemed happy to answer questions after lectures. Her tests are difficult though, but as long as you put in the work they're manageable. The hardest part is studying, she provides a study guide but makes it very clear that the study guide does not cover everything, which it doesn't.

Sonita is a very kind lady, but her exams are difficult because they require you to know a lot of information only to be tested on random specific things.Her study guides do actually cover what is on the exam just make sure you go in depth with your studying. Other than that, her class is easy and light work cuz you kinda just sit around during lec

This is probably the worst professor I have ever had. It's pointless for studying for exams because nothing on the exams was ever taught and if it was it was stated very briefly and not in the lecture slides. She was not helpful when asked questions through email and provided a lot of useless information that I don't know when I would ever use.

Overall the class was pretty simple and basic information. Didn't find it useful for future Nursing unless you interested in pediatrics. Its almost impossible to study for the Exams and overall many students don't. The information on the study guide compared to the exam is not related. Information on the Exam is often not taught or provided.

She is great! Very clear grading expectations, and lots of interesting discussion topics. My only complaint was the amount of writing every week expected was a bit excessive, especially since she groups readings by topics I felt I was writing similar paragraphs repeatedly. However the class and professor were great, definitely take her

She was one of the best teachers I've had. She encouraged students by complimenting their work frequently and leading interesting discussions. negative reviews may be because some students didn't listen, while others engaged in her discussions frequently and thus got a better understanding of her coursework and got more enjoyment from the class

There seemed to be a lot of work several readings however they usually only took an hour and were usually interesting. great teacher everyone loves him. doesn't do tests or quizzes just grades on attendance and homework.

One of the best profs ever! He is so funny and extremely intelligent. He truly knows how to make a classroom feel like a safe space for everyone. I hope to take another class with him in the future.
One of the best professors I have had !!! So so so sweet and kind, I always enjoyed coming to class and learning !! He is the nicest man - love him!! 1000% recommend

Beidy is the best professor I have had at IU!! You just have to go to most of the classes and talk to him and discuss in class so he knows who you are and then you will automatically get an A!! Nicest, sweetest professor you could ask for and easy A if you show up

Want an easy A with one of the most sincere and kindest professors? Here's the class! If you need to fulfill a language requirement this is the best class, no textbook required and he works at a very reasonable pace. This class always fills me with happiness and joy because Beidy's so great!

Professor Cho is amazing! His demeanor is so nice, and he truly cares about his students. If you can, take any class with Cho. He is great! He gives you materials to help you prepare for tests and actually takes student's feedback

A great professor in every regard. His lectures are to die for and he explains everything so clearly that you will never forget the concepts again. A great introductory machine learning class and i would love to see him teach a theoretical ML class. Highly recommended !!

90% of what I know in Machine Learning is from him. the greatest professor. His class is engaging to both beginners and students who have previous knowledge. His explanation of concepts are the best. In short, learning under him makes more sense of Machine Learning.

he explain very difficult concept in machine learning in an easily understandable manner. Difficulty of the assignments are reasonable, not to hard too make you cry, not too easy either. overall a good prof.

Professor Sremanak was great! Her class was fin and she was really engaging in lectures. Put a decent amount of work into the class and you'll be golden

best a&h ive taken by far, super easy

professor suslak is awesome! he completely got me interested in anthropology, i was only taking an 8 weeks class (topics in anthropology, youth and adolesence). the class was easy overall, and he was so enthusiastic and really made sure everyone understood the material.
