Prof M is a great human. She definitely looks out for her students. The class is difficult and feels a little chaotic sometimes but overall Prof M will take care of you grade wise. If you study, your grade will reflect that. I often felt terrible after exams but when grades came back they reflected the difficulty of class and my effort.

Monaco was probably my favorite professor at Kelley, she really does care about each and every student she has. Shes funny and will make time for you whenever you need it. She wants everyone to do well, and although her tests are challenging, her goal is to make you work, not trick you
This is the first time I came for a review so you get the idea, never seen a professor trying this hard to give students good grade

Lots of readings & can be confusing. Discussions & chatgpt helped me to grasp certain concepts. Hes super chill and easy to talk to. Explains the best he can and clarifies anything if u ask about it. Very easy class tbh only hard thing is the philosophers and understanding them. Exams were fairly easy if u understand the concepts.

explains concepts as best as he can with many analogies and metaphors to make what he's saying come across better. lots of reading per week, but if you're able to make sense of the concepts in the course you'll be okay. also thought his lectures were entertaining. good guy

I'm Pre-Med and took P141 for my ethics credit. Take another class with a different professor if you are in the same/similar situation. No introduction, you jump right into the thick of philosophy...even though this is a 100 level class. I knew nothing about philo. before this class, and I still know absolutely nothing. Essays/assignments are HARD.
This guy is super boring and his grading is extremely harsh. If you value your GPA don't take. However, he is a very nice guy who cares about his students.

the most boring professor I have ever had. you do three papers and the last one comes with a 30 minute oral exam which is really just a 30 minute long interrogation about ur paper on zoom. also he is super blunt like scary tbh
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I wish I would have seen the ratings of this professor before I took this class. His lectures are extremely boring. I knew nothing about philosophy coming into this class and did not enjoy learning about it. If you genuinely enjoy philosophy and can handle very boring lectures, then this professor is for you. "No pencil" for the final exam is silly
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Sussman is a great professor and very knowledgeable on 19th century and Kantian philosophy. Use his office hours and ask questions. While he does go off on tangents, this is where you find interesting examples and metaphors that help explain difficult concepts. Big advice: take notes on everything during the lecture if new to philosophy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Took this class for GenEd and I wish I had dropped it in the first week. Boring lecturer and boring class. The professor is just OK at the very best, and thinks everyone comprehends philosophy the same way he does. Get ready to have your essays *ripped apart* by the TA too. Provides vague material, but wants highly specific responses.
Beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pretentious. He and his TA's think that philosophy is common knowledge...even in an introductory class. Explains the course material...kinda. Talks in analogies that only make sense to those with previous knowledge of philosophy. EXTREMELY blunt, bordering rude at times. Would not take a class with him again or recommend him to others.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I found the lectures to be boring at times but I have a short attention span. This classes grades are pretty much all essays but he allows you to do re-writes and he is a fair grader. He was very responsive to emails and met with me outside of office hours to answer questions. If you put in the work, you'll get the grade you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: David Sussman is an absolutely amazing person and professor. He really cares about his students and makes his lectures personable and fun to be in. Although he does go on rants A LOT and takes a long time to get through his material, he makes sure to keep you updated on the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you love all things philosophy, Sussman is your guy. If you really pay attention to what he says, and actively engage with the content, you will learn a ton. Papers make up most of your grade. Try to engage with the material in class, it's super insightful and will open your perspective up. He's awkward but in a good way, and he's super nice

This professor has no understanding of the course itself. She constantly talks in circles and clearly has no idea how to teach. She is such a nice person but she clearly has no idea how to teach or communicate. When asked if she could provide practice questions based on previous quizzes she went to say she couldn't for unknown reasons for 35 mins.

Her quizzes never matched up with the review slides she'll give you from the class prior. She lacks empathy for her students and I once heard her tell a student "that's too bad" when he expressed his confusion with an assignment due to her very vague instructions. She would make students feel bad about small mistakes they made and had a smart mouth

Professor White was very kind and the class was interesting. She has a lot of experience in the industry and a lot of good insights on what its like to create an apparel brand. The class was super easy and I feel like I learned a lot.
Super nice professor and knows how to teach in the small lecture lab. Super slow at explaining things and makes sure you understand it.

I would definitely recommend this professor for helping you through K201. Learning Microsoft Access and Excel for the first time can be really intimidating, but Professor Sweeny broke everything down and made the information digestible. She is also very caring and understanding if you ever need help.

I gave this class an average for difficulty not because of the professor but just because it's a lot of work. It's easy, just a lot. Overall, Professor Sweeny was amazing, and she cares a lot for her students.

Super sweet and caring professor! I skipped class a lot and was fine, you can catch up if you do the textbook work outside of class. K201 is not a hard class, just try and go to class and not get behind.
always going off track

Professor Sweeny is super kind and an awesome teacher to have for K-201. Class is normally going over a couple practice problems over a topic. K-201 takes some effort to get a good grade, but doing the textbooks topic intros, and reviews, as well as attending class, doing the projects and practice test will provide a great understanding for exams.

She honestly is probably the best teacher you could get for K201. She's understanding if you cannot attend class, and is genuinely such a sweet and helpful teacher! If you attend class and actually try the assignments given, you'll be able to understand the exams and hopefully end with an A. I'm overall grateful that I got her as my K201 teacher.

Highly recommend Prof. Sweeny! By far one of the sweetest and most genuine professors I have had! Some of the topics in the class are challenging, but she has great way of explaining. No attendance based lab checks (hers were really easy 5 question quizzes about rating the test, how you studied, and getting feedback).

A great course to really give you an intro into the tech aspect of finance. This class is hard but Professor Sweeny made it way more tolerable and understandable. She is also a very funny person who genuinely cares about her students. I would easily take her class again and I wish she taught K-303.
She is absolutely amazing and thoroughly enjoys what she teaches. Very approachable and always willing to help. Will miss this class!

Best K201 professor you could have! No required lab checks and reading the textbook before lab was completely optional. She has a great way of explaining things, knows the material really well, and has office hours A LOT. She will work with you as long as you need! I never thought I'd say this but I'll miss K201 and having such a sweet professor.
Very helpful, and makes the class pretty easy as long as you go to lectures.

She's a great professor and genuinely cares about you. She explains each chapter so well and provides many resources for studying.  If you do the discoveries before class, attend the lecture, and then the reviews after class, you will finish with an A. She doesn't take attendance, but if you go to lectures, you'll be happy after each exam.

such a nice and helpful person. she is very soft spoken and genuinely wants to see her students succeed. taught my lab class and explains everything in a easy way. definitely take her if you can. she loves making jokes and is always in a happy mood. great teacher
One of the nicest professors I've ever had.

Prof. Sweeny is the best for K201. She makes a very hard class easy to understand and truly cares about her students. Will be very accommodating with issues if you tell her ahead of time. Worlds better than any other professor.

LOVE Prof Sweeny. K201 is a tough course no matter who you take it with but she truly cares about her students and is always willing to help. She gives extra practice, discoveries/reviews aren't mandatory, and she goes through how to work through and what topics to focus heavily on so she really focuses on the basics and important topics for exams.

Great profesor to have if you are not familiar with Microsoft. Professor Sweeny is very patient and good at breaking down the material. Attendance is not mandatory. Willing to stay after class to help you on lessons or graded projects.

Sweeny was very nice and understanding of students. K201 is a course that you either understand or dont, but you will only get it if you go to class. Sweeny did very well at teaching the concepts clearly and if you needed any extra help, she was happy to be there. She loves what she does and wants you to love it too.
If all the good professors are taken and you see Karen's name for fall sem, take this class during the spring instead

Professor Sweeny is awesome. Coming into K201, you hear a lot about how difficult the course is which can be intimidating, but Professor Sweeny does a great job of connecting with her students through her "lectures". If I were to take K201 again, I would take Sweeny's class 100/100 times. Great professor, better person.

K201 can be a tough class, but I think she does a good job teaching it. She gives additional resources for students to prepare and practice for the exams, and you can tell she enjoys the work that she does. As long as you attend class sessions and grind out the GPs, you will end with a decent score. Take advantage of the practice material!

Professor Sweeny is a great professor. If you can take her for k201 take it. It's a hard class but she makes it a lot easier than other professors. She will stop and answer any questions and is willing to meet outside of class to help.
Take this class with her. She is so sweet and easy to talk to. She really wants you to do well.

Highly recommend taking Karen's K201 class!! She is super caring and tells you good information. She doesnt care if you are on your phone in class and is always willing to help with homework questions!! No in-person lab checks - only mastery quizzes.

not sure why there are any negative reviews about her. K201 itself can be challenging, but Karen is a genuinely caring professor. She understands that the material is tough and makes herself easily available to help students who are struggling. Her calm demeanor/ soothing teaching style makes K201 much less intimidating. I definitely recommend her!

Great Professor, will take time after class to help you, explains concepts clearly during lectures and uses examples well without going too off track with her life. You have to study for this class regardless of the Professor, just smth to keep in mind :)
We don't get enough credit for taking the bullet by being in her class and saving you. If you got her class cause all the good teachers were taken I feel bad for you son.
That's why her name is Karen.

TAKE HER AND ONLY HER FOR K201! I was so scared about this class, I talked to her the first day of class that I am not at all good with computers. She told me: Try to practice K201 every day and that actually works. Her classes are so much fun, she makes everything easy to understand. GO to her Office hours- really helpful they are. Favorite class!

Professor Sweeny is a great professor. She tries to make the content as easy to digest as possible. Her thorough, step-by-step walk-through of the material was very helpful and she tries her best to ensure that her students get an A. Overall, I would strongly recommend taking K201 with her.

I absolutely love this professor. She is so kind and really cares about student success. My advice is to be sure to complete the recommended homework (the discoveries and review section of the textbook). If you do the recommended homework, the class is really not too difficult to follow.
K201 isn't really hard, and Professor Sweeny makes life so much easier. Just go to class and study and you will be fine.
Professor Sweeney was always available to ask questions to and help with whatever you needed. K201 was not too difficult but she makes it easier to understand, use her as a resource!!!!
Profesor Sweeny is extremely caring and makes a dreadful class fun and interesting.

Super nice professor, you can tell she cares about the course she teaches and the students who attend. K201 is notoriously hard, so make sure to attend classes. Outside of the teacher, you can attend KCove, but I highly recommend getting a group of friends together to compare answers and help each other out.
K201 itself is a hard class but the way she teaches and cares for her students makes the class much more easier to pass and to get through and she is much more understanding as a teacher.

Professor Sweeny made what appeared to be a tough class understandable and enjoyable. You can tell she really cares about her students and wants you to succeed. As compared to some teachers her lab checks are easy. She is really accommodating if you need something.

K201 is a hard class by itself but Professor Sweeny makes a great job at explaining topics way better than other teachers. Access is the hardest part of the class but if you put in the work and effort you will get a good grade. Her class averages 7% higher than other professors for this exam.  She is an awesome teacher

She is super nice and understanding. Always willing to help a student and tries her best to make the information clear. Graded projects are the hardest part about this class, but she is very willing to help both inside and outside of class.

K201 is a difficult class but professor sweeny will make sure that you understand what you need to do in order to get a good grade in the class, make sure to attend her lab classes as they will help you the most to remember what needs to be done for homework and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love her. Will take the time to know your name and personality. Good teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Karen is so great I loved having her for K201. The class is hard but thats the same with any teacher, and Karen was always available outside of class to help. Shes super patient and understanding, and genuinely wants everyone to do well. She gives you extra study resources and prepares you very well for tests by letting you know what to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Karen was so helpful with homework and exams. She led step by step and the exam was exactly like the sample questions but just change a few words. She offered a lot of help outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Karen's super kind and helpful. This class requires that you put in the work, but she's there to help you along the way. Definitely would recommend taking this class with her.

While Karen is nice and moves at a slower pace, I think she sometimes forgets to cover topics or mention why certain actions are important. K201 is separated into Access and Excel, but I only took Access with her before I dropped. Her teaching style is very dependent on you completing the activities outside of class and coming in for verification.

Karen is great and really easy to learn from. The material in K201 is difficult, but if you are confused and ask questions she helps so much. I came in before class several times with questions. While attendance is not mandatory, it is crucial to attend so you can understand the material.

Homework is no correlation to the class material. It usually spends you 10 hours to finish one project if you don't come to her office hour, and her office hour is from 8-9 am far from your dorm. It means you need to get up on 7am and transfer one bus to get to there. She doesn't give partal score at all, one small mistake will make project get a B

What sets Professor Sweeny apart from the other K201 professors is that she REALLY cares. The class can and will be challenging if you don't put in the time, but that is by no means Professor Sweeny's fault. She does all she can to help you succeed and is the nicest lady in the world - always ready to answer any question you have.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Pretty funny in class. Some people are bagging on her for their bad grade, but that is more because the course itself is hard, and that a lot of it is out of her control. She really does try her best to teach the material and prepare you for the exams. If you are taking K201, be ready to work, each professor has the same overall amount of work.
Such a sweet and helpful woman. She really wants her students to succeed and is always available for help. Would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Took her last semester, it was rough. The grade distribution looks good until you see that 1/3 of the class dropped with a W after the midterm. she dosen't give partial credit on anything so it's impossible to do well on anything unless you knew a lot of coding already.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Assigned homework assignments that took 20+ hours to complete and had nothing to do with what we learned in class. Will not listen to questions about your grade. Goes too fast and seems to have no idea if students are understanding or not. I wish someone had warned me. Run
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Look, K201 is going to suck no matter who you take it with. Karen Sweeny is incredibly kind and caring, but she gets distracted easily. I would recommend her, but there are definitely better teachers

You really don't see her that much because it is a lab. She was a fine professor, but her lectures were honestly pointless because it's a lab class. The lab was honestly pretty easy if you just turn your work in and go to lab.

Spencer is really not that bad. The class can be time consuming and tedious, but she is probably deserving of a slightly better review. The lectures have some important material but not a lot, and the post labs can take a long time. Just spend the time doing your work, prepare for lab and you'll be fine

You don't really interact with her, it wasn't too hard but busy work I'll say. The ratings are very over dramatic, there are a lot of AI hours so if it's not being taken advantage of, then it's your fault. Lectures were boring I studied or played Roblox. The formal lab report was kinda fun, it was a good brain buster.

I don't believe that 127 should be so time consuming. I average more time a week for 127 than I do for organic chemistry and molecular biology combined. All lab procedures are required to be handwritten which is completely unnecessary, lectures are pointless, and post labs take hours without using AI, although I'm sure 90% of the class does.

She was fine. She would explain the science behind the experiments instead of telling us how to complete it, and the post-lab assignments had questions way out of left field that required a level of understanding that requires way more time than college students have, but for the msot part its doable.

Meh. She was alright just not the most exciting class in the world. She can be a little weird sometimes and hit or miss with her attitude but she's not that bad. There are definitely some more deserving 1.7s but maybe shes gotten worse or was really bad in the past.

Her lectures are simple and easy to understand. The class should definitely be worth more credits, as it takes the same amount of time every week as 117. Other than that, if you put in effort and don't expect to be handed everything on a silver platter, this class will go fine for you. 
SHE IS NOT A BAD PROFESSOR.

I didn't attend all the lectures, but the ratings for her on here are mostly undeserved. For C127 you don't really need to attend the lectures, but they do offer some clarity for some of the more confusing labs. The lectures are long and often early, but not unbearable. Just make sure to do the Labflow homework and read the prelabs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class itself was fairly easy, and it was possible to earn a good grade, however, the labs were stressful and time-consuming. The professor often came across as unapproachable and condescending, which made the experience less enjoyable despite manageable coursework.

The labs are always extremely frustrating they are often difficult to understand without having a lot of help from your TA. They never went smooth there was always some issue. There are 5 “skills assignments” which is busy work that takes sometimes up to three hours.

The lecture is pointless and is info you will read either way. Tedious labs and busy work outside of class. Too much time spent outside of class for a 2-credit class. Your AI is extremely important and could screw you over, but most are nice and willing to help. Spencer is a nice woman for the most part and will help if you have any questions.

Actually the worst lectures of any class in the history of education. Don't waste your time listening to this nonsense. Do NOT miss lecture because it is worth way too much of your grade. Pray that you have a good AI for your lab otherwise it's genuinely over. Don't talk to prof. Spencer it's not worth it.

This is by far the worst class I have taken at IU. Unnecessarily hard. Took Bio lab at the same time and it was a breeze in comparison. There is no room for mistakes in this course. Two major reports you need to complete too. So much busy work. Post labs were the end of me. 0/10
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lectures are completely useless, the professor poorly and vaguely explains the lab procedure for next week and didn't even give useful advice for our first lab report. Typos in every online document or assignment which are years old and would be easy to fix. I also don't know what she does besides lectures, TAs do everything from what I can tell.

Not nearly as bad as people make her out to be, but was still sometimes a bit passive-aggressive or dry. Seemed to actually care about the students and wanted to see them succeed, did not prep very well for labs but at least the lectures were informative. If you stay on top of your work, anyone can get an A or B here

CHEM-C 127 was not an extremely difficult course. The workload is on the heavier side (mainly Post Lab assignments). Professor Spencer was hostile at times, and her weekly, attendance-mandatory lectures were pointless. I rarely interacted with Professor Spencer, but when I did, it was never pleasant. If you are a good student, you will do fine.

Professor Spencer, and the class in general, are just super annoying. There is no reason to have a lecture to explain the lab if all the information is in the procedure. She spends more time slurping down her Diet Dr.Pepper and talking about her kids than explaining anything useful. The lab UTIN numerous times told me incorrect information.

Be prepared...her mood depends on the crispiness of her Dr.Pepper that morning. Her lectures are so boring that you will become a master at looking busy when you're not even paying attention. Her attitude when corrected is like a kindergartner before their nap. But hey, Deborah is the AI for you. If you get her, you're lucky.

This class was so useless. It would've been better with a horse as the prof. The slideshows she shows are so unnecessary and do not help anyone understand the labs any better. Be cautious when using AI throughout this course as well. If you don't have to take her, DON'T! I loved my AI, though, if you have a chance to choose, pick Deborah!

Do NOT take this class with her unless you have to, this class is so useless. She will take attendance right when class starts and won't count you present even if you were 2 minutes late. She is probably the worst professor I've ever had. My AI Deborah was AMAZING though; she was the reason I did good in this class.

I don't understand why the rating is so low. Dr. Spencer is a caring Professor who wants to help students and lectures were alright. Only thing is, the lectures were super early in the morning and there was a TopHat for attendance.

She just reads off the slides and explains what the next lab is going to be about, yet it is also explained online. 127 lectures are completely pointless, yet attendance is mandatory. Also got mad at some people for having laptops out during lecture one time (??)
Labs were not too difficult but they involved a lot of unnecessary work which made them take longer than they should have. Lectures are unhelpful and not necessary to understand the lab.

Really rude to students, lectures are bad, they are required, but completely unhelpful, and lab handouts make zero sense. There was one lecture in particular where she was yelling at everyone about being inconsiderate and how people are rude, using their computers, and missing class. But she was actually just yelling at the ones that showed up.

Avoid this professor at all costs.HAND WRITE EVERY SINGLE WORD for lab procedure when can just print it out.tiny misunderstanding with the formal lab report, but she insisted on reporting it to the school. dropped from A+ to C+,  Worst studying experience and worst professor I've ever met and worst people alive i've met too.

This professor does not know how to format post lab assignments and makes them the most meticulous assignment that take hours to do. The lecture is required even though there is no educational benefit to them and they do not help in any way shape or form with the lab. The only redeemable part of this class was my AI who was willing to help.

Maybe the worst prof I've ever had? She was incredibly rude and yelled at students multiple times for having computers out just to take notes? Extremely condescending every day. AI is mainly in charge of grading and if you luck out it will be fine as long as you do every assignment. Attendance is "necessary" but it won't matter if you don't go.

The teacher frequently displays rude and dismissive behavior toward students, particularly during morning classes. Students have reported that the teacher often appears irritated or impatient, which creates a tense and uncomfortable classroom environment. This behavior negatively affects students' confidence and willingness to participate.

She is so disrespectful to students and very unhelpful for any questions you may have. She's literally got mad at our class for people going to the bathroom and having their computers out, like what? The lecture is useless anyway, as all the information needed is in the lab protocol and she just repeats the information straight from the protocol.

This class isn't quite as bad as people make it out to seem. Your grade is highly dependent on your lab ai and how strict of a grader they are. My biggest complaint is that this class involves WAY too much work for a 2 credit class. Lecture is extremely borning and the labs often seem pointless. The professor often seems annoyed when lecturing.

I genuinely feel ill any time I even think about this class. Incredibly stressful for an introductory 2 credit course. The lab manuals are extremely convoluted and make 0 sense, and the homework costs like $50 to access. I'm not sure if any of this is really Spencer's fault but you don't really ever talk to her (she was nice the one time I did).

The class itself isn't super hard, but your grade is entirely dependent on your AI. Spencer is honestly pretty rude and has a major ego problem, but just put in headphones during her lectures - you won't miss anything useful.

Attendance is mandatory and is maybe the least useful thing ever, most people leave after attendance is taken. First lecture I was present but mistook the attendance for the top hat join code. When I went to tell her after she said that she would not mark me present as I missed the tophat. Unbelievable amount of work for a 2 credit class. Terrible.

Extremely easy class but awful professor and AI. Lectures are useless but attendance is required. Lab AI doesn't know how to do anything, gives us the wrong answers, and mislabels bottles in lab; the only helpful person was the UTIN. The rubrics for the lab report contradict each other and assignments on Canvas contradict what she says in lecture.

Lecture is early morning and completely useless. Could send everything in a short email. She's boring and acts like common sense material is groundbreaking information. Attendance is required, but if you show up even 5 minutes late, you won't get credit. If you have the opportunity to take this class with anyone else, do it.

She was incredibly rude the one time I asked her a simple question. The class is extremely easy, but she will do everything she can to make the class feel harder than it is. She gets mad and will have outbursts in class if attendance is too low or someone leaves during the lecture. I have never had a professor this terrible in my 3 years of college

Prof Spencer is lowkey mean and makes you scared to ask questions. Don't worry about her terrible rating, you won't deal with her much just get to lecture and do attendance. Don't even listen to the lab lecture it's not worth ur time just do other work. Your grade will depend entirely on your AI, pray you get a good one (most are super chill tho).

Professor Spencer is not very nice and is very boring. The lectures are early in the morning and not even worth listening to. The post-labs are graded very hard and they just throw you in the water and make you do an unnecessary amount of work. Do not recommend.

Lectures are mandatory and are usually early in the morning, but what she teaches is usually useless as all the information can be found online. She also discusses the next week's lab which most students will forget about by the time it comes around. Actual labs were fine, its just her lectures were not good.

Terrible professor. Lecture attendance is 5% of the grade. If they weren't worth anything no one would show up. (I had 5/13 and got an A). Completely useless. Grade in class however is completely based on your AI (mine was AMAZING), so don't worry too much about her bad rating she doesn't actually do much its mostly the lab specific AI or head AI.

She can be pretty nasty/rude at times. Your grade entirely depends on your AI. I was lucky and my AI was a very easy grader.I know others were not. Wants you to use inscribe but 95% of the time she just responds go to office hours, defeating the entire point of the program.She would get mad at side convos in class and pause until no more talking.

Unnecessary lectures as she doesn't actually grade any of the work, she just talks about the lab which you could just read about in the pre-lab work at home. Can be rude and makes you feel dumb for even asking a simple question. If you have a chill AI, you're in luck because they grade everything. Only worth 2 credits for the amount of work you do.

She genuinely forces every single student to go to lecture and often takes attendance on tophat one minute after class has started. I had her 8 am section and a lot of people roll in late, understandable - people live across campus and dont want to wake up at 6 for a useless lecture that teaches you nothing and puts you back to sleep.

Get ready for busy work upon more busy work. Also make sure you know how to use excel since all of the experiments require it and provide 0 explanation on how to do things. This class genuinely makes me more miserable then C117. Also her lectures are beyond useless and provide no real value, yet she requires attendance. Pray you get a good TA.
Lectures were pointless, boring and long. I don't find the need in having a lecture for this lab. Her voice makes me wanna listen to music. The ai's are not helpful. Not a difficult class however.

The lectures for C127 were pointless and weren't helpful to the labs we were learning. Attendance was mandatory and taken by a geotracker on TopHat. However, I only attended like 6/15 lectures and was fine. 
You need to have a good AI for lab otherwise you wont know what to do and the AI's in office hours have no idea what theyre doing.
I think that sometimes she can be harsh, but overall she's a pretty decent professor. The worst part of this class was the geotracking top hat attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible professor. Lab lectures were mandatory and completely useless. Did not explain how to do the post labs, so all of them ended up taking hours to complete while you figure out how to do everything on your own. If you have a good TA, you'll be fine but good luck if not. Waste of my tuition.
If you have a good AI, you'll be fine but prof spencer's lectures are entirely useless. haven't needed them once all semester yet attendance is still mandatory.

When I asked for help or clarification she seemed annoyed and didn't give clear answers. The lectures seem pointless and unorganized. Prof Sweeny is probably one of the best K201 professors at IU. The course material is by no means easy and there is so much to cover in so little time. Sweeny dumbs all the concepts down, making them easier to understand and process. Make sure to go to class because if you miss one lecture you will be behind. He is very accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Sweeny is a great choice for K201. His lectures go a bit fast, but he and the peer tutors were always very helpful whenever I got stuck. The class is very straightforward, so as long as you show up and pay attention you should pass.

Most laid back K201 prof. K201 in general is hard af but he makes Lab manageable. Sit in the front and he'll help you + he talks w/ the TAs a lot abt upcoming assignments and stuff. I always felt prepared for exams and quizzes, but if you skip class ur screwed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Adam is a GREAT professor who really cares about his students and you can definitely tell. He is very direct and honest with what you need to know vs what you don't. He's clear when teaching the lessons and reviews often. I honestly don't see an excuse why you wouldn't at least get an 80%. He's available during office hours & always there to help!

Sweeny is an amazing instructor who really cares about his students and their performance in the class. His recorded lectures are very easy to follow along with and he is more than willing to go over any material again during synchronous portions of the class. Would definitely recommend.
HE IS AWESOME
Adam makes K201 a much more manageable class. He explains all of the concepts clearly and concisely. Would definitely recommend him to any future K201 student

Adam is the BEST K201 teacher! He makes a widely feared class much better on students. He lessens the work and makes sure that you are getting the best grade in the class AS LONG AS you are putting in the work outside of class. Office hours are the KEY to passing this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor, no in-class quiz when I took it. It was easy to get a great grade if you listen carefully in lecture.

Swank is a great lecturer and poses very interesting points for discussion among the class. Fairly easy course, but great intro to US law. Some case briefs (short ish papers), two exams (straight shooters if you study you'll be fine), and attendance is taken. Overall, great instructor and was really intrigued by and enjoyed this class.

Prof. Swank is one of the best professors that I have had on campus at IU. Be sure to come to class having read the reading, as large parts of the class period are often dedicated to discussion about the readings. They are fairly easy to complete and quite entertaining as many of them are real case documents and not busy work.

Prof Swank is very kind and a good teacher. I had to drop because I failed the exams which were way harder than I expected. I would recommend him as a professor but his exams are very difficult especially for a 100 level class.

Swank was a great professor and ran a pretty easy class. As long as you show up, do your work, and chime in every once in and while you should be fine. You really don't need to read, what you need to know for the test he will go over in class. He was pretty engaging and answered all of my questions.

Professor Swank was very attentive and caring about the class that he constructed. He did a great job at boiling down the topic to the basics, and the exams were not too hard. He was sure to make the topics understandable and relevant to real-world events. He worked around his personal schedule to be available outside of his set office hours.

He does a good job at boiling down the the fundamentals of American law in line with the Law 101 book. He dedicates periods to exam prep / Q&A and does not lay material on too thick. He uses relevant real-world examples and will keep you engaged and interested.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Swank is a really great professor. Took him for law and public affairs at 8 in the morning and he was able to keep the class awake and participating. His lectures are fun and there is always open debate. He is very clear about what you need to know and a very effective professor. Received an A!

At first, I thought this class would be difficult, but there are no surprises and he completely preps you for exams/case briefs. Good at answering questions and super helpful. You should participate. Lots of readings and sometimes pop quizzes over them. He likes to converse with the class and overall a nice guy. Would take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES! Rush is fine, he grades kind of tough, couldn't get above a B for any of the projects. The workload you have to do is absolutely horrendous, especially since its art and you need inspiration. Easily 15 hours of outside work per week, PER WEEK, EVERY WEEK. Only take this if you absolutely need to
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Grades very harshly and doesn't give much constructive feedback. Makes it difficult to improve because points just seemed to be taken off sporadically.

Rush lives up to his name. He teaches class like he's constantly running out of time. Sometimes comes to class extremely unprepared, he forgets how to do something and spend the rest of the session struggling to get things to work. Information is thrown at you rapidly in a way that leaves you more confused than when you started.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Rush has a certain reputation at IU. He's a smart guy and knows his stuff (sometimes), but it's very difficult to get him to acknowledge you outside of class. He is a tough grader, but I do believe he wants to see you get better. He is very brutal with his criticism and I went months before he said something overtly positive about my progress.
Great teacher who knows his stuff. A fairly tough grader but if you ask him for any advice/critiques, he will inform you of what you need to know. Solid dude, solid classes.
Just a super dope dude all around, no big oofs to worry about, just don't show up cross faded or you will catch a big L yeet!

I hate spanish but she Profe Swann made it bearable. She actually cares about her students' wellbeing and wanted us to learn. She's so good she made me consider minoring in spanish (even though I hate spanish lol).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Swann is a top-tier professor! She teaches the material so well and doesn't expect you to learn everything on your own. She is understanding and will work with you if you're having trouble in the class, and really just wants her students to succeed. She's super kind and caring, so if you get a chance to take a class with her, take it!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Profe Swann is awesome. She's cool and chill. Most of your grade is participation and you need to go to lecture. Overall the course is really easy. All exams and quizzes are taken online at home. There is only one speaking exam and it is with a group.

I took OS and Networking before this class and I feel like I've learned very little. I did the least amount of work I could do and somehow I have an A, which shocks me. I was super excited to take the class, but the ugly looking power point presentations and the professors melancholic voice have entirely turned me away from distributed systems.

E318 is a good class about networking. Early assignments are in C; as the semester progresses, you can pick between C or Python. I didn't know C and I got by with a lot of Google. Swany is a fine lecturer but is competely inaccessible outside of class. No office hours and he doesn't respond to emails. Your only resource will be the TAs.

This isn't a class you should go into without at least reading up on related material (Operating Systems: A Xinu Approach... also Operating Systems in Three Easy Pieces). The undergraduate and graduate sections are identical and on the same scale as of spring 2022. 

This is the hardest undergraduate CS class offered at IU.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Advanced Operating System. It is not as hard as students usually thought. The assignments are graded by autograder, one assignment per week. However, you need to catch up with the lectures, since the following assignments are based on their previous ones. If you really struggling with C, you need to spend time on it. Do not copy code from internet.

Horrible. Assignments are only very loosely coupled to lectures. In lecture, he rambles over slides that are stuffed full of information and will just slide change whenever. Test has barely anything to do with assignments. No way to check understanding. Avoid this class like the plague

Straightforward course, but the lectures are a bit dry. Most of the grade comes from Labs. Lab assignments are posted 12 days before the due date, so make sure to start early and go to office hours or lab sessions if you need help. AIs were incredibly helpful in this course. Lectures are recorded and slides are posted on Canvas.
Easily the most awful teacher/professor I have seen in my whole life.
Swany did not do too much for the class besides the lectures. All my questions were mainly answered by TA's. That being said, I learned a lot in E201 and I am a much better programmer now.

Dr. Swany knows what he's talking about. His understanding of all the topics covered was really deep and that maybe one of the reason why it is hard for him to present this information better. In my opinion, slides with loads of text is not an efficient means to convey the depth of what he covers. Assignments and discussions are helpful.

Swany's pop quizzes are really something. He somehow thinks giving a minute for a question without warning you is a fair assessment. That being said, his grading curves everything nicely by the end. Lectures are uninteresting and largely do not correlate with homework material. He clearly put a lot on the struggling TAs to pull the class together.

You can tell he cares just maybe not through the teaching medium. Overall he's fine, you show up hw, talks with slides for an hour, and then you leave. Hw in the beginning was tough but it mellowed out. If you need help your best bet is the AI's. Exams are hit or miss, no clear grading criteria, maybe just get lucky in what you choose to study.

Just here to tear this professor a new one, as I struggle through a project that he provided 0 guidance for. This class never ends, not even after the exam. The class started fine, but it's just gotten more and more infuriating as the semester has dragged on.

Swany is definitely someone who gets his salary more for research rather than teaching. He's knowledgeable enough, but it's pretty clear that he spends way more time making the university money via research grants than actually preparing for the class. There aren't enough characters left to explain how frustrating it is to deal with this man.

Seems like he doesn't have time to teach the class; by the midterm we had 0 assignments/quizzes graded, he cancels discussions the day of, sometimes cancels the lecture and tells you to watch online pre-recorded videos. Doesn't hold regular office hours and he and the UIs are hard to get in touch with. Boring lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: First and foremost, this class is HARD. The good news is that he warns you from the very beginning that this isn't for the faint of heart, but if your reading this, I'll assume this class is mandatory for you, so you can't drop your pack even if you wanted too. This class is like a battlefield so grab a buddy fast, make a friend, and do it together
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's a great professor. He seems to care that we understand the material he is trying to teach.
Full of Information its up to you to extract it
He made the Operating System class a joke, reads form slides with no proper explanation. I have never seen him in the whole semester, used to teach through video conferencing.
Does not teach ,Reads from slides .. course content is not that great . Too much theory in a course that is supposed to be Project based.

The professor seems friendly, but the course (P536) is nothing but a joke to me. If you prefer the question "define and describe how to do addition" to that doing some actual addition in your exam, this course is your type.  But good luck anyway because the TA seem never know and never care about how to grade such questions in a correct way.

This is one of the best professors at IU. He is VERY clear if you actually pay attention, otherwise no. He answers questions when hands are raised. Otherwise, why would he explain if everyone supposedly gets it? His grading is slow, but overall he's good.

This professor is just useless. Assignments are always not clear. He himself is confused and never says clearly what is expected. Very disappointed with final grade. Gives all theoretical questions in midterm. Assignments are checked after a very long time. Class is boring.
Reads from the slides. Doesn't bother to explain unless someone asks a question. Knows his stuff. Interested more in research than teaching.
One of the better professors at IU. Always willing to answer questions before, during, or after the class.
Dr. Swany is very nice and knowledgeable. It is evident that he enjoys what he is doing.

Dr. Sweany is one of few professors that manages to make poetry fun. She looks at all possible interpretations of a poem and welcomes student perspectives. She also gives awesome feedback on graded papers. Class time is mainly a class discussion of the poems. Overall, the class was very enjoyable, but be prepared to read at least 8 poems per week!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Lots of pointless & "busy work" type assignments, 1-2 quizzes a week. Every week the due dates and syllabus dates changed. Not on top of grading or giving feedback, always rushed & not prepared for class. She was hands down the most disrespectful professor I have ever had. Rude and annoying, never take a class from her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Quite the incompetent Visiting Lecturer. Had to give up and drop the class. Only teacher that I've had in college that has gotten angry with me for asking questions. Highly disorganized and unprepared, assignments are unclear, unapproachable, very tedious tough grader that will nit pick your work. As others mentioned, you will likely not get an A

It's all writing reports, resumes, and memos, so pretty helpful for after college stuff. The teacher grades incredibly hard and inside a range: No one in our class got an A. She doesn't stay on topic, has called out students in class (unprofessional IMO), and usually isn't prepared for the class beforehand. Pop quizzed over readings each class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Be prepared to not get a good grade in her class. She gives out c's religiously and even when you hand in a draft of an assignment, and take the time to correct everything she says, she will make it a point of finding something else to dock you on. Worst professor I've ever had. If I could give a 0/5, that still wouldn't be low enough of a rating.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: While she might care about her students, she still fails at teaching. Her class isn't well organized nor are her assignments. She doesn't explain the assignments very well either. The instructional readings that she assigns aren't very helpful.

Hands down the worst teacher I have had at IU. She makes you read novels that she thinks are interesting (the last thing we read was about two aliens who eat their pet dog). She gives out all C's on papers and cusses during class. She loves pop quizzes and she never explains the books we read or the assignments that are due. Terrible teacher.

Without a doubt, the BEST professor I've ever had. Class is super interesting, especially when he gets students engaged in the discussion, which is fairly often. Has a great way of explaining complex topics, and is SO helpful when you don't understand something. Definitely take a class with him before you graduate!

Classes were boring as he droned on non-stop for 50 minutes. The information is useful and interesting but it's hard to pay attention when all he does is talk. Other than that he's pretty useful. Take really good notes and you should be okay.

without a doubt the best prof i've had so far. very knowledgeable about the material he's teaching, and his AI was extremely friendly and helpful. Attendance is mandatory, but there's never been a day I felt like skipping anyhow.

Fun teacher, very nice and friendly. When you get his syllabus before ever going to class you'd probably think he's a hardass, but he isn't. He just knows what he wants and expects it. As such he's a hard grader, but fun to listen to.
Good class and great prof!

Adam was a great professor! He goes the extra mile outside of class for you, as long as you do too. Go to office hours, email him, etc. and you will see this. He can explain one topic several different ways until you understand it! He is caring, kind, and funny. Exams were straightforward. Make sure to get help with the math early if you need it.

He takes the material slow and tries to make everything clear. His accent isnt thick enough to be hard to listen to but his handwriting made lectures difficult to follow sometimes. If you prioritize very engaging and easy to follow lectures I would not take his class, but he is very laid back, and you can always use the textbook

Very nice teacher. Provides insightful responses and answers to a lot of the questions posed by students. His grading can be bit picky, however, he offers chances for students to compensate sometimes. I highly encourage to visit him during office hours simply because its very interesting to have a chat with him.
Reads slides, no real learning.

Very funny and approachable guy but he beats around the bush all lecture long and never truly says much that pertains to  the material that will be on exams. Gives 6% extra credit for optional hw problems, straight forward concept based exams.
Good professor who keeps lecture interesting. However he doesn't finish example problems because he says the rest is just math.

Adam is amazing - he's funny, laid-back, and extremely fair about grading. Plus his accent is awesome. Homework every day, but exams are mostly take-home and there are only a couple of lab projects. There's no better option for intro physics than Adam.
This guy is amazing and his Polish accent is extremely endearing. By the end of the semester, my impression of Adam's accent will be perfect.
No Comments

Adam is a really great instructor and I would recommend him to anyone. I always thought it was amazing how he could keep a lecture flow going and make physics interesting. Even though this class is "honors," I think it is at a reasonable level for all types of students, whether they're science majors or otherwise. Most exams are take home.
Tough and good do not take if you do not want to work and genuinely learn. If you do, Professor Saburova is the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She's a nice person, but goes on tangents about the most random things which takes up class time and makes everything very droll. You make one point and she finds a way to make that into 45 minutes of something you didn't even mean.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The only upside is that there are no tests; otherwise, get ready to listen to her yap about nonsense. Papers are graded very harshly, and the work is monotonous.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Like most of the bad comments on here, she rambles about nothing and is nice enough but when it comes to grading its like she forgets all about it. Near the end of the semester and of course she has only graded 3 things. Papers are graded harshly and the requirements seem easy but she always comes with comments of sources not being cited etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: In all respect, DO NOT listen to these good reviews. This is the worst instructor I've ever had. She rambles in class about nothingness. She gives basically no rubric or instructions for assignments and then grades us very harshly and acts like it was our fault. Don't bother asking feedback because she'll ignore your question and just RAMBLE!No thx

The professor seems like she means well but lacks structure in her teaching. She stands in front of the class and talks about things unrelated to the course material. Her assignments are clearly self-made because they do not have grading criteria, and she is the hardest grading professor I have ever had. If you want a bad grade, take the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is a very sweet lady and it is obvious that she is passionate about the subject. But, she is a harsh grader and does not give clear, well-organized instructions. It seems that she expects you to come into the class with prior knowledge of the subject. She also tends to babble on about random things. The class doesn't really have much structure.

I would not recommend taking her. Nothing agianst her as a person, she was actually very nice. But her style of teaching was awful. I have never taken a class so hard in my whole 3 years of college. There were so many papers to do and don't even get me starting on the sources. Don't take this class because its is sooo time consuming. Don't take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
I want to preface this by saying none of this is personal about the Prof. She is a kind lady.

She is the worst instructor I have had in all of college. She goes on tangents and rambles through class and we would complete none of the planned instruction. Assignments have no rubric, are vague, and graded hard. She will often change them on whim.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take especially if you're looking for an easy Gen-Ed. Professor talks non stop but none of what she says helps with assignments. Only grades came from writing assignments and were graded very tough even though very little instruction was given.

Dr. Saburova is incredibly passionate about her various subjects and MAPS regarding them. She is always more than willing to help & provide additional sources & help if you need. Classes are lecture heavy, but engaging. Assignment instructions can be particular, if you're unsure, don't be afraid to ask questions. She is one of the best!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Saburova is a very intelligent, kind, and passionate professor. She is easy to work with and learn from. She is very interested in what she teaches, and she cares about her students just as much. She offers office hours, and she is very prompt in answering emails. She also gives extensions! If I could give her 100 stars, I would.
Dr. Saburova (Tati) is an incredible professor and person. She is kind, funny, and very understanding. She loves to have discussions in class and does not believe in tests.

Dr. Saburova was an amazing professor! She was so sweet and so engaged with her students. Her class was interesting, and she was always willing to grant extensions! All you have to do is talk to her and you'll love her too!

She is very passionate about her lectures and her course. While she does take a long time to return essays and other grades she will always work with you when you are confused and will never say no to an extension. Really caring woman if you put in effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: While Prof. Saburova may take a while to return essay grades and give feedback, I enjoyed having her as a professor. She responds to emails promptly and has never denied a request for an extension/extra help. She is not a tough grader, but her rubrics are unconventional- pay attention to her formatting requests (or you'll lose points).

Kind of surprised her rating is low. There were a few classes that felt a bit disjointed, but overall the class was interesting, not too hard, and even fun at times. Her zoom classes were more engaging than any other zoom classes Ive had to take, and the group project was engaging. She clearly cares about not suffocating students with work.

She talks a lot about things that aren't related to class. I wouldn't miss class if I were you, she seems pretty harsh when it comes to attendance even when sick. I wouldn't take this class again, it is not what I thought it would be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Her lectures do not help whatsoever on the essays. They are not spread out correctly at all, and you teach yourself most of the material. Unless you need the world history credit, do not step foot in the classroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Saburova really cares about her students, however, takes months to grade anything and is a hard grader. Most students, myself included, seem really confused about what is going on in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Saburova seems genuinely caring towards her students and knowledgable about history. However, much of the course in the first month has been her lecturing and asking questions to the class over assigned readings, with no powerpoints. If you're able to learn fairly well from often dense writings by historians, you will be okay.

Lectures were long and boring and I found myself not listening a lot of the time. Professor Saburova though is a very sweet woman who is interested in all of her students and likes to check in with everyone. She is pretty unorganized when it comes to assignments though and it seemed like the students were almost always lost.
If taking over zoom, this is one of the most time consuming classes you will take with the smallest reward. She takes months to grade work and is the harshest grader i have ever encountered

Worst professor and worst class you can take at IU. She does not want her student to succeed and purposely gives out bad grades to students. She is always super behind and always wasting time in lectures. She thinks that this class is the most important class you'd ever take at IU and always trying to make her student fail. DO NOT TAKE HER!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is very boring and the lectures are useless, but you still have to be present in class cause she takes attendance. She also demands way too much for a 100 level history course. This class is a complete waste of time for anyone that's taking it (don't gain much from her lecture and textbook). Do yourself a favor and take something else...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Tatiana was amazing! I took her intensive writing class on Siberia and she was willing to help revise even outside of office hours. She even helped with my paper by recommending good sources! I felt she really cared about the topic and students. The paper was about 6,000 words and extremely time consuming, but she made the class so much better.
Shes very knowledgeable and a great professor. The class is very lecture and paper heavy, and you have some group work. It wasnt my type of class, but I still think its a good course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I never wrote a review for any professor but Professor John Talbott deserves one. He's truly the most genuine professor I have come across in Kelley, he goes out of his way to teach students and look out for them. I am taking Kelley Outfitters with him next semester, highly recommend him!

John Talbott made me so uncomfortable to the point that I dropped the class after only the first lecture. He singled me out several times and even rubbed my shoulder. It's confusing to see how many people adore him on here. As a woman, I don't recommend taking his class.

You don't really have to try at all, and attendance isn't mandatory. Just finish all your assignments and you will receive credit. Doesn't affect GPA, but it does give you 3 credits over the summer. If you don't do it, not the end of the world.

The professor cares about his students. Classes are usually shorter than the scheduled time and exams are online, open book. There is always a homework before each class. The class is very interesting and the professor is open to help and discuss whatever you would like after class. Only thing, is go to classes because he uses top hat attendance.
One of the most caring professors I have ever had. Class was easy if you show up. Would recommend him so much.

I graduated from Indiana University in 2020. And still, when I think of which professor(s) made the biggest impact on me - it has to be Professor Talbott! His vast knowledge, expert industry experience, and innate ability to mentor students with genuine care and enthusiasm make him the perfect mentor for all students. I highly recommend his class!

One of the best professors at IU don't hesitate to take any of his classes. Cares about his students and makes sure they have everything they need to be successful. Grading is clear and as long as you do the work you will get a good grade.

X170 is kind of a blow off summer course for incoming direct admits. It's an easy A, so if you do all of your work, you are guaranteed a starting 4.0 GPA. My only complaint is how dry the course was, as well as the group project at the end of it.

One of the best professors, I have ever had. Great guy and really wants the best for you and wants you to get something out of the class. The class is super cool, each week is a new retailer. Easy A yet, you have to come to class and you have to participate or he will not care for you and you will fall behind.

John Talbott is an excellent professor for X170 and was one of my few favorites. He was genuinely funny and a really nice guy. I would definitely recommend this class as it is an easy GPA Booster. A or out. 3 credit class. Only 4 assignments and Fantasy Startup was really fun.

This class was an A or out. As long as you showed participation and turned everything in, you got an A. You also got 3 credits. I spent maybe 3 hours a week at most doing stuff for this course. We have 3 one hour long lectures each week.

Literally he talks for hours about nothing, not even anything related to the course. I am personally not a fan. It is definitely an easy A but you won't enjoy your summer if you take this class. It is constant stream of busy work that you learn next to nothing from, especially in the last three weeks.
John is a cool guy but X170 is kind of a waste of time. But X170 is also 3 credit hours and a really easy A and is a nice GPA booster. Your choice

Best prof I've had at Kelley thus far. He has excellent online classes, makes you feel like you're in a classroom. He's a dynamic speaker, he's relevant, and he 'gets it'. Class material is perfect for the summer term. Light, informative, interesting, and yes--the Simulation was fun. Highly recommend John. I'd take him again in a heartbeat.

Talbott is awesome! He really cares about his students if you take the time to get to know him. Definitely one of the best professors in Kelley. He will go above and beyond to try and get you the best job you can out of college but you have to put in the effort and show him why.

Probably the funniest professor within ICORE! I will definitely be taking another class with Talbott if I have the opportunity to do so.  Make sure to go to class as clicker questions are provided every day, but they're relatively easy points.

Unfortunately this is the one ICore class you can not skip because of his clicker questions. That being said his clickers are very easy and Talbott is an awesome lecturer. He does his best to make the lectures as exciting and engaging as can be and it is clear he knows his stuff about marketing.

Talbott himself was an excellent professor. He was very kind, approachable, and definitely knew a lot about marketing seeing that he was a VP at fossil. However, the class of X170 is a total waste. The professors give huge papers but don't even grade them, so therefore no consistency with the grading. Don't take X 170 but take Talbott.
Great enthusiasm and very approachable. He was a fair grader, and towards the end of the term  becomes  more lenient with grading.

Professor Talbott is amazing.  I am seeking out classes that he teaches and have recommended in my reviews to the school that other professors take advice from him.  I feel highly respected and motivated in his class to do my best and to learn.  He provides great resources and I learned a lot.  This class is "easier" because he is such a good prof.

I liked Talbott as a guy and he's probably a good teacher for his upper level business classes but X170 is a terrible class and I highly recommend you do not take it. reviews.comment: Her lectures are interesting and she is funny! She challenges her students to think. If you show that you are putting forth effort, she will help you. Her tests can be difficult, but you will learn a lot if you take this class.
Hard tests, so much out of class work (which did not help on the tests), Impossible quizzes, worst professor I've had at IU
Tests are super confusing and hard. There is way too much busy work for a 100 level class.

Tests are super hard and confusing. I went to office hours and she wasn't much help. Most of your grade is dependent on your discussion leader. Learns everyones name. Heavy on attendence. Doesn't let you turn in missed work for excused absences.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are crazy, and the busy work is insane. The class really depends on AI or TA, the discussion is where all your points come from.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr Bent is a great professor, easy to talk to and explains things well. The grading is pretty tight however and practicing transcriptions outside of class is definitely needed. Homework isn't hard but it's easy to make small mistakes if you're not paying attention.

Dr. Bent is impossible to reach via email. Not much help when you need it and this class was graded very tough- small mistakes were counted of for assignments not worth a lot of points. Do not even try to retake an exam- it is impossible and you have to go all the way to the hospital to do it. good class but dont take it unless you need it.

Dr. Bent is a very good professor and always willing to help. She explains things clearly and has a good way of demonstrating concepts. There's not a lot of work, but assignments like every other week but they're not tedious. Quizzes and exams are straightforward and she lets you know what's on them.

Professor Bent is extremely kind and thoughtful towards her students. I feel that I have learned a lot from this class, but if you do not attend class you will fall behind because learning is mostly through participation and group activity. There are 2 exams and 1 final exam and if you prepare then you will do fine.

FOR SLHS-S209 !! Dr. Bent was a great prof and amazing researcher! This class was for a research based class/project. She is very lenient with deadlines and very helpful towards students when they are conducting their own research. Very fun class!

Dr. Bent is a qualified educator and researcher. However, I felt like this class felt a big disorganized. It has been a few years since she taught this course, so I will give her that. She is an easy grader but really goes hard on annotations. Attend class and you will be just fine.

I had Dr. Bent for Phonetics and Speech Perception Seminar! She's one of my favorite profs at IU! SO helpful & caring & easy to understand. Grading & rubrics are easy to understand and you will learn so much from her classes.

Dr. Bent is AMAZING. She made phonetics so interesting, and she lays everything out perfectly. If you come to class, you'll pass no problem. If you skip class, she's less understanding, but she still promotes student learning. She's very well respected in SPHS and if you ever get the chance to have her as a professor, DO IT!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Respected

reviews.comment: Prof was not a bad teacher in general, but don't even think about asking for help. She'll make you feel so stupid and talk in a very condescending manner. The class itself wasn't incredibly awful but she definitely needs to learn how to help students without being rude.

I respected her but she was not my favorite. She talks down to her students in a condescending tone and is not very approachable when it comes to extra help. Class isn't mandatory but should attend in order to understand better, just looking at the slides will not help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great Prof. Loved Phonetics with her. Starts to make you listen to words and analyze even outside of class. Study lots and over time for exams and you will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Amazing! She is very kind and cares about her students. Was wonderful in office hours. You work in groups which makes it a lot better. Drops lowest quick and homework. Some of the material is difficult toward the end but she is very helpful if you don't understand. Take her!

Dr. Bent is definitely one of the most caring professors I've met - she goes the extra mile to make sure everyone understands the material with lots of group exercises and plenty of examples. She also makes the content very interesting and explains topics very well. Not the easiest grader, but appreciates participation and effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Bent really cares about her students and tries hard to make the class understandable. Although some of the material in this class is difficult she makes it easy to understand. Few assignments and she drops your lowest assignment and quiz grade.

Really enjoyed this class. We worked in small groups and learned a lot in class. The homework doesn't take a lot of time. Drops your lowest HW and quiz grade. Be respectful and pay attention and she and the AIs/TAs will be very helpful. Exams were relatively easy. No surprises in this class. If you do the work and pay attention you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Bent makes class exciting and was always very enthusiastic. For me, I did not like the class material and I found myself spending a lot of time studying.
I felt like she talked down to us a lot and wasn't very nice. Her power points were good but that's about it.
My favorite class of the first semester. She makes sure everyone understands the class material and goes into great detail for every topic. Loved this class!
She's really nice and willing to help you out. I had her for 111 and it wasn't a very hard class. If you go to class and study for the quizzes/test you'll be fine.

Had professor Bent for both 111 and 333. She was very good at teaching 111 however, 333 she wasn't good at all. Bent made 333 WAY MORE COMPLICATED than it needed to be. Honestly, avoid her,she doesn't actually care about her students or their grades. It's easy to see she's here at IU for research cause she would never go out of a way for a student

I loved this class.  I thought Dr. Bent was a really good teacher.  I thought she made it really clear what would be on exams and quizzes.  I thought the homework assignments were good practice for the exams/quizzes.  All in all--take her!

She is a great professor. I had her for this class and now I have her for S333, and I've enjoyed it both times. She's pretty funny and will answer any questions students have. I highly recommend taking her class!

Great professor! She really knows her stuff and is enthused to teach it.  Her lectures are kind of boring, but it's hard to make phonetics exciting.  She always comes to class in a good mood, and seems like a pretty sweet lady. I'd recommend her!

I had Dr. Bent for an intensive class that involved small discussions.  She got to know all of the students by name.  Her teaching style may not be for some, as it's mostly independent work, but definitely not unmanageable.  Do the homework and participate in class and  you'll do fine.  She's open to new ideas and I would definitely recommend her!

If you follow the syllabus, do the homework, and show up to class, you will be fine. I did not have any experiences where I felt the grading was subjective to my detriment. This class was an easy A for me.

While I do agree that sometimes her grading can be subjective, she does set her students up to do well in this class. Her notes are consistent and clear as well as her teaching methods. I've always done well in her classes and am having her for a third semester in a row because I know I can get an A (if I do the work).

Dr. Bent treats students like they are beneath her....very far beneath her and apparently not worth her time or effort.  While I accept that professors obviously have more knowledge than the students in the courses they teach, there is just no need to condescend or belittle students as Dr. Bent does.  Not recommended!

She doesn't seem to make herself available to students and seems unwilling to meet outside of class. Seems like she doesn't want to be teaching the class. VERY SUBJECTIVE grading.. beware.Has strange and strict rules in syllabus and is upset if you don't refer to her as Dr. Good grades are doable she just makes me feel like I'm on her bad side.

While Prof. Bent is clear the material is dry and boring and she does little to make it interesting. We spend lots of time on trivial things and no time on the concepts that show up on quizzes and tests. She seems to use grading as punishment. She is more focused on punishing bad students than rewarding good ones. I don't care for this prof.
Great teacher. Take her!
Dr. Bent is a great teacher. I've also had her for S111 and S333 and she's been great. Very clear and explains things well. Always willing to help in office hours! take her class
One of the best teachers I have had here. She is really fun and good at explaining the information. I have her again now for 333 and she is just as awesome.
Hes my dad
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class
