Great class. Hard subject material, but he really seems to want the students to "get it".

Shane is great! I really enjoy his class and would recommend him to anyone taking L371.  The topics are difficult but he makes it worth it and you learn a lot. His class is probably my favorite English class I've ever taken.
He is a wonderful teacher. Makes very difficult material easy to understand. Cares about student success. Highly recommended!
First time I've ever shown up to every class. I would learn more if I could keep my eyes off of him!
Great class, provocitive teacher! Engages the class at every turn.

I scheduled my semester around Shane's L371 because he was sooo helpful in L203.  The way he explains the material makes reading Marx, Nietzsche, & Freud worth it.  Everything becomes so clear to me when he lectures.  By far, the best English professor I've ever had.

shane is dreamy --his ability to walk you through diificult works makes me want to take his class again without credit.  very caring, very kind, and more than willing to meet with you outside of class.  plus he tells hilarious stories about plane rides across the ohio valley.
No Comments
not all that exciting
Go to class.  Shane's lectures clarify the reading.  Pretty easy class, not too much reading.  Shane is very helpful.

Genuinely cares about his students. His lectures are slide heavy, which makes studying way easier come exam time, as everything you need is on the slides he posts online. Very engaging and available outside of class. Wonderful dude all around. Do your best and you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: idk why people are hating on Mark, his lectures are slides heavy but hes super helpful outside of the classroom and hes willing to improve his lectures. He cares about his students, I was not interested in finance field at all before this class but bc of him, im willing to have finance as one of my future careers.

Plays favorites and has the typical IB superiority complex. New to teaching, so he isn't great at explaining material. If you don't have a high-finance background, concepts are challenging; you are expected to know most of them already. Class is graded on 6 things, so it's hard to recover from a bad grade. Unless you are super finance-savvy, avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He had worked in the industry before and had practical experience, but was a terrible professor. His teaching was bad, exams were much harder than the practice, and he expected you to know everything about corporate finance. The case instructions were super vague and useless. This course shouldn't be more difficult than F303, but he made it worse.
Hard class, good professor.

F305 is a difficult class if you've never interacted with finance material outside of I-CORE, so don't let that sway your review. I think if you're willing to put in the work, this professor is not bad at all. Mark is very accessible outside of class to meet, and he provides so many practice problems to prepare for the exams. Plus, he's a good guy!

Super uninteresting professor who takes favorites. Seems like a terrible human being who enjoys watching his students fail. Created an account on this website to let other student know to not take his class.
very nice and helped me better my skills. definitely a difficult grader but you get what you put in

I had a great experience with Professor Walton! She was always very kind, and gave great feedback on presentations. She can be a bit on the harsher side of grading, but as long as you put in the work for the class, you will do well.

I really loved professor walton. At the beginning of the year she was a tough grader but gave excellent feedback and you can really tell she wants her students to do good. She was always there if you needed help and she just overall cared for her students. if you have the opportunity to take her you 100% should.

If you're taking C104 don't worry about the people talking about her compass class. Professor Walton was sort of tough on grading at the beginning of the semester but gave great feedback and all of the major assignments she was an easy grader. Excellent teacher all around, couldn't ask for a better one for business presentations.
Professor Walton was my favorite! She was so kind and encouraging to everyone + always gave good feedback. She responds to emails fast and is a very fair/reasonable grader.
I was warned she was a hard grader, but she really wasn't too bad. I got A's on all assignments except one, but it was a deserved B. She wants you to do well and succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is very accommodating and gives useful feedback. I love Professor Walton!

Gives clear introductions on assignments and feedback on what you need to improve. Difficult to fail her class if you practice your presentations at all. Reading is not mandatory and does not matter, you do not need to pay attention during lectures. Highly recommend.

This class was much more focused on actual presenting skills rather than the content being delivered. Most presentations were total slop when it came to content but if it was delivered well then they received a good grade. Make sure to have nice clothing or you'll get docked points. Tough luck if you have a stutter or speech impediment.
Professor Walton gives really good feedback and makes C104 enjoyable. She genuinely wants students to get better at presenting and helps you to get there. Highly recommend taking her for C104

the most useless class I have taken in my entire class. Nobody learns anything, worst of all I think she might just assign more homework that any other class. Somehow got a C on an introduce yourself post???? and had to write about 1000 words every weekly discussion just to get an A.

This class is so dumb like i don't understand why Kelley makes us do this. I think that its to boost your GPA while taking I-core but like, wouldn't it boost our GPAs if we just concentrated on classes instead of this stupid class. Haven't learned a thing in class. I get that she doesn't choose the content but she could not assign the dumb HW
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Business presentations was great with her. She was a little on the tougher side of grading, but not too tough. By her standards it was hard to get below an 80, but hard to get above a 90 on presentations. Homework boosted us a lot.  She taught very well and gave amazing feedback. She was really nice and respected. Overall a good professor.
Compass 3 is the worst class in Kelley. Prof Waltons class taught me nothing. Easy A to help iCore gpa, but such a waste of time.
Words cannot describe how useless Compass 3 was. I got nothing from Prof Walton's class (and I really tried to try and find some worthwhile takeaways)
It's amazing that Compass 3 is an actual class. It was such a waste of time. Prof Walton seemed enthusiastic about it but I don't think any students learned anything this semester.
She seems nice enough, but this is the most pointless class. I got nothing out of any of the assignments that we completed.

It's not Prof Walton's fault that Compass 3 is the most useless class at Kelley. I, and every single person that I've talked to, has said that they have gotten nothing out of this class. All of the work is busy work. Professor Walton grades harder than the other teachers. I don't usually mind tough grading, but we're getting nothing out of it.

Let's be honest. Compass 3 is like a side-dish course of I-core. But Christi is too tough. She is the worst grader I've ever met. Her quiz is too difficult and direction is very not clear. Very unprofessional. If you can, please choose other instructors.

The most unprofessional professor I've ever had. She was extremely rude to myself and my group. Would not recommend. Easy class but she will tear apart all assignments apart and then give you NO explanation on why you received the grade. Avoid her at all costs.

Super tough grader! Be prepared for the discussions. They aren't worth much but you need to put in the effort and write a book for each one. Also, read every detail. She will take points away for very minor things that you forget and those add up fast. Would recommend another professor for compass III.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Attendence was completely optional until week ten, when there weren't enough students to do the group project he planned. I went to almost every PACE-250 lecture, and I don't think I could tell you what the class was about, and most of it didn't make sense. Assignments are vague and unrelated. Easy A if you can handle long-winded rambles. Nice guy

Professor Weinman is very smart, approachable, and accommodating. Lectures focus on specific, niche topics, so you may not learn broad content, but the class is easy, and it's possible to get an A with effort. Overall, a positive and enjoyable experience.

Professor Weinman is a fair grader and nice person but his lectures are often long winded and extremely hard to understand. I got an A+ but I did not end up learning a single thing in this class. Wouldn't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor super intellectual. Is a rambler but super easy grader if you show a little bit of focus and care and attention. Super sweet guy.

Dr. Wei was a great professor, his lectures were super straight-forward, and all the exams were a direct copy of the lecture notes or the review. Nothing was harder than it had to be. Doesn't take attendance, and lecture notes are posted online but they can be kind of hard to follow without having been in class. Txtbk only necessary for hw
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: To be successful in his class you will need to show up and be engaged. He talks fast and will make problems harder than it has to be. If you communicate with him he will help you out.

Professor Wei is knowledgeable, but his explanations are overly long and confusing. Many students rely on self-study, and class engagement is low. Most skip lectures, and with projects and homework worth only 1%, poor test-takers often fail.

IMPOSSIBLE to understand. All students in the class are obviously not paying attention because he is hard to listen to. He doesnt make it any easier on students with the loads of homework and quizzes. Wish they had other professors to teach this class.
He will give the examples in the book during his notes, but will assign harder problems in the homework and on tests.

Great teacher, super friendly. I would recommend her class to anyone! 
(Class taken: English Comp 1)

Prof is a presumptuous person or huge arrogance. I could no longer engage with her because she lacks basic critical thinking skills. was obsessed with stats about people who had ran a marathon and completed an advanced degree. very strange.
You must go to office hours to be successful in this class. She is very strange but cancels class a lot.  Very hard and boring class

Courtney is the nicest person, and she is always there for you.  She has made me look at the world in a new way.  I was dreading W131, but Courtney made it exciting!  While the writing was a little difficult, she would give great writing advice at her office hours.  I feel as if I am a better writer, and she personally cares about all her students.

Courtney was great! I love when my teachers have passion for their subjects, and she definitely does. She gladly met me for office hours whenever I needed help, and my final paper in her class was probably the best paper I've written in my life. I am a much better writer because of her class!

She is great and very funny. You never knew ahead of time the crazy connections we would make in class. We talked about novels and how their themes can be found in movies tv, music, and on youtube. I enjoyed learning about literature in new ways. You have to read a lot but is all worth it. She made us laugh and challenged us.

Her class is hard but fun. She knows a lot about literature and film and made us think a lot about culture. She takes the time to get to know her students and treats us like adults. I am a better writer because of her. Cool class. Smart teacher!
Courtney is am amazing teacher. It's hard to believe she's only a graduate student with her breadth of knowledge. She really loves her subject and is totally hot.

Beware of this 170.  She grades MUCH more difficultly than her 131.  She really likes feminist topics and was very disorganized.  She knows a whole lot about emotion and has a range of feelings, but gives graduate level work with little direction.  Be prepared for a great deal of office hours.

Courtney is an inspiring teacher. I will never look at media or movies again in the same way. Courtney is very helpful, and good at bringing out your best writing. I see her as a kind of role model. Also, she's beautiful. Take this class!

A very, very nice person, but is very disorganized.  She was very hard on grading.  Pick a feminist subject and you will do fine, but she is very opinionated about what you write about.  She either likes your topic or does.  She will give you lots of lee-way to pick, but the assignments are really had to understand.

Courtney is a great AI who really respects and is interested in her students. SHe is very knowledgable about the material and is very energetic and gave helpful comments on papers. Made the course worth while!
Courtney is the best teacher I've ever had. she really knows how to make writing interesting. I recommend this class.
Courtney actually cares if you pass. She knows how to get through to you and treats you like a person.

Great teacher that lets you write about things that are actually interesting and somewhat easy, especially if you go to see her in her office hours.  I would strongly recommend this class over any other 131.
Nice, and likes to get to know her students. Makes W131 not so hellish. Only 3 papers total instead of 10!!

Exam questions are straight forward, if you attend the lectures and take good notes exam will be information from the lectures.  Gave curves on test after saying he would not at the beginning. tells you what will be on the exam

The chillest dude ever. Gave a curve on all the tests after saying he wouldn't. tells you exactly what is going to be on the tests. You kinda have to attend class and take notes, but if you do that, it's a free A. If you don't, it wont effect your grade, but you'll have to just read the book. He's the literal goat, so chill

Lectures the whole time every class, and goes quickly. There are no slides provided or course material provided. Your whole grade is determined by 4 tests, nothing else, so if you are not a good test-taker and aren't able to quickly understand and write down notes at a high, detailed, and fast-paced efficiency, this is not the class for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I would describe his class as old school because he lectures the entire class without slides or handing out any resources. Doing the readings is a must if you want to perform well on his exams. Before you enroll in his course a quick heads up is that your entire grade is made up of only 4 exams each worth 25% of your grade.

Grading is brutally harsh and completely inconsistent with the expectations set at the start of the semester. Rubrics are vague, but points get docked for the most trivial things — a missing comma, a graph that's slightly off. There's no partial credit, no benefit of the doubt, and no room for honest mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Course structure is incredibly tough for a 1.5 credit class - assignments can be worth up to 25% with no late work allowed, making it hard or impossible to recover from mistakes. Lectures move quickly, and grading is handled by TAs. Very limited flexibility and support outside class. Would highly recommend another professor or not take the class.

I thought this class was way too much work for a 1.5 credit course. The MINIs took forever to write and served almost no purpose. Strict grading criteria, but as long as you actually read the lengthy assignment instructions and submit everything on time you'll be alright. I wouldn't go into it with no coding experience tho

Unclear grading criteria. Gives example submissions of "Minis" and homeworks AFTER first one is due so the first one of each will go poorly. Not so bad if there weren't only 3 of each making the bombing of the first one substantial. Homework had unclear grading criteria with multiple interpretations but only HIS is right apparently.

My experience with Whitmer was generally positive. I found the HW assignments to be not too difficult and he was helpful with questions I asked, only issue was with the MINI assignments which were kind of long. Cannot speak to others experiences with him but mine differs greatly from the negative reviews he has gotten.

Insists on using his own horribly made and outdated website outside of canvas, the standard for every other course at IUB. It is very ironic that he teaches web design and yet has an almost unusable and unreadable website that is forced upon the students. It is actually so hard to fathom that I am paying for this course.

Get ready to write ridiculously long "Minis" with no clear criteria for the first one (no examples until after everyone fails the first one). Wasted. hours doing those. Also get ready with ambiguous wording on SQL queries that can be interpreted many ways sometimes, but NOPE his is the only one. Not the actual worst but unreasonably strict on rules
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was my least favorite professor experience so far at IUB. Professor Whitmer is an incredibly unsympathetic instructor focused more on intimidating students with harsh deadlines than providing meaningful class information. Course material is relatively easy, but do not expect any help the professor in any aspect of this course.

One phrase that describes him
Manufactured urgency

This guys gonna make your life hell
Not worth it
Boring classes 
Outdated material 
Very unhelpful in and outside of class
Just don't. I would have just dropped his course if I had a choice. I had a scholarship so I couldn't. Grades on very few things. Got so stressed out during class.

One of the most unique professors at IU, he brings a certain intensity to the classroom that many can't match. If you follow the deliverables closely you'll have no problem in this class. He's quite stern but don't let that fool you, he cares about educating his students.
He isn't a bad professor. He might be a lot when he stares at you, but he's a good professor.

If you take this class with even a little bit of prior knowledge it'll be the easiest A of your life. Whitmer's lectures are one of a kind. He'll discuss topics that other CS teachers often skip over, and they're engaging if you actually care about computer science. Don't let those that took this class blindly and hated it dissuade you.

Whitmer is not a good professor. He doesn't actually teach the programming language that he is supposed to be teaching and expects you to know everything already and will give homework about topics without actually teaching you how to do it. He also will creepily stare at you for like 5 minutes while he is talking about something.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Joke of a class. Class is pretty easy to learn and succeed in but the Professor is like a child with grading. If you fail to do anything exactly how he wants he will tank your grade. And with so few assignments these decisions really affect your grade. Your far better choosing any class to learn C or any other language with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is an okay professor at best, his biggest downfall in my eyes is the way he runs his class. I had to take two of his classes during the COVID online class period. I can conclude this professor should not teach an online class, everything about how he runs an online class is rough. Its his way or the highway, he doesn't care why you had problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class itself is not too difficult, however his grading is pretty strict. If you make one small mistake you will get hit hard for it. On the bright side he responds to emails quickly and he's helpful with answering questions. His lectures do correlate nicely to the assignments. Overall, not a bad class and it helped me prepare for C291.

Professor Whitmer prefers to use his own class website rather than the website system IU recommends all teachers use, Canvas. Information for projects and homework is scattered and not immediately and easliy understandable. Writing is a big component in his class. This is tedious and less valuable than using instruction & testing instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. Whitmer does not care for his students learning, rather their ability to follow his ridiculously laid out instructions. If you dont follow every instruction exactly as he has laid out, you will receive a zero on the assignment no matter the weight. Avoid him at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This professor is extremely hard on his students. His assignment descriptions span tens of pages, and are very difficult to understand even after reading them multiple times through. He is very harsh on due dates, and will not accept late work, which will result in a "0". He expects more than is explicitly stated, and I would avoid him at all cost.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Prof. Whitmer is the worst professor I have ever had. No rubric for assignments. I went to office hours, he smirked at me the entire time I spoke, and then refused to give guidance. He kept most students at a D or and F til the end of the semester, and then assigned "participation points" based on what grade he wanted to give. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!
If you have another choice, never take his class and you will appreciate my advice.
He gives good notes but he is a tough grader.
He's not bad. Do the work and you will be fine.

He knows what he's talking about, and you'll learn how computers actually work, but there are four 20-page assignments and a final "paper" that was like writing a textbook. His grading is so difficult that almost everyone failed the first assignment. And the second. He curves at the end, but it is nor generous. Do not take if you can avoid it!

Jeff expects excellence from everyone. He is an extremely hard grader so don't be surprised if you fail the homework. The course will provide an appreciation for the complexity of network hardware and implementation. That understanding will be paired with REAL knowledge that can be applied in the REAL world. It's an excellent & challenging course!

Whitmer is a great professor for C and Unix. He's not an ass liek everyone says. He doesn't take your b.s. though. Turn in assignments on time, come to class prepared, and have a basic understanding and you'll easily earn an A. Engage in basic brown-nosing behavior and he's nice. He also looks like a Jedi boy scout. How can you go wrong with that?

He is generally fairly friendly in class, but doesn't help with questions, rather relaying then to our AI who doesn't speak good enough English to be teaching a jargon-heavy computer course. His assignments are minutia-oriented busywork, and very difficult to understand.
Barks out his lectures like a drill sergeant, which makes him difficult to understand.  Lame assigments.  Wears a different sports jersey and baseball cap every day!

Jeff doesn't once indicate that this class is meant to be easy, class attendance is mandatory to do well on the test. He lays out all his notes perfectly and builds his tests and hw directly from them. Attend and you will do well.
Very strict, but if you do everything that is required, you will be ok.
Strict, but if you study and do homework, you'll be fine.

One of the easiest upper level labs I've taken. Graded on weekly quizzes that are 5 questions long in person, also pre-lab quizzes that are online. Also graded on lab participation and reading reflections. So its not hard to do well in the class. No lab reports which is great.

Almost the entire class meetings are spent in a breakout room with your group. She's an ok explainer but I rarely felt prepared for the zoom meetings where we would work out problems on tophat because she throws a couple of youtube videos at you and then asks hard questions when you only know basic info. Lots of drops. Hope you get a good group

Lectures are made up of youtube videos, and are not super helpful with tests and in class group work. Book readings are required, and are more helpful than the lectures. During in class, the suggested knowledge is not really used. I spent around 15 hours a week studying and reading material ( summer class).

Awesome professor, one of the easiest labs I've taken. There is a quiz each week about previous weeks material, they are only worth 10% total though. Reading response and lab participation is most of your grade. She is very kind and is passionate about cell bio, highly recommend.

Whitworth utilizes a flipped classroom scenario, but most of her "lectures" are just YouTube videos. Most of the in class time is group projects done online and going over the answers as a class. She drops plenty of assignments, and it's not too hard of a class, but this teaching style just feels lazy. I'd be doing a lot worse if it were in person.

Overall the class was okay. She doesn't actually teach the classes, the TAs do so I really feel like depending on the TA you get it could make or break your experience. You aren't really taught much and I was really overwhelmed my first few classes because you are expected to come in with knowledge and know how to use exel. Overall okay though.
I took her asynchronous bio lab and it was pretty easy. She made her syllabus and guidelines very clear. Not a bad course, did not take too much time and was easy to get an A.

Honestly great. Easy to get an A; but it really is on you to learn the material since tests were open book online. If you do not actually try to learn the material, you won't but if you do, you will learn a lot. Super caring and knowledgeable!

If you havent taken AP bio or something equivalent don't take this class. All the lectures are recorded videos and she barely teaches. You have to teach yourself. However, all exams are open note and the class assignments are mainly group based. Also, 2 of 4 exams get dropped so you are likely to do well but possibly learn nothing.

Took this class online so there was a decent amount of videos and material outside of class (all very helpful and so I didn't mind the workload). Exams were open note. Class met on zoom once a week where she thoroughly went through and explained practice problems. Hard to not do well in her class. Cares a lot about her students and their success

Great Professor, she really is interested in the topics and works with you to understand them. I found this class super difficult and very test heavy. She drops a lot of the assignments and tests but be prepared to work because she gives a lot of it. Solely wouldn't take again because it was so much work that I had no time for my other classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Whitworth is truly one of a kind! If you get to have her in the small biology setting like her online course of L112, she is truly amazing and helpful! I highly recommend. Enjoy biology and participate in her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Her lectures were YouTube videos and I feel like I learned nothing. I am lucky this was online and open notes/books exams or I probably wouldve done bad in this class. Shes not the best teacher I feel like and her lecture notes handouts had no pictures which made some bio concepts hard.

You did have to watch videos before class and you did tophat (kahoot like) in class to apply what you learned. Biology is mostly studying concepts and memorizing so it makes sense that we have to learn it outside of class and apply it in class. If you don't do good on a test you can schedule an appointment w her and she'll help you w study teqniqu.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Whitworth is the professor but the only person that grades your work is the Al. You aren't actually taught anything, just expeted to know. There arquizzes every week in lab with a final at the end. She writes the final but the AI makes the quizzes and it was nothing like the final which was very difficult. I didnt think think the course was fair
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: So, uh, what the hell? I never met her, everything was purely delegated to the AIs. She added some points at the end of the class which was her saving grace, but... yeah. No. The labs were fine, even the AIs were not that bad. But she had nothing to do with anyone and clearly could not care less about the class.

Lectures are poorly designed and utilize Youtube videos throughout the experience. Felt like the class was taught through these videos and not through a faculty member. Lack of communication and desire to work with students is not within this instructors skills. Avoid if possible.

Dr. Whitworth was the best for L330! She helped break down the information and was a great teacher. She certainly expects you to know the material, but she made biology very enjoyable. Never thought I'd say a lecture class was fun!

Dr. Whitworth is your best bet for Bio 112. She is a REALLY fast talker so pay close attention if you want to take notes in class. She posts all of the powerpoints on canvas which is really helpful and nearly all of the test questions come from Mastering Bio. She also drops an entire test and a lot of homework assignments.

Lectures are dry and dense. There are 3 exams (plus the final), of which the lowest grade is dropped. There's lots of busy work, and you have to go to discussion to get the points for the worksheets (no lates or emails). Masteringbio due almost everyday. 100+ pages of reading for every exam. Professor Whitworth is there if you need help though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is the worst bio 112 teacher in the whole department! Hardest professor. Her tests are 100x harder than every other bio 112 section. Get ready to do O-Chem in this class if you take her. My TA who had her even said she didn't know how to help us because her test were so much harder and changed completely this year.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Her lectures are very long, dry, and dense. She doesn't do a good job of keeping her students engaged. She is the toughest biology 112 professor at IU and expects you to eat sleep and breath biology. Her exams are EXTREMELY specific and do not correspond with the lecture notes (which are crazy long). WHATEVER YOU DO, DON'T TAKE HER CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class was very dense and the lectures were very monotone. Staying awake was hard. Exams were also more difficult compared to other sections of this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She was the most friendly professor I've ever had making this somewhat challenging class much easier.

Absolutely the best professors I have ever had, he is hilarious, inspirational, and kind. He really cares about taxes and his students. He incorporates a lot of real-life examples and experiences that make you passionate about taxes as well. He makes it extremely easy to do well in the class you just have to make sure you go to every class!!!!!
Awesome professor. He doesn't care about people's grade but cares a lot more about his students and them actually learning the material. Would 1000% take again.

Amazing teacher who has insane tax knowledge. Very tough subject, but if you go to class it will be a easy grade. Awesome lectures and will always meet outside of class to help you with anything you need. Does not care about grades at all and just cares about getting the students to learn.

genuinely good professor, you can tell he cares about his students. my favorite professor ive had at iu. he knows his stuff and is very flexible and understanding outside of class. he takes time to meet his students and you can tell he loves his job. work gets hard but he is always willing to help out.
Professor Wisher is amazing! Super down-to-earth, and she gives really good feedback. I was nervous about this class, but I ended up learning so much.

I love her so much she is genuinely such a nice person I have no complaints. One of the few professors who is truly so dedicated to teaching, supporting students, and going above and beyond to bring passion to every part of class. Dawn deserves the world and much more.

She genuinely cares about all the students becoming better presenters which is why some grades are harder to get. Listen to the feedback she gives and apply it well. You can justify your own grades for the later presentations. I'm not a great speaker but I learned some things and ended with a 93
Her grading system can be very frustrating at time, but Professor Wisher genuinely cares about her students improving as a presenter.
DWisher is the sweetest, kindest, most caring professor ever. Take her she's so awesome.

Super sweet and fun class. Grades were done in "bands", so 100%, 93%, 83%, etc. Hard to get an A, but you get to argue for points at the end of the semester. Mainly done in teams. If you apply her feedback and do things she mentions in class, you'll do well.

Love her. She genuinely cares about each and every student, and takes their feedback about the course into consideration. Extremely teamwork-intensive class, with vast majority of presentations being with your team. She's a pretty lenient grader, as long as she can see you put in effort to your work and presentation, you will do well in the class.
shes great and very friendly but it is hard to get an a in this class, don't make mistakes

If you get to choose who you have for business presentations, take it with Dawn Wisher. She is a wonderful professor that provides great feedback because she really cares about you succeeding. She is very responsive and communicates expectations clearly through Canvas. Does assign some short "busy work", but it is all to help you learn.

Professor Wisher is a great teacher and an awesome person. She makes it very clear what she is looking for in Business Presentations and gives great feedback so you can improve. More than anything, she wants to see you grow in your presenting skills at the beginning of the year. Very thorough and always available for extra help or office hours.

Professor Wisher cares a lot about her students. She doesn't provide very detailed instructions for assignments but after the first big presentation, you can get a sense of how she grades. The class itself takes a lot of time outside of the class no matter the teacher, but as long as you are prepared and she sees you trying your best your fine.

She's nice but if you want defined instructions, she is not the professor for you. She really is pretty supportive but it can be frustrating as her grading is subjective and unclear. She tries to be hip with the youth and be besties with everyone so my best tip is to show up a little early and get to know her.

Professor Wisher was a very nice teacher, and I would take her class again if needed. She made conversation and engaged with students to make the classroom a welcoming environment. Although her grading could be a bit tedious at times, it is easy to get an A in her class. Do the online work, review her presentation rubrics, and you will be good.
She was really great! She cares about her students and wants to help them improve and grow throughout the duration of the semester. I enjoyed this class.
Professor Wisher was a pleasure to have. She provided great feedback and did her best to be accessible to groups for presentations. She was kind to students, and knew us on a personal level.

She's a great professor! Easy to talk to, clear communication, and will help make you a better presenter. You must show up to class, otherwise you will fail, but this applies to all presentation classes. You do get graded as a group for group assignments so I see how this could be a con if you had a bad group.

Professor Wisher, while a good teacher, isn't a great option for a business class. Furthermore, she isn't very good at giving good feedback, and it becomes very difficult to determine what you need to work on moving forwards. Overall, so long as she likes you, you'll probably be fine.
She provides a lot of useful feedback. The class is a lot of work at times - usually you have a presentation once a week. Groups are graded as a team, instead of an individual basis.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I don't think I could've had a better Prof for C106. Prof. Wisher is so uplifting and she really made me feel much more confident in myself. It's a hard class, but she gives good guidance to make an A, even if you suck. From the first presentation, she uses it as a learning experience to grow from rather than grading harshly and discouraging you.

Professor Wisher is amazing for presentations. All the assignments are clearly explained and so is the grading criteria. She is very respectful and gives valuable feedback. She is also very helpful in her office hours, and discusses any course related queries at length.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Wisher is a great choice. I had her over zoom this year, and she is very engaging and friendly. She makes you work for your grade, but if you participate in class and show enthusiasm then she will notice it. She encourages the class to work together, and it's very easy to get to know classmates because of how she structures the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Wisher is a great professor that cares about the development of her students. She provides helpful feedback, is very positive, and is easy to communicate with over email. She is also extremely helpful in office hours.
Wisher has been really good, she will help you if you ask for it! It is a lot of work, but it has been really helpful even after the class. Practice your presentations and you can do it
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dawn is incredible. She does a fantastic job of building a sense of community within the classroom and making it so you feel like you actually know the people in your class. This class is a lot of work no matter who your prof is, so be ready to put in time if you want to do well. Dawn does a great job teaching it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dawn grades in comparison to your peers, so if you have a good group, you are more likely to get a good grade. She judges on effort too, so try in the class and pay attention to the rubric and her feedback. There is a lot of work outside of class.

I loved having Dawn as my teacher! She always gave great feedback after each presentation and was a fair grader. Each student in my class improved their presentation skills over the semester. Dawn truly cared and was super sweet to get to know. Would recommend her over any other presentations teacher!

This class gave me anxiety and depression. Dawn is the hardest grader I've ever had in my life. The feedback she gives is mostly positive and you're all happy until you find out you got a C on your presentation. She grades relatively, so if you end up in the worst group in your class, you're screwed.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Sure, she is a picky grader, but overall, she is engaging and fun in the classroom. In my experience, her grades may be strict but generally they reflect your performance in comparison to your peers. You may have to work a little harder for your grade, but you will definitely leave feeling like you've learned a lot!

Self-centered, cold, calculating, and evil are a few words to describe Dawn. The human embodiment of hell, Dawn spends her free time micro managing the Devil during her free time, and boring her students with dry lectures as a "profession". She has the charisma and intelligence of the wooden board from Ed, Edd n Eddy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had Dawn for C106. You may hear that presentations is an easy class, but she can be a tough grader. If you do not have a good group, be aware that your grade will follow the performance of the worst one. The feedback is generally good but the final grade determination can seem random and without clarity about why you lost points.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dawn Wisher is the sweetest woman ever and I'm so happy I ended up in her business presentations class. C106 is a lot of work in general but if you work hard with your team and follow the guidelines she gives you you're guaranteed an A. Perceived effort is especially important in this class.

Dawn is very sweet and was a very lenient grader at times and is easier on guidelines than other C104/C106 professors I've heard about. However, her feedback on presentations is almost too nice sometimes, so my growth from just her wasn't amazing. This class requires a lot of group collaboration, but the presentation practice is nice.

This class teaches almost no new information. You do get tons of practice. Only because if it weren't for 1-2 presentations a week, the entire class could be taught in 3 class periods. If you "color within the lines" you will do fine. However, if you try to apply your passions/ think differently than the masses, you will end up being discouraged.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great Class. C106 isn't hard, but you have to show up to class and put effort into your presentations. Dawn cares about you succeeding and will do anything to help. Very accessible and understanding of issues that come up. If you put effort in you will get an A.

dawn is a very understanding and accommodating prof. she doesn't want anyone to do bad and gives very clear instructions of what is expected for each speech. she also gives great feedback for every speech so it's easy to improve and get better grades. loved the class, loved the prof, pretty sure everyone in our section got an A-, A, or A+.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dawn is one of the best professors I have ever had in my educational career. The subject matter is tough, and she does not grade lightly, but she will make you grow so much as a public speaker. I would absolutely recommend taking her class if you want to grow and be the best you can be. She's great.

You do not learn a lot, but get a ton of practice presenting different topics to the class which can help with stage precense. She is not easy but not hard. If you ask a lot of questions, follow the rubric, act natural, and prepare than all will be well.
Most of your grade is based on group projects, so make sure you are ready to work that first day because thats how she assigns your groups.
I liked her as a professor and she made presentations fun. She is a tough grader so be prepared to work for your grade. I would recommend her class. Learned a lot from her.
Her grading was quite often unclear and it seemed like she gave grades based on her mood. Never knew what to expect with her, but if you thought you did well, you probably didn't.

Professor Wisher was a very good C104 teacher & I enjoyed her class. She has high expectations & be ready for group work, but if you come to class, participate, and prepare , you will do fine. Unfortunately I did not have a very good group for presentations, but I still did well in the class because she is helpful if you make the effort.

She is very fair. Going to class isn't important, but if you miss 3 classes your grade drops a letter grade so you have to attend. She is a fair grader, but grades tough on the final. She tries to make the class as entertaining as possible.

Professor Wood's lab lectures for H127 felt unnecessary and pointless. Lab assignments and instructions felt hard to follow, especially with her "do-it-yourself" formula. The difficulty ramped up with the semester. Lab assignments were also time-consuming but reasonable for an honors level course.

I cannot say enough good things about Professor Wood. I had her for both C341 and C342 and she was amazing for both. Her lecture notes are very organized and similar to the quizzes/exams, and she clearly outlines what she expects for you to succeed in her class. She is always cheerful, and makes a hard class seem doable. LOVE HER!

I LOVEEEEDDD ALI WOOD! I had her for both c341/342 and cannot rave any more about her! Genuinely made every lecture so fun and engaging. She is extremely caring, accessible and helpful in office hours. She made such a daunting class so enjoyable and knew exactly how to simplify concepts for us! Just do what she assigns and you'll be just fine!

I loved having Dr. Wood as a professor! I had her for C341 and C342, and she made both classes very manageable. Her lectures were clear and usually easy to follow, and you can tell she cares about helping students understand the content. I would definitely recommend taking either course with her!

An absolute gem in such a dreary department. The course content is incredibly challenging, but she does a good job teaching it and shows a lot of care for her students, always thinking of new ways to improve the teaching of the content. Her lecture notes are concise and well-formatted, and she gives a fair amount of homework. Highly recommend!

Dr. Wood is a great professor! Her lectures were straightforward, and as long as you did the homework and studied, it was not hard to get an A in this course. Of course, the content and exams were difficult, but the practice materials provided proved similar to exam questions, and every exam was worth 110 points and graded out of 100.

Ali Wood is a good professor if you show up and work hard. GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS they helped me tremendously. Expect to put in at least a little bit every day (whether it be going over the lecture, reading the book, doing hw, etc.) Students that say she is a bad teacher either 1. don't know how to study or 2. don't try hard enough.

Very rude and passive-aggressive to students. Makes snarky comments when students are lost and not understanding the material. She does a very poor job budgeting her class time; we were behind the entire semester. Does not provide practice exams or curves on exams.

I could tell that Ali tried to make C341 lectures fun and she was very helpful during office hours. Sometimes I felt that she didn't budget her time very well in class, but I think that was because it was her first time teaching the class. She gave us a reagent sheet for the last few quizzes, an exam, and the final!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ali is very kind and easy to talk to. She makes orgo feel manageable and explains things in a very clear and simple way. I also had her for orgo 1 and she really breaks concepts down and uses fun analogies.
One of my favorite professors at IU! She has made Orgo less daunting! Super knowledgable and genuinely cares about her students.
Professor Wood is very kind and goes out of her way to ensure that her students understand the content. Great at explaining stuff

Very accessible outside of class and willing to work with students. She took much of the content from another chem professor and the exams are work 70% of the grade and very hit or miss. She doesn't  offer extra credit and when someone asks about grades in class she excuses her teaching style and difficulty of assignments/tests that "ochem is hard"

Unironically my fav professor at IU. Great at describing the reactions in context, using model kits, drawing structures, or whatever is needed to convey the material. Accessible through office hours/email. Strict when necessary, but sweet otherwise. The quick checks and homework were difficult but effective for learning. Made orgo actually fun!

Prof Wood/the AIs for this class were very knowledgable and accessible outside of class. C127 is a lot more work than indicated by the credit hrs and attending office hours felt like the only way to succeed, but I don't blame Prof Wood for this- the class is just hard. My advice is GO TO OFFICE HOURS and attend lecture- the lectures are helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Wood was very knowledgeable about what she was teaching. Post labs were hard at times but going to office hours was so so helpful. As long as you show up and do all your work, it's not difficult to do well in this class.

Bogus lectures that teach you absolutely nothing. Nitpicky AIs that will take points of your lab reports for God knows what. She gave like 50 people 0s on one of the lab reports because they all had similar data graphs... like we didn't all do the same exact experiment with the same materials, same concentrations. Duh the data gonna look the same.

This professor lacked good communication outside of class. Poor at responding to emails or canvas messages. Some assignments took multiple weeks past due date to get a grade. Would personally recommend.
Good professor. Definitely attend lectures, they are a big part of the grade. Lectures can be uninteresting but are necessary. She has many online resources available and offers many office hours.
just make sure to attend lectures above 50%. I almost got destroyed because to get a 2/5 on a 5% grade portion you have to go to lecture at least 50%. good lecturer

Never take this class unless it is an absolute must for your degree/career path. This class is extremely time consuming where you have to deal with at least 15 hours per week of work to get a good grade. Also, the AIs don't follow the grading curriculum from Professor Wood.

She is very nice and helpful but the grading for this class is crazy. Her AI's do not follow the rubric and grade differently than her so when she grades your assignments, she grades them very hard. While there is a rubric for all assignments, it is clearly not followed or enforced by the Professor and the grading is a free for all.

Prof Wood's lectures were quite boring and overly simple in comparison to the homework. I disliked the pacing of the lecture, as she usually had to finish very quickly at the end. However, she is very caring and willing to help if you reach out. It is a lot of work for a 2 credit lab.

She turned this course around as it used to be much harder before. Her lectures were actually helpful for the lab material and homework and she had a big teaching team that made it more bearable to work on LabFlow. I was originally worried about taking this course but she made the grading much more reasonable compared to the previous professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was a great teacher. It was her first year teaching the course, so she was still working through the kinks, but otherwise was amazing. She offered extra credit for the final lab report, which was very helpful.
Professor Wood was accessible outside of class and was clear about grading. It is a lot of work, but that is to be expected with lab classes.
She is a nice professor, but her lecture can be boring sometimes, a lot of work for 2 credit hour lab.

Professor Wood's lectures could be boring and too simplified at times, but she recorded all of her lectures and put them on Canvas which was helpful for assignments. She was much better at explaining concepts and helping her students during her office hours, so I highly recommend that you attend those.

Prof Wood is amazing. She explains materials & the ideas about the topic of the lab really well. She is very good at answering questions in her office hours & makes the class the best she can for her students. The class is a lot of work, but if you put in the effort, it's an easy A. The papers we have to write are a little hard to do and understand

She really cares about her students! She wants them to succeed, and is they best chemistry professor ive ever had. Her class requires a lot of work to do well in, but she makes in manageable and wants the best for her students. Please take her class? However, sometimes her AIs wouldn't show up to office hours with no notice, which was inconvenient.

She was a great professor that explained each lab very well. She gave multiple attempts on the assignments and even had a 24 hr policy no questions asked policy on them. She truly cares about her students and popped into lab sections in order to spend some time with them. Highly recommended!
Professor Wood was very kind! Her lectures were clear and she was accessible outside of the classroom. She is very understanding and as long as you ask questions she will help you. I liked her a lot!
Ali would be better as a high school teacher, her lecture is boring and Labflow is so annoying. The program never accepts answers and is not explained very well by Ali.

He is a super nice professor and wants everyone to do well, there is so many help sessions if your confused and the tests are almost identical to the homeworks and classworks. My only complaint is the amount of homework and classwork for this class. There is a classwork do every day after class and a homework as well.
might be the worst professor ever. does not tell you what he wants on the test. could get right answer and get no points. takes points off for no reason even if it is correct work.

I started off the semester not being able to submit homework because i did it off my ipad but his sofware caused issues. then this continued through the semester and through spring break to the end of the semester none of my assignments or class work was graded. this then resulted in me not knowing my acual grade the whole semester.

took his online course you are required to do a video w questions and homework and then classwork have it down before each class mwf very heavy work unfounded as base math course also doesn't teach during class bc 1 hour long videos he posts teach you not him a class you take and drop tests r on nonclass days may conflict with other courses

I really enjoyed professor wheeler; very sweet. Provides plenty opportunities for help. However, you get assigned a lot of homework, have to watch a video before each lecture. All test are open note, and are just what we have done in class and on the homework. It's an easy class if you do the work, and solve the problems how he wants you to.

Wheeler makes sure the content is well understood, and obviously cares about understanding, and not just your grades. However, homework is assigned after each class, and note taking is mandatory and graded. Math at IU generally has the same reputation, but at least this class covers pretty basic math concepts.

have to watch 1 hr notes before each class. hw after every class. tests are open note, including final. overall if you pay attention and up on hw you will pass. he is always available and holds multiple help sessions a week. so sweet but talks a lot. tough grader!!! if you do not do it how he teaches, he takes off a lot of points! Overall not bad.

Prof. Wheeler's class is a challenge, but the effort pays off. The workload is heavy, with lots of homework, but using resources like unstuck AI can help. His teaching style takes some getting used to, but he's genuinely committed to helping students succeed.

This class was so hard. The amount of work required for a "base level finite course" is crazy and takes multiple hours every day to just get the hang of. Prof. Wheeler is obviously smart, but his teaching style is messy and hard to follow. It's also impossible to read his handwriting. Takes forever to grade. Don't take this class!!

Wayy to much homework over 6 hours of just videos and 6 assignments a week for his class, if you get behind your done for. Will fail you if you dont explain every detail, when you are able to use a calculator instead. 

His setup up for canvas is godawful just a throwup of a UI. 
You as well need to waste you money on codes to turn in your homework
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Mr.Wheeler is a passionate teacher and uses flipped classroom style of teaching. this class easily take 6-9 hours weekly w/o counting class. Wheeler is a good teacher and makes himself constantly available. The test are open note including the final which helps but if you do not use wheeler's way of working out the problem you will miss points.

When Prof. says you will not be able to succeed in his class if you have a job or any other responsibilities, believe him. The workload is outrageous. The total number of papers to be turned in for this class is EIGHTY FIVE. It is not about time management. It is about life devotion. If you cannot afford to do spend 20hrs weekly, DO NOT TAKE HIM.

I tend to struggle with math, and I will say that I've had the most success of any math course in his. He's very kind and tries to make problems relevant. That said, he assigns a ridiculous amount of homework. His handwriting is awful, and he's particular about HOW the problem is done. You lose points if you don't follow his steps to the letter.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I loved this professor so much he was always the sweetest and always took the time to say hello to everyone before the class. If you keep up with the course work then it is very easy to get a good grade.
Very nice, bad handwriting

do not take this class with him!!!!! the workload seemed insane for this course, and took so much more time than my other classes. grading is ridiculous, and it's very hard to understand him or read his handwriting. only good thing is that all 4 exams are open note, but overall super difficult class due to the teacher and grading.

Professor Wheeler is one of the most caring professor's I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. He works overtime to help his students by offering help sessions the day before every homework assignment is due and individual help sessions if you need them. He assigns a lot of homework which can be overwhelming at times but it's worth doing it.

Wheeler is truly a great guy, but you HAVE to put in the effort to pass/do well in V118. Do NOT take this class if you cant commit to 4-8 hours a week of homework, or sometimes 2 hours nightly. The video quizzes are an hour each, as well as nightly homework assignments and discussion. Requires tons of effort but youll get an A if you try.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Nice guy, but his grading on tests was impossible because even if you get the answer right, its more about memorizing his specific steps than knowing the content. This class is also VERY homework heavy and requires LOTS of outside work.

Don't take V118 because you think it'll be easier than normal econ easily the largest work load i've had in a college class. While I think I enjoyed it more than regular finite it is very hard to earn an A if thats what you're shooting for.

For finite I feel like Professor Wheeler was a really good professor. Compared to my friends experiences he was awesome. He talks a lot and sometimes too much but he is trying to make the material relevant and easier to understand. You have to do the work he assigns, which is a lot, but it pays off.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: people struggled in my class but I felt like it was because the material not the prof I enjoyed Wheeler as a professor and felt like he tried to help us understand by using demonstrations and examples. There is a lot of work but I think that is what helped me understand the material. I would take wheeler over the profs my friends had any day.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I honestly think Wheeler was a great prof. You definitely have to learn his style, but once you do, he gives you a lot of points for such easy steps in the problem along with the answer. Wheeler also seemed very caring to his students. His style and how he runs the class is way behind the times though, so that will be something to get used to
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Absolutely terrible class, DO NOT take this course. Trust me you will be better in any other math class. He has created his own teaching style and you have to follow it exactly to every last little detail or you will fail homework and exams. There are problems that normally would take 5 mins to do, but following his steps they can take up to 15+.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: You need to do everything for this class, but Wheeler will still give you a zero for EVERYTHING. He was rude when I brought it to him and said he wouldn't promise anything about fixing it. I'm down over 300 points that I should have. 300 PARTICIPATION points
rip your grade do not take finite
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: ended up having to drop the class, but his style really didnt work for me, especially online. very confusing system.

This was hands down one of the worst classes I have ever taken, you will barely be able to read his hand writing and he forces you to do it his way or you will fail Dont expect him to email back ever, Ive emailed him over 7 times with questions and Ive gotten a response once. Hes a nice guy, he just goes about teaching very very poorly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: You have to learn to play the game. The concepts are easy and you just have to learn how to write them the way he wants on the exams to pass. I got a 56% on the first exam because I didn't write out the work the way he wanted, despite my correct answers. I just received my second exam back and got a 95% because I wrote out my work like he wanted.

The worst professor I have ever had. Borderline senile and goes on incoherent rants for large portions of the class. Doesnt actually teach, just makes you sit there while he does math problems in barely legible handwriting for 50 minutes . Grading is not based on whether you know the material but how closely you can copy his work. DONT TAKE

Professor Wheeler is one of the most caring and nicest professors I have had. With that being said, this class is organized in the most ridiculous way imaginable. Videos due everyday before class that are lengthy and overly pedantic. I took M118 and had to drop, this material is slightly easier but way more tedious work and must be done his way.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: One of the most patient, kind and caring professors Ive ever had.

Honestly, this class is like a part-time job. He is soo nice though. You have to watch online lectures before class. They are an average an hour long. Class time is used for practice problems. One thing I highly disliked was that he is so strict with your math work, he wants it written in a specific way or he will mark off points on the exam

Worst class experience I've ever had, honestly. It doesn't matter if you understand the content, your work has to 100% match his or you fail, but he never gives clear criteria. Makes you to watch hour+ videos before every lecture, then just rehashes the same information. Answers questions poorly, if at all, and wastes time with repetitive tangents.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He is a horrible teacher. He lectures the entire class with his back to the students so he rarely answers questions. Do it his way or you're wrong. You won't understand how far he takes that notion unless you've been unfortunate enough to have him as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This man does not have what it takes, in any sense, to teach another human being. He knows his way any nothing more, your perspective is incorrect. A very nice old man that knows his stuff but is incapable of effectively communicating. He does though provide a large amount of resources that make it possible to pass with some work, so there's that

Wheeler is a delightful older guy who seems to care about his students. As a professor, though, he assigns a lot of homework and uses a teaching method that requires you to watch hour-long videos the night before and then review the material in class, and then do homework on it. You'll get an A and understand, but it's a lot of time and work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof. Wheeler is a really cool dude who is knowledgeable and passionate about this course. However, if youre not a fan of meticulously copying someone elses work and nightly hour plus long videos this is not the class for you. If I saw him in the street I would most definitely stop and ask how he is, but I wouldnt take another one of his courses
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I was really nervous to take math my senior year. Professor Wheeler is a caring guy who always asks how we are doing after class. The class is hard, but as long as you do the homework and watch the lectures and actually show up, you'll do well. I was always bad at math, but with keeping on top of the work, I got a 95% on the midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Wheeler only grades on how close your work is to his. Understand the concept? Well that's great but if your work isn't the same as his he will take off. If you like classes where you have to mindlessly copy down someone else's work to the minuscule degree then this is for you. Otherwise, I would highly recommend NOT taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Cares more about work than the answers, but he wants you to do the math work ONLY his way. Exams graded based on how specifically you fit his criteria for showing work, and points get deducted for using short hand to go through work faster. If you care about doing math efficiently, don't sign up for this professor.
I wish every professor could be like Prof. Wheeler. His dedication is unmatched by many. If you come to class and put in the effort you will be rewarded.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's a genuinely nice guy who wants his students to do well. He has online help sessions three times a week that's just him telling you how to do the homework. The homework was pretty much exactly the same as the classwork. It's really formulaic, you just need to plug in the numbers. That being said, those videos were WAY too long.

Professor Wheeler was so kind and extremely willing to help every student! He had help sessions three times a week, and he will work with you so you can succeed in this class. The material was very confusing, but he was great about being there to help!

This class has a crazy amount of homework and classwork. Unlike most classes where getting the answer or demonstrating an understanding matters its all about drawing out models that are identical to his. If you have no pride or are stupid this might be a good fit but if your human its demoralizing and insanely boring. He also writes illegibly.

Worst prof I've ever had. Very unclear and not willing to help. Worst part is, he makes you watch the lecture (usually a 70 min video) before class, then doesn't teach in class.  Avoid him at all costs. About 3 hours of homework & mandatory videos, 3 times per week. I'm an A student & I chose to drop his class because his teaching style is horrible

Prof. Wheeler is a really genuinely nice guy and definitely cares about his work and wants students to do well. Also has a rather acute memory. I sat in on his class almost two years later, and he remembered me and where I sat, although I hadn't gone to his office hours or talked with him outside of class.

You can't read his hand writing. The last two weeks he barely taught anything in class and what he did teach had nothing to do with the homework. He takes off for the tiniest details. I got the right answer on a quiz but received a failing grade because I didn't do it his way. He is a nice guy, don't get me wrong.  But, I would not take this class.

An unrealistic amount of time consuming work is assigned to students every single night, as if this is the only class students are taking. Students are discouraged from asking questions and his style of teaching is unique in the worst way possible. Avoid having him as a professor at all costs.
The amount of online videos you will watch is absurd.

Wheeler is the nicest old man ever! And he will do anything to help you understand the  material. He holds help sessions three times a week and they're even available online if you can't make it in. Take him!

After reading the reviews, I was freaked out about taking Mr. Wheeler's class.  But so far, the material has been easy and Mr. Wheeler has been clear in all of his lectures.  Even if the material does get harder from hereon out, the organization of the class ensures that if you watch his videos and attend class, you can get an A.  He seems great!

This guy really makes math exciting.  I despised math prior to this course, but he made it so fun, that I wasn't afraid to try new higher-level courses after that semester!  If you need to take finite, do so with him! He does anything to help you and his review sessions are heaven sent.

Possibly the worst professor I've ever had. Bad handwriting. The homework is inconsistent with the lectures and I felt that I was taking an online class. 3 hours of lectures a week, 3 hours of videos a week, plus 3 hours of webwork a week. And that if you're understanding everything. Do not take this class.

By far the most interesting class i have taken in college.  The fact of the matter is that Professor Wheeler's class doesnt prepare you in the least to succeed in applying mathematical concepts to real life; it instead is a real life case study in adhering to the insanity of the cliche "crazy" boss.  As such, I recommend it be added to Kelley
Wheeler really cares about his students and wants everyone to do well but he gives WAY too much homework.

Wheeler gets off track a lot, but is really one of the few professors who can make math doable.  It takes him a while to get to the point, but he is an excellent teacher and the only one I would recommend for Finite.

Wheeler is difficult, but is doable. His tests are based on his notes from class. You do his methods on every problem of the webwork (no matter how long it takes) and you will get an A guaranteed. He is also very reasonable about giving you extra time on an exam if drawing his diagrams are taking too long. Just talk to him and get his method.

At first, he is hard to follow. However, if you stay focused in class and pay close attention, you will be set. He has a very particular way of doing things, so make sure to understand his method before completing his assignments. PAY ATTENTION and you will be fine. He is definitely eccentric though.
Best math class I've ever taken. This is the one & only time I "got" concepts in math.

worst class ever. Professor made no sense and his tests were impossible. If you deviated from his one single way to do a problem you got no points on that problem. I tried to get a grad student tutor but since no one knows "his way" of doing math no one could help me. Avoid at all costs
Terrible teacher -____- don't take his class !
Very unclear but willing to help!

Wheeler is not as bad as everyone says he is.  He does talk really fast and the test times are bad.  But if you pay attention to what he is writing you will be fine.  Also before every test he will give you a practice test with all the answers showing what will be on the test. If you know any math at all, you will be fine taking Wheeler
Don't take finite with Wheeler. He's the most difficult finite teacher. He often repeats nonsensical things during lecture and is not helpful in teaching material.

Absolutely useless. He's so random in his ideas and he actually makes math more complicated. He grades your work on the tests too harshly and may knock you down 15% because you did not close a box and add an arrow. Most frustrating class I've ever had. Easy A, but not worth it.

He rambles too much and talks very quickly but is repetitive, so if you miss something he is sure to re-explain it later. He can be very confusing but if you take good notes and go to the help sessions you should be alright. Only downside is that the tests are inconveniently scheduled.

He does not teach anything. You have to learn everything on your own. He spends the first 20 minutes rambling, schedules tests at the worst times, and doesnt let anyone get out of them. Avoid getting him as a teacher or it is going to be a painful semester.

Wheeler is a funny guy.  He talks really fast and sometimes holds class late but if you pay CLOSE attention then he makes learning the material not too hard.  He's very smart.  If you're struggling he offers help sessions, which is nice.  Schedules exams at terrible times (typically around 5:30 p.m. on a Friday night).  That sucks.  Rest is okay.

Pretty terrible prof. Makes learning the material difficult and lectures are impossible. The scheduling of tests and midterms is awful. Don't take this course if you don't like Friday night tests, night tests the day before a break starts, or tests on the last day for finals.

Really a bad professor. Talks a mile a minute, and is hard to comprehend. The material isn't difficult, but he presents it in a way that makes it infinitely more difficult to grasp, and then requires you to match his method on the tests.  He schedules exams as if he is trying to select the most inconvenient times, and will not let you reschedule.

He is the worst professor ever. He doesn't even realize that he is in the same world as his students. He wastes 20 minutes of class rambling and being spastic. He doesn't respond to e-mails and schedules tests at the worst times. If you want to learn, don't take this math course.
He's not so good during class, but is very helpful in his study sessions!

Class is easy if you know any math at all but he does his best to make it incomprehensible and counterintuitive.  tests suck cause 1/2 grade is shown work which has to be done in the exact nonsensical way he teaches. I would miss 1-2 answers on the test and get a B-. Oh well no more math for me so i can deal with this inane class for one semester

His class would be so much easier if he taught it well. He is a really cute old man so it's hard to get mad at him but SO hard to understand, and he does schedule tests friday nights. There isn't a textbook which is annoying and he is very unorganized and hard to follow, like really hard to follow. If you take this class get help!!!

honestly, this class is super EASY if you just go to class - people complaining are the people who failed bc they wanted to skip every week.  make sure you do the webwork (more points than you realize and stupid not to do)and if you do the practice test youre almost garunteed to get an a/b on the test bc its almost exact but with different numbers.

This guy has no clue what he is doing. he shows up every day, kills twenty minutes by telling trivial stories and than keeps you ten minutes after because he lost his time. He is an old guy who doesn't know how to teach. The reason why i got a C was because i taught myself a semester of finite. If you want to keep your sanity stay away from him.
Worst professor at I.U. Schedules exams on worst possible days, and very unhelpful and oblivious to the students need of an environment of learning.
This guy rambles and doesn't stop for anyone, wanna learn math? GOOD LUCK.

Worst class I have ever taken, mainly because of him. The only reason I went to class was to prove attendance, when I really just went home and re-taught everyhting he tried to go over. He scheduled tests Saturday mornings, conflicting with tailgates first semester, and second semester, he scheduled the Friday NIGHT before spring break and little 5

For the record, he didn't schedule a test during Homecoming. I had him last semester and yes there are Saturday tests and it sucks, but they aren't during Homecoming. I can't vouch for Little 5 though. Overall, class is easy if you try and put the effort in just like any other college class.

The only good thing about Prof Wheeler was that he wore different bow ties every day. The test had about 19 options for each question, even if he offered review sessions they were not helpful because he made me feel stupid, he does not try to teach another way if you aren't understanding his method, and he never admits fault when he's wrong. Don't.

Horrible teacher. Talks to the screen the entire class. Speaks very fast. End up working on the homework online and teaching yourself everything. Puts test outside of class time late. He doesnt care about IU traditions and scheduled a test on IU homecoming and little 5. Strongly suggest dont take his class!

This class is not as bad as everyone says. Attend every class or else you will be confused. He offers 3 help sessions, and his TAs offer 2.
