Go to class, do the webwork, and make sure you do the practice exams (they are very similar to the actual exams). Study in a group for this class; odds are if you don't understand something someone else does!

He is the worst professor I have ever had and should be fired. On top of that, he is extremely mean and not understanding at all. I hope IU does not hire anyone who even somewhat resembles him in the future.

He is not helpful at all. He never responds back to email. He always ignores you when you are trying to talk to him. The exams are unreasonable and some of the questions are just not related to math. The webwork stuffs are pointless and you won't learn anything from it. Overall I won't recommend others to take his class.

Professor Wheeler was the best math instructor I ever had. I previously tried many Math classes in the past and either and had to drop them because I was doing so horrible. He offers a lot of help, 3 help sessions a week not including the ones offered by the AIs. He genuinely cares about his students and want them to pass. Great professor!

I took M119 my freshman year and ended up having to drop it because i was doing so bad. Took A118 with Wheeler sophomore year and got almost an A+, easily. He can be all over the place at times, but he offers 3 help sessions every week, plus ones his ta's hold.  If you go to class and do webwork it is a VERY easy A.

Wheeler flat out sucks! He never once explained the concept of what he was attempting to teach. He rushed through class, he doesn't help at help sessions and he never responds to emails. Plus, he sounds like Mr. Mackey from South Park.

THIS CLASS IS HORRIBLE 1. his test times are horrible 2. he doesnt care about any indivudial students 3. NEVER emails back 4.stumbles in to class, mumbles when he talks, and his handwriting is horrible 5. thinks the world if finite. 6. never teaches the basics 7. moves way to fast 8. HE REPEATS himself about 9millino times a class.DO NOT TAKE CLASS

This is a terrible class. He teaches way too fast. The only way to learn in this class is going to the help sessions with the TA's. Don't bother going to his office hours, its a waste of time. Don't email him, he won't answer you. If you were once good at math, that time is over. DO NOT TAKE, TAKE M118 INSTEAD!!!!

I HATE math and got Bs and Cs in it all through high school. This class is great and I have an A. It is presented in a way comprehensible to non-math people. You get out of the class what you put in. Do the homework and attend class and you'll do well. Wheeler is helpful and offers many help sessions throughout the week for further instruction.

Chicken scratch, his writing is horrible, incomprehensible. He goes way too fast and doesnt actually teach the basics of how to solve the problems on exams, he just jumps right into it. Also he has made up rules, such st DTDR, STDR no Reps/Reps, all of those are not actual mathematical laws or theories, just wheelers way of making finite harder.
Do not take this class!

I'm taking his class right now and I don't think it's that bad. If you go to class,you'll do well in his exams.Also do all the homework on webwork and practice exams. He is always willing to help you when you don't understand something. People are just exaggerating.

He is a very stubborn man who digresses in class often. His exams are too often and at inconvienent times. His way "is the only way" and takes off quality points even you get all the multiple choice right. Biggest mistake of my life to take this class.

Take it from someone who's never been good at Math: if you try and pay attention, you will pass easily. 80% of negative ratings come from those who wish they could just skip every day. Look; bring your laptop, be on Facebook the first 30 mins, learn the last 5 and type in your class key. Easiest. A. Ever.

Great professor who goes VERY far out of his way to help students with 3 times a week help sessions. Most who don't like him are the ones who don't try at all in his class. Pay attention and put forth effort and this is an easy math class. There are tons of different ways to get help from Wheeler personally if you are struggling.

Prof. Wheeler was a great teacher. He talked fast, but if you listened well and pay close attention... his ways of math actually make sense. Although it was hard to get help from others because the way he taught it and the way others taught it were completely different. Overall... good prof. that reminds you of your sweet grandparents back home!:)

Prof. Wheeler's intentions are all good and well but can be very condescending. He thinks his way of math is the best and only way. He does offer help sessions 3 days a week which is ok, unless you can't make them. Don't visit help centers becasue the tutors there don't know "his" math. Not flexable with dates, Saturday exams at 8am suck.

He is an interesting professor. He talks pretty fast and can sometimes be random, but he KNOWS and LOVES finite!!! He will help you pass if you attend his office hours and weekly reviews in addition to the class. He is Great and I HIGHLY recommend everyone to take his class if you have to take finite!

He speaks towards the board instead of the students. His class wasn't too bad, but you can tell his students are struggling. He talks fast and doesn't wait around for questions. He doesn't really teach the material you need for the class work that day.

Textbook is on cd (has helpful video examples and was only $10 or so), Class key for attendance *can skip class easily, haha.*, Wears a bowtie and plays classical music at beginning of class...Not the best at explaining, but is enthusiastic!  Be sure to make good use of the chatroom when doing webwork ;)

He's very fast in regular lecture, but he takes his time and explains everything in the help sessions. If you find the large class size daunting and can't focus (or even if you don't) you definitely need to attend the help sessions (3 times a week). They help a bunch. Almost all the homework is online. Textbook is on the computer.

I'm really bad at math so I was afraid to take this course, but it was the easiest math class I've ever taken. If you go to class everyday and really pay attention towards the end of class, you should do fine. He wastes a lot of time in the beginning and rushes to teach new material at the end, so just make sure you are listening at the end

ONLY TAKE IF YOU HAVE TO. the chat room is more helpful then him, and while he is enthusiastic about math, he cannot teach it. you almost never learn all you need to for the math homework, and his help sessions are rarely useful. his AI's might be helpful, but since he's discredited them i'm not certain. be ready to teach yourself how to work math.
Wheeler is very into what he is teaching and everyday gives me a good laugh! He goes off onto any different tangents while teaching but I think he is an overall good prof.

I'm not very good at math, so this was nerve-wracking to begin with. He rambles A LOT, and his help sessions are not all that helpful despite their frequency. Send your class key every day, do the class work and web work, and show your work on exams! That's what is keeping me at a B!

While in-class much of what he said was incomprehensible, and we didn't always learn what we were expected to know for homework, he obviously cared whether we passed or failed. Anyone who didn't understand what he taught in-class was welcome to get one-on-one help. Maybe not a great professor, but certainly a good one.

Wheeler is the most caring professor I have ever had. He cares so much about his students and wantes everyone to pass. He sometime seems unorganized, and a little boggle-minded but talking to him one-on-one is SO helpful. Everyone is so rude to him when he tries SO hard to be a helpful teacher. He seems to be a great professor.

Very nice man. You can tell he generally cares for the success of his students, however he is not so good at teaching math. The oncoarse chatroom will be a  better teacher than him. If it wasn't for participation points i wouldn't have attended a single one of the useless lectures.

I never looked forward to a single class. Nothing personal against him, but the poor man is so disorganized and doesn't even realize how incoherent he is when it comes to teaching math. E-homework every class; spent most of the nights on class message board with other students trying to learn it. Tests were on weekend mornings and painfully long.

Words can't explain how I and many feel about this man. He seriously needs to go teach math in a nursing home where he wouldn't get the rise of going up to a student in a random lecture class of 200 students and asking them to introduce themselves to the whole class.

I truly believe this man is insane.  He won't start talking at his useless help sessions until every single person there has been introduced to each other.  He doesn't talk about anything relevant in class until the last 2 minutes and he won't accept any method but his own convoluted psychotic ways.  A BS class, wish I had never take it.
Not the best professor extremely ambiguous

Be prepared to teach yourself! Prof Wheeler likes to talk about everything BUT the problem he's working on. If you pay attention, you'll get the basic point, but I spent many nights teaching the material to myself!

Hate does'nt begin to describe my feelings for this class.  This man is demeaning, belittling, and a closet-jerk (he's mean to people but hides it with a smile and a nice tone of voice).  Out of a 50 minute class, the first 25-30 minutes is spent talking about why the red light on his mic is on or rambling about easy homework.  WASTE OF MY LIFE!!!

This was one of the most miserable class experiences of my life.  Wheeler rambles and tends to try to "flesh out" the characters in his math problems on occasion, which only then makes students zone out on his overall point.  In general, I hated his class.  Don't take Wheeler's class if you can help it.

This man genuinely wants to be here to teach.  He schedules help sessions in abundance.  He explains a problem to death, making sure he has covered every single detail, again and again.  He has a charm and twinkle that is unmatched by any professor I've ever had.  He is your best bet!!

He wasn't actually my professor, but he was in the room before me, and just listening to him in the hall was pretty bad. I tried talking to him before class once, to be friendly, and he was quite rude and curt. He also blares this really obnoxiously generic classical music before each class, as if he's trying to ACT the way a professor should.
If he didn't take an attendance grade I would not go to class because there is no point.

Awful professor.  I tried on numerous occasions to get a hold of him via email and in class. He only responded once and that was weeks after.  Exams long and awful. Literally 10 multiple choice options.  Took points off for guessing on the two short answer questions. Its like he wanted his students to fail. Seemed nice but that's all i can say.

Wheeler rambles on which makes it REALLY hard to focus in class, which in turn makes you miss important things. He is NOT considerate of student's struggles and personal needs, and it's his TAs that lead his help sessions. He is hard to follow and complicates things with his rambling on. Hes the only one who teaches A118 (sucks), but dont take M118

Avoid him if you can! He sucks. Seriously, never finishes what he wants to teach and then you don't have a prayer with the homework.  He wastes so much class time, that it's unbelievable.  Plus, he teaches as though he is teaching children. If you have any other options, DO NOT take his classes.

He often turns something that should take just a few minutes to explain into an entire class meeting, and ends up not teaching what we need to learn in class. He however tries to compensate for lost time with videos. Also, he rarely let us out on time! He would always ask for us to send in our numbers after time was up!(class participation grade)

Professor is interesting, makes finite math easy to understand. Whatever you don't understand, he does help sessions 3 days a week. No excuse to get a bad grade. I suck at math, but did very well in this class. However, you have to do the work and study. Overall very good.
he likes to ramble on

Crazy! He plays classical music before every class and gets very "involved" in his lectures (waving his arms around, etc.) GO TO CLASS (he takes attendance). Finite is generally confusing, and he gives you looooots of opportunites for help. Not a very understanding teacher though... he can be surprisingly catty at times.
SELFISH

This class is better than regular finite if you are looking to study.  You will definitely need to do the webwork and keep up to get a good grade.  I did and it is an easy A.  The lectures are often a waste of time, so bring a book.  He doesn't throw wild cards at you on the exam.  So, yeah, they were very easy.
He is crazy.  Worst teacher.  don't take finite with him.
Worst professor, and worst class.  Dont take it.  Youre better off with regular finite where you can get a tutor.

The most ridiculous teacher I've ever had. You can teach yourself everything just by doing the homework, but he takes attendance so unless you want to fail, you actually have to go listen to him ramble about the people in his absurd story problems without actually teaching you how to do said problems. Horrible class.

This is the single worst teacher I have ever had in my life. Speaks in circles for 45 minutes about nothing, then teaches something new in the last 5 minutes before class. Homework is always online on Webwork, which is ALWAYS down or broken. Will not give tutors, and says to come to help sessions instead, even when they are inaccessable.

Prof. Wheeler is an excellent teacher.  It is very rare that a Math professor is excited about the material, and donates time out of his day for helpful study sessions.  He lectures in a way that makes the subject easier to understand.  I would recommend him to all!!

I would have made a good grade had participation not been such a large factor in the final grade. I understood all the material, so I found it unecessary to go to class. Prof. Wheeler did not share my point of view.

He never liked to take questions before class, so don't try, it just makes him angrey.  He curved all the tests so that made a big difference in my grade. The webwork and participation scores really do help your grade. The class could have been worse, although my roomate and I resorted to playing hangman for most of the classes.

First math class ever to have a chance at an A.If your bad at math,take this class with Wheeler,best with someone you know so you can study together.Talks way to much about NOTHING AT ALL.REPEATES HIMSELF.133 times in one class.By end just read paper in class,learned with roomie later.Final Blew,know STDR stuff,{&(. Overall happy I got a good grade
pain in the ass, really smart guy...wish he wouldnt talk so much and eased up on the webwork

I really like Prof Wheeler! Yes, he rambles on forever and ever, but he is one of the only math professors I have ever understood. Plus, he has his own help sessions three times a week, he doesnt make his AIs do it.  I have done well so far and I am glad I have him!

He helped me thoroughly understand Calculus II when I had a random hippie for a "professor" for Calc I.  I didn't learn much from the hippie.  I appreciate Wheeler taking time out to hold help sessions and office hours.

He is the only math teacher that will ever explain anything instead of just saying "thats how it is, accept it" even if he does explain more then he should, there is no way you wont understand something

He is very knowledgable and extremely helpful. He will make time to meet w/ you outside of class and had scheduled help sessions the night before homework is due.  Calc was difficult, but with another professor i would have probally failed.  AND he has a calculator based section which helps alot, even just to picture what's going on.
he is a nice guy. he just doens't know when to stop talking. he goes into all this unneccesary info about the problems.you have to kinda sift through his words to get to what you really need to know.

Definitely makes things way harder than they have to be.  Best thing is to ignore him and teach yourself through the book, or find someone else to help you along.  Exams aren't that bad as long as you know the material... besure to know his definitions for

If he stays this easy then I dont have a problem with math this semester. He explained how a circle was round for like ten minutes... then proceeded to say it can roll... he wants his students to understand and not fall behind
Son . . . the math don't lie! HAHAHAH!
don't choose him unless you have no choice

Wheeler took time out of his already-busy schedule to meet with me every day after class to help me with homework.  He is the reason I made it through that class (the 3rd time!)  Had I known about him before, I would have registered for his section.
Don't let anyone tell you to take this class because it's easier than M118.  Given the chance, he will fail your you know what!!!
No Comments
Worst math class ever.  Made everything more difficult and confusing.  Tests were awful.  He is the devil in a bow tie.
I did really well in this class an dI think it was because he was such a great teacher. He was very helpful and explained things very well.
I took finite math three times and i finally past it with Wheeler.
No Comments
Only brings up new material the last 5 min,tests are mult.choice,but w/15options
Easy to understand.  Always available and helpful during OFFICE HOURS.

Wooldridge is genuinely the GOAT. Everyone on here saying shes bad literally didnt go to class. Half the time she would put the exam questions in her slides and talk about everything that would appear on the exam in class. Easiest I-Core class, good lecturer, highly recommend only if you go to class.

I LOVE LOVE LOVE HER!!! She is the nicest professor I've ever had. Also, she makes it so easy to succeed. Her lectures are amazing. She gives out topic lists for exams so that you don't have to memorize everything she's talked about in lecture. You also get a notecard for exams. Take Wooldridge for I-Core Marketing!!!
Gives supporting examples to the slides and wants students to succeed. Always rambling on about Kenya and her son.

She gives exam topic lists for each module that you can cross-reference w/ slides and the book, so it is easy to study. She barely gives homework, wants everyone to succeed, and genuinely tries to make class fun and engaging. She does talk a lot, but she is very knowledgeable and has fairly in-depth slides.

I don't understand why Barbara's rating is so low. Her slides are clear, and she's incredibly empathetic. She genuinely cares about her students and creates a safe discussion environment. After mid-term OCQs, she immediately implemented feedback, something my other ICore professors didn't do. She is caring, which I find most important.

She's so sweet and caring, fosters participation and her content is really interesting and engaging. She gives a lot of real world examples and doesn't give out basically any homework so you can focus on the lectures.

These other ratings are so wrong. Prof is a great speaker and captures her audience. She includes a lot of activities creating a unique learning environment. She is a great professor to talk to if you take the time to come up to her before or after class or go to her office hours. I 100% recommend her, she is one of the best I-core professors.

She is the nicest teacher ever, do NOT listen to these reviews. Her slide decks aren't just verbatim what she's saying, and she'll provide real world examples to make the content easier to understand. Plus, she legit GIVES OUT CANDY IF YOU PAY ATTENTION. Truly my favorite i-core professor and criminally underrated on here. Barb4life

Class feels like elementary school, spends half the class handing out candy instead of actually teaching, acts nice but can come off as very condescending. Class time felt useless, exams are pretty easy and all of the material can be learned much easier by just reading the book and other materials.
Professor is racist against Indian students

She changes the course every semester to optimize so alot of complaints about the course have been resolved. I will say she is a teacher who tries to engage her class a lot and its a bit corny at times but not in a bad way. Just show up and make a good cheat sheet for tests. There is plenty of practice material.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: People stop showing up to lecture 3 weeks in. Does not really care for her students. Won't stop talking about her own job in africa. Take someone else if you can for ICORE
Teacher is racist toward indian students.
She is truly very kind just not a great lecturer. Lectures will be very long and boring. There are LOTS of useless homeworks but the exams are fairly easy plus you get a notecard.
if u want to learn from someone who doesn't know how to create a slide deck or teach a class pick her

While Barbara has good intentions for her students at heart, she (unfortunately) is unable to translate it into her teaching. Lectures are hard to follow. Attempts to engage students in class often fall upon deaf ears, and there is more awkward silence than beneficial discussion. Notecard made exams very easy.
drop immediately

Half the class wouldn't even show up to lecture because it was useless. She wastes so much time going on tangents or stating very obvious things you really learn nothing. Not terribly difficult. Exams were pretty easy but be prepared for this class to waste your time.

Exam is 50 MCQ. You have 2 Quizzes similar to questions you will get on the exam, 1 before midterm and final. She gives extra credit opportunities. Make sure to go to her class and pay attention to all the examples she gives(including her personal life examples about her son and husband). She is a very nice professor and cares about her students.
Good professor, poorly written exams.

Assigning 300 multiple choice questions a week does nothing for my learning, makes me extremely apathetic toward the class, and actually makes me detest marketing. I don't understand the decision making process behind assigning so many low-effort MCQs a week, do something more interactive that actually makes people think instead of pressing buttons

Nice lady but god awful lectures and don't get me started on the quizzes. 15 minute quizzes that you can't go back and review your answers once you go to the NEXT QUESTION! 50% of class was video and was a waste of time. 80% of the test was book and the 20% was her in class so you have to go but if it was all textbook there would be no point
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wastes so much class time playing vids instead of teaching. Doesn't teach at all, and makes the homework quizzes extremely difficult. As a marketing major, I shouldn't be struggling this much in this course. Additionally, she is extremely rude when reaching out via email. She shouldn't be allowed to teach Icore.

Graded only by quizzes she "discusses in class" but they are the most difficult quizzes I've ever had. I'm shocked at how difficult she makes it to get an A for a marketing class. She one time made us watch a 10-minute video on a person eating chicken tenders and then quizzed us on it and the quiz was extremely difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: There is no value in attending her lectures as they contain little to no materials that you will be tested on. Her quizzes are hyper-specific to random things she will say in lecture, and most people get very low scores on them. The class also consists of watching 30 minutes worth of YouTube videos. She is a nice lady tho.

Seems like a really nice lady. However, she really should not be an i-core teacher. Coming to class did not help at all. Also the quizzes she gave (which nobody does well on) are pretty useless. I wouldn't say she is a bad person. She seems sweet. But she should consider teaching outside of i-core.
Gives you quizzes that are insanely hard which brings your grade down. You are at a disadvantage in taking her because of these quizzes. Don't take her for ICORE if you can avoid it.

She displayed a lack of enthusiasm/involvement in the lectures, relying upon YouTube videos for class. The quizzes were extremely specific about in-class info & connect homework was too long. I would have been just as successful in this course watching marketing YouTube videos and reading the textbook on my own rather than attending class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I cannot believe that she is an iCore professor. She has zero respect for students or their education. Will show up 20 minutes late to a class with no apology or canvas announcement. I do not think she actually understands anything that she is teaching. She reads off of a paper throughout the whole entire class and shows us YouTube videos.

She was late, her lessons consisted of playing 10 different videos, and not teaching us whatsoever. The questions we were quizzed on where about examples she mentioned once in class. I felt as if going to her class was wasting my time. I absolutely do not recommend her class to anyone. She is also lowkey rude to the students that bother to show up.

The thing I would advise is to make sure you are ready, because there are a lot of quick assignments, and missing just a few can lower your grade by a decent amount. Don't get complacent, and read the syllabus. It is really easy not to put a lot of effort into the mid-semester project, and it is worth a large amount of the final grade.
She is the sweetest professor at IU.

Super sweet professor. Cared a lot about students succeeding. Material was digestible. Graded mostly on Canvas quizzes (unlimited attempts), homework assignments (got full credit if you did everything correctly), 2 exams, and a big project. Very easy to do well!

I adore this woman. She is so attentive, knows students' names, and is easy to reach. The class is nicely structured and easy to follow, even when not in class. It's easy to follow for projects as she provides step by step instructions and clear directives.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher for this class. Super understanding if you are unable to submit any assignments, gives clear feedback, and is very easy to reach outside of class. There are a lot of pre-lecture assignments, but they are just videos to watch through. Lots of people don't end up watching, but they ultimately are helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice professor who clearly cares about the subject and is always kind and supportive with students. Had her for I123 and she explained all topics very intuitively and easily, making the class a breeze (for those who attend!). Would certainly take again.

This is a great class. Dr. Wood and the TAs are very supportive. If you feel a grade is unfair (like the review below), talk to them! They're open to discussion and have added points back when my reasoning made sense. Accusing them of lazy AI grading without evidence is unfair and malicious. I've learned a lot and truly appreciate their efforts.

Shes very bubbly and tried to make the material as fun as possible. However, I noticed the TA's she used were very lazy/tough at grading, using AI to directly compare your answer to an example answer. this resulted in many of my projects being an 80%, as AI nitpicked the hell out of it. My points just didnt fit the examples points.
So unbelievably boring I would rather do anything than actually go to this class.
Attend the lectures! But also make sure you do the assigned videos before hand! I would also recommend going over things you miss in quizzes with her during office hours.

such a smart and hardworking woman!!! i really enjoyed her class, would 100% recommend!!! it's not difficult at all, every week there's an exploration and open note quiz due on sunday. very sweet and caring professor.
Ask him his chipotle order

I have yet to take F-420 with Prof. Woeppel until the spring semester, but his F-303 class was easily my most enjoyable as a junior. Structured lectures, yet extremely entertaining and engaging. Exams are fair and he brings the best out of his students. I'm certain his F-420 class will be no different. Bad reviews are from the lazy unmotivated.

Michael Woeppel is passionate about the success of his students and creates a fun learning environment through in-class exercises and real-world applications. He is very good at writing fair yet challenging exams with no surprises. He is also very good at helping students prepare for exams by hosting review sessions the night before exam day.

Mike tried his best to teach a class that he had little experience with, but I would prefer a professor who can tell marvelous stories about venture capital and understand the tricks behind rather than a young one who just prepares from readings and notes. I hope he can improve the way he manages class discussion in future classes.

Easiest class I've taken at IU (senior). Professor Woeppel was the most apathetic professor I've had and it isn't close. Never prepared for class, commonly said his own notes were incorrect and didn't care about student learning. If you want an easy A take professor Woeppel. If you want to learn anything about personal finance stay far away.

Mike's class is my favorite class I've taken at IU. The material was actually useful and Mike was engaging and kept the class lively (which was much needed at 8am). This class was straightforward. Attend class, complete the homework and use the notes and practice questions to prep for the exams and you'll be fine. Cannot say enough good things.

Professor Wood was very enthusiastic about the content, so lectures were always interesting. My biggest issue was with the grading, criteria was often confusing and the TAs could be overly harsh in their scoring. The attendance policy was also rather inflexible, there were no grace days. The format of the lecture quizzes also proved challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I cannot recommend Justin or I216 highly enough. He is a fantastic lecturer, extremely passionate about the subject, and consistently updates his course to keep it up-to-date with the latest developments in AI. Grading criteria can be a little unclear sometimes, but if you're at all interested in AI, take this class!

Professor Woods is a really nice and smart guy. The class was pretty simple, just attend lecture, do the quizzes on time (one quiz per lecture, due on sunday, can use your notes) and make an effort on the reflection essays and you'll do fine. Grade is 50/50 quizzes and short 600 word essays, NO EXAMS!! Easy class for cognitive science credit.

The best professor I have had at IU. She is extremely personable, took the time to really get to know the class. Her notes are laid out very well, and she welcomes questions. The class is very discussion based, and attendance is important. She is super understanding when it comes to missing class for whatever reason. Highly recommend this course!

Oh my Angie made going to class fun. She took the time to learn each student by name/have small talk most days. Easy class, manageable workload, you do not have to come to class on test days!! Attendance is weighted highly, each day you miss is -1% of your grade. She likes to be super fair (did not give extensions unless you were basically dying).

Angie was one of my favorite professors. She was very sweet and accommodating in and out of class. Her class was not too difficult and the workload was extremely manageable. I would definitely take one of her classes again, and I recommend taking her courses if you have the opportunity. She is a great person and very smart, I loved her!
This online course is very easy, provided that you carefully read the weekly presentation slides. This course is much easier than others. The professor also offers extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Wong is so sweet and kind. She really cares about her students, and tries to be engaging and fun. I really enjoyed her class. She regularly gives feedback on discussion posts, and is very encouraging.

she was so sweet and engaging and always gave such good feedback on discussion posts! the book is mandatory but u could skim it and get the info you needed and it can be found for free online! your grade is basically quiz/test grades but they come straight from modules and questions are often repeated later. easy class and nice prof overall
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is extremely helpful in getting students ready for the real world with jobs and internships. I highly recommend this class to get prepared for life outside of school. Lectures can be boring, but homework helps with creating a resume, cover page, references. etc. She takes attendance everyday and offers extra credit too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Angie is a great person! The class is about preparing for the career world. Attendance is mandatory but no exams or quizzes, only homework. She's funny and extremely caring. She's always willing to help and gives a lot of guidance to her students. Definitely recommend and easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Wright was awesome but I would not take the course again. If I had known what it actually was I would not have taken it. The exams were hard and very wordy but multiple choice.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My favorite professor that I have had at IU so far. He cares a lot about his students and always starts the class by talking about what we have going on. Very understanding of what we have going on and will not let you fail the class. The class is just small online quizzes and 3 exams, but he gives so many extra credit opportunities.
A few papers, a couple exams. Not too hard, but practically useful content. Good intro to media course.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tons of useful information about media, great intro course. Professor is kind and answers emails fast. Highly recommend.

Took this class asynch, not a media major and had slight interest in media but he squashed that. class is entirely long written papers with 2 hard exams (3 hour exams because he knows they are terrible). I hope he reads these so he does better. I walked away from this class knowing nothing about media because i dont learn by writing essays.

For being an introductory and asynch class, it was excessively difficult. There are 4 papers (for a 7 week class that seems too much) and 2 extremely difficult exams. When people sign up for a media class they aren't expecting it to be an english/writing class, and honestly I would've learned a lot more if he had traditional assignments/quizzes.
Best professor I've had, the class was very informative while not being too challenging.

The class itself is a hard class. He makes it so enjoyable and understands that you also have a life and things that go on too. An amazing human. Also talks about his family a lot which is pure :). love this man.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not an easy class, but a great professor. Knows alot and cares about his students.
Pual is a great teacher & even better guy. Truly cares about his students. He held an outside of normal class time review session for each exam. Really wants students to succeed.
most informative course taken in m school so far. great lectures n out of class support
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hard class, but learned a ton. I'm SPSS proficient now. Lots of job ads in marketing and advertising ask for this. Glad I took.

By far one of the worst classes I have taken at IU. Don't take it unless you're required to. Paul is a nice guy, but would go on a 20-minute side story about how to do something in SPSS and then say "you don't need to know this though" or "this is getting too complicated for our purposes, but..." Honestly don't think I actually learned anything.

Audience Analysis is a dry topic, it's mainly research procedures. The content was hard to get behind because it's just so boring, but Prof. Wright was relatable and tried to make the class interesting. He has a good personality and wants his students to succeed. Definitely recommend him, the course however I wouldn't recommend unless required.

I had Paul for Audience Analysis, which is essentially a media statistics class, and I think he did the best he could given how dry the material is. His lectures were easy to understand and he provided a lot of examples to flesh out the concepts. However, he does give pop quizzes on reading. He genuinely cares about students and wants your success.

Paul is a funny and interesting teacher. He cares about his student's learning and will take the time to go over concepts we didn't understand. Your final grade is in your own hands because if you go to class and pay attention it's easy to get a goo grade.

He makes class fun, but at times, you need to pay attention since it's mostly lectures. He's pretty cool in letting you give him input during class and is easy to talk to in regards to the material and help you might need.
Paul is a great, funny and interesting professor. Really knows his subject and is interactive with the class in a fun way. Relates to the students well. Show up to class and you'll get an A
Interesting class and he teaches it well. He makes class fun and he makes you want to show up. No required textbook for the class I took, everything was online.

Im still currently in this class, but Professor Wray has been amazing. She is so helpful, has engaging class material and is super understanding. After I had to miss several classes for family reasons, Professor Wray was incredibly understanding and flexible, and it was clear to me she really cares about her students.

Only good things to say about Professor Wray! She's very personable and kind. She goes over the material for tests before and after giving it, so you learn about your mistakes and get to study more efficiently.

Profesora Wray is the best. She is very kind and you can tell she genuinely is invested in her students. She is very forgiving and understanding if you need help/extensions. If you give 100% genuine effort, you will be fine.

This woman is seriously one of the kindest teachers I have ever had in my life. She is so caring and so understanding. She is super chill, and she encourages her students well. Goes over everything on the exam, grades mostly for effort, makes the class genuinely interesting. If you're going to take this class, Wray is a MUST. Take it with her.

One of the nicest people you'll meet. Very relaxed on deadlines. Always checks up on her students. Definitely would recommend her for any class. Go to class and watch the videos outside of class because everything will be on the exams. She has review sessions before the exams and they are so helpful. She pretty much gives the answers to you. 10/10

Cares more about effort than precision/accuracy. Heavy focus on speaking skills. Will offer you extensions if you need them! Absolute gem of a professor who actually cares about her students, love ya profe! :)
I loved her as a teacher and person I would recommend her for sure.

Dr. Wright is a great sociology teacher. His lectures make the material easy to understand and as long as you put in the work each week you will do good. He makes a really useful study guide before exams and he isnt too tough of a grader. He gives room for extra credit and make up assignments too so I would definitely take his course again
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Wright was super awesome! I was interested in Sociology beforehand, but Dr. Wright's enthusiasm made less-interesting topics enjoyable to learn about. The modules were highly organized and very easy to navigate. The subject material was always interesting and easy to understand, and the homework was definitely manageable.

Great professor and a class that I thoroughly enjoyed, enough to change my major to sociology. Made lectures and the overall workload for the week very easy to understand and it was all layed out each week. Was very understanding of Covid situation and made sure to offer a lot of extra credit. Overall great guy. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class was the best class I have taken at IU. Professor Wright is super caring and truly wants what is best for his students. He is very passionate about what he teaches as well. Would highly recommend taking this class with him!
Professor Wright was one of the best professors I had at IU! He made the course material very interesting. Very easy class to get a good grade if you pay attention. Highly recommend!
As long as you do the readings and participate you'll do great in his classes
(Sociology of sport) His class is amazing and he's a great professor. He keeps things interesting and often refers to current sporting events. Take him if you can, strongly recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Eric really cares about what he is teaching and tries his best to make it interesting. The class is very easy if you come to every lecture and actually pay attention.
One of my favorite profs, wish I could have him again.

Eric thinks very highly of his class, will give at least 60 pages worth of reading for every class. If you ask him a question he will avoid it and tell you to reread the readings. His lectures are long and boring and always go past the time allotted.
Eric really loves teaching and it shows in his class. He's funny and very enthusiastic. It was a good class and pretty easy to do well. If you attend and do the readings, you will get an A.

Enthusiastic instructor! Very passionate about his field of study, I would recommend this class. He does have daily reading quizzes or short writing responses to class material, but gives you guided reading questions that make skimming easy.

He does not post his notes online so you have to go to class and gives random pop quiz's about the reading the night before. Gives his opinion about certain topics which gets very annoying. Sweats a lot but that has nothing to do with his teaching style. When you go to office hours he says look in the book when the book is not clear.
Go to class, lots of in-class assignments and quizzes. Hard to recover if you don't go to class. Eric is really cool though, and gives extra credit

Eric is a super cool and funny dude. I loved his class and it was super easy. If you don't get at least a B+ then you didn't even try because he does everything in his power to make the students succeed.

Eric is a funny, outgoing professor that tries to make his lectures fun attend. You definitely have to attend every class in order to do well in this class. Exams aren't hard as long as you actually study. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS- he wants to help as much as he can! He is one of my favorite professors by far.

Genuine and funny guy. Always finds a way to make class interesting, eager to discuss things that might make you uncomfortable but that's what makes it a good class. Readings aren't too intense. Overall loved this class.

I took S100 my freshman year and really enjoyed it. I decided to change my major to sociology primarily because of this class and how interesting professor Wright made it. He is a high energy professor with interesting lectures. When the more boring material comes up, he finds a way to make it bearable and adds his energy to it. He's great!

At first, I was intimidated by the long readings for the course. After the first exam though, I realized that it's only necessary to skim the chapters and know the definitions. He gives out study guide for exams that basically cover the entire thing. He's young and funny, so easy to understand and relate too. Always wants students at office hours.

He was a good teacher and I actually learned a lot, so, if you want to learn and are passionate about polysci, he is the teacher for you. He is passionate about it and enjoys everything he teaches, so I recommend him. He is also a good guy. The class in general is just a little hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Wright was not helpful in the slightest and refused to post any sort of grades online. When asked for help by email, he took his sweet time to get back to me.

Prof. Wright is a well-known expert in congressional elections and state politics. He always combined a great mixture of objectiveness and sarcastic humor with his lectures. Overall great professor who really tries to get his students excited on subject matter. Do the readings: they're crucial for the tests. And just come to class and participate.

Wright was overall okay. Sometimes I thought he was super passionate and intelligent about what we were discussing but at other times he definitely feels the need to always get the last word and his beliefs shine through in a lot of discussions. Not many assignments at ALL, so what you do has to be very good. I don't regret taking it with him.

Impartial political analyst, who challenges the way you perceive and think about American politics.  He has high expectations, and is not an easy professor, but you learn a lot and will be better off from the hard work.
Completely unorganized and downright boring lectures. The grading procedure was completely incomprehensible. Wright has a narrow point of view when it comes to political analysis.

Contrary to what people have said, you DO need the books for POLS Y200 at least the Elections class because weekly quizzes are based off of them...but they're super simple. He clearly has a passion for this and exudes intelligence about the topic with insight you couldnt get from just anyone. A lot of time devoted to discussion! Loved it.
He knows what he's talking about, but his class can be super boring at times. The tests are kind a bit difficult. Don't need the textbook.

Professor Wright is fantastic! In a current events course, we would discuss the election for about half the classs while then discussing basic political ideas for the second half. I will say that this is not an easy class. Wright's exams are all free response, however if you are able to write clearly and concisely, you will do very well in Y200

You can tell he is really interested in what he is teaching. He is really smart and gives good lectures. You know all of the material before the test but he is still a tough grader. overall awesome class and very interesting.

The subject matter is interesting, but the class itself isn't. The first 50 minutes is just pretentious students debating and showing off, and the last part is him trying to figure out how to show us a video on Youtube. The homework is just online quizzes made by the AIs and the tests are graded by them too, and pretty harshly in my opinion.

He is a great professor! He enjoys debates in class and assigns online quizzes which are quite easy if you do the readings. He is entertaining, and sometimes has trouble with technology, which normally annoy me, but he makes it funny. It's a great class!

Although you will no doubt learn about Elections, the professor is completely uninterested in his students, and is an incompetent critical analyzer. I had to send a message to the dean of students to get him to respond to emails. Went in to talk about grad school, and he basically told me not to try to get in to Yale. Funny how he couldn't either.

Moderately interesting professor. I got tired of him constantly adjusting his hearing aids and complaining of the ringing in his ears. The first class I had with him and his wife was useless, he was better at explaining things though. The second class the AI was better and I took away something. Not bad, but there are better profs.
Horrible class. Horrible TA. Don't take.

This isn't a class. It's a nightmare come true. If you don't care about grades then maybe he's passable as interesting, but the level of organization was so poor in this class, not to mention his TA was completely incompetent. Don't take this class unless you don't care what grade you get.

Ridiculously difficult multiple choice tests- I managed a 58/60 on our first midterm but even though I obviously knew the information got a 16/40 on the multiple choice section. Boring lectures with uninteresting topics; I know it's only a midterm election, but nonetheless, it should've been more interesting.

What a nightmare. I'm an A student with a high interest in politics, yet he somehow manages to make this class nearly impossible. Grading methods are incomprehensible, especially since the AI isn't even a politics student - he studies management! Wright is a nice guy but unfortunately cannot make a passable test.

While he is a nice guy, he is literally useless as teacher. His A.I. is clueless about what is going on and didn't even know that a test was coming up, even though he is the one that does all the grading. He refuses to do review in class and students are literally pulling their hair out over the nonsense which the class is. Avoid at all costs.
Testing was completely unfair and ambiguous, and even when all students struggled on it and complained, he was completely unreceptive and stubborn about grading.

Definitely knows what he's talking about.  Great discussion leader, but doesn't always know what's going on in terms of his own assignments.  Really nice guy though, wish I could have taken more than 2 classes with him.
tests are extremely hard.  lectures are boring.
Great teacher...but AI's were terrible and didn't seem to know what was going on.
AI were terrible, but prof Wright is a cool guy!! Tests were really difficult, but the extra credit movies were points that were easy to get.

Smart, clever, and witty. I missed some classes, but most of what he covers in lecture is in the book. Tests are not that hard if you study and the essay assignments are easy. Way better than his wife because he can explain things and he's a logical human being. Probably the best intro class I've taken.
great class
Nice guy...kinda like your cool grandpa.

Prof Wright was a nice man, very interested in politics but didn't make class super interesting.  His tests were pretty hard, but had 3-5 points of extra credit. Going to class is suggested because he has test questions about recent news that he covers in lecture and sometimes gives bonus points for attending.
I agree--AIs are terrible!
A very frustating class mainly due to the AI's. The exams are not very fair as he tests you on material that he barely covers in class. You do get opportunities to earn extra credit though.
He's ok, but his AIs do not seem to know what they are doing.  It is best to go straight to prof. wright with your questions because the AI will not be able to help.
Does not really show up for office hours or meetings with students

I took every class that Professor Wright offered a while, due to my own laziness, I struggled in one of his classes I still grew to appreciate his intelligence and intense understanding of the subject matter. Now that I work in politics, I can look back and truly respect his insightfulness.
Very interesting professor
Its a shame he isn't nearly as good a teacher as his wife.
Good guy...the tests are harder than you would expect.
Great lecturer, very nice guy, knows tons on the subject. Tests aren't exactly easy, but it's a great class.
No Comments

Professor Wu is very knowledgeable, but the class format is incredibly dull. Also, not suitable for non-history majors. Tests happen every 3 weeks and are based entirely on remembering assigned readings/sources. The class size also attracts a lot of non-history majors, so discussion is often not very insightful or relevant to the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Love her and her class so much. Passionate about what she teaches and keeps you engaged. Lots of readings but u could get off by just reading one since the daily questions only focus on one. Easy to reach through email. Gives great feedback and clarification so ask for help if u need it. Fairly easy and chill class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Wu is an amazing professor! I absolutely loved her class! The class was well structured and easy to follow. Pay attention in class and do the readings to ensure you'll do well on the papers. She is very open to everyone and gives great insight into thinking more critically about real-world issues. I would take this class again!

Totally regret taking this class. Reading is easy but the structure of the class needs serious work. 2 huge papers- which she doesn't talk about in class at all and is not very helpful when you reach out for help. She's interested in her topics, but only really listens to students who agree with what she's saying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Took this class for a requirement and did not regret it. Prof. Wu knows what she's doing and the class is fairly easy. Attendance policy is fairly lenient and participating is easy and gets you extra credit. Definitely a lot of reading but you can usually get by skimming the articles, but expect daily writing. Overall, a good prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: take prof wu, she's genuinely passionate about history and values class participation, so if you love history and talking she is the best. she also gives out a ton of extra credit if you do the readings and show up to class. i love her!!!

Wonderful Professor and super knowledgable about her topics. Her passion pours through in her lectures and she is all for answering questions you have during class or after. Quite a bit of reading required, but if you are passionate about history and similar topics, these are a breeze. Highly recommend her class and encourage you to participate.

Professor Wu is one of the sweetest teachers I've had at this school. She is super knowledgable in her area of study and encourages students to speak out about the readings or lectures. Lots of reading involved, but if you keep up and do your work, her class will be a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I learned a lot from her class, busting the melting pot myth. I genuinely recommend Professor Wu. She was caring and very knowledgeable about her topic. I would take another one of her classes again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Her class does take work, but through every step of the work she offers extra credit and clear guidelines for all the assignments. She is very understanding, so if you ever have a problem she will help. I loved her lecturing style and the topic of the class. Her class was really eye opening. Would love to take this class again if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class structure was this: Get assigned reading, go home and read, discuss readings in next class, repeat. Little input from Wu during discussions besides asking student opinions. Mischaracterized historical events or completely omitted crucial details. Felt like she was perpetuating an agenda, not an unbiased exploration of history.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Shes a fantastic and a true expert on the history of Asian Americans. Americas Pacific isnt an easy course, but the material is invaluable. Highly recommended, but definitely not a easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She was great. I had Busting the Melting Pot Myth with her and I thoroughly enjoyed the class.
Long readings. Tends to relate EVERYTHING to Asian Americans regardless of relevance. Lectures are sporadic and often confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Wu is fair and a good instructor. She assigns readings that when you can understand what topics she's looking for you'll do well on any homework or test. Bluebooks and papers, she's a fair grader and tries to make the lectures not just death by powerpoint. Good instructor.

Professor Wu is a good instructor. She tried to add elements to lectures so that they don't just turn into death by powerpoint. The readings are chosen for a reason so pay attention to what kind of things she is looking for and you'll be fine. Blue book midterm and final, but she's fair and nice. Would take course with her again.

As an upperclassman, I quite enjoyed this class, although many younger students did not. Yes, the class did require a lot of reading, writing, thinking, and participation, but I ultimately found it to be shockingly interesting and motivational. The midterm was awful, but Professor Wu responded by changing the final exam, which I really appreciated.

The class had a huge amount of work for a 100 level.I don't mind putting significant time and effort in when a class is critically engaging, but this wasn't and the expectations were unclear. Her TA handled all grading  so Wu was not very helpful if you had questions there.

Like a previous reviewer, I'm a bit baffled by the negative feedback. Prof. Wu actually cares about her students, which can sometimes be a rare thing. She leaves excellent feedback on papers and always takes the effort to answer and questions or concerns. She also tries to stimulate  critical thinking with discussions.

I'm a bit baffled by the negative reviews. I think it's obvious that professor Wu takes a lot of effort to stimulate critical thinking, and she was always willing to answer questions or concerns. Feedback is excellent also.

I honestly don't get all the bad reviews. She assigns a reasonable amount of hw. Her feedback on papers is excellent, and she'll gladly stay after class if you need help. Very knowledgeable. Pay attention during lecture (which admittedly was dry at times), do the reading, and ask questions. If you're looking for an easy A, find another professor.

She does not teach, rather, reads notes from her podium the whole class...anyone could have taught this class. Very demanding for a 100 level class. Somehow managed to make World War II (one of my favorite subjects) dry and boring. I do not recommend this professor.

She is honestly my least favorite teacher that I have had here at IU. Somehow she manages to talk so much, but say nothing at all. She has no passion for history.  All of her lectures were padded with some useless clip from YouTube..

This woman is the most boring teacher I've ever had. I'm a history major and she made the subject so dry. She goes way to fast and expects a crazy amount of work from you for a 100 level class. Don't take this class from her unless you have no other choice!

Attendance is not mandatory but he gives random quizzes every so often. They are participation based and can improve your grade by ~10%. Class is hard and he overcomplicates things compared to other professors I've heard about

The funniest thing about him is how bad he is. For our second midterm he asked us what we would want to feel more prepared going into the test. Somebody asked if he could make a review exam so we could know what the exam would be like and what lines of questioning to be ready for. He blankly said "No" and was confused we would ask for that.

Doesn't prepare you for exams which are 80% of your grade. Classes are not engaging by any means, just writing down whatever he reads off a slideshow (which is EVERY single class). Very little resources, you have to teach the entire class to yourself before the exams.

Professor did a horrible job teaching. Forced taught myself for every test. When the final came it was 35% of our grade and average was under 50%. Class GPA was 1.7. 6 people got an F, 7 withdrew while passing, 4 D's, 9 C's, 5 B's, and 2 A's. He gave us 1-10% Ec round up at the end of semester. If that didn't happen everyone would've done poorly.

Professor Wu is an extremely nice person. He is very patient with all students and is always open to questions. The way he formats this class is a little unorthodox. However, he does not require attendance at all. Due to this, it is easy to succeed in this class by learning all the material on your own right before exams.

Easily one of the worst professors at Indiana University. All personal characteristics aside, anyone who takes this class is destined to either do poorly or work an absurd amount of time teaching themselves the material. Xavier was honestly my favorite professor this semester. He is hilarious and really cares about his students. He is very open and makes class discussions fun and engaging. Midterm and final were take home and no surprise quizzes. The readings were sometimes difficult, but overall Xavier is definitely worth taking a class with at IU.

Xavier is so nice! He's very helpful and welcoming. He is careful to make sure that every student is comfortable. He is very flexible with tests and quizzes. We got to choose how we were tested. Xavier cares a lot about his students and is passionate about his field. He is extremely nice and also funny. He grades pretty easily. My only complaint is that a couple of times he said he would do something and did not follow through. However, I would still highly recommend taking his classes.

Prof. Xiao is a very approachable instructor. She is a fair grader who is willing to give one or two extra credits here and there. The content of the course is not too heavy. If one has questions, she can be easily reached through office hours, emails, and other options.

reviews.comment: Overall I like the course very much. The lectures were OK. Instructor was of great help and assignments were not that hard. Case studies were interesting.

Good professor, but old school. Does not give very clear feedback on weekly papers.

The information in the class was never covered on the exams. Exams were super hard and determine your whole grade. He was not available outside of class. The class was very interesting and an easy A. He is a well-respected researcher in his field and KNOWS what he is talking about. He is very open, kind, and easy to talk to.

The class is really interesting and Yarber really knows his stuff, however the tests can be hard. Questions are straight from the book, not so much from lecture. Awesome professor! At first I wasn't sure what to think with the videos, lecture, etc. but overall I loved the class. Human Sexuality and Professor Yarber completely changed my mind for my major & possible career. The tests weren't extremely easy but doing the homework/reading/mastery quizzes online really help! I definitely recommend this course!

Exams are almost entirely out of the textbook - as long as you skim over the chapters before the exam AND do the practice multiple choice and true/false that is provided online (because they are word for word on the test) you will be fine. Awkward lecture at times, but Yarber is an interesting, funny professor who knows his stuff. Do the homework.

TERRIBLE! I showed up to every lecture and it didn't help me a bit on the test. pretty much everything is based off readings in the book, so if you get stuck with him READ EVERYTHING! Tests are impossible, he teaches basically nothing in class.
Easy class as long as you pay attention. Unfortunately he lets you out of class early most of the time which upsets me due to the fact that I am paying for it but oh well!

His lectures are kind of an extension of the textbook so you really need to read/come to class. 3 SexSources and 3 Study Guide pages due at every class. The length was kind of exhausting. Don't be shocked by the videos. They are very open but Yarber knows his stuff.
When it came time for tests, 99% of my class was confused because it seemed like we hadn't learned anything at all. Slightly boring lectures, but not too bad.

He was not very clear about what exactly would be on the test. The lectures are very broad on the context covered and the tests are very specific. I did all of my homework, went to every class, studied for all of my tests and I never managed an A on any of the tests.

Yarber can get boring (and a little out of touch) but he is definitely an expert in the field. I was always learning fun sexual trivia. Tests are super easy, half of the questions are taken from the practice tests in the workbook.

Professor yarber knows his stuff.  you just really need to listen more than anything.  yes you need to take notes, but sometimes its just better to listen for like 10 mins then jot stuff down.  listening is key.  go to discussion or your grade will be the suck. Professor Yarber was a good guy.  He knows Human sexuality very well and is a researcher for the Kinsey institute.  He is interesting and answers lots of questions.  Tests weren't exactly EASY, but the first one was common sense.  make sure you do your homework and go to discussion.
Mind numbingly boring.

No Comments
not super interesting class but super super easy

Assigns readings, but you can succeed w/o reading them. Class is interesting if you like art history. Offers extra credit. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if you miss class you also miss the content. You will do well on the exams if you take good notes and attend every class.

reviews.comment: Class is pretty easy if you pay attention in class. Whatever is taught in lectures appears in exams too. If you know how to communicate your thoughts then writing the exam will not be that bad. Teacher is also understanding and provides interesting lectures.

Boring asf. Lectures were a waste considering tests were open book/computer. However, the TA was a total jerk. Holly graded things so hard for a 100 level class and for kids who were in the class for a gen-ed. If you somehow like art I guess this would be the class. Weitian Yan tho is passionate and nice.

She was decent for this class. The lectures were sometimes difficult to follow along with, especially when she added on to the slides in her own writing. The assignments were manageable and relevant, and she did prepare us well for the exams.

She was very nice and understanding but lectures were extremely dull and hard to follow. She frequently didn't really understand student's questions. Tophats were often right at the beginning of our 9:35 class. Tests were pretty easy if you make a decent cheat sheet and understand the slides fully before.

Professor is very kind and brings occasional treats to class on exam or presentation days. I found lectures rather hard to follow, but I'm not sure what this comes down to. I didn't have a good experience with the final group project and didn't like the material very much, but it wasn't really her fault.

Made data mining very enjoyable. Clear grading critera and HW is not too theory based, which allows us to explore more applicable stuff. Final project was very open ended and helped improve understanding of the material. Fantastic course and professor.
She uses Hacker Rank for lab and homework assignments and your grade depends on how you do. This professor would fail you automatically and her exams were terrible. Avoid this professor.

You will learn a lot in Prof Rodak's class, but the workload is unreasonably heavy. She takes a long time to grade and feedback is unnecessarily nit-picky. It is very difficult to do well in her class, and you can expect to spend 8-10 hours a week on homework.

Do not take this professor. Does a poor job of teaching in class, assigns a lot of busy work that she grades overly harshly. Very unclear on expectations, every assignment I submitted felt like a gamble because her feedback was not helpful.
Professor Umbridge

Welcome to hell!

Rodak is the only teacher I've ever had that will make a passive aggressive comment while giving you a 20% on every "completion" assignment. It shouldn't take two hours to get full points on every assignment (there's like 7 per week) while trying to complete two projects, which are both as fun as drinking a broken glass smoothie.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Please, do not take this professor. Miserable Experience

Please restructure the communications department to remove this professor. I don't know what this school is doing, but genuinely this class requires more time and is more difficult than all of my other classes combined.
Useless, uninteresting, and hard - three words to describe this class. Worst 20 hour per week time investment I had the displeasure of being involved in.

legitimately the largest waste of my time ever. Expect to do assignments every single day except Saturday, like 45 minute learning snapshots, hour long comparison assignments, or drafting reports and slide decks. The total outside of class investment required to get a B is at minimum 10-15 hours.

Avoid Miranda Rodak at all costs.
Legitimately the most passive aggressive and useless teacher/class I have been apart of. Made me consider dropping my finance degree. avoid at all costs
Bad, don't take

Do not take Rodak for C205. She will spend the semester drowning you in busy work due the day after it is assigned and then take 8 weeks to grade it and give everyone a C. Has stated that only one or two students in each class will get an A. Makes you read hundreds of pages of her own consulting papers for no reason. Take anyone else.

reviews.comment: do not take
Changed grade distribution as of Fall 25. Insane amount of work graded hard and 8 weeks later. Talks down to you. Worst ever. Trust me don't take.

reviews.comment: Horrible Professor. Insane amount of work graded tough. It might seem like easy busy work until you get your grade back and it is horrific. Absolute waste of time class and a bad grade. I feel horrible daily due to this class. MAJOR regret taking Rodak. You will not get an A. Please trust me and take any other professor.
