reviews.comment: I personally thoroughly enjoyed this class with Dr. Z. You can tell from every class how well-informed he is on every topic covered. There are weekly reports due from readings that can be tedious as the readings they correspond with can be long and technical but he doesn't expect perfection, just take the time to do it. Would recommend him always!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The worst teacher I have ever had in my time here so far. Exams are 75% of grade and are excessively difficult for a level 100 class, he gives pop quizzes, and his lectures are extremely dry. He snaps if you as so much double check your phone for a moment, and is extremely strict in all areas. Difficult, extremely boring class. Do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Easily worst teacher I've had at IU. He knows what he's talking about but he makes the class unbearable. No talking allowed unless you're directing a question towards him, even if you're whispering to the person next to you he will call you out for being "disruptive". No laptops to take notes, and tests are unnecessarily hard for a 100 level class.

Mahnaz was one of the kindest professors I've ever had. She was flexible and truly understood her students' problems. The class was designed in a way that made it easy to follow. It was lab-based, and to complete the lab worksheets, we worked in groups with other students.
She was really good and energetic.
Mahnaz is a great teacher who makes learning interesting and engaging. Her passion for teaching really shows, and she always supports her students. I'm grateful to be in her class!"
She is very energetic, and I appreciate her attitude when it comes to explaining concepts in more detail.

I've never had a class that has had me leave angry every single class before having this teacher. Some of the worst instructional strategies I have ever seen in a teacher. Absolutely no effort on creating assignments that aren't middle school level, and gives very little time for lecturing and actually explaining things yet exams are very thorough

She's super nice and the exams are really easy. But class time is just not worth it and you dont learn much. She pretty much just asks like questions the whole class and barely lectures. Attendance is graded by participation AND a sign in sheet. Caring but the class has less material than most quizlets.

Interesting Name, W Prof , Nice Vibe, Could play better songs in start. Drop lowest participation grades plzz

Add a bit of extra credit or subjective grading. My friend got 89 make that 90 and help her get A- why drop our gpa for 1% when we are recruiting. 

Rest, all easy funny and chill. W Aura just received a warning once for talking too much.

Professor Zolboo is really sweet but this course is straight up booty cheeks. I can only recall like 2 or 3 things I learned in this class. It's very irrelevant and I don't know how this is gonna bread me up in the future.

Professor Zolboo's positivity and enthusiasm, especially during late class, made a big difference. I really appreciated the times she brought Asian snacks for us to try. I learned so much about the importance of cultural differences and doing macro-environmental PESTEL analysis.
It's meh. Hard to understand what to study for exams. Some group activities and in class activities are kinda not relevant.

Repetitive contents and meaningless paper activities. She's keep showing same slides and talking about similar stuffs over and over. Couldn't help thinking I'm wasting my time while I'm taking this course.
Every class was so boring. She tries stuffs but in the end I couldn't understand what we are learning at all. Course structure is very random too
Lame. I don't think she knows what she's teaching...

Caring and tried her best but her being new made the class difficult. She makes classes very discussion based and doesn't tell you if what students say are correct so hard to know what to study for tests. Has participation grades so have to talk in class which was hard for me since I didn't know much about business in Asia. Not easy to talk to.
We all know she is new, but all of her lectures were worth attending. Throughout the semester, I found her to be very caring and dedicated.

She is a new but a decent prof who cares about her students. Be sure to take notes during lectures becuase videos shown appear on the exams. However, I wish her handling of group projects was better. She was no help when we had a member who didn't contribute yet received the same grade. She has the potential to be a better prof but for now very mid

I am so grateful to have taken this class. Even though she is new, I feel like she works so hard in every single class. It's one of the best classes this semester, and it has made me rethink a lot about my future. I really admire her dedication how much effort she puts into preparing for each class, including funny videos. Thank you, Professor!

Grade makeup:  Participation 15% 2 exams each 20% group project 35% she is uncompromising (if someone doesn't pull their weight she tells you to deal with it). New having only taught 2 years. Cares for students. Her exams can be on videos watched in class PAY ATTENTION. Didn't like her as she did things in class that felt like a waste of time.

Professor Zlotin is one of the most genuinely kind and interested professors at IU. Yes lectures were long but usually he broke them up with some really interesting videos. His accent is not that hard to understand if you're paying attention.  We only had 1 test-style exam, the rest were take home essays, so not too difficult. One of my fave profs.

Zlotin's accent is very thick, so lectures will feel a little slow because he's difficult to understand. The tests are the majority of your grade, so be sure to study. They aren't as easy as you'd expect. DON'T buy or rent the textbook, all test answers come from his lecture notes, the VHS videos, and labs.

I'm quite surprised with all of the low ratings he has solely based on his accent. It's unfortunate, he's not that hard to understand. More importantly, his class is very easy going. I will say that if you don't like writing long papers, don't take this course. The midterm and final are 10+ page papers that are mandatory.
nice guy with accencent

Yeah he has an accent, but I have never found him hard to understand. He's very nice, his lectures are basically reading the notes from online, and watching old videos(vhs). Only annoying thing is he takes attendance everyday. just use class time to study or something. tests are multiple choice.

Very nice man, you can tell he really loves what he teaches. He is Russian so his accent his kinda thick, makes it difficult to pay attention to him but he is clearly understandable. Class is very basic but easy to get lost in in you dont listen.

I loved Professor Zlotin! The accent was difficult to overcome at first, but I had him in an Environmental Studies class first semester and got used to it then. I love hearing him say "water vapor!" :) His lectures are a bit dull but the tests were easy and the labs were good.

This class is insanely easy.  All he does is read off lecture notes (which are posted online). We also watched a lot of videos (made in the 80s!).  Basically, its a bunch of maptests and last minute studying.  There are midterm and final review sheets online.  I haven't opened the textbook once.

This class was okay. The tests are pretty easy because the lecture notes are very clear and he lets you know what will be on the test. Definitely need to study for them though. His lectures are pretty boring; he throws in a few jokes here and there.
He's nice but very hard to understand and  has very boring lectures.

Excellent professor-- very knowledgable, friendly, charming; apparently very well-liked by all the students in our class. I find it hard to reconcile the negative comments on this page with my experience of him-- he is not difficult to understand at all (maybe his English has improved very quickly?) and he's a very good teacher!
test are fairly easy which is based on the lecture note..one thing should try hard is lab coz it weighted 25% of your final grade...take advantage of it..
fairly easy class. exams are based of of the lecture notes which are online. zlotin is impossible to understand but just bring a cell phone with games,  laptop, or headphones and just tune him out.

Still pretty hard to understand, but the tests are easy if you study at all.  He grades really hard if you miss classes or tests, though--I was going to be graded down for this, but convinced him not to do so after a lot of discussion and proving that my alarm clock really had misfunctioned. Otherwise, his handouts are great--use them.
He was a good teacher and it was really nice that the lecture notes were given to us.  His accent is kind of difficult, but his class is easy.
His english is getting better and his class is easy.
No Comments

Thick accent is often tough to overcome, but all test questions are directly off his lecture notes that you can print out. Go to class, I was downgraded from an A+ to a A- for missing classes...you can sit there with headphones if you want.

His accent is thick, but he's really not too bad of a prof, considering research is his primary thing. He does like to show cheesy science videos, which are worth a good laugh. Get past the accent, you'll be fine, because his grading scale is awesome (86-100 is the A range).
No Comments
Great Professor. He has a thick accent, but it can be worked around.  Very smart. Take the class,  you'll be fine.
No Comments
Thick Russian accent.

Kurt Zorn is one of the worst teachers I've ever had. I had a family emergency and had to leave school with only 1 month left in the semester and he was the only teacher to give me a hard time about taking an incomplete. When I came back to school he was so incredibly unhelpful and is making me retake the class even though I had 5 ASSIGNMENTS LEFT!
It's a tough class to sit though because he is not inspiring or an interesting person to listen to. Don't have your phone out in class he will yell at you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Zorn is fairly stern in class but he really knows what he is talking about and loves to go on rants, which are pretty funny. Don't be afraid to ask questions. He has (really easy) pop quizzes at the end of class since he doesn't take attendance. Overall very helpful and knowledgeable. Course isn't too bad. Definitely would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: No Comments

Total jerk. Likes to think he's accessible and friendly and just being stern in class. Truth is- he's just inaccessible and unfriendly all the time. He also develops this group of tired frat boys who hang out in his office after class- all of whom score "A"s , while those who don't spend time kissing up outside of class don't get "pointers."
No Comments

Class is way harder than it needs to be. Zobel grades way to hard for an intro course. He's a bit arrogant/snobbish which is why he grades hard. Doesn't realize his class isn't everything. However, he is actually a nice guy, does want to interact and cares about students. Just needs a reality check on his course. Literally my only B in college.

Awful teacher. Makes stupid jokes about things no one understands from movies that are at least 100 years old. Biggest struggle is staying awake in class. He doesn't know how to teach he just expects us to know it all, even though we are in an intro class.

Although this class was way tougher than I imagined for an intro class, it was extremely interesting. Lots of films screened (although some very "strange" at first) he goes VERY in depth with the material. Can be very complex concepts to grasp but overall I felt as if I learned a lot. Just a little tough, take good notes! I
Awful. Thinks he is teaching a higher level class and treats students like they are dumb.

A wonderful human being. He was probably one of the coolest guys I will meet throughout my college career. Unfortunately, this comment will probably go unnoticed because he's moving on to bigger and better things. Good  luck in law school, man.

Zubey is so funny with his little math jokes and his commentaries during notes. He is very helpful and understanding. Go to his office hours, they are definitely worthwhile. You should try to be friends with him because Zubey is AMAZING! much love.. ABCB !

Very helpful, he honestly cares about whether or not you understand the material. He helps you as much as you need during office hours and will go out of his way to make sure you can meet with him! He is a great teacher, I highly recommend him!

Excellent Professor. Don't be fooled by the name, he's very American(no accent). follows the text very closely; lectures are very clear and not too fast; exams are not difficult; lots of office hours; very helpful
You have to go to class because she doesn't post anything online . Her tests are also all over the place
Amazing prof. So sweet and genuinely cares if you do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Zolan is a wonderful lecturer. She is very good at explaining the topics at hand and loves to encourage her students. I personally took her hybrid class which involved a fair amount of online work. It was a great fit for my learning style, but if you aren't very productive when you have to pace yourself, then you may not do so hot.

Mimi is just about the sweetest lady you could meet.  Visit during office hours!  I disliked  the "flipped classroom" setup.   hw is Mastering Biology + pre-discussion worksheets + question banks + 10+ pg notes that had to be printed, filled out and brought to class.   class format  is: a quiz, lecture & clicker Q, small group discussion with AI

Her class style is a bit "hand-holdy" as you have constant required homework, quizzes each week, and mandatory attendance (due to having the quizzes and learning group each week), but if you do the homework, attend each class, and do a small amount of preparation before each class (like going over the question bank), you should have an easy time.
Quiz every class, video guideline notes, question bank, and mastering biology due every week
Professor Zolan is fantastic. The way she explains the material and presents it makes it easy for anyone to understand it. I would take more classes with her.

Dr. Zolan was an inspiring, enthusiastic professor. Not only does she clearly know the material, but she also knows how to translate it to a large group of students with varying degrees of bio background. She's awesome.

Dr. Zolan is one of my favorite professors at IU, I wish I could take all my bio courses with her. She goes above and beyond the average professor to see her students succeed. Her lectures, notes, assignments, and quizzes are clear and organized. I took this class because it was hybrid (half online, 1 class a week) and I would recommend it.

Dr. Z is an above average teacher.  She cares so much about her students doing well that she provides an extensive amount of resources to students including free tutors. Her lectures are engaging. I took the hybrid course and would recommend it.

She is one of the nicest women ever.  She holds office hours every week, and if you go to those it's an easy A.  The tests are difficult because they are not just memorization type questions, you have to really think deeper.

Dr. Zolan is a great professor! She's such a nice lady too. However, this class doesn't come easy because you do have to work hard and attendance is mandatory (you get points and you have quizzes). She helped me learn a lot of stuff in bio I didn't understand before. Would take another class with her!

Super helpful, has an online chat session and helps with any question. Tests are semi difficult but we dropped our lowest test score in my particular class. I took the flipped classroom which requires a lot of independent study. Great class and teacher if you study hard.

She's super sweet and accommodating. She WANTS you to do well, you just have to come to her. She's willing to add office hours and she prints out extra worksheets and she's open to suggestions . The material can be confusing and she sometimes contradicts herself, but she's quick to clarify if you ask.

One of sweetest ladies ever! I enjoyed her lectures, but at points, they dragged on. Her notes format is very different, which takes a bit to used to. Her exam format includes a very large essay portion, which makes the exams fairly difficult. Overall, good professor. I wish I could have had her for a whole semester, but an illness stopped her.

Absolutely loved her.  She was the sweetest lady ever.  Only had her for half a semester because of an illness, but she explains things well.  Tests weren't too difficult, and she is a fan of "collaborative learning."  Definitely recommend.

Prof Zolan always did her best to get the material across as easily as she could. The class wasn't too terribly hard either. Clicker questions are nice, easy points. She had a good sense of humor and even let my friend lead our lecture in singing me happy birthday.

Prof. Zolan is one of the best professors at IU. Her lectures are engaging & I was never bored. I always looked forward to class. She has the ability to make difficult material easy. I truly learned while I was in lecture, I did not have to rely on the book. Exams are easy because she provides previous exams & possible questions. She is the best!!

Dr. Zolan is definitely the easier of professors teaching intro bio. Exam questions come straight from her notes, so the book is more of a supplementary resource. Dr. Zolan made her lectures interesting and really engaged the class. Small groups were not helpful, but the course was good overall. I learned a lot and had fun doing it.

You have to have Dr. Z for this class. She makes this class awesome by teaching applications of the concepts she talks about. If you're interested in medicine, this can be fascinating at times. Highly recommend this professor.

Dr. Zolan is a great professor!! She does a great job of answering your questions in a timely manner, and does not give difficult tests. If you attend lecture, it is easy to do extremely well in this class.

The material is easy and straight forward but it's worth saying that Professor Zolan does a great job. Attendance is pretty much mandatory due to clicker points and assigned online activities help students learn the material. Zolan is very approachable. If you just DO the work you will learn the material no problem and walk away with an A.
Professor Zolan is a phenomenal teacher. 112 is a hard class, there is no doubt about that. However, she presents the material clearly and grades fairly. Work hard and you will get a good grade

Becomes really engaged in teaching,you can tell she loves what she does.Class was very hard for me though.She also has cards where she will call on people to answer quiz ?'s,but if you don't want to answer you can send her an email.I did & she called on me anyway.She apologized,but for all her preparedness you'd think it wouldn't happen.

Professor Zolan not only presents the material very clearly, but is also very concerned about her students' grades. There are several chances to get extra points in class. Moreover, much material is taught during this course in a way that promises future retention.

This class is so easy it borders on condescending. Attendance is taken randomly, discussion sections are mandatory, and you must attend several "movie nights" throughout the semester. This is all a ploy to pad your grade with extra points, which is good for slacker students but is annoying for anyone with half a brain.

Dr. Zolan was extremely organized and posted outlines and weekly summaries on oncourse prior to each class. Her lectures were thorough, easy to follow and comprehend, and engaging. She used many live examples to illustrate points. She prepares you as best as possible for the exams and as long as you do what she has assigned you will succeed.
Dr. Zolan is great.  She works hard to make things clear.  Work outside of the classroom is vital, because her exams can be tricky.  She enjoys "puzzles" so be ready to use that brain!
She was an excellent teacher.  Very helpful outside of class and her lectures were always easy to follow.
